value.title: Windshield broke early and replacement glass was unavailable
value.summary: A G60 owner in the USA reported that the windshield broke about 10 days after purchase and replacement glass was unavailable for more than two months. The owner also described substantial rental costs and frustration with BMW corporate's response.
highlights: Windshield broke about 10 days after purchase; replacement glass was unavailable for more than two months.
One reported case: a USA G60 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 owner reported that the windshield broke about 10 days after purchase, and replacement glass was unavailable for more than two months. [signal:5ace8b75-aaf3-460c-96e3-ef6fc6c76820]

## What customers say
The owner said the delay led to thousands of dollars in rental-car costs and described feeling that BMW corporate did not care. [signal:5ace8b75-aaf3-460c-96e3-ef6fc6c76820] The owner said the local dealership tried hard to help. [signal:5ace8b75-aaf3-460c-96e3-ef6fc6c76820]

## Differences between markets
The signal is from the USA; no other market is represented. [signal:5ace8b75-aaf3-460c-96e3-ef6fc6c76820]

## Open questions
The cause of the breakage and the reasons for the replacement-glass delay are not established by this signal. [signal:5ace8b75-aaf3-460c-96e3-ef6fc6c76820]

value.title: Remote control responds slowly
value.summary: A driver in Rest of World reports that the remote control is slow to react, making vehicle interactions feel insufficiently responsive.
highlights: Remote control response is perceived as slow.
One signal concerns a Rest of World F70 driver.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A driver reports that the remote control is slow to react. [signal:7ef52fe1-1143-40dd-9368-6dc87f8f8b64]

## What customers say
The driver says the remote control reacts slowly and also describes door locking and automatic braking as seeming to respond poorly. [signal:7ef52fe1-1143-40dd-9368-6dc87f8f8b64]

## Differences between markets
The available signal is from Rest of World and concerns an F70; there is no other market signal for comparison. [signal:7ef52fe1-1143-40dd-9368-6dc87f8f8b64]

## Open questions
How frequent is the slow remote response, and under what conditions does it occur?

value.title: Remote interior camera use is unclear
value.summary: Customers in the USA report difficulty using the Remote Interior camera: one cannot access the view because of Data Privacy settings, while another asked how to use it.
highlights: Customers report access and how-to difficulties with the Remote Interior camera.
Signals are from USA G70 and G60 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report difficulty accessing or understanding how to use the Remote Interior camera in the My BMW App. [signal:773bd6e4-2ba6-4278-a8b8-a17e49c4e16a] [signal:d14f09f6-42fa-4e5c-9f16-073a969ff21f]

## What customers say
A G70 customer said the app blocked the remote camera view because of Data Privacy settings. [signal:773bd6e4-2ba6-4278-a8b8-a17e49c4e16a] A G60 customer asked how to use the camera; the response explained that it can take interior photos that are then viewable in the My BMW App. [signal:d14f09f6-42fa-4e5c-9f16-073a969ff21f]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA, and they describe different usability issues: camera access in the G70 and understanding how to use the feature in the G60. [signal:773bd6e4-2ba6-4278-a8b8-a17e49c4e16a] [signal:d14f09f6-42fa-4e5c-9f16-073a969ff21f]

## Open questions
Do customers understand how Data Privacy settings affect camera access? [signal:773bd6e4-2ba6-4278-a8b8-a17e49c4e16a]
Do customers know how to capture and find interior photos in the app? [signal:d14f09f6-42fa-4e5c-9f16-073a969ff21f]

value.title: Remote live view from interior cameras is wanted
value.summary: Two G70 customers in the USA want live remote video from the interior cameras in the My BMW App. A G60 customer says they enjoy the internal camera.
highlights: Two customers want live remote interior-camera video.
Signals are from two USA G70 customers and one USA G60 customer.
One customer says Tesla already offers this capability.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Two G70 customers in the USA want to view live video remotely from the interior cameras in the My BMW App. [signal:01cbb6c3-cd87-4fd4-9a28-bf06c8d3e105] [signal:26ddd2eb-322f-4e0e-bb1e-a86dfb06cbab]

## What customers say
One customer asks for a live view from the remote cameras, and another specifically wants remote video in the My BMW App. [signal:01cbb6c3-cd87-4fd4-9a28-bf06c8d3e105] [signal:26ddd2eb-322f-4e0e-bb1e-a86dfb06cbab] A G60 customer says they enjoy the internal camera. [signal:172755df-8002-493e-9813-02fffc4fad88]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA: two G70 customers request live remote video, while one G60 customer expresses enjoyment of the internal camera. [signal:01cbb6c3-cd87-4fd4-9a28-bf06c8d3e105] [signal:26ddd2eb-322f-4e0e-bb1e-a86dfb06cbab] [signal:172755df-8002-493e-9813-02fffc4fad88]

## Open questions
- Do customers beyond the two G70 signal authors want live remote video from the interior cameras? [signal:01cbb6c3-cd87-4fd4-9a28-bf06c8d3e105] [signal:26ddd2eb-322f-4e0e-bb1e-a86dfb06cbab]
- One customer says Tesla already provides the capability; no further competitor details are given. [signal:26ddd2eb-322f-4e0e-bb1e-a86dfb06cbab]

value.title: Windshield chips, scratches, and replacement-glass access concerns
value.summary: Some USA customers report a windshield that chips easily, arrived scratched, or is difficult to source for replacement. Another customer values the larger windshield on the G60 compared with an earlier 5 Series.
highlights: Reports include easy chipping, scratches at delivery, and difficulty locating replacement glass.
Four USA signals cover the G60 and G70; one G60 customer likes the larger windshield.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the windshield chips from small rocks, and one G70 customer described a rock strike that cracked the glass. [signal:433e02c2-020b-4fc7-91c7-afe435d6e042] [signal:7fe53cbe-f163-4e86-b159-8f63450eab7d]
A G70 customer said the windshield had scratches when the vehicle was received and that the dealership would not cover the damage. [signal:ead2b851-4486-407b-96b7-787c83b8f3cf]
The G70 customer with a cracked windshield said their insurer was having trouble locating the correct replacement glass. [signal:7fe53cbe-f163-4e86-b159-8f63450eab7d]

## What customers say
A G60 customer would prefer a tougher windshield because small rocks seem to chip it easily. [signal:433e02c2-020b-4fc7-91c7-afe435d6e042]
A G60 customer likes that the windshield seems larger than the one in their earlier 5 Series. [signal:a2220db0-a34a-4a8a-9aa9-d064567db2d5]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA and concern the G60 or G70. [signal:433e02c2-020b-4fc7-91c7-afe435d6e042] [signal:7fe53cbe-f163-4e86-b159-8f63450eab7d] [signal:ead2b851-4486-407b-96b7-787c83b8f3cf] [signal:a2220db0-a34a-4a8a-9aa9-d064567db2d5]
The feedback is mixed: customers report damage and replacement-glass sourcing concerns, while one G60 customer likes the larger windshield. [signal:433e02c2-020b-4fc7-91c7-afe435d6e042] [signal:7fe53cbe-f163-4e86-b159-8f63450eab7d] [signal:ead2b851-4486-407b-96b7-787c83b8f3cf] [signal:a2220db0-a34a-4a8a-9aa9-d064567db2d5]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common windshield damage or replacement-glass sourcing issues are beyond these reports. [signal:433e02c2-020b-4fc7-91c7-afe435d6e042] [signal:7fe53cbe-f163-4e86-b159-8f63450eab7d] [signal:ead2b851-4486-407b-96b7-787c83b8f3cf]
The G70 customer with delivery scratches planned to take the vehicle in, but the signal does not report the outcome. [signal:ead2b851-4486-407b-96b7-787c83b8f3cf]

value.title: Android Auto media takes over radio and support feels weaker
value.summary: Some G60 owners report weaker Android support than iPhone and say Android Auto switches the radio to its own media, while other G60 and G70 owners value the feature’s ease of use and connection.
highlights: Android support feels weaker to one owner, and Android Auto media takes over the radio for another.
Signals cover G60 owners in the USA and Rest of World, and G70 owners in the USA.
One signal compares Android support unfavourably with iPhone.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One G60 owner says Android support feels weaker than iPhone support, while acknowledging they have not fully figured everything out [signal:99188df9-f126-408e-871b-557bd75645a3]. Another G60 owner says Android Auto automatically takes over radio media on connection, and returning to the built-in radio takes three clicks [signal:4ecff86f-068f-4880-9929-bd7b65d02175].

## What customers say
Feedback is mixed: some G60 and G70 owners in the USA say they like Android Auto, find it connects effortlessly, or appreciate automatic connection [signal:13aa3026-9e26-43d4-afed-dc6dbc9a499b] [signal:1b9498b4-2074-4ffd-8892-7e952becd4f7] [signal:42466f12-2772-493d-a4db-a0e3f1895db7] [signal:495b662b-e7e4-4735-9b58-2120c8f61356]. The radio-media complaint comes from a G60 owner in the USA [signal:4ecff86f-068f-4880-9929-bd7b65d02175].

## Differences between markets
In the Rest of World, one G60 owner feels Android support is weaker than iPhone support [signal:99188df9-f126-408e-871b-557bd75645a3]. In the USA, G60 feedback includes both a complaint about media switching and positive comments about Android Auto, while G70 owners report easy or automatic connection [signal:4ecff86f-068f-4880-9929-bd7b65d02175] [signal:13aa3026-9e26-43d4-afed-dc6dbc9a499b] [signal:1b9498b4-2074-4ffd-8892-7e952becd4f7] [signal:42466f12-2772-493d-a4db-a0e3f1895db7] [signal:495b662b-e7e4-4735-9b58-2120c8f61356].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the radio-media switching or weaker-support concerns are [signal:4ecff86f-068f-4880-9929-bd7b65d02175] [signal:99188df9-f126-408e-871b-557bd75645a3].

value.title: No running board to ease entry and protect the sill
value.summary: A customer in the USA with a G60 would like a running board to make getting in and out easier and help prevent shoe scuffs on the door sill.
highlights: A customer wants a running board for easier entry and less door-sill scuffing.
One signal: a USA customer with a G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer would like a running board to help with getting in and out and to reduce shoe scuffs on the door sill plate. [signal:28ad8dd3-eb4a-41a5-8ced-fd08c892ca4a]

## What customers say
The customer says the door sill plate scratches easily from shoes and that she has put something over the area herself to prevent scuffing. [signal:28ad8dd3-eb4a-41a5-8ced-fd08c892ca4a]

## Differences between markets
The signal is from the USA and concerns a G60; no other markets or vehicles are represented. [signal:28ad8dd3-eb4a-41a5-8ced-fd08c892ca4a]

## Open questions
The signal does not address how common this need is among other customers. [signal:28ad8dd3-eb4a-41a5-8ced-fd08c892ca4a]

value.title: Remote app services are confusing and sometimes unreliable
value.summary: Customers report confusing app navigation, intermittent vehicle communication, and inaccurate or unavailable remote-service information. The signals are from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: App tasks can be hard to navigate, and connectivity and vehicle-status information can be unreliable.
USA signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles, with three reports for each line.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the My BMW app as awkward to use and report difficulty with delayed charging, sending destinations to vehicle navigation, and accessing location services. [signal:086dd2b1-18e0-413a-9d61-1ec95826e6e6] [signal:3f155ec8-d8a1-4357-bfb5-6abb2a2093bd] [signal:ae1a4667-f5e7-47bc-8043-66609596e17c] [signal:ba250ed2-b7bd-4451-9c70-bd65de3fb180]
Customers also report intermittent communication with the vehicle and a door-open warning that appeared despite the doors being closed. [signal:086dd2b1-18e0-413a-9d61-1ec95826e6e6] [signal:67184925-0284-4930-9e62-84c790de45de]
One customer asked whether the vehicle could be turned off remotely if taken without permission; they were told it could not be turned off once drive-ready. [signal:58840852-fa8f-41f5-83f8-6cd39097903b]

## What customers say
A customer who described themself as not very tech oriented needed help selecting a vehicle and sending a destination from the app to navigation. [signal:3f155ec8-d8a1-4357-bfb5-6abb2a2093bd]
A customer encountered an app communication error while trying to set delayed charging, and another described intermittent mobile-phone connection issues. [signal:086dd2b1-18e0-413a-9d61-1ec95826e6e6] [signal:ba250ed2-b7bd-4451-9c70-bd65de3fb180]
A customer reported that the vehicle did not appear in location services, while another reported a door-open warning that eventually cleared by itself. [signal:ae1a4667-f5e7-47bc-8043-66609596e17c] [signal:67184925-0284-4930-9e62-84c790de45de]

## Differences between markets
All six supplied signals are from the USA: three concern G60 vehicles and three concern G70 vehicles. [signal:086dd2b1-18e0-413a-9d61-1ec95826e6e6] [signal:3f155ec8-d8a1-4357-bfb5-6abb2a2093bd] [signal:ba250ed2-b7bd-4451-9c70-bd65de3fb180] [signal:58840852-fa8f-41f5-83f8-6cd39097903b] [signal:67184925-0284-4930-9e62-84c790de45de] [signal:ae1a4667-f5e7-47bc-8043-66609596e17c]

## Open questions
Do app navigation and usability issues occur beyond the reported destination-sharing task? [signal:3f155ec8-d8a1-4357-bfb5-6abb2a2093bd]
How often do vehicle communication failures and inaccurate or missing status information occur? [signal:086dd2b1-18e0-413a-9d61-1ec95826e6e6] [signal:67184925-0284-4930-9e62-84c790de45de] [signal:ae1a4667-f5e7-47bc-8043-66609596e17c]

value.title: Remote app controls miss desired functions
value.summary: Some US BMW owners want more control over navigation destinations, climate settings and window closing through the app. A European F70 owner, by contrast, describes the My BMW app as excellent.
highlights: US owners report missing or limited remote app functions.
Signals include US G60 and G70 owners and a positive European F70 owner.
Customers compare remote features with a Lincoln and address sending with a Mercedes.
value.body_md:
## Problem
US customers describe gaps in remote app functions: they want to send an address directly to the vehicle, set the interior temperature, start climate control at maximum, and close the windows. [signal:0461956c-2312-4013-8efb-c0013777a8d4] [signal:5432061d-1efd-4792-bd7e-26a596badc42] [signal:bb1aa15e-5080-4e6a-a3b4-204fee4f79dd] [signal:f45b0a7f-ae5a-4230-9a7b-4b21afc3b2c4]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says addresses can be sent to their BMW profile, but wants to send one directly to the vehicle’s navigation screen; the owner reports being able to send an address to a son’s Mercedes without signing into their own profile there. [signal:0461956c-2312-4013-8efb-c0013777a8d4]

Another G60 owner wants improved remote features comparable to those on a prior Lincoln MKZ. [signal:5252c717-f0c0-48a1-85f1-4ad8d463d205]

One G60 owner says the app does not offer a direct way to make climate control start at maximum, and that the vehicle still feels hot on entry. [signal:5432061d-1efd-4792-bd7e-26a596badc42] G70 owners ask for app-based window closing and the ability to set the desired cabin temperature. [signal:bb1aa15e-5080-4e6a-a3b4-204fee4f79dd] [signal:f45b0a7f-ae5a-4230-9a7b-4b21afc3b2c4]

## Differences between markets
The US signals include requests for additional remote app controls from G60 and G70 owners. [signal:0461956c-2312-4013-8efb-c0013777a8d4] [signal:5432061d-1efd-4792-bd7e-26a596badc42] [signal:bb1aa15e-5080-4e6a-a3b4-204fee4f79dd] [signal:f45b0a7f-ae5a-4230-9a7b-4b21afc3b2c4] A European F70 owner calls the My BMW app excellent. [signal:3324c231-bbed-4043-a1ff-1451a4f4b010] The signals therefore show both requests for more functionality and a positive app assessment; they do not establish how widespread either view is.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these requests are beyond the reported customers, or whether the requested functions are available in other markets or vehicle lines. [signal:0461956c-2312-4013-8efb-c0013777a8d4] [signal:5432061d-1efd-4792-bd7e-26a596badc42] [signal:bb1aa15e-5080-4e6a-a3b4-204fee4f79dd] [signal:f45b0a7f-ae5a-4230-9a7b-4b21afc3b2c4]

value.title: Stability and traction praised in bad weather
value.summary: Two USA G60 customers value the car’s stability and report satisfactory traction in bad weather. One has not experienced truly severe conditions.
highlights: Customers praise stability and report fine traction in bad weather.
Signals are from two USA customers with G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers value the car’s stability and traction, though the available feedback does not establish performance in truly severe conditions. [signal:2cfa51da-64b7-491b-a5a2-4d433ef1b4e5] [signal:73a8e501-d157-4220-82d2-168b68e32d16]

## What customers say
One customer describes the car’s stability as spectacular. [signal:2cfa51da-64b7-491b-a5a2-4d433ef1b4e5] Another says traction has been fine in bad weather, but notes they have not encountered truly severe conditions. [signal:73a8e501-d157-4220-82d2-168b68e32d16]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from USA customers with G60 vehicles; no other markets or vehicle lines are represented. [signal:2cfa51da-64b7-491b-a5a2-4d433ef1b4e5] [signal:73a8e501-d157-4220-82d2-168b68e32d16]

## Open questions
The signals do not show how the car performs in truly severe weather conditions. [signal:73a8e501-d157-4220-82d2-168b68e32d16]

value.title: Remote app services fail or respond inconsistently
value.summary: Customers report failed, delayed, or unavailable remote services through the My BMW App, including repeated first-attempt failures and missing vehicle status updates. Signals come from USA G60 and G70 owners and Europe F70 owners.
highlights: Remote commands and services can fail, respond slowly, or work only after a retry.
Signals include 6 USA reports across G60 and G70, and 2 Europe reports for F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that remote commands and services through the My BMW App do not work reliably: some fail or time out, while others work only after a retry. [signal:43b5e86a-52a0-44b0-a573-69261215cc2b] [signal:4d2f659d-12f7-4fda-9b88-669b383465ca] [signal:8eb15442-3749-4b66-bbd1-7402213f17e1]

Reported symptoms also include slow app-to-car communication, unavailable vehicle status, and remote features that do not always function. [signal:527748de-e3f3-401e-b058-b3a7d930d58b] [signal:88f94c45-da41-4674-a712-03163e2a5114] [signal:b982ba18-0a8c-4a7c-adcb-a0a45d171a4f]

## What customers say
A G70 owner said remote commands failed roughly weekly, showed error messages, and did not update vehicle status in the app; resetting iDrive helped temporarily. [signal:43b5e86a-52a0-44b0-a573-69261215cc2b]

G60 owners described remote-service errors that cleared on a second attempt, remote start that failed on the first attempt, and remote climate or camera features that did not always work properly. [signal:4d2f659d-12f7-4fda-9b88-669b383465ca] [signal:8eb15442-3749-4b66-bbd1-7402213f17e1] [signal:527748de-e3f3-401e-b058-b3a7d930d58b]

One G70 owner said the app did not show the complete list of remote services until the app was reinstalled; an attempted automatic-door command stopped partway and the app showed no connection. [signal:b982ba18-0a8c-4a7c-adcb-a0a45d171a4f]

F70 owners in Europe reported that Remote Drive would not work with a phone they described as having a sufficiently new Android version, and separately described My BMW App problems including the My Trips function stopping. [signal:afeda260-3a2e-4487-9746-cf34e5659c5f] [signal:e8b38a4f-a6a4-44b0-a223-fcd256fc14d3]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA reports concern G60 and G70 vehicles and include failed or inconsistent remote commands, remote start, remote climate, remote camera, app connection, and service-list availability. [signal:43b5e86a-52a0-44b0-a573-69261215cc2b] [signal:4d2f659d-12f7-4fda-9b88-669b383465ca] [signal:527748de-e3f3-401e-b058-b3a7d930d58b] [signal:88f94c45-da41-4674-a712-03163e2a5114] [signal:8eb15442-3749-4b66-bbd1-7402213f17e1] [signal:b982ba18-0a8c-4a7c-adcb-a0a45d171a4f]

The supplied Europe reports concern F70 vehicles and describe Remote Drive phone compatibility and other app or software problems. [signal:afeda260-3a2e-4487-9746-cf34e5659c5f] [signal:e8b38a4f-a6a4-44b0-a223-fcd256fc14d3]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported failures share a cause across vehicle lines, services, or markets. [signal:43b5e86a-52a0-44b0-a573-69261215cc2b] [signal:4d2f659d-12f7-4fda-9b88-669b383465ca] [signal:afeda260-3a2e-4487-9746-cf34e5659c5f]

The available reports do not clarify how often each service fails across the wider customer population. [signal:527748de-e3f3-401e-b058-b3a7d930d58b] [signal:8eb15442-3749-4b66-bbd1-7402213f17e1]

value.title: Android Auto connections and functions are unreliable
value.summary: Customers report Android Auto disconnecting or failing to connect, as well as playback and track-control problems. Signals cover F70, G60, and G70 vehicles in Europe, Rest of World, and the USA.
highlights: Android Auto connections drop or fail, with some reports of playback and track-control faults.
11 signals span Europe, Rest of World, and the USA; vehicles include F70, G60, and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report intermittent or repeated Android Auto connection failures, including wireless dropouts and the need to reconnect or reset the pairing. [signal:27bff556-891e-4927-884e-e7687eab051d] [signal:2c5f8967-3fd0-46e4-8b87-03ec7f3afcbc] [signal:3d317036-c103-4d92-8d8b-ef38ea555602] Other reported issues include music not playing correctly when navigation starts and track-skip buttons failing while Android Auto is in use. [signal:3ec24116-510b-4d9d-84c3-24b84f273f9c] [signal:8e5a4f6b-2b5f-4d51-b0cc-94b2c2032e34]

## What customers say
One customer says Android Auto drops and reconnects repeatedly over wireless; another says the connection only works reliably after unpairing and pairing again. [signal:2c5f8967-3fd0-46e4-8b87-03ec7f3afcbc] [signal:3d317036-c103-4d92-8d8b-ef38ea555602] A G60 owner describes recurring music playback problems when starting Tmap or other navigation apps. [signal:3ec24116-510b-4d9d-84c3-24b84f273f9c] A G70 owner reports that console and steering-wheel skip buttons sometimes fail while Android Auto is connected and Spotify is playing. [signal:8e5a4f6b-2b5f-4d51-b0cc-94b2c2032e34] Another customer reports repeated connectivity issues with a phone running the newest operating system. [signal:93cee030-e790-43ad-b308-81ca6016c23a]

## Differences between markets
The 11 signals span Europe, Rest of World, and the USA, and include F70, G60, and G70 vehicles. [signal:1d19ac71-2d38-4984-8dc1-982e72202c92] [signal:27bff556-891e-4927-884e-e7687eab051d] [signal:3d317036-c103-4d92-8d8b-ef38ea555602] [signal:2c5f8967-3fd0-46e4-8b87-03ec7f3afcbc] [signal:3ec24116-510b-4d9d-84c3-24b84f273f9c] [signal:8e5a4f6b-2b5f-4d51-b0cc-94b2c2032e34] [signal:93cee030-e790-43ad-b308-81ca6016c23a] [signal:a82fbee7-48df-42e3-8a27-ffaccd5df816] [signal:1d01dde7-62e2-475a-affe-10d60404527e] [signal:49bffe8a-db44-41e9-861b-85b2148e4726] [signal:533dcad5-bc29-4491-9d73-cefa0f992cbd] The reported symptoms vary across the signals, from connection loss and repeated resets to playback and skip-button faults. value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report varied glass concerns: a delivery-time windshield chip, an internal rear-window crack, a crack after an object struck the windshield, and blemishes or distortion in other glass. ## What customers say
A USA G70 customer said the vehicle arrived with a chipped windshield and reported waiting more than a month for its surrounding molding. [signal:0cfc3c90-9ca6-4561-aea0-7e1a8da6b8bf]

A USA G70 customer reported an internal crack in the rear window about a week after purchase and was waiting for parts. [signal:a885623e-2a26-406e-877e-f9a903460189]

A USA G60 customer attributed a windshield crack to an object thrown from a four-wheeler, but questioned whether the glass met the expected standard after a repair attempt. [signal:426a3267-a1d5-4dd5-84bd-494c782b3aa8]

Other reports describe a blemish on a G70 door window and a blemished appearance in a G60 rear window. [signal:224bbf65-7888-450c-926f-e914345c406d] [signal:340a8126-6e26-4fcb-9770-8b46a0b9b277]

A Europe F70 owner said a sheen appears on the windscreen with each wiper pass after ceramic coating, despite cleaning the blades and glass. [signal:68f787e1-b899-410f-90dd-3b38966bfe7d]

## Differences between markets

## Open questions

value.title: Android Auto setup and use feel unreliable or limited
value.summary: Customers report awkward or unreliable setup, unwanted auto-launch, missing contacts, connection and audio glitches, and limited functionality. Signals come from F70, G60, and G70 owners across Rest of World, the USA, and Europe.
highlights: Android Auto is described as awkward, difficult to set up, unreliable, or limited.
Nine signals span Rest of World, the USA, and Europe, across F70, G60, and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe Android Auto as awkward to use, difficult to set up, or unreliable across two F70 reports [signal:38b51ec6-8881-4984-8462-cc3cc57a61e8] [signal:3a6eb663-3b07-496f-a35d-13bf5066abf5]. Other reports mention unwanted automatic playback or launch [signal:43e4911b-6efe-4fd7-9af7-d3548b58a301] [signal:4daa8aae-6aa1-4a21-a485-61f52bbbc823], a bare-feeling experience [signal:a6d1e9b3-7862-421f-9333-d09fac1c0c1c], and poor performance [signal:b673f509-1558-4af7-b7a5-57a074c3e1d9].

## What customers say
One F70 owner says Android Auto was tricky and unreliable with both a new and an older Samsung phone, though it seemed more stable later [signal:3a6eb663-3b07-496f-a35d-13bf5066abf5]. A G70 owner reports that Audible started automatically instead of the selected radio source; turning off the Android Auto auto-play setting resolved it [signal:43e4911b-6efe-4fd7-9af7-d3548b58a301]. Another G70 owner did not want Android Auto to launch by default and was given instructions to disable it [signal:4daa8aae-6aa1-4a21-a485-61f52bbbc823].

A G70 owner reports intermittent cellular loss and music glitches while using Spotify and YouTube with an Android phone, and says playback continued after disconnecting the phone from the vehicle system [signal:ac36749b-1336-4317-9a21-be785fee1e07]. Another G70 owner could make calls but could not get phone contacts to appear in Android Auto [signal:c8843673-f37a-417c-970a-52df1e63284d]. A G60 owner says iDrive works poorly with Android Auto [signal:b673f509-1558-4af7-b7a5-57a074c3e1d9].

## Differences between markets
The nine signals cover Rest of World (three reports), the USA (five), and Europe (one), across F70, G60, and G70 [signal:38b51ec6-8881-4984-8462-cc3cc57a61e8] [signal:3a6eb663-3b07-496f-a35d-13bf5066abf5] [signal:43e4911b-6efe-4fd7-9af7-d3548b58a301] [signal:4daa8aae-6aa1-4a21-a485-61f52bbbc823] [signal:a6d1e9b3-7862-421f-9333-d09fac1c0c1c] [signal:ac36749b-1336-4317-9a21-be785fee1e07] [signal:ac64326e-75c6-4c9c-a830-be54eb9a6e9d] [signal:b673f509-1558-4af7-b7a5-57a074c3e1d9] [signal:c8843673-f37a-417c-970a-52df1e63284d]. The Rest of World reports concern F70 setup and usability, including a repeated report of the same setup concern [signal:38b51ec6-8881-4984-8462-cc3cc57a61e8] [signal:3a6eb663-3b07-496f-a35d-13bf5066abf5] [signal:ac64326e-75c6-4c9c-a830-be54eb9a6e9d]. USA reports cover G60 and G70, including default launch, playback, contacts, and performance concerns [signal:43e4911b-6efe-4fd7-9af7-d3548b58a301] [signal:4daa8aae-6aa1-4a21-a485-61f52bbbc823] [signal:ac36749b-1336-4317-9a21-be785fee1e07] [signal:b673f509-1558-4af7-b7a5-57a074c3e1d9] [signal:c8843673-f37a-417c-970a-52df1e63284d]. The single Europe report describes Android Auto as bare [signal:a6d1e9b3-7862-421f-9333-d09fac1c0c1c].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported connection and audio glitches share a cause, or how often they occur [signal:ac36749b-1336-4317-9a21-be785fee1e07]. One customer had not tested whether the issue also occurred with Sirius XM [signal:ac36749b-1336-4317-9a21-be785fee1e07]. The signals do not clarify which Android Auto functions customers consider missing when they describe it as bare [signal:a6d1e9b3-7862-421f-9333-d09fac1c0c1c].

value.title: Battery control lacks driving-charge and reserve options for some owners
value.summary: Some USA G60 and G70 owners want more control over battery charging or battery use while driving. Other signals value the battery’s range, charging, or boost, while one Europe G60 owner describes its range as limited but reasonable for everyday driving.
highlights: Some owners want to charge the battery while driving or reserve capacity for later.
USA G60 and G70 owners raise control wishes; positive battery feedback also appears in Europe and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some USA G60 owners say current programming does not let them hold back battery capacity for later while using some during a trip, or ask for battery control that charges the HV battery while driving. [signal:2ec314e2-a62e-4bbb-9898-c08a2da189d2] [signal:ad5beb51-81cf-44d8-8dba-51f896e1d108]
A USA G70 owner also wishes for a software option to recharge the battery while driving. [signal:965ef94a-57ba-40ad-988e-ca37b32a0ad4]

## What customers say
One USA G60 owner values local electric trips alongside the engine for longer journeys, but asks for battery control that can charge the HV battery while driving. [signal:ad5beb51-81cf-44d8-8dba-51f896e1d108]
A different USA G60 owner wants to preserve some battery for later on long drives while still using battery power for boost. [signal:2ec314e2-a62e-4bbb-9898-c08a2da189d2]
Positive feedback includes a Rest of World G60 owner who says the larger battery gives noticeably longer real-world range, and a USA G60 owner who describes charging as satisfactory. [signal:20fc9c55-a5eb-4e82-bae6-4483247bfa1f] [signal:2add37ad-29db-4017-b148-a0c4e608b4ac]
A Europe F70 owner values the boost from the 48 battery, while a Europe G60 owner calls the battery range limited but reasonable for everyday driving. [signal:36f40345-3dfc-42a4-b5f8-ce944ce8ffa0] [signal:f3702b66-46db-4cf7-b0ed-f54c5baa47bc]

## Differences between markets
The requests for charging while driving or controlling battery use come from USA G60 and G70 signals. [signal:2ec314e2-a62e-4bbb-9898-c08a2da189d2] [signal:965ef94a-57ba-40ad-988e-ca37b32a0ad4] [signal:ad5beb51-81cf-44d8-8dba-51f896e1d108]
Battery feedback in the Europe signals is mixed in emphasis: the F70 owner praises battery boost, while the G60 owner describes range as limited but adequate for everyday use. [signal:36f40345-3dfc-42a4-b5f8-ce944ce8ffa0] [signal:f3702b66-46db-4cf7-b0ed-f54c5baa47bc]
The Rest of World G60 signal praises the battery’s larger capacity and longer real-world range. [signal:20fc9c55-a5eb-4e82-bae6-4483247bfa1f]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the requests for charging while driving or battery reservation are beyond the owners quoted. [signal:2ec314e2-a62e-4bbb-9898-c08a2da189d2] [signal:965ef94a-57ba-40ad-988e-ca37b32a0ad4] [signal:ad5beb51-81cf-44d8-8dba-51f896e1d108]
A USA G70 owner asks whether new high-voltage battery technology might be used in hybrid models; the signal says no confirmation was available to the customer. [signal:ddf1d810-1e95-4d58-89d6-2bc04b8b68fe]

value.title: Horn activation is difficult and the sound is poorly judged
value.summary: USA customers report that the horn can require a firm press in the center, while others dislike its sound or find it too loud and prolonged. Signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report difficult activation, an out-of-place sound, and a beep that is too loud or long.
All five signals are from the USA: two concern G60 vehicles and three concern G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the horn as difficult to activate, with one report saying it requires a firm press in the center rather than a light press at the side [signal:cde2be3f-d72e-4e24-aebe-eb0d94eb27db]. Other customers criticize the sound as out of place or poor, and one says the horn is too loud and lasts too long [signal:54b85a1d-417b-40c3-aaa6-e29721e0c576] [signal:5f631ad8-81f2-463a-8ae7-79b170d8c951] [signal:ae7b3f32-18a8-4bc2-9989-74518c178196].

## What customers say
One G70 customer says the horn cannot be lightly pressed at the side and must be pushed firmly in the center to activate [signal:cde2be3f-d72e-4e24-aebe-eb0d94eb27db]. G60 customers describe the tone as not matching the car’s luxury and quality, and compare it to one from a Pinto [signal:54b85a1d-417b-40c3-aaa6-e29721e0c576] [signal:1633de25-8ad6-4e08-8f04-2c6716ccc67d]. A G70 customer says the sound system speakers perform badly [signal:5f631ad8-81f2-463a-8ae7-79b170d8c951]. Another G70 customer wants a softer, brief beep, describing the current horn as too loud and long [signal:ae7b3f32-18a8-4bc2-9989-74518c178196].

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA, so the signals provide no comparison between markets. [signal:54b85a1d-417b-40c3-aaa6-e29721e0c576] [signal:5f631ad8-81f2-463a-8ae7-79b170d8c951] [signal:cde2be3f-d72e-4e24-aebe-eb0d94eb27db] [signal:1633de25-8ad6-4e08-8f04-2c6716ccc67d] [signal:ae7b3f32-18a8-4bc2-9989-74518c178196].

## Open questions
Do the reported activation difficulty and sound concerns occur beyond the individual G60 and G70 reports in these signals? [signal:cde2be3f-d72e-4e24-aebe-eb0d94eb27db] [signal:54b85a1d-417b-40c3-aaa6-e29721e0c576] [signal:5f631ad8-81f2-463a-8ae7-79b170d8c951] [signal:1633de25-8ad6-4e08-8f04-2c6716ccc67d] [signal:ae7b3f32-18a8-4bc2-9989-74518c178196].

value.title: Battery warnings, charging problems and high-voltage faults
value.summary: Customers report battery maintenance warnings, unsatisfactory range or charging, and high-voltage battery-related faults. Signals come from USA G60 and G70 owners and Europe F70 owners.
highlights: Reports include battery warnings, charging and range concerns, and battery-related faults.
Signals mention USA G60 and G70, and Europe F70; the supplied sample contains no complete case counts.
One G60 owner finds charging more complicated than with a Tesla; another compares a battery repair unfavourably with Mercedes.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe battery concerns ranging from perceived insufficient capacity and poor range to recurring maintenance warnings and reported high-voltage battery or cell-module faults. [signal:13f4213a-3308-4269-8a14-9ed3ec7c3b00] [signal:19ea51a2-b236-4c87-adc5-0c9e24f40040] [signal:14972b46-0fa3-4687-985e-f12330299c60] [signal:5c8e59ef-1a0f-43d1-a817-7d2d3d9ccb48]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner says the battery capacity feels insufficient, charging is troublesome, and the cable repeatedly disconnects. [signal:13f4213a-3308-4269-8a14-9ed3ec7c3b00] Another G60 owner is unhappy with battery range and the charging experience. [signal:19ea51a2-b236-4c87-adc5-0c9e24f40040]

A USA G60 owner reports repeated battery maintenance warnings after short trips and a day parked, despite charging the battery fully. [signal:14972b46-0fa3-4687-985e-f12330299c60] A Europe F70 owner says the hybrid assistance from the battery seems ineffective and is unsure whether it is working properly. [signal:0df6222d-8b27-47e8-8e2d-9b15bf526306]

A USA G60 owner reports a check-engine light shortly after delivery and says the dealer identified a cell module and two connected batteries for replacement, with repairs expected to take at least three to four weeks. [signal:5c8e59ef-1a0f-43d1-a817-7d2d3d9ccb48] A USA G70 owner says a check-engine light went away after the dealer discharged and recharged the high-voltage battery. [signal:2563b812-6666-474d-af03-c6d9d99aa307] A Europe F70 owner reports battery and drivetrain problems during the first three months. [signal:9fb8ea04-4d3f-4c2a-8b72-919258830e48]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include USA reports from G60 and G70 owners, and Europe reports from F70 owners. [signal:13f4213a-3308-4269-8a14-9ed3ec7c3b00] [signal:2563b812-6666-474d-af03-c6d9d99aa307] [signal:9fb8ea04-4d3f-4c2a-8b72-919258830e48] USA G60 reports include range, charging, maintenance warnings, and a cell-module repair; Europe F70 reports include concerns about hybrid assistance and battery problems. [signal:19ea51a2-b236-4c87-adc5-0c9e24f40040] [signal:14972b46-0fa3-4687-985e-f12330299c60] [signal:5c8e59ef-1a0f-43d1-a817-7d2d3d9ccb48] [signal:0df6222d-8b27-47e8-8e2d-9b15bf526306] The supplied signals do not establish whether these differences reflect market or vehicle-line differences. [signal:0df6222d-8b27-47e8-8e2d-9b15bf526306] [signal:13f4213a-3308-4269-8a14-9ed3ec7c3b00]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the cause of the recurring maintenance warnings after short trips or whether the reported charging and range concerns share a cause. [signal:14972b46-0fa3-4687-985e-f12330299c60] [signal:13f4213a-3308-4269-8a14-9ed3ec7c3b00] They also do not clarify whether the G70 check-engine light was caused by the high-voltage battery or why discharging and recharging made it disappear. [signal:2563b812-6666-474d-af03-c6d9d99aa307]

value.title: Battery use and charging are confusing in different situations
value.summary: Drivers report uncertainty about battery use and charging, alongside faster battery depletion or reduced charging in cold weather or when vehicles are driven infrequently. The signals include first-time electric-car drivers and hybrid owners in the USA, and a driver in Europe.
highlights: Battery use, charging expectations, and cold-weather behavior are unclear or frustrating.
Signals concern USA G60 and G70 drivers and a Europe F70 driver.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe adjusting to battery use as difficult, including a first-time electric-car driver who said it took about six weeks to get used to the battery. [signal:287d7f7c-055a-4b9d-aec0-4c4756d7fb0d] A G60 driver reported that the battery drops quickly in cold January weather, and another said the car does not reach a complete charge when it is cold. [signal:287d7f7c-055a-4b9d-aec0-4c4756d7fb0d] [signal:9a3d5c66-3997-4c3f-85b5-a752528d74b4]

A G60 owner asked how to leave the battery when the car is parked for a while and received guidance about charge levels and long storage. [signal:48204620-4a36-4823-83a4-d9bd39d10c47] A G70 hybrid owner was unsure whether the battery needed to stay charged when the car was mostly driven on gas. [signal:b0fb8a51-b3f4-45a7-bea7-ba6936703d7a] A Europe F70 driver said the battery seems to run down quickly when the car is not driven often. [signal:be500e96-9ef6-4fed-b754-e0f238a95a03]

## What customers say
One G60 driver attributed rapid battery drop to cold January temperatures, two motors, and wide tires, but also said they came to enjoy the driving experience after getting used to it. [signal:287d7f7c-055a-4b9d-aec0-4c4756d7fb0d] Another G60 driver said the car uses the main hybrid battery in a situation described as “on the ice,” and that this behavior hurts practicality for commuters; the signal does not clarify the exact conditions. [signal:37b8b449-2212-452d-81bf-d8ece7f135df]

A G70 hybrid owner said she and her husband mostly use gas and do not plug in every day; the service writer told her daily charging was not required. [signal:b0fb8a51-b3f4-45a7-bea7-ba6936703d7a] A G60 customer received advice to keep the battery around 30–50% for shorter periods of storage, avoid leaving it fully depleted, and contact a service center for storage of about three months or longer. [signal:48204620-4a36-4823-83a4-d9bd39d10c47]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include reports of cold-weather battery drop or incomplete charging, uncertainty about parking and charging, and a complaint about hybrid battery behavior. [signal:287d7f7c-055a-4b9d-aec0-4c4756d7fb0d] [signal:9a3d5c66-3997-4c3f-85b5-a752528d74b4] [signal:48204620-4a36-4823-83a4-d9bd39d10c47] [signal:37b8b449-2212-452d-81bf-d8ece7f135df] In Europe, one F70 driver reported that the battery seems to run down quickly when the car is driven infrequently. [signal:be500e96-9ef6-4fed-b754-e0f238a95a03] The signals describe different situations, so they do not establish whether battery usability differs between markets.

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify the conditions behind the G60 report about battery use “on the ice,” or how often drivers encounter that behavior. [signal:37b8b449-2212-452d-81bf-d8ece7f135df] They also do not quantify how frequently cold weather limits charging or how quickly batteries lose charge during infrequent use. [signal:9a3d5c66-3997-4c3f-85b5-a752528d74b4] [signal:be500e96-9ef6-4fed-b754-e0f238a95a03]

No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The available signal does not describe high-voltage battery preconditioning or its reliability [signal:1cbaadc4-50dd-4c34-bfe8-5ec2a7ae9aa6].

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner says the car reacts too slowly when another vehicle moves into or out of the lane ahead [signal:1cbaadc4-50dd-4c34-bfe8-5ec2a7ae9aa6]. The customer does not mention battery preconditioning [signal:1cbaadc4-50dd-4c34-bfe8-5ec2a7ae9aa6].

## Differences between markets
Only a USA signal is available, and it does not address battery preconditioning [signal:1cbaadc4-50dd-4c34-bfe8-5ec2a7ae9aa6].

## Open questions
There is no signal here about preconditioning reliability, customer impact, or competitors [signal:1cbaadc4-50dd-4c34-bfe8-5ec2a7ae9aa6].

value.title: Preconditioning access is limited and Siri control is wanted
value.summary: Some US customers want Siri control or object to preconditioning being unavailable from the key fob when the vehicle is not charged enough. Other US G60 customers value preconditioning, especially its winter warming.
highlights: Customers want Siri control and dislike a charge-related limit on key-fob preconditioning.
Signals are from US customers with G70 and G60 vehicles; three signals concern the G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One US G70 customer wants to precondition the vehicle using Siri, and one US G60 customer dislikes that key-fob preconditioning is unavailable when the vehicle is not charged enough. [signal:afe56d9a-9ac8-465a-9b0e-1e8c32cd20cd] [signal:d223076a-7771-4116-b069-d0901be9382c]

## What customers say
The G60 customer says the charge-related limitation is unwelcome. [signal:d223076a-7771-4116-b069-d0901be9382c] Two other G60 customers appreciate the preconditioning capability, including winter preconditioning that warms the car. [signal:b47faa50-a678-4c9c-9b85-76cab771481e] [signal:fd290566-03d4-4c9b-bb56-00c898c96243]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA, so they provide no comparison between markets. [signal:afe56d9a-9ac8-465a-9b0e-1e8c32cd20cd] [signal:d223076a-7771-4116-b069-d0901be9382c] [signal:b47faa50-a678-4c9c-9b85-76cab771481e] [signal:fd290566-03d4-4c9b-bb56-00c898c96243]

## Open questions
The signals do not say what charge level prevents key-fob preconditioning or whether Siri control is available through another method. [signal:afe56d9a-9ac8-465a-9b0e-1e8c32cd20cd] [signal:d223076a-7771-4116-b069-d0901be9382c]

value.title: Wi-Fi hotspot drops, fails to appear or cannot connect
value.summary: Customers report Wi-Fi connectivity that drops, is difficult to set up, or is unavailable. Signals mention USA and Rest of World customers across G70, G60 and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Wi-Fi connectivity can drop, be difficult to set up, or fail to appear.
Reports are from the USA and Rest of World, across G70, G60 and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe Wi-Fi that drops repeatedly, does not appear in network searches, or is unavailable in the vehicle. [signal:3acfea62-69c8-4b6d-8a2c-23b18f139cee] [signal:77013f31-c95e-457e-9da1-ae633caa4426] [signal:408c7257-46e1-4adc-9992-de7f5a8e483b]

Some reports describe wireless Apple CarPlay or Android Auto disconnecting alongside Wi-Fi or wireless connectivity problems. [signal:3acfea62-69c8-4b6d-8a2c-23b18f139cee] [signal:3d0aac7e-5472-401d-ac26-b0fc53e27519]

## What customers say
A G70 owner calls the Wi-Fi connection process difficult, while other G70 owners describe frequent drops, repeated resets, or the car’s Wi-Fi not appearing among available networks. [signal:3803cc1a-5653-49ac-be91-0fb2ccb0e945] [signal:67f5ed91-0a4b-4bc0-bccd-fa16fb5e6250] [signal:77013f31-c95e-457e-9da1-ae633caa4426]

A G60 owner says the Wi-Fi option does not work and reports being told by a BMW representative that a software fault would not be fixed in the near term. [signal:408c7257-46e1-4adc-9992-de7f5a8e483b]

A Rest of World F70 report describes Android Auto repeatedly cutting out and reconnecting over wireless. [signal:3d0aac7e-5472-401d-ac26-b0fc53e27519]

## Differences between markets
The sampled reports include USA complaints about G70 and G60 vehicles, and a Rest of World complaint about an F70. [signal:3803cc1a-5653-49ac-be91-0fb2ccb0e945] [signal:408c7257-46e1-4adc-9992-de7f5a8e483b] [signal:3d0aac7e-5472-401d-ac26-b0fc53e27519]

The reports describe different symptoms; they do not establish whether reliability differs by market or vehicle line. [signal:3acfea62-69c8-4b6d-8a2c-23b18f139cee] [signal:3d0aac7e-5472-401d-ac26-b0fc53e27519] [signal:408c7257-46e1-4adc-9992-de7f5a8e483b]

## Open questions
Do the reported wireless phone-projection dropouts share a cause with the Wi-Fi hotspot issues? [signal:3acfea62-69c8-4b6d-8a2c-23b18f139cee] [signal:3d0aac7e-5472-401d-ac26-b0fc53e27519]

How often does the Wi-Fi option fail or disappear, and are these reports concentrated in particular markets or vehicle lines? [signal:77013f31-c95e-457e-9da1-ae633caa4426] [signal:408c7257-46e1-4adc-9992-de7f5a8e483b]

value.title: Ambient lighting distracts drivers and is hard to adjust
value.summary: Drivers report ambient-light reflections in exterior mirrors, difficulty finding or changing settings, and limited control over individual lights. Signals come from Europe and the USA across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Mirror reflections distract drivers, while settings can be difficult to find or control.
Signals include 5 Europe/F70 and 6 USA/G60–G70 reports.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Ambient lighting can reflect in exterior mirrors at night and distract drivers; one driver said reducing brightness made the reflections less of an issue. [signal:12e6ded3-29e7-4f27-8b2c-f8f6281e0b07] [signal:1955c252-1b01-4af7-a7f9-fc566adf7fca] [signal:1fcdcac0-637c-48de-afa9-b1a1f5dea233]

A Europe-based F70 driver wanted the side ambient lights to be dimmable independently of the rest of the lighting. [signal:275e6c74-9c94-4623-93f4-7fb450bf0ac5]

## What customers say
Some USA customers asked how to find the controls to change ambient-light colors or brightness; in the reported interactions, staff directed them through vehicle-screen menus. [signal:4d56f261-90ad-4a07-9f9e-24bd303fb58b] [signal:547824e4-1bdd-45b9-9d49-968a8ab50fba] [signal:67cd6326-4567-4adb-b5a9-624cab843fd4] [signal:806f9334-f3e3-44d1-bcc7-dad3bc0ea365]

One USA G70 customer said the lighting changed from purple and they did not know why. [signal:481bf25d-3f75-4ff6-b5da-367c923ffabe]

## Differences between markets
Mirror-reflection complaints appear in Europe on F70 and in the USA on G60; the USA G60 customer reported that lowering brightness reduced the issue. [signal:12e6ded3-29e7-4f27-8b2c-f8f6281e0b07] [signal:1955c252-1b01-4af7-a7f9-fc566adf7fca] [signal:1fcdcac0-637c-48de-afa9-b1a1f5dea233]

The independent-dimming request and reports of needing help with settings are represented in different signals; the signals do not establish whether these experiences differ by market. [signal:275e6c74-9c94-4623-93f4-7fb450bf0ac5] [signal:4d56f261-90ad-4a07-9f9e-24bd303fb58b] [signal:547824e4-1bdd-45b9-9d49-968a8ab50fba]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often mirror reflections occur, whether they affect lighting configurations beyond those described, or why one customer's color changed. [signal:12e6ded3-29e7-4f27-8b2c-f8f6281e0b07] [signal:1fcdcac0-637c-48de-afa9-b1a1f5dea233] [signal:481bf25d-3f75-4ff6-b5da-367c923ffabe]

value.title: Ambient lighting changes, fails, or shows physical defects
value.summary: Customers report ambient lighting that reverts to another color, has uneven or failed LEDs, stops working, or has trim that drops down. Signals cover USA and Europe vehicles across the G70, G60, and F70.
highlights: Ambient lighting reports include color reversion, uneven or failed LEDs, loss of function, and loose trim.
Five complaints: four in the USA and one in Europe, across G70, G60, and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report several ambient-lighting reliability issues: a selected color reverting, an unevenly colored light-bar section, lighting ceasing to work, LEDs failing, and trim dropping down and exposing LEDs. [signal:0d78057a-8558-45cd-a37c-3e3ae3b77dfb] [signal:3346ec82-3aa3-4438-ba19-86042aa3ea20] [signal:70e577ab-eeb2-4190-acc3-0103647b9bd0] [signal:d38cbac6-8bbe-45fb-b053-980220539e85] [signal:dda814fb-63d5-4a93-bc82-3b3e95489dbe]

## What customers say
One G70 customer says the blue setting reverts to clear after about two days, even though the customer reports their driver profile loads and remains active. [signal:0d78057a-8558-45cd-a37c-3e3ae3b77dfb]

A G60 customer reports a section of the dashboard light bar has a different color from the rest; service diagnosed the issue and a replacement part had been ordered. [signal:3346ec82-3aa3-4438-ba19-86042aa3ea20]

An F70 customer says all interior mood lighting stopped working after a software update and complains about having to bring the car in. [signal:70e577ab-eeb2-4190-acc3-0103647b9bd0]

A G70 customer reports that a strip of black plastic trim drops down when the roof is opened and drops again after being pressed back up and the shade is cycled. [signal:d38cbac6-8bbe-45fb-b053-980220539e85]

Another G70 customer says multiple LEDs, including the center dashboard ambient lights, no longer work; replacement parts were needed, with an estimated wait of about three weeks. [signal:dda814fb-63d5-4a93-bc82-3b3e95489dbe]

## Differences between markets
Four signals are from the USA: three concern G70 vehicles and one concerns a G60. [signal:0d78057a-8558-45cd-a37c-3e3ae3b77dfb] [signal:3346ec82-3aa3-4438-ba19-86042aa3ea20] [signal:d38cbac6-8bbe-45fb-b053-980220539e85] [signal:dda814fb-63d5-4a93-bc82-3b3e95489dbe] One signal is from Europe and concerns an F70. [signal:70e577ab-eeb2-4190-acc3-0103647b9bd0] The reported issues differ across the signals; the evidence does not establish whether the pattern differs by market. [signal:0d78057a-8558-45cd-a37c-3e3ae3b77dfb] [signal:3346ec82-3aa3-4438-ba19-86042aa3ea20] [signal:70e577ab-eeb2-4190-acc3-0103647b9bd0] [signal:d38cbac6-8bbe-45fb-b053-980220539e85] [signal:dda814fb-63d5-4a93-bc82-3b3e95489dbe]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why the color reverts or whether the reported profile behavior is related. [signal:0d78057a-8558-45cd-a37c-3e3ae3b77dfb]
The signals do not establish whether the F70 lighting failure is attributable to the software update. [signal:70e577ab-eeb2-4190-acc3-0103647b9bd0]
The signals do not establish how common these issues are beyond the five complaints provided. [signal:0d78057a-8558-45cd-a37c-3e3ae3b77dfb] [signal:3346ec82-3aa3-4438-ba19-86042aa3ea20] [signal:70e577ab-eeb2-4190-acc3-0103647b9bd0] [signal:d38cbac6-8bbe-45fb-b053-980220539e85] [signal:dda814fb-63d5-4a93-bc82-3b3e95489dbe]

value.title: Battery preconditioning is confusing and unreliable through the app
value.summary: Some U.S. G60 and G70 customers are unsure what preconditioning does, when to use it, or how to activate it. One customer also reports that app activation does not connect on the first attempt.
highlights: Customers have questions about preconditioning’s purpose, timing, and activation; one reports first-attempt app connection failure.
Signals provided are from U.S. G60 and G70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers ask what battery preconditioning does, when it is useful, and how to operate it. [signal:4bf3332d-7e1a-43de-86be-86781db1a7e0] [signal:732bffb8-7b5a-492c-aad3-0d39960957f3] [signal:e90962a3-b9b6-48cd-b6d3-9ae4e736045a] One customer says the car does not connect through the app on the first preconditioning attempt. [signal:f3d0b9d4-e36d-4c54-816e-3d724075c212]

## What customers say
A G70 customer asked what preconditioning means and at what temperature to start using it. [signal:4bf3332d-7e1a-43de-86be-86781db1a7e0] Another G70 customer said they were still learning the feature. [signal:6b736afc-2a09-42ce-8557-eee5edb0cd4d] G60 customers asked whether preconditioning is needed while driving after an earlier session, whether it is advisable in warm weather, and how to activate it. [signal:6f18781c-9acc-4556-b9a9-62f6776e8382] [signal:732bffb8-7b5a-492c-aad3-0d39960957f3] [signal:e90962a3-b9b6-48cd-b6d3-9ae4e736045a]

## Differences between markets
All signals provided are from the USA and concern G60 or G70 vehicles; no market comparison is present in the signals. [signal:4bf3332d-7e1a-43de-86be-86781db1a7e0] [signal:6b736afc-2a09-42ce-8557-eee5edb0cd4d] [signal:6f18781c-9acc-4556-b9a9-62f6776e8382] [signal:732bffb8-7b5a-492c-aad3-0d39960957f3] [signal:e90962a3-b9b6-48cd-b6d3-9ae4e736045a] [signal:f3d0b9d4-e36d-4c54-816e-3d724075c212]

## Open questions
How common are first-attempt app connection failures beyond the reported case? [signal:f3d0b9d4-e36d-4c54-816e-3d724075c212] Which preconditioning questions recur most often across the wider set of signals? [signal:4bf3332d-7e1a-43de-86be-86781db1a7e0] [signal:6b736afc-2a09-42ce-8557-eee5edb0cd4d] [signal:6f18781c-9acc-4556-b9a9-62f6776e8382] [signal:732bffb8-7b5a-492c-aad3-0d39960957f3] [signal:e90962a3-b9b6-48cd-b6d3-9ae4e736045a]

value.title: WiFi hotspot setup is difficult and access is unclear
value.summary: Customers in the USA report difficulty connecting to or activating the WiFi hotspot, along with uncertainty about trial duration. The complaints cover G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report difficult setup, unusable WiFi, and confusion about hotspot trial duration.
All five signals are from the USA: three concern G70 and two concern G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report difficulty using or activating the WiFi hotspot, and one customer is unsure how long hotspot access lasts. [signal:0c735f73-6108-486e-a47e-e4794ea67cbf] [signal:3e2f7f08-0fde-48d3-b177-fde3267204fa] [signal:4e613e29-dc2a-4e80-b7a8-d7f61aaa0ff3] [signal:726e6d6c-1f01-4ac0-bf57-5a65ae0bdb60] [signal:84dcd8c9-6084-4652-a4ec-b2f1df92cd6b]

## What customers say
- A G70 customer said the hotspot could not be used despite the eSIM being set up and working with their phone. [signal:0c735f73-6108-486e-a47e-e4794ea67cbf]
- A G70 customer questioned whether hotspot access lasts three months or three years and was told it is a three-month trial. [signal:3e2f7f08-0fde-48d3-b177-fde3267204fa]
- A G60 customer reported that the WiFi alternative did not work; after about an hour being transferred between BMW and AT&T, a BMW representative reportedly said there was a BMW software issue that would not be fixed soon. [signal:4e613e29-dc2a-4e80-b7a8-d7f61aaa0ff3]
- A G70 customer who had liked the WiFi in a 2023 vehicle described the connection process in their new vehicle as very difficult. [signal:726e6d6c-1f01-4ac0-bf57-5a65ae0bdb60]
- A G60 customer wanted to use a personal hotspot and was advised to contact their mobile provider about eSIM activation, then follow in-app instructions. [signal:84dcd8c9-6084-4652-a4ec-b2f1df92cd6b]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA, so the signals do not provide a market comparison. [signal:0c735f73-6108-486e-a47e-e4794ea67cbf] [signal:3e2f7f08-0fde-48d3-b177-fde3267204fa] [signal:4e613e29-dc2a-4e80-b7a8-d7f61aaa0ff3] [signal:726e6d6c-1f01-4ac0-bf57-5a65ae0bdb60] [signal:84dcd8c9-6084-4652-a4ec-b2f1df92cd6b]

## Open questions
- Is the reported BMW software issue related to the other hotspot connection and activation difficulties? [signal:4e613e29-dc2a-4e80-b7a8-d7f61aaa0ff3] [signal:0c735f73-6108-486e-a47e-e4794ea67cbf] [signal:84dcd8c9-6084-4652-a4ec-b2f1df92cd6b]
- What explains the customer’s uncertainty about whether hotspot access lasts three months or three years? [signal:3e2f7f08-0fde-48d3-b177-fde3267204fa]

value.title: Rear cross-traffic warning triggers too late
value.summary: USA G60 owners report that rear cross-traffic warnings come only when another car is very close or provide less warning than expected. One owner says lower-priced cars give more warning.
highlights: Warnings are reported as too late or insufficient.
Both signals are from USA owners of the G60.
One owner says lower-priced cars provide more warning.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners report that rear cross-traffic warnings come too late, including one account that the alert triggers when another car is only a few feet away. [signal:4083b766-fdcf-48b5-8b9a-23d8809e22a3] Another owner says the vehicle does not give enough warning. [signal:fe0d9b1f-46c3-4f11-88e6-3ff77c088bdf]

## What customers say
One owner says BMW indicated the issue should be corrected with a July update, but the owner is waiting to see whether it is. [signal:4083b766-fdcf-48b5-8b9a-23d8809e22a3] Another owner says they assumed the vehicle would provide more warning. [signal:fe0d9b1f-46c3-4f11-88e6-3ff77c088bdf]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are complaints from USA owners of G60 vehicles; no other markets or vehicle lines appear in these signals. [signal:4083b766-fdcf-48b5-8b9a-23d8809e22a3] [signal:fe0d9b1f-46c3-4f11-88e6-3ff77c088bdf]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported warning timing differs by situation or whether the mentioned July update changes it. [signal:4083b766-fdcf-48b5-8b9a-23d8809e22a3] The signals do not specify which lower-priced cars provide more warning. [signal:fe0d9b1f-46c3-4f11-88e6-3ff77c088bdf]

value.title: USB access, playback and charging reliability concerns
value.summary: Customers report different USB-related problems: missing ports, unsatisfactory audio controls with a USB drive, and an intermittently or permanently failed charging port. The signals cover F70, G60 and G70 vehicles in Europe, Rest of World and the USA.
highlights: USB concerns range from missing ports and poor USB-drive controls to a failed charging hub.
Signals cover Europe F70 (4), Rest of World G60 (1) and USA G70 (1).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe several distinct USB concerns: missing rear charging points or USB ports, audio controls they find worse when using a USB flash drive, and a charging port that worked intermittently before being reported as permanently failed. [signal:1661af02-61db-4d9c-89be-9de10e37e3c9] [signal:2897bc64-3a6f-4db8-ae47-f9cda81e1fa9] [signal:afc90c92-2b49-4b7d-a072-0f881b063223] [signal:c725f309-97a3-4433-8f70-8be4bd3840c1]

## What customers say
An F70 owner says rear USB charging points are missing. [signal:1661af02-61db-4d9c-89be-9de10e37e3c9]

A G60 owner says the audio controls feel worse when using a USB flash drive. [signal:2897bc64-3a6f-4db8-ae47-f9cda81e1fa9]

A G70 service record describes an intermittently working center charging port and identifies a faulty USB hub; the recorded defect description says the USB hub had permanently failed. [signal:afc90c92-2b49-4b7d-a072-0f881b063223]

Another F70 owner says there are no USB ports, only a phone charger. [signal:c725f309-97a3-4433-8f70-8be4bd3840c1]

An F70 owner says they miss “usb contention”; the wording does not clarify the specific issue. [signal:46bf7810-061f-4ac4-8344-4d8339ec1093]

## Differences between markets
The four Europe signals concern F70 vehicles; USB-related comments include missing ports or charging points and an unclear “usb contention” complaint. [signal:1661af02-61db-4d9c-89be-9de10e37e3c9] [signal:46bf7810-061f-4ac4-8344-4d8339ec1093] [signal:c725f309-97a3-4433-8f70-8be4bd3840c1]

The Rest of World signal concerns a G60 and reports worse audio controls with a USB flash drive, while the USA signal concerns a G70 and records a faulty charging-port hub. [signal:2897bc64-3a6f-4db8-ae47-f9cda81e1fa9] [signal:afc90c92-2b49-4b7d-a072-0f881b063223]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reports concern one shared reliability issue or separate concerns about port availability, USB-drive controls and charging-hub failure. [signal:1661af02-61db-4d9c-89be-9de10e37e3c9] [signal:2897bc64-3a6f-4db8-ae47-f9cda81e1fa9] [signal:afc90c92-2b49-4b7d-a072-0f881b063223] [signal:c725f309-97a3-4433-8f70-8be4bd3840c1]

The meaning of “usb contention” is unclear from the customer’s wording. [signal:46bf7810-061f-4ac4-8344-4d8339ec1093]

value.title: USB ports charge but cannot play stored music
value.summary: Customers report that USB ports provide charging but not data access, limiting music playback from flash drives and other devices. Requests for more ports or different port locations also appear, across F70, G70 and G60 feedback.
highlights: Charging-only USB ports prevent customers from playing music from stored media.
Signals span F70 in Europe and Rest of World, plus G70 and G60 in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that USB-C points charge devices but do not provide data access, preventing playback from flash drives or other stored media. [signal:63cab9e0-9ebf-40c3-b46f-4d66efacbc54] [signal:f1632e2f-08b1-46aa-b2f8-9bd9662abd61] [signal:13364a2e-7750-4a07-a522-5f22eaabbd99]

Other feedback describes too few ports, missing rear charging points, or ports that are inconvenient to reach or leave devices and cables exposed. [signal:c4145d89-7e9b-4df6-ad2d-d0c18e894c54] [signal:f5f0e99a-fd21-43a7-8cde-7cc0c51a20fa] [signal:e49ce471-0e44-4730-ae2a-337f6a405187]

## What customers say
F70 owners describe being unable to play music from USB media, including flash drives and memory sticks. [signal:63cab9e0-9ebf-40c3-b46f-4d66efacbc54] [signal:f1632e2f-08b1-46aa-b2f8-9bd9662abd61] [signal:13364a2e-7750-4a07-a522-5f22eaabbd99]

A G60 owner says the loss of console USB ports means an iPod and its cable sit exposed, taking up console space. [signal:e49ce471-0e44-4730-ae2a-337f6a405187]

Other requests include a port for CarPlay, more easily reached front ports, and at least one USB-A port. [signal:b828e5a1-b955-4199-b433-515167cb0fff] [signal:f5f0e99a-fd21-43a7-8cde-7cc0c51a20fa] [signal:7b21219b-ac81-4b0a-8dd4-dfa1d77cd6ce]

## Differences between markets
In Europe, F70 feedback focuses on USB data access for music and on missing rear charging points. [signal:c4145d89-7e9b-4df6-ad2d-d0c18e894c54] [signal:f1632e2f-08b1-46aa-b2f8-9bd9662abd61] [signal:13364a2e-7750-4a07-a522-5f22eaabbd99]

Rest of World feedback on the F70 also describes charging-only USB-C ports and limited options for playing music without a smartphone. [signal:63cab9e0-9ebf-40c3-b46f-4d66efacbc54]

In the USA, G70 and G60 feedback mentions port availability, placement, and keeping an iPod connection inside the console. [signal:b828e5a1-b955-4199-b433-515167cb0fff] [signal:f5f0e99a-fd21-43a7-8cde-7cc0c51a20fa] [signal:fe9df664-284e-402b-ae9e-b55db16fc792] [signal:e49ce471-0e44-4730-ae2a-337f6a405187]

## Open questions
Do customers primarily need USB data access for music, more charging points, or different port locations? [signal:63cab9e0-9ebf-40c3-b46f-4d66efacbc54] [signal:c4145d89-7e9b-4df6-ad2d-d0c18e894c54] [signal:f5f0e99a-fd21-43a7-8cde-7cc0c51a20fa]

How widespread are these concerns across the 20 signals in the case, and how do needs vary by vehicle and market?

value.title: USB ports and media playback are difficult to use
value.summary: Customers report that USB media playback is unavailable or unreliable for their needs, and that charging ports can be hard to find or insufficient. These concerns appear across F70, G60 and G70 signals in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: USB media playback is missing for some customers, while port access and charging also cause problems.
Signals cover F70, G60 and G70 in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 customers say they cannot play music from a USB flash drive and object to needing a phone or Bluetooth for music. [signal:21264515-9e57-49ca-8bcb-1639f3658d83] [signal:4290265c-fa73-4d8c-b650-5794fcd2c7de] [signal:4786355f-c1ce-4776-bb2c-7c8737c94097] Others describe the USB setup as poor or say they want USB media playback retained. [signal:5844e192-caa1-408b-9316-5a724620e6df] [signal:5f751212-4c8e-4889-953d-2de156659baf]

Some G60 customers want another place to plug in a phone when the wireless charging pad is in use, and one reports that a charging tray adds little or no charge during a drive. [signal:1f7ba513-8627-493e-8a04-6918d214d5b8] [signal:44c8a5e7-5fac-4561-b557-970def3de3ff] A G70 customer says the USB ports are difficult to locate, including after checking the manual. [signal:62db8c05-280f-471e-a619-61bb847a359d]

## What customers say
An F70 customer says a thumb drive cannot be used for music playback, while another says Bluetooth sound quality is poor. [signal:21264515-9e57-49ca-8bcb-1639f3658d83] [signal:4290265c-fa73-4d8c-b650-5794fcd2c7de] A G60 customer was advised that music files encrypted by a previous vehicle could not be moved to another device, and that original files should be copied to a thumb drive. [signal:46c8557d-67aa-4c7d-9884-5f132b4f0073] A different G60 customer was shown where the Type-C ports are located in the center console. [signal:1f7ba513-8627-493e-8a04-6918d214d5b8]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include F70 USB media playback complaints from Europe and Rest of World. [signal:21264515-9e57-49ca-8bcb-1639f3658d83] [signal:5844e192-caa1-408b-9316-5a724620e6df] [signal:5f751212-4c8e-4889-953d-2de156659baf] [signal:4290265c-fa73-4d8c-b650-5794fcd2c7de] [signal:4786355f-c1ce-4776-bb2c-7c8737c94097] The supplied USA signals describe a desire for additional charging access, slow charging, and difficulty locating ports. [signal:1f7ba513-8627-493e-8a04-6918d214d5b8] [signal:44c8a5e7-5fac-4561-b557-970def3de3ff] [signal:62db8c05-280f-471e-a619-61bb847a359d]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread USB playback, charging, or port-location concerns are across the full set of 29 signals. [signal:21264515-9e57-49ca-8bcb-1639f3658d83] [signal:1f7ba513-8627-493e-8a04-6918d214d5b8] [signal:44c8a5e7-5fac-4561-b557-970def3de3ff] [signal:62db8c05-280f-471e-a619-61bb847a359d] The signals also do not clarify which USB-port or media-playback behaviors apply across the different vehicle lines and markets. [signal:21264515-9e57-49ca-8bcb-1639f3658d83] [signal:46c8557d-67aa-4c7d-9884-5f132b4f0073] [signal:62db8c05-280f-471e-a619-61bb847a359d]

value.title: Concern about leg protection in rear impacts

value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer reported that the driver seat slid forward during a rear impact and its bottom struck and injured the backs of her calves. [signal:709eaad2-9d6c-4adb-96b7-6b39fe978886]

## What customers say
The customer wondered whether an airbag beneath the seat bottom might have pushed her legs forward and lessened the impact. [signal:709eaad2-9d6c-4adb-96b7-6b39fe978886]

The signal is from the USA and concerns a G70; there are no other market signals to compare. [signal:709eaad2-9d6c-4adb-96b7-6b39fe978886]

value.title: Blind spot warnings lack audible alerts
value.summary: Some US G60 and G70 customers want an audible warning in addition to the visual blind spot alert. Other customers in the US and Europe value the feature’s current visual warning.
highlights: Some customers want an audible alert when blind spot monitoring detects a vehicle.
Requests come from US customers in the G60 and G70.
Maserati and Mercedes are cited as offering audible warnings.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some US customers say blind spot monitoring provides a flashing light but no audible alert when they signal or move toward an occupied lane. [signal:584e8bcc-f633-435b-aa89-2f4352bedd9b] [signal:70d479b4-26f5-4521-b949-2067ba6d3b3f] [signal:c3d42c51-48eb-4530-ad05-82ac8b0e8bd3]

## What customers say
Three US customers in the G60 and G70 request audible warnings. [signal:584e8bcc-f633-435b-aa89-2f4352bedd9b] [signal:70d479b4-26f5-4521-b949-2067ba6d3b3f] [signal:c3d42c51-48eb-4530-ad05-82ac8b0e8bd3] One G60 customer says previous Maserati and Mercedes vehicles beeped when changing lanes with the turn signal on. 

Other customers value the feature: US G60 and G70 owners say they like blind spot detection, and a European F70 owner finds the mirror warning light helpful and effective. [signal:1c280173-43b1-47d5-9441-97a2c13864aa] [signal:d4b1cc8b-22ac-493f-9d22-4c889403797b] [signal:93fa95a6-3a7b-4335-a5b6-6e3b58babb9d]

## Differences between markets
The requests for audible alerts are from US customers, while the positive comment about the mirror warning light is from a European customer. [signal:584e8bcc-f633-435b-aa89-2f4352bedd9b] [signal:70d479b4-26f5-4521-b949-2067ba6d3b3f] [signal:c3d42c51-48eb-4530-ad05-82ac8b0e8bd3] [signal:93fa95a6-3a7b-4335-a5b6-6e3b58babb9d]

## Open questions
Do customers who value the visual warning also want an audible alert, or does preference differ by market or vehicle line? [signal:1c280173-43b1-47d5-9441-97a2c13864aa] [signal:93fa95a6-3a7b-4335-a5b6-6e3b58babb9d] [signal:584e8bcc-f633-435b-aa89-2f4352bedd9b] [signal:70d479b4-26f5-4521-b949-2067ba6d3b3f] [signal:c3d42c51-48eb-4530-ad05-82ac8b0e8bd3]

value.title: Rear cross-traffic warning is inconsistent and can brake without an obstacle
value.summary: Customers report missed or late rear cross-traffic detection and occasional unexpected braking while reversing. Signals come from USA G70 and G60 owners and one Europe F70 owner.
highlights: Detection can be inconsistent or late, and braking can activate when no obstacle is present.
Five USA signals cover G70 and G60; one Europe signal covers F70.
A USA customer says the feature works well in less expensive Kia vehicles, citing clear audible alerts.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe rear cross-traffic detection as inconsistent or insufficiently sensitive, including missed detections and braking when nothing is behind the vehicle. [signal:2816fb86-2fe0-48a1-b204-ca4c822b0c16] [signal:62ee50c5-5f10-4673-a1d7-011c6db16b84] [signal:92adf172-6410-4ff2-98b3-4c371639808d] [signal:b5fa5141-670a-4e43-a86e-acf003db2093]

## What customers say
A G70 owner in the USA reports that the system sometimes detects something and brakes hard while reversing. [signal:2816fb86-2fe0-48a1-b204-ca4c822b0c16]
A G70 owner in Europe says emergency braking activated while reversing despite nothing being behind the car, leaving them stopped in the road. [signal:62ee50c5-5f10-4673-a1d7-011c6db16b84]
USA G60 customers report that the warning did not operate properly, was less sensitive than other systems, or required an oncoming car to get very close before detection. [signal:900b5ace-102c-44e7-9c75-1aeea036f89a] [signal:92adf172-6410-4ff2-98b3-4c371639808d]
One G60 customer says the issue persisted from their previous 2023 model and that reduced neck mobility makes the function increasingly important to them. [signal:900b5ace-102c-44e7-9c75-1aeea036f89a]

## Differences between markets
The five USA signals concern G70 and G60 vehicles, with reports of missed or late detection and inconsistent operation. [signal:2816fb86-2fe0-48a1-b204-ca4c822b0c16] [signal:8450c912-8afd-4b78-9bde-f101b1acc59f] [signal:900b5ace-102c-44e7-9c75-1aeea036f89a] [signal:92adf172-6410-4ff2-98b3-4c371639808d] [signal:b5fa5141-670a-4e43-a86e-acf003db2093]
The single Europe signal concerns an F70 and describes unexpected braking while reversing. [signal:62ee50c5-5f10-4673-a1d7-011c6db16b84]
A USA G60 customer compares the warning unfavorably with Kia vehicles, saying those provide clear audible alerts. [signal:900b5ace-102c-44e7-9c75-1aeea036f89a]

## Open questions
How often do missed detections, late detections, and unexpected braking occur across the reported vehicle lines? [signal:2816fb86-2fe0-48a1-b204-ca4c822b0c16] [signal:62ee50c5-5f10-4673-a1d7-011c6db16b84] [signal:92adf172-6410-4ff2-98b3-4c371639808d]
Do customers experience different warning behavior across vehicle lines or markets? [signal:2816fb86-2fe0-48a1-b204-ca4c822b0c16] [signal:62ee50c5-5f10-4673-a1d7-011c6db16b84] [signal:900b5ace-102c-44e7-9c75-1aeea036f89a]

value.title: Rear cross-traffic warning is difficult to understand and use
value.summary: Some USA G60 and G70 customers are unsure how rear cross-traffic warning works or whether it is active. One customer also reports that the audible alert behaves differently between parking views.
highlights: Customers report unclear operation, uncertain activation, and an alert that may not sound in assisted parking view.
Signals identify USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report uncertainty about how rear cross-traffic warning works, whether it is active, and when it alerts. [signal:43e92d4d-4a7d-4b65-a2e7-b1495ac1b3e9] [signal:96e277fa-a30f-4f21-b593-945a7820b74b] [signal:b48c7a54-0d6b-4f7f-9597-5655e3f8bfc3] One customer says the rear audible alert seems absent in assisted parking view but sounds in standard parking view. [signal:73855826-0621-44e0-9e63-1eaa6f118b87]

## What customers say
A customer asked how alerts and braking work when backing out or pulling forward from a blind parking space; the explanation given was that the system alerts when an approaching vehicle is detected and may brake if a collision is expected. [signal:43e92d4d-4a7d-4b65-a2e7-b1495ac1b3e9] Other customers were unsure how the feature works, thought it might respond to nearby pedestrians, or did not know whether rear cross-traffic warning was included and active. [signal:b48c7a54-0d6b-4f7f-9597-5655e3f8bfc3]  A customer worried that the alert was missing while reversing toward an approaching vehicle; staff confirmed the setting was active and also mentioned that PDC signal volume could be increased. [signal:eaea3510-7625-4757-af36-046d3d24ccbf]

## Differences between markets
All supplied customer signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:43e92d4d-4a7d-4b65-a2e7-b1495ac1b3e9] [signal:5580c521-2fb2-417e-8cc3-81585688ccc6] [signal:73855826-0621-44e0-9e63-1eaa6f118b87]  [signal:b48c7a54-0d6b-4f7f-9597-5655e3f8bfc3] [signal:eaea3510-7625-4757-af36-046d3d24ccbf]

## Open questions
Does the audible-alert behavior differ between assisted and standard parking views, or was this a one-off observation? [signal:73855826-0621-44e0-9e63-1eaa6f118b87] What alerts should customers expect in situations involving nearby pedestrians? [signal:b48c7a54-0d6b-4f7f-9597-5655e3f8bfc3]

value.title: No shift paddles frustrate one F70 driver
value.summary: One Europe-based F70 driver says the lack of paddles is frustrating because they cannot take control of shifting. A USA-based G60 driver values the paddles when driving up and down hills.
highlights: An F70 driver is frustrated by having no paddles to take control of shifting.
Signals concern one Europe F70 driver and one USA G60 driver.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One F70 driver in Europe says the version they drive has no paddles and that this is frustrating because they cannot take control of shifting. [signal:0cf897c1-4469-4b8b-886f-1268ade76511]

## What customers say
The Europe-based F70 driver praises the gearbox management but wants the option to take control through paddles. [signal:0cf897c1-4469-4b8b-886f-1268ade76511]
A USA-based G60 driver says she enjoys having paddles when going up and down hills, because she does not always want to rely on the brakes. [signal:dbee8a15-2d1c-4476-b43b-196e01e6f1b5]

## Differences between markets
The Europe F70 signal describes frustration about missing paddles, while the USA G60 signal describes enjoyment of having them. [signal:0cf897c1-4469-4b8b-886f-1268ade76511] [signal:dbee8a15-2d1c-4476-b43b-196e01e6f1b5]

## Open questions
Do other F70 drivers share the frustration about missing paddles? [signal:0cf897c1-4469-4b8b-886f-1268ade76511]
How broadly do drivers value paddles for controlling shifts on hills? [signal:dbee8a15-2d1c-4476-b43b-196e01e6f1b5]

value.title: Shift paddles detach or stop functioning
value.summary: Customers report a shift paddle coming loose or not functioning. The signals concern one G60 and one G70 in the USA.
highlights: One paddle came loose; another did not function.
Two USA reports: one G60 and one G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers reported two shift paddle defects: one paddle came loose from the steering wheel, and another did not function [signal:02365a29-cf15-45cf-80f9-7e29b7c164f8] [signal:8d3c2d63-cd78-48c3-9146-95d109639b23].

## What customers say
A G60 customer in the USA said the left paddle came loose and dropped off the steering wheel; they intended to arrange a dealer visit [signal:02365a29-cf15-45cf-80f9-7e29b7c164f8]. A G70 customer in the USA said one paddle was not functioning shortly after purchase and reported that the dealer resolved the problem [signal:8d3c2d63-cd78-48c3-9146-95d109639b23].

## Differences between markets
Both reports are from the USA, one involving a G60 and one a G70; the signals do not provide a comparison across markets [signal:02365a29-cf15-45cf-80f9-7e29b7c164f8] [signal:8d3c2d63-cd78-48c3-9146-95d109639b23].

## Open questions
- Are similar paddle defects reported beyond these two USA cases? [signal:02365a29-cf15-45cf-80f9-7e29b7c164f8] [signal:8d3c2d63-cd78-48c3-9146-95d109639b23]
- What was the cause of each reported defect? [signal:02365a29-cf15-45cf-80f9-7e29b7c164f8] [signal:8d3c2d63-cd78-48c3-9146-95d109639b23]

value.title: Airbag and restraint-system errors prompt dealer visits
