All four signals are from USA customers with G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
G70 customers report airbag or restraint-system alerts; some signals describe dealer attention, including replacement of a passenger seat-belt buckle. [signal:95ee8b06-5b80-498b-9f63-13b22a67b222] [signal:9876385f-5ba1-4158-9873-75612ed6add7] [signal:f1bd7821-c667-488d-ab71-4c965ab97a74]

## What customers say
- One customer said a passenger restraint-system error led the dealer to install a new passenger seat-belt buckle. [signal:95ee8b06-5b80-498b-9f63-13b22a67b222]
- Another reported a driver restraint-system alert and planned to contact the dealership; they said they could still buckle their seat belt. [signal:9876385f-5ba1-4158-9873-75612ed6add7]
- One customer said the airbag alert appeared as expected but still required dropping the car off at the dealer. [signal:f1bd7821-c667-488d-ab71-4c965ab97a74]
- One customer reported an airbag malfunction error twice, and said it cleared after restarting the car on both occasions. [signal:fbb3f332-d436-4b8d-aa8c-db08f1f3e696]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA and concern the G70; the signals provide no comparison between markets. [signal:95ee8b06-5b80-498b-9f63-13b22a67b222] [signal:9876385f-5ba1-4158-9873-75612ed6add7] [signal:f1bd7821-c667-488d-ab71-4c965ab97a74] [signal:fbb3f332-d436-4b8d-aa8c-db08f1f3e696]

## Open questions
What caused the reported alerts, and were the issues resolved after dealer attention? The signals do not report the outcome of the planned appointment or the cause of the recurring error. [signal:9876385f-5ba1-4158-9873-75612ed6add7] [signal:fbb3f332-d436-4b8d-aa8c-db08f1f3e696]

value.title: Blind spot monitoring warnings and operation are unreliable
value.summary: Drivers report blind spot monitoring that appears inaccurate or stops working, as well as recurring driver-assistance restriction warnings. Signals come from Europe on an F70 and the USA on G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Reports describe inaccurate or intermittent warnings and recurring system restrictions.
Signals cover Europe (F70) and the USA (G70 and G60); the G70 complaint appears twice.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report blind spot monitoring that appears inaccurate or inconsistent, stops functioning, or triggers a recurring driver-assistance restriction warning. [signal:3f3a4878-d919-4a8d-b08e-c5c5867adc8d] [signal:b5960b64-657a-4d9d-b471-2748a9d935cd] [signal:f401d30e-5de2-4f09-b71c-db24df3aab05]

## What customers say
An F70 owner describes the blind spot visual warning as a promising idea but says it does not seem to work as expected; the available quote is cut off before the specific issue is clear. [signal:3f3a4878-d919-4a8d-b08e-c5c5867adc8d]

A G70 owner reports a daily “support from driver assistance restricted” warning tied to active blind spot detection and says service visits did not resolve the issue. [signal:b5960b64-657a-4d9d-b471-2748a9d935cd]

A G60 owner reports that blind spot warning and lane departure temporarily stopped functioning despite appearing active in settings, then worked again the next day. [signal:f401d30e-5de2-4f09-b71c-db24df3aab05]

## Differences between markets
The Europe signal concerns an F70 and says the visual warning seems problematic in practice, but the quote does not provide the specific failure. [signal:3f3a4878-d919-4a8d-b08e-c5c5867adc8d] The USA signals describe a recurring restriction warning on a G70 and a temporary loss of blind spot warning on a G60. [signal:b5960b64-657a-4d9d-b471-2748a9d935cd] [signal:f401d30e-5de2-4f09-b71c-db24df3aab05]

## Open questions
- What specific behavior did the F70 owner observe? [signal:3f3a4878-d919-4a8d-b08e-c5c5867adc8d]
- What causes the recurring G70 restriction warning, and the temporary G60 loss of function? [signal:b5960b64-657a-4d9d-b471-2748a9d935cd] [signal:f401d30e-5de2-4f09-b71c-db24df3aab05]
- Are the two G70 entries independent reports? [signal:b5960b64-657a-4d9d-b471-2748a9d935cd] [signal:ef5bb319-d8da-47f7-a570-d0c7a3f45938]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the blind spot warning can be difficult to notice or understand: one describes a small, dim mirror light, while others ask about audible alerts or report unexpected alert behavior. [signal:fca3ec8c-d49e-480f-8cd7-6e34ce386e12] [signal:15b0f46c-8196-4162-bcab-fe2374a5c852] [signal:829ca7ec-bd18-4e8c-b9d2-234b0842a052]

One customer wanted to adjust the warning chime volume and was told it could only be switched off; another wanted an audible alert when a vehicle entered the blind spot. [signal:3213abc6-83fd-4cdd-a4a9-844208f00429] [signal:c3553de6-8753-4062-b03c-9d354f7e126f]

## What customers say
A G60 customer said the mirror indicator was too small and dim to notice quickly, and preferred checking by turning their head. [signal:fca3ec8c-d49e-480f-8cd7-6e34ce386e12]

Another G60 customer was still adapting to the monitor and its triangle indicator when a vehicle was in the next lane. [signal:1e4c67ce-569a-4fbf-bd05-462027fcc28e]

A G60 customer asked whether the system gives an audible alert and was told it uses a flashing visual warning and steering-wheel vibration with steering intervention. [signal:15b0f46c-8196-4162-bcab-fe2374a5c852]

A G70 customer reported no warning for a vehicle directly behind despite selecting an early setting; the response cited limitations of the level 2 system. [signal:829ca7ec-bd18-4e8c-b9d2-234b0842a052]

## Differences between markets
The sample contains six USA signals involving G60 and G70 vehicles, and one Europe signal involving an F70. [signal:15b0f46c-8196-4162-bcab-fe2374a5c852] [signal:1e4c67ce-569a-4fbf-bd05-462027fcc28e] [signal:829ca7ec-bd18-4e8c-b9d2-234b0842a052] [signal:fca3ec8c-d49e-480f-8cd7-6e34ce386e12] [signal:3213abc6-83fd-4cdd-a4a9-844208f00429] [signal:c3553de6-8753-4062-b03c-9d354f7e126f] [signal:e4a65d3b-be88-484a-a4c5-a567557e4303]

The Europe signal describes the visual blind-spot warning as a good idea but begins to criticize how it appears in practice; the available quote is incomplete. [signal:e4a65d3b-be88-484a-a4c5-a567557e4303] The USA signals include concerns about indicator visibility, alert behavior, and sound controls. [signal:fca3ec8c-d49e-480f-8cd7-6e34ce386e12] [signal:829ca7ec-bd18-4e8c-b9d2-234b0842a052] [signal:3213abc6-83fd-4cdd-a4a9-844208f00429] [signal:c3553de6-8753-4062-b03c-9d354f7e126f]

## Open questions
What aspect of the visual warning is problematic in the Europe report? The available quote ends before the concern is fully described. [signal:e4a65d3b-be88-484a-a4c5-a567557e4303]

How often do customers miss the indicator or expect an audible alert across the full set of case signals? The provided sample includes these concerns but does not establish their frequency across all ten signals. [signal:fca3ec8c-d49e-480f-8cd7-6e34ce386e12] [signal:15b0f46c-8196-4162-bcab-fe2374a5c852] [signal:c3553de6-8753-4062-b03c-9d354f7e126f]

value.title: Shift paddle functions and operation are unclear

No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers ask what the paddles do, how manual shifting works, and how to activate Boost; one customer pulled the Boost paddle but did not accelerate before the countdown ended, so the car did not react as expected. [signal:3cd8f238-520f-403d-8e6b-aacc70fde93a] [signal:6d389818-eb08-4e39-a03d-0c8d3d7b264f] [signal:71eb0267-98b1-40ce-b906-121213a7f64e] [signal:85187581-18cb-4065-927e-323f01053b21] [signal:96528a0b-8f20-44e9-9afe-5a1049ad74ae] [signal:acdde76e-afe5-4370-a8a4-a2eb55b736b0]

## What customers say
A G60 customer was unsure what the left-side Boost paddle did, and another asked how Boost differed from kick-down. [signal:3cd8f238-520f-403d-8e6b-aacc70fde93a] [signal:85187581-18cb-4065-927e-323f01053b21]
A G70 customer reported seeing a countdown after pulling the Boost paddle but getting no response, and asked how to use it. [signal:6d389818-eb08-4e39-a03d-0c8d3d7b264f]
Customers also asked about the plus/minus paddles and upshift function; one said they preferred automatic driving and probably would not use the paddles. [signal:71eb0267-98b1-40ce-b906-121213a7f64e] [signal:96528a0b-8f20-44e9-9afe-5a1049ad74ae] [signal:acdde76e-afe5-4370-a8a4-a2eb55b736b0]
A Rest of World G70 customer raised a question about the paddle switch turning with the steering wheel, but the available quote ends before the question is complete. [signal:92ca0c93-334c-48af-b8cc-e49311b86145]

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA signals cover G60 and G70 customers asking about paddle functions and operation. [signal:3cd8f238-520f-403d-8e6b-aacc70fde93a] [signal:6d389818-eb08-4e39-a03d-0c8d3d7b264f] [signal:71eb0267-98b1-40ce-b906-121213a7f64e] [signal:85187581-18cb-4065-927e-323f01053b21] [signal:96528a0b-8f20-44e9-9afe-5a1049ad74ae] [signal:acdde76e-afe5-4370-a8a4-a2eb55b736b0]
The sampled Rest of World signal is from a G70 customer and concerns the paddle switch turning with the steering wheel; the quote is incomplete, so the specific concern is unclear. [signal:92ca0c93-334c-48af-b8cc-e49311b86145]

## Open questions
What specifically concerns the Rest of World customer about the paddle switch turning with the steering wheel? [signal:92ca0c93-334c-48af-b8cc-e49311b86145]
The case states there are eight signals, but the supplied sample contains seven; the remaining signal's details are not available here.

Neither comment reports blower reliability or a blower failure [signal:4ba5f686-ecf5-4cca-9549-1360ca61b92f] [signal:fb4c1645-9887-48cc-bcfb-c41e24b7662e].

The signals provide no market comparison about blower reliability [signal:4ba5f686-ecf5-4cca-9549-1360ca61b92f] [signal:fb4c1645-9887-48cc-bcfb-c41e24b7662e].

The signals do not say whether customers experience blower failures, how often they occur, or which markets or vehicle lines are affected.

value.title: Blower noise disrupts comfort, even at low settings
value.summary: Customers in the USA and Rest of World report that the blower is loud or makes unusual noises, with some saying it disrupts driving or leads them to turn it off.
highlights: Blower noise is reported as loud, unusual, or disruptive.
Signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles in the USA, plus G60 in Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report blower or fan noise that they find excessive, including at low settings; one customer says they shut off the windshield blower because of the loudness. [signal:3b9ae64d-afa3-4309-adc0-8b20d6ea0d92] [signal:5f261f46-28a7-4569-a8a6-1e366b7270d7]

Other reports describe a weird sound at high speed, a knocking noise when the air conditioning is on, or noise when heating or air conditioning is turned on. [signal:2e2d4e65-fa89-4efc-b904-99fb857367ed] [signal:5258eb2f-bcb4-4358-accc-6b9443d0b8a6] [signal:0cc59648-876a-4f23-b90e-bf7594ee6f8f]

## What customers say
One G70 customer says the fan is very loud even at the minimum setting and that quieter operation would make driving nicer. [signal:3b9ae64d-afa3-4309-adc0-8b20d6ea0d92] Another says the fan is louder than in their 2017 750i and too loud at low or medium settings. [signal:5f261f46-28a7-4569-a8a6-1e366b7270d7]

A Rest of World G60 customer describes the car as both quiet and powerful, but also says the air-conditioning fan is loud enough to be annoying. [signal:d09ccdfa-0ba9-47df-9d60-f4c8e61af953]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include reports from the USA and Rest of World; the USA reports concern G60 and G70 vehicles, while the Rest of World report concerns a G60. [signal:0cc59648-876a-4f23-b90e-bf7594ee6f8f] [signal:2e2d4e65-fa89-4efc-b904-99fb857367ed] [signal:3b9ae64d-afa3-4309-adc0-8b20d6ea0d92] [signal:5258eb2f-bcb4-4358-accc-6b9443d0b8a6] [signal:5f261f46-28a7-4569-a8a6-1e366b7270d7] [signal:66a5dbae-250a-4d55-875e-3491842bbf29] [signal:d09ccdfa-0ba9-47df-9d60-f4c8e61af953] The Rest of World customer calls the fan annoying, while also describing the car as quiet and powerful. [signal:d09ccdfa-0ba9-47df-9d60-f4c8e61af953]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the cause of the reported noises; the knocking-noise report mentions a possible link to the air-conditioning pumps based on an internet forum, not a confirmed diagnosis. [signal:5258eb2f-bcb4-4358-accc-6b9443d0b8a6]

[signal:33dbf24d-c295-4fbf-8456-910a5596c227] [signal:60edc2c5-c648-4cbc-a5de-66ed599b532a] [signal:6c78b0f0-940e-443d-aefc-301c8d96073e] [signal:8f76bb67-45fb-4a25-851c-fd0917a86fb8] [signal:978dddf8-0d0d-464c-af7c-539360a53086] [signal:b342fe97-7c37-4615-8dac-378a2f11b1ba] No other market is represented in the supplied signals. value.title: Remote engine start fails or needs repeated attempts
value.summary: Some US customers report that remote engine start through the My BMW App fails or does not work on the first attempt. One customer says the vehicle starts with the key fob, but the app has started it successfully only once.
highlights: Remote engine start fails or needs repeated attempts.
Two explicit reports are from US customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Remote engine start through the My BMW App is reported as unreliable: one customer says it fails on the first attempt, while another says it has worked only once. [signal:7bee313a-7b19-4900-a212-40c53cb15382] [signal:834eb865-fdb2-40e9-8000-ed43d37be0ef]

## What customers say
A G60 customer says the app’s remote-start request initially returns “failed.” [signal:7bee313a-7b19-4900-a212-40c53cb15382] A G70 customer says the app displays a retry message and the engine does not start; the customer reports that starting with the key fob works and that app-based starting succeeded only once. [signal:834eb865-fdb2-40e9-8000-ed43d37be0ef]

## Differences between markets
Both explicit reports about remote engine start are from the USA, on G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:7bee313a-7b19-4900-a212-40c53cb15382] [signal:834eb865-fdb2-40e9-8000-ed43d37be0ef] A Europe report mentions difficulty loading the BMW app after a phone change, but does not specifically describe remote engine start. [signal:5282537b-8b0b-4d5a-b7a7-90209e796493]

## Open questions
Do the reported failures share a cause, and are they limited to particular app, phone, or vehicle conditions? [signal:7bee313a-7b19-4900-a212-40c53cb15382] [signal:834eb865-fdb2-40e9-8000-ed43d37be0ef] The available reports do not establish how widespread the issue is. [signal:7bee313a-7b19-4900-a212-40c53cb15382] [signal:834eb865-fdb2-40e9-8000-ed43d37be0ef]

value.title: Airflow vents are difficult to direct and controls are confusing
value.summary: Customers report difficulty directing and understanding airflow, and some find the fan controls confusing or cumbersome. Signals describe these issues in USA G70 and G60 vehicles and Europe F70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers struggle to direct airflow and operate vent or fan controls.
Signals cover USA G70 and G60 vehicles and Europe F70 vehicles.
A USA G70 customer says airflow control is worse than in a Genesis G90.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that vents are hard to direct and it can be difficult to tell where the airflow is going [signal:65479423-8da0-41ae-b5a8-7fc03f373f92] [signal:7106d4d8-7395-460b-81de-46976aba4fb6]. Some also find vent or fan controls confusing or awkward to use [signal:3f28a3c2-bae0-4034-b174-cac7df04cc0b] [signal:9b43234f-4e46-4c26-bfb1-277fd5a54ba6].

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer did not understand that the vent slider opens or closes the vent [signal:2a0cac62-1fba-43e1-bb98-03d217cbfe7e]. Another G70 customer said the fan controls seemed cheap and confusing [signal:3f28a3c2-bae0-4034-b174-cac7df04cc0b].

A USA G60 customer said changing fan speed required several extra taps through the climate screen [signal:4712dde3-3afd-42ef-ba14-e73f35133d7c]. Another G60 customer said the narrow-slot vents made airflow difficult to direct and identify [signal:7106d4d8-7395-460b-81de-46976aba4fb6].

A USA G70 customer said the vents could not direct air onto his face as desired, compared them unfavorably with a Genesis G90, and installed a separate fan [signal:65479423-8da0-41ae-b5a8-7fc03f373f92]. European F70 customers described noisy ventilation, limited control from slotted vents, or awkward vent controls [signal:4c8715ab-bdc9-4e8f-984e-23969fbdfa11] [signal:9b43234f-4e46-4c26-bfb1-277fd5a54ba6].

## Differences between markets
USA signals include difficulty understanding a vent slider, confusing fan controls, extra screen taps to adjust fan speed, and difficulty directing airflow [signal:2a0cac62-1fba-43e1-bb98-03d217cbfe7e] [signal:3f28a3c2-bae0-4034-b174-cac7df04cc0b] [signal:4712dde3-3afd-42ef-ba14-e73f35133d7c] [signal:65479423-8da0-41ae-b5a8-7fc03f373f92] [signal:7106d4d8-7395-460b-81de-46976aba4fb6]. Europe signals describe noisy ventilation, limited vent control, and awkward vent operation [signal:4c8715ab-bdc9-4e8f-984e-23969fbdfa11] [signal:9b43234f-4e46-4c26-bfb1-277fd5a54ba6].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread each specific complaint is across the 22-signal case, or whether experiences differ by vehicle configuration [signal:2a0cac62-1fba-43e1-bb98-03d217cbfe7e] [signal:4c8715ab-bdc9-4e8f-984e-23969fbdfa11] [signal:4712dde3-3afd-42ef-ba14-e73f35133d7c].

value.title: Remote engine start lacks requested control options
value.summary: Some US customers want remote engine start to work alongside preconditioning and to offer temperature control. Other customers value using the app to schedule a start or cool the vehicle before getting in.
highlights: Customers request classic remote start, engine start with preconditioning, and temperature selection.
Signals include US G60 and G70 customers; a European F70 customer praises the app generally.
A US G70 customer says Tesla and Audi offer air-conditioning temperature selection.
value.body_md:

US customers describe different expectations for remote engine start: one prefers the classic feature, while another wants preconditioning to start the engine when the battery is depleted so heating or cooling can operate. [signal:0eafa831-ea02-45b2-8cd3-67da51fca172] [signal:15179525-40f6-4464-93b4-f8c61d40e2e5]

A G70 customer wants to choose the air-conditioning temperature when using remote engine start in the My BMW app. [signal:bd28afde-6450-4b85-bade-9dde48bbe7d2]

## What customers say
A G70 customer appreciates starting the vehicle after golf so it is cool by the time they return. [signal:1b71682c-d317-4e88-ae82-b3697c14718e]

A G60 customer values scheduling through the My BMW App so the vehicle starts and is heated or cooled to their preferred temperature before they get in. [signal:770703df-c9d5-437e-8126-5daae6d3ccc9]

## Differences between markets
The remote-start requests and examples of use in the supplied signals are from the USA, including G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:0eafa831-ea02-45b2-8cd3-67da51fca172] [signal:15179525-40f6-4464-93b4-f8c61d40e2e5] [signal:bd28afde-6450-4b85-bade-9dde48bbe7d2] [signal:1b71682c-d317-4e88-ae82-b3697c14718e] [signal:770703df-c9d5-437e-8126-5daae6d3ccc9]

A European F70 customer praises the BMW app generally, but does not specifically mention remote engine start. [signal:3bbb1d0b-aeb8-455a-85c2-c4e084d857b7]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often customers want engine start to accompany preconditioning when the battery is depleted. [signal:15179525-40f6-4464-93b4-f8c61d40e2e5]

value.title: Lock and unlock behavior lacks expected access and customization
value.summary: Customers report missing or paid-for door-handle access, limited lock-setting choices, and automatic locking behavior they cannot control. These concerns appear across Europe and the USA, with several reports from G60 owners.
highlights: Customers cite missing door-handle access, limited settings, and unwanted automatic locking.
Signals include Europe (F70) and the USA (G60, G70); four relevant USA reports concern G60.
One customer compares the feature with a prior Prius; another says similar functions are standard on most cars.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe lock and unlock functions that do not match their expectations: door-handle buttons may be inactive without an extra-cost option, some settings are not customizable, and automatic locking can happen in unwanted situations. [signal:63f6a8d4-81c9-4b9c-b3dd-54aaab08c58f] [signal:83f92e13-cd89-42ac-8d53-b9acd9a01dd5] [signal:bc24a8dc-87a2-49fc-bcbc-e39d6bcb4a33] [signal:cae882c6-2570-4dd2-b0d7-36b2c16c8bf9]

## What customers say
An F70 owner in Europe says the door-handle button is present but only works with an extra-cost option, and expected this function to be standard. [signal:63f6a8d4-81c9-4b9c-b3dd-54aaab08c58f]

A G60 owner in the USA says the vehicle locked while a Digital Key phone was inside, after another configured phone moved away. [signal:83f92e13-cd89-42ac-8d53-b9acd9a01dd5]

A G60 owner appreciates being able to unlock only the front doors but wants more choices, including a way to unlock the remaining doors using the handle. The owner cites a prior Prius as an example. [signal:bc24a8dc-87a2-49fc-bcbc-e39d6bcb4a33]

Another G60 owner is disappointed about losing the door-lock feature on all four doors. [signal:f18f9624-fc99-407c-87b0-fcd2a4ce97ab]

A G70 owner prefers that the doors not lock automatically while driving and says there is no option to disable this behavior. [signal:cae882c6-2570-4dd2-b0d7-36b2c16c8bf9]

One G60 owner says approach and walk-away auto lock/unlock works well except at home, where repeatedly passing the car causes an issue. [signal:40607b99-a9ac-4641-a56d-18a7c2672a76]

## Differences between markets
The Europe signal is about a door-handle button requiring an extra-cost option. [signal:63f6a8d4-81c9-4b9c-b3dd-54aaab08c58f] USA signals cover locking with a Digital Key inside, unlock customization, automatic locking while driving, loss of a four-door lock feature, and approach/walk-away behavior at home. [signal:83f92e13-cd89-42ac-8d53-b9acd9a01dd5] [signal:bc24a8dc-87a2-49fc-bcbc-e39d6bcb4a33] [signal:cae882c6-2570-4dd2-b0d7-36b2c16c8bf9] [signal:f18f9624-fc99-407c-87b0-fcd2a4ce97ab] [signal:40607b99-a9ac-4641-a56d-18a7c2672a76]

## Open questions
Do other customers experience the door-handle button as an unexpected extra-cost feature? [signal:63f6a8d4-81c9-4b9c-b3dd-54aaab08c58f]

## Problem

[signal:9617a75e-a4a4-41b0-b36e-3a0b0d07c259] A fourth wants rear fog lights to be standard on future vehicles. [signal:e8e11e0d-3073-41b3-98c7-6a0bcbfc5fd9]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA and concern the G60; no other market or vehicle line is represented. [signal:29eeba6c-2a84-4b5e-837c-055e5f3acdfa] [signal:87e8334f-0fd2-49f4-b147-03e682f0084f] [signal:9617a75e-a4a4-41b0-b36e-3a0b0d07c259] [signal:e8e11e0d-3073-41b3-98c7-6a0bcbfc5fd9]

## Open questions

value.title: Remote Engine Start fails or is difficult to use
value.summary: Some US G60 and G70 owners report that Remote Engine Start fails, times out, or is confusing to activate. One owner received a message that only the fan could be turned on.
highlights: Remote Engine Start can fail, time out, or be confusing to activate.
US reports include G60 and G70 vehicles, with two directly relevant examples for each.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners report that Remote Engine Start through the My BMW app fails, times out, or returns a message that the vehicle cannot be started remotely. [signal:1ff525de-c2cf-433e-a904-1ec9d1837371] [signal:52730156-4c75-441d-9ba6-2e28f102be90] One owner said the app indicated that only the fan could be turned on, not the engine. [signal:73a15b0d-d3ed-480c-ac0a-340d34f961fd]

## What customers say
A G70 owner asked for instructions on using Remote Start in the app. [signal:46b6ac86-8711-4522-b923-74af83729217] Another G70 owner said requests timed out or failed; the response explained that a disclaimer must be accepted in the vehicle settings. [signal:52730156-4c75-441d-9ba6-2e28f102be90] A G60 owner reported repeated app failures and said remote start through the key fob typically failed as well. [signal:1ff525de-c2cf-433e-a904-1ec9d1837371]

## Differences between markets
The directly relevant examples provided are from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:1ff525de-c2cf-433e-a904-1ec9d1837371] [signal:46b6ac86-8711-4522-b923-74af83729217] [signal:52730156-4c75-441d-9ba6-2e28f102be90] [signal:73a15b0d-d3ed-480c-ac0a-340d34f961fd] The signals do not provide evidence for comparing markets.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether failed starts share a cause, or how often accepting the disclaimer resolves the issue. [signal:1ff525de-c2cf-433e-a904-1ec9d1837371] [signal:52730156-4c75-441d-9ba6-2e28f102be90] They also do not show how widespread the fan-only message is. [signal:73a15b0d-d3ed-480c-ac0a-340d34f961fd]

value.title: Door unlocking behavior is confusing and inconsistent
value.summary: Customers report difficulty understanding lock and unlock settings, and some doors do not unlock as they expect. The signals include drivers of G60, G70 and F70 vehicles in the USA, Europe and Rest of World.
highlights: Door unlocking can be confusing, slow or require unexpected extra steps.
Signals include G60 and G70 drivers in the USA, F70 drivers in Europe and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe lock and unlock behavior that is difficult to understand or does not match their expectations, including rear or passenger doors remaining locked and doors requiring multiple clicks to open. [signal:21255737-09af-4dba-874f-60db6960a666] [signal:3a6bd302-f3c0-4456-a9d6-d8b7073d2f4e] [signal:708aa64e-8127-4de7-8fe3-0b892fbe2b4d]

Some customers do not know how to change the relevant settings, while another reports that keyless unlocking sometimes reacts slowly. [signal:3b951b67-d167-4841-8e5e-9926b115644e] [signal:631a94cd-8ea3-48bf-939c-219bd8b54f4d]

## What customers say
A G60 customer wants the rear door to unlock at the same time as the other doors and describes uncertainty about how the automatic locking behavior is configured. [signal:21255737-09af-4dba-874f-60db6960a666]

Other G60 customers report that doors do not unlock as expected when exiting or opening the driver door; one says he knows the behavior can be changed but does not know how. [signal:3a6bd302-f3c0-4456-a9d6-d8b7073d2f4e] [signal:3b951b67-d167-4841-8e5e-9926b115644e]

An F70 customer says the driver door takes a double click to open and the passenger doors remain locked, and another describes the lock as hard to open. [signal:708aa64e-8127-4de7-8fe3-0b892fbe2b4d] [signal:966ecf9e-cec9-44bd-8c8d-6341c6cc18fe]

A G70 customer asks for doors to unlock automatically at the end of a trip; the response in the signal points to a setting for this behavior. [signal:2b83044a-ace5-4116-a85f-1d874070cfbc]

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA signals include G60 reports about door selection and settings, as well as a G70 request for automatic unlocking at the end of a trip. [signal:21255737-09af-4dba-874f-60db6960a666] [signal:3b951b67-d167-4841-8e5e-9926b115644e] [signal:2b83044a-ace5-4116-a85f-1d874070cfbc]

The sampled Europe signals include F70 complaints about doors staying locked, double-click operation and slow keyless unlocking, as well as a complaint about locking when two drivers are in the car. [signal:708aa64e-8127-4de7-8fe3-0b892fbe2b4d] [signal:631a94cd-8ea3-48bf-939c-219bd8b54f4d] [signal:37e3e916-5cbd-48e5-af2f-13808b8f33b3]

A Rest of World F70 customer says the lock is hard to open. The signals describe different experiences and do not establish whether these differences are market-wide. [signal:966ecf9e-cec9-44bd-8c8d-6341c6cc18fe]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common each reported behavior is across the 40 signals, or whether the reported issues share a cause. [signal:21255737-09af-4dba-874f-60db6960a666] [signal:708aa64e-8127-4de7-8fe3-0b892fbe2b4d] [signal:631a94cd-8ea3-48bf-939c-219bd8b54f4d]

value.title: Vehicle locks behave unpredictably and can lock occupants inside
value.summary: Customers report inconsistent phone-key unlocking, unwanted relocking and vehicles locking while they are inside. Reports come from USA and Europe across G60, G70 and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Phone-key unlocking fails, or vehicles lock and unlock unexpectedly—including while occupants are inside.
Reports span USA and Europe, and G60, G70 and F70 vehicles.
Mercedes is mentioned for app and window functions, not lock reliability.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe unreliable or unpredictable locking: doors sometimes fail to unlock on approach, vehicles relock after being unlocked, or locking occurs while someone is inside. [signal:10f3eb4a-bfec-44f3-b17b-04f0bdad0e1e] [signal:4c102286-a278-4aa9-ae41-0dda2e2320ae] Some also report repeated locking and unlocking near the vehicle or difficulty choosing between two drivers’ phones. [signal:64fe0e6a-0341-43b8-83d7-6b46b1ad7fe7] [signal:8a50d75c-b49a-43c9-9f43-1f2cc535a846]

## What customers say
One G60 owner says phone-key unlocking fails about every other week, requiring use of the app. [signal:10f3eb4a-bfec-44f3-b17b-04f0bdad0e1e] Other G60 owners describe unwanted relocking after disabling walk-away auto-lock, repeated locking and unlocking near the car, and difficulty getting all doors to unlock on approach. [signal:20cf4d54-bfbd-4875-a683-cd8773c5d308] [signal:64fe0e6a-0341-43b8-83d7-6b46b1ad7fe7] [signal:68b6d0d1-7595-40d5-a632-6f3801290635]

F70 owners in Europe report the car locking while they are nearby or inside; one account says this set off the alarm, disabled the vehicle and required BMW assistance. [signal:43a117c4-73de-4987-920d-a573570445c2] [signal:4c102286-a278-4aa9-ae41-0dda2e2320ae] A G70 owner also reports doors locking while they were inside after an update, followed by the car not starting; the dealer identified a faulty battery. [signal:819f5911-1081-42da-8729-1aba88a4e218]

## Differences between markets
USA reports include G60 and G70 vehicles, with concerns about phone-key unlocking, door-selection behavior and locking while inside. [signal:10f3eb4a-bfec-44f3-b17b-04f0bdad0e1e] [signal:20cf4d54-bfbd-4875-a683-cd8773c5d308] [signal:64fe0e6a-0341-43b8-83d7-6b46b1ad7fe7] [signal:68b6d0d1-7595-40d5-a632-6f3801290635] [signal:819f5911-1081-42da-8729-1aba88a4e218] Europe reports include F70 concerns about relocking and locking while occupants are inside, as well as a G60 report of being locked out after leaving a phone or keys inside. [signal:43a117c4-73de-4987-920d-a573570445c2] [signal:4c102286-a278-4aa9-ae41-0dda2e2320ae] [signal:a205bde4-0551-42bf-8c17-de0e56ca96f6] The signals do not establish whether the issue differs in frequency or severity between markets. [signal:10f3eb4a-bfec-44f3-b17b-04f0bdad0e1e] [signal:4c102286-a278-4aa9-ae41-0dda2e2320ae]

## Open questions
Do the reported behaviors share a cause, or are they distinct issues involving phone keys, remote keys, walk-away locking or software updates? [signal:10f3eb4a-bfec-44f3-b17b-04f0bdad0e1e] [signal:4c102286-a278-4aa9-ae41-0dda2e2320ae] [signal:64fe0e6a-0341-43b8-83d7-6b46b1ad7fe7] [signal:819f5911-1081-42da-8729-1aba88a4e218] How often do they occur across vehicles and markets? The signals provide individual accounts, not a comparable rate. [signal:10f3eb4a-bfec-44f3-b17b-04f0bdad0e1e] [signal:4c102286-a278-4aa9-ae41-0dda2e2320ae] [signal:68b6d0d1-7595-40d5-a632-6f3801290635]

## Problem

An F70 owner says the doors do not seem very solid. [signal:4b7e3558-80e6-424e-8d53-38bda006604f] Other F70 owners criticize the door material or report driver-door alignment as a quality issue. [signal:4207d14d-d71d-4d5c-a22b-1429c18e0b5b] [signal:3862ba30-74dd-4705-badb-8c25198c8648] A G60 owner says the lower door panels feel like cheap plastic compared with the soundproof material and leather in their previous car. [signal:4762764a-5f48-48f9-ab19-eb788373b18e]

Views differ: one USA G60 owner says the car felt more solidly put together than Tesla and Lucid, while other owners report door-quality concerns. [signal:00b5d33b-4f87-49e6-9625-ca531b9021a2] [signal:4b7e3558-80e6-424e-8d53-38bda006604f]

The supplied signals include door-quality concerns from Europe on F70 and G60 vehicles, and from Rest of World on a G60. [signal:4b7e3558-80e6-424e-8d53-38bda006604f] [signal:4207d14d-d71d-4d5c-a22b-1429c18e0b5b] [signal:3862ba30-74dd-4705-badb-8c25198c8648] [signal:4762764a-5f48-48f9-ab19-eb788373b18e] [signal:2d1b55ed-ae6c-4c0e-9e2a-31d3df17324a] The USA G60 signal is positive about perceived solidity relative to Tesla and Lucid. [signal:00b5d33b-4f87-49e6-9625-ca531b9021a2]

## Open questions
Do the material and solidity concerns vary by vehicle line, market or specific door area? [signal:4b7e3558-80e6-424e-8d53-38bda006604f] [signal:4207d14d-d71d-4d5c-a22b-1429c18e0b5b] [signal:3862ba30-74dd-4705-badb-8c25198c8648] [signal:4762764a-5f48-48f9-ab19-eb788373b18e] [signal:2d1b55ed-ae6c-4c0e-9e2a-31d3df17324a]

value.title: Wireless charging is slow, hard to use, or does not fit
value.summary: Customers report slow or limited charging, difficulty using the tray, and phones that do not fit; others value the charging tray. Signals span USA G60/G70, Europe F70, and Rest of World G70.
highlights: Charging can be slow or ineffective, and some trays are hard to use or too narrow.
In the provided sample: USA G60/G70 complaints, Europe F70 mixed feedback, and one Rest of World G70 complaint.
One customer compares charging wattage unfavorably with other cars in the same class.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers say wireless charging can be slow or ineffective, particularly while using Apple CarPlay, and some report that the tray is difficult to use or too narrow for their phone. [signal:315eea2a-3a37-4840-b9c7-800034f32bd8] [signal:5054c4bc-0b0e-46a7-8517-ef14ba48adea] [signal:76838416-19a6-47bf-b7a0-99710527efec] A Rest of World G70 customer also reports that heat during charging slows it down. [signal:0aa737cb-f530-4287-a400-46b705bf8540]

## What customers say
In the USA, G60 customers describe not knowing how to use the pad, a tray that will not fit phones larger than an iPhone 13, and charging that seems slow or below full capacity. [signal:1443bda3-ed5e-43c3-965b-283830d74a9b] [signal:5054c4bc-0b0e-46a7-8517-ef14ba48adea] [signal:315eea2a-3a37-4840-b9c7-800034f32bd8] A G60 customer who uses the tray for a wallet says it turns back on after being disabled. [signal:5531bafb-c1f0-4385-91c7-3cf49741c7d9] USA G70 customers say charging feels slow or mainly maintains the phone’s battery while CarPlay is in use. [signal:6c0e34cd-480a-4824-aa60-39b8fb496f2a] [signal:76838416-19a6-47bf-b7a0-99710527efec]

Feedback is not uniformly negative: two Europe F70 customers praise the phone charging tray, while another says they miss having a charging pad in the car. [signal:5b9aa8d7-dc84-4df2-96ec-9bf2a1f157e8] [signal:c09a31ca-49db-4f11-88c2-9f26acf9f93b] [signal:499279a3-1db1-4405-afb5-7d25c409be81]

## Differences between markets
The provided sample includes USA complaints about usability, fit, and charging performance on G60 and G70; Europe F70 feedback includes both praise and a complaint about the missing pad. [signal:1443bda3-ed5e-43c3-965b-283830d74a9b] [signal:315eea2a-3a37-4840-b9c7-800034f32bd8] [signal:5054c4bc-0b0e-46a7-8517-ef14ba48adea] [signal:5531bafb-c1f0-4385-91c7-3cf49741c7d9] [signal:6c0e34cd-480a-4824-aa60-39b8fb496f2a] [signal:76838416-19a6-47bf-b7a0-99710527efec] [signal:5b9aa8d7-dc84-4df2-96ec-9bf2a1f157e8] [signal:c09a31ca-49db-4f11-88c2-9f26acf9f93b] [signal:499279a3-1db1-4405-afb5-7d25c409be81] One Rest of World G70 complaint links charging heat to slower charging. [signal:0aa737cb-f530-4287-a400-46b705bf8540]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often phones fail to fit across phone models, or whether reported slow charging depends on the phone, case, or vehicle conditions. [signal:5054c4bc-0b0e-46a7-8517-ef14ba48adea] [signal:315eea2a-3a37-4840-b9c7-800034f32bd8] The G60 report mentions profile sign-in as relevant to the tray setting, but does not confirm whether that resolved the repeated reactivation. [signal:5531bafb-c1f0-4385-91c7-3cf49741c7d9]

[signal:08c222eb-eb1d-4506-ad39-728ee692d2cd] [signal:3cef540e-9efd-47dc-9175-65bae9b4e3f3] [signal:b48b2b7c-fbb0-4702-bb1e-267ed96f5cf2]

The sampled requests for a higher-grade stereo, audio profiles, and concerns about the volume control come from USA G60 or G70 owners. [signal:47621eb5-72e0-43ed-8944-7384568dbcc9] [signal:78f5bdd6-eb69-467c-8e63-a5e277b6f0e3] [signal:661dd086-7fc0-486c-b308-87791610e32c] [signal:a29603ea-333f-474a-9d71-06c89f7782cd]

value.title: Audio quality and reliability concerns across BMW models
value.summary: Customers report weak or disappointing sound, audio component failures, and inconsistent radio behavior. The signals include USA owners of G60 and G70 vehicles and a Europe F70 owner.
highlights: Audio sound quality and reliability complaints range from weak bass to component failures.
Signals include USA G60 and G70 owners and a Europe F70 owner.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe disappointing audio quality, including weak bass and midrange, and report failures or inconsistent behavior involving audio components and the radio. [signal:03106d66-85a2-46e4-8b34-af1a57b7b2ae] [signal:1f9d1e1e-cb05-4e2c-8f58-5f7f84c5dbe6] [signal:9c1e7af8-53dc-491d-b1ec-586e99cccecc] One G70 owner also reported a black main screen that prevented access to functions. [signal:507a08ce-20e2-4051-9ed2-a665f2da0b10]

## What customers say
A G70 owner called the upgraded Bowers & Wilkins system disappointing, particularly when turned up, citing a lack of bass and midrange. [signal:03106d66-85a2-46e4-8b34-af1a57b7b2ae] A G60 owner reported that the bass stopped working after about a week; the dealership replaced the amplifier, and the customer said the bass then worked correctly without further issues. [signal:1f9d1e1e-cb05-4e2c-8f58-5f7f84c5dbe6] Another G70 owner said the car arrived with a bad speaker that was later replaced. [signal:c169d300-61d6-470a-8eeb-98fda2e5f03d] A G60 owner reported that the radio turned back on after exiting the vehicle and closing the door, and only turned off after locking the car. [signal:9c1e7af8-53dc-491d-b1ec-586e99cccecc]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include complaints from G60 and G70 owners about sound quality, audio failures, and radio behavior. [signal:03106d66-85a2-46e4-8b34-af1a57b7b2ae] [signal:1f9d1e1e-cb05-4e2c-8f58-5f7f84c5dbe6] [signal:507a08ce-20e2-4051-9ed2-a665f2da0b10] [signal:9c1e7af8-53dc-491d-b1ec-586e99cccecc] [signal:c169d300-61d6-470a-8eeb-98fda2e5f03d] The Europe F70 signal criticizes the exhaust sound, describing speaker-generated pops as disappointing for a performance model. [signal:8442547d-49af-4c0d-b24b-1feb7068b7ad] These signals describe different sound concerns; they do not establish whether experiences differ systematically by market. [signal:03106d66-85a2-46e4-8b34-af1a57b7b2ae] [signal:8442547d-49af-4c0d-b24b-1feb7068b7ad]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these audio complaints are across owners or whether the reported issues share a cause. [signal:03106d66-85a2-46e4-8b34-af1a57b7b2ae] [signal:1f9d1e1e-cb05-4e2c-8f58-5f7f84c5dbe6] [signal:9c1e7af8-53dc-491d-b1ec-586e99cccecc] The G60 owner whose amplifier was replaced reported no further issue, but the signals do not provide longer-term outcomes. [signal:1f9d1e1e-cb05-4e2c-8f58-5f7f84c5dbe6]

Signals cover G60 and F70 vehicles in the USA, Europe, and Rest of World.
One G60 owner says the sound system is weak compared with rivals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Audio experiences differ: some customers report weak sound, poor Bluetooth audio, inability to play music over USB, or disruptive CarPlay volume behavior [signal:d488c8c7-f472-437c-8b95-62c5f308ed9c] [signal:cd51412a-4ffd-4408-9c05-67f17c4892c0] [signal:e2c98286-419f-4c6-9af4-f937e4f10627]. Other customers describe the audio as excellent, good, or brilliant [signal:1f72499d-553b-4171-9bd9-670591b30ce8] [signal:0592b0a8-ade8-408f-9ce3-4d656273302f] [signal:5686b75f-9800-4013-b4ae-38f3023dad21] [signal:83ac79c2-94a5-4cc4-b93b-8713d24434f6] [signal:bd5e5bdd-9543-4115-825b-ffc65269569b].

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner says the sound system is weak compared with rivals [signal:d488c8c7-f472-437c-8b95-62c5f308ed9c]. Another USA G60 owner reports needing to set radio volume very high to hear CarPlay audio normally, after which incoming calls can be excessively loud [signal:e2c98286-419f-4c6-9af4-f937e4f10627]. A Rest of World F70 owner says USB music cannot be played and Bluetooth sound quality is poor [signal:cd51412a-4ffd-4408-9c05-67f17c4892c0].

Positive feedback also appears: USA G60 owners call the speakers or audio excellent [signal:1f72499d-553b-4171-9bd9-670591b30ce8] [signal:0592b0a8-ade8-408f-9ce3-4d656273302f], while Europe G60 and F70 owners praise the audio [signal:5686b75f-9800-4013-b4ae-38f3023dad21] [signal:83ac79c2-94a5-4cc4-b93b-8713d24434f6] [signal:bd5e5bdd-9543-4115-825b-ffc65269569b].

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals show both positive and negative audio feedback in the USA: praise for sound quality alongside complaints about weak sound and CarPlay volume behavior [signal:1f72499d-553b-4171-9bd9-670591b30ce8] [signal:0592b0a8-ade8-408f-9ce3-4d656273302f] [signal:d488c8c7-f472-437c-8b95-62c5f308ed9c] [signal:e2c98286-419f-4c6-9af4-f937e4f10627]. Europe G60 and F70 signals praise the sound [signal:5686b75f-9800-4013-b4ae-38f3023dad21] [signal:83ac79c2-94a5-4cc4-b93b-8713d24434f6] [signal:bd5e5bdd-9543-4115-825b-ffc65269569b], while the Rest of World F70 signal reports USB and Bluetooth problems [signal:cd51412a-4ffd-4408-9c05-67f17c4892c0].

## Open questions
Do the reported sound-quality differences relate to audio system configuration, vehicle line, or market? [signal:d488c8c7-f472-437c-8b95-62c5f308ed9c] [signal:5686b75f-9800-4013-b4ae-38f3023dad21] [signal:83ac79c2-94a5-4cc4-b93b-8713d24434f6] What causes the reported CarPlay volume behavior and the USB and Bluetooth playback issues? value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 owners dislike the artificial engine sound, with one calling it a major letdown on an M model and another saying it is not to everyone’s taste. [signal:9833630a-6e68-4f52-ab37-bc8c6b40284c] [signal:aa527a7a-c5dd-4b46-88fd-83f62b50c246] One owner also says the Harman Kardon sound system is disappointing compared with the systems in four previous BMWs. [signal:c9164288-05be-423f-afe5-d22a40250255]

## What customers say
One owner says the artificial engine sound is a major letdown on an M model. [signal:9833630a-6e68-4f52-ab37-bc8c6b40284c] Another says their previous Mk8 Golf R sounded better. [signal:aa527a7a-c5dd-4b46-88fd-83f62b50c246] A customer comparing several 1 Series BMWs says the F70’s speaker facings use less appealing plastics than those on their previous F40 with Harman Kardon. [signal:6d720b4e-c333-4788-b22c-f0df538f09d5] A separate owner reports disappointing Harman Kardon sound-system quality relative to four previous BMWs. [signal:c9164288-05be-423f-afe5-d22a40250255]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from Europe and concern the F70. [signal:6d720b4e-c333-4788-b22c-f0df538f09d5] [signal:9833630a-6e68-4f52-ab37-bc8c6b40284c] [signal:aa527a7a-c5dd-4b46-88fd-83f62b50c246] [signal:c9164288-05be-423f-afe5-d22a40250255] Two owners criticize the artificial engine sound; one also reports concerns about speaker facings, while another criticizes Harman Kardon sound quality. [signal:6d720b4e-c333-4788-b22c-f0df538f09d5] [signal:9833630a-6e68-4f52-ab37-bc8c6b40284c] [signal:aa527a7a-c5dd-4b46-88fd-83f62b50c246] [signal:c9164288-05be-423f-afe5-d22a40250255]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these sound concerns are among F70 owners. [signal:6d720b4e-c333-4788-b22c-f0df538f09d5] [signal:9833630a-6e68-4f52-ab37-bc8c6b40284c] [signal:aa527a7a-c5dd-4b46-88fd-83f62b50c246] [signal:c9164288-05be-423f-afe5-d22a40250255] They also do not clarify whether the audio-system criticism concerns sound quality, speaker materials, or both across customers. [signal:6d720b4e-c333-4788-b22c-f0df538f09d5] [signal:c9164288-05be-423f-afe5-d22a40250255]

highlights: F70 engine or exhaust sound is described as too quiet, artificial, or disappointing; a G70 speaker complaint cites insufficient volume.
Signals cover six Europe F70 reports, one Rest of World F70 report, and one USA G70 report.
One Europe F70 report says other cars in the class have far better sound.
value.body_md:
## Problem
F70 customers describe the engine or exhaust sound as too quiet, artificial, or lacking a real exhaust note. [signal:3e2670ab-bb1b-465a-8a34-432c8a402147] [signal:625e6f4b-62fd-4ae8-a462-78990d96b1f6] [signal:6a64d9d4-8ce8-4d3c-b787-375e52c7418c] [signal:81cd9ac9-f67c-4974-b2b6-68fae95c0d81] [signal:98cd29ec-1088-46ec-a699-9a4e6641819d]
A USA G70 customer says the speakers do not get loud enough and expects the audio to be loud and clear. [signal:4fd73552-14a0-414f-954e-7a4ebaec8133]

## What customers say
Some F70 customers object to fake internal engine sound or noise cancelling and want a more natural sporty tone. [signal:3e2670ab-bb1b-465a-8a34-432c8a402147] [signal:625e6f4b-62fd-4ae8-a462-78990d96b1f6]
Other F70 comments describe the sound as a letdown, too quiet, or missing a real exhaust note. [signal:6a64d9d4-8ce8-4d3c-b787-375e52c7418c] [signal:81cd9ac9-f67c-4974-b2b6-68fae95c0d81] [signal:98cd29ec-1088-46ec-a699-9a4e6641819d]
One Europe F70 report says other cars in the class have far better sound. [signal:98cd29ec-1088-46ec-a699-9a4e6641819d]
The signal marked as a like repeats the same critical sound text as a complaint signal. [signal:d21b18b3-5e13-448e-8917-7279e96dae08] [signal:98cd29ec-1088-46ec-a699-9a4e6641819d]

## Differences between markets
Six signals are from Europe about the F70, one is from Rest of World about the F70, and one is from the USA about the G70. [signal:3e2670ab-bb1b-465a-8a34-432c8a402147] [signal:56cd9faf-a0fc-4d4e-bd0a-99e3982f1b13] [signal:625e6f4b-62fd-4ae8-a462-78990d96b1f6] [signal:6a64d9d4-8ce8-4d3c-b787-375e52c7418c] [signal:98cd29ec-1088-46ec-a699-9a4e6641819d] [signal:d21b18b3-5e13-448e-8917-7279e96dae08] [signal:81cd9ac9-f67c-4974-b2b6-68fae95c0d81] [signal:4fd73552-14a0-414f-954e-7a4ebaec8133]
The Europe and Rest of World F70 comments concern engine or exhaust sound, while the USA G70 comment concerns speaker volume and clarity. [signal:3e2670ab-bb1b-465a-8a34-432c8a402147] [signal:625e6f4b-62fd-4ae8-a462-78990d96b1f6] [signal:6a64d9d4-8ce8-4d3c-b787-375e52c7418c] [signal:81cd9ac9-f67c-4974-b2b6-68fae95c0d81] [signal:98cd29ec-1088-46ec-a699-9a4e6641819d] [signal:4fd73552-14a0-414f-954e-7a4ebaec8133]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify whether the general request for better sound refers to engine sound, exhaust sound, or in-car audio. [signal:56cd9faf-a0fc-4d4e-bd0a-99e3982f1b13]
The signals do not establish how widespread the speaker-volume concern is beyond the single USA G70 report. [signal:4fd73552-14a0-414f-954e-7a4ebaec8133]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA. [signal:47041a06-bf7d-4a60-9c47-8d4c100e4f97] [signal:dcbce095-e35d-4dab-a05c-8937e234aaf0] [signal:0c9b7fd1-987e-48d8-8dbe-70cdca23d2d1] [signal:2f4c5fe0-bf1a-49e4-b555-1b4b0dddd3ba] Feedback differs by topic: customers raised concerns about controls and knee cushioning, while other customers expressed positive views about the doors and rear-door screens. [signal:47041a06-bf7d-4a60-9c47-8d4c100e4f97] [signal:dcbce095-e35d-4dab-a05c-8937e234aaf0] [signal:0c9b7fd1-987e-48d8-8dbe-70cdca23d2d1] [signal:2f4c5fe0-bf1a-49e4-b555-1b4b0dddd3ba]

## Open questions
How prevalent are the touch-button and knee-cushioning concerns beyond the individual G60 and G70 reports? [signal:47041a06-bf7d-4a60-9c47-8d4c100e4f97] [signal:dcbce095-e35d-4dab-a05c-8937e234aaf0]

value.title: My BMW App status and charging information feel unreliable or incomplete
value.summary: Some US customers want more current vehicle status, more dependable charging information, and additional vehicle-tracking details in the My BMW App, while other customers value its convenience and remote functions.
highlights: US customers report stale vehicle status and charging information, and want more tracking details.
Signals cover US G60/G70, Europe F70, and Rest-of-World F70 customers.
A customer says BMW video tutorials helped with the transition and Mercedes lacked a comparable offering.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some US customers say the My BMW App does not show vehicle status in real time and want it to include vehicle-production and transport tracking.[signal:6c8908bd-e860-4f69-a0ec-02f8d819f884] [signal:b9122dd3-d6f7-4379-8f30-66998dce2a45] One customer reports that charging locations shown in the app and car navigation often have chargers that are unavailable or fail to start charging.[signal:04a96e89-94f7-491f-90e1-03bda6515ac2]

## What customers say
A G60 customer says the app status reflects the last time the vehicle was locked and requires a message to the car to update.[signal:6c8908bd-e860-4f69-a0ec-02f8d819f884] A G70 customer says roughly two-thirds of the Electrify America chargers they visit are broken or already in use, and describes charging failing to start after repeated connection attempts.[signal:04a96e89-94f7-491f-90e1-03bda6515ac2]

Other customers praise the app: one says remote starting works well, and European F70 owners describe the app as working well, convenient, or useful for seeing vehicle information and alerts.[signal:3884557a-337d-444c-b1ef-00eb56e46ad7] [signal:4a7134ee-2be7-4c9b-b0f6-490cb43e5a0b] [signal:631aaebf-643a-40f7-af05-47401f8c6167] [signal:64844042-0c06-4690-92d7-9cc74fa935c7] [signal:b24f3dd8-2485-4c74-99c7-a232e39b1b34]

## Differences between markets
The sampled US signals include requests and complaints about status updates, charging information, and production or transport tracking.[signal:6c8908bd-e860-4f69-a0ec-02f8d819f884] [signal:04a96e89-94f7-491f-90e1-03bda6515ac2] [signal:b9122dd3-d6f7-4379-8f30-66998dce2a45] Sampled European F70 signals are positive about the app, while a Rest-of-World F70 customer also calls the app connection convenient.[signal:4a7134ee-2be7-4c9b-b0f6-490cb43e5a0b] [signal:631aaebf-643a-40f7-af05-47401f8c6167] [signal:64844042-0c06-4690-92d7-9cc74fa935c7] [signal:b24f3dd8-2485-4c74-99c7-a232e39b1b34] The signals therefore include both app praise and reported gaps; they do not establish how widespread either experience is.[signal:6c8908bd-e860-4f69-a0ec-02f8d819f884] [signal:4a7134ee-2be7-4c9b-b0f6-490cb43e5a0b]

## Open questions
Do other customers also find that vehicle status is not current unless they prompt an update?[signal:6c8908bd-e860-4f69-a0ec-02f8d819f884] How often do charging locations shown in the app correspond to chargers that are available and able to start charging?[signal:04a96e89-94f7-491f-90e1-03bda6515ac2] How many customers want vehicle production photos or video and transport tracking in the app?[signal:b9122dd3-d6f7-4379-8f30-66998dce2a45]

value.title: BMW app connections and functions work inconsistently
value.summary: Customers report slow or failed connections, account access problems, and app functions or vehicle data that stop working or disappear. Signals come from USA G70, Europe F70, and Rest of World F70 owners.
highlights: App connections and functions are inconsistent; some data disappears or stops updating.
Reports cover USA G70, Europe F70, and Rest of World F70 owners.
One customer rates BMW luxury above Mercedes, but gives no competitor app-reliability comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe app connections that are slow, awkward, or fail, alongside functions that stop working or data that disappears. [signal:1231cf43-6ae9-4337-9b30-bee50859af30] [signal:1b653776-8a47-4bca-b0e8-e1e0aa085d9b] [signal:61ad43bc-d36b-467a-aa35-784ce6e60484] A USA customer also reports being locked out despite entering the account information correctly. [signal:2e9a5fa0-8359-4c93-88c0-66bf54ba7500]

## What customers say
A G70 owner says the car can be slow or unable to connect to a phone on short drives; another says app alerts arrive for only one of two BMWs. [signal:1231cf43-6ae9-4337-9b30-bee50859af30] [signal:22527061-71bc-48c6-bc10-369cff1764b1] F70 owners report trip statistics stopping, trips vanishing, mileage disappearing and later returning, and general stability and functionality problems. [signal:1b653776-8a47-4bca-b0e8-e1e0aa085d9b] [signal:61ad43bc-d36b-467a-aa35-784ce6e60484] [signal:7bb3244c-06f4-4cda-a3ef-af7cc2d7f815] One G70 owner describes difficulty sending videos from the car to the app, while another says rear-seat eSIM connectivity stops working despite appearing active in both the app and the carrier account. [signal:3690592b-b740-4b27-8c79-f3d358f6a86a] [signal:4c304e4a-a793-4823-b495-727d38ae2620]

## Differences between markets
USA reports in this sample concern G70 vehicles and include phone connection delays, account access, alerts, video transfer, and eSIM connectivity. [signal:1231cf43-6ae9-4337-9b30-bee50859af30] [signal:2e9a5fa0-8359-4c93-88c0-66bf54ba7500] [signal:22527061-71bc-48c6-bc10-369cff1764b1] [signal:3690592b-b740-4b27-8c79-f3d358f6a86a] [signal:4c304e4a-a793-4823-b495-727d38ae2620] Europe reports concern F70 app connection, trip statistics, and stability or functionality. [signal:1b653776-8a47-4bca-b0e8-e1e0aa085d9b] [signal:2f563b42-6597-4b9e-a0ec-c994fdf025bb] [signal:61ad43bc-d36b-467a-aa35-784ce6e60484] A Rest of World F70 owner reports mileage disappearing and returning without intervention. [signal:7bb3244c-06f4-4cda-a3ef-af7cc2d7f815] These are differences in the reported examples; the signals do not establish that reliability differs by market.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often each issue occurs across the wider customer base. [signal:1231cf43-6ae9-4337-9b30-bee50859af30] [signal:1b653776-8a47-4bca-b0e8-e1e0aa085d9b] They also do not clarify whether the reported failures share a cause or how long the problems last. [signal:61ad43bc-d36b-467a-aa35-784ce6e60484] [signal:7bb3244c-06f4-4cda-a3ef-af7cc2d7f815]

value.title: Front door panels feel flimsy, rough or low quality
value.summary: Customers report flimsy-feeling front door panels, a rough edge, rattles and low-quality door-card materials. Signals come from F70 owners in Europe and G60 owners in the USA.
highlights: Front door panels feel flimsy or low quality, and some doors rattle.
Concerns appear in Europe on F70 and in the USA on G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe front door panels as flimsy, rough-edged or low quality, and report rattles from passenger-side doors. [signal:7b77e95b-aaab-4f2e-a697-35920d6554d6] [signal:d63227d2-9156-42b5-8504-f2459414f2bd] [signal:e59737b3-cb0c-40aa-b300-5d23af2f6413] [signal:ebc93082-03de-4d13-a080-79c03a777c33]

## What customers say
An F70 owner says the front door panels feel flimsy and describes a rough patch on the inner edge of a front door. [signal:7b77e95b-aaab-4f2e-a697-35920d6554d6]
An F70 owner reports a rattle in the passenger door and says something seems loose behind the door card. [signal:d63227d2-9156-42b5-8504-f2459414f2bd]
A G60 owner reports an annoying rattle from the passenger-side door. [signal:e59737b3-cb0c-40aa-b300-5d23af2f6413]
Another G60 owner calls the door cards low quality and points to hard plastic in the lower section. [signal:ebc93082-03de-4d13-a080-79c03a777c33]

## Differences between markets
The supplied front-door-related concerns come from Europe on the F70 and the USA on the G60. [signal:7b77e95b-aaab-4f2e-a697-35920d6554d6] [signal:d63227d2-9156-42b5-8504-f2459414f2bd] [signal:e59737b3-cb0c-40aa-b300-5d23af2f6413] [signal:ebc93082-03de-4d13-a080-79c03a777c33]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these concerns are beyond the reported customer accounts. [signal:7b77e95b-aaab-4f2e-a697-35920d6554d6] [signal:d63227d2-9156-42b5-8504-f2459414f2bd] [signal:e59737b3-cb0c-40aa-b300-5d23af2f6413] [signal:ebc93082-03de-4d13-a080-79c03a777c33]
The rough patch’s origin was unclear to the F70 owner. [signal:7b77e95b-aaab-4f2e-a697-35920d6554d6]

value.title: BMW app setup, navigation and connectivity are difficult
value.summary: Customers report difficult setup, hard-to-find settings and features, and unreliable app-to-vehicle connections. The signals cover BMW and MINI app usability concerns across Europe and the USA.
highlights: Customers describe complex setup, confusing navigation and app connection problems.
Signals cover Europe and the USA, including F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that app setup can be complex, settings and features can be difficult to find or understand, and connections to the vehicle may fail or be hard to verify. [signal:169541be-cd5e-4140-a76a-3e4d65e8ff25] [signal:15562da0-7c85-4ced-9ce5-68dd4b4dc89e] [signal:1e6cc621-aff6-497f-9aea-ffcf5b191e4e] [signal:2008a53d-d9cf-49f3-84aa-e46ec3586193]

Some customers also say they do not use the app or dislike depending on a smartphone for vehicle functions. [signal:0475ed27-acdd-4bc2-8ffe-b940bb175b02] [signal:c7c736d9-a5f8-4ade-9acf-0bce8375b9a6]

## What customers say
One customer said the app had not worked for two months, while another reported that the app had stopped connecting before the connection returned. [signal:0766beec-4fec-4c23-9ea9-8abc2a5a5606] [signal:2008a53d-d9cf-49f3-84aa-e46ec3586193]

Other reported difficulties include explaining and completing data-line setup, telling whether the app is connected, finding the Financial section, and keeping track of app settings. [signal:169541be-cd5e-4140-a76a-3e4d65e8ff25] [signal:1e6cc621-aff6-497f-9aea-ffcf5b191e4e] [signal:15562da0-7c85-4ced-9ce5-68dd4b4dc89e]

One customer wanted month-by-month information about driving habits; the response in the signal pointed them to the My Trips section. [signal:158fc963-83e9-4d4b-b164-2f50820292d1]

## Differences between markets
The Europe signals describe a customer with no use for the app and another who says smartphone ownership is needed for some everyday vehicle functions. [signal:0475ed27-acdd-4bc2-8ffe-b940bb175b02] [signal:c7c736d9-a5f8-4ade-9acf-0bce8375b9a6]

The USA signals describe app reliability, setup, connection, navigation and settings difficulties. [signal:0766beec-4fec-4c23-9ea9-8abc2a5a5606] [signal:169541be-cd5e-4140-a76a-3e4d65e8ff25] [signal:2008a53d-d9cf-49f3-84aa-e46ec3586193] [signal:1e6cc621-aff6-497f-9aea-ffcf5b191e4e] [signal:15562da0-7c85-4ced-9ce5-68dd4b4dc89e]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common each issue is across markets or vehicle lines. [signal:0475ed27-acdd-4bc2-8ffe-b940bb175b02] [signal:0766beec-4fec-4c23-9ea9-8abc2a5a5606] [signal:15562da0-7c85-4ced-9ce5-68dd4b4dc89e] [signal:169541be-cd5e-4140-a76a-3e4d65e8ff25] [signal:1e6cc621-aff6-497f-9aea-ffcf5b191e4e] [signal:2008a53d-d9cf-49f3-84aa-e46ec3586193] [signal:158fc963-83e9-4d4b-b164-2f50820292d1] [signal:c7c736d9-a5f8-4ade-9acf-0bce8375b9a6]

The signals do not clarify whether reported connection and setup problems share a cause. [signal:169541be-cd5e-4140-a76a-3e4d65e8ff25] [signal:2008a53d-d9cf-49f3-84aa-e46ec3586193]

value.title: Audio sound quality and controls frustrate some BMW owners
value.summary: Some owners report disappointing sound quality or difficulty controlling audio and call volume. The sampled concerns involve USA G70 and G60 owners and a Europe F70 owner.
highlights: Owners report weak or poor sound, background noise, and audio controls that are hard to use.
Sampled signals include USA G70 and G60 owners and a Europe F70 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners describe poor sound quality, including weak bass or midrange, background noise, and a basic system that does not meet their expectations. [signal:05219290-2155-467f-a66a-eb4b549ba425] [signal:367a831a-2083-4c5a-990d-5005e237b9d4] [signal:7309bb55-30df-45ae-a86d-77bc0e167e32]
Others report difficulty managing audio or call volume, or uncertainty about audio-zone behavior during calls. [signal:4404e78d-0ae6-4677-8c1e-e394a30ff6cf] [signal:59c4c50a-10b6-4d19-9b53-2220334ab30b] [signal:5d8fb2e2-9dc2-4953-ba18-a7d9b04b7698]

## What customers say
A G70 owner says the upgraded Bowers & Wilkins system sounds poor at higher volume, with little bass or midrange, and compares it unfavorably with earlier BMW systems. [signal:05219290-2155-467f-a66a-eb4b549ba425]
A G70 customer reports background noise when increasing audio volume. [signal:367a831a-2083-4c5a-990d-5005e237b9d4]
A G60 customer reports bass problems with Harman Kardon when listening over Bluetooth. [signal:3f481704-31e2-4b1c-a3dd-e54cb558b1bb]
Another G60 owner prefers a physical radio on/off button and says using the volume control to silence the radio during a call is less convenient than the dedicated button in earlier BMWs. [signal:4404e78d-0ae6-4677-8c1e-e394a30ff6cf]
A G70 customer says she sometimes cannot be heard on calls and is unsure whether the audio zone is switching automatically. [signal:59c4c50a-10b6-4d19-9b53-2220334ab30b]
A different G70 customer initially struggles to hear a call and asks how to adjust call volume, then raises it successfully with guidance. [signal:5d8fb2e2-9dc2-4953-ba18-a7d9b04b7698]
A Europe F70 owner says the basic audio system is below the brand's expected standard and does not make listening enjoyable. [signal:7309bb55-30df-45ae-a86d-77bc0e167e32]

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA signals include sound-quality complaints on G70 and G60, as well as reports about audio controls and call audio. [signal:05219290-2155-467f-a66a-eb4b549ba425] [signal:367a831a-2083-4c5a-990d-5005e237b9d4] [signal:3f481704-31e2-4b1c-a3dd-e54cb558b1bb] [signal:4404e78d-0ae6-4677-8c1e-e394a30ff6cf] [signal:59c4c50a-10b6-4d19-9b53-2220334ab30b] [signal:5d8fb2e2-9dc2-4953-ba18-a7d9b04b7698]
The sampled Europe F70 complaint criticizes the basic system's sound quality. [signal:7309bb55-30df-45ae-a86d-77bc0e167e32]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these sound-quality or control concerns are across the 19 signals in the case, vehicle lines, or markets. [signal:05219290-2155-467f-a66a-eb4b549ba425] [signal:367a831a-2083-4c5a-990d-5005e237b9d4] [signal:3f481704-31e2-4b1c-a3dd-e54cb558b1bb] [signal:4404e78d-0ae6-4677-8c1e-e394a30ff6cf] [signal:59c4c50a-10b6-4d19-9b53-2220334ab30b] [signal:5d8fb2e2-9dc2-4953-ba18-a7d9b04b7698] [signal:7309bb55-30df-45ae-a86d-77bc0e167e32]
The reports do not clarify whether the issues share a cause; the G60 Bluetooth bass complaint mentions Enhanced Audio, while the other sound and usability reports describe different situations. [signal:3f481704-31e2-4b1c-a3dd-e54cb558b1bb] [signal:05219290-2155-467f-a66a-eb4b549ba425] [signal:367a831a-2083-4c5a-990d-5005e237b9d4]

value.title: Steering wheel feels too chunky
value.summary: One Europe-based F70 owner says the steering wheel feels too chunky, despite liking the car overall.
highlights: The steering wheel feels too chunky to one owner.
The signal is from Europe and concerns the F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One owner says the steering wheel feels too chunky. [signal:7f8ba229-843d-47a3-8fef-049b7f6c646d]

## What customers say
The owner says the car is great overall but identifies the steering wheel as their only gripe. [signal:7f8ba229-843d-47a3-8fef-049b7f6c646d]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from Europe, so there is no market comparison. [signal:7f8ba229-843d-47a3-8fef-049b7f6c646d]

## Open questions
The signal does not specify what aspect of the wheel makes it feel too chunky. [signal:7f8ba229-843d-47a3-8fef-049b7f6c646d]

value.title: Front door panels produce rattles, squeaks, clicks and other noise
value.summary: Customers report varied noises from front door panels and nearby areas, including rattling, squeaking, clicking, knocking, wind noise and tapping. Reports come from USA owners of G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Front-door-area noises range from rattles and squeaks to clicks, knocking, wind noise and tapping.
Six USA signals cover G70 and G60; three describe very minor issues.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report several kinds of noise around the front doors, including rattling, squeaking, clicking, knocking, wind noise and tapping. [signal:6e18c039-9ef7-4fc5-9561-284063a3624a] [signal:af9e5651-8489-4823-a7c9-0d891c259377] [signal:b52e31ea-771f-4f9f-ae33-b1d2761bc380] [signal:b7c4fcf2-6949-4349-9261-421a0aebd867] [signal:d36aa415-8008-4d91-93ef-98b28265d778] [signal:e0a93c64-ed38-468b-a77d-66ecc656904b]

## What customers say
One G70 owner reported that both front-door light bars rattled over bumps or with the stereo turned up; the service note attributed the noise to slightly loose touch box panels. [signal:6e18c039-9ef7-4fc5-9561-284063a3624a]
Another G70 owner described door-wide clicking and a loud driver-door squeak in rain or snow, while a separate report cited wind noise around both front-door seals since day one. [signal:af9e5651-8489-4823-a7c9-0d891c259377] [signal:b52e31ea-771f-4f9f-ae33-b1d2761bc380]
G60 owners reported sound near the driver-side window and seal, possible seat-belt tapping against the passenger door panel, and knocking from the front passenger door. [signal:b7c4fcf2-6949-4349-9261-421a0aebd867] [signal:d36aa415-8008-4d91-93ef-98b28265d778] [signal:e0a93c64-ed38-468b-a77d-66ecc656904b]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA, so these signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:6e18c039-9ef7-4fc5-9561-284063a3624a] [signal:af9e5651-8489-4823-a7c9-0d891c259377] [signal:b52e31ea-771f-4f9f-ae33-b1d2761bc380] [signal:b7c4fcf2-6949-4349-9261-421a0aebd867] [signal:d36aa415-8008-4d91-93ef-98b28265d778] [signal:e0a93c64-ed38-468b-a77d-66ecc656904b]

## Open questions
For the G60 reports, the source of the window-area sound, passenger-side tapping and knocking is not confirmed in the signals. [signal:b7c4fcf2-6949-4349-9261-421a0aebd867] [signal:d36aa415-8008-4d91-93ef-98b28265d778] [signal:e0a93c64-ed38-468b-a77d-66ecc656904b]

value.title: Front door pockets feel small and awkward to use
value.summary: Some USA G60 and G70 customers report awkwardly shaped or insufficient front door storage, including pockets that do not fit their needs. Another G60 customer values the increased door-panel storage.
highlights: Customers report awkward shapes, reduced space, short openings, and pockets too small for their needs.
Signals are from USA G60 and G70 vehicles: five complaints and one positive comment.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers find the front door storage awkwardly shaped, reduced in capacity, or difficult to use for the items they want to store. [signal:33b64244-bc90-432a-9ed0-119c1994b37a] [signal:ad3aaef4-138c-4b65-b103-5ffbe0ef95de] Others describe an opening that is too short, want a phone pocket, or want space for a larger water bottle. [signal:b9b732f5-5b73-43c5-b016-f46c5d3f22ab] [signal:dff8b43a-5153-453b-a911-b2318c4381d1] [signal:f9c18c12-3213-44f0-ba80-4fcc88e93c1a]

## What customers say
A G60 customer says the compartment’s awkward shape makes items hard to fit. [signal:33b64244-bc90-432a-9ed0-119c1994b37a] Another G60 customer says storage is reduced compared with their previous G30. [signal:ad3aaef4-138c-4b65-b103-5ffbe0ef95de] G70 customers mention a short opening and pockets that do not fit a larger water bottle as well as those in a 2023 X5. [signal:b9b732f5-5b73-43c5-b016-f46c5d3f22ab] [signal:f9c18c12-3213-44f0-ba80-4fcc88e93c1a] A G60 customer would like additional driver-side storage and a small phone pocket. [signal:dff8b43a-5153-453b-a911-b2318c4381d1] In contrast, another G60 customer appreciates the increased door-panel storage. [signal:6c361e50-dbb4-456a-97d8-ee2e5bc1cf3e]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:33b64244-bc90-432a-9ed0-119c1994b37a] [signal:ad3aaef4-138c-4b65-b103-5ffbe0ef95de] [signal:b9b732f5-5b73-43c5-b016-f46c5d3f22ab] [signal:dff8b43a-5153-453b-a911-b2318c4381d1] [signal:f9c18c12-3213-44f0-ba80-4fcc88e93c1a] [signal:6c361e50-dbb4-456a-97d8-ee2e5bc1cf3e]

## Open questions
Do the reported storage limitations vary between the G60 and G70? [signal:33b64244-bc90-432a-9ed0-119c1994b37a] [signal:ad3aaef4-138c-4b65-b103-5ffbe0ef95de] [signal:b9b732f5-5b73-43c5-b016-f46c5d3f22ab] Do customers’ assessments of storage space differ based on what they carry or their previous vehicle? [signal:ad3aaef4-138c-4b65-b103-5ffbe0ef95de] [signal:f9c18c12-3213-44f0-ba80-4fcc88e93c1a] [signal:6c361e50-dbb4-456a-97d8-ee2e5bc1cf3e]

value.title: Front door controls are hard to use and easy to activate accidentally
value.summary: USA customers report door-panel cupholders that let drinks lean, controls that are hard to identify by touch, an easily triggered door-open button, and icons that are difficult to read in strong sunlight. The signals cover the G60 and G70.
highlights: Door-panel usability concerns include leaning drinks, hard-to-find controls, accidental activation, and poor icon legibility.
Four door-specific signals are from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
USA customers describe several front door-panel usability issues: door cupholders do not keep drinks fully upright, some controls are hard to locate by touch, the door-open button can be pressed unintentionally, and some driver-door icons are hard to read in strong sunlight. [signal:f45d86d9-f909-4d93-b5bb-1b52b11d6219] [signal:f90428f4-73c9-441b-a6e9-088c76ce0a23] [signal:11870577-c6f1-43b5-af7d-7cb0a66e55f3] [signal:41b5b885-8d86-40b6-920c-d5dc901de3d0]

## What customers say
A G60 customer says drinks lean in the door cupholders and describes their design as goofy. [signal:f45d86d9-f909-4d93-b5bb-1b52b11d6219]
A G60 customer says the lock/unlock and seat buttons have little tactile feedback and are difficult to find by touch. [signal:41b5b885-8d86-40b6-920c-d5dc901de3d0]
A G70 customer reports that their leg unintentionally pressed the door-open button while they were stopped at a red light, opening the door. [signal:11870577-c6f1-43b5-af7d-7cb0a66e55f3]
A G70 customer says some driver-door icons are nearly unreadable in strong sunlight. [signal:f90428f4-73c9-441b-a6e9-088c76ce0a23]

## Differences between markets
All four signals about specific door-panel usability issues are from the USA; they cover the G60 and G70. [signal:f45d86d9-f909-4d93-b5bb-1b52b11d6219] [signal:f90428f4-73c9-441b-a6e9-088c76ce0a23] [signal:11870577-c6f1-43b5-af7d-7cb0a66e55f3] [signal:41b5b885-8d86-40b6-920c-d5dc901de3d0]

## Open questions
Do these concerns occur beyond the USA or on other vehicle lines? The signals provide no other markets or vehicle lines. [signal:f45d86d9-f909-4d93-b5bb-1b52b11d6219] [signal:f90428f4-73c9-441b-a6e9-088c76ce0a23]  [signal:41b5b885-8d86-40b6-920c-d5dc901de3d0]

value.title: Launch Control activation and use are unclear to customers
value.summary: Customers report uncertainty about whether Launch Control is available, how to activate it, when to use it, and what to expect during use. The signals concern USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers are unsure how to activate Launch Control and interpret its behavior.
Signals shown cover USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers ask whether their vehicle has Launch Control and how or when to use it. [signal:016b98f4-0d2f-49a5-8540-5d3d71a686d7] [signal:1789e50d-1648-43ff-a3c6-718b480526b8] [signal:238b31ac-04c8-4dfe-a64f-93518452248a]

## What customers say
A G60 customer did not know the activation steps, and another thought the feature was missing after not selecting Sport Plus mode. [signal:1789e50d-1648-43ff-a3c6-718b480526b8] [signal:238b31ac-04c8-4dfe-a64f-93518452248a]

A G70 customer asked whether Launch Control was available and was told to wait until after the 1,200-mile break-in period. [signal:4b74ace7-d330-4d1d-8291-cb5d326a8a65]

Another G70 customer reported wheelspin when the checkered flag appeared and was unsure whether the brake had been pressed firmly enough. [signal:6e2dea5e-b8c3-4f39-ba72-2a1c844ee4cd]

A G60 customer asked whether Launch Control and boost provide the same horsepower and was told they do. [signal:8115f391-9f34-417f-9e7b-56695fa79d04]

## Differences between markets
All signals shown are from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles; no other market is represented in the supplied signals. [signal:016b98f4-0d2f-49a5-8540-5d3d71a686d7] [signal:1789e50d-1648-43ff-a3c6-718b480526b8] [signal:238b31ac-04c8-4dfe-a64f-93518452248a] [signal:4b74ace7-d330-4d1d-8291-cb5d326a8a65] [signal:6e2dea5e-b8c3-4f39-ba72-2a1c844ee4cd] [signal:8115f391-9f34-417f-9e7b-56695fa79d04]

## Open questions
Do customers understand the required mode and pedal inputs without assistance? [signal:016b98f4-0d2f-49a5-8540-5d3d71a686d7] [signal:1789e50d-1648-43ff-a3c6-718b480526b8] [signal:238b31ac-04c8-4dfe-a64f-93518452248a]

How do customers interpret the checkered flag and wheelspin during activation? [signal:6e2dea5e-b8c3-4f39-ba72-2a1c844ee4cd]

value.title: Steering wheel design is valued for feel, comfort and orientation
value.summary: Customers in the USA and Europe praise the steering wheel’s shape, ergonomics, materials and feel. One USA customer values the flatter lower arc for identifying wheel orientation without looking.
highlights: Customers praise the wheel’s design, comfort and tactile feel.
Signals shown: 6 USA customers across G70 and G60; 2 Europe customers in F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals shown describe positive perceptions rather than a reported design problem. USA customers praise the wheel’s shape, ergonomics and appearance, while one customer values the flatter lower arc as a tactile orientation cue. [signal:29d1f589-45df-4ff3-837d-40432e96cb03] [signal:39de36fe-a191-4649-b212-4c7c427563a3] [signal:537420e4-b9e8-4574-a8a8-64ea985c4445] [signal:6049adcb-bf94-46dd-a308-e941b3828993] [signal:616ff6bc-c8c1-42f1-8358-9eed8216566a]

## What customers say
A USA customer says the non-round shape and flatter lower arc help them sense steering-wheel orientation without looking. [signal:29d1f589-45df-4ff3-837d-40432e96cb03] Other USA customers describe the wheel as attractive, ergonomically comfortable, cockpit-like, and well made, mentioning soft leather and colored detailing. [signal:39de36fe-a191-4649-b212-4c7c427563a3] [signal:537420e4-b9e8-4574-a8a8-64ea985c4445] [signal:6049adcb-bf94-46dd-a308-e941b3828993] [signal:616ff6bc-c8c1-42f1-8358-9eed8216566a] [signal:6b702d25-5de5-4487-b1ca-088e9df09300]

In Europe, an F70 customer praises steering feedback, and another values the soft touch of the steering wheel. [signal:380dc98d-9ec9-4981-ad21-530bd79d1092] [signal:4de2307a-5e76-4824-b5f0-2f9d93714c79]

## Differences between markets
The signals shown are positive in both markets: USA comments focus on design, ergonomics, appearance and materials, while Europe comments mention steering feedback and soft touch. [signal:29d1f589-45df-4ff3-837d-40432e96cb03] [signal:39de36fe-a191-4649-b212-4c7c427563a3] [signal:537420e4-b9e8-4574-a8a8-64ea985c4445] [signal:6049adcb-bf94-46dd-a308-e941b3828993] [signal:616ff6bc-c8c1-42f1-8358-9eed8216566a] [signal:6b702d25-5de5-4487-b1ca-088e9df09300] [signal:380dc98d-9ec9-4981-ad21-530bd79d1092] [signal:4de2307a-5e76-4824-b5f0-2f9d93714c79]

## Open questions
- Do customers in other markets or vehicle lines share these positive impressions?
- How common is the orientation cue benefit of the flatter lower arc?

[signal:e00caa09-d54e-4bb8-b08a-68ded569fca5] Separately, one customer said the shape of the front bumper had grown on them over time. [signal:c360bea6-e3d1-4c2c-acff-9cb73cf322a3]

The signals do not establish when or how the reported damage occurred. [signal:257cb742-1589-4bcc-a061-c9d982b510a2] [signal:d36fc031-0ea9-484a-8b87-98ec1ea3c179] [signal:e00caa09-d54e-4bb8-b08a-68ded569fca5]

value.title: Steering wheel quality concerns across feel, operation and finish
value.summary: Customers report a cheap-feeling steering-wheel button, an uncomfortable thick wheel, choppy steering feel, and crooked stitching. These concerns appear in European F70 and US G60 and G70 signals.
highlights: Concerns include button feel, wheel thickness and comfort, choppy steering, and crooked stitching.
Four signals: two from Europe on F70, and two from the USA on G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe several different steering-wheel quality concerns: a knurled button that feels cheap, a wheel that feels too thick and uncomfortable, choppy steering movement, and crooked stitching. [signal:0a43d5cb-2e68-40d0-81e3-7c81bf89aad1] [signal:030d162b-24ba-4756-ae2a-b3c4c4cce4c7] [signal:8f5f1eb2-7d38-429f-bbfa-b24b14135d38] [signal:90621b2b-01ee-4fc8-8606-2d4873b202e9]

## What customers say
One F70 owner says the knurled steering-wheel button feels cheap, while another says the wheel is too thick and less comfortable than earlier BMW wheels. [signal:0a43d5cb-2e68-40d0-81e3-7c81bf89aad1] [signal:030d162b-24ba-4756-ae2a-b3c4c4cce4c7]
A G60 owner reports a choppy sensation near the steering center after driving for 20–30 minutes above roughly 50 mph, and says the dealership has not reproduced it. [signal:8f5f1eb2-7d38-429f-bbfa-b24b14135d38]
A G70 owner reports crooked, misaligned stitching on the steering wheel. [signal:90621b2b-01ee-4fc8-8606-2d4873b202e9]

## Differences between markets
The two European signals are about the F70 and describe button feel and wheel thickness and comfort. [signal:0a43d5cb-2e68-40d0-81e3-7c81bf89aad1] [signal:030d162b-24ba-4756-ae2a-b3c4c4cce4c7]
The two USA signals are about the G60 and G70 and describe choppy steering feel and crooked stitching, respectively. [signal:8f5f1eb2-7d38-429f-bbfa-b24b14135d38] [signal:90621b2b-01ee-4fc8-8606-2d4873b202e9]

## Open questions
Is the reported choppy steering sensation reproducible beyond the one G60 owner's experience? [signal:8f5f1eb2-7d38-429f-bbfa-b24b14135d38]
How common are the reported button, thickness, comfort, and stitching concerns beyond these signals? [signal:0a43d5cb-2e68-40d0-81e3-7c81bf89aad1] [signal:030d162b-24ba-4756-ae2a-b3c4c4cce4c7] [signal:90621b2b-01ee-4fc8-8606-2d4873b202e9]
