value.title: Steering wheel adjustment and shape cause usability concerns
value.summary: Some customers report limited steering-wheel adjustment, a wheel that can obstruct the driver-facing camera, or a rim that feels too thick. The concerns appear in signals from Europe and the USA across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Concerns include limited adjustment, camera obstruction and a rim that feels too thick.
Signals cover Europe’s F70 and USA’s G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe steering-wheel usability concerns involving adjustment range, positioning and rim shape or thickness. [signal:978a492d-7a3c-4b38-9c88-a3479fb04038] [signal:8f2fb42f-e3c8-498f-92bf-51ee6964d477] [signal:ba0cfb84-8412-473d-9f07-a78ccebc16b0] One customer also asks why the wheel is not fully round. [signal:99ca72de-7a7c-4fc7-a9fc-ef0f66610e59]

## What customers say
A G60 customer says the tilt range does not provide enough adjustment for a shorter driver. [signal:978a492d-7a3c-4b38-9c88-a3479fb04038] In a G70, lowering the wheel for long-distance driving can block the driver-facing camera used by the driving-assist program. [signal:8f2fb42f-e3c8-498f-92bf-51ee6964d477] An F70 customer says the wheel feels too thick for their hands, especially on a long trip. [signal:ba0cfb84-8412-473d-9f07-a78ccebc16b0] A G60 customer asked how to adjust the wheel vertically and in or out. [signal:34813f7c-7617-4daf-8d1d-395d73ed5ba3] Another G60 customer questioned its non-round shape; the service writer described it as a sport-style wheel intended to improve grip in sharp turns. [signal:99ca72de-7a7c-4fc7-a9fc-ef0f66610e59]

## Differences between markets
The supplied Europe signals include an F70 customer describing the wheel as too thick, while the USA signals include G60 concerns about adjustment range and shape, and a G70 report of camera obstruction. [signal:ba0cfb84-8412-473d-9f07-a78ccebc16b0] [signal:978a492d-7a3c-4b38-9c88-a3479fb04038] [signal:99ca72de-7a7c-4fc7-a9fc-ef0f66610e59] [signal:8f2fb42f-e3c8-498f-92bf-51ee6964d477]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these concerns are among customers or whether they apply beyond the reported vehicles. [signal:978a492d-7a3c-4b38-9c88-a3479fb04038] [signal:8f2fb42f-e3c8-498f-92bf-51ee6964d477] [signal:ba0cfb84-8412-473d-9f07-a78ccebc16b0]

value.title: Steering wheel feel, controls and heating disappoint some drivers
value.summary: Drivers report a steering wheel that feels loose or locks while turning, alongside concerns about its size, controls and heating. Signals come from Europe and the USA across F70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Reports range from a loose, intermittently locking wheel to confusing controls, a chunky feel and lukewarm heating.
Europe: F70 appears in three relevant signals; USA: G60 appears in one.
A driver says heated steering wheels in a MINI and an i4 worked better.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe several distinct steering-wheel concerns: one reports looseness and intermittent locking while turning, while others mention confusing controls, a chunky feel or insufficient heating. [signal:94c7eee9-2dad-4436-94a2-564d8870d9f0] [signal:573eeef7-9fbc-4b0f-a8ba-3a1adb1b95e6] [signal:ae5019c9-100b-4af8-a51e-7cc1511c3573] [signal:d7e035cf-7e1d-4571-8a4d-91c2ee81028d]

## What customers say
A G60 driver in the USA says the steering wheel feels loose and sometimes seems to lock when turning. [signal:94c7eee9-2dad-4436-94a2-564d8870d9f0]

Two F70 drivers in Europe mention the wheel: one finds its controls difficult to understand, and another says it feels too chunky. [signal:573eeef7-9fbc-4b0f-a8ba-3a1adb1b95e6] [signal:ae5019c9-100b-4af8-a51e-7cc1511c3573]

An F70 driver in Europe says the heated wheel only gets lukewarm and that a MINI and an i4 had better-performing heated wheels; the driver says a medical condition makes adequate wheel heat important. [signal:d7e035cf-7e1d-4571-8a4d-91c2ee81028d]

## Differences between markets
The steering-wheel concerns in the signals come from Europe and the USA: Europe has three relevant F70 reports, while the USA has one G60 report. [signal:573eeef7-9fbc-4b0f-a8ba-3a1adb1b95e6] [signal:ae5019c9-100b-4af8-a51e-7cc1511c3573] [signal:d7e035cf-7e1d-4571-8a4d-91c2ee81028d] [signal:94c7eee9-2dad-4436-94a2-564d8870d9f0]

The reports describe different concerns rather than a consistent market-level pattern: control complexity, wheel thickness and heating in Europe, and looseness or intermittent locking in the USA. [signal:573eeef7-9fbc-4b0f-a8ba-3a1adb1b95e6] [signal:ae5019c9-100b-4af8-a51e-7cc1511c3573] [signal:d7e035cf-7e1d-4571-8a4d-91c2ee81028d] [signal:94c7eee9-2dad-4436-94a2-564d8870d9f0]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the looseness or intermittent locking occurs, or whether it is related to the other concerns. [signal:94c7eee9-2dad-4436-94a2-564d8870d9f0]

The heated-wheel comparison is one driver's report; the signals do not provide broader comparisons with MINI or i4 vehicles. [signal:d7e035cf-7e1d-4571-8a4d-91c2ee81028d]

value.title: Quiet cabins are valued by customers across vehicle lines

Quiet interior acoustics are valued by customers, who describe the cabin or ride as quiet and peaceful. [signal:00cebdd7-1c24-43b6-ab34-a40b8c6633e0] [signal:17fe5268-640a-4200-ad1d-8a5f9a0c8894]

value.title: Road, wind and interior noise reduce cabin quietness
value.summary: US owners of the G70 and G60 report road, wind or interior noise that detracts from cabin quietness. One G70 owner compares its cabin hush unfavorably with luxury competitors, while another G60 owner says their SUVs are quieter.
highlights: Owners report excessive road noise, loud freeway wind noise and an interior rattle.
All four signals are from the USA: two G70 and two G60 owners.
Competitor comparisons favor Maybach, Bentley, Rolls-Royce and two SUVs over BMW for cabin quietness.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners describe road noise in the G70 and G60, loud wind noise in one G70, and an interior rattle in one G60. [signal:00307da1-d371-4f3e-a42c-1e0799c43be8] [signal:5c0daa55-fe0e-45bb-91c1-3e31ad08e8c2] [signal:a5683ace-eb91-476f-ab3d-4b083ee75681] [signal:ca46d9f4-ff3a-4bc3-80a6-ea4440428c7d]

## What customers say
One G70 owner says they wish the ride were quieter and considers Maybach, Bentley and Rolls-Royce models quieter than the i7. [signal:00307da1-d371-4f3e-a42c-1e0799c43be8]
A G60 owner says cabin noise is noticeably higher than in their wife's two SUVs, while describing the issue as minor and saying they love the 5 Series. [signal:5c0daa55-fe0e-45bb-91c1-3e31ad08e8c2]
Another G70 owner describes freeway wind noise as extremely loud, like driving with the windows slightly open or through a windstorm. [signal:a5683ace-eb91-476f-ab3d-4b083ee75681]
A G60 owner reports an interior rattle that the service center could not reproduce. [signal:ca46d9f4-ff3a-4bc3-80a6-ea4440428c7d]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA, covering two G70 and two G60 owners; there are no signals from other markets to compare. [signal:00307da1-d371-4f3e-a42c-1e0799c43be8] [signal:5c0daa55-fe0e-45bb-91c1-3e31ad08e8c2] [signal:a5683ace-eb91-476f-ab3d-4b083ee75681] [signal:ca46d9f4-ff3a-4bc3-80a6-ea4440428c7d]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these noise complaints are beyond the four reports, or whether the road, wind and rattle concerns share a cause. [signal:00307da1-d371-4f3e-a42c-1e0799c43be8] [signal:5c0daa55-fe0e-45bb-91c1-3e31ad08e8c2] [signal:a5683ace-eb91-476f-ab3d-4b083ee75681] [signal:ca46d9f4-ff3a-4bc3-80a6-ea4440428c7d]

value.title: Steering wheel functions and controls draw mixed feedback
value.summary: Some customers want more functions or easier access to controls at the steering wheel, while others value its comfort, grip, and design.
highlights: Customers request steering-wheel functions and easier access to controls.
Signals come from USA G60 and G70 owners and Europe F70 owners.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want functions or controls to be easier to access from the steering wheel: one would like the hazard-light switch there, and another prefers a previous steering-wheel-based setup to the current shift dial. [signal:35c97346-f2b1-4d8b-8185-05836d0a7477] [signal:de66990d-db56-49ff-b6cf-04004efd5044]

A customer also wishes the wheel would lift higher when the car is switched off to make entry and exit easier. [signal:e561d769-96e9-4aa6-9b6d-2dea3d6c5812]

## What customers say
Feedback is mixed: customers describe the steering wheel as great, comfortable, and pleasant to grip, and one particularly likes its chunky feel. [signal:0dfc6dbd-2c19-43a9-8d54-50851e6c6725] [signal:1bb5a760-56a3-4766-8dcc-5d08e9c85b2f] [signal:8096457d-7b4c-4f33-8de0-8130412d48f1] [signal:9294b809-dc86-42da-81ec-c24bd11f7fb0]

One customer dislikes the red strip at the top of the wheel. [signal:b487fd48-c5ea-449f-bbb1-3ef12a51db25] Other customers praise the new or strong steering wheel. [signal:62491ba2-528e-42c3-966e-ca894c93d12c] [signal:64663c95-e005-4e03-814d-bb762daaf6ff]

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA signals include requests concerning hazard-light access, the red strip, wheel lift, and a preference for a prior steering-wheel-based setup. [signal:35c97346-f2b1-4d8b-8185-05836d0a7477] [signal:b487fd48-c5ea-449f-bbb1-3ef12a51db25] [signal:e561d769-96e9-4aa6-9b6d-2dea3d6c5812] [signal:de66990d-db56-49ff-b6cf-04004efd5044]

The sampled Europe signals praise the wheel's design, strength, or grip; one Europe signal also mentions difficulty distinguishing centre-console buttons and distraction from the touchscreen, but does not specify a steering-wheel control issue. [signal:62491ba2-528e-42c3-966e-ca894c93d12c] [signal:64663c95-e005-4e03-814d-bb762daaf6ff] [signal:8096457d-7b4c-4f33-8de0-8130412d48f1] [signal:9294b809-dc86-42da-81ec-c24bd11f7fb0] [signal:c3792455-9195-4c3c-afa2-cd008a7c0aee]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify which steering-wheel functions customers expect to control there beyond the hazard-light switch, or what the previous steering-wheel-based setup refers to. [signal:35c97346-f2b1-4d8b-8185-05836d0a7477] [signal:de66990d-db56-49ff-b6cf-04004efd5044]

The signals do not establish how common these preferences are beyond the examples provided. [signal:35c97346-f2b1-4d8b-8185-05836d0a7477] [signal:de66990d-db56-49ff-b6cf-04004efd5044] [signal:e561d769-96e9-4aa6-9b6d-2dea3d6c5812]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Feedback on interior acoustics is mixed: some owners describe a quiet cabin, while others report tyre noise or poor Bluetooth sound quality. [signal:194a99ed-ee14-4075-9f50-844e5f807004] [signal:6b0fb895-1764-484a-85d3-6409e8c41c04] [signal:e68b905a-342e-454e-b07d-b0ce415d5826]

## What customers say
A Rest of World owner says the cabin feels quiet and safe. [signal:194a99ed-ee14-4075-9f50-844e5f807004] Another describes low road noise and a quiet cabin, but reports poor Bluetooth sound quality and inability to play music from USB. [signal:e68b905a-342e-454e-b07d-b0ce415d5826]

A Europe owner says overall refinement is good but is spoiled by too much tyre noise on poor surfaces. [signal:6b0fb895-1764-484a-85d3-6409e8c41c04] A Rest of World owner says the speakers sound better now. [signal:e3d86800-b9ae-43c1-babb-3a9c2c38bb93]

## Differences between markets
Rest of World signals include both positive reports of cabin quietness and a complaint about Bluetooth sound quality. [signal:194a99ed-ee14-4075-9f50-844e5f807004] [signal:e68b905a-342e-454e-b07d-b0ce415d5826] The Europe signal praises overall refinement but notes tyre noise on poor surfaces. [signal:6b0fb895-1764-484a-85d3-6409e8c41c04]

## Open questions

Do other owners share the contrasting views on cabin quietness and audio quality? [signal:194a99ed-ee14-4075-9f50-844e5f807004] [signal:e68b905a-342e-454e-b07d-b0ce415d5826]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe noticeable wind noise around windows, doors, and mirrors, as well as other sounds inside or near the vehicle. [signal:4c799c09-d698-49bd-8e8d-219539f26cca] [signal:e5734953-78b6-45d0-94ae-948a533170c5] [signal:07198b31-27d9-43cc-9d40-308c371335f2] [signal:d2b1f155-6308-4751-9096-48b4ee9e680b] [signal:d351cbdd-37ea-4961-ba61-0759d715e3a1]

## What customers say
A USA G70 driver says outside sounds are clearly audible while driving and that parts inside the car also make noise. [signal:4c799c09-d698-49bd-8e8d-219539f26cca]

Other USA reports describe wind noise from the windows above 70 MPH, from the outside mirrors, and from both front window areas. [signal:07198b31-27d9-43cc-9d40-308c371335f2] [signal:d2b1f155-6308-4751-9096-48b4ee9e680b] [signal:d351cbdd-37ea-4961-ba61-0759d715e3a1]

One G70 owner reports a buzzing followed by an air-release-like sound near the trunk or rear of the vehicle on some first starts. [signal:e5734953-78b6-45d0-94ae-948a533170c5]

A Rest of World G70 complaint also mentions substantial external noise. [signal:efabd43d-0caf-4d0d-85b8-74fdd1cdfc34]

The Europe F70 feedback differs: the driver describes the car as very quiet, but says wind enters around the door and wing-mirror area and artificial adaptive driving sounds are annoying. [signal:f239ec6a-67f1-4572-9d2d-e2a3232fa640]

## Differences between markets
USA signals describe wind noise in G60 and G70 vehicles and other unwanted cabin or rear-area sounds in G70 vehicles. [signal:07198b31-27d9-43cc-9d40-308c371335f2] [signal:d2b1f155-6308-4751-9096-48b4ee9e680b] [signal:d351cbdd-37ea-4961-ba61-0759d715e3a1] [signal:4c799c09-d698-49bd-8e8d-219539f26cca] [signal:e5734953-78b6-45d0-94ae-948a533170c5]

The Rest of World G70 complaint mentions external noise, while the Europe F70 report combines door-area wind noise with a description of the car as very quiet and dissatisfaction with artificial driving sounds. [signal:efabd43d-0caf-4d0d-85b8-74fdd1cdfc34] [signal:f239ec6a-67f1-4572-9d2d-e2a3232fa640]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the cause of the reported wind noise or whether the rear-area sound is related to changing weather or first starts. [signal:07198b31-27d9-43cc-9d40-308c371335f2] [signal:e5734953-78b6-45d0-94ae-948a533170c5]

The signals do not show how common these reports are beyond the individual cases provided. [signal:4c799c09-d698-49bd-8e8d-219539f26cca] [signal:e5734953-78b6-45d0-94ae-948a533170c5] [signal:efabd43d-0caf-4d0d-85b8-74fdd1cdfc34] [signal:f239ec6a-67f1-4572-9d2d-e2a3232fa640] [signal:07198b31-27d9-43cc-9d40-308c371335f2] [signal:d2b1f155-6308-4751-9096-48b4ee9e680b] [signal:d351cbdd-37ea-4961-ba61-0759d715e3a1]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers report road, wind or general cabin noise that becomes more noticeable at speed, with some describing it as annoying or disturbing. [signal:05d4f877-0c9f-41a7-bf4c-f2d880395d09] [signal:6368baf1-829a-4900-80ab-c4b76fe70109] [signal:87636580-028a-40ba-88ad-ac7aba3305e6]  [signal:a63b4d77-35db-4dfb-ba55-e6e952b2f112]

## What customers say
A USA G70 driver describes road and wind noise as a minor issue that is sometimes annoying. [signal:05d4f877-0c9f-41a7-bf4c-f2d880395d09]
A Europe F70 driver says road noise above about 50 mph makes the radio hard to hear. [signal:6368baf1-829a-4900-80ab-c4b76fe70109]
A USA G60 driver reports loud cabin noise above 55 mph; service staff also noticed it, but could not identify a fix, and a similar car had the same issue. [signal:87636580-028a-40ba-88ad-ac7aba3305e6]
A Rest of World F70 driver finds noise and vibration at higher speeds a little annoying. 
A Europe G70 driver says wind noise becomes obvious and disturbing above about 110–120 km/h, despite having a special package. [signal:a63b4d77-35db-4dfb-ba55-e6e952b2f112]

## Differences between markets
The signals include noise complaints from the USA, Europe and Rest of World, across G70, G60 and F70 vehicles. [signal:05d4f877-0c9f-41a7-bf4c-f2d880395d09] [signal:6368baf1-829a-4900-80ab-c4b76fe70109] [signal:87636580-028a-40ba-88ad-ac7aba3305e6]  [signal:a63b4d77-35db-4dfb-ba55-e6e952b2f112]
The reported speed thresholds and impact differ: one driver says noise makes radio listening difficult, while others describe it as annoying or disturbing. [signal:05d4f877-0c9f-41a7-bf4c-f2d880395d09] [signal:6368baf1-829a-4900-80ab-c4b76fe70109]  [signal:a63b4d77-35db-4dfb-ba55-e6e952b2f112]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported noise has the same cause across vehicle lines or markets. [signal:05d4f877-0c9f-41a7-bf4c-f2d880395d09] [signal:6368baf1-829a-4900-80ab-c4b76fe70109] [signal:87636580-028a-40ba-88ad-ac7aba3305e6]  [signal:a63b4d77-35db-4dfb-ba55-e6e952b2f112]
The reports give different speed thresholds, but do not clarify how noise varies by road surface, conditions or configuration. [signal:6368baf1-829a-4900-80ab-c4b76fe70109] [signal:87636580-028a-40ba-88ad-ac7aba3305e6]  [signal:a63b4d77-35db-4dfb-ba55-e6e952b2f112]

[signal:479f4987-a521-4b19-9edc-de0320193f02] [signal:c647eb14-c5a6-4c1e-b9f1-073c0ec352eb] A USA G60 owner says cabin noise is too high and affects driving comfort. [signal:904e28a5-5269-45d5-9ebb-8c38d2b2c92b] [signal:479f4987-a521-4b19-9edc-de0320193f02] [signal:c647eb14-c5a6-4c1e-b9f1-073c0ec352eb] [signal:d961e4e8-4eaf-41d4-824f-c0d9c6b14ccc] The Europe signal calls wind noise noticeable in the F70, while the Rest of World signals praise quiet cabins in the F70 and G60. [signal:658e06d5-87d1-4ccd-992d-4d54c69560a0] [signal:3d9385cc-642f-47d8-9bc1-a0f0ce6e41ee] [signal:60ea4b22-727c-4613-a5b6-34661215e69d] The signals therefore show differing experiences rather than a consistent view of cabin acoustics. [signal:658e06d5-87d1-4ccd-992d-4d54c69560a0] [signal:3d9385cc-642f-47d8-9bc1-a0f0ce6e41ee]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Two customers say the G70 headrest cannot be adjusted to suit their needs: one reports that it sits too high and creates blind spots, and another says it cannot move forward or backward. [signal:73930a28-f02a-415e-8d27-50b466b1cf36] [signal:a967b17c-54fd-463c-86c1-7df294dc5510]

## What customers say
One customer says the headrest obstructs views when checking lanes, parallel parking, backing up, and looking over the right shoulder. [signal:73930a28-f02a-415e-8d27-50b466b1cf36]
Another says they have to recline the seat to get proper head support and finds the lack of forward/backward adjustment odd in a luxury vehicle. [signal:a967b17c-54fd-463c-86c1-7df294dc5510]
A third customer describes the seat cushions and headrests as incredibly comfortable. [signal:1f5a1834-d440-4601-a585-9d2aae5922a6]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from USA G70 customers, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:73930a28-f02a-415e-8d27-50b466b1cf36] [signal:a967b17c-54fd-463c-86c1-7df294dc5510] [signal:1f5a1834-d440-4601-a585-9d2aae5922a6]
The feedback is mixed: two customers report adjustment or visibility concerns, while one praises headrest comfort. [signal:73930a28-f02a-415e-8d27-50b466b1cf36] [signal:a967b17c-54fd-463c-86c1-7df294dc5510] [signal:1f5a1834-d440-4601-a585-9d2aae5922a6]

## Open questions
Do the reported visibility and positioning concerns apply to a wider range of drivers or seating positions? [signal:73930a28-f02a-415e-8d27-50b466b1cf36] [signal:a967b17c-54fd-463c-86c1-7df294dc5510]
How common are the adjustment concerns compared with positive views of headrest comfort? [signal:73930a28-f02a-415e-8d27-50b466b1cf36] [signal:a967b17c-54fd-463c-86c1-7df294dc5510] [signal:1f5a1834-d440-4601-a585-9d2aae5922a6]

No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report difficulty understanding or achieving the desired headrest position. Issues include uncertainty about adjustment, an uncomfortable angle, and the headrest not lowering far enough. [signal:102d17ed-0cf4-40c2-872f-16c244cb0b5c] [signal:5959533d-593f-4b1f-85c3-1979e219e52b] [signal:7022fb4f-22ff-437e-93df-30e276dd0521] [signal:a706d850-689c-4365-a440-c94da01e72f6]

## What customers say
A G60 customer asked how to change headrest height; the service writer explained that pressing the side button allows the headrest to be pushed or pulled. [signal:102d17ed-0cf4-40c2-872f-16c244cb0b5c]
A G70 customer reported a large gap between their head and the headrest and was unsure whether it adjusted forward and backward; the writer described the side-button adjustment. [signal:5959533d-593f-4b1f-85c3-1979e219e52b]
A G60 owner said the headrest felt less comfortable and they could not get the angle right. [signal:7022fb4f-22ff-437e-93df-30e276dd0521]
A G70 customer said the driver headrest did not lower far enough, leaving the top of their head against its lower edge. [signal:a706d850-689c-4365-a440-c94da01e72f6]

## Differences between markets
The three USA complaints cover G60 and G70 and describe adjustment uncertainty, head-to-headrest spacing, and insufficient downward travel. [signal:102d17ed-0cf4-40c2-872f-16c244cb0b5c] [signal:5959533d-593f-4b1f-85c3-1979e219e52b] [signal:a706d850-689c-4365-a440-c94da01e72f6]
The Europe complaint concerns a G60 and describes discomfort and difficulty finding the right angle. [signal:7022fb4f-22ff-437e-93df-30e276dd0521]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these issues are beyond the four reported complaints. [signal:102d17ed-0cf4-40c2-872f-16c244cb0b5c] [signal:5959533d-593f-4b1f-85c3-1979e219e52b] [signal:7022fb4f-22ff-437e-93df-30e276dd0521] [signal:a706d850-689c-4365-a440-c94da01e72f6]
The signals do not clarify whether the reported discomfort and limited downward travel share a cause. [signal:7022fb4f-22ff-437e-93df-30e276dd0521] [signal:a706d850-689c-4365-a440-c94da01e72f6]

value.title: Headrest noise and adjuster retention concerns

## Problem

[signal:1727f3ac-a055-4bd1-9e67-c963b29ccacd] Another customer said the driver's headrest adjuster came out, was found on the back-seat floor, and stayed in place after being snapped back in. [signal:eaa173cc-c0b1-4f29-a03b-0b8dfe99bbf9]

## What customers say
The G70 customer said the noise was confirmed by a shop foreman, but had stopped by the time a technician tried to diagnose it; it returned a few days later. [signal:1727f3ac-a055-4bd1-9e67-c963b29ccacd] The G60 customer said the adjuster had not been used before it came out. [signal:eaa173cc-c0b1-4f29-a03b-0b8dfe99bbf9]

## Differences between markets
Both headrest-reliability reports are from the USA, covering one G70 and one G60. [signal:1727f3ac-a055-4bd1-9e67-c963b29ccacd] [signal:eaa173cc-c0b1-4f29-a03b-0b8dfe99bbf9] The Europe signal describes other vehicle concerns and does not report a headrest-reliability issue. [signal:67e5b4cb-095f-43e4-9dd7-e52ecaae8fc7]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the cause of the intermittent noise or why the adjuster came out. [signal:1727f3ac-a055-4bd1-9e67-c963b29ccacd] [signal:eaa173cc-c0b1-4f29-a03b-0b8dfe99bbf9] The G70 customer had not yet returned for further diagnosis. [signal:1727f3ac-a055-4bd1-9e67-c963b29ccacd]

[signal:0cf7d76b-3a0d-43b6-87aa-0220cbfb8f3f] [signal:0e8dfaf3-d441-465a-8bd6-17ed96567fd3] [signal:0f983058-2a5e-455b-a4c0-17ee7dfff42d] [signal:51c16cbb-dfed-4be2-bdc1-07ca2b9326aa]

## What customers say
A G60 owner said she initially could not charge at home because she used the wrong adapter and did not know there was a separate adapter for a Level 2 charger. [signal:0cf7d76b-3a0d-43b6-87aa-0220cbfb8f3f]

A G70 owner said nearly two months after purchase, he still had no clear installation timing for a promoted BMW Wallbox, and that Qmerit took about a month to return his initial call. [signal:0e8dfaf3-d441-465a-8bd6-17ed96567fd3]

A G60 owner said a third-party-installed Wallbox did not work and that it took about four weeks for the dealership to resolve the issue. [signal:0f983058-2a5e-455b-a4c0-17ee7dfff42d] Another G70 owner said the included charger did not charge at home, the vehicle had been in service twice in about two months, and they were adding a 220-volt outlet. [signal:51c16cbb-dfed-4be2-bdc1-07ca2b9326aa]

Experiences are not uniformly negative: one hybrid owner found home charging slower than with their other EVs but said the slower speed was acceptable. [signal:495369f3-9751-4c03-bd05-b7c21822e1ee] A G60 owner without a home charger said charging made using the vehicle harder. [signal:38896257-b505-4e62-8a60-117556d167c7]

## Differences between markets
The signals shown here are from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles; they do not establish differences between markets. [signal:0cf7d76b-3a0d-43b6-87aa-0220cbfb8f3f] [signal:0e8dfaf3-d441-465a-8bd6-17ed96567fd3] [signal:0f983058-2a5e-455b-a4c0-17ee7dfff42d] [signal:38896257-b505-4e62-8a60-117556d167c7] [signal:495369f3-9751-4c03-bd05-b7c21822e1ee] [signal:51c16cbb-dfed-4be2-bdc1-07ca2b9326aa]

## Open questions
Do the other signals in the 22-signal case show additional markets, vehicle lines, or charging issues? [signal:0cf7d76b-3a0d-43b6-87aa-0220cbfb8f3f] [signal:0e8dfaf3-d441-465a-8bd6-17ed96567fd3] [signal:0f983058-2a5e-455b-a4c0-17ee7dfff42d] [signal:38896257-b505-4e62-8a60-117556d167c7] [signal:495369f3-9751-4c03-bd05-b7c21822e1ee] [signal:51c16cbb-dfed-4be2-bdc1-07ca2b9326aa] What share of reported charging difficulties concerns adapter selection, installation timing, or equipment that does not work? [signal:0cf7d76b-3a0d-43b6-87aa-0220cbfb8f3f] [signal:0e8dfaf3-d441-465a-8bd6-17ed96567fd3] [signal:0f983058-2a5e-455b-a4c0-17ee7dfff42d] [signal:51c16cbb-dfed-4be2-bdc1-07ca2b9326aa]

value.title: Air-conditioning settings are hard to balance or unreliable
value.summary: Customers report difficulty balancing air-conditioning settings, concerns about single-zone climate control, and isolated control or ventilation faults. Signals come from Europe, Rest of World and the USA, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Air-conditioning settings can be difficult to balance, and some controls or ventilation components have failed.
Signals span Europe, Rest of World and the USA; F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers find it difficult to balance the air-conditioning or direct airflow using the controls [signal:9e8201f0-1fd1-4ed0-985a-77e397e9b4cf]. A Europe-based F70 owner objects to single-zone climate controls [signal:6480431a-7aa7-45ff-9611-cda7ceb83e2b]. In a USA G70, a customer reported an unresponsive passenger fan-speed slider and a stuck ventilation flap; service notes say the passenger vent worked only on maximum A/C [signal:df69f7f9-b15e-4a0d-a2e5-50ecf65386ad]. Another USA G70 customer reported air leaking into the cabin and an issue with the A/C [signal:f0011a11-e7b0-4f74-b17f-9d14f89fefc7].

## What customers say
The G60 owner says the earlier controls made it easier to change temperature and direct air to the face or hands [signal:9e8201f0-1fd1-4ed0-985a-77e397e9b4cf]. The F70 owner describes single-zone climate control as cost-cutting and says dual-zone air should be standard on an M model [signal:6480431a-7aa7-45ff-9611-cda7ceb83e2b]. The G70 slider issue was repaired, and the customer said the control worked properly afterward [signal:df69f7f9-b15e-4a0d-a2e5-50ecf65386ad].

## Differences between markets
Europe signals include an F70 complaint about single-zone climate controls and a G60 complaint about balancing airflow and temperature [signal:6480431a-7aa7-45ff-9611-cda7ceb83e2b] [signal:9e8201f0-1fd1-4ed0-985a-77e397e9b4cf]. USA signals describe G70 ventilation or A/C issues, including one repaired slider fault and a separate report of cabin air leakage [signal:df69f7f9-b15e-4a0d-a2e5-50ecf65386ad] [signal:f0011a11-e7b0-4f74-b17f-9d14f89fefc7]. The Rest of World F70 signal describes broader control-system concerns, but the available excerpt does not specify an air-conditioning fault [signal:caa26c23-9721-40a1-a803-327e8ebd7d1a].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequent the reported control or ventilation faults are, or whether the reports share a cause [signal:df69f7f9-b15e-4a0d-a2e5-50ecf65386ad] [signal:f0011a11-e7b0-4f74-b17f-9d14f89fefc7]. They also do not show whether the single-zone configuration or difficulty balancing settings is common beyond these individual reports [signal:6480431a-7aa7-45ff-9611-cda7ceb83e2b] [signal:9e8201f0-1fd1-4ed0-985a-77e397e9b4cf].

value.title: Climate controls lack independent settings and preferred access
value.summary: Customers report missing independent temperature settings and request different ways to operate or access climate controls. The signals come from Europe’s F70 and US G60 and G70 customers.
highlights: Customers miss split temperature controls and request more accessible climate-control operation.
Signals include Europe F70 and US G60 and G70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 customers in Europe say driver and passenger temperatures cannot be adjusted independently, or that dual climate control is no longer standard; one reports the function disappeared after vehicle pickup. [signal:074f771a-b3c8-4b10-9870-59132b843a49] [signal:2416ff02-d6d4-43f9-bcef-dfa7f3c10d47] [signal:a3c127ac-7762-4585-af8d-fed040545154] [signal:15f4eb35-fac4-46f5-bca1-932e73b4e808] [signal:2e101b75-d2ab-4361-be4a-5fb7f73d6223] [signal:aec9f3bf-62fe-4e6d-8fce-d96e5cf662a3]

US customers request steering-wheel controls, rear climate controls, four-way climate control, and physical climate buttons. [signal:544e8a47-b4b4-446f-8790-c71a8e938784] [signal:54ede08a-9b2e-45d1-80eb-37211882c679] [signal:ae49486b-048c-4164-82b8-f040ef48a0bb] [signal:5fd5cfb0-6b1f-4de4-ab87-624656a6c553] [signal:ec014fb2-24bc-498d-907c-bd22df7a492b]

## What customers say
One European customer links the loss of dual temperature controls to different comfort needs for themself and their son, who experiences motion sickness. [signal:074f771a-b3c8-4b10-9870-59132b843a49] A US G70 customer says finding the fan control on the screen requires looking away from the road and prefers physical buttons, despite using voice control. [signal:5fd5cfb0-6b1f-4de4-ab87-624656a6c553]

Not all feedback is negative: a US G60 customer appreciates having air conditioning while living in Florida. [signal:f4f4f92f-d4c5-4e54-80b3-cdb62824cf53]

## Differences between markets
European feedback shown here focuses on independent driver and passenger temperature settings in the F70. [signal:074f771a-b3c8-4b10-9870-59132b843a49] [signal:2416ff02-d6d4-43f9-bcef-dfa7f3c10d47] [signal:a3c127ac-7762-4585-af8d-fed040545154] [signal:15f4eb35-fac4-46f5-bca1-932e73b4e808] [signal:2e101b75-d2ab-4361-be4a-5fb7f73d6223] [signal:aec9f3bf-62fe-4e6d-8fce-d96e5cf662a3] US feedback shown here includes requests about control location, physical buttons, rear passengers, and four-way climate control across the G60 and G70. [signal:544e8a47-b4b4-446f-8790-c71a8e938784] [signal:54ede08a-9b2e-45d1-80eb-37211882c679] [signal:ae49486b-048c-4164-82b8-f040ef48a0bb] [signal:5fd5cfb0-6b1f-4de4-ab87-624656a6c553] [signal:ec014fb2-24bc-498d-907c-bd22df7a492b]

## Open questions
Do the reported loss of dual temperature controls and the absence of standard dual climate control refer to the same F70 configuration? [signal:074f771a-b3c8-4b10-9870-59132b843a49] [signal:2416ff02-d6d4-43f9-bcef-dfa7f3c10d47] The signals do not clarify what customers mean by four-way climate control. [signal:ae49486b-048c-4164-82b8-f040ef48a0bb]

value.title: Climate settings are difficult to understand and adjust
value.summary: Customers report difficulty understanding or adjusting climate settings, including sync, temperature zones, and screen-based controls. Signals cover USA G60 and G70 customers and Europe F70 customers.
highlights: Customers struggle with climate controls, including sync, airflow, and screen-based adjustments.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 vehicles and Europe F70 vehicles.
One customer says sync stays active in other vehicles they have owned.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe climate settings as difficult to understand or operate, including how to turn the system on, change airflow, use sync, or adjust heating through the screen. [signal:1484fb71-00b9-4a19-8086-12ae5f91a50f] [signal:0665a3c5-3985-4787-95a4-944fa65002a4] [signal:4de54842-0164-4fa7-8e66-97d00aceb79f] [signal:ebf9f401-97df-4e9c-9b0a-b92e0f7e5652]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer says sync must be pressed each time they get into the car, unlike in other vehicles they have owned. [signal:01d45927-f279-4e6d-b5a7-e9e2e7e5dd10]

A USA G60 customer is frustrated that heating is controlled through the screen rather than traditional buttons. [signal:361c1c86-be29-4e10-a2ba-bc74243b06ad]

In Europe, F70 customers report difficulty unsyncing the climate controls or finding a sync-off control, and one says the screen-based heater adjustment feels awkward and unsafe while driving. [signal:5b4ae5ad-ff58-4642-b1bd-2a19edf85fd1] [signal:752fa784-5443-4de8-abbd-6b8c3da20e27] [signal:7b7ffa9a-fce6-42f4-8d0a-eaecb498ee7b] [signal:ebf9f401-97df-4e9c-9b0a-b92e0f7e5652]

## Differences between markets
USA signals describe questions about airflow, climate activation, Auto mode, and screen-based heating controls in G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:0665a3c5-3985-4787-95a4-944fa65002a4] [signal:2f308a85-5c7d-40cd-b91e-bb31f2313bc8] [signal:361c1c86-be29-4e10-a2ba-bc74243b06ad] [signal:4de54842-0164-4fa7-8e66-97d00aceb79f]

Europe F70 signals focus on synchronization: some customers cannot find how to unsync the settings, while another says the AC cannot be unsynced. [signal:5b4ae5ad-ff58-4642-b1bd-2a19edf85fd1] [signal:752fa784-5443-4de8-abbd-6b8c3da20e27] [signal:7b7ffa9a-fce6-42f4-8d0a-eaecb498ee7b]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported sync behavior is consistent across F70 vehicles or how the controls behave across all affected vehicles. [signal:5b4ae5ad-ff58-4642-b1bd-2a19edf85fd1] [signal:7b7ffa9a-fce6-42f4-8d0a-eaecb498ee7b]

The signals do not clarify how often customers encounter difficulty with climate activation, airflow adjustment, or screen-based heating controls. [signal:0665a3c5-3985-4787-95a4-944fa65002a4] [signal:4de54842-0164-4fa7-8e66-97d00aceb79f] [signal:ebf9f401-97df-4e9c-9b0a-b92e0f7e5652]

## Problem

The menu-access and targeting complaints shown here are from USA G70 signals. [signal:2a53a338-5b2d-4552-8d7d-fc202e457544] [signal:b03ff19a-2b58-4be2-addf-ecaa2cfb471a] [signal:15dbfca7-584e-4a0d-bb58-2154978c202d]
Rest of World F70 signals mention the massage option, but the available quotes do not describe a specific usability issue with it. [signal:3f484254-fe01-490c-a0bd-82dfd8008c03] [signal:d9acf725-f93e-4a2a-80c1-61fca6ece4de]

## Open questions
Do customers in other markets or vehicle lines also have difficulty finding the massage controls or targeting a specific area? The provided usability details are from USA G70 signals. value.body_md:

The signals describe massage seats as a valued feature in a customer's previous car, absent from a current car, or unclear in the vehicle's packaging information; they do not describe a reliability failure. The signals do not establish how common the preference for darker interiors is, or whether it varies by vehicle line or market.

value.title: Massage seats missing or unavailable on selected vehicles
value.summary: Customers of G60 and G70 vehicles want massage seats, miss the feature in a vehicle they previously had it in, or are disappointed when they find it was not included or cannot be added. Requests include both front and rear seats.
highlights: Customers want massage seats or are disappointed they are missing or unavailable.
Signals include USA G60 and G70 customers and a Rest of World G60 customer.
One buyer mentions initially considering another make; the signal is incomplete.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers want massage seats in their vehicles, and some report that the feature is missing from the vehicle they bought or cannot be added afterward. [signal:16e6a800-4658-4206-a709-318c0530b2fc] [signal:60a7ba67-ac86-4850-8918-3b0ad90b6d24] One customer specifically wanted rear massage seats and was told the option had to be selected when the vehicle was built. [signal:0d6efe14-dbcb-4734-880f-9bc283d10c86]

## What customers say
G60 customers ask for massage seats, including front seats, and one customer says the car would be better with the feature. [signal:16e6a800-4658-4206-a709-318c0530b2fc] [signal:34ecff4a-546b-4368-96c5-c635139cc3f1] [signal:409de7cf-e4f0-46f8-be2d-c0ec10f0a23b] A G70 customer says they enjoyed massage seats in their previous 740 and were disappointed their current car did not have them. [signal:45f60633-1f3e-4af9-8226-0baef2766224] Another G70 customer expected the feature, learned it was not available on their trim, and was told it could not be added after purchase. [signal:60a7ba67-ac86-4850-8918-3b0ad90b6d24] A Rest of World G60 customer says they miss having seat massage in their current car compared with their previous 540i. [signal:e51d429a-cf06-4a79-9943-61e9a76cd177]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA signals include requests and reports of missing massage seats for G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:16e6a800-4658-4206-a709-318c0530b2fc] [signal:34ecff4a-546b-4368-96c5-c635139cc3f1] [signal:409de7cf-e4f0-46f8-be2d-c0ec10f0a23b] [signal:45f60633-1f3e-4af9-8226-0baef2766224] [signal:60a7ba67-ac86-4850-8918-3b0ad90b6d24] The supplied Rest of World signal is from a G60 customer who misses massage seats from a previous vehicle. [signal:e51d429a-cf06-4a79-9943-61e9a76cd177]

## Open questions
The supplied signals do not establish how often massage seats are wanted for front versus rear seats. [signal:0d6efe14-dbcb-4734-880f-9bc283d10c86] [signal:409de7cf-e4f0-46f8-be2d-c0ec10f0a23b] They also do not show how availability varies by trim or market beyond the individual customer accounts. [signal:60a7ba67-ac86-4850-8918-3b0ad90b6d24]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say the interior design is less appealing than an earlier version, or that materials and trim feel cheap or untidy. [signal:b1bd4ee9-372f-4507-9d8c-68a96ac55d85] [signal:d579b90e-3c09-4eca-b257-052b131e0d60] [signal:dca51f04-737b-4eea-a3c2-c4541114be8a] Others report that piano-black center-console trim scratches easily. [signal:0cbfe8d6-7c31-4a46-95ac-d5f582e92d36]

## What customers say
A Europe-based F70 owner preferred the older interior design and said some materials and the center console felt cheap or untidy. [signal:b1bd4ee9-372f-4507-9d8c-68a96ac55d85] [signal:dca51f04-737b-4eea-a3c2-c4541114be8a] Another Europe-based F70 owner singled out the door material and plastic tray under the center console as feeling cheap, while praising the steering wheel and sweeping screen. [signal:0327d335-b62d-4039-ada5-5e91481a1f7a] A Rest of World G60 owner also described the interior materials as cheap-looking. [signal:d579b90e-3c09-4eca-b257-052b131e0d60]

Feedback is not uniformly negative: customers also describe interiors as gorgeous, high-quality, or wonderful. [signal:ff29f481-e55f-4bdf-97fb-031b62387c8a] [signal:1c1ac1df-3cc0-4455-bd87-a8c1e6d42d42] [signal:1ed3a8cd-8d3c-4193-9335-505af8374426] A USA-based G60 owner praised the overall appearance and steering wheel but reported easily scratched piano-black trim. [signal:0cbfe8d6-7c31-4a46-95ac-d5f582e92d36]

## Differences between markets
In the sampled feedback, concerns about perceived material quality appear in Europe for F70 and in Rest of World for G60. [signal:0327d335-b62d-4039-ada5-5e91481a1f7a] [signal:dca51f04-737b-4eea-a3c2-c4541114be8a] [signal:d579b90e-3c09-4eca-b257-052b131e0d60] Positive assessments also appear in Europe and Rest of World, so the signals do not show a consistent view within those markets. [signal:1c1ac1df-3cc0-4455-bd87-a8c1e6d42d42] [signal:1ed3a8cd-8d3c-4193-9335-505af8374426] [signal:0327d335-b62d-4039-ada5-5e91481a1f7a]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these design and material concerns are beyond the examples provided. [signal:b1bd4ee9-372f-4507-9d8c-68a96ac55d85] [signal:d579b90e-3c09-4eca-b257-052b131e0d60] They also do not clarify whether views differ by interior configuration or customer expectations. [signal:dca51f04-737b-4eea-a3c2-c4541114be8a] [signal:0cbfe8d6-7c31-4a46-95ac-d5f582e92d36]

value.title: Reflective crystal details distract some drivers
value.summary: Some USA G70 customers find glossy and crystal interior details distracting because they can create glare, while others value their appearance and interaction with ambient lighting.
highlights: Glossy and crystal details can cause distracting glare for some drivers.
Signals are from USA customers describing the G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say glossy cockpit surfaces and crystal controls create reflections or sun glare that distract them, including while driving. [signal:4163970f-37b1-4270-9faf-3d4d0bfa3138] [signal:8b30c70c-8ff1-4f7f-b19c-720b3c6c72a5] [signal:c29f3298-4647-4677-a699-9f54d2b572c8]

Other feedback values the crystal details: customers describe them as tasteful and say they enjoy how they catch ambient lighting. [signal:76f8796e-3377-4b7d-b460-eb758a5bcfa5] [signal:7d8afef6-c5ca-40ae-a597-17cfcb2fac47]

## What customers say
One customer says the crystal controls feel effeminate and prefers stainless steel. [signal:ee16b530-c477-4ad8-98d7-5616ae4294ec] Another says wood trim in a previous 740 did not have the sun-glare issue. [signal:c29f3298-4647-4677-a699-9f54d2b572c8]

Some customers particularly like the crystal door accents, chair controls, center dial, and shifter. [signal:76f8796e-3377-4b7d-b460-eb758a5bcfa5] Another appreciates the crystal details alongside the large, immersive dashboard screen. [signal:7d8afef6-c5ca-40ae-a597-17cfcb2fac47]

## Differences between markets
The provided signals are from USA customers describing the G70; they do not show differences between markets. [signal:4163970f-37b1-4270-9faf-3d4d0bfa3138] [signal:8b30c70c-8ff1-4f7f-b19c-720b3c6c72a5] [signal:c29f3298-4647-4677-a699-9f54d2b572c8] [signal:ee16b530-c477-4ad8-98d7-5616ae4294ec] [signal:76f8796e-3377-4b7d-b460-eb758a5bcfa5] [signal:7d8afef6-c5ca-40ae-a597-17cfcb2fac47]

## Open questions
How often do the reflections distract drivers, and under what driving or lighting conditions? [signal:4163970f-37b1-4270-9faf-3d4d0bfa3138] [signal:8b30c70c-8ff1-4f7f-b19c-720b3c6c72a5] Do customers who appreciate the crystal details experience the same glare concerns?  [signal:7d8afef6-c5ca-40ae-a597-17cfcb2fac47]

G60 customers ask for more premium materials and less plastic; one says the glossy finish picks up fingerprints wherever it is touched. [signal:4e2c6bc7-85a6-4bf7-afe6-c313a1b3081e] [signal:8317ab64-65eb-40c6-be1a-35d72b711a46]

One G60 customer says the cabin feels less nice than their previous M340i and M440i Gran Coupe, and describes the interior as plain and minimalistic, with too much piano black and less visible stitching. [signal:88e7db0a-28c5-4904-b809-1f2fb7cdfc3c]

value.title: Seat adjustments feel limited for some customers
value.summary: Some USA G60 and G70 customers want more seat adjustment options or dynamic side bolsters, and one G60 customer describes the seats as uncomfortable. Other customers value the leg extension and easy entry/exit function.
highlights: Some customers report discomfort or want additional seat adjustments and dynamic side bolsters.
Signals cover four USA G60 customers and two USA G70 customers.
One customer says BMW is one of the few brands still offering a seat leg extension.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want seat functions or adjustments they do not currently have, including thigh-bolster buttons, upper-backrest adjustment, and dynamic side bolsters [signal:79c0a438-3e34-47b6-8e7b-e260bdb6f694] [signal:93622d19-6539-41e7-845b-70756d27a8b9] [signal:0a6ab443-75dd-4fbb-85b9-f606611aed62]. One G60 customer says the seats are uncomfortable and that the multi-contour seats have fewer adjustments than in their previous G30 [signal:03137b3d-8e40-40c7-8668-f1dbdf9df29b].

## What customers say
A G60 customer wants the thigh-bolster adjustment setup from her previous car, and another wants adjustment for the upper section of the front backrests [signal:79c0a438-3e34-47b6-8e7b-e260bdb6f694] [signal:93622d19-6539-41e7-845b-70756d27a8b9]. A G70 customer wants active side bolsters during cornering [signal:0a6ab443-75dd-4fbb-85b9-f606611aed62].

Other customers value existing functions: one says the leg extension eases her knee pain, and another appreciates easy entry/exit, while wishing the seat slid farther back and lowered more [signal:8c33c283-b20a-4fec-9471-c961a544b74c] [signal:b20cae24-1bb6-45db-85d6-32d63a8e948e].

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA, so the signals provide no comparison between markets [signal:03137b3d-8e40-40c7-8668-f1dbdf9df29b] [signal:0a6ab443-75dd-4fbb-85b9-f606611aed62] [signal:79c0a438-3e34-47b6-8e7b-e260bdb6f694] [signal:93622d19-6539-41e7-845b-70756d27a8b9] [signal:8c33c283-b20a-4fec-9471-c961a544b74c] [signal:b20cae24-1bb6-45db-85d6-32d63a8e948e].

## Open questions
Do the adjustment concerns differ between G60 and G70 customers? The signals include four G60 and two G70 customers, with different seat requests across the vehicles [signal:03137b3d-8e40-40c7-8668-f1dbdf9df29b] [signal:79c0a438-3e34-47b6-8e7b-e260bdb6f694] [signal:93622d19-6539-41e7-845b-70756d27a8b9] [signal:8c33c283-b20a-4fec-9471-c961a544b74c] [signal:0a6ab443-75dd-4fbb-85b9-f606611aed62] [signal:b20cae24-1bb6-45db-85d6-32d63a8e948e]. How common are discomfort and requests for these adjustments beyond the customers represented here? [signal:03137b3d-8e40-40c7-8668-f1dbdf9df29b] [signal:79c0a438-3e34-47b6-8e7b-e260bdb6f694] [signal:93622d19-6539-41e7-845b-70756d27a8b9] [signal:0a6ab443-75dd-4fbb-85b9-f606611aed62]

value.title: Seat fit and adjustment needs vary across models
value.summary: Some drivers report limited seat adjustment, an unwanted or unsuitable seat extension, or discomfort; others praise seat comfort and space. Concerns appear in Europe’s F70 and the USA’s G60, while positive seat feedback also appears across F70 and G70 signals.
highlights: Some drivers report uncomfortable seats, limited adjustment, or an unsuitable seat extension.
Concerns appear in Europe’s F70 and USA’s G60; other signals praise F70 and G70 seat comfort.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Seat feedback is mixed: some drivers describe discomfort or insufficient adjustment, while others say the seats are comfortable or offer ample space. [signal:b2b35b05-507f-4959-9708-de6ec527b72d] [signal:88c92cb5-3a6c-42ce-919f-14d266b98517] [signal:35f55287-1f87-4566-8de4-e194a8e87e51] [signal:8537b3ad-3417-4cb9-8bcc-ac5c9c586697]

## What customers say
An F70 driver in Europe misses the front extension on the sports seat. [signal:054484ab-e2c0-4837-810e-365f683fb854]

A USA G60 driver who is not tall says the seat extension seems intended for taller drivers and wishes it could be retracted, particularly on the driver seat. [signal:a8973b5e-17d9-47b6-9e2f-a5b46264fc38]

Another USA G60 driver reports fewer adjustments in the multi-contour seats than in the earlier G30 and describes the seats as uncomfortable. [signal:b2b35b05-507f-4959-9708-de6ec527b72d]

A G60 driver in the USA says getting the driver seat adjusted has taken hours and has been associated with serious lower-right-back and right-knee pain. [signal:88c92cb5-3a6c-42ce-919f-14d266b98517]

Positive feedback differs: an F70 driver calls the new seats comfortable, a G70 driver reports improved seat comfort, and another G70 driver praises rear-seat legroom despite being 6'6\". [signal:35f55287-1f87-4566-8de4-e194a8e87e51] [signal:429b3b39-a8d9-4609-a6c9-93542762ee67] [signal:8537b3ad-3417-4cb9-8bcc-ac5c9c586697]

## Differences between markets
The seat-extension concerns appear in Europe’s F70 and the USA’s G60. [signal:054484ab-e2c0-4837-810e-365f683fb854] [signal:a8973b5e-17d9-47b6-9e2f-a5b46264fc38]

The reports of fewer seat adjustments and difficulty finding a comfortable driver-seat position are from USA G60 drivers. [signal:b2b35b05-507f-4959-9708-de6ec527b72d] [signal:88c92cb5-3a6c-42ce-919f-14d266b98517]

Positive feedback is also present: an F70 driver in Europe praises seat comfort, while USA G70 drivers praise seat comfort or rear-seat legroom. [signal:35f55287-1f87-4566-8de4-e194a8e87e51] [signal:429b3b39-a8d9-4609-a6c9-93542762ee67] [signal:8537b3ad-3417-4cb9-8bcc-ac5c9c586697]

## Open questions
Do seat-extension preferences or adjustment difficulties vary by driver stature, seat type, or vehicle line? [signal:054484ab-e2c0-4837-810e-365f683fb854] [signal:a8973b5e-17d9-47b6-9e2f-a5b46264fc38] [signal:b2b35b05-507f-4959-9708-de6ec527b72d] [signal:88c92cb5-3a6c-42ce-919f-14d266b98517]

How do the positive comfort reports relate to the discomfort and adjustment complaints across models? [signal:35f55287-1f87-4566-8de4-e194a8e87e51] [signal:429b3b39-a8d9-4609-a6c9-93542762ee67] [signal:8537b3ad-3417-4cb9-8bcc-ac5c9c586697] [signal:b2b35b05-507f-4959-9708-de6ec527b72d] [signal:88c92cb5-3a6c-42ce-919f-14d266b98517]

## Problem

[signal:10e79a28-fec8-4587-828c-ba3abad2ddc4] [signal:31695a74-1d9d-496d-b47f-698e9b3f2e64] [signal:32d411ef-b656-446c-8bd4-aad8dbde45b0] [signal:51f4bf0e-ffd1-4d5e-aec6-1f44a205e122] [signal:a5f68a16-1bb4-4e69-9d77-2f2633617908]

value.title: Seat materials stain easily and feel like a step down

highlights: Seat materials are described as easily soiled, delicate, deteriorated or lower quality.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe seat materials that stain or soil easily, leave residue after contact with wetness, or feel like a deterioration in quality. [signal:3f7704f5-0050-44bf-a35d-f7648e6ec51c] [signal:662e67f3-0ba1-43f3-a0aa-6be1b2185989] [signal:0e91d346-0fa2-4170-b6fb-f887426855cf] A G60 owner also says the seats feel cheap and that leather seats should be included at the car’s price point. [signal:6571be33-ace7-4924-945a-7eaf560211be]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the seats stain easily and wetness leaves residue, and is unsure how to clean them. [signal:3f7704f5-0050-44bf-a35d-f7648e6ec51c] A USA G70 owner reports that white leather seats are delicate and quickly show dirt when touched. [signal:662e67f3-0ba1-43f3-a0aa-6be1b2185989] A Rest of World F70 owner says the seats have deteriorated compared with a previous 3 Series. [signal:0e91d346-0fa2-4170-b6fb-f887426855cf] A USA G70 owner says the seat and headrest feel too tall for their 5-foot-6-inch stature. [signal:169496a7-19ba-43de-a483-b2b2cda932ae] Some customers specifically want leather seats to be standard or included. [signal:2e274e60-7ae8-426a-aa84-d7b13dd53f9c] [signal:6571be33-ace7-4924-945a-7eaf560211be]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include seat-quality concerns in the USA and Rest of World, and requests for leather seats as standard in Europe. [signal:3f7704f5-0050-44bf-a35d-f7648e6ec51c] [signal:662e67f3-0ba1-43f3-a0aa-6be1b2185989] [signal:0e91d346-0fa2-4170-b6fb-f887426855cf] [signal:2e274e60-7ae8-426a-aa84-d7b13dd53f9c] The supplied signals do not establish whether these concerns differ in prevalence between markets. [signal:3f7704f5-0050-44bf-a35d-f7648e6ec51c] [signal:662e67f3-0ba1-43f3-a0aa-6be1b2185989] [signal:0e91d346-0fa2-4170-b6fb-f887426855cf] [signal:2e274e60-7ae8-426a-aa84-d7b13dd53f9c]

## Open questions
The signals do not explain which seat materials or finishes are most prone to staining, or what cleaning guidance customers have received. [signal:3f7704f5-0050-44bf-a35d-f7648e6ec51c] They also do not clarify how broadly seat height or headrest fit is a concern beyond the individual report. [signal:169496a7-19ba-43de-a483-b2b2cda932ae]

value.title: Seat adjustment range does not meet some customers’ needs
value.summary: Some customers want more seat height to improve their view, while another wants more rearward travel despite the theatre-screen stop. These requests come from USA customers in G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Some customers say the available seat adjustment range does not meet their needs.
Three USA signals cover G60 and G70; two concern shorter occupants seeking more height.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want the seat to adjust higher: one G60 customer says she is 5 feet tall and wants at least another inch, and another says his wife wants about another quarter inch or more to see over the hood [signal:0c923290-33f8-44e0-88e2-0a9a17770075] [signal:eca6ce81-167a-42c1-a8ea-dae6040c7643]. A G70 customer wants the seat to move farther back than the current stop, or at least another two inches [signal:1cc779e6-b34c-4c9b-a18d-58d35401b84f].

## What customers say
The G60 customer uses a cushion because the seat does not adjust high enough, and says it is uncomfortable and interferes with airflow from the ventilated seat [signal:0c923290-33f8-44e0-88e2-0a9a17770075]. She says the dealership had nothing to offer [signal:0c923290-33f8-44e0-88e2-0a9a17770075]. The G70 customer understands that the seat stops about six inches from the theatre screen to avoid damaging it, but wants an option to move it farther back at their own risk [signal:1cc779e6-b34c-4c9b-a18d-58d35401b84f].

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA; two concern G60 seat height and one concerns G70 rearward travel [signal:0c923290-33f8-44e0-88e2-0a9a17770075] [signal:1cc779e6-b34c-4c9b-a18d-58d35401b84f] [signal:eca6ce81-167a-42c1-a8ea-dae6040c7643]. The signals describe different adjustment needs, not conflicting views about the same adjustment [signal:0c923290-33f8-44e0-88e2-0a9a17770075] [signal:1cc779e6-b34c-4c9b-a18d-58d35401b84f] [signal:eca6ce81-167a-42c1-a8ea-dae6040c7643].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these adjustment needs are beyond the three reported cases [signal:0c923290-33f8-44e0-88e2-0a9a17770075] [signal:1cc779e6-b34c-4c9b-a18d-58d35401b84f] [signal:eca6ce81-167a-42c1-a8ea-dae6040c7643].

value.title: Seat adjustment controls are confusing and difficult to use

highlights: Seat adjustment can take multiple steps, be hard to find, or provide insufficient lumbar support.
The supplied signals mention USA customers and G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers describe seat adjustment as unintuitive or difficult, including controls split between the seat and touchscreen, controls that are hard to locate, and adjustment procedures requiring multiple actions. [signal:44c17433-9e1d-4164-98ff-8a4592993581] [signal:49996993-990a-4de3-8df2-5de8a9641bd4] [signal:6b47d5a0-f05e-44a3-95ac-9917424cf0a8]

A customer also reports difficulty finding a comfortable driving position, while another says lumbar support is insufficient. [signal:1a77c29d-aa9f-4b76-bc7b-b8877429b85d] [signal:5df0fddc-78d8-44b8-9aa8-e8ed6b99e4a9]

## What customers say
One customer says they spent hours trying to adjust the driver’s seat and experienced lower-back and knee pain. [signal:1a77c29d-aa9f-4b76-bc7b-b8877429b85d]

Customers describe touchscreen-based adjustments as confusing, seat controls as difficult to find or use while driving, and seat-position changes as requiring three or four actions. [signal:44c17433-9e1d-4164-98ff-8a4592993581] [signal:49996993-990a-4de3-8df2-5de8a9641bd4] [signal:6b47d5a0-f05e-44a3-95ac-9917424cf0a8]

One customer wants to adjust the passenger seat from the driver’s side and says explaining the controls can be harder than adjusting the seat themselves. [signal:1c55cc60-d1eb-416d-8d09-397dded9c578]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals shown here are from the USA and mention G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:1a77c29d-aa9f-4b76-bc7b-b8877429b85d] [signal:1c55cc60-d1eb-416d-8d09-397dded9c578] [signal:44c17433-9e1d-4164-98ff-8a4592993581] [signal:49996993-990a-4de3-8df2-5de8a9641bd4] [signal:5df0fddc-78d8-44b8-9aa8-e8ed6b99e4a9] [signal:6b47d5a0-f05e-44a3-95ac-9917424cf0a8]

## Open questions
Do the reported control difficulties or comfort concerns vary by seat function, vehicle line, or customer circumstances? The supplied signals include concerns about headrest adjustment, lumbar support, control location, and passenger-seat adjustment. [signal:44c17433-9e1d-4164-98ff-8a4592993581] [signal:5df0fddc-78d8-44b8-9aa8-e8ed6b99e4a9] [signal:6b47d5a0-f05e-44a3-95ac-9917424cf0a8] [signal:1c55cc60-d1eb-416d-8d09-397dded9c578]

value.title: Driver seat position and extension do not suit all drivers

value.body_md:
## Problem
Two USA drivers describe driver-seat fit or positioning concerns: one says the G70 seat sits too low and makes it hard to judge distances; another says the G60 seat extension is intended for taller drivers and should retract. [signal:524d068d-5fcf-443c-a8a6-7af14c277687] [signal:c2480f4d-631c-490d-ad01-607950feb652]

## What customers say
The G70 driver compares the seating position unfavourably with their 2007 and 2015 7 Series, saying they did not have the same difficulty judging distances in those cars. [signal:524d068d-5fcf-443c-a8a6-7af14c277687]

The G60 driver says they are not tall and wants the driver-seat extension to retract. [signal:c2480f4d-631c-490d-ad01-607950feb652]

## Differences between markets
Both seat-usability complaints are from the USA, covering the G70 and G60. [signal:524d068d-5fcf-443c-a8a6-7af14c277687] [signal:c2480f4d-631c-490d-ad01-607950feb652] The Rest of World signal discusses limitations with the rear-seat monitor, not seat fit or positioning. [signal:aa32f0f6-0f14-4cf4-b746-619c71a5f4d8]

## Open questions
Do other drivers experience difficulty judging distances because of the G70 driver-seat position? [signal:524d068d-5fcf-443c-a8a6-7af14c277687]

How widespread is the concern about the G60 seat extension among drivers who are not tall? [signal:c2480f4d-631c-490d-ad01-607950feb652]

value.title: Seat bolsters unavailable outside Sport mode

One customer wants to use the bolsters in modes other than Sport. [signal:8b6b8405-daf6-4d7e-bf6b-71661610932d] Another customer praises the side bolster support, describing how it wraps around her back when Sport mode is on during spirited driving. [signal:5dedab65-620a-4a30-aafa-6112d2ff4bbf]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA and concern the G60. [signal:8b6b8405-daf6-4d7e-bf6b-71661610932d] [signal:5dedab65-620a-4a30-aafa-6112d2ff4bbf] The signals differ in emphasis: one describes a mode limitation, while the other values the support in Sport mode. [signal:8b6b8405-daf6-4d7e-bf6b-71661610932d] [signal:5dedab65-620a-4a30-aafa-6112d2ff4bbf]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common this limitation is among G60 customers. [signal:8b6b8405-daf6-4d7e-bf6b-71661610932d] They also do not indicate whether customers in other markets report the same experience. value.title: Bluetooth pairing must be repeated after phone power cycling
value.summary: A G70 owner in the USA says switching a phone off and on requires repeating Bluetooth pairing; other customers value connecting two phones at once and in-car mobile connectivity.
highlights: A G70 owner reports having to redo Bluetooth pairing after switching the phone off and on.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 vehicles and a Europe F70; two-phone connectivity is appreciated by a G70 owner.
Audi, Mercedes and Chrysler are referenced in connection with phone connectivity or call behavior.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G70 owner in the USA says switching a phone off or on means redoing Bluetooth pairing and spending a long time reconnecting the phone to the car. [signal:3bba71a8-295a-448e-995b-f8c29d163073]

## What customers say
One G70 owner appreciates being able to connect two phones to the car at the same time. [signal:14769021-b2aa-4e7e-91c9-390018170586]
A Europe F70 owner values the car’s mobile-phone connectivity. [signal:76008876-0da0-4340-acf1-8c49da1b5576]
A G60 owner says a paired phone’s call can move to the car when the phone is close and the car is on, and wants the connection distance reduced. [signal:c022f0db-e5f4-4a79-b8d6-71f88ff0491c]
A G70 owner wants audio to resume when a call is made private and moved to the phone, citing a Chrysler Pacifica as an example that handles this well. [signal:8090215d-48d0-4951-a80a-c633ee415a74]
The G70 owner reporting repeated pairing says they had not experienced phone-connection trouble in four prior Audi A8 and Mercedes S-Class cars. [signal:3bba71a8-295a-448e-995b-f8c29d163073]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include a complaint about repeated pairing and a wish to reduce call-transfer distance, as well as appreciation for connecting two phones. [signal:3bba71a8-295a-448e-995b-f8c29d163073] [signal:c022f0db-e5f4-4a79-b8d6-71f88ff0491c] [signal:14769021-b2aa-4e7e-91c9-390018170586]
The Europe signal expresses appreciation for mobile-phone connectivity. [signal:76008876-0da0-4340-acf1-8c49da1b5576]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often repeated pairing occurs beyond the reported G70 owner’s experience. [signal:3bba71a8-295a-448e-995b-f8c29d163073]
The signals do not establish whether the call-transfer distance concern occurs beyond the reported G60 owner’s experience. [signal:c022f0db-e5f4-4a79-b8d6-71f88ff0491c]
