value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe Bluetooth connections that drop, fail to find or authorize a phone, or require pairing again. [signal:06ab82fa-3f9a-4fcb-9d70-fece793fabee] [signal:058b1ac5-6614-460b-9ef4-2ef10759777f] [signal:1b463add-8817-4730-aa09-26cf759029c0] Some report having to reconnect every time they enter the vehicle. [signal:61190d00-e3b2-4f27-83f5-88cfb6f82d25]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer says the car sometimes will not see the phone and requires pairing again. [signal:1b463add-8817-4730-aa09-26cf759029c0] Another USA G70 customer reports having to redo pairing when switching the phone on or off. [signal:3dd3b56b-7443-4af2-b700-cb21f566b0c6] A USA G60 customer says the connection repeatedly drops and must be re-established. [signal:06ab82fa-3f9a-4fcb-9d70-fece793fabee] A Europe F70 customer reports reconnecting every time they get in, while another describes device links going on and off. [signal:61190d00-e3b2-4f27-83f5-88cfb6f82d25] [signal:ad361617-c918-486a-9bda-ec3bcdafa8a7]

One USA customer compares the connection unfavorably with their previous Audi A8 and Mercedes S-Class cars, where they say they had no phone-connection trouble. [signal:3dd3b56b-7443-4af2-b700-cb21f566b0c6]

## Differences between markets
USA reports include phones not being found or authorized, repeated pairing, and dropped connections in G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:058b1ac5-6614-460b-9ef4-2ef10759777f] [signal:1b463add-8817-4730-aa09-26cf759029c0] [signal:06ab82fa-3f9a-4fcb-9d70-fece793fabee] Europe reports describe reconnecting at each journey and links switching on and off in F70 vehicles. [signal:61190d00-e3b2-4f27-83f5-88cfb6f82d25] [signal:ad361617-c918-486a-9bda-ec3bcdafa8a7] Both markets report connection reliability problems. [signal:06ab82fa-3f9a-4fcb-9d70-fece793fabee] [signal:61190d00-e3b2-4f27-83f5-88cfb6f82d25]

## Open questions
Do the reported issues share a cause across the USA G70/G60 and Europe F70 reports? [signal:06ab82fa-3f9a-4fcb-9d70-fece793fabee] [signal:61190d00-e3b2-4f27-83f5-88cfb6f82d25]
Are the connection failures associated with particular phones or software versions? [signal:058b1ac5-6614-460b-9ef4-2ef10759777f] [signal:06ab82fa-3f9a-4fcb-9d70-fece793fabee]

value.title: Bluetooth pairing and connection are unreliable or hard to manage
value.summary: Customers report difficult pairing, repeated reconnection, connection dropouts and device-priority issues. The signals span USA, Europe and Rest of World, across G60, G70 and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Pairing and maintaining Bluetooth connections can be difficult or unreliable.
Signals cover USA G60/G70, Europe F70, and Rest of World G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe Bluetooth pairing and device management as difficult, with phones needing repeated reconnection or connections dropping out. [signal:608e8d3d-aaa0-4e5c-b2ce-ec6587c1aa00] [signal:a66062c6-ad85-4652-8902-22773661a80f]

Other reported issues include a phone connecting and disconnecting intermittently, another driver's phone taking priority, and a device failing to reconnect after Bluetooth and Wi-Fi were switched off. [signal:49616000-b228-4ac7-b1f0-0a704b51569f] [signal:a4c9abdb-a2d7-4af1-b6e7-433851b5e94e]

## What customers say
A Europe F70 owner says the phone must be reconnected whenever they return to the car, even after a brief stop; another reports that pairing takes too long, the connection cuts out, and only two phones can be stored permanently. [signal:608e8d3d-aaa0-4e5c-b2ce-ec6587c1aa00] [signal:a66062c6-ad85-4652-8902-22773661a80f]

USA G70 reports include intermittent connection and incorrect phone priority, as well as difficulty getting Bluetooth to connect correctly. [signal:49616000-b228-4ac7-b1f0-0a704b51569f] [signal:6bdf438f-08ac-48cf-86a7-1f53ac2531e1]

One USA G70 customer restored phone audio by selecting the phone as the preferred device and checking that it was enabled for calls. [signal:a4c9abdb-a2d7-4af1-b6e7-433851b5e94e]

A USA G60 support interaction involved an error while connecting an iPhone, but the provided account does not include the error details or outcome. [signal:175708f8-1456-4272-bf1a-a4862831a3c5]

## Differences between markets
Europe reports emphasize repeated reconnection, slow pairing, dropouts, and a limit of two permanently stored phones. [signal:608e8d3d-aaa0-4e5c-b2ce-ec6587c1aa00] [signal:a66062c6-ad85-4652-8902-22773661a80f]

USA reports include pairing and reconnection trouble, device-priority behavior, and low Bluetooth audio volume. [signal:6bdf438f-08ac-48cf-86a7-1f53ac2531e1] [signal:49616000-b228-4ac7-b1f0-0a704b51569f] [signal:59c17355-bf88-4c7b-a1ad-8712a869afa3]

A Rest of World G60 customer feels Android support is weaker than iPhone support, while also noting they have not fully figured out the system. [signal:e4f818b1-1ef6-46a6-9b5f-3761b851af2a]

## Open questions
What caused the reported connection error in the USA G60 case, and was it resolved? [signal:175708f8-1456-4272-bf1a-a4862831a3c5]

How often do connection drops, repeated pairing, and incorrect device priority occur across markets and vehicle lines? [signal:608e8d3d-aaa0-4e5c-b2ce-ec6587c1aa00] [signal:49616000-b228-4ac7-b1f0-0a704b51569f]

Is the reported two-phone storage limit specific to the Europe F70 experience? [signal:a66062c6-ad85-4652-8902-22773661a80f]

value.title: Cooling component failures cause overheating and extended downtime
value.summary: Customers report cooling-system failures, warning lights and overheating, sometimes soon after delivery, with vehicle downtime and uncertainty about repair timing. The reports cover G70 and G60 customers in the USA, Rest of World and Europe.
highlights: Cooling faults include failed fans, pumps and battery-cooling components, with reports of overheating and extended repairs.
Signals span the USA, Rest of World and Europe, and G70 and G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report cooling-related defects that trigger warning lights or overheating, including failures involving fans, a water pump and a high-voltage battery cooling expansion valve. [signal:2a3bb0a6-046c-42b2-a7db-e0c8286b0948] [signal:34b7e39c-317f-4570-baee-4ca939caab8e] [signal:0cf0719d-0d8e-42c5-9912-118571c542d3]
Some customers say the vehicle was off the road for weeks, and repair timing or parts availability was uncertain. [signal:49c6539a-c6fa-407b-acb2-c00c701c986e] [signal:819affef-e7d8-43f9-a9bd-66c13104388a] [signal:f7042e8f-2fc1-49be-bc48-29084a025f40]

## What customers say
A G70 owner reported overheating within the first half hour of ownership and said the car took about 45 days to return because parts were unavailable. [signal:49c6539a-c6fa-407b-acb2-c00c701c986e]
Other G70 reports describe check-engine warnings linked to a faulty battery-cooling expansion valve or passenger battery coolant fan. [signal:0cf0719d-0d8e-42c5-9912-118571c542d3] [signal:290cde77-e4b6-49cf-ae4a-8cfdbcb9ac90]
G60 owners describe overheating, a faulty water pump, and a cooling fan failure accompanied by coolant leakage. [signal:19895cd6-c4e6-4a41-a2e7-92d22d22bfd8] [signal:34b7e39c-317f-4570-baee-4ca939caab8e] [signal:6509046f-b939-40ae-ae40-fb1dfec8abaa]
Customers also report anxiety about trusting or recommending the car after a cooling failure and repair. [signal:19895cd6-c4e6-4a41-a2e7-92d22d22bfd8] [signal:49c6539a-c6fa-407b-acb2-c00c701c986e]

## Differences between markets
The supplied reports include USA cases involving G70 and G60 vehicles, Rest of World cases involving G60 vehicles, and a Europe case involving a G60. [signal:0cf0719d-0d8e-42c5-9912-118571c542d3] [signal:34b7e39c-317f-4570-baee-4ca939caab8e] [signal:19895cd6-c4e6-4a41-a2e7-92d22d22bfd8] [signal:f7042e8f-2fc1-49be-bc48-29084a025f40]
The reported symptoms and repair experiences vary, including overheating, warning lights, component replacement and parts delays; the signals do not establish a market-level difference. [signal:49c6539a-c6fa-407b-acb2-c00c701c986e] [signal:819affef-e7d8-43f9-a9bd-66c13104388a] [signal:f7042e8f-2fc1-49be-bc48-29084a025f40]

## Open questions
The reports do not establish how frequently these failures occur across vehicles or whether they share a common cause. [signal:0cf0719d-0d8e-42c5-9912-118571c542d3] [signal:34b7e39c-317f-4570-baee-4ca939caab8e]
How long are affected vehicles typically unavailable, and how often do parts delays extend repair time? [signal:49c6539a-c6fa-407b-acb2-c00c701c986e] [signal:f7042e8f-2fc1-49be-bc48-29084a025f40]

value.title: Vehicle location remains incorrect after overnight parking
value.summary: A G70 customer in the USA reports that the displayed vehicle location is wrong after overnight parking in a garage, then corrects after driving briefly.
highlights: Displayed vehicle location is wrong after overnight garage parking and corrects after driving briefly.
One USA signal affects a G70 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
After the vehicle sits overnight in a parking garage, its displayed location is wrong until the customer drives briefly, when it corrects itself. [signal:1511d3e0-8858-45c1-a9e2-134c37645380]

## What customers say
A G70 customer reports this location issue after overnight parking in a garage. [signal:1511d3e0-8858-45c1-a9e2-134c37645380] The writer suggested that an interrupted satellite signal in the garage may cause the disconnect until the signal is re-established. [signal:1511d3e0-8858-45c1-a9e2-134c37645380]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from the USA, so there is no cross-market comparison in the available evidence. [signal:1511d3e0-8858-45c1-a9e2-134c37645380]

## Open questions
Does this issue occur for other customers, vehicles, or parking situations? Is the displayed location accurate again after a short drive in other cases?

value.title: Navigation directions and destination entry are difficult to use
value.summary: USA drivers report confusing or inaccurate directions, difficulty identifying the right destination, and cumbersome navigation controls. Signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Directions, destination selection, and controls can be confusing or inaccurate.
USA signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
USA drivers report navigation that can give unclear or incorrect directions, make it hard to identify the right destination, and require cumbersome interactions. [signal:1172dc42-5cd4-483e-b06b-6125cd43ed52] [signal:7d36d5bb-e0ee-49aa-8628-624793838758] [signal:b69619a2-0f13-49ba-8d4e-5b426136335c]

One G60 driver says the system can mishandle turns and lane splits on country roads and repeatedly prompt after a wrong turn. [signal:1172dc42-5cd4-483e-b06b-6125cd43ed52] A G70 driver says similar addresses can lead the system to the wrong location. [signal:6f6c6f8d-03a4-4ecd-9379-281c4b92a917]

## What customers say
A G60 driver says the next action appears in the head-up display but not on the main screen. [signal:2b2f2656-49e7-4676-a512-2013bb4fd3e7] G70 drivers report that destination options may not show addresses or street names until selected, and choosing the wrong option means cancelling guidance and starting again. [signal:7d36d5bb-e0ee-49aa-8628-624793838758] Another G70 driver reports incorrect traffic information and address or place-finding problems. [signal:8e8d29a4-c7ac-449d-a76a-36e8c03f4793]

A G70 driver describes the system as having too many steps, a poor menu structure, and controls that are difficult to understand. [signal:b69619a2-0f13-49ba-8d4e-5b426136335c]

## Differences between markets
The provided signals are from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles; they do not provide a comparison between markets. [signal:1172dc42-5cd4-483e-b06b-6125cd43ed52] [signal:2b2f2656-49e7-4676-a512-2013bb4fd3e7] [signal:6f6c6f8d-03a4-4ecd-9379-281c4b92a917] [signal:7d36d5bb-e0ee-49aa-8628-624793838758] [signal:8e8d29a4-c7ac-449d-a76a-36e8c03f4793] [signal:b69619a2-0f13-49ba-8d4e-5b426136335c]

## Open questions
How often do these issues occur across the full set of 14 signals, and how do they vary by vehicle, route type, or navigation task? What are the reported impacts of the direction, destination-selection, and control issues?

value.title: Navigation reliability and location information are inconsistent
value.summary: Navigation problems include unreliable operation, incorrect positioning, screens that stop responding, and missing place names. Signals come from F70 owners in Europe and Rest of World, and G60 and G70 owners in the USA.
highlights: Navigation can be unreliable, show the wrong location, freeze, or omit place names.
Reports cover F70 in Europe and Rest of World, plus G60 and G70 in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report navigation that is unreliable or inefficient, shows the vehicle in the wrong place, stops responding, or omits place names. [signal:43d07d4a-c13b-4ebc-b798-b996201439bb] [signal:322e438e-6786-4c30-b65a-94851da7c391] [signal:59c944db-4ccb-47f4-a5c9-425a973a5a1d] [signal:71fc18a0-1bee-4fa8-a6f6-34d0cd1d4241]

## What customers say
A European F70 owner describes the navigation as neither efficient nor reliable. [signal:43d07d4a-c13b-4ebc-b798-b996201439bb] Another Rest of World F70 owner says place names are missing, making it difficult to tell where they are. [signal:71fc18a0-1bee-4fa8-a6f6-34d0cd1d4241]

A Rest of World F70 owner reports that a warning remains on the navigation status screen and the screen then stops responding; dealer visits have not fully resolved the recurring issue. [signal:59c944db-4ccb-47f4-a5c9-425a973a5a1d] A USA G60 owner says navigation initially showed the car in the wrong place, then worked after an iDrive reboot. [signal:322e438e-6786-4c30-b65a-94851da7c391] A USA G70 owner reports that navigation stayed on “starting navigation system” and worked again after a long iDrive reboot. [signal:920fe62c-8089-47b4-a7bc-36d8f35ff75a]

## Differences between markets
European reports include navigation described as inefficient and unreliable in an F70. [signal:43d07d4a-c13b-4ebc-b798-b996201439bb] Rest of World F70 reports mention missing place names and a recurring unresponsive screen. [signal:71fc18a0-1bee-4fa8-a6f6-34d0cd1d4241] [signal:59c944db-4ccb-47f4-a5c9-425a973a5a1d] USA reports describe initial incorrect positioning in a G60 and a navigation startup failure in a G70; both owners say the function worked again after an iDrive reboot. [signal:322e438e-6786-4c30-b65a-94851da7c391] [signal:920fe62c-8089-47b4-a7bc-36d8f35ff75a]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequently these problems occur or whether they share a cause. [signal:43d07d4a-c13b-4ebc-b798-b996201439bb] [signal:59c944db-4ccb-47f4-a5c9-425a973a5a1d] [signal:322e438e-6786-4c30-b65a-94851da7c391] [signal:920fe62c-8089-47b4-a7bc-36d8f35ff75a] The signals also do not clarify why navigation works again after a reboot in the two USA reports, or why the Rest of World F70 issue recurs after dealer visits. [signal:322e438e-6786-4c30-b65a-94851da7c391] [signal:920fe62c-8089-47b4-a7bc-36d8f35ff75a] [signal:59c944db-4ccb-47f4-a5c9-425a973a5a1d]

value.title: Navigation routing and options fall short of customer expectations
value.summary: Customers report untrustworthy routing and missing route choices, while others want easier access to preferred navigation services and clearer map presentation. Signals cover European F70 complaints and USA G60 and G70 requests and complaints.
highlights: Navigation routing, route choices, and map usability fall short for some customers.
Signals include European F70 reports and USA G60 and G70 reports.
Customers compare navigation with Google Maps and Waze.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say navigation routes are untrustworthy or offer too few route choices. [signal:757993e6-23fb-4604-8b5d-62bc658dbae5] [signal:d91882a1-4abf-4498-9085-361947658bc9]
Other requests concern default app selection, map graphics, and displaying upcoming details. [signal:8e3b52a8-de46-4eff-9a5a-73bf9396707b] [signal:99574c87-3edb-4ac1-82c1-3bb6f08d7ab5] [signal:b72294f6-d137-4c19-b0e5-d5279a1d3d38]

## What customers say
Two European F70 drivers describe being routed onto narrow lanes; one says this happened on three trips and caused delays and stress. [signal:757993e6-23fb-4604-8b5d-62bc658dbae5] [signal:d91882a1-4abf-4498-9085-361947658bc9]
One of them says the previous 1 Series offered fastest or shortest route choices, which the current model does not. [signal:d91882a1-4abf-4498-9085-361947658bc9]
A USA G70 owner calls the navigation dreadful and says it does not seem set up for Americans. [signal:55efaf3b-ba3c-4da5-aa43-60a62a86419e]
USA requests include restoring the arrow icon, setting Apple Maps as the default, refining BMW map graphics, and showing upcoming details. [signal:17d703f9-5c32-485e-b753-0da6a8d22211] [signal:8e3b52a8-de46-4eff-9a5a-73bf9396707b] [signal:99574c87-3edb-4ac1-82c1-3bb6f08d7ab5] [signal:b72294f6-d137-4c19-b0e5-d5279a1d3d38]
A USA G70 customer says Google Maps is superior and makes it easier to begin guidance. [signal:12ff5b23-7698-43f1-8660-51de08b1599e]

## Differences between markets
The supplied European F70 reports focus on narrow-road routing and route-choice limitations. [signal:757993e6-23fb-4604-8b5d-62bc658dbae5] [signal:d91882a1-4abf-4498-9085-361947658bc9]
The supplied USA G60 and G70 signals focus on comparison with other navigation apps, app defaults, map presentation, and navigation controls. [signal:12ff5b23-7698-43f1-8660-51de08b1599e] [signal:17d703f9-5c32-485e-b753-0da6a8d22211] [signal:8e3b52a8-de46-4eff-9a5a-73bf9396707b] [signal:99574c87-3edb-4ac1-82c1-3bb6f08d7ab5] [signal:b72294f6-d137-4c19-b0e5-d5279a1d3d38]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often these navigation issues occur across the wider customer population. [signal:757993e6-23fb-4604-8b5d-62bc658dbae5] [signal:d91882a1-4abf-4498-9085-361947658bc9] [signal:12ff5b23-7698-43f1-8660-51de08b1599e]
The signals do not clarify whether the reported route behavior varies by location or navigation settings. [signal:757993e6-23fb-4604-8b5d-62bc658dbae5] [signal:d91882a1-4abf-4498-9085-361947658bc9]

value.title: Navigation routes, accuracy and access frustrate F70 drivers
value.summary: F70 drivers report navigation that can choose unsuitable routes, miss traffic and be less accurate than Google Maps. Other concerns include missing route choices, smartphone dependence and access to a better navigation version.
highlights: Navigation complaints include unsuitable routes, missed traffic, limited route choices and smartphone dependence.
Signals cover five F70 reports: four from Europe and one from Rest of World.
One customer says Google Maps is more accurate than the car navigation.
value.body_md:
## Problem

F70 drivers report navigation taking them onto very narrow lanes, lacking a fastest-versus-shortest route choice, and failing to account for future traffic problems. [signal:0f43c114-f82b-4ccc-96c0-069b71901f47] [signal:571e124b-662c-4f1b-ada1-6ec557c111cb]

One customer says the system has fallen back to basic navigation and that a better version requires an extra payment. [signal:e34d157c-e738-4d1c-b015-784035b4fdbd]

A Rest of World customer says navigation needs a smartphone connection to work. [signal:20e952fe-7dd7-4c41-8307-583b7241f448]

## What customers say

A European customer describes narrow-lane routing on three trips, causing delays and stress, and says their previous 1 Series offered fastest and shortest route choices. [signal:0f43c114-f82b-4ccc-96c0-069b71901f47]

Another European customer says Google Maps is more accurate and reports a journey estimate of one hour that took two because the car navigation did not account for future traffic problems. [signal:571e124b-662c-4f1b-ada1-6ec557c111cb]

## Differences between markets

Four signals are from Europe and one is from Rest of World; all five concern the F70. [signal:0f43c114-f82b-4ccc-96c0-069b71901f47] [signal:20e952fe-7dd7-4c41-8307-583b7241f448] [signal:571e124b-662c-4f1b-ada1-6ec557c111cb] [signal:e34d157c-e738-4d1c-b015-784035b4fdbd] [signal:28c6dab3-eaa7-4e8a-9fb0-6c4b4fc15e79]

The European reports mention routing, traffic accuracy, route-choice availability and access to a better version; the Rest of World report mentions smartphone dependence. [signal:0f43c114-f82b-4ccc-96c0-069b71901f47] [signal:571e124b-662c-4f1b-ada1-6ec557c111cb] [signal:e34d157c-e738-4d1c-b015-784035b4fdbd] [signal:20e952fe-7dd7-4c41-8307-583b7241f448]

## Open questions

Do other customers also encounter unsuitable narrow-lane routes or missing route choices? [signal:0f43c114-f82b-4ccc-96c0-069b71901f47]

How widespread are concerns about traffic accuracy, smartphone dependence and access to the better navigation version? [signal:571e124b-662c-4f1b-ada1-6ec557c111cb] [signal:20e952fe-7dd7-4c41-8307-583b7241f448] [signal:e34d157c-e738-4d1c-b015-784035b4fdbd]

value.title: Google Maps overlay is an extra-cost option
value.summary: A customer in Europe with an F70 says the Google Maps overlay should come as standard rather than costing extra. They also say the technology sometimes acts up.
highlights: The Google Maps overlay is viewed as something that should come standard, not at extra cost.
The signal is from one Europe-based F70 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer says the Google Maps overlay should come as standard instead of costing extra. [signal:21bdee49-691d-4b5f-8575-f5d1a7e5f06a]

## What customers say
The customer says the technology is very good, but sometimes acts up a little. [signal:21bdee49-691d-4b5f-8575-f5d1a7e5f06a]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from Europe and concerns an F70; there are no other market signals to compare. [signal:21bdee49-691d-4b5f-8575-f5d1a7e5f06a]

## Open questions
How often does the technology act up, and what does the customer mean by the Google Maps overlay? [signal:21bdee49-691d-4b5f-8575-f5d1a7e5f06a]

value.title: Navigation guidance is hard to find for some tasks
value.summary: Some USA G60 customers need help finding navigation settings and charging-station options. Other customers value proactive charging and traffic guidance.
highlights: Some customers need help finding navigation settings and charging options.
All four signals are from the USA: three G60s and one G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers had difficulty finding navigation features, including uneven-road alerts and charging stations along a trip. [signal:2082207b-256a-454d-bcfa-d259d28efb87] [signal:817426bf-6d3a-426e-9452-87b68a998c58]

## What customers say
Two USA G60 signals describe customers needing assistance to find or understand navigation features. [signal:2082207b-256a-454d-bcfa-d259d28efb87] [signal:817426bf-6d3a-426e-9452-87b68a998c58] In contrast, a G70 customer valued navigation routing to a charging station when the remaining charge was not enough to get home. [signal:acb07dee-c3cc-48c5-8537-bec494ce6195] A G60 customer appreciated an alert about congestion and the presentation of alternate routes. [signal:d51e0a9d-229e-4141-b942-dbc3f9a36021]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA, so they do not show differences between markets. [signal:2082207b-256a-454d-bcfa-d259d28efb87] [signal:817426bf-6d3a-426e-9452-87b68a998c58] [signal:acb07dee-c3cc-48c5-8537-bec494ce6195] [signal:d51e0a9d-229e-4141-b942-dbc3f9a36021]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether customers can find these features without assistance in other situations. [signal:2082207b-256a-454d-bcfa-d259d28efb87] [signal:817426bf-6d3a-426e-9452-87b68a998c58]

value.title: Voice navigation limits destination choices
value.summary: A Rest of World F70 driver says voice destination entry shows only a small number of options and automatically selects one, preventing them from choosing.
highlights: Voice destination entry shows few options and selects one automatically.
One complaint comes from a Rest of World F70 driver.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A Rest of World F70 driver reports that voice destination entry shows only a small number of options and automatically selects one, leaving them unable to choose. [signal:709ac73a-1733-470e-a175-02592e792597]

## What customers say
The driver describes being unable to select among destination options when setting a navigation destination by voice. [signal:709ac73a-1733-470e-a175-02592e792597]

## Differences between markets

value.title: Navigation is hard to use, see, or trust
value.summary: Customers describe navigation that can be difficult to operate, see, or trust, while another customer says the system is good overall. Signals span Europe, the USA, and Rest of World, across F70, G60, and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Navigation complaints include awkward controls, unclear displays, unreliable voice input, and route concerns.
Signals span Europe, USA, and Rest of World; vehicle lines include F70, G60, and G70.
Customers compare navigation with the X2 system and Waze; one prefers a previous 750 navigation display.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report difficulty operating navigation, seeing its information, and relying on its route guidance. [signal:10f294b5-673d-477e-972b-a4c9a1507714] [signal:4922eb95-f729-4847-9bd1-e59815a4889c] [signal:a460f3c4-7b38-458f-b464-58a8c90824cf] [signal:a8165285-a41b-4fe3-8fa8-19af72b669ed]

## What customers say
- A Europe-based F70 customer says the satnav is less clear and informative than the X2 system. [signal:10f294b5-673d-477e-972b-a4c9a1507714]
- Another F70 customer says voice requests for directions often fail, making it frustrating to set a route while driving. [signal:4922eb95-f729-4847-9bd1-e59815a4889c]
- An F70 customer says using navigation involves several steps and voice control is unreliable. [signal:4d51d851-75da-4e2b-80e4-cdbd20afd69f]
- A G60 customer describes navigation as good overall, but says traffic information is tiny and difficult to access while moving, and minor roads appear too faintly. [signal:40efb48d-e3cf-49d1-be98-2ca84fc34af0]
- An F70 customer says the satnav has repeatedly routed them onto single-track lanes, reducing their trust in it. [signal:a460f3c4-7b38-458f-b464-58a8c90824cf]
- A Rest of World F70 customer says the genuine navigation is hard to see. [signal:a8165285-a41b-4fe3-8fa8-19af72b669ed]
- A USA G70 customer finds the expanding arrows and large live road image near turns distracting, and prefers the previous 750's smaller image and countdown. [signal:706b2234-ba9c-4142-8521-e17f558cb706]
- A USA G70 customer says built-in navigation is not as good as Waze for finding the fastest route, and wants Waze guidance on the head-up display. [signal:c28f1fc1-614b-466e-b8bb-c19274a80ea2]
- A Rest of World G60 customer asks for more updates for Apple CarPlay navigation/head-up-display compatibility. [signal:236c54ff-5582-4517-baaa-a7091a7c473a]

## Differences between markets
Signals from Europe include concerns about clarity, voice commands, interaction steps, and route choices; one G60 customer nevertheless describes navigation as good overall. [signal:10f294b5-673d-477e-972b-a4c9a1507714] [signal:4922eb95-f729-4847-9bd1-e59815a4889c] [signal:4d51d851-75da-4e2b-80e4-cdbd20afd69f] [signal:40efb48d-e3cf-49d1-be98-2ca84fc34af0] [signal:a460f3c4-7b38-458f-b464-58a8c90824cf]
USA G70 signals mention a distracting turn display and a preference for Waze routing, while Rest of World signals mention visibility and CarPlay navigation/head-up-display compatibility. [signal:706b2234-ba9c-4142-8521-e17f558cb706] [signal:c28f1fc1-614b-466e-b8bb-c19274a80ea2] [signal:a8165285-a41b-4fe3-8fa8-19af72b669ed] [signal:236c54ff-5582-4517-baaa-a7091a7c473a]

## Open questions
Do the reported voice-command failures and multi-step interactions occur across more than the specific F70 experiences described? [signal:4922eb95-f729-4847-9bd1-e59815a4889c] [signal:4d51d851-75da-4e2b-80e4-cdbd20afd69f]
How widespread are concerns about route choices, display legibility, and the turn-view presentation across markets and vehicle lines? [signal:a460f3c4-7b38-458f-b464-58a8c90824cf] [signal:a8165285-a41b-4fe3-8fa8-19af72b669ed] [signal:706b2234-ba9c-4142-8521-e17f558cb706] [signal:40efb48d-e3cf-49d1-be98-2ca84fc34af0]

## Problem
A Rest of World G60 customer said the navigation voice could not be lowered enough, the tunnel screen felt crude and distracting, and the next guidance could not be checked while it was shown. [signal:b187a570-5e88-4821-9496-ca63c8ef5835] The customer also said navigation prompts and warning sounds muted the music. [signal:b187a570-5e88-4821-9496-ca63c8ef5835]

The G60 customer wanted a lower minimum navigation voice volume, a less distracting tunnel experience with access to the next guidance, and control over music muting. [signal:b187a570-5e88-4821-9496-ca63c8ef5835] A USA G70 customer asked how to raise the navigation voice volume and acknowledged advice to use the volume control while spoken directions were active. [signal:c3192fb7-d26e-475c-9c7a-36ffcaef8e5e]

## Differences between markets
The Rest of World customer said the minimum voice volume was too loud, while the USA customer asked how to raise the voice volume; the signals therefore describe different volume needs. [signal:b187a570-5e88-4821-9496-ca63c8ef5835] [signal:c3192fb7-d26e-475c-9c7a-36ffcaef8e5e] The reported vehicles were G60 in Rest of World and G70 in the USA. Customers describe two missing convenience functions: configuring vehicle settings from home and switching off selected functions together for a carwash. [signal:18014648-97fd-4172-8819-d95764606a51] [signal:c9535eed-effb-4842-9627-5d345755f0c6]

## What customers say
A G70 customer wants to set ambient light colors, radio presets, favorite apps, widgets, and other items remotely; the customer also mentioned more extensive customization using a VR headset. [signal:18014648-97fd-4172-8819-d95764606a51]

A G60 customer wants a carwash mode that disables automatic windshield wipers, automatic engine start-stop, and parking sensors, then makes it easier to reactivate them together. [signal:c9535eed-effb-4842-9627-5d345755f0c6]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA, so they do not show differences between markets. [signal:18014648-97fd-4172-8819-d95764606a51] [signal:c9535eed-effb-4842-9627-5d345755f0c6]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common either request is beyond these two customer examples. [signal:18014648-97fd-4172-8819-d95764606a51] [signal:c9535eed-effb-4842-9627-5d345755f0c6]

value.title: Small equipment and usability issues across F70 and G60
value.summary: Customers report missing rear USB sockets and several usability or noise annoyances, alongside positive assessments of the cars. The signals come from F70 and G60 drivers in Europe and the Rest of World.
highlights: Reported issues include missing rear USB sockets, loose or tapping parts, and a hard-to-reach door pocket.

No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers mention missing rear USB sockets, a charging-port cover that swings and knocks against the body in windy conditions, a passenger seat belt that taps against the B-pillar, and a deep door pocket that makes items hard to reach. [signal:0a137a8d-c46c-45f4-a7d6-26d95685dac3] [signal:3d2fd15d-b8aa-408f-b58b-bf202c5da520] [signal:531e75c5-86a0-40b5-9272-e9fb3c8b916b]

## What customers say
One F70 customer says the car is simple to operate and meets expectations, while wishing for rear USB sockets. [signal:0a137a8d-c46c-45f4-a7d6-26d95685dac3]
A G60 customer describes the car and service positively but reports the charging-cover and seat-belt noises as irritating details. [signal:3d2fd15d-b8aa-408f-b58b-bf202c5da520]
An F70 customer describes the car as easy to drive and reassuring, while finding the door pocket awkward to use. [signal:531e75c5-86a0-40b5-9272-e9fb3c8b916b]

## Differences between markets
The two Europe signals concern an F70 customer's wish for rear USB sockets and a G60 customer's reports of charging-cover and seat-belt noise. [signal:0a137a8d-c46c-45f4-a7d6-26d95685dac3] [signal:3d2fd15d-b8aa-408f-b58b-bf202c5da520]
The Rest of World signal concerns an F70 customer's difficulty reaching items in the deep door pocket. [signal:531e75c5-86a0-40b5-9272-e9fb3c8b916b]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these issues are beyond the three reports, or whether they occur in other markets or vehicle lines. [signal:0a137a8d-c46c-45f4-a7d6-26d95685dac3] [signal:3d2fd15d-b8aa-408f-b58b-bf202c5da520] [signal:531e75c5-86a0-40b5-9272-e9fb3c8b916b]

## Problem

value.title: Technology and equipment feel complicated or fall short
value.summary: Customers describe technology that can be difficult to operate and equipment or functions they find disappointing or missing. Signals span US G70 and European F70 owners, alongside broader concerns about body movement and seat positioning.
highlights: Technology can feel overly complicated, while some equipment is disappointing or missing.
Signals cover 3 US G70, 3 European F70, and 1 Rest of World F70.
A US owner compares desired rear-camera functionality with a previous Tesla.
value.body_md:
## Problem
US G70 owners report that the AV system is too complicated to operate and lacks support, and that the interactive screen offers almost too many choices. [signal:9a80086d-d9b9-4797-9e6f-e927be0facaf] [signal:c3057756-b40f-4dad-bac2-fd74c9c2c6e4] One US owner would like an automatic closing door to be standard and a rear-view camera to remain visible on the dash while driving. [signal:3d542813-e764-4114-9a69-651481af1595] Other reported concerns include disappointing air-vent design, occasional failure of the electric driver seat to reach the right position, and disappointment with the fake engine sound. [signal:9a80086d-d9b9-4797-9e6f-e927be0facaf] [signal:b332cae2-ad7b-4eed-ba49-6e5331aa58b7]

## What customers say
One US owner praises the car's clever technology, while also wishing for a rear-view camera like the one in their previous Tesla. [signal:3d542813-e764-4114-9a69-651481af1595] Another describes the interactive screen as working well but having almost too many choices. [signal:c3057756-b40f-4dad-bac2-fd74c9c2c6e4] A European F70 owner calls the visual blind-spot warning a great idea, but says it does not work as expected in practice. [signal:4c4cadbd-c831-4399-869d-f120c7741c32]

## Differences between markets
The specific reports of complicated AV operation, excessive screen choices, and desired additional equipment come from US G70 owners. [signal:9a80086d-d9b9-4797-9e6f-e927be0facaf] [signal:c3057756-b40f-4dad-bac2-fd74c9c2c6e4] [signal:3d542813-e764-4114-9a69-651481af1595] The European F70 signals include a concern about blind-spot warning performance, electric-seat positioning, and fake engine sound. [signal:4c4cadbd-c831-4399-869d-f120c7741c32] [signal:b332cae2-ad7b-4eed-ba49-6e5331aa58b7] A Rest of World F70 owner reports frequent shaking and large-feeling body movement depending on the road surface. [signal:5dcdbf3d-2c5a-4de1-9887-183c24a45978] These signals describe different concerns; they do not establish a single market-wide view.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these concerns are beyond the reports provided. [signal:9a80086d-d9b9-4797-9e6f-e927be0facaf] [signal:c3057756-b40f-4dad-bac2-fd74c9c2c6e4] [signal:1d4a6917-9ae4-42c7-b273-7035d15b0237] [signal:3d542813-e764-4114-9a69-651481af1595] [signal:4c4cadbd-c831-4399-869d-f120c7741c32] [signal:5dcdbf3d-2c5a-4de1-9887-183c24a45978] [signal:b332cae2-ad7b-4eed-ba49-6e5331aa58b7] The screen-choice comment is truncated, so the signal does not specify what changes the owner wanted. [signal:c3057756-b40f-4dad-bac2-fd74c9c2c6e4]

value.title: Technology feels less capable and harder to use
value.summary: Customers report missing or reduced equipment, confusing interfaces, and technology functions that are unreliable or distracting. These concerns appear in Europe’s F70 and in G60 feedback from the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Customers cite lost features, confusing controls, and unreliable or distracting technology.
Signals cover three Europe F70 customers, one USA G60 customer, and one Rest of World G60 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say newer vehicles have lost equipment or functions they valued, while technology controls and features can feel confusing, distracting, or unreliable. [signal:432d5244-ed85-4f9c-9fd6-aa5446c878da] [signal:6a1d7a3d-bf76-4107-b135-efe780852b3c] [signal:c8b871c2-ddff-42b9-92c3-e38b9ee75ad1] [signal:cfdefc3c-1fcc-4d24-91e7-f0d3593ac02b]

## What customers say
A Europe F70 customer says some paid technology functions worked only as a three-month trial, and that the expiry of Digital Premium was not made clear. [signal:432d5244-ed85-4f9c-9fd6-aa5446c878da]

Another Europe F70 customer says the loss of automatic dual-zone climate control leaves both sides with the same temperature, and describes screen-based controls as distracting and voice control as inconsistent. [signal:6a1d7a3d-bf76-4107-b135-efe780852b3c]

A further Europe F70 customer describes apps and drive modes as complex, difficult to use while driving, and distracting. [signal:c8b871c2-ddff-42b9-92c3-e38b9ee75ad1]

The USA G60 customer calls the infotainment unintuitive and difficult to navigate, and says the assistant interrupts without being addressed. [signal:cfdefc3c-1fcc-4d24-91e7-f0d3593ac02b]

The Rest of World G60 customer values some upgrades over an older vehicle but misses seat massage and soft-closing doors, and reports problems with the parking assistant and navigation routes. [signal:598e18fe-21d6-4b6e-94c5-3ec6af632747]

## Differences between markets
The three Europe F70 signals describe lost or reduced equipment and concerns about technology usability. [signal:432d5244-ed85-4f9c-9fd6-aa5446c878da] [signal:6a1d7a3d-bf76-4107-b135-efe780852b3c] [signal:c8b871c2-ddff-42b9-92c3-e38b9ee75ad1]

The USA G60 signal focuses on infotainment navigation and unwanted assistant interruptions, while the Rest of World G60 customer praises some upgrades but reports missing features and issues with assistance and navigation. [signal:cfdefc3c-1fcc-4d24-91e7-f0d3593ac02b] [signal:598e18fe-21d6-4b6e-94c5-3ec6af632747]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these experiences are beyond the five reported cases. [signal:432d5244-ed85-4f9c-9fd6-aa5446c878da] [signal:6a1d7a3d-bf76-4107-b135-efe780852b3c] [signal:c8b871c2-ddff-42b9-92c3-e38b9ee75ad1] [signal:cfdefc3c-1fcc-4d24-91e7-f0d3593ac02b] [signal:598e18fe-21d6-4b6e-94c5-3ec6af632747]

The signals do not clarify which specific technology concerns are shared across vehicle lines or markets. [signal:432d5244-ed85-4f9c-9fd6-aa5446c878da] [signal:6a1d7a3d-bf76-4107-b135-efe780852b3c] [signal:c8b871c2-ddff-42b9-92c3-e38b9ee75ad1] [signal:cfdefc3c-1fcc-4d24-91e7-f0d3593ac02b] [signal:598e18fe-21d6-4b6e-94c5-3ec6af632747]

value.title: Battery and climate control options missing
value.summary: A USA G60 owner wants battery control mode restored and a specific temperature setting for climate-control activation. The owner appreciates electric-only local trips alongside the engine for long journeys.

value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 owner asks for battery control mode to be restored, with the ability to charge the high-voltage battery to a chosen level between 30% and 100% while driving. [signal:e1ff22ba-fb5a-4049-95f5-d89f052c72f7] The owner also wants to set the specific temperature at which climate control rules activate. [signal:e1ff22ba-fb5a-4049-95f5-d89f052c72f7]

## What customers say
The owner says most iDrive 8.5 changes are good, but these two options bother them. [signal:e1ff22ba-fb5a-4049-95f5-d89f052c72f7] They appreciate being able to make local trips entirely on electric power and use the engine for long journeys, avoiding range anxiety and long charging stops. [signal:e1ff22ba-fb5a-4049-95f5-d89f052c72f7]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from the USA, so there is no market comparison. [signal:e1ff22ba-fb5a-4049-95f5-d89f052c72f7]

## Open questions
The signal does not specify the climate-control temperature choices beyond beginning to quote them as “off, low”. [signal:e1ff22ba-fb5a-4049-95f5-d89f052c72f7] There are no signals from other customers or markets to show how broadly these concerns are shared. [signal:e1ff22ba-fb5a-4049-95f5-d89f052c72f7]

Four signals: three from Rest of World and one from Europe; two each concern F70 and G70.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers say overall quality does not meet their expectations, and some describe the construction as poor or report continuing product troubles. [signal:bad36bbd-2df9-42e7-999d-43892752efae] [signal:c1587ccf-7546-4d1c-9da1-9dbdf0da6952] [signal:e7993a2c-6604-4f69-874b-fa584416950c]

## What customers say
A Europe-based F70 customer says the overall quality is below expectations. [signal:bad36bbd-2df9-42e7-999d-43892752efae]
A Rest of World F70 customer describes the product quality as low and says troubles keep recurring. [signal:c1587ccf-7546-4d1c-9da1-9dbdf0da6952]
Rest of World G70 customers describe the quality and service situation as serious and the construction as poor. [signal:3a781b5d-406d-4ca8-9a3c-c39c061fabe3] [signal:e7993a2c-6604-4f69-874b-fa584416950c]

## Differences between markets
The signals include one Europe complaint about an F70 and three Rest of World complaints, split between F70 and G70. [signal:bad36bbd-2df9-42e7-999d-43892752efae] [signal:3a781b5d-406d-4ca8-9a3c-c39c061fabe3] [signal:c1587ccf-7546-4d1c-9da1-9dbdf0da6952] [signal:e7993a2c-6604-4f69-874b-fa584416950c]

## Open questions
Which specific quality issues are behind the reports of poor construction and recurring troubles? [signal:c1587ccf-7546-4d1c-9da1-9dbdf0da6952] [signal:e7993a2c-6604-4f69-874b-fa584416950c]
What aspects of service contribute to the reported serious quality and service situation? [signal:3a781b5d-406d-4ca8-9a3c-c39c061fabe3]

value.title: Strong perceived overall build quality
value.summary: Customers in the signals value BMW’s perceived build quality, solidity and premium feel. Positive comments come from owners of several vehicle lines and markets.
highlights: Customers praise perceived build quality, solidity and attention to detail.
Signals include USA G60/G70, Europe F70/G60 and Rest of World G70 owners.
Customers compare BMW favorably with Audi, Mercedes, Cadillac and Peugeot.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals shown emphasize quality as a valued attribute: customers describe vehicles as solid, well built and luxurious. [signal:0a2cb278-6d29-4268-9748-74dc73194811] [signal:0d17e6c6-81e9-47bb-bcb5-b5b9710ad7eb] [signal:0ac2701a-ad4d-47f7-8661-6a442b2f9cc6]

## What customers say
A G60 owner appreciates how the car is put together, including the engine bay, and compares it favorably with other makes, including Mercedes. [signal:04cc88c3-1552-4db6-ac9d-fc3179d936f4]

A F70 owner describes the car as beautifully built and says its quality is superior to their previous Audi. [signal:0ac2701a-ad4d-47f7-8661-6a442b2f9cc6]

Other comments praise the vehicle’s solid feel, flawless functioning, and overall quality. [signal:0a2cb278-6d29-4268-9748-74dc73194811] [signal:0f3dbf09-b7b0-4c34-8f5e-8c57debd6c79] A G60 owner says the vehicle feels more luxurious than their previous Cadillac. [signal:0d17e6c6-81e9-47bb-bcb5-b5b9710ad7eb]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include positive quality comments from USA owners of G60 and G70 vehicles, Europe owners of F70 and G60 vehicles, and a Rest of World G70 owner. [signal:0a2cb278-6d29-4268-9748-74dc73194811] [signal:1bdc17d6-51ad-43c0-9175-f55d96316bcb] [signal:0ac2701a-ad4d-47f7-8661-6a442b2f9cc6] [signal:33a4b9d3-ed0c-4ba2-b59a-45c84b29c63b] [signal:504e151d-e076-4ac6-8f31-7ac11aba9641] These supplied comments are positive; they do not establish whether perceptions differ between markets. [signal:0a2cb278-6d29-4268-9748-74dc73194811] [signal:0ac2701a-ad4d-47f7-8661-6a442b2f9cc6] [signal:504e151d-e076-4ac6-8f31-7ac11aba9641]

## Open questions
Do customers report quality concerns elsewhere in the full set of 86 signals, and do perceptions vary by vehicle line or market? The supplied sample does not answer these questions. [signal:0a2cb278-6d29-4268-9748-74dc73194811]

value.title: Build quality and technology experience vary across models
value.summary: Customers report strong build quality and technology in several cars, but others describe poor cabin refinement, lower-quality speaker plastics, or technology that is difficult to use. These differing experiences appear in Europe and the USA across the F70, G70 and G60.
highlights: Build quality is praised by some and criticized by others; technology usability is also a concern.
Signals cover six Europe F70 reviews and two USA reviews: one G70 and one G60.
Some customers rate BMW build quality above Tesla and VW; another reports excessive wind noise versus other BMWs and cheaper cars.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Build quality is praised in several reviews but criticized in a USA G70 review, which describes poor quality for the price and very loud wind noise. [signal:a36d1ad5-8996-4f5a-8af6-4f27db402138] A Europe F70 owner also says the speaker plastics feel inferior to those in their previous F40. [signal:1cdeee29-382b-4b8c-b642-c99a582caa07] Some F70 owners find the technology fiddly, overly complicated, or difficult to use. [signal:7a769178-96be-4fd8-a778-3155f6a4d268] [signal:e8552c2b-a2a0-4ac4-aa5f-8466f60336c3]

## What customers say
Several Europe F70 owners praise the car’s build quality; one describes it as excellent, and another says BMW retains an edge over VW and other brands. [signal:b05d0425-8afd-462b-9ca5-12cfa839a946] [signal:d7499ef2-6f4e-40c2-a6e4-c00cc144cc8a] Other owners praise solid build quality and driveability, while an F70 owner says the F40 felt better finished. [signal:dcf920a8-db03-4c43-b8c5-34ed691d56a9] [signal:1cdeee29-382b-4b8c-b642-c99a582caa07] A USA G60 owner says BMW’s build quality feels clearly better than Tesla’s, and praises the car’s quietness and audio system. [signal:ab16f823-41ca-46a0-900a-8d5fd120c520]

Technology feedback also differs: one F70 owner calls the in-car technology great, while others describe it as complicated and difficult to operate. [signal:b05d0425-8afd-462b-9ca5-12cfa839a946] [signal:7a769178-96be-4fd8-a778-3155f6a4d268] [signal:e8552c2b-a2a0-4ac4-aa5f-8466f60336c3] One older F70 owner says the controls are hard to use and the voice command works for some functions but not others. [signal:e8552c2b-a2a0-4ac4-aa5f-8466f60336c3]

## Differences between markets
The six Europe F70 signals include both positive build-quality assessments and concerns about speaker plastics and technology usability. [signal:1cdeee29-382b-4b8c-b642-c99a582caa07] [signal:7a769178-96be-4fd8-a778-3155f6a4d268] [signal:b05d0425-8afd-462b-9ca5-12cfa839a946] [signal:d7499ef2-6f4e-40c2-a6e4-c00cc144cc8a] [signal:dcf920a8-db03-4c43-b8c5-34ed691d56a9] [signal:e8552c2b-a2a0-4ac4-aa5f-8466f60336c3] In the USA, the G70 review criticizes build quality and wind noise, while the G60 review praises build quality and quietness. [signal:a36d1ad5-8996-4f5a-8af6-4f27db402138] [signal:ab16f823-41ca-46a0-900a-8d5fd120c520]

## Open questions
What accounts for the different build-quality and cabin-noise experiences reported for the G70 and G60? [signal:a36d1ad5-8996-4f5a-8af6-4f27db402138] [signal:ab16f823-41ca-46a0-900a-8d5fd120c520] How often do customers find the F70’s controls and menus difficult to use? [signal:7a769178-96be-4fd8-a778-3155f6a4d268] [signal:e8552c2b-a2a0-4ac4-aa5f-8466f60336c3]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners report mixed experiences with overall technology and perceived quality. Some find functions difficult to access through the touchscreen and criticize build quality, while other owners describe the cars as solidly built. [signal:e538d9b7-ff81-4179-a628-2047f9782426] [signal:ee4386ca-3973-4e3c-8f54-79e1d4a8f125] [signal:85487d4a-3102-4656-8a87-65f2e1277f10] [signal:b2c0b337-0c79-47f1-bb50-d3250975511d] [signal:bd7631a9-3bd9-4da5-8c55-70811c8fc020]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner says losing physical buttons and knobs makes functions harder to find, objects to the lack of automatic fan-speed mode, and says general build quality could be better. [signal:e538d9b7-ff81-4179-a628-2047f9782426]

Another USA G60 owner describes the build quality as solid but criticizes the climate controls and air vents. [signal:ee4386ca-3973-4e3c-8f54-79e1d4a8f125]

European F70 owners also describe touchscreen-based controls as awkward; one says using the screen for controls could be unsafe, while another misses an in-car handbook and prefers physical buttons and knobs. [signal:322c9e1c-62ee-43d9-9489-75668555a03a] [signal:85487d4a-3102-4656-8a87-65f2e1277f10]

Other owners praise the solid feel: a USA G60 owner says build quality was the main reason for choosing the car over a Model S, and a European G70 owner describes the build as very solid. [signal:b2c0b337-0c79-47f1-bb50-d3250975511d] [signal:bd7631a9-3bd9-4da5-8c55-70811c8fc020]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include both criticism of G60 build quality and praise for its solid build, as well as complaints about climate controls. [signal:e538d9b7-ff81-4179-a628-2047f9782426] [signal:ee4386ca-3973-4e3c-8f54-79e1d4a8f125] [signal:b2c0b337-0c79-47f1-bb50-d3250975511d]

The European F70 signals criticize touchscreen-based controls, while the European G70 signal praises the solid build. [signal:322c9e1c-62ee-43d9-9489-75668555a03a] [signal:85487d4a-3102-4656-8a87-65f2e1277f10] [signal:bd7631a9-3bd9-4da5-8c55-70811c8fc020]

## Open questions
Do concerns about perceived build quality vary by vehicle line or reflect different owner expectations? The signals include both criticism and praise of build quality, but do not explain the difference. [signal:e538d9b7-ff81-4179-a628-2047f9782426] [signal:ee4386ca-3973-4e3c-8f54-79e1d4a8f125] [signal:b2c0b337-0c79-47f1-bb50-d3250975511d] [signal:bd7631a9-3bd9-4da5-8c55-70811c8fc020]

Are touchscreen-control concerns concentrated in particular functions or shared across vehicle lines? The signals mention general control access, climate controls, and switching drive modes, but do not establish how widespread each concern is. [signal:e538d9b7-ff81-4179-a628-2047f9782426] [signal:ee4386ca-3973-4e3c-8f54-79e1d4a8f125] [signal:322c9e1c-62ee-43d9-9489-75668555a03a]

value.title: F70 technology controls feel difficult and distracting to use
value.summary: F70 owners report that touch-focused controls and a complicated interface make common tasks difficult and can draw attention away from driving. The signals also describe concerns with app reliability, voice instructions, sounds, and hazard-switch placement.
highlights: Touch-focused controls and complex menus make common tasks difficult and distracting.
All four signals concern the F70: three from Europe and one from Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
F70 owners describe the technology interface and controls as difficult to use, particularly when operating common functions through the touch panel or menus. [signal:3317c753-e488-451a-9372-7b4706be6702] [signal:5380fc46-e75e-436c-95b5-b1615ee36c89] [signal:5892be7b-e44d-4113-8b66-18f843e2a95f] One owner says using the touchscreen for tasks pulls attention away from the road. [signal:5380fc46-e75e-436c-95b5-b1615ee36c89]

## What customers say
An owner says changing drive modes and turning off start-stop are awkward, and that the centre-console buttons are hard to distinguish by touch. [signal:3317c753-e488-451a-9372-7b4706be6702] Another says changing drive mode takes multiple taps and adjusting fan speed is similarly frustrating. [signal:5380fc46-e75e-436c-95b5-b1615ee36c89]

One Rest of World owner reports that the hazard switch is poorly placed for use without looking, dislikes entry sounds, and says the VICS feature costs extra. [signal:5892be7b-e44d-4113-8b66-18f843e2a95f] A Europe owner reports an unreliable connected app, unreliable voice instructions, a complicated interface, repeated software updates, and a ConnectedDrive Premium service lasting three months. [signal:e5bf3a5c-7477-4708-be3a-6b095ed56660]

## Differences between markets
The three Europe signals describe concerns with physical controls, touch interaction, interface complexity, app reliability, voice instructions, and software updates. [signal:3317c753-e488-451a-9372-7b4706be6702] [signal:5380fc46-e75e-436c-95b5-b1615ee36c89] [signal:e5bf3a5c-7477-4708-be3a-6b095ed56660] The Rest of World signal raises concerns about touch-panel usability, hazard-switch placement, entry sounds, and VICS cost. [signal:5892be7b-e44d-4113-8b66-18f843e2a95f] The signals do not establish whether these differences reflect broader market patterns.

## Open questions
How frequently do owners encounter the reported app and voice-instruction reliability problems? [signal:e5bf3a5c-7477-4708-be3a-6b095ed56660] How widespread are the concerns about hazard-switch placement, entry sounds, and VICS cost beyond the single Rest of World signal? [signal:5892be7b-e44d-4113-8b66-18f843e2a95f]

[signal:4eaea65f-9e30-4e03-be52-1cc15a6f2dcd] [signal:c5efa9aa-b570-4f77-ba22-9205531c6728]

[signal:4eaea65f-9e30-4e03-be52-1cc15a6f2dcd] Another USA G60 owner appreciates the dashboard, curved display, and app. [signal:8d43776b-e949-48a6-bf6d-a2b579b5d2ac] A third says limited ability to customize things contributes to a lower rating. [signal:c5efa9aa-b570-4f77-ba22-9205531c6728]

[signal:a550d403-51fc-497c-a45e-18d1cdd8f766]

## Open questions
Do the missing equipment and customization concerns apply to other vehicles or markets beyond the cited G60 feedback? value.summary: Some customers report that entering or exiting is difficult because of restricted space, door opening, or contact with the door frame; one Rest of World customer describes getting out as pleasant.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers describe getting into or out of the vehicle as difficult, citing tight space, a need for a wider door opening, or bumping their head on the door frame. [signal:44ec715b-c39a-4a33-b089-5d8046dfb77c] [signal:86541c11-ea56-4cce-94d7-547b034a8b35] [signal:c9c21abc-0cb1-4d1f-aac3-49b139627525]

One Europe customer says the door must swing quite wide for comfortable entry and exit, especially in car parks. [signal:432399f4-043f-4f1c-b550-5f68a36a5e78] A USA customer reports that exiting requires reaching over the outer entrance lip and worries about scuffing it. [signal:c85494e1-c735-49b1-bad5-51277a25ac1f]

## What customers say
A larger G60 customer says the A-pillar gets in the way and that they rub against the steering wheel while entering or exiting. [signal:86541c11-ea56-4cce-94d7-547b034a8b35] Another G60 customer says entering and exiting the front passenger seat is challenging, while noting a history of strokes and seizures that also makes vehicle access difficult generally. [signal:a4dfbc94-02c0-4259-96a4-d6af15eace80]

Some customers ask about or have been advised about comfort-exit settings, including a seat moving rearward to ease exit. [signal:adcf53ee-b996-4dd8-994f-95e3d81848fa] [signal:c9c21abc-0cb1-4d1f-aac3-49b139627525] A Rest of World G60 customer describes stepping out as a nice feeling. [signal:9eb1da65-e67e-4b6e-9ba8-e018e46cdda5]

## Differences between markets
The supplied Europe F70 signal mentions needing a wide door opening, while USA G60 and G70 signals describe difficulty entering or exiting, tight access, or contact with the door frame. [signal:432399f4-043f-4f1c-b550-5f68a36a5e78] [signal:44ec715b-c39a-4a33-b089-5d8046dfb77c] [signal:86541c11-ea56-4cce-94d7-547b034a8b35] [signal:c9c21abc-0cb1-4d1f-aac3-49b139627525] The Rest of World G60 signal is positive about stepping out. [signal:9eb1da65-e67e-4b6e-9ba8-e018e46cdda5]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these experiences are across the full case, or how access comfort varies by customer needs and vehicle line. [signal:44ec715b-c39a-4a33-b089-5d8046dfb77c] [signal:86541c11-ea56-4cce-94d7-547b034a8b35] [signal:a4dfbc94-02c0-4259-96a4-d6af15eace80] [signal:9eb1da65-e67e-4b6e-9ba8-e018e46cdda5]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners describe awkward entry because of the door shape, including bumping their heads when getting in. [signal:6c7c239e-3092-45fb-8b96-c36f308ac477] A USA owner says digital-key detection is inconsistent, making it hard to get into the car. [signal:741e4c31-6d84-42f6-951a-79debad68e7a] A Rest of World owner reports that auto-lock can fail when leaving the car. [signal:4af4af11-a6b9-465c-b31b-d128c827ecac]

## What customers say
One Europe owner says keyless entry, which was available on their previous car, is missing from their current F70. [signal:58643f8c-2b6e-4be0-b567-9fbe9a8a1b02] A USA G60 owner says auto-lock/unlock works well except at home, where walking past the car repeatedly triggers it. [signal:a9978bfe-431e-4f74-8b7c-80ef07a62bae] Another USA owner says media continues playing after leaving the car. [signal:096596e1-cee2-4aad-9c15-bd77b2c1f65e]

## Differences between markets
The signals describe entry and access concerns in Europe, the USA, and Rest of World, but do not establish how common these issues are in each market. [signal:6c7c239e-3092-45fb-8b96-c36f308ac477] [signal:741e4c31-6d84-42f6-951a-79debad68e7a] [signal:4af4af11-a6b9-465c-b31b-d128c827ecac] The specific concerns differ: awkward physical entry and missing keyless entry are reported in Europe, digital-key inconsistency and home auto-lock behavior in the USA, and auto-lock failure in Rest of World. [signal:6c7c239e-3092-45fb-8b96-c36f308ac477] [signal:58643f8c-2b6e-4be0-b567-9fbe9a8a1b02] [signal:741e4c31-6d84-42f6-951a-79debad68e7a] [signal:a9978bfe-431e-4f74-8b7c-80ef07a62bae] [signal:4af4af11-a6b9-465c-b31b-d128c827ecac]

## Open questions
- How often do owners encounter each access or exit issue?
- Do these concerns vary by vehicle configuration or usage context?

value.title: Getting in and out feels cramped or awkward
value.summary: Customers report difficult entry and exit, including cramped access, a high door jamb and head bumps. Other customers value simple access or a vehicle height that feels well matched to the ground.
highlights: Entry and exit can feel cramped, awkward or difficult.
Signals cover F70 in Europe and Rest of World, and G60/G70 in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe entry and exit as cramped or awkward, with reports of a high door jamb, head bumps and difficult seat access. [signal:3f7f5c4f-1f17-4d11-a46b-c7cb89db88fe] [signal:4ee5731e-0350-4bf7-9712-2e8cb25e9f89] [signal:80f2ab10-c5a4-4ec7-bb7a-08af2efaca09] [signal:c716fe33-ddc1-4a91-83a9-de9a8bd35444] [signal:f1ac887e-95d9-4f38-9f95-df60a7783fd1]

## What customers say
F70 customers report tight access and awkward door shape; one says they bump their head while getting in. [signal:3f7f5c4f-1f17-4d11-a46b-c7cb89db88fe] [signal:80f2ab10-c5a4-4ec7-bb7a-08af2efaca09]
G60 customers mention a high door jamb, difficult access, and the need to simplify seat access for elderly riders. [signal:c716fe33-ddc1-4a91-83a9-de9a8bd35444] [signal:e40a294a-29b5-4c01-b133-f3b81d7a903e] [signal:f1ac887e-95d9-4f38-9f95-df60a7783fd1]
Experience is not uniformly negative: one G70 customer says access feels simple, and one G60 customer likes the vehicle's height relative to the ground. [signal:143c198e-ef1c-4654-985b-daa4ebbb07f0] [signal:1d531462-eb0c-4234-ba6d-a9fabaf6834a]

## Differences between markets
In Europe and Rest of World, F70 customers describe access as cramped or awkward. [signal:3f7f5c4f-1f17-4d11-a46b-c7cb89db88fe] [signal:4ee5731e-0350-4bf7-9712-2e8cb25e9f89] [signal:80f2ab10-c5a4-4ec7-bb7a-08af2efaca09]
In the USA, G60 feedback includes difficulty getting in and out, alongside a positive comment about vehicle height; G70 feedback includes both a wish related to seat access and a positive comment that access feels simple. [signal:c716fe33-ddc1-4a91-83a9-de9a8bd35444] [signal:e40a294a-29b5-4c01-b133-f3b81d7a903e] [signal:f1ac887e-95d9-4f38-9f95-df60a7783fd1] [signal:1d531462-eb0c-4234-ba6d-a9fabaf6834a] [signal:293fedd4-e0af-4a3a-a506-bdc074e28617] [signal:143c198e-ef1c-4654-985b-daa4ebbb07f0]

## Open questions
Do access concerns vary by customer age or physical stature? Customers mention awkward access for a 50-year-old, elderly riders, and head bumps, but the signals do not establish how broadly these experiences are shared. value.title: Window controls feel fragile and lack desired locking options
value.summary: Customers describe window switches as lacking premium tactile feel or feeling easy to break, and some want more control over when windows can be operated or close. Signals come from USA G60 and G70 customers and a Europe F70 customer.
highlights: Window switches feel low-quality or fragile, and customers want more control over window operation.
Signals span USA G60 and G70 customers and a Europe F70 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that window switches lack a premium tactile feel or feel fragile, and some want to prevent accidental operation or ensure windows are closed when locking the car. [signal:fd0dafe2-042c-4f1e-805b-67351eff505f] [signal:6774170b-2408-4bc0-8a99-3d39ec5a2ecd] [signal:8c0e17f2-6bda-45fa-8b9c-24182d552f24] [signal:c096b039-38b6-455e-b68f-a0a6f8f78ce1]

## What customers say
A G60 customer in the USA says the window switches lack a premium tactile feel. [signal:fd0dafe2-042c-4f1e-805b-67351eff505f]

A customer in Europe says they are nervous about snapping off an F70 window switch. [signal:6774170b-2408-4bc0-8a99-3d39ec5a2ecd]

A G70 customer in the USA is concerned passengers could operate the front passenger window and damage newly applied tint; they were told the child lock prevents use of the rear windows from the rear controls, but there is no lock for the front passenger side. [signal:8c0e17f2-6bda-45fa-8b9c-24182d552f24]

Another USA G60 customer wants all windows to close automatically when the car is locked, after their children have previously left rear windows open. [signal:c096b039-38b6-455e-b68f-a0a6f8f78ce1]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include concerns about accidental window operation and windows being left open, as well as a complaint about switch feel. [signal:8c0e17f2-6bda-45fa-8b9c-24182d552f24] [signal:c096b039-38b6-455e-b68f-a0a6f8f78ce1] [signal:fd0dafe2-042c-4f1e-805b-67351eff505f]

The Europe signal describes concern that an F70 window switch could break. [signal:6774170b-2408-4bc0-8a99-3d39ec5a2ecd]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these concerns are across customers or vehicle lines. [signal:8c0e17f2-6bda-45fa-8b9c-24182d552f24] [signal:fd0dafe2-042c-4f1e-805b-67351eff505f] [signal:6774170b-2408-4bc0-8a99-3d39ec5a2ecd] [signal:c096b039-38b6-455e-b68f-a0a6f8f78ce1]

It is unclear whether the concerns about switch feel and durability reflect the same underlying issue. [signal:fd0dafe2-042c-4f1e-805b-67351eff505f] [signal:6774170b-2408-4bc0-8a99-3d39ec5a2ecd]

value.title: Firm suspension feels harsh on rough roads
value.summary: Some F70 drivers, particularly in Europe, find the suspension too firm on rough roads or for family use. A G60 driver in the USA values its tight ride for highway trips.
highlights: Some drivers find the suspension too firm, especially on rough roads.
Feedback covers F70s in Europe and Rest of World, plus one positive G60 signal from the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 drivers describe the suspension as harsh or too firm on rough roads, and some question its suitability for family use. [signal:30dbae1f-5692-4cd0-99b3-7926d31d59ee] [signal:7256a714-e141-49c8-81cb-c7f7bcf22197] [signal:b6300be0-d418-45b3-beeb-38f68c6964e2] [signal:d4ca1f8c-c190-490a-b1f3-63d61ad1284a]

## What customers say
An F70 driver in Europe says the suspension feels harsh on rough roads; another describes it as firm, possibly more noticeable because the cabin is quiet. [signal:30dbae1f-5692-4cd0-99b3-7926d31d59ee] [signal:37d15a81-51d0-4980-9987-bc57ac100367] An F70 driver in Rest of World says the suspension might not suit families, and two European F70 drivers call it too firm for rough British roads or family use. [signal:7256a714-e141-49c8-81cb-c7f7bcf22197] [signal:b6300be0-d418-45b3-beeb-38f68c6964e2] [signal:d4ca1f8c-c190-490a-b1f3-63d61ad1284a] By contrast, a USA G60 driver likes the tight ride and says it makes highway trips enjoyable. [signal:04a4f9b2-7f48-4573-8d0e-00b6e414acb4]

## Differences between markets
The four European F70 signals describe a firm or harsh ride, while the single Rest of World F70 signal raises family suitability. [signal:30dbae1f-5692-4cd0-99b3-7926d31d59ee] [signal:37d15a81-51d0-4980-9987-bc57ac100367] [signal:b6300be0-d418-45b3-beeb-38f68c6964e2] [signal:d4ca1f8c-c190-490a-b1f3-63d61ad1284a] [signal:7256a714-e141-49c8-81cb-c7f7bcf22197] The USA G60 signal is positive about the tight ride, so feedback differs across the signals and vehicle lines. [signal:04a4f9b2-7f48-4573-8d0e-00b6e414acb4]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these views are beyond the six comments provided. [signal:04a4f9b2-7f48-4573-8d0e-00b6e414acb4] [signal:30dbae1f-5692-4cd0-99b3-7926d31d59ee] [signal:37d15a81-51d0-4980-9987-bc57ac100367] [signal:7256a714-e141-49c8-81cb-c7f7bcf22197] [signal:b6300be0-d418-45b3-beeb-38f68c6964e2] [signal:d4ca1f8c-c190-490a-b1f3-63d61ad1284a]

value.title: Suspension comfort feels inconsistent across roads and vehicles
value.summary: Some F70 drivers and passengers in Europe and the Rest of World find the suspension too firm on rough roads, while US G60 and G70 feedback also describes soft, loose, or heavily damped ride behavior.
highlights: F70 ride can feel too firm on rough roads, while some US feedback describes soft, loose, or heavy damping.
Signals span F70 in Europe and the Rest of World, plus G60 and G70 in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 owners describe the suspension as too hard or firm on rough roads, with discomfort for drivers and passengers. [signal:0b11f18c-ebb9-40fd-8fb8-97c02e23a0d0] [signal:ad4ab7f6-c8f3-4313-a1d6-a254d68893aa] [signal:ade6e1d6-484f-436f-8201-1e2f32db09ce]
US feedback also describes different ride concerns: a G60 that does not absorb bumps as well as the customer’s X5, a G60 ride that feels too soft, and G70 suspension described as loose or heavily damped over a speed bump. [signal:2f7be850-3da7-4a80-b45e-f33d74460549] [signal:748960d2-067c-4ca3-b350-2f8d1f66d9c9] [signal:8065191d-29aa-46d6-9205-72d53971175d] [signal:969f9bd5-0b93-4694-b36c-5873ed3383bc]

## What customers say
An F70 owner in Europe says the suspension is too hard for everyday use on British roads; another says the sports-focused ride is less forgiving than they want. [signal:0b11f18c-ebb9-40fd-8fb8-97c02e23a0d0] [signal:164459c1-d49b-4fa8-b2e1-02875c03e589]
F70 feedback from Europe and the Rest of the World also mentions discomfort for rear-seat passengers, back pain, and concern about bouncing on uneven roads. [signal:ad4ab7f6-c8f3-4313-a1d6-a254d68893aa] [signal:ade6e1d6-484f-436f-8201-1e2f32db09ce] [signal:a1caf98a-e1c3-47ef-b71f-dd92cc4274d0]
One Rest of the World owner says the firm suspension makes things tough for passengers, while another says the stiffness is more than needed but feels like something to accept with a BMW. [signal:b29cd1a5-542d-4c56-a22e-0c436f2a223e] [signal:c22c13bf-929c-4c22-967c-ee46b165fc01]

## Differences between markets
The sampled F70 feedback from Europe and the Rest of the World emphasizes a firm or hard ride. [signal:86325a55-4563-4632-803d-f333cd2cb830] [signal:a1caf98a-e1c3-47ef-b71f-dd92cc4274d0]
US feedback is mixed: G60 customers report both insufficient bump absorption and a ride that feels softer than expected, while G70 comments describe looseness or heavy damping over a speed bump. [signal:2f7be850-3da7-4a80-b45e-f33d74460549]  [signal:8065191d-29aa-46d6-9205-72d53971175d] [signal:969f9bd5-0b93-4694-b36c-5873ed3383bc]

## Open questions
Do ride concerns vary by road surface, vehicle line, or passenger position? [signal:ad4ab7f6-c8f3-4313-a1d6-a254d68893aa] [signal:2f7be850-3da7-4a80-b45e-f33d74460549]
How do customers’ expectations of firmness relate to the conflicting US descriptions of softness, looseness, and heavy damping?  [signal:8065191d-29aa-46d6-9205-72d53971175d] [signal:969f9bd5-0b93-4694-b36c-5873ed3383bc]

value.title: Abnormal suspension noises during turns and rough-road driving
value.summary: USA customers report suspension-area noises or sensations during low-speed turns and, in one G60 report, on rough roads. The signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Suspension-area noises and sensations occur during turns and rough-road driving.
Reports are from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report abnormal noises or sensations they associate with the suspension or brakes during turns, and a rattle near the right rear wheel area on rough roads. [signal:05052dfb-0972-4b6f-99ce-7a2cbe190852] [signal:057e974a-a463-474c-b25c-d47f01235d54] [signal:54f804af-4e46-4c52-8e87-2a8328d2f167] [signal:56b45dbc-2c60-448c-9927-d5ab49f90633]

## What customers say
A G60 owner reports sounds when steering at full lock and when turning the other way. [signal:05052dfb-0972-4b6f-99ce-7a2cbe190852] A G70 customer describes weird sounds when turning out of a driveway, while another reports ongoing crunching or grinding sounds and sensations through the floor, mostly during low-speed turns. [signal:057e974a-a463-474c-b25c-d47f01235d54] [signal:56b45dbc-2c60-448c-9927-d5ab49f90633] A G60 customer reports a right-rear-area rattle at around 30 mph on rough roads, but not on a smooth highway. [signal:54f804af-4e46-4c52-8e87-2a8328d2f167]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:05052dfb-0972-4b6f-99ce-7a2cbe190852] [signal:057e974a-a463-474c-b25c-d47f01235d54] [signal:54f804af-4e46-4c52-8e87-2a8328d2f167] [signal:56b45dbc-2c60-448c-9927-d5ab49f90633]

## Open questions
The reports do not establish the cause of the sounds or sensations; one customer describes the issue as possibly coming from the suspension or brakes, and another says the rattle sounds like it comes from the bottom of the shock absorber. [signal:057e974a-a463-474c-b25c-d47f01235d54] [signal:54f804af-4e46-4c52-8e87-2a8328d2f167]

value.title: Suspension feels too firm for some F70 drivers
value.summary: Some F70 drivers, particularly in Europe, find the suspension too firm or insufficiently forgiving, while another driver enjoys its firm feel. The signals include a comparison with a prior Audi whose suspension felt softer.
highlights: Some drivers find the suspension too firm or insufficiently forgiving.
Mostly European F70 owners; one Rest of World F70 driver enjoys the firm feel.
One European driver says the suspension feels harder than on their prior Audi.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 owners describe the suspension as firm, too hard, or insufficiently forgiving, including for UK roads. [signal:6ca9cdc4-6307-431b-8412-fe8851330912] [signal:a5deff92-8a7c-4f20-8aed-871695ce4cb2] [signal:de5de7b8-0901-45ae-9e4f-f600a3d36b7d] [signal:e813686d-8c07-4982-a3fb-2b6423287ccb]

## What customers say
One European F70 owner says the suspension is harder than that of their previous Audi. [signal:a5deff92-8a7c-4f20-8aed-871695ce4cb2]
Another European owner says the suspension could feel firm for some, and a different owner says standard active suspension is a real improvement over their prior 118i. [signal:6ca9cdc4-6307-431b-8412-fe8851330912] [signal:989efd4c-91f8-4f1e-84c3-4b21378238d5]
A Rest of World F70 owner personally enjoys the firm suspension, while acknowledging that people may be divided on it. [signal:dba6f35f-783d-4fee-8274-53ac55324408]

## Differences between markets
The reports of suspension being too firm or needing more tuning are from European F70 owners. [signal:6ca9cdc4-6307-431b-8412-fe8851330912] [signal:a5deff92-8a7c-4f20-8aed-871695ce4cb2] [signal:de5de7b8-0901-45ae-9e4f-f600a3d36b7d] [signal:e813686d-8c07-4982-a3fb-2b6423287ccb]
The Rest of World F70 owner says they enjoy the firm feel. [signal:dba6f35f-783d-4fee-8274-53ac55324408]
The USA G70 signal does not comment on suspension. [signal:804a050b-b82b-448a-a2d0-8f2584a54d4a]

## Open questions
Do drivers’ views of firmness vary with their preferred comfort level or road conditions? The signals include a request for more forgiveness on UK roads and a Rest of World owner who enjoys the firm feel. [signal:e813686d-8c07-4982-a3fb-2b6423287ccb] [signal:dba6f35f-783d-4fee-8274-53ac55324408]
How do customers distinguish the feel of standard active suspension from other suspension setups? One F70 owner calls the move to standard active suspension an improvement, while other F70 owners describe firm or hard suspension. [signal:989efd4c-91f8-4f1e-84c3-4b21378238d5] [signal:a5deff92-8a7c-4f20-8aed-871695ce4cb2]

value.body_md:
## Problem
F70 owners describe the suspension as too firm on bumpy or uneven roads, with some reporting shaking, discomfort, or back pain. [signal:603f2c98-c220-4d3a-a80a-9ebed9a5f78c] [signal:869da6eb-da4b-4ce8-b2c7-ce857306d73a] One owner says the rear feels especially stiff. [signal:309932a2-edb2-414c-a933-338e2e6a804c]

## What customers say
A Europe-based F70 owner says the ride is harsh on British roads and that passengers have commented on it. [signal:6983e1c7-3f6d-49a2-8588-f0aa5b1294c2] Another says the suspension is not forgiving enough for their needs and associates the car’s setup with sports suspension. [signal:88f547f6-9adf-4840-a157-fa47c8a92ace] A Rest of World owner reports back pain on rough roads, while another describes frequent shaking that causes anxiety. [signal:869da6eb-da4b-4ce8-b2c7-ce857306d73a] [signal:71b425a3-9afa-4b33-867c-5ee736569a74] One F70 owner questions the usefulness of adaptive suspension because it cannot be adjusted. [signal:8dc3be9c-f9d3-4f07-89ea-a9c7425a8540]

## Differences between markets
The sampled F70 complaints about firm ride quality come from both Europe and Rest of World. [signal:603f2c98-c220-4d3a-a80a-9ebed9a5f78c] [signal:309932a2-edb2-414c-a933-338e2e6a804c] A USA G60 owner instead describes the vehicle as very comfortable and quiet. [signal:a392df02-cd26-493a-8c1d-703b0b2e6dc9] These comments concern different vehicle lines, so the signals do not establish a market-level disagreement for the same vehicle.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the F70 ride complaint is across the full set of 18 signals. The sampled accounts also do not clarify how ride comfort varies by road surface, passenger load, or suspension configuration.
