value.title: MSA restarts feel rough and cannot be permanently disabled
value.summary: Some US G70 and G60 drivers report shuddering or jolting when the engine restarts, and one G70 driver objects to not being able to disable MSA permanently. They describe reduced comfort and, in some accounts, delayed response when pulling into traffic.
highlights: Restart shudder, jolts, and limited ability to disable MSA are reported.
Signals shown are from US G70 and G60 drivers.
One G70 signal compares restart smoothness with other brands and a 2024 BMW 530i.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers report that the engine restart can make the vehicle shake, shudder, or jolt. [signal:0123f6a1-b9e2-4af7-a8b3-ef47e0c0fe1f] [signal:30c885ce-377d-41e6-8a25-e67ed7e512fe] [signal:4ab10566-e06a-4a24-b132-df504bb55cc4] One driver says the restart delay affects pulling into traffic, while another says MSA cannot be permanently disabled except by using Sport mode. [signal:1ae6898c-a960-48d5-9282-34acb8074d40] [signal:4b444d64-9768-426e-9126-b213717d5573]

## What customers say
A G70 driver says the car shudders at each stop in traffic. [signal:0123f6a1-b9e2-4af7-a8b3-ef47e0c0fe1f] G60 and G70 drivers describe rough restarts or shaking that detracts from the expected smoothness and quietness. [signal:30c885ce-377d-41e6-8a25-e67ed7e512fe] [signal:4b444d64-9768-426e-9126-b213717d5573] One driver says Sport mode prevents engine shutoff but feels less fuel-efficient; a suggested Sport Individual workaround did not resolve the issue for that customer. [signal:30c885ce-377d-41e6-8a25-e67ed7e512fe] Another driver describes a delay before the engine and power are ready when pulling into traffic. [signal:1ae6898c-a960-48d5-9282-34acb8074d40] [signal:4b444d64-9768-426e-9126-b213717d5573]

## Differences between markets
The signals shown are from the USA and include G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:0123f6a1-b9e2-4af7-a8b3-ef47e0c0fe1f] [signal:30c885ce-377d-41e6-8a25-e67ed7e512fe] No other market is represented in the signals shown.

## Open questions
Do restart smoothness and response differ between vehicle lines or driving conditions? The signals describe G70 and G60 experiences but do not establish those differences. [signal:0123f6a1-b9e2-4af7-a8b3-ef47e0c0fe1f] [signal:30c885ce-377d-41e6-8a25-e67ed7e512fe] How do customers evaluate restart smoothness against competing systems? One G70 driver compares it with other brands and a 2024 BMW 530i, but the available quote does not provide the full comparison. [signal:3cb61453-9ccf-4581-a275-1e691e7d1dec]

value.title: Suspension comfort and adjustability vary across customers
value.summary: Some F70 customers describe the suspension as too hard or stiff, while others value its gentle, comfortable ride. Customers also express interest in adjustability, and a USA G60 customer is unsure whether a perceived suspension issue is present.
highlights: Ride comfort is inconsistent: some customers find the suspension too hard, while others praise its comfort.
Signals include USA G60 and G70 customers, and F70 customers in Europe and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report differing experiences of suspension comfort: some describe a hard or stiff ride, while others value a gentle or improved suspension feel. [signal:074287fc-a0db-4247-9bb8-8c734100c534] [signal:0792caa7-0eef-483e-8d88-2b563a78f50d] [signal:12e802a4-ba6d-402b-8e8b-cec287302ff1] [signal:339b948c-eed6-4888-bfb0-e0d9ac897a2b] [signal:3840e24f-d4d9-403d-8210-e7ba517b3341] [signal:5115bc3e-80eb-4730-8689-12172e5c1469] Some customers also want suspension adjustment, including changing ride height or settings. [signal:d089a9f4-6727-41ee-89c3-1458614f0193] [signal:0792caa7-0eef-483e-8d88-2b563a78f50d]

## What customers say
F70 customers describe the M Sport suspension as too hard over rough roads, report discomfort for rear-seat passengers on bumpy surfaces, or say the rear feels overly stiff. [signal:0792caa7-0eef-483e-8d88-2b563a78f50d] [signal:5115bc3e-80eb-4730-8689-12172e5c1469] Other F70 customers praise a gentle ride, improved suspension, or comfortable handling. [signal:3840e24f-d4d9-403d-8210-e7ba517b3341] [signal:339b948c-eed6-4888-bfb0-e0d9ac897a2b] [signal:444122ab-8559-4364-bb9e-5b2cad1693c9] One USA G70 customer says the suspension feels softer than on their previous 7 Series. [signal:7914c8b1-50b4-4f64-8c99-3ff135bb1ec9] A USA G60 customer wants to raise the suspension to avoid scraping on a driveway, while another G60 customer is uncertain whether a possible suspension issue exists after only a brief drive. [signal:d089a9f4-6727-41ee-89c3-1458614f0193] [signal:520eb912-09fa-44f0-9a61-020e3f4679b5]

## Differences between markets
In the provided signals, reports that the F70 suspension is too hard or stiff come from Europe and Rest of World; positive comments about its comfort or improvement also come from Europe and Rest of World. [signal:074287fc-a0db-4247-9bb8-8c734100c534] [signal:0792caa7-0eef-483e-8d88-2b563a78f50d] [signal:12e802a4-ba6d-402b-8e8b-cec287302ff1] [signal:5115bc3e-80eb-4730-8689-12172e5c1469] [signal:3840e24f-d4d9-403d-8210-e7ba517b3341] [signal:339b948c-eed6-4888-bfb0-e0d9ac897a2b] [signal:444122ab-8559-4364-bb9e-5b2cad1693c9] The USA signals concern softer-than-previous-7-Series feel, a request for height adjustment, and an uncertain possible issue. [signal:7914c8b1-50b4-4f64-8c99-3ff135bb1ec9] [signal:d089a9f4-6727-41ee-89c3-1458614f0193] [signal:520eb912-09fa-44f0-9a61-020e3f4679b5]

## Open questions
How often does suspension discomfort occur across vehicle lines and markets beyond the examples in these signals? What driving conditions and passenger positions are associated with the reports of a hard or stiff ride? [signal:0792caa7-0eef-483e-8d88-2b563a78f50d] [signal:5115bc3e-80eb-4730-8689-12172e5c1469]

value.title: Start-stop control feels intrusive or difficult to access
value.summary: Some customers want an easier way to deactivate automatic engine start-stop, while others value its smoother operation or improved control. Signals describe different experiences across USA, Europe, and Rest of World vehicles.
highlights: Customers describe start-stop as irritating, hard to deactivate, or awkward to control.
Concerns appear in USA G70 and G60, Europe F70, and Rest of World G60 signals.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers find automatic start-stop irritating, feel it is constantly active, or want a simpler way to switch it off. One customer says it makes parking harder and feels unsafe. [signal:01cd5752-9b6e-472b-9954-3590ef0f3270] Others describe finding the control through menus or the app as awkward. [signal:f00d7e7a-60b3-4ab5-8905-c875b9e41b3a] [signal:07241740-f9b5-4023-89db-73d10ae37216]

## What customers say
USA G70 customers request a way to switch the function off, including a physical button or an option that does not require driving in Sport mode. [signal:59b0be69-0532-41d6-a4ed-89ab5a7a9965] [signal:f0b9587d-47cf-48ec-8f0d-57cf3a1336c8] Another USA G70 customer says the function cannot be switched off. [signal:01cd5752-9b6e-472b-9954-3590ef0f3270]

Experiences are not uniformly negative: some F70 customers value smoother start-stop or say it has improved, and one reports that deactivation through the app made it easier. [signal:53b588d2-16bb-4d47-8d70-849ef4756dd6] [signal:7fa0f6d7-5009-40e4-9cff-b883d51549fa] [signal:265fe44a-9476-4539-b0b7-8c65e9655637] One USA G70 customer also says she appreciates being able to switch it off. [signal:47f98d81-f8e9-4c1b-a6e5-acc2e5c8b2d9]

## Differences between markets
In the USA, G70 signals include requests for an off option and reports that the function cannot be switched off, as well as a report that it can now be deactivated. [signal:59b0be69-0532-41d6-a4ed-89ab5a7a9965] [signal:01cd5752-9b6e-472b-9954-3590ef0f3270] [signal:47f98d81-f8e9-4c1b-a6e5-acc2e5c8b2d9] USA G60 feedback also objects to the loss of cancellation or permanent-off control. [signal:c853bb5f-4f78-4296-afdb-8ec8708e3784]

In Europe, an F70 customer calls the control awkward to use, while another says app-based deactivation is easier; other F70 feedback praises smoother or improved operation. [signal:f00d7e7a-60b3-4ab5-8905-c875b9e41b3a] [signal:265fe44a-9476-4539-b0b7-8c65e9655637] [signal:53b588d2-16bb-4d47-8d70-849ef4756dd6] Rest of World G60 feedback says cancellation has effectively been removed, while Rest of World F70 feedback says the function has improved. [signal:07241740-f9b5-4023-89db-73d10ae37216] [signal:7fa0f6d7-5009-40e4-9cff-b883d51549fa]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify why customers report different availability of deactivation, including within USA G70 feedback. [signal:01cd5752-9b6e-472b-9954-3590ef0f3270] [signal:47f98d81-f8e9-4c1b-a6e5-acc2e5c8b2d9] They also do not establish how widespread the concerns or positive experiences are beyond the examples provided. [signal:59b0be69-0532-41d6-a4ed-89ab5a7a9965] [signal:53b588d2-16bb-4d47-8d70-849ef4756dd6]

## Problem

value.title: MSA is hard to disable and resets between drives
value.summary: Drivers who dislike automatic engine start-stop report that disabling it is inconvenient or not possible permanently. Complaints in the signals come from USA, Europe and Rest of World, across G60, G70 and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Drivers report no quick off control, a missing setting, or having to disable MSA each drive.
Signals include USA, Europe and Rest of World, and G60, G70 and F70 vehicles.
A USA driver also finds the same feature irritating in a Porsche Turbo 911.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe MSA as annoying and difficult to disable, including having to navigate through the center display or switch it off on each start. [signal:03b44255-dd47-42ec-833c-9bcbf3294705] [signal:36a13986-310e-4ae0-a7b9-2682d045809c] [signal:d9708c68-d10e-4323-a6cd-469810072216]
One G70 driver reports that the MSA off setting does not appear in the iDrive path they were shown, and does not want to use Sport Mode to stop the function. [signal:21cdbeff-612a-476c-8629-69c263d95261]
A G60 driver also objects to the engine shutting off when they unbuckle and leave the vehicle running. [signal:2f9fba31-f597-4f67-8e22-53029ab430cc]

## What customers say
A USA G60 driver says MSA bothers them and that having to switch it off every time they get in is frustrating. [signal:03b44255-dd47-42ec-833c-9bcbf3294705]
A Rest of World F70 driver worries that being unable to disable idle stop could affect battery and starter-motor durability. [signal:267c72cd-6aba-45ee-ab3b-960caaf4eb3e]
A USA G70 driver considers the function annoying and says it is irritating in their Porsche Turbo 911 as well. [signal:2717339c-1810-448a-a0c1-446486bdcd52]

## Differences between markets
Complaints about disabling MSA appear in the USA for G60 and G70, Europe for F70, and Rest of World for F70. [signal:03b44255-dd47-42ec-833c-9bcbf3294705] [signal:21cdbeff-612a-476c-8629-69c263d95261] [signal:d9708c68-d10e-4323-a6cd-469810072216] [signal:267c72cd-6aba-45ee-ab3b-960caaf4eb3e]
The sampled signals show complaints in these markets; they do not establish whether experiences differ by market. [signal:03b44255-dd47-42ec-833c-9bcbf3294705] [signal:21cdbeff-612a-476c-8629-69c263d95261] [signal:d9708c68-d10e-4323-a6cd-469810072216] [signal:267c72cd-6aba-45ee-ab3b-960caaf4eb3e]

## Open questions
Do the reported missing or hard-to-find controls vary by vehicle configuration or software version? [signal:21cdbeff-612a-476c-8629-69c263d95261] [signal:36a13986-310e-4ae0-a7b9-2682d045809c]
How widespread are the concerns about MSA resetting between drives and its effects on battery and starter-motor durability? [signal:d9708c68-d10e-4323-a6cd-469810072216] [signal:267c72cd-6aba-45ee-ab3b-960caaf4eb3e]

value.title: Engine restarts feel harsh, jerky and unsettling
value.summary: Drivers in the USA and Rest of World report uncomfortable or unsettling engine restarts, including harshness while stationary and a sudden lurch when the engine starts. One driver says the function feels fine when pulling away from a stop.
highlights: Engine restarts can feel harsh or cause a sudden lurch.
Complaints come from USA (G60) and Rest of World (F70).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe engine restarts as harsh while stationary or as sudden enough to make the car lurch forward; one calls the experience dangerous. [signal:c884a5f3-7264-4b3b-b853-81a8009adb96] [signal:eb9aa1d7-9bec-485c-a9f4-2a4c0f4fc392]

## What customers say
A G60 driver in the USA says restarts while sitting still feel harsh, but that the function feels fine when pulling away and the first cold start of the morning is smoother. [signal:c884a5f3-7264-4b3b-b853-81a8009adb96]
A driver of an F70 in the Rest of World wants a mode that keeps the engine idling and says sudden engine starts feel jerky and make the car lurch forward. [signal:eb9aa1d7-9bec-485c-a9f4-2a4c0f4fc392]

## Differences between markets
The USA signal describes harshness while stationary and a smoother experience when pulling away or during the first cold start. [signal:c884a5f3-7264-4b3b-b853-81a8009adb96]
The Rest of World signal describes sudden starts, a lurch, and a request for a mode that keeps the engine idling. [signal:eb9aa1d7-9bec-485c-a9f4-2a4c0f4fc392]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these experiences are beyond the two reported vehicles. [signal:c884a5f3-7264-4b3b-b853-81a8009adb96] [signal:eb9aa1d7-9bec-485c-a9f4-2a4c0f4fc392]

value.title: Start-stop behavior is unwanted or seems inconsistent
value.summary: Customers report that MSA cannot be kept off, seems to shut the engine off despite being switched off, or interrupts comfort in hot conditions. Signals include both frustration with the repeated or unwanted operation and positive assessments of the system.
highlights: Customers dislike having to disable MSA repeatedly or report that it still seems to activate.
Signals span USA (4), Europe (5) and Rest of World (1), across G70, G60 and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers cannot keep MSA disabled between drives and find repeated shutoffs or the need to switch it off frustrating. [signal:6b2f075e-657d-446c-9b3e-c005faf5d3ff] [signal:9b40df2c-f3bd-44b2-bbd0-45bf8273de7f] [signal:c11f5505-9cb2-4c1f-801b-6c7ad4d5dfbf] In one USA report, the engine seemed to shut off in Efficient Mode even after the customer switched Auto Start/Stop off. [signal:f0cf63b6-4c50-421d-9d76-4e6e7cdd6a13] A South Florida customer says engine shutoff at red lights brings back the heat in the cabin. [signal:048df570-e933-4beb-a339-514e48c82652]

## What customers say
A G70 owner says automatic start-stop cannot be switched off, while an F70 owner has to cancel it on every start and asks about keeping it off permanently. [signal:6b2f075e-657d-446c-9b3e-c005faf5d3ff] [signal:9b40df2c-f3bd-44b2-bbd0-45bf8273de7f] Another F70 owner finds it annoying to switch off start-stop every time they get in. [signal:c11f5505-9cb2-4c1f-801b-6c7ad4d5dfbf] A G60 customer reports that the engine still seems to shut off after they select Efficient Mode and switch Auto Start/Stop off. [signal:f0cf63b6-4c50-421d-9d76-4e6e7cdd6a13]

Feedback is not uniformly negative: an F70 owner says the stop-start system is better than in their previous model, and another calls it far superior to the previous system. [signal:240ad059-5fda-4d9e-8caa-8963d2023236] [signal:9b74f388-2cc4-4582-8945-aead0c4467bb] A Rest of World F70 owner worries that being unable to disable idle stop could affect long-term battery and starter-motor durability. [signal:40a755a6-526b-43cc-8d40-55499e8ad38f] One F70 reviewer says the system seems to “nap” often and finds this annoying when moving off at junctions. [signal:bbded951-5491-49c7-8de8-85c33c6e2fce]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include four USA reports, five Europe reports and one Rest of World report. [signal:048df570-e933-4beb-a339-514e48c82652] [signal:519b970f-6d55-4e74-a268-01b92c7dbe1e] [signal:6b2f075e-657d-446c-9b3e-c005faf5d3ff] [signal:f0cf63b6-4c50-421d-9d76-4e6e7cdd6a13] [signal:240ad059-5fda-4d9e-8caa-8963d2023236] [signal:9b40df2c-f3bd-44b2-bbd0-45bf8273de7f] [signal:9b74f388-2cc4-4582-8945-aead0c4467bb] [signal:bbded951-5491-49c7-8de8-85c33c6e2fce] [signal:c11f5505-9cb2-4c1f-801b-6c7ad4d5dfbf] [signal:40a755a6-526b-43cc-8d40-55499e8ad38f] European F70 reports include both praise for improved stop-start operation and complaints about recurring shutoff or the need to disable it on each start. [signal:240ad059-5fda-4d9e-8caa-8963d2023236] [signal:9b74f388-2cc4-4582-8945-aead0c4467bb] [signal:9b40df2c-f3bd-44b2-bbd0-45bf8273de7f] [signal:c11f5505-9cb2-4c1f-801b-6c7ad4d5dfbf] USA reports include concerns about cabin heat during engine shutoff and an apparent shutoff after the customer switches the function off. [signal:048df570-e933-4beb-a339-514e48c82652] [signal:f0cf63b6-4c50-421d-9d76-4e6e7cdd6a13]

## Open questions
The G60 report does not establish why the engine seems to shut off after the customer switches Auto Start/Stop off. [signal:f0cf63b6-4c50-421d-9d76-4e6e7cdd6a13] The signals do not establish how often the reported behavior occurs or whether it reflects a reliability fault. [signal:439602c3-9f2a-46d6-be05-76ccb758181b] [signal:883da6dc-6d0d-4013-b3cf-70fb4fd4c048] [signal:90a01601-a550-41d8-bb87-614019938567] [signal:95c7d173-1b10-4192-ab1e-383c5545c2b7] [signal:cb21f63f-af08-4239-83be-e2385e2e6e78] [signal:cd9d4480-ae8d-47ba-a42d-aa9a7fdd2e38] No other market comparison is available in these signals.

## Problem

## What customers say
A G70 customer would prefer blacked-out trim instead of chrome, while another G70 customer would like more chrome, including a horizontal side strip compared with Jaguar detailing. [signal:01fe64dd-2fd1-4688-aefc-c5383103d2dd] [signal:18a2d10b-34ab-48d5-ab8f-0859068124c0]

A G70 customer would prefer more black and Brooklyn Grey, with less chrome on the muffler and grille. [signal:4ed823a8-bff3-4cf1-81df-bf199e4be2c0]

A Rest of World F70 customer says the car is not available in red and recalls Melbourne Red on a previous 125 as a favorite. [signal:7516feab-2df9-4daa-bf7c-86bd94de580b]

The USA signals include G70 requests for different colors and varied preferences about chrome, plus G60 dissatisfaction with exterior trim. [signal:01fe64dd-2fd1-4688-aefc-c5383103d2dd] [signal:05cd5e9c-f9fb-4495-966f-203caa9ef764] [signal:18a2d10b-34ab-48d5-ab8f-0859068124c0] [signal:23d4f4c4-ffcf-4960-a615-dc5649347fef] [signal:31925bb7-0f6f-4984-83a9-93261eb81733] [signal:4ed823a8-bff3-4cf1-81df-bf199e4be2c0]

The Rest of World signal is an F70 customer's wish for a red exterior color. [signal:7516feab-2df9-4daa-bf7c-86bd94de580b]

## Open questions
The signals show differing views on chrome, including requests for both less and more exterior chrome. [signal:01fe64dd-2fd1-4688-aefc-c5383103d2dd] [signal:18a2d10b-34ab-48d5-ab8f-0859068124c0] [signal:23d4f4c4-ffcf-4960-a615-dc5649347fef] [signal:4ed823a8-bff3-4cf1-81df-bf199e4be2c0] How do these preferences vary across customers and configurations? value.title: Rear door handles are difficult to grip and confusing to use
value.summary: Some customers in the USA find the rear handles hard to grip or confusing to operate. The signals describe concerns on G60 and G70 vehicles, including difficulty for a passenger with limited use of one arm.
highlights: Flush handles are hard to grip, and the correct activation area can be unclear.
Three complaints concern the USA G60; one wish concerns the USA G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say the flush G60 rear door handles are harder to grip than the protruding handles on an earlier 528, and one customer says this can make opening the door difficult for his wife, who has limited use of one arm. [signal:21bfb0af-b1d5-4487-8d76-0bc8add44477] [signal:40232d1e-f662-4936-942e-7e04147090da] [signal:9669b37e-d7b3-4379-9273-6fafc9231656]
On the G70, a customer says passengers may press the wrong part of the rear handle’s cover plate and struggle to activate the automatic doors. [signal:73da8fc2-0245-40d8-9c1d-0405699d570a]

## What customers say
One G60 customer prefers the more protruding handles on his previous 528 because they offered more to grab. [signal:21bfb0af-b1d5-4487-8d76-0bc8add44477]
Another says the flush handles require a pull toward the user and were harder for his wife to manage than earlier models. [signal:40232d1e-f662-4936-942e-7e04147090da]
A further customer reports that his wife sometimes has trouble opening the door because the handle sits very flush against the body. [signal:9669b37e-d7b3-4379-9273-6fafc9231656]
For the G70, a customer says first-time passengers tend to press the circular part of the cover plate rather than the corner that activates the automatic doors. [signal:73da8fc2-0245-40d8-9c1d-0405699d570a]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA, so they provide no comparison between markets. [signal:21bfb0af-b1d5-4487-8d76-0bc8add44477] [signal:40232d1e-f662-4936-942e-7e04147090da] [signal:9669b37e-d7b3-4379-9273-6fafc9231656] [signal:73da8fc2-0245-40d8-9c1d-0405699d570a]
The three G60 signals describe difficulty gripping or operating flush handles, while the G70 signal describes confusion about where to press to activate the automatic doors. [signal:21bfb0af-b1d5-4487-8d76-0bc8add44477] [signal:40232d1e-f662-4936-942e-7e04147090da] [signal:9669b37e-d7b3-4379-9273-6fafc9231656] [signal:73da8fc2-0245-40d8-9c1d-0405699d570a]

## Open questions
How often do passengers have difficulty gripping or pulling the G60 rear handles, including passengers with limited use of one arm? [signal:40232d1e-f662-4936-942e-7e04147090da]
How often do G70 passengers press the wrong area when trying to activate the automatic doors? [signal:73da8fc2-0245-40d8-9c1d-0405699d570a]

[signal:44164241-84de-4408-8dee-643c7f260772] [signal:5ed60cf9-e7e7-4d93-b118-62c1907716c7] [signal:9c366c2a-0db8-4d2e-883e-766c96ab058d] [signal:1cb00aa0-feb1-4908-8bae-a06c63ed2c93]

Do the F70 reports reflect a consistent change in reverse-dip availability, or differences between vehicles or configurations? [signal:44164241-84de-4408-8dee-643c7f260772] [signal:5ed60cf9-e7e7-4d93-b118-62c1907716c7] [signal:9c366c2a-0db8-4d2e-883e-766c96ab058d]

How widespread is the value placed on folding mirrors to avoid damage? [signal:1cb00aa0-feb1-4908-8bae-a06c63ed2c93]

value.title: Personal eSIM access and carrier availability are limited
value.summary: Some US customers cannot use Personal eSIM as expected: access is tied to the BMW ID associated with it, and some carriers are not available during setup. Affected customers report switching carriers or being unable to share access with another BMW ID.
highlights: Personal eSIM access is BMW ID-specific, and some carriers are unavailable.
Three US signals describe issues: two on G70 and one on G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers report that a Personal eSIM works only when the BMW ID associated with it is signed in, preventing another user with a different BMW ID from accessing it. [signal:18eae54e-6b5e-422c-94d7-9b0b2f9f394c] Other customers could not find their carrier in the setup list or could not use the eSIM with their carrier. [signal:3938f9b2-c2c5-490c-9daf-b9c328a61fe5] [signal:fd5c3726-dbe7-4c66-a04e-14f775bc4402]

## What customers say
One customer said his wife could not use the Personal eSIM with her BMW ID, although it worked with his. [signal:18eae54e-6b5e-422c-94d7-9b0b2f9f394c] A G60 customer could not find Nordline in the carrier list and described it as a major carrier in his region. [signal:3938f9b2-c2c5-490c-9daf-b9c328a61fe5] A G70 customer said Spectrum did not work for the planned eSIM use, so they switched to T-Mobile. [signal:fd5c3726-dbe7-4c66-a04e-14f775bc4402]

## Differences between markets
The three signals describing Personal eSIM access or carrier issues are from the USA, across G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:18eae54e-6b5e-422c-94d7-9b0b2f9f394c] [signal:3938f9b2-c2c5-490c-9daf-b9c328a61fe5] [signal:fd5c3726-dbe7-4c66-a04e-14f775bc4402] The signals do not establish how the feature performs in other markets.

## Open questions
Do customers expect a Personal eSIM to be accessible across multiple BMW IDs? [signal:18eae54e-6b5e-422c-94d7-9b0b2f9f394c] Which carriers are unavailable to customers during setup, and how widely does this affect them? [signal:3938f9b2-c2c5-490c-9daf-b9c328a61fe5] [signal:fd5c3726-dbe7-4c66-a04e-14f775bc4402]

value.title: Exterior mirror faults and visibility problems
value.summary: Customers report exterior mirrors that fail to adjust or make noise when folding, while lighting can obstruct the view in side mirrors. Signals come from F70, G60 and G70 owners in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Exterior mirrors are reported as non-functional, noisy, or difficult to see clearly.
Signals mention F70, G60 and G70 in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report a parking mirror that does not work, mirror noise during folding, and interior lighting that obstructs visibility in side mirrors. [signal:170e2785-7389-4e20-8dcf-274940bdadaf] [signal:36f13616-ff7c-4dd7-99e1-c3e3b422f197] [signal:85f0319b-8c57-472c-acb6-db5d3e851317]

## What customers say
Two Europe-based F70 reviews say the parking mirror has never worked. [signal:170e2785-7389-4e20-8dcf-274940bdadaf] [signal:7ce279a8-2311-48a8-a966-c7a93d55f7c3]

A Rest of World F70 owner reports squeaking when the mirrors open or close, and a USA G60 owner reports noise when side mirrors fold and unfold. [signal:36f13616-ff7c-4dd7-99e1-c3e3b422f197] [signal:85f0319b-8c57-472c-acb6-db5d3e851317]

Owners in Europe and the USA say interior lighting shines into or reflects off the driver-side mirror at night and interferes with visibility. [signal:5ec18dba-5998-4e51-9be4-235290e94484] [signal:688badda-c1a5-40b3-8e4e-d446b1f5e5f6] One Rest of World G60 owner also says interior lights make the side mirrors harder to see clearly at night. [signal:85f0319b-8c57-472c-acb6-db5d3e851317]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include mirror complaints from Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:170e2785-7389-4e20-8dcf-274940bdadaf] [signal:688badda-c1a5-40b3-8e4e-d446b1f5e5f6] [signal:85f0319b-8c57-472c-acb6-db5d3e851317]

The reports differ by issue: the Europe F70 reports describe a non-working parking mirror and nighttime reflections; the USA reports describe nighttime visibility interference; Rest of World reports describe folding noise and nighttime visibility. [signal:170e2785-7389-4e20-8dcf-274940bdadaf] [signal:5ec18dba-5998-4e51-9be4-235290e94484] [signal:688badda-c1a5-40b3-8e4e-d446b1f5e5f6] [signal:36f13616-ff7c-4dd7-99e1-c3e3b422f197] [signal:85f0319b-8c57-472c-acb6-db5d3e851317]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these mirror issues are across the 25 signals in the case, or whether the reported faults were resolved. [signal:170e2785-7389-4e20-8dcf-274940bdadaf] [signal:36f13616-ff7c-4dd7-99e1-c3e3b422f197]

value.title: Rattling and squeaking noises in the roof area
value.summary: G60 customers in the USA report rattling or squeaking around the headliner and roof trim. One customer also says trim near the rear glass came loose and its clips needed replacement.
highlights: Roof-area rattles and squeaks, with one report of loose trim.
Three complaints, all from USA customers with G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report rattling or squeaking noises around the headliner and roof area, and one reports loose trim by the rear glass. [signal:20d853fa-888e-40ab-8b54-844371fb3c51] [signal:45bbc832-fa20-4ea2-ab92-94c75709db84] [signal:d336d716-07bf-46af-a295-037ef4e9d0b7]

## What customers say
One customer heard a rattle near the sunroof switches on the day of purchase, including on relatively smooth streets at about 25–35 mph; technicians could not reproduce it during a check. [signal:20d853fa-888e-40ab-8b54-844371fb3c51]

Another customer described a frequent rattle in the passenger-side roof area that did not seem tied to speed; pressing the headliner temporarily stopped the sound. [signal:45bbc832-fa20-4ea2-ab92-94c75709db84]

A third customer said trim around the upper tail light at the top of the rear glass came loose, and two clips were replaced within the first three months. [signal:d336d716-07bf-46af-a295-037ef4e9d0b7]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA and concern the G60; the signals provide no comparison with other markets or vehicle lines. [signal:20d853fa-888e-40ab-8b54-844371fb3c51] [signal:45bbc832-fa20-4ea2-ab92-94c75709db84] [signal:d336d716-07bf-46af-a295-037ef4e9d0b7]

## Open questions
Do the reported noises share a cause, and how often can they be reproduced during inspection? [signal:20d853fa-888e-40ab-8b54-844371fb3c51] [signal:45bbc832-fa20-4ea2-ab92-94c75709db84]

value.title: Exterior mirror controls and visibility are difficult for some drivers
value.summary: Some drivers struggle to understand mirror controls or find the reverse tilt too intrusive; others report poor visibility due to reflections or obstruction. Reports come from the USA, Europe and Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Reverse-tilt behavior and mirror settings can be confusing or interfere with visibility.
Reports span USA, Europe and Rest of World; vehicles include F70, G60 and G70.
One customer compares with another car’s video rear-view mirror.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers find it difficult to control exterior-mirror behavior, including reverse tilt and folding on lock; one customer says the passenger mirror tilts too far to see a garage door while reversing. [signal:44025428-8bcf-47c9-b35c-d663fbc03b4f] [signal:559192f0-6a37-49f8-a8ea-95b8932ffbc3] Other reports describe cabin or ambient lighting reflecting in the door mirror and making it distracting or hard to use. [signal:9f058e02-f78a-4313-a9ee-c08a651ca66b] [signal:7bd3b02e-904d-473e-8e40-26149adaaa9f]

## What customers say
In USA reports, customers ask how to stop the passenger-side mirror tilting down in reverse, and one says the tilt obstructs their view of a garage door. [signal:1a8b7ffa-04ab-4e35-a83f-086f5f8c3233] [signal:317f700b-985c-4cae-93fa-3c7bf72286ed] [signal:44025428-8bcf-47c9-b35c-d663fbc03b4f] Another customer wanted the mirrors to fold when locking the vehicle and needed instructions to activate the setting. [signal:559192f0-6a37-49f8-a8ea-95b8932ffbc3] A separate USA customer said their current vehicle’s mirrors do not fold in, unlike those on their previous M440i. [signal:4f11524c-228f-4640-807c-85aa44d36b60]

In Rest of World reports, one driver says cabin lights reflecting in the door mirror make it unusable, while another says ambient lighting reflects into the mirror and is distracting. [signal:9f058e02-f78a-4313-a9ee-c08a651ca66b] [signal:7bd3b02e-904d-473e-8e40-26149adaaa9f] A G70 customer also says the right-side mirror becomes hard to see from the front passenger seat and reports that it tilts far down when reversing. [signal:68341a0a-912e-48ab-b792-2cb244a34c6e] This customer mentions another car with a video image in the rear-view mirror. [signal:68341a0a-912e-48ab-b792-2cb244a34c6e]

## Differences between markets
The supplied examples include USA reports about reverse tilt and folding settings, Europe reports about reflections in the door mirror, and Rest of World reports about reflections and mirror visibility. [signal:1a8b7ffa-04ab-4e35-a83f-086f5f8c3233] [signal:317f700b-985c-4cae-93fa-3c7bf72286ed] [signal:559192f0-6a37-49f8-a8ea-95b8932ffbc3] [signal:7bd3b02e-904d-473e-8e40-26149adaaa9f] [signal:9f058e02-f78a-4313-a9ee-c08a651ca66b] The examples describe different issues; they do not establish whether those differences are typical of each market. [signal:1a8b7ffa-04ab-4e35-a83f-086f5f8c3233] [signal:7bd3b02e-904d-473e-8e40-26149adaaa9f]

## Open questions
How often do drivers find reverse tilt excessive or difficult to disable? [signal:44025428-8bcf-47c9-b35c-d663fbc03b4f] How often do lighting reflections impair mirror visibility, and under what conditions? [signal:9f058e02-f78a-4313-a9ee-c08a651ca66b] [signal:7bd3b02e-904d-473e-8e40-26149adaaa9f]

value.title: Sunroof opening feels limited or is missing
value.summary: Some USA customers want a more openable sunroof, with one G60 owner saying it opens only halfway and a G70 customer reporting no opening sunroof. Other G70 customers like the moonroof or the roof’s appearance.
highlights: Customers describe a halfway-opening sunroof or a missing opening sunroof.
Signals are from the USA: one G60 and three G70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say the sunroof opens only halfway or that an opening sunroof is missing. [signal:961906d1-cde9-49f1-bb56-8e4526646dd6] [signal:0d4cc6d5-e5db-496f-8faf-f6ccc9f36d57]

## What customers say
A G60 owner calls the halfway-opening sunroof a major negative. [signal:961906d1-cde9-49f1-bb56-8e4526646dd6] A G70 customer says an opening sunroof is missing. [signal:0d4cc6d5-e5db-496f-8faf-f6ccc9f36d57] Other G70 customers say they like the moonroof or that the roof looks beautiful. [signal:6b16af74-5109-4ff8-8dae-7849a18a61a5] [signal:cce9873e-d1f5-4036-b88b-1c1bfcb03164]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA. [signal:961906d1-cde9-49f1-bb56-8e4526646dd6] [signal:0d4cc6d5-e5db-496f-8faf-f6ccc9f36d57] [signal:6b16af74-5109-4ff8-8dae-7849a18a61a5] [signal:cce9873e-d1f5-4036-b88b-1c1bfcb03164] The complaints come from one G60 and one G70, while the positive comments come from two G70 customers. [signal:961906d1-cde9-49f1-bb56-8e4526646dd6] [signal:0d4cc6d5-e5db-496f-8faf-f6ccc9f36d57] [signal:6b16af74-5109-4ff8-8dae-7849a18a61a5] [signal:cce9873e-d1f5-4036-b88b-1c1bfcb03164]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify whether the reports of a halfway-opening or missing opening sunroof refer to the same roof configuration. [signal:961906d1-cde9-49f1-bb56-8e4526646dd6] [signal:0d4cc6d5-e5db-496f-8faf-f6ccc9f36d57]

value.title: Personal eSIM setup and connection are unreliable
value.summary: Some USA G60 and G70 owners report difficult activation, recurring setup prompts, or unreliable connections. One owner also reports problems using the eSIM across multiple cars.
highlights: Activation can be difficult, and connections may fail or require repeated setup.
Signals describe USA G60 and G70 owners; no total affected count is given.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners describe Personal eSIM activation as difficult or unclear, including needing to contact a mobile provider or open an account first. [signal:0a08c4fb-8da7-4f60-9233-fbc6a38fc6e4] [signal:26189f37-a001-447c-90ff-d6757fde286b] Other reports describe connections that repeatedly fail or drop, recurring setup prompts, and difficulty using the eSIM across multiple cars. [signal:1347d145-ddfd-40b4-a9ea-be61c25028fc] [signal:47ca4b8e-a72a-457f-bbd8-bb6a92436e36] [signal:3ce24aca-432a-4d97-81d5-310d3e9231f9]

## What customers say
One G70 owner says the connection often does not work and may drop the following day. [signal:1347d145-ddfd-40b4-a9ea-be61c25028fc] Another says the eSIM works only when their phone is physically in the vehicle and is unsure whether this relates to the driver profile. [signal:2dd7af8d-42ff-41df-894b-7947d8eea356] A G70 owner reports needing to repeat setup after using Remote Engine Start, sometimes rebooting iDrive to restore operation. [signal:47ca4b8e-a72a-457f-bbd8-bb6a92436e36] One G60 owner says the eSIM barely connects across two or more cars and is tied to one phone number. [signal:3ce24aca-432a-4d97-81d5-310d3e9231f9]

## Differences between markets
The eSIM-related signals cited here are from USA G60 and G70 owners. [signal:0a08c4fb-8da7-4f60-9233-fbc6a38fc6e4] [signal:1347d145-ddfd-40b4-a9ea-be61c25028fc] [signal:26189f37-a001-447c-90ff-d6757fde286b] [signal:2dd7af8d-42ff-41df-894b-7947d8eea356] [signal:3ce24aca-432a-4d97-81d5-310d3e9231f9] [signal:47ca4b8e-a72a-457f-bbd8-bb6a92436e36] The provided Europe signal discusses other aspects of the vehicle and does not mention Personal eSIM. [signal:e2778e1f-2a74-4289-8ce1-4945c761ed53]

## Open questions
The reports do not establish how common each activation or connection issue is, or whether the reported profile and multi-car limitations share the same cause. [signal:2dd7af8d-42ff-41df-894b-7947d8eea356] [signal:3ce24aca-432a-4d97-81d5-310d3e9231f9]

value.title: Roof leaks, looseness, damage and rattling
value.summary: Customers report roof water leaks, a roof panel coming loose and breaking, visible roof damage, and a sunroof rattle. Signals come from G60 and G70 owners in the USA and an F70 owner in Europe.
highlights: Reported roof defects range from leaks and rattling to a loose panel and visible damage.
Signals cover three USA complaints on G60 and G70, and one Europe complaint on F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report several roof-related quality problems: water entering during a carwash, a rear roof panel coming loose and breaking, a dent and scratches, and a sunroof rattle. [signal:368985d1-95b7-4d56-be0b-107858d065c8] [signal:8a3edc1a-9095-404f-a5b8-4ccff1770ef0] [signal:a56d322c-7001-4233-ab7f-939ba3506813] [signal:ccc5324d-d8c9-4b95-85fd-cdc033dab9a3]

## What customers say
A G60 owner in the USA reported water drops entering on the passenger side and back seat after a carwash. [signal:368985d1-95b7-4d56-be0b-107858d065c8]
A G70 owner in the USA described wind noise before a rear roof panel came loose and broke while the vehicle was being driven. [signal:8a3edc1a-9095-404f-a5b8-4ccff1770ef0]
Another G60 owner in the USA noticed a roof dent within the first five days of ownership and also reported scratches, including on the roof. [signal:a56d322c-7001-4233-ab7f-939ba3506813]
An F70 owner in Europe reported a sunroof rattle from the start of ownership and said the vehicle had been back to the dealer several times for it. [signal:ccc5324d-d8c9-4b95-85fd-cdc033dab9a3]

## Differences between markets
The three USA signals describe a leak, a loose and broken roof panel, and visible roof damage across G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:368985d1-95b7-4d56-be0b-107858d065c8] [signal:8a3edc1a-9095-404f-a5b8-4ccff1770ef0] [signal:a56d322c-7001-4233-ab7f-939ba3506813]
The single Europe signal describes a sunroof rattle on an F70. [signal:ccc5324d-d8c9-4b95-85fd-cdc033dab9a3]

## Open questions
How often do these different roof issues occur across markets and vehicle lines? [signal:368985d1-95b7-4d56-be0b-107858d065c8] [signal:8a3edc1a-9095-404f-a5b8-4ccff1770ef0] [signal:a56d322c-7001-4233-ab7f-939ba3506813] [signal:ccc5324d-d8c9-4b95-85fd-cdc033dab9a3]
Are the reported issues related, or do they represent separate failure modes? [signal:368985d1-95b7-4d56-be0b-107858d065c8] [signal:8a3edc1a-9095-404f-a5b8-4ccff1770ef0] [signal:a56d322c-7001-4233-ab7f-939ba3506813] [signal:ccc5324d-d8c9-4b95-85fd-cdc033dab9a3]

value.title: Traffic light and stop sign warnings are missing
value.summary: US customers want traffic-light and sign awareness, including a green-light alert and detection of stop lights and stop signs. One customer says the car may proceed through a red light if the driver is not paying attention.
highlights: Customers want green-light alerts and stop light and stop sign detection.
Signals are from US customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
A Tesla Model 3 rental is cited as a competitor example.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 customer wants an alert when a traffic light turns green, and a G70 customer says the car does not detect stop lights or stop signs by itself. [signal:8fdb3443-6f75-4052-9ac1-734fd8b5cc2f] [signal:d2b7c8d9-8864-4767-94b6-df555b215ed0]

## What customers say
The G60 customer describes a green-light ding in a 2022 Tesla Model 3 rental as a neat feature they would like in their vehicle. [signal:8fdb3443-6f75-4052-9ac1-734fd8b5cc2f]
The G70 customer says the car can stop when a vehicle ahead is already stopped, but does not independently identify stop lights or stop signs; they are concerned it could go through a red light if the driver is not paying attention. [signal:d2b7c8d9-8864-4767-94b6-df555b215ed0]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA, covering G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:8fdb3443-6f75-4052-9ac1-734fd8b5cc2f] [signal:d2b7c8d9-8864-4767-94b6-df555b215ed0]

## Open questions
Do customers want alerts for green lights, recognition of stop lights and stop signs, or both? [signal:8fdb3443-6f75-4052-9ac1-734fd8b5cc2f] [signal:d2b7c8d9-8864-4767-94b6-df555b215ed0]
How broadly is the red-light concern shared beyond this G70 customer? [signal:d2b7c8d9-8864-4767-94b6-df555b215ed0]

value.title: Personal eSIM fails to activate or remain available
value.summary: Some owners report that Personal eSIM does not work or activate reliably, preventing use of connected features such as rear-seat streaming. Reports in the supplied signals come from USA and Europe, including G70 and G60 owners.
highlights: Personal eSIM may fail to work, remain stuck setting up, or activate inconsistently.
Reports span USA and Europe; G70 and G60 appear in the supplied signals.
One owner praised the drive as better than a Mercedes S; no competitor reliability evidence is given.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners report that Personal eSIM can fail to work, remain stuck on “Setting up personal eSIM,” or refuse to activate. [signal:2c1b310f-caa7-4c61-b094-fb757ca14647] [signal:3acfd4f3-1f4b-4d6b-aa66-e893cfdaabc1] [signal:900aac4b-da2f-4cde-82ca-c879f30a8542] One G70 owner said the issue occurred on roughly 70% of vehicle starts and prevented streaming to the Theater Screen. [signal:3acfd4f3-1f4b-4d6b-aa66-e893cfdaabc1]

## What customers say
A G70 owner in the USA said they still could not get eSIM working after about three months and needed it for the Theater Screen. [signal:269cd49c-a755-4462-a14b-edcc75455347] Another USA G70 owner said they had been unable to use the feature since taking delivery and had gone through months of troubleshooting without a real fix. [signal:4c7b8880-efe4-4b3c-947c-1757d905c7b8] A further USA owner reported ongoing problems that began after a remote software update. [signal:4dd37967-5382-44db-a73d-79c6dfb2b810]

A G70 owner in Europe described the eSIM as randomly refusing to activate. [signal:900aac4b-da2f-4cde-82ca-c879f30a8542] The same account appears in two supplied signals. [signal:900aac4b-da2f-4cde-82ca-c879f30a8542] [signal:b6ca14e8-3a34-4b50-bccc-1ab1d5b8355c]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include USA reports for G70 and G60, and Europe reports for G70. [signal:269cd49c-a755-4462-a14b-edcc75455347] [signal:2c1b310f-caa7-4c61-b094-fb757ca14647] [signal:3acfd4f3-1f4b-4d6b-aa66-e893cfdaabc1] [signal:4c7b8880-efe4-4b3c-947c-1757d905c7b8] [signal:4dd37967-5382-44db-a73d-79c6dfb2b810] [signal:900aac4b-da2f-4cde-82ca-c879f30a8542] The reports describe similar activation or availability problems in both markets; the supplied signals do not establish a market-level difference. [signal:3acfd4f3-1f4b-4d6b-aa66-e893cfdaabc1] [signal:900aac4b-da2f-4cde-82ca-c879f30a8542]

## Open questions
Do activation failures share a cause across vehicles and markets, given reports of failures at startup, random activation refusals, and an issue beginning after a remote software update? [signal:3acfd4f3-1f4b-4d6b-aa66-e893cfdaabc1] [signal:900aac4b-da2f-4cde-82ca-c879f30a8542] [signal:4dd37967-5382-44db-a73d-79c6dfb2b810] How often do failures prevent use of other connected features beyond Theater Screen streaming? [signal:3acfd4f3-1f4b-4d6b-aa66-e893cfdaabc1]

value.title: Vehicle theft and concerns about security and tracking
value.summary: Customers report vehicle theft and concerns that security or tracking can be inadequate. The signals come from Europe and the USA, across F70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report theft and concerns about security and tracking.
Signals cover Europe (F70) and the USA (G60).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A Europe-based F70 customer said the vehicle was stolen within four weeks and linked a possible future purchase to improved security. [signal:adb59a70-1bda-45f3-8add-e9a6691710e5] A USA-based G60 customer reported that the vehicle was stolen and its GPS tracking was disabled within about four minutes; the customer also said tracking continued to show an incorrect location. [signal:b5ccaae5-8472-48a8-bbbc-b75a9b7b2c70]

## What customers say

value.title: Open safety recalls undermine confidence in G60 reliability
value.summary: USA G60 owners report safety concerns and uncertainty when recalls have no available remedy or clear resolution timeline. One owner also fears a fire could affect their own car after their father’s i5 caught fire.
highlights: Open safety recalls, fire concerns, and unavailable remedies undermine confidence.
All five signals are USA complaints about the G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners report that open safety recalls raise concerns about vehicle safety, especially when there is no remedy or clear timeline for resolution. [signal:07069496-fd14-4739-9961-9a593c819343] [signal:4dbe7991-f052-4f93-9db3-8b7d5736175f] [signal:bdf44cc2-39f6-4bb9-8bbd-55a8857f66e8]

## What customers say
Two signals describe a 2025 i5 with three major recalls within three months and no clear resolution timeline. [signal:07069496-fd14-4739-9961-9a593c819343] [signal:fa753669-43f1-4d72-9368-e325f487a777]

One owner reports that their father’s i5 caught fire and says this has made them fear the same could happen to their car. [signal:13059f28-95e7-456d-826b-129852264a5e]

Another owner cites a recall warning of possible stalling while driving and engine fire, with no remedy offered. [signal:4dbe7991-f052-4f93-9db3-8b7d5736175f]

A further owner says BMW’s letter described a dangerous issue but said no repair was available. [signal:bdf44cc2-39f6-4bb9-8bbd-55a8857f66e8]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are USA complaints about the G60; no other market or vehicle line appears in these signals. [signal:07069496-fd14-4739-9961-9a593c819343] [signal:13059f28-95e7-456d-826b-129852264a5e] [signal:4dbe7991-f052-4f93-9db3-8b7d5736175f] [signal:bdf44cc2-39f6-4bb9-8bbd-55a8857f66e8] [signal:fa753669-43f1-4d72-9368-e325f487a777]

## Open questions
What is the resolution timeline for the reported open recalls? [signal:07069496-fd14-4739-9961-9a593c819343] What remedy is available for the reported stalling and fire risks? [signal:4dbe7991-f052-4f93-9db3-8b7d5736175f]

value.title: Traffic light and sign warnings are inconsistent and intrusive
value.summary: USA customers report incorrect, missed, or repeated traffic light and sign warnings, alongside questions about accessing and adjusting the feature. Signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Warnings can be incorrect, inconsistent, missed, or repeatedly audible.
Six USA signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe warnings for traffic lights and signs that appear incorrectly, fail to appear consistently, or sound repeatedly near intersections. [signal:05456add-5e21-4d89-a250-d7a3354d84be] [signal:2db04dd0-4250-4c54-9fea-f8084881d912] [signal:30e65e60-f0c9-4854-9e2b-43a9d7fc6e7e] [signal:683b0079-10a2-4bfe-a27e-cb58b5f163e0] [signal:79be082c-bcb4-4e10-a3b7-270db95276e1]

One customer also asked how to add the feature to the vehicle. [signal:220506dd-3bb7-41ea-b54a-486e27bb7a31]

## What customers say
A G60 customer reported red-light and no-turn-on-red warnings despite describing a green light and a right-turn lane. [signal:05456add-5e21-4d89-a250-d7a3354d84be]

A G70 customer said the system sometimes displayed stop, red-light, or yield signs incorrectly, including at a road fork; another described stop-sign recognition as inconsistent. [signal:2db04dd0-4250-4c54-9fea-f8084881d912] [signal:683b0079-10a2-4bfe-a27e-cb58b5f163e0]

A G60 customer said a stop-sign icon appeared in the head-up display most of the time but was sometimes absent. Another reported repeated dings, especially near intersections with stop signs or traffic lights. [signal:30e65e60-f0c9-4854-9e2b-43a9d7fc6e7e] [signal:79be082c-bcb4-4e10-a3b7-270db95276e1]

Customers were told that warning timing can be adjusted; one was also told the feature could be obtained through the ConnectedDrive store in the car or app. [signal:30e65e60-f0c9-4854-9e2b-43a9d7fc6e7e] [signal:683b0079-10a2-4bfe-a27e-cb58b5f163e0] [signal:220506dd-3bb7-41ea-b54a-486e27bb7a31]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA and concern G60 or G70 vehicles. [signal:05456add-5e21-4d89-a250-d7a3354d84be] [signal:220506dd-3bb7-41ea-b54a-486e27bb7a31] [signal:2db04dd0-4250-4c54-9fea-f8084881d912] [signal:30e65e60-f0c9-4854-9e2b-43a9d7fc6e7e] [signal:683b0079-10a2-4bfe-a27e-cb58b5f163e0] [signal:79be082c-bcb4-4e10-a3b7-270db95276e1]

## Open questions
The signals describe incorrect and missed warnings, but do not establish how often these occur across vehicles or what causes the differences in recognition. [signal:05456add-5e21-4d89-a250-d7a3354d84be] [signal:2db04dd0-4250-4c54-9fea-f8084881d912] [signal:30e65e60-f0c9-4854-9e2b-43a9d7fc6e7e] [signal:683b0079-10a2-4bfe-a27e-cb58b5f163e0]

value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 driver says the technology is distracting and makes it hard to keep needed information on the main screen without switching between screens. [signal:49a13dc2-4acd-4da8-93b1-25fca6ba4ebd] A G70 driver reports daily warnings that driver-assistance support is restricted, and says the warning is worrying and the issue remains unresolved after three service visits. [signal:cf611512-5155-426e-8c58-a2ee9f1e6f97] Another G70 driver says the vehicle exceeded expectations overall but that the TV screen has fewer safety functions. [signal:82ac46aa-3374-411d-bb1e-0c0e59c0fdf0]

## What customers say
The G60 driver feels less safe because the displays seem more distracting than helpful and require too much switching. [signal:49a13dc2-4acd-4da8-93b1-25fca6ba4ebd] The G70 driver with the recurring warning says service staff checked the software and described the warning as normal, but the driver believes it may be a hardware problem. [signal:cf611512-5155-426e-8c58-a2ee9f1e6f97] The other G70 driver reports an overall positive experience alongside the complaint about fewer safety functions on the TV screen. [signal:82ac46aa-3374-411d-bb1e-0c0e59c0fdf0]

## Differences between markets
All three signals describing technology or safety-function concerns are from the USA; two concern G70 vehicles and one concerns a G60. [signal:49a13dc2-4acd-4da8-93b1-25fca6ba4ebd] [signal:82ac46aa-3374-411d-bb1e-0c0e59c0fdf0] [signal:cf611512-5155-426e-8c58-a2ee9f1e6f97] The feedback is not uniform: one driver reports an overall experience that exceeded expectations, while others describe distraction or an unresolved safety warning. [signal:49a13dc2-4acd-4da8-93b1-25fca6ba4ebd] [signal:82ac46aa-3374-411d-bb1e-0c0e59c0fdf0] [signal:cf611512-5155-426e-8c58-a2ee9f1e6f97]

## Open questions

Which safety functions does the driver find missing from the TV screen? [signal:82ac46aa-3374-411d-bb1e-0c0e59c0fdf0]
Which information do drivers need to access without switching between screens? [signal:49a13dc2-4acd-4da8-93b1-25fca6ba4ebd]

value.title: Alarm activation and controls are confusing
value.summary: Customers report unexpected alarm activation and difficulty understanding or controlling alarm-related functions. The signals come from USA G60 and G70 owners and one Europe F70 owner.
highlights: Unexpected activation and unclear alarm controls make the system difficult to use.
Signals shown: 6 from the USA and 1 from Europe, across G60, G70 and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe alarms sounding unexpectedly and uncertainty about how to prevent or stop activation. [signal:1712a80a-c24b-47ab-a5b7-098511eb720e] [signal:2834efef-a10e-4cfc-8ccb-8cdaedb07d52] [signal:6c15041b-633f-4054-aaa8-a64d45d58c34] Some also report difficulty understanding when alarm functions are available or how to switch them off quickly. [signal:7cb4fbbc-f195-448f-bb24-21a16028933e] [signal:9ce5819d-35e7-4517-adb0-8a53fe184bd2]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the alarm briefly sounds when her husband exits to retrieve something from the trunk. [signal:1712a80a-c24b-47ab-a5b7-098511eb720e] A G70 owner reports several unexpected activations after a software update and says he now presses the lock button twice to stop them. [signal:2834efef-a10e-4cfc-8ccb-8cdaedb07d52] Another G70 owner says the alarm sounded after leaving a key fob inside the vehicle and was told this behavior could not be configured. [signal:6c15041b-633f-4054-aaa8-a64d45d58c34]

A G60 owner wanted to switch off the alarm for her dog without using the physical key and received instructions for doing so through iDrive. [signal:2e91d9b7-a7d8-4f5f-bb81-73edb72a3feb] Another G60 owner was unsure how to turn off the alarm quickly and was advised to press the key-fob lock button twice within about 10 seconds. [signal:9ce5819d-35e7-4517-adb0-8a53fe184bd2] A G70 owner saw the My BMW App report that the panic button was unavailable while inside the unlocked vehicle and was told it should become available after exiting and locking the vehicle. [signal:7cb4fbbc-f195-448f-bb24-21a16028933e]

A Europe F70 owner describes an alarm triggered when getting too close to the car in front, alongside concerns about parking-sensor alerts. [signal:34989290-d27d-4af8-94bc-92bb5ca04d80]

## Differences between markets
The supplied sample contains six USA signals across G60 and G70, and one Europe signal for F70. [signal:1712a80a-c24b-47ab-a5b7-098511eb720e] [signal:2834efef-a10e-4cfc-8ccb-8cdaedb07d52] [signal:2e91d9b7-a7d8-4f5f-bb81-73edb72a3feb] [signal:6c15041b-633f-4054-aaa8-a64d45d58c34] [signal:7cb4fbbc-f195-448f-bb24-21a16028933e] [signal:9ce5819d-35e7-4517-adb0-8a53fe184bd2] [signal:34989290-d27d-4af8-94bc-92bb5ca04d80] The USA reports focus on alarm activation and control or availability, while the Europe report associates an alarm with getting close to another car and also mentions parking-sensor alerts. [signal:1712a80a-c24b-47ab-a5b7-098511eb720e] [signal:2834efef-a10e-4cfc-8ccb-8cdaedb07d52] [signal:2e91d9b7-a7d8-4f5f-bb81-73edb72a3feb] [signal:6c15041b-633f-4054-aaa8-a64d45d58c34] [signal:7cb4fbbc-f195-448f-bb24-21a16028933e] [signal:9ce5819d-35e7-4517-adb0-8a53fe184bd2] [signal:34989290-d27d-4af8-94bc-92bb5ca04d80]

## Open questions
The supplied signals do not establish why the unexpected activations occur, including the reported post-update activations or the activation after a key fob was left inside. [signal:2834efef-a10e-4cfc-8ccb-8cdaedb07d52] [signal:6c15041b-633f-4054-aaa8-a64d45d58c34] The Europe report does not clarify whether the alarm described is the vehicle anti-theft alarm or another alert. [signal:34989290-d27d-4af8-94bc-92bb5ca04d80]

value.title: Radiator grille finish, durability and appearance disappoint customers
value.summary: Customers report grille appearance and finish that do not meet their expectations, including a missing ordered or expected feature and peeling or scratching. Views differ: some dislike the grille’s look or feel, while another customer praises its styling.
highlights: Grille concerns include missing features, disappointing appearance or feel, and peeling or scratching.
Nine grille-related signals span the USA, Europe and Rest of World, across G70, G60 and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe grille issues involving a chrome finish missing from an order and an expected illuminated grille that was not present [signal:13e78ab4-ced7-47da-928e-92e1420ac161] [signal:7e59a4c6-f2a4-47e8-82a7-9e22468f4778]. Other concerns include the black plastic grille feeling insufficiently premium, dissatisfaction with the grille’s appearance, and an illuminated section peeling and scratching during washing [signal:89c25065-ad33-491c-8f12-a3ec903c6a6a] [signal:a92f2a52-4827-4098-97b9-b240b63d47d8] [signal:cc4b4bc7-fcc3-47d3-8aac-ebec618c5267].

## What customers say
A G70 owner in the USA said the car arrived without the chrome grille they had ordered [signal:13e78ab4-ced7-47da-928e-92e1420ac161]. A G70 owner in Rest of World said the promised illuminated kidney grille was absent [signal:7e59a4c6-f2a4-47e8-82a7-9e22468f4778]. A Europe-based G60 owner called the black plastic grille insufficiently premium [signal:89c25065-ad33-491c-8f12-a3ec903c6a6a], while a USA-based G60 M60 owner preferred the front grille of the i5 eDrive40 [signal:a92f2a52-4827-4098-97b9-b240b63d47d8]. A Rest of World G60 owner reported the Iconic Glow section peeling after about three months and getting scratched during washing despite a requested coating [signal:cc4b4bc7-fcc3-47d3-8aac-ebec618c5267].

Views are not uniformly negative: a USA-based G70 owner praised the front grille, and a Europe-based F70 owner preferred a fully black grille to the original chrome surround [signal:93ee45cb-826a-4999-9fca-9f3fd37f04c1] [signal:97a7c449-5133-48f7-b7f6-ad49a8eac951].

## Differences between markets
The signals include a missing ordered chrome grille in the USA, missing expected illumination in Rest of World, and concerns about grille feel in Europe [signal:13e78ab4-ced7-47da-928e-92e1420ac161] [signal:7e59a4c6-f2a4-47e8-82a7-9e22468f4778] [signal:89c25065-ad33-491c-8f12-a3ec903c6a6a]. Grille appearance preferences and durability concerns also appear in USA, Europe and Rest of World signals [signal:a92f2a52-4827-4098-97b9-b240b63d47d8] [signal:97a7c449-5133-48f7-b7f6-ad49a8eac951] [signal:cc4b4bc7-fcc3-47d3-8aac-ebec618c5267]. The signals therefore show differing preferences rather than a single shared view of grille appearance [signal:93ee45cb-826a-4999-9fca-9f3fd37f04c1] [signal:97a7c449-5133-48f7-b7f6-ad49a8eac951] [signal:a92f2a52-4827-4098-97b9-b240b63d47d8].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequently grille finish, feature availability, appearance or durability issues occur across the wider customer population [signal:13e78ab4-ced7-47da-928e-92e1420ac161] [signal:7e59a4c6-f2a4-47e8-82a7-9e22468f4778] [signal:cc4b4bc7-fcc3-47d3-8aac-ebec618c5267]. They also do not clarify whether the reported missing grille features reflect order configuration, delivery specification or another cause [signal:13e78ab4-ced7-47da-928e-92e1420ac161] [signal:7e59a4c6-f2a4-47e8-82a7-9e22468f4778].

value.title: ConnectedDrive value, access and feature expectations are unclear
value.summary: Customers report uncertainty about ConnectedDrive’s duration and cost, want some features included or accessible, and have differing preferences for map services. Signals cover Europe F70 and USA G60 and G70 customers.
highlights: Customers question feature access, renewal costs and which functions are included.
Signals cover Europe F70 and USA G60 and G70 customers.
One US customer prefers Apple Maps via CarPlay to BMW maps.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe uncertainty about ConnectedDrive: one F70 owner says some system functions were active for roughly three months and they do not recall being told this at purchase [signal:e4c3b844-cde1-4315-bd82-2ecf4cdccab8]. Another F70 owner says they do not really know what ConnectedDrive is and expect renewal to cost more [signal:6904a6b0-7ce4-440f-900b-f67852584767]. Some customers want features such as Spotify and enhanced maps included as standard rather than extra [signal:c34cb1ba-2642-43aa-a8d9-4eae8bc1d4ff].

## What customers say
A G60 customer wants emails displayed in the vehicle as text messages were, and says emails appeared directly on the touchscreen in a previous BMW [signal:3e96f3b0-81e5-43ec-8882-2b998f8f97e4]. A G60 customer also says semi-autonomous driving is absent and should be standard or available through the ConnectedDrive Store [signal:f35c1e88-d488-4dd0-a814-61bcda08df90]. A G70 customer uses CarPlay and prefers Apple Maps to BMW maps [signal:f6dce99d-2396-4ff8-b6e2-cb9873326f45].

## Differences between markets
In the Europe F70 signals, customers raise short-lived access, uncertainty about renewal and cost, and whether Spotify and enhanced maps should be included [signal:e4c3b844-cde1-4315-bd82-2ecf4cdccab8] [signal:6904a6b0-7ce4-440f-900b-f67852584767] [signal:c34cb1ba-2642-43aa-a8d9-4eae8bc1d4ff]. In the USA, G60 customers ask for in-car email display and access to semi-autonomous driving [signal:3e96f3b0-81e5-43ec-8882-2b998f8f97e4] [signal:f35c1e88-d488-4dd0-a814-61bcda08df90], while a G70 customer prefers Apple Maps through CarPlay [signal:f6dce99d-2396-4ff8-b6e2-cb9873326f45].

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify which functions were unavailable after roughly three months or what renewal covers [signal:e4c3b844-cde1-4315-bd82-2ecf4cdccab8] [signal:6904a6b0-7ce4-440f-900b-f67852584767]. They also do not establish how widespread the requests for included features, email display, or semi-autonomous driving are [signal:c34cb1ba-2642-43aa-a8d9-4eae8bc1d4ff] [signal:3e96f3b0-81e5-43ec-8882-2b998f8f97e4] [signal:f35c1e88-d488-4dd0-a814-61bcda08df90].

value.title: Rain sensor mode feels slow and difficult to adjust
value.summary: Some US G60 and G70 customers say automatic wipers do not keep up in heavy rain or are difficult to adjust. Others report not knowing how to manage the feature during hand-washing or car washes.
highlights: Wiper speed in rain sensor mode can feel too slow or difficult to adjust.
US signals cover two G60 and three G70 customer reports.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that automatic wipers can seem too slow in heavy rain, and that adjusting their speed in rain sensor mode can be difficult. [signal:619ccfbe-e479-4b0c-97ed-cb0bd314fff6] [signal:8222d389-53c3-4088-997c-2500d736a5ba] [signal:9f3888c4-fad5-4d48-bc48-9819ea8a1eb4]
One customer was unaware the vehicle had rain sensors and described a wiper blade striking his hand and detaching; another said the wipers kept running during a car wash. [signal:fd927598-fa99-47af-911c-6e9058b72038] [signal:f1915d3b-6a3a-4ec6-a613-5025d30b7ba9]

## What customers say
A G60 customer said the wipers seemed slow at maximum auto speed in heavy traffic, and acknowledged that vehicle speed influences wiper speed. [signal:619ccfbe-e479-4b0c-97ed-cb0bd314fff6]
A G70 customer said the wipers did not keep up in heavy rain and learned that speed could be adjusted using the wiper-stalk toggle while remaining in auto. [signal:8222d389-53c3-4088-997c-2500d736a5ba]
A G60 customer disliked the steps needed to adjust speed in rain sensor mode and said the setup did not feel very polite. [signal:9f3888c4-fad5-4d48-bc48-9819ea8a1eb4]
A G70 customer said the dealership showed him how to switch the feature off when hand-washing the car. [signal:fd927598-fa99-47af-911c-6e9058b72038]
Another G70 customer preferred the automatic wipers to shut off when the vehicle is in neutral because they keep running during car washes. [signal:f1915d3b-6a3a-4ec6-a613-5025d30b7ba9]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA, covering G60 and G70 vehicles; the signals provide no evidence for comparing markets. [signal:619ccfbe-e479-4b0c-97ed-cb0bd314fff6] [signal:8222d389-53c3-4088-997c-2500d736a5ba] [signal:9f3888c4-fad5-4d48-bc48-9819ea8a1eb4] [signal:fd927598-fa99-47af-911c-6e9058b72038] [signal:f1915d3b-6a3a-4ec6-a613-5025d30b7ba9]

## Open questions
How often do customers find auto wiper speed inadequate in heavy rain, and in what driving conditions? [signal:619ccfbe-e479-4b0c-97ed-cb0bd314fff6] [signal:8222d389-53c3-4088-997c-2500d736a5ba]
What steps do customers find difficult when adjusting speed in rain sensor mode? [signal:9f3888c4-fad5-4d48-bc48-9819ea8a1eb4]
How common are misunderstandings about rain sensors or wiper behavior during washing? [signal:fd927598-fa99-47af-911c-6e9058b72038] [signal:f1915d3b-6a3a-4ec6-a613-5025d30b7ba9]

value.title: ConnectedDrive availability and app syncing are unreliable
value.summary: Customers report ConnectedDrive outages, difficulty connecting with T-Mobile, and driving-status data that does not stay synced with the app. Some European F70 owners also say they were not told the service required renewal or a subscription.
highlights: Outages, connection failures, and app-sync problems undermine ConnectedDrive reliability.
Signals cover three USA G70, three Europe F70, and one Rest of World F70 complaint.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that ConnectedDrive is unavailable or unreliable: one USA owner says it was down when they needed assistance after a flat tire, and another says driving status will not stay synced with the app without resetting the car about monthly. [signal:06e0c0f1-ee2e-4c5f-9ec9-2a30b2c4eb57] [signal:a83d1923-8733-457d-86b5-317177d64d55]

Two USA G70 complaints say ConnectedDrive will not work with T-Mobile despite repeated attempts. [signal:37292dec-9ae0-49c9-bb51-fd9a32a3c4ee] [signal:7541e5a1-066b-481f-bdbe-9b2b5a6bb6a5]

Some Europe F70 owners also complain that ConnectedDrive or related digital services were switched off or due for renewal, and that subscription requirements were not explained during purchase. [signal:042b4f19-0a9b-47b2-b4ca-4f8019600f17] [signal:2c0dc481-81f2-41f8-ba1a-7e0dcf99cf60] [signal:9fd7b234-1c99-40b3-9943-a2952fcf35bf]

## What customers say
A USA owner says the ConnectedDrive outage coincided with a flat tire after a storm and affected their ability to arrange a tow. [signal:06e0c0f1-ee2e-4c5f-9ec9-2a30b2c4eb57]

Two USA owners report unsuccessful attempts to use ConnectedDrive with T-Mobile. [signal:37292dec-9ae0-49c9-bb51-fd9a32a3c4ee] [signal:7541e5a1-066b-481f-bdbe-9b2b5a6bb6a5]

A Rest of World F70 owner says driving status in the app stops syncing unless they reset the car about once a month. [signal:a83d1923-8733-457d-86b5-317177d64d55]

Europe F70 owners describe surprise at service expiry or subscription requirements, as well as dissatisfaction with earlier digital-service performance. [signal:042b4f19-0a9b-47b2-b4ca-4f8019600f17] [signal:9fd7b234-1c99-40b3-9943-a2952fcf35bf]

## Differences between markets
The USA complaints focus on an outage and T-Mobile connection failures, while Europe complaints include service expiry and subscription communication alongside a report of earlier poor performance. [signal:06e0c0f1-ee2e-4c5f-9ec9-2a30b2c4eb57] [signal:37292dec-9ae0-49c9-bb51-fd9a32a3c4ee] [signal:7541e5a1-066b-481f-bdbe-9b2b5a6bb6a5] [signal:042b4f19-0a9b-47b2-b4ca-4f8019600f17] [signal:9fd7b234-1c99-40b3-9943-a2952fcf35bf]

The single Rest of World complaint describes app-sync problems. [signal:a83d1923-8733-457d-86b5-317177d64d55]

## Open questions
What caused the reported USA outages and T-Mobile connection failures? [signal:06e0c0f1-ee2e-4c5f-9ec9-2a30b2c4eb57] [signal:37292dec-9ae0-49c9-bb51-fd9a32a3c4ee] [signal:7541e5a1-066b-481f-bdbe-9b2b5a6bb6a5]

How often does app syncing fail, and do the reported expiry and subscription experiences occur beyond the Europe F70 complaints? [signal:a83d1923-8733-457d-86b5-317177d64d55] [signal:042b4f19-0a9b-47b2-b4ca-4f8019600f17] [signal:2c0dc481-81f2-41f8-ba1a-7e0dcf99cf60] [signal:9fd7b234-1c99-40b3-9943-a2952fcf35bf]

value.title: ConnectedDrive services feel unreliable and difficult to use
value.summary: Some customers report an unreliable app, a complicated interface, and dissatisfaction with ConnectedDrive services or their duration and cost. Reports come from Europe and the USA, across F70, G60, and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report unreliable or complicated services, unclear duration, and poor value.
Signals include Europe (F70) and USA (G60, G70); several complaints concern other features.
One USA customer says BMW Connect works poorly and compares the car unfavorably with Audi.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers describe the connected app as unreliable and the technology interface as overly complicated. [signal:f1dc3544-053c-41bd-ad1a-c012d0185c47] Other customers express dissatisfaction with ConnectedDrive or question the value of its service duration and monthly cost. [signal:26d1b52f-194f-4139-a63c-8d309124533b] [signal:9f51a472-d0dd-4a9a-957e-545cfadd92e6] [signal:b3bb3376-8f43-48b0-8f33-031efccaafdf]

## What customers say
One F70 owner says the connected app sometimes does not work, the interface feels complicated, voice instructions are unreliable, and software updates seem frequent. [signal:f1dc3544-053c-41bd-ad1a-c012d0185c47] Another F70 owner says ConnectedDrive Premium lasts only three months; a separate owner questions a £9.99 monthly charge. [signal:f1dc3544-053c-41bd-ad1a-c012d0185c47] [signal:b3bb3376-8f43-48b0-8f33-031efccaafdf] A G60 owner reports that a Bluetooth-unavailable and digital-key-restricted warning appeared once and disappeared after restarting the car. [signal:a26b8304-b374-4ab0-b86d-1f284704e972] A USA customer says BMW Connect works poorly and reports remote-parking issues. [signal:afc67874-dc20-4c5a-bb43-452cb3e78555]

## Differences between markets
European F70 complaints include app reliability, interface complexity, service duration, and perceived cost. [signal:f1dc3544-053c-41bd-ad1a-c012d0185c47] [signal:26d1b52f-194f-4139-a63c-8d309124533b] [signal:9f51a472-d0dd-4a9a-957e-545cfadd92e6] [signal:b3bb3376-8f43-48b0-8f33-031efccaafdf] USA reports include a one-time Bluetooth and digital-key warning on a G60, and criticism of BMW Connect and remote parking on a G60. [signal:a26b8304-b374-4ab0-b86d-1f284704e972] [signal:afc67874-dc20-4c5a-bb43-452cb3e78555] The reports describe different issues, so they do not establish whether overall usability differs by market. [signal:f1dc3544-053c-41bd-ad1a-c012d0185c47] [signal:a26b8304-b374-4ab0-b86d-1f284704e972]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify how often the reported app failures occur or whether they share a cause. [signal:f1dc3544-053c-41bd-ad1a-c012d0185c47] They also do not establish whether the reported service-duration and pricing concerns are common beyond these individual accounts. [signal:9f51a472-d0dd-4a9a-957e-545cfadd92e6] [signal:b3bb3376-8f43-48b0-8f33-031efccaafdf]

value.title: Trunk space and opening make loading difficult
value.summary: Some USA G60 and G70 owners say the trunk lacks usable space or an opening wide enough for their needs. They report difficulty loading luggage, shopping, bulky items and a wheelchair.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners describe the trunk as too small or poorly shaped for their needs: one G60 owner says its limited depth makes taller items and a large suitcase difficult to fit, while a G70 owner says the trunk does not provide enough room for his needs. [signal:07f9ad1b-2a41-4b8a-97fa-03b59cff7099] [signal:098d9dd5-e553-41b5-ba2f-3925b30f54ac]
A G70 owner says the opening is too narrow for his daughter's wheelchair, which he has to angle and reposition to load. [signal:104b0807-691b-475e-89b3-a4b8796c9c96]
G60 owners also describe difficulty fitting shopping, work-related items and bulky or long items; one says the spare tire takes up nearly half the trunk and makes loading harder. [signal:4143eb58-cf52-4bd1-b4e7-a0a916b35ef6] [signal:416b76df-7949-4765-95aa-f5bc650d9048]

## What customers say
One G60 owner says a large suitcase would be hard to fit for longer travel. [signal:07f9ad1b-2a41-4b8a-97fa-03b59cff7099] Another says shopping and items needed for his sales work do not fit adequately. [signal:4143eb58-cf52-4bd1-b4e7-a0a916b35ef6]
A G70 owner compares wheelchair loading unfavorably with a Mercedes S 580, and a G60 owner says his Charger has a bigger trunk. [signal:104b0807-691b-475e-89b3-a4b8796c9c96] [signal:4edd4419-c1ca-4d7a-8685-158438e4cc2e]
One G70 owner says he sometimes wishes he had chosen an X7 for its extra room. [signal:098d9dd5-e553-41b5-ba2f-3925b30f54ac]

## Differences between markets
All six supplied sample signals are from the USA: four concern G60 vehicles and two concern G70 vehicles. [signal:07f9ad1b-2a41-4b8a-97fa-03b59cff7099] [signal:098d9dd5-e553-41b5-ba2f-3925b30f54ac] [signal:104b0807-691b-475e-89b3-a4b8796c9c96] [signal:4143eb58-cf52-4bd1-b4e7-a0a916b35ef6] [signal:416b76df-7949-4765-95aa-f5bc650d9048] [signal:4edd4419-c1ca-4d7a-8685-158438e4cc2e]

## Open questions
The supplied signals do not establish how often these loading difficulties occur across all 36 signals, or whether they differ by market or vehicle configuration. [signal:07f9ad1b-2a41-4b8a-97fa-03b59cff7099] [signal:098d9dd5-e553-41b5-ba2f-3925b30f54ac] [signal:104b0807-691b-475e-89b3-a4b8796c9c96] [signal:4143eb58-cf52-4bd1-b4e7-a0a916b35ef6] [signal:416b76df-7949-4765-95aa-f5bc650d9048] [signal:4edd4419-c1ca-4d7a-8685-158438e4cc2e]
