value.title: Luggage compartment fit, access and usable space vary
value.summary: Customers report specific frustrations with fitting, hooks, storage space and cargo layout, while others value concealed belongings or a useful lower compartment. Signals come from Europe’s F70 and the USA’s G60 and G70.
highlights: Complaints include a parcel shelf that slips, low bag hooks and cargo space that feels cramped.
Eight signals: Europe F70 (3); USA G60 (3) and G70 (2).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe luggage-compartment usability issues involving a parcel shelf that is difficult to refit, bag hooks that sit too low, limited depth for larger items and a layout that does not fit two golf bags side by side [signal:608f331e-c77d-4a94-819b-19dd9ba25621] [signal:e9b267d7-f88b-47d3-bc1d-fe8dc8b594ed] [signal:edf7d9f2-aba3-417d-b471-152a6733a0b3] [signal:9475f3ea-9ded-41df-9016-b6349597f697].

## What customers say
An F70 owner says the parcel shelf is slightly too narrow and slips out of place when being refitted [signal:608f331e-c77d-4a94-819b-19dd9ba25621]. Another F70 owner calls the boot bag hooks nearly useless because they sit too low [signal:e9b267d7-f88b-47d3-bc1d-fe8dc8b594ed]. A G60 owner says the trunk feels cramped and lacks depth for larger items, attributing this to the spare tire taking up space [signal:edf7d9f2-aba3-417d-b471-152a6733a0b3]. A G70 owner says two golf bags fit only when positioned diagonally [signal:9475f3ea-9ded-41df-9016-b6349597f697].

Other signals express different experiences: a G60 owner values a traditional trunk for keeping belongings out of sight, and an F70 owner finds the lower boot compartment handy for stabilizing shopping bags and wine boxes [signal:2d8789a6-3ee3-4bf6-872c-0cd7e2b50fb8] [signal:96f53bd9-3a36-435e-bf8b-4b8f7b0331b6]. A G70 customer also describes unfamiliar metallic units under the trunk mat and says they appear permanently mounted [signal:9c1a5f19-9cce-493c-acbd-47f407033bd7].

## Differences between markets
Europe signals include F70 complaints about the parcel shelf and bag hooks, alongside an F70 owner’s positive view of the lower compartment [signal:608f331e-c77d-4a94-819b-19dd9ba25621] [signal:e9b267d7-f88b-47d3-bc1d-fe8dc8b594ed] [signal:96f53bd9-3a36-435e-bf8b-4b8f7b0331b6]. USA signals include G60 feedback about limited space and a wish for a trunk-lock button, as well as appreciation for the traditional trunk’s concealed storage; G70 signals mention golf-bag fit and unfamiliar units under the mat [signal:edf7d9f2-aba3-417d-b471-152a6733a0b3] [signal:f26088cc-8e1d-47b4-9929-0adc6ebe060f] [signal:2d8789a6-3ee3-4bf6-872c-0cd7e2b50fb8] [signal:9475f3ea-9ded-41df-9016-b6349597f697] [signal:9c1a5f19-9cce-493c-acbd-47f407033bd7].

## Open questions
The G70 customer’s description does not identify the metallic units under the mat [signal:9c1a5f19-9cce-493c-acbd-47f407033bd7]. The signals do not establish how widespread the reported space, fit or access issues are beyond the individual reports provided [signal:608f331e-c77d-4a94-819b-19dd9ba25621] [signal:edf7d9f2-aba3-417d-b471-152a6733a0b3] [signal:9475f3ea-9ded-41df-9016-b6349597f697].

value.title: CarPlay connection and integration issues disrupt use
value.summary: Some BMW drivers report unreliable connections and limitations in CarPlay navigation, phone selection, and text access. Others value wireless connection, while the reported issues span USA and Europe signals.
highlights: CarPlay connection failures and integration limits interrupt navigation and restrict how drivers use the function.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 vehicles and Europe F70 vehicles.
One customer says text access is similarly limited in most car companies; no specific competitor is named.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers report that CarPlay can be temperamental or fail to connect when needed for navigation and music. [signal:15aa01f1-30da-4b02-b4c6-a861f70081e4] [signal:e25f1b5c-55a5-4527-8bbb-936e9a35fe21] Some USA drivers also report that CarPlay navigation does not appear in the head-up display. [signal:0b5bd24a-9cd9-45a0-b1ac-75bd41df2d36] [signal:112dcaf3-a919-44ca-8fd9-9656d3a3c10d]

## What customers say
One Europe customer says CarPlay failed to connect on two occasions, including before a long trip, then worked again the next day. [signal:15aa01f1-30da-4b02-b4c6-a861f70081e4] A USA G60 customer says the car often connects to the last-used phone rather than the phone associated with the active BMW profile. [signal:bc81d154-7eb3-4c09-b983-03cdefa78605] A USA G70 customer says messages are read aloud but the actual text cannot be viewed, and says this limitation is common with most car companies. [signal:4a09f3fe-dedf-4071-ab21-16559516c80d] One customer values wireless CarPlay because it avoids plugging in a cord. [signal:00d22e8e-055f-4da9-a2d9-c071e354f423]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA signals include requests for CarPlay navigation in the head-up display and concerns about which phone connects; a G70 signal also reports restricted text access. [signal:0b5bd24a-9cd9-45a0-b1ac-75bd41df2d36] [signal:112dcaf3-a919-44ca-8fd9-9656d3a3c10d] [signal:bc81d154-7eb3-4c09-b983-03cdefa78605] [signal:4a09f3fe-dedf-4071-ab21-16559516c80d] The supplied Europe F70 signals describe temperamental behavior and two connection failures. [signal:e25f1b5c-55a5-4527-8bbb-936e9a35fe21] [signal:15aa01f1-30da-4b02-b4c6-a861f70081e4]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often connection or phone-selection problems occur across drivers or vehicles. [signal:15aa01f1-30da-4b02-b4c6-a861f70081e4] [signal:e25f1b5c-55a5-4527-8bbb-936e9a35fe21] They also do not indicate whether the head-up-display limitation varies by vehicle or CarPlay navigation app. [signal:0b5bd24a-9cd9-45a0-b1ac-75bd41df2d36] [signal:112dcaf3-a919-44ca-8fd9-9656d3a3c10d]

value.title: Apple CarPlay is inconsistent and difficult to navigate
value.summary: Customers report inconsistent connection and launch behavior, slow loading, and difficulty navigating CarPlay or using its controls. Signals come from USA G70 and G60 owners and a Europe F70 owner.
highlights: CarPlay can be slow, inconsistent, or confusing to use.
Signals include USA G70 and G60 owners and a Europe F70 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that CarPlay sometimes does not work or launch consistently, takes a long time to load, and can be difficult to navigate or control from the car [signal:23364279-ac42-497e-bae0-31ea7e3ce8de] [signal:29ece082-93bd-47ff-b476-35f84397890e] [signal:1f74f72e-0799-46d3-90f9-a630b3e9256e]. One customer says CarPlay can connect a partner’s phone despite the selected phone priorities when CarPlay is active in the background [signal:0730c458-a3f5-46eb-83e8-eefadaee363c].

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer says wireless CarPlay functions often do not work; another says the vehicle sometimes launches in CarPlay and sometimes does not [signal:23364279-ac42-497e-bae0-31ea7e3ce8de] [signal:29ece082-93bd-47ff-b476-35f84397890e]. A USA G70 customer needed help finding messages in CarPlay [signal:0d527ac1-88d6-43a2-bd1f-1a42ba049c9f]. Another G60 customer says pressing the navigation button while using Waze opens BMW Navigation instead [signal:29ece082-93bd-47ff-b476-35f84397890e]. A Europe F70 customer says CarPlay takes ages to load [signal:1f74f72e-0799-46d3-90f9-a630b3e9256e].

## Differences between markets
The USA signals describe inconsistent operation, launch behavior, phone connection priority, and navigation or message access [signal:23364279-ac42-497e-bae0-31ea7e3ce8de] [signal:29ece082-93bd-47ff-b476-35f84397890e] [signal:0730c458-a3f5-46eb-83e8-eefadaee363c] [signal:0d527ac1-88d6-43a2-bd1f-1a42ba049c9f]. The Europe signal describes slow CarPlay loading in an F70 [signal:1f74f72e-0799-46d3-90f9-a630b3e9256e].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often these issues occur across the 31 signals, or whether the reported behaviors share a cause [signal:23364279-ac42-497e-bae0-31ea7e3ce8de] [signal:29ece082-93bd-47ff-b476-35f84397890e] [signal:1f74f72e-0799-46d3-90f9-a630b3e9256e].

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners report that an automatic door or its controls stopped working; another describes the doors as inconsistent. [signal:4e796903-e26f-46f8-a2c0-a3a9f7eaf4a9] [signal:4feb0a53-fb8e-422b-a3b7-670c392e0b3b]

## What customers say
One owner said the passenger-side door would not open or shut from its control panel, and reported that the dealer fixed it. [signal:4e796903-e26f-46f8-a2c0-a3a9f7eaf4a9]

Other reports describe a nonfunctioning automatic door button or door-opening control. [signal:5cf7bc01-181c-40fa-8a53-c5f84dc4c5c2] [signal:753c8ebd-517b-4e98-be24-972374c2347d]

One owner said the door failed after about 2,600 miles and that the car had remained at the service center for roughly a month while waiting for a part. [signal:711b730b-2a35-489d-8705-45e1e9aaacec]

## Differences between markets
All 6 signals in the provided sample are from the USA and concern the G70; no other market or vehicle is represented in this sample. [signal:4e796903-e26f-46f8-a2c0-a3a9f7eaf4a9] [signal:4feb0a53-fb8e-422b-a3b7-670c392e0b3b] [signal:5cf7bc01-181c-40fa-8a53-c5f84dc4c5c2] [signal:711b730b-2a35-489d-8705-45e1e9aaacec] [signal:753c8ebd-517b-4e98-be24-972374c2347d] [signal:92580a30-5d40-4751-804e-ec4e1007a59d]

## Open questions
The reports do not establish the cause of the failures or whether the separate control and door complaints share a cause. [signal:4e796903-e26f-46f8-a2c0-a3a9f7eaf4a9] [signal:5cf7bc01-181c-40fa-8a53-c5f84dc4c5c2] [signal:753c8ebd-517b-4e98-be24-972374c2347d]

Follow-up details are unavailable for one report, and another says the issue was scheduled for inspection; the outcomes are not stated. [signal:5cf7bc01-181c-40fa-8a53-c5f84dc4c5c2] [signal:753c8ebd-517b-4e98-be24-972374c2347d]

value.title: Automatic doors feel unsafe or lack easier closing
value.summary: Feedback on automatic doors is mixed: some G70 owners value their convenience, while others worry about accidental opening in gear or want easier, softer closing. Requests for soft-close or automatic closing also appear for the G60.
highlights: Concerns include accidental opening in gear and doors that are hard to shut without slamming.
Signals cover G70 owners in the USA and G60 owners in the USA and Europe.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some feedback describes the automatic door opening button as a safety concern because a door can open if it is touched while the car is in gear. [signal:c7397c2a-ad0a-4209-a4b1-2b15815aa780] Other feedback asks for soft-close or automatic closing, with one G60 owner saying the doors are hard to shut without slamming. [signal:a0638959-06cb-4781-ae6c-d9b51b4ace35] [signal:f036a858-0a80-46ba-9c6b-3002b5bb1c10]

## What customers say
Some G70 owners in the USA like the automatic doors, including the ability to close a door by pressing the brake and avoid leaning out to pull it shut. [signal:068d763c-afca-4eb8-9684-78129c23fbb4] Other G70 owners say they enjoy the doors opening on their own or simply like the feature. [signal:15d1d8bb-a492-49e7-9bf9-50ba066243a6] [signal:1d81a741-8508-48f1-817d-6f47d0fa1a7b] [signal:1e9a5e32-3e81-402d-bd18-7ef96fbff2d1] Feedback also includes a preference for manual handles over powered opening. [signal:c7397c2a-ad0a-4209-a4b1-2b15815aa780]

## Differences between markets
In the USA, G70 feedback includes both appreciation for the automatic doors and a concern about accidental opening while in gear. [signal:068d763c-afca-4eb8-9684-78129c23fbb4] [signal:15d1d8bb-a492-49e7-9bf9-50ba066243a6] [signal:1d81a741-8508-48f1-817d-6f47d0fa1a7b] [signal:1e9a5e32-3e81-402d-bd18-7ef96fbff2d1] [signal:c7397c2a-ad0a-4209-a4b1-2b15815aa780] In the USA and Europe, G60 owners ask for soft-close or automatic door closing. [signal:f036a858-0a80-46ba-9c6b-3002b5bb1c10] [signal:a0638959-06cb-4781-ae6c-d9b51b4ace35]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often doors are accidentally opened while in gear. [signal:c7397c2a-ad0a-4209-a4b1-2b15815aa780] They also do not clarify whether requests for soft-close and automatic closing describe the same unmet need. [signal:a0638959-06cb-4781-ae6c-d9b51b4ace35] [signal:f036a858-0a80-46ba-9c6b-3002b5bb1c10]

value.title: Rear headrests are uncomfortable and restrict passenger views
value.summary: Rear headrests are reported as unadjustable, uncomfortable, or obstructive to passengers’ views. Signals come from F70 owners in Europe and G70 owners in the USA.
highlights: Rear headrests are reported as hard to adjust, uncomfortable, or obstructive to passengers’ views.
Four complaint signals: one from Europe on F70 and three from the USA on G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Rear headrests are reported as unadjustable in one F70 complaint [signal:0391a3dd-4365-48e5-bbaf-6a4bb59b2a7b]. G70 passengers report discomfort and restricted views associated with the headrests [signal:37d5d6f0-2064-433d-8881-4e95c9d606b4] [signal:90c1e975-e4b4-4196-a1f0-75347c6368f8] [signal:d981b7aa-912a-4e8b-948a-de0c08367bcf].

## What customers say
An F70 owner says the headrests cannot be adjusted [signal:0391a3dd-4365-48e5-bbaf-6a4bb59b2a7b]. A G70 owner says all four headrests are uncomfortable because their neck rests in the gap between the seat and headrest [signal:37d5d6f0-2064-433d-8881-4e95c9d606b4]. Another G70 customer says built-in rear headrests limit passengers’ view of people in front, requiring them to shift sideways to look ahead [signal:90c1e975-e4b4-4196-a1f0-75347c6368f8]. A G70 customer says changing the passenger headrest position did not resolve difficulty seeing out the vehicle’s right side [signal:d981b7aa-912a-4e8b-948a-de0c08367bcf].

## Differences between markets
The Europe signal, from an F70 owner, reports that the headrests cannot be adjusted [signal:0391a3dd-4365-48e5-bbaf-6a4bb59b2a7b]. The three USA signals, all from G70 owners, report discomfort or visibility concerns [signal:37d5d6f0-2064-433d-8881-4e95c9d606b4] [signal:90c1e975-e4b4-4196-a1f0-75347c6368f8] [signal:d981b7aa-912a-4e8b-948a-de0c08367bcf].

## Open questions
Do the reported discomfort and visibility concerns apply to all rear seating positions or only particular positions? The signals describe discomfort across all four headrests in one G70, built-in rear headrests in another, and a passenger headrest in a third [signal:37d5d6f0-2064-433d-8881-4e95c9d606b4] [signal:90c1e975-e4b4-4196-a1f0-75347c6368f8] [signal:d981b7aa-912a-4e8b-948a-de0c08367bcf].

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers ask how to access Experience modes and whether they affect driving behavior, while some question their purpose beyond changing the cabin ambience. [signal:19bcc591-1e19-4277-bf75-89721d6a8fa7] [signal:7edbf27e-1986-4763-904e-9373354a8260] [signal:9d77992d-84d4-4117-b78d-3cbc23902418]

## What customers say
A G70 customer was unsure how to obtain additional Experience modes and was told they are included with the ConnectedDrive package. [signal:19bcc591-1e19-4277-bf75-89721d6a8fa7]

G60 customers asked whether modes could remain active between trips and how Expressive and Art modes differ; one was told Expressive can be set as the start mode, while Sport and Efficient must be selected for each drive. [signal:1f867034-11e5-4bfd-8424-72a094ff4090] [signal:6d7c8e20-aa49-4697-b421-7db7f40fb91d]

Customers were told Experience modes mainly change cabin ambience, not drivetrain behavior; one customer said Expressive and Digital Art looked nice but did not seem useful beyond that. [signal:a69da4dd-e733-409b-9dff-d7072f13d813] [signal:9d77992d-84d4-4117-b78d-3cbc23902418]

## Differences between markets
All supplied signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:19bcc591-1e19-4277-bf75-89721d6a8fa7] [signal:1f867034-11e5-4bfd-8424-72a094ff4090] [signal:6d7c8e20-aa49-4697-b421-7db7f40fb91d] [signal:7edbf27e-1986-4763-904e-9373354a8260] [signal:9d77992d-84d4-4117-b78d-3cbc23902418] [signal:a69da4dd-e733-409b-9dff-d7072f13d813]

## Open questions
- How many customers have difficulty accessing Experience modes or understanding their behavior?
- Do customers in other markets share these usability and value concerns?

value.title: RTTI is hard to find, verify, or justify paying for
value.summary: Some customers struggle to find, recognize, or confirm that Real Time Traffic Information is active, while others value the information it provides. A European customer also objects to paying after a trial period.
highlights: Customers report difficulty finding or confirming RTTI and dissatisfaction with trial-based pricing.
Signals include USA G60 and G70, Europe F70, and Rest of World F70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers are unsure how to access traffic information, tell whether RTTI is active, or interpret its display indicator. [signal:0b262d2f-c9cf-4a9d-a3f7-0f8055c3facf] [signal:821faac0-29d2-4f41-b0f0-777b201705a3] [signal:be9ada37-c4c3-4869-9194-388f5aeaa1b9] One G60 customer reported seeing roads but no traffic flow. [signal:47969166-acbd-43ee-8877-52c997e9f09e] A European customer found it disappointing that traffic information was available only as a trial before requiring payment. [signal:da0549bd-008c-4c02-b7ff-caf145d16c4e]

## What customers say
A USA customer was unsure how to check traffic conditions, and another needed guidance to confirm RTTI was switched on. [signal:0b262d2f-c9cf-4a9d-a3f7-0f8055c3facf] [signal:821faac0-29d2-4f41-b0f0-777b201705a3] A customer asked what the traffic-information icon meant. [signal:be9ada37-c4c3-4869-9194-388f5aeaa1b9] In contrast, two USA customers said they were pleased with the traffic information; one specifically liked details about traffic lights and school speed. [signal:24088d49-f5ef-4ecb-90a2-431c5f41904b] [signal:9023ec0e-1658-49e1-8008-fbf639058b9a] A Rest of World customer wanted traffic reports to come on automatically but was unsure whether that could be set. [signal:70c7328a-052e-48e8-90bf-c60a43cae86c]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include both difficulty accessing, viewing, or identifying RTTI and positive feedback about the information it provides. value.title: Ride comfort is too firm for some European customers
value.summary: A European F70 customer finds the ride too firm, while US G60 and Rest of World F70 customers praise the ride or BMW driving feel. A US G60 customer also reports shortcomings in lane assist and cruise control.
highlights: Ride feedback is mixed, with one European complaint about firmness and positive ride or driving-feel feedback elsewhere.
Signals cover USA G60 and Europe and Rest of World F70 customers.
A US G60 customer points to Hyundai as a tech comparison; no direct handling competitor comparison is given.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Ride and driving-feel feedback differs: a European F70 customer says the ride is too firm, while customers in the USA and Rest of World praise the ride or BMW driving feel. [signal:78bacd89-7531-4a40-af18-4ef3e62d1495] [signal:015a2afd-be36-49f6-80ef-8c5e2fbbe6c3] [signal:bef7a897-8af6-4142-9d5e-2fdd11a647e0] [signal:bf73815f-8870-4486-ba00-b1ddf698e7c9] [signal:e0ce791f-ba63-4ed7-a94f-0be6904e108e] A US G60 customer says lane assist does not keep the car centered through corners for the whole trip, and that cruise control does not correctly maintain the selected following distance. [signal:e7e27a2a-4a0b-47b1-a1bb-88101a82e698]

## What customers say
One USA G60 customer loves the quiet ride, and another says they enjoy how the car rides. [signal:015a2afd-be36-49f6-80ef-8c5e2fbbe6c3] [signal:e7e27a2a-4a0b-47b1-a1bb-88101a82e698] Rest of World F70 customers describe easy handling, a fun ride, and a typical BMW driving feel. [signal:bef7a897-8af6-4142-9d5e-2fdd11a647e0] [signal:e0ce791f-ba63-4ed7-a94f-0be6904e108e] A European F70 customer says the ride is too firm for this kind of car. [signal:78bacd89-7531-4a40-af18-4ef3e62d1495]

## Differences between markets
USA G60 signals praise ride comfort but also report lane-assist and cruise-control shortcomings. [signal:015a2afd-be36-49f6-80ef-8c5e2fbbe6c3] [signal:e7e27a2a-4a0b-47b1-a1bb-88101a82e698] The Europe F70 signal criticizes ride firmness, while Rest of World F70 signals praise handling and BMW driving feel. [signal:78bacd89-7531-4a40-af18-4ef3e62d1495] [signal:bef7a897-8af6-4142-9d5e-2fdd11a647e0] [signal:bf73815f-8870-4486-ba00-b1ddf698e7c9] [signal:e0ce791f-ba63-4ed7-a94f-0be6904e108e]

## Open questions
Do other European customers also find the F70 ride too firm? [signal:78bacd89-7531-4a40-af18-4ef3e62d1495] How consistently do USA G60 customers experience the reported lane-centering and following-distance issues? [signal:e7e27a2a-4a0b-47b1-a1bb-88101a82e698]

value.title: Handling and ride feel differ from prior BMWs

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customer feedback is mixed: some say their current BMW feels less sporty, less tight, or does not ride as well as a previous BMW, while others praise its ride and driving enjoyment. [signal:3b276a0f-2a07-4a84-b149-8c572c71ae55] [signal:79d5f706-5bdf-437a-92a5-7b0d87fbf39e] [signal:cb3a15a7-a9d3-4398-8ada-6029eae5d532] [signal:01319957-138e-4d81-85d1-569d588d8563] [signal:01459d93-193a-48cb-b8b2-230d67489bf2] [signal:023e688c-1e37-43d3-9e69-184d05690356]

## What customers say
A G60 customer compares handling unfavorably with a prior 540i and says a 2023 540 felt sportier than the 530. [signal:3b276a0f-2a07-4a84-b149-8c572c71ae55]

A G70 customer says the 2024 7 Series does not ride as well as the 2019 model and could be slightly softer. [signal:79d5f706-5bdf-437a-92a5-7b0d87fbf39e] Another describes the current car as more floaty and less tight, and less sporty than a prior 7 Series. [signal:cb3a15a7-a9d3-4398-8ada-6029eae5d532]

Positive feedback in the sample includes a G60 customer calling the ride their best BMW experience and better than Mercedes, another describing driving as enjoyable, and a G70 customer calling the ride very smooth. [signal:01319957-138e-4d81-85d1-569d588d8563] [signal:01459d93-193a-48cb-b8b2-230d67489bf2] [signal:023e688c-1e37-43d3-9e69-184d05690356]

## Differences between markets
All six supplied sample signals are from the USA, covering G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:3b276a0f-2a07-4a84-b149-8c572c71ae55] [signal:79d5f706-5bdf-437a-92a5-7b0d87fbf39e] [signal:cb3a15a7-a9d3-4398-8ada-6029eae5d532] [signal:01319957-138e-4d81-85d1-569d588d8563] [signal:01459d93-193a-48cb-b8b2-230d67489bf2] [signal:023e688c-1e37-43d3-9e69-184d05690356] The supplied sample does not show feedback from other markets.

## Open questions
Do these contrasting assessments vary by vehicle configuration or driving conditions? The supplied signals do not specify those details. [signal:3b276a0f-2a07-4a84-b149-8c572c71ae55] [signal:79d5f706-5bdf-437a-92a5-7b0d87fbf39e] [signal:01319957-138e-4d81-85d1-569d588d8563]

value.body_md:
## Problem
The available comments describe ease of driving, comfortable rides, and good handling as valued qualities, rather than identifying a specific problem [signal:101445e3-778a-4442-aafe-04c56f98d8ee] [signal:2ae11214-9ae1-47df-bcda-84987bcd2194] [signal:3ef0550e-c4a6-429d-9eb3-55fc3b550406]. One F70 driver says they wish the car had a larger engine, while also praising its smooth ride and acceleration [signal:5be01138-5395-4aff-ac70-7d7c6522d5d0].

## What customers say
F70 drivers describe the car as comfortable, simple or easy to drive, and nimble [signal:0a51262c-1cdd-4375-b063-e90f7274f007] [signal:164f7417-d51f-455a-bb2a-9a7f4939f589] [signal:30a16931-ab72-4dde-b848-8ccbb923035c]. Other F70 comments praise its handling and comfort on the road [signal:2ae11214-9ae1-47df-bcda-84987bcd2194] [signal:9cab0d45-9ad9-47b8-b616-2e294323a438]. A G60 driver in the USA also describes it as comfortable, easy to drive, and good at handling [signal:3ef0550e-c4a6-429d-9eb3-55fc3b550406].

## Differences between markets
The provided comments from Rest of World and Europe praise F70 comfort or ease of driving [signal:101445e3-778a-4442-aafe-04c56f98d8ee] [signal:30a16931-ab72-4dde-b848-8ccbb923035c]. The USA comment praises the G60's comfort, ease of driving, and handling [signal:3ef0550e-c4a6-429d-9eb3-55fc3b550406]. The available comments do not establish a difference in opinion between markets.

## Open questions
Do customers report specific handling or ride shortcomings beyond the isolated wish for a larger engine? [signal:5be01138-5395-4aff-ac70-7d7c6522d5d0]

value.title: Front-wheel drive feels unlike the brand
value.summary: Most supplied comments value the handling and ride, but one Europe F70 owner says front-wheel drive feels unlike the brand. This creates a tension between positive driving impressions and a drivetrain experience that does not match that owner’s expectations.
highlights: Handling is often praised, while one F70 owner says front-wheel drive feels unlike the brand.
Signals cover Europe F70, USA G60, and Rest of World F70 vehicles.
One owner says their F70 handles better than a Mercedes-AMG; other signals give no handling comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Handling and ride are praised in several comments, but one Europe F70 owner says the front-wheel-drive feel is unlike the brand and contributes to disappointment with the car [signal:09f2dc2f-c4c2-4dd1-b1af-0f86c0628d6f].

## What customers say
Several F70 owners in Europe praise how the car handles or drives [signal:189e58e9-ea8c-41cd-8d77-c8c0bcae4dc8] [signal:407fa0fb-e84b-450d-beca-bcc207f59995] [signal:7160fc7e-cb27-4fbd-a6e0-670cb13128ad] [signal:81043e3e-3032-4a76-ac16-0422cd56db7f]. A USA G60 owner calls the handling outstanding [signal:0a2d3b0d-bb0f-4bfe-a340-c44ff98be67d], and another praises the ride feel and highway tracking [signal:97bc89d7-1b64-4a6c-8e26-507d17246d91]. A Rest of World F70 owner also describes the handling as excellent [signal:c3f50cea-b2ea-4ba6-8e0b-a339a8bb2224].

One Europe F70 owner says the car handles better than their previous Mercedes-AMG [signal:407fa0fb-e84b-450d-beca-bcc207f59995]. This positive comparison coexists with another F70 owner's concern that front-wheel drive feels unlike the brand [signal:09f2dc2f-c4c2-4dd1-b1af-0f86c0628d6f].

## Differences between markets
The supplied Europe F70 comments include both praise for handling and the concern about front-wheel-drive feel [signal:189e58e9-ea8c-41cd-8d77-c8c0bcae4dc8] [signal:407fa0fb-e84b-450d-beca-bcc207f59995] [signal:09f2dc2f-c4c2-4dd1-b1af-0f86c0628d6f]. The supplied USA G60 comments praise handling and ride [signal:0a2d3b0d-bb0f-4bfe-a340-c44ff98be67d] [signal:41eaee51-5b9d-43e6-b2b6-71dd71c6845c] [signal:97bc89d7-1b64-4a6c-8e26-507d17246d91] [signal:9eaa6e3e-1030-4f9e-934a-25cd3411d937]. The supplied Rest of World F70 comments also include praise for handling [signal:5fe88ccc-c2b4-4df4-bd8a-555b69f8e66b] [signal:c3f50cea-b2ea-4ba6-8e0b-a339a8bb2224].

## Open questions
The supplied comments do not establish how widespread the concern about front-wheel-drive feel is beyond the owner who raised it [signal:09f2dc2f-c4c2-4dd1-b1af-0f86c0628d6f].

## Problem
The signals primarily describe valued driving characteristics rather than a handling complaint: drivers praise the comfortable ride, ease of driving and smooth acceleration. [signal:226a1c10-4e2e-47ed-b918-44c8de6e63f9] [signal:574a28e7-bbf1-49d7-8022-aec4fa05cc1d] [signal:e4c5fa19-6f0c-4d94-bcc6-c7e936e2ed23] One driver says the car feels lighter to drive, and another says it is simpler to drive than the earlier model. [signal:896d7800-3a98-4e2c-936f-7ca0a60c9bed] [signal:fa99fd04-5c62-44cb-b7b5-a862ee517a73]

## What customers say
A driver links smoother transmission operation with easier accelerator use and family comfort while riding. [signal:574a28e7-bbf1-49d7-8022-aec4fa05cc1d] Another notes smoother acceleration and easier operation. [signal:e4c5fa19-6f0c-4d94-bcc6-c7e936e2ed23] One driver says they are not yet fully used to the panel operations, but enjoy the car once driving. [signal:765e6efe-8f9f-4573-a9bc-0cdbeff8bb96] A driver also expresses puzzlement that equipment weight has increased. [signal:226a1c10-4e2e-47ed-b918-44c8de6e63f9]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the Rest of World market and concern the F70, so the signals do not show market differences. [signal:226a1c10-4e2e-47ed-b918-44c8de6e63f9] [signal:574a28e7-bbf1-49d7-8022-aec4fa05cc1d] [signal:765e6efe-8f9f-4573-a9bc-0cdbeff8bb96] [signal:896d7800-3a98-4e2c-936f-7ca0a60c9bed] [signal:e4c5fa19-6f0c-4d94-bcc6-c7e936e2ed23] [signal:fa99fd04-5c62-44cb-b7b5-a862ee517a73]

## Open questions
The signals do not explain what contributes to the reported increase in equipment weight or which panel operations the driver finds unfamiliar. [signal:226a1c10-4e2e-47ed-b918-44c8de6e63f9] [signal:765e6efe-8f9f-4573-a9bc-0cdbeff8bb96]

## Differences between markets

## Open questions
The signals do not identify a specific handling or ride shortcoming.[signal:2c408112-a50f-4ac9-9e4f-f45cbe6f7680] [signal:442dd778-e9e0-496d-972e-a00226244c3b] [signal:8cf2caba-5e8e-4f9c-855e-3b14602bba8e] [signal:d7f9a5b9-f34e-45c4-9a2e-7548008283e6]

value.summary: Many customers praise smoother, more comfortable rides and good handling, while one says the car has lost much of its playful character. A European G60 customer also says its power and driving dynamics fall short of expectations.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Most signals praise ride comfort or handling, but one customer says the car’s playful character has been substantially reduced. [signal:e107aee4-c527-40c2-ad63-c9ba97407c84] A European G60 customer also says torque, overall power and driving dynamics do not meet expectations. [signal:33f09777-3f9b-40d4-8a87-a76ef4f1b1cb]

## What customers say
Customers across the signals describe the ride as smoother or more comfortable than before. [signal:20559096-f46e-454c-8d3d-b416253167be] [signal:30cde831-b2e0-4c84-9294-8513db2ae4e1] [signal:6d18ebbe-e956-4e21-b925-b0de90fbd5c3] [signal:af392fbe-a96c-42f5-b715-43ab52bc29a4] [signal:c75a2b7b-f424-4057-b469-a2fde71387e6] Some also praise handling, road behavior or a smooth, balanced drive. [signal:33f09777-3f9b-40d4-8a87-a76ef4f1b1cb] [signal:86bbf45c-7751-46b4-84eb-0305033824fb] [signal:89d852b5-bb39-4b65-9f39-67b04aeb793f] [signal:9da1c169-1a1a-406a-8377-88a06a7a6b13] One USA G60 customer particularly praises the 19-inch wheel-and-tire setup compared with a wider, low-profile setup. [signal:89d852b5-bb39-4b65-9f39-67b04aeb793f] Another USA G60 customer says conventional non-run-flat tires improve ride and speed and reduce cabin noise. [signal:9da1c169-1a1a-406a-8377-88a06a7a6b13]

## Differences between markets
The 10 signals comprise 3 from Europe, 4 from Rest of World and 3 from the USA; they cover F70, G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:30cde831-b2e0-4c84-9294-8513db2ae4e1] [signal:33f09777-3f9b-40d4-8a87-a76ef4f1b1cb] [signal:af392fbe-a96c-42f5-b715-43ab52bc29a4] [signal:20559096-f46e-454c-8d3d-b416253167be] [signal:6d18ebbe-e956-4e21-b925-b0de90fbd5c3] [signal:c75a2b7b-f424-4057-b469-a2fde71387e6] [signal:e107aee4-c527-40c2-ad63-c9ba97407c84] [signal:86bbf45c-7751-46b4-84eb-0305033824fb] [signal:89d852b5-bb39-4b65-9f39-67b04aeb793f] [signal:9da1c169-1a1a-406a-8377-88a06a7a6b13] The European signals include both praise for smooth ride and handling and criticism of a G60’s power and driving dynamics. [signal:30cde831-b2e0-4c84-9294-8513db2ae4e1] [signal:33f09777-3f9b-40d4-8a87-a76ef4f1b1cb] [signal:af392fbe-a96c-42f5-b715-43ab52bc29a4] USA and Rest of World signals also praise ride comfort or handling, while a Rest of World customer says the car has lost much of its playful character. [signal:86bbf45c-7751-46b4-84eb-0305033824fb] [signal:89d852b5-bb39-4b65-9f39-67b04aeb793f] [signal:9da1c169-1a1a-406a-8377-88a06a7a6b13] [signal:20559096-f46e-454c-8d3d-b416253167be] [signal:6d18ebbe-e956-4e21-b925-b0de90fbd5c3] [signal:c75a2b7b-f424-4057-b469-a2fde71387e6] [signal:e107aee4-c527-40c2-ad63-c9ba97407c84]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify what aspects of the car’s playful character the customer feels have been reduced. [signal:e107aee4-c527-40c2-ad63-c9ba97407c84] They also do not explain which driving-dynamics expectations the European G60 customer feels are unmet. [signal:33f09777-3f9b-40d4-8a87-a76ef4f1b1cb]

## Problem
Most signals praise the F70's ride and handling, but one owner says it is less quiet and comfortable than their previous 3 Series. [signal:5cda18a7-31c0-4a9a-a15e-deb74f4d97ab] [signal:9b2e5f63-308d-4514-af3d-5ef867541a19] [signal:9e188431-3b3d-43d8-a108-4709207626cf] [signal:ea7aabea-cd3c-47d3-8c14-80f8db6141a5] [signal:fc30de9e-7c33-4c0b-aa54-d2d42a2d1522]

## What customers say
Owners describe the ride as smooth and comfortable, and praise the car's handling. [signal:5cda18a7-31c0-4a9a-a15e-deb74f4d97ab] [signal:9b2e5f63-308d-4514-af3d-5ef867541a19] [signal:ea7aabea-cd3c-47d3-8c14-80f8db6141a5]
One Europe owner says the suspension is improved compared with a pre-facelift 1 Series, while a Rest of World owner says the F70 feels lighter to handle than their old 1 Series. [signal:9e188431-3b3d-43d8-a108-4709207626cf] [signal:d6a00ebf-4d1c-442c-90a4-4c977c5af883]
A Rest of World owner who moved from a 3 Series says that car is quieter and rides more comfortably. [signal:fc30de9e-7c33-4c0b-aa54-d2d42a2d1522]

## Differences between markets
The four Europe signals praise the ride, suspension or driving experience. [signal:5cda18a7-31c0-4a9a-a15e-deb74f4d97ab] [signal:9b2e5f63-308d-4514-af3d-5ef867541a19] [signal:9e188431-3b3d-43d8-a108-4709207626cf] [signal:ea7aabea-cd3c-47d3-8c14-80f8db6141a5]
The two Rest of World signals differ: one praises the lighter handling compared with an old 1 Series, while the other reports less comfort and quiet than a 3 Series. [signal:d6a00ebf-4d1c-442c-90a4-4c977c5af883] [signal:fc30de9e-7c33-4c0b-aa54-d2d42a2d1522]

## Open questions

value.title: Conflicting handling feedback and throttle response delay
value.summary: F70 drivers in Europe give conflicting feedback on handling, ranging from excellent cornering to boat-like behavior, and one reports a notable throttle delay. A driver of the G60 in Rest of World praises its power delivery and comfort.
highlights: F70 handling is praised by some drivers but described as boat-like by another.
Four Europe F70 signals and one Rest of World G60 signal address handling or driving feel.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
F70 drivers in Europe disagree about handling: one praises its cornering and another calls it boat-like, regardless of drive setting. [signal:476f1649-24ba-4e8e-8baa-ef90ae1ae0c3] [signal:6c43bd16-ed41-4dea-bec6-94b6482905f0]
One F70 driver also reports a notable delay on the throttle. [signal:79ec885e-ece4-4aa1-9048-0db3c8b18eea]

## What customers say
One F70 driver describes the car as smooth and says it corners well. [signal:476f1649-24ba-4e8e-8baa-ef90ae1ae0c3]
Another says its handling feels like a boat in a storm and that it does not feel like a sport hatch. [signal:6c43bd16-ed41-4dea-bec6-94b6482905f0]
A third calls the steering and handling excellent, while noting a throttle delay. [signal:79ec885e-ece4-4aa1-9048-0db3c8b18eea]
An F70 driver says power is responsive enough for everyday driving and describes the steering as light, firming up with speed. [signal:fbde2ee8-e9bf-4f7b-8099-a74c39283c2b]

## Differences between markets
The Europe signals about the F70 include both positive handling feedback and a strongly negative assessment. [signal:476f1649-24ba-4e8e-8baa-ef90ae1ae0c3] [signal:6c43bd16-ed41-4dea-bec6-94b6482905f0] [signal:79ec885e-ece4-4aa1-9048-0db3c8b18eea]
The Rest of World G60 driver says power delivery is impressive, particularly in Sport mode, and describes the car as comfortable to drive. [signal:9a2916c8-abc4-4be0-8062-2e313bb9f7fa]

## Open questions
How common is the reported throttle delay among F70 drivers? [signal:79ec885e-ece4-4aa1-9048-0db3c8b18eea]
What accounts for the difference between the F70 drivers who praise its handling and the driver who describes it as boat-like? [signal:476f1649-24ba-4e8e-8baa-ef90ae1ae0c3] [signal:6c43bd16-ed41-4dea-bec6-94b6482905f0]

value.title: Firm ride and less involving driving feel in some F70s
value.summary: Some F70 customers report a ride that is too firm, slower downshifts, or less involving driving feel. Other customers praise comfort, handling and ride quality, so experiences differ across vehicles and markets.
highlights: Some F70 drivers find the ride too firm or the driving feel less involving.
Four of seven signals concern F70s; reports span Europe and Rest of World.
One USA customer compares suspension with the Audi Q8 e-tron.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 customers describe the ride as too firm for normal comfort driving, or the driving operation and ride comfort as low in sensitivity. One also says the car feels less involving than a G42 230i. [signal:14513169-d121-4d2f-a51f-c04040933d2f] [signal:f000db50-5576-468a-aa23-8a8c943e76e0] [signal:998609ac-1698-4df4-b1d7-3ff3e3b0d1d9]

A separate F70 complaint is that gear changes feel slow when downshifting, despite being rapid under acceleration. [signal:14513169-d121-4d2f-a51f-c04040933d2f]

## What customers say
F70 feedback is mixed: one customer describes a firm ride, while another says the car is comfortable and has strong handling. [signal:000dc5a3-69bb-443c-9d22-35eebf537d59] [signal:998609ac-1698-4df4-b1d7-3ff3e3b0d1d9]

A USA customer praises the G60’s comfort, responsive handling and suspension, but says they would prefer air suspension like the Audi Q8 e-tron or BMW i7. [signal:00c86e1f-794c-450d-a0e0-0075a99604e8]

A USA G70 customer praises ride comfort and steering feel, and a Rest of World G70 customer describes ride comfort as excellent. [signal:80a57d5d-5299-4a53-9b66-c55e0241dd1a] [signal:b5416902-40bb-4c7f-8b21-c814bf43e8cf]

## Differences between markets
In the Europe signals, F70 feedback includes a firm ride and slow downshifts, alongside praise for comfort and strong handling. [signal:000dc5a3-69bb-443c-9d22-35eebf537d59] [signal:14513169-d121-4d2f-a51f-c04040933d2f] [signal:998609ac-1698-4df4-b1d7-3ff3e3b0d1d9]

The Rest of World F70 customer reports low sensitivity in driving operation and ride comfort, while the Rest of World G70 customer praises ride comfort. [signal:f000db50-5576-468a-aa23-8a8c943e76e0] [signal:b5416902-40bb-4c7f-8b21-c814bf43e8cf]

USA feedback is positive about G70 ride comfort and G60 suspension, though the G60 customer would prefer air suspension. [signal:80a57d5d-5299-4a53-9b66-c55e0241dd1a] [signal:00c86e1f-794c-450d-a0e0-0075a99604e8]

## Open questions
How often do F70 customers experience the ride as too firm, and how does this vary by driving conditions? [signal:14513169-d121-4d2f-a51f-c04040933d2f]

What aspects of driving operation and ride comfort do customers mean by “low in sensitivity”? [signal:f000db50-5576-468a-aa23-8a8c943e76e0]

Another G70 customer praised its ride compared with their Bentleys [signal:182ed029-bb07-41cd-96b0-b506900ee167].

## What customers say
The G70 complaint compares the ride unfavorably with a Mercedes but gives no additional details [signal:c51c99ea-0f6b-4944-bfb0-ca4e21d6ebc6]. The G60 customer said their Genesis was around a thousand pounds heavier and built more as a chauffeur car [signal:10409937-5270-4b4f-988a-cdd7166229f0]. In contrast, a G70 customer said the vehicle rode and drove far better than their Bentleys, and praised its limousine-like luxury and sporty character in Sport mode [signal:182ed029-bb07-41cd-96b0-b506900ee167].

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA: two concern the G70 and one concerns the G60 [signal:c51c99ea-0f6b-4944-bfb0-ca4e21d6ebc6] [signal:10409937-5270-4b4f-988a-cdd7166229f0] [signal:182ed029-bb07-41cd-96b0-b506900ee167]. The signals include both criticism and praise of the ride [signal:c51c99ea-0f6b-4944-bfb0-ca4e21d6ebc6] [signal:182ed029-bb07-41cd-96b0-b506900ee167].

## Open questions
The G70 complaint does not provide further detail about what made the ride less subtle than the Mercedes [signal:c51c99ea-0f6b-4944-bfb0-ca4e21d6ebc6]. The signals do not specify which aspects of the G60 ride differed from the customer's Genesis [signal:10409937-5270-4b4f-988a-cdd7166229f0].

value.title: Conflicting views on F70 maneuverability
value.summary: F70 feedback from Rest of World is split: one customer says the growing minimum turning radius makes the car harder to recommend, while another finds it easy to maneuver in tight parking spaces.
highlights: One customer finds the minimum turning radius increasingly problematic; another praises easy maneuvering.
Two Rest of World F70 signals: one complaint and one positive assessment.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Feedback differs on F70 maneuverability: one customer says its minimum turning radius keeps getting larger, while another describes it as easy to maneuver in tight parking spaces. [signal:58b4749e-3439-46c9-af9b-570d47d62cdf] [signal:17d5a0ef-e985-4a38-bc2f-a3e6eb889edc]

## What customers say
The customer raising a concern says the increasing turning radius is a drawback for a car marketed as compact and cites Japan's road situation. [signal:58b4749e-3439-46c9-af9b-570d47d62cdf] Another says the car is compact, easy to maneuver in tight parking spaces, and easy to drive overall. [signal:17d5a0ef-e985-4a38-bc2f-a3e6eb889edc]

The complaint also mentions less satisfying sound compared with an early M135i and concern about expanding subscription functions. [signal:58b4749e-3439-46c9-af9b-570d47d62cdf]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Rest of World and concern the F70; one is a complaint and the other is positive. [signal:58b4749e-3439-46c9-af9b-570d47d62cdf] [signal:17d5a0ef-e985-4a38-bc2f-a3e6eb889edc]

## Open questions
What explains the differing assessments of maneuverability is not specified in these signals. [signal:58b4749e-3439-46c9-af9b-570d47d62cdf] [signal:17d5a0ef-e985-4a38-bc2f-a3e6eb889edc]

value.title: Ride comfort varies, with hard suspension and tires reported
value.summary: Some F70 and G70 drivers report a ride that is too harsh or stiff for passenger comfort, while other drivers describe the ride positively. The signals span the Rest of World, USA, and Europe.
highlights: Some drivers find the suspension or tire setup too harsh for comfortable riding.
Reports include F70 drivers in the Rest of World and Europe, and G70 drivers in the USA.
A Europe-based F70 driver says the ride is a big change from a harder-riding Ford Focus RS.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say the ride is too harsh or the suspension too stiff, making journeys uncomfortable for passengers or causing back pain. [signal:2d4defea-96db-4104-a93f-a66264308425] [signal:484bc273-1d5a-4dbe-be48-8764b4f22cb8] [signal:609f09e8-2bef-479c-b09d-50102c53750d]

A USA-based G70 driver says the supplied Pirelli high-performance tires made the ride too harsh for a luxury sedan, and reports better comfort after changing to Bridgestone Turanza 6 tires. [signal:212b3cde-a4c3-4c25-ab03-cd1ad3f3ea0f]

## What customers say
An F70 driver in the Rest of World says the hard suspension makes things tough for passengers, while another reports that rough-road impacts—especially at the rear—cause back pain. [signal:2d4defea-96db-4104-a93f-a66264308425] [signal:609f09e8-2bef-479c-b09d-50102c53750d]

Not all feedback is negative: one Rest of World F70 driver enjoys fast driving and mountain passes despite finding the suspension hard. [signal:2d4defea-96db-4104-a93f-a66264308425] Another says the ride and drive are good, and a USA G70 driver praises ride comfort, steering feel, and braking. [signal:5ea391e1-0ad3-4da6-a541-d9f78c2960c3] [signal:36a0b7ff-c6f7-43f3-865d-66196f4cbb40]

A Europe-based F70 driver says the ride is a big change after a Ford Focus RS with a very hard ride. [signal:4526fb3e-bd11-4fe8-9152-89977e2e7152]

## Differences between markets
In the available signals, harsh-ride concerns come from F70 drivers in the Rest of World and a G70 driver in the USA. [signal:2d4defea-96db-4104-a93f-a66264308425] [signal:484bc273-1d5a-4dbe-be48-8764b4f22cb8] [signal:609f09e8-2bef-479c-b09d-50102c53750d] [signal:212b3cde-a4c3-4c25-ab03-cd1ad3f3ea0f]

The Europe-based F70 driver describes a positive change from a harder-riding previous car, while some Rest of World F70 drivers report discomfort. [signal:4526fb3e-bd11-4fe8-9152-89977e2e7152] [signal:2d4defea-96db-4104-a93f-a66264308425] [signal:609f09e8-2bef-479c-b09d-50102c53750d]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the ride-comfort concern is across markets or vehicle configurations. [signal:2d4defea-96db-4104-a93f-a66264308425] [signal:212b3cde-a4c3-4c25-ab03-cd1ad3f3ea0f]

The signals do not clarify whether the reported harshness is primarily associated with tire choice, suspension tuning, road conditions, or a combination of these factors. [signal:212b3cde-a4c3-4c25-ab03-cd1ad3f3ea0f] [signal:609f09e8-2bef-479c-b09d-50102c53750d]

value.title: Harsh ride and limited steering feel

Signals cover the G60 in Rest of World and the F70 in Europe.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Feedback combines praise for a comfortable but sporty ride with a wish for more steering feel, while another comment describes the ride as harsh. [signal:235f2cac-ad0c-4681-8a94-2c0962d8a72f] [signal:8463d3ef-af3a-409d-bde1-776a2b7e5fac]

## What customers say

A Europe comment about the F70 describes it as nice to drive, although the ride feels somewhat harsh. [signal:8463d3ef-af3a-409d-bde1-776a2b7e5fac]

## Differences between markets
The Rest of World G60 comment focuses on steering feel while praising ride comfort; the Europe F70 comment focuses on ride harshness while praising the driving experience. [signal:235f2cac-ad0c-4681-8a94-2c0962d8a72f] [signal:8463d3ef-af3a-409d-bde1-776a2b7e5fac]

## Open questions
Do steering-feel concerns occur beyond the G60 comment from Rest of World? [signal:235f2cac-ad0c-4681-8a94-2c0962d8a72f]
Is the harsh-ride feedback limited to the F70 comment from Europe? [signal:8463d3ef-af3a-409d-bde1-776a2b7e5fac]

value.body_md:
## Problem
No handling or usability problem is reported in these signals; drivers describe the F70 positively for stability, operation and confidence. [signal:458de753-f560-4387-92e4-122aeb46e113] [signal:6385d7c4-bcf1-4aa9-ade5-d62b1d03684c] [signal:f819df54-c8bf-4336-b9b4-e0fc6f2b6615]

## What customers say

Another says the F70's driving feel comes out on top compared with the 3 Series. [signal:6385d7c4-bcf1-4aa9-ade5-d62b1d03684c]
A driver who previously considered Volkswagen the segment leader says the F70 feels almost like a four-wheel-drive car and inspires confidence. [signal:f819df54-c8bf-4336-b9b4-e0fc6f2b6615]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from Rest of World and concern the F70; there are no signals from other markets to compare. [signal:458de753-f560-4387-92e4-122aeb46e113] [signal:6385d7c4-bcf1-4aa9-ade5-d62b1d03684c] [signal:f819df54-c8bf-4336-b9b4-e0fc6f2b6615]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how representative these positive handling impressions are among F70 drivers. [signal:458de753-f560-4387-92e4-122aeb46e113] [signal:6385d7c4-bcf1-4aa9-ade5-d62b1d03684c] [signal:f819df54-c8bf-4336-b9b4-e0fc6f2b6615]

value.title: Handling and ride feel vary across vehicles and driving conditions
value.summary: Some drivers report excess body roll, reduced stability, or poor traction, while others value smooth, easy handling. Feedback spans several vehicle lines and markets.
highlights: Reports include body roll, reduced highway stability, and poor winter traction.
In the sample: six USA complaints across G60 and G70; positive handling feedback in Europe and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe handling and ride concerns including cornering roll, less stable highway behavior than an earlier 5 Series, and poor traction on packed snow. [signal:0c017c6b-b622-42d8-8f30-05807be0761b] [signal:7f9fda6d-8138-4313-924c-6d5f0113571e] [signal:93b64baa-5568-4903-8f45-847f2cd65a87] [signal:3497662d-834d-457c-b41b-272e06875310]

## What customers say
A G60 driver says the car feels bigger and heavier than their previous 540, leans in turns, and corners less smoothly, but performs significantly better in Sport mode. [signal:0c017c6b-b622-42d8-8f30-05807be0761b] Other G60 drivers compare the ride unfavorably with a former 4 Series or report a lighter highway feel than in an older BMW. [signal:18da8270-237c-448f-a1a6-a326ceff0715] [signal:79ebcc7b-e9ff-40ff-a8c4-c469830d3675]

A G70 driver reports poor winter traction despite fitting winter tires, including near loss of control and difficulty stopping on packed snow. [signal:3497662d-834d-457c-b41b-272e06875310] A separate G70 comment also describes too much cornering roll. [signal:7f9fda6d-8138-4313-924c-6d5f0113571e]

Other drivers value the experience: F70 owners describe smooth handling, easy control, and enjoyable performance, while a G60 owner praises its handling. [signal:1210c3a9-cb35-4e06-a012-12cce0ca14be] [signal:2c2421ba-67d6-4cac-84ce-2bd0876fb230] [signal:2e19eefa-cdbc-4eaa-b7d2-82dd552ef5ae] [signal:3a009e08-5bbc-481a-a7a6-587a5f08b0ba] [signal:51bd9cb1-4c2d-4355-a188-32085644acb3]

## Differences between markets
The sample includes USA complaints about G60 ride or highway feel and G70 roll or winter traction. [signal:0c017c6b-b622-42d8-8f30-05807be0761b] [signal:18da8270-237c-448f-a1a6-a326ceff0715] [signal:79ebcc7b-e9ff-40ff-a8c4-c469830d3675] [signal:93b64baa-5568-4903-8f45-847f2cd65a87] [signal:3497662d-834d-457c-b41b-272e06875310] [signal:7f9fda6d-8138-4313-924c-6d5f0113571e] In Europe, one G60 driver praises smooth road behavior but criticizes the turning circle, while an F70 driver praises smooth handling. [signal:841ca63c-59bb-4b00-ab64-c455ff4aa019] [signal:1210c3a9-cb35-4e06-a012-12cce0ca14be] Rest of World F70 comments praise easy handling and performance, and a G60 comment praises handling. [signal:2c2421ba-67d6-4cac-84ce-2bd0876fb230] [signal:2e19eefa-cdbc-4eaa-b7d2-82dd552ef5ae] [signal:3a009e08-5bbc-481a-a7a6-587a5f08b0ba] [signal:51bd9cb1-4c2d-4355-a188-32085644acb3]

## Open questions
Do the reported ride and stability concerns vary by prior vehicle, driving mode, or road conditions? [signal:0c017c6b-b622-42d8-8f30-05807be0761b] [signal:93b64baa-5568-4903-8f45-847f2cd65a87] What factors contribute to the G70 winter traction reports? [signal:3497662d-834d-457c-b41b-272e06875310]

[signal:7fb5d404-2e53-407f-9b08-c4d3b61956dc]

[signal:57870ee2-176a-4410-9456-09d0e306fc58] The two USA signals cover a G70, with positive ride feedback and noise complaints, and a G60, with positive handling feedback and concerns about distracting technology and radio usability. [signal:ab09cb4e-01e3-4c4d-89b2-f3f8fb372a27] [signal:7fb5d404-2e53-407f-9b08-c4d3b61956dc]

value.title: Self-leveling suspension controls and behavior are unclear to some owners
value.summary: Some G70 owners in the USA are unsure what the suspension control does or find the lift sequence unexpected, while another finds it simple to use. In Europe, a G60 owner wants the car to feel more compliant over bumps and wonders about air suspension.
highlights: Some owners are unsure about the control or find the lift sequence unexpected.
Signals include USA G70 owners and a Europe G60 owner.
A USA G60 owner cites air suspension as a luxury omission compared with Mercedes.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some USA G70 owners ask what the suspension control does or how to raise the car; one says the lift sequence behaves differently from what he expects and worries the initial front-end drop could cause damage on a steep driveway. [signal:5b335ae5-7f97-449e-b564-f301fa49efa1] [signal:912e6509-192a-4213-801d-f4aaa5a46d35] Another owner asked whether the front could be raised to avoid obstacles. [signal:e4174800-c599-435e-a72e-655789e762b9]

## What customers say
One G70 owner appreciated learning that the center-console control raises and lowers ground clearance. [signal:5b335ae5-7f97-449e-b564-f301fa49efa1] Another said lifting and lowering the vehicle is simple. [signal:0baa2d42-8d35-4dfe-bb0b-db1551b32ab9] A different G70 owner described the lift sequence as strange and worried about potential front-end damage when approaching a steep driveway. [signal:912e6509-192a-4213-801d-f4aaa5a46d35]

A Europe G60 owner said the car does not float enough over bumpy roads and wondered whether air suspension could have been available. [signal:090c1139-a1a3-4b34-8938-774fa5329ae8] A USA G60 owner described air suspension as one of several luxury omissions compared with Mercedes. [signal:df0685ab-afdb-4334-96a9-711b946a74aa]

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA G70 signals include questions about the control and lift behavior, as well as one positive comment about ease of use. [signal:5b335ae5-7f97-449e-b564-f301fa49efa1] [signal:912e6509-192a-4213-801d-f4aaa5a46d35] [signal:e4174800-c599-435e-a72e-655789e762b9] [signal:0baa2d42-8d35-4dfe-bb0b-db1551b32ab9] The Europe G60 signal expresses a wish for more floating comfort and asks about air suspension. [signal:090c1139-a1a3-4b34-8938-774fa5329ae8]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common the control or lift-sequence concerns are, or whether the reported front-end drop occurs in other use cases. [signal:5b335ae5-7f97-449e-b564-f301fa49efa1] [signal:912e6509-192a-4213-801d-f4aaa5a46d35] They also do not show whether the Europe G60 owner's ride-comfort concern is shared by other owners. [signal:090c1139-a1a3-4b34-8938-774fa5329ae8]

## Problem
Customers describe difficulty adjusting the interior rearview mirror, including limited hand clearance and a stiff feel. [signal:95541239-b4d1-43ae-8451-79d1f0df197e] Another customer says headlights can cause glare through a gap in the dimming mirror's border. [signal:83249507-9d7a-4b24-8ec4-ec72f8783cb7]

Some customers are unsure how to adjust the mirror manually; one customer sought clarification after mistaking the buttons beneath it for adjustment controls. [signal:62bbb4bc-9417-4ded-a82d-e5db936f7b77] [signal:a89e37e1-0d9b-4252-9c46-b4de0c1e6f40] Customers in the USA describe limited space above the mirror, while one also says it feels stiff to move. [signal:be7bfbac-9ff9-4508-854f-96fecc3948d3]

[signal:2f35a836-0055-47c3-bcea-34b30c259448] [signal:62bbb4bc-9417-4ded-a82d-e5db936f7b77] [signal:83249507-9d7a-4b24-8ec4-ec72f8783cb7] [signal:95541239-b4d1-43ae-8451-79d1f0df197e] [signal:a89e37e1-0d9b-4252-9c46-b4de0c1e6f40] One signal is from Europe and concerns the F70. [signal:2f35a836-0055-47c3-bcea-34b30c259448] [signal:62bbb4bc-9417-4ded-a82d-e5db936f7b77] [signal:83249507-9d7a-4b24-8ec4-ec72f8783cb7] [signal:95541239-b4d1-43ae-8451-79d1f0df197e] [signal:a89e37e1-0d9b-4252-9c46-b4de0c1e6f40] [signal:be7bfbac-9ff9-4508-854f-96fecc3948d3]

Drivers describe feeling safe or secure in their vehicles, with some specifically valuing sensors, cameras, warning lights, or safety-focused facilities [signal:07c1da7d-c1c1-4071-a0d1-9168fa3f05f4] [signal:3723f1aa-266b-4da4-a14c-4885ffe3f9bc] [signal:44bbf474-a095-408b-b9b0-508b7f75a0fc] [signal:74b1b6b0-3784-4b0e-8811-13f8df419175]. One USA driver says using the screen takes their eyes off the road, although safety matters most to them [signal:209540e3-95d4-41ec-a235-438edf5570af].

## What customers say
Europe F70 drivers say sensors and a rear camera make driving feel safe, and one appreciates using voice controls without distraction [signal:3723f1aa-266b-4da4-a14c-4885ffe3f9bc]. Other Europe F70 drivers describe the car as safe or stable and value safety-focused facilities and warning lights in the wing mirrors [signal:44bbf474-a095-408b-b9b0-508b7f75a0fc] [signal:5ada2600-f82e-4cc1-bbcb-3168fc3308b6] [signal:74b1b6b0-3784-4b0e-8811-13f8df419175] [signal:89511484-b2de-4597-b703-5bb1c06274a6]. Drivers in Rest of World describe feeling secure or secure behind the wheel [signal:416997c5-e6ef-4857-ae61-3f60873116c1] [signal:a013e9fd-f3fe-4b2e-b0b9-acd24c818f58]. The USA G60 driver values safety but finds screen interaction distracting [signal:209540e3-95d4-41ec-a235-438edf5570af].

## Differences between markets
The provided Europe signals are positive about feeling safe and about safety-related features [signal:07c1da7d-c1c1-4071-a0d1-9168fa3f05f4] [signal:3723f1aa-266b-4da4-a14c-4885ffe3f9bc] [signal:44bbf474-a095-408b-b9b0-508b7f75a0fc] [signal:5ada2600-f82e-4cc1-bbcb-3168fc3308b6] [signal:74b1b6b0-3784-4b0e-8811-13f8df419175] [signal:89511484-b2de-4597-b703-5bb1c06274a6]. The provided Rest of World signals describe feeling secure [signal:416997c5-e6ef-4857-ae61-3f60873116c1] [signal:a013e9fd-f3fe-4b2e-b0b9-acd24c818f58]. The USA signal values safety while also describing distraction from the screen [signal:209540e3-95d4-41ec-a235-438edf5570af].

## Open questions
Do other drivers share the USA G60 driver's concern that screen interaction can distract from the road? [signal:209540e3-95d4-41ec-a235-438edf5570af]

value.title: Drivers value the vehicle’s reassuring sense of safety
value.summary: Customers in the USA and Rest of World describe feeling safe or secure in their vehicles. Some connect that feeling to safety features or vehicle size; one customer praised the vehicle after it was totaled.
highlights: Customers value the reassuring sense of safety, though the signals do not describe a recurring safety problem.
Supplied sample: USA (6), Rest of World (2); G70 (4), G60 (2), F70 (2).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The supplied signals describe a valued impression of safety rather than a reported problem: customers say they feel safe or secure in their vehicles [signal:1a1ab5f0-7929-4615-9f39-f21f3a0ed766] [signal:4180c6eb-1973-492e-9b6f-4dcc04b8b583] [signal:4cfa5d29-0d45-4eb6-a9a2-621d56299d82].

## What customers say
Some USA customers associate feeling secure with the vehicle’s safety features [signal:215e1c0a-e19e-463d-b438-98d9f5ed3474] [signal:429aa70b-18b9-4690-b4ed-23b15058edc7], while another attributes it to the vehicle’s larger size [signal:26c6b89e-d66f-49bd-aff3-615c499d6852]. One G70 customer said the vehicle was totaled about three weeks after pickup and credited it with keeping everyone safe [signal:7d00e856-9d5f-453d-8b9a-495a4ee5a492]. A Rest of World F70 customer also described it as outstanding for safety [signal:b09757dc-1a01-4c86-ac80-2ddb6d5f47d7].

## Differences between markets
The supplied sample includes positive safety impressions in both the USA and Rest of World [signal:1a1ab5f0-7929-4615-9f39-f21f3a0ed766] [signal:4cfa5d29-0d45-4eb6-a9a2-621d56299d82]. The sample has six USA signals across G70 and G60, and two Rest of World signals for F70 [signal:1a1ab5f0-7929-4615-9f39-f21f3a0ed766] [signal:215e1c0a-e19e-463d-b438-98d9f5ed3474] [signal:26c6b89e-d66f-49bd-aff3-615c499d6852] [signal:4180c6eb-1973-492e-9b6f-4dcc04b8b583] [signal:429aa70b-18b9-4690-b4ed-23b15058edc7] [signal:7d00e856-9d5f-453d-8b9a-495a4ee5a492] [signal:4cfa5d29-0d45-4eb6-a9a2-621d56299d82] [signal:b09757dc-1a01-4c86-ac80-2ddb6d5f47d7].

## Open questions
The supplied excerpts do not show how widespread this perception is or consistently identify what creates it; customers mention safety features and vehicle size in some cases [signal:215e1c0a-e19e-463d-b438-98d9f5ed3474] [signal:26c6b89e-d66f-49bd-aff3-615c499d6852].

value.body_md:
## Problem
Two US complaints describe defects in front heating and cooling controls or vents: poor heat output in a G70 and an air conditioner without power in a G60. [signal:56b40ba1-43e2-4d6e-8e3b-74bdae405ec9] [signal:ecfeef54-4b18-45d3-8ead-44594dbce4b5]

The G60 owner said the AC had no power because its power fuse was not connected, and they noticed this minutes after leaving the dealership. [signal:ecfeef54-4b18-45d3-8ead-44594dbce4b5]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA; they describe different faults in a G70 and a G60. [signal:56b40ba1-43e2-4d6e-8e3b-74bdae405ec9] [signal:ecfeef54-4b18-45d3-8ead-44594dbce4b5]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common either fault is beyond these two reports. [signal:56b40ba1-43e2-4d6e-8e3b-74bdae405ec9] [signal:ecfeef54-4b18-45d3-8ead-44594dbce4b5]

value.title: Engine sound feels artificial and is hard to find or customize
value.summary: Some USA customers find the G60’s Iconic Sound unlike a real engine and miss their previous vehicle’s sound, while others have difficulty finding sound settings. A G70 customer asked whether a sound plays in Sport Mode.
highlights: G60 sound is described as artificial, and sound settings are hard to find.
Signals are from USA customers in G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 customer described Iconic Sound as terrible and unlike engine noise, and said they missed the sound of their prior M550i [signal:28c90cd9-21fc-4b63-90f2-b2396346b782]. Another G60 customer could not find how to adjust the engine sound, although they had adjusted it in their previous vehicle [signal:668aa7e0-f1e7-40f5-9cb7-c02fa368316c].

## What customers say
One customer asked whether a sound plays while driving in Sport Mode; the writer explained that Iconic Sound imitates combustion-engine noise and becomes more pronounced in Sport Mode [signal:a4e4b8f3-da7c-4a4c-9702-513465619cc0]. A separate G60 customer mentioned difficulty customizing things generally, without specifying engine sound [signal:a230afd2-0bcd-428d-bb9a-422214c5227a].

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets [signal:28c90cd9-21fc-4b63-90f2-b2396346b782] [signal:668aa7e0-f1e7-40f5-9cb7-c02fa368316c] [signal:a230afd2-0bcd-428d-bb9a-422214c5227a] [signal:a4e4b8f3-da7c-4a4c-9702-513465619cc0].

## Open questions
Do other G60 customers also find Iconic Sound unlike a real engine, or have difficulty locating its settings? [signal:28c90cd9-21fc-4b63-90f2-b2396346b782] [signal:668aa7e0-f1e7-40f5-9cb7-c02fa368316c]

value.title: Engine sound is muted or intermittently reports a malfunction
value.summary: Customers report an intermittent external acoustic malfunction on a G60, while some F70 and G70 drivers find the exhaust sound too muted. The signals cover USA and Europe.
highlights: Reports range from an intermittent acoustic malfunction to exhaust sound customers find too weak.
Three signals mention sound concerns: USA G60 and G70, plus Europe F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 owner reports an intermittent “external acoustic malfunction” message at startup. [signal:836e5744-044d-4f5b-b042-aafb9bc7acae] Drivers of an F70 and a G70 say the exhaust sound is too muted or weak. [signal:a6383c2c-a4ab-480d-87a8-fd85644bba7e] [signal:ba9c7bfc-79ef-4927-87a3-361b78302202]

## What customers say
The G60 owner says the malfunction appears every now and then and describes the issue as a known bug, but says the dealer has not been helpful about addressing it. [signal:836e5744-044d-4f5b-b042-aafb9bc7acae] The F70 owner wants sport mode to let the exhaust sound more pronounced and notes that EU rules may play a part in the muted sound. [signal:a6383c2c-a4ab-480d-87a8-fd85644bba7e] The G70 owner criticizes the weak exhaust sound with the M Sport package and compares it unfavorably with the exhausts on their M850 and their wife's X7 with M package. [signal:ba9c7bfc-79ef-4927-87a3-361b78302202]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include an intermittent acoustic malfunction complaint for the G60 and a weak exhaust sound complaint for the G70. [signal:836e5744-044d-4f5b-b042-aafb9bc7acae] [signal:ba9c7bfc-79ef-4927-87a3-361b78302202] The Europe signal is an F70 owner's complaint that sport-mode exhaust sound is too muted. [signal:a6383c2c-a4ab-480d-87a8-fd85644bba7e] The reports describe different concerns, so they do not establish whether the markets differ in sound preference or malfunction rates. [signal:836e5744-044d-4f5b-b042-aafb9bc7acae] [signal:a6383c2c-a4ab-480d-87a8-fd85644bba7e] [signal:ba9c7bfc-79ef-4927-87a3-361b78302202]

## Open questions
How frequently does the G60 startup malfunction occur, and what resolution did the owner ultimately receive? [signal:836e5744-044d-4f5b-b042-aafb9bc7acae] How common are muted-exhaust complaints on the F70 and G70 beyond these individual reports? [signal:a6383c2c-a4ab-480d-87a8-fd85644bba7e] [signal:ba9c7bfc-79ef-4927-87a3-361b78302202]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe climate controls that are hard to find or see, vents that are awkward to adjust, and screen-based controls that take too many steps. [signal:067f53f8-c4a3-41a9-9a19-57fb6183dee0] [signal:297228cf-6aa8-4fe1-af69-88a697ae8592] [signal:41594e09-a038-40f0-ad71-a60d534225be] [signal:4541d388-17c5-434d-b5c8-8f35870e8e18] [signal:6957f2ce-219c-41b2-a57d-0f36531f1947]

## What customers say
Some customers want physical buttons or knobs instead of navigating a display to change climate settings. [signal:067f53f8-c4a3-41a9-9a19-57fb6183dee0] [signal:50e6e3fc-3581-46e0-8e76-e9b347a07c11] [signal:5edde8f5-d46c-4891-8155-7dacc060b7fb]
Customers also report that the controls are difficult to see, that the panel does not make changing heat clear, and that vents are tricky to aim. [signal:297228cf-6aa8-4fe1-af69-88a697ae8592] [signal:4933bba6-80ff-47e2-857b-07d09595ffde] [signal:41594e09-a038-40f0-ad71-a60d534225be]
One F70 customer says the temperature controls are only reachable through the infotainment system and feel unsafe to use while driving. [signal:6f0346ed-42df-4c43-9aa4-795b3e175bcf]

## Differences between markets
USA signals from G60 and G70 owners mention screen navigation, unclear heat controls, and vents that are difficult to locate or aim. [signal:067f53f8-c4a3-41a9-9a19-57fb6183dee0] [signal:4933bba6-80ff-47e2-857b-07d09595ffde] [signal:50e6e3fc-3581-46e0-8e76-e9b347a07c11] [signal:41594e09-a038-40f0-ad71-a60d534225be] [signal:4541d388-17c5-434d-b5c8-8f35870e8e18] [signal:6957f2ce-219c-41b2-a57d-0f36531f1947]
Europe signals from F70 owners mention controls that are hard to see or fiddly, awkward vent operation, and concern about accessing temperature settings through the infotainment system while driving. [signal:297228cf-6aa8-4fe1-af69-88a697ae8592] [signal:4071fd17-2cf3-4f4e-b0aa-c479283c511c] [signal:5b4af978-225f-45c6-8d1c-ee1eb0e3d79e] [signal:6f0346ed-42df-4c43-9aa4-795b3e175bcf]

## Open questions
How frequently do customers encounter each type of difficulty across the affected vehicle lines and markets?
Do customers experience the controls as difficult mainly because they are hard to see, require screen navigation, or are awkward to operate? [signal:067f53f8-c4a3-41a9-9a19-57fb6183dee0] [signal:297228cf-6aa8-4fe1-af69-88a697ae8592] [signal:41594e09-a038-40f0-ad71-a60d534225be]

value.title: Safety-related controls and visibility feel difficult to use
value.summary: Customers describe safety concerns involving visibility, control placement and operation, while one customer reports a strong sense of safety. The signals span Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Concerns include obstructed views, awkward controls and uncertainty about emergency operation.
The case contains 25 signals; the examples span Europe, USA and Rest of World, and F70, G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers raise safety-related usability concerns about mirror visibility, reflections, control layout and emergency operation [signal:14e1b433-92c5-4c80-836d-c9e1410867b7] [signal:202276c1-3164-46b8-acb9-475041287964] [signal:442057ac-e5f3-4076-a07a-ac4891a41d39]. One customer, however, says the car gives a strong sense of safety [signal:27cc3042-5553-4cfa-903e-789cde84da33].

## What customers say
A Europe F70 owner says the dashboard reflection on the windscreen is worse at night and describes removing the iDrive knob and physical heating buttons as a safety problem [signal:14e1b433-92c5-4c80-836d-c9e1410867b7]. Another Europe F70 owner says the heating controls are awkward and feel unsafe to use while driving [signal:9e8aaa28-f441-4a76-ba14-0309bc1ed5f0].

Customers also report visibility and layout concerns: a USA G70 owner says the door light reflects in the driver-side mirror at night [signal:202276c1-3164-46b8-acb9-475041287964], while a Rest of World F70 owner says the interior lighting reflects off the door mirrors by default [signal:27cc3042-5553-4cfa-903e-789cde84da33]. A Europe F70 owner describes the rear-view mirror as distorted and says reversing with it is difficult [signal:5351b98c-9189-40af-87b0-02d606008155].

A USA G70 customer says many drivers may not know about the physical emergency door handles [signal:442057ac-e5f3-4076-a07a-ac4891a41d39]. A USA G60 owner considers the lack of old-style knobs and dials a serious safety risk for drivers other than the very youngest [signal:88e566e7-918c-4029-9ea9-81b2c320a8fb].

## Differences between markets
The supplied Europe examples include concerns about physical heating controls, the rear-view mirror, windscreen reflections and button proximity [signal:14e1b433-92c5-4c80-836d-c9e1410867b7] [signal:5351b98c-9189-40af-87b0-02d606008155] [signal:9477d6cb-641c-41d4-be53-486c2d03df4b] [signal:9e8aaa28-f441-4a76-ba14-0309bc1ed5f0]. The supplied USA examples include concerns about mirror visibility, emergency door-handle awareness and the absence of physical controls [signal:202276c1-3164-46b8-acb9-475041287964] [signal:442057ac-e5f3-4076-a07a-ac4891a41d39] [signal:88e566e7-918c-4029-9ea9-81b2c320a8fb]. The Rest of World examples are mixed: one customer reports mirror reflections but also says the car gives a strong sense of safety [signal:27cc3042-5553-4cfa-903e-789cde84da33].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common each concern is across the 25 case signals or whether experiences differ by vehicle configuration. The supplied examples also do not show whether the reported visibility and control concerns occur under the same conditions across markets [signal:202276c1-3164-46b8-acb9-475041287964] [signal:27cc3042-5553-4cfa-903e-789cde84da33] [signal:5351b98c-9189-40af-87b0-02d606008155].

value.title: Engine and exhaust sounds disappoint or disturb drivers
value.summary: Drivers report unwanted startup vibration or knocking, while some F70 owners feel the exhaust sound is too weak or artificial. The signals cover F70 owners in Europe and a G70 owner in Rest of World, with an additional G70 complaint in the USA about a distracting rear-side valve noise.
highlights: Unwanted engine-related noise and disappointing exhaust sound
Europe: F70; Rest of World and USA: G70 signals
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers report diesel-like vibration and noise at startup in a G70 [signal:1b71ac58-e08b-4dc7-b6a1-6dbe369a0c57]. A USA G70 owner describes a repeating, distracting noise from the right rear, traced by the dealership to a fuel-vapor valve [signal:c5e41d0e-3e7c-41ca-b005-f9d692f8554f]. F70 owners in Europe say the exhaust sound is weak or disappointing, and one describes speaker-generated pops as artificial [signal:fbe2c68c-7030-4853-8e8a-3052fb1bff60] [signal:00bcb6a3-41fb-43ba-9395-65cf06141970] [signal:48962b3c-5aef-4cb1-87e9-c6f9a64a8d3c].

## What customers say
A Rest of World G70 signal mentions fuel-economy benefits alongside diesel-type startup vibration and noise [signal:1b71ac58-e08b-4dc7-b6a1-6dbe369a0c57]. The USA G70 owner says the recurring valve noise is extremely annoying and distracting [signal:c5e41d0e-3e7c-41ca-b005-f9d692f8554f]. European F70 owners say they expected more exhaust sound, and one compares it unfavorably with an earlier F40 M135i [signal:fbe2c68c-7030-4853-8e8a-3052fb1bff60] [signal:48962b3c-5aef-4cb1-87e9-c6f9a64a8d3c]. A USA G70 owner also says the M Sport exhaust is weak compared with the exhausts on their M850 and their wife's X7 [signal:00bcb6a3-41fb-43ba-9395-65cf06141970].

## Differences between markets
The exhaust-sound complaints in the supplied signals are from Europe F70 owners [signal:fbe2c68c-7030-4853-8e8a-3052fb1bff60] [signal:48962b3c-5aef-4cb1-87e9-c6f9a64a8d3c]. The G70 startup vibration/noise signal is from Rest of World, while the rear-side valve-noise complaint is from the USA [signal:1b71ac58-e08b-4dc7-b6a1-6dbe369a0c57] [signal:c5e41d0e-3e7c-41ca-b005-f9d692f8554f]. The signals describe different sound concerns and do not establish whether experiences differ systematically by market [signal:1b71ac58-e08b-4dc7-b6a1-6dbe369a0c57] [signal:c5e41d0e-3e7c-41ca-b005-f9d692f8554f] [signal:fbe2c68c-7030-4853-8e8a-3052fb1bff60].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these sound concerns are across the affected vehicle lines [signal:1b71ac58-e08b-4dc7-b6a1-6dbe369a0c57] [signal:c5e41d0e-3e7c-41ca-b005-f9d692f8554f] [signal:fbe2c68c-7030-4853-8e8a-3052fb1bff60]. They also do not clarify whether the reports concern the same operating conditions or sound sources across vehicles [signal:1b71ac58-e08b-4dc7-b6a1-6dbe369a0c57] [signal:c5e41d0e-3e7c-41ca-b005-f9d692f8554f] [signal:48962b3c-5aef-4cb1-87e9-c6f9a64a8d3c].

value.title: Exterior size and styling divide customer opinions
value.summary: Exterior feedback is mixed: some customers find the G60 boxy and less sporty or the G70 too large, while another customer likes the G60 styling. The signals come from USA and Rest of World customers.
highlights: Some customers dislike the boxy look, reduced sportiness, or overall size.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 customers and a Rest of World G60 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Exterior feedback is mixed: a USA G60 customer describes the 2026 530i as boxy and less sporty than the older body style, while a USA G70 customer says the 7 Series is too big and the earlier model was an ideal size. ## Differences between markets
The USA signals include criticism of G60 sportiness and G70 size, while the Rest of World G60 signal is positive about styling. [signal:0366c87e-5f27-43a1-ab37-e286e818924b] [signal:987fc1a7-7ba4-4ba7-b662-9a8061db2e31] [signal:f06d0bc6-a381-46bf-b4e9-dd3118b5e598]

[signal:146e7139-a740-45fd-8338-2cf6b470b13e] [signal:be75cc72-6513-4f6b-92b5-0aa0e5d6c0a5]

## Differences between markets
Six supplied signals are from the USA, one from Rest of World, and one from Europe. [signal:026359d7-983f-4cd5-8bc6-ae0d03549ddd] [signal:10e21b63-f66b-45d3-94ca-3c399c8d78c7] [signal:28f8e67d-4c39-4963-b371-f54221912b76] [signal:5c1cc47c-4ee1-4011-b39b-106cc30a9aa5] [signal:7c073aed-9352-49b1-98e4-40d23e3ff771] [signal:b316aa07-10a1-4623-a800-f1e4b1e32fdb] [signal:146e7139-a740-45fd-8338-2cf6b470b13e] [signal:be75cc72-6513-4f6b-92b5-0aa0e5d6c0a5] The USA reports describe several kinds of paint and trim defects; the Rest of World report concerns the rear-glass surface, and the Europe report describes fragile paint. [signal:026359d7-983f-4cd5-8bc6-ae0d03549ddd] [signal:10e21b63-f66b-45d3-94ca-3c399c8d78c7] [signal:28f8e67d-4c39-4963-b371-f54221912b76] [signal:5c1cc47c-4ee1-4011-b39b-106cc30a9aa5] [signal:7c073aed-9352-49b1-98e4-40d23e3ff771] [signal:b316aa07-10a1-4623-a800-f1e4b1e32fdb] [signal:146e7139-a740-45fd-8338-2cf6b470b13e] [signal:be75cc72-6513-4f6b-92b5-0aa0e5d6c0a5]

value.title: Exterior size feels too bulky for some, right for others
