value.body_md:
## Problem
Exterior size is not experienced consistently: one USA G70 owner says the car is too wide, long and bulky and cannot fit in their garage. [signal:265b6b1c-c4e2-4c75-9d6b-89de4f8e0fe1] Other owners say the size suits them or remains easy to handle. [signal:69b52afa-82c9-429d-8805-6a030b4e30e5] [signal:6c36eeba-6403-4938-bd4b-ca16dbde2369] [signal:a5742fe4-7be1-43d9-a44c-9e3076fab6cd] [signal:b6128c8d-51d5-4198-8d8b-efe989d14f32] [signal:cc58d0e0-96ae-4586-864d-92d187cbda57]

## What customers say
The G70 complaint describes the car as oversized and says it does not feel like a driver's car. [signal:265b6b1c-c4e2-4c75-9d6b-89de4f8e0fe1] By contrast, a USA G60 owner calls the 540i the right size for the family, neither oversized nor cramped. [signal:69b52afa-82c9-429d-8805-6a030b4e30e5] A Rest of World G70 owner says the car is really huge but easy and comfortable to handle like a mid-size car. [signal:6c36eeba-6403-4938-bd4b-ca16dbde2369] A Rest of World F70 owner says its size is at the upper limit but still easy to handle on tight roads. [signal:a5742fe4-7be1-43d9-a44c-9e3076fab6cd] Other F70 owners say the size suits them, including for carrying passengers and luggage. [signal:b6128c8d-51d5-4198-8d8b-efe989d14f32] [signal:cc58d0e0-96ae-4586-864d-92d187cbda57]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include a G70 owner who cannot fit the car in their garage and a G60 owner who says the size is right for their family. [signal:265b6b1c-c4e2-4c75-9d6b-89de4f8e0fe1] [signal:69b52afa-82c9-429d-8805-6a030b4e30e5] Rest of World owners describe G70 and F70 size as manageable, though one F70 owner places it at the upper limit. [signal:6c36eeba-6403-4938-bd4b-ca16dbde2369] [signal:a5742fe4-7be1-43d9-a44c-9e3076fab6cd] Europe F70 owners say the size suits them. [signal:b6128c8d-51d5-4198-8d8b-efe989d14f32] [signal:cc58d0e0-96ae-4586-864d-92d187cbda57]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common garage-fit concerns are beyond the one USA G70 complaint. [signal:265b6b1c-c4e2-4c75-9d6b-89de4f8e0fe1] One F70 owner compares the design with similar classes from other makers, but does not name a competitor. [signal:c53c697d-d74f-4f5a-ad1f-0f6dd05785d0]

value.title: Exterior paint and fit-and-finish defects undermine confidence
value.summary: Customers report paint-quality concerns and exterior parts that are damaged, misaligned, loose, or not working as expected. Signals come from USA and European owners of G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Paint defects and exterior fit-and-finish issues are reported.
Reports cover USA and Europe, across G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report exterior paint and fit-and-finish concerns, including stains beneath paint sealant, dull spots, fragile-feeling paint, and damage with a poor repair [signal:04c0be53-1e73-4eb0-a539-4d56686d9e17] [signal:893b0362-6bcb-4956-9d23-e6c6c2b15393] [signal:9c51d89b-9dff-40f3-b2f4-8d1ff0552db5] [signal:0d0b1961-20f6-4e90-b42e-e56f84de213a]. Other reports describe misaligned trim or hood fit and a tow-hitch cover that came loose and went missing [signal:2eec01b0-6af9-487f-978a-07e33650fb71]  [signal:6db8f4b1-0fc6-4757-a003-9cae6b730c9d].

## What customers say
A USA owner said water stains remained on the hood after at least three dealership visits [signal:04c0be53-1e73-4eb0-a539-4d56686d9e17]. Another USA owner reported dull spots in the front paint finish [signal:893b0362-6bcb-4956-9d23-e6c6c2b15393]. A European owner described paint damage on the first delivered car and an unsatisfactory repair [signal:0d0b1961-20f6-4e90-b42e-e56f84de213a], while another said the paint seemed fragile [signal:9c51d89b-9dff-40f3-b2f4-8d1ff0552db5].

A G70 owner in the USA reported trim that stood proud between the front and rear doors [signal:2eec01b0-6af9-487f-978a-07e33650fb71]. A G60 owner said the hood sat higher on one side and did not sit flush . Another USA G70 owner said the tow-hitch cover repeatedly worked loose and went missing at a car wash [signal:6db8f4b1-0fc6-4757-a003-9cae6b730c9d]. A European F70 owner also reported being unable to get the exterior door-handle lighting programmed, with the dealer unable to assist [signal:5ab91a9c-8ce3-47f6-a1ff-4fb3af9d254a].

## Differences between markets
The sample includes USA reports about paint finish, hood and trim alignment, and a loose tow-hitch cover [signal:04c0be53-1e73-4eb0-a539-4d56686d9e17] [signal:893b0362-6bcb-4956-9d23-e6c6c2b15393] [signal:2eec01b0-6af9-487f-978a-07e33650fb71]  [signal:6db8f4b1-0fc6-4757-a003-9cae6b730c9d]. European reports include paint damage and repair concerns, perceived paint fragility, and exterior door-handle lighting that could not be programmed [signal:0d0b1961-20f6-4e90-b42e-e56f84de213a] [signal:9c51d89b-9dff-40f3-b2f4-8d1ff0552db5] [signal:5ab91a9c-8ce3-47f6-a1ff-4fb3af9d254a]. These signals describe different issues; they do not establish a market-level difference in reliability.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequently these issues occur across the wider vehicle population [signal:04c0be53-1e73-4eb0-a539-4d56686d9e17] [signal:6db8f4b1-0fc6-4757-a003-9cae6b730c9d]. They also do not clarify whether the reported paint and alignment concerns share a common cause [signal:893b0362-6bcb-4956-9d23-e6c6c2b15393] [signal:2eec01b0-6af9-487f-978a-07e33650fb71] .

value.title: Wind noise and artificial driving sounds detract from the experience
value.summary: Customers report intrusive wind noise around windows, doors and mirrors, while one also finds the adaptive driving sounds artificial and annoying. Reports span F70 and G70 vehicles in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Wind noise is reported in the cabin; one customer also dislikes artificial adaptive driving sounds.
Reports mention F70 and G70 vehicles in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
One signal compares the car with a prior Mercedes, but not their sound performance.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe wind noise entering around front windows, doors and mirrors, including with the windows and sunroof closed. [signal:13868108-ea6c-46b0-93d7-2c21e42d4805] [signal:1802e78d-942f-4132-bac0-354bc3cccec0] [signal:18114c26-89c7-422e-9beb-60a87e8525a8] [signal:2735d6f4-d545-4d2a-9f51-01bf8b068bf5] One customer also calls the adaptive driving sounds fake and annoying. [signal:c616610d-388c-4110-98b2-8e686a1fac55]

## What customers say
A G70 owner reports wind noise through both side windows on every drive, while another says the noise seems to come from the mirrors. [signal:13868108-ea6c-46b0-93d7-2c21e42d4805] [signal:18114c26-89c7-422e-9beb-60a87e8525a8] Another G70 complaint describes excessive wind noise at the front doors or windows with the windows and sunroof closed. [signal:2735d6f4-d545-4d2a-9f51-01bf8b068bf5] An F70 customer reports wind noise around the door and wing mirror area, while another says front-window wind noise detracts from an otherwise positive experience. [signal:c616610d-388c-4110-98b2-8e686a1fac55] [signal:370b3e67-e1a8-4db9-ae3f-e9766847d774] One G70 report says wind noise becomes very loud above 100 km/h. [signal:6ce68570-6136-4ea8-a35d-6b002f4e2123]

A G70 customer says the car has more wind noise than their previous 7 Series and reports being told it is due to the car’s shape. [signal:18114c26-89c7-422e-9beb-60a87e8525a8] A separate customer reports that a dealer found a bubble in the driver-front window glass after investigating wind noise and replaced the glass. [signal:6a10054c-aade-46cd-8e68-71279fd0e884] An F70 customer describes the adaptive driving sounds as artificial and annoying. [signal:c616610d-388c-4110-98b2-8e686a1fac55]

## Differences between markets
The provided examples include F70 wind-noise complaints from Europe and G70 complaints from the USA and Rest of World. [signal:1802e78d-942f-4132-bac0-354bc3cccec0] [signal:18114c26-89c7-422e-9beb-60a87e8525a8] [signal:6ce68570-6136-4ea8-a35d-6b002f4e2123] Both F70 and G70 examples describe wind noise; the available examples do not establish whether its severity differs by market. [signal:370b3e67-e1a8-4db9-ae3f-e9766847d774] [signal:2735d6f4-d545-4d2a-9f51-01bf8b068bf5]

## Open questions
Which locations and driving conditions account for the reported wind noise, given reports around windows, doors and mirrors and at speeds above 100 km/h? [signal:13868108-ea6c-46b0-93d7-2c21e42d4805] [signal:18114c26-89c7-422e-9beb-60a87e8525a8] [signal:6ce68570-6136-4ea8-a35d-6b002f4e2123] How widespread are the complaints across the 27 signals, and how often do customers object to adaptive driving sounds? [signal:c616610d-388c-4110-98b2-8e686a1fac55]

value.title: Emergency call reliability warnings and outages
value.summary: Customers report emergency-call malfunction alerts, the function turning off, or uncertainty about whether it is available. Signals include USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Emergency-call alerts and outages undermine confidence that the function is available.
USA signals include G60 and G70 vehicles; the case contains 10 signals.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report emergency-call malfunction messages or the function turning off, leaving them unsure whether emergency calling is available. [signal:1dba4171-6b99-4b05-96b3-4ee57dd06e87] [signal:24f637fa-ac5d-4c5f-bdd8-7ce2bfd3dfa6] [signal:74501957-5cbd-4f83-8d18-ec15951cad6c]

## What customers say
One G70 customer said the function turned off on roughly 90 percent of vehicle starts. [signal:1dba4171-6b99-4b05-96b3-4ee57dd06e87] A G60 customer saw a warning continuously for about a month, after which it disappeared. [signal:47482454-b25b-4c80-a270-7f4a14dc1bfd] Another G70 customer had not arranged service because the dealership had no loaner vehicles available. [signal:5017707f-a1a8-4a10-a561-689592100e74]

One G60 service record reports a permanently failed battery in the telematics control unit, an unresponsive unit, and the map being unable to locate the car; the customer also reported the car was not communicating with the app. [signal:5a84d769-9e1f-4d6f-9f60-58f3e610c4e7] A G70 customer said the function worked correctly after a dealer system update. [signal:74501957-5cbd-4f83-8d18-ec15951cad6c] Reported outcomes therefore differ: one warning disappeared without a stated repair, while another customer reported normal operation after an update. [signal:47482454-b25b-4c80-a270-7f4a14dc1bfd] [signal:74501957-5cbd-4f83-8d18-ec15951cad6c]

## Differences between markets
The supplied examples are from the USA and include G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:1dba4171-6b99-4b05-96b3-4ee57dd06e87] [signal:24f637fa-ac5d-4c5f-bdd8-7ce2bfd3dfa6] [signal:47482454-b25b-4c80-a270-7f4a14dc1bfd] [signal:5017707f-a1a8-4a10-a561-689592100e74] [signal:5a84d769-9e1f-4d6f-9f60-58f3e610c4e7] [signal:74501957-5cbd-4f83-8d18-ec15951cad6c] No other market is represented in the supplied examples, so a market comparison is not available.

## Open questions
- How often does the function become unavailable, and how long do alerts persist?
- Do customers experience emergency-call failures alongside other connected-service symptoms?
- What are the causes and outcomes for the remaining signals in the case?

value.title: Emergency request button use is unclear and sometimes difficult
value.summary: Some G60 and G70 customers are unsure when or how to use the SOS button; one G60 customer also found its touch-style control difficult to press when the screen was dirty. A G70 customer reported an emergency-call-system warning after the vehicle sat in the sun.
highlights: Customers ask when and how to use the SOS button; one reports difficulty pressing it when dirty.
Seven signals: six from the USA and one from Rest of World; five concern G60 and two G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Several customers ask what the SOS button does or when it should be used, while one customer reports that a touch-style emergency button is hard to press if the screen has dirt. [signal:3684435a-a270-4e67-8dd5-19855482f6bf] [signal:81b50043-7372-481b-93c6-6874b389db0b] [signal:c200bded-a694-4c03-bb64-fbcddbeb45ab] Other signals describe questions about testing the button and roadside assistance, and a reported emergency-call-system warning that appears after parking in the sun. [signal:c52a9409-3fe9-49a9-878c-7ff34867c966] [signal:d6c48419-f0c7-465e-97e1-4af83b30895a] [signal:dd0c5334-146a-4909-ae6f-9bf91650a6a0]

## What customers say
USA customers asked when the SOS button should be used, what it does if they are stranded, and whether it can be pressed to check that it works. [signal:3684435a-a270-4e67-8dd5-19855482f6bf] [signal:81b50043-7372-481b-93c6-6874b389db0b] [signal:c52a9409-3fe9-49a9-878c-7ff34867c966] Other USA customers asked about roadside assistance or the purpose of the overhead SOS button. [signal:d6c48419-f0c7-465e-97e1-4af83b30895a] [signal:f666ca04-5a05-495c-9522-2a38ee3971bd] A Rest of World customer said the touch-style emergency button was hard to press when the screen had dirt. [signal:c200bded-a694-4c03-bb64-fbcddbeb45ab] A USA G70 customer reported an “Emergency Call System Malfunction” message after the vehicle was left parked in the sun; the customer said it went away after the car was put in a garage and the roof exterior cooled. [signal:dd0c5334-146a-4909-ae6f-9bf91650a6a0]

## Differences between markets
The six USA signals include questions about button purpose, usage, testing and roadside assistance, as well as a report of a sun-related warning. [signal:3684435a-a270-4e67-8dd5-19855482f6bf] [signal:81b50043-7372-481b-93c6-6874b389db0b] [signal:c52a9409-3fe9-49a9-878c-7ff34867c966] [signal:d6c48419-f0c7-465e-97e1-4af83b30895a] [signal:dd0c5334-146a-4909-ae6f-9bf91650a6a0] [signal:f666ca04-5a05-495c-9522-2a38ee3971bd] The single Rest of World signal reports difficulty physically pressing the touch-style button when the screen is dirty. [signal:c200bded-a694-4c03-bb64-fbcddbeb45ab]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common button-use uncertainty or pressing difficulty is beyond these reports. [signal:3684435a-a270-4e67-8dd5-19855482f6bf] [signal:c200bded-a694-4c03-bb64-fbcddbeb45ab] They also do not establish the cause of the G70 warning or whether it is expected behavior. [signal:dd0c5334-146a-4909-ae6f-9bf91650a6a0]

## Problem

[signal:c0018e28-b059-466c-9b09-74090d8a8173] [signal:3e54ac76-ffb1-4a42-afb1-5fb2be3b01cf] One Europe customer says the previous 1 Series console felt smoother and better quality. [signal:a2f9870a-8c8d-4ac2-9d51-daf2bba2a9d1]

## What customers say
A G70 customer in the USA wants a fridge in the center console. [signal:a97742a8-6df1-4a21-892e-5e0c415f37c8] Another USA G70 customer likes having places to put napkins and trash out of sight. [signal:f6e791da-55c0-4671-9ce4-baee90548e56] A G60 customer says the console surface is difficult to keep clean-looking and that sunlight reflects harshly off the dial. [signal:3e54ac76-ffb1-4a42-afb1-5fb2be3b01cf]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include both a request for a fridge and appreciation for concealed storage, alongside complaints about the console finish and reflections. [signal:a97742a8-6df1-4a21-892e-5e0c415f37c8] [signal:f6e791da-55c0-4671-9ce4-baee90548e56] [signal:c0018e28-b059-466c-9b09-74090d8a8173] [signal:3e54ac76-ffb1-4a42-afb1-5fb2be3b01cf] The Europe console feedback is a preference for the previous 1 Series console's smoother feel and perceived quality. [signal:a2f9870a-8c8d-4ac2-9d51-daf2bba2a9d1]

## Open questions
Do customers who report cleaning or reflection concerns refer to the same console surface or finish? [signal:c0018e28-b059-466c-9b09-74090d8a8173] [signal:3e54ac76-ffb1-4a42-afb1-5fb2be3b01cf] How common are the fridge request and the preference for concealed storage beyond these individual reports? [signal:a97742a8-6df1-4a21-892e-5e0c415f37c8] [signal:f6e791da-55c0-4671-9ce4-baee90548e56]

value.title: Front center console buttons stick and feel cheap
value.summary: Some customers report sticking or unresponsive front center console buttons, while others criticize the console’s materials and button layout. The signals come from G60 customers in the USA and F70 customers in Europe.
highlights: Reports include sticking or unresponsive buttons, cheap-feeling plastics, and hard-to-distinguish controls.
Signals include three USA reports across G70 and G60, and two Europe reports for F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers report that front center console buttons stick or do not always respond when pressed. [signal:4dcac025-f5fa-446a-8524-c0c90e4cb842] Other complaints concern plastics that feel cheap and buttons that are difficult to distinguish. [signal:6ba86d23-4e5b-4661-b281-01d5505ff5a3] [signal:8d5c2922-333b-4047-9020-bc0bbd6faf18]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer says some center console buttons stick or do not always respond. [signal:4dcac025-f5fa-446a-8524-c0c90e4cb842] A Europe F70 customer says the console plastics feel cheap, while another says the console buttons are hard to distinguish and have little separation. [signal:6ba86d23-4e5b-4661-b281-01d5505ff5a3] [signal:8d5c2922-333b-4047-9020-bc0bbd6faf18] A USA G70 customer says their knee hits the wood console and wishes that area were padded leather. [signal:34db84a0-6612-463e-bca8-9843d5118141]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include a G60 complaint about buttons sticking or not responding and a G70 complaint about the hard wood console surface. [signal:4dcac025-f5fa-446a-8524-c0c90e4cb842] [signal:34db84a0-6612-463e-bca8-9843d5118141] The Europe F70 signals criticize the plastics and the difficulty of distinguishing console buttons. [signal:6ba86d23-4e5b-4661-b281-01d5505ff5a3] [signal:8d5c2922-333b-4047-9020-bc0bbd6faf18]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the sticking or unresponsive buttons occur beyond the reported G60 complaint. [signal:4dcac025-f5fa-446a-8524-c0c90e4cb842] They do not establish whether the material and button-layout complaints are shared by other customers or vehicle lines. [signal:34db84a0-6612-463e-bca8-9843d5118141] [signal:6ba86d23-4e5b-4661-b281-01d5505ff5a3] [signal:8d5c2922-333b-4047-9020-bc0bbd6faf18]

value.title: Front center console layout raises usability and comfort concerns
value.summary: Some G60 and G70 customers find the front center console uncomfortable or difficult to use, citing layout, control safety, storage access, and heat. Other G60 customers value the changed console, while one customer compared BMW’s interior finish unfavorably with Genesis.
highlights: Concerns include awkward phone and cupholder use, risky-feeling button placement, and crystal controls that heat in sunlight.
Signals cover G60 customers in the USA and a G70 customer in Europe.
One customer said Genesis’s interior finish seemed better; another preferred an Audi wagon.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers describe the console or its controls as difficult or uncomfortable to use: one G60 customer struggled to position a phone in the wireless charger while using the cupholders, and another was nervous about the start/stop button’s proximity to other buttons [signal:86d15811-312d-4bd9-9b78-0419e78af2e3] [signal:be11da40-fb1f-4fc8-a2af-1367722d79fd]. A G70 customer said operating everything through the center console felt unsafe while driving [signal:61cfe654-ae30-438f-adfd-e74ee804543c]. Another G70 customer disliked crystal controls because they become hot in the sun [signal:f2e9619b-1128-4fcb-9ced-f9e828ccaeca].

## What customers say
A G60 customer said the new console was different and an improvement [signal:47d60aea-a143-4265-9972-4c392c4a2815]. In contrast, another G60 customer described the layout as terrible and said the start/stop button placement made her feel unsafe [signal:be11da40-fb1f-4fc8-a2af-1367722d79fd]. A G70 customer, on their seventh or eighth 7 Series, said comfort and ergonomics were below those of earlier cars and objected to having to operate everything through the console [signal:61cfe654-ae30-438f-adfd-e74ee804543c].

A G60 customer said Genesis appealed because its interior finish seemed better than BMW’s, while an Audi wagon appealed because of a preference for wagons and prior ownership of Audi Avant wagons [signal:7f6a6c41-5897-4eef-9a01-629f308f9628]. Another G60 customer called the glossy trim around the console and across the dash a letdown, saying it showed fingerprints and smears and was difficult to keep clean [signal:6ebb532a-067f-4879-8dc5-5189495c9f86].

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA signals include both positive feedback on the changed G60 console and complaints about its layout, phone and cupholder use, button placement, and trim [signal:47d60aea-a143-4265-9972-4c392c4a2815] [signal:86d15811-312d-4bd9-9b78-0419e78af2e3] [signal:be11da40-fb1f-4fc8-a2af-1367722d79fd] [signal:6ebb532a-067f-4879-8dc5-5189495c9f86]. The supplied Europe signal concerns a G70 customer’s broader dissatisfaction with comfort and ergonomics, including reliance on the center console while driving [signal:61cfe654-ae30-438f-adfd-e74ee804543c].

## Open questions
Do console usability concerns differ between G60 and G70, or between markets? Which specific controls or layout details contribute most to the reported safety concerns? What aspects of the console are behind the positive assessment?

value.title: Front center console controls and storage are difficult to use
value.summary: Some USA G60 and G70 customers describe console controls that are hard to find or confirm, surfaces that show marks and glare, and desired functions or storage features that are missing. The signals cover several distinct usability concerns rather than one shared complaint.
highlights: Customers report hard-to-locate, unresponsive buttons, visible marks, glare, and missing console features.
Signals are from USA G60 and G70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 customer says console buttons are hard to locate, not very responsive, and awkward to operate, while basic functions rely too much on multi-step apps [signal:2446979d-cca6-4b2b-87df-29ca7ce65811]. Another G60 customer says button presses are difficult to confirm while driving [signal:e54a1620-17f4-4cb9-9810-970796c6b911].

A G60 customer says the console surface shows every touch and sunlight reflects harshly off the dial [signal:5d16bb40-e21d-4912-818d-d164e74db8b3]. Customers also expressed wishes for a lockable console [signal:779caecb-2547-4c65-a9ac-a3be7417926e], a USB port instead of the existing 12V outlet, and a small light inside the console [signal:f52f6314-d256-4f5a-9854-3070cdcbd423].

## What customers say
One G70 customer described frustration with choosing the default phone when moving between cars, specifically mentioning a phone plugged into the wired USB in the center console [signal:84508468-59f8-43b4-b216-87008958b3bf]. The same customer also criticized the personal assistant, so the signal includes concerns beyond the console itself [signal:84508468-59f8-43b4-b216-87008958b3bf].

## Differences between markets
All provided signals are from the USA and concern G60 or G70 vehicles [signal:2446979d-cca6-4b2b-87df-29ca7ce65811] [signal:5d16bb40-e21d-4912-818d-d164e74db8b3] [signal:84508468-59f8-43b4-b216-87008958b3bf] [signal:779caecb-2547-4c65-a9ac-a3be7417926e] [signal:e54a1620-17f4-4cb9-9810-970796c6b911] [signal:f52f6314-d256-4f5a-9854-3070cdcbd423]. The signals do not provide a comparison between markets.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common each concern is, or whether the different console issues affect the same customers [signal:2446979d-cca6-4b2b-87df-29ca7ce65811] [signal:5d16bb40-e21d-4912-818d-d164e74db8b3] [signal:779caecb-2547-4c65-a9ac-a3be7417926e] [signal:e54a1620-17f4-4cb9-9810-970796c6b911] [signal:f52f6314-d256-4f5a-9854-3070cdcbd423].

value.title: Front center console storage feels too small
value.summary: Customers say the front center console offers too little space or depth for everyday items. Reports cover G60, G70 and F70 vehicles across the USA, Rest of World and Europe.
highlights: Customers describe the console storage as too small or shallow.
Reports span the USA, Rest of World and Europe, across G60, G70 and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the front center console storage is too small or shallow, limiting what they can keep between the front seats. [signal:0d336b17-dcac-4c07-83a1-e73ca8483458] [signal:1ca95100-1ec4-47a7-a690-4864247e1f1d]

## What customers say
One G70 customer said the compartment fit only sunglasses and one other small item. [signal:1f23982d-d106-4c96-8e31-c59004000aa0] A G60 customer with children wanted more room for items between the front seats. [signal:17136406-58e5-4085-9603-07a747b5ee3e] Another G60 customer said they would prefer extra storage over the wireless charging pad. [signal:0381e017-b0c9-4a19-affa-e8459f080719]

## Differences between markets
Complaints appear in the USA for G60 and G70, in Rest of World for G60 and F70, and in Europe for F70. [signal:0d336b17-dcac-4c07-83a1-e73ca8483458] [signal:0eacc84c-737b-4f36-9d3f-250b2eb1de23] [signal:5d1aa330-640c-42f2-bb13-515d4fda54d3] [signal:a0200282-7f85-4c63-a3f4-143245b1418d] [signal:ea2e1514-343b-4c48-80c2-a81578863307] The supplied signals all describe limited storage; they do not show a market expressing satisfaction with it. [signal:0381e017-b0c9-4a19-affa-e8459f080719] [signal:0d336b17-dcac-4c07-83a1-e73ca8483458] [signal:0eacc84c-737b-4f36-9d3f-250b2eb1de23] [signal:17136406-58e5-4085-9603-07a747b5ee3e] [signal:1ca95100-1ec4-47a7-a690-4864247e1f1d] [signal:1f23982d-d106-4c96-8e31-c59004000aa0] [signal:5d1aa330-640c-42f2-bb13-515d4fda54d3] [signal:a0200282-7f85-4c63-a3f4-143245b1418d] [signal:ea2e1514-343b-4c48-80c2-a81578863307]

## Open questions
What items do customers most often want to store in the console, and how much additional depth or volume would address the reported limits? [signal:17136406-58e5-4085-9603-07a747b5ee3e] [signal:1ca95100-1ec4-47a7-a690-4864247e1f1d]

value.title: Front console quality, usability and finish concerns
value.summary: Customers report visible fingerprints, perceived lower-quality materials, console flex and sluggish operation, alongside concerns about console layout and storage. Signals come from USA and Europe across G70, G60 and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Concerns include fingerprints, flex, perceived material quality, sluggishness and difficult-to-use controls.
Signals span USA (G70, G60) and Europe (F70); console-specific concerns appear in both markets.
A USA customer said Genesis had better-seeming interior finish.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe several different front-console concerns: shiny trim shows fingerprints, the console can flex when pressed, and some customers perceive the interior finish as lower quality than before. [signal:e4a2d32f-63e5-45b9-9433-a643c31e0004] [signal:9a56c340-e873-487c-a1e5-35b2d4861ec5] [signal:b59c30f7-77c7-4fa7-86d7-51a1da2bc689] [signal:ad0f5738-f32c-4519-8ce3-6bd07b67d0fa] [signal:bf31bee0-5c18-4383-bf7b-6a6e39ef6828] One F70 owner also reports that the center console can be sluggish or freeze, while a G70 owner finds controls difficult to locate and use without looking away from the road. [signal:958676f0-62aa-481b-8e5a-11a94f363614] [signal:70476323-1da4-4ebf-86f8-6eff79162377]

## What customers say
A G70 owner says fingerprints are clearly visible on the shiny trim around the iDrive Controller; another says fingerprints show on the center console and other shiny surfaces. [signal:9a56c340-e873-487c-a1e5-35b2d4861ec5] [signal:e4a2d32f-63e5-45b9-9433-a643c31e0004] An F70 owner says the console flexes when pressing the My Modes button and feels cheap. [signal:b59c30f7-77c7-4fa7-86d7-51a1da2bc689] Other F70 owners compare the interior console or finish unfavorably with their previous cars, including citing more plastic in the interior finish. [signal:ad0f5738-f32c-4519-8ce3-6bd07b67d0fa] [signal:bf31bee0-5c18-4383-bf7b-6a6e39ef6828]

An F70 owner reports intermittent sluggishness and freezing that required a reset; after a firmware update, the console seemed quicker. [signal:958676f0-62aa-481b-8e5a-11a94f363614] A G70 owner says controls and functions such as seat adjustment are hard to find in the central monitor, and objects to the start-stop button being next to the menu. [signal:70476323-1da4-4ebf-86f8-6eff79162377] A G60 owner says the front console does not provide enough storage. [signal:07f197f2-ac2c-48c7-bc7e-0232e6947d01]

## Differences between markets
In the USA signals, G70 owners mention visible fingerprints and difficulty using or locating controls; a G60 owner mentions insufficient front-console storage. [signal:e4a2d32f-63e5-45b9-9433-a643c31e0004] [signal:9a56c340-e873-487c-a1e5-35b2d4861ec5] [signal:70476323-1da4-4ebf-86f8-6eff79162377] [signal:07f197f2-ac2c-48c7-bc7e-0232e6947d01] In Europe, F70 owners mention sluggishness or freezing, console flex, and perceived lower-quality interior finish compared with previous BMWs. [signal:958676f0-62aa-481b-8e5a-11a94f363614] [signal:b59c30f7-77c7-4fa7-86d7-51a1da2bc689] [signal:ad0f5738-f32c-4519-8ce3-6bd07b67d0fa] [signal:bf31bee0-5c18-4383-bf7b-6a6e39ef6828] The signals do not establish that these differences are unique to either market. [signal:70476323-1da4-4ebf-86f8-6eff79162377] [signal:958676f0-62aa-481b-8e5a-11a94f363614]

## Open questions
Do the reports of visible fingerprints concern the same trim surface across vehicles, or different surfaces? [signal:e4a2d32f-63e5-45b9-9433-a643c31e0004] [signal:9a56c340-e873-487c-a1e5-35b2d4861ec5] How frequent are the reported console sluggishness and freezing, and do they persist after the firmware update? [signal:958676f0-62aa-481b-8e5a-11a94f363614] How widespread are the reported concerns about console flex, perceived material quality, control usability and storage? [signal:b59c30f7-77c7-4fa7-86d7-51a1da2bc689] [signal:bf31bee0-5c18-4383-bf7b-6a6e39ef6828] [signal:70476323-1da4-4ebf-86f8-6eff79162377] [signal:07f197f2-ac2c-48c7-bc7e-0232e6947d01]

value.title: Charging routes limited to current location and charge level
value.summary: A G70 owner in the USA says charging routes can only be planned from the car’s current location and current charge level. A separate G60 complaint mentions tech and charging more broadly but does not describe a specific route-planning issue.
highlights: Charging-route planning is limited by the current location and charge level.
Signals are from two USA complaints: one G70 route-planning complaint and one broader G60 tech-and-charging complaint.
Hyundai is cited as a broader tech benchmark, not specifically for route planning.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G70 owner says a charging route cannot be planned from a location other than where the vehicle is parked, or with a starting charge level different from the current one. [signal:a44f1eb5-ae99-49c7-8156-bb4d3544816b]

## What customers say
The G70 owner describes the in-car navigation system as having room for improvement and identifies these limits in charging-route planning. [signal:a44f1eb5-ae99-49c7-8156-bb4d3544816b]
A G60 owner mentions room for improvement in technology and charging, but the quoted feedback does not specify a charging-route reliability problem. [signal:c10df1f9-f780-4c19-ae04-7dfcc148beb9]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA; the specific route-planning complaint is about the G70, while the broader technology-and-charging complaint is about the G60. [signal:a44f1eb5-ae99-49c7-8156-bb4d3544816b] [signal:c10df1f9-f780-4c19-ae04-7dfcc148beb9]

## Open questions
Do other customers report charging-route reliability issues beyond the G70 owner’s stated planning limits?
Does the G60 owner’s broader charging feedback include a route-planning concern?

value.title: Charging-route planning is unclear and limited
value.summary: Customers report uncertainty about using charging-route features, along with limits in route planning and charging-station selection. Signals come from USA G70 and G60, Europe G60, and Rest of World G60 and F70 drivers.
highlights: Customers report confusing charging-route controls and limits in route planning and station selection.
Signals span USA G70/G60, Europe G60, and Rest of World G60/F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe difficulty understanding or using charging-route functions, and report limits in planning routes and selecting charging stations. [signal:198ad99b-11b6-4e0e-ad79-0e51dc50fe9c] [signal:1eba5c7a-4c73-4b63-b0d3-3e532a71e5c7] [signal:de274e81-a0f5-4dcf-91cc-4e8817005b84] One customer says a charging route cannot be planned from a location other than the car’s current position or with a starting charge level different from the current one. [signal:edd57d15-768f-4995-b7e2-2fb70c756d3f]

## What customers say
A G70 customer needed instructions to set a charge target for arrival at a destination. [signal:198ad99b-11b6-4e0e-ad79-0e51dc50fe9c] Another G70 customer was unsure how route-optimized charging worked and said using the MY BMW app achieved the desired result after receiving guidance. [signal:1eba5c7a-4c73-4b63-b0d3-3e532a71e5c7] A G60 customer says navigation does not always choose the nearest charging station. [signal:de274e81-a0f5-4dcf-91cc-4e8817005b84] A Europe G60 driver wants to plan charging stops and send a complete multi-waypoint route from the app to the car, saying stops currently arrive separately and must be pieced together again. [signal:37c6762e-c27f-464a-ad7b-4f6c0972d939]

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA signals include G70 reports about charging-route guidance and planning, and a G60 report about charging-station selection. [signal:198ad99b-11b6-4e0e-ad79-0e51dc50fe9c] [signal:1eba5c7a-4c73-4b63-b0d3-3e532a71e5c7] [signal:de274e81-a0f5-4dcf-91cc-4e8817005b84] The Europe signal is a G60 request concerning app-based planning and transfer of a complete route. [signal:37c6762e-c27f-464a-ad7b-4f6c0972d939] The sampled Rest of World signals mention navigation concerns, but do not specifically describe route-optimized charging. [signal:ec6c4213-ac52-4e99-aa8c-6980e9ab8e53] [signal:d2c48d09-91be-4b26-a2e3-6f91c8e43065]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often these route-planning limitations occur beyond the reports shown. [signal:198ad99b-11b6-4e0e-ad79-0e51dc50fe9c] [signal:1eba5c7a-4c73-4b63-b0d3-3e532a71e5c7] [signal:de274e81-a0f5-4dcf-91cc-4e8817005b84] They also do not explain why navigation sometimes selects a station other than the nearest one. [signal:de274e81-a0f5-4dcf-91cc-4e8817005b84]

value.title: Panorama glass roof is highly valued by owners
value.summary: Two USA customers describe the roof as their favorite part of the interior: one in a G60 mentions the moonroof, and one in a G70 mentions the panoramic roof.
highlights: Customers name the roof as their favorite interior feature.
Signals come from two USA customers, with vehicles identified as G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem

## What customers say

A G70 customer says the same about the panoramic roof. [signal:db036414-6e6d-41cd-8936-9d2d1f0cbdaa]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA; they describe the roof positively in different vehicle lines, G60 and G70. [signal:a2f09ec0-3941-4bc8-a797-98c67abce3c9] [signal:db036414-6e6d-41cd-8936-9d2d1f0cbdaa]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify whether customers distinguish between a moonroof and a panoramic roof. [signal:a2f09ec0-3941-4bc8-a797-98c67abce3c9] [signal:db036414-6e6d-41cd-8936-9d2d1f0cbdaa]

value.title: Digital Key compatibility and setup remain inconsistent
value.summary: Customers report missing or delayed keycards, phone compatibility and setup problems, and difficulty distinguishing which driver’s key is present. These concerns appear in the provided signals from Europe and the USA.
highlights: Reported gaps include unavailable keycards, phone compatibility and setup issues, and driver identification.
In the provided sample: USA G60/G70 signals and one Europe F70 signal.
One customer compared phone-based starting with a Corvette and Lexus.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe gaps in Digital Key availability and operation: one buyer had not received a keycard, several customers asked about phone support, and one reported that the car did not distinguish between two drivers’ keys. [signal:215d9381-41d8-4cba-bdf1-23431b41d88c] [signal:2f7ebef3-4563-4863-89ad-b3be8e487530] [signal:341b9471-05af-476c-95d6-9952429b9514] [signal:f8b083ec-db44-4ec2-9f6a-41ad660a3b51]

## What customers say
A G60 customer said the dealer did not have a programmable keycard at purchase and that the customer was still waiting for it to be mailed. [signal:215d9381-41d8-4cba-bdf1-23431b41d88c]

Customers with G60 and G70 vehicles asked for Digital Key or Digital Key Plus support for Google Pixel 8 devices. [signal:2f7ebef3-4563-4863-89ad-b3be8e487530] [signal:341b9471-05af-476c-95d6-9952429b9514]

A G70 customer said a dealer could not connect an iPhone 8 Plus to lock and unlock the car, and the phone could not start it; the customer contrasted this with starting a Corvette and Lexus from an iPhone. [signal:8b2e48a0-7c29-44ff-8481-42d535af14b1]

A G70 customer wanted a second digital key for a spouse and was told that when both phones were inside, the car would detect whichever arrived in the area first. [signal:d28944ee-4c1e-40d0-99e9-17538d7649d5]

An F70 customer said the car did not identify which of two people was driving when both had keys in the car. [signal:f8b083ec-db44-4ec2-9f6a-41ad660a3b51]

## Differences between markets
The provided sample includes USA signals for G60 and G70 vehicles and one Europe signal for an F70; the USA examples concern keycard delivery, phone support or setup, and adding a spouse’s phone, while the Europe example concerns identifying the driver. [signal:215d9381-41d8-4cba-bdf1-23431b41d88c] [signal:2f7ebef3-4563-4863-89ad-b3be8e487530] [signal:341b9471-05af-476c-95d6-9952429b9514] [signal:83894d5b-561a-4278-aff8-37edf73d37a2] [signal:8b2e48a0-7c29-44ff-8481-42d535af14b1] [signal:d28944ee-4c1e-40d0-99e9-17538d7649d5] [signal:f8b083ec-db44-4ec2-9f6a-41ad660a3b51]

## Open questions
Which phone models and Digital Key functions are supported or fail in the reported cases? [signal:2f7ebef3-4563-4863-89ad-b3be8e487530] [signal:341b9471-05af-476c-95d6-9952429b9514] [signal:8b2e48a0-7c29-44ff-8481-42d535af14b1]

How often do keycard availability and multi-driver identification issues occur beyond these reports? [signal:215d9381-41d8-4cba-bdf1-23431b41d88c] [signal:f8b083ec-db44-4ec2-9f6a-41ad660a3b51]

value.title: Digital Key connection and access are unreliable
value.summary: Customers report Digital Key failures and inconsistent connection or access, sometimes requiring an app, a reset, or dealer help. Signals come from USA G70 and G60 owners and Europe F70 owners.
highlights: Digital Key connection, unlocking, and related functions are inconsistent or fail.
Signals cover 10 complaints: 6 in the USA across G70 and G60, and 4 in Europe on F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe Digital Key as inconsistent or unreliable, including connection failures and occasions when the key does not unlock the vehicle. Some reports also concern driver recognition, profiles, or key sharing. [signal:0960ffd2-398d-40d3-bd2f-c0b95d6892a3] [signal:1a4e0758-8a48-4470-bf57-0b36dbac436e] [signal:1cf9b26c-cddd-4271-94ac-ff80e39124fc] [signal:2e1e1776-ff96-477b-a871-98b68d578a15] [signal:bbd17b21-fd2f-4c17-9dc6-d3f0e0713733] [signal:c147e383-1a1c-4673-849e-d59dcba06a45] [signal:d94605a6-8c07-48b8-bad2-1603e0c46cb3]

## What customers say
- A G70 owner says the phone key sometimes acts up after remote start; another says the digital key no longer connects. [signal:0960ffd2-398d-40d3-bd2f-c0b95d6892a3] [signal:1a4e0758-8a48-4470-bf57-0b36dbac436e]
- A G60 owner was locked out despite configuring the app key; the key card opened the door but did not start the car. [signal:2f6900d5-56ee-446f-a335-b660c0d23f2e]
- G60 owners also report inconsistent unlocking or connection, with one saying updates and re-pairing improved but did not resolve the issue. [signal:c147e383-1a1c-4673-849e-d59dcba06a45] [signal:d94605a6-8c07-48b8-bad2-1603e0c46cb3]
- F70 owners report inconsistent keys, difficulty identifying which of two key holders is driving, and problems with separate profiles or sharing a digital key. [signal:1cf9b26c-cddd-4271-94ac-ff80e39124fc] [signal:2e1e1776-ff96-477b-a871-98b68d578a15] [signal:bbd17b21-fd2f-4c17-9dc6-d3f0e0713733]
- One F70 owner says digital-key problems required dealer updates; another says the keys work inconsistently and may be difficult for people less confident with digital technology. [signal:3a359f1d-a5f6-459b-97d9-5c0bd5d7761a] [signal:bbd17b21-fd2f-4c17-9dc6-d3f0e0713733]

## Differences between markets
USA signals describe connection or access problems across G70 and G60, including reports involving Android phones and Samsung devices. [signal:1a4e0758-8a48-4470-bf57-0b36dbac436e] [signal:2f6900d5-56ee-446f-a335-b660c0d23f2e] [signal:b0da269b-617a-489c-a78e-7c9c70cf6929] [signal:c147e383-1a1c-4673-849e-d59dcba06a45] [signal:d94605a6-8c07-48b8-bad2-1603e0c46cb3] Europe signals concern inconsistent operation as well as driver identification, profiles, key sharing, and dealer updates on F70. [signal:1cf9b26c-cddd-4271-94ac-ff80e39124fc] [signal:2e1e1776-ff96-477b-a871-98b68d578a15] [signal:3a359f1d-a5f6-459b-97d9-5c0bd5d7761a] [signal:bbd17b21-fd2f-4c17-9dc6-d3f0e0713733]

## Open questions
Do the connection and access problems vary by phone, vehicle line, or use context? [signal:0960ffd2-398d-40d3-bd2f-c0b95d6892a3] [signal:1a4e0758-8a48-4470-bf57-0b36dbac436e] [signal:b0da269b-617a-489c-a78e-7c9c70cf6929] [signal:d94605a6-8c07-48b8-bad2-1603e0c46cb3] How often do profile, driver-recognition, and sharing issues occur relative to connection or unlocking failures? [signal:1cf9b26c-cddd-4271-94ac-ff80e39124fc] [signal:2e1e1776-ff96-477b-a871-98b68d578a15] [signal:bbd17b21-fd2f-4c17-9dc6-d3f0e0713733]

value.title: Panorama roof cracks, admits mist, and lets in heat
value.summary: Customers report roof cracking, water mist during high-pressure washing, and heat entering the cabin; another customer finds the sunroof too small. Signals come from USA G60 and G70 owners and a Europe F70 owner.
highlights: Reported issues include spreading or stress cracks, water mist, and heat entering the cabin.
Signals mention USA G60 and G70 vehicles and a Europe F70 vehicle.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe several panorama or sunroof quality concerns: cracks, water mist during a high-pressure car wash, and heat entering the cabin. [signal:30e4b42c-dc06-4ba2-8eea-6a7c69ca1dd3] [signal:9aee9484-fea4-4676-ae84-7255ac07601c] [signal:63a7efcd-4b58-46b8-9415-80d030360ddf]

## What customers say
A G70 owner in the USA said a moon glass defect kept spreading and that the dealership later attributed it to an impact; the owner disputed that explanation. [signal:30e4b42c-dc06-4ba2-8eea-6a7c69ca1dd3]

Another USA G70 owner said the moonroof cracked about a week after a tint shop applied a clear coat, and BMW would not cover the repair. [signal:61139a29-15df-4d08-a345-56729b8f68a3]

A USA G70 owner reported a stress crack in the panoramic roof while he was away from the vehicle; the dealership was waiting for BMWNA to respond. [signal:bd72aa61-cc93-4ee9-ae82-998f9300bfd1]

A USA G60 customer reported light mist entering near the sunroof during a high-pressure car wash, but called it minor and did not want service because of concern it could worsen. [signal:9aee9484-fea4-4676-ae84-7255ac07601c]

A USA G60 customer said the sunroof lets substantial heat into the cabin. [signal:63a7efcd-4b58-46b8-9415-80d030360ddf]

## Differences between markets
USA signals describe cracks on G70 vehicles and heat or water-mist concerns on G60 vehicles. [signal:30e4b42c-dc06-4ba2-8eea-6a7c69ca1dd3] [signal:61139a29-15df-4d08-a345-56729b8f68a3] [signal:bd72aa61-cc93-4ee9-ae82-998f9300bfd1]  [signal:63a7efcd-4b58-46b8-9415-80d030360ddf]

The Europe F70 customer instead said the sunroof was disappointing because they would have preferred a larger one. [signal:6b948d14-8fc9-4db9-a90b-53ad1da00f5e]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish what caused the reported cracks or whether the clear-coat application contributed to one of them. [signal:30e4b42c-dc06-4ba2-8eea-6a7c69ca1dd3] [signal:61139a29-15df-4d08-a345-56729b8f68a3] [signal:bd72aa61-cc93-4ee9-ae82-998f9300bfd1]

The signals do not indicate how often water mist or heat concerns occur beyond the individual reports.  [signal:63a7efcd-4b58-46b8-9415-80d030360ddf]

value.title: Digital Key reliability and usability vary
value.summary: Customers report inconsistent recognition, setup difficulties and uncertainty about how the Digital Key works, with concerns spanning USA and European signals. Some customers rely on a physical key or card when the phone key does not work as expected.
highlights: Phone recognition, setup and day-to-day use can be inconsistent or unclear.
Signals cover USA G70 and G60 customers and European F70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe Digital Key recognition and operation as inconsistent, including occasions when a phone does not unlock the car or is not recognized on approach. [signal:3a8a75f4-9fdf-4c5a-92c1-dfc5afe9dc03] [signal:165db20a-56e8-410e-a84c-8ea3e649d504] [signal:44a994ed-1935-442c-8559-4b888049957e] European F70 customers also describe the setup or day-to-day behavior as frustrating, and one says the keys work inconsistently. [signal:70168f0b-4253-4163-af2b-6209d240ae14] [signal:0fcc87fe-01ed-4058-acea-2e0f5dd28d2d]

## What customers say
One USA G70 customer says failures happen around 1% of the time; when they do, the phone does not connect through Bluetooth and comfort access does not unlock the doors, so the customer taps the phone on the handle instead. [signal:3a8a75f4-9fdf-4c5a-92c1-dfc5afe9dc03] A USA G60 customer says the app did not unlock the car on one occasion when the key fob was left elsewhere, raising concern about relying on the phone alone. [signal:165db20a-56e8-410e-a84c-8ea3e649d504]

Customers also report uncertainty about setup and operation: one asked what the supplied card was for and received an explanation that it needs activation, while another had difficulty setting up a second key for a Google Pixel phone. [signal:4223c2a2-110c-456f-bc9d-e05a472025c2] [signal:44a994ed-1935-442c-8559-4b888049957e] A USA G70 customer was told that the NFC card must be held near the door handles and placed in the tray to start the car, and that it will not open the tailgate. [signal:0ac095a6-326d-4016-bc37-6dc4e1cffa75] One European F70 customer says the car can lock again after loading the boot and walking around to the driver door; another says the car often does not recognize them and they have to lock and unlock it before it does. [signal:70168f0b-4253-4163-af2b-6209d240ae14] [signal:35467253-5012-4cd5-ab29-866c5e492edc]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include G70 and G60 customers describing intermittent access, setup difficulty, and questions about the key card. [signal:3a8a75f4-9fdf-4c5a-92c1-dfc5afe9dc03] [signal:44a994ed-1935-442c-8559-4b888049957e] [signal:4223c2a2-110c-456f-bc9d-e05a472025c2] European F70 signals describe inconsistent keys and recognition, including relocking while moving from the boot to the driver door. [signal:0fcc87fe-01ed-4058-acea-2e0f5dd28d2d] [signal:70168f0b-4253-4163-af2b-6209d240ae14] The signals do not establish whether the experiences differ systematically by market or vehicle line. [signal:3a8a75f4-9fdf-4c5a-92c1-dfc5afe9dc03] [signal:0fcc87fe-01ed-4058-acea-2e0f5dd28d2d]

## Open questions
How often do phone recognition and unlocking failures occur across vehicles and markets? [signal:3a8a75f4-9fdf-4c5a-92c1-dfc5afe9dc03] Do setup and reliability experiences vary by phone type or by use of the Digital Key card? [signal:44a994ed-1935-442c-8559-4b888049957e] [signal:4223c2a2-110c-456f-bc9d-e05a472025c2]

Both were told that the primary profile is tied to the vehicle warranty and must use the legal name; setting up another profile was suggested as a workaround. [signal:2410cdff-1328-4cb7-91fe-9f40d631aa93] [signal:6f9f9f78-8742-4cbd-8ff6-4693e01b3775]

## What customers say

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA, so these signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:2410cdff-1328-4cb7-91fe-9f40d631aa93] [signal:6f9f9f78-8742-4cbd-8ff6-4693e01b3775] [signal:ccf6270b-6da1-4b5f-8c34-e56057c716b7] [signal:f370d8c7-355b-409f-8676-2423d93aaf03]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether customers can change the displayed name without creating another profile, or how often this need occurs beyond the two name-change requests. [signal:2410cdff-1328-4cb7-91fe-9f40d631aa93] [signal:6f9f9f78-8742-4cbd-8ff6-4693e01b3775]

No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem

Other customers say they like or use gesture control, including for music playback. [signal:5cd1745b-f66c-4238-9133-48d74f2e4a87] [signal:64cf9c8f-5a5f-4e45-861c-ab15b31f11d6] [signal:7e559130-165f-4503-b2e1-24671e3d21e8]

## What customers say

A G60 customer missed the feature from a prior BMW, while another G60 customer said they liked using it to manage music playback. [signal:c91210b7-8a99-459b-81b6-b3f8a8470d9c] [signal:5cd1745b-f66c-4238-9133-48d74f2e4a87]

## Differences between markets
