[signal:b83ad4db-fd6f-42d0-9caf-f725c97a4166] [signal:c5ddf868-d98d-4766-8887-a27b29936c5b] [signal:c91210b7-8a99-459b-81b6-b3f8a8470d9c] [signal:5cd1745b-f66c-4238-9133-48d74f2e4a87] [signal:64cf9c8f-5a5f-4e45-861c-ab15b31f11d6] [signal:7e559130-165f-4503-b2e1-24671e3d21e8]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the difficulty using gesture control or the requests for its return are. [signal:b83ad4db-fd6f-42d0-9caf-f725c97a4166] [signal:c5ddf868-d98d-4766-8887-a27b29936c5b] [signal:c91210b7-8a99-459b-81b6-b3f8a8470d9c]

value.title: Panorama roof opening limits, rattles and glass failures
value.summary: Customers report panorama roof problems including failure to open, rattling, cracking and limited opening. Signals come from customers in the USA and Europe across G70, G60 and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Reports include roofs that will not open, rattle, crack or open only halfway.
Signals span USA G70 and G60 vehicles and Europe F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report a range of panorama roof issues: a roof that will not open, a rattle, cracked glass, and opening restricted to halfway. [signal:266ce17a-5af1-45be-a24e-a48baf18bbf1] [signal:548cbc38-5fb7-423c-a6b5-ecac52980bb7] [signal:90a1b6ab-5d26-4343-a32d-23a7316f0b2c] [signal:5933a9e3-4313-43ef-ae50-87e3a08a6b94]

## What customers say
A USA G70 owner says the sunroof will not open; the same report appears twice in the signals. [signal:266ce17a-5af1-45be-a24e-a48baf18bbf1] [signal:fe814e5c-3bc6-4a9c-9832-9f437ceafef5]
A Europe F70 owner reports a sunroof rattle from the start and says the vehicle had been back to the dealer several times for it. [signal:548cbc38-5fb7-423c-a6b5-ecac52980bb7]
A USA G70 owner says the Sky Lounge glass cracked less than two months after purchase; the dealer identified a glass defect, but had not provided a repair date. [signal:90a1b6ab-5d26-4343-a32d-23a7316f0b2c]
A USA G60 owner objects that the sunroof opens no more than halfway, while another USA G70 owner says the car lacks an opening sunroof. [signal:5933a9e3-4313-43ef-ae50-87e3a08a6b94] [signal:cda190a3-2ae9-4122-b772-bc9aa22ca8db]

## Differences between markets
The signals include reports from the USA for G70 and G60 vehicles and from Europe for an F70 vehicle. [signal:266ce17a-5af1-45be-a24e-a48baf18bbf1] [signal:5933a9e3-4313-43ef-ae50-87e3a08a6b94] [signal:548cbc38-5fb7-423c-a6b5-ecac52980bb7]
The reported issues differ: USA signals mention opening limitations and cracked glass, while the Europe signal describes a rattle. [signal:5933a9e3-4313-43ef-ae50-87e3a08a6b94] [signal:90a1b6ab-5d26-4343-a32d-23a7316f0b2c] [signal:548cbc38-5fb7-423c-a6b5-ecac52980bb7]

## Open questions
Do the reports of a roof that will not open and one that opens only halfway reflect different roof configurations or different faults? [signal:266ce17a-5af1-45be-a24e-a48baf18bbf1] [signal:5933a9e3-4313-43ef-ae50-87e3a08a6b94]
What caused the reported rattle and glass crack, and how long did repair take? [signal:548cbc38-5fb7-423c-a6b5-ecac52980bb7] [signal:90a1b6ab-5d26-4343-a32d-23a7316f0b2c]

value.title: Panorama roof operation and opening limits are unclear
value.summary: Some customers are unsure how the glass roof operates, including whether it opens fully, can be opened at all, or can tilt. One customer valued having a sunroof, while others reported difficulty or sought operating guidance.
highlights: Customers report unclear controls, unexpected operating behavior, and uncertainty about how far the roof opens.
The provided signals include USA customers with G70 and G60 vehicles; the case contains 17 signals.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers sought help understanding roof operation, including how to tilt it, whether it opens, and whether it should slide fully open. [signal:be401f90-1ed5-4e9c-b461-972495d856ac] [signal:81e8d426-e3b6-421b-ab40-9e92a4e420fd] [signal:2ef17f3a-ea75-4da0-a94f-c7783b1cfab6]
A customer reported that the shade initially did not work, and another said an automatic opening behavior had stopped. [signal:08e975db-f55f-488d-8d49-9d5ef672504c] [signal:1292aff1-880b-4dda-a335-99ba48878e51]

## What customers say
One customer was told that pressing the center of the opening toggle tilts the roof. [signal:be401f90-1ed5-4e9c-b461-972495d856ac]
Customers asked whether the roof could open and whether it was meant to slide all the way; in one case, the customer was told it is fixed glass, and in another, that it is not designed to open fully. [signal:81e8d426-e3b6-421b-ab40-9e92a4e420fd] [signal:2ef17f3a-ea75-4da0-a94f-c7783b1cfab6]
A customer described having a sunroof on the i5 as a plus, while also reporting an initial shade issue. [signal:7b3bb6df-0599-4854-b732-b74cd4fc952d] [signal:08e975db-f55f-488d-8d49-9d5ef672504c]

## Differences between markets
The provided signals are from the USA and include G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:08e975db-f55f-488d-8d49-9d5ef672504c] [signal:1292aff1-880b-4dda-a335-99ba48878e51] [signal:2ef17f3a-ea75-4da0-a94f-c7783b1cfab6] [signal:7b3bb6df-0599-4854-b732-b74cd4fc952d] [signal:81e8d426-e3b6-421b-ab40-9e92a4e420fd] [signal:be401f90-1ed5-4e9c-b461-972495d856ac]

## Open questions
Do customers understand which roof functions are available on their vehicle, given questions about opening, full sliding, and tilt operation? [signal:81e8d426-e3b6-421b-ab40-9e92a4e420fd] [signal:2ef17f3a-ea75-4da0-a94f-c7783b1cfab6] [signal:be401f90-1ed5-4e9c-b461-972495d856ac]
What explains the reported change in automatic roof behavior, and how often do shade or control issues occur? [signal:1292aff1-880b-4dda-a335-99ba48878e51] [signal:08e975db-f55f-488d-8d49-9d5ef672504c]

value.title: Sluggish shifts and delayed response when pulling away
value.summary: Some F70 drivers in Europe report sluggish gear changes and a noticeable delay between pressing the accelerator and pulling away. One also describes a dead spot that makes gentle parking manoeuvres difficult.
highlights: Sluggish shifts and delayed pull-away response are reported.
Two Europe signals concern the F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Two Europe F70 signals describe sluggish gear changes or a delay in response when pulling away from a standstill. [signal:16819e0c-425d-4a5f-840e-faa300201765] [signal:e87dcd69-3ff7-4430-b178-46ed4320a906]

## What customers say
One driver reports a dead spot on the accelerator that makes gentle parking manoeuvres difficult, and says the gearbox is slow to change down when slowing. [signal:16819e0c-425d-4a5f-840e-faa300201765]
Another describes sluggish upshifts and noticeable lag between pressing the accelerator and pulling away. [signal:e87dcd69-3ff7-4430-b178-46ed4320a906]

## Differences between markets
Both transmission-related signals are from Europe and concern the F70; the provided signals contain no transmission feedback from another market or vehicle line. [signal:16819e0c-425d-4a5f-840e-faa300201765] [signal:e87dcd69-3ff7-4430-b178-46ed4320a906]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these experiences are beyond the two reports, or whether they reflect the same transmission behaviour. [signal:16819e0c-425d-4a5f-840e-faa300201765] [signal:e87dcd69-3ff7-4430-b178-46ed4320a906]

value.title: Panorama glass roof admits noise and develops rattles
value.summary: Customers report highway noise, rattling, or cracking-like sounds associated with the glass roof. Reports come from USA, Europe, and Rest of World owners across G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Glass-roof noise ranges from highway noise to rattles and cracking-like sounds.
Four sound-related reports: USA (2), Europe (1), and Rest of World (1), across G60, G70, and F70.
One Rest of World quote contains an incomplete comparison with an unnamed competitor.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe unwanted sound associated with the panorama glass roof, including loud interior noise at highway speeds, rattling, and a cracking-like noise. [signal:2f62fb1f-dfe4-4827-8931-216c300081aa] [signal:90696e81-9003-4c0c-b1aa-463e08515f99] [signal:ba650884-4041-4add-acf1-17eef3b24836] One owner says the sunroof seems to let in more ambient noise. [signal:ffe532bd-2a96-48ab-9466-5c41412304d5]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner says cabin noise gets really loud above 55 mph and that service staff also noticed it, but could not find a cause; a similar car had the same problem. [signal:2f62fb1f-dfe4-4827-8931-216c300081aa] A USA G70 owner describes a cracking-like sound mainly from the rear area of the glass sunroof. [signal:90696e81-9003-4c0c-b1aa-463e08515f99] A Europe F70 owner reports a sunroof rattle from the start and says the car had been back to the dealer several times for it. [signal:ba650884-4041-4add-acf1-17eef3b24836] A Rest of World G60 owner says the sunroof seems to let in more ambient noise. [signal:ffe532bd-2a96-48ab-9466-5c41412304d5]

## Differences between markets
The USA reports describe loud highway noise in a G60 and a cracking-like sound in a G70. [signal:2f62fb1f-dfe4-4827-8931-216c300081aa] [signal:90696e81-9003-4c0c-b1aa-463e08515f99] The Europe report concerns a sunroof rattle in an F70, while the Rest of World report describes ambient noise in a G60. [signal:ba650884-4041-4add-acf1-17eef3b24836] [signal:ffe532bd-2a96-48ab-9466-5c41412304d5] The reported sound types differ; the signals do not establish whether the underlying issue is the same across markets. [signal:2f62fb1f-dfe4-4827-8931-216c300081aa] [signal:90696e81-9003-4c0c-b1aa-463e08515f99] [signal:ba650884-4041-4add-acf1-17eef3b24836] [signal:ffe532bd-2a96-48ab-9466-5c41412304d5]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the causes of the different sounds or whether they occur under the same driving conditions. [signal:2f62fb1f-dfe4-4827-8931-216c300081aa] [signal:90696e81-9003-4c0c-b1aa-463e08515f99] [signal:ba650884-4041-4add-acf1-17eef3b24836] [signal:ffe532bd-2a96-48ab-9466-5c41412304d5] The Rest of World quote ends with an incomplete comparison to “ko,” so the competitor reference cannot be identified from the signal. [signal:ffe532bd-2a96-48ab-9466-5c41412304d5]

value.title: Gesture control triggers unintended radio changes
value.summary: Drivers and passengers report that ordinary hand movements can trigger gesture control and change or mute the radio. One driver also reports inconsistent response when deliberately using gestures.
highlights: Talking or resting a hand can trigger unintended radio changes.
The six supplied signals are from USA drivers in G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers report gesture control reacting to ordinary movements, including gestures made while talking and a hand resting near the cupholder. One driver says the system can trigger accidentally yet fail to respond to an intended gesture. [signal:16cc5361-6fc2-4f5d-8cab-e899e6163f4c] [signal:35d995aa-3444-4c73-a669-ad2f3819af9e] [signal:35ef3e6b-c187-4c7e-aebb-5a8c6722d448] [signal:8354ed11-f73d-47ab-b6bf-ee040aeaa8e5] [signal:cfecf902-9b3b-4353-acc3-1c83b454a8a0] [signal:ebc1f9dd-e3d6-417e-a0e7-86e96280bf55]

## What customers say
A G60 driver says gestures while talking have caused unintended changes and led him to switch gesture control off. [signal:16cc5361-6fc2-4f5d-8cab-e899e6163f4c] A G70 passenger’s movements reportedly changed radio settings, and another G70 customer said his wife accidentally triggered radio gestures while talking. [signal:35ef3e6b-c187-4c7e-aebb-5a8c6722d448] [signal:35d995aa-3444-4c73-a669-ad2f3819af9e]

A G60 customer reports accidentally muting the radio while talking with her hands. [signal:8354ed11-f73d-47ab-b6bf-ee040aeaa8e5] Another G60 customer says a hand resting over the cupholder can trigger pause. [signal:ebc1f9dd-e3d6-417e-a0e7-86e96280bf55] One G60 customer reports both unintended song changes and missed attempts to skip a track. [signal:cfecf902-9b3b-4353-acc3-1c83b454a8a0]

## Differences between markets
All six supplied signals are from the USA and concern G60 or G70 vehicles; the sample contains no signals from other markets. [signal:16cc5361-6fc2-4f5d-8cab-e899e6163f4c] [signal:35d995aa-3444-4c73-a669-ad2f3819af9e] [signal:35ef3e6b-c187-4c7e-aebb-5a8c6722d448] [signal:8354ed11-f73d-47ab-b6bf-ee040aeaa8e5] [signal:cfecf902-9b3b-4353-acc3-1c83b454a8a0] [signal:ebc1f9dd-e3d6-417e-a0e7-86e96280bf55]

## Open questions
Do unintended triggers and missed deliberate gestures occur under different conditions? One customer reports both behaviors, but the signal does not identify the conditions. [signal:cfecf902-9b3b-4353-acc3-1c83b454a8a0] How often do passengers trigger the feature, and which movements cause it? The supplied passenger-related reports describe incidents but do not quantify frequency or specify the movements. [signal:35d995aa-3444-4c73-a669-ad2f3819af9e] [signal:35ef3e6b-c187-4c7e-aebb-5a8c6722d448]

value.title: Driver profiles switch, forget preferences or require repeated login
value.summary: Drivers report profiles switching between users, failing to restore saved settings, or requiring repeated login. The reports come from USA G60 and G70 owners and Europe F70 owners.
highlights: Profiles switch unexpectedly, lose preferences, or require repeated login.
Reports span USA G60 and G70 vehicles and Europe F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers report profile reliability problems, including unexpected switching between users, settings not being restored, and repeated login requests. [signal:13b219da-40b4-4a65-9530-d3b565a11b07] [signal:68249d93-dca5-410a-9482-505f210e352a] [signal:7c44a5c6-d90f-4c23-ad61-d747d96b393d] [signal:e6ccf0ea-e39a-4da3-ac4d-ee1c8e0117f5]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner says the car keeps switching between two profiles and can play the other user's music. [signal:13b219da-40b4-4a65-9530-d3b565a11b07]
A Europe F70 owner says settings are wiped between drives, while another reports having to scan the QR code again every two or three trips. [signal:68249d93-dca5-410a-9482-505f210e352a] [signal:7c44a5c6-d90f-4c23-ad61-d747d96b393d]
A USA G70 owner says the profile appears with their name, but preferences such as AC temperature and seat position are not restored. [signal:e6ccf0ea-e39a-4da3-ac4d-ee1c8e0117f5]
A Europe F70 owner also reports that the key system has difficulty identifying who is approaching when two people arrive together. [signal:560926ec-1537-48f2-8bcb-99cebd005932]

## Differences between markets
USA reports describe profiles switching between users in a G60 and saved preferences not returning in a G70. [signal:13b219da-40b4-4a65-9530-d3b565a11b07] [signal:e6ccf0ea-e39a-4da3-ac4d-ee1c8e0117f5]
Europe F70 reports describe settings being wiped, repeated QR-code login, and difficulty identifying the approaching user. [signal:68249d93-dca5-410a-9482-505f210e352a] [signal:7c44a5c6-d90f-4c23-ad61-d747d96b393d] [signal:560926ec-1537-48f2-8bcb-99cebd005932]

## Open questions
Do the reports describe separate causes, or related profile reliability problems across vehicle lines? [signal:13b219da-40b4-4a65-9530-d3b565a11b07] [signal:68249d93-dca5-410a-9482-505f210e352a] [signal:7c44a5c6-d90f-4c23-ad61-d747d96b393d] [signal:e6ccf0ea-e39a-4da3-ac4d-ee1c8e0117f5]
How often do profile login and user-identification problems occur beyond these reports? [signal:560926ec-1537-48f2-8bcb-99cebd005932] [signal:7c44a5c6-d90f-4c23-ad61-d747d96b393d]

value.title: High-beam assistant switches off too slowly for oncoming cars
value.summary: A driver of a BMW F70 in Europe reports that, with the lights set to automatic, high beam sometimes takes too long to switch off when a car approaches.
highlights: High beam sometimes switches off too slowly for oncoming traffic.
One reported case: Europe, BMW F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A driver reports that automatic high beam sometimes does not switch off quickly enough when a car is coming towards them. [signal:44bc9637-cfd0-479e-90b9-d42073029439]

## What customers say
The driver describes this as their only real concern with the vehicle so far. [signal:44bc9637-cfd0-479e-90b9-d42073029439]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from Europe, so there is no evidence to compare markets. [signal:44bc9637-cfd0-479e-90b9-d42073029439]

## Open questions
How often does the delayed switch-off occur, and under what driving conditions? [signal:44bc9637-cfd0-479e-90b9-d42073029439]

value.title: Engine and exhaust sound lacks inspiration
value.summary: A European F70 driver says the engine and exhaust sound is not inspiring. A Rest of World G70 complaint mentions gear-shift problems but does not comment on transmission sound.
highlights: The F70’s engine and exhaust sound is described as uninspiring.
Signals cover one European F70 and one Rest of World G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A European F70 driver says the engine and exhaust sound is not very inspiring. [signal:72b2f397-7031-483d-a520-17f8e4733236]

## What customers say
The F70 driver also reports that after slowing down, the car changes down and may drop one or two gears when accelerating again, making the engine revvy and the car jerky. [signal:72b2f397-7031-483d-a520-17f8e4733236] A Rest of World G70 owner reports a gear-shift error and a D-to-S change issue, but does not mention sound. [signal:8611bb33-8e2e-4d3d-8145-cc20e2d2d43a]

## Differences between markets
The European signal describes uninspiring engine and exhaust sound alongside downshifting and re-acceleration behavior. [signal:72b2f397-7031-483d-a520-17f8e4733236] The Rest of World signal mentions gear-shift issues but provides no view on sound. [signal:8611bb33-8e2e-4d3d-8145-cc20e2d2d43a]

## Open questions
How common are these sound and shift-behavior concerns among F70 drivers? [signal:72b2f397-7031-483d-a520-17f8e4733236] Are the reported G70 gear-shift issues related to the sound concern? [signal:8611bb33-8e2e-4d3d-8145-cc20e2d2d43a]

value.title: Driver profiles are confusing to set up and recognize
value.summary: Customers report time-consuming setup, repeated sign-ins, and profiles loading for the wrong driver or not applying settings. Signals span F70, G60 and G70 vehicles in the USA, Europe and Rest of World.
highlights: Profile setup, sign-in, recognition and settings can be difficult or unreliable.
Signals cover USA, Europe and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe driver profiles as taking time to set up, requiring repeated QR-code sign-ins, or loading the wrong profile. Some also report that profile-linked seat settings do not apply, and that it is unclear which settings are driver-specific versus vehicle-wide. [signal:79d56777-9bd9-4764-8d57-d9498c4cd9db] [signal:dd9ad3b9-8622-459c-8b6f-e9697952a0c7] [signal:005dc0e2-6e43-4215-b439-b61c47aeb743] [signal:16cd7984-9482-4a57-8485-9e2f05e4d13a] [signal:17f7d17e-9513-420b-8153-bc4b6e8c63fa]

## What customers say
One customer says profile setup takes a while for each driver. [signal:79d56777-9bd9-4764-8d57-d9498c4cd9db] Another reports having to scan a QR code again every two or three trips. [signal:dd9ad3b9-8622-459c-8b6f-e9697952a0c7]

Customers describe profile recognition switching to Guest when entering with a Digital Key, loading a spouse's profile instead of the driver's, or mistaking another registered user for the driver. [signal:005dc0e2-6e43-4215-b439-b61c47aeb743] [signal:1f65a438-de8d-44a6-8b98-99870fdd1872] [signal:8038efba-a947-4198-9147-929983982bc8] A customer also says the seat does not adjust after selecting a profile, and reports being asked to log in with a phone to modify the setting. [signal:16cd7984-9482-4a57-8485-9e2f05e4d13a]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include profile-usability complaints from the USA, Europe and Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:005dc0e2-6e43-4215-b439-b61c47aeb743] [signal:10fe4d17-473d-4a4f-8821-fd9480bbb121] [signal:9b7294d0-bb2f-4c4a-b7b6-9441d039d4c5] [signal:79d56777-9bd9-4764-8d57-d9498c4cd9db]

USA signals mention profile recognition, seat settings and distinguishing driver-specific settings from vehicle-wide settings. [signal:1f65a438-de8d-44a6-8b98-99870fdd1872] [signal:16cd7984-9482-4a57-8485-9e2f05e4d13a] [signal:17f7d17e-9513-420b-8153-bc4b6e8c63fa] Europe signals include repeated QR-code sign-ins and a complaint about attaching two keys to one profile. [signal:dd9ad3b9-8622-459c-8b6f-e9697952a0c7] [signal:9b7294d0-bb2f-4c4a-b7b6-9441d039d4c5] A Rest of World signal describes another registered user being mistaken for the driver. [signal:8038efba-a947-4198-9147-929983982bc8]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often these issues occur across all 41 case signals or how experiences vary by vehicle line. What circumstances lead to repeated QR-code sign-ins, and when does profile recognition select someone other than the driver? [signal:dd9ad3b9-8622-459c-8b6f-e9697952a0c7] [signal:1f65a438-de8d-44a6-8b98-99870fdd1872]

value.title: Manual transmission choice is missing for some customers
value.summary: Some customers want a manual transmission option, particularly in Europe’s F70 and in a USA G70 signal. Other customers praise the transmission’s smooth shifting or behavior.
highlights: Some customers say automatic-only availability leaves them without their preferred transmission choice.
Manual preference appears in four Europe F70 signals and one USA G70 signal.
One Rest of World signal says other cars and transmissions in the class are better.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want a manual transmission, and one Europe F70 customer says the model is available only with an automatic gearbox in the UK. [signal:1ae363fa-4202-4613-af00-8e35d188efd5] [signal:34060945-24bb-48b1-9621-0aa55aef4b52] [signal:3e508915-d47a-42c3-ae2c-445438ef6276] [signal:761d91e3-9e2e-4b7e-8402-d27e80d2b5cf] A USA G70 customer also prefers a manual transmission. [signal:99a004b9-f29b-47ce-8b11-7d08cf44854f]

## What customers say
The manual preference appears in four Europe F70 signals and one USA G70 signal. [signal:1ae363fa-4202-4613-af00-8e35d188efd5] [signal:34060945-24bb-48b1-9621-0aa55aef4b52] [signal:3e508915-d47a-42c3-ae2c-445438ef6276] [signal:761d91e3-9e2e-4b7e-8402-d27e80d2b5cf] [signal:99a004b9-f29b-47ce-8b11-7d08cf44854f] Other feedback is positive: a USA G60 customer describes shifting as very smooth, and another says they are pleased with the transmission’s behavior. [signal:2d72830a-58ed-4216-9989-08f5c2f36b67] [signal:b34d077d-5686-4f41-9164-bb885218ebdb]

## Differences between markets
Manual preference is reported in Europe for the F70 and in the USA for the G70. [signal:1ae363fa-4202-4613-af00-8e35d188efd5] [signal:34060945-24bb-48b1-9621-0aa55aef4b52] [signal:3e508915-d47a-42c3-ae2c-445438ef6276] [signal:761d91e3-9e2e-4b7e-8402-d27e80d2b5cf] [signal:99a004b9-f29b-47ce-8b11-7d08cf44854f] Positive transmission feedback appears in USA G60 signals. [signal:2d72830a-58ed-4216-9989-08f5c2f36b67] [signal:b34d077d-5686-4f41-9164-bb885218ebdb]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread manual preference is beyond these reports, or whether the preference varies by vehicle line or market. [signal:1ae363fa-4202-4613-af00-8e35d188efd5] [signal:34060945-24bb-48b1-9621-0aa55aef4b52] [signal:3e508915-d47a-42c3-ae2c-445438ef6276] [signal:761d91e3-9e2e-4b7e-8402-d27e80d2b5cf] [signal:99a004b9-f29b-47ce-8b11-7d08cf44854f] One Rest of World customer says other cars and transmissions in the class are better, without specifying a comparison or transmission detail. [signal:5f9eb652-d6bc-48be-9701-938e4b659b14]

value.title: High-beam assistant valued for responsive, effortless lighting
value.summary: Customers in the USA value the high-beam assistant, describing it as quick and responsive and saying automatic beam changes made an open-road drive feel effortless.
highlights: Customers value the automatic, responsive beam changes and effortless-feeling drive.
Signals cover three customers in the USA, across G70 and G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals describe a valued feature rather than a reported problem: customers appreciate automatic bright lights and responsive switching between high and low beams. [signal:5e85cd7c-f0d0-4648-8e1f-74f26907dcc3] [signal:a78e3320-f2d6-40b3-bac6-2c73d28b54cc] One customer said automatic beam changes made an open-road trip feel effortless. [signal:e6354eb6-0e3b-46b4-ac42-ac3be78d0ca3]

## What customers say
A G70 customer appreciated the automatic bright lights feature. [signal:5e85cd7c-f0d0-4648-8e1f-74f26907dcc3] A G60 customer praised the assistant’s speed and responsiveness. [signal:a78e3320-f2d6-40b3-bac6-2c73d28b54cc] Another G60 customer described automatic high- and low-beam changes on the drive home as making the trip feel effortless. [signal:e6354eb6-0e3b-46b4-ac42-ac3be78d0ca3]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA, covering G70 and G60 vehicles; there are no signals from other markets to compare. [signal:5e85cd7c-f0d0-4648-8e1f-74f26907dcc3] [signal:a78e3320-f2d6-40b3-bac6-2c73d28b54cc] [signal:e6354eb6-0e3b-46b4-ac42-ac3be78d0ca3]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how customers perceive the feature in other driving conditions or markets. [signal:5e85cd7c-f0d0-4648-8e1f-74f26907dcc3] [signal:a78e3320-f2d6-40b3-bac6-2c73d28b54cc] [signal:e6354eb6-0e3b-46b4-ac42-ac3be78d0ca3]

value.title: Transmission faults and inconsistent shifting
value.summary: Customers report transmission failures, replacement gearboxes, and shifting that feels rough or uncertain. Signals concern F70 owners in Europe and G70 owners in the USA.
highlights: Reported issues range from rough, slipping shifts to a failed transmission.
Signals concern F70 in Europe and G70 in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe transmission behavior that is rough, noisy, jerky, or uncertain about gear selection. Other reports describe slipping or serious faults, including a transmission failure and a replacement gearbox. [signal:1eaca993-2436-44a1-9e41-dc5164ff7f2d] [signal:04cc33ed-7994-4ff5-bac9-89202b1eaf88] [signal:6326c0b7-c6ee-4fe7-a2a1-6d69cc5a3003] [signal:5abb105c-4d66-46d0-9ede-566b4cd1abf3] [signal:cbcffed0-3115-4481-a4e9-454f1df1e4b0]

## What customers say
An F70 owner describes delayed downshifting near junctions followed by a jerky response when pressing the throttle. [signal:04cc33ed-7994-4ff5-bac9-89202b1eaf88] F70 owners also report gearbox noise and juddering, uncertain gear selection, slipping while accelerating on roundabouts, and an “awful” transmission. [signal:1eaca993-2436-44a1-9e41-dc5164ff7f2d] [signal:6326c0b7-c6ee-4fe7-a2a1-6d69cc5a3003] [signal:bce66094-2b1d-4358-8aae-de7e998f078c] One F70 owner says serious faults led to multiple garage visits and a replacement gearbox. [signal:cbcffed0-3115-4481-a4e9-454f1df1e4b0] A G70 owner reports that the first 760’s transmission failed at about 380 miles. [signal:5abb105c-4d66-46d0-9ede-566b4cd1abf3]

## Differences between markets
The supplied Europe signals concern the F70 and include complaints about shifting smoothness, gear selection, slipping, and transmission replacement. [signal:04cc33ed-7994-4ff5-bac9-89202b1eaf88] [signal:1eaca993-2436-44a1-9e41-dc5164ff7f2d] [signal:6326c0b7-c6ee-4fe7-a2a1-6d69cc5a3003] [signal:bce66094-2b1d-4358-8aae-de7e998f078c] [signal:cbcffed0-3115-4481-a4e9-454f1df1e4b0] The supplied USA transmission report concerns a G70 and describes a failure at about 380 miles. [signal:5abb105c-4d66-46d0-9ede-566b4cd1abf3] These reports describe different symptoms; the signals do not establish whether the underlying issues are related.

## Open questions
How often do the reported shifting complaints and failures occur across the affected vehicle lines? [signal:04cc33ed-7994-4ff5-bac9-89202b1eaf88] [signal:1eaca993-2436-44a1-9e41-dc5164ff7f2d] [signal:5abb105c-4d66-46d0-9ede-566b4cd1abf3] Are the reported rough or uncertain shifts related to the failures and gearbox replacement in other reports? [signal:1eaca993-2436-44a1-9e41-dc5164ff7f2d] [signal:cbcffed0-3115-4481-a4e9-454f1df1e4b0]

value.title: Transmission response and gear changes feel inconsistent
value.summary: Some European F70 and US G60 owners report delayed or awkward transmission responses, while US G60 and G70 owners also praise smooth shifting. The signals therefore show differing experiences across markets and vehicles.
highlights: Some owners report delayed engagement, awkward gear changes, or jerky low-speed behavior.
Reports include European F70 and US G60 owners; positive shifting feedback also comes from US G60 and G70 owners.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners describe transmission responses as delayed or awkward, including hesitation when shifting from Drive to Reverse and a lurch near junctions. [signal:5105fd1c-c128-4ddd-aa65-ce971b297153] [signal:672f1b13-75ad-46e4-95ca-a0349f910372]
A US G60 owner says the shift from Park to Drive takes a second or two, while noting they do not consider it a problem requiring repair. [signal:84a563e2-7bdb-4982-a545-82478969f064]

## What customers say
A European F70 owner calls the transmission awful, and another says its behavior differs from other BMW models they have owned. [signal:31a99263-2f2a-42c2-9973-b7e90f539182] [signal:61afac67-d955-48f9-80b9-9cc947b7adc3]
A European F70 owner reports that the gearbox does not select the lowest gear approaching junctions until throttle is applied, after which the car lurches. [signal:672f1b13-75ad-46e4-95ca-a0349f910372]
Other US owners give positive feedback: one says the transmission shifts fantastically, and another describes the shifts as very smooth. [signal:2e4b966e-c462-4096-8e8e-0ef7e4765d47] [signal:9f8b6171-b8ab-472c-95ff-088f2810b637]

## Differences between markets
The negative transmission reports shown here come from European F70 and US G60 owners. [signal:5105fd1c-c128-4ddd-aa65-ce971b297153] [signal:672f1b13-75ad-46e4-95ca-a0349f910372] [signal:84a563e2-7bdb-4982-a545-82478969f064]
Positive shifting feedback comes from US G60 and G70 owners, so the signals do not show a uniformly negative experience. [signal:2e4b966e-c462-4096-8e8e-0ef7e4765d47] [signal:9f8b6171-b8ab-472c-95ff-088f2810b637]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the reported delays or awkward shifts occur across vehicles. [signal:5105fd1c-c128-4ddd-aa65-ce971b297153] [signal:84a563e2-7bdb-4982-a545-82478969f064]
The signals also do not explain why some US owners praise the shifting while other owners report delays or awkward behavior. [signal:2e4b966e-c462-4096-8e8e-0ef7e4765d47] [signal:9f8b6171-b8ab-472c-95ff-088f2810b637] [signal:672f1b13-75ad-46e4-95ca-a0349f910372]

value.title: Transmission shifts feel rough, jerky or slow to respond
value.summary: Customers report rough or jerky shifts, delays in engagement and slow transmission responses across several BMW vehicle lines. The signals come from Europe and the USA.
highlights: Transmission shifts can feel rough, jerky or delayed.
Reports cover F70 in Europe and G70 and G60 in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe transmission behavior that feels rough or jerky, or responds slowly when shifting or accelerating. [signal:0230ace1-3cf5-436b-a03e-8b5b78d8cdfc] [signal:1f21712b-0e61-4e35-9ed4-64bbecf7550a] [signal:2ebdf94e-db6f-402f-8ed7-35a7181abb6c] [signal:36514795-49a4-4955-99ec-6cc65c826cbc]

## What customers say
In Europe, F70 owners report jerky low-speed maneuvering, slow acceleration response, and delays or odd behavior when changing between drive and reverse. [signal:1b679c2d-ad28-4f66-89b1-7270bfc1966f] [signal:1f21712b-0e61-4e35-9ed4-64bbecf7550a] [signal:491f8a8d-3d22-481c-bf77-5bee7877dfed]

In the USA, G70 owners describe rough shifts, noticeable kicks on downshifts, or a long delay after pressing the accelerator again. [signal:2ebdf94e-db6f-402f-8ed7-35a7181abb6c] [signal:36514795-49a4-4955-99ec-6cc65c826cbc] [signal:56f8d298-8f93-4559-ad06-c465efde3347]

USA G60 reports describe a jerk when changing between reverse and drive or moving off in a parking lot, and a brief delay between selecting a gear and engagement. [signal:3da12c66-7cfb-4f01-8eb7-54af0ba5602e] [signal:6fdeead5-0fa3-4cdf-ace7-1c80c527c6bd]

## Differences between markets
The European reports shown concern the F70 and include jerky low-speed behavior and slow or unusual responses. [signal:1b679c2d-ad28-4f66-89b1-7270bfc1966f] [signal:1f21712b-0e61-4e35-9ed4-64bbecf7550a] [signal:491f8a8d-3d22-481c-bf77-5bee7877dfed]

The USA reports shown concern G70 and G60 vehicles and describe rough shifts, kicks, jerks, or delayed engagement. [signal:2ebdf94e-db6f-402f-8ed7-35a7181abb6c] [signal:36514795-49a4-4955-99ec-6cc65c826cbc] [signal:3da12c66-7cfb-4f01-8eb7-54af0ba5602e] [signal:6fdeead5-0fa3-4cdf-ace7-1c80c527c6bd]

## Open questions
Do the reported shift and engagement behaviors have a common cause across these vehicles and markets? [signal:1f21712b-0e61-4e35-9ed4-64bbecf7550a] [signal:36514795-49a4-4955-99ec-6cc65c826cbc] [signal:6fdeead5-0fa3-4cdf-ace7-1c80c527c6bd]

How often do the reported delays occur, and under what driving conditions? [signal:36514795-49a4-4955-99ec-6cc65c826cbc] [signal:3da12c66-7cfb-4f01-8eb7-54af0ba5602e] [signal:6fdeead5-0fa3-4cdf-ace7-1c80c527c6bd]

value.title: Phone connection does not follow the active driver profile
value.summary: A G60 owner in the USA says Apple CarPlay often connects to the last-used phone rather than the phone associated with the active BMW profile. The owner also wants more than two driver profiles for adult children who use the car.
highlights: CarPlay may connect to the last-used phone instead of the active driver’s phone.
One G60 owner in the USA reports the issue and wants more driver profiles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 owner says Apple CarPlay often connects to the last-used phone, which may not belong to the person driving under the active BMW profile. [signal:b041f2b9-673a-4db9-9466-dbc330f28cd8]

## What customers say
The owner wants the phone linked to the active BMW profile to connect, and says the car should support more than two driver profiles so adult children using a key can have their own profiles rather than relying on the guest setting. [signal:b041f2b9-673a-4db9-9466-dbc330f28cd8]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from the USA, so there is no market comparison. [signal:b041f2b9-673a-4db9-9466-dbc330f28cd8]

## Open questions
The signal does not establish how often this occurs across other drivers or vehicles. [signal:b041f2b9-673a-4db9-9466-dbc330f28cd8]

value.title: Front door handle unlocking is intermittently unresponsive
value.summary: A customer in Rest of World reports that the door-unlocking sensor sometimes does not respond to a touch. A separate USA report says a rear passenger door does not fully open when its handle button is pressed.
highlights: Door-handle unlocking sometimes fails to respond; a separate report describes incomplete rear-door opening.
One directly relevant report is from a Rest of World F70; a USA G70 report concerns the rear passenger door.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A Rest of World F70 owner says the door-unlocking sensor feels too insensitive and fails to react roughly one time in five when the handle is touched. [signal:810bc3ba-ee19-45d6-8f51-d8c4e5b97679]
A USA G70 owner separately reports that the rear passenger door never fully opens when the button on its handle is pressed. [signal:4de82bd2-5d13-425f-ae9e-bb21d712b486]

## What customers say
The F70 owner describes inconsistent response to touching the handle to unlock the doors. [signal:810bc3ba-ee19-45d6-8f51-d8c4e5b97679]
The G70 owner describes incomplete opening after pressing the rear passenger door’s handle button. [signal:4de82bd2-5d13-425f-ae9e-bb21d712b486]

## Differences between markets
The handle-touch unlocking complaint is from Rest of World on an F70, while the incomplete rear-door opening complaint is from the USA on a G70. [signal:810bc3ba-ee19-45d6-8f51-d8c4e5b97679] [signal:4de82bd2-5d13-425f-ae9e-bb21d712b486]

## Open questions
- Does the reported intermittent sensor response concern the front outer door handle?
- Are the two reported behaviors related, or do they concern different handle functions?

value.title: Front door handles feel awkward and difficult to use
value.summary: Some USA G60 and G70 customers find the front door handles awkward to grip or use, and some dislike electronics integrated into the handle. One customer also found the small key-access plate confusing.
highlights: Some customers find the handles awkwardly positioned, hard to grip, or difficult to understand.
Signals are from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers describe the front door handles as awkward to use, hard to pull, or lacking enough depth for a proper grip. [signal:bd9032e5-1898-4557-8558-9ab9735e5a8b] [signal:f783cfbd-6a93-4e10-90a4-d1fb35b039b7] One G60 customer specifically calls the underhand design awkward. [signal:aaa92f94-a870-4e19-ae37-00dac7d20cda]

## What customers say
A G70 customer was unhappy with electronics integrated into the handles and preferred a classic handle design. [signal:9573ad5b-a07c-4159-b6a8-a419c55dfa5f] Another G70 customer did not understand the small plate that pops out when pressed; the explanation given was that it provides access for the physical key inside the fob. [signal:22d78891-118d-4a82-8ca2-f601abd9df80]

## Differences between markets
All provided signals are from the USA; they concern G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:22d78891-118d-4a82-8ca2-f601abd9df80] [signal:aaa92f94-a870-4e19-ae37-00dac7d20cda] [signal:bd9032e5-1898-4557-8558-9ab9735e5a8b] [signal:f783cfbd-6a93-4e10-90a4-d1fb35b039b7] [signal:9573ad5b-a07c-4159-b6a8-a419c55dfa5f] [signal:d202af9b-ac5f-40a1-838c-5582a55b26e0] The signals do not provide a comparison with other markets.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread each usability concern is or whether it differs between G60 and G70. [signal:aaa92f94-a870-4e19-ae37-00dac7d20cda] [signal:bd9032e5-1898-4557-8558-9ab9735e5a8b] [signal:f783cfbd-6a93-4e10-90a4-d1fb35b039b7] [signal:9573ad5b-a07c-4159-b6a8-a419c55dfa5f] [signal:22d78891-118d-4a82-8ca2-f601abd9df80]

value.title: Fuel flap delivery delays and freezing concern
value.summary: A customer reports a long wait for a fuel door on a new 760i xDrive, while another wants help preventing the flap from freezing closed. Both signals are from the USA and mention G70 or G60 vehicles.
highlights: A fuel door is taking a long time to arrive, and a fuel flap may freeze closed.
USA signals mention a 760i xDrive (G70) and a G60; two signals total.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One customer says the fuel door for a brand-new 760i xDrive is taking a long time to arrive. [signal:534a2818-11f6-47c2-a4ff-b503a9244d49] Another wants a feature to help keep the fuel filler flap from freezing closed in cold weather. [signal:91711d68-6cb2-40fd-962d-d5024e18f79f]

## What customers say
The 760i xDrive customer links the delayed fuel door to a lower rating. [signal:534a2818-11f6-47c2-a4ff-b503a9244d49] The G60 customer expresses a wish for protection against the flap freezing shut. [signal:91711d68-6cb2-40fd-962d-d5024e18f79f]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA, so the signals provide no cross-market comparison. [signal:534a2818-11f6-47c2-a4ff-b503a9244d49] [signal:91711d68-6cb2-40fd-962d-d5024e18f79f]

## Open questions
The signals do not say how long the fuel door takes to arrive or whether the freezing concern reflects a problem already experienced. [signal:534a2818-11f6-47c2-a4ff-b503a9244d49] [signal:91711d68-6cb2-40fd-962d-d5024e18f]

value.title: Fuel filler flap falls out and is difficult to open
value.summary: Two USA G70 customers report fuel-filler-flap problems: one says the lid fell out and could not be put back, while another struggled to work out how to open it.
highlights: One customer says the fuel flap fell out and could not be reattached; another struggled to open it.
Both signals are from USA G70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One customer reported that the fuel tank lid fell out at around 400 miles and could not be put back in. [signal:50c3a4e8-ece2-42dd-8922-75a7447a6612] Another said it took about 20 minutes of reading the manual to work out how to open the fuel door. [signal:91a0b9a0-f8c5-478f-bd12-0dde52611dd1]

## What customers say
The first customer could not provide further details during the call and was asked to send pictures. [signal:50c3a4e8-ece2-42dd-8922-75a7447a6612] The second customer described the fuel-door operation as difficult to figure out. [signal:91a0b9a0-f8c5-478f-bd12-0dde52611dd1]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from USA G70 customers, so the signals provide no market comparison. [signal:50c3a4e8-ece2-42dd-8922-75a7447a6612] [signal:91a0b9a0-f8c5-478f-bd12-0dde52611dd1]

## Open questions
It is not clear from the first signal how the lid came loose or whether it was subsequently reattached. [signal:50c3a4e8-ece2-42dd-8922-75a7447a6612] The signals do not establish whether the difficulty opening the fuel door is shared by other customers. [signal:91a0b9a0-f8c5-478f-bd12-0dde52611dd1]

value.title: Phone priorities fail to reliably select the intended device
value.summary: When multiple phones are in the car, customers report that the vehicle connects to the wrong phone or seems unable to choose, even when priorities are set. The issue appears in reports from the USA and Rest of World, while a Europe signal describes related phone-key difficulties.
highlights: The intended phone is not always selected, and customers say priority settings may not resolve competing connections.
Reports mention the USA (G60, G70), Rest of World (F70), and related phone-key difficulties in Europe (F70).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that when two phones are in the vehicle, the car may not select the intended phone, or the phones may compete for the connection. [signal:00361aba-9903-453c-838b-a1c84243b425] [signal:215e5f03-3fce-4f5e-838b-0e15b59f97ff] [signal:265bc9e6-5a28-4b81-8bc8-fae1db547c69]
A Rest of World report says phone recognition sometimes fails when both people are in the car, despite a priority being set. [signal:c20010fa-11e7-45d0-960d-c3f28c86befc]

## What customers say
In the USA, one customer says the car has trouble deciding which phone to connect to when both occupants are inside. [signal:00361aba-9903-453c-838b-a1c84243b425]
Other USA reports say the wife's phone takes over as primary, or that the priority list does not prevent the two phones from competing for the connection. [signal:06747a70-46f7-4b8d-867e-6f59f8831e68] [signal:265bc9e6-5a28-4b81-8bc8-fae1db547c69]
A USA customer also asked how the vehicle chooses which phone to connect to; the response described separate priority lists for each driver profile. [signal:17a54ec9-38bc-40e9-a941-919de8bee731]

## Differences between markets
USA reports describe phone selection or priority conflicts in G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:00361aba-9903-453c-838b-a1c84243b425] [signal:06747a70-46f7-4b8d-867e-6f59f8831e68] [signal:17a54ec9-38bc-40e9-a941-919de8bee731] [signal:215e5f03-3fce-4f5e-838b-0e15b59f97ff] [signal:265bc9e6-5a28-4b81-8bc8-fae1db547c69]
The Rest of World report describes phone recognition sometimes failing when both people are in an F70, even with a priority set. [signal:c20010fa-11e7-45d0-960d-c3f28c86befc]
A Europe F70 report describes phone-key resets and unlocking difficulties, but does not specify a telephone-priority conflict. [signal:2d69ed8a-ec48-408e-aa70-fd91faec6294]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often priority conflicts occur, or whether the behavior differs by phone, driver profile, or vehicle configuration. [signal:00361aba-9903-453c-838b-a1c84243b425] [signal:06747a70-46f7-4b8d-867e-6f59f8831e68] [signal:17a54ec9-38bc-40e9-a941-919de8bee731] [signal:215e5f03-3fce-4f5e-838b-0e15b59f97ff] [signal:265bc9e6-5a28-4b81-8bc8-fae1db547c69] [signal:c20010fa-11e7-45d0-960d-c3f28c86befc]

value.title: No extra trunk in the engine compartment
value.summary: A European G60 owner enjoys the i5 but regrets that the engine compartment does not provide extra trunk space.
highlights: An owner wants the engine compartment used for extra trunk space.
One signal: a Europe-based G60 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 owner says the engine compartment is not used to provide extra trunk space. [signal:fb69b1dc-80c0-4313-bb5a-8e24d35dd05f]

## What customers say
The owner enjoys driving the i5 and describes its ride as comfortable and finish as nice, but regrets the lack of extra trunk space in the engine compartment. [signal:fb69b1dc-80c0-4313-bb5a-8e24d35dd05f]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from Europe, so there is no market comparison in the available evidence. [signal:fb69b1dc-80c0-4313-bb5a-8e24d35dd05f]

## Open questions
How common is the desire for extra trunk space in the engine compartment among G60 owners or in other markets? [signal:fb69b1dc-80c0-4313-bb5a-8e24d35dd05f]

value.title: Front visor light failures reported in G70
value.summary: Two USA G70 customers reported a front visor light that was not functioning correctly. The available signals do not establish how widespread the issue is or whether it affects other vehicle lines.
highlights: Two customers reported a nonfunctioning front visor light.
Both reports are from USA G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Two USA G70 customers reported a front visor light that was not functioning correctly; one specified the driver's side. [signal:68eda34e-aef6-4ed2-9ae1-95fc2822f343] [signal:92c1c922-e017-4405-aebb-4ddbcc37ff1e]

## What customers say
One customer said the visor light issue had been raised with the dealership previously and was told parts needed to be ordered. [signal:68eda34e-aef6-4ed2-9ae1-95fc2822f343] Another said they planned to visit the dealership to have the driver's-side visor light checked. [signal:92c1c922-e017-4405-aebb-4ddbcc37ff1e]

## Differences between markets
Both reports are from the USA and concern the G70; the signals provide no evidence about other markets. [signal:68eda34e-aef6-4ed2-9ae1-95fc2822f343] [signal:92c1c922-e017-4405-aebb-4ddbcc37ff1e]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the cause, repair outcome, or frequency of the reported failures. [signal:68eda34e-aef6-4ed2-9ae1-95fc2822f343] [signal:92c1c922-e017-4405-aebb-4ddbcc37ff1e] The G60 signal does not provide usable information about a visor-light issue. [signal:f2627b33-5c19-4b06-aabe-abfb31cf1aa0]

value.title: Front sun visor lighting, coverage and closing sound concerns
value.summary: Customers report vanity-mirror lighting that is ineffective at night, a side-window coverage gap, and a sun visor that sounds cheap when shut. Signals come from USA G70 and G60 customers and a Rest of World G60 customer.
highlights: Concerns include night-time mirror lighting, side-window sun exposure, and a cheap-sounding visor closure.
Signals: USA G70 and G60; Rest of World G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe three front sun visor concerns: vanity-mirror lighting is ineffective at night, the visor leaves a gap when swung toward the side window, and shutting it firmly sounds cheap. [signal:01558fd8-e298-43e4-a986-028e2b542edc] [signal:1e490566-f99b-429f-91bc-453f17328d1f] [signal:3c6c4912-d842-424a-a6f4-a69be412f3fe]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer says the vanity-mirror lighting angle is too strong and the mirror is basically useless at night. [signal:01558fd8-e298-43e4-a986-028e2b542edc]
A USA G60 customer reports a gap between the B-pillar and visor that lets sunlight through and causes glare when the visor is swung toward the driver-side window. [signal:1e490566-f99b-429f-91bc-453f17328d1f]
A Rest of World G60 customer says firmly shutting the visor sounds like sheet metal and makes the car feel cheap; the same comment also describes loud roof noise in strong rain. [signal:3c6c4912-d842-424a-a6f4-a69be412f3fe]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals concern mirror lighting in a G70 and side-window coverage in a G60, while the Rest of World G60 signal concerns the visor’s closing sound and also mentions roof noise in rain. [signal:01558fd8-e298-43e4-a986-028e2b542edc] [signal:1e490566-f99b-429f-91bc-453f17328d1f] [signal:3c6c4912-d842-424a-a6f4-a69be412f3fe]

## Open questions
How widespread are the lighting, coverage and closing-sound concerns beyond these three signals? [signal:01558fd8-e298-43e4-a986-028e2b542edc] [signal:1e490566-f99b-429f-91bc-453f17328d1f] [signal:3c6c4912-d842-424a-a6f4-a69be412f3fe]

value.title: High-beam assistant is difficult to understand and operate
value.summary: Some USA customers have difficulty understanding the assistant’s status and behavior, finding its controls, or getting high beams to activate in dark areas with nearby carriage lights.
highlights: Customers report confusing status and behavior, hard-to-find controls, and high beams that do not activate in some dark settings.
Signals shown: USA; 3 reports each for G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers ask what the automatic high-beam indicator means, how to switch the assistant off, and when it will lower the high beams. [signal:115ea580-187e-4b6e-805b-7054af1a46f4] [signal:2adc99f7-81ee-4b68-80b4-f630f867093c] [signal:73cc4c63-4449-42fd-a747-6b9995d595c4] One customer says the control is behind the steering wheel and requires leaning forward to see while driving. [signal:50e0c6e2-53de-4c29-b860-393829dfc8a9] Another reports that carriage lights near driveways prevent the high beams from activating in an otherwise extremely dark area. [signal:6ba002e8-8ac4-4350-8840-d9cd436419eb]

## What customers say
A customer did not recognize the instrument-cluster icon with an “A” as the automatic high-beam assistant until it was explained. [signal:115ea580-187e-4b6e-805b-7054af1a46f4] A customer asked how to turn the assistant off and received instructions to find the setting through Vehicle Apps and Exterior Lighting. [signal:2adc99f7-81ee-4b68-80b4-f630f867093c] Customers also asked where to activate the function and when it dips the high beams. value.title: Front sun visor is hard to position and use
value.summary: Some USA drivers report difficulty positioning or using the front sun visor, including interference with a raised seat and a visor edge that does not block the sun. A separate complaint concerns the dim mirror light.
highlights: Drivers report positioning, coverage, and mirror-light usability problems.
Four USA signals cover the G70 and G60, with two signals for each.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers report difficulty swinging the visor to the driver-side window, interference with the headrest when the seat is high, and insufficient side-window coverage because the visor does not extend. [signal:3ce32aaa-b83a-4d39-b08a-d63880b4525c] [signal:83680828-3d2b-47c0-b351-f2b291d47eb6] [signal:aea3a030-6a24-444b-aa31-dd8f6259fbbb] One customer also says the driver-side mirror light is too dim for tasks such as applying makeup. [signal:8478e13f-d8e2-4e28-a184-e664add2c874]

## What customers say
One G70 customer says she uses a suction-cup visor because swinging the installed visor to the driver-side window is difficult. [signal:3ce32aaa-b83a-4d39-b08a-d63880b4525c] Another G70 customer says they sometimes lean forward to keep sunlight from coming through the driver window past the visor edge. [signal:aea3a030-6a24-444b-aa31-dd8f6259fbbb] A G60 customer reports the visor colliding with the headrest when the seat is positioned high. [signal:83680828-3d2b-47c0-b351-f2b291d47eb6] A different G60 customer says the mirror light is too dim to use for applying makeup. [signal:8478e13f-d8e2-4e28-a184-e664add2c874]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA; the signals do not provide a market comparison. [signal:3ce32aaa-b83a-4d39-b08a-d63880b4525c] [signal:83680828-3d2b-47c0-b351-f2b291d47eb6] [signal:aea3a030-6a24-444b-aa31-dd8f6259fbbb] [signal:8478e13f-d8e2-4e28-a184-e664add2c874]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often these issues occur beyond the four reports, or whether they affect other vehicle lines or markets. [signal:3ce32aaa-b83a-4d39-b08a-d63880b4525c] [signal:83680828-3d2b-47c0-b351-f2b291d47eb6] [signal:aea3a030-6a24-444b-aa31-dd8f6259fbbb] [signal:8478e13f-d8e2-4e28-a184-e664add2c874]

value.title: Fuel filler flap sometimes will not open
value.summary: G70 owners in the USA report fuel filler flaps that fail to open, sometimes repeatedly and during refueling. One report also describes difficulty opening and closing the flap.
highlights: Fuel filler flaps fail to open, with one owner also reporting difficulty opening and closing.
Reports are from USA G70 owners; no other market or vehicle line appears in the supplied signals.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
G70 owners report fuel filler flaps that would not open, including repeated failures while trying to refuel.[signal:01baa499-d1e8-4725-946f-c87c1a5b0502] [signal:b7859381-ab87-498d-a7f2-79df9697e80b] One owner described difficulty opening and closing the fuel door.[signal:067031bd-e224-4196-93e9-cf2dd327de68] Another said the fuel door would not open when they were far from home.[signal:c3e9d1ff-577f-4c7f-b580-7aaf3fd17add]

## What customers say
One owner said the flap would not open at about 615 miles; the dealer removed it and later installed a replacement.[signal:01baa499-d1e8-4725-946f-c87c1a5b0502] Another reported returning to the dealership three times because the gas door did not work, including after taking delivery of the vehicle.[signal:ac93f18c-a698-4880-b7da-0681621bceaf] A separate repair report says a faulty fuel door lid was found after the owner said the door had failed on several occasions.[signal:b7859381-ab87-498d-a7f2-79df9697e80b]

## Differences between markets
All supplied signals that describe a market are from the USA and concern the G70; there are no other market signals to compare.[signal:01baa499-d1e8-4725-946f-c87c1a5b0502] [signal:067031bd-e224-4196-93e9-cf2dd327de68] [signal:6f06f118-560e-4d45-aff8-f5d61f9962fd] [signal:ac93f18c-a698-4880-b7da-0681621bceaf] [signal:b7859381-ab87-498d-a7f2-79df9697e80b] [signal:c3e9d1ff-577f-4c7f-b580-7aaf3fd17add]

## Open questions
The supplied reports do not establish how frequently the issue occurs across G70 vehicles or whether the failures share a cause.[signal:01baa499-d1e8-4725-946f-c87c1a5b0502] [signal:b7859381-ab87-498d-a7f2-79df9697e80b]

value.title: Fuel filler flap is difficult to open
value.summary: Customers report difficulty understanding the release procedure, locating the ventilation button, or opening a stuck fuel flap. The signals concern USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Opening the fuel flap can be confusing or difficult, including when the vehicle is unlocked.
USA signals concern G60 and G70 customers.
One customer says previous vehicles from other brands did not require a separate fuel-tank unlock.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe confusion about how to release the fuel flap, difficulty locating the ventilation button, and cases where the flap would not open as expected. [signal:011c337e-a7d9-406c-98ca-e0dfc59c99a0] [signal:3dc52037-9780-49ab-a013-3d1f426a2caf] [signal:3e49b562-6bbb-4daf-9fd7-e7d72cd6a9f6] [signal:c6febd28-7625-4569-8de4-979d924eabc4]

## What customers say
One G60 customer was unfamiliar with a fuel-door release button and the explanation that the tank must depressurize first. [signal:011c337e-a7d9-406c-98ca-e0dfc59c99a0] Another said the flap did not release while the car was unlocked, but did after opening the driver's door. [signal:3dc52037-9780-49ab-a013-3d1f426a2caf]

A G70 customer found the ventilation button difficult to locate; the customer and dealership Genius resorted to the emergency release before later learning the procedure. [signal:3e49b562-6bbb-4daf-9fd7-e7d72cd6a9f6] Another G70 customer said it took about 20 minutes with the manual to work out how to open the flap. [signal:58624bf1-6566-4c7a-b52d-27f11dffac26] A further customer reported a stuck flap and needing dealership help to open it. [signal:c6febd28-7625-4569-8de4-979d924eabc4]

One G60 customer said that, unlike their past vehicles from other brands, the fuel tank had to be unlocked even when the doors were already unlocked. [signal:127caca9-6c7a-4896-a615-880868dc2b17]

## Differences between markets
All supplied signals are from the USA and concern G60 or G70 vehicles; no other market is represented. [signal:011c337e-a7d9-406c-98ca-e0dfc59c99a0] [signal:3dc52037-9780-49ab-a013-3d1f426a2caf] [signal:3e49b562-6bbb-4daf-9fd7-e7d72cd6a9f6] [signal:58624bf1-6566-4c7a-b52d-27f11dffac26] [signal:c6febd28-7625-4569-8de4-979d924eabc4] [signal:127caca9-6c7a-4896-a615-880868dc2b17]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported opening difficulties share a cause or how frequently they occur. [signal:011c337e-a7d9-406c-98ca-e0dfc59c99a0] [signal:3dc52037-9780-49ab-a013-3d1f426a2caf] [signal:3e49b562-6bbb-4daf-9fd7-e7d72cd6a9f6] [signal:58624bf1-6566-4c7a-b52d-27f11dffac26] [signal:c6febd28-7625-4569-8de4-979d924eabc4]

value.title: Air compressor failure early in ownership
value.summary: A G60 owner in the USA reports an air compressor failure after about 1,700 miles, followed by nearly three weeks in the shop. The issue has raised concerns about future mechanical problems and vehicle integrity.
highlights: The air compressor failed after roughly 1,700 miles, with the car in the shop nearly three weeks.
One reported case affects a USA G60 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 owner reports that the air compressor failed after roughly 1,700 miles, and that the car had been in the shop for nearly three weeks [signal:cc0ad9e2-e041-4f08-84c4-d253f006ba73].

## What customers say
The owner says the failure is frustrating and has raised concerns about future mechanical problems and the vehicle's integrity after it was taken apart for repairs [signal:cc0ad9e2-e041-4f08-84c4-d253f006ba73]. They also say they love the car and how it drives [signal:cc0ad9e2-e041-4f08-84c4-d253f006ba73].

## Differences between markets
The signal is from the USA; there is no evidence from other markets to compare [signal:cc0ad9e2-e041-4f08-84c4-d253f006ba73].

## Open questions
How representative is this report of air compressor reliability for G60 vehicles? [signal:cc0ad9e2-e041-4f08-84c4-d253f006ba73]

value.title: Air-conditioning fan noise and battery top-up limitations
value.summary: A USA G70 owner finds the AC fan very loud even at its minimum setting. A Europe G60 owner says they can no longer top up the battery via the petrol engine to have air conditioning the next day without a charging spot.
highlights: The fan is loud at minimum, and engine-based battery top-up for next-day AC is no longer possible.
Signals are from one USA G70 owner and one Europe G60 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A USA G70 owner says the AC fan is very loud even on its minimum setting. [signal:2303a17c-24a1-487e-ad6c-163cb143e613] A Europe G60 owner says it is no longer possible to top up the battery via the petrol engine to have air conditioning the next day at a location without a charging spot. [signal:d5f697ae-dbcb-40c8-a587-4cd1a31c0800]

## What customers say
The G70 owner says driving would be nicer if the fan were quieter, while also saying they love the car overall. [signal:2303a17c-24a1-487e-ad6c-163cb143e613] The G60 owner mentions the loss of engine-based battery top-up alongside software hassle, while describing improved electric range and faster charging positively. [signal:d5f697ae-dbcb-40c8-a587-4cd1a31c0800]

## Differences between markets
The fan-noise complaint comes from the USA and concerns a G70; the battery top-up concern comes from Europe and concerns a G60. [signal:2303a17c-24a1-487e-ad6c-163cb143e613] [signal:d5f697ae-dbcb-40c8-a587-4cd1a31c0800] The signals describe different concerns, so they do not establish whether experiences differ by market. [signal:2303a17c-24a1-487e-ad6c-163cb143e613] [signal:d5f697ae-dbcb-40c8-a587-4cd1a31c0800]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify when or under what conditions the G70 fan is loud, or the circumstances in which engine-based battery top-up for next-day AC is unavailable in the G60. [signal:2303a17c-24a1-487e-ad6c-163cb143e613] [signal:d5f697ae-dbcb-40c8-a587-4cd1a31c0800]

value.title: No frunk for customers seeking front storage
value.summary: Some USA customers want a frunk for additional storage and are disappointed that the G70 and G60 do not have one. One customer also found the hood area confusing and expected it might contain usable space.
highlights: Customers want a frunk for extra storage or as a reason to choose a BEV.
USA signals cover four G70 customers and two G60 customers.
A customer says many other electric cars turn the front area into a frunk.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want a frunk for additional storage, and one says it was a significant reason for choosing a BEV. [signal:37eb5409-d0d2-49b0-9579-554d6c2d5e6c] [signal:625069cc-2d92-4e0b-923c-325692e9fe5e] One customer considers a large hood without a frunk a poor decision. [signal:76739994-33c7-40b8-b7f3-eedb72ed9d38]

## What customers say
Customers request a frunk on the G70 and G60, including for added storage. [signal:08d50d5a-5324-479b-a79d-5664af54d075] [signal:37eb5409-d0d2-49b0-9579-554d6c2d5e6c] [signal:38d243ec-619d-46e2-b31d-93b7eb4e7bdd] One customer found it odd that there were no directions for opening the hood and assumed there was nothing there, despite seeing a large, empty-looking area. [signal:0fa04bbd-c7cc-4c7c-8ae4-030d8c896828] The response in that interaction clarified that the i7 has no frunk and that the space mainly contains wiring and other components. [signal:0fa04bbd-c7cc-4c7c-8ae4-030d8c896828]

## Differences between markets
The provided signals are from the USA and mention the G70 and G60. [signal:08d50d5a-5324-479b-a79d-5664af54d075] [signal:37eb5409-d0d2-49b0-9579-554d6c2d5e6c] [signal:38d243ec-619d-46e2-b31d-93b7eb4e7bdd] [signal:625069cc-2d92-4e0b-923c-325692e9fe5e] [signal:76739994-33c7-40b8-b7f3-eedb72ed9d38] [signal:0fa04bbd-c7cc-4c7c-8ae4-030d8c896828] No market comparison is present in these signals.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how much usable storage customers expect from a frunk or how often the hood-area confusion occurs. [signal:37eb5409-d0d2-49b0-9579-554d6c2d5e6c] [signal:0fa04bbd-c7cc-4c7c-8ae4-030d8c896828]

Reported by a G70 owner in the USA; two other similarly equipped vehicles are also mentioned.

value.title: Air conditioning feels weak and cools too slowly
value.summary: Customers report weak air conditioning, slow cooling and difficulty directing airflow, particularly in USA feedback about G70 and G60 vehicles. A Europe signal also says the air conditioning could be better.
highlights: Air conditioning is described as weak, slow to cool, and difficult to direct.
Signals cover USA (5) and Europe (1), across G70, G60 and F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe air conditioning as weak or poor, and some say the cabin takes too long to cool after the car has been in the sun. [signal:1f81f608-9177-4422-80b4-65a3ac7adea0] [signal:5cec0b17-4ea2-4cfd-8aec-7fcbe3b45962] [signal:79c62bf5-e43a-4f1c-a479-d4796c639c3f] [signal:a3cb5ce7-f8c1-4f79-9efd-b83fceeef19a]

Some USA customers say airflow cannot be aimed directly at one person or at the driver's face. [signal:5cec0b17-4ea2-4cfd-8aec-7fcbe3b45962] [signal:79c62bf5-e43a-4f1c-a479-d4796c639c3f] [signal:a3cb5ce7-f8c1-4f79-9efd-b83fceeef19a]

## What customers say
A G70 customer in South Florida says the car can be uncomfortable for 5–10 minutes after sitting in the sun while the cabin cools. [signal:a3cb5ce7-f8c1-4f79-9efd-b83fceeef19a]

Another G70 customer suggests hidden vents may contribute to weak cooling and says window tint helped somewhat. [signal:1f81f608-9177-4422-80b4-65a3ac7adea0]

A G60 customer says the air conditioning feels downgraded, without giving further performance detail in the available quote. [signal:f34737d0-47f8-4a24-a22d-ecc75a84c412]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include reports of weak cooling and airflow that cannot be directed at an individual. [signal:1f81f608-9177-4422-80b4-65a3ac7adea0] [signal:5cec0b17-4ea2-4cfd-8aec-7fcbe3b45962] [signal:79c62bf5-e43a-4f1c-a479-d4796c639c3f] [signal:a3cb5ce7-f8c1-4f79-9efd-b83fceeef19a] [signal:f34737d0-47f8-4a24-a22d-ecc75a84c412]

[signal:1f81f608-9177-4422-80b4-65a3ac7adea0] [signal:5cec0b17-4ea2-4cfd-8aec-7fcbe3b45962] [signal:79c62bf5-e43a-4f1c-a479-d4796c639c3f] [signal:a3cb5ce7-f8c1-4f79-9efd-b83fceeef19a] [signal:b07d086b-0844-443c-b3a4-33a5e5c35d56] [signal:f34737d0-47f8-4a24-a22d-ecc75a84c412]

The available feedback does not clarify whether cooling performance differs by conditions, configuration or vehicle line. [signal:1f81f608-9177-4422-80b4-65a3ac7adea0] [signal:5cec0b17-4ea2-4cfd-8aec-7fcbe3b45962] [signal:79c62bf5-e43a-4f1c-a479-d4796c639c3f] [signal:a3cb5ce7-f8c1-4f79-9efd-b83fceeef19a] [signal:b07d086b-0844-443c-b3a4-33a5e5c35d56] [signal:f34737d0-47f8-4a24-a22d-ecc75a84c412]

value.title: Tire repair kit disliked and inflator lacks a proper storage place
value.summary: USA customers describe the tire repair kit as an unwanted alternative to run-flat tires, and one G60 owner says the inflator takes up trunk space without a designated place. Another customer wants an integrated compressor to maintain tire pressure, particularly in cold conditions.
highlights: Customers dislike the repair kit, its trunk storage, or the lack of an integrated compressor.
Signals are from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers raise different concerns about the tire repair kit: one dislikes it and prefers run-flat tires, while another says the inflator occupies trunk space and has no designated storage place. [signal:0cdffb27-32ae-49de-b60d-6f0eb99af3ac] [signal:8ea3ef42-185a-4411-b6f1-3edb12c06903]

A further customer wants an integrated compressor for maintaining tire pressure, especially in colder conditions. [signal:d6deec63-e7c7-4ad6-aa50-d97609b511f3]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the inflator feels like an afterthought because it has no proper trunk location and uses cargo space. [signal:0cdffb27-32ae-49de-b60d-6f0eb99af3ac]

A G70 owner prefers run-flat tires to the tire repair kit. [signal:8ea3ef42-185a-4411-b6f1-3edb12c06903]

Another G70 customer wants an integrated compressor to reduce trips to air pumps and help keep tire pressures up in colder weather. [signal:d6deec63-e7c7-4ad6-aa50-d97609b511f3]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA; they concern G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:0cdffb27-32ae-49de-b60d-6f0eb99af3ac] [signal:8ea3ef42-185a-4411-b6f1-3edb12c06903] [signal:d6deec63-e7c7-4ad6-aa50-d97609b511f3]

## Open questions
Do customers primarily want a different tire-failure option, better storage for the inflator, or easier access to tire-pressure maintenance? [signal:0cdffb27-32ae-49de-b60d-6f0eb99af3ac] [signal:8ea3ef42-185a-4411-b6f1-3edb12c06903] [signal:d6deec63-e7c7-4ad6-aa50-d97609b511f3]

value.title: Multi-function steering wheel controls behave inconsistently
value.summary: Customers report a steering-wheel button malfunction in a USA G70 and limited or inconsistent audio-control behavior in Europe F70s.
highlights: Reports include buttons controlling only volume, one-track playlist scrolling, and inconsistent next-track buttons.
Signals cover one USA G70 and two Europe F70 complaints.
A Europe signal mentions a Mercedes steering-wheel touchpad as a comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G70 owner reported that every multi-function steering-wheel button affected volume; the dealer replaced the steering wheel, after which the owner reported no remaining issue. [signal:6b177466-c5d4-49f6-9fa6-3e0c2ea6f076] F70 owners described audio controls that only scroll a playlist one track at a time and next-track buttons that are inconsistent. [signal:a635863a-04ba-4efd-b7d6-499b3a583373] [signal:c9e58a2e-fc2e-4e12-bc12-1e01d8e885e7]

## What customers say
The G70 owner said the button issue occurred at 1,974 miles and that the steering wheel was replaced after dealership inspection. [signal:6b177466-c5d4-49f6-9fa6-3e0c2ea6f076] An F70 owner said selecting a song from a large playlist required returning to the main screen, taking their attention from the road. [signal:a635863a-04ba-4efd-b7d6-499b3a583373] Another F70 owner called both next-track buttons inconsistent and irritating to use. [signal:c9e58a2e-fc2e-4e12-bc12-1e01d8e885e7]

## Differences between markets
The USA signal describes all steering-wheel buttons affecting volume in a G70, while the two Europe signals describe audio-control limitations or inconsistency in F70s. [signal:6b177466-c5d4-49f6-9fa6-3e0c2ea6f076] [signal:a635863a-04ba-4efd-b7d6-499b3a583373] [signal:c9e58a2e-fc2e-4e12-bc12-1e01d8e885e7]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these issues are beyond the reported vehicles. [signal:6b177466-c5d4-49f6-9fa6-3e0c2ea6f076] [signal:a635863a-04ba-4efd-b7d6-499b3a583373] [signal:c9e58a2e-fc2e-4e12-bc12-1e01d8e885e7]

highlights: Customers report hard-to-find releases, uneven folding, and needing to enter the cabin to fold seats flat.
