value.body_md:
## Problem
G60 customers in the USA describe rear-seat folding as difficult to understand or use: one could not find the release levers, another reported uneven folding, and another had to enter the cabin to fold the seat flat. [signal:a2488ac3-b19a-4140-b66f-63ebacbdda19] [signal:db47ce2e-68fc-497b-92c7-b46465ec58fa] [signal:b6e6aef5-19c3-4bce-a584-243d577bbdc8]

## What customers say
One customer initially thought the rear seats did not fold, then found the release levers in the trunk area after being told where to look. [signal:a2488ac3-b19a-4140-b66f-63ebacbdda19]
Another customer said the seats fold down unevenly. [signal:db47ce2e-68fc-497b-92c7-b46465ec58fa]
A customer said using the release handle still required climbing into the cabin to fold the seat flat, and wished it worked like their X5, where pulling the release alone dropped the seat. [signal:b6e6aef5-19c3-4bce-a584-243d577bbdc8]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA and concern the G60; there are no signals from other markets or vehicle lines in this case. [signal:a2488ac3-b19a-4140-b66f-63ebacbdda19] [signal:db47ce2e-68fc-497b-92c7-b46465ec58fa] [signal:b6e6aef5-19c3-4bce-a584-243d577bbdc8]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these issues are among G60 customers, or whether the reported uneven folding is related to the release-location and seat-folding concerns. [signal:a2488ac3-b19a-4140-b66f-63ebacbdda19] [signal:db47ce2e-68fc-497b-92c7-b46465ec58fa] [signal:b6e6aef5-19c3-4bce-a584-243d577bbdc8]

value.title: Tirefit is confusing, missing, or ineffective when needed
value.summary: US customers report difficulty understanding or finding the tire mobility kit, and one says it did not work after a sidewall tear. Concerns span the G60 and G70.
highlights: Customers report confusion, missing equipment, storage concerns, and a repair kit that failed after a sidewall tear.
Signals are from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
US customers describe several usability concerns with the tire mobility kit: one reports it did not work after a sidewall tear, another did not understand the system, and another said the kit was missing. [signal:039f55b1-4999-4e79-badb-6f0a23b4abf6] [signal:17d8a00a-98ff-4581-8ceb-780b107d3c12] [signal:47b5247b-a6ba-4a36-b92e-0b2fc9b5563a]

One customer criticized the kit's Velcro attachment to the trunk side as inappropriate for a $90,000 vehicle. [signal:3d8fbd14-a71a-478e-ab06-8b84ec20d009] A customer also asked whether a tire could be repaired after the sealant had been used, and the writer could not confirm. [signal:646edacb-6ac9-489e-9cfc-f0c5e97f2458]

## What customers say
A G70 customer said the dealer had not fully explained the system and they had not yet needed to use it. [signal:17d8a00a-98ff-4581-8ceb-780b107d3c12] In another G70 interaction, a customer asked what the pouch containing a pump and sealant was for. [signal:25f39563-4e88-4b3e-9554-ef8332d171e4]

A G60 customer said a sidewall tear from a pothole left them needing a tow truck because the kit did not function in that situation. [signal:039f55b1-4999-4e79-badb-6f0a23b4abf6]

## Differences between markets
All supplied signals are from the USA, so they do not show differences between markets. [signal:039f55b1-4999-4e79-badb-6f0a23b4abf6] [signal:17d8a00a-98ff-4581-8ceb-780b107d3c12] [signal:25f39563-4e88-4b3e-9554-ef8332d171e4] [signal:3d8fbd14-a71a-478e-ab06-8b84ec20d009] [signal:47b5247b-a6ba-4a36-b92e-0b2fc9b5563a] [signal:646edacb-6ac9-489e-9cfc-f0c5e97f2458]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the kit is missing or fails, or whether the tire can be repaired after sealant use. [signal:47b5247b-a6ba-4a36-b92e-0b2fc9b5563a] [signal:039f55b1-4999-4e79-badb-6f0a23b4abf6] [signal:646edacb-6ac9-489e-9cfc-f0c5e97f2458]

value.title: Air conditioning feels weak or difficult to direct
value.summary: Some customers report inadequate cooling or limited control over where the airflow goes. The concerns appear in USA G70, Europe F70 and Rest of World G60 signals.
highlights: Customers report weak cooling, airflow that is hard to direct, or AC that stops in hot weather.
Signals: USA G70 (3), Europe F70 (1), and Rest of World G60 (1).
One Rest of World customer says the AC feels lacking compared with Japanese cars.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe air conditioning that does not cool well, is difficult to direct, or stops in hot weather. [signal:18bd2b19-654c-4fd1-8c8d-61a17db1b80b] [signal:7a57ba8d-5e60-4fa1-8ba4-95b74abcdbdd] [signal:8bae7967-ee51-4ce3-af5e-5b215218b80d] [signal:9c34d9aa-b2f4-4eb4-9690-5f1eac42e999] [signal:af64e2c0-a63a-49eb-81f9-d48627e41f1c]

## What customers say
A Rest of World customer says the AC system feels lacking compared with Japanese cars. [signal:18bd2b19-654c-4fd1-8c8d-61a17db1b80b]

A USA customer says the air conditioning stops when the car cuts off at intersections in 90-degree weather. [signal:7a57ba8d-5e60-4fa1-8ba4-95b74abcdbdd]

A USA customer describes the airflow as not focused enough, while another says the front vents have only a very limited range of adjustment. [signal:8bae7967-ee51-4ce3-af5e-5b215218b80d] [signal:af64e2c0-a63a-49eb-81f9-d48627e41f1c]

A Europe customer says the air conditioning does not cool as well as in their previous car and says rear vents are missing. [signal:9c34d9aa-b2f4-4eb4-9690-5f1eac42e999]

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA signals describe AC stopping in hot weather and limited or unfocused airflow; the Europe signal describes weaker cooling and missing rear vents. [signal:7a57ba8d-5e60-4fa1-8ba4-95b74abcdbdd] [signal:8bae7967-ee51-4ce3-af5e-5b215218b80d] [signal:af64e2c0-a63a-49eb-81f9-d48627e41f1c] [signal:9c34d9aa-b2f4-4eb4-9690-5f1eac42e999]

The Rest of World signal compares the system unfavourably with Japanese cars. [signal:18bd2b19-654c-4fd1-8c8d-61a17db1b80b]

## Open questions
Do the reported cooling and airflow concerns vary by vehicle configuration, including whether rear vents are fitted? [signal:9c34d9aa-b2f4-4eb4-9690-5f1eac42e999] [signal:af64e2c0-a63a-49eb-81f9-d48627e41f1c]

How often does AC stop during engine cut-off at intersections in hot weather? [signal:7a57ba8d-5e60-4fa1-8ba4-95b74abcdbdd]

value.title: Front armrest height and proximity to controls concern G70 owners
value.summary: Some G70 owners say the front center armrest is too low or too close to the console controls, while a G60 owner says the driver armrest sits well. Another G60 owner likes the split-top storage design.
highlights: G70 owners report low armrest height and accidental contact with nearby controls.
Signals are from USA owners of G70 and G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some G70 owners say the front center armrest is too low or positioned too close to the center-console controls, making accidental button presses possible. [signal:70d96ecd-8982-4218-8660-c9e8d776d7dd] [signal:89024d59-52da-4190-83dd-373f0b007c33]

## What customers say
One G70 owner wants the adjacent wood console area to be padded and the armrest raised. [signal:70d96ecd-8982-4218-8660-c9e8d776d7dd] Another says resting an arm there can bump the controls and change settings unintentionally. [signal:89024d59-52da-4190-83dd-373f0b007c33] A G60 owner says the driver armrest sits perfectly relative to the steering wheel, and another likes the split-top storage design. [signal:6ef1c6d5-95bf-45fd-9144-9a57069653d5] [signal:7c0d701e-b721-44ca-a846-6aeaef707912]

## Differences between markets
All armrest-related signals are from the USA. [signal:70d96ecd-8982-4218-8660-c9e8d776d7dd] [signal:89024d59-52da-4190-83dd-373f0b007c33] [signal:6ef1c6d5-95bf-45fd-9144-9a57069653d5] [signal:7c0d701e-b721-44ca-a846-6aeaef707912] The G70 signals raise concerns about height and proximity to controls, while the G60 signals are positive about armrest position and storage style. [signal:70d96ecd-8982-4218-8660-c9e8d776d7dd] [signal:89024d59-52da-4190-83dd-373f0b007c33] [signal:6ef1c6d5-95bf-45fd-9144-9a57069653d5] [signal:7c0d701e-b721-44ca-a846-6aeaef707912]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these experiences are beyond the individual reports provided. [signal:70d96ecd-8982-4218-8660-c9e8d776d7dd] [signal:89024d59-52da-4190-83dd-373f0b007c33] [signal:6ef1c6d5-95bf-45fd-9144-9a57069653d5] [signal:7c0d701e-b721-44ca-a846-6aeaef707912]

value.title: Steering-wheel controls feel incomplete for some drivers
value.summary: Some drivers miss dedicated steering-wheel buttons and find screen-based operation risky while driving, while another customer is pleased with the controls. Signals span USA and Europe vehicles.
highlights: Some drivers miss dedicated buttons or find operating functions through screens risky while driving.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70, and Europe G60 and F70.
A customer cites a Mercedes EV’s split steering-wheel controls as easier for adjusting screens.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say removed or absent steering-wheel buttons make functions harder to operate, and that using the screen while driving can feel unsafe. [signal:0fe323c1-79f2-416d-918a-90e8f8b00af4] [signal:84593d0a-034c-442d-9d59-3246f73af565] Others report positive experiences with the steering-wheel controls. [signal:d4f5d4ab-608a-4ed0-8968-6f8da0ba4eae] [signal:84593d0a-034c-442d-9d59-3246f73af565]

## What customers say
A USA G60 driver misses the ACC toggle and distance-control buttons on the steering wheel and says the software places too much on the screen. [signal:0fe323c1-79f2-416d-918a-90e8f8b00af4] A Europe G60 driver says screen operation can feel risky, though some adjustments can be made with voice control or from the steering wheel. [signal:84593d0a-034c-442d-9d59-3246f73af565] A USA G70 customer says his aunt is pleased with the steering-wheel controls. [signal:d4f5d4ab-608a-4ed0-8968-6f8da0ba4eae]

A customer describes a Mercedes EV arrangement in which the left steering-wheel side controls the instrument cluster and the right side controls the center touchscreen, saying it made screen adjustments easier. [signal:dad366f7-a57b-4e0c-8751-881da6e28c5f]

## Differences between markets
In the USA, a G60 driver specifically misses ACC and distance-control buttons, while a G70 customer reports satisfaction with the steering-wheel controls. [signal:0fe323c1-79f2-416d-918a-90e8f8b00af4] [signal:d4f5d4ab-608a-4ed0-8968-6f8da0ba4eae] In Europe, a G60 driver says screen operation can feel risky but notes steering-wheel and voice-control options; a F70 driver says the technology took time to get used to. [signal:84593d0a-034c-442d-9d59-3246f73af565] [signal:eb8c3c50-5a32-4170-877b-3bd548a45379] The signals therefore include both complaints and positive feedback, and do not establish a consistent market-wide preference. [signal:0fe323c1-79f2-416d-918a-90e8f8b00af4] [signal:84593d0a-034c-442d-9d59-3246f73af565] [signal:d4f5d4ab-608a-4ed0-8968-6f8da0ba4eae]

## Open questions
Do concerns depend on which function is being operated, given the G60 driver’s specific requests for ACC and distance-control buttons and the separate reports about screen adjustments? [signal:0fe323c1-79f2-416d-918a-90e8f8b00af4] [signal:dad366f7-a57b-4e0c-8751-881da6e28c5f] How do preferences vary between drivers who find the controls easy to use and those who report difficulty or safety concerns? [signal:d4f5d4ab-608a-4ed0-8968-6f8da0ba4eae] [signal:84593d0a-034c-442d-9d59-3246f73af565] [signal:eb8c3c50-5a32-4170-877b-3bd548a45379]

value.title: Front armrests feel too wide while driving
value.summary: A G60 driver in the USA says the front armrests are too wide, forcing an uncomfortable “chicken wing” driving posture. The signals do not describe an armrest reliability problem.
highlights: A G60 driver says the front armrests are too wide and uncomfortable.
The relevant complaint is from one USA G60 owner.
The owner says a Honda Pilot and Boeing aircraft have more comfortable armrests.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A USA G60 driver says the front armrests are too wide and cause an uncomfortable “chicken wing” posture while driving. [signal:71caa6f7-3ac7-4b2a-b54c-47e9102e72f7] The available armrest signal concerns comfort and fit, not reliability. [signal:71caa6f7-3ac7-4b2a-b54c-47e9102e72f7]

## What customers say
The driver, who describes being 6 feet tall and about 205 pounds, says the armrests feel as though they were designed for someone much larger. [signal:71caa6f7-3ac7-4b2a-b54c-47e9102e72f7] They say their Honda Pilot and Boeing 737, 757, 767, and 777 have narrower, more comfortable armrests. [signal:71caa6f7-3ac7-4b2a-b54c-47e9102e72f7]

## Differences between markets
The armrest complaint is from the USA and concerns a G60. [signal:71caa6f7-3ac7-4b2a-b54c-47e9102e72f7] The other USA signal is about a G70 and does not mention armrests. [signal:773bd647-2de2-4573-a53d-b17c105665b8] There is no armrest feedback from another market in these signals.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the armrest fit concern is beyond this one G60 complaint. [signal:71caa6f7-3ac7-4b2a-b54c-47e9102e72f7] The second signal provides no additional evidence about front armrests. [signal:773bd647-2de2-4573-a53d-b17c105665b8]

value.title: Through-loading and rear-seat folding needs vary by vehicle
value.summary: Some USA customers want rear seats that fold down or a through-loading system, while a G60 customer appreciates the existing passthrough for carrying a snowboard. Another G60 customer wants more convenient folding controls.
highlights: Customers request rear-seat folding, a through-loading system, or easier folding controls.
Signals are from USA customers in the G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
USA customers in the G70 signals want rear seats that fold down or a through-loading system to create extra space [signal:0b6ca46c-546e-4595-9727-0059ea9cf788] [signal:4846e28e-daf0-4e55-88ca-1e3a94c1e5d6]. A G60 customer also says the current rear-door controls make folding the seats inconvenient [signal:275540a3-9e62-4a66-a973-6991ca319230].

## What customers say
A G70 customer says folding rear seats would create extra space [signal:0b6ca46c-546e-4595-9727-0059ea9cf788]. Another G70 customer asks for a through-loading system [signal:4846e28e-daf0-4e55-88ca-1e3a94c1e5d6]. A G60 customer wants more convenient folding controls and says using the rear-door controls requires walking around the car [signal:275540a3-9e62-4a66-a973-6991ca319230]. In contrast, a G60 customer appreciates the seat passthrough for carrying a snowboard [signal:11a38e39-91ec-48d6-81a9-bd792aad4165].

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA [signal:0b6ca46c-546e-4595-9727-0059ea9cf788] [signal:275540a3-9e62-4a66-a973-6991ca319230] [signal:4846e28e-daf0-4e55-88ca-1e3a94c1e5d6] [signal:11a38e39-91ec-48d6-81a9-bd792aad4165]. The G70 signals request folding seats and a through-loading system, while the G60 signals include both a request about folding controls and appreciation for the passthrough [signal:0b6ca46c-546e-4595-9727-0059ea9cf788] [signal:4846e28e-daf0-4e55-88ca-1e3a94c1e5d6] [signal:275540a3-9e62-4a66-a973-6991ca319230] [signal:11a38e39-91ec-48d6-81a9-bd792aad4165].

## Open questions
Do the G70 requests concern the same rear-seat or passthrough capability, or different needs? [signal:0b6ca46c-546e-4595-9727-0059ea9cf788] [signal:4846e28e-daf0-4e55-88ca-1e3a94c1e5d6] How often do customers value the passthrough while also finding seat-folding controls inconvenient? [signal:275540a3-9e62-4a66-a973-6991ca319230] [signal:11a38e39-91ec-48d6-81a9-bd792aad4165]

value.title: Front armrest width and console visibility draw mixed feedback
value.summary: Some G60 customers find the armrests too wide or cannot see inside the center console at night, while a G70 customer finds the armrest comfortable. The feedback comes from USA customers.
highlights: Feedback ranges from armrests feeling too wide to a comfortable fit; one customer also wants console lighting.
Six USA signals: five for G60 and one for G70.
A customer compares the armrests unfavorably with the Honda Pilot and Boeing aircraft.
value.body_md:
## Problem
G60 customers report that the armrests feel too wide, while another customer says the center console is difficult to use at night because its interior is not visible when opened. [signal:90108a8a-17c5-4200-9f35-dc7bdf0edb36] [signal:e490281e-04ee-44cf-969c-64450426e769]

## What customers say
One G60 customer says the armrests cause an uncomfortable driving posture and compares them unfavorably with the narrower armrests in a Honda Pilot and Boeing aircraft. [signal:90108a8a-17c5-4200-9f35-dc7bdf0edb36] A different G60 customer says the door armrest should be wider, which contrasts with the complaint about armrest width. [signal:7b5791b2-8095-4bdf-a0e6-d2e03c094cfe] A G70 customer says the armrest is comfortable. [signal:3cc1dbd3-f95c-4f55-b401-3570febda163] One G60 customer says finding items inside the center console at night is a hassle without a light. [signal:e490281e-04ee-44cf-969c-64450426e769]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA: five concern the G60 and one concerns the G70. [signal:4069d24f-e1ba-4cc0-bdb3-3e137c2bae61] [signal:7b5791b2-8095-4bdf-a0e6-d2e03c094cfe] [signal:90108a8a-17c5-4200-9f35-dc7bdf0edb36] [signal:e490281e-04ee-44cf-969c-64450426e769] [signal:09a0f7ea-bbbc-414c-9aae-a5b78b33dccd] [signal:3cc1dbd3-f95c-4f55-b401-3570febda163] The feedback includes both a G60 complaint about armrest width and a G70 report of comfort. [signal:90108a8a-17c5-4200-9f35-dc7bdf0edb36] [signal:3cc1dbd3-f95c-4f55-b401-3570febda163]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the width complaint concerns the center armrest specifically or other armrests in the cabin. [signal:90108a8a-17c5-4200-9f35-dc7bdf0edb36] They also do not show how common the night-time console visibility issue is beyond one customer report. [signal:e490281e-04ee-44cf-969c-64450426e769]

value.title: Steering wheel controls are small, confusing, or easy to activate by mistake
value.summary: Customers report that some steering wheel controls are too small or unclear, and that an active-cruise button can be triggered accidentally. Signals come from USA and Europe and include G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Small or unclear controls, plus accidental activation, make steering wheel operation difficult.
Signals span USA and Europe, and G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe steering wheel buttons as too small to operate easily, and one customer says a thumb can activate active cruise control unintentionally. [signal:2f584477-99c3-4d8a-9cd8-7cf6d9b504f7] [signal:477ae8e7-837e-4ab8-bbbc-2086d3d08eef] [signal:586200ea-459e-47e9-b810-38f47a1c9469]

Some customers are unsure what steering wheel controls do or how to use them to navigate messages and settings. [signal:61d69c90-76ab-44b2-aa20-0d16f88faf50] [signal:86f65434-1c84-4994-8a8f-a4dff77ae69a] [signal:9ffe8277-b204-4949-9fa0-75f89c819ae8]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer says the radio button is too small to operate easily. [signal:2f584477-99c3-4d8a-9cd8-7cf6d9b504f7] A Europe G60 customer also describes the steering wheel buttons as too tiny. [signal:477ae8e7-837e-4ab8-bbbc-2086d3d08eef]

A USA G70 customer says active cruise control has been switched on by mistake three times because their thumb naturally rests on its button. [signal:586200ea-459e-47e9-b810-38f47a1c9469]

A USA G60 customer asked how to handle instrument-cluster notifications; the response explained that the right-side scroll wheel navigates messages and a press selects one. [signal:61d69c90-76ab-44b2-aa20-0d16f88faf50] A USA G70 customer was unsure about the purpose of the gear icon and nearby dial, and was told they control display settings and scrolling. [signal:86f65434-1c84-4994-8a8f-a4dff77ae69a]

A Europe F70 customer says they enjoy driving the car and find it simple to manage overall, but do not understand many of the steering wheel controls. [signal:9ffe8277-b204-4949-9fa0-75f89c819ae8]

## Differences between markets
Small-button complaints appear in USA and Europe G60 signals. [signal:2f584477-99c3-4d8a-9cd8-7cf6d9b504f7] [signal:477ae8e7-837e-4ab8-bbbc-2086d3d08eef] Questions or confusion about controls are described in USA G60 and G70 signals and a Europe F70 signal. [signal:61d69c90-76ab-44b2-aa20-0d16f88faf50] [signal:86f65434-1c84-4994-8a8f-a4dff77ae69a] [signal:9ffe8277-b204-4949-9fa0-75f89c819ae8]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these experiences are across the 12 signals in the case, or whether they vary by steering wheel configuration. [signal:2f584477-99c3-4d8a-9cd8-7cf6d9b504f7] [signal:477ae8e7-837e-4ab8-bbbc-2086d3d08eef] [signal:586200ea-459e-47e9-b810-38f47a1c9469] [signal:61d69c90-76ab-44b2-aa20-0d16f88faf50] [signal:86f65434-1c84-4994-8a8f-a4dff77ae69a] [signal:9ffe8277-b204-4949-9fa0-75f89c819ae8]

value.title: Hybrid power flexibility valued by G60 customers
value.summary: The signals highlight positive feedback on coasting and the flexibility to drive using electric or gas power. Both come from USA G60 customers.
highlights: Customers value coasting and the flexibility to use electric or gas power.
Two positive signals, both from USA G60 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals report positive feedback, not a battery-performance complaint: one customer praised the coasting feature, and another valued the ability to drive using electric or gas power. [signal:04b3dc84-2dee-48ad-846a-f8e6ebb82bcc] [signal:628cfc2e-eb58-4be0-a31f-60cfa4a3bf0b]

## What customers say
One customer said coasting was “really nice” after discovering the feature. [signal:04b3dc84-2dee-48ad-846a-f8e6ebb82bcc] Another was happy with the hybrid setup’s electric-or-gas flexibility. [signal:628cfc2e-eb58-4be0-a31f-60cfa4a3bf0b]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from USA customers with G60 vehicles; the signals provide no comparison across markets or vehicle lines. [signal:04b3dc84-2dee-48ad-846a-f8e6ebb82bcc] [signal:628cfc2e-eb58-4be0-a31f-60cfa4a3bf0b]

## Open questions
The signals do not address battery range, charging, or measured battery performance. [signal:04b3dc84-2dee-48ad-846a-f8e6ebb82bcc] [signal:628cfc2e-eb58-4be0-a31f-60cfa4a3bf0b]

value.title: In-car Spotify intermittently fails to load or play
value.summary: Some U.S. G60 and G70 customers report that the in-car Spotify app fails to load or play. One report describes recurring failures; another says the app loaded after a telecommunications reboot and app update.
highlights: In-car Spotify sometimes gets stuck loading or fails to play.
Two U.S. complaints, from G60 and G70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
In-car Spotify failed to play after displaying a spinning connection icon for one G60 customer, and the issue recurred at least a couple of times per week [signal:5a61c28b-4f8d-4437-8911-477e9b3efd9b]. A G70 customer reported that the app showed “Loading” and would not operate; it loaded after a telecommunications reboot and an update to apps and services [signal:c5531868-e263-48d5-b5d1-002eb277d950].

## What customers say
The G60 customer said deleting and reinstalling the app did not resolve the recurring issue, while Spotify worked on their phone and home Sonos setup [signal:5a61c28b-4f8d-4437-8911-477e9b3efd9b]. The G70 customer confirmed they were using the BMW system app rather than Apple CarPlay or Android Auto [signal:c5531868-e263-48d5-b5d1-002eb277d950].

## Differences between markets
Both complaints are from the USA; one concerns a G60 and the other a G70 [signal:5a61c28b-4f8d-4437-8911-477e9b3efd9b] [signal:c5531868-e263-48d5-b5d1-002eb277d950]. The reports differ in outcome: the G60 issue was recurring despite reinstalling, while the G70 app loaded after a reboot and update [signal:5a61c28b-4f8d-4437-8911-477e9b3efd9b] [signal:c5531868-e263-48d5-b5d1-002eb277d950].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the G70 issue recurred after the app loaded [signal:c5531868-e263-48d5-b5d1-002eb277d950]. They also do not establish how common the issue is beyond these two complaints [signal:5a61c28b-4f8d-4437-8911-477e9b3efd9b] [signal:c5531868-e263-48d5-b5d1-002eb277d950].

value.body_md:
## Problem

## What customers say

G70 customers appreciate being able to see the car and its surroundings, including through surround view in the app. [signal:55b8ba0c-adfe-40fb-b80c-12688e2e9539] [signal:d1c49cbf-461e-4f33-a7ab-8a0d9a1bf1c5]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA: two concern G60 and two concern G70. [signal:8239c750-cd46-40d3-b096-f69c2b5a48fb] [signal:2683ef80-334b-43a2-8f03-f80c99d95b1a] [signal:55b8ba0c-adfe-40fb-b80c-12688e2e9539] [signal:d1c49cbf-461e-4f33-a7ab-8a0d9a1bf1c5]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how many customers want continuous recording beyond the one G60 customer who raised it. [signal:8239c750-cd46-40d3-b096-f69c2b5a48fb]

value.title: 80% charging guidance makes paid-for range feel restricted
value.summary: A USA G60 owner says being advised to stop charging at 80% makes the extra range feel restrictive. Another USA G60 customer values the smooth takeoff and stopping transitions and not needing to plug in.
highlights: One owner says 80% charging guidance limits access to the range they paid for.
Signals concern the G60 in the USA; one owner raises the charging concern.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 owner says being advised to stop charging at 80% feels restrictive because they cannot consistently use the extra range they paid for. [signal:0602c12a-d028-4bde-8147-e648c1b74997] They wish the i5 had lithium iron phosphate batteries so they would not have to worry about charging to 100% regularly. [signal:0602c12a-d028-4bde-8147-e648c1b74997]

## What customers say
One USA G60 owner says the 80% guidance limits their use of the paid-for range. [signal:0602c12a-d028-4bde-8147-e648c1b74997] Another USA G60 customer appreciates that the battery pack and motor setup smooths initial takeoff and the stopping transition, and that they do not have to plug in to charge. [signal:840aba3d-34ca-47c9-b80a-bf9359b115d1]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA and concern the G60. [signal:0602c12a-d028-4bde-8147-e648c1b74997] [signal:840aba3d-34ca-47c9-b80a-bf9359b115d1] One reports concern about charging guidance and usable range, while the other values the smooth transitions and not needing to plug in. [signal:0602c12a-d028-4bde-8147-e648c1b74997] [signal:840aba3d-34ca-47c9-b80a-bf9359b115d1]

## Open questions
- The signals do not specify how many G60 owners share the charging concern. [signal:0602c12a-d028-4bde-8147-e648c1b74997]
- The signals do not give further detail on the conditions behind the 80% charging guidance. [signal:0602c12a-d028-4bde-8147-e648c1b74997]

value.title: Battery faults and warnings affect new BMWs
value.summary: Customers report faulty or quickly depleted batteries and replacement warnings, including shortly after delivery. The reports concern G70 and G60 owners in the USA.
highlights: Battery faults, rapid drain, and replacement warnings
USA reports cover G70 and G60 vehicles
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report battery faults and replacement warnings, including soon after delivery, as well as a battery that seems to run down quickly. [signal:15b06b9e-8653-45e9-8db8-4c90cd58ead6]  [signal:33b4b04f-1805-4cef-b19b-f983b79010da] [signal:3493652e-12ed-4962-98a3-8798bc2899d7]

## What customers say
A G70 owner said a faulty battery left the vehicle unable to start and that the replacement would take a month to arrive from Germany. [signal:15b06b9e-8653-45e9-8db8-4c90cd58ead6]

Another G70 owner reported a 12V battery warning about two days after purchase, followed by dealer replacement. 

A G70 owner said a battery replacement warning had appeared since delivery; the dealer advised driving the vehicle before contacting them about replacement. [signal:3493652e-12ed-4962-98a3-8798bc2899d7]

A G60 owner said the battery seemed to run down quickly and described electrical and drivetrain problems within a couple of months. [signal:33b4b04f-1805-4cef-b19b-f983b79010da]

## Differences between markets
The battery-related reports shown are from the USA and concern G70 and G60 vehicles; no other market is represented in these signals. [signal:15b06b9e-8653-45e9-8db8-4c90cd58ead6]  [signal:33b4b04f-1805-4cef-b19b-f983b79010da] [signal:3493652e-12ed-4962-98a3-8798bc2899d7]

## Open questions
Do the reported faults and warnings share a cause, and how frequently do they occur across G70 and G60 vehicles? [signal:15b06b9e-8653-45e9-8db8-4c90cd58ead6]  [signal:33b4b04f-1805-4cef-b19b-f983b79010da] [signal:3493652e-12ed-4962-98a3-8798bc2899d7]

How long do customers typically wait for replacement batteries? [signal:15b06b9e-8653-45e9-8db8-4c90cd58ead6]

value.title: In-car apps valued, but app choice and use are limited
value.summary: Some USA customers value the available in-car apps, especially Spotify, while others want to install additional apps or use video calling while the vehicle is moving.
highlights: Customers want more app choice and video calling while driving, though some value the available apps.
Signals are from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want to install third-party apps such as Pandora, which is not available as an option in the reported case [signal:3135fb48-32ed-487e-bc6e-2e2eb1d5e268]. Another customer wishes to place video calls while the vehicle is moving, while acknowledging this may be restricted for safety [signal:6351c8ad-3a54-422f-b746-d924c8f4b9d1]. Other customers say they like the available apps [signal:12912f18-2b75-4c2b-bc51-4db85c575fba] [signal:4b428aa5-a785-4ff2-8922-701505ececcd].

## What customers say
A G60 customer wanted to add Pandora and was told custom third-party app installation was not available [signal:3135fb48-32ed-487e-bc6e-2e2eb1d5e268]. A G70 customer wished to use video calling while the vehicle was in motion [signal:6351c8ad-3a54-422f-b746-d924c8f4b9d1].

Other G60 and G70 customers expressed positive views of the apps available in the vehicle [signal:12912f18-2b75-4c2b-bc51-4db85c575fba] [signal:4b428aa5-a785-4ff2-8922-701505ececcd]. Two G70 customers specifically praised Spotify: one liked using it directly through the vehicle [signal:8a6d29f9-37ad-4171-a6da-75c279092852], and another said its sound levels were better than when playing audio via Apple CarPlay [signal:bb8c1c23-ae9c-4a99-a603-d473a70b803b].

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals are all from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles [signal:3135fb48-32ed-487e-bc6e-2e2eb1d5e268] [signal:6351c8ad-3a54-422f-b746-d924c8f4b9d1] [signal:12912f18-2b75-4c2b-bc51-4db85c575fba] [signal:4b428aa5-a785-4ff2-8922-701505ececcd] [signal:8a6d29f9-37ad-4171-a6da-75c279092852] [signal:bb8c1c23-ae9c-4a99-a603-d473a70b803b]. The signals include both requests for broader app access or use and positive feedback about available apps [signal:3135fb48-32ed-487e-bc6e-2e2eb1d5e268] [signal:6351c8ad-3a54-422f-b746-d924c8f4b9d1] [signal:12912f18-2b75-4c2b-bc51-4db85c575fba] [signal:4b428aa5-a785-4ff2-8922-701505ececcd].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the requests for third-party app installation or moving-vehicle video calling are [signal:3135fb48-32ed-487e-bc6e-2e2eb1d5e268] [signal:6351c8ad-3a54-422f-b746-d924c8f4b9d1].

value.title: In-car apps are confusing and feel excessive
value.summary: Some USA G70 and G60 customers find the in-car app experience confusing or excessive, while one customer wants a specific music app. The signals also include questions about app functions and what can be used in the vehicle.
highlights: Customers describe confusing apps, too many choices, and a missing YouTube Music app.
Signals are from USA customers in G70 and G60 vehicles; six signal examples were provided.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say the in-car apps are confusing or take a long time to learn [signal:066c38c2-0f3a-447b-b019-99624032d159] [signal:2eb933a3-7faf-4345-86ab-4de5898a5698]. One customer says there are too many apps available while driving [signal:2eb933a3-7faf-4345-86ab-4de5898a5698], and another considers the app selection excessive [signal:6cdff67e-d831-417f-b62d-e48a31c821a7].

## What customers say
A customer asked how the automated habits app works and was told it can trigger an action at a selected GPS location [signal:0a7606f9-725a-44e2-b39d-4ecf85e09f10]. Another asked about watching YouTube and playing games in the vehicle, and was told games were available through AirConsole using a phone [signal:a8666054-7960-4a23-8eaf-926402aa2350]. One customer wants a YouTube Music app, saying Bluetooth use reduces sound quality [signal:4354c894-e043-4fa1-a274-d189f5d73062].

## Differences between markets
All six provided signal examples are from the USA and concern G70 or G60 vehicles; no other markets or vehicle lines appear in these examples [signal:066c38c2-0f3a-447b-b019-99624032d159] [signal:0a7606f9-725a-44e2-b39d-4ecf85e09f10] [signal:2eb933a3-7faf-4345-86ab-4de5898a5698] [signal:4354c894-e043-4fa1-a274-d189f5d73062] [signal:6cdff67e-d831-417f-b62d-e48a31c821a7] [signal:a8666054-7960-4a23-8eaf-926402aa2350].

## Open questions
Do customers primarily need clearer explanations of app functions, fewer available apps, or particular missing apps? The examples raise each of these concerns [signal:066c38c2-0f3a-447b-b019-99624032d159] [signal:0a7606f9-725a-44e2-b39d-4ecf85e09f10] [signal:6cdff67e-d831-417f-b62d-e48a31c821a7] [signal:4354c894-e043-4fa1-a274-d189f5d73062].

value.title: Battery reliability and purpose are unclear to some owners
value.summary: Some US owners report a battery-related repair issue or uncertainty about what the 48V battery does, while another values the electric battery’s benefits.
highlights: Battery-related repair concerns and uncertainty about the battery’s role appear alongside positive feedback.
USA: signals cover three G60 owners and one G70 customer.
One G60 owner compares the repair experience unfavorably with their Mercedes.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Signals include a reported battery-related repair issue and a customer asking whether a vehicle described as a hybrid is a mild hybrid; another owner appreciates the electric battery’s benefits. [signal:41b758af-6dc9-4f20-b490-b26094f7d856] [signal:e6ba3edc-ff96-477b-bc8f-a9c5bb60e6f5] [signal:80173ece-d4a5-49c0-a98e-949c92791cb7]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the dealer attributed a check-engine-light issue to cell module 1 and two connected batteries, with repairs expected to take at least three to four weeks. [signal:41b758af-6dc9-4f20-b490-b26094f7d856]
A G70 customer asks whether the car is a mild hybrid after seeing it labeled as a hybrid; the writer explains its 48V battery’s role in some driving scenarios, and the customer acknowledges the explanation. [signal:e6ba3edc-ff96-477b-bc8f-a9c5bb60e6f5]
A G60 owner says they appreciate the electric battery’s benefits and do not miss visiting gas stations. [signal:80173ece-d4a5-49c0-a98e-949c92791cb7]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA. [signal:08c0f648-ec41-4c4d-aba6-d8705dcd6b7f] [signal:41b758af-6dc9-4f20-b490-b26094f7d856] [signal:e6ba3edc-ff96-477b-bc8f-a9c5bb60e6f5] [signal:80173ece-d4a5-49c0-a98e-949c92791cb7] Feedback differs: one owner reports a battery-related repair issue, while another expresses appreciation for the electric battery. [signal:41b758af-6dc9-4f20-b490-b26094f7d856] [signal:80173ece-d4a5-49c0-a98e-949c92791cb7]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common battery-related repair issues are beyond the reported case. [signal:41b758af-6dc9-4f20-b490-b26094f7d856] They also do not show whether the G70 customer’s question reflects broader confusion about the 48V battery. [signal:e6ba3edc-ff96-477b-bc8f-a9c5bb60e6f5]

value.title: Regenerative braking slows the car when lifting off

value.title: Fueling instructions and nozzle behavior cause confusion
value.summary: US customers report uncertainty about fuel guidance and the purpose of a component by the fuel opening, alongside nozzle shutoff and fuel overspill issues. Signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report confusing fuel guidance, a nozzle that clicks off early, and fuel overspill.
All four signals are from the USA: three concern G60 and one concerns G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
US customers report difficulty understanding fuel guidance and a black component beside the filler opening; other reports describe the nozzle clicking off before the tank is full or fuel overspilling during automatic filling. [signal:0610a0ec-f858-4e4d-861e-74a763ad83b1] [signal:4e4b673f-526c-4a56-ae38-e5c45120e7a2] [signal:51767518-eef3-4a40-ae0b-434a47773721] [signal:dcb5b56f-8ad3-426f-81f9-0d60ed2a315f]

## What customers say
One G60 customer described a mismatch between sales-representative advice to use 91 octane or above and a fuel-door label recommending 89 to 93 octane. [signal:0610a0ec-f858-4e4d-861e-74a763ad83b1]
A G70 customer asked about the black component beside the fuel opening; the service writer described it as a vent. [signal:4e4b673f-526c-4a56-ae38-e5c45120e7a2]
A G60 customer said the fuel nozzle repeatedly clicked off before the tank was full. [signal:51767518-eef3-4a40-ae0b-434a47773721]
Another G60 customer reported a small fuel overspill when using a gas station's automatic nozzle feature. [signal:dcb5b56f-8ad3-426f-81f9-0d60ed2a315f]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA, so the provided evidence does not show differences between markets. [signal:0610a0ec-f858-4e4d-861e-74a763ad83b1] [signal:4e4b673f-526c-4a56-ae38-e5c45120e7a2] [signal:51767518-eef3-4a40-ae0b-434a47773721] [signal:dcb5b56f-8ad3-426f-81f9-0d60ed2a315f]

## Open questions
Do customers experience the early nozzle shutoff or overspill across other vehicles or fueling conditions? [signal:51767518-eef3-4a40-ae0b-434a47773721] [signal:dcb5b56f-8ad3-426f-81f9-0d60ed2a315f]
How often do customers find the fuel-octane guidance or the component beside the filler opening unclear? [signal:0610a0ec-f858-4e4d-861e-74a763ad83b1]

value.title: Fuel tank size and range are valued unevenly
value.summary: Some customers want a larger tank, while others value the available capacity and range. Signals differ across markets and vehicle lines.
highlights: Some customers want a bigger tank; others value the tank size and range.
Signals span USA, Europe and Rest of World, across G70, G60 and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers would prefer a larger fuel tank: one Rest of World F70 owner says the tank should be bigger, and a USA G70 owner compares their 760 xDrive unfavorably with an older 750’s tank size [signal:9f230a69-1558-4333-9e54-24266c90c3c0] [signal:75ab608e-ab81-4e61-a74e-27303597eb7a]. Other customers value the capacity and range, including a USA G70 owner who reports around 400 miles on a full tank [signal:3c6126fb-47bc-4f72-b287-abc432cb1de6].

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer appreciates that the 2026 has a larger tank than the 2016 [signal:44962b5b-3361-4e6f-ae2c-b0de9e7303ff]. A USA G60 customer values its full-size tank compared with a prior hybrid’s smaller tank, and another describes the G60’s full-tank range as strong [signal:5bf5f55d-76f7-497d-87b3-346394b9669c] [signal:5c57a777-eba6-473e-b8a1-69a42c2eac84]. A Europe F70 owner says the bigger tank, together with better fuel economy and regenerative braking, provides a useful increase in overall range [signal:5b79047f-957c-496b-a701-ef7f223f0779].

## Differences between markets
USA signals include both a request for more tank capacity on a 760 xDrive and positive feedback on tank size or range for G70 and G60 vehicles [signal:75ab608e-ab81-4e61-a74e-27303597eb7a] [signal:44962b5b-3361-4e6f-ae2c-b0de9e7303ff] [signal:3c6126fb-47bc-4f72-b287-abc432cb1de6] [signal:5bf5f55d-76f7-497d-87b3-346394b9669c] [signal:5c57a777-eba6-473e-b8a1-69a42c2eac84]. For the F70, a Rest of World customer wants a larger tank, while a Europe customer praises the bigger tank’s contribution to range [signal:9f230a69-1558-4333-9e54-24266c90c3c0] [signal:5b79047f-957c-496b-a701-ef7f223f0779].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how tank capacity or driving conditions relate to the different range assessments [signal:3c6126fb-47bc-4f72-b287-abc432cb1de6] [signal:5c57a777-eba6-473e-b8a1-69a42c2eac84] [signal:9f230a69-1558-4333-9e54-24266c90c3c0].

value.title: Remote 3D View is slow, distorted, or difficult to activate
value.summary: USA customers report slow, distorted camera images and difficulty finding or enabling Remote 3D View’s data privacy setting. The signals cover G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Slow, distorted images and confusing or missing activation settings
Four USA signals: one G70 and three G60
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that Remote 3D View can refresh slowly and produce a distorted image [signal:5e34f0ce-4f04-4cf0-b1e3-1807f391ba7b]. Other customers have difficulty enabling or accessing the feature through data privacy settings [signal:91946e45-315a-442c-94f2-070323ff6e05] [signal:93dbbabc-3998-4464-abc9-546162c91bab] [signal:e0dc8b53-fe3e-49a5-b7d3-048cef86c13a].

## What customers say
A G70 customer said the remote camera view refreshed slowly and looked warped [signal:5e34f0ce-4f04-4cf0-b1e3-1807f391ba7b]. In one G60 case, the setting was still missing after the customer followed guidance and tried an iDrive reset and app and service updates [signal:e0dc8b53-fe3e-49a5-b7d3-048cef86c13a].

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA; there is no evidence about other markets [signal:5e34f0ce-4f04-4cf0-b1e3-1807f391ba7b] [signal:91946e45-315a-442c-94f2-070323ff6e05] [signal:93dbbabc-3998-4464-abc9-546162c91bab] [signal:e0dc8b53-fe3e-49a5-b7d3-048cef86c13a].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the slow, distorted image and the activation or settings issues share a cause [signal:5e34f0ce-4f04-4cf0-b1e3-1807f391ba7b] [signal:91946e45-315a-442c-94f2-070323ff6e05] [signal:93dbbabc-3998-4464-abc9-546162c91bab] [signal:e0dc8b53-fe3e-49a5-b7d3-048cef86c13a].

value.title: Welcome light animation fails after subscription activation
value.summary: A customer in the USA reported that the Welcome Light Carpet animation did not work after activating the subscription. The issue persisted after an iDrive reboot.
highlights: Welcome light animation remained unavailable after subscription activation and an iDrive reboot.
One reported case: a USA customer with a G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer reported that the welcome light animation did not work after the subscription was activated; the subscription showed as active, and an iDrive reboot did not resolve the issue. [signal:fc07863f-28ec-41d0-bc49-69995a0d7a21]

## What customers say
The customer said the dealership suggested an iDrive reboot, which did not restore the animation. [signal:fc07863f-28ec-41d0-bc49-69995a0d7a21] The customer also said the dealership seemed to know little about the feature. [signal:fc07863f-28ec-41d0-bc49-69995a0d7a21]

## Differences between markets
The signal is from one USA customer with a G60; there is no evidence about other markets or vehicle lines. [signal:fc07863f-28ec-41d0-bc49-69995a0d7a21]

## Open questions
The signal does not say whether the issue was ultimately resolved or whether other customers experienced it. [signal:fc07863f-28ec-41d0-bc49-69995a0d7a21]

value.title: Brake regeneration preferences are not retained or adjustable enough
value.summary: Some US G60 and G70 customers want B Mode to be the startup default, more control over recuperation, or stronger deceleration through a full stop. The signals reflect differing preferences for how brake regeneration behaves.
highlights: Customers request default B Mode, adjustable or stronger recuperation, and deceleration to a full stop.
Signals are from US customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want B Mode retained or selected at startup, while others want to adjust or increase brake recuperation; one customer wants lift-off regeneration to slow the vehicle to a full stop. [signal:184caaeb-310a-4e64-badf-ede68a336c39] [signal:2b901629-254b-44d3-9b3e-f812554204c9] [signal:4e8db60a-f211-438f-a17d-e6018efe190a] [signal:4f96dfb8-36ad-4cac-a3d2-a1daab6e7eae] [signal:5689af0a-1e81-44b9-9c80-f5bbb5b5fee8] [signal:7f238367-8597-4ef0-92ab-35a89efc3e57]

## What customers say
Two G60 customers prefer B Mode as the default at startup. [signal:184caaeb-310a-4e64-badf-ede68a336c39] [signal:5689af0a-1e81-44b9-9c80-f5bbb5b5fee8] Three G70 customers ask for adjustable or higher recuperation, or for the vehicle to start directly in B Mode. [signal:2b901629-254b-44d3-9b3e-f812554204c9] [signal:4e8db60a-f211-438f-a17d-e6018efe190a] [signal:4f96dfb8-36ad-4cac-a3d2-a1daab6e7eae] A further G70 customer wants lift-off regeneration to bring the vehicle to a full stop. [signal:7f238367-8597-4ef0-92ab-35a89efc3e57]

## Differences between markets
All six provided signals are from the USA, so they do not show differences between markets. [signal:184caaeb-310a-4e64-badf-ede68a336c39] [signal:2b901629-254b-44d3-9b3e-f812554204c9] [signal:4e8db60a-f211-438f-a17d-e6018efe190a] [signal:4f96dfb8-36ad-4cac-a3d2-a1daab6e7eae] [signal:5689af0a-1e81-44b9-9c80-f5bbb5b5fee8] [signal:7f238367-8597-4ef0-92ab-35a89efc3e57]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common each preference is across the full set of 16 signals, or whether preferences differ beyond the examples provided. [signal:184caaeb-310a-4e64-badf-ede68a336c39] [signal:2b901629-254b-44d3-9b3e-f812554204c9] [signal:4e8db60a-f211-438f-a17d-e6018efe190a] [signal:4f96dfb8-36ad-4cac-a3d2-a1daab6e7eae] [signal:5689af0a-1e81-44b9-9c80-f5bbb5b5fee8] [signal:7f238367-8597-4ef0-92ab-35a89efc3e57]

value.title: Front camera image makes parking obstacles seem closer
value.summary: A USA G60 customer says the front camera image makes obstacles appear closer than they are and makes parking blocks harder to see.
highlights: Front camera perspective makes obstacle distance harder to judge.
Reported by one customer in the USA on a G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer says the front camera image makes obstacles appear closer than they are and makes parking blocks harder to see. [signal:e2b774bb-0081-44e8-ab35-4aa0e477a375]

## What customers say
The customer compared the camera position with an earlier 2016 5 Series and said the current front camera appears slightly higher. [signal:e2b774bb-0081-44e8-ab35-4aa0e477a375] They said the image seems to show them nearer to obstacles than they actually are, making parking blocks more difficult to see. [signal:e2b774bb-0081-44e8-ab35-4aa0e477a375]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from the USA, so there is no market comparison in the available evidence. [signal:e2b774bb-0081-44e8-ab35-4aa0e477a375]

## Open questions
Does this camera-image concern occur for other G60 customers or in other markets? [signal:e2b774bb-0081-44e8-ab35-4aa0e477a375]

value.title: Welcome light carpet does not project the requested BMW logo
value.summary: Some USA customers want the door-opening lights to project a BMW logo onto the ground rather than provide basic illumination. Other customers value the welcome lights and ground illumination, including customers in the Rest of World market.
highlights: Some customers want logo projection instead of basic door-opening illumination.
USA G70 and G60 customers request logo projection; positive feedback comes from USA G60 and Rest of World F70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some USA customers say the door-opening lights provide basic illumination and want them to project a BMW logo onto the ground instead. [signal:7d51be1c-c2ac-402c-99bc-6bfc6b5e55a4] Another USA customer asks for the roundel to project onto the ground when the doors open. [signal:bedc7b0a-c722-4958-aed1-db0fcc2d6f51]

## What customers say
A G60 customer asked how to make the BMW logo appear on the ground and was told to check that Welcome Lights were switched on in the vehicle settings. [signal:9f4dc10f-b961-4840-9e22-bb83e5881f1c] A separate G60 customer says they like the Welcome Lights. [signal:6b939740-404f-4bed-931f-43c48c36a778] Another G60 customer likes that the car lights up as they walk past. [signal:64ab66b2-890d-48d3-ad41-4bac0afd5e69] An F70 customer in the Rest of World market says the M light on the ground when stepping out in the dark is handy. [signal:27115705-f876-42b2-9fea-4ac0117be09f]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include requests for ground projection on G70 and G60 vehicles, alongside positive feedback about Welcome Lights on G60 vehicles. [signal:7d51be1c-c2ac-402c-99bc-6bfc6b5e55a4] [signal:bedc7b0a-c722-4958-aed1-db0fcc2d6f51] [signal:9f4dc10f-b961-4840-9e22-bb83e5881f1c] [signal:6b939740-404f-4bed-931f-43c48c36a778] In the Rest of World signal, an F70 customer values the M light projected on the ground. [signal:27115705-f876-42b2-9fea-4ac0117be09f]

## Open questions
Do customers requesting a BMW logo projection mean the same thing as customers valuing the existing M light on the ground? [signal:7d51be1c-c2ac-402c-99bc-6bfc6b5e55a4] [signal:27115705-f876-42b2-9fea-4ac0117be09f] Is uncertainty about whether Welcome Lights are equipped or switched on also present beyond the one G60 interaction? [signal:9f4dc10f-b961-4840-9e22-bb83e5881f1c]

value.title: Camera cleaning is hard to find and 360 view is not standard
value.summary: A G60 owner in the USA had difficulty finding how to clean the cameras, while a G70 owner said a 360 camera was not included as standard.
highlights: Camera-cleaning controls are difficult to find, and a 360 camera was reported absent as standard.
Signals concern USA owners of the G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 owner reported difficulty working out how to clean the cameras after receiving a dirty-camera notification. [signal:3adbbd91-bbcf-48b6-bfcb-70ad4ce962ef] A G70 owner said a 360 camera was not included as standard. [signal:7c0886d4-905d-46dc-aeee-a3d853215e1d]

## What customers say
The G60 owner asked how to clean the cameras; the service writer described a route through the Apps menu, Parking app, More, and Camera Cleaning. [signal:3adbbd91-bbcf-48b6-bfcb-70ad4ce962ef] The G70 owner also complained about creaking rear interior door panels and the absence of standard 360 camera coverage. [signal:7c0886d4-905d-46dc-aeee-a3d853215e1d]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA, covering the G60 and G70. [signal:3adbbd91-bbcf-48b6-bfcb-70ad4ce962ef] [signal:7c0886d4-905d-46dc-aeee-a3d853215e1d]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether camera-cleaning discoverability or standard 360 camera availability is a broader issue beyond these reports. [signal:3adbbd91-bbcf-48b6-bfcb-70ad4ce962ef] [signal:7c0886d4-905d-46dc-aeee-a3d853215e1d]

value.title: Surround View cameras stop displaying images
value.summary: Customers in the USA report front or rear camera images failing or disappearing, including an intermittent front-camera failure. The reports involve G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Front or rear camera images fail to appear or stop working.
Three USA complaints involve G70 and G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report front or rear camera images that do not appear, show black, or stop functioning. [signal:56aa362c-95ab-42cf-825f-0012bc3ce9bf] [signal:59423b23-ead5-4ed4-8510-55db1845f7e9] [signal:ce40e440-79f0-4f76-8150-bfc3d38a1b34]

## What customers say
A G70 customer said the front image would not appear while parking; after the camera was replaced, it worked properly. [signal:56aa362c-95ab-42cf-825f-0012bc3ce9bf]

A G60 customer said the rear image appeared black; the repair was completed and the customer reported no further issues. [signal:59423b23-ead5-4ed4-8510-55db1845f7e9]

Another G70 customer said the front camera failed after the first day of ownership, worked at the dealership, then failed again after the drive home; the side cameras continued to work. [signal:ce40e440-79f0-4f76-8150-bfc3d38a1b34]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA, covering G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:56aa362c-95ab-42cf-825f-0012bc3ce9bf] [signal:59423b23-ead5-4ed4-8510-55db1845f7e9] [signal:ce40e440-79f0-4f76-8150-bfc3d38a1b34] No other markets are represented in these signals. [signal:56aa362c-95ab-42cf-825f-0012bc3ce9bf] [signal:59423b23-ead5-4ed4-8510-55db1845f7e9] [signal:ce40e440-79f0-4f76-8150-bfc3d38a1b34]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequently these failures occur or whether they share a cause. [signal:56aa362c-95ab-42cf-825f-0012bc3ce9bf] [signal:59423b23-ead5-4ed4-8510-55db1845f7e9] [signal:ce40e440-79f0-4f76-8150-bfc3d38a1b34] The outcome of the final G70 customer's return to the dealership is not included in the signal. [signal:ce40e440-79f0-4f76-8150-bfc3d38a1b34]

value.title: Caring Car function missing from G60
value.summary: A customer in the USA misses the Caring Car function in the G60. She valued the Vitalize program for waking her up and the Relax program for calming her before stressful activities.
highlights: A customer misses the Caring Car function in her vehicle.
The signal is from one customer in the USA with a G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer says she misses the Caring Car function in her G60. [signal:7a0f56a7-4cf8-43df-a80f-0d72b8183e4a]

## What customers say
She liked the Vitalize program to help wake her up and would use the Relax program to calm herself before stressful activities. [signal:7a0f56a7-4cf8-43df-a80f-0d72b8183e4a] She also enjoyed music playing with the old Relax mode. [signal:7a0f56a7-4cf8-43df-a80f-0d72b8183e4a]

## Differences between markets
The signal is from the USA; there are no signals from other markets to compare. [signal:7a0f56a7-4cf8-43df-a80f-0d72b8183e4a]

## Open questions
Are other customers missing the Caring Car function, and do they value the same programs and music experience? [signal:7a0f56a7-4cf8-43df-a80f-0d72b8183e4a]

value.title: Welcome light carpet use and controls are unclear
value.summary: Customers in the USA are unclear about some welcome-light options and want the ground-projection lighting to support additional uses. Other customers value the lighting’s appearance and want it to stay on after the vehicle is turned off.
highlights: Customers ask what welcome-light options do and want the ground projection to help when reversing.
Signals are from five USA customers across G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers ask for clarification about welcome-light options, while another wants the welcome light carpet to turn on when reversing to help spot obstacles at night. [signal:b3bff01e-c1fd-42c8-b45c-9c6de0eaeac2] [signal:b31c1026-0c2f-44e5-86cc-2bb179715768]

A customer also asked whether the ground projection could display the BMW logo and was told this could not be changed through the vehicle. [signal:de62953b-a906-4370-a236-dad07029bd0c]

## What customers say
One G70 customer said the crystal headlights sparkle when approaching the vehicle and make them feel fancy. [signal:8b6f1e59-d5ea-43a2-8a84-267424b59a69]

Another customer wanted a way to keep the lights on for a set period after the vehicle is turned off. [signal:e38ed63d-e665-4c7f-98ec-2b6537aa8485]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA, covering G60 and G70 vehicles; the signals do not provide a market-to-market comparison. [signal:b3bff01e-c1fd-42c8-b45c-9c6de0eaeac2] [signal:de62953b-a906-4370-a236-dad07029bd0c] [signal:b31c1026-0c2f-44e5-86cc-2bb179715768] [signal:8b6f1e59-d5ea-43a2-8a84-267424b59a69] [signal:e38ed63d-e665-4c7f-98ec-2b6537aa8485]

## Open questions
Do customers understand the distinction between the welcome-light animation and the regular welcome lights? [signal:b3bff01e-c1fd-42c8-b45c-9c6de0eaeac2]

How often do customers want the ground projection for reversing or want to change its displayed image? [signal:b31c1026-0c2f-44e5-86cc-2bb179715768] [signal:de62953b-a906-4370-a236-dad07029bd0c]

value.title: Brake energy recuperation feels difficult to understand and predict
value.summary: Some USA G60 and G70 customers find brake energy recuperation confusing, uncomfortable, or unpredictable, including its settings and how it changes the vehicle’s deceleration.
highlights: Customers report confusing settings, unexpected coasting, unfamiliar slowing, and a jolt near stopping.
Signals are from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe recuperation as difficult to understand or adjust, and some report behavior that feels unexpected or uncomfortable. [signal:4e9af550-61ab-40e3-9925-263215b9822b] [signal:75513aa7-c37b-4e3a-a54b-ce3a921ab35a] [signal:86389a96-d8d7-48b0-96ef-727f1cbecb7e]

One G60 customer said the vehicle slowed more than expected when lifting off the accelerator and felt different from an ICE vehicle; the customer felt the explanation at purchase could have been better. [signal:72e3ecea-38be-45ce-a136-93ec27c785ad] Another G60 customer said the i5 sometimes coasted unexpectedly and was challenging to adjust to compared with the iX. [signal:86389a96-d8d7-48b0-96ef-727f1cbecb7e] A G70 customer reported a jolt as the vehicle came to a stop with recuperation on, which was absent when it was turned off. [signal:77fc2bee-9cd7-4fb2-bf79-1f2f5915c01e]

## What customers say
A G60 customer asked how Adaptive, High, Medium, and Low differ; the explanation given was that Adaptive varies recuperation with driving conditions, while the other levels keep it fixed. [signal:4e9af550-61ab-40e3-9925-263215b9822b] Another G60 customer asked whether turn-signal use affects recuperation and whether Sport mode gives the strongest regeneration. [signal:384c609f-4f04-420e-ba5b-3f70e64761c5]

A G70 customer said they were uncomfortable with adaptive recuperation and asked whether it could be adjusted. [signal:75513aa7-c37b-4e3a-a54b-ce3a921ab35a] A separate G70 report described a jolt at a complete stop, with Automatic Hold inactive; the customer said the behavior had not occurred at delivery and had not yet been reported to a dealer. [signal:77fc2bee-9cd7-4fb2-bf79-1f2f5915c01e]

## Differences between markets
All six supplied signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:384c609f-4f04-420e-ba5b-3f70e64761c5] [signal:4e9af550-61ab-40e3-9925-263215b9822b] [signal:72e3ecea-38be-45ce-a136-93ec27c785ad] [signal:75513aa7-c37b-4e3a-a54b-ce3a921ab35a] [signal:77fc2bee-9cd7-4fb2-bf79-1f2f5915c01e] [signal:86389a96-d8d7-48b0-96ef-727f1cbecb7e]

The supplied signals include G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:384c609f-4f04-420e-ba5b-3f70e64761c5] [signal:75513aa7-c37b-4e3a-a54b-ce3a921ab35a] The G60 reports include questions about settings and differences in deceleration behavior; the G70 reports include discomfort with adaptive recuperation and a jolt at stopping. [signal:4e9af550-61ab-40e3-9925-263215b9822b] [signal:86389a96-d8d7-48b0-96ef-727f1cbecb7e] [signal:75513aa7-c37b-4e3a-a54b-ce3a921ab35a] [signal:77fc2bee-9cd7-4fb2-bf79-1f2f5915c01e]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why the reported jolt occurs or whether it is limited to a particular vehicle condition. [signal:77fc2bee-9cd7-4fb2-bf79-1f2f5915c01e] They also do not establish how common these experiences are beyond the supplied reports.

value.title: Auto-Hold brakes fail to release consistently
value.summary: Some customers report Auto-Hold failing to release the brakes as expected, including one case where the parking brake remained locked. A European F70 customer also says Auto-Hold cannot be left permanently enabled.
highlights: Auto-Hold may hold the brakes on or release them only after hard acceleration.
Signals concern USA G60 and G70 customers and a Europe F70 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe Auto-Hold brake-release problems: one reports the parking brake locking and not releasing, while another reports that the brakes do not release before hard acceleration. [signal:679a0a5b-0b69-471e-b3b4-cf1014edb2ee] [signal:9e54e60b-2b14-451a-bf0d-d24652b67639]

A European F70 customer says Auto-Hold cannot be left permanently enabled; the available quote is truncated. [signal:ce2b1b33-d5d5-4f8e-8aa4-62cefcf000fb]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer says the parking brake locked while Auto-Hold was active and could not be released by accelerating or switching Auto-Hold off; Genius advised waiting about 30 minutes for a system reset. [signal:679a0a5b-0b69-471e-b3b4-cf1014edb2ee]

A USA G70 customer says the brakes fail to release before hard acceleration, causing a bang from the electric motor area, and keeps the feature turned off. [signal:9e54e60b-2b14-451a-bf0d-d24652b67639]

A Europe F70 customer says Auto-Hold cannot be left permanently enabled, but the reason is unclear in the truncated quote. [signal:ce2b1b33-d5d5-4f8e-8aa4-62cefcf000fb]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals describe brake-release problems on G60 and G70, while the Europe F70 signal describes an inability to leave Auto-Hold permanently enabled. [signal:679a0a5b-0b69-471e-b3b4-cf1014edb2ee] [signal:9e54e60b-2b14-451a-bf0d-d24652b67639] [signal:ce2b1b33-d5d5-4f8e-8aa4-62cefcf000fb]

## Open questions
The available Europe quote is cut off, so the reason Auto-Hold cannot be left permanently enabled is unknown. [signal:ce2b1b33-d5d5-4f8e-8aa4-62cefcf000fb]

value.title: Surround View missing from some G60 and G70 vehicles
value.summary: Some USA customers miss Surround View in their current G60 or G70, including after having it in a previous BMW; another customer says they love the vehicle’s cameras.
highlights: Some customers want Surround View or miss its absence in their current vehicle.
USA signals include G60 and G70 customers; four request or miss Surround View, while one praises the cameras.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some USA customers say their current G60 or G70 lacks Surround View, or that they want the feature. One G70 customer says their previous 7 Series had it, and another says their last BMW was equipped with it. [signal:32dd174f-f4f1-4f41-a7d7-341b2f02e048] [signal:6f53035f-4b82-43d1-9274-792470b19d10]

A G70 customer says every BMW 760 ought to have side-view cameras that provide a complete surround view. [signal:a230c3b4-74dc-44dc-bb61-fff8a562bffb]

## What customers say
A G70 customer says they love all of the vehicle’s cameras. [signal:1765e11f-9b64-41bc-92c3-97fa8fc90447]

Customer feedback is not uniformly negative: some request or miss Surround View, while another praises the vehicle’s cameras. [signal:32dd174f-f4f1-4f41-a7d7-341b2f02e048] [signal:6f53035f-4b82-43d1-9274-792470b19d10] [signal:a230c3b4-74dc-44dc-bb61-fff8a562bffb] [signal:1765e11f-9b64-41bc-92c3-97fa8fc90447]

## Differences between markets
The supplied Surround View feedback is from the USA and concerns G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:32dd174f-f4f1-4f41-a7d7-341b2f02e048] [signal:6f53035f-4b82-43d1-9274-792470b19d10] [signal:a230c3b4-74dc-44dc-bb61-fff8a562bffb] [signal:1765e11f-9b64-41bc-92c3-97fa8fc90447]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often Surround View is absent across G60 or G70 vehicles, or whether the camera praise refers specifically to Surround View. [signal:32dd174f-f4f1-4f41-a7d7-341b2f02e048] [signal:6f53035f-4b82-43d1-9274-792470b19d10] [signal:1765e11f-9b64-41bc-92c3-97fa8fc90447]

value.title: Surround View controls are difficult to find or access
value.summary: Some US G60 and G70 customers find camera or related parking functions difficult to access, or want camera views in situations where they are not appearing automatically. The signals describe both difficulty locating controls and requests for additional camera access.
highlights: Camera and parking-function access can be difficult or unavailable when customers want it.
Four US signals cover the G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
US customers describe difficulty finding or accessing camera and parking-related functions. One G60 customer asked how to switch on the cameras before entering a garage, and a G70 customer found Car Wash Mode challenging to locate. [signal:189d0a3c-aaca-496b-9648-1b4349c862f2] [signal:2a64b7b5-7fb7-4f91-81ad-ab7e155c4e42]

Other customers want camera views in specific situations: one requested a rearview camera on the center display with the theatre screen lowered, and another wanted the front camera to appear when approaching a curb. [signal:a2cb91e8-de38-4e21-87ab-d7bcdd53aef9] [signal:d852f714-6e44-47c5-b4b5-e501474194f4]

## What customers say
A G60 customer worried about bumping into something in the garage and asked how to activate the cameras before pulling in; the explanation cited the parking button on the center console. [signal:189d0a3c-aaca-496b-9648-1b4349c862f2]

A G70 customer said reaching Car Wash Mode while pulling into a car wash requires pressing several buttons. [signal:2a64b7b5-7fb7-4f91-81ad-ab7e155c4e42]

A G70 customer wanted the rearview camera on the center display while the theatre screen is lowered. [signal:a2cb91e8-de38-4e21-87ab-d7bcdd53aef9]

A G60 customer said the front camera typically does not activate automatically near curbs because they are too low for the vehicle to sense, and noted that the cameras can be brought up manually using the Parking Assistant button. [signal:d852f714-6e44-47c5-b4b5-e501474194f4]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA; they cover the G60 and G70. [signal:189d0a3c-aaca-496b-9648-1b4349c862f2] [signal:2a64b7b5-7fb7-4f91-81ad-ab7e155c4e42] [signal:a2cb91e8-de38-4e21-87ab-d7bcdd53aef9] [signal:d852f714-6e44-47c5-b4b5-e501474194f4]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these access difficulties or camera-view requests are among G60 or G70 customers. value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers report that rear passengers do not understand how to use the Rear Passenger Touch Command controllers. [signal:0a1a76d3-028a-42ec-93b9-1236646a1c04]

Another customer said a young child’s tapping on the rear touch pads changed vehicle modes, climate settings, and sun shades. [signal:3753499a-33d9-4e38-9624-01ad300a2a39] The customer was told that some functions could be disabled, but not all. [signal:3753499a-33d9-4e38-9624-01ad300a2a39]

## What customers say
One customer said passengers did not understand how to use the controllers. [signal:0a1a76d3-028a-42ec-93b9-1236646a1c04] Another described unintended setting changes when a child tapped the pads. [signal:3753499a-33d9-4e38-9624-01ad300a2a39]

## Differences between markets
Both relevant signals are USA complaints about the G70; there is no market comparison for this feature in the relevant signals. [signal:0a1a76d3-028a-42ec-93b9-1236646a1c04] [signal:3753499a-33d9-4e38-9624-01ad300a2a39]

## Open questions
How often do rear passengers have difficulty understanding the controllers, and which functions are most often changed unintentionally?

value.title: Automatic-hold is hard to access and use smoothly
value.summary: Automatic-hold can be difficult to find, understand, or use smoothly. The signals describe these concerns among USA G60 and G70 customers and Europe F70 customers.
highlights: Automatic-hold access, operation, and smooth pull-away are usability concerns.
Signals mention USA G60 and G70 customers and Europe F70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe automatic-hold as difficult to access or understand, and some find pulling away or manoeuvring with it difficult to do smoothly. [signal:17e120f5-9b94-4d6e-ae58-73ef3737bf52] [signal:84d505c7-36d9-4e4a-bb0b-103327f1fc75] Some USA customers ask what the Auto H button does or need help understanding how the feature releases. [signal:1c210942-bb07-458c-9358-08790deca9c1] [signal:2130fccd-aa9d-440e-91e5-617fd4873959]

## What customers say
A Europe F70 customer says automatic-hold is awkward to access and needlessly complex. [signal:17e120f5-9b94-4d6e-ae58-73ef3737bf52] Another says enabling it takes four sections of the central screen and must be repeated for each trip. [signal:99009ed2-0600-4fbc-a081-6e864ef65c8c] A separate F70 customer describes pull-away and manoeuvring as all-or-nothing, while noting they are becoming more accustomed to it. [signal:84d505c7-36d9-4e4a-bb0b-103327f1fc75]

USA G60 customers report uncertainty about the button and whether the car will move when traffic does, and one describes inconsistent behavior when releasing the brake at red lights. [signal:63cc6f24-f28a-4540-9a55-bb6e5f540dff] [signal:2affbfae-2447-4e53-83e7-caba6e2cf22c] A USA G70 customer says they need to press the accelerator to release the brake when parking, and another asked what the console button does. [signal:0bd8eaf2-fb10-4048-bff7-4f5e838efee3] [signal:1c210942-bb07-458c-9358-08790deca9c1]

## Differences between markets
The Europe F70 signals emphasize difficult access, repeated activation, and smoothness when pulling away or manoeuvring. [signal:17e120f5-9b94-4d6e-ae58-73ef3737bf52] [signal:99009ed2-0600-4fbc-a081-6e864ef65c8c] [signal:84d505c7-36d9-4e4a-bb0b-103327f1fc75] The USA G60 and G70 signals describe questions about the feature’s operation and reports of inconsistent stopping behavior. [signal:63cc6f24-f28a-4540-9a55-bb6e5f540dff] [signal:2affbfae-2447-4e53-83e7-caba6e2cf22c] [signal:0bd8eaf2-fb10-4048-bff7-4f5e838efee3] These signals do not establish whether the differences are specific to each market or vehicle line.

## Open questions
How often do customers encounter difficulty finding or reactivating automatic-hold? [signal:99009ed2-0600-4fbc-a081-6e864ef65c8c] How common are reports of abrupt pull-away or inconsistent holding across the vehicle lines mentioned? [signal:84d505c7-36d9-4e4a-bb0b-103327f1fc75] [signal:2affbfae-2447-4e53-83e7-caba6e2cf22c]

value.title: Rear touch controls are hard to read or use
value.summary: Some USA G70 customers value managing features from the rear seats, while others say the rear touch controls are difficult to read or less straightforward than they would like.
highlights: Rear touch controls draw complaints about readability and ease of use.
Signals include USA G70 customers and a broader controls complaint from a Europe F70 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers report that rear touch controls are difficult to read or use, while others value being able to manage features from the rear seats. [signal:749fd72b-122a-4a44-92f6-27a54e336596] [signal:af3f6143-3a8d-4bc9-bb1d-a37bc5395986] [signal:0288c09b-a4fa-4bca-a0c8-38f082155e82] [signal:02f96582-67fc-4b70-9885-48c4144eb278]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer says the lettering on the rear door-handle tablet is too small to read easily, even with glasses. [signal:749fd72b-122a-4a44-92f6-27a54e336596]

Another USA G70 customer prefers quick-select buttons for rear-seat heating and massage, saying they would make it simpler for children to operate those functions. [signal:af3f6143-3a8d-4bc9-bb1d-a37bc5395986]

Other USA G70 customers praise the rear touch controls for managing media, sunshades and volume from the rear seats. [signal:0288c09b-a4fa-4bca-a0c8-38f082155e82] [signal:02f96582-67fc-4b70-9885-48c4144eb278]

## Differences between markets
The rear touch-control comments shown here are from USA G70 customers; the positive and negative feedback differs. [signal:749fd72b-122a-4a44-92f6-27a54e336596] [signal:af3f6143-3a8d-4bc9-bb1d-a37bc5395986] [signal:0288c09b-a4fa-4bca-a0c8-38f082155e82] [signal:02f96582-67fc-4b70-9885-48c4144eb278]

A Europe F70 customer describes the car’s controls more generally as complicated and difficult to understand; the comment does not specifically mention rear touch controls. [signal:b7895152-be8f-4255-a7f1-ba96167ce440]

## Open questions
Do the readability and usability concerns extend beyond the individual USA G70 customers who raised them? [signal:749fd72b-122a-4a44-92f6-27a54e336596] [signal:af3f6143-3a8d-4bc9-bb1d-a37bc5395986]

How do customers weigh the convenience of rear-seat feature control against the effort needed to read and operate the interface? [signal:749fd72b-122a-4a44-92f6-27a54e336596] [signal:0288c09b-a4fa-4bca-a0c8-38f082155e82]

value.title: Range estimates fluctuate and battery range seems to drop quickly
value.summary: USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles report fluctuating range estimates and battery range that seems to fall quickly. The signals also show customers seeking clarity on what affects range.
highlights: Customers report fluctuating estimates and range that seems to drop quickly.
The supplied signals include USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the range estimate fluctuates or that battery range seems to drop quickly. [signal:014800a5-a57e-4379-be3e-f83a443e7c3d] [signal:0e1de1ce-3bea-445d-9df6-6ed6c5a86825] [signal:1b39e4c6-d357-4ec9-a3b5-6e11788d6bfd] [signal:6114bb30-184e-4ba9-8a38-a62f17a96e8f]

## What customers say
A G60 customer asked whether a constantly fluctuating range estimate was expected; the writer said it adjusts based on recent driving habits. [signal:0e1de1ce-3bea-445d-9df6-6ed6c5a86825] Other G60 customers described the battery range or level as dropping quickly. [signal:1b39e4c6-d357-4ec9-a3b5-6e11788d6bfd] [signal:6114bb30-184e-4ba9-8a38-a62f17a96e8f]

A G60 customer asked what influences range and was told that factors include climate control, driving style, charging patterns, terrain, navigation use, and driving mode. [signal:241014da-ed63-4598-b2ae-07725861c533] A G70 customer without a home charging station was told climate control might be affecting range. [signal:ac6f79e5-b65c-4984-bb1c-f7114370214f]

## Differences between markets
All supplied signals are from the USA, so the provided sample does not show differences between markets. [signal:014800a5-a57e-4379-be3e-f83a443e7c3d] [signal:0e1de1ce-3bea-445d-9df6-6ed6c5a86825] [signal:1b39e4c6-d357-4ec9-a3b5-6e11788d6bfd] [signal:241014da-ed63-4598-b2ae-07725861c533] [signal:6114bb30-184e-4ba9-8a38-a62f17a96e8f] [signal:ac6f79e5-b65c-4984-bb1c-f7114370214f]

## Open questions
How often do customers experience unexpectedly fluctuating estimates or rapid range loss? What expectations do customers have for range estimates as driving conditions and habits change?

value.title: Electric range feels limited on longer trips and in cold weather

value.body_md:

A G60 owner says range feels questionable on longer trips, while another says it drops to roughly 200 miles in below-freezing weather during normal driving. [signal:816ae494-63ca-4fcc-9c41-0fdd90bed61b] [signal:32edd927-e1b4-4630-966e-0c8afa69b161]

## What customers say

Other owners connect longer-trip range concerns with greater reliance on public charging. [signal:816ae494-63ca-4fcc-9c41-0fdd90bed61b]

All five signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:04465619-65af-4c4e-8d1b-0e4712c2ce4d] [signal:167ad52b-b5cf-4d9d-a97b-a10c5d4cd5bc] [signal:19c4f7b7-a3ba-4b3d-917b-7e3114b96bf6] [signal:32edd927-e1b4-4630-966e-0c8afa69b161] [signal:816ae494-63ca-4fcc-9c41-0fdd90bed61b]

[signal:04465619-65af-4c4e-8d1b-0e4712c2ce4d] [signal:167ad52b-b5cf-4d9d-a97b-a10c5d4cd5bc] [signal:19c4f7b7-a3ba-4b3d-917b-7e3114b96bf6] [signal:32edd927-e1b4-4630-966e-0c8afa69b161] [signal:816ae494-63ca-4fcc-9c41-0fdd90bed61b]

value.title: Electric range feels insufficient or uncertain for some drivers
value.summary: Some drivers worry that electric range is too short or difficult to predict, affecting confidence in everyday and longer trips. Other customers value the range for removing range anxiety.
highlights: Drivers report insufficient range, range anxiety, and uncertainty about remaining range.
Concerns appear in sampled USA G60/G70, Europe F70/G60, and Rest of World G60 signals.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say the electric range feels too short, including one who avoids a 305-mile family trip in the G60 because the roughly 300-mile range causes range anxiety. [signal:1668fae5-7637-4e31-a2b8-02282784cbe1] Another G60 driver reports uncertainty about the range estimate after a 100-mile round trip in cold weather. [signal:21aaec01-0621-4f32-b6f3-27ac46bda27a]

## What customers say
A USA G70 driver worries about reaching a charger on longer journeys. [signal:0f496148-597e-4ef6-961f-49a32c26c315] A USA G60 driver says they are unsure what the actual range is. [signal:0cc0f80a-7e84-4fdd-be57-f24bd582d92b] Customers also ask for more range, including one who says the electric range should be much longer. [signal:2b284bd7-2d8f-4e1a-b2c4-972f4a0e4ab6] [signal:e5ee5da2-6513-4487-aae6-b9308e31bfbe]

Signals are not uniformly negative: a Europe G60 customer says the car has completely removed their range anxiety. [signal:77e85a49-5260-43ad-9543-c95a447f912b]

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA signals describe concerns about range sufficiency, range estimates, and longer-trip charging confidence in G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:1668fae5-7637-4e31-a2b8-02282784cbe1] [signal:21aaec01-0621-4f32-b6f3-27ac46bda27a] [signal:0f496148-597e-4ef6-961f-49a32c26c315]

In Europe, one F70 shopper says short electric-only distance contributed to choosing a self-charging hybrid, while a G60 owner says the car removed their range anxiety. [signal:936021c3-f15f-4e9b-a2b3-5810fd1a2d27] [signal:77e85a49-5260-43ad-9543-c95a447f912b] A Rest of World G60 customer would like more battery range. [signal:e5ee5da2-6513-4487-aae6-b9308e31bfbe]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how actual range compares with customer expectations across conditions; one driver specifically questions the estimate after a cold-weather trip. [signal:21aaec01-0621-4f32-b6f3-27ac46bda27a] They also show differing experiences, from range anxiety to having that anxiety removed. [signal:1668fae5-7637-4e31-a2b8-02282784cbe1] [signal:77e85a49-5260-43ad-9543-c95a447f912b]
