value.summary: Customers report lower-than-expected electric range, especially in cold weather, and range displays they consider inaccurate. The signals concern USA drivers of G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Electric range feels lower than expected, and displayed estimates can seem inaccurate.
The case covers 10 signals in the USA, involving G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that real-world electric range is below expectations, with cold weather and heating mentioned as factors. [signal:01a385fa-e0d8-4be7-a1e8-649124a01b47] [signal:4f86ee47-bb66-4e58-8e4b-725fc6e0a3b4] [signal:7916df07-7dca-4357-9986-13f75e2f0db7]
Some customers also describe the range display as inaccurate or unpredictable. [signal:8ba588e2-fe1e-4346-b1d3-aba2fafc16ef] [signal:91045534-68eb-4e5d-be92-fead24ffd104] [signal:a8cd566b-dbc0-4673-b849-a2627d67256a]

## What customers say
A G60 driver says heating the cabin affects range, while a G70 driver reports a serious range drop below 40°F. [signal:01a385fa-e0d8-4be7-a1e8-649124a01b47] [signal:4f86ee47-bb66-4e58-8e4b-725fc6e0a3b4]
A G60 driver says real-world range is much lower than expected from marketing materials. [signal:7916df07-7dca-4357-9986-13f75e2f0db7]
G60 and G70 drivers describe range estimates that do not match their expectations or observed driving. [signal:8ba588e2-fe1e-4346-b1d3-aba2fafc16ef] [signal:91045534-68eb-4e5d-be92-fead24ffd104] [signal:a8cd566b-dbc0-4673-b849-a2627d67256a]

## Differences between markets
The signals shown are from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:01a385fa-e0d8-4be7-a1e8-649124a01b47] [signal:4f86ee47-bb66-4e58-8e4b-725fc6e0a3b4] [signal:7916df07-7dca-4357-9986-13f75e2f0db7] [signal:8ba588e2-fe1e-4346-b1d3-aba2fafc16ef] [signal:91045534-68eb-4e5d-be92-fead24ffd104] [signal:a8cd566b-dbc0-4673-b849-a2627d67256a]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how much range varies across temperatures, driving conditions, or vehicle configurations. [signal:01a385fa-e0d8-4be7-a1e8-649124a01b47] [signal:4f86ee47-bb66-4e58-8e4b-725fc6e0a3b4]
The signals do not establish how often displayed range differs from actual range across drivers. [signal:8ba588e2-fe1e-4346-b1d3-aba2fafc16ef] [signal:91045534-68eb-4e5d-be92-fead24ffd104] [signal:a8cd566b-dbc0-4673-b849-a2627d67256a]

value.title: G60 electric range falls short for many customers
value.summary: Many G60 customers in the USA and Europe say the electric range is disappointing or not good enough. One USA customer considers it adequate, but still wishes it were higher.
highlights: G60 electric range is described as disappointing, too short, or not good enough by several customers.
Range feedback covers five G60 signals: three from the USA and two from Europe.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Several G60 customers describe the electric range as disappointing, too short, or not good enough. [signal:3cbdb7ed-234f-4303-81ce-cfac34e4f04b] [signal:5a299bea-7753-4e7b-ad96-c951e26ebc4d] [signal:883dc7b1-d3a0-40d5-8903-824d857bf651] [signal:fadc60ee-ab36-4914-82d2-d43be851548d]

## What customers say
USA customers call the battery range disappointing or not very good. [signal:3cbdb7ed-234f-4303-81ce-cfac34e4f04b] [signal:5a299bea-7753-4e7b-ad96-c951e26ebc4d] Another USA customer says the e-drive range is adequate, though not perfect, and wishes it were at least 100 miles. [signal:e104dcf6-39f7-45d4-847b-01eddf430687]

Europe customers describe the real-world range as embarrassingly short and say it is not good enough. [signal:883dc7b1-d3a0-40d5-8903-824d857bf651] [signal:fadc60ee-ab36-4914-82d2-d43be851548d]

## Differences between markets
The four negative range comments come from G60 customers in both the USA and Europe: two from each market. [signal:3cbdb7ed-234f-4303-81ce-cfac34e4f04b] [signal:5a299bea-7753-4e7b-ad96-c951e26ebc4d] [signal:883dc7b1-d3a0-40d5-8903-824d857bf651] [signal:fadc60ee-ab36-4914-82d2-d43be851548d] A further USA G60 customer calls the range adequate, while wishing it were higher. [signal:e104dcf6-39f7-45d4-847b-01eddf430687]

## Open questions
The signals do not specify the driving conditions or measurement basis behind customers’ range assessments. [signal:3cbdb7ed-234f-4303-81ce-cfac34e4f04b] [signal:5a299bea-7753-4e7b-ad96-c951e26ebc4d] [signal:883dc7b1-d3a0-40d5-8903-824d857bf651] [signal:fadc60ee-ab36-4914-82d2-d43be851548d] [signal:e104dcf6-39f7-45d4-847b-01eddf430687]

value.title: Long-trip range concerns limit electric-car use
value.summary: A USA G60 owner values the car’s efficiency for everyday and medium-distance driving but is unsure it suits long road trips because recharging would require stops. They plan to keep using a gas car for those trips.
highlights: Long-trip charging stops make the electric car feel less suitable for those journeys.
One USA G60 owner reports this concern.
The owner says they will keep using their gas car for long trips.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The owner is unsure the G60 is suitable for really long road trips because those drives would mean stopping to recharge. [signal:2e9ba1af-9c8e-4bbe-8b9e-53e29d340a6c]

## What customers say
The owner describes the car as extremely efficient for daily use and medium-distance visits to friends or family, but says they will keep using their gas car for long trips. [signal:2e9ba1af-9c8e-4bbe-8b9e-53e29d340a6c]

## Differences between markets
The signal is from the USA; no other market is represented. [signal:2e9ba1af-9c8e-4bbe-8b9e-53e29d340a6c]

## Open questions
The signal does not specify how long a trip must be before the owner prefers the gas car, or how charging-stop frequency affects that choice. [signal:2e9ba1af-9c8e-4bbe-8b9e-53e29d340a6c]

value.title: Electric range is praised, with no range complaint reported

highlights: Range is praised; neither signal reports a specific range complaint.
Both signals are from Europe and concern the G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals do not identify a specific electric-range problem; one owner says the range has significantly improved, and another says the estimates are pretty accurate. [signal:33d705ae-bc11-4786-b667-91cd5f8201da] [signal:2cc9331a-31a3-4ba1-bbac-9344732add6c]

## What customers say
One owner values the significantly improved electric range. [signal:33d705ae-bc11-4786-b667-91cd5f8201da] Another says the range estimates are pretty accurate. [signal:2cc9331a-31a3-4ba1-bbac-9344732add6c]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Europe and concern the G60, so they do not provide a market comparison. [signal:33d705ae-bc11-4786-b667-91cd5f8201da] [signal:2cc9331a-31a3-4ba1-bbac-9344732add6c]

## Open questions
The signals do not specify the electric-range figures, driving conditions, or how range compares across markets. [signal:33d705ae-bc11-4786-b667-91cd5f8201da] [signal:2cc9331a-31a3-4ba1-bbac-9344732add6c]

value.title: Electric range falls short of the advertised mileage
value.summary: Two European G60 owners say the mileage forecast overstates the car’s range, with one reporting a larger shortfall when charging only to 80%.
highlights: Owners say actual mileage falls short of the advertised range.
Two signals from European G60 owners report the concern.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Two European G60 owners say the mileage forecast or actual mileage falls short of what is advertised. [signal:64e60c26-2083-43c5-9ff4-1709de8fc596] [signal:cea9dc0b-636c-4415-9545-71fdef6652e2]

## What customers say
One owner says the mileage forecast is overstated. [signal:64e60c26-2083-43c5-9ff4-1709de8fc596] Another says mileage is nowhere near the advertised figure, especially when charging the battery to 80%. [signal:cea9dc0b-636c-4415-9545-71fdef6652e2]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Europe and concern the G60; the signals provide no comparison with other markets or vehicle lines. [signal:64e60c26-2083-43c5-9ff4-1709de8fc596] [signal:cea9dc0b-636c-4415-9545-71fdef6652e2]

## Open questions
How large is the gap between advertised and experienced mileage, and how does it vary with charging to 80%? The signals do not quantify the gap. [signal:64e60c26-2083-43c5-9ff4-1709de8fc596] [signal:cea9dc0b-636c-4415-9545-71fdef6652e2]

value.title: Electric range expectations and energy-use figures are unclear
value.summary: US owners report dissatisfaction with the miles delivered and difficulty making sense of the car’s energy-use figures. The signals come from G60 and G70 owners.
highlights: Reported range falls short of expectations, and energy-use figures are hard to interpret.
US owners of the G60 and G70 are affected.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 owner said the car did not deliver anywhere near the expected miles [signal:e57b9738-c2fe-42ec-af4f-88e03cb3734f]. A G70 owner could not make sense of the kWh figures and questioned how they related to mileage [signal:3d003f7b-9c7f-42ec-a4c7-7ee04ecb7bba].

## What customers say
The G60 owner said they tried to return the car within the first week, when it had just over 40 miles on it, but were told returning it was impossible [signal:e57b9738-c2fe-42ec-af4f-88e03cb3734f]. The G70 owner compared around 8,000 miles driven with 1,000 kWh used and an indicated 3.4 miles per kWh, and said they might work it out themselves or ask the dealership .

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA, but describe different issues: range dissatisfaction in the G60 and difficulty interpreting energy-use figures in the G70 [signal:e57b9738-c2fe-42ec-af4f-88e03cb3734f] .

## Open questions
The signals do not explain what range the G60 owner expected or the conditions behind the reported range [signal:e57b9738-c2fe-42ec-af4f-88e03cb3734f]. The G70 signal does not clarify how the displayed kWh figure is calculated or what period it covers .

value.title: Electric range praised by some, too short for others
value.summary: Some customers want more electric range, while others describe the range as strong or very good. The signals span G60 and G70 customers in the USA, Europe, and the Rest of the World.
highlights: Some customers want more range; others praise it.
Signals cover G60 and G70 customers in the USA, Europe, and the Rest of the World.
A Model S is mentioned, but not in a range comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Range is a drawback for some customers: a G70 owner says it needs to be better, and G60 owners wish for more range [signal:28abf801-084d-4bb3-935a-00444d51a0d5] [signal:5cc406a7-87d6-4fc8-a143-68ce2d1f7420]. Another G60 owner includes range among the reasons for rating the car 7 or 8 out of 10 [signal:81fa64b3-7298-45ea-a9dc-439afd250f6b].

## What customers say
Views are mixed: some customers call the range strong, very good, or good [signal:8f3a75fa-07ec-467d-b090-e6a913673895] [signal:bd10e654-f12e-4383-a5a9-02267cc109fa] [signal:980415dd-cb14-412f-9ff0-0fa9008f26ed], while others want more [signal:28abf801-084d-4bb3-935a-00444d51a0d5] [signal:5cc406a7-87d6-4fc8-a143-68ce2d1f7420]. A USA G70 owner says the electric range is around 40 miles but that most short trips use electric [signal:fa5a05d3-9055-411f-8ce1-5a69f6069d5c].

## Differences between markets
In the USA, G70 and G60 owners include both a request for more range and praise for range [signal:28abf801-084d-4bb3-935a-00444d51a0d5] [signal:81fa64b3-7298-45ea-a9dc-439afd250f6b] [signal:8f3a75fa-07ec-467d-b090-e6a913673895]. In Europe, G60 owners describe range positively, including one who says it is good even in winter, while a Rest of World G60 owner wants slightly more driving range [signal:980415dd-cb14-412f-9ff0-0fa9008f26ed] [signal:bd10e654-f12e-4383-a5a9-02267cc109fa] [signal:5cc406a7-87d6-4fc8-a143-68ce2d1f7420].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish what range customers expect or under what driving conditions they find it insufficient [signal:28abf801-084d-4bb3-935a-00444d51a0d5] [signal:5cc406a7-87d6-4fc8-a143-68ce2d1f7420].

value.title: Electric range drops in cold weather
value.summary: Some U.S. electric-vehicle customers report reduced range in cold weather, while another reports still getting roughly 30 miles at 21°F. The signals describe different experiences across G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Cold-weather range is lower for some customers, with one reporting a roughly 40% drop.
U.S. reports concern G60 and G70 vehicles; one G60 owner still reports about 30 miles at 21°F.
Mercedes is mentioned for app features, not electric-range performance.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers report a substantial reduction in electric range in cold conditions. A G70 customer described a gap between advertised and actual range, estimating a roughly 40% drop in cold weather. [signal:3d31ca10-3bcd-43ac-af86-e7c35bc8e891] A G60 owner also said they were unhappy with the range in colder weather. [signal:2297e217-7dc3-49b8-8b04-f7437a491340]

## What customers say
The G70 customer reported that range in cold conditions was roughly 40% lower. [signal:3d31ca10-3bcd-43ac-af86-e7c35bc8e891] In contrast, a G60 owner reported roughly 30 miles on a full charge at 21°F and around 40 miles in warmer weather. [signal:db1ce54f-1ebd-48d5-bc41-965ace597909]

## Differences between markets
The cold-weather range complaints and the report of range at 21°F are from U.S. customers. [signal:2297e217-7dc3-49b8-8b04-f7437a491340] [signal:3d31ca10-3bcd-43ac-af86-e7c35bc8e891] [signal:db1ce54f-1ebd-48d5-bc41-965ace597909] The Europe signal discusses app access and windows, not electric range. [signal:bd2b0fcf-ee8c-4693-80bc-6422b511ec0d]

## Open questions
How does actual range vary with temperature across the vehicles and conditions represented by these reports? The signals include one estimate of a roughly 40% cold-weather drop and one report of about 30 miles at 21°F, but do not provide comparable test conditions. [signal:3d31ca10-3bcd-43ac-af86-e7c35bc8e891] [signal:db1ce54f-1ebd-48d5-bc41-965ace597909]

value.title: Electric range falls short, especially in cold weather
value.summary: Customers report electric range that is too low, particularly in cold weather, while some USA G60 owners find it acceptable or are happy with it. Concerns appear in USA and Europe signals across the G60 and G70.
highlights: Range complaints include poor cold-weather performance and range below expectations.
Signals cover 6 USA and 2 Europe reports, across G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers in the USA and Europe describe electric range as inadequate, with cold-weather performance a recurring concern. [signal:25d5413a-83e1-42cd-8b63-df853dabfdac] [signal:73163ec9-3d98-40a3-ab15-7e10d9744951] [signal:78dd2d12-8027-47e2-bb20-19a1ef0a7a00] [signal:950b10f9-c17a-45be-ab94-e4ba2783aef4] [signal:a0766391-7cd6-4e5e-851c-62f102ff30fa] [signal:e6ae4525-76cb-4168-9f35-fdc1221eb3da]

## What customers say
A USA G70 owner says the car did not reach the range they expected, reports being stranded, and describes anxiety about having enough range. [signal:950b10f9-c17a-45be-ab94-e4ba2783aef4] A Europe G60 owner says the range was far below what was advertised and traded the car for an i7 demonstrator. [signal:78dd2d12-8027-47e2-bb20-19a1ef0a7a00] A USA G60 owner reports about 160 miles at 80% charge in very cold conditions. [signal:a0766391-7cd6-4e5e-851c-62f102ff30fa]

Views are not uniformly negative: two USA G60 signals describe the range as acceptable or say the owner is happy with it. [signal:ab86a287-f0d6-4693-af0a-639c381fc37c] [signal:bf5b923e-1ec8-489a-87f8-885a8cddb082]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include complaints about cold-weather range on the G60 and G70, alongside two positive G60 assessments. [signal:25d5413a-83e1-42cd-8b63-df853dabfdac] [signal:73163ec9-3d98-40a3-ab15-7e10d9744951] [signal:950b10f9-c17a-45be-ab94-e4ba2783aef4] [signal:a0766391-7cd6-4e5e-851c-62f102ff30fa] [signal:ab86a287-f0d6-4693-af0a-639c381fc37c] [signal:bf5b923e-1ec8-489a-87f8-885a8cddb082] The two Europe signals are G60 complaints about range, including one report that it fell far short of advertising. [signal:78dd2d12-8027-47e2-bb20-19a1ef0a7a00] [signal:e6ae4525-76cb-4168-9f35-fdc1221eb3da]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how range varies across temperatures or whether reported experiences match the range customers were told to expect. [signal:25d5413a-83e1-42cd-8b63-df853dabfdac] [signal:950b10f9-c17a-45be-ab94-e4ba2783aef4] [signal:a0766391-7cd6-4e5e-851c-62f102ff30fa] [signal:78dd2d12-8027-47e2-bb20-19a1ef0a7a00] The signals also do not explain why some USA G60 owners are satisfied while others report poor range. [signal:a0766391-7cd6-4e5e-851c-62f102ff30fa] [signal:ab86a287-f0d6-4693-af0a-639c381fc37c] [signal:bf5b923e-1ec8-489a-87f8-885a8cddb082]

value.title: Short electric range leaves small-car buyers waiting for an EV
value.summary: A Europe-based customer looking for a small, handy all-electric car says available electric-only driving is too short and hopes for at least 500 km on one charge. They chose the self-charging hybrid 120 instead. [No citations permitted here.]
highlights: A customer says electric-only range is too short and wants at least 500 km from a small EV.
One of two Europe F70 signals describes this range concern; the other does not mention range.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One customer says electric-only driving in the hybrid options they considered covered only short distances, and hopes for a small, handy all-electric car with at least 500 km of range. They chose the self-charging hybrid 120 instead. [signal:7815ed54-ff51-4e6c-a286-17558b97c260]

## What customers say
The customer describes difficulty finding a follow-up car because they did not want to go fully electric, while the hybrid size classes felt bulky and their electric-only range felt short. [signal:7815ed54-ff51-4e6c-a286-17558b97c260]

The other Europe F70 signal praises the car’s speed, safety and driving enjoyment, but does not mention electric range. [signal:f9758ac2-ac05-4f64-831a-4f6b415e172f]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Europe and concern the F70; only one discusses electric range. [signal:7815ed54-ff51-4e6c-a286-17558b97c260] [signal:f9758ac2-ac05-4f64-831a-4f6b415e172f]

## Open questions
What electric-only range did the customer experience in the hybrid options they considered? [signal:7815ed54-ff51-4e6c-a286-17558b97c260]

value.title: G60 drivers are dissatisfied with electric range
value.summary: G60 drivers in Europe and the USA report dissatisfaction with electric range or mileage. The European complaint also mentions a fast-charging limit and a lack of communication.
highlights: G60 drivers report dissatisfaction with electric range or mileage.
Complaints are from Europe and the USA; both concern the G60.
A USA customer says rivals offer loads of features, but makes no range comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A European G60 driver is unhappy with the vehicle’s range, and a USA G60 driver is unhappy with the mileage they are getting. [signal:738d00c2-119e-4499-8fc1-0ce27f9297ac] [signal:dd6b7808-6542-4057-bf5c-ff361183e0d0]

## What customers say
The European customer also complains about a limit on how many times they can fast-charge in 24 hours and says BMW has communicated little about it. [signal:738d00c2-119e-4499-8fc1-0ce27f9297ac]
The USA customer discusses missing iDrive features and the lack of a formal way to propose ideas, saying this makes them feel BMW does not care about customer input. [signal:dd6b7808-6542-4057-bf5c-ff361183e0d0]

## Differences between markets
The European signal explicitly mentions range, a fast-charging limit, and communication; the USA signal mentions mileage alongside iDrive features and customer feedback. [signal:738d00c2-119e-4499-8fc1-0ce27f9297ac] [signal:dd6b7808-6542-4057-bf5c-ff361183e0d0]
The USA customer says rivals offer loads of features, but does not compare their electric range. [signal:dd6b7808-6542-4057-bf5c-ff361183e0d0]

## Open questions
How much range or mileage are these customers getting, and under what conditions? [signal:738d00c2-119e-4499-8fc1-0ce27f9297ac] [signal:dd6b7808-6542-4057-bf5c-ff361183e0d0]
Is the fast-charging limit also a concern in the USA, or is it specific to the European complaint? [signal:738d00c2-119e-4499-8fc1-0ce27f9297ac] [signal:dd6b7808-6542-4057-bf5c-ff361183e0d0]

## Problem

value.title: Electric range falls short in cold weather and real driving
value.summary: Some owners report electric range well below expectations, especially in cold weather or real driving, while others want more range for their daily needs. Signals come from USA G60 and G70 owners and a Rest of World G60 owner.
highlights: Reported range can fall sharply in cold weather or short of owners’ real-world needs.
Signals include USA G60 and G70 owners and a Rest of World G60 owner.
One owner compares the desired range with the Lucid Air; a 600-mile target is mentioned.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners report much less electric range than expected, including in cold weather; one G70 owner says the car fell short of a stated 350-mile expectation and that they were stranded [signal:41cd4095-2753-4a4e-a306-718ce8bfd279]. A G60 owner reports about 160 miles at 80% charge in very cold conditions [signal:01592efd-7320-458f-a364-13365d441c4a]. A G70 plug-in hybrid owner says roughly 25 miles in real driving is below the approximately 35-mile rating and their 55–65-mile commute [signal:60574720-6e04-4e55-b812-882a3889bd96]. Other G70 owners simply want greater range or say at least 100 miles would be helpful [signal:819dea65-8a1d-4005-8f4c-1d0aa9a7c620] [signal:60574720-6e04-4e55-b812-882a3889bd96].

## What customers say
The G70 owner reporting cold-weather shortfall says it caused range anxiety and that they had already been stranded [signal:41cd4095-2753-4a4e-a306-718ce8bfd279]. The G60 owner also mentions being unable to switch off the heaters, alongside the cold-weather range concern [signal:01592efd-7320-458f-a364-13365d441c4a]. A Rest of World G60 owner wants range information for different driving conditions, including performance by temperature [signal:be37466d-ed5e-4056-b77b-e00db97b0f89]. One G70 owner wants range increased to match a Lucid Air, naming a target of about 600 miles [signal:552fb4a6-251f-4121-8e7d-2a3fa434215e].

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include cold-weather range complaints for the G60 and G70, as well as a G70 plug-in hybrid owner’s real-world range and commute concern [signal:01592efd-7320-458f-a364-13365d441c4a] [signal:41cd4095-2753-4a4e-a306-718ce8bfd279] [signal:60574720-6e04-4e55-b812-882a3889bd96]. - How representative are the reported range shortfalls and desired range targets among owners? [signal:552fb4a6-251f-4121-8e7d-2a3fa434215e] [signal:60574720-6e04-4e55-b812-882a3889bd96]

## Problem

value.title: Interior complaints include water ingress, gasoline odor and HUD glare
value.summary: Three U.S. complaints describe water entering the cabin, a persistent gasoline smell after service, and recurring glare affecting the head-up display. The reports concern G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Reported issues include cabin water ingress, gasoline odor after service, and recurring HUD glare.
Three U.S. signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
- One G60 owner reported water accumulating on the front passenger floor; the leak source was not known, and the dealer was diagnosing it. [signal:69071252-4789-4fa0-86d4-d59855cf79dd]
- A G60 owner reported erratic low-fuel warnings and a strong gasoline smell in the interior after a repair. [signal:f2d10e3b-328b-467a-b6c1-661414d63990]
- A G70 complaint describes recurring glare interfering with the head-up display, although the reported issue was not replicated. [signal:fadd86a6-32d4-4636-b051-a67cf68fa2b5]

## What customers say
- The G60 owner said the vehicle was at the dealership while the water leak was being diagnosed. [signal:69071252-4789-4fa0-86d4-d59855cf79dd]
- Another G60 owner said the fuel-gauge warnings led to a service visit shortly after pickup and that the gasoline smell was difficult to remove. [signal:f2d10e3b-328b-467a-b6c1-661414d63990]
- The G70 complaint says the HUD glare keeps returning despite not being replicated. [signal:fadd86a6-32d4-4636-b051-a67cf68fa2b5]

## Differences between markets
- All three signals are from the USA, so they do not provide a comparison between markets. [signal:69071252-4789-4fa0-86d4-d59855cf79dd] [signal:f2d10e3b-328b-467a-b6c1-661414d63990] [signal:fadd86a6-32d4-4636-b051-a67cf68fa2b5]
- The water ingress and gasoline odor reports concern G60 vehicles; the HUD glare report concerns a G70. [signal:69071252-4789-4fa0-86d4-d59855cf79dd] [signal:f2d10e3b-328b-467a-b6c1-661414d63990] [signal:fadd86a6-32d4-4636-b051-a67cf68fa2b5]

## Open questions
- What was the source of the G60 water leak? The reporting customer did not know, and the dealer was still diagnosing it. [signal:69071252-4789-4fa0-86d4-d59855cf79dd]
- What caused the gasoline smell after the G60 repair, and how long did it persist? The customer described it as hard to get rid of. [signal:f2d10e3b-328b-467a-b6c1-661414d63990]
- What causes the recurring HUD glare in the G70, given that it could not be replicated? [signal:fadd86a6-32d4-4636-b051-a67cf68fa2b5]

value.title: Interior technology functions are not uniformly satisfying
value.summary: Most signals praise cabin quality, space, equipment, and technology, but one USA G60 owner reports a driver-profile conflict and too few trip-computer options. The concern is specific to that owner; the other signals are positive or mixed rather than reporting the same issue.

value.body_md:

One USA G60 owner says adding CarPlay to a secondary-driver profile made the spouse’s setup “kind of dead,” and that the trip computer has fewer options than the owner’s X5 or 328d, including too few separate trips for work logging. [signal:3b6fcc65-c044-4530-848e-39da1519b651]

Other signals praise interior space, cabin appearance and quality, equipment, and interior technology. [signal:21a23db4-02ab-4f61-9328-8a810648bc33] [signal:40554fae-d889-4942-a85f-141f5fd4e000] [signal:578e6a43-74c5-41f2-8500-070b448951fd] [signal:5fa249ac-538f-4217-b723-96d7013bf56a] [signal:9f763ff5-bb7c-4da6-9654-10effe3f578d] [signal:dbe5266c-9d60-4a03-85f6-5fc695905723]

The USA G60 owner describes the profile issue and trip logging limitation as frustrating. [signal:3b6fcc65-c044-4530-848e-39da1519b651]

[signal:21a23db4-02ab-4f61-9328-8a810648bc33] [signal:578e6a43-74c5-41f2-8500-070b448951fd] [signal:5fa249ac-538f-4217-b723-96d7013bf56a] [signal:9f763ff5-bb7c-4da6-9654-10effe3f578d] [signal:dbe5266c-9d60-4a03-85f6-5fc695905723]

The profile and trip-computer complaint comes from a USA G60 owner. [signal:3b6fcc65-c044-4530-848e-39da1519b651]

Positive interior feedback appears in both USA and Rest of World signals, including praise for G70 cabin quality and G60 roominess. [signal:578e6a43-74c5-41f2-8500-070b448951fd] [signal:9f763ff5-bb7c-4da6-9654-10effe3f578d] [signal:5fa249ac-538f-4217-b723-96d7013bf56a]

## Open questions
Do other owners experience the same profile interaction or trip-computer limitation? [signal:3b6fcc65-c044-4530-848e-39da1519b651]

value.title: Interior controls, storage and materials feel awkward or lacking
value.summary: Some BMW customers find interior controls awkward or distracting, storage limited, and materials or trim below expectations. Others value the cabin or its quality, so experiences differ.
highlights: Customers report awkward controls, limited storage, distracting reflections, and disappointing materials or trim.
Signals mention F70, G60 and G70 vehicles in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
Genesis, Audi and Mercedes are mentioned as alternatives considered by a customer.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe a range of interior usability and quality concerns, including awkward controls, infotainment interactions requiring multiple taps, limited storage, reflective glass controls, and materials or trim that feel lacking. [signal:743cfda7-3fc4-486b-93d7-7d99144e0464] [signal:885145cc-2947-4b62-884d-4ba0c31866b0] [signal:06efaacd-39ec-4fbd-9088-eeb73bbf7f04] [signal:7d9c4ac9-a100-42c4-bc85-3d7d07de35bb] [signal:cf26c6b0-bcb3-4528-8b46-27d35e9a46c7] [signal:8a9fa06d-e064-4df3-8479-889ba95f9e63]

One customer says the center console and door bins hold too little, with no convenient place for small items. [signal:06efaacd-39ec-4fbd-9088-eeb73bbf7f04] Another says replacing physical buttons with screen interactions makes common tasks take more steps and pulls attention from the road. [signal:885145cc-2947-4b62-884d-4ba0c31866b0]

## What customers say
Some feedback is positive: customers describe the interior as something they love, high quality, or comfortable. [signal:2ccb889d-4900-4d6b-92d2-f022d29f967e] [signal:a875a2fd-84e0-4dac-bdd4-d28e60e5eab7] Other customers say the materials, trim, or overall interior feel awkward or below expectations. [signal:743cfda7-3fc4-486b-93d7-7d99144e0464] [signal:20fd7e95-f3d9-4831-995d-e7780fde713c] [signal:cf26c6b0-bcb3-4528-8b46-27d35e9a46c7]

A USA customer reports that glass controls can reflect sunlight intensely enough to be blinding. [signal:7d9c4ac9-a100-42c4-bc85-3d7d07de35bb] A customer in Europe says changing drive mode or fan speed through the infotainment system takes multiple taps. [signal:885145cc-2947-4b62-884d-4ba0c31866b0]

## Differences between markets
The provided signals include interior concerns from Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:0100d9ef-b737-4e51-bfa5-b8966a9b7096] [signal:06efaacd-39ec-4fbd-9088-eeb73bbf7f04] [signal:086c225d-5e12-4acb-b044-039e58de996e] [signal:20fd7e95-f3d9-4831-995d-e7780fde713c] [signal:2ccb889d-4900-4d6b-92d2-f022d29f967e] [signal:743cfda7-3fc4-486b-93d7-7d99144e0464] [signal:7d9c4ac9-a100-42c4-bc85-3d7d07de35bb] [signal:885145cc-2947-4b62-884d-4ba0c31866b0] [signal:8a9fa06d-e064-4df3-8479-889ba95f9e63] [signal:a875a2fd-84e0-4dac-bdd4-d28e60e5eab7] [signal:cf26c6b0-bcb3-4528-8b46-27d35e9a46c7] [signal:d31f465c-2251-454f-a9ee-0726b800705c]

The concerns vary across the feedback: a USA customer describes limited storage and another reports reflective glass controls, while European customers mention multi-step infotainment interactions and mixed views of interior quality. [signal:06efaacd-39ec-4fbd-9088-eeb73bbf7f04] [signal:7d9c4ac9-a100-42c4-bc85-3d7d07de35bb] [signal:885145cc-2947-4b62-884d-4ba0c31866b0] [signal:a875a2fd-84e0-4dac-bdd4-d28e60e5eab7] [signal:20fd7e95-f3d9-4831-995d-e7780fde713c]

## Open questions
How common are the individual concerns about storage, controls, reflections and materials across the full set of signals? [signal:06efaacd-39ec-4fbd-9088-eeb73bbf7f04] [signal:7d9c4ac9-a100-42c4-bc85-3d7d07de35bb] [signal:743cfda7-3fc4-486b-93d7-7d99144e0464]

How do customers’ positive assessments of cabin quality relate to reports of disappointing materials and trim? [signal:a875a2fd-84e0-4dac-bdd4-d28e60e5eab7] [signal:20fd7e95-f3d9-4831-995d-e7780fde713c] [signal:cf26c6b0-bcb3-4528-8b46-27d35e9a46c7]

value.title: Cupholders poorly fit, obstruct nearby controls, and make noise
value.summary: Customers report that some cupholders do not securely fit common drinks, can obstruct nearby controls, and make noise during use. The supplied signals concern USA-market G60 and G70 customers.
highlights: Some drinks fit poorly, holders can obstruct nearby controls, and retractable clasps make noise.
The supplied signals cover USA-market G60 and G70 vehicles.
One customer contrasts the noisy clasps with quieter cupholders in an HMC truck.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe front holders as too large for common cans, cups, and bottles, while rear holders are too shallow to hold drinks securely. [signal:7c4eaf90-1165-493f-b046-346bd034f979] Another customer says the holders fit about 8-ounce cups, while the cups people use are closer to 12 ounces. [signal:f21f77a5-b80d-4d33-9a2d-1654b82dfe6c] Customers also report that larger drinks can obstruct access to the wireless charger or that drinks may spill into the adjacent phone tray. [signal:dae68938-0bb2-4405-bb7e-5a06d3756964] [signal:2dd690f8-4993-4c99-a259-cfdc8bfa2fe9] One customer says bottles tip over and phones are blocked in holders without a cover. [signal:17860f72-f218-4cfe-9d56-9cf1c9d39a7a] Retractable clasps are described as noisy when inserting or removing a cup. [signal:d84a8d1f-30f8-48fa-a7dc-779d3705efb0]

## What customers say
One customer says the front holders are oversized and the rear holders too shallow; the same signal mentions insufficient holder capacity and drinks bouncing or shaking. [signal:7c4eaf90-1165-493f-b046-346bd034f979] A G70 customer says a larger cup or bottle makes the wireless charger difficult to reach. [signal:dae68938-0bb2-4405-bb7e-5a06d3756964] Another G70 customer is concerned that a spill could reach the phone tray beside the cupholders. [signal:2dd690f8-4993-4c99-a259-cfdc8bfa2fe9] A G60 customer says the retractable pieces annoy their husband and contrasts their noise with quiet cupholders in an HMC truck. [signal:d84a8d1f-30f8-48fa-a7dc-779d3705efb0]

## Differences between markets
The supplied sample contains USA-market signals for G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:17860f72-f218-4cfe-9d56-9cf1c9d39a7a] [signal:2dd690f8-4993-4c99-a259-cfdc8bfa2fe9] [signal:7c4eaf90-1165-493f-b046-346bd034f979] [signal:dae68938-0bb2-4405-bb7e-5a06d3756964] [signal:f21f77a5-b80d-4d33-9a2d-1654b82dfe6c] [signal:d84a8d1f-30f8-48fa-a7dc-779d3705efb0] The supplied sample does not provide evidence for comparing markets. [signal:17860f72-f218-4cfe-9d56-9cf1c9d39a7a] [signal:2dd690f8-4993-4c99-a259-cfdc8bfa2fe9] [signal:7c4eaf90-1165-493f-b046-346bd034f979] [signal:dae68938-0bb2-4405-bb7e-5a06d3756964] [signal:f21f77a5-b80d-4d33-9a2d-1654b82dfe6c] [signal:d84a8d1f-30f8-48fa-a7dc-779d3705efb0]

## Open questions
The supplied signals do not establish how often each reported fit, obstruction, or noise issue occurs across the full case. [signal:17860f72-f218-4cfe-9d56-9cf1c9d39a7a] [signal:2dd690f8-4993-4c99-a259-cfdc8bfa2fe9] [signal:7c4eaf90-1165-493f-b046-346bd034f979] [signal:dae68938-0bb2-4405-bb7e-5a06d3756964] [signal:f21f77a5-b80d-4d33-9a2d-1654b82dfe6c] [signal:d84a8d1f-30f8-48fa-a7dc-779d3705efb0]

value.title: Back-up Assistant’s direction and purpose can be unclear
value.summary: Some customers want the Back-up Assistant to reverse out in a direction other than the one used to enter, or want clearer guidance on its purpose. Others value its ease and convenience.
highlights: Customers request more exit-direction flexibility and clearer guidance on the feature.
Relevant signals cover USA G70 and G60 customers and a Europe F70 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want the Back-up Assistant to exit a parking spot in either direction, rather than only retracing the entry path [signal:509201c7-b350-43b4-8ae3-24290e909c0f]. Another customer wants an explanation of the feature’s purpose before activation [signal:f2935cbc-4303-4793-9234-3acb9d527491].

## What customers say
A G70 customer says the feature is amazing, and another says it is simple to operate [signal:23e5c989-10fa-4545-9288-4aec74c46023] [signal:7f37f05d-1828-4e48-ad34-ddff9e7f286c]. A G60 customer values using it to reverse out of a driveway and says it makes the process easier [signal:a9b3507b-3435-404f-a75f-e1a8211495a7]. A Europe F70 customer describes the automatic reversing assist as brilliant, particularly for someone who keeps the car in a garage [signal:e3f20c3f-359f-46be-b0bf-c642a92281a0].

## Differences between markets
The requests for more exit-direction flexibility and an explanation of the feature come from USA G70 customers [signal:509201c7-b350-43b4-8ae3-24290e909c0f] [signal:f2935cbc-4303-4793-9234-3acb9d527491]. Positive feedback comes from USA G70 and G60 customers and a Europe F70 customer [signal:23e5c989-10fa-4545-9288-4aec74c46023] [signal:7f37f05d-1828-4e48-ad34-ddff9e7f286c] [signal:a9b3507b-3435-404f-a75f-e1a8211495a7] [signal:e3f20c3f-359f-46be-b0bf-c642a92281a0].

## Open questions
Do customers want to reverse out in either direction in situations beyond the reported parking-spot use case? [signal:509201c7-b350-43b4-8ae3-24290e909c0f] What aspects of the feature’s purpose or operation are unclear to customers? [signal:f2935cbc-4303-4793-9234-3acb9d527491]

value.title: Voice control often fails to understand or carry out commands

Seven signals report voice issues: six F70s and one G70 across Europe, Rest of World, and the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe voice control that frequently fails to understand commands, cannot complete tasks such as changing radio stations or setting navigation, or drops out. [signal:2b7b3582-ce58-4603-9d77-f75c66144207] [signal:4fb89adc-c8b7-4e2f-8761-965b3adbb9ec] [signal:681ecd8a-c2aa-4eb6-bd96-f015095d9c43] [signal:99cc410c-a084-4515-abc0-1dcd073494f6] One Rest of World customer also says the system repeatedly reacts to voice input but is hard to hear. [signal:287844e2-6875-4ceb-abfe-93856906233d]

## What customers say
A Europe customer says voice recognition fails about 99% of the time. [signal:2b7b3582-ce58-4603-9d77-f75c66144207] Other Europe customers report failures with radio and navigation commands, and one says the speech function repeatedly dropped out and the navigation voice function disappeared. [signal:4fb89adc-c8b7-4e2f-8761-965b3adbb9ec] [signal:681ecd8a-c2aa-4eb6-bd96-f015095d9c43] [signal:99cc410c-a084-4515-abc0-1dcd073494f6] A Rest of World customer says a recognized navigation place name does not make it through to the navigation system. [signal:c7a5bcd3-0b44-455d-8245-dca25309b047] A USA customer calls the voice control system irritating and says it is the infotainment feature they would most like improved. [signal:b41ba227-5790-4a73-a7e8-f8f39ac9d92d]

## Differences between markets
The voice-control complaints are from Europe (four signals), Rest of World (two signals), and the USA (one signal). [signal:2b7b3582-ce58-4603-9d77-f75c66144207] [signal:4fb89adc-c8b7-4e2f-8761-965b3adbb9ec] [signal:681ecd8a-c2aa-4eb6-bd96-f015095d9c43] [signal:99cc410c-a084-4515-abc0-1dcd073494f6] [signal:287844e2-6875-4ceb-abfe-93856906233d] [signal:c7a5bcd3-0b44-455d-8245-dca25309b047] [signal:b41ba227-5790-4a73-a7e8-f8f39ac9d92d] Six concern the F70 and one concerns the G70. [signal:287844e2-6875-4ceb-abfe-93856906233d] [signal:2b7b3582-ce58-4603-9d77-f75c66144207] [signal:4fb89adc-c8b7-4e2f-8761-965b3adbb9ec] [signal:681ecd8a-c2aa-4eb6-bd96-f015095d9c43] [signal:99cc410c-a084-4515-abc0-1dcd073494f6] [signal:c7a5bcd3-0b44-455d-8245-dca25309b047] [signal:b41ba227-5790-4a73-a7e8-f8f39ac9d92d]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why voice control fails or whether the reported problems share a cause. [signal:2b7b3582-ce58-4603-9d77-f75c66144207] [signal:4fb89adc-c8b7-4e2f-8761-965b3adbb9ec] [signal:681ecd8a-c2aa-4eb6-bd96-f015095d9c43] [signal:99cc410c-a084-4515-abc0-1dcd073494f6] [signal:287844e2-6875-4ceb-abfe-93856906233d] [signal:c7a5bcd3-0b44-455d-8245-dca25309b047] [signal:b41ba227-5790-4a73-a7e8-f8f39ac9d92d]

value.title: Voice control is inconsistent and lacks some requested languages
value.summary: Some European F70 and G60 drivers report unreliable recognition or missing language support, while other drivers in Europe, the USA and Rest of World value the feature. Experiences therefore differ across the signals.
highlights: Some drivers report hit-or-miss recognition or missing language support.
Signals span Europe, the USA and Rest of World, including F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
A European customer says cheaper cars offer Danish voice control.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some European F70 and G60 drivers say voice recognition can be unreliable or that requested languages are unavailable. [signal:dc6204f3-89cb-4bb5-8164-4f815e95994d] [signal:70cae680-ec9a-4444-b6e6-84cd29e50d23] [signal:b81d9b3e-5f50-40dd-8adb-a193f85d0620]

## What customers say
An F70 owner says navigation voice control is hit and miss and often does not understand requests. [signal:dc6204f3-89cb-4bb5-8164-4f815e95994d] Another F70 owner says the feature could be better. [signal:a865f3f5-96e2-42d4-946f-41c854f1fd79]

One G60 owner says Danish voice control is unavailable, and another requests Russian. [signal:70cae680-ec9a-4444-b6e6-84cd29e50d23] [signal:b81d9b3e-5f50-40dd-8adb-a193f85d0620] Other owners describe verbal commands as working well, voice control as handy, or voice recognition as very useful. [signal:28729b2c-8ad1-40eb-811e-f83885abd741] [signal:001a8eca-991b-4065-bf38-2ea203eca046] [signal:46fed4a5-102a-44ae-97b9-4f4ea9a955b3] [signal:a29ab9db-79c7-4844-9212-b6b1df70e504] [signal:aeb019c4-e906-48b5-b539-a72adf565baf] [signal:c26084fa-83e7-4406-897b-3e7a217e396e]

## Differences between markets
European signals include complaints about recognition and requests for Danish and Russian, as well as a positive report about verbal commands. [signal:dc6204f3-89cb-4bb5-8164-4f815e95994d] [signal:70cae680-ec9a-4444-b6e6-84cd29e50d23] [signal:b81d9b3e-5f50-40dd-8adb-a193f85d0620] [signal:28729b2c-8ad1-40eb-811e-f83885abd741] In Rest of World, an F70 owner says voice control and recognition are handy. [signal:46fed4a5-102a-44ae-97b9-4f4ea9a955b3] In the USA, G60 owners praise voice control or Siri. [signal:a29ab9db-79c7-4844-9212-b6b1df70e504] [signal:aeb019c4-e906-48b5-b539-a72adf565baf] [signal:c26084fa-83e7-4406-897b-3e7a217e396e]

A European customer says Danish voice control is available in cheaper cars. [signal:70cae680-ec9a-4444-b6e6-84cd29e50d23]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how recognition reliability varies by language or request type. [signal:dc6204f3-89cb-4bb5-8164-4f815e95994d] They also do not establish which vehicle configurations support Danish or Russian voice control. [signal:70cae680-ec9a-4444-b6e6-84cd29e50d23] [signal:b81d9b3e-5f50-40dd-8adb-a193f85d0620]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want Steering and Lane Control Assistant to help keep them centered in the lane; another says the system cannot be added after the vehicle leaves the factory. [signal:4c8c8b1a-d6c2-44b7-a666-6d12470c3ff3] [signal:75f1e405-3468-4e5b-a320-242268bd35e9]

A G70 customer says the autonomous-driving system is less advanced than Mercedes, particularly in lane centering and how long the driver can keep their hands off the wheel. [signal:7de8ec23-9bc5-4e5c-9f58-9034503bfa30] Another customer wants clearer, easier-to-see navigation information in front of them while using Assisted Driving Plus. [signal:98597909-42f1-4ef3-aaee-8b91162c59d0]

## What customers say
One G60 customer wants help staying centered in the lane, and another asks about adding the assisted-driving mode they experienced in a loaner. [signal:4c8c8b1a-d6c2-44b7-a666-6d12470c3ff3] [signal:75f1e405-3468-4e5b-a320-242268bd35e9]

Feedback is not uniformly negative: one G70 customer praises the autonomous-driving capabilities and attention detection, while a G60 customer says they like Driving Assistant Plus. [signal:104ef252-b87d-4d54-91aa-dead482bf138] [signal:2a101feb-900b-4bd9-8fa4-6c3c2825f89a]

## Differences between markets
All six supplied signals are from the USA: three concern G60 vehicles and three concern G70 vehicles. [signal:4c8c8b1a-d6c2-44b7-a666-6d12470c3ff3] [signal:75f1e405-3468-4e5b-a320-242268bd35e9] [signal:2a101feb-900b-4bd9-8fa4-6c3c2825f89a] [signal:7de8ec23-9bc5-4e5c-9f58-9034503bfa30] [signal:98597909-42f1-4ef3-aaee-8b91162c59d0] [signal:104ef252-b87d-4d54-91aa-dead482bf138] No other market is represented in the supplied signals. [signal:4c8c8b1a-d6c2-44b7-a666-6d12470c3ff3]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often customers encounter the lane-centering concerns or whether they apply beyond the reported vehicles and market. [signal:4c8c8b1a-d6c2-44b7-a666-6d12470c3ff3] [signal:7de8ec23-9bc5-4e5c-9f58-9034503bfa30] They also do not clarify how common the positive experiences are relative to the requests for stronger or additional assistance. [signal:104ef252-b87d-4d54-91aa-dead482bf138] [signal:4c8c8b1a-d6c2-44b7-a666-6d12470c3ff3]

value.title: Back-up Assistant is confusing and unpredictable to use
value.summary: US customers report difficulty understanding or using Back-up Assistant, including cases of incorrect routing, failure to work, and unexpected vehicle behavior. Some also see limited value when their usual maneuver does not require reversing along a recorded path.
highlights: Customers report confusion, failed operation, incorrect routing, and unexpected braking or acceleration.
The signals are from US customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe uncertainty about how Back-up Assistant works and when it is useful. [signal:64f02b51-dfab-434c-b9fa-0b5ec17768c1] [signal:b551b28e-39df-456d-bb76-3455bc79e29b] Other reports describe the feature not working, repeatedly choosing the wrong direction, or unexpected braking or acceleration while in use. [signal:b2eeaad1-d2b3-4700-8380-986e33058794] [signal:bc341bdf-332c-47c1-b8a8-9c1cab96c063] [signal:adc15c24-16b6-433d-89ed-c2b0d7a1d9c3] [signal:afcbf1fa-7f8a-4fdb-85e5-d02081707196]

## What customers say
One customer was told the system records the last 160 feet of travel, but felt it would add little value for a straight driveway. [signal:64f02b51-dfab-434c-b9fa-0b5ec17768c1] Another customer was unfamiliar with the feature and unsure how to operate it for a home parking maneuver involving a three-point turn. [signal:b551b28e-39df-456d-bb76-3455bc79e29b]

A G70 customer reported that the vehicle suddenly braked while following a recorded path. [signal:adc15c24-16b6-433d-89ed-c2b0d7a1d9c3] Another G70 customer said the vehicle picked up speed after the brake pedal was released while backing out of a garage, contacted a wall, and damaged the driver-side mirror. [signal:afcbf1fa-7f8a-4fdb-85e5-d02081707196] A G70 customer said the feature had never worked when attempting to leave a parking space; the dealership reportedly suggested the canopy over the space might be related. [signal:b2eeaad1-d2b3-4700-8380-986e33058794]

A G60 customer said the system repeatedly tried to turn the wrong way when leaving a garage, requiring manual takeover. [signal:bc341bdf-332c-47c1-b8a8-9c1cab96c063]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals are all from the USA, so they do not establish differences between markets. [signal:64f02b51-dfab-434c-b9fa-0b5ec17768c1] [signal:adc15c24-16b6-433d-89ed-c2b0d7a1d9c3] [signal:afcbf1fa-7f8a-4fdb-85e5-d02081707196] [signal:b2eeaad1-d2b3-4700-8380-986e33058794] [signal:b551b28e-39df-456d-bb76-3455bc79e29b] [signal:bc341bdf-332c-47c1-b8a8-9c1cab96c063]

## Open questions
- How often do customers encounter unexpected braking or acceleration, and under what conditions? [signal:adc15c24-16b6-433d-89ed-c2b0d7a1d9c3] [signal:afcbf1fa-7f8a-4fdb-85e5-d02081707196]
- What conditions affect whether the feature works or selects the intended route? [signal:b2eeaad1-d2b3-4700-8380-986e33058794] [signal:bc341bdf-332c-47c1-b8a8-9c1cab96c063]
- How well do customers understand the feature’s operation and where it is useful? [signal:64f02b51-dfab-434c-b9fa-0b5ec17768c1] [signal:b551b28e-39df-456d-bb76-3455bc79e29b]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers say voice control often fails to recognize commands, misinterprets words, or does not take them to the intended function. Some report having to repeat commands or phrase them exactly, while one customer says the system can activate without being addressed. [signal:07c23695-f037-424e-a01c-37b077a95acf] [signal:2020c8e9-4679-49be-8ee3-fa85f5f14bed] [signal:2c736730-6a51-4f10-aa98-6da0e128ec72] [signal:339da9b6-e34e-4dcb-a3ac-37e1519d8d7d] [signal:67d1daa2-731f-4631-b018-54b9bc2dad84]

Some customers say the difficulty makes it harder to use vehicle functions and can divert attention to the display while driving. [signal:013313a3-7d58-4a31-aeb8-28d80cbbd268] [signal:2c736730-6a51-4f10-aa98-6da0e128ec72] Others mention short handover explanations or unclear interactions, including a change in the system voice. [signal:4c212dfb-7818-421a-b4d0-83fa06770d35]

## What customers say

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include complaints from Europe (5), the USA (4) and Rest of World (2). [signal:176a3f5b-a2b7-4a2b-9884-fa5212b8258b] [signal:2020c8e9-4679-49be-8ee3-fa85f5f14bed] [signal:2c736730-6a51-4f10-aa98-6da0e128ec72] [signal:4c212dfb-7818-421a-b4d0-83fa06770d35] [signal:51ef8e0a-c942-4527-bba0-a719730e6601] [signal:07c23695-f037-424e-a01c-37b077a95acf] [signal:339da9b6-e34e-4dcb-a3ac-37e1519d8d7d] [signal:595fc71d-a86b-4151-84ad-368e5515835e] [signal:67d1daa2-731f-4631-b018-54b9bc2dad84] [signal:013313a3-7d58-4a31-aeb8-28d80cbbd268] [signal:15a362eb-545e-4d12-a085-4c76b343c3bc] The complaints span F70, G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:013313a3-7d58-4a31-aeb8-28d80cbbd268] [signal:07c23695-f037-424e-a01c-37b077a95acf] [signal:339da9b6-e34e-4dcb-a3ac-37e1519d8d7d]

## Open questions
How often do commands fail or trigger unintentionally across vehicle lines and markets? [signal:339da9b6-e34e-4dcb-a3ac-37e1519d8d7d] [signal:07c23695-f037-424e-a01c-37b077a95acf]

Which command types, words or interaction steps are most difficult for customers? [signal:67d1daa2-731f-4631-b018-54b9bc2dad84] [signal:07c23695-f037-424e-a01c-37b077a95acf]

value.title: Steering and lane assistance is difficult to use consistently
value.summary: Customers report difficulty activating and using lane-change and steering assistance, alongside concerns about lane guidance behavior and driver-attention detection. Signals come from USA G60 and G70 owners and one Europe F70 owner.
highlights: Customers report confusing activation, inconsistent operation, and unwanted or concerning lane guidance behavior.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 owners and one Europe F70 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report uncertainty about activating Lane Change Assistant, lane-change assistance that worked only once, and difficulty using basic cruise control without adaptive functions. [signal:405acb0c-bd35-4f9f-a11c-46618eb20939] [signal:7f0270bc-1358-4b53-b660-67c4cb32265a] [signal:8c213770-bc23-4a72-b814-222b79491c7e]
A G60 owner says lane assistance can lose track of lane markings and move toward a line ending, including once across a double yellow line. [signal:54d31410-0761-4e22-a7da-86ec586a65ca]
G70 owners report the attention monitor not recognizing that they are paying attention, with one describing more frequent prompts at night. [signal:3fd9888b-fa55-4279-919a-98101009d7b6] [signal:725a5d5d-1c22-4afb-be88-c7a170a14690]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer was unsure how to activate Lane Change Assistant; another said it had worked only once. [signal:405acb0c-bd35-4f9f-a11c-46618eb20939] [signal:7f0270bc-1358-4b53-b660-67c4cb32265a]
A G60 customer reported incorrect adjacent-lane vehicle detection on curvy Virginia roads and frustration that basic cruise control was unavailable without adaptive functions. [signal:8c213770-bc23-4a72-b814-222b79491c7e]
A G70 customer reported attention detection difficulty with and without glasses; another described nighttime steering-wheel prompts and wondered whether head angle or glasses frames affected detection. [signal:3fd9888b-fa55-4279-919a-98101009d7b6] [signal:725a5d5d-1c22-4afb-be88-c7a170a14690]
A Europe F70 owner said lane guidance had to be turned off at every start and felt the feature was more dangerous than not having it. [signal:41a5a127-1d15-4570-80c9-e956a74772c6]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals cover G60 concerns about activation, lane behavior, and cruise-control modes, and G70 concerns about attention detection and lane-change operation. [signal:405acb0c-bd35-4f9f-a11c-46618eb20939] [signal:54d31410-0761-4e22-a7da-86ec586a65ca] [signal:8c213770-bc23-4a72-b814-222b79491c7e] [signal:3fd9888b-fa55-4279-919a-98101009d7b6] [signal:725a5d5d-1c22-4afb-be88-c7a170a14690] [signal:7f0270bc-1358-4b53-b660-67c4cb32265a]
The Europe signal describes having to disable lane guidance at each start and concern about its safety. [signal:41a5a127-1d15-4570-80c9-e956a74772c6]

## Open questions
How often do attention-detection difficulties occur across drivers, lighting conditions, and eyewear? [signal:3fd9888b-fa55-4279-919a-98101009d7b6] [signal:725a5d5d-1c22-4afb-be88-c7a170a14690]
How frequently does lane guidance lose track of markings or detect vehicles in adjacent lanes, and in what road conditions? [signal:54d31410-0761-4e22-a7da-86ec586a65ca] [signal:8c213770-bc23-4a72-b814-222b79491c7e]
How common are uncertainty about activation and difficulty accessing basic cruise control without adaptive functions? [signal:405acb0c-bd35-4f9f-a11c-46618eb20939] [signal:8c213770-bc23-4a72-b814-222b79491c7e]

value.title: Charging and route-planning functions fall short
value.summary: G60 owners report gaps in charging and route-planning functions: one cannot schedule charging, while another wants to send a complete multi-stop route from the app to the car. Assisted driving and safety features are praised in the signals.
highlights: Scheduled charging and end-to-end route planning are reported as missing or unreliable.
Signals cover G60 owners in Europe and the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A USA G60 owner says the car charges only immediately and does not follow a scheduled time or date; after it failed to charge overnight, the owner had to stop en route for a compatible charger. [signal:6e1e97b2-915d-4df3-965c-fb44679f3c13] A Europe G60 owner wants to plan charging stops and multi-waypoint trips in the app and send the complete route to the car, rather than receiving separate stops that must be reassembled. [signal:1dae5099-25aa-4996-93b4-1c76f48e536b]

## What customers say
The Europe owner says assisted driving gives good support, and describes the software and range estimates positively. [signal:1dae5099-25aa-4996-93b4-1c76f48e536b] The USA owner praises the car's safety features. [signal:6e1e97b2-915d-4df3-965c-fb44679f3c13]

## Differences between markets
The Europe signal highlights difficulty transferring a complete planned route from the app to the car. [signal:1dae5099-25aa-4996-93b4-1c76f48e536b] The USA signal reports that scheduled charging did not occur and describes a resulting need to charge during a trip. [signal:6e1e97b2-915d-4df3-965c-fb44679f3c13] The signals describe different issues and do not establish whether either occurs in both markets.

## Open questions
Do other G60 owners experience the same route-transfer or scheduled-charging issues? [signal:1dae5099-25aa-4996-93b4-1c76f48e536b] [signal:6e1e97b2-915d-4df3-965c-fb44679f3c13]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report mixed experiences with driver assistance: some praise its performance, while others object to lane assist, braking they consider unnecessary, or difficulty operating the controls. [signal:e8e43c94-e102-44e9-9d83-1f073e3f4aaa] [signal:854b0c62-6713-4a71-94ff-cca70034d61d] [signal:d11fbc47-7467-4f15-8b7f-e4b80db4fb21]

One Europe-based F70 owner wishes for motorway driver assistance. [signal:93e47c49-bc35-44c4-ab73-700f1deba78f]

## What customers say
Positive comments describe highway assistance as impressive or outstanding, and driver assistance and safety features as excellent. [signal:13f12dc4-ee13-41f0-b587-521898b23453] [signal:4c28c9c0-be6e-459b-a1cb-b3f3f4046ab5] [signal:854b0c62-6713-4a71-94ff-cca70034d61d] [signal:96fe3ed5-a65b-4742-bd9f-0be88cee3f41] [signal:d11fbc47-7467-4f15-8b7f-e4b80db4fb21] [signal:e5f64c3b-f011-4644-bc37-bbd504c773d3]

Other comments describe lane assist as dangerous, report braking without an apparent need, or say complex controls make it hard to use the car’s capabilities fully. [signal:e8e43c94-e102-44e9-9d83-1f073e3f4aaa] [signal:854b0c62-6713-4a71-94ff-cca70034d61d] [signal:d11fbc47-7467-4f15-8b7f-e4b80db4fb21]

## Differences between markets
The two Europe signals include a wish for motorway assistance and a complaint about lane assist and unwanted braking. [signal:93e47c49-bc35-44c4-ab73-700f1deba78f] [signal:e8e43c94-e102-44e9-9d83-1f073e3f4aaa]

USA signals include praise for highway assistance and driver-assistance features, as well as a comment that complex controls limit use. [signal:13f12dc4-ee13-41f0-b587-521898b23453] [signal:4c28c9c0-be6e-459b-a1cb-b3f3f4046ab5] [signal:d11fbc47-7467-4f15-8b7f-e4b80db4fb21] [signal:e5f64c3b-f011-4644-bc37-bbd504c773d3]

Rest of World signals praise assistance and safety features; one also says the control panel is awkward and feels dangerous to use while driving. [signal:854b0c62-6713-4a71-94ff-cca70034d61d] [signal:96fe3ed5-a65b-4742-bd9f-0be88cee3f41] [signal:d0119dad-875e-46da-a5af-244b361ef273]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often unwanted braking or lane-assist concerns occur, or which specific functions and control interactions are involved. [signal:e8e43c94-e102-44e9-9d83-1f073e3f4aaa] [signal:854b0c62-6713-4a71-94ff-cca70034d61d] [signal:d11fbc47-7467-4f15-8b7f-e4b80db4fb21]

## Differences between markets
In the USA, customers express wishes for more assistance or full self-driving, while others praise the vehicle’s automation and features. [signal:4008093f-2375-41d0-939b-d4ee60b8f080] [signal:749250d6-1997-4359-aad0-7a931634ecd3] [signal:9fef9964-3b7d-4e2f-8a3d-bcc05c7a844e]  [signal:28b95c6a-bb28-447b-84fb-ea319003f186] [signal:62a1ef55-8e18-4e7a-8a67-4f6df7efd045]

In Europe, one F70 customer describes enjoying the assistance systems, while another raises concern about the removal of braking assistance. [signal:7c9125e7-84de-459b-9e57-001bba8e177a] [signal:f09b725e-9b7a-4805-9e33-8e0010445fa1]

Rest of World customers describe the assistance as complete, effective, or sufficient for their needs. [signal:814315dc-ff5d-4e5c-8d99-bb2ee212b3c4] [signal:9bce1ea0-caa4-485d-a66b-ca555684f181] [signal:ccfcfcb9-cc8c-4e44-8346-d7461dd224d7] [signal:d3668c9c-9f49-4555-9353-ea5152dd18f0]

## Open questions
How often, and in what circumstances, is braking assistance removed? [signal:f09b725e-9b7a-4805-9e33-8e0010445fa1]

What specific capabilities do customers mean by full self-driving, and how do those requests relate to the assisted-driving package they mention? [signal:4008093f-2375-41d0-939b-d4ee60b8f080] [signal:749250d6-1997-4359-aad0-7a931634ecd3] [signal:9fef9964-3b7d-4e2f-8a3d-bcc05c7a844e]

value.title: Side-impact warnings and protection are missing for some customers
value.summary: Two USA customers describe missing or desired side-impact functions: a G60 owner expected alerts for potential side collisions, while a G70 owner wanted pre-impact protection like a feature on his prior Mercedes S-Class.
highlights: Customers report missing side-collision alerts and want a side-impact mitigation feature.
Two USA signals: one G60 owner and one G70 owner.
A customer cited a prior Mercedes S-Class feature that raised one side of the vehicle before an imminent side impact.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 customer said the vehicle did not alert him to potential collisions on the sides; he was told the feature was not included in his vehicle and came with the Driver's Assistance Professional package. [signal:e1488aef-cce2-46df-836e-7c2490ea723e] A G70 customer wanted a feature that raises one side of the vehicle when it senses an imminent side impact, intended to lessen collision severity. [signal:f8fbba32-5048-41e9-b722-6a299a2baba3]

## What customers say
The G60 customer asked whether the vehicle was supposed to warn about side collisions and acknowledged the explanation about package availability. [signal:e1488aef-cce2-46df-836e-7c2490ea723e] The G70 customer said his prior Mercedes S-Class had a one-sided air-suspension lift function for imminent side impacts and asked for a similar kind of feature on the BMW 760i. [signal:f8fbba32-5048-41e9-b722-6a299a2baba3]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA; one concerns a G60 and the other a G70. [signal:e1488aef-cce2-46df-836e-7c2490ea723e] [signal:f8fbba32-5048-41e9-b722-6a299a2baba3] The concerns differ: one is about alerts for potential side collisions, while the other is about reducing the severity of an imminent side impact. [signal:e1488aef-cce2-46df-836e-7c2490ea723e] [signal:f8fbba32-5048-41e9-b722-6a299a2baba3]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the requested side-impact lift function is available on any BMW vehicle, or whether the two customers are referring to the same function. [signal:e1488aef-cce2-46df-836e-7c2490ea723e] [signal:f8fbba32-5048-41e9-b722-6a299a2baba3]

value.title: Driver assistance alerts and functions are unreliable
value.summary: Customers report recurring or unexplained driver-assistance alerts, and some say assistance features stopped working or disappeared. Reports come from USA G70/G60 and Europe F70 owners.
highlights: Driver-assistance alerts recur, or functions become unavailable or disappear.
Five relevant reports span USA G70/G60 and Europe F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report intermittent driver-assistance warnings, reduced assistance availability, and functions becoming unavailable or disappearing. [signal:1754e6fd-8bdf-4922-9259-941b2e080976] [signal:32661fb7-be1a-45d1-8961-9dc878ac3747] [signal:3b711b9a-5f1c-4422-91e6-c4e49c9cc832] [signal:3287f842-67b2-4b81-819e-a505f0f19cb8]

## What customers say
A USA G70 owner reports multiple assistance messages appearing repeatedly when leaving a parking lot, even when Drive Assist is not in use. [signal:1754e6fd-8bdf-4922-9259-941b2e080976]

A USA G60 owner describes a one-time sequence of alerts for reduced driver assistance, side-collision warning, blind-spot detection, and lane-departure warning. [signal:32661fb7-be1a-45d1-8961-9dc878ac3747]

A Europe F70 owner says collision functions in Driving Assistance Professional stopped working after a software update, about a week after delivery. [signal:3b711b9a-5f1c-4422-91e6-c4e49c9cc832]

Another Europe F70 owner says High Beam Assistant disappeared after about a month, followed by other functions, including 3D navigation and live traffic information. [signal:3287f842-67b2-4b81-819e-a505f0f19cb8]

A USA G70 owner also reported safety-related check lights cycling on and off; the dealer replaced the RAM receiver audio module, after which the car reportedly drove normally. [signal:035e1287-22ea-4b28-8df3-d09ac4a89471]

## Differences between markets
The supplied reliability reports include USA G70 and G60 vehicles and Europe F70 vehicles. [signal:1754e6fd-8bdf-4922-9259-941b2e080976] [signal:32661fb7-be1a-45d1-8961-9dc878ac3747] [signal:035e1287-22ea-4b28-8df3-d09ac4a89471] [signal:3b711b9a-5f1c-4422-91e6-c4e49c9cc832] [signal:3287f842-67b2-4b81-819e-a505f0f19cb8]

The USA reports describe alerts, including one recurring pattern and one alert episode; the Europe reports describe functions stopping or disappearing. [signal:1754e6fd-8bdf-4922-9259-941b2e080976] [signal:32661fb7-be1a-45d1-8961-9dc878ac3747] [signal:3b711b9a-5f1c-4422-91e6-c4e49c9cc832] [signal:3287f842-67b2-4b81-819e-a505f0f19cb8]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the causes of the assistance alerts or missing functions, or whether the reports share a cause. [signal:1754e6fd-8bdf-4922-9259-941b2e080976] [signal:32661fb7-be1a-45d1-8961-9dc878ac3747] [signal:3b711b9a-5f1c-4422-91e6-c4e49c9cc832] [signal:3287f842-67b2-4b81-819e-a505f0f19cb8]

value.title: Driver assistance feels intrusive, confusing or unavailable to some drivers
value.summary: Some drivers find assistance systems intrusive, hard to understand or unavailable, while others value their intuitive support. Signals cover G70, G60 and F70 drivers across the USA, Europe and Rest of World.
highlights: Drivers report intrusive alerts, confusing controls and difficulty accessing assistance features.
Signals cover G70, G60 and F70 drivers in the USA, Europe and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say assistance systems intervene or alert too often, feel like they dictate how to drive, or are difficult to access and understand. [signal:209f82c4-f437-454f-824d-a21d013d37ba] [signal:7f0d1782-493f-4305-ad07-a68bf513db94] [signal:a5bdd025-70ec-465a-8dbd-ffd6b686f90a] Other feedback describes too many separate safety systems or a feeling that the car does too much driving. [signal:7ea83fe4-282c-4213-b553-3b347daa1bd5] [signal:b34011e8-4340-4840-b76d-fb52b6dbd6cd]

## What customers say
A USA G70 driver says an alert about not being attentive appears too often, even without lane drifting. [signal:209f82c4-f437-454f-824d-a21d013d37ba] A USA G60 driver could not access Drive Assistant Professional, while another driver asked a dealer about the driver-assistance shortcut button. [signal:a5bdd025-70ec-465a-8dbd-ffd6b686f90a] [signal:3d506a3d-1af6-49df-84a9-4378b58f6ac7] A USA G70 driver reports that assisted driving will not allow him to hold a cup close to his face. [signal:e57132ce-42f2-4cb9-b683-b12a850cc408]

Experiences are not uniformly negative: a Rest of World G60 driver values the up-to-date assistance features for calmer driving, and a Europe F70 driver describes the systems as intuitive and helpful. [signal:948cfa5f-628c-4cce-b161-9958de6fe1ff] [signal:ba60ccef-8d90-4775-8306-fbdaf85437df]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include an overly frequent attentiveness warning, difficulty accessing Drive Assistant Professional, questions about a shortcut button, and a restriction reported during assisted driving. [signal:209f82c4-f437-454f-824d-a21d013d37ba] [signal:a5bdd025-70ec-465a-8dbd-ffd6b686f90a] [signal:3d506a3d-1af6-49df-84a9-4378b58f6ac7] [signal:e57132ce-42f2-4cb9-b683-b12a850cc408] Europe feedback includes frustration with the car seeming to dictate how to drive, as well as praise for intuitive, helpful systems. [signal:7f0d1782-493f-4305-ad07-a68bf513db94] [signal:ba60ccef-8d90-4775-8306-fbdaf85437df] Rest of World feedback includes concern about numerous safety systems and the car doing too much, alongside praise for assistance features. [signal:7ea83fe4-282c-4213-b553-3b347daa1bd5] [signal:b34011e8-4340-4840-b76d-fb52b6dbd6cd] [signal:948cfa5f-628c-4cce-b161-9958de6fe1ff]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often these usability issues occur across the 15-signal case, or whether they vary by vehicle configuration. [signal:209f82c4-f437-454f-824d-a21d013d37ba] [signal:a5bdd025-70ec-465a-8dbd-ffd6b686f90a] [signal:7ea83fe4-282c-4213-b553-3b347daa1bd5] The signals also do not clarify which specific systems are meant by the reports of too many safety systems or of the car doing too much. [signal:7ea83fe4-282c-4213-b553-3b347daa1bd5] [signal:b34011e8-4340-4840-b76d-fb52b6dbd6cd]

value.title: Door closing needs force and rear convenience access is missing
value.summary: Some customers report that doors need to be pushed or slammed to latch, while others miss soft-close or self-closing doors and convenient rear-door controls. The signals come from USA customers of G60 and G70 vehicles and a Rest of World G60 customer.
highlights: Customers report forceful door closing, missing soft-close, and limited door controls.
Signals mention USA G60 and G70 customers and a Rest of World G60 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say their doors need to be pushed or slammed hard to latch, and miss the soft-close doors they had on previous vehicles. [signal:2a8631c2-81f6-4555-b700-aa75e190b251] [signal:40dc8811-33a5-48fa-a1cb-c58d4968b942] Other customers want self-closing doors or a way to close all doors from a physical rear-seat button rather than using a voice command. [signal:3e6c94de-18cb-4d83-b386-a4ed6126d489] [signal:05ad4b28-44b3-4676-be47-11c00ba918d7] A Rest of World G60 customer says the rear doors lack the convenience open-or-lock feature available on the front passenger doors. [signal:6ef805a5-5234-4324-bd24-6697c25cdb98]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer says the doors feel as if they have to be slammed and misses the soft-close doors on a previous 5 Series. [signal:2a8631c2-81f6-4555-b700-aa75e190b251] Another USA G60 customer says the door needs to be shut fairly hard to latch and expected it to close gently like a previous 540i. [signal:40dc8811-33a5-48fa-a1cb-c58d4968b942] A USA G70 customer says they want self-closing doors. [signal:3e6c94de-18cb-4d83-b386-a4ed6126d489] Another USA G70 customer prefers a physical rear-seat button to close all doors instead of needing a voice command. [signal:05ad4b28-44b3-4676-be47-11c00ba918d7]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals mention forceful closing, soft-close or self-closing doors, and a physical button to close all doors. [signal:2a8631c2-81f6-4555-b700-aa75e190b251] [signal:40dc8811-33a5-48fa-a1cb-c58d4968b942] [signal:3e6c94de-18cb-4d83-b386-a4ed6126d489] [signal:05ad4b28-44b3-4676-be47-11c00ba918d7] The Rest of World G60 signal instead concerns the absence of convenience opening or locking for the rear doors, while that function remains on the front passenger doors. [signal:6ef805a5-5234-4324-bd24-6697c25cdb98]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these concerns are across the 19 signals in the case, or whether they apply to other vehicle lines or markets. [signal:2a8631c2-81f6-4555-b700-aa75e190b251] [signal:6ef805a5-5234-4324-bd24-6697c25cdb98] The signals also do not clarify which door-closing or convenience functions are available by vehicle configuration. [signal:2a8631c2-81f6-4555-b700-aa75e190b251] [signal:6ef805a5-5234-4324-bd24-6697c25cdb98]

value.title: Resting-state behavior after door opening is difficult to control
value.summary: Customers report that audio may continue after shutdown, while opening the driver’s door can also switch the vehicle off. These behaviors frustrate drivers who want more immediate control over shutdown or need the vehicle to remain running for a passenger.
highlights: Audio may continue after shutdown, while opening the driver’s door can switch the vehicle off.
Signals describe USA customers in G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe different, sometimes conflicting expectations for what should happen after shutdown or when a door opens: some want audio to stop sooner, while another reports that the vehicle shuts off when they want to keep it running for a passenger. [signal:10330e91-db15-4318-abf6-c11a0789a9fe] [signal:3128e3e9-a6f7-4d4d-82a6-a415b079e59c] [signal:26fa2723-e2e6-461b-873c-303b419fb4fe]

## What customers say
One G70 customer finds it annoying that music continues after the vehicle is turned off and says it stops when the vehicle is locked. [signal:10330e91-db15-4318-abf6-c11a0789a9fe]

A G60 customer says the radio does not shut off immediately after switching off the car and would like it to power down at that point. [signal:3128e3e9-a6f7-4d4d-82a6-a415b079e59c]

Another G60 customer says the vehicle switches off when they want to keep it running for a passenger’s comfort, leaving them unsure whether they are doing something wrong. [signal:26fa2723-e2e6-461b-873c-303b419fb4fe]

A G70 customer dislikes that the vehicle powers off when the driver’s door is opened. [signal:3eccc246-93f7-4081-9aff-7b1a845c1d3d]

## Differences between markets
The relevant examples provided are from USA customers in G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:10330e91-db15-4318-abf6-c11a0789a9fe] [signal:16d57423-2528-415d-bd60-4f7967aeeefb] [signal:26fa2723-e2e6-461b-873c-303b419fb4fe] [signal:3128e3e9-a6f7-4d4d-82a6-a415b079e59c] [signal:3eccc246-93f7-4081-9aff-7b1a845c1d3d]

## Open questions
Do customers distinguish between audio shutoff after engine shutdown and the vehicle’s resting-state behavior after a door opens? [signal:10330e91-db15-4318-abf6-c11a0789a9fe] [signal:3128e3e9-a6f7-4d4d-82a6-a415b079e59c] [signal:3eccc246-93f7-4081-9aff-7b1a845c1d3d]

How often do customers want the vehicle to remain running for a passenger, compared with wanting it to shut down sooner? [signal:26fa2723-e2e6-461b-873c-303b419fb4fe]

No competitor evidence in the signals.

[signal:7b32812f-790a-495b-98b9-98ed54ed448a] [signal:80b1adbe-d9c6-44d1-9897-5e23d36b9b] [signal:cfdc4347-be16-4e47-92fa-ba033b796566] [signal:f77e4036-74dc-418d-8d44-6368a7ded81a]
