value.title: Door-open resting state conflicts with customer preferences
value.summary: Customers in the USA report that vehicle, climate, radio and horn behavior after door opening can be unwanted or disruptive. Others value the automatic radio shutoff or horn reminder, so preferences differ.
highlights: After door opening, vehicle shutdown, radio restart and horn behavior do not suit every customer.
Feature-related signals come from USA customers in the G60 and G70; three express wishes or complaints.
A G60 customer compares the desired stay-on period with a Tesla Model 3.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe conflicting expectations for what happens after a door opens: some want the vehicle to remain on, while others value automatic shutoff behavior. [signal:ff51964d-5acd-4b31-acfb-47aff0ffca54] [signal:9487c2a2-4006-4ac1-bc3c-69a517cf4ed6] A G70 customer reports that the vehicle powers down when the driver exits, leaving passengers without air conditioning and the horn sounding. [signal:7cfe74c4-0a59-494c-a539-ed81bb820aa1]

## What customers say
A G60 customer wants the vehicle to remain on after opening the door, citing a Tesla Model 3 that stayed on for about 10–15 minutes while they stepped away. [signal:ff51964d-5acd-4b31-acfb-47aff0ffca54] A G70 customer says the radio turns back on when they re-enter after switching the car off, which they do not want. [signal:fddff8c8-841e-4408-bd41-e35c9d4490ac]

Other G70 customers value the horn as a reminder to switch off a running vehicle and the radio turning off when the doors open. [signal:66495422-e4c6-41d6-8f81-297a8b725793] [signal:9487c2a2-4006-4ac1-bc3c-69a517cf4ed6] One G70 complaint also mentions a loud rear air fan and difficulty using the auto door feature while displays remain uncleared. [signal:7cfe74c4-0a59-494c-a539-ed81bb820aa1]

## Differences between markets
The feature-related signals shown are from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:ff51964d-5acd-4b31-acfb-47aff0ffca54] [signal:fddff8c8-841e-4408-bd41-e35c9d4490ac] [signal:66495422-e4c6-41d6-8f81-297a8b725793] [signal:9487c2a2-4006-4ac1-bc3c-69a517cf4ed6] [signal:7cfe74c4-0a59-494c-a539-ed81bb820aa1] Within those signals, preferences differ: some customers want the vehicle or radio to stay off, while another wants the vehicle to stay on. [signal:fddff8c8-841e-4408-bd41-e35c9d4490ac] [signal:ff51964d-5acd-4b31-acfb-47aff0ffca54] [signal:9487c2a2-4006-4ac1-bc3c-69a517cf4ed6]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common each preference is across customers or whether expectations differ beyond the USA and the G60 and G70. [signal:ff51964d-5acd-4b31-acfb-47aff0ffca54] [signal:fddff8c8-841e-4408-bd41-e35c9d4490ac] [signal:66495422-e4c6-41d6-8f81-297a8b725793] [signal:9487c2a2-4006-4ac1-bc3c-69a517cf4ed6] [signal:7cfe74c4-0a59-494c-a539-ed81bb820aa1]

value.title: Low front clearance risks scraping on everyday transitions
value.summary: Some USA drivers report the low front end or underside scraping on driveways, inclines, curbs and parking barriers. The supplied signals cover G60 and G70 drivers, including one who says they did not know about the height-raising ability.
highlights: Low clearance can lead to scraping at driveways, inclines, curbs and parking barriers.
Supplied signals: USA, G60 (5) and G70 (1).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say the low front end or underside scrapes when entering or leaving driveways, crossing mild inclines, or parking near curbs and barriers. [signal:07e59112-27b0-43d7-a064-bb9eaa4058c1] [signal:0dad039a-773b-4a28-bbdb-e1ed5a384cdf] [signal:5d3f0f9a-133b-4005-a847-ef9b204bf8cf] [signal:a444374d-1471-4ee7-972c-c1b8a068c482]

## What customers say
A G60 driver reports the underside scraping almost every time they leave a driveway, while another describes scraping on mild inclines, when parking, and at driveways. [signal:0dad039a-773b-4a28-bbdb-e1ed5a384cdf] [signal:5d3f0f9a-133b-4005-a847-ef9b204bf8cf]

Other G60 drivers mention parking curbs and barriers catching or scraping the front air dam or bumper underside. [signal:07e59112-27b0-43d7-a064-bb9eaa4058c1] [signal:a444374d-1471-4ee7-972c-c1b8a068c482]

One G70 driver says the front end is extremely low and notes not knowing about the height-raising ability. [signal:13a8091e-beab-4d54-8cf7-9994d53a6b7e]

One G60 driver considers low clearance expected for a performance car but says they must take care at an angled garage exit and around high parking barriers. [signal:a444374d-1471-4ee7-972c-c1b8a068c482]

## Differences between markets
All six supplied signals are from the USA: five concern the G60 and one the G70. [signal:07e59112-27b0-43d7-a064-bb9eaa4058c1] [signal:0dad039a-773b-4a28-bbdb-e1ed5a384cdf] [signal:13a8091e-beab-4d54-8cf7-9994d53a6b7e] [signal:5d3f0f9a-133b-4005-a847-ef9b204bf8cf] [signal:6c7c3676-eb7f-4def-a71d-4c9d4d464927] [signal:a444374d-1471-4ee7-972c-c1b8a068c482]

## Open questions
Do drivers who report scraping know about or use the height-raising ability? One G70 driver says they did not know about it. [signal:13a8091e-beab-4d54-8cf7-9994d53a6b7e]

How often does scraping lead to damage, and which obstacles are most commonly involved? The supplied reports mention driveways, inclines, curbs, and parking barriers but do not describe damage. [signal:07e59112-27b0-43d7-a064-bb9eaa4058c1] [signal:0dad039a-773b-4a28-bbdb-e1ed5a384cdf] [signal:5d3f0f9a-133b-4005-a847-ef9b204bf8cf] [signal:a444374d-1471-4ee7-972c-c1b8a068c482]

value.title: Door handles are awkward and doors can be hard to close
value.summary: Customers report awkward interior door controls, unreliable touch unlocking, and doors that need a hard slam to latch. The signals cover Europe’s F70 and the USA’s G60 and G70.
highlights: Interior controls, touch unlocking, and closing effort make door use difficult.
Signals mention Europe F70 and USA G60 and G70; no model-level counts are provided.
A customer says the F70 doors take more effort to latch than a VW Scirocco.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe several door-use difficulties: some doors need a hard slam to latch, some handles or buttons are awkward to operate, and touch unlocking may not work on the first attempt. [signal:1f05a962-e6e5-4a74-989e-47328615fb48] [signal:26bfd648-0422-490a-bde8-8a2141d46f09] [signal:28df7cd5-1184-42a5-92fd-bf38d266cfa2]

## What customers say
F70 owners in Europe say the doors can be awkward to shut and may need a hard slam; another customer says the doors need to be swung wide for comfortable entry and exit, particularly in car parks. [signal:335a3342-9bdf-4d10-90b4-b4136014f0a0] [signal:ab46b8bb-d7aa-4082-a631-b52dba76fc14]

G60 owners in the USA describe the inside handle position as hard to use and the design as challenging. [signal:26bfd648-0422-490a-bde8-8a2141d46f09] [signal:28ba304a-e466-4090-a667-da3bb6b326ad] A separate G60 complaint says touch unlocking is tricky and often fails on the first attempt. [signal:28df7cd5-1184-42a5-92fd-bf38d266cfa2]

G70 customers say the small interior door-open button is less desirable than a conventional pull handle, and may be pressed unintentionally when someone swings a leg over. [signal:2ef0915a-2c48-46cd-9378-e3ec03ef9d4d] [signal:31ac10da-1ee0-4b93-805c-9af0a0677ff6]

One F70 customer compares the effort needed to latch the doors unfavourably with a VW Scirocco. [signal:1f05a962-e6e5-4a74-989e-47328615fb48]

## Differences between markets
The supplied examples include door-closing and wide-opening complaints from Europe about the F70, and handle, touch-unlock, and interior-button complaints from the USA about the G60 and G70. [signal:1f05a962-e6e5-4a74-989e-47328615fb48] [signal:ab46b8bb-d7aa-4082-a631-b52dba76fc14] [signal:26bfd648-0422-490a-bde8-8a2141d46f09] [signal:28df7cd5-1184-42a5-92fd-bf38d266cfa2] [signal:2ef0915a-2c48-46cd-9378-e3ec03ef9d4d]

## Open questions
The supplied examples do not establish how common each issue is across the 45 signals or across vehicle lines. [signal:1f05a962-e6e5-4a74-989e-47328615fb48] [signal:26bfd648-0422-490a-bde8-8a2141d46f09] [signal:2ef0915a-2c48-46cd-9378-e3ec03ef9d4d]

value.title: Door sounds vary in quality and missed-closure warnings
value.summary: Customers value a warning sound when a door is open and a car is approaching, but others report no audible warning when a door is not fully closed, squeaking, or a less satisfying closing sound. Signals come from F70, G60 and G70 owners in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Door sounds are valued in one use case but criticized for missed-closure alerts, squeaks and closing quality.
Signals cover F70 in Europe and Rest of World, plus G60 and G70 in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report different concerns about door sounds: one values an audible warning when a door is open and a car is approaching [signal:08ac05f0-c279-4220-9af8-a8920edd6ccf], while another says an incompletely closed door triggers only a small visual warning and no sound [signal:11556ee3-72c3-4bad-a405-eaebddaa585d]. Other reports describe doors that do not shut right [signal:3bb61601-28f7-4307-b4bb-afc00017fe2d], doors that squeak when opened [signal:d1adca6d-5eb9-4231-9152-0816e8391791], and a changed closing sound compared with older BMWs [signal:b8c25943-bd95-438e-b0cb-e2699d9ceaf6].

## What customers say
An F70 owner in Europe likes the warning sound that alerts them when a door is open and a car is coming [signal:08ac05f0-c279-4220-9af8-a8920edd6ccf]. A G60 owner in the USA says the doors usually need a gentle slam to latch and that an incompletely closed door produces no sound warning [signal:11556ee3-72c3-4bad-a405-eaebddaa585d]. Another F70 owner in Europe says the doors do not shut right [signal:3bb61601-28f7-4307-b4bb-afc00017fe2d]. A G70 owner in the USA reports squeaking when opening the doors, with the dealer recommending hinge replacement [signal:d1adca6d-5eb9-4231-9152-0816e8391791]. A G60 owner in the USA recalls older BMW doors having a solid, satisfying closing clunk, then begins contrasting the current sound; the quote is truncated before describing it [signal:b8c25943-bd95-438e-b0cb-e2699d9ceaf6].

## Differences between markets
The positive report about the open-door warning sound comes from an F70 owner in Europe [signal:08ac05f0-c279-4220-9af8-a8920edd6ccf]. Reports of incomplete closure or unsatisfactory closing sound come from G60 owners in the USA [signal:11556ee3-72c3-4bad-a405-eaebddaa585d] [signal:b8c25943-bd95-438e-b0cb-e2699d9ceaf6], while an F70 owner in Europe reports doors that do not shut right [signal:3bb61601-28f7-4307-b4bb-afc00017fe2d]. The reported door-opening squeak is from a G70 owner in the USA [signal:d1adca6d-5eb9-4231-9152-0816e8391791]. These reports differ in the sound or behavior described; they do not establish a market-wide difference.

## Open questions
Do the reports of doors that do not shut right and doors needing a gentle slam describe the same issue? [signal:3bb61601-28f7-4307-b4bb-afc00017fe2d] [signal:11556ee3-72c3-4bad-a405-eaebddaa585d]
What did the G60 owner mean by the current door-closing sound? The quote is truncated. [signal:b8c25943-bd95-438e-b0cb-e2699d9ceaf6]
How frequently do customers experience the missing audible warning or door squeaks? The signals do not provide counts beyond these individual reports. [signal:11556ee3-72c3-4bad-a405-eaebddaa585d] [signal:d1adca6d-5eb9-4231-9152-0816e8391791]

value.title: Door opening, closing and locking are unreliable
value.summary: Customers report doors that are slow or difficult to operate, fail to latch or unlock consistently, or behave unexpectedly with digital access. The signals span F70, G60 and G70 owners in the Rest of World, Europe and the USA.
highlights: Doors can be slow, require force, fail to latch or unlock, or behave unpredictably.
Sample: 12 signals across F70, G60 and G70 in the USA, Rest of World and Europe.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe inconsistent door operation, including doors that take extra effort to close, do not latch reliably, or cannot be opened from inside. Digital unlocking and door-related controls also cause problems in some reports. [signal:4aaf7c69-5ff9-4c0f-a9af-c33114805f27] [signal:42c3fca8-7790-4378-a500-f03f3c522357] [signal:5249cc20-3496-4459-b163-274771a9d8a4] [signal:d515d2ed-cfdb-44cc-89b2-b097701dcdb2]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the front passenger and driver doors need more force to shut than other BMWs they have owned. [signal:4aaf7c69-5ff9-4c0f-a9af-c33114805f27] Another G60 report says doors may seem shut without latching, sometimes requiring a slam, and the car will not start unless the driver door is fully closed. [signal:42c3fca8-7790-4378-a500-f03f3c522357]

F70 owners report doors that are slow to open and close, and one says the driver door locked and would not open from inside. [signal:1a2a6a13-e27e-41e0-ac3f-9eb73a101c79] [signal:5249cc20-3496-4459-b163-274771a9d8a4] A separate F70 report says the handle sensor sometimes does not unlock the doors when touched. [signal:d515d2ed-cfdb-44cc-89b2-b097701dcdb2]

Other reported issues include a G70 driver’s knee accidentally hitting a door switch and opening the door while driving, and digital-key experiences involving lockout or unexpected locking. [signal:3d2ead69-80f1-46f3-8291-253e54e4c663] [signal:042eb426-b944-4e43-af88-bc9c5f2241e2] [signal:b6ddd64b-9c6c-4c5f-ba57-33145f993413]

## Differences between markets
The supplied sample includes USA reports for G60 and G70, Rest of World reports for F70, and a Europe report for F70. [signal:042eb426-b944-4e43-af88-bc9c5f2241e2] [signal:3d2ead69-80f1-46f3-8291-253e54e4c663] [signal:1a2a6a13-e27e-41e0-ac3f-9eb73a101c79] [signal:b6ddd64b-9c6c-4c5f-ba57-33145f993413] The USA sample includes complaints about closing effort, latching and door controls; Rest of World reports include slow operation, an interior-opening failure and an insensitive unlock sensor. [signal:4aaf7c69-5ff9-4c0f-a9af-c33114805f27] [signal:42c3fca8-7790-4378-a500-f03f3c522357] [signal:3d2ead69-80f1-46f3-8291-253e54e4c663] [signal:1a2a6a13-e27e-41e0-ac3f-9eb73a101c79] [signal:5249cc20-3496-4459-b163-274771a9d8a4] [signal:d515d2ed-cfdb-44cc-89b2-b097701dcdb2] The Europe report describes digital-key locking again after the boot is closed and the owner walks to the driver’s door. [signal:b6ddd64b-9c6c-4c5f-ba57-33145f993413]

## Open questions
The reports do not establish how often each door-operation issue occurs across vehicles or whether the reported failures share a cause. [signal:42c3fca8-7790-4378-a500-f03f3c522357] [signal:5249cc20-3496-4459-b163-274771a9d8a4] [signal:d515d2ed-cfdb-44cc-89b2-b097701dcdb2] The supplied sample also does not clarify whether digital-key locking and handle-sensor complaints are related. [signal:042eb426-b944-4e43-af88-bc9c5f2241e2] [signal:b6ddd64b-9c6c-4c5f-ba57-33145f993413] [signal:d515d2ed-cfdb-44cc-89b2-b097701dcdb2]

value.title: Child seat installation and buckling are difficult
value.summary: Customers in the USA report difficulty installing or detaching child restraints, reaching buckles and accessing tether points in G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Child restraint setup, buckling and tether access are difficult.
Six USA signals: four for G60 and two for G70.
One customer says the difficulty is common to cars generally, not just BMW.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report difficulty using child restraints, including adjusting rear headrests, reaching seat-belt buckles and accessing tether points. [signal:1d0e453b-ff3f-4bc8-9587-bedbe58b9b74] [signal:39f0c25d-3bbf-415c-be49-7ec6e678a0d3] [signal:e36f553b-5d6d-45ec-a5f1-d4d835421854] [signal:fab45089-dc6b-404c-9e29-1f2ec12f10e6]

## What customers say
A G60 customer says the buckle is hard to reach with a booster seat, and another says they use belt extenders to buckle booster seats. [signal:39f0c25d-3bbf-415c-be49-7ec6e678a0d3] [signal:6b92c07c-8510-4db8-9364-02fac2cac2d9]
A G70 customer reports that rear headrests make child-seat setup difficult; another says reaching the tether requires going through the headrest. [signal:1d0e453b-ff3f-4bc8-9587-bedbe58b9b74] [signal:fab45089-dc6b-404c-9e29-1f2ec12f10e6]
One customer says the issue applies to pretty much all cars, not just BMW. [signal:b71ebc58-5a75-4a8e-babc-28ed6fbb85e3]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA; four concern the G60 and two the G70. [signal:1d0e453b-ff3f-4bc8-9587-bedbe58b9b74] [signal:39f0c25d-3bbf-415c-be49-7ec6e678a0d3] [signal:6b92c07c-8510-4db8-9364-02fac2cac2d9] [signal:b71ebc58-5a75-4a8e-babc-28ed6fbb85e3] [signal:e36f553b-5d6d-45ec-a5f1-d4d835421854] [signal:fab45089-dc6b-404c-9e29-1f2ec12f10e6]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequently each difficulty occurs beyond these reports, or whether the reported access issues affect other vehicle lines or markets. [signal:1d0e453b-ff3f-4bc8-9587-bedbe58b9b74] [signal:39f0c25d-3bbf-415c-be49-7ec6e678a0d3] [signal:6b92c07c-8510-4db8-9364-02fac2cac2d9] [signal:b71ebc58-5a75-4a8e-babc-28ed6fbb85e3] [signal:e36f553b-5d6d-45ec-a5f1-d4d835421854] [signal:fab45089-dc6b-404c-9e29-1f2ec12f10e6]

value.title: Rear visibility blocked or unavailable while driving
value.summary: Some owners report that rear visibility is blocked by screens or want a rear-view camera image to remain on the dash while driving. The signals include USA G70 complaints and a Rest of World G60 comment praising a front camera.
highlights: Owners report blocked rear visibility or want a rear-camera image displayed while driving.
Signals include two USA G70 complaints and one Rest of World G60 comment.
One USA owner compares the desired camera display with a Tesla.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One owner says screens block the rear view completely, creating safety concerns. [signal:cb4be4c4-426e-4c2c-ba96-78a95574ff4c] Another wants a rear-view camera image permanently displayed on the dash while driving, as on their previous Tesla. [signal:83b3e9fc-7a11-4552-856b-3021415b1b65]

## What customers say
The USA G70 signals describe different concerns: one asks for a persistent camera view, while the other says the theater screen and rear window screen block the rear view. [signal:83b3e9fc-7a11-4552-856b-3021415b1b65] [signal:cb4be4c4-426e-4c2c-ba96-78a95574ff4c] A Rest of World G60 owner calls the front virtual reality camera a nice feature; the signal does not comment on rear-camera quality. [signal:cdd96d52-22a2-4aea-ae20-24098d8c8028]

## Differences between markets
Both USA signals are complaints about rear visibility or camera display, and both list G70. [signal:83b3e9fc-7a11-4552-856b-3021415b1b65] [signal:cb4be4c4-426e-4c2c-ba96-78a95574ff4c] The Rest of World signal lists G60 and praises the front camera, but does not discuss the rear view. [signal:cdd96d52-22a2-4aea-ae20-24098d8c8028]

## Open questions
Do the reported rear-view obstruction and the request for a persistent camera display concern the same use case? [signal:83b3e9fc-7a11-4552-856b-3021415b1b65] [signal:cb4be4c4-426e-4c2c-ba96-78a95574ff4c] Does the positive comment about the G60 front camera relate to rear-camera quality? [signal:cdd96d52-22a2-4aea-ae20-24098d8c8028]

value.title: Rear camera visibility and alignment problems
value.summary: Some F70 drivers in Europe report that the rear camera can be obscured by rain or appears off-centre, and one says its view does not match the parking sensors.
highlights: Rain can obscure the camera view; reports also mention an off-centre image and mismatch with sensors.
Camera-related complaints are from three Europe-market F70 signals.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 owners in Europe report rear-camera visibility or alignment problems: rain drops can make the view unusable, the camera appears off-centre, or its view does not match the parking sensors. [signal:378491d0-43c0-4753-935e-44380d81981c] [signal:405a871d-2ffe-4d2a-87ac-9972a298ab8f] [signal:f7fa2142-7e35-4e47-a67a-ab8ee0afa7a5]

## What customers say
One driver says rain drops sometimes make it impossible to see through the rear camera. [signal:378491d0-43c0-4753-935e-44380d81981c]

Another says the camera view and parking sensors do not match up properly, making parking difficult. [signal:405a871d-2ffe-4d2a-87ac-9972a298ab8f]

A third describes the reversing camera as off-centre. [signal:f7fa2142-7e35-4e47-a67a-ab8ee0afa7a5]

## Differences between markets
All three signals specifically mentioning rear-camera problems are from Europe-market F70 owners. [signal:378491d0-43c0-4753-935e-44380d81981c] [signal:405a871d-2ffe-4d2a-87ac-9972a298ab8f] [signal:f7fa2142-7e35-4e47-a67a-ab8ee0afa7a5]

The sample includes other markets and vehicles, but their supplied quotes do not describe a rear-camera reliability problem. [signal:b2fd2cfa-7143-4df4-8380-e192e473cda6] [signal:c22b7742-4ec8-47a4-96fa-660882990248] [signal:d1d4bfce-9e0a-4258-b3ce-817475b0cdce]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often rain obscures the camera, whether the off-centre view is a recurring issue, or what causes the reported mismatch with the sensors. [signal:378491d0-43c0-4753-935e-44380d81981c] [signal:405a871d-2ffe-4d2a-87ac-9972a298ab8f] [signal:f7fa2142-7e35-4e47-a67a-ab8ee0afa7a5]

value.title: Interior lighting is too dim or poorly placed
value.summary: Customers report that interior lighting is too faint or missing in some areas, making it difficult to see at night. Signals come from USA owners of G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Interior lighting is too dim or absent in some areas.
Six USA signals: five for G60 and one for G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report faint interior lighting and areas where lighting is absent or ineffective, making it harder to see in the vehicle at night. [signal:00f62ce0-a3e4-4069-8405-82361b0c5472] [signal:8aaf2c19-2337-4d2c-8075-87aa25504311] [signal:a5100926-2bce-4e77-9370-1f80e7105813] [signal:d33fe4f2-1bff-45b2-8384-811fa59b7a4e] [signal:d92f5ac7-5c70-4ade-971e-d2ed41c34b14] [signal:fbc0ca2b-c34a-4da4-ba87-189136a39765]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA; five concern the G60 and one concerns the G70. [signal:00f62ce0-a3e4-4069-8405-82361b0c5472] [signal:8aaf2c19-2337-4d2c-8075-87aa25504311] [signal:a5100926-2bce-4e77-9370-1f80e7105813] [signal:d33fe4f2-1bff-45b2-8384-811fa59b7a4e] [signal:d92f5ac7-5c70-4ade-971e-d2ed41c34b14] [signal:fbc0ca2b-c34a-4da4-ba87-189136a39765]

## Open questions

[signal:00f62ce0-a3e4-4069-8405-82361b0c5472] [signal:8aaf2c19-2337-4d2c-8075-87aa25504311] [signal:a5100926-2bce-4e77-9370-1f80e7105813] [signal:d33fe4f2-1bff-45b2-8384-811fa59b7a4e] [signal:d92f5ac7-5c70-4ade-971e-d2ed41c34b14] [signal:fbc0ca2b-c34a-4da4-ba87-189136a39765]

value.title: 12 V socket position makes charging awkward in the G60
value.summary: G60 customers in the USA find the 12 V socket difficult to use because of its position: charging can prevent the console lid from closing, require a longer cable, or leave a cord crossing the console.
highlights: The socket’s position makes charging awkward and can obstruct the console lid.
All three signals are from USA customers with G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
G60 customers report that the 12 V socket is awkwardly positioned: a connected device can prevent the center-console lid from closing, and some devices need longer cables or have cords that cross the console. [signal:1b9162c7-9201-4210-8098-646fb95be4f8] [signal:95fd4370-d79b-49c2-adda-f5580c8bc9d9] [signal:e83d569b-0687-49f5-bd7d-d9546d0906d8]

## What customers say
One customer cannot close the center-console lid while a device is charging. [signal:1b9162c7-9201-4210-8098-646fb95be4f8] Another says the socket is out of the way and requires a longer-than-usual cable. [signal:95fd4370-d79b-49c2-adda-f5580c8bc9d9] A customer using a radar detector says its power cord drags across the center console and notes the absence of a socket where the cigarette lighter traditionally was. [signal:e83d569b-0687-49f5-bd7d-d9546d0906d8]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA and concern the G60; no other markets or vehicle lines are represented. [signal:1b9162c7-9201-4210-8098-646fb95be4f8] [signal:95fd4370-d79b-49c2-adda-f5580c8bc9d9] [signal:e83d569b-0687-49f5-bd7d-d9546d0906d8]

## Open questions
Do these socket-position concerns occur in markets or vehicle lines not represented in these signals? [signal:1b9162c7-9201-4210-8098-646fb95be4f8] [signal:95fd4370-d79b-49c2-adda-f5580c8bc9d9] [signal:e83d569b-0687-49f5-bd7d-d9546d0906d8]

value.title: Active cruise reacts too slowly to cars entering the lane
value.summary: A US G60 driver says the Level 2 driving system reacts too slowly when another car moves into or out of the lane ahead.
highlights: The system may maintain speed too long when a slower car merges ahead.
One complaint from a USA G60 driver.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A driver reports that the car reacts too slowly when another vehicle moves into or out of the lane ahead. [signal:57ccf60d-3932-4897-a3f7-dc2c86adaf15] In one example, the BMW 550e continued at a higher speed as a slower car merged into the lane. [signal:57ccf60d-3932-4897-a3f7-dc2c86adaf15]

## What customers say
The driver says Level 2 driving mostly works very well, but identifies the delayed response to lane changes as an issue. [signal:57ccf60d-3932-4897-a3f7-dc2c86adaf15]

## Differences between markets
The signal is from one USA G60 driver; no other markets are represented. [signal:57ccf60d-3932-4897-a3f7-dc2c86adaf15]

## Open questions
The signal ends mid-sentence while describing what happened after the merging car slowed, so the outcome is unclear. [signal:57ccf60d-3932-4897-a3f7-dc2c86adaf15]

value.title: Child safety lock location and status are hard to understand
value.summary: Some USA G70 and G60 customers have difficulty finding, understanding, or changing the child safety lock; one report also describes a rear lock that stayed engaged. The signals include confusion about the control and one reported operating issue.
highlights: Customers report difficulty locating, understanding, and switching the child safety lock.
Reports are from USA customers with G70 and G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report difficulty finding the child safety lock control and understanding whether it is engaged or how to switch it off. [signal:3fec96ab-5d98-4ff8-81b2-5ebe9af29e63] [signal:8d31da23-0aa9-400e-a9c6-d3e3d672fbb8] [signal:97977e0b-1bdc-48c0-b185-2f17fb687d65] [signal:9ff2d781-ac63-4856-b065-1f54e494b8a5]
One G60 report says the passenger-side rear lock remained engaged despite attempts to switch it off, while the other rear door operated correctly. [signal:dd716216-623c-4c5c-bbc5-9287c0a41fae]

## What customers say
A G70 customer said the lock button was next to the window-open button and that they needed a dealer visit to learn how to switch the lock off. [signal:3fec96ab-5d98-4ff8-81b2-5ebe9af29e63]
Another G70 customer did not initially realize the child lock was engaged and said rear passengers could not open their own door. [signal:8d31da23-0aa9-400e-a9c6-d3e3d672fbb8]
Other G70 reports describe not knowing why the rear doors stayed locked and difficulty locating the control, including difficulty finding it even at the dealership. [signal:97977e0b-1bdc-48c0-b185-2f17fb687d65] [signal:9ff2d781-ac63-4856-b065-1f54e494b8a5]
A G60 customer said it was hard to work out which lock configuration suited them. [signal:a4622ec2-3ab6-41c9-b95a-b8e7e464e7b7]

## Differences between markets
All six provided signals are from the USA, so they do not show how the issue differs between markets. [signal:3fec96ab-5d98-4ff8-81b2-5ebe9af29e63] [signal:8d31da23-0aa9-400e-a9c6-d3e3d672fbb8] [signal:97977e0b-1bdc-48c0-b185-2f17fb687d65] [signal:9ff2d781-ac63-4856-b065-1f54e494b8a5] [signal:a4622ec2-3ab6-41c9-b95a-b8e7e464e7b7] [signal:dd716216-623c-4c5c-bbc5-9287c0a41fae]

## Open questions
Is the reported passenger-side rear lock that stayed engaged an isolated operating issue, or does it occur in other cases? [signal:dd716216-623c-4c5c-bbc5-9287c0a41fae]
How often do customers have difficulty locating the control or understanding its status across the G70 and G60? [signal:3fec96ab-5d98-4ff8-81b2-5ebe9af29e63] [signal:9ff2d781-ac63-4856-b065-1f54e494b8a5] [signal:a4622ec2-3ab6-41c9-b95a-b8e7e464e7b7]

value.title: Parking camera guidance is unclear or incomplete
value.summary: Drivers report unclear parking alerts, limited distance or side-traffic visibility, and occasional camera activation issues. The supplied signals include reports from USA G60 and G70 drivers and a Europe F70 driver.
highlights: Camera and parking guidance can be unclear, incomplete, or fail to appear when needed.
Supplied signals mention USA G60 and G70 vehicles and a Europe F70 vehicle.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers say parking-camera information can be difficult to interpret or insufficient for judging nearby obstacles and traffic. One driver also reports that the camera does not always appear when pulling into a garage. [signal:3cb404f8-1004-4292-aced-5081a595dc03] [signal:4e94f26b-e145-40eb-9631-1ce209d5c410] [signal:53fee151-8a97-43e8-b237-045279adbf70] [signal:90e8769f-d25d-4133-8ac9-e0f8442d7f92]

## What customers say
A G60 driver says multiple lights and beeps are hard to interpret, while another says parking assistance is less clear than on their previous model and lacks parking-radius lines when reversing. [signal:3cb404f8-1004-4292-aced-5081a595dc03] [signal:4a34ffab-f7ae-4015-bd18-3796dcb0b8d6]

Drivers describe difficulty judging curb distance and front clearance; one also says screen reflections make the image hard to see in sunlight. [signal:4e94f26b-e145-40eb-9631-1ce209d5c410] [signal:886f4cd2-e0a7-4626-abdb-6417496ac719]

A G70 driver says the rear camera shows only directly behind the car and would benefit from a wider view to see traffic approaching from the sides. [signal:90e8769f-d25d-4133-8ac9-e0f8442d7f92]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA signals describe specific parking-camera or parking-assistance difficulties in G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:3cb404f8-1004-4292-aced-5081a595dc03] [signal:4a34ffab-f7ae-4015-bd18-3796dcb0b8d6] [signal:4e94f26b-e145-40eb-9631-1ce209d5c410] [signal:53fee151-8a97-43e8-b237-045279adbf70] [signal:886f4cd2-e0a7-4626-abdb-6417496ac719] [signal:90e8769f-d25d-4133-8ac9-e0f8442d7f92]

The supplied Europe signal describes more limited rear visibility than in the driver's previous 3 Series and growing reliance on the camera while reversing. [signal:a31cc53c-29b4-4f7e-a938-1dd8bc065896]

## Open questions
The supplied signals do not establish how often the camera fails to appear or whether this occurs in conditions other than pulling into a garage. [signal:53fee151-8a97-43e8-b237-045279adbf70]

The supplied signals do not clarify how widespread the visibility, guidance, or screen-reflection concerns are across markets and vehicles. [signal:4a34ffab-f7ae-4015-bd18-3796dcb0b8d6] [signal:90e8769f-d25d-4133-8ac9-e0f8442d7f92] [signal:886f4cd2-e0a7-4626-abdb-6417496ac719]

value.title: 12 V outlets missing or inconveniently located
value.summary: USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles want more 12 V outlets or outlets in more convenient locations. Some say existing outlet locations make it difficult to connect devices such as radar detectors.
highlights: Customers want additional or better-positioned 12 V outlets.
Signals are from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers request 12 V outlets in the rear seating area and trunk, as well as additional cigarette-lighter-style connections [signal:12adf6f0-1586-4ff7-9e6d-83443941afb2] [signal:34d955b0-b626-4069-a4ad-cf27a4a2b073]. Some customers say the available outlet is inconveniently located for connecting a radar detector, requiring a long cord across or toward the front of the car [signal:ba16908c-d273-4529-a06d-c14f285a83c3] [signal:df9ebf65-c51c-45ce-86fa-607695ca261c].

## What customers say
A G60 customer wanted outlets in the trunk and for rear-seat passengers [signal:12adf6f0-1586-4ff7-9e6d-83443941afb2]. Another G60 customer missed having a cigarette-lighter port to connect an adapter and USB charger [signal:1491191a-9cf6-4fe8-9057-3bd110266aca]. A G70 customer said they were used to having several cigarette-lighter sockets and questioned their removal [signal:34d955b0-b626-4069-a4ad-cf27a4a2b073]. G70 customers also requested a front outlet for a radar detector, noting the cord needed to reach the existing outlet [signal:ba16908c-d273-4529-a06d-c14f285a83c3] [signal:c79b351b-82dd-463a-a0a3-351d1627d233] [signal:df9ebf65-c51c-45ce-86fa-607695ca261c].

## Differences between markets
All provided signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets [signal:12adf6f0-1586-4ff7-9e6d-83443941afb2] [signal:1491191a-9cf6-4fe8-9057-3bd110266aca] [signal:34d955b0-b626-4069-a4ad-cf27a4a2b073] [signal:ba16908c-d273-4529-a06d-c14f285a83c3] [signal:c79b351b-82dd-463a-a0a3-351d1627d233] [signal:df9ebf65-c51c-45ce-86fa-607695ca261c].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how many outlets customers expect, or which locations would meet their needs across the G60 and G70 [signal:12adf6f0-1586-4ff7-9e6d-83443941afb2] [signal:34d955b0-b626-4069-a4ad-cf27a4a2b073] [signal:ba16908c-d273-4529-a06d-c14f285a83c3].

value.title: Rear camera usability and visibility concerns vary
value.summary: Customers report issues with rear-camera positioning, visibility and control, while others value its clear parking view. Concerns appear across several markets and vehicle lines.
highlights: Concerns include an off-centre view, obstructed rear visibility, and camera usability or control.
Signals span Europe, the USA and Rest of World, and F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
A Rest of World customer compares surround-camera usability with Toyota and Lexus.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe different rear-camera concerns: one reports an off-centre reversing-camera view [signal:9d783696-9d5d-42f2-a5b2-b205742ca462], while others say screens obstruct the rear view or mirror [signal:621abdef-5d98-4db9-80ea-9b810ecd7b49] [signal:835221e1-f000-48f9-ba42-d987ed3eae86]. A USA customer says the rear-view camera keeps him from relying on his mirrors when reversing [signal:9e7f66b9-89fd-4700-8769-f477498efa31].

## What customers say
A Europe F70 owner says the camera clearly shows objects while parking and calls it brilliant [signal:0b24a282-180f-445a-b547-a111808e1afd]. Another Europe F70 owner describes the camera system as excellent [signal:613c7572-13dc-4c98-a603-50954f05e12f]. In contrast, a Rest of World F70 customer says the surround camera is not as straightforward to use as Toyota or Lexus systems [signal:795abe45-b0f9-47e0-ad09-993ea9692fa7].

Requests and concerns also include a rear-view camera in the mirror when a screen blocks the mirror [signal:835221e1-f000-48f9-ba42-d987ed3eae86], the ability to turn the camera off permanently [signal:9e7f66b9-89fd-4700-8769-f477498efa31], and a camera because a lowered screen limits the rear view [signal:a2c9416c-d8ef-4d72-a0fb-45219f62d97f]. A separate USA G60 comment concerns recording while driving and says recording lasts about 30 seconds [signal:5487b1d0-2528-49f3-9301-d695f648e1c4].

## Differences between markets
In the Europe signals, customers include both praise for clear parking visibility and a complaint about an off-centre view [signal:0b24a282-180f-445a-b547-a111808e1afd] [signal:9d783696-9d5d-42f2-a5b2-b205742ca462]. USA signals include concerns about screens blocking the rear view or mirror, and a request to turn the camera off [signal:621abdef-5d98-4db9-80ea-9b810ecd7b49] [signal:835221e1-f000-48f9-ba42-d987ed3eae86] [signal:9e7f66b9-89fd-4700-8769-f477498efa31]. A Rest of World customer compares surround-camera usability with Toyota and Lexus [signal:795abe45-b0f9-47e0-ad09-993ea9692fa7].

## Open questions
Do the reports of obstructed rear visibility concern the rear-view camera itself or screens that block the mirror or rear window? [signal:621abdef-5d98-4db9-80ea-9b810ecd7b49] [signal:835221e1-f000-48f9-ba42-d987ed3eae86] What conditions lead to the off-centre camera view? [signal:9d783696-9d5d-42f2-a5b2-b205742ca462] What aspects of Toyota and Lexus surround-camera operation feel more straightforward to the customer? [signal:795abe45-b0f9-47e0-ad09-993ea9692fa7]

value.title: Missing seat belt hug and M stitching option
value.summary: In the USA, customers report missing the brief seat belt snugging effect in a G70 and wanting M stitching as an option in a G60. Another G60 customer appreciates the belt tightening while driving.
highlights: One customer misses the entry-time seat belt hug; another wants M stitching as an option.
Three USA signals: two from G60 customers and one from a G70 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One G70 customer misses the brief seat belt snugging effect they experienced in a prior BMW [signal:edef7f61-aefa-47e3-b707-b8ceae802645]. One G60 customer wished M stitching had been available as a seat belt option [signal:789dff1a-1940-442d-8622-401e1d912095].

## What customers say
The G70 customer says the belt used to pull snug briefly upon getting into their prior BMW, but no longer does so in this car [signal:edef7f61-aefa-47e3-b707-b8ceae802645]. A G60 customer appreciates the way the seat belt tightens while driving [signal:8d97d917-b2e5-4270-8328-40f968faf8c2]. Another G60 customer says they would have chosen a seat belt with M stitching if that option had been available [signal:789dff1a-1940-442d-8622-401e1d912095].

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA: two concern the G60 and one concerns the G70 [signal:789dff1a-1940-442d-8622-401e1d912095] [signal:edef7f61-aefa-47e3-b707-b8ceae802645] [signal:8d97d917-b2e5-4270-8328-40f968faf8c2]. The signals include both a customer who misses the entry-time snugging effect and one who appreciates tightening while driving [signal:edef7f61-aefa-47e3-b707-b8ceae802645] [signal:8d97d917-b2e5-4270-8328-40f968faf8c2].

## Open questions
The signals do not indicate how common these preferences are beyond the three customers represented [signal:789dff1a-1940-442d-8622-401e1d912095] [signal:edef7f61-aefa-47e3-b707-b8ceae802645] [signal:8d97d917-b2e5-4270-8328-40f968faf8c2].

value.title: Cruise control failures and inconsistent operation
value.summary: Customers report cruise control faults, intermittent loss of function, and unreliable automatic braking. The signals cover F70, G60, and G70 vehicles in Europe, the USA, and Rest of World.
highlights: Cruise control faults, intermittent failures, and untrusted automatic braking
Reports cover F70, G60, and G70 vehicles across Europe, the USA, and Rest of World
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe cruise control faults and failures, including systems that stop working or operate inconsistently. [signal:26ceceb2-9f1a-4168-8fd0-db18e94f20a6] [signal:9c1b79d2-31af-4828-90b9-ba46ede673a5] [signal:a12417d7-a1a5-4a7c-bc02-50ba2811dd5d] One USA customer says automatic braking in auto cruise is not trustworthy when approaching slower or stopped traffic. [signal:ac5aebe5-89f6-44fc-bb1e-57318c2a7115]

## What customers say
An F70 owner in Europe says the car arrived with a cruise control fault that remained unresolved after four months. [signal:26ceceb2-9f1a-4168-8fd0-db18e94f20a6] Other European F70 owners report a cruise control system failure, or cruise control stopping for weeks before returning and failing again. [signal:9c1b79d2-31af-4828-90b9-ba46ede673a5] [signal:a12417d7-a1a5-4a7c-bc02-50ba2811dd5d] A USA G60 owner says cruise control has been working inconsistently. [signal:1e8aec3e-d5e8-4099-bf77-3360af9b007a] A Rest of World F70 owner says auto-cruise stopped functioning while driving. [signal:e0835141-627b-41e2-9577-a28c04730fec] A USA G70 owner questions whether automatic braking in auto cruise can be trusted around slower or stopped traffic. [signal:ac5aebe5-89f6-44fc-bb1e-57318c2a7115]

## Differences between markets
European reports concern faults or recurring loss of cruise control on F70 vehicles. [signal:26ceceb2-9f1a-4168-8fd0-db18e94f20a6] [signal:9c1b79d2-31af-4828-90b9-ba46ede673a5] [signal:a12417d7-a1a5-4a7c-bc02-50ba2811dd5d] In the USA, reports mention inconsistent cruise control on a G60 and untrusted auto-cruise braking on a G70. [signal:1e8aec3e-d5e8-4099-bf77-3360af9b007a] [signal:ac5aebe5-89f6-44fc-bb1e-57318c2a7115] The Rest of World report describes auto-cruise stopping while the vehicle was moving, on an F70. [signal:e0835141-627b-41e2-9577-a28c04730fec]

## Open questions
Do the reported faults and loss of function share a cause? Do customers experience the same reliability issue across markets and vehicle lines? The signals do not establish this.

value.title: Active cruise availability and controls disappoint some drivers
value.summary: Some drivers say active cruise control is missing or not standard, or that its controls are awkward to use. Other drivers praise how well it works, with concerns and positive feedback represented across multiple markets and vehicle lines.
highlights: Drivers report missing active cruise, awkward controls, or a preference for basic cruise without active functions.
Concerns appear in USA G60/G70 and Europe F70 signals; positive feedback also appears in Europe and Rest of World F70 signals.
Comparisons mention Toyota, Lexus, and a cheaper vehicle; some drivers prefer those vehicles’ cruise or controls.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say active cruise control was not included on their vehicle or should have been standard, while others find its controls awkward or difficult to access. [signal:e31939bd-6b53-4f70-bbbb-9ce9de086076] [signal:0ce305f0-e934-4186-b9d8-0e2b53168a53] [signal:5a10e915-26b4-4036-aeed-028b761cf04b] [signal:fd16d0ef-4a7c-4ce4-867a-1f67d37574c8]
One driver would like basic cruise control to operate independently of active cruise. [signal:ae8e5da8-645c-4ea1-b46b-eaf514f1fdb6]

## What customers say
A G60 driver says following distance is difficult to adjust through menus and prefers a steering-wheel control; a G70 driver misses a physical distance button. [signal:06da85bf-2477-49c0-9522-1207b748ff5d] [signal:79abade2-c9ca-4ba3-98ed-8839b9f5869d]
An F70 driver describes the cruise buttons as small and awkward. [signal:fd16d0ef-4a7c-4ce4-867a-1f67d37574c8]
Feedback is not uniformly negative: F70 drivers in Europe and Rest of World say the traffic-slowing function or adaptive cruise works well or excellently. [signal:50f7c527-2350-4d52-874f-a4823972df63] [signal:8a5f650a-1665-4e7b-9a3c-9fc1d3f3fe09] [signal:9ac95f5f-6d7b-4f93-9711-8cc622acf441]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA signals include G60 feedback about missing active cruise, following-distance controls, and preference for another vehicle’s cruise control, alongside a G60 request for basic cruise; they also include G70 feedback about missing equipment and the distance-adjustment control. [signal:e31939bd-6b53-4f70-bbbb-9ce9de086076] [signal:06da85bf-2477-49c0-9522-1207b748ff5d] [signal:a1452af2-30a7-417e-ac06-c1eeb3c1bddb] [signal:ae8e5da8-645c-4ea1-b46b-eaf514f1fdb6] [signal:5a10e915-26b4-4036-aeed-028b761cf04b] [signal:79abade2-c9ca-4ba3-98ed-8839b9f5869d]
The supplied Europe F70 signals include a request for adaptive cruise as standard and a complaint about button ergonomics, as well as positive comments about traffic slowing and cruise performance. [signal:0ce305f0-e934-4186-b9d8-0e2b53168a53] [signal:fd16d0ef-4a7c-4ce4-867a-1f67d37574c8] [signal:50f7c527-2350-4d52-874f-a4823972df63]
The supplied Rest of World F70 signals praise adaptive cruise control. [signal:8a5f650a-1665-4e7b-9a3c-9fc1d3f3fe09] [signal:9ac95f5f-6d7b-4f93-9711-8cc622acf441]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often active cruise is unavailable across the full set of 27 signals, or whether availability and control concerns differ by vehicle configuration. [signal:e31939bd-6b53-4f70-bbbb-9ce9de086076] [signal:0ce305f0-e934-4186-b9d8-0e2b53168a53] [signal:5a10e915-26b4-4036-aeed-028b761cf04b]
The signals do not clarify whether the positive assessments refer to the same functions or conditions as the reported control and availability concerns. [signal:06da85bf-2477-49c0-9522-1207b748ff5d] [signal:50f7c527-2350-4d52-874f-a4823972df63] [signal:8a5f650a-1665-4e7b-9a3c-9fc1d3f3fe09]

value.title: Cruise control is difficult to operate and understand
value.summary: Customers report that cruise control controls and settings can be fiddly, confusing, or hard to confirm while driving. Signals cover drivers in Europe and the USA across F70, G60, and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Cruise controls and settings can be awkward to find, change, or confirm.
Signals cover Europe and the USA, and F70, G60, and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe cruise control as more complicated or fiddly than expected, with some unsure how to activate it or change its settings. [signal:07988899-1cb7-433c-a62a-e3f392c5447a] [signal:287eb23a-fbf7-4e92-afc0-b361a410d424] [signal:6fba79f6-545e-4f44-9142-4cf56c063f2d]

Changing the following distance while driving is described as awkward, and one customer says they have not worked out how to change it. [signal:00089617-b3dc-4a96-a341-e12569d2076d] [signal:25c48a55-b8be-4fd7-8e61-5fab9d87bc24]

One customer reports cruise control operating briefly before switching off, then working again after a vehicle restart and reboot. [signal:20c806cd-e42b-4a7a-892e-0c8549929042]

## What customers say
A USA customer says pressing the wrong button after braking can restore the previous set speed, which they find confusing. [signal:07988899-1cb7-433c-a62a-e3f392c5447a]

A Europe customer says they need to look at the screen to confirm cruise control is on; another says multiple button presses to access cruise control do not feel intuitive. [signal:6fba79f6-545e-4f44-9142-4cf56c063f2d] [signal:3de2b27f-36f2-43ba-af3c-5ee0d7ef3fe0]

Experiences are not uniformly negative: one Europe customer says adaptive cruise works fine, while finding the distance adjustment awkward. [signal:00089617-b3dc-4a96-a341-e12569d2076d]

## Differences between markets
Usability concerns appear in signals from both Europe and the USA. [signal:00089617-b3dc-4a96-a341-e12569d2076d] [signal:07988899-1cb7-433c-a62a-e3f392c5447a]

The supplied signals include F70 reports from Europe and G60 reports from both Europe and the USA, as well as a G70 report from the USA. [signal:3de2b27f-36f2-43ba-af3c-5ee0d7ef3fe0] [signal:00089617-b3dc-4a96-a341-e12569d2076d] [signal:07988899-1cb7-433c-a62a-e3f392c5447a] [signal:18d769ec-dcfd-4d24-94f7-c43785cdcbc0]

## Open questions

value.title: Run-flat tires missing or not offered as an option

highlights: Customers report missing or unavailable run-flat tires, or want them included as standard.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say run-flat tires are missing from their vehicle or unavailable as an option, while one Europe-based customer says they paid extra for them and believes they should be standard. [signal:09bafe3f-2351-4a87-9cce-d2b59b7cf7d6] [signal:4e486efd-1864-4bac-a069-8882263dd01c] [signal:877da1ff-c885-4125-8923-ae40224dcaed]

## What customers say
Customers value the reassurance of run-flat tires and the ability to continue driving after a puncture. [signal:6f9213ac-8b14-4ed4-a29e-5b9ed7f32f15] [signal:99a7817a-8466-4c58-9424-9c5fd9f0242c]

One G70 customer reports two flat tires and asks for a run-flat choice; another says they relied on run-flats previously and wants them again. [signal:60a34136-43a6-46d4-84e5-ef5574e4b290] [signal:1e340ef5-766f-4d52-a91a-6086ba22688e]

A G60 customer who cannot change a tire themself prefers being able to keep driving rather than call for roadside assistance. [signal:4e486efd-1864-4bac-a069-8882263dd01c]

## Differences between markets
USA signals describe missing run-flats or a desire for them as an option on G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:09bafe3f-2351-4a87-9cce-d2b59b7cf7d6] [signal:4e486efd-1864-4bac-a069-8882263dd01c] [signal:60a34136-43a6-46d4-84e5-ef5574e4b290] [signal:6f9213ac-8b14-4ed4-a29e-5b9ed7f32f15] [signal:99a7817a-8466-4c58-9424-9c5fd9f0242c]

Europe signals include an F70 customer questioning their removal and another who paid extra for run-flat tires and thinks they should be standard. [signal:68f3b7df-000f-44e5-8ee8-fa4ad4c9b11f] [signal:877da1ff-c885-4125-8923-ae40224dcaed]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the concern is across markets or vehicle lines. [signal:09bafe3f-2351-4a87-9cce-d2b59b7cf7d6] [signal:68f3b7df-000f-44e5-8ee8-fa4ad4c9b11f]

One G60 customer was told run-flats were unavailable because of sustainability considerations and limited product availability; the signals do not establish whether these constraints apply across the vehicles mentioned. [signal:4e486efd-1864-4bac-a069-8882263dd01c]

## Problem
Customers report concern about vehicles without run-flat tires or a spare, and one owner says they have not figured out how to use the tire inflator. [signal:2c6b7c38-2e23-4bdd-b2dc-f6aee88ff957] [signal:79d7e08f-592e-49d9-8b33-b382697c70d7]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says their vehicle has neither a spare nor run-flat tires. [signal:2c6b7c38-2e23-4bdd-b2dc-f6aee88ff957]

A G70 owner says they only discovered there was no spare after buying the car without run-flat tires. [signal:789b5adb-9ae0-4832-bed6-5e0703518146]

A Europe-based F70 owner questions why run-flat tyres were dropped, while another calls dropping the proper spare-wheel option a bad decision. [signal:d93cec1c-fd79-4ae2-bb02-37ba30f78859] [signal:f8f891e1-541e-40b2-a932-00d5980f3bc8]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include G60 and G70 owners reporting concerns about missing run-flat tires or a spare, including one account of a flat and tow. [signal:2c6b7c38-2e23-4bdd-b2dc-f6aee88ff957] [signal:499359d7-fa7d-40ce-9005-1e108fb69a82] [signal:789b5adb-9ae0-4832-bed6-5e0703518146] [signal:79d7e08f-592e-49d9-8b33-b382697c70d7]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how many affected vehicles lack both run-flat tires and a spare, or how consistently owners understand the tire inflator. [signal:2c6b7c38-2e23-4bdd-b2dc-f6aee88ff957] [signal:79d7e08f-592e-49d9-8b33-b382697c70d7]

value.title: Seat belt height and latching are difficult for some customers
value.summary: Some USA customers report that belts cut into the neck or are difficult to latch, and one customer wants a pre-tensioner. These concerns appear in G60 and G70 feedback.

USA feedback names the G60 and G70; one customer says his short wife is affected.
An Audi A6 owner says its belts pre-tension; no other competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say the seat belt cuts into the neck and ask for height adjustment [signal:8a974e7c-eb72-45c5-b817-910faec12344] [signal:899e37e0-3190-4ee1-8faf-4458a5c4dc2b]. One G60 customer says latching the belt into the receiver is difficult and bought an extension [signal:fb5dd338-cb6d-43bf-8ada-de30f77890fd]. Another G60 customer wants a pre-tensioner [signal:9e486e5e-89d6-4178-99cc-56ee6c146276].

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the belt cuts into their neck and asks to bring back height adjustment [signal:8a974e7c-eb72-45c5-b817-910faec12344]. A G70 customer says the belt digs into his short wife's neck despite seat adjustment and a belt cover, and asks for adjustable belt height [signal:899e37e0-3190-4ee1-8faf-4458a5c4dc2b]. A G60 customer reports difficulty latching the belt and says they bought an extension [signal:fb5dd338-cb6d-43bf-8ada-de30f77890fd]. A G60 customer says their Audi A6 belts pre-tension and wants that function [signal:9e486e5e-89d6-4178-99cc-56ee6c146276].

## Differences between markets
The seat-belt height and latching concerns shown here are from USA feedback on G60 and G70 vehicles [signal:8a974e7c-eb72-45c5-b817-910faec12344] [signal:fb5dd338-cb6d-43bf-8ada-de30f77890fd] [signal:899e37e0-3190-4ee1-8faf-4458a5c4dc2b]. The Rest of World signal mentions a seat-belt warning sign in a complaint about auto-lock behavior, rather than belt fit or latching [signal:e452e4ec-6809-446d-8300-0f7815eb1349].

## Open questions
Do height-adjustment and latching concerns occur beyond the USA G60 and G70 examples shown here? [signal:8a974e7c-eb72-45c5-b817-910faec12344] [signal:fb5dd338-cb6d-43bf-8ada-de30f77890fd] [signal:899e37e0-3190-4ee1-8faf-4458a5c4dc2b] How broadly is the pre-tensioner preference shared? [signal:9e486e5e-89d6-4178-99cc-56ee6c146276]

value.title: Tire options and perceived quality vary across markets
value.summary: Customers report limited all-season tire availability, dissatisfaction with basic or budget tires, and a preference for smaller wheels in one parking-related case. The signals come from G70 and G60 owners in the USA and F70 owners in Europe and the Rest of World.
highlights: Concerns include all-season tire availability, perceived tire quality, and wheel size.
USA: G70 and G60; Europe and Rest of World: F70 tire-quality complaints.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say the available tire setup does not suit their needs: a G70 owner could not find all-season tires for 21-inch wheels, and a G60 owner says the car could only be ordered with summer tires [signal:2a8fd1c1-9be1-46a8-ab75-25b0aaa4ae8e] [signal:2c1b0d54-68d7-4122-9149-28253e4fe1c0]. F70 owners describe the tires as poor, basic, or budget, with one reporting vibration on certain road surfaces [signal:6d64e1ee-27a0-40f1-9173-3163754e948d] [signal:81b4013d-e319-43c8-8521-5feb8855bdd5] [signal:a2eabe4c-c366-401b-b1bf-57cf9c402396]. A G60 owner prefers 19-inch rather than 20-inch wheels, citing parking and camera visibility [signal:2c136c75-9ee7-4ea2-af47-2b9035059038].

## What customers say
A G70 owner asks for an all-season tire package or better dealer availability [signal:12cfe958-d411-402a-be33-5459c3ea7654]. Another says they could not find all-season tires that fit the 21-inch wheels [signal:2a8fd1c1-9be1-46a8-ab75-25b0aaa4ae8e]. A G60 owner says they wanted all-season tires that handle water better, but could only configure the car with summer tires [signal:2c1b0d54-68d7-4122-9149-28253e4fe1c0]. F70 owners criticize tire quality; one says the tires are made in China, while another links basic tires to vibration on some road surfaces [signal:6d64e1ee-27a0-40f1-9173-3163754e948d] [signal:81b4013d-e319-43c8-8521-5feb8855bdd5]. One F70 owner says the car arrived on budget tires and was disappointed that a change to premium tires was refused [signal:a2eabe4c-c366-401b-b1bf-57cf9c402396].

## Differences between markets
In the USA signals, G70 owners raise all-season tire availability for 21-inch wheels, and a G60 owner raises the summer-only configuration [signal:2a8fd1c1-9be1-46a8-ab75-25b0aaa4ae8e] [signal:2c1b0d54-68d7-4122-9149-28253e4fe1c0]. A separate USA G60 signal expresses a preference for 19-inch wheels over 20-inch wheels for parking and camera visibility [signal:2c136c75-9ee7-4ea2-af47-2b9035059038]. In Europe, F70 owners describe the tires as basic or budget, with one reporting vibration [signal:81b4013d-e319-43c8-8521-5feb8855bdd5] [signal:a2eabe4c-c366-401b-b1bf-57cf9c402396]. The Rest of World F70 signal calls the tires poor [signal:6d64e1ee-27a0-40f1-9173-3163754e948d].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these concerns are beyond the examples provided [signal:12cfe958-d411-402a-be33-5459c3ea7654] [signal:2a8fd1c1-9be1-46a8-ab75-25b0aaa4ae8e] [signal:2c1b0d54-68d7-4122-9149-28253e4fe1c0] [signal:2c136c75-9ee7-4ea2-af47-2b9035059038] [signal:6d64e1ee-27a0-40f1-9173-3163754e948d] [signal:81b4013d-e319-43c8-8521-5feb8855bdd5] [signal:a2eabe4c-c366-401b-b1bf-57cf9c402396]. They do not clarify which specific tire models or wheel configurations are associated with the F70 quality complaints [signal:6d64e1ee-27a0-40f1-9173-3163754e948d] [signal:81b4013d-e319-43c8-8521-5feb8855bdd5] [signal:a2eabe4c-c366-401b-b1bf-57cf9c402396].

## Problem
Customers report seat belt or restraint warnings, belts not functioning correctly, and a driver restraint system repair. [signal:1455e121-6060-4338-a2e7-a425ae5ac206] [signal:17d2a4ed-570f-4c89-b976-7c3bc7d501b6] [signal:a3793a0d-195f-4eea-832a-0ad1c776699f] [signal:b3455436-739a-47c5-9550-356abda6d8b9] [signal:c8a01813-a7f8-41bb-b9d4-8be710e52caa] [signal:fc72253a-c255-47f5-9022-94bde81b40a9] One driver said the restraint malfunction made them feel unsafe driving. [signal:fc72253a-c255-47f5-9022-94bde81b40a9]

## What customers say
A G60 owner reported a seat belt warning despite the belt operating normally, and was awaiting the dealer's diagnosis. [signal:17d2a4ed-570f-4c89-b976-7c3bc7d501b6] F70 owners described a warning while driving, belts not functioning, and a rear-seat-belt recall that required a dealer visit. [signal:1455e121-6060-4338-a2e7-a425ae5ac206] [signal:b3455436-739a-47c5-9550-356abda6d8b9] [signal:bfee591f-4f07-48d6-986d-7df7d8917318] G70 owners reported a rear belt malfunction and a restraint warning that returned about a week after it disappeared. [signal:a3793a0d-195f-4eea-832a-0ad1c776699f] [signal:c8a01813-a7f8-41bb-b9d4-8be710e52caa] A G60 owner also reported a driver restraint repair; the service description cites a temporarily malfunctioning seat module/control unit and incomplete driver-seat calibration. [signal:fc72253a-c255-47f5-9022-94bde81b40a9] One G60 owner said the lack of seat-belt height adjustment caused the belt to cut into their neck. [signal:65d76a89-bb07-42b2-b211-8411545c2d81]

## Differences between markets
Signals describe concerns in both Europe and the USA: the Europe reports are from F70 owners, while the USA reports are from G60 and G70 owners. [signal:1455e121-6060-4338-a2e7-a425ae5ac206] [signal:b3455436-739a-47c5-9550-356abda6d8b9] [signal:bfee591f-4f07-48d6-986d-7df7d8917318] [signal:17d2a4ed-570f-4c89-b976-7c3bc7d501b6] [signal:65d76a89-bb07-42b2-b211-8411545c2d81] [signal:a3793a0d-195f-4eea-832a-0ad1c776699f] [signal:c8a01813-a7f8-41bb-b9d4-8be710e52caa] [signal:fc72253a-c255-47f5-9022-94bde81b40a9] The reports include warning messages, reported belt-function problems, and a recalled rear belt, but do not establish whether prevalence or causes differ by market. [signal:1455e121-6060-4338-a2e7-a425ae5ac206] [signal:17d2a4ed-570f-4c89-b976-7c3bc7d501b6] [signal:a3793a0d-195f-4eea-832a-0ad1c776699f] [signal:b3455436-739a-47c5-9550-356abda6d8b9] [signal:bfee591f-4f07-48d6-986d-7df7d8917318] [signal:c8a01813-a7f8-41bb-b9d4-8be710e52caa] [signal:fc72253a-c255-47f5-9022-94bde81b40a9]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the overall frequency of these problems or whether the reported warning and belt-function issues share a cause. [signal:1455e121-6060-4338-a2e7-a425ae5ac206] [signal:17d2a4ed-570f-4c89-b976-7c3bc7d501b6] [signal:a3793a0d-195f-4eea-832a-0ad1c776699f] [signal:b3455436-739a-47c5-9550-356abda6d8b9] [signal:c8a01813-a7f8-41bb-b9d4-8be710e52caa] [signal:fc72253a-c255-47f5-9022-94bde81b40a9] Dealer outcomes are not reported for several cases, and one owner was still awaiting a diagnosis. [signal:17d2a4ed-570f-4c89-b976-7c3bc7d501b6] [signal:a3793a0d-195f-4eea-832a-0ad1c776699f] [signal:c8a01813-a7f8-41bb-b9d4-8be710e52caa]

value.title: Tire durability, traction and availability concerns
value.summary: Customers report tire damage or pressure loss, reduced traction on rough surfaces, and difficulty obtaining replacement tires. The signals come from customers in Europe and the USA across several vehicle lines.
highlights: Reports include a sidewall puncture, low tire pressure, poor traction, and replacement-tire availability concerns.
Signals mention Europe F70 and USA G60 and G70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe tire concerns ranging from pressure loss and sidewall damage to traction on rough roads and trouble finding replacement tires. [signal:396f7f85-eb6e-4b1e-895d-8a6d5f60ebe2] [signal:471aa26e-a94a-4c26-adad-e24562b6e33d] [signal:271a28a3-a661-43f8-a17f-3194813fcadf] [signal:3a0689ce-18ce-4f07-b772-7a4a251315b2]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner noticed one tire at around 24 psi after roughly 1,100 miles and was monitoring it for a possible slow leak. [signal:396f7f85-eb6e-4b1e-895d-8a6d5f60ebe2]

Another USA G60 owner reported an early flat from a small sidewall hole, with no remembered impact and no dealer investigation into a possible tire defect. [signal:471aa26e-a94a-4c26-adad-e24562b6e33d]

A Europe F70 owner said the wheels and tires seemed to struggle and skid when pulling away on rough surfaces. [signal:271a28a3-a661-43f8-a17f-3194813fcadf]

A Europe F70 owner reported difficulty obtaining a replacement tire after a puncture. [signal:3a0689ce-18ce-4f07-b772-7a4a251315b2] A USA G70 owner wished for an all-season tire package or better dealer availability of all-season tires. [signal:1c572dc7-ddd4-408b-9b18-5d2ae55a6387]

## Differences between markets
The Europe signals describe traction on rough surfaces and difficulty obtaining a replacement tire for the F70. [signal:271a28a3-a661-43f8-a17f-3194813fcadf] [signal:3a0689ce-18ce-4f07-b772-7a4a251315b2]

The USA signals describe a pressure concern and sidewall damage on the G60, and a request for all-season tire availability on the G70. [signal:396f7f85-eb6e-4b1e-895d-8a6d5f60ebe2] [signal:471aa26e-a94a-4c26-adad-e24562b6e33d] [signal:1c572dc7-ddd4-408b-9b18-5d2ae55a6387]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported pressure loss or sidewall damage resulted from a tire defect. [signal:396f7f85-eb6e-4b1e-895d-8a6d5f60ebe2] [signal:471aa26e-a94a-4c26-adad-e24562b6e33d]

The signals do not indicate how widespread the replacement-tire or all-season tire availability concerns are. [signal:3a0689ce-18ce-4f07-b772-7a4a251315b2] [signal:1c572dc7-ddd4-408b-9b18-5d2ae55a6387]

value.title: Tire noise disrupts cabin refinement across several markets
value.summary: Customers in Europe, the USA and Rest of World report tire or tyre noise, including whistling, roaring, humming and excessive noise on poor surfaces. Reports involve F70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Tire noise ranges from whistling and roaring to humming and excessive road-surface noise.
Signals come from Europe (F70 and G60), the USA (G60), and Rest of World (F70).
Bridgestone and Hankook tires are linked to noise; one customer prefers Michelin.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report tire noise that detracts from driving refinement, with descriptions including whistling, roaring, humming and excessive noise on poor surfaces. [signal:74049529-750e-4e12-9741-b0eadb4a6dae] [signal:ae86698c-9619-42e5-b9ec-70f44bd2bd3e] [signal:d2a37369-dd47-4f89-b96a-f1a072ada386] [signal:e04c95f5-d669-4c82-81a1-59815bfb06d4] [signal:f6a53df8-fea0-4913-bbc0-1c951600bda3]

## What customers say
An F70 owner in Europe reports a loud whistling sound from Bridgestone tires around 95 km/h. [signal:74049529-750e-4e12-9741-b0eadb4a6dae]

A G60 owner in the USA describes Hankook tires as extremely noisy and says they produce a roaring sound; the customer would rather have Michelin tires, which they feel are quieter. [signal:ae86698c-9619-42e5-b9ec-70f44bd2bd3e]

A G60 owner in Europe reports tire humming and speculates it may relate to low-profile tires or large rims. [signal:d2a37369-dd47-4f89-b96a-f1a072ada386]

An F70 owner in Europe says excessive tyre noise on poor surfaces spoils otherwise good refinement. [signal:e04c95f5-d669-4c82-81a1-59815bfb06d4]

An F70 owner in Rest of World describes the tyre noise as awful. [signal:f6a53df8-fea0-4913-bbc0-1c951600bda3]

## Differences between markets
Noise complaints appear in Europe for F70 and G60, in the USA for G60, and in Rest of World for F70. [signal:74049529-750e-4e12-9741-b0eadb4a6dae] [signal:ae86698c-9619-42e5-b9ec-70f44bd2bd3e] [signal:d2a37369-dd47-4f89-b96a-f1a072ada386] [signal:e04c95f5-d669-4c82-81a1-59815bfb06d4] [signal:f6a53df8-fea0-4913-bbc0-1c951600bda3]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common the issue is beyond these reports or whether the noise varies by tire specification or road conditions. [signal:74049529-750e-4e12-9741-b0eadb4a6dae] [signal:ae86698c-9619-42e5-b9ec-70f44bd2bd3e] [signal:d2a37369-dd47-4f89-b96a-f1a072ada386] [signal:e04c95f5-d669-4c82-81a1-59815bfb06d4] [signal:f6a53df8-fea0-4913-bbc0-1c951600bda3]

value.title: Instrument-panel design draws mixed reactions
value.summary: Reactions to the instrument-panel and cockpit design are mixed: one European F70 owner says the display feels unsafe and poorly designed, while other owners praise the dash or cockpit.
highlights: One owner finds the console display unsafe and poorly designed; others value the cockpit and dash.
Signals cover Europe and the USA: F70 (2) and G60 (2).
One owner reports others comparing the car to Kia and Ford Focus, but disputes the comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Reactions to the design differ: one F70 owner in Europe says the console display feels unsafe while driving and calls it a poor design decision. [signal:d83b3fab-ee91-48f0-880c-9505186017f6] Other owners praise the cockpit, curved screen, or dash. [signal:0f16275b-c897-4cad-bb64-796ac8ced232] [signal:55c1bd6f-8901-4763-98eb-63125b0b6d73] [signal:6065dbe0-997e-4be4-9272-9503b08721b1]

## What customers say
The F70 critic says the display feels unsafe and that moving from a 4 Series to this car was too large a downgrade in driving experience. [signal:d83b3fab-ee91-48f0-880c-9505186017f6] A USA G60 owner says the cockpit is their favorite part of the interior; another names the curved screen and sporty wheel. [signal:0f16275b-c897-4cad-bb64-796ac8ced232] [signal:6065dbe0-997e-4be4-9272-9503b08721b1] A different Europe F70 owner likes the dash. [signal:55c1bd6f-8901-4763-98eb-63125b0b6d73]

## Differences between markets
The two Europe F70 signals conflict: one owner dislikes the display, while another likes the dash. [signal:d83b3fab-ee91-48f0-880c-9505186017f6] [signal:55c1bd6f-8901-4763-98eb-63125b0b6d73] Both USA G60 signals praise the cockpit or curved screen. [signal:0f16275b-c897-4cad-bb64-796ac8ced232] [signal:6065dbe0-997e-4be4-9272-9503b08721b1]

## Open questions
How representative are the negative and positive reactions across owners? The signals contain one negative and three positive design reactions. [signal:d83b3fab-ee91-48f0-880c-9505186017f6] [signal:0f16275b-c897-4cad-bb64-796ac8ced232] [signal:55c1bd6f-8901-4763-98eb-63125b0b6d73] [signal:6065dbe0-997e-4be4-9272-9503b08721b1]
How widespread is the reported Kia and Focus comparison? One F70 owner says others make it and rejects it. [signal:55c1bd6f-8901-4763-98eb-63125b0b6d73]

value.title: Dashboard noises and limited control of navigation audio
value.summary: Customers report rattling or chattering around the instrument panel in US G60 and G70 vehicles, while a Rest of World G60 customer says navigation volume and audio behavior are disruptive.
highlights: Instrument-panel rattling, chattering, and restrictive navigation audio settings are reported.
Signals cover US G60 and G70 vehicles and a Rest of World G60 vehicle.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report recurring rattling or chattering noises around the dashboard and instrument panel, and one customer describes navigation audio settings as disruptive. [signal:25cabb2c-8005-421b-b21d-32385b8978f0] [signal:4f668eb9-d4dc-47b3-91e7-d130f5227633] [signal:64d257e5-fe4b-498b-8cf4-b001b660b17c] [signal:74550f16-6e34-4b3b-999b-2168b9c6c987]

## What customers say
A US G60 customer reports a constant rattle from the center-console speaker behind the display that remained after a repair attempt. [signal:25cabb2c-8005-421b-b21d-32385b8978f0]
A US G70 customer hears a rattle from the air-conditioning area behind the instrument panel. [signal:4f668eb9-d4dc-47b3-91e7-d130f5227633]
Another US G60 customer reports chattering under the display when slowing down, most often during one-pedal driving. [signal:64d257e5-fe4b-498b-8cf4-b001b660b17c]
A Rest of World G60 customer says the minimum navigation voice volume is too loud for a child to sleep, the navigation tunnel screen is distracting, and prompts or warnings mute the music. [signal:74550f16-6e34-4b3b-999b-2168b9c6c987]

## Differences between markets
The US reports describe physical rattling or chattering in G60 and G70 vehicles; the Rest of World report concerns navigation volume, display behavior, and music muting in a G60. [signal:25cabb2c-8005-421b-b21d-32385b8978f0] [signal:4f668eb9-d4dc-47b3-91e7-d130f5227633] [signal:64d257e5-fe4b-498b-8cf4-b001b660b17c] [signal:74550f16-6e34-4b3b-999b-2168b9c6c987]

## Open questions
Do the reported rattles and chatter share a cause, given the different locations and driving conditions described? [signal:25cabb2c-8005-421b-b21d-32385b8978f0] [signal:4f668eb9-d4dc-47b3-91e7-d130f5227633] [signal:64d257e5-fe4b-498b-8cf4-b001b660b17c]
How often do the navigation audio concerns occur beyond this single report? [signal:74550f16-6e34-4b3b-999b-2168b9c6c987]

value.title: Driver-side instrument-panel storage is missing

The supplied storage-space complaints are from USA customers in G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:21251fe9-fb4b-4d28-be72-b80660174c7d] [signal:432d950f-dba0-4b1e-94a1-15ccb7ccfcf4] [signal:a6795d2a-0908-4929-b15a-8c3baa7d8ff8] [signal:c2acff52-aada-45d5-a208-9377a977531e] [signal:d8e90002-ac72-4864-9eef-05cb7295d096] [signal:ddd7ac04-4970-47a6-888d-6c4927a0a571]

value.title: Instrument panel crashes and fails to show saved radio information
value.summary: Some owners report a complete dashboard failure or radio information not appearing as expected. The reports concern F70 owners in Europe and G70 owners in the USA.
highlights: Dashboard crashes and radio information may not display as expected.
Reports include Europe (F70) and the USA (G70).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One F70 owner reports that the entire dashboard crashed after about five weeks with a new car and required a replacement part. [signal:3ab2f1a0-1218-4ff2-86be-d2dc32f7541b] Another F70 owner says favourite radio stations saved to a steering-wheel button do not always appear on the dashboard. [signal:5687a004-d4ea-457f-9604-ed598d66c4ff]

## What customers say
The dashboard failure left one owner without their car for roughly five weeks and reduced their confidence in the brand. [signal:3ab2f1a0-1218-4ff2-86be-d2dc32f7541b] The radio-station display issue is intermittent; the stations remain saved and are visible on the home screen. [signal:5687a004-d4ea-457f-9604-ed598d66c4ff]

## Differences between markets
The reported complete dashboard failure and missing radio favourites are from Europe, both on the F70. [signal:3ab2f1a0-1218-4ff2-86be-d2dc32f7541b] [signal:5687a004-d4ea-457f-9604-ed598d66c4ff] No directly comparable instrument-panel reliability report from another market is present in these signals.

## Open questions
How often do complete dashboard failures or intermittent radio-display issues occur? [signal:3ab2f1a0-1218-4ff2-86be-d2dc32f7541b] [signal:5687a004-d4ea-457f-9604-ed598d66c4ff] Are these issues limited to the reported F70 vehicles, or do they affect other vehicle lines or markets?

value.title: Instrument panel feedback differs across markets

highlights: One F70 customer says the new panel makes the car dangerous to drive.
Signals cover Europe/F70 and USA/G60 and G70; five of six are positive or a wish.

What aspect of the new panel led the F70 customer to describe the car as dangerous to drive? [signal:4e21eeb3-4e0f-4a98-8b48-8b546374c058] What items or use cases underlie the G70 customer's request for nearby storage? [signal:e4a32f7b-c2fe-457f-b6c1-433f2176791d]

value.title: Garage opener range and button visibility frustrate some drivers
value.summary: Some US G60 and G70 drivers report limited range or difficulty locating the garage door opener buttons; one G60 driver also wants gates and garages to open automatically by geofencing. A separate European signal praises the car’s technology but does not clearly comment on the opener itself.
highlights: US drivers cite limited range, hard-to-find buttons, and a desire for geofenced opening.
Signals mention US G60 and G70 drivers and one Europe F70 signal.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some US drivers say the garage door opener’s range is too short, its buttons are difficult to locate, or they want gates and garages to open automatically by geofencing. [signal:00678dd6-4d5e-4911-a64a-c34086fb6f46] [signal:6b00a2d9-8c54-4367-816f-e78c523b18da] [signal:ce33dd2e-66a9-4a76-bb1d-6d674b3969b8] [signal:d6dcad0f-9a1f-462a-b483-c491cd715280]

## What customers say
A G60 driver says the range is insufficient for a long driveway and that they must wait until near the gate to press the mirror-mounted button. [signal:00678dd6-4d5e-4911-a64a-c34086fb6f46]

A G70 driver wants illuminated buttons for easier nighttime use; another says the buttons feel small and are hard to locate. [signal:6b00a2d9-8c54-4367-816f-e78c523b18da] [signal:ce33dd2e-66a9-4a76-bb1d-6d674b3969b8]

A G60 driver says geofencing should automatically open gates and garages; the quoted comment is truncated. [signal:d6dcad0f-9a1f-462a-b483-c491cd715280]

## Differences between markets
The usability complaints and geofencing request are from US G60 and G70 signals. [signal:00678dd6-4d5e-4911-a64a-c34086fb6f46] [signal:6b00a2d9-8c54-4367-816f-e78c523b18da] [signal:ce33dd2e-66a9-4a76-bb1d-6d674b3969b8] [signal:d6dcad0f-9a1f-462a-b483-c491cd715280]

A Europe F70 signal praises the design, comfort, and technology, but its mention of “the garage” and reception does not clearly refer to the garage door opener. [signal:66921285-a9de-439d-a684-7524f555abbe]

## Open questions
Do the range and button-location concerns occur beyond the specific US G60 and G70 reports? [signal:00678dd6-4d5e-4911-a64a-c34086fb6f46] [signal:6b00a2d9-8c54-4367-816f-e78c523b18da] [signal:ce33dd2e-66a9-4a76-bb1d-6d674b3969b8]

What additional context would clarify the G60 driver’s geofencing request? [signal:d6dcad0f-9a1f-462a-b483-c491cd715280]

value.title: Instrument panel controls difficult and distracting to use
value.summary: Some drivers find instrument-panel functions hard to locate and adjust, particularly while driving; others report distracting glare or excessive display brightness. The signals include complaints from Europe and the USA across F70, G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Drivers report difficult-to-find controls, distraction, glare and excessive display brightness.
Signals cover Europe (F70) and the USA (G70, G60).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say functions moved into the iDrive screen are harder or slower to adjust than physical buttons, and that using the screen while driving can take attention away from the road. [signal:51581fa3-71ee-4945-8f70-3a95991636bb] [signal:76ab8cbc-c6ac-47fe-9311-bf5ca12dad8b] [signal:9fa36cf0-140d-46c6-8e64-3442f1afc2f3] Other drivers report distracting reflections or display brightness that remains uncomfortable even at the lowest setting. [signal:57ca45b1-496c-4d69-9032-50d8dc7b1b25] [signal:5c932454-455c-48cb-9e58-6e69bf631575]

## What customers say
One F70 driver says removing individual buttons made settings harder to change because it is necessary to find the relevant app. [signal:51581fa3-71ee-4945-8f70-3a95991636bb] Another F70 driver says they pull over to make adjustments when alone because using the electronic dash while moving feels unsafe. [signal:9fa36cf0-140d-46c6-8e64-3442f1afc2f3] A driver also describes the controls as complicated and difficult to figure out. [signal:c87f3d9a-98e5-4df1-a9b3-2a7da77fad9b]

USA complaints describe sunlight reflecting from the dash glass and center-console controls, as well as a main display that remains too bright at its lowest setting. [signal:57ca45b1-496c-4d69-9032-50d8dc7b1b25] [signal:c22a9a15-35a6-4768-a511-81bf9c12c09d] [signal:5c932454-455c-48cb-9e58-6e69bf631575]

## Differences between markets
The sampled Europe complaints focus on finding and operating controls through the screen, including while driving. [signal:51581fa3-71ee-4945-8f70-3a95991636bb] [signal:76ab8cbc-c6ac-47fe-9311-bf5ca12dad8b] [signal:9fa36cf0-140d-46c6-8e64-3442f1afc2f3] The sampled USA complaints focus on glare, reflections and screen brightness. [signal:57ca45b1-496c-4d69-9032-50d8dc7b1b25] [signal:5c932454-455c-48cb-9e58-6e69bf631575] [signal:c22a9a15-35a6-4768-a511-81bf9c12c09d]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these experiences are across all 31 case signals, or whether they vary by configuration or driving conditions. [signal:37730d06-160b-4e47-972a-273a2ebef827] [signal:7071e7d5-d0ff-4fa0-b259-4f0df4820812] [signal:849ac3f5-d236-469f-9f77-242761c9e3a9]

value.title: Physical CD playback missing from current vehicles

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say their vehicles lack CD playback and want to play physical CDs in the car. [signal:32273abc-e16d-4bd9-b599-8d64e7ff797c] [signal:8bbedebd-e96c-42a4-900b-3fb9b73e678b]
One customer says their wife misses the CD player and digital storage for several CDs in their 2017 BMW. [signal:16811a22-c56e-44e9-801a-ce072db72f7c]

## What customers say
A customer with a CD collection wants to play it in the vehicle and requests a CD player as an optional feature. [signal:32273abc-e16d-4bd9-b599-8d64e7ff797c]
Another customer describes a factory CD player as the most important possible improvement to their infotainment system. [signal:4b04acc0-7a20-493c-9a70-41b3bbf0d17e]
Customers also miss CD and DVD players in earlier 7 Series models. [signal:458e7384-4db9-4a9b-adc1-c71a1cf56cd3]

## Differences between markets
The CD-player requests shown here are from USA customers, including G60 and G70 owners. [signal:16811a22-c56e-44e9-801a-ce072db72f7c] [signal:32273abc-e16d-4bd9-b599-8d64e7ff797c] [signal:458e7384-4db9-4a9b-adc1-c71a1cf56cd3] [signal:4b04acc0-7a20-493c-9a70-41b3bbf0d17e] [signal:7f9d77ca-d085-4eb0-9fec-9df21ba29c30] [signal:8bbedebd-e96c-42a4-900b-3fb9b73e678b]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how many customers overall want CD playback, or whether demand differs by vehicle line. [signal:16811a22-c56e-44e9-801a-ce072db72f7c] [signal:32273abc-e16d-4bd9-b599-8d64e7ff797c] [signal:458e7384-4db9-4a9b-adc1-c71a1cf56cd3] [signal:4b04acc0-7a20-493c-9a70-41b3bbf0d17e] [signal:7f9d77ca-d085-4eb0-9fec-9df21ba29c30] [signal:8bbedebd-e96c-42a4-900b-3fb9b73e678b]
