value.title: Garage door opener pairing and operation are unreliable
value.summary: Some U.S. G60 and G70 owners report that the built-in garage door opener is difficult to program or pair, or does not function. One G70 owner also reports a persistent unresolved opener fault.
highlights: Owners report failed operation, difficult programming or pairing, and a persistent fault.
Signals describe U.S. G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners report that the built-in garage door opener does not function, is difficult to program, or has trouble pairing with garage and gate openers. [signal:4b06dc25-ac9f-428a-83f2-c51c00e081a0] [signal:4f1f30a8-b650-408b-a1f5-779efa767ac6] [signal:5cd2e0f7-88a2-4b36-ba98-ce6589aa2905]

One G70 owner says the opener fault remained unresolved while the vehicle was at a service center. [signal:712cc136-0091-4a16-8bce-9b6adcee82ca]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the opener was still not functioning, and another says they had not managed to program it despite doing so in six previous BMWs. [signal:4b06dc25-ac9f-428a-83f2-c51c00e081a0] [signal:5cd2e0f7-88a2-4b36-ba98-ce6589aa2905]

A G70 owner reports difficulty pairing garage and gate openers with the vehicle. [signal:4f1f30a8-b650-408b-a1f5-779efa767ac6]

Another G70 owner says the vehicle had been at the service center since January for an opener problem and reports being told it was a wiring issue. [signal:712cc136-0091-4a16-8bce-9b6adcee82ca]

## Differences between markets
The relevant reports shown here are from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles; no other market is represented in these signals. [signal:4b06dc25-ac9f-428a-83f2-c51c00e081a0] [signal:4f1f30a8-b650-408b-a1f5-779efa767ac6] [signal:5cd2e0f7-88a2-4b36-ba98-ce6589aa2905] [signal:712cc136-0091-4a16-8bce-9b6adcee82ca]

## Open questions
Do the reported programming, pairing, and persistent-fault problems share a cause? [signal:4b06dc25-ac9f-428a-83f2-c51c00e081a0] [signal:4f1f30a8-b650-408b-a1f5-779efa767ac6] [signal:5cd2e0f7-88a2-4b36-ba98-ce6589aa2905] [signal:712cc136-0091-4a16-8bce-9b6adcee82ca]

How frequently do these issues occur across G60 and G70 vehicles? [signal:4b06dc25-ac9f-428a-83f2-c51c00e081a0] [signal:4f1f30a8-b650-408b-a1f5-779efa767ac6] [signal:5cd2e0f7-88a2-4b36-ba98-ce6589aa2905] [signal:712cc136-0091-4a16-8bce-9b6adcee82ca]

value.title: Dashboard failures, glare and difficult controls undermine confidence
value.summary: Customers report dashboard failures, distracting reflections and controls they find difficult to use. Signals come from F70, G60 and G70 drivers in Europe and the USA.
highlights: Dashboard failures, glare and difficult-to-use controls affect confidence and driving comfort.
Signals cover Europe and the USA, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that dashboard components can fail, reflections can interfere with visibility, and controls can be difficult to operate or locate. [signal:1fb4f8e0-0aec-4781-bdb5-7fc3a7cd8e28] [signal:5a7fd198-9d7b-4395-9e19-7d96f5c12338] [signal:705d478e-c9b0-487d-aa5b-2a914bc881b3] [signal:7cda2bc2-f08c-473f-9315-1a3de692140e]

## What customers say
One F70 owner said the dashboard failed after about five weeks, leaving them without their car for roughly another five weeks while it was repaired. [signal:1fb4f8e0-0aec-4781-bdb5-7fc3a7cd8e28] Another F70 owner reported that the entire left side of the dashboard stopped working, taking hands-free, radio and air conditioning with it. [signal:ce17bea1-7cba-4505-8308-4d3b03d39b0c]

Some customers describe the electronic controls as difficult or distracting to use while driving. One F70 owner avoids changing settings on the move because of the time spent looking away from the road; a G70 owner says controls are difficult to find in the central monitor. [signal:705d478e-c9b0-487d-aa5b-2a914bc881b3] [signal:7cda2bc2-f08c-473f-9315-1a3de692140e] A G70 owner also wants more support to understand the dashboard functions and reports that the navigation arrow sometimes drifts off the road line. [signal:8adf2957-1e80-4880-a18d-39bc5de1c217]

Customers also report distracting reflections: an F70 owner says interior lighting reflects in the wing mirrors at night, while a G70 owner says the dashboard strip can reflect sunlight into the occupants’ eyes. [signal:5a7fd198-9d7b-4395-9e19-7d96f5c12338] [signal:7cda2bc2-f08c-473f-9315-1a3de692140e] A USA G60 owner mentions a dashboard quality issue that is noticeable in sunlight, but the available quote does not specify further details. [signal:7bf90d09-7762-43da-8dc3-268292808c20]

## Differences between markets
European signals include F70 reports of dashboard failures, difficulty using settings while driving and reflections in the mirrors. [signal:1fb4f8e0-0aec-4781-bdb5-7fc3a7cd8e28] [signal:705d478e-c9b0-487d-aa5b-2a914bc881b3] [signal:5a7fd198-9d7b-4395-9e19-7d96f5c12338] A European G60 owner also says they cannot choose their dashboard color when efficiency is selected. [signal:5ced3a57-b827-42a4-8d04-6486b9ddb562]

USA signals include G70 complaints about hard-to-find controls, sunlight reflections and navigation guidance, as well as a G60 dashboard quality concern in sunlight. [signal:7cda2bc2-f08c-473f-9315-1a3de692140e] [signal:8adf2957-1e80-4880-a18d-39bc5de1c217] [signal:7bf90d09-7762-43da-8dc3-268292808c20] The signals show different reported issues by market; they do not establish whether the underlying experiences differ systematically. [signal:5a7fd198-9d7b-4395-9e19-7d96f5c12338] [signal:7cda2bc2-f08c-473f-9315-1a3de692140e]

## Open questions
How often do the reported dashboard failures occur, and are the two F70 failure reports related? [signal:1fb4f8e0-0aec-4781-bdb5-7fc3a7cd8e28] [signal:ce17bea1-7cba-4505-8308-4d3b03d39b0c]

How widespread are the reported reflections and control-use difficulties across vehicles and driving conditions? [signal:5a7fd198-9d7b-4395-9e19-7d96f5c12338] [signal:7cda2bc2-f08c-473f-9315-1a3de692140e] [signal:705d478e-c9b0-487d-aa5b-2a914bc881b3]

What is the specific dashboard quality issue reported by the USA G60 owner? [signal:7bf90d09-7762-43da-8dc3-268292808c20]

value.title: Garage door opener pairing is difficult for some customers
value.summary: Some customers report difficulty programming or syncing the garage door opener, including uncertainty about the steps and needing a handheld remote. The signals include reports from USA and Rest of World customers across G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report difficulty programming or syncing the garage door opener.
In the supplied sample, six USA signals concern G60 or G70 vehicles; one Rest of World signal concerns G60.
A customer said setup worked with a 2023 Ford F250, but took a few tries.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report being unable to pair or sync the garage door opener, or being unsure how to program it. [signal:333ab398-c9f1-47ea-8d31-34a361d8c7f0] [signal:37ea6e23-c35c-478f-a2b2-a8f81f6dadea] [signal:4152c3df-e4d2-4a2d-933c-b7367268798d]

Some customers could not proceed without a handheld remote. [signal:252c0d41-1465-46ce-b55b-86c85d75f5f3] [signal:387cfbe2-7312-48a1-b2e1-3d2c652e4b40]

## What customers say
One customer had watched a video several times but still could not connect the opener, while another had tried the owner’s manual and contacted the garage door manufacturer but remained unsure how to pair it. [signal:333ab398-c9f1-47ea-8d31-34a361d8c7f0] [signal:37ea6e23-c35c-478f-a2b2-a8f81f6dadea]

One customer needed help from an engineer friend to sync the vehicle, and another described difficulty getting the doors to sync properly. [signal:2f588334-de0e-4de3-880e-bf7211cfef1e] [signal:4152c3df-e4d2-4a2d-933c-b7367268798d]

A customer said pairing with a 2023 Ford F250 worked after a few tries. [signal:333ab398-c9f1-47ea-8d31-34a361d8c7f0]

## Differences between markets
In the supplied sample, six relevant signals are from the USA and concern G60 or G70 vehicles; one is from Rest of World and concerns a G60. [signal:252c0d41-1465-46ce-b55b-86c85d75f5f3] [signal:2f588334-de0e-4de3-880e-bf7211cfef1e] [signal:333ab398-c9f1-47ea-8d31-34a361d8c7f0] [signal:37ea6e23-c35c-478f-a2b2-a8f81f6dadea] [signal:387cfbe2-7312-48a1-b2e1-3d2c652e4b40] [signal:4152c3df-e4d2-4a2d-933c-b7367268798d] [signal:cb2f6cd4-5628-408c-8f7a-0e0b8e897b24]

The Rest of World signal describes HomeLink integration being an option on a luxury car as undesirable; the USA signals describe setup or pairing difficulties. [signal:cb2f6cd4-5628-408c-8f7a-0e0b8e897b24] [signal:252c0d41-1465-46ce-b55b-86c85d75f5f3] [signal:2f588334-de0e-4de3-880e-bf7211cfef1e] [signal:333ab398-c9f1-47ea-8d31-34a361d8c7f0] [signal:37ea6e23-c35c-478f-a2b2-a8f81f6dadea] [signal:387cfbe2-7312-48a1-b2e1-3d2c652e4b40] [signal:4152c3df-e4d2-4a2d-933c-b7367268798d]

## Open questions
Do the setup difficulties differ by opener or remote type? [signal:333ab398-c9f1-47ea-8d31-34a361d8c7f0] [signal:37ea6e23-c35c-478f-a2b2-a8f81f6dadea]

How often does the need for a handheld remote prevent customers from completing setup? [signal:252c0d41-1465-46ce-b55b-86c85d75f5f3] [signal:387cfbe2-7312-48a1-b2e1-3d2c652e4b40]

value.title: Key detection and operation are unreliable or unclear
value.summary: Some US G70 and G60 owners report that the key is not detected reliably or is difficult to use, including confusion about locking and setup.
highlights: Key detection can fail, and key-fob operation is unclear.
Five US signals: one G70 and four G60 complaints.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
US owners report key-fob detection failures and difficulty using or setting up the key. [signal:3c9b1727-63de-454d-bd34-872351f7dd3d] [signal:863ed0f4-bac9-4bfe-b054-1ee8eebaafe5] [signal:f2ddb54d-28a1-4051-838d-c4f0f3200bfd]

## What customers say
A G70 owner says the car failed to detect the fob on three occasions, and that placing it on the steering-column symbol sometimes did not work. [signal:3c9b1727-63de-454d-bd34-872351f7dd3d]

G60 owners describe difficulty opening the car and figuring out settings, uncertainty about how to lock it, and problems when one of two fobs goes out of range while the other remains nearby. [signal:863ed0f4-bac9-4bfe-b054-1ee8eebaafe5] [signal:d3908a22-d875-44dc-a147-b6fa76f7c813] [signal:d69a31d4-1b69-41dc-902c-89c67fa1ce1c]

One G60 owner also reports needing a replacement battery after two weeks and having trouble setting up the key. [signal:f2ddb54d-28a1-4051-838d-c4f0f3200bfd]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA; they cover one G70 and four G60 complaints. [signal:3c9b1727-63de-454d-bd34-872351f7dd3d] [signal:863ed0f4-bac9-4bfe-b054-1ee8eebaafe5] [signal:d3908a22-d875-44dc-a147-b6fa76f7c813] [signal:d69a31d4-1b69-41dc-902c-89c67fa1ce1c] [signal:f2ddb54d-28a1-4051-838d-c4f0f3200bfd] No other market is represented in these signals. [signal:3c9b1727-63de-454d-bd34-872351f7dd3d] [signal:863ed0f4-bac9-4bfe-b054-1ee8eebaafe5] [signal:d3908a22-d875-44dc-a147-b6fa76f7c813] [signal:d69a31d4-1b69-41dc-902c-89c67fa1ce1c] [signal:f2ddb54d-28a1-4051-838d-c4f0f3200bfd]

## Open questions
Do these reported detection and usability problems occur beyond the five US complaints represented here? [signal:3c9b1727-63de-454d-bd34-872351f7dd3d] [signal:863ed0f4-bac9-4bfe-b054-1ee8eebaafe5] [signal:d3908a22-d875-44dc-a147-b6fa76f7c813] [signal:d69a31d4-1b69-41dc-902c-89c67fa1ce1c] [signal:f2ddb54d-28a1-4051-838d-c4f0f3200bfd]

value.title: Only one key and key fob for some customers
value.summary: Customers in the USA report that one supplied key or key fob is insufficient when multiple people use the vehicle; another customer wants a smaller key fob.
highlights: Customers want an additional key or key fob, and one also wants a smaller fob.
Signals are from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say a single supplied key or key fob does not meet their needs, particularly when multiple people share the vehicle. [signal:28a2a8d7-8a90-4f1c-8c68-6b77edf5afce] [signal:4163ebbe-1163-48d2-a841-b7347da7c944] One customer also wants the key fob to be smaller. [signal:34b12602-5606-456c-920f-4c7a5582610d]

## What customers say
Customers describe wanting a second key or fob for family members or two main drivers. [signal:04fb812d-0576-45ae-b8c7-7f881898bcd4] [signal:28a2a8d7-8a90-4f1c-8c68-6b77edf5afce] One customer says having only one key feels unsafe, while another notes that the vehicle came with one key and a service card. [signal:8ec8ffef-5efd-416c-97f8-0aedfa841313] [signal:42f010c6-6f26-473b-acd3-18b80242c83b]

## Differences between markets
All supplied examples are from the USA, covering G60 and G70 vehicles; the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:04fb812d-0576-45ae-b8c7-7f881898bcd4] [signal:28a2a8d7-8a90-4f1c-8c68-6b77edf5afce] [signal:34b12602-5606-456c-920f-4c7a5582610d] [signal:4163ebbe-1163-48d2-a841-b7347da7c944] [signal:42f010c6-6f26-473b-acd3-18b80242c83b] [signal:8ec8ffef-5efd-416c-97f8-0aedfa841313]

## Open questions
The supplied examples do not establish how common the request for an additional key is, or how widespread the preference for a smaller fob is. [signal:04fb812d-0576-45ae-b8c7-7f881898bcd4] [signal:34b12602-5606-456c-920f-4c7a5582610d]

value.title: Vehicle key usability and clarity concerns
value.summary: Customers report several difficulties with the vehicle key, including carrying it, attaching a keyring, removing the physical key, and understanding the panic button. A separate concern is repeated beeping when the fob is left in a running vehicle.
highlights: Reported issues include key-fob beeping, bulk, keyring fit, physical-key removal, and panic-button clarity.
All six supplied signals are from the USA: four for G70 and two for G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the fob is bulky to carry and difficult to attach to a keychain; one customer wants a larger opening for a regular-size keyring. [signal:37d3dd11-964b-4a94-9e5d-3f11bb904e64] [signal:1ce94ad7-1c65-4d38-b6b8-438d52bddfc6] [signal:07e0b580-7b9f-4d5c-a1ee-bc0194cde6dc]
A customer says removing the physical key is harder than before, and another asked what the panic button does. [signal:7d9148f6-0d4c-4c7a-93a8-8bcb774816fc] [signal:5fb86070-4297-44b1-bd51-fff7dd584f25]
One customer reports that the vehicle beeps when the fob is left inside while the vehicle is running. [signal:195931a9-7d10-4407-a265-990eb1e835f8]

## What customers say
A G70 customer in Florida says the beeping makes it difficult to leave the fob in the running vehicle with the windows up in hot weather; the dealer recommended remote start through the My BMW app. [signal:195931a9-7d10-4407-a265-990eb1e835f8]
A G60 customer describes the physical key as harder to remove than when it was released with a button. [signal:7d9148f6-0d4c-4c7a-93a8-8bcb774816fc]
A G60 customer asked what the panic button does and was told it activates the vehicle alarms, with a second press shutting them off. [signal:5fb86070-4297-44b1-bd51-fff7dd584f25]

## Differences between markets
All supplied signals are from the USA; there are no signals from other markets for comparison. [signal:195931a9-7d10-4407-a265-990eb1e835f8] [signal:1ce94ad7-1c65-4d38-b6b8-438d52bddfc6] [signal:37d3dd11-964b-4a94-9e5d-3f11bb904e64] [signal:5fb86070-4297-44b1-bd51-fff7dd584f25] [signal:7d9148f6-0d4c-4c7a-93a8-8bcb774816fc] [signal:07e0b580-7b9f-4d5c-a1ee-bc0194cde6dc]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these concerns are beyond the reported cases, or whether they occur on other vehicle lines or in other markets. [signal:195931a9-7d10-4407-a265-990eb1e835f8] [signal:1ce94ad7-1c65-4d38-b6b8-438d52bddfc6] [signal:37d3dd11-964b-4a94-9e5d-3f11bb904e64] [signal:5fb86070-4297-44b1-bd51-fff7dd584f25] [signal:7d9148f6-0d4c-4c7a-93a8-8bcb774816fc] [signal:07e0b580-7b9f-4d5c-a1ee-bc0194cde6dc]

value.title: Vehicle key detection and operation are unreliable
value.summary: Customers report inconsistent digital-key or key-fob operation, including difficulty unlocking the vehicle and intermittent key detection. Reports come from USA, Europe and Rest of World, across G70 and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Keys are inconsistently detected or respond poorly, causing access and stored-setting problems.
Reports span USA (G70), Europe (F70) and Rest of World (F70); counts by market and line are not provided.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe digital keys or key fobs that work inconsistently, making it difficult to access the vehicle or reliably load stored settings. [signal:0b60a9b0-6160-4210-9245-2612f73c3fac] [signal:10267ad9-5a57-4def-9597-598b17cc0f39]

Some customers also report that digital-key problems required dealer updates, or that the key fob quality has declined. [signal:22d784b1-0bbd-465e-9f25-390f652e599f] [signal:2b52d3e4-51d5-4b25-ae0e-15f344ef82a8]

## What customers say
A USA G70 owner says the digital key is detected only intermittently, making it hard to get into the car. [signal:0b60a9b0-6160-4210-9245-2612f73c3fac] Another USA G70 owner says inconsistent key detection often prevents stored settings such as lights, seat adjustment and radio presets from loading. [signal:10267ad9-5a57-4def-9597-598b17cc0f39]

In Europe, F70 owners describe inconsistent digital keys and say the vehicle came with only one physical key. [signal:22d784b1-0bbd-465e-9f25-390f652e599f] [signal:335a922f-073d-49ec-be75-1b08c26a37de] A separate F70 owner says the key fob quality has gone backwards. [signal:2b52d3e4-51d5-4b25-ae0e-15f344ef82a8]

In Rest of World, F70 owners report key issues, including a smart key that often responds poorly and may require pressing its button to open or close the vehicle. [signal:4c9e9591-595f-47a8-a544-4d4f8c4c9bde] [signal:6764e394-bf42-4b3e-a552-ebf696ceba55]

## Differences between markets
USA reports in the sample describe intermittent digital-key detection in G70 vehicles, including access and settings issues. [signal:0b60a9b0-6160-4210-9245-2612f73c3fac] [signal:10267ad9-5a57-4def-9597-598b17cc0f39]

Europe reports in the sample describe unreliable digital keys in F70 vehicles, concerns about key-fob quality, and having only one physical key. [signal:22d784b1-0bbd-465e-9f25-390f652e599f] [signal:2b52d3e4-51d5-4b25-ae0e-15f344ef82a8] [signal:335a922f-073d-49ec-be75-1b08c26a37de] Rest of World reports in the sample describe key issues or poor smart-key response in F70 vehicles. [signal:4c9e9591-595f-47a8-a544-4d4f8c4c9bde] [signal:6764e394-bf42-4b3e-a552-ebf696ceba55]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequently the problem occurs across the 34 signals, or whether the reports reflect different key types or causes. [signal:0b60a9b0-6160-4210-9245-2612f73c3fac] [signal:22d784b1-0bbd-465e-9f25-390f652e599f]

value.title: Interior camera privacy concerns alongside valued uses

highlights: One customer raises privacy concerns about being unable to switch off the interior cameras.
Signals are from USA customers in G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Feedback points to differing expectations for the interior camera: one customer wants to switch it off for privacy, while others like having it or want to use it for Zoom meetings. [signal:80a8a89f-d5a5-48e2-aad5-663e17550c95] [signal:88249cb5-3d8b-46a3-8ee6-465807cf87e6] [signal:00b8b77c-79e4-4251-9d70-d147a8c53945] [signal:2d658caa-5648-4417-8553-79745981aa52] [signal:3684b809-35b2-47a0-a187-7f781af1b302] [signal:4d0fc9a0-66a3-4dbb-964b-9d3c7cf09087]

## What customers say

Other USA customers say they enjoy using the camera for selfies, like having it available, or are pleased with it; a G70 customer calls it “really cool.” [signal:00b8b77c-79e4-4251-9d70-d147a8c53945] [signal:2d658caa-5648-4417-8553-79745981aa52] [signal:3684b809-35b2-47a0-a187-7f781af1b302] [signal:4d0fc9a0-66a3-4dbb-964b-9d3c7cf09087]

## Differences between markets
All provided signals are from the USA, covering G60 and G70 vehicles; there is no market comparison in the provided signals. [signal:80a8a89f-d5a5-48e2-aad5-663e17550c95] [signal:88249cb5-3d8b-46a3-8ee6-465807cf87e6] [signal:00b8b77c-79e4-4251-9d70-d147a8c53945] [signal:2d658caa-5648-4417-8553-79745981aa52] [signal:3684b809-35b2-47a0-a187-7f781af1b302] [signal:4d0fc9a0-66a3-4dbb-964b-9d3c7cf09087]

## Open questions
Do customer expectations differ by intended camera use, such as privacy, meetings, or personal use?

value.title: Tire pressure alerts and tire recognition are unreliable
value.summary: Some customers report tire-pressure warnings that clear or are unclear, repeated failure to recognize unchanged tires, and a pressure issue that persists after a dealer check. The reports come from US G70 owners and a European G60 owner.
highlights: Warnings clear, are unclear, or recur alongside repeated tire-recognition failures.
Reports include US G70 owners and one European G60 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers report tire-pressure monitoring problems: a malfunction alert cleared by itself, a tire-related diagnostic warning was unclear, and unchanged tires repeatedly showed as unrecognized. [signal:a4bff0b0-25d7-42f7-972e-ce80f9c1d785] [signal:a4eeda29-7611-4dc1-a5cf-65438bfc98d9] [signal:b456938c-e911-4b40-88d6-665b217650d9]

A European G60 owner reported a tire-pressure issue that continued after adding air and after a dealer said everything was fine. [signal:ba335f3f-ac1c-40fd-ba18-6ddf8839f5e4]

## What customers say
A US G70 owner said a tire-pressure monitoring malfunction alert disappeared the next day. [signal:a4bff0b0-25d7-42f7-972e-ce80f9c1d785]

Another US G70 owner was unsure what a recurring tire-related diagnostic warning meant and had not yet had it checked by a dealer. [signal:a4eeda29-7611-4dc1-a5cf-65438bfc98d9]

A US G70 owner said the car repeatedly failed to recognize its original tires after selecting and resetting the tire type. [signal:b456938c-e911-4b40-88d6-665b217650d9]

## Differences between markets
The US G70 reports describe monitoring alerts, an unclear diagnostic warning, and repeated tire-recognition failures. [signal:a4bff0b0-25d7-42f7-972e-ce80f9c1d785] [signal:a4eeda29-7611-4dc1-a5cf-65438bfc98d9] [signal:b456938c-e911-4b40-88d6-665b217650d9]

The European G60 report describes a tire-pressure issue that persisted despite adding air and a dealer check. [signal:ba335f3f-ac1c-40fd-ba18-6ddf8839f5e4]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the causes of the alerts, recognition failures, or persistent pressure issue. [signal:a4bff0b0-25d7-42f7-972e-ce80f9c1d785] [signal:a4eeda29-7611-4dc1-a5cf-65438bfc98d9] [signal:b456938c-e911-4b40-88d6-665b217650d9] [signal:ba335f3f-ac1c-40fd-ba18-6ddf8839f5e4]

It is unclear from the reports whether the symptoms share a cause or how often they occur beyond these cases. [signal:a4bff0b0-25d7-42f7-972e-ce80f9c1d785] [signal:a4eeda29-7611-4dc1-a5cf-65438bfc98d9] [signal:b456938c-e911-4b40-88d6-665b217650d9] [signal:ba335f3f-ac1c-40fd-ba18-6ddf8839f5e4]

value.title: Tire pressure information can be hard to find or interpret
value.summary: Some customers have difficulty locating tire pressure information or interpreting changing readings, while another appreciates having actual and suggested pressures visible. These signals come from USA G60 and G70 customers and a Europe F70 customer.
highlights: Tire pressure information can feel buried, difficult to find, or unclear.
Signals include USA G60 and G70 customers and a Europe F70 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers report difficulty finding tire pressure information in the vehicle interface. [signal:47bc9145-a605-473f-a57b-00560cbb502a] [signal:48960ce0-d44e-4d7f-b3c2-3bb1c3f09a87] A Europe F70 customer says the tyre pressure gauge changes frequently, making it unclear how much air to add. [signal:4254cf2f-5ad0-4e96-8098-f118a0adfc71]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer says the pressure display feels buried, while a USA G60 customer says they had a hard time finding it. [signal:47bc9145-a605-473f-a57b-00560cbb502a] [signal:48960ce0-d44e-4d7f-b3c2-3bb1c3f09a87] In contrast, a USA G70 customer liked seeing actual and suggested tire pressures on screen. [signal:639fe413-bb37-4b7a-88a7-503920acdf4b] Another USA G70 customer asked whether low pressure would trigger an alert and was told a notification appears in the instrument cluster. [signal:8a1ad911-43f9-4a2b-ae65-bcd24175b8b3] A USA G60 customer reported a temporary monitor malfunction followed by a low-pressure warning after finding a screw in a tire. [signal:041f9a0f-a5c7-4741-9339-7baa89c3c144] A USA G70 customer said snow tires bought for an older 760 no longer worked with the current car’s tire monitor sensors. [signal:34e576c3-4f9e-4bde-852b-8d4df45bed61]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include difficulty accessing or finding the display, positive feedback about visible pressure values, a question about low-pressure alerts, a temporary monitor malfunction, and a sensor compatibility complaint. [signal:47bc9145-a605-473f-a57b-00560cbb502a] [signal:48960ce0-d44e-4d7f-b3c2-3bb1c3f09a87] [signal:639fe413-bb37-4b7a-88a7-503920acdf4b] [signal:8a1ad911-43f9-4a2b-ae65-bcd24175b8b3] [signal:041f9a0f-a5c7-4741-9339-7baa89c3c144] [signal:34e576c3-4f9e-4bde-852b-8d4df45bed61] The Europe F70 signal describes changing gauge readings and uncertainty about inflation pressure. [signal:4254cf2f-5ad0-4e96-8098-f118a0adfc71] These accounts differ in the aspects of tire-pressure usability they describe; the signals do not establish whether experiences differ by market.

## Open questions
Do customers have difficulty locating the pressure display across other vehicle lines or markets? [signal:47bc9145-a605-473f-a57b-00560cbb502a] [signal:48960ce0-d44e-4d7f-b3c2-3bb1c3f09a87] What causes the changing readings described by the Europe F70 customer, and how widespread is that experience? [signal:4254cf2f-5ad0-4e96-8098-f118a0adfc71]

value.title: Interior camera access and use are hard to recall
value.summary: Customers report difficulty finding or recalling how to access the interior camera, use its remote features, and understand its purpose. The signals come from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers need help finding camera controls and recalling access steps.
Five USA signals: two G60 and three G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers asked how to access the interior camera, retrieve recordings, use remote pictures, and understand the feature’s purpose. [signal:0dcf1992-d964-4efb-be4e-6e49df0a4185] [signal:334536ae-c941-4042-83ed-de5ab13f4c8e] [signal:69f9c8b7-9295-48fd-ba67-57027c2402fa] [signal:b2ba0864-748a-47f4-b3b5-18b2b08d4885]
One customer was unsure whether the camera app had to be reopened each time, and was told it does not stay open after exiting. [signal:a1ff8d7d-6d0a-4ae7-8e3f-9c0a8841c226]

## What customers say
Customers needed guidance to find the camera or its recordings through the vehicle’s apps menu. [signal:0dcf1992-d964-4efb-be4e-6e49df0a4185] [signal:69f9c8b7-9295-48fd-ba67-57027c2402fa] [signal:a1ff8d7d-6d0a-4ae7-8e3f-9c0a8841c226]
For remote pictures, a customer needed help with the steps and was told to acknowledge the camera, accept the privacy agreement, and turn on the camera in the vehicle. [signal:334536ae-c941-4042-83ed-de5ab13f4c8e]
A customer asked what the camera is for; the response described taking selfies and capturing an interior image in the event of a break-in. [signal:b2ba0864-748a-47f4-b3b5-18b2b08d4885]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA: two concern G60 vehicles and three concern G70 vehicles. [signal:0dcf1992-d964-4efb-be4e-6e49df0a4185] [signal:334536ae-c941-4042-83ed-de5ab13f4c8e] [signal:69f9c8b7-9295-48fd-ba67-57027c2402fa] [signal:a1ff8d7d-6d0a-4ae7-8e3f-9c0a8841c226] [signal:b2ba0864-748a-47f4-b3b5-18b2b08d4885]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether these usability issues occur in other markets or vehicle lines. [signal:0dcf1992-d964-4efb-be4e-6e49df0a4185] [signal:334536ae-c941-4042-83ed-de5ab13f4c8e] [signal:69f9c8b7-9295-48fd-ba67-57027c2402fa] [signal:a1ff8d7d-6d0a-4ae7-8e3f-9c0a8841c226] [signal:b2ba0864-748a-47f4-b3b5-18b2b08d4885]
They also do not establish how often customers understand the camera’s purpose or the prerequisites for remote use without assistance. [signal:334536ae-c941-4042-83ed-de5ab13f4c8e] [signal:b2ba0864-748a-47f4-b3b5-18b2b08d4885]

value.title: Driving experience and technology are praised
value.summary: In the provided examples, customers praise the driving experience, comfort, handling and technology. Positive comments come from owners of F70, G60 and G70 vehicles in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Customers praise smooth, enjoyable driving, responsive handling and comfort.
Examples span Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The provided examples mainly express satisfaction rather than a clear problem with driving dynamics, chassis or overall technology. Customers describe enjoyable, smooth driving and positive handling, comfort and technology experiences. [signal:0c3fab39-5570-49be-b565-7640e9b2dc7c] [signal:13471228-dff3-4c5c-a9d8-95ea62fa71fc]

## What customers say
Customers praise driving pleasure and ride comfort, including a report of responsive, nimble handling and good ride quality in wet weather. [signal:0c3fab39-5570-49be-b565-7640e9b2dc7c] [signal:13471228-dff3-4c5c-a9d8-95ea62fa71fc]

Technology is also valued: one G60 owner calls it solid, while another says they love the technology in the car. [signal:0c3fab39-5570-49be-b565-7640e9b2dc7c] [signal:0c5d778d-e588-4362-a1fa-15239a49ae6c]

## Differences between markets
The provided examples include positive driving feedback from Europe, the USA and Rest of World. [signal:049253cc-2f8f-498a-bbe5-3b6c37188d32] [signal:104a081a-f9e0-42c5-8891-e2c6f9052c5e] [signal:0116be71-1f1c-4060-b2c9-e474f7dbd32b]

The examples cover F70, G60 and G70 vehicles; they do not establish whether experiences differ by market or vehicle line. [signal:0d015b4a-4ade-4c24-9560-79223bdc5cd2] [signal:12b03a0a-5f6e-44eb-8c45-dde980318c37] [signal:01a33685-40d7-4adb-97ef-07228703c7da]

## Open questions
How representative are these positive examples of the full set of 251 signals? [signal:0c3fab39-5570-49be-b565-7640e9b2dc7c] [signal:13471228-dff3-4c5c-a9d8-95ea62fa71fc]

value.title: Driving enjoyment alongside excessive or complicated technology
value.summary: Drivers praise the cars’ enjoyment and quality on the road, while some F70 and G70 owners find the technology excessive or complicated. One F70 owner also says the new technology makes parts of the drive less fun than in their previous 128ti.
highlights: Some drivers enjoy the cars, but others find the technology excessive or lessens driving enjoyment.
Signals cover F70 owners in Europe and G70 owners in Rest of World and the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers value the cars’ driving experience, but some say technology is excessive, complicated, or detracts from enjoyment. [signal:02a25daf-d97e-4a47-a272-88eb3627f9a3] [signal:1210ee2a-f449-458e-9330-508b96d78ad3] [signal:6a1e1432-f074-431d-8196-b861457eb2cf]

## What customers say
An F70 owner says the car is less fun in certain areas than their previous 128ti and feels that new technology has spoiled parts of the experience. [signal:02a25daf-d97e-4a47-a272-88eb3627f9a3]
Another F70 owner says they enjoy driving the car but find the technology excessive, particularly the steering-wheel controls, whose purpose they do not understand. [signal:1210ee2a-f449-458e-9330-508b96d78ad3]
A G70 owner in Rest of World describes the technology as somewhat complicated while still calling the car lovely to drive. [signal:6a1e1432-f074-431d-8196-b861457eb2cf]
Other owners describe the F70 as lovely to drive and the G70 as wonderful and expressive. [signal:378aa355-60e0-4427-a994-fa1cb56c1f80] [signal:b12f2aec-de56-41d9-ac2b-2f27841ec151]

## Differences between markets
In Europe, F70 owners report both strong driving enjoyment and concerns about excessive technology; one says it reduces enjoyment compared with their previous car. [signal:02a25daf-d97e-4a47-a272-88eb3627f9a3] [signal:1210ee2a-f449-458e-9330-508b96d78ad3] [signal:378aa355-60e0-4427-a994-fa1cb56c1f80]
The Rest of World G70 owner mentions complicated technology alongside a positive driving experience, while the USA G70 owner describes the car as wonderful and expressive to drive. [signal:6a1e1432-f074-431d-8196-b861457eb2cf] [signal:b12f2aec-de56-41d9-ac2b-2f27841ec151]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish which technologies reduce driving enjoyment, or whether the concerns differ between F70 and G70. [signal:02a25daf-d97e-4a47-a272-88eb3627f9a3] [signal:1210ee2a-f449-458e-9330-508b96d78ad3] [signal:6a1e1432-f074-431d-8196-b861457eb2cf]

value.title: Driving technology can be enjoyable but less intuitive to control
value.summary: Drivers value the enjoyable dynamics and advancing technology, but some find the move to touchscreen controls and the range of in-car apps difficult or distracting. These concerns appear in feedback from European F70 and US G70 owners.
highlights: Some drivers find touchscreen controls and in-car apps less usable or distracting while driving.
Concerns appear in Europe on F70 and in the USA on G70; positive driving feedback also spans these markets.
Hyundai is described as having more distracting alerts; no direct driving-dynamics comparison is given.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers praise the enjoyable, smooth driving experience and say BMW technology continues to advance, but some feedback points to reduced control flexibility and distracting or cumbersome in-car technology. [signal:016fe2ce-f7df-44c4-8896-aeb84dd6c9c3] [signal:10c20772-ce21-4a70-bec4-ca828dd6977a] [signal:1164fd93-e232-45c8-b8fa-e20cd2e12fac]

One European F70 owner misses iDrive and physical climate controls, and says the driver display is less flexible than in their previous BMW. [signal:01d606cd-8e19-4226-93b5-d1f2e7594dad] A US G70 owner says there are too many apps available while driving. [signal:1164fd93-e232-45c8-b8fa-e20cd2e12fac]

## What customers say
Positive feedback includes a smooth, relaxing drive, enjoyable handling, and technology that continues to advance while driving remains fun. [signal:016fe2ce-f7df-44c4-8896-aeb84dd6c9c3] [signal:0e1cf2d9-9b5c-4158-bd8c-29f59f99e5ae] [signal:10c20772-ce21-4a70-bec4-ca828dd6977a]

The concerns are about interaction as well as driving: one owner prefers physical climate controls and a more flexible driver display, while another objects to the number of apps available on the move. [signal:01d606cd-8e19-4226-93b5-d1f2e7594dad] [signal:1164fd93-e232-45c8-b8fa-e20cd2e12fac]

## Differences between markets
In the sampled feedback, a European F70 owner raises concerns about touchscreen climate controls and driver-display flexibility. [signal:01d606cd-8e19-4226-93b5-d1f2e7594dad] A US G70 owner reports too many apps while driving. [signal:1164fd93-e232-45c8-b8fa-e20cd2e12fac] Positive comments on driving enjoyment and technology also appear in Europe and the USA. [signal:016fe2ce-f7df-44c4-8896-aeb84dd6c9c3] [signal:0e1cf2d9-9b5c-4158-bd8c-29f59f99e5ae] [signal:10c20772-ce21-4a70-bec4-ca828dd6977a]

A European F70 owner contrasts the BMW favorably with a Hyundai, describing the Hyundai's alerts as distracting; this is an alert-noise comparison, not a direct comparison of driving dynamics. [signal:0715fa9b-1e90-4bda-9265-78399151fe08]

## Open questions
The feedback does not establish how widespread the control and app concerns are across the 156 signals, or whether they differ by model, market, or driver. [signal:01d606cd-8e19-4226-93b5-d1f2e7594dad] [signal:1164fd93-e232-45c8-b8fa-e20cd2e12fac]

value.title: Strong acceleration and enjoyable driving are valued
value.summary: Drivers in Europe and the Rest of World praise the cars’ strong acceleration and enjoyable driving; European F70 drivers also value the boost function for overtaking and joining a short on-ramp.
highlights: Drivers praise strong acceleration and enjoyable driving.
Signals cover two F70s in Europe and one G70 in the Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals describe a valued driving experience: drivers praise strong acceleration and enjoyable driving. [signal:02bcf3ec-f643-4a3b-9b6f-84b3690bd4a5] [signal:bfc95190-b25b-41d1-9571-4d865b04eb2f] European F70 drivers also say the boost function helps with overtaking and joining a road with a short run-in. [signal:bfc95190-b25b-41d1-9571-4d865b04eb2f] [signal:d98f6181-3daa-43da-a6f4-17faaa0cf131]

## What customers say
A Rest of World G70 driver calls the car powerful and fun to drive. [signal:02bcf3ec-f643-4a3b-9b6f-84b3690bd4a5] European F70 drivers praise its strong pull, quicker pickup, and lack of the lag they experienced in the previous model. [signal:bfc95190-b25b-41d1-9571-4d865b04eb2f] [signal:d98f6181-3daa-43da-a6f4-17faaa0cf131]

## Differences between markets
The two European F70 signals praise strong acceleration and the boost function, while the Rest of World G70 signal praises power and driving enjoyment. [signal:bfc95190-b25b-41d1-9571-4d865b04eb2f] [signal:d98f6181-3daa-43da-a6f4-17faaa0cf131] [signal:02bcf3ec-f643-4a3b-9b6f-84b3690bd4a5] The signals do not report a disagreement between markets. [signal:02bcf3ec-f643-4a3b-9b6f-84b3690bd4a5] [signal:bfc95190-b25b-41d1-9571-4d865b04eb2f] [signal:d98f6181-3daa-43da-a6f4-17faaa0cf131]

## Open questions
The signals do not provide competitor comparisons. [signal:02bcf3ec-f643-4a3b-9b6f-84b3690bd4a5] [signal:bfc95190-b25b-41d1-9571-4d865b04eb2f] [signal:d98f6181-3daa-43da-a6f4-17faaa0cf131]

value.title: Overall driving experience earns positive feedback
value.summary: Customers in the USA and Rest of World describe their overall driving experience positively. Feedback covers G60 and G70 vehicles but does not identify specific driving-dynamics or chassis attributes.
highlights: Customers report positive overall driving experiences.
The sample includes 6 USA and 2 Rest of World signals across G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The available feedback values the overall driving experience, but does not specify particular driving-dynamics or chassis attributes. [signal:01621b6e-9754-4ea2-bc0f-c5b2474709ea] [signal:659620e1-47ff-4de1-9a3e-13953c5c47f5] [signal:8ff7f8d3-3779-4bbc-bd81-56c081f98b82] [signal:9c0372ff-de2b-4b08-b529-b25b568d475c]

## What customers say
USA customers describe their overall experience as going well, excellent, or good, and one calls the driving experience great. [signal:01621b6e-9754-4ea2-bc0f-c5b2474709ea] [signal:0304712c-21d7-421f-ab79-e12d27ea9444] [signal:118fd384-44f8-4f4e-bbc9-81bfc4c588c3] [signal:828f2bfd-b8f3-43b9-b05c-71e6c8849b19] [signal:8fb007af-8f52-4d40-ab5a-3fd56957e0ac] [signal:9c0372ff-de2b-4b08-b529-b25b568d475c] Rest of World customers say they are satisfied with the driving and software, or happy with how the vehicle drives. [signal:659620e1-47ff-4de1-9a3e-13953c5c47f5] [signal:8ff7f8d3-3779-4bbc-bd81-56c081f98b82]

## Differences between markets
Positive feedback appears in both the USA and Rest of World sample; the signals do not establish a difference in sentiment between markets. [signal:01621b6e-9754-4ea2-bc0f-c5b2474709ea] [signal:659620e1-47ff-4de1-9a3e-13953c5c47f5]

## Open questions
- Which specific driving-dynamics or chassis characteristics are customers responding to?
- Are there specific driving concerns that are not captured in these comments?

value.title: Early ownership issues temper an otherwise positive driving experience
value.summary: F70 owners in Europe praise the driving experience, but one reports two issues within the first three months and another describes a delayed grille fitting.
highlights: Early issues and a delayed grille fitting detract from positive ownership experiences.
Both signals are from F70 owners in Europe.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The driving experience is praised, but one owner says two issues arose within the car’s first three months [signal:046bbe31-daa8-4682-a3e6-ec09e7b2ab49]. Another owner describes a requested black grille not being fitted before collection because the part had not arrived [signal:04ad9284-88bf-4f6e-8070-d56004da7d7c].

## What customers say
One owner says the car gives a “fantastic drive” and worries that further problems could lower their rating [signal:046bbe31-daa8-4682-a3e6-ec09e7b2ab49]. Another says they enjoy driving the car, but calls the grille issue annoying [signal:04ad9284-88bf-4f6e-8070-d56004da7d7c].

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Europe and concern the F70 [signal:046bbe31-daa8-4682-a3e6-ec09e7b2ab49] [signal:04ad9284-88bf-4f6e-8070-d56004da7d7c]. The signals describe different concerns: early issues in one account and a delayed grille fitting in the other [signal:046bbe31-daa8-4682-a3e6-ec09e7b2ab49] [signal:04ad9284-88bf-4f6e-8070-d56004da7d7c].

## Open questions
What were the two early issues, and were they related to driving dynamics or technology? [signal:046bbe31-daa8-4682-a3e6-ec09e7b2ab49] The available account does not say whether or when the grille was eventually fitted [signal:04ad9284-88bf-4f6e-8070-d56004da7d7c].

value.title: Driving praised, but range and screen-based controls raise concerns
value.summary: Drivers across Europe and the USA praise the cars’ comfort, performance, efficiency and driving feel. Some European F70 feedback raises concerns about screen-based climate controls and the loss of independent heating controls, while a US G60 driver is concerned about expected range.
highlights: Driving is widely praised, but range expectations and screen-based climate controls concern some drivers.
Concerns appear in Europe F70 and USA G60 feedback; the sample also includes Europe G60 and USA G70.
Mercedes and Porsche are mentioned as previous cars, without a direct comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The supplied feedback is largely positive about driving, comfort, power and efficiency, but includes concerns about expected range and finding climate controls on the screen. [signal:00488bc7-a99a-4cc8-b78a-bae864a19498] [signal:a54fa8db-b8f3-46bf-b49b-a5345fdfd0f2] [signal:a2320e32-ea17-4ca6-a120-aca71a09d6b6]

One F70 driver also misses the independent heating controls in a previous car. [signal:44e22df9-be97-4e2c-8ddb-958ad0520f28]

## What customers say
F70 drivers describe the car as smooth, comfortable, enjoyable to drive and economical; one says its steering reacts better than that of their previous BMW 120. [signal:00488bc7-a99a-4cc8-b78a-bae864a19498] [signal:07c72c47-c845-4df5-befb-a4f395f37515] [signal:7cfd1c29-fdef-42b1-b896-76fbcd1fd995] [signal:a2320e32-ea17-4ca6-a120-aca71a09d6b6]

G60 drivers praise comfort, power and driving enjoyment; a US driver says the expected range is a concern, while another says range suits a daily commute. [signal:5f94c939-c799-46ed-90b8-d89a03f14f25] [signal:a54fa8db-b8f3-46bf-b49b-a5345fdfd0f2] [signal:fee92ec3-a968-4b24-a6d4-f92cf8ec4f1e]

One European F70 driver says locating the climate controls on the screen takes their eyes off the road for too long. Another finds the absence of a paper handbook annoying and misses independent heating controls. [signal:a2320e32-ea17-4ca6-a120-aca71a09d6b6] [signal:44e22df9-be97-4e2c-8ddb-958ad0520f28]

## Differences between markets
The supplied European feedback includes positive comments on F70 and G60 driving experience, alongside F70 concerns about screen-based climate controls and heating controls. [signal:00488bc7-a99a-4cc8-b78a-bae864a19498] [signal:5f94c939-c799-46ed-90b8-d89a03f14f25] [signal:a2320e32-ea17-4ca6-a120-aca71a09d6b6] [signal:44e22df9-be97-4e2c-8ddb-958ad0520f28]

US feedback praises driving and hybrid performance in the G70 and G60; one US G60 driver also expresses concern about expected range. [signal:2bf8a2c5-33f4-41e5-8fcb-cadb466aa275] [signal:a54fa8db-b8f3-46bf-b49b-a5345fdfd0f2] [signal:fee92ec3-a968-4b24-a6d4-f92cf8ec4f1e]

## Open questions
How widespread are concerns about expected range among G60 drivers, given that one US driver flags it and another says the range suits their commute? [signal:a54fa8db-b8f3-46bf-b49b-a5345fdfd0f2] [signal:fee92ec3-a968-4b24-a6d4-f92cf8ec4f1e]

How often do drivers find screen-based climate controls distracting or miss independent heating controls? [signal:a2320e32-ea17-4ca6-a120-aca71a09d6b6] [signal:44e22df9-be97-4e2c-8ddb-958ad0520f28]

value.title: Smooth, comfortable driving feel is highly valued
value.summary: Customers describe the driving experience as smooth, comfortable, luxurious and enjoyable across several vehicle lines and markets. One i5 owner explicitly favors it over a Tesla.
highlights: Customers value a smooth, comfortable and enjoyable driving experience.
Signals span USA (6), Europe (4) and Rest of World (1), across F70, G60 and G70.
One USA i5 owner says it rides better than other BMWs owned and compares it favorably with Tesla.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals describe driving feel as a valued strength rather than a complaint: customers praise the mix of sportiness and comfort, smoothness, quietness and enjoyment. [signal:01a70f2c-42c8-426a-ac41-6838c2a6c07b] [signal:1ededc83-7264-4bdd-8f37-e383fe9fa795] [signal:5ce8e731-3456-41d1-9b68-700b62a5c6db]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner calls the sporty-and-comfortable balance the best part of the driving feel. [signal:01a70f2c-42c8-426a-ac41-6838c2a6c07b] Another USA G60 owner describes the i5 as quiet, smooth, powerful and better-riding than other BMWs they have owned. [signal:1ededc83-7264-4bdd-8f37-e383fe9fa795]

Europe F70 owners describe the car as easy to drive, quick, efficient and smooth, and say it brings back driving pleasure. [signal:5ce8e731-3456-41d1-9b68-700b62a5c6db] [signal:f5e4588b-da60-4fee-83bd-af5b9c9b9464] USA G70 owners praise its smooth start, enjoyable drive and luxurious feel. [signal:c77ae80a-53ce-4b03-9285-5891f150d031] [signal:f250b1fb-414c-46ed-9a98-4f97bfb0bbd8]

One USA i5 owner says there is no comparison with a brother's Tesla and describes the i5 as retaining the qualities they expect from a BMW and luxury car. [signal:1ededc83-7264-4bdd-8f37-e383fe9fa795]

## Differences between markets
The positive comments come from the USA (6 signals), Europe (4) and Rest of World (1); none of the supplied signals reports a negative driving-feel experience. [signal:01a70f2c-42c8-426a-ac41-6838c2a6c07b] [signal:1ededc83-7264-4bdd-8f37-e383fe9fa795] [signal:773e1ac7-30d8-4f33-8f89-ba052f6e8f7b] [signal:aee64a9a-4739-4f86-946a-f03342f7d53f] [signal:c77ae80a-53ce-4b03-9285-5891f150d031] [signal:f250b1fb-414c-46ed-9a98-4f97bfb0bbd8] [signal:397dc687-173d-476b-b74b-ec9ced26eeeb] [signal:5ce8e731-3456-41d1-9b68-700b62a5c6db] [signal:604f50d1-ad4e-4906-878d-df858b2d5673] [signal:f5e4588b-da60-4fee-83bd-af5b9c9b9464] [signal:4aa8ba0e-1e94-4f5e-b3b9-39cb111c8481] The signals cover F70, G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:397dc687-173d-476b-b74b-ec9ced26eeeb] [signal:5ce8e731-3456-41d1-9b68-700b62a5c6db] [signal:f5e4588b-da60-4fee-83bd-af5b9c9b9464] [signal:01a70f2c-42c8-426a-ac41-6838c2a6c07b] [signal:1ededc83-7264-4bdd-8f37-e383fe9fa795] [signal:604f50d1-ad4e-4906-878d-df858b2d5673] [signal:773e1ac7-30d8-4f33-8f89-ba052f6e8f7b] [signal:aee64a9a-4739-4f86-946a-f03342f7d53f] [signal:c77ae80a-53ce-4b03-9285-5891f150d031] [signal:f250b1fb-414c-46ed-9a98-4f97bfb0bbd8] [signal:4aa8ba0e-1e94-4f5e-b3b9-39cb111c8481]

## Open questions
The comments praise overall feel but do not specify which individual chassis or comfort attributes drive that experience. [signal:01a70f2c-42c8-426a-ac41-6838c2a6c07b] [signal:1ededc83-7264-4bdd-8f37-e383fe9fa795] [signal:5ce8e731-3456-41d1-9b68-700b62a5c6db]

value.title: Driving enjoyment is a valued part of the experience
value.summary: Customers across several markets describe driving as fun and enjoyable, and one values the feeling of being connected to the car.
highlights: Customers value fun, enjoyable driving and a strong feeling of connection with the car.
Signals cover F70 (6), G60 (2) and G70 (1) across Rest of World, Europe and USA.
One customer says the car drives and feels better than other cars.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The available signals describe driving enjoyment as a strength, rather than reporting a specific problem. Customers call driving fun and enjoyable, with one describing a strong feeling of being one with the car. [signal:13b8411f-ab03-48f9-811c-ee2360b5dbd6] [signal:1b63dc30-3ab2-478b-b8be-48f0d004b0be] [signal:5080e565-a83f-4eed-88ea-d78f818c0c40]

## What customers say
F70 drivers describe the car as fun to drive and say it runs well. [signal:3813cd38-e0b6-4a08-a7da-32e9efa0cfe5] [signal:57cf228f-db8b-45d1-b8e4-3183dd2ce9f0] A G60 driver says it drives and feels better than other cars. [signal:0465313b-3cbf-4f36-8c76-d5ba8cb60a74]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals are positive in Rest of World, Europe and the USA; they do not show a market-level disagreement. [signal:13b8411f-ab03-48f9-811c-ee2360b5dbd6] [signal:5080e565-a83f-4eed-88ea-d78f818c0c40] [signal:a40d5ecf-8856-4bdd-9ab0-944dba0e9c8d] The supplied examples include F70, G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:13b8411f-ab03-48f9-811c-ee2360b5dbd6] [signal:0465313b-3cbf-4f36-8c76-d5ba8cb60a74] [signal:a40d5ecf-8856-4bdd-9ab0-944dba0e9c8d]

## Open questions
What specific driving characteristics create the enjoyment customers describe? The supplied comments praise the overall experience but do not identify those characteristics. [signal:13b8411f-ab03-48f9-811c-ee2360b5dbd6] [signal:1b63dc30-3ab2-478b-b8be-48f0d004b0be]

value.title: F70 driving feel and dimensions suit Japanese roads
value.summary: Drivers in Japan value the F70’s road-friendly dimensions and modest sporty feel, with one signal also praising its fuel economy. The feedback describes enjoyable driving, including for weekend outings.
highlights: F70 dimensions and driving feel are valued for Japanese roads.
Both signals are from Rest of World and concern the F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
No specific driving or chassis problem is reported; the two signals describe positive feedback on the F70’s dimensions and driving experience in Japan. [signal:0a55319c-ce2e-4f88-be37-e5a78a067c13] [signal:fac4e1f8-5ee9-4eea-818f-f510f33079c8]

Another says the F70’s 1,800 mm overall width feels ideal on Japanese roads, and praises its enjoyable drive and fuel economy. [signal:fac4e1f8-5ee9-4eea-818f-f510f33079c8]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Rest of World and refer to driving in Japan; no other market is represented. [signal:0a55319c-ce2e-4f88-be37-e5a78a067c13] [signal:fac4e1f8-5ee9-4eea-818f-f510f33079c8]

The signals do not establish how broadly these views are shared among F70 drivers in Japan. [signal:0a55319c-ce2e-4f88-be37-e5a78a067c13] [signal:fac4e1f8-5ee9-4eea-818f-f510f33079c8]

value.title: Hands-free parking assist feels intimidating to one F70 driver
value.summary: One European F70 driver finds the hands-free parking assist intimidating and expects it to take practice. Other signals value the F70’s straightforward driving and handling.
highlights: Hands-free parking assist feels intimidating and takes practice to learn.
Signals cover the F70 in Europe and Rest of World; one European driver mentions this concern.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One F70 driver says the hands-free assist parking option is intimidating and will need quite a bit of practice. [signal:067799e8-b0b3-4c05-bfe3-43e49b258fe1]

## What customers say
The same driver otherwise describes the car as quick to respond and straightforward to drive as an automatic. [signal:067799e8-b0b3-4c05-bfe3-43e49b258fe1] Other F70 drivers describe it as easy to drive, handle, or park. [signal:12193b7c-9e6d-474c-b24a-c9acdaecc68f] [signal:51d4d4f2-3ae0-4998-9a3b-e8dd7462c121] [signal:69e92ee4-7aee-4959-a416-324b484e6440] [signal:94a6276a-2fe5-484c-ae8f-c8fd72b36636] [signal:9ad0dd9e-93d9-49f6-9b57-34c6c123292a] [signal:9b6e4103-403c-472e-8ca3-8d1ec1107035] [signal:b77858a5-61b0-4126-a7d1-5d0931ea4cae] [signal:e8da36eb-af17-4a7f-a6dc-1b767c2a4668]

## Differences between markets
The European signals include the hands-free parking-assist concern and positive comments about handling. [signal:067799e8-b0b3-4c05-bfe3-43e49b258fe1] [signal:b77858a5-61b0-4126-a7d1-5d0931ea4cae] [signal:e8da36eb-af17-4a7f-a6dc-1b767c2a4668] Rest of World signals praise the F70’s ease of driving, handling, or parking. [signal:12193b7c-9e6d-474c-b24a-c9acdaecc68f] [signal:51d4d4f2-3ae0-4998-9a3b-e8dd7462c121] [signal:69e92ee4-7aee-4959-a416-324b484e6440] [signal:94a6276a-2fe5-484c-ae8f-c8fd72b36636] [signal:9ad0dd9e-93d9-49f6-9b57-34c6c123292a] [signal:9b6e4103-403c-472e-8ca3-8d1ec1107035]

## Open questions
The signals do not explain what specifically makes the hands-free parking assist intimidating, or whether other drivers share this concern. [signal:067799e8-b0b3-4c05-bfe3-43e49b258fe1]

value.title: F70 driving praised for ease, power and sporty feel
value.summary: Sampled F70 owners value driving that feels easy, responsive and fun, with a sense of safety and useful power. One owner also notes that rear-seat comfort could be better.
highlights: F70 driving is described as easy, responsive, powerful and fun.
The sample includes 6 Europe and 3 Rest of World signals, all for F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The sampled feedback is predominantly positive: F70 owners value easy handling, responsive driving, power and a sporty or fun feel. [signal:08462947-e14c-4233-a261-30cd5f8fb704] [signal:17883d0b-76cf-42e7-a707-23e519fed8c7] [signal:46d42b77-4df8-4f81-b8e5-396599aebcdb] [signal:7bcda7d1-8139-49d5-a084-f60129668f78]

## What customers say
Owners describe the car as straightforward and easy to drive, with a feeling of safety and a sporty character. [signal:08462947-e14c-4233-a261-30cd5f8fb704] [signal:376426ea-e503-4012-9249-b7b0168fe5bf]
They also praise its power and fun driving experience. [signal:17883d0b-76cf-42e7-a707-23e519fed8c7] [signal:46d42b77-4df8-4f81-b8e5-396599aebcdb] One owner says rear-seat comfort could be better. [signal:9cc19f2b-5405-402f-a01f-873ef915e2dd]

## Differences between markets
The sample includes positive driving feedback from Europe and Rest of World; it does not establish a difference between the markets. [signal:08462947-e14c-4233-a261-30cd5f8fb704] [signal:46d42b77-4df8-4f81-b8e5-396599aebcdb] [signal:7bcda7d1-8139-49d5-a084-f60129668f78]

## Open questions
Do the positive driving impressions and the rear-seat comfort concern vary across markets or among F70 owners?

value.title: Easy handling and comfort valued in F70
value.summary: Rest of World F70 customers value easy, stress-free handling alongside comfort and luxurious equipment.
highlights: Customers value easy, stress-free handling and comfort.
Both signals are from Rest of World customers describing the F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers value handling that feels easy and stress-free while remaining comfortable. [signal:0caa147e-373c-4765-b176-f5f00c31224d] [signal:a481c167-db4f-4511-8a1e-33c765e7373c]

## What customers say
One customer describes the experience as simple to handle and stress-free, and also values the luxurious equipment. [signal:0caa147e-373c-4765-b176-f5f00c31224d] Another values ease of handling alongside comfort. [signal:a481c167-db4f-4511-8a1e-33c765e7373c]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Rest of World customers describing the F70, so the signals do not show a market difference. [signal:0caa147e-373c-4765-b176-f5f00c31224d] [signal:a481c167-db4f-4511-8a1e-33c765e7373c]

## Open questions
The signals do not explain which aspects of handling or comfort customers value most. [signal:0caa147e-373c-4765-b176-f5f00c31224d] [signal:a481c167-db4f-4511-8a1e-33c765e7373c]

value.title: F70 driving dynamics and technology are valued by owners
value.summary: F70 owners in Rest of World and Europe praise its driving dynamics and broader functions. European feedback also values the smoother, quieter ride, improved acceleration and range, and curved-screen system.
highlights: F70 owners praise its agile handling and several driving and technology functions.
Signals cover F70 feedback from Rest of World and Europe.
A European signal says the curved-screen system compares favorably with similar systems in other cars.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals describe positive experiences rather than a reported problem: a Rest of World owner praises the F70's agile handling, while a European owner calls it a major step up from the F40. [signal:098cd14d-49ed-46ab-b052-5c1d6455c01c] [signal:a85afde8-5848-48d8-a654-ded6474b3258]

## What customers say
A Rest of World owner says the F70 is more agile and enjoyable to drive, and notes improved fuel economy with the mild hybrid. [signal:098cd14d-49ed-46ab-b052-5c1d6455c01c]

A European owner praises the smoother ride, quieter cabin, increased acceleration, better fuel economy, regenerative braking, and the range gain associated with a bigger fuel tank. [signal:a85afde8-5848-48d8-a654-ded6474b3258]

The European owner says the curved screen for driver information, navigation, and climate works well and is better than similar systems in many other cars. [signal:a85afde8-5848-48d8-a654-ded6474b3258]

## Differences between markets
The Rest of World signal emphasizes agility, driving enjoyment, and fuel economy. [signal:098cd14d-49ed-46ab-b052-5c1d6455c01c]

The Europe signal covers ride comfort, cabin quietness, acceleration, fuel economy, regenerative braking, range, and the curved-screen system. [signal:a85afde8-5848-48d8-a654-ded6474b3258]

## Open questions
Do these positive views of driving dynamics and technology functions hold across more F70 owners and markets? [signal:098cd14d-49ed-46ab-b052-5c1d6455c01c] [signal:a85afde8-5848-48d8-a654-ded6474b3258]

value.title: Strong driving feel valued across markets

value.title: Light steering makes the F70 easy to handle
value.summary: F70 drivers in the Rest of World value the light steering feel because it makes the car easy to drive and handle.
highlights: Light steering feel is valued for easy driving and handling.
Two signals from Rest of World F70 drivers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers value the F70’s light steering feel because they say it makes the car easy to drive and handle. [signal:0df501f5-0eba-4600-bc26-93a389ee0e86] [signal:1427cb84-2943-463b-98c9-c5659eb289df]

## What customers say
One driver says the steering feels very light and makes the car easy to drive. [signal:0df501f5-0eba-4600-bc26-93a389ee0e86] Another, who moved from a 3 Series to a 1 Series, says the steering is light and easy to handle, requiring only small turns. [signal:1427cb84-2943-463b-98c9-c5659eb289df]

## Differences between markets

value.title: Driving feel improves, but settings and response draw complaints
value.summary: F70 drivers in Europe describe improved driving feel and performance, but some report frustrating settings access and delays or pauses in drive response.
highlights: Improved driving feel is valued, while settings access and response issues are reported.
Signals cover 6 Europe reports about the F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 drivers praise smoother driving and improved performance, while others report difficulty reaching settings and delays or pauses in drive response. [signal:0a32f631-cbc9-499d-9d32-a3e054b39780] [signal:20e3d439-ba7a-479e-8364-4988ecd5a5ac] [signal:61ecccc4-57c8-43e6-bc9d-d20ad7582e10] [signal:b24f36d1-6f3e-4fcf-957e-a03531553bfb] [signal:bbd6ae76-f7cf-4a66-a7e0-cee0e89b8caa]

## What customers say
One driver says the car is much better than the previous model and appreciates that stop-start now works smoothly. [signal:0a32f631-cbc9-499d-9d32-a3e054b39780] Another describes smoother acceleration and less brake snatch, while a further driver praises improved performance and standard active suspension. [signal:61ecccc4-57c8-43e6-bc9d-d20ad7582e10] [signal:b24f36d1-6f3e-4fcf-957e-a03531553bfb]

The same signals also describe recurring friction: one driver finds it irritating to turn off the speed-limit warning on every drive, and another says customisation settings require extensive menu scrolling and the handbook is unclear. [signal:0a32f631-cbc9-499d-9d32-a3e054b39780] [signal:b24f36d1-6f3e-4fcf-957e-a03531553bfb] One driver reports a delay when shifting from drive to reverse and a pause when pulling away. [signal:bbd6ae76-f7cf-4a66-a7e0-cee0e89b8caa]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from Europe and concern the F70, so they do not provide a comparison between markets. [signal:0a32f631-cbc9-499d-9d32-a3e054b39780] [signal:20e3d439-ba7a-479e-8364-4988ecd5a5ac] [signal:48d015cb-a317-4cc6-a798-64fd483913d0] [signal:61ecccc4-57c8-43e6-bc9d-d20ad7582e10] [signal:b24f36d1-6f3e-4fcf-957e-a03531553bfb] [signal:bbd6ae76-f7cf-4a66-a7e0-cee0e89b8caa]

## Open questions
- How often do drivers encounter the reported drive-to-reverse delay and pause when pulling away? [signal:bbd6ae76-f7cf-4a66-a7e0-cee0e89b8caa]
- Which settings are hardest to find, and how much does menu scrolling affect everyday use? [signal:b24f36d1-6f3e-4fcf-957e-a03531553bfb]

Drivers describe the F70 as pleasant or enjoyable to drive, but some raise concerns about whether its size or suspension suits families. [signal:115c808b-0f22-4426-97d5-2ced5b840bd6] [signal:f84ac552-6bb3-4b5c-9f32-40a0329a7d59]

## What customers say
Two European drivers praise the driving experience; one says the car feels a bit small for a family, while the other considers it right as a family car. [signal:115c808b-0f22-4426-97d5-2ced5b840bd6] [signal:891f2d79-75ad-49a0-8a85-9b62285e1571] A driver in the Rest of World also enjoys driving the car but questions whether its suspension suits families. ## Differences between markets
European signals include both a concern about family size and a positive view of the car as a family car. [signal:115c808b-0f22-4426-97d5-2ced5b840bd6] [signal:891f2d79-75ad-49a0-8a85-9b62285e1571] The Rest of World signal raises a concern about family suitability related to suspension. value.title: Driving technology feels less intuitive than the driving experience
value.summary: Drivers praise the ride and driving feel, but some say screen-based controls and driving-assistance functions are difficult or unsafe to use. These concerns appear in signals from Europe and the USA, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Driving technology and controls can feel difficult or unsafe to use.
Signals span Europe and the USA, and F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers describe the driving experience as comfortable, engaging or high quality, while also finding controls and technology less intuitive or harder to use while driving. [signal:5162c7c4-94dd-4b47-bc94-3c27844aa570] [signal:59a214cc-96e5-4579-919b-6ffddc6db5d8] [signal:68baa1e7-13aa-4859-a0e6-19eb67c32f27] [signal:b894e9d5-1baf-43cc-ac75-3352ea989f1c]

## What customers say
Drivers praise handling, ride comfort, acceleration and driving enjoyment. [signal:1b58d655-17ec-4267-b81d-a5a5df1f5e9e] [signal:59a214cc-96e5-4579-919b-6ffddc6db5d8] [signal:ee81c34c-3cdc-40a3-8a65-ffb0d4843e47]

Some say frequently used functions are buried in the touchscreen, making them difficult or unsafe to operate on the move; others miss physical steering-wheel controls. [signal:5162c7c4-94dd-4b47-bc94-3c27844aa570] [signal:59a214cc-96e5-4579-919b-6ffddc6db5d8] [signal:b894e9d5-1baf-43cc-ac75-3352ea989f1c]

Driving-assistance feedback is mixed: one driver says highway lane keeping and hands-off driving work very well, while another reports slow reactions when traffic merges ahead. [signal:08525cb0-8438-4c94-bd0f-d42b2127e74d] [signal:ee81c34c-3cdc-40a3-8a65-ffb0d4843e47]

Other reported concerns include limited sport-mode adjustment and drive modes that one driver considers of little benefit. [signal:fec291bc-7748-4575-8b23-54790d99b3d3] [signal:59a214cc-96e5-4579-919b-6ffddc6db5d8]

## Differences between markets
The signals include both positive driving feedback and control or technology complaints from Europe and the USA. [signal:1b58d655-17ec-4267-b81d-a5a5df1f5e9e] [signal:5162c7c4-94dd-4b47-bc94-3c27844aa570] [signal:68baa1e7-13aa-4859-a0e6-19eb67c32f27] [signal:b894e9d5-1baf-43cc-ac75-3352ea989f1c]

The examples cover F70, G60 and G70 vehicles; the provided signals do not establish whether the concerns differ by market or vehicle line. [signal:1b58d655-17ec-4267-b81d-a5a5df1f5e9e] [signal:ee81c34c-3cdc-40a3-8a65-ffb0d4843e47] [signal:68baa1e7-13aa-4859-a0e6-19eb67c32f27]

## Open questions
How frequently do drivers encounter the reported control and usability concerns, and do they vary by vehicle line or market? [signal:5162c7c4-94dd-4b47-bc94-3c27844aa570] [signal:b894e9d5-1baf-43cc-ac75-3352ea989f1c]

How consistently does driving assistance respond to vehicles merging into the lane? [signal:ee81c34c-3cdc-40a3-8a65-ffb0d4843e47]

Some Europe-based F70 owners enjoy the car but say its driving character does not meet their expectations for sharpness, power or engine sound. [signal:623c8e25-a79d-4017-8d37-5d109cc2672e]

F70 owners describe the car as enjoyable or nice to drive, while also saying it feels less sharp than the M140i, has muted and artificial engine sound, or lacks power compared with the Golf R. [signal:15e6c239-7a59-458b-af20-4a00a3e7817e] [signal:321cadfd-82af-4e48-acaa-4e060e73dcec] [signal:404bada2-1326-4bda-bcae-e5e6b376d792] [signal:4367fe01-c9bf-42de-ae06-d6edcccc95ac] One owner says the latest M135i drives better than its predecessor, but also says it has lost standard features. [signal:4af10ed6-3c3d-4975-b4af-4f558b7bf767] Other F70 complaints concern single-zone climate control and having functions buried in the screen. [signal:15e6c239-7a59-458b-af20-4a00a3e7817e] [signal:321cadfd-82af-4e48-acaa-4e060e73dcec] [signal:4af10ed6-3c3d-4975-b4af-4f558b7bf767]

The Europe F70 signals include both positive driving impressions and criticism of driving character and cabin technology. [signal:15e6c239-7a59-458b-af20-4a00a3e7817e] [signal:321cadfd-82af-4e48-acaa-4e060e73dcec] [signal:404bada2-1326-4bda-bcae-e5e6b376d792] [signal:4af10ed6-3c3d-4975-b4af-4f558b7bf767] The USA G70 signal focuses on wind and cabin noise rather than driving dynamics. [signal:623c8e25-a79d-4017-8d37-5d109cc2672e]

## Open questions
The available signals do not establish how widespread the reported driving, control or noise concerns are across owners. value.body_md:
## Problem
Both USA G60 drivers describe the driving experience positively, but report concerns about battery use or range in cold weather. [signal:3dab478f-4603-4f3b-933a-d3bd8bae273d] [signal:dffa7acc-24ee-477a-a1db-4732a63f118c]

[signal:3dab478f-4603-4f3b-933a-d3bd8bae273d] Another reports roughly 200 miles of range in temperatures below about 32°F, with normal driving. [signal:dffa7acc-24ee-477a-a1db-4732a63f118c]

One driver calls the driving experience incredible and says the technology is fun to use and works well. [signal:3dab478f-4603-4f3b-933a-d3bd8bae273d] The other says driving the car is good, with no complaints. [signal:dffa7acc-24ee-477a-a1db-4732a63f118c]

One driver also says the charging flap feels low-tech because it is not powered. [signal:3dab478f-4603-4f3b-933a-d3bd8bae273d]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA and G60; there is no market-to-market comparison in the signals. [signal:3dab478f-4603-4f3b-933a-d3bd8bae273d] [signal:dffa7acc-24ee-477a-a1db-4732a63f118c]

- Do drivers in other markets report similar experiences?

## Problem

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers praise the cars’ driving experience but report technology or comfort functions failing or underperforming. [signal:6538f2ba-f10c-41b3-a123-6480d6a25022] [signal:673c7a5a-9cad-406b-95ce-f16d6bfaa0be] [signal:80c89295-fdec-4a29-8713-96dc2acc5d93]

One F70 owner says both display modules have gone blank several times in below-zero temperatures. [signal:6538f2ba-f10c-41b3-a123-6480d6a25022] A G60 owner reports inconsistent computer behavior and says it once shut the car off while stopped. [signal:673c7a5a-9cad-406b-95ce-f16d6bfaa0be] Another F70 owner says the heated steering wheel gets only lukewarm and makes driving difficult given their medical condition. [signal:80c89295-fdec-4a29-8713-96dc2acc5d93]

## What customers say
The customers who report the display and computer issues also describe the car as driving very well or beautifully. [signal:6538f2ba-f10c-41b3-a123-6480d6a25022] [signal:673c7a5a-9cad-406b-95ce-f16d6bfaa0be] The F70 owner with the heated-wheel complaint says a MINI they previously owned and their husband’s i4 had better-performing heated wheels. [signal:80c89295-fdec-4a29-8713-96dc2acc5d93]

## Differences between markets
The two Europe signals concern F70 vehicles: one reports blank displays in below-zero temperatures, and the other reports insufficient steering-wheel heat. [signal:6538f2ba-f10c-41b3-a123-6480d6a25022] [signal:80c89295-fdec-4a29-8713-96dc2acc5d93] The USA signal concerns a G60 and reports inconsistent computer behavior, including one shutdown while stopped. [signal:673c7a5a-9cad-406b-95ce-f16d6bfaa0be]

## Open questions
Do the display and computer issues recur under conditions other than those described by the customers? [signal:6538f2ba-f10c-41b3-a123-6480d6a25022] [signal:673c7a5a-9cad-406b-95ce-f16d6bfaa0be] How often do customers experience insufficient heated steering-wheel performance, and in which vehicles and markets? [signal:80c89295-fdec-4a29-8713-96dc2acc5d93]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the F70 as enjoyable and easy to drive, while also reporting technology that is difficult to use, intrusive, unavailable or tied to extra cost. [signal:6ef6908b-10ea-44d2-9a00-6a86837df1a9] [signal:a259af55-93af-47a0-aeaf-c9da8c0f94de] [signal:a292ac9c-cb09-4fa4-a2bd-140a34989f87] [signal:d4ab6c12-27a2-4547-b5d3-6e42eed7a79a]

## What customers say
One driver says the computer system is not straightforward to use. [signal:6ef6908b-10ea-44d2-9a00-6a86837df1a9]

A customer says the door-handle button does not lock or unlock the car unless the function is paid for, and says similar access is standard on most cars, including basic versions. [signal:a259af55-93af-47a0-aeaf-c9da8c0f94de]

Customers mention missing auto high beam and remote boot operation, and one says the boot cannot be opened or closed using the remote key. [signal:a292ac9c-cb09-4fa4-a2bd-140a34989f87] [signal:e0df2189-a1b1-4d53-a735-f7f2aa2a9927]

value.title: Some drivers find newer BMWs less playful and engaging

highlights: Some drivers miss the playful or engaging feel they expect.
Signals cover F70 owners in Europe and Rest of World, and one G60 owner in the USA.
One USA owner says the G60 540 feels more like a Lexus than a sporty 540.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners describe reduced playfulness or engagement: one Rest of World F70 owner says the car’s playful side feels cut about in half, and a Europe F70 owner says it could feel more engaging. [signal:1944ec23-ec18-401f-91d3-530c6c2db751] [signal:6deb1bb5-4e70-4f52-8183-f03587375367]

## What customers say
A USA G60 540 owner says the car feels like it is trying to be a Lexus rather than the sporty 540 they previously knew. [signal:252b1d6e-f743-4cdf-963b-ac797383438e]
Other F70 owners report a more positive driving experience: one says driving feel improved versus the last model, and another says it drives far better than the previous version. [signal:331b0042-a0c8-4f4e-bd57-e61d18bc4c97] [signal:b96033aa-890c-4882-a0d7-e1202ea26c47]

## Differences between markets
The signals include mixed views from Rest of World F70 owners: one misses playfulness, while another says driving feel improved compared with the last model. [signal:1944ec23-ec18-401f-91d3-530c6c2db751] [signal:331b0042-a0c8-4f4e-bd57-e61d18bc4c97]
In Europe, one F70 owner says the car could feel more engaging but also says their previous car was a V8 M3, which they considered an unfair benchmark. [signal:6deb1bb5-4e70-4f52-8183-f03587375367]
The USA signal describes a G60 540 as less sporty than the owner's previous 540. [signal:252b1d6e-f743-4cdf-963b-ac797383438e]

## Open questions
How common is the reduced-playfulness or engagement concern across F70 and G60 owners, given the positive F70 comparisons in the signals? [signal:1944ec23-ec18-401f-91d3-530c6c2db751] [signal:6deb1bb5-4e70-4f52-8183-f03587375367] [signal:331b0042-a0c8-4f4e-bd57-e61d18bc4c97] [signal:b96033aa-890c-4882-a0d7-e1202ea26c47]

value.title: G60 driving enjoyment feedback is mixed

Signals cover four USA G60 owners: one complaint and three positive comments.
Two owners favorably compare BMW with Mercedes-Benz or Audi.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Feedback on G60 driving enjoyment is mixed: one owner says the car became disappointing after its newness faded and was less fun than their previous i3s, while three owners praise the car’s performance or enjoyment behind the wheel. [signal:77379c7b-f718-48cc-9bf8-d0a27504b1be] [signal:1f81c710-43c2-4f3e-b1e7-fe0b9446f5a4] [signal:79465f5d-905d-44f4-b224-ff645b3b252e] [signal:7d5b67bc-fbc5-4e88-a77b-869b4a6758fd]

## What customers say
One owner says their previous i3s was “by far much more fun” and describes the G60 as a mistake. [signal:77379c7b-f718-48cc-9bf8-d0a27504b1be]
Another says the 5 Series is better than their previous Mercedes-Benz vehicles in ride and performance. [signal:1f81c710-43c2-4f3e-b1e7-fe0b9446f5a4]
A third says the G60 is more enjoyable to drive than the Audi A8L they traded. [signal:79465f5d-905d-44f4-b224-ff645b3b252e]
A fourth says the 2026 530i surpasses earlier versions. [signal:7d5b67bc-fbc5-4e88-a77b-869b4a6758fd]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from USA G60 owners, so these signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:77379c7b-f718-48cc-9bf8-d0a27504b1be] [signal:1f81c710-43c2-4f3e-b1e7-fe0b9446f5a4] [signal:79465f5d-905d-44f4-b224-ff645b3b252e] [signal:7d5b67bc-fbc5-4e88-a77b-869b4a6758fd]

## Open questions
What aspects of the G60’s driving experience made one owner prefer their previous i3s, while others praised the G60’s performance or enjoyment? [signal:77379c7b-f718-48cc-9bf8-d0a27504b1be] [signal:1f81c710-43c2-4f3e-b1e7-fe0b9446f5a4] [signal:79465f5d-905d-44f4-b224-ff645b3b252e]

value.title: Wipers leave streaks and may activate too late
value.summary: Some US G60 and G70 owners report that the wipers leave streaks or fail to clear the windshield effectively; one G70 owner says they activate only when visibility is already very poor. The signals describe issues on both a brand-new vehicle and vehicles needing fresh blades.
highlights: Wipers leave streaks, clear poorly, or reportedly activate too late.
Four US complaints: one G60 and three G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners report streaking and ineffective windshield clearing, including on a brand-new vehicle [signal:20f12a0b-d93f-4fcf-be48-0dbc303803cb] [signal:2d124469-af6b-439e-bdc7-614ac8c27db0] [signal:ec9d620b-0cf2-4d23-9c77-30728a50abf3]. One G70 complaint says the wipers begin working only when visibility is nearly lost and clear the glass briefly [signal:4631ce5b-5b08-4d9e-94cd-c5cfb8594771].

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the wipers do not clear well in rain and feels replacement should not be needed on a new car [signal:20f12a0b-d93f-4fcf-be48-0dbc303803cb]. A G70 owner reports a streak when the wiper returns to its closed position and suspects the blade may need replacing [signal:2d124469-af6b-439e-bdc7-614ac8c27db0]. Another G70 owner says activation comes too late and wiping lasts only briefly [signal:4631ce5b-5b08-4d9e-94cd-c5cfb8594771]. A further G70 owner reports streaking despite cleaning the glass and blades, while describing the issue as not horrible [signal:ec9d620b-0cf2-4d23-9c77-30728a50abf3].

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA: one concerns a G60 and three concern a G70 [signal:20f12a0b-d93f-4fcf-be48-0dbc303803cb] [signal:2d124469-af6b-439e-bdc7-614ac8c27db0] [signal:4631ce5b-5b08-4d9e-94cd-c5cfb8594771] [signal:ec9d620b-0cf2-4d23-9c77-30728a50abf3]. No other market is represented in these signals [signal:20f12a0b-d93f-4fcf-be48-0dbc303803cb] [signal:2d124469-af6b-439e-bdc7-614ac8c27db0] [signal:4631ce5b-5b08-4d9e-94cd-c5cfb8594771] [signal:ec9d620b-0cf2-4d23-9c77-30728a50abf3].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported problems share a cause, or whether the delayed activation complaint is related to the streaking complaints [signal:20f12a0b-d93f-4fcf-be48-0dbc303803cb] [signal:2d124469-af6b-439e-bdc7-614ac8c27db0] [signal:4631ce5b-5b08-4d9e-94cd-c5cfb8594771] [signal:ec9d620b-0cf2-4d23-9c77-30728a50abf3].

value.title: Windshield wipers fail, clean poorly, or behave unexpectedly
