Five signals: three from USA G60/G70 vehicles and one from a Europe F70 vehicle; one additional signal is also from the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe several windshield-wiper concerns, including wipers that did not operate, poor cleaning when spraying water, streaks on wiper covers, and behavior that did not meet expectations. [signal:1df9bb69-98b5-4a85-9de0-86f03b1bd650] [signal:29644940-1f4a-467c-a84d-8f13ae557504] [signal:5ec554ec-be59-4800-93ab-c74a360d0868] [signal:6d70873b-e4e6-4680-8958-10c149ef3993] [signal:cea98b47-ba41-4c9d-9f40-0df430aa256c]

## What customers say
A G70 customer said the wipers would not operate after a rain event and a dead battery; the dealer replaced them, and the customer reported no further problems afterward. [signal:29644940-1f4a-467c-a84d-8f13ae557504]

Another G70 customer said the wipers did not work the first time he tried them, within about a week of purchase; the dealer found they had not been correctly connected, and they worked after connection. [signal:cea98b47-ba41-4c9d-9f40-0df430aa256c]

A G60 customer reported that the water shield barely cleaned when spraying water and left water dripping across the area. [signal:5ec554ec-be59-4800-93ab-c74a360d0868]

A different G60 customer reported white streaks on the wiper covers after roughly a week and believed they were present from the factory. [signal:1df9bb69-98b5-4a85-9de0-86f03b1bd650]

A Europe F70 customer described the wipers as not always behaving as expected, while characterizing the concern as minor. [signal:6d70873b-e4e6-4680-8958-10c149ef3993]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include reports from G60 and G70 customers: cover streaks, poor cleaning, and two early operating failures. [signal:1df9bb69-98b5-4a85-9de0-86f03b1bd650] [signal:5ec554ec-be59-4800-93ab-c74a360d0868] [signal:29644940-1f4a-467c-a84d-8f13ae557504] [signal:cea98b47-ba41-4c9d-9f40-0df430aa256c]

The Europe signal is from an F70 customer who described unexpected wiper behavior as a minor concern. [signal:6d70873b-e4e6-4680-8958-10c149ef3993]

## Open questions
Do the cover streaks and poor cleaning reflect separate concerns or a shared issue? [signal:1df9bb69-98b5-4a85-9de0-86f03b1bd650] [signal:5ec554ec-be59-4800-93ab-c74a360d0868]

What conditions preceded the two G70 operating failures, given that one report mentions a dead battery and rain event while the other mentions incorrect connection? [signal:29644940-1f4a-467c-a84d-8f13ae557504] [signal:cea98b47-ba41-4c9d-9f40-0df430aa256c]

What specific wiper behavior did the F70 customer find unexpected? [signal:6d70873b-e4e6-4680-8958-10c149ef3993]

value.title: Seat memory controls and position recall are confusing
value.summary: Some USA customers find seat-memory controls unclear or poorly placed, and some are unsure why their saved seat position is not applied. The signals also include questions about how seat memory works with driver profiles.
highlights: Controls can be hard to distinguish or see, and saved positions may not seem to apply.
USA signals include G70 (4) and G60 (2).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers describe the seat-memory controls as poorly located or unclear, including the proximity of buttons and difficulty seeing the screen in strong sunlight. [signal:04daeea7-39dd-4048-ab34-0b93e334e715] [signal:273dc3e5-04ec-4504-82b9-7ecc16c424d4] [signal:b9a72ed2-1543-4815-8e54-a53e9281edf1]
A G60 customer said the seat did not seem to remember their position, and another described the exit position as inconsistent. [signal:09dc8b73-200e-4fd6-8c85-75c927f7ce85] [signal:b0a12ac6-533b-4d53-9f81-00e451927cfb]

## What customers say
One G70 customer asked whether each driver profile has its own memory buttons; the response explained that profiles have separate memory settings and that a stored seat position can be applied when a profile is selected. [signal:34ecc597-a89d-458c-85f5-edf35720e746]
A G60 customer was advised to save the position using the driver-door buttons and to be signed into their profile for the setting to be retained. [signal:09dc8b73-200e-4fd6-8c85-75c927f7ce85]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals are from the USA and cover G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:04daeea7-39dd-4048-ab34-0b93e334e715] [signal:09dc8b73-200e-4fd6-8c85-75c927f7ce85] [signal:273dc3e5-04ec-4504-82b9-7ecc16c424d4] [signal:34ecc597-a89d-458c-85f5-edf35720e746] [signal:b0a12ac6-533b-4d53-9f81-00e451927cfb] [signal:b9a72ed2-1543-4815-8e54-a53e9281edf1]
No comparison between markets is available in these signals.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the reported control and recall issues occur across the full set of 14 signals, or whether they affect other markets or vehicle lines.

value.title: Driving experience concerns span noise, shutdown, and system warnings
value.summary: U.S. G70 and G60 owners report a recurring start-of-drive clunk, rocking when shutting off, a park-and-engine-running limitation, and warning or seat-release issues. One Rest of World F70 owner says the car is easier to drive than other cars they have owned.
highlights: U.S. owners report a start-of-drive clunk, shutdown rocking, a parking limitation, and system warnings.
Signals cover three U.S. owners in G70 and G60, plus one Rest of World owner in F70.
One F70 owner says it is easier to drive than other cars they have owned.
value.body_md:
## Problem
U.S. owners describe different driving-experience concerns: a clunk after the vehicle has been unused, rocking at shutdown, a wish to keep the engine running after shifting into park, and battery and brake warnings alongside an inoperative rear-seat release [signal:0fdf71c7-e4e8-4fe9-9cbc-f203d6510c18] [signal:1ee3a8a1-7cf1-430f-851f-484853a4c5c5] [signal:bfde0a42-e7ac-4051-af73-6e21127cc55d]. A Rest of World owner reports a positive driving experience, saying the car is easier to drive than cars they previously owned [signal:f8063e5c-7a29-4d88-b925-23905ac5f8a3].

## What customers say
A G70 owner reports two pop/clunk sounds at the start of a drive after the car has been parked for a few hours, then no recurrence until it has been shut off and left for several hours; the owner suspects the active roll stabilizer [signal:0fdf71c7-e4e8-4fe9-9cbc-f203d6510c18]. A G60 owner says the car rocks after shutdown and that they wait for it to settle before using the parking brake; they also want to shift into park while keeping the engine running briefly [signal:1ee3a8a1-7cf1-430f-851f-484853a4c5c5]. Another G60 owner reports a battery-charge pop-up, a brake-system warning, and a rear-seat release mechanism that did not work [signal:bfde0a42-e7ac-4051-af73-6e21127cc55d]. In contrast, an F70 owner says it is easier to drive than other cars they have owned [signal:f8063e5c-7a29-4d88-b925-23905ac5f8a3].

## Differences between markets
The three complaints are from U.S. owners of G70 and G60 vehicles, while the positive driving-ease comment is from a Rest of World F70 owner [signal:0fdf71c7-e4e8-4fe9-9cbc-f203d6510c18] [signal:1ee3a8a1-7cf1-430f-851f-484853a4c5c5] [signal:bfde0a42-e7ac-4051-af73-6e21127cc55d] [signal:f8063e5c-7a29-4d88-b925-23905ac5f8a3]. These signals describe different experiences, so they do not establish whether the differences are associated with market or vehicle line [signal:0fdf71c7-e4e8-4fe9-9cbc-f203d6510c18] [signal:1ee3a8a1-7cf1-430f-851f-484853a4c5c5] [signal:bfde0a42-e7ac-4051-af73-6e21127cc55d] [signal:f8063e5c-7a29-4d88-b925-23905ac5f8a3].

## Open questions
Is the G70 start-of-drive clunk related to the active roll stabilizer, as the owner suspects? [signal:0fdf71c7-e4e8-4fe9-9cbc-f203d6510c18] Are the G60 shutdown rocking and the reported battery and brake warnings related, or separate issues? [signal:1ee3a8a1-7cf1-430f-851f-484853a4c5c5] [signal:bfde0a42-e7ac-4051-af73-6e21127cc55d]

value.title: Seat memory is missing for some occupants and valued by others
value.summary: Some customers want memory for driver or passenger seats, while others value automatic seat-position recall. The signals include customers in the USA and Europe across G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report missing or limited seat-memory functions, alongside appreciation for automatic recall.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 customers and Europe G60 customers.
One USA customer compares favorably with a prior Toyota Camry; no other competitor evidence.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that seat memory is missing or does not recall passenger-seat positions as expected. [signal:84842be6-1d04-4209-b51f-e503bf8cc62c] [signal:46854a8b-4523-4150-bb61-b6eb31bd78ce] Other customers value automatic seat movement and personalized position recall. [signal:4fab9e7a-4a46-4ee2-ac27-f21ab175d2e4] [signal:63ffeaa2-d001-4664-b1af-532c4a600d4c]

## What customers say
A Europe G60 customer says driver-seat memory is not standard and finds this disappointing. [signal:84842be6-1d04-4209-b51f-e503bf8cc62c] A USA G60 customer wants memory buttons on the passenger seat. [signal:17849dd0-e972-41f6-bbd4-02936a3108cf] A USA G70 customer says passenger-seat positions no longer change automatically from the driver-side memory buttons, so passengers must press a button themselves. [signal:46854a8b-4523-4150-bb61-b6eb31bd78ce] Another USA G60 customer wants to configure seat settings for their boyfriend and has not finished setting up personalization. [signal:af2dd51a-fb8d-4a5d-97ef-da55d70955dd]

Other USA G60 customers appreciate seats moving automatically and the recall of seating positions and preferences. [signal:4fab9e7a-4a46-4ee2-ac27-f21ab175d2e4] [signal:63ffeaa2-d001-4664-b1af-532c4a600d4c] One customer says they love the memory seats, contrasting them with the basic power seats in their previous Camry. [signal:c0ea2293-2a1d-48fe-9d00-771cb97a3bcb]

## Differences between markets
The Europe signal describes driver-seat memory not being standard on a G60. [signal:84842be6-1d04-4209-b51f-e503bf8cc62c] USA signals include requests or concerns about passenger-seat memory in G60 and G70 vehicles, as well as positive feedback about automatic recall in G60 vehicles. [signal:17849dd0-e972-41f6-bbd4-02936a3108cf] [signal:46854a8b-4523-4150-bb61-b6eb31bd78ce] [signal:4fab9e7a-4a46-4ee2-ac27-f21ab175d2e4] [signal:63ffeaa2-d001-4664-b1af-532c4a600d4c] The signals therefore include both complaints and appreciation; they do not establish how common either view is in either market.

## Open questions
Do the reported gaps depend on seat position, vehicle configuration, or personalization setup? The signals describe driver-seat memory not being standard, passenger-seat memory requests, and a passenger-seat behavior change, but do not explain their relationship. [signal:84842be6-1d04-4209-b51f-e503bf8cc62c] [signal:17849dd0-e972-41f6-bbd4-02936a3108cf] [signal:46854a8b-4523-4150-bb61-b6eb31bd78ce] [signal:af2dd51a-fb8d-4a5d-97ef-da55d70955dd]

value.title: Charging POI results can be unreliable and poorly ranked
value.summary: USA G60 drivers report charging search results that can be poorly ranked, abandoned or inaccessible; one driver values the nearby gas-station prompt when fuel is low.
highlights: Charging POI results can be poorly ranked, abandoned or inaccessible.
All five signals are from USA G60; three are complaints, one a wish and one a like.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Three USA G60 customers complain that charging POI search can return abandoned locations, chargers they cannot access, or nearby results far down the list. [signal:18f37bae-42f4-479f-a4ac-3e56b4ed07ba] [signal:bd56d4ec-21df-422f-b273-531cff264f0c] [signal:eea1f1e4-a855-4e1a-aa84-2d45911e4f6d]

## What customers say
One customer said a long-trip search routed them to abandoned buildings and places without chargers, and they needed to be towed twice to reach a charging station. [signal:18f37bae-42f4-479f-a4ac-3e56b4ed07ba]

Another said a Target about five minutes away appeared around 13th in the POI results. [signal:bd56d4ec-21df-422f-b273-531cff264f0c]

A customer said compatible-charger results sometimes include office or apartment chargers unavailable to the general public. [signal:eea1f1e4-a855-4e1a-aa84-2d45911e4f6d]

One customer wants to manually choose charging stops when planning a route. [signal:34f16323-ea73-45f6-8c2b-ea8f31618c78]

In contrast, one customer likes that when fuel is low, the vehicle offers a nearby gas station and directions. [signal:4eb43e0b-2e68-4a6d-90ee-89bf62214cf1]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA and concern the G60, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:18f37bae-42f4-479f-a4ac-3e56b4ed07ba] [signal:bd56d4ec-21df-422f-b273-531cff264f0c] [signal:eea1f1e4-a855-4e1a-aa84-2d45911e4f6d] [signal:34f16323-ea73-45f6-8c2b-ea8f31618c78] [signal:4eb43e0b-2e68-4a6d-90ee-89bf62214cf1]

## Open questions
How often do charging searches return abandoned or inaccessible locations, and how often are nearby POIs ranked lower in the results? [signal:18f37bae-42f4-479f-a4ac-3e56b4ed07ba] [signal:bd56d4ec-21df-422f-b273-531cff264f0c] [signal:eea1f1e4-a855-4e1a-aa84-2d45911e4f6d]

How common is the preference for manually selecting charging stops, and does the positive gas-station prompt reflect a broader experience? [signal:34f16323-ea73-45f6-8c2b-ea8f31618c78] [signal:4eb43e0b-2e68-4a6d-90ee-89bf62214cf1]

value.title: Seat memory fails to recall or apply driver settings
value.summary: Customers report seat memory that does not consistently recall or apply saved positions, and one European G60 customer says driver-seat memory is not standard. The reports affect G70 and G60 customers in the USA and a G60 customer in Europe.
highlights: Saved seat positions, driver recognition, and easy-access movement are reported as inconsistent.
Reports cover five USA G70s, one USA G60, and one European G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe seat memory that sometimes forgets or fails to register saved positions, does not recognize the driver by key fob, or stops moving the seat for easier entry [signal:0189c530-8e9a-4f70-a5a4-0d63cfb7ac2a] [signal:794d3140-27b8-4741-a7ca-bfa1766b3cfe] [signal:9b82b4d2-4321-4c7d-9b42-c5f19f0306ed] [signal:c477ec32-cea4-4a04-babe-f6a500531cfd]. A separate complaint says the selector buttons are too close together [signal:ce19a927-15ca-497f-869d-e099a6e8040a].

## What customers say
A G70 owner says the car occasionally forgets the last seat position, requiring manual adjustment [signal:0189c530-8e9a-4f70-a5a4-0d63cfb7ac2a]. Another G70 owner says the car does not recognize the driver associated with the key fob, so the seat must be adjusted by hand [signal:794d3140-27b8-4741-a7ca-bfa1766b3cfe]. One customer says memory does not register [signal:9b82b4d2-4321-4c7d-9b42-c5f19f0306ed].

A G60 owner reports the memory seats did not work at delivery and operated correctly after service [signal:38a95bf3-3251-48db-9f31-143efa5a6a6a]. A G70 owner says easy-access seat movement became inconsistent after two remote software updates [signal:c477ec32-cea4-4a04-babe-f6a500531cfd]. A G70 customer also says the selector buttons are too near one another [signal:ce19a927-15ca-497f-869d-e099a6e8040a].

A European G60 customer says driver-seat memory is not included as standard [signal:58309aa1-10f1-49dc-99a7-039fa6bdf7bc].

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include reports about inconsistent recall, driver recognition, delivery-time operation, easy-access movement, and button spacing across G70 and G60 vehicles [signal:0189c530-8e9a-4f70-a5a4-0d63cfb7ac2a] [signal:38a95bf3-3251-48db-9f31-143efa5a6a6a] [signal:794d3140-27b8-4741-a7ca-bfa1766b3cfe] [signal:9b82b4d2-4321-4c7d-9b42-c5f19f0306ed] [signal:c477ec32-cea4-4a04-babe-f6a500531cfd] [signal:ce19a927-15ca-497f-869d-e099a6e8040a]. The Europe signal is about driver-seat memory not being standard on a G60, rather than a reported reliability failure [signal:58309aa1-10f1-49dc-99a7-039fa6bdf7bc].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the reported failures occur beyond these individual reports [signal:0189c530-8e9a-4f70-a5a4-0d63cfb7ac2a] [signal:38a95bf3-3251-48db-9f31-143efa5a6a6a] [signal:794d3140-27b8-4741-a7ca-bfa1766b3cfe] [signal:9b82b4d2-4321-4c7d-9b42-c5f19f0306ed] [signal:c477ec32-cea4-4a04-babe-f6a500531cfd] [signal:ce19a927-15ca-497f-869d-e099a6e8040a]. They also do not clarify whether the European G60 customer’s standard-equipment concern applies to other vehicles or markets [signal:58309aa1-10f1-49dc-99a7-039fa6bdf7bc].

value.title: Non-contact trunk opening works inconsistently

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the non-contact trunk opener does not work reliably: it may fail to open the trunk or require repeated foot motions. [signal:37f23aca-a310-4f0c-a3df-cdd67c030c67] [signal:5cb37dc3-344c-46cf-ab05-ac6bdf072e71] [signal:73025e42-dcaa-4f28-bca8-d31bca6385a2] [signal:b98d9178-e65c-4ff9-bef1-e5324c2f1a51]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the sensor almost never works on the first try and requires three or four foot swings. [signal:37f23aca-a310-4f0c-a3df-cdd67c030c67]
A G60 owner and a G70 owner say the trunk opens with the foot motion only sometimes. [signal:b98d9178-e65c-4ff9-bef1-e5324c2f1a51] [signal:73025e42-dcaa-4f28-bca8-d31bca6385a2]
An F70 owner says the hands-free automatic boot opener triggers only now and then. [signal:5cb37dc3-344c-46cf-ab05-ac6bdf072e71]

## Differences between markets
USA reports describe failures or intermittent operation on G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:37f23aca-a310-4f0c-a3df-cdd67c030c67] [signal:b98d9178-e65c-4ff9-bef1-e5324c2f1a51] [signal:73025e42-dcaa-4f28-bca8-d31bca6385a2]
The Europe report also describes intermittent triggering, on an F70. [signal:5cb37dc3-344c-46cf-ab05-ac6bdf072e71]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the opener fails across the wider vehicle population, or whether reliability differs by vehicle line or market.

Customers describe glove boxes as smaller than expected or absent, and report difficulty finding or operating the release. Some also report that the glove box has no light. [signal:1868fc9a-7461-48e3-bf89-433f40fc31f3] [signal:3125a902-27cc-4124-b84a-7e822e2a148b] [signal:04d4031d-8264-4d03-be28-cd9e37fb2c8d] [signal:050041ef-f60e-4435-8c99-151cb2dabecc] [signal:8945196c-4e22-4097-8a09-0043d46ce19a]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner says the glove box is much smaller than in earlier cars; another describes it as smaller than in earlier cars alongside other storage concerns. [signal:1868fc9a-7461-48e3-bf89-433f40fc31f3] [signal:2cdd1a05-cd76-48cf-9a99-4d3cf7583b67] A separate USA G60 signal says there is no glove box. [signal:3125a902-27cc-4124-b84a-7e822e2a148b]

USA G70 and G60 owners say the opening or release is hard to spot; one says it is unclear which end of the latch to press, especially in dim light. [signal:04d4031d-8264-4d03-be28-cd9e37fb2c8d] [signal:050041ef-f60e-4435-8c99-151cb2dabecc] A USA G70 owner would prefer a latch on the door rather than an electric button. [signal:133af981-81bc-4e92-a8cb-ff1dfcd1e991]

Europe F70 owners mention no glove-box light, and one says there is no glove box on the passenger side. [signal:8945196c-4e22-4097-8a09-0043d46ce19a] [signal:8ee37aa6-35e5-4eb6-abf6-caa96f50e0c2] [signal:9549af51-49ab-43b0-aa28-35c1eef11e66] [signal:bbdea79c-b3e2-4544-a15c-99dd0cf383ed]

## Differences between markets
In the supplied sample, USA signals concern G60 and G70 vehicles and mention size, absence, or difficulty finding and operating the glove box. [signal:1868fc9a-7461-48e3-bf89-433f40fc31f3] [signal:3125a902-27cc-4124-b84a-7e822e2a148b] [signal:04d4031d-8264-4d03-be28-cd9e37fb2c8d] [signal:050041ef-f60e-4435-8c99-151cb2dabecc] [signal:133af981-81bc-4e92-a8cb-ff1dfcd1e991] [signal:2cdd1a05-cd76-48cf-9a99-4d3cf7583b67] Europe F70 signals mention no glove-box light or no passenger-side glove box. [signal:8945196c-4e22-4097-8a09-0043d46ce19a] [signal:8ee37aa6-35e5-4eb6-abf6-caa96f50e0c2] [signal:9549af51-49ab-43b0-aa28-35c1eef11e66] [signal:bbdea79c-b3e2-4544-a15c-99dd0cf383ed]

## Open questions
Do the reported size and absence concerns apply to particular configurations or vehicle versions? [signal:1868fc9a-7461-48e3-bf89-433f40fc31f3] [signal:3125a902-27cc-4124-b84a-7e822e2a148b] Are the visibility and release concerns concentrated in specific conditions, such as dim lighting? [signal:050041ef-f60e-4435-8c99-151cb2dabecc]

value.title: Seat ventilation and heating performance is inconsistent
value.summary: Customers report weak or noisy seat ventilation, inconsistent cooling controls, and heating that feels too intense or too weak. These concerns appear in USA and Europe signals across G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Seat cooling can be weak, noisy, inconsistent, or limited to maximum; heating is also criticized.
Signals cover USA and Europe, and G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
One Europe F70 owner says the heated seats are mediocre compared with competitors.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe seat ventilation that barely cools, cools too slowly, is noisy, or works only at the maximum setting. One owner also says the cooling switches itself on at every start [signal:1440eebb-fe5e-4679-97bc-af0ed8e92378] [signal:910087d6-2d55-4f2d-a0bb-c53902584cb3] [signal:ac4a4c71-e096-484f-b668-e3c5cb9f8b55]. Heating feedback is mixed: one owner finds the seat heating too intense on the legs, while another calls it mediocre compared with competitors [signal:962bfb16-b2c1-48c3-bc34-f110356052d2] [signal:c53d4544-90e2-4877-a4d9-33210476c78b].

## What customers say
A G70 owner reports loud noise around the headrest and says the cooling keeps turning itself on [signal:1440eebb-fe5e-4679-97bc-af0ed8e92378]. Another G70 owner says the first three cooling levels do not work and airflow is available only at maximum [signal:910087d6-2d55-4f2d-a0bb-c53902584cb3]. A G60 owner says the ventilated seats barely cool [signal:ac4a4c71-e096-484f-b668-e3c5cb9f8b55]. A different G60 owner says the car takes a long time to cool down and has no cooled seats [signal:0e2db3de-2e71-4fdb-8d08-837fef7fa530].

For heating, an F70 owner says seat heating is too intense on the legs and the footwell heater feels weak [signal:962bfb16-b2c1-48c3-bc34-f110356052d2]. Another F70 owner describes the heated seats as mediocre compared with competitors [signal:c53d4544-90e2-4877-a4d9-33210476c78b].

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA signals include complaints about weak, noisy, or inconsistent seat cooling in G60 and G70 vehicles [signal:0e2db3de-2e71-4fdb-8d08-837fef7fa530] [signal:1440eebb-fe5e-4679-97bc-af0ed8e92378] [signal:910087d6-2d55-4f2d-a0bb-c53902584cb3] [signal:ac4a4c71-e096-484f-b668-e3c5cb9f8b55]. The supplied Europe signals concern F70 seat heating, with one owner criticizing its intensity and another calling its performance mediocre [signal:962bfb16-b2c1-48c3-bc34-f110356052d2] [signal:c53d4544-90e2-4877-a4d9-33210476c78b]. These signals differ by reported issue and do not establish whether the difference is market-related.

## Open questions
- How often do the reported cooling-level, noise, and unintended activation issues occur across the 12 signals in the case? [signal:1440eebb-fe5e-4679-97bc-af0ed8e92378] [signal:910087d6-2d55-4f2d-a0bb-c53902584cb3]
- Do customers’ heating complaints concern different settings or use conditions? [signal:962bfb16-b2c1-48c3-bc34-f110356052d2] [signal:c53d4544-90e2-4877-a4d9-33210476c78b]

value.title: Ventilated seats missing for some customers
value.summary: Some customers want ventilated or cooled seats and feel their absence is disappointing, while other customers value ventilated seats or heated front seats. Signals include requests in the USA and Rest of World, alongside positive mentions in Rest of World and Europe.
highlights: Some customers want cooled or ventilated seats that their vehicles do not have.
Requests appear for USA G70/G60 and Rest of World G60; positive mentions include Rest of World G60 and Europe F70.
One Rest of World customer says a previous Kia included front ventilated seats by default.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say their vehicle lacks cooled or ventilated seats, or that the feature should be standard. [signal:06c898de-b4db-4813-8982-a476044031d4] [signal:0793d7b2-fdf5-4be8-8ef9-df3b7c6b481a] [signal:27adc2b0-c8b8-40a0-b4a0-61f9bacb31ca] [signal:31a241d2-b87c-48dc-b55d-5cb4ab2948d1] [signal:834bae98-d9ad-434d-a91c-e6ad50f4d306]

## What customers say
USA G70 customers ask for air-conditioned or ventilated seats; one says their absence affected their rating, and another says the feature should be standard at the car’s price and level. [signal:06c898de-b4db-4813-8982-a476044031d4] [signal:0793d7b2-fdf5-4be8-8ef9-df3b7c6b481a] [signal:20aa3f36-24a6-4859-8dd4-d88374892230] [signal:27adc2b0-c8b8-40a0-b4a0-61f9bacb31ca] [signal:31a241d2-b87c-48dc-b55d-5cb4ab2948d1]
A USA G60 customer also wants ventilated, cooled seats. [signal:5d835272-c59c-4d5d-b3d2-0f9006582388]
A Rest of World G60 customer wants front cooling or ventilation as standard and notes that their previous Kia included it by default. [signal:834bae98-d9ad-434d-a91c-e6ad50f4d306]
Other feedback is positive: a Rest of World G60 review lists ventilated seats among the car’s valued features, and a Europe F70 customer praises the heated front seats in cold weather. [signal:961dfca7-19e2-4faf-8ddd-bd96714c8f4a] [signal:d071f472-9a31-4a08-a7b9-7c11763acec5]

## Differences between markets
Requests for ventilated or cooled seats appear in USA feedback about the G70 and G60, and in Rest of World feedback about the G60. [signal:06c898de-b4db-4813-8982-a476044031d4] [signal:0793d7b2-fdf5-4be8-8ef9-df3b7c6b481a] [signal:20aa3f36-24a6-4859-8dd4-d88374892230] [signal:27adc2b0-c8b8-40a0-b4a0-61f9bacb31ca] [signal:31a241d2-b87c-48dc-b55d-5cb4ab2948d1] [signal:5d835272-c59c-4d5d-b3d2-0f9006582388] [signal:834bae98-d9ad-434d-a91c-e6ad50f4d306]
The Rest of World G60 feedback includes both a request for front seat ventilation to be standard and a positive mention of ventilated seats; Europe F70 feedback praises heated front seats. [signal:834bae98-d9ad-434d-a91c-e6ad50f4d306] [signal:961dfca7-19e2-4faf-8ddd-bd96714c8f4a] [signal:d071f472-9a31-4a08-a7b9-7c11763acec5]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how availability or customer experience with seat ventilation differs by vehicle configuration. [signal:06c898de-b4db-4813-8982-a476044031d4] [signal:5d835272-c59c-4d5d-b3d2-0f9006582388] [signal:834bae98-d9ad-434d-a91c-e6ad50f4d306] The signals also do not clarify how broadly customers value heated seats versus ventilated seats across markets. [signal:d071f472-9a31-4a08-a7b9-7c11763acec5] [signal:961dfca7-19e2-4faf-8ddd-bd96714c8f4a]

value.title: Seat heating and ventilation controls are difficult to use
value.summary: Customers in the USA and Europe report difficulty finding or operating seat heating and cooling controls, including too many menu steps and unwanted cooling defaults. Some also describe heated-seat performance as mediocre or say rear-seat heating features are missing.
highlights: Seat heating and cooling controls can be hard to find, operate, or keep at a preferred setting.
Signals cover USA and Europe, across G60, G70, and F70 vehicles; the case contains 21 signals.
One European F70 customer says the heated seats are mediocre compared with competitors.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe seat heating controls as difficult to locate or use, including controls accessed through climate menus or a rear control panel. [signal:0b94ba4a-567c-4243-a9b9-7e1b9dd128c1] [signal:10b4163f-3891-45ea-9d46-a775d49299c3] [signal:1c91eeb6-d6f6-4569-9c5c-d93b76816ea5]
Some customers object to needing the climate system for seat heating, or to navigating multiple display steps. [signal:0b94ba4a-567c-4243-a9b9-7e1b9dd128c1] [signal:356bc2cf-4f88-4989-8938-71e755357707]
A G60 customer says seat cooling turns on by default and must be switched off on every drive. [signal:56db2ea2-031c-4525-87a6-7883c697e0ea]
Other feedback concerns heated-seat quality and missing rear-seat features: one F70 customer calls the heating mediocre compared with competitors, while other F70 customers mention absent rear air vents. [signal:575997e1-3ed6-446b-92db-fdd50cd49a8c] [signal:00d160da-0288-46bb-94e5-716a4d76af4a]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer wants to operate seat heating without turning on climate airflow and finds touchscreen navigation too complicated. [signal:0b94ba4a-567c-4243-a9b9-7e1b9dd128c1]
USA G60 customers report difficulty locating rear heated-seat controls and uncertainty about using heated seats without switching on heat. [signal:10b4163f-3891-45ea-9d46-a775d49299c3] [signal:1c91eeb6-d6f6-4569-9c5c-d93b76816ea5]
A Europe F70 customer says it took two days to work out how to turn off the heated seats. [signal:11de0a2c-b5bb-4c24-aa97-a0c7b1a62d0b]

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA feedback describes menu navigation, climate-system dependency, rear control discoverability, and unwanted seat cooling defaults. [signal:0b94ba4a-567c-4243-a9b9-7e1b9dd128c1] [signal:10b4163f-3891-45ea-9d46-a775d49299c3] [signal:1c91eeb6-d6f6-4569-9c5c-d93b76816ea5] [signal:56db2ea2-031c-4525-87a6-7883c697e0ea]
The sampled Europe feedback includes difficulty turning heated seats off, a comparison describing heating as mediocre, and reports of missing rear air vents. [signal:11de0a2c-b5bb-4c24-aa97-a0c7b1a62d0b] [signal:575997e1-3ed6-446b-92db-fdd50cd49a8c] [signal:00d160da-0288-46bb-94e5-716a4d76af4a]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common each usability issue is across the 21 signals or across vehicle lines. [signal:0b94ba4a-567c-4243-a9b9-7e1b9dd128c1] [signal:10b4163f-3891-45ea-9d46-a775d49299c3] [signal:56db2ea2-031c-4525-87a6-7883c697e0ea]
The signals do not clarify whether reported missing rear air vents relate to seat heating or ventilation controls, or to separate rear-cabin equipment. [signal:00d160da-0288-46bb-94e5-716a4d76af4a]

value.title: Heated steering wheel only gets lukewarm
value.summary: One F70 owner in Europe says the heated steering wheel only gets lukewarm and is inadequate for their medical condition. The owner says the heated wheels in their previous MINI and their husband’s i4 were much better.
highlights: An F70 owner says the heated steering wheel only gets lukewarm.
The complaint is from one Europe-market F70 owner.
The owner says the MINI and i4 heated wheels were much better.
value.body_md:
## Problem
An F70 owner in Europe reports that the heated steering wheel only gets lukewarm and says they need a properly hot wheel because of a medical condition. [signal:8b3e4aa7-fd7e-4a40-858c-29b3af1e22db]

## What customers say
The owner says the wheel’s heat makes driving very hard for them. [signal:8b3e4aa7-fd7e-4a40-858c-29b3af1e22db] They describe the heated wheels in their previous MINI and their husband’s i4 as much better. [signal:8b3e4aa7-fd7e-4a40-858c-29b3af1e22db]

## Differences between markets
The relevant heated-wheel complaint is from Europe and concerns an F70. [signal:8b3e4aa7-fd7e-4a40-858c-29b3af1e22db] The signals provide no comparable heated-wheel complaint from another market.

## Open questions
The signal does not say whether the reported heat level is consistent across F70 vehicles or how it changes with use. [signal:8b3e4aa7-fd7e-4a40-858c-29b3af1e22db]

value.title: Heated steering wheel missing or offered at extra cost
value.summary: Some customers value the heated steering wheel, while others say it is missing or should not cost extra. The signals include customers in Europe, the USA and Rest of World across F70, G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report the feature missing or costing extra, while others praise it.
Signals cover Europe, the USA and Rest of World across F70, G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the heated steering wheel as missing from their car or as an extra-cost feature, while some praise having it [signal:36038910-884b-44c7-965d-35f8fa8214f7] [signal:fe4ea5d1-c046-4f29-9ee2-3a0b75465d07] [signal:01466487-4fa9-4d1c-ad34-adb535a81ce8]. One customer says a steering heater feels essential in their vehicle’s class [signal:ec5c4391-7ceb-4149-a7b9-07f29ec00b4c].

## What customers say
A Europe G70 owner objected to paying extra for the feature on a high-priced car and said it affected their decision to cancel an order; they also reported that BMW later added it to their current car for free [signal:36038910-884b-44c7-965d-35f8fa8214f7]. A Europe F70 customer said their requested car was missing the heated steering wheel [signal:fe4ea5d1-c046-4f29-9ee2-3a0b75465d07]. Other customers in Europe and the USA describe enjoying or loving the feature [signal:01466487-4fa9-4d1c-ad34-adb535a81ce8] [signal:0d8a4adf-0263-4a02-8d6f-d338a802775a] [signal:5e6bf37d-5c62-4c7c-8b45-ee88e51f11fd] [signal:7524d01e-0c01-470a-bbd6-1bfd9e290f5f] [signal:fa4a93cf-07a9-42f2-a1f8-53053c06367e].

## Differences between markets
Europe signals include both complaints about missing or extra-cost availability and positive comments from owners who have the feature [signal:36038910-884b-44c7-965d-35f8fa8214f7] [signal:fe4ea5d1-c046-4f29-9ee2-3a0b75465d07] [signal:01466487-4fa9-4d1c-ad34-adb535a81ce8] [signal:0d8a4adf-0263-4a02-8d6f-d338a802775a]. In the USA, one G60 customer wanted the feature as standard, while G70 and G60 customers also praised having it [signal:14a9a98c-3727-4dab-9ec2-758a76ea3a0d] [signal:5e6bf37d-5c62-4c7c-8b45-ee88e51f11fd] [signal:fa4a93cf-07a9-42f2-a1f8-53053c06367e]. A Rest of World F70 customer said a steering heater felt essential in the vehicle’s class [signal:ec5c4391-7ceb-4149-a7b9-07f29ec00b4c].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the feature is missing or charged for across markets and vehicle lines [signal:36038910-884b-44c7-965d-35f8fa8214f7] [signal:fe4ea5d1-c046-4f29-9ee2-3a0b75465d07] [signal:14a9a98c-3727-4dab-9ec2-758a76ea3a0d].

value.title: Seat heating and ventilation availability and reliability vary
value.summary: Customers report missing seat ventilation, incomplete or damaging seat heating, and difficulty accessing heated-seat controls. The signals come from G70 owners in the USA and Rest of World, F70 owners in Europe, and one G60 review in the USA.
highlights: Seat ventilation is missing for some customers, while heating is reported incomplete or damaging.
Signals include USA G70 and G60, Europe F70, and Rest-of-World G70 owners.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report unavailable cooled or ventilated seats, a passenger-seat heating fault, and marks left by a heated seat. [signal:05ee0350-b6bd-4dd1-af48-9dc4a83b5d28] [signal:eb13ba21-ccef-441a-ac4e-a4f7da4e20a9] [signal:f44cfa9b-7a5e-4c77-ae97-8b86c4c8cc10] [signal:feca9522-d871-4c7e-9e2f-6259197495ea]

## What customers say
A USA G70 owner says the car has heated seats but no ventilated ones; another says the front seats lack cooling, and the rear seats lack heating and cooling. [signal:05ee0350-b6bd-4dd1-af48-9dc4a83b5d28] [signal:f9a8a088-a443-4ff0-9a4f-9c3e1bd46e47] A Florida-market G70 owner also says the car has no cooled seats. [signal:eb13ba21-ccef-441a-ac4e-a4f7da4e20a9]

A Rest-of-World G70 owner reports that the passenger-side heating wire is incomplete. [signal:f44cfa9b-7a5e-4c77-ae97-8b86c4c8cc10] A Europe F70 owner says the heated seat left marks after about four months. [signal:feca9522-d871-4c7e-9e2f-6259197495ea] Another Europe F70 owner could not work out how to separate the driver’s heated seat from the passenger’s. [signal:2a63d71b-b298-430b-9d68-2c78f60f3ff2]

A Europe F70 owner misses physical controls for heated seats, saying the functions are buried in the screen. [signal:456139b2-ba1a-4e25-b013-681e899113a0] A USA G60 owner mentions the seats among several concerns but gives no specific seat issue in the available quote. [signal:42b240e1-e354-4522-9bea-5a978e4c5f82]

## Differences between markets
USA G70 signals focus on missing cooling or ventilation, while the Rest-of-World G70 signal reports a passenger-seat heating fault. [signal:05ee0350-b6bd-4dd1-af48-9dc4a83b5d28] [signal:eb13ba21-ccef-441a-ac4e-a4f7da4e20a9] [signal:f9a8a088-a443-4ff0-9a4f-9c3e1bd46e47] [signal:f44cfa9b-7a5e-4c77-ae97-8b86c4c8cc10] Europe F70 signals mention difficulty separating seat heating, screen-based controls, and marks from a heated seat. [signal:2a63d71b-b298-430b-9d68-2c78f60f3ff2] [signal:456139b2-ba1a-4e25-b013-681e899113a0] [signal:feca9522-d871-4c7e-9e2f-6259197495ea]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the reported heating faults or seat marks are, or whether they share a cause. [signal:f44cfa9b-7a5e-4c77-ae97-8b86c4c8cc10] [signal:feca9522-d871-4c7e-9e2f-6259197495ea] They also do not clarify which configurations or markets include seat cooling or ventilation. [signal:05ee0350-b6bd-4dd1-af48-9dc4a83b5d28] [signal:eb13ba21-ccef-441a-ac4e-a4f7da4e20a9] [signal:f9a8a088-a443-4ff0-9a4f-9c3e1bd46e47]

value.title: Interior space is valued across several BMW vehicle lines
value.summary: Customers in the signals appreciate roomy cabins and rear seating, including space for families. Positive comments come from USA, Europe and Rest of World signals across several vehicle lines.
highlights: Customers praise spacious cabins, rear seats and room for families.
Signals cover USA, Europe and Rest of World, and G60, G70 and F70.
One customer preferred the 7 Series cabin to the Mercedes-Benz S-Class, which felt cramped.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals shown emphasize interior space as a valued attribute, including roomy cabins and rear seating; they do not show a complaint about insufficient space. [signal:0bc41097-0716-4770-bc91-5c6eb2f38678] [signal:0e98fca1-dd63-45d8-8e54-294b14811e9c] [signal:234621ff-cf91-4e46-8e6b-f1993ff736ff]

## What customers say
Customers describe the G70 as spacious, with ample room for families and particularly good rear-seat space. [signal:0bc41097-0716-4770-bc91-5c6eb2f38678] [signal:0e98fca1-dd63-45d8-8e54-294b14811e9c] [signal:2567f913-0afd-4638-81d3-17c7b7ddd23d]
A USA G60 customer says its interior room feels comparable to a 7 Series. [signal:0b27f8a4-0978-4575-80b6-3c94c6b2661e] A Rest of World G70 customer praises the 7 Series cabin space and says the Mercedes-Benz S-Class felt cramped. [signal:0903e794-d1a4-428d-b196-1e6e1e2ff307]
F70 customers in Europe and Rest of World also describe the interior as spacious or wider inside than its exterior suggests. [signal:468b84bf-2205-4de0-842c-90cc1b7f4de0] [signal:7ef7236b-c398-4ab7-aee8-18e804c4ccbb]

## Differences between markets
Positive comments about space appear in the supplied signals from USA, Europe and Rest of World. [signal:0bc41097-0716-4770-bc91-5c6eb2f38678] [signal:468b84bf-2205-4de0-842c-90cc1b7f4de0] [signal:0903e794-d1a4-428d-b196-1e6e1e2ff307]

## Open questions
Do customer expectations of interior space differ by vehicle line or market? The supplied signals do not establish this. [signal:0b27f8a4-0978-4575-80b6-3c94c6b2661e] [signal:468b84bf-2205-4de0-842c-90cc1b7f4de0]

value.title: Heated steering wheel is missing or hard to find
value.summary: Some customers lack a heated steering wheel, while others find its controls difficult to locate or settings difficult to retain. The signals cover Europe and the USA, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report missing equipment, hard-to-find controls, slow warm-up and settings that do not stay on.
Signals cover Europe’s F70 and USA’s G60 and G70; no total by market or vehicle is provided.
A customer compares the missing feature with a Golf that has a heated steering wheel.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that a heated steering wheel is missing from some vehicles, or that its controls and settings are difficult to use. [signal:1bebdd1b-5854-427b-bb86-7989c2da7687] [signal:b9a30177-0b24-4418-bf7b-a2f00ae6f695] [signal:1d34967e-d081-44f4-8d50-1ffa364d2b04] [signal:4afa2278-3390-4187-a1bb-1177c1ce3892]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer says the control is not obvious and is found through temperature settings. [signal:1d34967e-d081-44f4-8d50-1ffa364d2b04] A USA G60 customer calls the climate-options route cumbersome and says they miss a dedicated button. [signal:7887a95d-097e-48b3-a353-c45738788c8a] Another G60 customer asked what the button beside the heated-seat control does; staff identified it as the heated steering-wheel control. [signal:437e573f-b42f-4a92-914a-fc77f7390bdc]

A G60 customer says the wheel takes too long to warm on cold days. [signal:2388abc5-cb0f-45b8-8129-b2c49fe1d73b] Another says the wheel should remain on when the car is preconditioned, but the setting does not stay on. [signal:4afa2278-3390-4187-a1bb-1177c1ce3892] A G70 customer praises the heat output and adjustment levels, while wishing for a steering-wheel control for changing seat heat. [signal:44badba6-0550-4faa-bbec-2ee9eaeaf4b3]

## Differences between markets
The sampled Europe F70 signals describe the feature as missing, and another customer says app-based adjustments for simple settings such as steering-wheel heating feel clumsy. [signal:1bebdd1b-5854-427b-bb86-7989c2da7687] [signal:b9a30177-0b24-4418-bf7b-a2f00ae6f695] [signal:74686d51-1abc-4160-b391-caa5ba44e684] In the sampled USA G60 and G70 signals, customers discuss control discoverability, operation, warm-up and setting retention; one G70 customer says the heating works very well. [signal:1d34967e-d081-44f4-8d50-1ffa364d2b04] [signal:2388abc5-cb0f-45b8-8129-b2c49fe1d73b] [signal:437e573f-b42f-4a92-914a-fc77f7390bdc] [signal:4afa2278-3390-4187-a1bb-1177c1ce3892] [signal:44badba6-0550-4faa-bbec-2ee9eaeaf4b3]

A Europe F70 customer says their sister’s Golf has a heated steering wheel. [signal:ca030950-e8f4-4e9d-b649-43af60bc0b4d]

## Open questions
- How often is the issue a missing feature versus a difficult-to-find control?
- Do customers experience different control or setting-retention issues across vehicle lines?

value.title: Interior space and storage feel mismatched to customer needs
value.summary: Customers describe cabin room, access and storage as inadequate or poorly matched to the vehicle’s size. The signals come from G60 owners in the USA and Rest of World, and an F70 owner in Europe.
highlights: Cabin room, access and usable storage do not meet some customers’ expectations.
Signals: 3 USA G60, 1 Rest of World G60 and 1 Europe F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report a mismatch between the vehicle’s exterior size and interior space, difficulty getting in and out, and limited or inconvenient storage for some needs. [signal:0f5a3cd8-0351-4beb-9728-4c81eee13361] [signal:6f40d22b-e3a7-4922-a8e5-61125e810087] [signal:af531dce-bbf3-4e67-82a1-dd7ecccda3c3]

## What customers say
One G60 owner says the body feels too big while the interior does not feel correspondingly spacious. [signal:0f5a3cd8-0351-4beb-9728-4c81eee13361] Another says the car feels smaller than expected, making entry and exit difficult, and feels some deep-trunk space could instead be cabin room. [signal:6f40d22b-e3a7-4922-a8e5-61125e810087]

Storage concerns include a spare tire taking up usable trunk space, smaller and impractical side-door bins, and a smaller trunk and narrower pass-through that make carrying larger items harder. [signal:3b68a135-2ea4-489c-842d-24d7a60d15ad] [signal:af531dce-bbf3-4e67-82a1-dd7ecccda3c3] An F70 owner says they want more cabin room. [signal:6cf7d74a-535b-493a-a596-2ebd110d4535]

## Differences between markets
The three USA G60 signals focus on storage limitations, access and interior room. [signal:3b68a135-2ea4-489c-842d-24d7a60d15ad] [signal:6f40d22b-e3a7-4922-a8e5-61125e810087] [signal:af531dce-bbf3-4e67-82a1-dd7ecccda3c3] The Europe F70 signal asks for more cabin room. [signal:6cf7d74a-535b-493a-a596-2ebd110d4535] In Rest of World, a G60 owner instead says the exterior feels too large relative to the interior. [signal:0f5a3cd8-0351-4beb-9728-4c81eee13361] These views differ: one customer found the car smaller than expected, while another felt its body was too big. [signal:6f40d22b-e3a7-4922-a8e5-61125e810087] [signal:0f5a3cd8-0351-4beb-9728-4c81eee13361]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these concerns are beyond the five reported cases. [signal:0f5a3cd8-0351-4beb-9728-4c81eee13361] [signal:3b68a135-2ea4-489c-842d-24d7a60d15ad] [signal:6cf7d74a-535b-493a-a596-2ebd110d4535] [signal:6f40d22b-e3a7-4922-a8e5-61125e810087] [signal:af531dce-bbf3-4e67-82a1-dd7ecccda3c3] The signals do not clarify which specific space or storage needs matter most across customers. [signal:0f5a3cd8-0351-4beb-9728-4c81eee13361] [signal:3b68a135-2ea4-489c-842d-24d7a60d15ad] [signal:6cf7d74a-535b-493a-a596-2ebd110d4535] [signal:6f40d22b-e3a7-4922-a8e5-61125e810087] [signal:af531dce-bbf3-4e67-82a1-dd7ecccda3c3]

value.title: Larger BMWs are difficult to fit into garages and parking spaces
value.summary: Some G70 and G60 owners in the USA and Rest of World say the cars are too large for their garages or difficult to park. A Rest of World F70 owner values the interior width and says the car fits a car-park height limit.
highlights: G70 and G60 owners report garage-fit and parking difficulties.
Signals include complaints from the USA and Rest of World, plus one positive F70 signal.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners say the G70 or G60 is too large for their garage or difficult to park. [signal:154b065d-95b6-4dd3-8ce0-7ca1880a1d3b] [signal:2bb6cee2-c034-4191-91e8-24b07f06f80e] [signal:348a6af2-35df-4345-a4a0-f9bc80234b00] [signal:7b56ad51-a738-4c4d-94a2-59beb7ff8eee]

## What customers say
A USA G70 owner says the car cannot fit in their garage and feels too wide, long, and bulky. [signal:154b065d-95b6-4dd3-8ce0-7ca1880a1d3b] A USA G60 owner says it does not fit in one garage and only fits tightly in another. [signal:2bb6cee2-c034-4191-91e8-24b07f06f80e] A Rest of World G60 owner says normal parking spaces are hard to use and worries about being hit by neighboring cars. [signal:348a6af2-35df-4345-a4a0-f9bc80234b00] A Rest of World G70 owner also finds parking difficult because the car is larger than expected. [signal:7b56ad51-a738-4c4d-94a2-59beb7ff8eee]

A Rest of World F70 owner says the car fits under a multi-storey car-park height limit and feels wider inside than it looks from outside. [signal:34ef6bc7-d503-4578-9e8a-32dcf63e40f8]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA signals describe garage-fit problems for the G70 and G60. [signal:154b065d-95b6-4dd3-8ce0-7ca1880a1d3b] [signal:2bb6cee2-c034-4191-91e8-24b07f06f80e] The Rest of World signals include parking concerns for the G60 and G70, alongside a positive F70 report about interior width and height clearance. [signal:348a6af2-35df-4345-a4a0-f9bc80234b00] [signal:7b56ad51-a738-4c4d-94a2-59beb7ff8eee] [signal:34ef6bc7-d503-4578-9e8a-32dcf63e40f8]

## Open questions
How often do G70 and G60 owners encounter garage or parking-space fit problems beyond these reports? [signal:154b065d-95b6-4dd3-8ce0-7ca1880a1d3b] [signal:2bb6cee2-c034-4191-91e8-24b07f06f80e] [signal:348a6af2-35df-4345-a4a0-f9bc80234b00] [signal:7b56ad51-a738-4c4d-94a2-59beb7ff8eee] How do perceptions of interior space and external size vary across vehicle lines? [signal:34ef6bc7-d503-4578-9e8a-32dcf63e40f8] [signal:154b065d-95b6-4dd3-8ce0-7ca1880a1d3b]

value.title: Compact size may shape perceptions of interior space
value.summary: In Rest of World feedback on the F70, one customer frames it as a compact-car choice, while another says its small size may mean a simple interior and equipment.
highlights: The F70’s compact size is linked to expectations of a simple interior.
Rest of World feedback concerns the F70; two signals are provided.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Feedback links the F70’s compact size with expectations of a simple interior and equipment, but does not directly describe a lack of space. [signal:1f97d79c-c5c2-4bb9-b7e1-a530b912b446] [signal:4720413b-ae3b-4fea-9088-daaced496603]

## What customers say
One customer says the car is best suited to people looking for a compact car. [signal:1f97d79c-c5c2-4bb9-b7e1-a530b912b446] Another says its small size may mean the interior and equipment are on the simple side. [signal:4720413b-ae3b-4fea-9088-daaced496603]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Rest of World and concern the F70; no market differences are shown. [signal:1f97d79c-c5c2-4bb9-b7e1-a530b912b446] [signal:4720413b-ae3b-4fea-9088-daaced496603]

## Open questions
Do customers perceive the F70’s compact size as limiting cabin space, or mainly as a cue for simpler interior features? [signal:1f97d79c-c5c2-4bb9-b7e1-a530b912b446] [signal:4720413b-ae3b-4fea-9088-daaced496603]

value.title: G60 body size and F70 mirror clearance constrain space
value.summary: A G60 owner finds the body too large for parking and narrow streets, while an F70 owner says limited clearance above the rear-view mirror makes it awkward to adjust. The signals also include positive feedback about the F70’s parking sensors and screen.
highlights: G60 body size and F70 mirror clearance are described as space constraints.
Concerns come from one G60 owner in Rest of World and one F70 owner in Europe.
The G60 owner compares its size unfavourably with the Mercedes-Benz E-Class and Audi A6.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 owner says the body is larger than a Mercedes-Benz E-Class or Audi A6, making parking and driving through narrow streets inconvenient. [signal:2daed6a7-4cdf-4e26-971e-9a28443e21e9] An F70 owner says there is too little room above the rear-view mirror to get fingers in comfortably for adjustment. [signal:8ef485a4-5e2d-4ad1-a9a5-4803ae08a384]

## What customers say
The G60 owner also reports that remote parking often refuses to work, especially in tight spaces, and estimates it fails about half the time across ten attempts. [signal:2daed6a7-4cdf-4e26-971e-9a28443e21e9] The F70 owner says its sensors and picture screen help with parking. [signal:8ef485a4-5e2d-4ad1-a9a5-4803ae08a384]

## Differences between markets
The body-size concern comes from a Rest of World G60 signal. [signal:2daed6a7-4cdf-4e26-971e-9a28443e21e9] The mirror-clearance concern and positive feedback about parking sensors and the screen come from a Europe F70 signal. [signal:8ef485a4-5e2d-4ad1-a9a5-4803ae08a384] These signals describe different vehicles and concerns, so they do not establish a market-wide difference.

## Open questions
The G60 owner is unsure whether a sensor error or another cause explains why remote parking is refused in tight spaces. [signal:2daed6a7-4cdf-4e26-971e-9a28443e21e9] The signals do not establish how widespread either space concern is.

value.title: Rear and boot space feel small to some F70 users
value.summary: Many customers value the roomy cabin, while some F70 users find the rear seats or boot small. Feedback differs across customers and markets.
highlights: Roominess is valued, but some customers find rear-seat or boot space limited.
Europe F70 feedback ranges from limited rear/boot space to ample cabin space; USA G60 and G70 feedback praises room.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers value the space in several vehicles, but some F70 feedback says the boot and rear seats may be small for some people. [signal:c11287ed-bfb0-47c6-a72e-0e2d9582559b] Other F70 customers describe the cabin as having plenty of space or more than enough space. [signal:8f7da965-bd2b-443c-a600-f8d83f11b595] [signal:cd62ce2a-e9f8-44d5-a9dc-7e79ec3b3453]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer praises space in both rows, while another describes generous front and rear room and a large trunk. [signal:5a6a12e7-9a70-4a03-b28b-f00d81a4db1c] [signal:dc312c17-30b4-4f4f-80b6-4d3b47b2dad6] USA G70 feedback also mentions a roomy interior. [signal:54130633-cc37-4426-8027-e37b3bb98ce1]

One Rest of World F70 customer likes the roomy cabin but worries that a larger body could be harder for people with limited road or parking space. [signal:239db480-19e5-4226-9920-ae4cbee47e57]

## Differences between markets
Europe F70 feedback is mixed: one customer says the boot and rear seats may be small for some, while other customers describe plenty of rear-seat legroom or more than enough cabin space. [signal:c11287ed-bfb0-47c6-a72e-0e2d9582559b] [signal:8f7da965-bd2b-443c-a600-f8d83f11b595] [signal:cd62ce2a-e9f8-44d5-a9dc-7e79ec3b3453] USA feedback on G60 and G70 is positive about interior room. [signal:5a6a12e7-9a70-4a03-b28b-f00d81a4db1c] [signal:dc312c17-30b4-4f4f-80b6-4d3b47b2dad6] [signal:54130633-cc37-4426-8027-e37b3bb98ce1]

## Open questions
How often do F70 customers find the rear seats or boot too small, and for which uses? [signal:c11287ed-bfb0-47c6-a72e-0e2d9582559b] How much does concern about road and parking space relate to the F70’s current size rather than a possible increase in size? [signal:239db480-19e5-4226-9920-ae4cbee47e57]

value.title: 7 Series size and interior room divide customers
value.summary: Some USA customers find the G70 too large overall yet less roomy inside than their previous 7 Series, particularly in the front footwells. Others value the G70’s full-size space or choose the G60 for a balance of room and cost.
highlights: Customers disagree on whether the 7 Series is too large or usefully spacious.
USA signals cover the G70 and G60; one G70 customer cites tighter front footwells.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Perceptions of 7 Series size and cabin space differ: some customers describe the G70 as too large overall, while one says it has less interior room than their previous extended 7 Series, especially in the front footwells. [signal:3b04a5ab-35a9-4e73-bfd2-366be4b21103] [signal:488ce42f-4803-4c58-a4c1-7160112ce6f8]

Other customers value the G70’s size and interior space. [signal:419ac4fd-337d-4cf1-a8e8-cd2645e539d1] [signal:d5a5e72c-7fec-4ab6-875f-3a24643599a4]

## What customers say
One G70 customer says an earlier 7 Series was the ideal size; another says their previous extended version offered more room, with the front footwells now feeling more cramped. [signal:3b04a5ab-35a9-4e73-bfd2-366be4b21103] [signal:488ce42f-4803-4c58-a4c1-7160112ce6f8]

In contrast, a G70 customer appreciates having the car’s size available when needed, and another says the i7’s interior space makes it preferable to a mid-size sedan. [signal:419ac4fd-337d-4cf1-a8e8-cd2645e539d1] [signal:d5a5e72c-7fec-4ab6-875f-3a24643599a4]

A G60 customer says the 530i provides more room than the 330 series for transporting elderly parents, while representing a cost compromise versus a 7 Series. [signal:8478e59d-c783-4517-b7df-8a67a3e61df5]

## Differences between markets
All provided signals are from the USA, so they do not show differences between markets. [signal:3b04a5ab-35a9-4e73-bfd2-366be4b21103] [signal:488ce42f-4803-4c58-a4c1-7160112ce6f8] [signal:570fb48f-eb0c-46ef-9dd8-cc182eacb1b7] [signal:419ac4fd-337d-4cf1-a8e8-cd2645e539d1] [signal:8478e59d-c783-4517-b7df-8a67a3e61df5] [signal:d5a5e72c-7fec-4ab6-875f-3a24643599a4]

## Open questions
Do other customers also perceive the G70’s front footwells as tighter than those of a previous extended 7 Series? [signal:488ce42f-4803-4c58-a4c1-7160112ce6f8]

How do preferences for overall vehicle size and interior room differ across customer groups or markets? The provided signals show differing views within the USA. [signal:3b04a5ab-35a9-4e73-bfd2-366be4b21103] [signal:419ac4fd-337d-4cf1-a8e8-cd2645e539d1]

value.title: Cabin space is valued in the G60 and F70
value.summary: Owners praise cabin room in the G60 and F70, including space for four adults in one F70 account. The signals describe space positively and do not report a space-related complaint.
highlights: Cabin room is praised; no space-related shortcoming is reported.
Space is praised in the Europe F70 and the Rest of World G60.
One G60 owner calls the car unmatched in its class for driving, not specifically for space.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The available signals describe cabin space positively rather than identifying a space-related problem. [signal:5af666d0-cbbe-46aa-ae7e-8c483bde3f4f] [signal:c69b564d-312b-408b-a175-7a6f9854a9cf]

## What customers say
A Rest of World G60 owner lists a roomy cabin among the car’s positives. [signal:5af666d0-cbbe-46aa-ae7e-8c483bde3f4f]

## Open questions

value.title: Vehicle size does not suit every customer's space needs
value.summary: Customers differ on how much space they want: some find vehicles too small for family or comfort needs, while others value spaciousness or prefer a smaller car. Signals span Europe, the USA and Rest of World across F70, G70 and G60.
highlights: Some customers find vehicle size too small or too large for their needs.
Signals cover Europe, the USA and Rest of World; F70, G70 and G60; 4 complaints among 12 signals.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report a mismatch between vehicle size and their needs: some find a car too compact for family or comfort, while another finds a 7 Series larger than preferred [signal:6628cd95-1d73-420a-b877-111722e181e4] [signal:a4552ff0-ffc2-4f49-ac43-ae807a95441e] [signal:7462957e-d4c8-4ac9-b762-74539bf5dea4]. Other customers value spaciousness or say the size feels right [signal:0fca5169-de36-4e3a-850f-f86b9f85a15c] [signal:41b23943-ecac-4b44-8099-9e5431a00844] [signal:43cbea09-e689-43bb-8a0c-0c0c353a793].

## What customers say
Some F70 owners say the car is too small for a family or feels too compact for their comfort needs [signal:6628cd95-1d73-420a-b877-111722e181e4] [signal:a4552ff0-ffc2-4f49-ac43-ae807a95441e] [signal:b2f3f1d6-f731-4609-820c-0f31a0104a89]. In contrast, other F70 owners call it the right size or value it as a smaller car [signal:1a367f4a-8d87-452d-97a4-b6785b9f97f4] [signal:43cbea09-e689-43bb-8a0c-0c0c353a793] [signal:713ca743-c51b-4317-bddf-8e33d34b257a] [signal:9f6d146e-3c8a-42a3-959e-1044bfb26528]. A USA G70 owner describes the 7 Series as larger than preferred, while other USA G70 owners praise its spaciousness, size and comfort [signal:7462957e-d4c8-4ac9-b762-74539bf5dea4] [signal:0fca5169-de36-4e3a-850f-f86b9f85a15c] [signal:2742eb6a-f87f-4647-bb8b-64c0c353a793]. USA G60 owners also describe the size as just right and value the car's length and outward visibility [signal:41b23943-ecac-4b44-8099-9e5431a00844] [signal:9f6d3286-862b-4c73-b50f-7c3fc267f5cf].

## Differences between markets
European F70 signals include complaints that the car is too small or compact, as well as positive views that its size is right or that a smaller car is desirable [signal:6628cd95-1d73-420a-b877-111722e181e4] [signal:a4552ff0-ffc2-4f49-ac43-ae807a95441e] [signal:b2f3f1d6-f731-4609-820c-0f31a0104a89] [signal:1a367f4a-8d87-452d-97a4-b6785b9f97f4] [signal:43cbea09-e689-43bb-8a0c-0c0c353a793] [signal:713ca743-c51b-4317-bddf-8e33d34b257a]. USA signals also differ: one G70 owner finds the vehicle larger than preferred, while other G70 and G60 owners value its spaciousness or size [signal:7462957e-d4c8-4ac9-b762-74539bf5dea4] [signal:0fca5169-de36-4e3a-850f-f86b9f85a15c] [signal:2742eb6a-f87f-4647-bb8b-64c0c353a793] [signal:41b23943-ecac-4b44-8099-9e5431a00844] [signal:9f6d3286-862b-4c73-b50f-7c3fc267f5cf]. One Rest of World F70 signal recommends the 1 Series for people who do not want a large car [signal:9f6d146e-3c8a-42a3-959e-1044bfb26528].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how commonly each size preference occurs beyond this 12-signal sample [signal:6628cd95-1d73-420a-b877-111722e181e4] [signal:7462957e-d4c8-4ac9-b762-74539bf5dea4] [signal:a4552ff0-ffc2-4f49-ac43-ae807a95441e] [signal:b2f3f1d6-f731-4609-820c-0f31a0104a89] [signal:0fca5169-de36-4e3a-850f-f86b9f85a15c] [signal:1a367f4a-8d87-452d-97a4-b6785b9f97f4] [signal:2742eb6a-f87f-4647-bb8b-64c0c353a793] [signal:41b23943-ecac-4b44-8099-9e5431a00844] [signal:43cbea09-e689-43bb-8a0c-0c0c353a793] [signal:713ca743-c51b-4317-bddf-8e33d34b257a] [signal:9f6d146e-3c8a-42a3-959e-1044bfb26528] [signal:9f6d3286-862b-4c73-b50f-7c3fc267f5cf].

[signal:7245e580-bf1f-426f-8623-ec50e4535a7e] [signal:a42bf7e0-3f6c-4b79-9443-3450e0d3eac4] [signal:03a40285-0cdb-4a9e-9b04-2e06e993abbc]

## What customers say
A G60 customer said the Build Your Own tool and inventory view felt separate, and that inventory did not display all vehicles; the signal also notes that the writer later found the requested comparison option was already available. [signal:03a40285-0cdb-4a9e-9b04-2e06e993abbc]
A G60 customer said the copper interior looked light brown in the online configuration but more orange in person, and wanted to see colors under different lighting conditions. [signal:24f219eb-627f-44af-ab61-ab7d0a165b64]
A G70 customer said it was difficult to locate specific information in the online owner's manual. [signal:7245e580-bf1f-426f-8623-ec50e4535a7e]
A G60 customer said My BMW online appeared to accept their login but then showed a page-unavailable message, preventing them from continuing. [signal:a42bf7e0-3f6c-4b79-9443-3450e0d3eac4]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:03a40285-0cdb-4a9e-9b04-2e06e993abbc] [signal:24f219eb-627f-44af-ab61-ab7d0a165b64] [signal:7245e580-bf1f-426f-8623-ec50e4535a7e] [signal:a42bf7e0-3f6c-4b79-9443-3450e0d3eac4]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequently these issues occur beyond the four reported cases. [signal:03a40285-0cdb-4a9e-9b04-2e06e993abbc] [signal:24f219eb-627f-44af-ab61-ab7d0a165b64] [signal:7245e580-bf1f-426f-8623-ec50e4535a7e] [signal:a42bf7e0-3f6c-4b79-9443-3450e0d3eac4]

value.title: Front collision warning reliability and control are inconsistent

highlights: One customer reports that collision warning and braking do not work; another wants more control over when warning is active.

No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customer experiences differ: one G60 owner says forward collision warning and automatic emergency braking still do not function after support and checks, while another customer wants the Frontal Collision Warning to remain off until reactivated. [signal:d2b7f575-a3e8-424b-9eaa-fb02cc14f0e8] [signal:e90b5299-a898-4061-8dcd-241198809c4b]

## What customers say
A G60 owner reports that the warning and braking features do not work despite several contacts with technical support and a vehicle check. [signal:d2b7f575-a3e8-424b-9eaa-fb02cc14f0e8]

A G70 owner wants the Frontal Collision Warning to stay off until they choose to reactivate it. [signal:e90b5299-a898-4061-8dcd-241198809c4b]

Other customers describe positive experiences: a G60 owner values emergency braking in traffic and object detection with braking, while a G70 owner praises warning functions for red lights and stop signs. [signal:4c162c5c-cee9-4115-8596-3adbbc375010] [signal:b4661c6c-b3d2-4039-9898-f44fe693c6fc] [signal:79a306e7-74c6-47a3-ac44-5b8ebc43f919]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA, and they cover G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:d2b7f575-a3e8-424b-9eaa-fb02cc14f0e8] [signal:e90b5299-a898-4061-8dcd-241198809c4b] [signal:4c162c5c-cee9-4115-8596-3adbbc375010] [signal:79a306e7-74c6-47a3-ac44-5b8ebc43f919] [signal:b4661c6c-b3d2-4039-9898-f44fe693c6fc]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the reported malfunction occurs, or whether the customers’ different experiences relate to vehicle configuration or operating conditions. [signal:d2b7f575-a3e8-424b-9eaa-fb02cc14f0e8] [signal:4c162c5c-cee9-4115-8596-3adbbc375010] [signal:79a306e7-74c6-47a3-ac44-5b8ebc43f919] [signal:b4661c6c-b3d2-4039-9898-f44fe693c6fc]

value.title: Front collision alerts are unreliable or alarming
value.summary: Drivers report missed or inconsistent forward collision warnings and braking in the USA, while a European driver describes sudden, alarming alerts. The signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles in the USA and an F70 in Europe.
highlights: Warnings or braking may fail to activate, while some alerts are described as sudden and alarming.
Five complaints: four from USA drivers in G60 and G70 vehicles, and one from a Europe driver in an F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe inconsistent front collision warning and automatic emergency braking: some report that the system does not activate when expected, while another describes sudden alarms when approaching the vehicle ahead. [signal:15cbf91e-820f-495e-9993-96b593685f62] [signal:47076c60-1b5c-4d78-96d1-5fa55dd1c4c7] [signal:8ae63b44-412c-467b-aca6-e0ba14dba1e7] [signal:cc0c1ca4-4010-4784-87d4-03d36ddf53b6]

## What customers say
A USA G60 driver says the system sometimes fails to activate just before contact with an object. [signal:15cbf91e-820f-495e-9993-96b593685f62]

A USA G70 driver describes the system as unreliable and says it does not give clear information. [signal:47076c60-1b5c-4d78-96d1-5fa55dd1c4c7]

A USA G60 driver says no forward collision intervention occurred when close behind the car ahead, although a red vehicle warning appeared on the display. [signal:8ae63b44-412c-467b-aca6-e0ba14dba1e7]

Another USA G60 driver says the features still did not function after technical support made adjustments and the vehicle was checked. [signal:cbb98651-e542-4a5b-9ff2-07a9f72c2b22]

A Europe F70 driver says an alarm sounds suddenly when getting too near the car ahead and finds the alerts intense and worrying. [signal:cc0c1ca4-4010-4784-87d4-03d36ddf53b6]

## Differences between markets
The four USA complaints describe missed or unreliable warnings and braking in G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:15cbf91e-820f-495e-9993-96b593685f62] [signal:47076c60-1b5c-4d78-96d1-5fa55dd1c4c7] [signal:8ae63b44-412c-467b-aca6-e0ba14dba1e7] [signal:cbb98651-e542-4a5b-9ff2-07a9f72c2b22]

The single Europe complaint, from an F70 driver, describes an alarm that feels too sudden and intense. [signal:cc0c1ca4-4010-4784-87d4-03d36ddf53b6]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the system fails to activate or sounds an alarming alert across drivers or vehicles. [signal:15cbf91e-820f-495e-9993-96b593685f62] [signal:cc0c1ca4-4010-4784-87d4-03d36ddf53b6]

The signals do not clarify whether the described issues reflect the same system behavior across markets and vehicle lines. [signal:8ae63b44-412c-467b-aca6-e0ba14dba1e7] [signal:cc0c1ca4-4010-4784-87d4-03d36ddf53b6]

value.title: Engine oil and maintenance information is hard to use
value.summary: Some G60 and G70 owners are unsure about oil requirements, maintenance timing, or whether they can handle oil-related tasks themselves. A G60 owner also wants an oil dipstick, while another reports being unable to select oil changes among consumables.
highlights: Owners report uncertainty about oil requirements, service timing, and handling oil-related tasks.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 owners and Rest of World G60 owners.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners ask whether they can add oil themselves, what oil their vehicle needs, and when an oil change is due. One owner wants an oil dipstick, and another says they cannot select oil changes among consumables. [signal:142c2fee-29cd-4765-9219-5688d23483e0] [signal:44d611d3-b67f-41d6-a7d9-151d7fd6b218] [signal:229220cd-6f75-4d8a-a641-69e065b0e71a] [signal:b2add597-627e-4003-b8e4-b867acc48d5f]

## What customers say
A G60 owner in the USA noticed the model requires a special oil and was unsure whether to top it off or visit BMW service. [signal:142c2fee-29cd-4765-9219-5688d23483e0]

A G70 owner in the USA wanted to know how to open the hood in case she needed to add oil; the response directed her to a BMW service center for routine maintenance. [signal:44d611d3-b67f-41d6-a7d9-151d7fd6b218]

G60 owners in the USA asked when initial service was due; responses described the first oil change as due at 10,000 miles or one year, whichever comes first, and said the car, app, or dealer would notify them. [signal:7343b41e-7678-46b5-88f9-99a2f369ad2a] [signal:a45f0638-03bb-4a36-a07e-761a6b7843b0]

One G70 owner in the USA was unsure what a dealership-service alert meant despite having hardly used the vehicle; the response suggested it was likely time for standard maintenance. [signal:56d21188-cc07-49c5-8267-6a6a586cce95]

A G60 owner in the Rest of World said they could not select oil changes when cycling through consumables. [signal:229220cd-6f75-4d8a-a641-69e065b0e71a]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include USA G60 and G70 concerns and a Rest of World G60 concern. The USA signals focus on oil handling and service timing, while the Rest of World signal concerns selecting oil changes among consumables; the signals do not establish whether these experiences differ systematically by market. [signal:142c2fee-29cd-4765-9219-5688d23483e0] [signal:44d611d3-b67f-41d6-a7d9-151d7fd6b218] [signal:7343b41e-7678-46b5-88f9-99a2f369ad2a] [signal:a45f0638-03bb-4a36-a07e-761a6b7843b0] [signal:56d21188-cc07-49c5-8267-6a6a586cce95] [signal:229220cd-6f75-4d8a-a641-69e065b0e71a]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify what makes the required oil feel special to the owner, or why oil changes cannot be selected among consumables. [signal:142c2fee-29cd-4765-9219-5688d23483e0] [signal:229220cd-6f75-4d8a-a641-69e065b0e71a]

The signals do not show whether owners who ask about oil handling or service timing later find the information clear. [signal:44d611d3-b67f-41d6-a7d9-151d7fd6b218] [signal:7343b41e-7678-46b5-88f9-99a2f369ad2a] [signal:a45f0638-03bb-4a36-a07e-761a6b7843b0]

value.title: Map updates are slow, unreliable, or unclear to customers
value.summary: Customers report that map updates can take too long or fail, while some are unsure whether updates happen and how they are delivered. Signals come from Rest of World, Europe, and USA customers across G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Map updates are reported as slow or not working, and update availability is unclear to some customers.
Signals cover Rest of World G60s, Europe F70, and USA G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report map updates taking too long or not working, and some ask whether updates will be provided. [signal:1a69a552-e883-486b-9d31-0b2f8adee453] [signal:36ded01d-4049-4c54-8192-bb90ced17310] [signal:08bdc34f-212a-4089-9b3e-11194c50a4f0] [signal:67ac4253-e5c5-472d-8414-684e85225d62]

## What customers say
A Rest of World G60 customer says navigation updates take too long and the software is overly complex. [signal:1a69a552-e883-486b-9d31-0b2f8adee453]
A Europe F70 customer says BMW Maps stopped working and that neither a map update nor a reset fixed it. [signal:36ded01d-4049-4c54-8192-bb90ced17310]
In the USA, G70 and G60 customers asked whether they would receive map updates; staff described automatic over-the-air updates, with updates several times a year. [signal:08bdc34f-212a-4089-9b3e-11194c50a4f0] [signal:67ac4253-e5c5-472d-8414-684e85225d62]

## Differences between markets
Rest of World G60 signals describe updates taking too long and navigation not working properly. [signal:1a69a552-e883-486b-9d31-0b2f8adee453] [signal:08b6101c-a881-4fa2-b98a-1b23ddcbb581]
The Europe F70 signal reports BMW Maps stopped working despite an update and reset. [signal:36ded01d-4049-4c54-8192-bb90ced17310]
USA signals describe questions about update availability and staff explanations of automatic updates, rather than a reported update failure. [signal:08bdc34f-212a-4089-9b3e-11194c50a4f0] [signal:67ac4253-e5c5-472d-8414-684e85225d62]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often updates fail, how long they take, or whether the reported issues share a cause. [signal:1a69a552-e883-486b-9d31-0b2f8adee453] [signal:36ded01d-4049-4c54-8192-bb90ced17310]

value.title: Vehicle clock fails to keep accurate time or update
value.summary: Customers report inaccurate clocks, failed daylight-saving updates, and unavailable or incorrect automatic time settings. The complaints are from USA owners of G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Vehicle clocks are inaccurate or fail to update automatically.
USA complaints cover G60 and G70 vehicles; five concern G60 and one concerns G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report clocks that are out of sync, remain one minute behind, or fail to update for daylight saving time. [signal:06483168-3b94-4fc0-ad11-b5f768d32515] [signal:88140b2d-9b22-4779-8d69-f826abfd20f7] [signal:98a1e507-4995-403e-b42b-99673392e7ff] Some also report that automatic clock synchronization is unavailable or selects the wrong time zone.  [signal:c6c9499a-853b-4284-ba98-6ef4fbef3154]

## What customers say
One G70 owner says the clock remained hours off despite trying to change it through the infotainment system and after a system update. [signal:06483168-3b94-4fc0-ad11-b5f768d32515] A G60 owner reports a persistent one-minute lag, while another says they could not manually adjust the clock after it failed to update for daylight saving time. [signal:88140b2d-9b22-4779-8d69-f826abfd20f7] [signal:98a1e507-4995-403e-b42b-99673392e7ff] Other G60 owners describe automatic sync as unavailable or the automatic time zone defaulting to Berlin while they are in Eastern time. [signal:abc9ee1b-28fc-4454-bdfb-58c268ab1d4a] [signal:c6c9499a-853b-4284-ba98-6ef4fbef3154] One customer says BMW acknowledged the daylight-saving issue and explained how to set the time manually; another says they had to set it themselves because sync was unavailable. [signal:9ccee205-67e5-4025-a2e2-05d87d7310d7] [signal:abc9ee1b-28fc-4454-bdfb-58c268ab1d4a]

## Differences between markets
All six provided signals are from the USA: five concern G60 vehicles and one concerns a G70. [signal:06483168-3b94-4fc0-ad11-b5f768d32515] [signal:88140b2d-9b22-4779-8d69-f826abfd20f7] [signal:98a1e507-4995-403e-b42b-99673392e7ff] [signal:9ccee205-67e5-4025-a2e2-05d87d7310d7] [signal:abc9ee1b-28fc-4454-bdfb-58c268ab1d4a] [signal:c6c9499a-853b-4284-ba98-6ef4fbef3154] No other market is represented in the provided signals. [signal:06483168-3b94-4fc0-ad11-b5f768d32515]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these clock issues are beyond the complaints provided, or whether they share a common cause. [signal:06483168-3b94-4fc0-ad11-b5f768d32515] [signal:88140b2d-9b22-4779-8d69-f826abfd20f7] [signal:98a1e507-4995-403e-b42b-99673392e7ff] [signal:9ccee205-67e5-4025-a2e2-05d87d7310d7] [signal:abc9ee1b-28fc-4454-bdfb-58c268ab1d4a] [signal:c6c9499a-853b-4284-ba98-6ef4fbef3154]

## Problem
Customers describe limits on video access: one G70 owner says a T-Mobile business account is unsupported, a G60 customer wants to use a smartphone data plan without purchasing an eSIM subscription, and a G70 customer wants front-passenger access to YouTube and Netflix while driving. [signal:52c6d2c0-ab0a-4fda-b44b-f36c9c40c2b8] [signal:38f8b33e-b64a-4392-a637-28147ae3e46a] [signal:ed39e865-7e79-45d8-8dc1-c503cac725d7]

## What customers say

A G60 customer says her husband enjoys watching TV while the car is charging, and another calls watching shows in the vehicle her favorite feature. [signal:1a5decd5-c7c8-4f48-88ad-2b4163e6ac20] [signal:a21979c3-7af4-44cd-a185-f673961585ad]

## Differences between markets

The signals include both access complaints or wishes and positive feedback about watching shows; they do not provide a comparison between markets. [signal:52c6d2c0-ab0a-4fda-b44b-f36c9c40c2b8] [signal:38f8b33e-b64a-4392-a637-28147ae3e46a] [signal:ed39e865-7e79-45d8-8dc1-c503cac725d7] [signal:1a5decd5-c7c8-4f48-88ad-2b4163e6ac20] [signal:a21979c3-7af4-44cd-a185-f673961585ad]

value.title: Front collision warnings feel unclear or intrusive

highlights: Alerts and braking can feel intrusive, while warning behavior can seem unclear or inconsistent.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe front collision warning behavior as difficult to use: some find alerts or braking intrusive in close traffic, while others say alerts are not clear or do not appear as expected. [signal:0b82f76f-6dab-4c2e-bee9-42c8ae5bc0f3] [signal:06e12fa3-57ca-4288-8f19-2e38dc05117c] [signal:24bcb137-71fd-4dbb-beb2-ceb3f1f652c0] [signal:87d035c1-f421-4cbe-b8f0-388e6e15ab55]

## What customers say
A G70 driver dislikes the vehicle slowing when another car moves into the lane ahead, while G60 and G70 drivers describe alerts as bothersome in busy or bumper-to-bumper traffic. [signal:06e12fa3-57ca-4288-8f19-2e38dc05117c] [signal:0b82f76f-6dab-4c2e-bee9-42c8ae5bc0f3] [signal:1d78d3af-a08a-4601-bb6e-52a27b0ad6fe]

[signal:24bcb137-71fd-4dbb-beb2-ceb3f1f652c0] A G70 driver says the frontal warning has not come on when he gets close to other cars and asks how to change the following-distance setting. [signal:87d035c1-f421-4cbe-b8f0-388e6e15ab55] Another G60 driver reports unexpected emergency braking on a clear driveway. [signal:bf6b0b7c-a2e4-4e97-a310-bb3b1f5ce121]

## Differences between markets
The provided examples are from the USA and include G60 and G70 vehicles; no other market is represented in these examples. [signal:06e12fa3-57ca-4288-8f19-2e38dc05117c] [signal:0b82f76f-6dab-4c2e-bee9-42c8ae5bc0f3] [signal:1d78d3af-a08a-4601-bb6e-52a27b0ad6fe] [signal:24bcb137-71fd-4dbb-beb2-ceb3f1f652c0] [signal:87d035c1-f421-4cbe-b8f0-388e6e15ab55] [signal:bf6b0b7c-a2e4-4e97-a310-bb3b1f5ce121]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often alerts or braking are intrusive, or why some drivers report missing or insufficiently noticeable warnings.
