value.title: Video streaming access is limited by driving and setup conditions
value.summary: Customers in the USA report limits on when and how they can use in-vehicle video streaming, including restrictions while driving, uncertainty about package duration, and an eSIM requirement for YouTube TV.
highlights: Streaming access is constrained by vehicle movement, package duration, or setup requirements.
Signals cover three G70 and two G60 cases, all from the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that front-screen video streaming is unavailable while the vehicle is moving, and one customer wants YouTube TV without setting up an eSIM. [signal:0bc2d560-00eb-4efd-af29-d4aed51087cb] [signal:e591c96c-47f3-4a80-8819-ef9cbb76de72] [signal:1e1c984b-64a6-4033-9cff-f5b51e36e305] A G60 customer also asked how long entertainment features, including streaming, would remain available after being told the package runs only until next year. [signal:d9275aab-f353-44d2-ac80-a908de233957]

## What customers say
Two G70 customers asked whether streaming works while the vehicle is moving; they were told it does not. [signal:0bc2d560-00eb-4efd-af29-d4aed51087cb] [signal:e591c96c-47f3-4a80-8819-ef9cbb76de72] A separate G70 customer found that DirectTV was available and already signed in on the Theater Screen. [signal:7aaacc2e-b824-4b2c-97eb-dc0f6c7f583e] One G60 customer wanted YouTube TV without setting up an eSIM and was told a YouTube app is available with eSIM setup. [signal:1e1c984b-64a6-4033-9cff-f5b51e36e305]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:0bc2d560-00eb-4efd-af29-d4aed51087cb] [signal:7aaacc2e-b824-4b2c-97eb-dc0f6c7f583e] [signal:d9275aab-f353-44d2-ac80-a908de233957] [signal:e591c96c-47f3-4a80-8819-ef9cbb76de72] [signal:1e1c984b-64a6-4033-9cff-f5b51e36e305]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify which entertainment features remain available after the package ends. [signal:d9275aab-f353-44d2-ac80-a908de233957] They also do not establish whether customers can use YouTube TV without eSIM setup. [signal:1e1c984b-64a6-4033-9cff-f5b51e36e305]

value.title: Starting and drive readiness feel confusing or poorly located
value.summary: Customers report confusion about whether the car is on or off, and concerns about the location of the start and park controls. These signals come from G60 and G70 owners in the USA.
highlights: Customers find start and drive-readiness controls confusing or poorly located.
All five signals are from the USA: two concern G60 and three concern G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe uncertainty about whether the car is on or off, and say the start and park controls are poorly located [signal:88f2c604-fd56-48b6-b9a8-20b409906055] [signal:787c747b-a2d1-4104-a3cc-dc1916a2247a] [signal:aa095319-ec31-4dec-8277-705e59af0475]. Another customer says setting up and starting the vehicle can be confusing [signal:a7e607ed-5be5-468f-8f5f-dc8560277083].

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the start and park buttons should be on the dash and raises concern that children in the front seat could hit them [signal:787c747b-a2d1-4104-a3cc-dc1916a2247a]. Another G60 owner dislikes the console placement of the control and prefers a manual transmission to the small flipper [signal:aa095319-ec31-4dec-8277-705e59af0475]. A G70 owner says it is hard to tell whether the car is on or off, particularly when leaving [signal:88f2c604-fd56-48b6-b9a8-20b409906055]. A G70 owner also describes confusion when setting up and starting the vehicle [signal:a7e607ed-5be5-468f-8f5f-dc8560277083]. One G70 signal values how welcoming the setup and starting experience feels [signal:b7837ec6-7777-49b2-abb1-390f6328626d].

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA, so these signals do not show differences between markets [signal:787c747b-a2d1-4104-a3cc-dc1916a2247a] [signal:88f2c604-fd56-48b6-b9a8-20b409906055] [signal:a7e607ed-5be5-468f-8f5f-dc8560277083] [signal:aa095319-ec31-4dec-8277-705e59af0475] [signal:b7837ec6-7777-49b2-abb1-390f6328626d].

## Open questions
Do customers have difficulty recognizing drive readiness beyond the reported uncertainty about whether the car is on or off? [signal:88f2c604-fd56-48b6-b9a8-20b409906055] Do the location concerns extend beyond the two G60 reports? [signal:787c747b-a2d1-4104-a3cc-dc1916a2247a] [signal:aa095319-ec31-4dec-8277-705e59af0475]

value.title: Engine start failures leave some cars unable to drive
value.summary: Some US G60 and G70 owners report that their cars will not start or lose electrical function, while another describes a one-time start issue tied to software and low temperatures. A separate G60 report describes digital-key access failing when the phone was in airplane mode.
highlights: Some cars will not start, or lose electrical function and require towing.
Signals identify US owners of G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
US owners report cars that would not start, including cases involving a computer malfunction, a drivetrain failure message, and repeated loss of electrical functions. [signal:027ce094-e060-4141-bc76-05c174be2931] [signal:202871b3-095d-4ece-8587-1151836d94d7] [signal:81e6e95e-300f-43d3-bb0d-4c6fda3947f4]

One G70 owner also reported a key-fob start failure followed by an error message. [signal:73ef91a7-b256-4432-a49b-08da36a3dea2]

## What customers say
A G70 owner said the car died with a drivetrain failure message and was replaced after BMW spent almost three months trying to identify the cause. [signal:027ce094-e060-4141-bc76-05c174be2931]

A G60 owner said a computer malfunction prevented starting and that they were waiting for parts. [signal:202871b3-095d-4ece-8587-1151836d94d7] Another G60 owner said the car had died twice in about two months, lost all electrical functions, and required towing; the problem was still unresolved. [signal:81e6e95e-300f-43d3-bb0d-4c6fda3947f4]

One G60 owner described a single start failure attributed to software and low temperatures. [signal:577d207e-75d6-4700-85dc-ed5cefc7ab1f] Another said the digital key did not work while their phone was in airplane mode, but worked after they changed that setting. [signal:77c76bb1-4df1-45ad-8fd5-fd7c2030fd97]

## Differences between markets
The supplied reports are from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:027ce094-e060-4141-bc76-05c174be2931] [signal:202871b3-095d-4ece-8587-1151836d94d7] [signal:577d207e-75d6-4700-85dc-ed5cefc7ab1f] [signal:73ef91a7-b256-4432-a49b-08da36a3dea2] [signal:77c76bb1-4df1-45ad-8fd5-fd7c2030fd97] [signal:81e6e95e-300f-43d3-bb0d-4c6fda3947f4] No market comparison is present in these reports. [signal:027ce094-e060-4141-bc76-05c174be2931]

## Open questions
The reports do not establish whether the recurring failures share a cause; one owner mentions a computer malfunction, another reports an unresolved issue, and another was told the one-time event involved software and low temperatures. [signal:202871b3-095d-4ece-8587-1151836d94d7] [signal:81e6e95e-300f-43d3-bb0d-4c6fda3947f4] [signal:577d207e-75d6-4700-85dc-ed5cefc7ab1f]

The reports do not show how often phone or key-fob conditions prevent starting beyond the individual cases described. [signal:77c76bb1-4df1-45ad-8fd5-fd7c2030fd97] [signal:73ef91a7-b256-4432-a49b-08da36a3dea2]

value.title: Hood paint defects and false open alerts
value.summary: Customers report visible hood paint or surface defects and, in one case, a false “hood is open” alert caused by a faulty sensor. The reported cases are from USA owners of G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Hood paint defects and a false open alert are reported.
USA complaints involve G60 and G70 vehicles.
One customer favored BMW over Mercedes in a broader comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe hood paint or surface concerns, including water stains, paint chips, and dents visible under certain lighting. [signal:5b5a5a52-bb7f-4e87-8b2a-69107fcf822c] [signal:694f0968-58df-45a5-b645-1568c61376ea] [signal:cc750cd2-d364-425b-adbd-6f03dce42076] A G70 owner also reported a “hood is open” alert while the hood was closed; the owner said a faulty sensor was identified. [signal:521513d8-15ac-4378-adf9-f5ae41f7371b]

## What customers say
One G60 owner said water stains remained on the hood after at least three dealer visits. [signal:5b5a5a52-bb7f-4e87-8b2a-69107fcf822c] Another reported paint chips on the hood shortly after delivery. [signal:694f0968-58df-45a5-b645-1568c61376ea] A customer described slight dents running along the hood that were visible only from certain viewpoints and in specific lighting. [signal:cc750cd2-d364-425b-adbd-6f03dce42076] The G70 owner described the false alert as stressful and said it led to three dealer visits. [signal:521513d8-15ac-4378-adf9-f5ae41f7371b]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals describe USA cases involving G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:521513d8-15ac-4378-adf9-f5ae41f7371b] [signal:5b5a5a52-bb7f-4e87-8b2a-69107fcf822c] [signal:694f0968-58df-45a5-b645-1568c61376ea] [signal:cc750cd2-d364-425b-adbd-6f03dce42076] No difference between markets is shown in these signals.

## Open questions
Do the reported hood surface issues share a cause, or are they separate types of defects? [signal:5b5a5a52-bb7f-4e87-8b2a-69107fcf822c] [signal:694f0968-58df-45a5-b645-1568c61376ea] [signal:cc750cd2-d364-425b-adbd-6f03dce42076] How often does a hood-open alert occur when the hood is closed, beyond the one reported G70 case? [signal:521513d8-15ac-4378-adf9-f5ae41f7371b] One customer compared BMW favorably with Mercedes in a broader ownership discussion; the signals do not provide a hood-specific competitor comparison. [signal:82a827f2-d12e-4b08-bf32-9c4589844585]

value.title: Fuel economy is inconsistent across drivetrain experiences
value.summary: Some F70 owners say fuel economy is weaker than they want, while other owners praise efficiency across several vehicles. The signals do not show a consistent efficiency experience by market or vehicle.
highlights: Fuel economy is praised by some owners but criticized by others.
Signals span Europe, Rest of World and USA, across F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners report conflicting experiences of drivetrain efficiency: some find fuel economy disappointing, while others describe it as excellent or better than expected. [signal:01dc73b7-db79-4470-99cb-db19f475c925] [signal:e33d01de-5050-4542-855c-748eb69c8d8b] [signal:14f188ed-db88-4e65-bbbc-70867f2567a1] [signal:d0bf3ac6-eef2-4b58-bea4-8a7577c93836]

## What customers say
Two F70 owners criticize fuel economy, with one saying it reduces their willingness to recommend the car. [signal:01dc73b7-db79-4470-99cb-db19f475c925] [signal:e33d01de-5050-4542-855c-748eb69c8d8b]
Other F70 owners praise fuel economy, including one who credits the hybrid setup and another who reports superb economy on a long trip. [signal:52abcae1-d048-4488-a54e-7dd2261a3b2b] [signal:567b61c8-d1f0-438f-ae74-0a902a325ba9]
G60 owners also describe better-than-expected or strong fuel efficiency. [signal:0d335b32-49f6-4735-b586-875981910963] [signal:d0bf3ac6-eef2-4b58-bea4-8a7577c93836] [signal:f508c523-9ceb-4f1b-b36f-4a9a727bd025]
A USA G70 owner likes the hybrid setup and reports around 40 miles of electric range, with most short trips using electric power. [signal:c1112602-3939-407e-a87b-7704544a13ac]

## Differences between markets
Europe signals include both F70 complaints about fuel economy and F70 praise for petrol consumption. [signal:01dc73b7-db79-4470-99cb-db19f475c925] [signal:38651c07-4041-49c1-be31-30e635f94d88] [signal:52abcae1-d048-4488-a54e-7dd2261a3b2b] [signal:567b61c8-d1f0-438f-ae74-0a902a325ba9]
Rest of World signals likewise include an F70 complaint and praise for fuel economy on F70 and G60. [signal:e33d01de-5050-4542-855c-748eb69c8d8b] [signal:14f188ed-db88-4e65-bbbc-70867f2567a1] [signal:f508c523-9ceb-4f1b-b36f-4a9a727bd025]
The USA signals praise efficiency for G60 and describe electric range and usage for G70. [signal:d0bf3ac6-eef2-4b58-bea4-8a7577c93836] [signal:c1112602-3939-407e-a87b-7704544a13ac]

## Open questions
Do the differing reports reflect variations in vehicle, drivetrain, use pattern or owner expectations? The signals do not establish a reason for the different assessments. [signal:01dc73b7-db79-4470-99cb-db19f475c925] [signal:567b61c8-d1f0-438f-ae74-0a902a325ba9] [signal:c1112602-3939-407e-a87b-7704544a13ac]

value.body_md:

Fuel economy is a concern for some drivers: one G60 owner reports around 20 MPG in comfort mode and says the vehicle is not achieving advertised MPG, while another expected better mileage based on improvements between model years. [signal:3a709695-8c98-4a89-abca-446b73d85b71] [signal:9699520d-723d-43e3-a61d-5a1caebdd3f5] Other owners describe fuel economy as good or excellent. ## What customers say
A G60 plug-in hybrid owner values using gas and electricity together, reporting about 1,000 miles before refueling. [signal:04bb9579-e0c3-4d4c-8994-043c936eb2af] Other drivers praise fuel consumption or say they appreciate not needing to visit a gas station. [signal:14521bd1-a4e2-436b-aa2c-e5c3253da2d1] [signal:16b10cfa-373e-40a2-a85f-f9a73429a175] By contrast, some Rest of World owners name fuel mileage or fuel economy as something they want improved. [signal:dccee507-c475-4a54-a33c-dbef6b93aaf8] [signal:da911a0c-bc15-4727-98fd-924f44ee34e8]

The sampled USA signals include both G60 fuel-economy complaints and positive accounts of efficiency. [signal:da911a0c-bc15-4727-98fd-924f44ee34e8] [signal:1be052cc-85cb-40ca-9411-9ace84ef55f5] A sampled Europe F70 owner describes fuel economy as pretty good. [signal:14a6ae10-c87d-4f2e-8526-83f4b29e6e03]

## Open questions

[signal:3a709695-8c98-4a89-abca-446b73d85b71] [signal:9699520d-723d-43e3-a61d-5a1caebdd3f5] How do experiences vary across the vehicle lines and markets represented in the signals? [signal:dccee507-c475-4a54-a33c-dbef6b93aaf8] [signal:14a6ae10-c87d-4f2e-8526-83f4b29e6e03]

value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 driver reports real-world MPG below the manual claim. [signal:f55573ad-c417-4bf3-89da-1d953875630b] A G70 owner says the V8 leads to increased fuel use and higher gas costs, but considers this expected and acceptable. [signal:133fc479-287a-4eb7-ad10-1897ea58b38e]

## Differences between markets

Another describes fuel consumption as reasonable and says diesel engine sound hardly enters the cabin. [signal:794939d3-f406-484a-a9b7-e3c7fa85b705]

Signals cover six Europe F70 owners and one USA G60 owner.
One owner says BMW is ahead of other car makers; no competitor is named.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Most sampled owners describe the drivetrain positively, but one F70 owner says their chosen model is slightly underpowered for their taste. [signal:4a9d4176-5575-49d8-aa04-31839d73c0c8]

Another F70 owner was initially concerned that the engine capacity was about 25% smaller, but says they quickly got used to it and now barely notice. [signal:97d9b389-05d4-4a33-a3ed-f9e2292ef965]

## What customers say
F70 owners describe the engine as strong, the car as more powerful than their previous 1 Series, and its response as quick. [signal:0f3a548c-69c9-4121-b337-4e8838bfb267] [signal:09343d1c-4fee-43d9-9f44-e0c23c9c0410] [signal:17380ee8-559b-43a4-9d98-dfec3ea4ead5]

One F70 owner says they usually prefer rear-wheel drive but that the BMW 1 still handles really well. [signal:4a9d4176-5575-49d8-aa04-31839d73c0c8]

## Differences between markets
The signals include six Europe F70 owners and one USA G60 owner. [signal:97d9b389-05d4-4a33-a3ed-f9e2292ef965] [signal:09343d1c-4fee-43d9-9f44-e0c23c9c0410] [signal:0f3a548c-69c9-4121-b337-4e8838bfb267] [signal:17380ee8-559b-43a4-9d98-dfec3ea4ead5] [signal:4a9d4176-5575-49d8-aa04-31839d73c0c8] [signal:521c2214-7d6f-46a9-b3b8-f5cefe70bced] [signal:62c9bf40-e27e-4a25-90e4-001b14e0ac66]

The Europe F70 feedback includes both positive drivetrain impressions and one report of power below the owner’s preference; the USA G60 owner says the car surpasses earlier versions. [signal:4a9d4176-5575-49d8-aa04-31839d73c0c8] [signal:09343d1c-4fee-43d9-9f44-e0c23c9c0410] [signal:0f3a548c-69c9-4121-b337-4e8838bfb267] [signal:17380ee8-559b-43a4-9d98-dfec3ea4ead5] [signal:62c9bf40-e27e-4a25-90e4-001b14e0ac66]

## Open questions
The available quote about the smaller engine ends mid-sentence after introducing another concern, so the nature of that concern is unclear. [signal:97d9b389-05d4-4a33-a3ed-f9e2292ef965]

The signals do not establish how widespread the underpowered impression is beyond the single F70 owner who reports it. [signal:4a9d4176-5575-49d8-aa04-31839d73c0c8]

## Open questions

## Problem
The supplied signals describe electric driving positively rather than identifying a drivetrain complaint: customers say they appreciate or enjoy owning an EV. [signal:0e54734b-3285-4034-bda1-b74260bbefd0] [signal:0e58fa54-a7fb-4dfe-a83a-3b01cf5dbc9a] [signal:1889473f-5328-4bb4-9de8-48d17ef4cc10] [signal:1ac031a3-dead-470b-a1ae-9525d52068e0] [signal:2275a2cf-4202-4145-b8f2-6bd8e2af08d9] [signal:2cf5669b-6466-41f5-91dc-70d64d5e02dc] [signal:fc390958-937a-42d4-a033-e69cc92ad722]

value.title: G70 drivetrain choices miss some customer preferences
value.summary: Some G70 shoppers want a 750 with a combustion engine only, while another customer points to limited drivetrain availability across the 740i and 740d. The signals come from the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Some customers want a combustion-only 750 or different drivetrain availability across 740i and 740d.
Signals cover G70 customers in the USA and Rest of World.
A Rest of World customer raises Mercedes-Benz and Audi as comparison points.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A USA customer was put off buying a 2024 750 because it is a plug-in hybrid; they prefer a combustion engine without a hybrid motor or battery. [signal:34717ce7-a687-4ba5-bf60-1c4158c6721e] A Rest of World customer says the 740i is available only with rear-wheel drive, while the 740d is available with four-wheel drive. [signal:9c684992-2dcd-4149-b406-f046c480bec2]

## What customers say
The USA customer prefers a 750 with a regular combustion engine and no hybrid motor or battery. [signal:34717ce7-a687-4ba5-bf60-1c4158c6721e] The Rest of World customer says the 740i is sold only with rear-wheel drive and the 740d is the version available with four-wheel drive. [signal:9c684992-2dcd-4149-b406-f046c480bec2]

## Differences between markets
The USA signal concerns the 750's plug-in-hybrid drivetrain and a preference for combustion only. [signal:34717ce7-a687-4ba5-bf60-1c4158c6721e] The Rest of World signal concerns rear- versus four-wheel-drive availability across the 740i and 740d. [signal:9c684992-2dcd-4149-b406-f046c480bec2]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread either preference is. [signal:34717ce7-a687-4ba5-bf60-1c4158c6721e] The Rest of World customer says drivetrain availability should be considered in comparison with Mercedes-Benz and Audi, but provides no specific competitor configurations. [signal:9c684992-2dcd-4149-b406-f046c480bec2]

[signal:3ece70a3-afa8-4b8b-b1c7-ae20030d7a3c]

[signal:c53b272d-e01c-4687-b090-a5136ea5c077] [signal:c66c3d28-6eba-4486-83ab-815b12f37173] A USA G60 driver says the 530 can feel slow to pick up speed. [signal:c53b272d-e01c-4687-b090-a5136ea5c077] Another Europe F70 driver says the seven-speed gearbox sometimes reacts slowly, delaying acceleration and potentially creating dangerous situations. [signal:c66c3d28-6eba-4486-83ab-815b12f37173] A USA G60 driver finds slow pickup frustrating given the car's cost. [signal:9f9a1b4a-bb62-4267-8b32-579ea07b625a] Other drivers describe performance as just right, strong, or good. [signal:03b3956f-52ef-4190-ac03-80552f515021] [signal:36178de2-a6db-4e1f-a0c3-c81a2e683169] [signal:755b4b9c-8bbb-4b94-9d4e-4448bdd1029c]

[signal:c53b272d-e01c-4687-b090-a5136ea5c077] [signal:c66c3d28-6eba-4486-83ab-815b12f37173] [signal:9f9a1b4a-bb62-4267-8b32-579ea07b625a] Positive assessments of performance also appear in Europe and Rest of World signals. [signal:36178de2-a6db-4e1f-a0c3-c81a2e683169] [signal:03b3956f-52ef-4190-ac03-80552f515021] The signals therefore include both complaints and positive assessments; they do not establish how common either experience is by market. [signal:c53b272d-e01c-4687-b090-a5136ea5c077] [signal:36178de2-a6db-4e1f-a0c3-c81a2e683169] [signal:03b3956f-52ef-4190-ac03-80552f515021]

value.title: Strong drivetrain performance, but ride response feels too sharp to some
value.summary: Owners value the performance, acceleration, power delivery and responsiveness, while one F70 owner in Rest of World says sharp reactions to bumps and road unevenness undermine comfort. The signals include feedback from F70 and G60 owners across Rest of World, the USA and Europe.
highlights: Performance is praised, but one owner reports sharp reactions to bumps and uneven roads.
Feedback covers F70 and G60 owners in Rest of World, the USA and Europe.
One owner references the Audi Q8 e-tron and BMW i7 when discussing suspension preference.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Performance is praised in several comments, including feedback on acceleration, power delivery, responsiveness and smooth engine performance. [signal:98923157-fa51-4795-ba3c-523df487a549] [signal:0ab5482f-675a-4cdb-aa79-d57a927e3a31] [signal:1dbb42e6-7d7e-4fb3-9fa6-4da4763e3ee7] One F70 owner in Rest of World says the car reacts too sharply to bumps and uneven roads, with vibration coming through, and feels worse in this respect than the 3 Series and 5 Series. [signal:9627627b-4649-443d-8bf4-d451032f7345]

## What customers say
Positive comments describe excellent acceleration and power delivery, a smooth and responsive engine, and a smooth automatic gearbox that can deliver a punch when requested. [signal:98923157-fa51-4795-ba3c-523df487a549] [signal:0ab5482f-675a-4cdb-aa79-d57a927e3a31] [signal:1dbb42e6-7d7e-4fb3-9fa6-4da4763e3ee7] [signal:0886caf7-1405-4e19-ab8b-4953951ba157] Other owners describe driving performance as top-level or a good mix of luxury and performance. [signal:0146bcf4-f53e-4409-9e76-d2291600d7f6] [signal:037a3f12-f367-48c0-aace-b545f8c99127] The G60 owner who praises acceleration says they do not feel a need for the M version's extra power. [signal:98923157-fa51-4795-ba3c-523df487a549] That owner also expresses a preference for air suspension, citing experience with the Audi Q8 e-tron and BMW i7. [signal:98923157-fa51-4795-ba3c-523df487a549]

## Differences between markets
The sampled feedback includes positive performance comments from owners in Rest of World, the USA and Europe. [signal:0146bcf4-f53e-4409-9e76-d2291600d7f6] [signal:037a3f12-f367-48c0-aace-b545f8c99127] [signal:0886caf7-1405-4e19-ab8b-4953951ba157] [signal:06176b4c-791a-4d6f-9970-9aabdcd76994] [signal:14e8cf16-5dd5-4e0e-948b-c484ade90054] The sharp-response and vibration complaint comes from one Rest of World F70 owner, while other Rest of World owners praise ride comfort and performance. [signal:9627627b-4649-443d-8bf4-d451032f7345] [signal:0433d7b6-65ca-4491-ae69-5305a2e96a93] [signal:06176b4c-791a-4d6f-9970-9aabdcd76994] The feedback therefore differs within that market; the sample does not establish a broader market pattern.

## Open questions
How common is the sharp response to bumps and transmitted vibration beyond the single F70 complaint shown here? [signal:9627627b-4649-443d-8bf4-d451032f7345] How do these concerns vary by vehicle line, given the positive performance feedback across both F70 and G60 comments? [signal:9627627b-4649-443d-8bf4-d451032f7345] [signal:98923157-fa51-4795-ba3c-523df487a549] [signal:06176b4c-791a-4d6f-9970-9aabdcd76994]

A Rest of World F70 owner describes power and performance as strong, while a Rest of World G60 driver calls acceleration solid. [signal:409f23d1-ae66-45f2-9c1e-39996cfd6426] [signal:18c0b9a3-ab55-4701-9849-002457166206]

The performance concerns shown here are from Europe F70 drivers; positive performance feedback comes from both Europe and Rest of World, including F70 and G60 owners. [signal:6e6386dc-ee65-48bb-af26-62f0b81c7f4d] [signal:333c879f-fae5-4a83-9f03-eadff1b4b55a] [signal:96c84966-d87f-426c-8df7-de84cb83f1f2] [signal:a62ec066-83c6-4bcc-a3e7-7e83e5016d4a] [signal:5e16128a-04d0-4fb0-a76f-0c08b11a95e7] [signal:409f23d1-ae66-45f2-9c1e-39996cfd6426] [signal:18c0b9a3-ab55-4701-9849-002457166206]

value.title: Drivetrain performance ranges from underwhelming to hard to manage
value.summary: Drivers report both performance that feels less responsive than expected and acceleration that demands close attention, while others value the power and speed. These signals come from several markets and vehicle lines.
highlights: Some drivers find performance underwhelming; others say acceleration is difficult to manage.
The sample includes USA G60 and G70, Europe F70, and Rest of World G60, G70, and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe a range of performance experiences: one G60 owner says acceleration is so quick it requires close attention, while a G60 owner moving from a 540i to a 530i says the 530i feels less responsive and less peppy than expected. [signal:44fe624b-c153-4595-820d-6a677d085dde] [signal:ef7725d2-9f38-4ca4-b75f-3c52916847e9]

Other drivers value the performance, including a G70 owner who says they love how the vehicle performs and a G60 owner who praises its punchy power. [signal:01baba4c-7849-459e-8275-044cca4bf12f] [signal:02f8ee70-29cb-4063-a27f-a9fa718e0447]

## What customers say
Some USA G60 owners say the vehicle is extremely fast and requires respect or close attention. [signal:44fe624b-c153-4595-820d-6a677d085dde] [signal:75c3f705-4b44-4bd2-9e13-c3e4ea52c92d]

A USA G60 owner with previous 540i experience says their 530i feels less peppy and responsive than expected. [signal:ef7725d2-9f38-4ca4-b75f-3c52916847e9]

Positive comments include confidence in the car’s power from a USA G60 owner, strong speed when needed from a Europe F70 owner, and good performance from a Rest of World F70 owner. [signal:03335ad0-77fc-4115-9b99-22c14bd29d4a] [signal:31c2e1e6-c794-4bfa-a863-2a2f26bfb186] [signal:529f1938-31a2-4a19-a696-936831bdbc1d]

## Differences between markets
The sampled signals include both concerns and positive comments from the USA, including fast acceleration concerns for the G60 and praise for performance in the G60 and G70. [signal:44fe624b-c153-4595-820d-6a677d085dde] [signal:01baba4c-7849-459e-8275-044cca4bf12f] [signal:03335ad0-77fc-4115-9b99-22c14bd29d4a]

The Europe F70 comments praise the engine and speed when needed; Rest of World comments praise performance in the F70 and power in the G60 and G70. [signal:2e3a175c-b91f-4f3d-a6b1-1c106bfb87dd] [signal:31c2e1e6-c794-4bfa-a863-2a2f26bfb186] [signal:529f1938-31a2-4a19-a696-936831bdbc1d] [signal:2c260e98-cc12-40ae-b6f5-d3200cb63c49] [signal:43e14ce1-798d-454f-9949-c5018b20a602]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread either the performance concerns or positive experiences are across the 247 signals. [signal:44fe624b-c153-4595-820d-6a677d085dde] [signal:ef7725d2-9f38-4ca4-b75f-3c52916847e9] [signal:03335ad0-77fc-4115-9b99-22c14bd29d4a]

The signals do not clarify which driving conditions or expectations explain the different assessments of performance. [signal:44fe624b-c153-4595-820d-6a677d085dde] [signal:ef7725d2-9f38-4ca4-b75f-3c52916847e9]

highlights: Performance is mostly praised, with one class-relative assessment of adequacy.

value.body_md:

value.title: Drivetrain performance feels inconsistent across situations
value.summary: Some F70 drivers report slow downshifts, low-speed hesitation or performance below expectations, while some G60 drivers describe power as lacking or the car’s performance feel as diminished. Other drivers praise performance, speed or stability.
highlights: Drivers report slow downshifts, low-speed hesitation and performance that can feel lacking or diminished.
Signals mention F70s in Europe and Rest of World, and G60s in Rest of World and the USA.
One F70 driver compares the M135 with the Volkswagen Golf R and says the Golf R is their next-car alternative.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 drivers say downshifts feel slow when overtaking or that the car’s performance is lower than the previous M135i; another describes slight acceleration lag. [signal:0916c1bc-985e-42e1-97ef-7b00d477df73] [signal:40826ada-a622-4921-8408-57a1a97d1e5b] [signal:7b930fc3-981f-433c-9720-88f1a1489fe9]
A Rest of World F70 driver finds the M135’s performance excellent, but says it does not feel ahead of other cars. [signal:d1a4c14f-3937-46d3-b443-f46ee218b63b]
G60 feedback also differs: a Rest of World driver says power feels relatively lacking in a 530i, while a USA driver says the typical BMW performance feel is gone. [signal:51f9dbfe-4711-49c2-8a12-e874ca1d3d57] [signal:d78b331b-2694-478b-a6d6-8b761a8925ad]

## What customers say
An F70 driver says downshifts can take a long time when trying to overtake and wants performance closer to a Golf R; another says the M135’s performance is lower than the previous M135i. [signal:7b930fc3-981f-433c-9720-88f1a1489fe9] [signal:0916c1bc-985e-42e1-97ef-7b00d477df73]
A Rest of World F70 driver says a competitor’s car felt smoother from a standstill, but describes the BMW 120 as superior in speed once moving. [signal:37e1322c-ec28-405a-ba79-a68e8547e72e]
A Rest of World G60 driver says power feels relatively lacking in the 530i; a different Rest of World driver says power feels slightly too strong when pulling away. [signal:51f9dbfe-4711-49c2-8a12-e874ca1d3d57] [signal:57022393-7bf7-4f4c-8240-2a5ee6fd6762]
A USA G60 driver reports little engine braking when lifting off the accelerator and says both their 530 and 540 behave that way. [signal:6f2a3a3d-cb3e-45b6-af63-880c291d5fd2]

## Differences between markets
In Europe, F70 feedback includes slow downshifts when overtaking and performance below the previous M135i. [signal:7b930fc3-981f-433c-9720-88f1a1489fe9] [signal:0916c1bc-985e-42e1-97ef-7b00d477df73]
In Rest of World, F70 feedback includes low-speed roughness from a standstill and a view that the M135 does not feel ahead of other cars; G60 feedback ranges from power feeling lacking to slightly too strong off the line. [signal:37e1322c-ec28-405a-ba79-a68e8547e72e] [signal:d1a4c14f-3937-46d3-b443-f46ee218b63b] [signal:51f9dbfe-4711-49c2-8a12-e874ca1d3d57] [signal:57022393-7bf7-4f4c-8240-2a5ee6fd6762]
In the USA, a G60 driver reports little engine braking and a diminished BMW performance feel. [signal:6f2a3a3d-cb3e-45b6-af63-880c291d5fd2] [signal:d78b331b-2694-478b-a6d6-8b761a8925ad]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these experiences are across the vehicles or configurations mentioned. [signal:0916c1bc-985e-42e1-97ef-7b00d477df73] [signal:6f2a3a3d-cb3e-45b6-af63-880c291d5fd2]
The feedback differs on power at low speeds: one driver reports lag or roughness, while another says power feels too strong when pulling away. [signal:40826ada-a622-4921-8408-57a1a97d1e5b] [signal:37e1322c-ec28-405a-ba79-a68e8547e72e] [signal:57022393-7bf7-4f4c-8240-2a5ee6fd6762]

[signal:05d1935d-9bab-4498-ada8-95db7e429d67] [signal:35785d7b-b61d-4c7c-8fdb-7cb9c8066ac5] [signal:6b790866-5011-42c3-9064-1559ac82d751] [signal:b1186512-021e-45b4-bad4-39decd7032a6]

One F70 customer says the car picks up speed well when needed, particularly in Sport mode, but wishes it had a larger engine. [signal:05d1935d-9bab-4498-ada8-95db7e429d67]
Another F70 customer wants more power like a Golf R or similar rivals, while still describing the car as fun to drive. [signal:35785d7b-b61d-4c7c-8fdb-7cb9c8066ac5]
A Rest of World F70 customer values the comfort-and-sport balance but wants slightly more assist-motor power. [signal:6b790866-5011-42c3-9064-1559ac82d751]
A USA G60 customer would prefer more power all the time. [signal:b1186512-021e-45b4-bad4-39decd7032a6]

## Differences between markets
Europe has two F70 signals asking for a larger engine or more power, including one comparison with the Golf R. [signal:05d1935d-9bab-4498-ada8-95db7e429d67] [signal:35785d7b-b61d-4c7c-8fdb-7cb9c8066ac5]
The Rest of World has one F70 signal asking for slightly more assist-motor power. [signal:6b790866-5011-42c3-9064-1559ac82d751]
The USA has one G60 signal asking for more power and one G70 signal that calls the power solid while preferring the larger engine. [signal:b1186512-021e-45b4-bad4-39decd7032a6] [signal:21d5f930-3ab4-4d22-bae9-607ae17d387c]

## Open questions

The comments do not specify which engine configurations customers compared or what level of additional power they wanted. [signal:05d1935d-9bab-4498-ada8-95db7e429d67] [signal:35785d7b-b61d-4c7c-8fdb-7cb9c8066ac5] [signal:6b790866-5011-42c3-9064-1559ac82d751] [signal:b1186512-021e-45b4-bad4-39decd7032a6] [signal:21d5f930-3ab4-4d22-bae9-607ae17d387c]

value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals primarily describe performance as a strength: F70 drivers praise the 123’s responsiveness, acceleration, power and driving enjoyment. [signal:0779f0dc-5cca-46c6-9c09-7bdb7fb65b43] [signal:43f75588-37b8-4c71-8a4b-5c47469d2fce] One driver says the car is not short on performance. [signal:a61a8850-3ad2-4a16-bb3e-18ef84e0cb1d]

## What customers say
A driver calls the 123 quick to respond, strongly accelerating and fun to drive. [signal:0779f0dc-5cca-46c6-9c09-7bdb7fb65b43] Another says it has more than enough power and is a joy to drive. [signal:43f75588-37b8-4c71-8a4b-5c47469d2fce] A third says the 123 retains the performance of their previous 128ti and drives more smoothly when moving off. [signal:690879b4-4c96-494c-a673-dc40124ff480] One driver compares the driving enjoyment with an Audi ur quattro they owned, but the comment is truncated after saying they were unhappy that BMW “de…”. [signal:a61a8850-3ad2-4a16-bb3e-18ef84e0cb1d]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from Europe and concern the F70, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:a61a8850-3ad2-4a16-bb3e-18ef84e0cb1d] [signal:0779f0dc-5cca-46c6-9c09-7bdb7fb65b43] [signal:43f75588-37b8-4c71-8a4b-5c47469d2fce] [signal:690879b4-4c96-494c-a673-dc40124ff480]

value.title: Acceleration feels weak for some, while others praise smooth power delivery
value.summary: Drivetrain feedback is mixed: one European F70 owner reports wheel spin, light-feeling steering and insufficient punch when overtaking, while other owners value smooth, responsive or powerful delivery.
highlights: One owner reports wheel spin, light-feeling steering and weak overtaking acceleration.
In the 12 shown signals: 6 Europe, 5 USA and 1 Rest of World; vehicles include F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One European F70 owner says the car has wheel spin, steering that can feel light, and insufficiently punchy acceleration when overtaking. [signal:a3ec6348-cf05-49a6-86f2-9350040ba088]

Other owners describe smooth or responsive engines, sporty response, and strong or powerful delivery. [signal:0601f5e3-762e-4ff7-95e9-9071853095ad] [signal:2e75bccb-6c69-44ed-bac1-121c9a31d582] [signal:0b6737ef-c1ba-46e1-bcdd-7a16157eebec] [signal:32ff397b-223c-4a6c-b2a9-2095fb7ff9d3]

## What customers say
The F70 complainant links their concern to road holding, wheel spin, steering feel and overtaking acceleration. [signal:a3ec6348-cf05-49a6-86f2-9350040ba088]

F70 owners also praise engine response, smooth acceleration, pace and an engaging drive. [signal:0601f5e3-762e-4ff7-95e9-9071853095ad] [signal:0ec3e23f-a657-4526-964f-cf60ddc0857a] [signal:2382f72e-7d9b-44e6-9d44-d0d46d1779a7] [signal:259555be-51f5-4389-8c19-6f1b70ac89c4]

G60 owners describe the drivetrain as smooth, strong, powerful or sporty in its response; a G70 owner praises instant, silky power delivery. [signal:05aea83c-4306-43cf-9cbb-f29770dd43c7] [signal:26b4b521-b9d2-4f70-9fb5-766e581dba89] [signal:2e75bccb-6c69-44ed-bac1-121c9a31d582] [signal:32ff397b-223c-4a6c-b2a9-2095fb7ff9d3] [signal:0b6737ef-c1ba-46e1-bcdd-7a16157eebec]

## Differences between markets
The shown Europe signals include one complaint about road holding and overtaking acceleration, alongside praise for response, smoothness and pace. [signal:a3ec6348-cf05-49a6-86f2-9350040ba088] [signal:0601f5e3-762e-4ff7-95e9-9071853095ad] [signal:0683934e-9c1c-4042-b81c-740b96a4e36d] [signal:0ec3e23f-a657-4526-964f-cf60ddc0857a] [signal:2382f72e-7d9b-44e6-9d44-d0d46d1779a7] [signal:259555be-51f5-4389-8c19-6f1b70ac89c4]

The shown USA signals praise smoothness, strength, power or sporty response. [signal:05aea83c-4306-43cf-9cbb-f29770dd43c7] [signal:0b6737ef-c1ba-46e1-bcdd-7a16157eebec] [signal:26b4b521-b9d2-4f70-9fb5-766e581dba89] [signal:2e75bccb-6c69-44ed-bac1-121c9a31d582] [signal:32ff397b-223c-4a6c-b2a9-2095fb7ff9d3]

The single shown Rest of World signal says the response feels good. [signal:0760792c-38de-47ba-957b-87f39eab2224]

## Open questions
Do other owners report wheel spin, light-feeling steering or weak overtaking acceleration, and how often? [signal:a3ec6348-cf05-49a6-86f2-9350040ba088]

How do these concerns vary by vehicle line and market beyond the shown signals? [signal:a3ec6348-cf05-49a6-86f2-9350040ba088] [signal:0b6737ef-c1ba-46e1-bcdd-7a16157eebec] [signal:05aea83c-4306-43cf-9cbb-f29770dd43c7]

value.title: Smooth, powerful acceleration valued on narrow Japanese roads
value.summary: F70 drivers in Rest of World signals value the compact size and smooth, powerful acceleration for driving on Japanese roads. The signals describe the experience positively, not as a complaint.
highlights: F70 drivers value smooth, powerful acceleration and easy passing on narrow roads.
Both signals concern the F70 in Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The available signals describe a positive experience: drivers value the F70’s size and performance on Japanese roads, including smooth, powerful acceleration [signal:0c828fb3-fda7-454b-a6de-1c4a0f1c949d] [signal:431783c3-4d62-473c-9c43-ff9f1813d310].

## What customers say
One driver says the car’s size and performance make driving in Japan stress-free [signal:0c828fb3-fda7-454b-a6de-1c4a0f1c949d]. Another says the compact 1 Series is easy to pass in narrow Kisarazu roads and that the 2.0L diesel and 48V mild-hybrid combination delivers smooth, enjoyable acceleration [signal:431783c3-4d62-473c-9c43-ff9f1813d310].

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Rest of World and concern the F70; no market comparison is available in these signals [signal:0c828fb3-fda7-454b-a6de-1c4a0f1c949d] [signal:431783c3-4d62-473c-9c43-ff9f1813d310].

## Open questions
The signals do not show whether this positive experience is shared by other F70 drivers or in other markets [signal:0c828fb3-fda7-454b-a6de-1c4a0f1c949d] [signal:431783c3-4d62-473c-9c43-ff9f1813d310].

value.title: Drivetrain performance feedback is mixed in its classification
value.summary: Rest of World F70 signals praise the engine, handling, mild-hybrid support and high-speed fuel use, but one positive-sounding quote is classified as a complaint. The signals do not establish a consistent performance problem.
highlights: Positive performance feedback is offset by a complaint label that conflicts with its quote.
Signals concern the F70 in Rest of World; no counts beyond the four supplied signals are available.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals do not establish a consistent drivetrain-performance problem: several comments praise the engine, handling, mild-hybrid support or fuel use, while one positive-sounding comment is classified as a complaint. [signal:74eab633-a1ba-42c9-a88d-c749680b2af8] [signal:0ae56447-c781-4b3d-b083-4d65af0e6846] [signal:56a3bc0e-6f2d-4f00-b6f6-e7c4b782adf3] [signal:dedc6114-ef07-4830-a5a6-ef1dafff0ff2]

## What customers say
One quote says the engine and handling feel better than expected for an entry model. [signal:74eab633-a1ba-42c9-a88d-c749680b2af8]

Another describes the engine as comparable to higher-end models, the front-wheel-drive control sensation as close to rear-wheel drive, mild-hybrid support as pleasant, and initial turbo lag as nearly absent. [signal:0ae56447-c781-4b3d-b083-4d65af0e6846] [signal:56a3bc0e-6f2d-4f00-b6f6-e7c4b782adf3]

A further comment praises fuel use at higher speeds. [signal:dedc6114-ef07-4830-a5a6-ef1dafff0ff2]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from Rest of World and concern the F70; no other market or vehicle is represented. [signal:74eab633-a1ba-42c9-a88d-c749680b2af8] [signal:0ae56447-c781-4b3d-b083-4d65af0e6846] [signal:56a3bc0e-6f2d-4f00-b6f6-e7c4b782adf3] [signal:dedc6114-ef07-4830-a5a6-ef1dafff0ff2]

## Open questions
Why the performance quote classified as a complaint describes performance positively is unclear from the signals. [signal:74eab633-a1ba-42c9-a88d-c749680b2af8]

value.title: Software glitches undermine drivetrain reliability confidence
value.summary: A driver in Rest of World says fundamental driving performance is solid, but apparent software glitches make reliability feel doubtful.
highlights: Apparent software glitches undermine confidence in drivetrain reliability despite solid fundamental performance.
One signal concerns an F70 driver in Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The driver describes fundamental driving performance as solid, but says multiple events that look like software glitches make reliability feel doubtful. [signal:0ee15148-62ee-4848-9de6-1f8250964cb0]

## What customers say
The driver reports multiple apparent software glitches and doubts reliability as a result. [signal:0ee15148-62ee-4848-9de6-1f8250964cb0]

## Differences between markets
The signal is from Rest of World; no comparison with other markets is available. [signal:0ee15148-62ee-4848-9de6-1f8250964cb0]

## Open questions
What events appear to be software glitches, and how do they affect reliability in use?

value.title: Drivetrain power feels lacking or uneven across driving situations
value.summary: Some G60 and F70 drivers describe power as lacking, while other F70 feedback praises acceleration. A G60 driver reports twitchy power delivery and intrusive traction control during hard launches.
highlights: Power feels lacking in some vehicles; hard launches can feel twitchy.
Concerns appear in G60 and F70 feedback across Rest of World, Europe, and the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers describe the engine as underpowered or unable to match the vehicle’s weight, while a G60 driver reports twitchiness and intrusive traction control during hard launches. [signal:30ca5302-493b-46e1-8130-2ec61c6fa143] [signal:34b28f70-a4ed-45a7-b751-6522d72492de] [signal:0c30813f-9c3b-4eee-8447-bb7781d90d74]

## What customers say
A Rest of World G60 driver says the power is insufficient for the vehicle’s weight and makes pulling away difficult. [signal:30ca5302-493b-46e1-8130-2ec61c6fa143]
A European F70 driver describes the engine as somewhat underpowered. [signal:34b28f70-a4ed-45a7-b751-6522d72492de]
A USA G60 driver says power delivery can make the car twitch side to side during a hard launch, and that traction control feels too intrusive unless switched off. [signal:0c30813f-9c3b-4eee-8447-bb7781d90d74]

## Differences between markets
Feedback is mixed: the Rest of World and European complaints describe insufficient power, while Rest of World F70 feedback praises acceleration and strong power. [signal:30ca5302-493b-46e1-8130-2ec61c6fa143] [signal:34b28f70-a4ed-45a7-b751-6522d72492de] [signal:76a65716-2484-4e0a-b5bf-472cfe673b54] [signal:7a00f281-8579-4792-b168-95b7ddb4177c]
The USA G60 feedback focuses on twitchiness during hard launches and traction-control intervention rather than insufficient power. [signal:0c30813f-9c3b-4eee-8447-bb7781d90d74]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the concerns are or whether the different experiences relate to particular drivetrain configurations. [signal:30ca5302-493b-46e1-8130-2ec61c6fa143] [signal:34b28f70-a4ed-45a7-b751-6522d72492de] [signal:0c30813f-9c3b-4eee-8447-bb7781d90d74] [signal:76a65716-2484-4e0a-b5bf-472cfe673b54] [signal:7a00f281-8579-4792-b168-95b7ddb4177c]

value.title: Drivetrain performance is valued, but evidence is limited
value.summary: Customers in the signals generally value the car’s driving performance. One Rest of World F70 owner says they have driven too little to assess the car fully.
highlights: Available feedback on driving performance is positive, with no performance complaint in the signals.
Four signals cover Europe and Rest of World F70s and a USA G60; one owner reports limited driving.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals contain positive assessments of driving performance, but one owner says limited use leaves them unsure of the car’s full quality. [signal:6cac707d-90dd-4369-a594-3bf7771adc8f]

## What customers say
An F70 owner in Europe says the car drives amazingly. [signal:fb7a1178-ec11-412a-8382-ace31602ce6b]
Another F70 owner in Europe says the way the car drives is good. [signal:0ea5f0e6-bd4a-46e5-9125-0425834f40e7]
An F70 owner in the Rest of World market describes performance as good, but reports driving only about 1,500 km and not yet knowing the car’s full quality. [signal:6cac707d-90dd-4369-a594-3bf7771adc8f]
A USA G60 owner is very satisfied with performance. [signal:c4bfaca5-85b8-461a-bdfb-bfbe97405b6e]

## Differences between markets
The Europe F70 signals praise the driving experience, while the Rest of World F70 owner also rates performance positively but has limited driving experience. [signal:fb7a1178-ec11-412a-8382-ace31602ce6b] [signal:0ea5f0e6-bd4a-46e5-9125-0425834f40e7] [signal:6cac707d-90dd-4369-a594-3bf7771adc8f]
The USA G60 owner is satisfied with performance. [signal:c4bfaca5-85b8-461a-bdfb-bfbe97405b6e]

## Open questions
Do customers continue to rate performance positively after more extensive use, particularly the Rest of World F70 owner who reports limited driving? [signal:6cac707d-90dd-4369-a594-3bf7771adc8f]

value.title: Strong drivetrain performance is valued across markets
value.summary: Customers praise the vehicles’ performance and driving experience in the USA, Europe, and Rest of World. The signals contain positive feedback, not drivetrain complaints.
highlights: Customers describe performance and driving as strong, enjoyable, or satisfying.
Six positive signals cover G60 in the USA and F70 in Europe and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals do not identify a drivetrain performance problem; all six describe performance or driving positively. [signal:0e569aae-f1ad-46c6-8218-c2df7e9e1857] [signal:48358385-fc88-4159-aa1a-232181bb913c] [signal:4bf95e23-e1f4-40f3-b179-db5c3b5f4cde] [signal:5506413a-a303-4dae-a2f9-075c13480fea] [signal:6dfda745-69f5-4853-b1a2-e2783d8a2402] [signal:f3fc13e5-4d90-4a54-9b5a-60ef7c4c800e]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer says the car drives as expected, and another praises its strong performance. [signal:0e569aae-f1ad-46c6-8218-c2df7e9e1857] [signal:48358385-fc88-4159-aa1a-232181bb913c] Europe F70 customers praise its performance and sharp handling. [signal:4bf95e23-e1f4-40f3-b179-db5c3b5f4cde] [signal:5506413a-a303-4dae-a2f9-075c13480fea] A Rest of World F70 customer describes driving, engine, braking, and turning as enjoyable and satisfying. [signal:f3fc13e5-4d90-4a54-9b5a-60ef7c4c800e]

## Differences between markets
Positive performance feedback appears in the USA for G60, Europe for F70, and Rest of World for F70. [signal:48358385-fc88-4159-aa1a-232181bb913c] [signal:4bf95e23-e1f4-40f3-b179-db5c3b5f4cde] [signal:5506413a-a303-4dae-a2f9-075c13480fea] [signal:6dfda745-69f5-4853-b1a2-e2783d8a2402] [signal:f3fc13e5-4d90-4a54-9b5a-60ef7c4c800e]

value.title: Mild-hybrid drivetrain performance is valued by owners
value.summary: Owners praise the mild-hybrid drivetrains for smooth, powerful acceleration and an improved driving experience. One European G60 owner preferred a larger engine but says the 2-litre mild-hybrid performs well.
highlights: Owners value the mild-hybrid drivetrain’s smoothness, power and driving experience.
Five Rest of World F70 signals and one Europe G60 signal.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals describe drivetrain performance positively: F70 owners praise the mild-hybrid system’s boost, smooth and powerful acceleration, and contribution to the driving experience. [signal:0e031ba6-05b9-4c98-98c9-2e955a1f7a11] [signal:312b87e3-e37a-4424-8cd0-79375e85c9a8] [signal:ddd9835d-5ebe-4e9c-8334-23310fae42be]

A G60 owner who had previously driven a 3-litre BMW preferred a larger engine, but says the 2-litre petrol mild-hybrid performs well. [signal:b72fb540-4756-4ae7-9753-281b436517ba]

## What customers say
F70 owners describe the mild-hybrid boost as making fast driving convenient, and the 2-litre diesel with 48V mild hybrid as delivering smooth, enjoyable acceleration. [signal:0e031ba6-05b9-4c98-98c9-2e955a1f7a11] [signal:312b87e3-e37a-4424-8cd0-79375e85c9a8]

Other F70 owners say the torquey diesel provides plenty of performance and that the mild hybrid helps the driving experience. [signal:3ded1b2a-dd75-42e3-8e82-ff28f84e90de] [signal:ddd9835d-5ebe-4e9c-8334-23310fae42be]

The G60 owner was not disappointed with the 2-litre petrol mild-hybrid’s performance, despite having preferred a larger engine. [signal:b72fb540-4756-4ae7-9753-281b436517ba]

## Differences between markets
All five Rest of World signals concern the F70 and express positive views of its mild-hybrid drivetrain. [signal:0e031ba6-05b9-4c98-98c9-2e955a1f7a11] [signal:1fa67a15-4b66-4ccf-ad30-d1fc3f3221aa] [signal:312b87e3-e37a-4424-8cd0-79375e85c9a8] [signal:3ded1b2a-dd75-42e3-8e82-ff28f84e90de] [signal:ddd9835d-5ebe-4e9c-8334-23310fae42be]

The single Europe signal concerns the G60: its owner wanted a larger engine but still rates the 2-litre mild-hybrid’s performance positively. [signal:b72fb540-4756-4ae7-9753-281b436517ba]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how broadly these views represent F70 or G60 owners beyond the six comments provided. [signal:0e031ba6-05b9-4c98-98c9-2e955a1f7a11] [signal:1fa67a15-4b66-4ccf-ad30-d1fc3f3221aa] [signal:312b87e3-e37a-4424-8cd0-79375e85c9a8] [signal:3ded1b2a-dd75-42e3-8e82-ff28f84e90de] [signal:b72fb540-4756-4ae7-9753-281b436517ba] [signal:ddd9835d-5ebe-4e9c-8334-23310fae42be]

value.title: Diesel drivetrain performance is valued for quietness and economy
value.summary: Customers value the diesel drivetrains for quiet operation, good fuel economy and, in one signal, strong low-speed torque. The feedback covers F70, G70 and G60 vehicles in Europe and Rest of World.
highlights: Customers praise quiet engines, fuel economy and, in one signal, low-speed torque.
Nine supplied signals cover Europe and Rest of World, across F70, G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals mainly describe valued drivetrain performance: customers praise quiet engines and fuel economy, with one also highlighting excellent low-speed torque. [signal:330cd8e4-0ee1-4273-840b-f2c8dbbdf80d] [signal:1d2170de-34d5-4726-84c8-8a30eaa62f7e] [signal:77d609fb-97ef-4883-b8a3-3f32ad7a8ef7]

## What customers say
Customers describe the engines as quiet or quieter than expected, and praise driving capability, fuel economy and low refuelling costs. [signal:0a58e627-c101-452d-8db9-87e48516bbb9] [signal:1d2170de-34d5-4726-84c8-8a30eaa62f7e] [signal:37f02eab-4d46-4199-82a6-0fc9890be763] [signal:6b6db6dc-86d7-4c6d-a125-e5af5c0f90cb] [signal:72c7c5ab-9352-431d-9e24-196a2fd30102] [signal:77d609fb-97ef-4883-b8a3-3f32ad7a8ef7] [signal:8ca12dd8-b716-4dd3-92d9-406fc51c8b68] [signal:91ed4b14-a75e-49a1-8e6a-3a6e30458e7b] One signal is classified as a complaint, but its quote says the diesel noise is not bothersome and praises low-speed torque. [signal:330cd8e4-0ee1-4273-840b-f2c8dbbdf80d]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include three Europe examples and six Rest of World examples; all three Europe examples concern the F70. [signal:6b6db6dc-86d7-4c6d-a125-e5af5c0f90cb] [signal:77d609fb-97ef-4883-b8a3-3f32ad7a8ef7] [signal:91ed4b14-a75e-49a1-8e6a-3a6e30458e7b] [signal:330cd8e4-0ee1-4273-840b-f2c8dbbdf80d] [signal:0a58e627-c101-452d-8db9-87e48516bbb9] [signal:1d2170de-34d5-4726-84c8-8a30eaa62f7e] [signal:37f02eab-4d46-4199-82a6-0fc9890be763] [signal:72c7c5ab-9352-431d-9e24-196a2fd30102] [signal:8ca12dd8-b716-4dd3-92d9-406fc51c8b68] The Rest of World examples cover F70, G70 and G60. [signal:330cd8e4-0ee1-4273-840b-f2c8dbbdf80d] [signal:0a58e627-c101-452d-8db9-87e48516bbb9] [signal:37f02eab-4d46-4199-82a6-0fc9890be763] [signal:72c7c5ab-9352-431d-9e24-196a2fd30102] [signal:1d2170de-34d5-4726-84c8-8a30eaa62f7e] [signal:8ca12dd8-b716-4dd3-92d9-406fc51c8b68] Both markets include positive comments on quietness or fuel economy. [signal:6b6db6dc-86d7-4c6d-a125-e5af5c0f90cb] [signal:77d609fb-97ef-4883-b8a3-3f32ad7a8ef7] [signal:91ed4b14-a75e-49a1-8e6a-3a6e30458e7b] [signal:1d2170de-34d5-4726-84c8-8a30eaa62f7e] [signal:72c7c5ab-9352-431d-9e24-196a2fd30102] [signal:8ca12dd8-b716-4dd3-92d9-406fc51c8b68]

## Open questions
The supplied signals do not establish how common these views are beyond this set, or whether customers compare the drivetrain with competitors. [signal:330cd8e4-0ee1-4273-840b-f2c8dbbdf80d] [signal:0a58e627-c101-452d-8db9-87e48516bbb9] [signal:1d2170de-34d5-4726-84c8-8a30eaa62f7e] [signal:37f02eab-4d46-4199-82a6-0fc9890be763] [signal:6b6db6dc-86d7-4c6d-a125-e5af5c0f90cb] [signal:72c7c5ab-9352-431d-9e24-196a2fd30102] [signal:77d609fb-97ef-4883-b8a3-3f32ad7a8ef7] [signal:8ca12dd8-b716-4dd3-92d9-406fc51c8b68] [signal:91ed4b14-a75e-49a1-8e6a-3a6e30458e7b]

value.title: Strong drivetrain performance is valued by drivers
value.summary: Drivers value strong performance in G70 and F70 vehicles, with comments from the USA and Rest of World. One F70 driver also says the performance feels safe.
highlights: Drivers praise strong performance and say it feels safe.
Signals cover G70 and F70 drivers in the USA and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe strong performance as a valued part of the drivetrain experience. [signal:107a1f2a-fd76-4e5b-adcb-345932660dff] [signal:19c88fbd-77be-4540-a74b-db61f3796aa6] [signal:552a4c87-fb1c-47f5-94db-cb4171603487]

## What customers say
A G70 driver in Rest of World says the vehicle is easy to use and delivers excellent performance. [signal:107a1f2a-fd76-4e5b-adcb-345932660dff] A USA G70 driver praises strong performance and reliable dependability. [signal:19c88fbd-77be-4540-a74b-db61f3796aa6] Another Rest of World G70 driver values strong performance alongside many functions and lower maintenance costs. [signal:552a4c87-fb1c-47f5-94db-cb4171603487] A Rest of World F70 driver says the vehicle is simple to handle and feels safe in terms of performance. [signal:6825cc38-7474-4aaf-917d-b3cc6855abf0]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say the engine does not meet their expectations: one F70 driver misses the sharp edge associated with the M140i and says a four-cylinder does not feel right for a super-hot hatch [signal:18c0a1aa-81dc-41b1-a249-3600762905c0]. A G60 driver is not thrilled with its four-cylinder engine [signal:2c6a9752-0368-4ef8-85e8-c5c319f68c8a]. Another F70 driver wanted a 2-litre engine and says the 1.6 was a letdown [signal:ed7ace7a-668f-47a2-9d04-16d2af99d0a4].

## What customers say
The F70 feedback includes a desire for more of the sharpness associated with the M140i, alongside disappointment with the engine's cylinder count or displacement [signal:18c0a1aa-81dc-41b1-a249-3600762905c0] [signal:ed7ace7a-668f-47a2-9d04-16d2af99d0a4]. The G60 driver also expresses dissatisfaction with the four-cylinder engine [signal:2c6a9752-0368-4ef8-85e8-c5c319f68c8a]. One F70 driver otherwise describes the car as enjoyable and well equipped [signal:18c0a1aa-81dc-41b1-a249-3600762905c0].

## Differences between markets
Two signals concern the F70 in Europe, while one concerns the G60 in the USA [signal:18c0a1aa-81dc-41b1-a249-3600762905c0] [signal:ed7ace7a-668f-47a2-9d04-16d2af99d0a4] [signal:2c6a9752-0368-4ef8-85e8-c5c319f68c8a]. The European comments mention sharpness and displacement; the USA comment expresses general dissatisfaction with the four-cylinder engine [signal:18c0a1aa-81dc-41b1-a249-3600762905c0] [signal:ed7ace7a-668f-47a2-9d04-16d2af99d0a4] [signal:2c6a9752-0368-4ef8-85e8-c5c319f68c8a].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how representative these views are among F70 or G60 drivers [signal:18c0a1aa-81dc-41b1-a249-3600762905c0] [signal:2c6a9752-0368-4ef8-85e8-c5c319f68c8a] [signal:ed7ace7a-668f-47a2-9d04-16d2af99d0a4].

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers in Europe, the USA, and Rest of World report that power, torque, or overall performance does not meet their expectations. [signal:0f73dad4-d238-43fb-978d-1bd7b7b655bc] [signal:266e2954-6ee9-4f6f-a1d3-c001356bbfd4] [signal:273e5568-94be-43a8-aa94-df11b33a5744] [signal:433f0e47-879d-43dc-9349-8e14c8c763f0] [signal:b3c6c2ce-d6dd-4599-b0df-e0139b417512]
One F70 owner says the engine feels short on power under strain, while another describes poor sound alongside a lack of power and oomph. [signal:0f73dad4-d238-43fb-978d-1bd7b7b655bc] [signal:8120c0e6-74e5-4471-9878-0a13bafed1c3]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner who switched from a 12-cylinder car says the four-cylinder is not very strong; a Rest of World G60 owner also finds its overall output underwhelming. [signal:266e2954-6ee9-4f6f-a1d3-c001356bbfd4] [signal:273e5568-94be-43a8-aa94-df11b33a5744]
A Europe G60 owner says torque, overall power, and driving dynamics fall short of expectations and wishes for a stronger entry engine. [signal:b3c6c2ce-d6dd-4599-b0df-e0139b417512]
F70 feedback varies by trim and preference: one owner says the 120 lacks power while the 135 is too strong, and another says their chosen model is underpowered. [signal:49a106e0-09d0-4636-94da-c2ea489b1df8] [signal:7f308c56-e197-4d16-8bc2-40a25619de53]
A USA G70 owner says the car does not deliver the power or performance they expect from the M badge and package. [signal:ec81d559-8833-48d2-bb01-734ff0523c7a]

## Differences between markets
The signals include six Europe complaints, two USA complaints, and one Rest of World complaint; they cover F70, G60, and G70 vehicles. [signal:0f73dad4-d238-43fb-978d-1bd7b7b655bc] [signal:433f0e47-879d-43dc-9349-8e14c8c763f0] [signal:49a106e0-09d0-4636-94da-c2ea489b1df8] [signal:7f308c56-e197-4d16-8bc2-40a25619de53] [signal:8120c0e6-74e5-4471-9878-0a13bafed1c3] [signal:b3c6c2ce-d6dd-4599-b0df-e0139b417512] [signal:266e2954-6ee9-4f6f-a1d3-c001356bbfd4] [signal:ec81d559-8833-48d2-bb01-734ff0523c7a] [signal:273e5568-94be-43a8-aa94-df11b33a5744]
Europe feedback includes both general concerns about weak power and trim-specific views, including one owner who finds the 135 too strong. [signal:0f73dad4-d238-43fb-978d-1bd7b7b655bc] [signal:49a106e0-09d0-4636-94da-c2ea489b1df8] [signal:7f308c56-e197-4d16-8bc2-40a25619de53]

## Open questions
How do power expectations differ by trim and by customer preference, given that some F70 owners find their version underpowered while one finds the 135 too strong? [signal:49a106e0-09d0-4636-94da-c2ea489b1df8] [signal:7f308c56-e197-4d16-8bc2-40a25619de53]
How much of the reported shortfall relates to power or torque versus broader expectations about driving dynamics and the M badge? [signal:b3c6c2ce-d6dd-4599-b0df-e0139b417512] [signal:ec81d559-8833-48d2-bb01-734ff0523c7a]

value.title: Drivetrain response feels delayed or sluggish during acceleration
value.summary: Drivers report delayed or weak acceleration, especially when pulling away or accelerating in hybrid mode. Signals cover F70 drivers in Europe and Rest of World, and G60 drivers in the USA.
highlights: Delayed or sluggish response when pulling away and accelerating.
Signals: 6 Europe F70, 1 Rest of World F70, and 2 USA G60.
One USA signal says acceleration is weaker than a Tesla; another compares lag with a Fiat 500e.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe a delay or sluggishness between accelerator input and vehicle response, particularly when pulling away from a stop or while slowing down. [signal:197a5e56-b569-4b16-a62f-0ba166396e11] [signal:52100c20-7b43-4d33-82a9-e384d1a7377b] [signal:eeb7daaf-2ebf-4198-9da6-1ffad713ee69]

Some reports describe this in hybrid operation, including lag when starting on the hybrid motor and a delay when switching from EV to the gas engine. [signal:32690f31-9f41-4c8f-b344-7a8647cc9e65] [signal:635816bd-d70e-47e2-94f3-2c5cbaa69ab1]

## What customers say
One F70 driver says the delay when accelerating while the vehicle is still slowing down feels dangerous when pulling out from a slow roll. [signal:197a5e56-b569-4b16-a62f-0ba166396e11] Another F70 driver describes about a second of no response when pulling away, and says they use Sport mode near junctions and roundabouts. [signal:eeb7daaf-2ebf-4198-9da6-1ffad713ee69]

A G60 driver reports that acceleration is not as strong as in a Tesla. [signal:1f318bfb-2e5e-469a-acac-70809a0fa637] Another says hybrid power delivery feels confused, with excessive battery drain and a long delay before the engine responds under acceleration. [signal:635816bd-d70e-47e2-94f3-2c5cbaa69ab1]

An F70 driver compares slight acceleration lag with a Fiat 500e, while another says throttle response is slow. [signal:adcc48d8-da25-4bc1-a195-dc369ac52787] [signal:bcb50d34-8b2c-4f90-bd23-b2518d5c4383]

## Differences between markets
Europe signals concern F70 response when pulling away, throttle response, and acceleration lag; one report describes the delay as unnerving at junctions and roundabouts. [signal:197a5e56-b569-4b16-a62f-0ba166396e11] [signal:52100c20-7b43-4d33-82a9-e384d1a7377b] [signal:adcc48d8-da25-4bc1-a195-dc369ac52787] [signal:bcb50d34-8b2c-4f90-bd23-b2518d5c4383] [signal:eeb7daaf-2ebf-4198-9da6-1ffad713ee69] [signal:fa094efc-2b3d-43b6-a94a-361ab1f8b1fb]

The Rest of World signal also reports lag starting off on the F70 hybrid motor. [signal:32690f31-9f41-4c8f-b344-7a8647cc9e65] The two USA signals concern G60 acceleration strength versus a Tesla and delayed hybrid power delivery. [signal:1f318bfb-2e5e-469a-acac-70809a0fa637] [signal:635816bd-d70e-47e2-94f3-2c5cbaa69ab1]

## Open questions
- How often does the reported delay occur, and under what driving conditions?
- How does the experience vary between drivetrain configurations and drive modes?
- How do drivers assess acceleration strength relative to the vehicles they compare against?

value.title: F70 drivetrain performance feels inconsistent to owners
value.summary: F70 owners report both improved, satisfying performance and disappointing accelerator response or a different-feeling drivetrain. The feedback comes from Europe and Rest of World.
highlights: Owners disagree on whether F70 drivetrain performance is improved or disappointing.
Feedback concerns the F70 in Europe and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
F70 drivetrain feedback is mixed: some owners describe better or satisfying performance, while one owner reports poor accelerator response and disappointment with the driving experience. [signal:2dff7a7b-12c1-4a44-ae25-bcb2013b7967] [signal:2124ce6b-eb92-44c3-b7ab-cd0e76efddc3] [signal:5b09384f-6867-4398-91d3-566af4806aa5]

## What customers say
One owner moving from a 118i says the 120i engine is superior, more powerful and more economical as a hybrid. [signal:2124ce6b-eb92-44c3-b7ab-cd0e76efddc3]
Another owner says the car has excellent road performance, and others describe improved performance or satisfaction with the mild-hybrid system. [signal:5b09384f-6867-4398-91d3-566af4806aa5] [signal:93585c14-23be-4e1a-9b95-12be73840496] [signal:b03bbbd5-b570-4217-82c6-4265a145d36a]
By contrast, one owner found the accelerator response poor and expected a nicer driving experience. [signal:2dff7a7b-12c1-4a44-ae25-bcb2013b7967]
One owner coming from a 120d says the performance felt quite different at first, but became more comfortable with it over time. [signal:92a4e2d9-c26f-41f5-a0c8-9e66cef197da]

## Differences between markets
European feedback includes both positive accounts of improved or superior performance and a complaint about accelerator response. [signal:2124ce6b-eb92-44c3-b7ab-cd0e76efddc3] [signal:93585c14-23be-4e1a-9b95-12be73840496] [signal:2dff7a7b-12c1-4a44-ae25-bcb2013b7967]
Rest of World feedback describes excellent road performance, superior performance to a previous 118d, and satisfaction with the mild-hybrid system. [signal:5b09384f-6867-4398-91d3-566af4806aa5] [signal:9985d29f-a22d-489c-88f2-c60b826c23d0] [signal:b03bbbd5-b570-4217-82c6-4265a145d36a]

## Open questions
How common is the poor accelerator response compared with the positive performance feedback? [signal:2dff7a7b-12c1-4a44-ae25-bcb2013b7967] [signal:2124ce6b-eb92-44c3-b7ab-cd0e76efddc3]
Does the reported difference in performance feel persist for owners after they become accustomed to the drivetrain? [signal:92a4e2d9-c26f-41f5-a0c8-9e66cef197da]

## What customers say
An F70 driver in Europe says pickup is faster and the previous model’s lag is gone; the driver also finds the boost button handy when joining a motorway. [signal:24b94b1f-0d49-4794-a087-201258830c80]

In Rest of World, an F70 driver says the feeling of being pushed forward is much improved, while another says the car feels quicker rather than actually faster than the previous model. [signal:608b36ff-2225-4cdc-b02f-fff08517f488] [signal:f27f72fe-823d-42c8-8e21-263abd319df0]

A Rest of World G60 driver says performance is noticeably improved compared with the earlier model. [signal:64185611-a0cd-46ef-8634-d2ecd078ab27]

## Differences between markets
The Europe signal praises faster pickup and reduced lag in the F70. [signal:24b94b1f-0d49-4794-a087-201258830c80] Rest of World signals also praise performance, describing improved acceleration feel in the F70 and improved performance in the G60. All three signals are from USA G60 drivers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
No drivetrain performance problem is reported in these signals; instead, customers value the plug-in hybrid setup and how its power sources operate together. [signal:2fbdffe8-7acc-4e5f-9fb9-1076e37ec7d9] [signal:f59b3426-c448-4a97-a3e4-4b5a1d4c718c] [signal:f9373ce7-18e6-4cf4-b3cd-54f780c190f4]

## What customers say
One customer values having electric and conventional power sources, describing the setup as blending the best parts of electric driving and a conventional powertrain. [signal:2fbdffe8-7acc-4e5f-9fb9-1076e37ec7d9]

Another says the transition between battery drive and the gasoline engine is a favorite part of the vehicle’s driving comfort. [signal:f59b3426-c448-4a97-a3e4-4b5a1d4c718c]

A third enjoys how power comes on when the hybrid motor and gasoline engine work together. [signal:f9373ce7-18e6-4cf4-b3cd-54f780c190f4]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA and concern the G60; the signals provide no comparison with other markets. [signal:2fbdffe8-7acc-4e5f-9fb9-1076e37ec7d9] [signal:f59b3426-c448-4a97-a3e4-4b5a1d4c718c] [signal:f9373ce7-18e6-4cf4-b3cd-54f780c190f4]

## Open questions
The signals do not indicate how common these views are among G60 drivers beyond the three reported comments. [signal:2fbdffe8-7acc-4e5f-9fb9-1076e37ec7d9] [signal:f59b3426-c448-4a97-a3e4-4b5a1d4c718c] [signal:f9373ce7-18e6-4cf4-b3cd-54f780c190f4]

value.title: G60 performance feels weaker than previous BMWs
value.summary: Some G60 drivers in Rest of World say their 520i feels slower and heavier than a previous 320i, or that their 530 lacks the horsepower and acceleration they experienced in a 540. One driver connects the 530’s acceleration to merging onto major expressways.
highlights: G60 drivers report weaker-feeling acceleration and power than in their previous BMWs.
The signals concern Rest of World G60 520i and 530 drivers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 520i driver says the car feels slower and heavier than their previous 320i [signal:37c173e6-ce55-4225-b590-35e982945335]. A G60 530 driver says it does not feel as powerful as their previous 540 [signal:e43a4161-d9eb-444b-80d8-749f1142145c].

## What customers say
The 520i driver compares its performance unfavorably with the 320i [signal:37c173e6-ce55-4225-b590-35e982945335]. The 530 driver says the 540’s acceleration and horsepower helped with merging onto local expressways [signal:e43a4161-d9eb-444b-80d8-749f1142145c]. The same 530 quote appears in a signal labeled “like,” but its text also says the car does not feel as powerful as the 540 [signal:8acfe511-d748-49de-8377-6832653cf577].

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from Rest of World and concern the G60 [signal:37c173e6-ce55-4225-b590-35e982945335] [signal:e43a4161-d9eb-444b-80d8-749f1142145c] [signal:8acfe511-d748-49de-8377-6832653cf577].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish objective performance differences between the compared vehicles or how widely these impressions are shared [signal:37c173e6-ce55-4225-b590-35e982945335] [signal:e43a4161-d9eb-444b-80d8-749f1142145c] [signal:8acfe511-d748-49de-8377-6832653cf577].

value.title: Driving performance builds confidence and wins buyers
value.summary: Customers value BMW driving performance: it has prompted a recommendation and helped convince a customer to choose BMW over Audi.
highlights: Driving performance is valued and can influence recommendations and purchase decisions.
Signals cover F70 in Rest of World and G60 and G70 in the USA.
One USA customer chose BMW over Audi after a test drive.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers value BMW driving performance as a reason to recommend or choose the brand. [signal:41721bba-fa9e-413a-a39c-9d1a8b80bf58] [signal:53b39b5c-43d8-45f3-b5db-2011c0d20d5d] [signal:ab1017ea-3df6-47e8-98a6-31f0b216c651]

## What customers say
A customer said driving performance led them to recommend a 2 Series Gran Coupe, which an acquaintance then purchased at another store. [signal:41721bba-fa9e-413a-a39c-9d1a8b80bf58]
A G60 customer said they now understood why BMW is called the “ultimate driving machine.” [signal:53b39b5c-43d8-45f3-b5db-2011c0d20d5d]
A G70 customer who had planned to buy an Audi said a BMW test drive convinced them to choose BMW instead. [signal:ab1017ea-3df6-47e8-98a6-31f0b216c651]

## Differences between markets
The signals show positive feedback in Rest of World for the F70 and in the USA for the G60 and G70; they do not report conflicting views. [signal:41721bba-fa9e-413a-a39c-9d1a8b80bf58] [signal:53b39b5c-43d8-45f3-b5db-2011c0d20d5d] [signal:ab1017ea-3df6-47e8-98a6-31f0b216c651]

## Open questions
Which aspects of driving performance mattered most to these customers?

value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals describe drivetrain performance as strong or satisfying rather than identifying a performance shortfall. [signal:3ed18e7e-369d-4148-9e67-f83198bd70fa] [signal:782a51c2-08ac-4124-874c-b0aaed7b1a38] [signal:a9700817-032a-4abf-92b0-f09e8ced8b0f]

A G60 driver rates performance and stability strongly, giving 9 rather than 10 because of limited storage and an awkward touchpad. [signal:a9700817-032a-4abf-92b0-f09e8ced8b0f]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the Rest of World market, covering the F70, G70 and G60. [signal:3ed18e7e-369d-4148-9e67-f83198bd70fa] [signal:782a51c2-08ac-4124-874c-b0aaed7b1a38] [signal:a9700817-032a-4abf-92b0-f09e8ced8b0f]

## Open questions
The signals praise performance but do not specify which performance attributes customers value most. [signal:3ed18e7e-369d-4148-9e67-f83198bd70fa] [signal:782a51c2-08ac-4124-874c-b0aaed7b1a38] [signal:a9700817-032a-4abf-92b0-f09e8ced8b0f]

value.title: Drivetrain performance feedback remains incomplete
value.summary: Drivetrain performance is praised in several signals, but one F70 owner has not yet assessed the engine at high speeds. The signals cover F70 and G60 drivers in Rest of World, Europe and the USA.
highlights: One F70 owner has not yet assessed engine capability during high-speed driving.
Signals cover 3 F70s and 2 G60s across Rest of World, Europe and the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Feedback is mostly positive, but one F70 owner says they have not yet experienced real high-speed driving and cannot rate the engine. [signal:bb83a36b-a37f-4e2c-8c05-2a68586a271d]

## What customers say
F70 drivers describe improved overall driving performance, power, and a safe, enjoyable drive. [signal:40efd654-0353-42db-bfba-ec2405d462c4] [signal:c71b9072-a8a1-40e2-adf8-79d00a21d378]
G60 drivers praise the 540i’s power and say its drivetrain is better than the previous 540i. [signal:b916c0b3-3c91-477f-b0d7-336760b87d43] [signal:de048ee3-e473-4809-b8b4-1e998271b1ed]

## Differences between markets
The F70 feedback includes positive performance comments from Europe and Rest of World, while the Rest of World feedback also includes an owner who has not yet assessed the engine at high speeds. [signal:c71b9072-a8a1-40e2-adf8-79d00a21d378] [signal:40efd654-0353-42db-bfba-ec2405d462c4] [signal:bb83a36b-a37f-4e2c-8c05-2a68586a271d]
Both USA G60 signals are positive about power or drivetrain performance. [signal:b916c0b3-3c91-477f-b0d7-336760b87d43] [signal:de048ee3-e473-4809-b8b4-1e998271b1ed]

## Open questions
The F70 owner has not yet tested the car on real high-speed runs, so engine capability remains unassessed in that signal. [signal:bb83a36b-a37f-4e2c-8c05-2a68586a271d]
Another F70 owner says winter-road driving is still ahead and they do not yet know how the car compares with four-wheel drive. [signal:40efd654-0353-42db-bfba-ec2405d462c4]

## What customers say

An F70 customer says the 2.0-litre diesel is the best diesel and praises how easy the car is to ride in. [signal:d3001e00-99d1-44f2-812f-0a336d8f3846]

## Differences between markets
The positive comments come from Europe for the G60 and Rest of World for the F70; the signals do not compare the markets directly. [signal:4c6c7cee-c871-4eee-ad02-2fdc4904ef5a] [signal:d3001e00-99d1-44f2-812f-0a336d8f3846]

## Open questions
The signals do not provide further detail on how broadly these preferences are shared. [signal:4c6c7cee-c871-4eee-ad02-2fdc4904ef5a] [signal:72d7f77f-1b80-4761-86d9-4e5ab526d605] [signal:d3001e00-99d1-44f2-812f-0a336d8f3846]

value.title: Luxury and performance valued together in electrified vehicles
value.summary: Customers value a combination of luxury and performance in the G60 and G70, including smooth, sporty driving and performance that does not feel lacking.
highlights: Customers value the combination of luxury and drivetrain performance.
Signals cover four USA customers with the G60 and one Rest of World customer with the G70.
One i7 owner compares it favorably with a previous Mercedes-Benz 580.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals describe a valued combination of luxury and performance, rather than a reported performance problem. USA customers praise the G60’s mix of luxury and performance, and one describes it as smooth and sporty [signal:4dee3553-2419-44e2-b9d8-d8937b131c8c] [signal:704e0f63-e268-49cf-afd4-3b4d5d32a488] [signal:87c6377b-ba06-4aa6-80f7-811f36fb59f7] [signal:a586263c-acf9-4ee3-ae6c-d9e67ae57316].

## What customers say
One USA customer says the G60 combines luxury with strong performance [signal:a586263c-acf9-4ee3-ae6c-d9e67ae57316]. Another specifically sought a vehicle mixing luxury and performance [signal:87c6377b-ba06-4aa6-80f7-811f36fb59f7]. A Rest of World customer says the G70 i7’s performance does not feel lacking, while also expressing satisfaction with convenience and cost-effectiveness [signal:8e02aa6d-5a12-4c0d-b644-e3c1f5906aa2].

## Differences between markets
The USA signals praise the G60’s luxury-and-performance mix [signal:4dee3553-2419-44e2-b9d8-d8937b131c8c] [signal:704e0f63-e268-49cf-afd4-3b4d5d32a488] [signal:87c6377b-ba06-4aa6-80f7-811f36fb59f7] [signal:a586263c-acf9-4ee3-ae6c-d9e67ae57316]. The Rest of World signal praises the G70 i7’s performance, but also notes that service takes too much time [signal:8e02aa6d-5a12-4c0d-b644-e3c1f5906aa2].

## Open questions
The signals do not specify particular performance attributes that customers want improved [signal:4dee3553-2419-44e2-b9d8-d8937b131c8c] [signal:704e0f63-e268-49cf-afd4-3b4d5d32a488] [signal:87c6377b-ba06-4aa6-80f7-811f36fb59f7] [signal:8e02aa6d-5a12-4c0d-b644-e3c1f5906aa2] [signal:a586263c-acf9-4ee3-ae6c-d9e67ae57316].
