value.title: Drivetrain response feels too abrupt or too soft
value.summary: USA customers describe drivetrain response as either too abrupt or too soft and slow, while others value its smooth acceleration. The signals cover G60 and G70 drivers.
highlights: Customers report acceleration that can feel too abrupt, too sensitive, or too slow.
All six signals are from the USA: three concern G60 and three concern G70.
One customer says BMW acceleration feels smoother and less sudden than in a Taycan.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers find acceleration too sensitive or abrupt, including reports of the car taking off with slight pedal input or jumping off the line [signal:74ee9e21-af03-43db-9c0b-f686da1d8730] [signal:b90acf45-85f0-448d-a1e5-99ba8fcd2c4a] [signal:e1143cba-39c6-4b0d-90b9-259bb7cff86d]. Another customer describes the engine as slow and the driving feel as unlike BMWs they previously owned [signal:81203624-8f31-416b-a34e-19f136f2e641].

## What customers say
A G70 driver moving from a 740i to a 760i says gradual acceleration is difficult and slight pedal input causes a strong launch and neck soreness [signal:74ee9e21-af03-43db-9c0b-f686da1d8730]. Another G70 driver finds the throttle softer than in a previous 7 Series but still wants it less sensitive [signal:b90acf45-85f0-448d-a1e5-99ba8fcd2c4a]. A G60 driver says the car jumps off the line and feels harsh, even at idle [signal:e1143cba-39c6-4b0d-90b9-259bb7cff86d].

Other customers value the acceleration: one G60 driver describes it as very smooth because the car does not shift through multiple gears [signal:b24eb8a2-debb-4678-84e2-c0e306986fd0]. One G70 driver says BMW torque feels smoother than in a Taycan, with the same speed but less sudden acceleration [signal:b58aff1e-e8d3-4f85-844b-d1aeff33f82f].

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA: three concern G60 vehicles and three concern G70 vehicles [signal:74ee9e21-af03-43db-9c0b-f686da1d8730] [signal:81203624-8f31-416b-a34e-19f136f2e641] [signal:b90acf45-85f0-448d-a1e5-99ba8fcd2c4a] [signal:e1143cba-39c6-4b0d-90b9-259bb7cff86d] [signal:b24eb8a2-debb-4678-84e2-c0e306986fd0] [signal:b58aff1e-e8d3-4f85-844b-d1aeff33f82f]. The signals include both complaints and positive feedback about smoothness [signal:74ee9e21-af03-43db-9c0b-f686da1d8730] [signal:81203624-8f31-416b-a34e-19f136f2e641] [signal:b90acf45-85f0-448d-a1e5-99ba8fcd2c4a] [signal:e1143cba-39c6-4b0d-90b9-259bb7cff86d] [signal:b24eb8a2-debb-4678-84e2-c0e306986fd0] [signal:b58aff1e-e8d3-4f85-844b-d1aeff33f82f].

## Open questions
Do these differing impressions relate to vehicle or powertrain differences, or to customers' prior vehicles? The signals include a 740i-to-760i comparison and references to previous BMWs, but do not establish the cause of the differing experiences [signal:74ee9e21-af03-43db-9c0b-f686da1d8730] [signal:81203624-8f31-416b-a34e-19f136f2e641] [signal:b90acf45-85f0-448d-a1e5-99ba8fcd2c4a].

value.title: Rough restarts, engine behavior and drivetrain transitions
value.summary: Customers report rough engine restarts and transitions, idle stumbles, unexpected surging and delayed acceleration. These concerns appear in feedback about F70, G60 and G70 vehicles across the USA, Europe and Rest of World.
highlights: Rough restarts and transitions, idle stumbles, surging and delayed acceleration.
Reports cover F70, G60 and G70 in the USA, Europe and Rest of World.
One G70 customer compares restart smoothness with other brands and a 2024 530i.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe uneven or abrupt drivetrain behavior, including vibration on restart, rough engine-to-battery transitions, idle stumbles, unexpected surging and delayed acceleration. [signal:003319f7-7ae8-4068-b630-f4c9517bf1ef] [signal:212d2128-6241-4322-8432-0064ce60b54a] [signal:98da53be-a5de-4669-adb9-5d7180ce9db6] [signal:a911d86e-53f1-4236-ab08-29fe76f8ff78] [signal:ceb492a0-79d8-4415-bcb2-7ef00c48e99a]

## What customers say
A Rest of World F70 owner says the three-cylinder engine has annoying vibrations and poor fuel consumption. [signal:003319f7-7ae8-4068-b630-f4c9517bf1ef]

A USA G60 owner reports frequent brief engine stumbles at idle, even with auto start-stop turned off; another describes unexpected surging that seems linked to the auto on/off function. [signal:98da53be-a5de-4669-adb9-5d7180ce9db6] [signal:212d2128-6241-4322-8432-0064ce60b54a]

G70 feedback describes a rough 48V mild-hybrid restart and a rough-feeling transition between battery and engine. One customer compares the restart unfavorably with other brands and a 2024 530i. [signal:35c35398-c87a-4624-aeac-acbb070bacb0] [signal:a911d86e-53f1-4236-ab08-29fe76f8ff78]

A Rest of World F70 owner reports strong vibration when the engine restarts after stop-and-ready, and says the engine revs up too quickly. [signal:ceb492a0-79d8-4415-bcb2-7ef00c48e99a]

A Europe F70 owner reports a delay when accelerating, including while reversing, which makes the car feel jumpy. [signal:85a501a5-3efa-4726-a8ec-0ca0114434b8]

## Differences between markets
The provided reports include idle stumbles and surging in USA G60s, rough mild-hybrid behavior in USA G70s, and restart vibration in Rest of World F70s. [signal:98da53be-a5de-4669-adb9-5d7180ce9db6] [signal:212d2128-6241-4322-8432-0064ce60b54a] [signal:35c35398-c87a-4624-aeac-acbb070bacb0] [signal:ceb492a0-79d8-4415-bcb2-7ef00c48e99a]

A Europe F70 report describes delayed, jumpy acceleration, while the other supplied Europe F70 reports do not mention drivetrain behavior. [signal:85a501a5-3efa-4726-a8ec-0ca0114434b8] [signal:5d2b9942-c7a1-4062-aaa6-8f6f57a200ae] [signal:643c1e6e-593d-474d-8280-873338631e31] [signal:74b146eb-894a-4220-8e6b-392e5d12963e]

## Open questions
Do the reported restarts, transitions, stumbles and surges share a cause, or are they separate behaviors? [signal:35c35398-c87a-4624-aeac-acbb070bacb0] [signal:98da53be-a5de-4669-adb9-5d7180ce9db6] [signal:212d2128-6241-4322-8432-0064ce60b54a] [signal:ceb492a0-79d8-4415-bcb2-7ef00c48e99a]

How frequently do these behaviors occur, and under what driving conditions? The supplied reports do not establish a common frequency or set of conditions. [signal:98da53be-a5de-4669-adb9-5d7180ce9db6] [signal:212d2128-6241-4322-8432-0064ce60b54a] [signal:35c35398-c87a-4624-aeac-acbb070bacb0]

value.title: Drivetrain faults, warning lights and inconsistent engine behavior
value.summary: Drivers report drivetrain faults that can make a vehicle undriveable, check-engine warnings requiring service, and concerns about engine behavior or hybrid integration. The sample includes reports involving G70 and G60 vehicles in the USA and F70 vehicles in Europe and the Rest of World.
highlights: Drivetrain faults, warning lights and engine-behavior concerns disrupt confidence and use.
Eight related reports in the sample: six USA, one Europe and one Rest of World; vehicles include G70, G60 and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe drivetrain faults and warning lights that prompt service, as well as concerns about engine behavior and hybrid integration. One G70 owner said a drivetrain fault made the vehicle undriveable and required a tow [signal:4c656e11-937b-42f6-a7d3-229e3c96b656]. A G70 customer reported a drivetrain malfunction while the vehicle was at a dealer with no repair ETA [signal:05c10d50-3ded-40f9-9b38-1de0d6d367a3].

## What customers say
G70 owners reported check-engine warnings that led to dealer visits; one also described a part lodged in the air intake and causing the engine to run too hot [signal:2f3ddf37-6c05-4cc1-8adc-f64374f592d7] [signal:28507f42-1fe1-4c5b-a04e-d2b10e84696a]. A G60 customer said a check-engine light and other warning messages prompted a service visit [signal:22f3ce9c-79d1-439e-8273-b7c4ead879d5]. Another G60 driver described rough idling during warm-up that improved once the engine was warm [signal:4d41fb15-20d4-4076-8713-4579fa4712b1].

An F70 owner said a software issue caused loss of control over acceleration, though the dealer could not find a fault [signal:3bb4da68-f837-4801-a061-1e13e2f36498]. An F70 owner also criticized how the hybrid system links with the engine [signal:3b1a1deb-8e92-4c23-aa7e-73971d38528e].

## Differences between markets
The sample contains six related reports from the USA involving G70 and G60 vehicles [signal:05c10d50-3ded-40f9-9b38-1de0d6d367a3] [signal:22f3ce9c-79d1-439e-8273-b7c4ead879d5] [signal:28507f42-1fe1-4c5b-a04e-d2b10e84696a] [signal:2f3ddf37-6c05-4cc1-8adc-f64374f592d7] [signal:4c656e11-937b-42f6-a7d3-229e3c96b656] [signal:4d41fb15-20d4-4076-8713-4579fa4712b1]. Europe has one F70 report about acceleration control [signal:3bb4da68-f837-4801-a061-1e13e2f36498], while the Rest of World has one F70 report about hybrid-engine integration [signal:3b1a1deb-8e92-4c23-aa7e-73971d38528e]. These reports describe different symptoms, so the sample does not establish whether the underlying issues are shared.

## Open questions
- What causes the reported drivetrain faults and warning lights, and are they related? [signal:05c10d50-3ded-40f9-9b38-1de0d6d367a3] [signal:22f3ce9c-79d1-439e-8273-b7c4ead879d5] [signal:4c656e11-937b-42f6-a7d3-229e3c96b656]
- What was the root cause of the acceleration-control issue that the dealer could not reproduce? [signal:3bb4da68-f837-4801-a061-1e13e2f36498]
- How common are these symptoms across the full set of 49 signals?

value.title: Traffic camera alerts are hard to activate and unreliable
value.summary: USA customers report missing or unavailable traffic camera alerts, confusion about subscriptions, trials and updates, and uncertainty about where alerts appear. Signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers struggle to activate the feature and report alerts missing or not working.
USA signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that traffic camera alerts do not appear or stop appearing, including when a subscription is shown as active. [signal:296186b6-82b3-40f9-9083-cfbbc5e30ca7] [signal:8c9f436a-374a-4454-b3c8-557e56887ecf] [signal:baf6dbae-4d7f-4aed-a5e2-c6064a95b7f9] Customers also describe confusion about whether an iPhone is required, whether a subscription or trial is active, and what updates or settings are needed. [signal:44c7e95d-28ed-49ba-9f78-2d7a8c529888] [signal:8c9f436a-374a-4454-b3c8-557e56887ecf] [signal:296186b6-82b3-40f9-9083-cfbbc5e30ca7]

## What customers say
One G60 customer said alerts had never appeared, even at known camera locations; the support response suggested checking app updates and data privacy permissions. [signal:296186b6-82b3-40f9-9083-cfbbc5e30ca7] A G70 customer said alerts that had previously worked no longer appeared and thought the trial had already been activated. [signal:8c9f436a-374a-4454-b3c8-557e56887ecf]

Customers received conflicting expectations about trial length: one said they had been told it would last three months but it ended after one month. [signal:cacaeb18-7997-4ac5-886f-63d566035819] One customer asked whether alerts were limited to the Head-Up Display; support explained they could also appear in the navigation view. [signal:486ca737-72a8-4906-995b-50085500a4d0]

## Differences between markets
All supplied signals are from the USA and concern G60 or G70 vehicles, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:296186b6-82b3-40f9-9083-cfbbc5e30ca7] [signal:44c7e95d-28ed-49ba-9f78-2d7a8c529888] [signal:486ca737-72a8-4906-995b-50085500a4d0] [signal:8c9f436a-374a-4454-b3c8-557e56887ecf] [signal:baf6dbae-4d7f-4aed-a5e2-c6064a95b7f9] [signal:cacaeb18-7997-4ac5-886f-63d566035819]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why alerts are missing when customers expect the feature to be active, or whether the suggested updates and privacy settings resolve the issue. [signal:296186b6-82b3-40f9-9083-cfbbc5e30ca7] [signal:baf6dbae-4d7f-4aed-a5e2-c6064a95b7f9] They also leave unclear why the reported trial duration differed from the customer’s expectation. [signal:cacaeb18-7997-4ac5-886f-63d566035819]

## Problem

No specific problem with the feature is reported in these signals [signal:555be8d4-f747-428c-bbef-3767d47f6dcd] [signal:6311d441-7c29-4379-bb37-2cb2ccc2bc6d] [signal:72dfc6f7-724b-497d-a87f-7f257b92bcce].

## What customers say
A Europe-based F70 driver says speed-camera details are useful [signal:555be8d4-f747-428c-bbef-3767d47f6dcd]. A USA-based G60 customer calls the feature nice to have while testing it [signal:6311d441-7c29-4379-bb37-2cb2ccc2bc6d]. Another USA-based G60 customer received a notice to renew the Traffic Camera program after the free trial ended [signal:72dfc6f7-724b-497d-a87f-7f257b92bcce].

## Differences between markets
The Europe signal is from an F70 driver and describes speed-camera details as useful; the two USA signals are from G60 customers and describe the feature positively or mention trial renewal [signal:555be8d4-f747-428c-bbef-3767d47f6dcd] [signal:6311d441-7c29-4379-bb37-2cb2ccc2bc6d] [signal:72dfc6f7-724b-497d-a87f-7f257b92bcce]. These signals do not establish whether views differ by market [signal:555be8d4-f747-428c-bbef-3767d47f6dcd] [signal:6311d441-7c29-4379-bb37-2cb2ccc2bc6d] [signal:72dfc6f7-724b-497d-a87f-7f257b92bcce].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how broadly customers value the feature beyond these three accounts [signal:555be8d4-f747-428c-bbef-3767d47f6dcd] [signal:6311d441-7c29-4379-bb37-2cb2ccc2bc6d] [signal:72dfc6f7-724b-497d-a87f-7f257b92bcce].

value.title: Charging port placement and connection usability concerns
value.summary: Some US G60 customers find the rear charging-port position inconvenient, while a US G70 customer reports intermittent charging connection failures. Other US customers mention access to Tesla charging stations and charging speed.
highlights: US G60 customers report inconvenient charging-port placement; a US G70 customer reports charging sometimes fails to start.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70, plus one Europe F70 signal unrelated to port usability.
A US G70 customer asks for Tesla charging-station usability.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some US G60 customers say the charging port’s rear position makes it inconvenient to reach with home or station cables. [signal:e7b61684-bdc1-4980-b8c2-3d07c8c75fb5] [signal:8687f230-97a9-4bcc-a146-364596a1edd7] One US G60 customer describes the placement as a small inconvenience. [signal:dd7531dd-045c-4483-adf5-300fd282d9d5] A US G70 customer says charging sometimes fails to start and may require several reconnections. [signal:df9dc60e-e9c0-489c-b931-7d7f5d9c9cca]

## What customers say
A US G60 customer says the rear port means reversing into a garage or charging station for the cable to reach, and prefers a driver-side port. [signal:e7b61684-bdc1-4980-b8c2-3d07c8c75fb5] Another says home charging setups commonly place the cable on the driver side. [signal:8687f230-97a9-4bcc-a146-364596a1edd7] A US G70 customer reports a red error flash when plugging in and says it can take four or five attempts before the blue charging light appears. [signal:df9dc60e-e9c0-489c-b931-7d7f5d9c9cca] A US G70 customer wants the vehicle to be usable at Tesla charging stations. [signal:040e674e-6421-4d63-9715-9dcf309bd57c] Another US G70 customer would prefer faster charging. [signal:c07887bb-49c3-45eb-9a41-2ddd9a0447c6]

## Differences between markets
The port-placement and charging-connection concerns in these signals are from the USA, involving G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:dd7531dd-045c-4483-adf5-300fd282d9d5] [signal:e7b61684-bdc1-4980-b8c2-3d07c8c75fb5] [signal:8687f230-97a9-4bcc-a146-364596a1edd7] [signal:df9dc60e-e9c0-489c-b931-7d7f5d9c9cca] The Europe F70 signal mentions a shortage of charging points, not charging-socket usability. [signal:9ab20518-b5f4-44da-afd6-bb74d30fb981]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often charging fails to start or whether the reported issue has a common cause. [signal:df9dc60e-e9c0-489c-b931-7d7f5d9c9cca] They also do not quantify how widely port placement affects customers beyond the individual G60 reports. [signal:dd7531dd-045c-4483-adf5-300fd282d9d5] [signal:e7b61684-bdc1-4980-b8c2-3d07c8c75fb5] [signal:8687f230-97a9-4bcc-a146-364596a1edd7]

value.title: Unwanted and artificial drivetrain sounds
value.summary: Customers report intrusive or concerning engine and drivetrain noises, while others value a quiet cabin or dislike artificial engine sound. The signals include experiences from F70 and G70 owners across Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Engine and drivetrain sounds range from concerning noises to artificial or unwanted sound.
Sound-related signals cover F70 and G70 vehicles in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe engine and drivetrain sounds that feel concerning, distracting or unnatural, while another customer values barely hearing the engine. [signal:70c3765b-e2cc-4167-9212-568809a62cb9] [signal:76c68455-67ae-4cf6-9c22-0700841e8991] [signal:8024b413-2ccd-4c1c-97e4-cc028acf5cf2] [signal:87d520b1-b0ec-4cdd-9e8d-59ce541683b1] [signal:ebd1d1e1-84cb-4edc-8c4a-1194dfc180d2] [signal:fc9e1c5e-3a98-4e16-97a9-48fddace5513]

## What customers say
One F70 owner says the engine sounds awful at startup; another reports a droning noise from the rear that has been present since vehicle delivery. [signal:70c3765b-e2cc-4167-9212-568809a62cb9] [signal:76c68455-67ae-4cf6-9c22-0700841e8991]
A Rest of World customer says the vehicle makes a loud sound for a while after the engine is switched off, and a USA G70 owner describes a distracting repeated knocking sound traced by the dealership to a valve that moves fuel vapors toward the engine. [signal:8024b413-2ccd-4c1c-97e4-cc028acf5cf2] [signal:87d520b1-b0ec-4cdd-9e8d-59ce541683b1]
Experiences differ: one F70 owner in Rest of World says the engine is hardly audible in the cabin, while another F70 owner dislikes the fake engine sound and wants a more natural sporty tone. [signal:ebd1d1e1-84cb-4edc-8c4a-1194dfc180d2] [signal:fc9e1c5e-3a98-4e16-97a9-48fddace5513]

## Differences between markets
European F70 owners report an unpleasant startup sound and rear droning, while another European F70 owner objects to fake engine sound. [signal:70c3765b-e2cc-4167-9212-568809a62cb9] [signal:76c68455-67ae-4cf6-9c22-0700841e8991] [signal:fc9e1c5e-3a98-4e16-97a9-48fddace5513]
In Rest of World, an F70 owner reports a loud sound after engine shutdown, while another says the engine is barely audible in the cabin. [signal:8024b413-2ccd-4c1c-97e4-cc028acf5cf2] [signal:ebd1d1e1-84cb-4edc-8c4a-1194dfc180d2]
A USA G70 owner reports a repeated rear knocking sound. [signal:87d520b1-b0ec-4cdd-9e8d-59ce541683b1]

## Open questions
Is the startup sound reported on the F70 expected for the model, or specific to that vehicle? The owner says the dealer found no fault, while the report also mentions an unresolved warning light. [signal:70c3765b-e2cc-4167-9212-568809a62cb9]
How common are the rear drone and post-shutdown sounds, and how do customers distinguish normal operating sounds from faults? [signal:76c68455-67ae-4cf6-9c22-0700841e8991] [signal:8024b413-2ccd-4c1c-97e4-cc028acf5cf2]

value.title: Owner’s manual is difficult to read and follow
value.summary: Some USA G70 and G60 owners find the owner’s manual difficult to use: complaints cite tiny print, a complicated format and a length of more than 400 pages. One older G70 owner says the manual is hard to follow and has relied on dealer visits and YouTube for information.
highlights: Owners describe the manual as complicated, hard to read or too long.
All three signals are from the USA: two concern the G70 and one the G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners report difficulty using the manual, citing tiny print, a complicated format and a length of more than 400 pages. [signal:30d42b5a-9034-43b5-a590-0bf8de4c8797] [signal:39f15a06-5cbb-4d7e-83d4-587a71266339] [signal:773eafa4-4c50-4243-93d9-cdee41b72e65]

## What customers say
One G70 owner, close to 80, says the small lettering is hard to read even with eyeglasses and that the manual is difficult to follow; he reports returning to the dealer to get features set up and turning to YouTube for information. [signal:39f15a06-5cbb-4d7e-83d4-587a71266339] Another G70 complaint describes the manual as overly complicated. [signal:30d42b5a-9034-43b5-a590-0bf8de4c8797] A G60 owner says the manual is more than 400 pages and prefers relying on the dealership to become familiar with the car. [signal:773eafa4-4c50-4243-93d9-cdee41b72e65]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA: two concern the G70 and one the G60. [signal:30d42b5a-9034-43b5-a590-0bf8de4c8797] [signal:39f15a06-5cbb-4d7e-83d4-587a71266339] [signal:773eafa4-4c50-4243-93d9-cdee41b72e65] The G70 complaints mention complexity and tiny print, while the G60 complaint emphasizes the manual’s length. [signal:30d42b5a-9034-43b5-a590-0bf8de4c8797] [signal:39f15a06-5cbb-4d7e-83d4-587a71266339] [signal:773eafa4-4c50-4243-93d9-cdee41b72e65]

## Open questions
Do these difficulties affect owners beyond the three complaints represented here? [signal:30d42b5a-9034-43b5-a590-0bf8de4c8797] [signal:39f15a06-5cbb-4d7e-83d4-587a71266339] [signal:773eafa4-4c50-4243-93d9-cdee41b72e65]

value.title: Owner's manual hard to access in a preferred format
value.summary: Some owners miss a printed handbook or find digital information difficult to use; others want more focused or video-based guidance. Signals cover F70 owners in Europe and G70/G60 owners in the USA.
highlights: Owners miss printed manuals or find digital guidance difficult to access and use.
Signals mention Europe (F70) and the USA (G70 and G60).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners say their car did not come with the paper manual they expected, or that they would rather consult a printed handbook than digital information. [signal:2c480b84-a2b2-40bf-9f0b-254b864faa12] [signal:ffebd26d-387d-43b1-a819-4bdd38013c37] [signal:2aec79df-a754-4bad-ad16-a68eb5c300ce] [signal:5860235b-2416-4c4d-803e-a1399a6cf461]

Others ask for different ways to access guidance, including a video walkthrough, a paper list of voice commands, or a smaller manual focused on key functions. [signal:08409202-7858-4d39-814b-5295aae440cd] [signal:2d747e1c-85cd-4b80-8d4a-849bf21ef703] [signal:78af839b-0d91-4277-9000-682827bf6a7f]

## What customers say
One F70 owner says a promised paper manual was not delivered despite repeated follow-ups. [signal:ffebd26d-387d-43b1-a819-4bdd38013c37]

Some owners say they dislike relying on digital information or find screen-based controls distracting or difficult to navigate. [signal:2c480b84-a2b2-40bf-9f0b-254b864faa12] [signal:2aec79df-a754-4bad-ad16-a68eb5c300ce] [signal:07a64869-4ef2-40ed-8413-d57cb5aa4e24]

Requests vary: one USA customer wants the complete manual as video content, another wants a printed list of voice commands, and another wants a compact manual for important functions. [signal:08409202-7858-4d39-814b-5295aae440cd] [signal:2d747e1c-85cd-4b80-8d4a-849bf21ef703] [signal:78af839b-0d91-4277-9000-682827bf6a7f]

Experiences are not uniform: one F70 owner describes iDrive as straightforward to operate, while other owners report difficulty with digital controls and menus. [signal:3056d850-8f3d-40d6-aa44-e4c712bf44fb] [signal:07a64869-4ef2-40ed-8413-d57cb5aa4e24] [signal:97189606-42b0-4d47-832e-324c6bf2b791]

## Differences between markets
The provided signals include requests and complaints from Europe for the F70, and from the USA for the G70 and G60. [signal:2c480b84-a2b2-40bf-9f0b-254b864faa12] [signal:ffebd26d-387d-43b1-a819-4bdd38013c37] [signal:08409202-7858-4d39-814b-5295aae440cd] [signal:48bc21ee-241b-45d3-91f3-c52f129a704e]

The provided examples do not establish whether preferences for printed, digital, or video guidance differ by market. [signal:2aec79df-a754-4bad-ad16-a68eb5c300ce] [signal:5860235b-2416-4c4d-803e-a1399a6cf461] [signal:08409202-7858-4d39-814b-5295aae440cd]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify how many owners received a paper manual, how often promised manuals were not delivered, or which format is preferred overall. [signal:ffebd26d-387d-43b1-a819-4bdd38013c37] [signal:5860235b-2416-4c4d-803e-a1399a6cf461] [signal:08409202-7858-4d39-814b-5295aae440cd]

The signals also do not show whether requests for a compact manual or video guidance are shared by other owners beyond the individual examples. [signal:78af839b-0d91-4277-9000-682827bf6a7f] [signal:08409202-7858-4d39-814b-5295aae440cd]

The five Europe signals concern F70 owners, several of whom miss a printed handbook or find digital information difficult to use. [signal:1001ed5e-3854-42ad-a34b-03a24eed2966] [signal:472d1711-14c8-49b7-84ea-758de1da21f2] [signal:a3cfa7a2-0b0f-4a4c-a130-6a971966697a] [signal:3fd66b2f-5a7c-4003-aa6b-d90dc4684158] [signal:adcc6ea0-14e4-49e3-b658-2ded26e70be3]
The single USA signal concerns a G60 owner’s view that the manual lacks detail and pictures compared with earlier versions. [signal:efda2c70-e9d6-42c4-adf6-37cb094de1d2]

## Open questions

value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners report difficulty learning and looking up vehicle functions when a paper handbook is absent or instructions are hard to understand. [signal:0ffb4048-35ca-46d3-9725-3e6873a59eef] [signal:19f0f10e-d1b1-46d0-ac9b-d823f3f9df8f] Some say they have not discovered or used features because instructions or initial explanations were insufficient. [signal:433e87d9-c4eb-492b-b300-3727be9aaed6] [signal:13abf7af-19b7-4e6e-8628-b6a973df381b]

## What customers say
Several owners miss a paper handbook as a convenient reference, including an older driver who says they are less comfortable using computers. [signal:0ffb4048-35ca-46d3-9725-3e6873a59eef] [signal:29834d95-21ba-4e41-8778-318d31a7a5c4] One owner says the manual is not well written and that digital icons make it take longer to understand vehicle functions. [signal:19f0f10e-d1b1-46d0-ac9b-d823f3f9df8f] Another says features have to be found or stumbled upon rather than located in a manual. [signal:433e87d9-c4eb-492b-b300-3727be9aaed6]

## Differences between markets
In the supplied sample, six signals are from Europe and concern F70 owners; two are from Rest of World and concern F70 owners; one is from the USA and concerns a G70 owner. [signal:0ffb4048-35ca-46d3-9725-3e6873a59eef] [signal:12485ca7-2c83-438b-b251-37177347c2a3] [signal:29834d95-21ba-4e41-8778-318d31a7a5c4] [signal:2b8097b8-b5d0-44b6-b40d-56a94208866e] [signal:433e87d9-c4eb-492b-b300-3727be9aaed6] [signal:5ba5948c-62ca-4801-8b8b-de401c7fa5cc] [signal:13abf7af-19b7-4e6e-8628-b6a973df381b] [signal:7d6af0ef-0f17-4fae-aa99-a8677cc84d4a] [signal:19f0f10e-d1b1-46d0-ac9b-d823f3f9df8f] The supplied signals across these markets describe manual or instruction usability concerns; they do not establish a market-level difference. [signal:0ffb4048-35ca-46d3-9725-3e6873a59eef] [signal:13abf7af-19b7-4e6e-8628-b6a973df381b] [signal:19f0f10e-d1b1-46d0-ac9b-d823f3f9df8f]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether owners can access a useful digital manual, or whether preferences for a paper handbook vary by age or market. [signal:0ffb4048-35ca-46d3-9725-3e6873a59eef] [signal:29834d95-21ba-4e41-8778-318d31a7a5c4] They also do not clarify how much difficulty comes from the manual itself versus limited guidance at vehicle handover. [signal:12485ca7-2c83-438b-b251-37177347c2a3] [signal:13abf7af-19b7-4e6e-8628-b6a973df381b]

The European F70 comments focus on paper handbook availability, delay, and difficulty using or understanding features; the US G70 comment focuses on manual length and menu navigation. [signal:8ac324f4-e00e-4f3d-a527-b6e5ec7c4d22] [signal:984f21a2-680e-48db-9f85-7f448f8c2c37] [signal:d5a0e66e-bf24-4de2-915c-bc9df77dd488] [signal:9bf2f7a5-7730-4f3a-901b-b93034e8665c]

The signals do not indicate what aspects of the manual, beyond helpfulness and clear step-by-step instructions, customers value. [signal:c87d17f4-7541-4ecb-b517-3efa551ea622] [signal:e464f4a2-47ba-4193-a009-e472bedd1896]

value.title: Head-up display difficult to read

value.body_md:

Customers report that the head-up display fades or is difficult to read. [signal:24d8bd62-0b15-47d1-9a6a-7a98cf729137] [signal:68222ab7-6245-4313-a45e-817fb262128c]

value.title: Head-up display visibility and availability concerns
value.summary: Drivers report that the head-up display disappears with polarized sunglasses, lacks Apple CarPlay directions, or is absent from a vehicle. These concerns appear in USA and Europe signals.
highlights: HUD visibility, content and availability are concerns.
Signals mention USA G70 and G60 vehicles and a Europe F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers report that the head-up display disappears when they wear polarized sunglasses and does not show Apple CarPlay directions. [signal:6e52cce9-1392-4073-a6f1-71ea67c3601f] A Europe F70 owner says the head-up display is gone. [signal:98614e84-d07e-433a-94f3-a2f6ecc269e0] A USA G70 signal mentions a change to the display in M mode, but the available quote is incomplete. [signal:1d7b38a4-a7d9-427c-8ad4-6730cdfa8430]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner says the display disappears with polarized sunglasses and Apple CarPlay directions do not appear on it. [signal:6e52cce9-1392-4073-a6f1-71ea67c3601f] A Europe F70 owner is unhappy that the head-up display is no longer present. [signal:98614e84-d07e-433a-94f3-a2f6ecc269e0]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals mention display behavior in G60 and G70 vehicles, while the Europe F70 signal describes the display being absent. [signal:6e52cce9-1392-4073-a6f1-71ea67c3601f] [signal:1d7b38a4-a7d9-427c-8ad4-6730cdfa8430] [signal:98614e84-d07e-433a-94f3-a2f6ecc269e0]

## Open questions
What change to the head-up display in M mode is described in the G70 signal? [signal:1d7b38a4-a7d9-427c-8ad4-6730cdfa8430] How common are the polarized-sunglasses visibility issue and missing Apple CarPlay directions? [signal:6e52cce9-1392-4073-a6f1-71ea67c3601f]

value.title: Head-Up Display visibility, information and availability vary
value.summary: Customers report issues with HUD positioning, visibility, displayed map information and size, while one F70 owner misses having the feature. Other customers value the HUD for keeping their eyes on the road.
highlights: Concerns include speed positioning, polarized-sunglass visibility, map details, display size and missing HUD availability.
Signals include USA G60 and G70, and Europe F70 and G60; both complaints and positive feedback appear.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers raise different concerns about the Head-Up Display: speed placement relative to the odometer, visibility with polarized sunglasses, the amount of Apple Maps information shown, and a display they find too large or obstructive. One F70 owner says the HUD is absent compared with their previous 118. [signal:bfe7df47-1c42-4c1c-9985-54b45d14e3ea] [signal:02622959-1526-43f7-9dce-81b74f0c66b3] [signal:c100dfee-6bc4-431b-9799-2cf8553a99ca] [signal:789a5253-1f77-48ba-8f21-c8522d7ad7fb] [signal:4831f6fe-c632-4f2f-a486-77cf02a9ac9c]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the speed appears in a different position from the odometer, and another wants an option to keep a map visible. [signal:bfe7df47-1c42-4c1c-9985-54b45d14e3ea] [signal:a190a7b9-3c0b-4fc4-9ccf-308b771d272b] A G70 customer says their 2022 X7 showed more Apple Maps information in the HUD. [signal:c100dfee-6bc4-431b-9799-2cf8553a99ca] One G70 owner finds the display large and obstructive. [signal:789a5253-1f77-48ba-8f21-c8522d7ad7fb]

Other customers value the feature: a G70 owner says they like it, and a G60 owner in Europe says it helps them keep their eyes on the road. [signal:07217afd-4806-4087-8f24-b2e8aa0f5afc] [signal:7acf16bb-215a-44dc-adb7-1a486fe3f914] A further European F70 owner also praises the HUD for allowing them to drive without taking their eyes off the road. [signal:fc7d0ac2-040d-41bd-a29d-e672adbbee05]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include HUD concerns from USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles, and a European F70 owner who misses the feature. [signal:bfe7df47-1c42-4c1c-9985-54b45d14e3ea] [signal:c100dfee-6bc4-431b-9799-2cf8553a99ca] [signal:02622959-1526-43f7-9dce-81b74f0c66b3] [signal:789a5253-1f77-48ba-8f21-c8522d7ad7fb] [signal:4831f6fe-c632-4f2f-a486-77cf02a9ac9c] European G60 and F70 owners also express positive views of the HUD. [signal:7acf16bb-215a-44dc-adb7-1a486fe3f914] [signal:bb1a6d35-1ef3-43d1-81ae-7feb3a6d2758] [signal:fc7d0ac2-040d-41bd-a29d-e672adbbee05]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread each concern is beyond the examples provided. [signal:bfe7df47-1c42-4c1c-9985-54b45d14e3ea] [signal:02622959-1526-43f7-9dce-81b74f0c66b3] [signal:c100dfee-6bc4-431b-9799-2cf8553a99ca] [signal:789a5253-1f77-48ba-8f21-c8522d7ad7fb] They also do not clarify which HUD configurations or conditions are associated with the reported visibility and information differences. [signal:02622959-1526-43f7-9dce-81b74f0c66b3] [signal:c100dfee-6bc4-431b-9799-2cf8553a99ca]

value.title: Head-up display visibility and positioning hinder use
value.summary: Some USA drivers say the head-up display is difficult to see or poorly positioned, including when wearing sunglasses or driving at night. A G60 customer also wanted radio-station information to appear, while the Europe F70 signal is incomplete and does not establish a usability complaint.
highlights: Drivers report poor visibility, awkward positioning, and missing desired information.
USA G60 and G70 complaints; a Europe F70 signal is also present.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some USA drivers report that the head-up display is hard to see: polarized sunglasses can make it nearly invisible, and another driver says sunglasses prevent proper viewing. [signal:15280b88-0715-4adf-8e76-6d9a6a2bed7e] [signal:1812418c-a8a8-474a-88b7-f07c0d0005cd]
A G60 driver says the display takes up too much windshield area and interferes with night-driving visibility; another describes it as sitting too low. [signal:17bcda0d-ad1c-4fc2-a2fd-df1667264b4b] [signal:23e94555-eba6-4cf0-b4e9-788a31fc101d]
A G70 driver reports that daytime visibility is poor, especially for navigation directions. [signal:1f7c271b-bbf7-4b59-8d35-17b4840ec5d6]
A G60 customer wanted radio-station information in the display as in a previous car; the service writer said this content could be enabled in the settings. [signal:2a85928a-e71b-4de4-a5a2-195c0d93332d]

## What customers say
The complaints describe visibility problems in different conditions, including with sunglasses, in daylight, and at night. [signal:15280b88-0715-4adf-8e76-6d9a6a2bed7e] [signal:1812418c-a8a8-474a-88b7-f07c0d0005cd] [signal:17bcda0d-ad1c-4fc2-a2fd-df1667264b4b] [signal:1f7c271b-bbf7-4b59-8d35-17b4840ec5d6]
One G60 customer says the display is too low, while another wanted radio information shown. [signal:23e94555-eba6-4cf0-b4e9-788a31fc101d] [signal:2a85928a-e71b-4de4-a5a2-195c0d93332d]

## Differences between markets
The supplied usability complaints are from USA G60 and G70 drivers. [signal:15280b88-0715-4adf-8e76-6d9a6a2bed7e] [signal:17bcda0d-ad1c-4fc2-a2fd-df1667264b4b] [signal:1812418c-a8a8-474a-88b7-f07c0d0005cd] [signal:1f7c271b-bbf7-4b59-8d35-17b4840ec5d6] [signal:23e94555-eba6-4cf0-b4e9-788a31fc101d] [signal:2a85928a-e71b-4de4-a5a2-195c0d93332d]
The Europe F70 wish signal is truncated and does not provide enough detail to establish a usability view of the head-up display. [signal:1ee2d7ed-57bb-42d3-9070-55d376d0f9b1]

## Open questions
Do the visibility and positioning complaints occur under particular display settings or driver conditions? [signal:15280b88-0715-4adf-8e76-6d9a6a2bed7e] [signal:17bcda0d-ad1c-4fc2-a2fd-df1667264b4b] [signal:1812418c-a8a8-474a-88b7-f07c0d0005cd] [signal:1f7c271b-bbf7-4b59-8d35-17b4840ec5d6]

value.title: Public charging is unreliable and difficult to find on trips
value.summary: Drivers report difficulty finding working, compatible public chargers, especially on longer trips. The signals include complaints from G60 and G70 owners in the USA and a G70 owner in Europe.
highlights: Public charging can be scarce, unreliable, or difficult to use on trips.
Signals cover G60 and G70 owners in the USA and a G70 owner in Europe.
Tesla Superchargers, Hyundai, Electrify America, and Charge America are mentioned as comparisons or networks.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe public charging as difficult to access on longer journeys: compatible chargers can be hard to find, unavailable when reached, or perceived as too few. [signal:7123109b-7df6-4620-ab24-a577c09e8091] [signal:27142002-425a-4caf-89ae-679221b8d66b] One G60 owner says long-distance charging is a hassle and cites the lack of a BMW-owned fast-charging network and a delayed Tesla Supercharger agreement. [signal:208cc4b0-5d3e-4fd8-8c47-b216c19a8658]

## What customers say
A G70 owner in the USA says it is hard to find compatible chargers that work on long trips, and some stations are non-functional on arrival. [signal:7123109b-7df6-4620-ab24-a577c09e8091] A G60 owner in the USA describes chargers as often damaged or out of service, with few chargers and spaces available. [signal:27142002-425a-4caf-89ae-679221b8d66b] Another G60 owner says uncertain range on longer trips increases reliance on public charging and describes Electrify America as poor. [signal:8548249c-5385-4202-a61b-e8df772236db]

A G70 owner in the USA says many chargers they found were in isolated locations and some were not on Charge America. [signal:1f53afae-68ee-4a19-bb57-e1ff6f65861e] A G70 owner in Europe says missing EV infrastructure limits satisfaction. [signal:522837fb-ed18-413e-8cc9-9a7a28e8443d] One G60 owner compares BMW technology with Hyundai’s and another says the Tesla Supercharger agreement is taking too long. [signal:15735824-ccb7-48b3-a05e-d5c2d574268d] [signal:208cc4b0-5d3e-4fd8-8c47-b216c19a8658]

## Differences between markets
USA signals describe difficulty finding compatible, working chargers, low charger availability, and concerns about station locations. [signal:7123109b-7df6-4620-ab24-a577c09e8091] [signal:27142002-425a-4caf-89ae-679221b8d66b] [signal:1f53afae-68ee-4a19-bb57-e1ff6f65861e] A Europe signal describes missing EV infrastructure more generally. [signal:522837fb-ed18-413e-8cc9-9a7a28e8443d]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequently chargers are unavailable across networks or markets. [signal:7123109b-7df6-4620-ab24-a577c09e8091] [signal:27142002-425a-4caf-89ae-679221b8d66b] They also do not specify which charging network was involved in every reported difficulty. [signal:7123109b-7df6-4620-ab24-a577c09e8091]

value.title: Cluster information is hard to find and customize
value.summary: Some drivers report that basic information or preferred views are difficult to find, inaccurate, or insufficiently customizable, while some European F70 drivers value the display and its information.
highlights: Drivers report hidden information, hard-to-find views, inaccurate speed limits, and limited customization.
Signals include USA G60 and G70 drivers and Europe F70 drivers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say basic cluster information is buried among menus or that the display shows irrelevant information; others have difficulty locating a particular cluster view or want more customization. [signal:74a97d3d-7439-4d19-b380-26562b0f8621] [signal:668e4692-c9cb-4a0d-8534-7ab4088f23ae] [signal:bd6ff471-b6c9-49fa-96e7-58a0896cece8] [signal:324e781f-ffe0-4f7f-af6d-4c7224937a77]
A USA G70 driver reported that the cluster clock remained incorrect even though the iDrive time was accurate. [signal:51ed3056-9b80-449e-9fbb-97f569a0dc88] A USA G60 driver said the displayed speed limit was wrong more often than not. [signal:ca26c2f2-5c61-4a66-a7e9-9fe3c0d0ea9f]

## What customers say
A USA G60 driver struggled to find the odometer and another could not locate a preferred efficiency and regenerative-braking view. [signal:668e4692-c9cb-4a0d-8534-7ab4088f23ae] [signal:bd6ff471-b6c9-49fa-96e7-58a0896cece8] A USA G70 driver said the cluster position made the navigation screen difficult to view while using Android Auto. [signal:5668cd92-eb56-42d4-8133-40e39d78e64c]
European F70 feedback is mixed: one driver wanted more customization for dials and driving information, while another praised the full-screen setup and the amount of information shown. [signal:324e781f-ffe0-4f7f-af6d-4c7224937a77] [signal:d372d97f-5c24-4f2a-a336-eea1c4fd7260]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA signals describe difficulty finding information, inaccurate speed-limit information, a clock discrepancy, and a cluster-position concern. [signal:668e4692-c9cb-4a0d-8534-7ab4088f23ae] [signal:74a97d3d-7439-4d19-b380-26562b0f8621] [signal:ca26c2f2-5c61-4a66-a7e9-9fe3c0d0ea9f] [signal:51ed3056-9b80-449e-9fbb-97f569a0dc88] [signal:5668cd92-eb56-42d4-8133-40e39d78e64c] The supplied Europe F70 signals include both a request for more customization and praise for the display. [signal:324e781f-ffe0-4f7f-af6d-4c7224937a77] [signal:d372d97f-5c24-4f2a-a336-eea1c4fd7260]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often these issues occur beyond the examples provided. [signal:51ed3056-9b80-449e-9fbb-97f569a0dc88] [signal:668e4692-c9cb-4a0d-8534-7ab4088f23ae] [signal:ca26c2f2-5c61-4a66-a7e9-9fe3c0d0ea9f] They do not clarify which cluster views are most difficult to find across vehicle lines. [signal:bd6ff471-b6c9-49fa-96e7-58a0896cece8] [signal:324e781f-ffe0-4f7f-af6d-4c7224937a77]

value.title: Instrument information is hard to find, understand and read
value.summary: Drivers report difficulty finding and understanding basic information in the instrument cluster, while some European F70 drivers also find the instruments hard to read. The signals cover USA G60 and G70 drivers and Europe F70 drivers.
highlights: Drivers struggle to locate, understand or read instrument-cluster information.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70, and Europe F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers report difficulty understanding the combined mileage figure and finding odometer information in the G60 display [signal:03fe5939-ed52-4a40-9414-6b5fc47a47b7] [signal:0579fb53-b03b-493f-aa65-b1b4004ec457]. Another G60 driver found viewing and resetting the trip odometer complicated, involving multiple screens [signal:0caa170f-cbd4-42ab-876a-05d8038a020d]. A G70 driver described the gauges as “simply awful,” and another said the clock was difficult to locate [signal:2652f745-03e3-4383-840c-b1e164115cb7] [signal:14baa7df-5ab4-4da2-ab35-d4be036c1109].

## What customers say
A G60 driver could not find an explanation in the owner’s manual for the combined mileage figure or the range indicator shown in efficient mode [signal:03fe5939-ed52-4a40-9414-6b5fc47a47b7]. Other G60 drivers had trouble finding the odometer or accessing and resetting trip data [signal:0579fb53-b03b-493f-aa65-b1b4004ec457] [signal:0caa170f-cbd4-42ab-876a-05d8038a020d]. One driver said they wanted to view total miles rather than remaining fuel range, but the call ended before the issue was resolved [signal:145e716c-9517-44a9-8e21-63afc27ebf91].

A Europe F70 driver said the instruments were harder to read and less ergonomically laid out than those in an older 325 coupe, and found traditional analogue gauges easier to glance at without looking away from the road [signal:f979c749-2fa0-4fd9-9d86-927e7ba881ad]. Another F70 driver questioned the safety of interacting with the onboard computer while driving [signal:2a30eb3a-331a-4ed4-b33d-0b17c6402e1e].

## Differences between markets
The USA signals describe difficulty locating or interpreting specific information in G60 and G70 clusters [signal:03fe5939-ed52-4a40-9414-6b5fc47a47b7] [signal:0579fb53-b03b-493f-aa65-b1b4004ec457] [signal:0caa170f-cbd4-42ab-876a-05d8038a020d] [signal:14baa7df-5ab4-4da2-ab35-d4be036c1109] [signal:2652f745-03e3-4383-840c-b1e164115cb7]. The Europe F70 signals emphasize readability, glanceability and the difficulty of interacting with the onboard computer while driving [signal:f979c749-2fa0-4fd9-9d86-927e7ba881ad] [signal:2a30eb3a-331a-4ed4-b33d-0b17c6402e1e].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread each issue is across the 34 signals in the case, or whether the reported difficulties vary by cluster configuration. The available examples do not clarify which information or controls are most difficult for drivers to locate while driving.

value.title: Public charging access and reliability are inconsistent
value.summary: US customers report unreliable Electrify America stations, charging interruptions and a stuck connector; one also reports a prolonged delay setting up a charging wallet card. The signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Public charging access is disrupted by out-of-service stations, interrupted sessions and a stuck connector.
US signals mention G60 and G70 vehicles; five provided signals describe charging access or reliability issues.
Electrify America is specifically described as unreliable.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that public charging can be unavailable or interrupted, and that a connector can become stuck. One customer also reports being unable to use a wallet charging card for almost five months and paying for charging themselves. [signal:3b0f7406-7c25-48b1-aee1-15dd78dee1f2] [signal:503cc463-b250-4267-b977-808cf5917db5] [signal:5dc07fee-0b0d-4b97-824a-0e9086f0b855] [signal:606c92a5-2451-4879-979f-f39180a5710b] [signal:1b9e7ff1-a867-40fb-9889-001c8743af4f]

## What customers say
One G70 customer said many Electrify America chargers were not working and described being stuck for around two hours after a connector would not release until a technician took the handle apart. [signal:3b0f7406-7c25-48b1-aee1-15dd78dee1f2]

A G60 customer said one of two nearby Electrify America chargers was always out of service; another said the provider’s stations were constantly out of order. [signal:503cc463-b250-4267-b977-808cf5917db5] [signal:606c92a5-2451-4879-979f-f39180a5710b]

One G60 customer reported that a public charging session stopped after about two minutes on one side of a charger, but charging worked after moving the cable to the other side. [signal:5dc07fee-0b0d-4b97-824a-0e9086f0b855]

A G60 customer said a technical problem setting up the wallet charging card remained unresolved almost five months after purchase, leaving them to pay for charging. [signal:1b9e7ff1-a867-40fb-9889-001c8743af4f]

## Differences between markets
All relevant signals provided here are from the USA; they cover G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:1b9e7ff1-a867-40fb-9889-001c8743af4f] [signal:3b0f7406-7c25-48b1-aee1-15dd78dee1f2] [signal:503cc463-b250-4267-b977-808cf5917db5] [signal:5dc07fee-0b0d-4b97-824a-0e9086f0b855] [signal:606c92a5-2451-4879-979f-f39180a5710b]

## Open questions
Do these reported problems occur with other charging providers or in other markets?

How often do charging sessions fail or connectors become stuck, and how long do customers typically wait for resolution?

value.title: Charging flap lacks powered operation and an emergency release
value.summary: Some USA G60 customers want the charging flap to open and close automatically or have a safety release for emergencies. Another customer values being able to lock it.
highlights: Customers request powered opening and closing and an emergency safety release.
Signals are from five USA G60 entries; one customer values the flap’s lockability.
One customer compares automatic closing with a prior Mercedes EQE.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want the charging flap to open and close automatically, describing manual operation as low-tech. Another customer asks for a safety release for emergencies. [signal:6646620f-376f-4651-a946-8c2205291386] [signal:915f3cb6-f89e-4c8b-a7ba-dde3d24b26bf] [signal:f1aae96c-a118-49d3-94fc-523e59180825] [signal:1d81d9ec-0190-4c2b-93e7-86db80ec6caf]

## What customers say
One customer wishes the flap would close automatically, as on her prior Mercedes EQE. [signal:6646620f-376f-4651-a946-8c2205291386] Two entries contain the same request for powered opening and closing, with the customer calling the current experience low-tech. [signal:915f3cb6-f89e-4c8b-a7ba-dde3d24b26bf] [signal:f1aae96c-a118-49d3-94fc-523e59180825] Another customer likes that the charging flap can be locked. [signal:6707bbde-77d8-48ca-ae76-3047c88cbb0f]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA and concern the G60; no other market or vehicle is represented. [signal:1d81d9ec-0190-4c2b-93e7-86db80ec6caf] [signal:6646620f-376f-4651-a946-8c2205291386] [signal:915f3cb6-f89e-4c8b-a7ba-dde3d24b26bf] [signal:f1aae96c-a118-49d3-94fc-523e59180825] [signal:6707bbde-77d8-48ca-ae76-3047c88cbb0f]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify how often customers need an emergency release or whether the request for powered operation is shared beyond these entries. [signal:1d81d9ec-0190-4c2b-93e7-86db80ec6caf] [signal:915f3cb6-f89e-4c8b-a7ba-dde3d24b26bf]

value.title: Public charging access and provider services are difficult to use
value.summary: Customers report difficulty finding accessible public charging and using external-provider services, including account setup and Plug & Charge. The signals come from USA and Rest of World customers across G60 and G70.
highlights: Public charging access and provider-service setup are difficult or unclear.
Signals include USA and Rest of World customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
A customer asked about Tesla station access; timing was uncertain.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe public charging as difficult to access or use, including uncertainty about station availability and problems with provider programs and Plug & Charge. [signal:061edda5-f7a6-4f48-93d6-24a6904ed553] [signal:13f54cb6-8280-4a8e-8688-6dde2418e594] [signal:2c7a41ba-6cf9-42fe-9ade-a4adc57b19a5]

## What customers say
A USA customer was unsure where and when to charge, particularly late at night, and described difficulty finding stations that felt safe. [signal:061edda5-f7a6-4f48-93d6-24a6904ed553] [signal:0c5b505c-84be-42e7-80c5-7a4b3d4e60b2]

One customer could not configure an Electrify America program for a secondary driver and reported that Plug & Charge did not recognize the car’s stored contract at the station. [signal:13f54cb6-8280-4a8e-8688-6dde2418e594]

Another customer was unsure whether Plug & Charge was enabled and needed help turning it on to use EA charging. [signal:2c7a41ba-6cf9-42fe-9ade-a4adc57b19a5]

A customer was unaware of included free charging and how to set up an account. [signal:223f35d4-0414-4e3e-8478-8fdf66e33f39]

A customer asked when Tesla charging stations would be usable; the response gave an early-2025 projection without a definitive date. [signal:199e7afa-2423-40a9-8920-a5200d78c8d8]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include concerns about station availability and perceived safety, as well as provider-program setup and Plug & Charge issues. [signal:061edda5-f7a6-4f48-93d6-24a6904ed553] [signal:0c5b505c-84be-42e7-80c5-7a4b3d4e60b2] [signal:13f54cb6-8280-4a8e-8688-6dde2418e594] [signal:223f35d4-0414-4e3e-8478-8fdf66e33f39] [signal:2c7a41ba-6cf9-42fe-9ade-a4adc57b19a5]

Rest of World signals mention a shortage of charging stations and concerns about dealership charging equipment and staff knowledge. [signal:01d41ed7-0ed4-44bd-b9b0-10157032250a] [signal:093316b5-e318-4e80-a72d-4451bec0b5b3]

## Open questions
How widespread are station availability and perceived-safety concerns across the reported markets? [signal:061edda5-f7a6-4f48-93d6-24a6904ed553] [signal:0c5b505c-84be-42e7-80c5-7a4b3d4e60b2]

How often do customers encounter issues with secondary-driver access, Plug & Charge recognition, or learning about included charging? [signal:13f54cb6-8280-4a8e-8688-6dde2418e594] [signal:2c7a41ba-6cf9-42fe-9ade-a4adc57b19a5] [signal:223f35d4-0414-4e3e-8478-8fdf66e33f39]

value.title: Public charging access and coverage feel unreliable
value.summary: Customers report limited or unreliable public charging access, including difficulty using charging offers and uncertainty about access to Tesla Superchargers. The signals cover USA G60 and G70 customers and a Europe G60 customer.
highlights: Public charging access, provider coverage and charging-offer usability are concerns.
Signals include USA G60/G70 customers and a Europe G60 customer.
Customers mention Electrify America, Tesla Superchargers, EVgo and Circle K.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe public charging as difficult to access or unreliable, and some say limited provider coverage reduces the value of a charging offer. [signal:04bfa4db-7b7d-40e1-84b3-6452b6303c69] [signal:0c1b26d0-e8b9-4c4a-a1ea-e6daa7823ff2] [signal:13bbbe92-94e7-42fb-8a24-a740e1d8c501] One G60 customer says Tesla Supercharger access had been represented as available before purchase, but remained unavailable to them. [signal:995b4057-bd3f-44d3-b6c7-6a1fd99e0e53]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer says the nearest Electrify America station is about 50 miles away, preventing use of the BMW/EA charging offer. [signal:04bfa4db-7b7d-40e1-84b3-6452b6303c69] A Southern California G70 customer says limited Electrify America coverage makes the partnership offer less valuable in their area and identifies EVgo as having better regional coverage. [signal:0c1b26d0-e8b9-4c4a-a1ea-e6daa7823ff2] A USA G60 customer says there are few commercial stations and charging away from home can be challenging. [signal:13bbbe92-94e7-42fb-8a24-a740e1d8c501] Another USA G60 customer describes Electrify America as unreliable and wants access to Tesla’s Supercharger network. [signal:0bca747a-da2c-429c-9fdf-f3962cd6bbbe] A Europe G60 customer wants fast-charging stations to be more prominent in trip planning and Circle K to be the only displayed provider when selected. [signal:3679179b-3aac-441c-8c28-fb46bd1780aa]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals describe limited commercial or Electrify America coverage, a charging offer that is difficult to use, and a request for Tesla Supercharger access. [signal:04bfa4db-7b7d-40e1-84b3-6452b6303c69] [signal:0c1b26d0-e8b9-4c4a-a1ea-e6daa7823ff2] [signal:13bbbe92-94e7-42fb-8a24-a740e1d8c501] [signal:995b4057-bd3f-44d3-b6c7-6a1fd99e0e53] [signal:0bca747a-da2c-429c-9fdf-f3962cd6bbbe] The Europe signal instead focuses on how fast chargers and a selected provider appear in trip-planning results. [signal:3679179b-3aac-441c-8c28-fb46bd1780aa]

## Open questions
How widespread are the reported coverage and reliability concerns across providers and regions? [signal:04bfa4db-7b7d-40e1-84b3-6452b6303c69] [signal:0c1b26d0-e8b9-4c4a-a1ea-e6daa7823ff2] [signal:0bca747a-da2c-429c-9fdf-f3962cd6bbbe] How often do customers encounter a mismatch between expected and actual Tesla Supercharger access? [signal:995b4057-bd3f-44d3-b6c7-6a1fd99e0e53] Do the Europe trip-planning requests reflect a broader need to filter results by provider? [signal:3679179b-3aac-441c-8c28-fb46bd1780aa]

value.title: Instrument-cluster design draws mixed reactions
value.summary: Many customers value the instrument layout and displays, while some find the LCD unappealing or the screen-based cockpit less distinctive or convenient. Signals include customers in the USA, Europe, and Rest of World across G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Design is valued by many, but some customers dislike LCD displays or find screen controls inconvenient.
Signals cover USA G60/G70, Europe F70, and Rest of World F70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customer reactions to instrument-cluster design differ: some praise the layout and displays, while others are underwhelmed by the design or dislike LCD monitors. [signal:16ccc57d-a1b7-4c08-8887-8301b754f149] [signal:4b095c1b-bc80-4331-986a-6515b2b72aca] [signal:9291b84f-844d-46e0-9a15-1a6fc7a0c3f0] [signal:a51b5180-a1ca-448b-89a1-cb4089a7a56f]

## What customers say
In the USA, G60 customers describe the dashboard as improved, sleek, and visually distinctive; one says instrument styling influenced the purchase decision. [signal:16ccc57d-a1b7-4c08-8887-8301b754f149] [signal:4b095c1b-bc80-4331-986a-6515b2b72aca] [signal:8efc0fe2-c916-4d08-a736-edcd39a94768] [signal:a1107ced-0f6b-4d80-a2ed-912dfd69193f]

USA G70 customers like the dashboard's appearance and layout and describe the displays as futuristic, with vivid colors. [signal:5010a706-c125-43da-a975-0356aa51428d] [signal:58984c3a-25e9-4897-be2b-02e20e0baa13]

Europe F70 customers describe the wide screen and cockpit layout positively, but one says the design is not distinctive enough to rave about and that climate controls buried in the screen are inconvenient. [signal:a51b5180-a1ca-448b-89a1-cb4089a7a56f] [signal:c7c2d484-8ad5-42a8-a3b0-261e1efc7402]

Another Europe F70 customer says the single information screen is better than the previous version. [signal:ccf03784-5c8e-4714-83d5-efdbbfc610ea]

A Rest of World F70 customer says LCD monitors do not feel good to them. [signal:9291b84f-844d-46e0-9a15-1a6fc7a0c3f0]

## Differences between markets
The provided signals are positive about the displays and layouts in the USA, while Europe F70 feedback combines praise with reservations about distinctiveness and screen-based controls. [signal:16ccc57d-a1b7-4c08-8887-8301b754f149] [signal:4b095c1b-bc80-4331-986a-6515b2b72aca] [signal:5010a706-c125-43da-a975-0356aa51428d] [signal:58984c3a-25e9-4897-be2b-02e20e0baa13] [signal:a51b5180-a1ca-448b-89a1-cb4089a7a56f] [signal:c7c2d484-8ad5-42a8-a3b0-261e1efc7402]

The Rest of World F70 signal expresses dislike of LCD monitors, while other F70 signals from Europe praise aspects of the screen and cockpit. [signal:9291b84f-844d-46e0-9a15-1a6fc7a0c3f0] [signal:a51b5180-a1ca-448b-89a1-cb4089a7a56f] [signal:ccf03784-5c8e-4714-83d5-efdbbfc610ea]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these differing views are beyond the feedback shown. [signal:9291b84f-844d-46e0-9a15-1a6fc7a0c3f0] [signal:16ccc57d-a1b7-4c08-8887-8301b754f149] [signal:4b095c1b-bc80-4331-986a-6515b2b72aca] [signal:5010a706-c125-43da-a975-0356aa51428d] [signal:58984c3a-25e9-4897-be2b-02e20e0baa13] [signal:8efc0fe2-c916-4d08-a736-edcd39a94768] [signal:a1107ced-0f6b-4d80-a2ed-912dfd69193f] [signal:a51b5180-a1ca-448b-89a1-cb4089a7a56f] [signal:c7c2d484-8ad5-42a8-a3b0-261e1efc7402] [signal:ccf03784-5c8e-4714-83d5-efdbbfc610ea]

value.title: Instrument displays start inconsistently or go blank
value.summary: Customers report instrument displays that start late, fail to power on or go blank, alongside other gauge and display-related faults. Signals span F70, G60 and G70 vehicles in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Instrument displays sometimes start late, fail to power on or go blank.
Reports span F70, G60 and G70 vehicles in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report instrument displays that start inconsistently, fail to power on or go blank, including while driving. [signal:0c0f0dad-bac9-4842-bb7c-4c18b4e1ca83] [signal:6092b010-879f-4498-b425-cab7ad0348bd] [signal:633fd908-5a48-46ec-ab6f-d5253112e2da] [signal:09808498-4990-47b0-ae46-583a67710e92]

Other reported issues include hard-to-read speedometer and rev-counter markings, false fuel-gauge warnings, an iDrive outage and unexpected screen messages. [signal:0eb67bfd-0776-4727-ba7e-5c0bb5368804] [signal:96bd24c4-859e-4fa5-8180-5a8f611b0031] [signal:a50737be-fbdd-40da-a518-c815feeb920b] [signal:c96207ff-6bd9-4a28-bcb5-cbf209f56e23] [signal:dbcc8c36-933b-40a7-bd90-7daa95238a7c]

## What customers say
An F70 owner in Europe says the instrument display sometimes starts immediately and sometimes takes a few minutes. [signal:0c0f0dad-bac9-4842-bb7c-4c18b4e1ca83]

Another European F70 owner reports both display modules going blank several times when the outside temperature is below zero; the car was at a dealer for checks and repair. [signal:633fd908-5a48-46ec-ab6f-d5253112e2da]

A Rest of World F70 owner says the navigation display and then the speedometer display went black while driving. [signal:09808498-4990-47b0-ae46-583a67710e92]

A US G60 owner reports that a second display screen twice failed to power on at startup and worked after turning the car off and restarting. [signal:6092b010-879f-4498-b425-cab7ad0348bd]

A European F70 owner says the speedometer and rev counter are hard to read because of their colours and markings, while the digital speed readout is easy to see. [signal:0eb67bfd-0776-4727-ba7e-5c0bb5368804]

US reports also include an iDrive outage, faulty screen notifications, a recurring “function not available” pop-up, and erratic warnings from the fuel gauge. [signal:a50737be-fbdd-40da-a518-c815feeb920b] [signal:c96207ff-6bd9-4a28-bcb5-cbf209f56e23] [signal:dbcc8c36-933b-40a7-bd90-7daa95238a7c] [signal:96bd24c4-859e-4fa5-8180-5a8f611b0031]

## Differences between markets
In the Europe F70 reports, customers describe delayed startup, blank displays in below-zero temperatures and difficult-to-read analogue-style gauge markings. [signal:0c0f0dad-bac9-4842-bb7c-4c18b4e1ca83] [signal:633fd908-5a48-46ec-ab6f-d5253112e2da] [signal:0eb67bfd-0776-4727-ba7e-5c0bb5368804]

The Rest of World F70 report describes displays going black while driving, while US reports cover a screen failing at startup on a G60 and several different display or gauge concerns on G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:09808498-4990-47b0-ae46-583a67710e92] [signal:6092b010-879f-4498-b425-cab7ad0348bd] [signal:96bd24c4-859e-4fa5-8180-5a8f611b0031] [signal:a50737be-fbdd-40da-a518-c815feeb920b] [signal:c96207ff-6bd9-4a28-bcb5-cbf209f56e23] [signal:dbcc8c36-933b-40a7-bd90-7daa95238a7c]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequently these faults occur across vehicles, or whether the reported startup failures and blackouts share a cause. [signal:0c0f0dad-bac9-4842-bb7c-4c18b4e1ca83] [signal:6092b010-879f-4498-b425-cab7ad0348bd] [signal:633fd908-5a48-46ec-ab6f-d5253112e2da] [signal:09808498-4990-47b0-ae46-583a67710e92]

The available reports also do not clarify the causes of the US screen messages or whether the fuel-gauge issue is related to the display faults. [signal:c96207ff-6bd9-4a28-bcb5-cbf209f56e23] [signal:dbcc8c36-933b-40a7-bd90-7daa95238a7c] [signal:96bd24c4-859e-4fa5-8180-5a8f611b0031]

value.title: Charging socket cover gets stuck on the BMW i5
value.summary: A BMW i5 owner in the USA reports repeated problems with the charging socket cover getting stuck, sometimes leaving them unable to charge with very little battery remaining.
highlights: The charging socket cover repeatedly gets stuck.
One USA signal concerns a G60 BMW i5 with under roughly 3,000 miles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A BMW i5 owner in the USA reports that the charging socket cover repeatedly got stuck, sometimes leaving them stranded with under about 5% battery remaining. [signal:1fc303c2-edbd-4b66-a4ef-b3b15889456e]

## What customers say
The owner says they visited the dealer twice because of the charging door issue, which was eventually repaired. [signal:1fc303c2-edbd-4b66-a4ef-b3b15889456e]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from the USA, so there is no market comparison. [signal:1fc303c2-edbd-4b66-a4ef-b3b15889456e]

## Open questions
The signal does not establish how frequently this issue occurs across vehicles or whether it recurs after repair. [signal:1fc303c2-edbd-4b66-a4ef-b3b15889456e]

value.title: Small gear selector feels inadequate to a G60 driver
value.summary: A USA G60 driver dislikes the small switch-style gear selector and says the controls are difficult to use. The signal does not describe a selector reliability failure.
highlights: A driver says the switch-style selector is not a proper gear shifter.
One complaint from a USA G60 driver.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 driver objects to the switch-style gear selector, calling it “goofy” and saying there is no proper gear shifter. [signal:f94fad6d-7650-4c5f-b38d-43414b56f007] The signal expresses dissatisfaction with the selector format, but does not report a selector reliability failure. [signal:f94fad6d-7650-4c5f-b38d-43414b56f007]

## What customers say
The driver says the controls are a pain to work with. [signal:f94fad6d-7650-4c5f-b38d-43414b56f007]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from the USA and concerns a G60; there is no other market evidence to compare. [signal:f94fad6d-7650-4c5f-b38d-43414b56f007]

## Open questions
The signal does not establish whether the selector has reliability problems or whether other drivers share this concern. [signal:f94fad6d-7650-4c5f-b38d-43414b56f007]

value.title: Remote reversing from outside the vehicle is a customer request

highlights: A customer asked about reversing the vehicle from outside.
Both signals are from USA G60 customers.

## Problem
A customer wanted to know if they could reverse the vehicle while standing outside it. [signal:d43b1e18-9e10-4780-89fe-e46612f542b9] The same signal says Remote Control Parking is available to purchase for that vehicle through the ConnectedDrive Store. [signal:d43b1e18-9e10-4780-89fe-e46612f542b9]

## What customers say
One customer asked about reversing the vehicle from outside. [signal:d43b1e18-9e10-4780-89fe-e46612f542b9] Another customer said they appreciated being able to purchase upgraded services via the ConnectedDrive Store. [signal:6aa87a1c-80f6-417a-825a-d9930a193372]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA and concern the G60; there are no other markets represented. [signal:d43b1e18-9e10-4780-89fe-e46612f542b9] [signal:6aa87a1c-80f6-417a-825a-d9930a193372]

value.title: ConnectedDrive upgrades inconsistently available after purchase
value.summary: Some U.S. G60 customers report that ConnectedDrive options are inconsistently available or do not appear in the store, while a model-year enhancement arriving soon after delivery can leave buyers dissatisfied.
highlights: Customers report options missing from the store and inconsistent availability.
Both signals concern U.S. G60 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
U.S. G60 customers report that options offered for purchase through ConnectedDrive are not consistently available or do not appear in the store [signal:8d783ba5-e8e8-4d66-97c9-c5408141acf1] [signal:9915ecbf-a1c4-4e7b-9078-23e6afb83131]. One customer also said a model-year enhancement arrived about three months after delivery, leaving a sour taste [signal:8d783ba5-e8e8-4d66-97c9-c5408141acf1].

## What customers say
One customer described the availability of options through the individual program as hit or miss [signal:8d783ba5-e8e8-4d66-97c9-c5408141acf1]. Another received emails offering Parking Assistant Professional, but could not find it in the ConnectedDrive store; the service writer said a software update was needed and described waiting for an OTA RSU or arranging a service visit [signal:9915ecbf-a1c4-4e7b-9078-23e6afb83131].

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA and concern the G60; the signals provide no evidence about other markets or vehicle lines [signal:8d783ba5-e8e8-4d66-97c9-c5408141acf1] [signal:9915ecbf-a1c4-4e7b-9078-23e6afb83131].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often options are unavailable, or whether the reported availability issue affects other customers, markets, or vehicle lines [signal:8d783ba5-e8e8-4d66-97c9-c5408141acf1] [signal:9915ecbf-a1c4-4e7b-9078-23e6afb83131].

value.title: Charging socket cover is difficult to open and close
value.summary: Customers in the USA report confusion, unreliable opening, and extra steps when opening or closing charging covers on G60 and G70 vehicles. One customer wants a key-fob button to open the cover.
highlights: Customers report confusing, inconsistent, or inconvenient charging-cover operation.
Six USA signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report difficulty understanding how to open the charging cover, instances when it sticks or requires several presses, and inconvenience from operating two separate flaps. [signal:17db82a2-c2e9-4906-aebf-3db9a51f4bd3] [signal:49dbb7af-a521-4094-9a68-e56949d707fa] [signal:9193176d-3df8-4159-96b3-55236446410f] [signal:51e203c9-72dd-4f22-b019-bec944cd7ba3]

## What customers say
One G60 customer could not work out how to open the flap until a salesperson demonstrated it. [signal:17db82a2-c2e9-4906-aebf-3db9a51f4bd3]
A G60 customer reported the door stuck closed at roughly 1,800 miles, then opened after driving a few miles and trying again. [signal:49db7af-a521-4094-9a68-e56949d707fa]
Another G60 customer said several presses were sometimes needed even when the vehicle was unlocked. [signal:9193176d-3df8-4159-96b3-55236446410f]
A G70 customer found it annoying to open and close two separate flaps. [signal:51e203c9-72dd-4f22-b019-bec944cd7ba3]
Another G70 customer said they had to open the rear door to get the charging door open; a writer explained the door-lock setting and how unlocking affects access. [signal:ecbfcb8f-238b-4a17-8b3b-29c25c9c6d26]
A G60 customer wished for a key-fob button to open the charging door. [signal:9ad377d2-088c-4a2f-9550-d6756166b86d]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA and concern G60 or G70 vehicles; the signals provide no other-market comparison. [signal:17db82a2-c2e9-4906-aebf-3db9a51f4bd3] [signal:49db7af-a521-4094-9a68-e56949d707fa] [signal:51e203c9-72dd-4f22-b019-bec944cd7ba3] [signal:9193176d-3df8-4159-96b3-55236446410f] [signal:ecbfcb8f-238b-4a17-8b3b-29c25c9c6d26] [signal:9ad377d2-088c-4a2f-9550-d6756166b86d]

## Open questions
Do opening difficulties vary with vehicle state or use conditions? [signal:49db7af-a521-4094-9a68-e56949d707fa] [signal:9193176d-3df8-4159-96b3-55236446410f]
How often do customers encounter the separate-flap and rear-door access issues? [signal:51e203c9-72dd-4f22-b019-bec944cd7ba3] [signal:ecbfcb8f-238b-4a17-8b3b-29c25c9c6d26]

value.title: Charging socket cover intermittently fails to open
value.summary: Customers report charging socket covers that intermittently fail to open, sometimes stopping altogether. The reports shown are from USA owners of G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: The charging cover may fail to open, intermittently or completely.
Reports shown are from USA owners of G60 and G70 vehicles.
Tesla and Lucid are mentioned in cross-shopping, but not compared on charging-cover reliability.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report charging covers that sometimes fail to open, including cases where restarting the vehicle appears to restore operation. Other reports describe the cover eventually stopping opening altogether. [signal:014bd10b-8c26-4ac1-8332-c49a646f02db] [signal:2cceee8b-d08a-4da7-87f6-e8ede035b962] [signal:41625459-342d-408c-9cac-c767e7b926a1]

One G70 report describes the cover stopping after two days of ownership; the service visit reportedly broke it further, and the vehicle waited four weeks for a backordered part. [signal:45a8102a-345b-47a3-829b-aba1a3124ec8]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says the cover occasionally would not open, but the issue had not recurred for about a month at the time of the report. [signal:45489f62-68b9-437d-9ae5-e849e4a3885c]

Another G60 owner says the cover often would not open even when the vehicle was unlocked, and restarting and shutting off the car was frequently needed. [signal:41625459-342d-408c-9cac-c767e7b926a1]

A G70 service report attributes a cover that stopped opening to a faulty hinge assembly. [signal:2cceee8b-d08a-4da7-87f6-e8ede035b962]

## Differences between markets
The reports shown here are from the USA and cover G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:014bd10b-8c26-4ac1-8332-c49a646f02db] [signal:2cceee8b-d08a-4da7-87f6-e8ede035b962] [signal:41625459-342d-408c-9cac-c767e7b926a1] [signal:45489f62-68b9-437d-9ae5-e849e4a3885c] [signal:45a8102a-345b-47a3-829b-aba1a3124ec8]

## Open questions
How frequently does the cover fail to open, and how often does the issue become permanent?

Do failure patterns or service outcomes differ by vehicle line or market?

value.title: Parking brake does not engage automatically in neutral

highlights: The parking brake does not engage automatically when the car is put in neutral.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report confusion about ConnectedDrive and MINI CONNECTED upgrades, including what features are available, whether they are included or paid, and how to make purchased features work. [signal:083cbc87-da46-4512-a3ca-d3f04853758a] [signal:2ba7d395-30f7-429c-b4fd-dae4a764ea5d] [signal:37ffcfab-a3f6-4696-ab88-282ec5726188] [signal:7fac7293-e039-4ad5-8750-60c9fc998494] [signal:a1809083-4ba4-41f6-91ca-ee1c73110ede] [signal:f11a97d0-6a7c-4a7d-bd11-8b0451b2d56a]

A customer understood Drive Recorder, Traffic Camera, and Parking Assistance to be purchased and active, but was told most items start as three-month trials and then require payment. [signal:a1809083-4ba4-41f6-91ca-ee1c73110ede]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:083cbc87-da46-4512-a3ca-d3f04853758a] [signal:2ba7d395-30f7-429c-b4fd-dae4a764ea5d] [signal:37ffcfab-a3f6-4696-ab88-282ec5726188] [signal:7fac7293-e039-4ad5-8750-60c9fc998494] [signal:a1809083-4ba4-41f6-91ca-ee1c73110ede] [signal:f11a97d0-6a7c-4a7d-bd11-8b0451b2d56a]

The signals do not establish how widespread these misunderstandings are beyond the six reported cases. [signal:083cbc87-da46-4512-a3ca-d3f04853758a] [signal:2ba7d395-30f7-429c-b4fd-dae4a764ea5d] [signal:37ffcfab-a3f6-4696-ab88-282ec5726188] [signal:7fac7293-e039-4ad5-8750-60c9fc998494] [signal:a1809083-4ba4-41f6-91ca-ee1c73110ede] [signal:f11a97d0-6a7c-4a7d-bd11-8b0451b2d56a]
