value.title: Smaller gear selectors feel unfamiliar or less satisfying to some drivers
value.summary: Some drivers miss a traditional gear lever or need time to adjust to the current selector, while others value its compact design and placement. Feedback comes from USA and Europe signals across G60, G70 and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Some drivers miss a larger or traditional gear lever, and one reports confusion with selector direction.
Signals cover USA and Europe, and G60, G70 and F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say they miss a larger shifter or a stick shifter [signal:a02a1f95-4daa-4ac9-9ff8-7155a03612a6] [signal:a95e191b-2b3d-4d83-a5cc-35cab6a79bba]. A G70 driver says the selector feels different from an old-style gear stick, takes adjustment, and its operating direction can cause confusion [signal:ddd9c01f-c0f1-43ef-977c-6c9d7475af6d]. In a Europe F70 signal, removal of the gear lever is described as almost unacceptable, alongside frustration with functions moved to the touchscreen [signal:b60d63cf-8108-4334-95b1-3fa37b8a689a].

## What customers say
Feedback is mixed: some USA G60 and G70 drivers like the new selector’s design or location [signal:9088d7c5-cf83-4c3a-a803-7b76758e46c6] [signal:ad3017fe-a73e-4762-b362-d5cfc8c82070]. One G60 driver values its smaller size because it no longer gets in the way of the cup holders [signal:1f8abead-851a-48b0-9931-7a53cde82b47]. Other USA G60 drivers wish for a bigger shifter or a stick shifter [signal:a02a1f95-4daa-4ac9-9ff8-7155a03612a6] [signal:a95e191b-2b3d-4d83-a5cc-35cab6a79bba].

## Differences between markets
USA signals include both positive views of the G60 and G70 selector design and concerns about missing a traditional shifter or adjusting to selector operation [signal:1f8abead-851a-48b0-9931-7a53cde82b47] [signal:9088d7c5-cf83-4c3a-a803-7b76758e46c6] [signal:ad3017fe-a73e-4762-b362-d5cfc8c82070] [signal:a02a1f95-4daa-4ac9-9ff8-7155a03612a6] [signal:a95e191b-2b3d-4d83-a5cc-35cab6a79bba] [signal:ddd9c01f-c0f1-43ef-977c-6c9d7475af6d]. The Europe signal concerns the F70’s removed gear lever and touchscreen operation [signal:b60d63cf-8108-4334-95b1-3fa37b8a689a]. The signals therefore show different feedback, but do not establish whether the difference is driven by market or vehicle [signal:b60d63cf-8108-4334-95b1-3fa37b8a689a] [signal:a02a1f95-4daa-4ac9-9ff8-7155a03612a6] [signal:ddd9c01f-c0f1-43ef-977c-6c9d7475af6d].

## Open questions
How widespread are the preference for a traditional lever and the reported confusion with selector direction? [signal:a95e191b-2b3d-4d83-a5cc-35cab6a79bba] [signal:ddd9c01f-c0f1-43ef-977c-6c9d7475af6d] Do these views vary by vehicle line or market? [signal:a02a1f95-4daa-4ac9-9ff8-7155a03612a6] [signal:b60d63cf-8108-4334-95b1-3fa37b8a689a] [signal:ddd9c01f-c0f1-43ef-977c-6c9d7475af6d]

value.title: Charging limits and scheduled charging are confusing
value.summary: Some USA G60 customers are unsure how much to charge and report scheduled charging that does not follow their settings. New EV drivers also describe uncertainty about when to plug in.
highlights: Customers report confusion about charge limits and inconsistent scheduled charging.
Signals include USA G60 customers and a first-time EV driver.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers ask whether everyday charging should stop at 80% and whether charging to 100% is acceptable for trips. Explanations in the signals differ, referring to 80%, 85%, and a recommended 10%–80% range. [signal:003d7ff7-8a1c-4eb9-8b7d-507b4e4a7b07] [signal:1ae84612-e1cc-4bbc-9b0f-59379146926d] [signal:1bff48d8-bdbd-41f1-986c-95be8a730b60]

One customer says scheduled charging often ignores the selected 8:30 PM slot, sometimes starting immediately or at other times, and that the configuration changes on its own. [signal:044d2f93-c1d9-44a5-ad97-5e2124e712aa]

## What customers say
A customer new to electric driving describes the first week of figuring out how and when to charge as tense. [signal:136f836a-66ca-4d4c-ab19-35fc03273670]

Customers ask if charging above 80% is allowed and describe charging to 100% for longer trips. [signal:003d7ff7-8a1c-4eb9-8b7d-507b4e4a7b07] [signal:1ae84612-e1cc-4bbc-9b0f-59379146926d] [signal:1bff48d8-bdbd-41f1-986c-95be8a730b60]

## Differences between markets
The sampled charging-limit questions and scheduled-charging complaint are from USA G60 signals. [signal:003d7ff7-8a1c-4eb9-8b7d-507b4e4a7b07] [signal:044d2f93-c1d9-44a5-ad97-5e2124e712aa] [signal:1ae84612-e1cc-4bbc-9b0f-59379146926d] [signal:1bff48d8-bdbd-41f1-986c-95be8a730b60] The Rest of World G60 signal calls charging a hassle but also mentions an unrelated rumble at speed, so it does not clarify a specific charging issue. [signal:96ec367b-309b-4c45-ad85-51368f69d3b5]

## Open questions
How often do customers encounter unexpected scheduled-charging behavior?

Which charge-limit guidance do customers see, and how do they interpret it?

value.title: Battery charging takes too long at home and on trips
value.summary: Customers in the USA report long home-charging times and time-consuming public charging, including on regular journeys. Some compare the experience unfavourably with other vehicles or charging networks.
highlights: Customers report long charging times at home and during trips.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 owners.
Competitor comparisons mention Volvo, Mercedes and Tesla-branded charging stations.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that charging the high-voltage battery takes longer than they expect, both at home and during trips. [signal:0d1a0817-487a-4fab-bbb9-65f51feeb336] [signal:4f3a52be-c84b-4d1d-880a-f1ff8ca2bf6f] [signal:61c7dcd0-d3f9-48f3-9910-8bbd1ea3f3c1]

One G70 customer reports stopping one or two times on a regular 190-mile one-way drive, losing roughly 20–30 minutes per charging session. [signal:47e9ccb2-9f36-40e6-a398-ac262b73d33f]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says charging from a household outlet takes the whole night and is slower than in a previous Volvo hybrid. [signal:0d1a0817-487a-4fab-bbb9-65f51feeb336]

G70 owners describe home charging taking around 10–11 hours on a 220-volt charger, 18–20 hours on a 110-volt outlet, or longer than expected compared with a previous Mercedes. [signal:4f3a52be-c84b-4d1d-880a-f1ff8ca2bf6f] [signal:61c7dcd0-d3f9-48f3-9910-8bbd1ea3f3c1]

A G70 owner also describes public charging delays, including queues, charging sessions of about 30 minutes, and reduced speed during maintenance. The customer compares local charging stations unfavourably with Tesla stations. [signal:427c7e3a-c8b2-4f91-8e11-1dd58e000e71]

One G60 owner reports charging sometimes starting despite a scheduled charging time, but says allowing it to charge overnight has avoided further problems. [signal:3048d4ba-77ea-4f95-a7d0-6ee7904ef2fb]

## Differences between markets
All provided signals are from the USA and concern G60 or G70 vehicles; no other market is represented. [signal:0d1a0817-487a-4fab-bbb9-65f51feeb336] [signal:3048d4ba-77ea-4f95-a7d0-6ee7904ef2fb] [signal:427c7e3a-c8b2-4f91-8e11-1dd58e000e71] [signal:47e9ccb2-9f36-40e6-a398-ac262b73d33f] [signal:4f3a52be-c84b-4d1d-880a-f1ff8ca2bf6f] [signal:61c7dcd0-d3f9-48f3-9910-8bbd1ea3f3c1]

The reports cover both household charging and public charging, so they describe different charging situations rather than a direct disagreement between markets. [signal:0d1a0817-487a-4fab-bbb9-65f51feeb336] [signal:427c7e3a-c8b2-4f91-8e11-1dd58e000e71]

## Open questions
The reports do not establish how much charging time is attributable to the vehicle, the household electrical setup, or public-station conditions. [signal:0d1a0817-487a-4fab-bbb9-65f51feeb336] [signal:427c7e3a-c8b2-4f91-8e11-1dd58e000e71] [signal:4f3a52be-c84b-4d1d-880a-f1ff8ca2bf6f]

The available signals do not clarify the G70 owner's reported 190-watt charging limit or the circumstances behind the scheduled-charging inconsistency. [signal:47e9ccb2-9f36-40e6-a398-ac262b73d33f] [signal:3048d4ba-77ea-4f95-a7d0-6ee7904ef2fb]

value.title: High-voltage battery charging is unreliable across charging situations
value.summary: Customers report charging failures or limitations involving fast charging, scheduled charging, and home charging. Signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles in the USA, Europe, and Rest of World.
highlights: Charging may fail, stop, or not follow the selected charging schedule.
Signals: 7 complaints—4 USA, 2 Europe, 1 Rest of World; six G60s and one G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe charging problems across several situations: a charge port door that will not open, fast charging that is limited or stops, scheduled charging that does not occur, and home charging that fails. [signal:1043220e-b577-4de7-9af9-3ee742dfcf3b] [signal:cb9f9e74-a3ee-483b-a11c-f34de132037e] [signal:db78321f-4070-4ea2-b17d-80ddccd332fa] [signal:f89bff41-2b21-4344-8e38-72e63f2b45a0]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer says the charge port door often will not open until restarting and shutting off the car. [signal:1043220e-b577-4de7-9af9-3ee742dfcf3b]

A Rest of World G60 customer reports that the car would not fast charge to 100%, despite being told it would, and says the dealer could not resolve the issue. [signal:8aa799d7-a887-463d-981c-fb054c8edfc5]

A Europe G60 customer says fast charging briefly reaches the promoted rate before the car shuts down while charging. [signal:cb9f9e74-a3ee-483b-a11c-f34de132037e]

A USA G60 customer says scheduled charging was not followed, leaving the car uncharged before a commute. [signal:db78321f-4070-4ea2-b17d-80ddccd332fa]

A USA G70 customer says the included charger does not charge the car at home and that the vehicle has been serviced twice in about two months. [signal:f89bff41-2b21-4344-8e38-72e63f2b45a0]

Another USA G60 customer reports problems with a fast charger but gives no further detail in the signal. [signal:4ed4f091-fd24-4e6c-b2b0-a7c3a2849cfa]

## Differences between markets
The signals include four USA complaints, two Europe complaints, and one Rest of World complaint; six concern G60 vehicles and one concerns a G70. [signal:1043220e-b577-4de7-9af9-3ee742dfcf3b] [signal:4ed4f091-fd24-4e6c-b2b0-a7c3a2849cfa] [signal:8aa799d7-a887-463d-981c-fb054c8edfc5] [signal:8babbc8b-0ac8-4cff-bc08-ea3dba48c2fa] [signal:cb9f9e74-a3ee-483b-a11c-f34de132037e] [signal:db78321f-4070-4ea2-b17d-80ddccd332fa] [signal:f89bff41-2b21-4344-8e38-72e63f2b45a0]

The reported issues differ by signal: USA complaints include charge-port access, fast-charger problems, scheduled charging, and home charging; Europe signals mention charging information and a charging shutdown; the Rest of World signal concerns fast charging to 100%. [signal:1043220e-b577-4de7-9af9-3ee742dfcf3b] [signal:4ed4f091-fd24-4e6c-b2b0-a7c3a2849cfa] [signal:8aa799d7-a887-463d-981c-fb054c8edfc5] [signal:8babbc8b-0ac8-4cff-bc08-ea3dba48c2fa] [signal:cb9f9e74-a3ee-483b-a11c-f34de132037e] [signal:db78321f-4070-4ea2-b17d-80ddccd332fa] [signal:f89bff41-2b21-4344-8e38-72e63f2b45a0]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the causes, frequency beyond individual customer reports, or whether the reported fast-charging limitations and shutdowns share a cause. [signal:4ed4f091-fd24-4e6c-b2b0-a7c3a2849cfa] [signal:8aa799d7-a887-463d-981c-fb054c8edfc5] [signal:cb9f9e74-a3ee-483b-a11c-f34de132037e]

value.title: Charging controls lack preferred timing and in-motion options

highlights: Owners mention missing charge-start timing and in-motion charging options.
The supplied sample includes U.S. G60 and G70 signals, with different charging concerns.
Tesla Supercharger access and Electrify America reliability appear in competitor-related comments.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want charging to start at a chosen time without setting a departure time, or want the battery to recharge while driving. [signal:d950fe43-60d2-4a0b-94da-ed60efecdda0] [signal:2e9d3612-5792-4f1a-ae56-870ec5591aa7]

Other charging-related concerns in the sample include reduced range in cold weather and limited or unreliable public charging access. [signal:770fb9a5-eac6-42e1-b23f-8cdffd898c4a] [signal:2952a413-8a7a-4ab4-acee-c46aee945296] [signal:ee97b3d9-f82c-4535-9739-4a4a24309419]

## What customers say
A G60 owner wants charging to begin at a selected time without entering a departure time. [signal:d950fe43-60d2-4a0b-94da-ed60efecdda0]

A G70 owner wishes for a software option to recharge the battery while driving. [signal:2e9d3612-5792-4f1a-ae56-870ec5591aa7]

A G70 customer reported that the vehicle has fast-charge capability. [signal:002561d6-ee57-40af-b15c-1dc74fd3620e]

A G60 owner says cold-weather range falls to roughly 200 miles and reports poor charging options in South Carolina. [signal:770fb9a5-eac6-42e1-b23f-8cdffd898c4a] Another G60 owner describes longer-trip range as questionable and Electrify America as unreliable. [signal:2952a413-8a7a-4ab4-acee-c46aee945296]

## Differences between markets
All supplied signals are from the USA, so the sample does not show differences between markets. [signal:2952a413-8a7a-4ab4-acee-c46aee945296] [signal:2e9d3612-5792-4f1a-ae56-870ec5591aa7] [signal:770fb9a5-eac6-42e1-b23f-8cdffd898c4a] [signal:d950fe43-60d2-4a0b-94da-ed60efecdda0] [signal:ee97b3d9-f82c-4535-9739-4a4a24309419] [signal:002561d6-ee57-40af-b15c-1dc74fd3620e]

## Open questions
The supplied signals do not establish how common the timing and in-motion charging requests are across the full set of 16 signals. [signal:d950fe43-60d2-4a0b-94da-ed60efecdda0] [signal:2e9d3612-5792-4f1a-ae56-870ec5591aa7]

The sample includes both a report of fast-charge capability and complaints about charging access, but does not clarify how customers assess charging performance itself. [signal:002561d6-ee57-40af-b15c-1dc74fd3620e] [signal:770fb9a5-eac6-42e1-b23f-8cdffd898c4a] [signal:2952a413-8a7a-4ab4-acee-c46aee945296]

value.title: Selector operation feels unfamiliar and Park status is unclear
value.summary: Some customers find the selector unfamiliar or unnatural, and some are unsure how to select or confirm Park. The supplied examples include USA G60/G70 and Europe F70 customers.
highlights: Customers report unfamiliar operation, unclear Park status, and difficulty adapting to the selector.
Supplied sample: 6 USA reports on G60/G70 and 3 Europe reports on F70.
Golf Mk8 is criticized for usability; a customer praises the F70’s Sport-mode selector action.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say the selector feels unfamiliar or unnatural, and report uncertainty about selecting or confirming Park. [signal:05359713-3057-459b-a6da-37af8b00c809] [signal:1f80f547-3578-45a2-85c5-94db1b10e353] [signal:62e71afb-782e-47cd-a233-20ad4580a009]

A G70 customer says pushing the selector forward selects Reverse, contrary to their expectation of selecting Park, and reports that the car began reversing after they released the brake. [signal:2115a826-9559-4312-b3bb-e0bc5b25bed1]

## What customers say
A G60 customer says they need to look down at the instrument cluster to confirm Park; another says the selector does not show a Park position. [signal:05359713-3057-459b-a6da-37af8b00c809] [signal:1f80f547-3578-45a2-85c5-94db1b10e353]

G70 customers describe difficulty adapting from a conventional selector, ask about parking without the automatically applied parking brake, and say the absence of a physical Park button is odd. [signal:154bb93c-d34b-4487-9c1d-73b5ca2095ec] [signal:0e005094-2820-463b-9530-d8ac4b86e1a4] [signal:500272bc-da5a-4a43-8930-696e456d2731]

An F70 customer says the direction of the selector movements for Reverse and Drive feels counterintuitive; another prefers the previous version’s grippable lever to the switch-style setup. [signal:3f35859c-05f3-4451-b568-1bb5d2ec0fb5] [signal:62e71afb-782e-47cd-a233-20ad4580a009]

Feedback is not entirely negative: an F70 customer praises being able to knock the gear stick into Sport mode. [signal:c89b3898-2b14-466b-ba05-8c4db5f83f45]

## Differences between markets
In the supplied examples, USA complaints concern G60 and G70 operation, Park indication, and the parking brake. [signal:05359713-3057-459b-a6da-37af8b00c809] [signal:1f80f547-3578-45a2-85c5-94db1b10e353] [signal:0e005094-2820-463b-9530-d8ac4b86e1a4] [signal:500272bc-da5a-4a43-8930-696e456d2731]

The supplied Europe F70 examples include complaints about movement direction and the switch-style feel, alongside praise for Sport-mode operation. [signal:3f35859c-05f3-4451-b568-1bb5d2ec0fb5] [signal:62e71afb-782e-47cd-a233-20ad4580a009] [signal:c89b3898-2b14-466b-ba05-8c4db5f83f45]

## Open questions
Do customers distinguish clearly between selecting Park and the automatic application of the parking brake? [signal:1f80f547-3578-45a2-85c5-94db1b10e353] [signal:0e005094-2820-463b-9530-d8ac4b86e1a4]

How much of the reported difficulty reflects adaptation to a different selector versus the selector’s feel or movement direction? [signal:154bb93c-d34b-4487-9c1d-73b5ca2095ec] [signal:3f35859c-05f3-4451-b568-1bb5d2ec0fb5] [signal:62e71afb-782e-47cd-a233-20ad4580a009]

highlights: A password-creation email and a separate support need were reported together.
One USA customer with a G60 is represented.

value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer reported receiving an email instructing her to create a new BMW ID password and also needing to speak with the financial department; the signal does not identify a usability problem with BMW Online or MINI Online. [signal:99769141-c71f-48be-bbc5-15666a8052ec]

## What customers say

## Problem
Customers report parking-brake warnings or faults associated with reduced braking power, a parking brake that will not release, or being unable to drive the vehicle. [signal:3c1d9382-20d5-447e-b91f-e2cd0fa87982] [signal:592442e9-ce59-48a0-859f-7cc78a85cc89] [signal:9d0225bf-f209-4264-a893-816b053a4e85] [signal:a3fbde74-4b18-4f30-a2c5-6a41a76fe2ab] [signal:eb30ddc4-c7c1-410d-ac47-bdd998a2a66b]

## What customers say
- An F70 owner in Europe reported a drivetrain brake fault that prevented driving; the vehicle had also been delayed at collection because of an unresolved error message. [signal:3c1d9382-20d5-447e-b91f-e2cd0fa87982]
- A G60 owner in the USA said a parking-brake warning appeared twice while driving and braking power was reduced, requiring much harder pedal pressure to stop. [signal:592442e9-ce59-48a0-859f-7cc78a85cc89]
- A G70 owner in the USA reported a stuck parking-brake button, inability to drive, and a nine-day repair. [signal:9d0225bf-f209-4264-a893-816b053a4e85]
- Another G60 owner in the USA said the parking brake sometimes would not release, beginning when the car was about a month old; they had largely stopped using it. [signal:a3fbde74-4b18-4f30-a2c5-6a41a76fe2ab]
- A G70 owner in the USA reported a parking-brake malfunction warning but gave no further cause details. [signal:eb30ddc4-c7c1-410d-ac47-bdd998a2a66b]

## Differences between markets
The signals include one Europe complaint involving an F70 and four USA complaints involving G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:3c1d9382-20d5-447e-b91f-e2cd0fa87982] [signal:592442e9-ce59-48a0-859f-7cc78a85cc89] [signal:9d0225bf-f209-4264-a893-816b053a4e85] [signal:a3fbde74-4b18-4f30-a2c5-6a41a76fe2ab] [signal:eb30ddc4-c7c1-410d-ac47-bdd998a2a66b] The reports describe different symptoms, so the signals do not establish whether the issue differs by market or vehicle line. [signal:3c1d9382-20d5-447e-b91f-e2cd0fa87982] [signal:592442e9-ce59-48a0-859f-7cc78a85cc89] [signal:9d0225bf-f209-4264-a893-816b053a4e85] [signal:a3fbde74-4b18-4f30-a2c5-6a41a76fe2ab] [signal:eb30ddc4-c7c1-410d-ac47-bdd998a2a66b]

## Open questions
- What caused the reduced braking power reported alongside a parking-brake warning? [signal:592442e9-ce59-48a0-859f-7cc78a85cc89]
- Are the reported failure-to-release and inability-to-drive symptoms related? [signal:3c1d9382-20d5-447e-b91f-e2cd0fa87982] [signal:9d0225bf-f209-4264-a893-816b053a4e85] [signal:a3fbde74-4b18-4f30-a2c5-6a41a76fe2ab]

value.title: Parking brake controls are unclear and easy to confuse
value.summary: Some customers have difficulty locating or understanding the parking brake, and one reports confusing it with Auto Hold. Signals come from USA G60 and G70 owners and Europe F70 owners.
highlights: Customers report uncertainty about the control, how it works, and accidental Auto Hold activation.
Among the 8 provided signals: 6 are from the USA (G60/G70) and 2 from Europe (F70).
One Europe customer considered a Mercedes A-Class; no parking-brake comparison is reported.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe uncertainty about where the parking brake is, how it operates, and how it relates to selecting Park. [signal:0c3aea69-aa6c-4d10-bbf9-798d393a803b] [signal:70ac42f9-029b-4545-8165-a8d7d9b17755] [signal:abc99f82-3e7d-46a0-a518-6d1dd3c6f2cc] One G60 customer says selecting Park without operating the handbrake control felt unfamiliar compared with their previous cars. [signal:3359fec1-3e5c-4898-96ef-5cc691bd5079] Another reports sometimes pressing Auto Hold when intending to press the Park button. [signal:3e622c16-bc3f-404a-be46-0eb5e5ceefa2]

## What customers say
A G60 customer was unsure where the emergency brake was, and identified the parking brake after a staff explanation. [signal:0c3aea69-aa6c-4d10-bbf9-798d393a803b] A G70 customer asked how the parking brake operates, while another asked whether it sets itself. [signal:70ac42f9-029b-4545-8165-a8d7d9b17755] [signal:abc99f82-3e7d-46a0-a518-6d1dd3c6f2cc] A G60 customer also reports that the vehicle reacts too sensitively during minor parking adjustments. [signal:77dce284-f838-4fbf-aad7-9397fcd4c688] A Europe F70 customer found the absence of a traditional handbrake frightening and described modern technology as complicated. [signal:1b858983-8bfe-4a98-8592-2c76dadf01b6] Another Europe F70 complaint says vehicle updates changed handbrake application settings without clearly indicating the change. [signal:a885935f-1784-47af-be20-49b53d92e3a8]

## Differences between markets
The provided USA signals describe uncertainty about control location and operation, confusion between Park and the handbrake control, accidental Auto Hold activation, and sensitive response during parking adjustments. [signal:0c3aea69-aa6c-4d10-bbf9-798d393a803b] [signal:3359fec1-3e5c-4898-96ef-5cc691bd5079]  [signal:70ac42f9-029b-4545-8165-a8d7d9b17755] [signal:77dce284-f838-4fbf-aad7-9397fcd4c688] [signal:abc99f82-3e7d-46a0-a518-6d1dd3c6f2cc] The Europe signals describe concern about not having a traditional handbrake and unclear communication about changes to handbrake settings. [signal:1b858983-8bfe-4a98-8592-2c76dadf01b6] [signal:a885935f-1784-47af-be20-49b53d92e3a8]

## Open questions
Do the reported difficulties extend beyond the eight signals provided here? [signal:0c3aea69-aa6c-4d10-bbf9-798d393a803b] [signal:1b858983-8bfe-4a98-8592-2c76dadf01b6] [signal:3359fec1-3e5c-4898-96ef-5cc691bd5079]  [signal:70ac42f9-029b-4545-8165-a8d7d9b17755] [signal:77dce284-f838-4fbf-aad7-9397fcd4c688] [signal:a885935f-1784-47af-be20-49b53d92e3a8] [signal:abc99f82-3e7d-46a0-a518-6d1dd3c6f2cc] How often do customers confuse the parking brake control with Auto Hold, or expect Park to work without a separate handbrake action?  [signal:3359fec1-3e5c-4898-96ef-5cc691bd5079]

## Problem
Customers describe several interior-lighting concerns: a passenger-door speaker light that does not illuminate, an interior light that comes on randomly, mirror reflections that obstruct visibility at night, and a weak visor-mirror light. [signal:0423285a-9a28-4b2d-a9f3-d947d1735dfa] [signal:12a99bb4-3629-4be4-bb7c-b3ae0e3244db] [signal:2748c7e3-9b6b-4d70-97aa-5f42ccf02ec8] [signal:808d5016-d5df-436a-bf52-e7ce037013f6] [signal:ac0401c8-c0d4-4cb6-a904-7d7c54e93ace] [signal:e11305c3-9ece-4e22-9ecc-fae6ce664a37]

## What customers say
A G70 owner in the USA reported that the front passenger-door speaker light would not turn on while the driver's-door speaker light was illuminated. [signal:0423285a-9a28-4b2d-a9f3-d947d1735dfa]
A Rest of World F70 owner said the interior light came on randomly while driving and could only be switched off through the screen. [signal:12a99bb4-3629-4be4-bb7c-b3ae0e3244db]
Customers in the USA, Rest of World, and Europe said interior lighting reflected in the side or wing mirrors at night and impaired clear vision. [signal:2748c7e3-9b6b-4d70-97aa-5f42ccf02ec8] [signal:808d5016-d5df-436a-bf52-e7ce037013f6] [signal:ac0401c8-c0d4-4cb6-a904-7d7c54e93ace] [signal:e11305c3-9ece-4e22-9ecc-fae6ce664a37]
A USA G70 owner also described the light behind the sun-visor mirror as too weak to see their face properly. [signal:2748c7e3-9b6b-4d70-97aa-5f42ccf02ec8]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include both a non-working passenger-door speaker light and reports of mirror glare; one also mentions weak visor-mirror lighting. [signal:0423285a-9a28-4b2d-a9f3-d947d1735dfa] [signal:2748c7e3-9b6b-4d70-97aa-5f42ccf02ec8]
The Rest of World signals include a randomly illuminated cabin light in an F70 and mirror glare in a G60. [signal:12a99bb4-3629-4be4-bb7c-b3ae0e3244db] [signal:808d5016-d5df-436a-bf52-e7ce037013f6]
The Europe signals both describe interior lights reflecting in the wing mirrors at night, in F70 vehicles. [signal:ac0401c8-c0d4-4cb6-a904-7d7c54e93ace] [signal:e11305c3-9ece-4e22-9ecc-fae6ce664a37]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the non-working or randomly activated lights occur beyond the individual reports. [signal:0423285a-9a28-4b2d-a9f3-d947d1735dfa] [signal:12a99bb4-3629-4be4-bb7c-b3ae0e3244db]
They also do not establish whether mirror glare varies by lighting setting or driving conditions. [signal:2748c7e3-9b6b-4d70-97aa-5f42ccf02ec8] [signal:808d5016-d5df-436a-bf52-e7ce037013f6] [signal:ac0401c8-c0d4-4cb6-a904-7d7c54e93ace] [signal:e11305c3-9ece-4e22-9ecc-fae6ce664a37]

## Problem
Some customers find touchscreen operation less user-friendly than the previous display or physical controls. [signal:1a585ae2-79ed-4e95-8588-fc09e568f3bb] [signal:0f1bc8b3-e4eb-4dfc-8797-b8b621fae242]

## What customers say

A Europe F70 owner is disappointed that iDrive is gone and climate settings are handled through the touchscreen. [signal:0f1bc8b3-e4eb-4dfc-8797-b8b621fae242]

value.title: Interior lighting reflects in mirrors and lacks desired controls

value.body_md:

[signal:4c6f5719-8f64-4503-aeae-60bf407c9bef] Customers also wish the interior lighting were easier to augment, that map lights could be controlled by touching the light, and that a ceiling-light option were available. [signal:01f073d9-dab6-4c51-9008-8288960544ae] [signal:15cc3159-7ac6-4d86-9d20-cc16446df74d] The signals therefore include both positive feedback and a complaint about the setting changing. [signal:09a8a365-fdcb-4d53-a42c-a8b9fff6995b] [signal:01f073d9-dab6-4c51-9008-8288960544ae] [signal:15cc3159-7ac6-4d86-9d20-cc16446df74d]

The mirror-reflection complaint comes from a European F70 driver. [signal:4c6f5719-8f64-4503-aeae-60bf407c9bef] Requests for easier adjustment and touch operation come from USA G70 and G60 customers, respectively. [signal:35aee227-8620-4a46-9f2c-66a2e23d398a] [signal:e3bc6cb3-4d16-4a04-b03e-5246a2fbbf51] The ceiling-light request comes from a Rest of World G70 customer. [signal:81a37868-c7f0-42ba-9f4f-a7511b6de9f1] Positive feedback and the changing-color complaint are both reported by USA G70 customers. [signal:01f073d9-dab6-4c51-9008-8288960544ae] [signal:15cc3159-7ac6-4d86-9d20-cc16446df74d] [signal:09a8a365-fdcb-4d53-a42c-a8b9fff6995b]

How often do the dashboard light reflections affect mirror visibility, and under what driving conditions? value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe touchscreen controls as awkward, complicated, or difficult to locate, with some saying that screen use takes attention away from driving. [signal:003646d4-ca0f-4c6a-acde-facdf010abf6] [signal:0e993038-72b7-4cdd-9c1a-c9b31bd8fa74] [signal:1601906e-eb68-43c3-9f22-c358b7528a34] [signal:3cdba788-6d81-40d2-82c2-d1b5e7b855fa]

Some customers specifically object to commonly used controls being placed in menus or on the screen, and describe screen interactions as distracting while driving. [signal:0e993038-72b7-4cdd-9c1a-c9b31bd8fa74] [signal:4639b803-8b2f-419e-9fcf-595d78bac3ea] One driver says changing map magnification on-screen is dangerous and contrasts it with using a central control knob. [signal:00716995-5492-4c07-8f2e-1dea9e1e0eab]

[signal:28484188-f1ca-4f5e-8a93-b762eb9a30d3] [signal:3ffa5a57-187d-43d4-82d2-da5b88256b81] One customer says using air conditioning on the screen is awkward and that the screen takes time to boot. [signal:cfa47722-a508-4f11-87dd-5ce47225d968]

Not all feedback is negative: one driver says the satnav is simple to use, while also saying the touchscreen takes getting used to. [signal:095b9cfc-4222-4e27-806d-fb3be1de0f5e]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include touchscreen-use complaints for F70 in Europe and Rest of World, and for G60 and G70 in the USA. [signal:003646d4-ca0f-4c6a-acde-facdf010abf6] [signal:cfa47722-a508-4f11-87dd-5ce47225d968] [signal:28484188-f1ca-4f5e-8a93-b762eb9a30d3] [signal:3cdba788-6d81-40d2-82c2-d1b5e7b855fa] The sample includes both a positive comment about satnav usability and complaints about finding, learning, or operating screen functions. [signal:095b9cfc-4222-4e27-806d-fb3be1de0f5e] [signal:003646d4-ca0f-4c6a-acde-facdf010abf6] [signal:28484188-f1ca-4f5e-8a93-b762eb9a30d3]

## Open questions

value.title: Touchscreen size, persistence and heat durability concerns
value.summary: Some USA customers raise concerns about touchscreen size, the need to turn the screen off repeatedly, and durability in strong heat, while others praise the screen and its rear-seat controls. These signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers raise concerns about screen size, repeated shutoff, and heat durability.
Signals are from USA customers in G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers question whether the touchscreen will withstand strong summer heat [signal:5a3ad1f3-5216-4ca8-ab7b-2f76f0a9fcb5], want to keep it off without repeating the action at every start [signal:96d80b5e-90e5-462a-8015-b3536aeeb0c9], or prefer a smaller screen [signal:984bfb59-d4da-415a-809d-3b48f2115488]. Other customers describe the touchscreen as excellent or say they appreciate its rear-seat controls [signal:20c79eec-74c4-4af3-9b5e-bfe2ed872d26] [signal:4ed8477d-98cb-4c6c-a463-ed589c0487af] [signal:64205ce9-5d1a-4d26-84e6-bfbe85bd2e8c].

## What customers say
One G60 owner is concerned about touchscreen longevity in strong summer heat [signal:5a3ad1f3-5216-4ca8-ab7b-2f76f0a9fcb5]. Another G60 owner wants a persistent screen-off preference rather than turning the screen off after every vehicle start [signal:96d80b5e-90e5-462a-8015-b3536aeeb0c9]. A G70 owner says the screen covers more of the dashboard than needed [signal:984bfb59-d4da-415a-809d-3b48f2115488]. In contrast, G60 and G70 owners praise the touchscreen, and one G70 owner values rear-seat touchscreens that let passengers manage options themselves [signal:20c79eec-74c4-4af3-9b5e-bfe2ed872d26] [signal:4ed8477d-98cb-4c6c-a463-ed589c0487af] [signal:64205ce9-5d1a-4d26-84e6-bfbe85bd2e8c].

## Differences between markets
All six supplied signals are from the USA, so they do not show differences between markets [signal:5a3ad1f3-5216-4ca8-ab7b-2f76f0a9fcb5] [signal:96d80b5e-90e5-462a-8015-b3536aeeb0c9] [signal:984bfb59-d4da-415a-809d-3b48f2115488] [signal:20c79eec-74c4-4af3-9b5e-bfe2ed872d26] [signal:4ed8477d-98cb-4c6c-a463-ed589c0487af] [signal:64205ce9-5d1a-4d26-84e6-bfbe85bd2e8c]. The concerns and positive feedback appear across G60 and G70 signals [signal:5a3ad1f3-5216-4ca8-ab7b-2f76f0a9fcb5] [signal:96d80b5e-90e5-462a-8015-b3536aeeb0c9] [signal:984bfb59-d4da-415a-809d-3b48f2115488] [signal:20c79eec-74c4-4af3-9b5e-bfe2ed872d26] [signal:4ed8477d-98cb-4c6c-a463-ed589c0487af] [signal:64205ce9-5d1a-4d26-84e6-bfbe85bd2e8c].

## Open questions
How common are the heat-durability, persistent screen-off, and screen-size concerns beyond these individual signals? [signal:5a3ad1f3-5216-4ca8-ab7b-2f76f0a9fcb5] [signal:96d80b5e-90e5-462a-8015-b3536aeeb0c9] [signal:984bfb59-d4da-415a-809d-3b48f2115488] Do preferences differ between G60 and G70 customers, or between front- and rear-seat touchscreen use? [signal:4ed8477d-98cb-4c6c-a463-ed589c0487af]

highlights: Screen glitches, lag, freezes and blackouts interrupt touchscreen operation.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report touchscreen and centre-console faults including sluggish response, glitches, freezing and screens going black, sometimes making controlled functions unavailable or requiring a reset. [signal:2ea7db32-e687-4aa7-8829-b491235d01aa] [signal:3743f5d9-894d-4616-9535-138bdc0c380b] [signal:49dd3169-f17f-44c7-9e28-55f1f679fa7f] A customer also reports lag and difficulty operating controls while driving. [signal:2a8a6f87-d589-49dc-97c5-3c767dfe235e]

## What customers say
In Europe, one F70 owner says the console is sometimes sluggish or frozen and has needed resetting; another reports the main screen went black, making its functions unusable until a service-centre reset. [signal:2ea7db32-e687-4aa7-8829-b491235d01aa] [signal:3743f5d9-894d-4616-9535-138bdc0c380b] In the USA, G70 owners describe recurring glitches despite an update and a brief screen blackout while driving; another says the screen becomes very hot and raises safety concerns. [signal:49dd3169-f17f-44c7-9e28-55f1f679fa7f] [signal:66858984-218d-44d6-800a-b96d09f41909] [signal:414087e1-78a8-45a7-a039-7ab3a76f1985]

A Rest of World F70 customer says the flat controls are hard to locate by feel and that panel movement and response lag hurt usability. [signal:2a8a6f87-d589-49dc-97c5-3c767dfe235e] A European F70 owner describes the touchscreen as dangerous and says they avoid using it while driving. [signal:28bc24b3-a8d8-4e9d-9915-868453fe7381]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include European F70 reports of sluggishness, freezing and a black screen; USA G70 reports of glitches, a brief blackout and screen heat; and a Rest of World F70 report of lag and difficult-to-find controls. value.title: Basic functions difficult to find or operate on the touchscreen
value.summary: Some F70 and G70 owners find touchscreen controls confusing or distracting, particularly when searching for basic functions or operating them while driving. Others describe the screen as clear and straightforward.
highlights: Some owners find touchscreen controls confusing, time-consuming to navigate, or distracting while driving.
Signals cover F70 owners in Europe and Rest of World, and G70 owners in the USA; 9 signals total.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners say touchscreen-based controls make basic functions harder to find or operate, and that searching through menus while driving can be distracting. [signal:90b0578a-c527-4169-844b-1184541a12c9] [signal:af4dd13d-887a-4eda-bc43-f55df698151c] [signal:d5e54b19-8b83-492d-9654-b6c0030e702a]

## What customers say
An F70 owner says ventilation now takes two screen interactions instead of one, and describes aiming at the screen while driving as difficult. [signal:90b0578a-c527-4169-844b-1184541a12c9]

Another F70 owner says the in-car screen controls can be confusing because they are unfamiliar. [signal:2b84d7bb-b76e-45d6-85d8-d696d4afdc1d]

A G70 owner says learning the electronics takes time and searching the display while driving can be distracting; another says basic functions are buried among screen apps. [signal:af4dd13d-887a-4eda-bc43-f55df698151c] [signal:d5e54b19-8b83-492d-9654-b6c0030e702a]

Experiences differ: one F70 owner finds the wraparound touchscreen clear and straightforward to use. [signal:9381adb3-45a0-4358-9c85-cb9a49cf70d2]

## Differences between markets
In Europe, an F70 owner reports difficulty operating ventilation through the screen, while another describes the touchscreen as straightforward. [signal:90b0578a-c527-4169-844b-1184541a12c9] [signal:9381adb3-45a0-4358-9c85-cb9a49cf70d2]

In Rest of World, an F70 owner says the controls are confusing because they are not yet familiar with them. [signal:2b84d7bb-b76e-45d6-85d8-d696d4afdc1d]

In the USA, G70 owners describe time-consuming learning and difficulty finding basic functions through the display. [signal:af4dd13d-887a-4eda-bc43-f55df698151c] [signal:d5e54b19-8b83-492d-9654-b6c0030e702a]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often owners encounter these difficulties after becoming familiar with the controls. [signal:2b84d7bb-b76e-45d6-85d8-d696d4afdc1d]

[signal:0cfbf0a1-19df-4eed-b295-7952cd9194e8] [signal:475d66ac-a80f-455f-9356-07776e14ae73] One G60 driver says touchscreens demand more visual attention than knobs and buttons. [signal:0cfbf0a1-19df-4eed-b295-7952cd9194e8] [signal:475d66ac-a80f-455f-9356-07776e14ae73] The USA G60 driver is still learning the touchscreen and menu structure, and is unsure whether touchscreens are as convenient as physical controls, while expecting to become more familiar with them over time. [signal:c37fd063-beae-447c-8f89-d9d80814db41]

[signal:0cfbf0a1-19df-4eed-b295-7952cd9194e8] [signal:475d66ac-a80f-455f-9356-07776e14ae73] The USA signal describes a G60 driver still learning the controls and questioning their convenience, rather than saying they are definitively unusable. ## Problem
Some drivers say touchscreen controls take time to learn or require looking away from the road to locate and tap controls, which they consider distracting or unsafe. [signal:6458a46e-ab6b-4e88-9fdb-ca2f5d36500c] [signal:8f977d60-ac3e-4889-9cc6-37cb6e653b32] [signal:ed224b66-9cb2-4109-9872-42dadbe5f23d]
A G70 driver says the screen is a reach when skipping tracks, while a Europe F70 driver says the screen is simple enough but they are still figuring things out. [signal:74a48a66-8ce3-4869-8595-92d54aacec5e] [signal:23016df5-f3ea-44f8-988b-977056b04577]

## What customers say
One F70 driver misses the iDrive knob’s more definite, possibly safer control and says screen apps do not provide usable access to trip data while driving. [signal:6458a46e-ab6b-4e88-9fdb-ca2f5d36500c]
Another F70 driver says the curved display was tricky at first but became easy to use after getting accustomed to it. [signal:1611b8d3-b967-4107-a100-878128313e6f]
A different F70 driver likes the wide screen but says it is not distinctive enough to rave about. [signal:5d5745c9-81b4-4892-ba7a-04ea88813757]

## Differences between markets
The provided signals include usability concerns from F70 drivers in Europe and a reach concern from a G70 driver in the USA. [signal:6458a46e-ab6b-4e88-9fdb-ca2f5d36500c] [signal:8f977d60-ac3e-4889-9cc6-37cb6e653b32] [signal:ed224b66-9cb2-4109-9872-42dadbe5f23d] [signal:74a48a66-8ce3-4869-8595-92d54aacec5e]
The F70 feedback is not uniform: one Rest of World driver says the display becomes easy to use, while some Europe drivers describe difficulty, distraction, or safety concerns. [signal:1611b8d3-b967-4107-a100-878128313e6f] [signal:8f977d60-ac3e-4889-9cc6-37cb6e653b32] [signal:ed224b66-9cb2-4109-9872-42dadbe5f23d]

## Open questions
The provided signals do not establish how common these experiences are across the 20 signals in the case, or whether usability differs by function or time using the vehicle.

value.title: Touchscreen navigation feels cluttered and difficult to use

## Problem
Some owners say touchscreen menus and functions are difficult to navigate, with too many icons or repeated swiping to find what they need. [signal:0ebbdb22-968d-41f8-a964-33026502567c] [signal:1e8b7e20-7cab-4ae5-a091-558648f4be4f] Others describe difficulty figuring out where to find information or a feature. [signal:0b5d9c93-a73d-45a3-b71b-b76a83eb7db1] [signal:2f7be94c-ebd5-4203-8b19-f307d628a8b3]

## What customers say

[signal:1e8b7e20-7cab-4ae5-a091-558648f4be4f] [signal:0ebbdb22-968d-41f8-a964-33026502567c] Other G70 complaints describe difficulty restoring a setup that was lost and uncertainty when pairing another phone. [signal:13a9ca2b-a2cf-4e82-9fba-3cb595612334] [signal:2388ca00-89ed-4b70-8dd4-5c7b852030ae]

[signal:0b5d9c93-a73d-45a3-b71b-b76a83eb7db1] [signal:0ebbdb22-968d-41f8-a964-33026502567c] [signal:13a9ca2b-a2cf-4e82-9fba-3cb595612334] [signal:1e8b7e20-7cab-4ae5-a091-558648f4be4f] [signal:2388ca00-89ed-4b70-8dd4-5c7b852030ae] [signal:2f7be94c-ebd5-4203-8b19-f307d628a8b3]

[signal:0b5d9c93-a73d-45a3-b71b-b76a83eb7db1] [signal:0ebbdb22-968d-41f8-a964-33026502567c] [signal:13a9ca2b-a2cf-4e82-9fba-3cb595612334] [signal:1e8b7e20-7cab-4ae5-a091-558648f4be4f] [signal:2388ca00-89ed-4b70-8dd4-5c7b852030ae] [signal:2f7be94c-ebd5-4203-8b19-f307d628a8b3]

value.title: Touchscreen controls distract drivers and are difficult to use
value.summary: Drivers report that touchscreen controls can be hard to learn or locate and may require attention away from the road. The signals include concerns from F70, G60 and G70 owners across Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Touchscreen controls can be confusing, difficult to operate and distracting while driving.
Signals span 29 reports across Europe, the USA and Rest of World, and F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers say touchscreen controls can be difficult to use, especially when they must find a control or tap a precise spot while driving. [signal:14d01ae6-61f5-4206-aee9-204377bdb339] [signal:466417ea-8a43-42d3-b631-730031f95591]
Some owners describe the screen as distracting or dangerous to use on the move. [signal:05962ce2-9019-40b9-bcc9-3f2d00cce067] [signal:28a2fdf9-87bf-4d43-b083-58e0742ec3ce]

## What customers say
One F70 driver says basic functions such as heating require looking away from the windscreen and aiming at an exact spot. [signal:14d01ae6-61f5-4206-aee9-204377bdb339]
A G60 owner says they and their husband cannot remember many touchscreen symbols, while another says the screen is tricky to adapt to and pulls focus from driving. [signal:612fcfd5-cf11-4442-b3c9-f3f7be00462d] [signal:64c6e867-5f88-48ec-b92e-59c12a6243da]
Some customers are still getting used to the screen or find controls confusing; others describe the controls as handy or say navigation is simple to use. [signal:30da94d4-b3c1-40f2-a5ee-e89bd179e7de] [signal:1f883f72-a87f-4579-b757-3919778acd7a]
A Rest of World F70 owner says audio, navigation and air-conditioning controls rely too much on the touch panel and are poorly operable. [signal:3b1b2110-46d8-4817-a579-bb1534a5a8f3]

## Differences between markets

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 owners say touch-screen controls are less easy or quick to use than physical controls. [signal:29f4e397-c4ce-4b1c-981d-d9f3289fadf2] [signal:c1647f5a-3148-4c98-968f-42d17436bbaf]

## What customers say
A Europe owner is unsure about having every control on a touch screen. [signal:29f4e397-c4ce-4b1c-981d-d9f3289fadf2]
A Rest of World owner says the smart touch panel works fine, but prefers mechanical buttons and a physical shift lever. [signal:c086446f-109a-4b70-9296-4084c254f705]
Another Rest of World owner finds the iDrive controller simpler to handle while driving and wonders about using both it and the touch panel. [signal:a01d901c-5744-45be-8f9a-df2d427fcb10]
A Europe owner says controls moved to the iDrive screen are not always easy or quick to use, compared with a button on a previous BMW for switching off selected safety features. [signal:c1647f5a-3148-4c98-968f-42d17436bbaf]

## Differences between markets
Signals from both Europe and the Rest of World describe preferences for physical controls or concerns about touch-screen usability. [signal:29f4e397-c4ce-4b1c-981d-d9f3289fadf2] [signal:c086446f-109a-4b70-9296-4084c254f705] [signal:c1647f5a-3148-4c98-968f-42d17436bbaf]
In the Rest of World, one owner says the touch panel works fine while preferring physical controls; another finds the iDrive controller simpler to use while driving. [signal:c086446f-109a-4b70-9296-4084c254f705] [signal:a01d901c-5744-45be-8f9a-df2d427fcb10]

## Open questions
Do owners have different usability concerns depending on which controls have moved to the touch screen? [signal:c1647f5a-3148-4c98-968f-42d17436bbaf]
How do preferences for touch-screen operation and physical controls vary across markets? [signal:29f4e397-c4ce-4b1c-981d-d9f3289fadf2] [signal:c086446f-109a-4b70-9296-4084c254f705]

value.title: Touchscreen controls feel distracting and difficult to use
value.summary: Some drivers find touchscreen-based controls unintuitive, distracting or slower than physical controls, particularly for frequently used functions. Signals describe these concerns in Europe, the USA and Rest of World across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Touchscreen controls can make common tasks slower, less intuitive and distracting while driving.
Signals mention Europe, USA and Rest of World, and F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say that putting controls on the touchscreen makes simple tasks take longer and can require them to look away from the road [signal:31719c39-b27d-47f7-ada9-56a29293d212]. Another describes touchscreen operation as distracting and awkward while moving [signal:301b0ec5-3888-4461-a192-7db04c3d71cf]. Drivers also report that functions are buried in menus or that the interface is not intuitive [signal:1493052a-bd0e-4eb0-9b00-65e4bcc4ce64] [signal:2b989946-5cf8-4e8e-b74f-2c5740986d1d].

## What customers say
One F70 driver says accessing heated seats and radio stations takes more steps on the screen than using buttons [signal:31719c39-b27d-47f7-ada9-56a29293d212]. Another F70 driver says the touchscreen is awkward to use while driving, especially on bumpy roads [signal:301b0ec5-3888-4461-a192-7db04c3d71cf]. An F70 owner misses physical controls for climate, heated seats and the heated steering wheel [signal:c40c8cae-4cb0-468b-a6b8-39bcf71ed324]. A G60 owner says the auto stop-start setting is buried in menus [signal:1493052a-bd0e-4eb0-9b00-65e4bcc4ce64]. A G70 owner reports that using the iDrive selection tool repeatedly opens a presets screen, making radio-station selection difficult [signal:19f72b01-a5f1-4ec4-b93b-258d4b070375]. A Rest of World G60 owner describes the ID8.5 interface as unintuitive [signal:2b989946-5cf8-4e8e-b74f-2c5740986d1d].

## Differences between markets
The sampled complaints include Europe F70 drivers describing distraction, extra steps and missing physical controls [signal:301b0ec5-3888-4461-a192-7db04c3d71cf] [signal:31719c39-b27d-47f7-ada9-56a29293d212] [signal:c40c8cae-4cb0-468b-a6b8-39bcf71ed324]. USA signals mention a buried setting in a G60 and a difficult radio-selection interaction in a G70 [signal:1493052a-bd0e-4eb0-9b00-65e4bcc4ce64] [signal:19f72b01-a5f1-4ec4-b93b-258d4b070375]. A Rest of World G60 owner calls the interface unintuitive [signal:2b989946-5cf8-4e8e-b74f-2c5740986d1d]. The sampled signals do not establish whether these experiences differ systematically by market.

## Open questions
Which touchscreen tasks most often cause distraction or require extra steps? [signal:31719c39-b27d-47f7-ada9-56a29293d212] [signal:301b0ec5-3888-4461-a192-7db04c3d71cf]
Do the reported menu and selection difficulties vary by vehicle or interface version? [signal:1493052a-bd0e-4eb0-9b00-65e4bcc4ce64] [signal:19f72b01-a5f1-4ec4-b93b-258d4b070375] [signal:2b989946-5cf8-4e8e-b74f-2c5740986d1d]

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe different experiences with touchscreen usability: some have trouble understanding or operating the controls, while another says the touchscreen makes things easier to use. [signal:399388b3-fd58-4864-b5cf-1ea8e4fb08d6] [signal:6c3355f8-0be9-437e-9551-f0e25b4d62a0] [signal:ac5ea85f-1ca2-49a3-9233-a8a55f09916e] [signal:758ee729-0137-47fa-b433-3f83564c0acc]

## What customers say
A G70 customer did not know what the rear-door-armrest touchscreens were for and planned to ask the dealer for help operating them. [signal:399388b3-fd58-4864-b5cf-1ea8e4fb08d6]

Another G70 customer said the on-screen buttons were too small and difficult to use while driving, raising safety concerns about reaching for them. [signal:6c3355f8-0be9-437e-9551-f0e25b4d62a0]

A G60 customer said it was taking time to get used to the computer systems and touchpad controls during the first weeks of ownership. [signal:ac5ea85f-1ca2-49a3-9233-a8a55f09916e]

A different G60 customer said the iDrive display starts very dark and wanted it to start lighter. [signal:36b129e2-227a-4e91-8f89-ee411ca283ff]

In contrast, a G60 customer said the touchscreen, onboard computer, and voice control make the vehicle easier to use. [signal:758ee729-0137-47fa-b433-3f83564c0acc]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:399388b3-fd58-4864-b5cf-1ea8e4fb08d6] [signal:6c3355f8-0be9-437e-9551-f0e25b4d62a0] [signal:ac5ea85f-1ca2-49a3-9233-a8a55f09916e] [signal:36b129e2-227a-4e91-8f89-ee411ca283ff] [signal:758ee729-0137-47fa-b433-3f83564c0acc]

Both signals are from Europe and the F70; they provide no comparison across markets. [signal:13053298-31fc-42f0-a51e-6d6c5e932855] [signal:55bf8c3d-e5c6-4d55-9ab4-e91d5c5f951b]

## Open questions
Do other customers share this reaction to the heating-seat graphics? [signal:13053298-31fc-42f0-a51e-6d6c5e932855] [signal:55bf8c3d-e5c6-4d55-9ab4-e91d5c5f951b]

value.title: Home screen sidebar cannot keep the weather app pinned
value.summary: A USA G70 owner says the weather app disappeared from the home screen’s left sidebar and they rely on quick shortcuts.
highlights: The weather app disappeared from the left sidebar, disrupting a quick shortcut the owner relied on.
One signal: a USA owner of a G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G70 owner says the weather app disappeared from the home screen’s left sidebar, so they moved it to the shortcut section instead. [signal:088381b4-51a6-4615-8e06-25fa89f68e85]

## What customers say
The owner says they rely on quick shortcuts and would like to pin more apps to the sidebar. [signal:088381b4-51a6-4615-8e06-25fa89f68e85]

## Differences between markets
The single signal is from the USA; there are no other market perspectives to compare. [signal:088381b4-51a6-4615-8e06-25fa89f68e85]

## Open questions
The signal does not explain why the weather app disappeared or whether other owners experienced the same issue. [signal:088381b4-51a6-4615-8e06-25fa89f68e85]

value.title: iDrive software behaves inconsistently, lags, or shuts down
value.summary: Customers report inconsistent software behavior, lag, glitches, and complete shutdowns. The signals come from F70 owners in Europe and a G70 owner in the USA.
highlights: Reported problems include unpredictable behavior, lag, glitches, and complete shutdowns.
Signals cover three Europe F70 complaints and one USA G70 complaint.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe inconsistent software behavior and iDrive glitches; one F70 owner reports two complete shutdowns within the first three months, requiring BMW assistance. [signal:339c1acb-b56d-4118-8def-ad02f8982f7d] [signal:4f2e21be-ca7d-4ba7-866b-7f0c33bc064c] [signal:60f52b4e-ffae-4580-a593-4fb9d94a51ef]

## What customers say
An F70 owner says the car acts unpredictably, while another describes the new iDrive setup as laggy and reports two shutdowns. [signal:339c1acb-b56d-4118-8def-ad02f8982f7d] [signal:4f2e21be-ca7d-4ba7-866b-7f0c33bc064c]
A G70 owner reports software glitches in iDrive 8 and hopes for an upgrade to 8.5. [signal:60f52b4e-ffae-4580-a593-4fb9d94a51ef]

## Differences between markets
The Europe signals concern F70 owners and mention unpredictable behavior, lag, and shutdowns; the USA signal concerns a G70 owner and mentions iDrive 8 glitches. [signal:339c1acb-b56d-4118-8def-ad02f8982f7d] [signal:4f2e21be-ca7d-4ba7-866b-7f0c33bc064c] [signal:cb25efd9-eb08-4e4c-9ff0-4effc638c55f] [signal:60f52b4e-ffae-4580-a593-4fb9d94a51ef]

## Open questions
How widespread are the reported glitches and shutdowns beyond these signals? [signal:339c1acb-b56d-4118-8def-ad02f8982f7d] [signal:4f2e21be-ca7d-4ba7-866b-7f0c33bc064c] [signal:60f52b4e-ffae-4580-a593-4fb9d94a51ef]

value.title: Finding needed information requires frequent screen switching
value.summary: A USA G60 driver says it is hard to find needed information on the main screen without switching between screens, and finds the displays distracting while driving.
highlights: Needed information is hard to find without frequent screen switching.
One signal from a USA G60 driver reports the issue.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 driver in the USA says finding needed information on the main screen requires switching between screens, and that the displays feel distracting rather than helpful while driving. [signal:0f13d32b-6c9b-43e2-bd3e-af6c26000453]

## What customers say
The driver says the technology features are excessive and that frequent screen switching makes them feel less safe. [signal:0f13d32b-6c9b-43e2-bd3e-af6c26000453]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from the USA, so the signals do not show whether experiences differ between markets. [signal:0f13d32b-6c9b-43e2-bd3e-af6c26000453]

## Open questions
Do other drivers or vehicle lines report similar difficulty finding information and distraction? [signal:0f13d32b-6c9b-43e2-bd3e-af6c26000453]

value.title: Vehicle settings are complicated and time-consuming to configure
value.summary: Customers in the USA report that configuring and learning vehicle settings is difficult and time-consuming in the G60 and G70.
highlights: Configuring the vehicle and figuring out its settings feels complicated and time-consuming.
The signals cover two USA complaints: one each for the G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe configuring the vehicle as an ongoing learning process and say figuring out settings is complicated and time-consuming. [signal:0cb27894-c525-45a2-9762-a5c291192efc] [signal:5ec703f3-f70f-4830-80c0-126f9e613385]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says setting up and starting the vehicle each time could be improved. [signal:0cb27894-c525-45a2-9762-a5c291192efc]
A G70 owner says figuring out all the settings takes too much time and is complicated. [signal:5ec703f3-f70f-4830-80c0-126f9e613385]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are complaints from the USA, one for the G60 and one for the G70; the signals provide no comparison with other markets. [signal:0cb27894-c525-45a2-9762-a5c291192efc] [signal:5ec703f3-f70f-4830-80c0-126f9e613385]

## Open questions
Do customers experience the settings as difficult across other markets or vehicle lines? The available signals are limited to the USA G60 and G70. [signal:0cb27894-c525-45a2-9762-a5c291192efc] [signal:5ec703f3-f70f-4830-80c0-126f9e613385]

value.title: Shortcut setup is difficult for some G70 customers
value.summary: Some USA G70 customers are unsure how to find, add, or remove shortcuts, while a USA G60 customer values being able to save frequently used settings there.
highlights: Some G70 customers find shortcut setup and management difficult.
Two USA G70 signals report difficulty; one USA G60 signal expresses appreciation.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Two USA G70 customers asked how to set up, add, or remove shortcuts, indicating difficulty using the shortcut feature. [signal:0cdb04fc-93a4-4b5f-9a03-5a70771fe80e] [signal:d11a2400-e3bc-4291-8896-f3d200064070]

## What customers say
One customer was unsure how to save or delete shortcuts, and another was unsure how to configure menu options for quick access. [signal:0cdb04fc-93a4-4b5f-9a03-5a70771fe80e] [signal:d11a2400-e3bc-4291-8896-f3d200064070] A USA G60 customer liked being able to place frequently used settings in the Shortcuts menu. [signal:f85edf00-39d9-43b4-a08a-c8a7e84d1d05]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA; the two reports of difficulty concern the G70, while the positive signal concerns the G60.  [signal:d11a2400-e3bc-4291-8896-f3d200064070] [signal:f85edf00-39d9-43b4-a08a-c8a7e84d1d05] The signals therefore differ in sentiment across vehicle lines. [signal:0cdb04fc-93a4-4b5f-9a03-5a70771fe80e] [signal:d11a2400-e3bc-4291-8896-f3d200064070] [signal:f85edf00-39d9-43b4-a08a-c8a7e84d1d05]

## Open questions
Whether shortcut setup is similarly difficult for other customers or vehicle lines is not established by these three signals. [signal:0cdb04fc-93a4-4b5f-9a03-5a70771fe80e] [signal:d11a2400-e3bc-4291-8896-f3d200064070] [signal:f85edf00-39d9-43b4-a08a-c8a7e84d1d05]

value.title: Automatic clock updates are delayed or fail
value.summary: Some USA G70 customers report that the clock does not update automatically when they change time zones or when the clocks change. One customer says their prior vehicle updated time zones right away.
highlights: Automatic clock updates can be delayed or fail.
Both signals are from USA customers with G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the vehicle clock does not update automatically as expected, either after entering a new time zone or during a recent time change. [signal:13097c4e-bdee-4ac9-bc17-1863f05bb692] [signal:f1f5bf70-ebd2-4285-b785-b770da45dfc4]

## What customers say
One customer said the time had not updated after a trip and was told the system could take up to two days; she said her prior vehicle updated as soon as she entered a different time zone. [signal:13097c4e-bdee-4ac9-bc17-1863f05bb692]
Another customer said the clock did not change for a recent time change, declined offered correction steps, and planned to ask the dealer for assistance. [signal:f1f5bf70-ebd2-4285-b785-b770da45dfc4]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA and concern the G70; the signals provide no comparison between markets. [signal:13097c4e-bdee-4ac9-bc17-1863f05bb692] [signal:f1f5bf70-ebd2-4285-b785-b770da45dfc4]

## Open questions
Do automatic clock-update issues occur in other markets or vehicle lines?
How often does the clock update late or fail, and under what conditions?

value.title: Too many electronics make the operating concept hard for older drivers
value.summary: Older drivers report difficulty learning and managing the G60’s functions and the G70’s electronics. The signals come from the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Older drivers find the functions and electronics difficult to learn and manage.
Three complaints cover the G60 in the USA and Rest of World, and the G70 in the USA.
One customer mentions a previous Mercedes-Benz, but makes no clear usability comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Older customers describe difficulty learning and managing the car’s functions and electronics. [signal:07272d9a-a5ca-4946-9c9c-80edfa4cbfc1] [signal:a6a1c76e-b387-48c9-9e0d-37afa38b0c32] [signal:e7a7a495-dc43-40d8-a41b-7108bcfa7b63]

## What customers say
A G60 customer in the USA says there are many new functions to learn and keep in mind, which can be hard for older people to manage. [signal:07272d9a-a5ca-4946-9c9c-80edfa4cbfc1]
A G60 customer in Rest of World says older people find it tough to learn the car using manuals and videos, and recalls spending around 20 hours explaining things in a previous Mercedes-Benz. [signal:a6a1c76e-b387-48c9-9e0d-37afa38b0c32]
A G70 customer in the USA, about 80 years old, says the car may have too many electronics for someone older. [signal:e7a7a495-dc43-40d8-a41b-7108bcfa7b63]

## Differences between markets
The complaints cover the G60 in both the USA and Rest of World, and the G70 in the USA. [signal:07272d9a-a5ca-4946-9c9c-80edfa4cbfc1] [signal:a6a1c76e-b387-48c9-9e0d-37afa38b0c32] [signal:e7a7a495-dc43-40d8-a41b-7108bcfa7b63]
The USA G60 customer acknowledges that new technologies are a broader trend, while still describing them as difficult to manage for older people. [signal:07272d9a-a5ca-4946-9c9c-80edfa4cbfc1]

## Open questions
Do these usability difficulties extend beyond older customers or the G60 and G70? [signal:07272d9a-a5ca-4946-9c9c-80edfa4cbfc1] [signal:a6a1c76e-b387-48c9-9e0d-37afa38b0c32] [signal:e7a7a495-dc43-40d8-a41b-7108bcfa7b63]
How does the previous Mercedes-Benz experience compare in usability? [signal:a6a1c76e-b387-48c9-9e0d-37afa38b0c32]

value.title: F70 controls feel unintuitive and require more taps
value.summary: A customer in Europe says the F70’s controls are unintuitive and that actions previously available with one button now take three screen taps. They also describe the interaction as dangerous.
highlights: Controls feel unintuitive, and common actions take more screen taps.
One customer signal from Europe, concerning the F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer says the F70’s controls are unintuitive and that tasks which used to take one button press now require three screen taps; they describe this as dangerous. [signal:1a24fd28-5711-4e7a-be24-3cf204203a3c]

## What customers say
The customer says they wish they could have kept their 2021 1 Series and that the new operating concept is difficult to make sense of. [signal:1a24fd28-5711-4e7a-be24-3cf204203a3c]

## Differences between markets
The available signal is from Europe and concerns the F70; there is no evidence here to compare markets. [signal:1a24fd28-5711-4e7a-be24-3cf204203a3c]

## Open questions
How representative is this experience among F70 customers, and which screen-based tasks require the additional taps?

value.title: Operating systems feel complex and difficult to learn
value.summary: Customers across the USA, Europe and Rest of World describe the operating concept as complicated, unintuitive or difficult to learn. Some value the technology but say it takes time to get used to.
highlights: Customers struggle to navigate screens, controls and features or learn how to use them.
Signals include the USA, Europe and Rest of World, and G60, G70 and F70; the case contains 54 signals.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the systems as complicated, unintuitive or difficult to figure out, with some saying they cannot fully learn the features or controls. [signal:062dbc17-8163-4a3d-8dce-c244ab4d3948] [signal:0c8d880f-52b9-4917-a731-2e2156566adb] [signal:1baa8539-2a5c-4704-aa7c-fd537ac3493b] [signal:92eb4f0a-7a9d-41c6-b3ba-5022db9ffa0b]

## What customers say
One USA customer described difficulty choosing among roughly 20 to 30 icons and moving through screens; the customer and his wife found the setup unintuitive. [signal:062dbc17-8163-4a3d-8dce-c244ab4d3948]

Other customers say there are too many features to sort out, that systems are hard to learn, or that features are challenging to unlock and use. [signal:25b09cca-45d0-45e1-9cf8-a75e27996f67] [signal:0af8babb-697c-4282-a0bf-dd6bddab0c29] [signal:27981306-7ece-43b8-b4f2-837a8bf49374]

Some customers mention getting help from family or wanting a lesson on the controls; one says sales staff did not provide enough help explaining the new model. [signal:062dbc17-8163-4a3d-8dce-c244ab4d3948] [signal:92eb4f0a-7a9d-41c6-b3ba-5022db9ffa0b] [signal:25b09cca-45d0-45e1-9cf8-a75e27996f67]

## Differences between markets
The sample includes difficulty-use complaints from the USA, Europe and Rest of World. [signal:062dbc17-8163-4a3d-8dce-c244ab4d3948] [signal:441db681-9dfd-4093-b4f3-cfff546aaf65] [signal:06bba555-84a0-4d98-91da-8e91f0fe5c0f]

Europe feedback is mixed: some customers call the technology or controls complex, while another says the technology is excellent but takes time to get used to. [signal:441db681-9dfd-4093-b4f3-cfff546aaf65] [signal:92eb4f0a-7a9d-41c6-b3ba-5022db9ffa0b] [signal:73806afb-e962-4c02-8045-00f7cfe664d2]

## Open questions
How does the difficulty vary by feature, screen or control? The signals describe broad usability concerns and individual examples, but do not identify a common specific interaction.  [signal:27981306-7ece-43b8-b4f2-837a8bf49374] [signal:92eb4f0a-7a9d-41c6-b3ba-5022db9ffa0b]

Do customers’ experiences differ by vehicle line or frequency of use? The sample includes G60, G70 and F70 feedback, and one customer says they do not use the vehicle daily. [signal:062dbc17-8163-4a3d-8dce-c244ab4d3948] [signal:0c8d880f-52b9-4917-a731-2e2156566adb] [signal:1baa8539-2a5c-4704-aa7c-fd537ac3493b]

value.title: Touchscreen-only controls feel difficult and distracting to use
value.summary: Customers in Europe, the Rest of World and the USA say moving more functions to the touchscreen makes familiar controls harder or more distracting to use. Several miss physical buttons or the iDrive controller, particularly in F70 feedback.
highlights: Screen-based controls and missing physical controls are described as awkward, hard to find, or distracting.
Signals cover six Europe F70 reviews, one Rest of World F70 review, and two US reviews for G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers say that relying on touchscreen controls and removing physical buttons or the iDrive controller makes some functions harder to operate, especially while driving. [signal:27c15c5b-78fe-4b71-a3e1-d9d4e09b0c7b] [signal:2b6cb96f-65fd-451b-aec3-4b725ef4b171] [signal:5add9a02-fee1-4cb9-89e0-de8e76cdf026] A Europe F70 customer says changing drive mode takes multiple taps and diverts attention from the road. [signal:27c15c5b-78fe-4b71-a3e1-d9d4e09b0c7b]

## What customers say
F70 customers describe missing the rotary controller and physical buttons, and report difficulty accessing driving modes, climate controls, cruise or limiter functions, and radio shortcuts. [signal:2b6cb96f-65fd-451b-aec3-4b725ef4b171] [signal:3826ee66-67a2-4a98-ae88-21517d3b0583] [signal:8ddd546d-b1a5-4504-8a6d-334c94326d23] A Rest of World F70 customer also reports that flat panel buttons are hard to find by feel and that button response lag affects usability. [signal:5add9a02-fee1-4cb9-89e0-de8e76cdf026] Some customers say they are pleased with the car overall, while still disliking the operating concept. [signal:27c15c5b-78fe-4b71-a3e1-d9d4e09b0c7b] [signal:744b1a97-0209-4b62-aa1a-80109ce38908]

## Differences between markets
The six sampled Europe signals concern the F70 and include complaints about touchscreen-only operation, removed physical controls, and unintuitive access to functions. [signal:27c15c5b-78fe-4b71-a3e1-d9d4e09b0c7b] [signal:2b6cb96f-65fd-451b-aec3-4b725ef4b171] [signal:3826ee66-67a2-4a98-ae88-21517d3b0583] [signal:744b1a97-0209-4b62-aa1a-80109ce38908] [signal:8ddd546d-b1a5-4504-8a6d-334c94326d23] [signal:920c073f-0c5e-4198-87de-6afa85a88462] The Rest of World F70 signal similarly criticizes removed controls and panel usability. [signal:5add9a02-fee1-4cb9-89e0-de8e76cdf026] The two USA signals concern the G70 and G60; both mention missing physical buttons, and the G70 customer says screen menus can be distracting and awkward. [signal:d4f11f06-8bef-4eed-9ec6-e29902eeb879] [signal:048125e4-0d6f-43aa-91d1-830552c5895a]

## Open questions
Do customers experience the same usability issues across the F70, G70 and G60? [signal:27c15c5b-78fe-4b71-a3e1-d9d4e09b0c7b] [signal:d4f11f06-8bef-4eed-9ec6-e29902eeb879] [signal:048125e4-0d6f-43aa-91d1-830552c5895a] How often do the reported difficulties lead to distraction while driving? [signal:27c15c5b-78fe-4b71-a3e1-d9d4e09b0c7b] [signal:d4f11f06-8bef-4eed-9ec6-e29902eeb879]

value.title: Infotainment switching and control behavior feels unintuitive
value.summary: Some USA G70 and G60 customers find media, navigation, and audio-source behavior unintuitive or want Apple CarPlay to remain active on entry. Another G70 customer values using CarPlay alongside BMW’s interface.
highlights: Navigation controls and audio-source changes can behave unexpectedly or feel unintuitive.
Signals cover three USA G70 customers and one USA G60 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers report that navigation controls and audio-source changes are difficult or unintuitive when using Android Auto or Apple CarPlay. [signal:1915121c-527c-4205-9083-21e897845355] [signal:757d6bc8-ce69-4c6e-8df7-2b8258f0a8e5]

One G70 customer said selecting Apple Maps on the touchscreen did not change the nav button’s behavior: it continued to open BMW navigation. [signal:1915121c-527c-4205-9083-21e897845355] A G60 customer would prefer the car to stay in Apple CarPlay upon entry instead of switching back to the BMW interface. [signal:b5c5f254-4339-44ba-b921-2ce338dbe209]

## What customers say
A G70 customer described changing audio sources as hard and unintuitive, particularly with Android Auto or Apple CarPlay for navigation. [signal:757d6bc8-ce69-4c6e-8df7-2b8258f0a8e5]

Another G70 customer values running Apple CarPlay alongside BMW’s interface, relying on BMW navigation while using CarPlay for phone functions and music. [signal:af2b8c58-bef5-422b-bbfb-474571306dbb] This positive view contrasts with reports of confusing switching behavior and a preference for CarPlay to remain active. [signal:1915121c-527c-4205-9083-21e897845355] 

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA; the signals provide no comparison between markets. [signal:1915121c-527c-4205-9083-21e897845355] [signal:757d6bc8-ce69-4c6e-8df7-2b8258f0a8e5] [signal:b5c5f254-4339-44ba-b921-2ce338dbe209] [signal:af2b8c58-bef5-422b-bbfb-474571306dbb]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these experiences are beyond the reported customers. [signal:1915121c-527c-4205-9083-21e897845355] [signal:757d6bc8-ce69-4c6e-8df7-2b8258f0a8e5] [signal:b5c5f254-4339-44ba-b921-2ce338dbe209] [signal:af2b8c58-bef5-422b-bbfb-474571306dbb]

value.title: iDrive complexity makes everyday functions harder to use
value.summary: Some customers find iDrive confusing, feature-heavy, or distracting, while others say it becomes more enjoyable after they learn it. The signals cover customers in the USA and Europe across G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report confusing menus, too many settings, and difficulty finding functions.
The case has 43 signals; the supplied examples include USA G60/G70 and Europe F70 customers.
One customer mentions prior Mercedes ownership; no direct competitor comparison is reported.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say iDrive is confusing or complicated, with many settings and features making functions difficult to find or operate. [signal:4897a337-89e9-4d1d-9265-69db69d7ae1c] [signal:eeadfd33-6963-4b9f-9310-ead9df959d46] [signal:0c005970-81cd-4730-8fb6-32a4f2cd83dd]
A customer says using iDrive while driving feels unsafe, and another says numerous apps make some features harder to find and distracting while driving. [signal:7580155b-3599-4b88-bad7-dfed2830b26c] [signal:3e60ab24-5047-4fd3-b287-b53c3e7dfaf5]

## What customers say
One long-time BMW owner misses the previous mechanical buttons and finds the system confusing. [signal:4897a337-89e9-4d1d-9265-69db69d7ae1c]
Some customers describe a learning curve; one says that after learning the system, they enjoy it more. [signal:7fb11772-dbf0-4019-8106-d59ec6ffc0d6] [signal:95f79994-730b-414f-8235-2295ca59f3c0]
Feedback is not uniformly negative: one customer calls the new iDrive mostly well designed, while objecting to its reliance on individual apps. [signal:3e60ab24-5047-4fd3-b287-b53c3e7dfaf5]

## Differences between markets
In the supplied examples, USA feedback includes reports of confusion, complexity, and a learning curve across G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:4897a337-89e9-4d1d-9265-69db69d7ae1c] [signal:7fb11772-dbf0-4019-8106-d59ec6ffc0d6] [signal:95f79994-730b-414f-8235-2295ca59f3c0] [signal:eeadfd33-6963-4b9f-9310-ead9df959d46] [signal:0c005970-81cd-4730-8fb6-32a4f2cd83dd] [signal:3e60ab24-5047-4fd3-b287-b53c3e7dfaf5]
The supplied Europe example, from an F70 owner, strongly criticizes iDrive 9 and describes using it while driving as unsafe. [signal:7580155b-3599-4b88-bad7-dfed2830b26c]

## Open questions
Do the reported usability difficulties vary by iDrive version or vehicle line? [signal:7580155b-3599-4b88-bad7-dfed2830b26c] [signal:4897a337-89e9-4d1d-9265-69db69d7ae1c]
How common are the concerns about finding functions, distraction while driving, and the learning curve across the full set of 43 signals? [signal:0c005970-81cd-4730-8fb6-32a4f2cd83dd] [signal:3e60ab24-5047-4fd3-b287-b53c3e7dfaf5] [signal:95f79994-730b-414f-8235-2295ca59f3c0]

value.title: Initial system setting quirks
value.summary: A G60 customer in the USA reported initial system setting quirks, which were sorted out quickly.
highlights: Initial system setting quirks were reported, then sorted out quickly.
The signal is from one USA customer with a G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
