value.title: Operating system menus and controls are difficult to use
value.summary: Customers report complicated menus, hard-to-find functions, and controls they find unintuitive or overly high-tech. Complaints come from USA owners of G70 and G60 vehicles and Europe owners of F70 vehicles, including older customers.
highlights: Menus and controls are difficult to navigate, with some functions hard to find.
Complaints span USA G70/G60 and Europe F70 owners; older customers are mentioned in Europe.
One USA customer compares the interface unfavorably with Apple products.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the operating system and controls as complicated, unintuitive, or difficult to navigate. [signal:19aaa147-ccd6-4d70-8e07-75c64b527669] [signal:df33c559-6210-434b-a2a9-739d227c6ee2] Some say the interface makes the audio-visual system unusable or that they dislike the controls. [signal:d135319f-cd70-4d6d-a185-f4fa5bb3e85f] [signal:db8ceaee-a973-4a62-8475-dbd8a12714ee]

## What customers say
A USA G70 owner says basic functions require digging through apps, while another describes the information system as badly thought through. [signal:19aaa147-ccd6-4d70-8e07-75c64b527669] [signal:99d41614-ce5f-4f2e-9d79-3f695623186e] A USA G60 customer says locating menu options takes time and compares the interface unfavorably with Apple products. [signal:df33c559-6210-434b-a2a9-739d227c6ee2] A Europe F70 owner says the menu structure is complicated, voice commands work for some functions but not others, and more traditional manual controls would be welcome. [signal:9907303b-2d0f-461a-b5d2-9c8df5357467] Another Europe F70 owner says the computer system is too complicated and that a handbook is missing. [signal:ebc480f3-bce2-4ef5-b61e-0642b3238ffe]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include complaints about menus, missing buttons, configuration limits, and the audio-visual interface. [signal:19aaa147-ccd6-4d70-8e07-75c64b527669] [signal:5d3a1aa9-394a-4819-a5fb-16eb128f30c5] [signal:d135319f-cd70-4d6d-a185-f4fa5bb3e85f] [signal:db8ceaee-a973-4a62-8475-dbd8a12714ee] [signal:df33c559-6210-434b-a2a9-739d227c6ee2] The Europe signals emphasize high-tech controls, complicated menus, inconsistent voice-command response, and a preference for manual options; one customer identifies as a pensioner and another as older. [signal:9907303b-2d0f-461a-b5d2-9c8df5357467] [signal:ebc480f3-bce2-4ef5-b61e-0642b3238ffe]

## Open questions
How consistently do customers encounter difficulty finding basic functions across vehicle lines? [signal:19aaa147-ccd6-4d70-8e07-75c64b527669] [signal:df33c559-6210-434b-a2a9-739d227c6ee2]
Which specific controls or functions are hardest to use, and how do experiences differ by age or market? [signal:9907303b-2d0f-461a-b5d2-9c8df5357467] [signal:ebc480f3-bce2-4ef5-b61e-0642b3238ffe]

value.title: Touchscreen controls take time to learn and set up
value.summary: Some European F70 owners find the electronic controls and BMW app take time to get used to, and say setting up the car can delay driving.
highlights: Touchscreen controls can feel annoying and take time to learn or set up.
Both signals are complaints from European F70 owners.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 owners in Europe say the electronic controls and BMW app take time to feel confident using, and that setting up the car can take a few minutes before driving. [signal:28eb9fdb-a900-43d3-9a60-04233f99f429] [signal:6817d2dc-fc4d-46fe-8443-77b779a81753]

## What customers say
One owner says there are many touchscreen buttons and they are gradually getting used to the controls and app. [signal:28eb9fdb-a900-43d3-9a60-04233f99f429] Another describes the system as annoying and says setup takes a few minutes before driving away. [signal:6817d2dc-fc4d-46fe-8443-77b779a81753]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Europe and concern the F70; no other markets or vehicle lines are represented. [signal:28eb9fdb-a900-43d3-9a60-04233f99f429] [signal:6817d2dc-fc4d-46fe-8443-77b779a81753]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these usability concerns are among European F70 owners. [signal:28eb9fdb-a900-43d3-9a60-04233f99f429] [signal:6817d2dc-fc4d-46fe-8443-77b779a81753]

value.title: G70 options are difficult to find and understand
value.summary: A US G70 customer says options are difficult to access and not grouped clearly, making the interface difficult to use.
highlights: Options are difficult to access and not clearly grouped.
The signal is from one US G70 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A US G70 customer says getting to the available options is difficult and that their grouping is not clear [signal:35deb393-1f9a-4b31-b8a9-1f15afdd8fa8].

## What customers say
The customer asks for a simpler interface [signal:35deb393-1f9a-4b31-b8a9-1f15afdd8fa8].

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from the USA, so there is no market comparison in the available evidence [signal:35deb393-1f9a-4b31-b8a9-1f15afdd8fa8].

## Open questions
Are options difficult to access or understand for other G70 customers or in other markets? The available signal does not answer this [signal:35deb393-1f9a-4b31-b8a9-1f15afdd8fa8].

value.title: Korean language pack unavailable in the USA
value.summary: A USA G70 customer wants the Korean language pack offered in Korea, but the vehicle’s listed language options are English, Spanish, French and Chinese.
highlights: The customer cannot access the Korean language pack they want.
One signal: a USA customer with a G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A USA G70 customer wants the Korean language pack offered in Korea, but the listed vehicle language options are English, Spanish, French and Chinese. [signal:3607cdc3-60d8-4475-b297-da542e4baa95]

## What customers say
The customer says they have sent several emails and have not heard back after being told someone would check with BMWNA about purchasing the Korean pack from Korea. [signal:3607cdc3-60d8-4475-b297-da542e4baa95]

## Differences between markets
The signal says the Korean language pack is offered in Korea, while the listed language options for this customer’s vehicle are English, Spanish, French and Chinese. [signal:3607cdc3-60d8-4475-b297-da542e4baa95]

## Open questions
The signal does not establish whether the Korean language pack can be purchased or enabled for this USA G70. [signal:3607cdc3-60d8-4475-b297-da542e4baa95]

value.title: Controls feel difficult to learn for some G70 customers
value.summary: Some USA G70 customers find the large-screen controls challenging to learn and ask for simpler operation. Other signals praise intuitive controls and easy-to-find features in the G60 and G70.
highlights: Some customers find the controls challenging to learn or operate.
Signals include USA G70 (3), USA G60 (1), and Europe G60 (1).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some USA G70 feedback describes learning the controls on the large screen as challenging and asks for controls that are simpler to understand and operate. [signal:cd83f9f5-957b-4eba-9cae-00e30118c33a] [signal:1d39f6c3-c484-4499-8e3c-d3a75d70ce08]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer appreciates intuitive menu access through dedicated buttons, which makes navigation easier without extensive searching. [signal:bcc4deac-36bb-4ced-b0a2-c28c748ed307]
A USA G60 customer says the features are simple to locate and the controls are intuitive. [signal:b63e5ef6-826a-4a27-a1b3-97c5160ac92d]
A Europe G60 customer says the controls and screens are positioned just right. [signal:679c5dd9-e1ad-47ea-a098-5b39c587b9d0]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals are mixed: G70 feedback includes difficulty learning the large-screen controls and a request for simpler operation, alongside appreciation for dedicated-button menu access. [signal:cd83f9f5-957b-4eba-9cae-00e30118c33a] [signal:1d39f6c3-c484-4499-8e3c-d3a75d70ce08] [signal:bcc4deac-36bb-4ced-b0a2-c28c748ed307] USA G60 feedback praises intuitive controls and easy-to-find features. [signal:b63e5ef6-826a-4a27-a1b3-97c5160ac92d] The Europe G60 signal also praises control and screen positioning. [signal:679c5dd9-e1ad-47ea-a098-5b39c587b9d0]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the difference in feedback is related to vehicle line, market, or individual experience. [signal:cd83f9f5-957b-4eba-9cae-00e30118c33a] [signal:679c5dd9-e1ad-47ea-a098-5b39c587b9d0] [signal:b63e5ef6-826a-4a27-a1b3-97c5160ac92d] [signal:bcc4deac-36bb-4ced-b0a2-c28c748ed307]

value.title: Touchscreen operation distracts drivers and is difficult to use
value.summary: USA customers in G60 and G70 vehicles say touchscreen controls can require repeated screen navigation and close visual attention, making operation while driving distracting or prone to unintended inputs. A G60 customer also wants larger, more distinct interface text because of poor eyesight.
highlights: Screen-based controls can distract drivers, require multiple taps, and lead to unintended inputs.
Signals are from five USA customers: three with G60 vehicles and two with G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe touchscreen operation as difficult or distracting while driving, including navigating several screens, looking closely at the display, and avoiding unintended actions. [signal:1d94de0d-c23f-4707-9e39-2cc6d6240a7c] [signal:578f537b-34c9-4590-bafa-bd231b2ec35e] [signal:a02ee251-afad-4e2d-a0b1-ad70edb9aa9f] [signal:c438c4ae-141b-4213-8811-78416afdab58]

## What customers say
A G60 driver said using the display while driving involved tapping through several screens and that sitting farther away sometimes led to pressing the wrong buttons. [signal:1d94de0d-c23f-4707-9e39-2cc6d6240a7c]

Other customers objected to replacing physical buttons with touchscreens or depending on the screen for settings, saying this made them take their eyes off the road. [signal:578f537b-34c9-4590-bafa-bd231b2ec35e] [signal:a02ee251-afad-4e2d-a0b1-ad70edb9aa9f]

A G70 driver described the display as distracting and said close attention was needed to avoid triggering unintended actions. [signal:c438c4ae-141b-4213-8811-78416afdab58]

A G60 customer with poor eyesight wanted interface text that was larger and more distinct. [signal:8dc56b91-dd3e-4b06-91f1-d43b3aa0de5e]

## Differences between markets
All five signals are from the USA, so the signals do not provide a comparison across markets. [signal:1d94de0d-c23f-4707-9e39-2cc6d6240a7c] [signal:578f537b-34c9-4590-bafa-bd231b2ec35e] [signal:a02ee251-afad-4e2d-a0b1-ad70edb9aa9f] [signal:c438c4ae-141b-4213-8811-78416afdab58] [signal:8dc56b91-dd3e-4b06-91f1-d43b3aa0de5e]

## Open questions
Do these usability concerns vary by setting or task, beyond the reported examples of navigating screens and adjusting settings? [signal:1d94de0d-c23f-4707-9e39-2cc6d6240a7c] [signal:a02ee251-afad-4e2d-a0b1-ad70edb9aa9f]

How common are the reported concerns among G60 and G70 customers beyond these five signals? [signal:1d94de0d-c23f-4707-9e39-2cc6d6240a7c] [signal:578f537b-34c9-4590-bafa-bd231b2ec35e] [signal:a02ee251-afad-4e2d-a0b1-ad70edb9aa9f] [signal:c438c4ae-141b-4213-8811-78416afdab58] [signal:8dc56b91-dd3e-4b06-91f1-d43b3aa0de5e]

value.title: iDrive features take too many menu steps to access

highlights: Accessing iDrive features requires digging through multiple menu layers.
One signal: a G70 owner in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.

## Problem
A G70 owner says accessing iDrive features means digging through multiple layers of menus. [signal:3a1c42df-f4f6-40b2-a61f-dc7b6d74402d]

The owner praises the car’s comfort and driving experience, but says they wish they had received more guidance on its features and found access to them less layered. [signal:3a1c42df-f4f6-40b2-a61f-dc7b6d74402d]

value.title: Dashboard controls demand too much attention while driving
value.summary: A driver of a European F70 says the electronic dashboard is too complex to adjust safely while moving, so adjustments are made by a passenger or after pulling over.
highlights: Dashboard adjustments are described as too complex and distracting to make safely while moving.
The signal comes from one European F70 owner, who reports around 3,800 miles of use.
The owner says the system is more complex than an iPhone.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A European F70 owner says changing settings hidden in the electronic dashboard takes their eyes off the road for too long and feels too dangerous while driving. [signal:365dad93-857c-4829-aea7-bf87b439beed]

## What customers say
The owner says that when travelling together, their wife makes adjustments; when alone, they pull over to do so. [signal:365dad93-857c-4829-aea7-bf87b439beed] They describe the system as many times more complex than an iPhone. [signal:365dad93-857c-4829-aea7-bf87b439beed]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from Europe, so it does not establish how experiences differ across markets. [signal:365dad93-857c-4829-aea7-bf87b439beed]

## Open questions
The signal does not specify which dashboard adjustments are difficult or whether other F70 drivers share this experience. [signal:365dad93-857c-4829-aea7-bf87b439beed]

value.title: Trip data and reset controls are difficult to find
value.summary: Some G70 and G60 customers in the USA had difficulty finding or using trip data and reset controls. One G70 customer also found some vehicle settings options missing until an iDrive reset restored them.
highlights: Customers had trouble finding trip data and resetting the trip odometer.
Three USA signals cover G70 (two) and G60 (one).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers described difficulty accessing trip data, consumption details, and trip odometer reset controls. [signal:7a8ea68b-bbd3-43fd-9dd9-f66a3502b94b] [signal:d18c00a3-b9e7-445f-ad26-ac95c636915e] One G70 customer also found some vehicle settings options missing; an iDrive reset brought the selections back. [signal:292daa97-a782-4d7f-9cdf-52809648aab6]

## What customers say
A G70 customer wanted to view the most recent trip alongside the odometer. [signal:292daa97-a782-4d7f-9cdf-52809648aab6] Another G70 customer asked how to reset the trip odometer and said the explanation was helpful. [signal:7a8ea68b-bbd3-43fd-9dd9-f66a3502b94b] A G60 customer was unsure how to access trip data and consumption details for a longer period, and confirmed the explanation identified the information sought. [signal:d18c00a3-b9e7-445f-ad26-ac95c636915e]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA: two concern G70 vehicles and one concerns a G60. [signal:292daa97-a782-4d7f-9cdf-52809648aab6] [signal:7a8ea68b-bbd3-43fd-9dd9-f66a3502b94b] [signal:d18c00a3-b9e7-445f-ad26-ac95c636915e] The signals provide no comparison between markets. [signal:292daa97-a782-4d7f-9cdf-52809648aab6] [signal:7a8ea68b-bbd3-43fd-9dd9-f66a3502b94b] [signal:d18c00a3-b9e7-445f-ad26-ac95c636915e]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often customers encounter these difficulties beyond the three reported cases. [signal:292daa97-a782-4d7f-9cdf-52809648aab6] [signal:7a8ea68b-bbd3-43fd-9dd9-f66a3502b94b] [signal:d18c00a3-b9e7-445f-ad26-ac95c636915e]

value.title: User interface feels underdeveloped or hard to navigate
value.summary: Some F70 and G60 customers find the interface underdeveloped or not straightforward, while another F70 customer values the setup. The signals come from Rest of World and the USA.
highlights: Interface usability feedback ranges from difficult to use to strongly positive.
Rest of World: 3 signals on F70; USA: 1 complaint on G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the interface as underdeveloped or say it should be more straightforward. [signal:44de4e96-d5e0-46b7-82a6-cca9410e564f] [signal:ebb5d712-9a4d-4364-b443-41d0e9796328]
One F70 customer says the interface does not give them a smartphone feeling. [signal:38b7ab4c-198d-4ef4-a173-20b9bbd68923]

## What customers say
An F70 customer says the interface setup is spot on, in contrast to the usability concerns in other signals. [signal:fd80a160-fad4-4c02-b38c-65ab7c0c8410] [signal:44de4e96-d5e0-46b7-82a6-cca9410e564f] [signal:ebb5d712-9a4d-4364-b443-41d0e9796328]

## Differences between markets
Rest of World has three F70 signals: two express unmet expectations or usability concerns, and one praises the interface setup. [signal:44de4e96-d5e0-46b7-82a6-cca9410e564f] [signal:38b7ab4c-198d-4ef4-a173-20b9bbd68923] [signal:fd80a160-fad4-4c02-b38c-65ab7c0c8410]
The USA has one G60 complaint that the interface should be more straightforward. [signal:ebb5d712-9a4d-4364-b443-41d0e9796328]

## Open questions
Do these differing experiences reflect differences between the F70 and G60, or variation among customers? [signal:44de4e96-d5e0-46b7-82a6-cca9410e564f] [signal:ebb5d712-9a4d-4364-b443-41d0e9796328] [signal:38b7ab4c-198d-4ef4-a173-20b9bbd68923] [signal:fd80a160-fad4-4c02-b38c-65ab7c0c8410]

value.title: Home screen widgets offer limited choice and visibility
value.summary: Some USA G60 customers want more choice in home-screen widgets and the ability to see more of them at once.
highlights: Customers want more widget choices, customization, and simultaneous visibility.
Signals come from two USA G60 customer comments.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe limited widget choices on the home screen and want to decide what appears there. [signal:3a4ec1db-7c1d-42c0-a98f-532525cb02eb] One customer wants more widgets visible simultaneously, even after confirming they knew they could scroll through them. [signal:987f9718-1aec-4d80-af9c-bbef34b993c9]

## What customers say
One customer would like to edit the available widgets and choose what is shown on the home screen. [signal:3a4ec1db-7c1d-42c0-a98f-532525cb02eb] Another wants additional widget functionality, including performance metrics, and more widgets visible in home mode. [signal:987f9718-1aec-4d80-af9c-bbef34b993c9]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA and concern the G60; the signals do not provide a market comparison. [signal:3a4ec1db-7c1d-42c0-a98f-532525cb02eb] [signal:987f9718-1aec-4d80-af9c-bbef34b993c9]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether customers primarily want more widget options, more control over selection, or more widgets visible at once. [signal:3a4ec1db-7c1d-42c0-a98f-532525cb02eb] [signal:987f9718-1aec-4d80-af9c-bbef34b993c9]

value.title: iDrive 9 feels bloated and unsafe to use while driving
value.summary: A Europe-based F70 driver describes iDrive 9 as bloated, difficult to use while driving, and lacking a useful customizable home screen. They say adjusting the fan by voice feels undesirable and that the system affects their willingness to buy another BMW.
highlights: iDrive 9 is described as bloated and unsafe to use while driving.
The complaint is from one Europe-based F70 driver.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A Europe-based F70 driver says iDrive 9 feels bloated, is difficult to use while driving, and has a home screen they cannot make useful to them. [signal:3d2eb406-dec7-410a-b476-fee9697325c4]

## What customers say
The driver says using the system while driving feels unsafe and does not want to use voice conversation to adjust the fan. [signal:3d2eb406-dec7-410a-b476-fee9697325c4] They say the system diminishes their enjoyment of driving and could prevent them from buying another BMW. [signal:3d2eb406-dec7-410a-b476-fee9697325c4]

## Differences between markets
The only signal is from Europe, so there is no cross-market comparison. [signal:3d2eb406-dec7-410a-b476-fee9697325c4]

## Open questions
The signal does not establish whether these concerns are shared by other F70 drivers or customers in other markets. [signal:3d2eb406-dec7-410a-b476-fee9697325c4]

value.title: Heating controls and settings feel clumsy and distracting
value.summary: Some Europe-based F70 customers find basic heating adjustments difficult and distracting with few physical controls; one also reports settings reverting after a software update.
highlights: Basic heating adjustments feel clumsy or distracting, and settings reportedly reverted after an update.
Two signals from Europe, both concerning the F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 customers describe adjusting heating functions through the operating concept as not straightforward or distracting. [signal:3850772c-0a4a-4d2c-b683-98a96e5222a3] [signal:86721e19-9b4f-4696-94bd-2db037b4b3af] One customer also says settings reverted to factory defaults after a software update. [signal:86721e19-9b4f-4696-94bd-2db037b4b3af]

## What customers say
One customer says there are hardly any physical heating switches or knobs and that changing settings while moving is not straightforward, though they expect it may feel more natural with use. [signal:3850772c-0a4a-4d2c-b683-98a96e5222a3] Another describes the apps setup as clumsy for simple adjustments such as seat or steering-wheel heating, and says a settings reset changed the instrument brightness. [signal:86721e19-9b4f-4696-94bd-2db037b4b3af]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from Europe and concern the F70; there are no signals from other markets to compare. [signal:3850772c-0a4a-4d2c-b683-98a96e5222a3] [signal:86721e19-9b4f-4696-94bd-2db037b4b3af]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported difficulty changes with experience, how often settings revert after updates, or whether these issues occur beyond the two reported cases. [signal:3850772c-0a4a-4d2c-b683-98a96e5222a3] [signal:86721e19-9b4f-4696-94bd-2db037b4b3af]

value.title: Operating menus are difficult to navigate
value.summary: Customers report that the operating menus are difficult to navigate, with too many icons, paths, or menus. The signals are from US G70 and G60 customers.
highlights: Menus feel difficult to navigate, crowded, and complicated.
Three US signals cover the G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the operating menus as difficult to navigate, with items that seem buried and menus spread across the screen. [signal:47887ed4-b2bd-43e9-82e7-779203b47621] [signal:d7d76b2a-e9dd-41d1-8c87-f4e973ff8719]

## What customers say
One G70 customer reports too many icons and multiple menu paths leading to the same option. [signal:50df9f67-4872-472a-aaf9-2b4584b5a1fd]
Another G70 customer says frequently used menus are hard to find. [signal:47887ed4-b2bd-43e9-82e7-779203b47621]
A G60 customer says the menus are more complicated than expected. [signal:d7d76b2a-e9dd-41d1-8c87-f4e973ff8719]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA, so they do not show differences between markets. [signal:47887ed4-b2bd-43e9-82e7-779203b47621] [signal:50df9f67-4872-472a-aaf9-2b4584b5a1fd] [signal:d7d76b2a-e9dd-41d1-8c87-f4e973ff8719]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these experiences are beyond the reported G70 and G60 cases. [signal:47887ed4-b2bd-43e9-82e7-779203b47621] [signal:50df9f67-4872-472a-aaf9-2b4584b5a1fd] [signal:d7d76b2a-e9dd-41d1-8c87-f4e973ff8719]

value.title: Too many menus make vehicle controls hard to use
value.summary: Customers report that menus and settings are difficult to navigate, and that important controls or information can be hard to find. The signals cover F70, G60 and G70 drivers across Europe, Rest of World and the USA.
highlights: Menus, settings and controls are described as difficult to navigate or find.
Five complaints: Europe (2), Rest of World (1) and USA (2); F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe complicated submenus, too many settings and awkward menus in the F70 [signal:34f0e8f8-1124-483b-bb3b-cafdeabcff4a] [signal:a5ea88fe-8f34-475b-a252-9f4ae7078012]. A Rest of World customer says the advanced technology is hard to grasp [signal:7f82a3cb-6f7b-49a6-a4c9-1ede5217bece]. USA customers report excessive menu navigation and difficulty locating basic information or controls [signal:bd3b4597-619e-4ea7-b87b-4f9f01f50ca7] [signal:d0de81d5-860c-4092-920e-ce80c0fadd3f].

## What customers say
An F70 owner misses the shortcut buttons on earlier models [signal:34f0e8f8-1124-483b-bb3b-cafdeabcff4a]. Another F70 owner says the speedometer and rev counter are hard to read, while the digital speed readout is easy to see [signal:a5ea88fe-8f34-475b-a252-9f4ae7078012]. A G60 owner says the cluster and infotainment display irrelevant information while basic details require searching [signal:bd3b4597-619e-4ea7-b87b-4f9f01f50ca7]. A G70 owner says controls such as seat adjustment are buried in the central monitor and are hard to operate without looking away from the road [signal:d0de81d5-860c-4092-920e-ce80c0fadd3f].

## Differences between markets
The Europe signals concern F70 menu complexity and instrument readability [signal:34f0e8f8-1124-483b-bb3b-cafdeabcff4a] [signal:a5ea88fe-8f34-475b-a252-9f4ae7078012]. The Rest of World F70 customer finds the advanced operation hard to grasp but expects to get used to it [signal:7f82a3cb-6f7b-49a6-a4c9-1ede5217bece]. The two USA signals describe menu overload and controls or information that are difficult to access in G60 and G70 vehicles [signal:bd3b4597-619e-4ea7-b87b-4f9f01f50ca7] [signal:d0de81d5-860c-4092-920e-ce80c0fadd3f].

## Open questions
Do menu and control concerns differ between the F70, G60 and G70? [signal:34f0e8f8-1124-483b-bb3b-cafdeabcff4a] [signal:7f82a3cb-6f7b-49a6-a4c9-1ede5217bece] [signal:a5ea88fe-8f34-475b-a252-9f4ae7078012] [signal:bd3b4597-619e-4ea7-b87b-4f9f01f50ca7] [signal:d0de81d5-860c-4092-920e-ce80c0fadd3f] Are the concerns concentrated in particular tasks, such as finding basic information or adjusting seats? [signal:bd3b4597-619e-4ea7-b87b-4f9f01f50ca7] [signal:d0de81d5-860c-4092-920e-ce80c0fadd3f]

value.body_md:
## Problem

value.title: Digital settings are difficult to find and change
value.summary: F70 drivers in Europe and the Rest of the World find digital settings difficult to navigate, with functions buried in menus or apps. Some drivers are unsure how to configure specific radio features.
highlights: Finding and changing digital settings can require menu scrolling or navigating apps.
All four signals concern F70 drivers: two in Europe and two in the Rest of the World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
F70 drivers report that changing digital settings is difficult, with settings requiring menu scrolling or figuring out which app to open. [signal:3e48dd84-2f21-4189-af44-e51e3386b645] [signal:ec5f86fa-93a8-4ee9-b628-280f564fd575]

## What customers say
One Europe-based driver says reaching settings involves extensive menu scrolling and finds the handbook unclear. [signal:3e48dd84-2f21-4189-af44-e51e3386b645]
Drivers in the Rest of the World describe individual settings as tricky; one is unsure whether the radio can show the station name or automatically play traffic reports. [signal:744c3f3c-878a-401e-855c-a7741e2a4028] [signal:b3b5e546-3f18-42ba-a95e-90427636c4a8]
A Europe-based driver says removing the individual button makes settings harder to change because they must work out which app to open. [signal:ec5f86fa-93a8-4ee9-b628-280f564fd575]

## Differences between markets
Drivers in both Europe and the Rest of the World report difficulty with settings. [signal:3e48dd84-2f21-4189-af44-e51e3386b645] [signal:744c3f3c-878a-401e-855c-a7741e2a4028] [signal:b3b5e546-3f18-42ba-a95e-90427636c4a8] [signal:ec5f86fa-93a8-4ee9-b628-280f564fd575]
The Europe signals mention menu scrolling, an unclear handbook, and finding the right app; the Rest of the World signals mention difficulty with individual settings and uncertainty about radio features. [signal:3e48dd84-2f21-4189-af44-e51e3386b645] [signal:ec5f86fa-93a8-4ee9-b628-280f564fd575] [signal:744c3f3c-878a-401e-855c-a7741e2a4028] [signal:b3b5e546-3f18-42ba-a95e-90427636c4a8]

## Open questions
Can the radio display the station name, and can traffic reports be set to play automatically? [signal:b3b5e546-3f18-42ba-a95e-90427636c4a8]
The signals do not establish which settings or apps are hardest to find for drivers beyond the examples given. [signal:3e48dd84-2f21-4189-af44-e51e3386b645] [signal:744c3f3c-878a-401e-855c-a7741e2a4028] [signal:b3b5e546-3f18-42ba-a95e-90427636c4a8] [signal:ec5f86fa-93a8-4ee9-b628-280f564fd575]

value.title: BMW controls feel less intuitive than older alternatives
value.summary: A US G60 owner finds the car less intuitive than their previous BMW and misses some features. A European F70 owner finds the older MINI Countryman’s controls simpler to use.
highlights: BMW operating controls feel less intuitive, and some previously enjoyed features are missing.
Two complaint signals: one from a US G60 owner and one from a European F70 owner.
A European owner finds the MINI Countryman’s older-style dials and controls simpler.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A US G60 owner says the car feels less intuitive than their previous BMW and that some features they enjoyed are no longer there. [signal:491ec7f9-cb88-4205-8613-b2fb55eae3e6]
A European F70 owner says the older-style dials and controls in their MINI Countryman are simpler to use. [signal:b606488d-b630-4d02-a77c-19a67a65600d]

## What customers say
The US owner is unsure whether the usability change is specific to the G60 or reflects broader changes at BMW, and says they have not yet had a Genius appointment. [signal:491ec7f9-cb88-4205-8613-b2fb55eae3e6]
The European owner says the Countryman’s controls give a driver everything they need. [signal:b606488d-b630-4d02-a77c-19a67a65600d]

## Differences between markets
The US signal concerns a perceived change from an older BMW and missing features; the European signal compares the F70 with a MINI Countryman and favors the MINI’s control simplicity. [signal:491ec7f9-cb88-4205-8613-b2fb55eae3e6] [signal:b606488d-b630-4d02-a77c-19a67a65600d]

## Open questions
The US owner is unsure whether the experience is specific to the G60 or reflects broader BMW changes, and has not yet attended a Genius appointment. [signal:491ec7f9-cb88-4205-8613-b2fb55eae3e6]
The signals do not establish whether the two owners are reacting to the same usability issue. [signal:491ec7f9-cb88-4205-8613-b2fb55eae3e6] [signal:b606488d-b630-4d02-a77c-19a67a65600d]

value.title: Too few physical controls for commonly used features
value.summary: Some BMW customers prefer physical buttons and switches for frequently used features, saying they make operation quicker and reduce distraction. The signals include customers in the USA and Europe.
highlights: Customers want more physical controls, including programmable buttons for presets and quick menu access.
Signals include six USA G60 customers and one Europe F70 customer.
One customer cites Cadillac as an example of a vehicle with more physical buttons.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say the limited number of physical buttons makes commonly used features less convenient to operate. [signal:8107619b-158b-4239-9814-6399f402cee8] [signal:4e7f3ef9-c20a-4099-99db-ff37cef7469e]

## What customers say
Customers ask for more physical controls, describing them as easier to use and less distracting while driving. [signal:4e7f3ef9-c20a-4099-99db-ff37cef7469e] Others specifically miss programmable memory buttons for radio presets and quick access to menus. [signal:806428fd-ac8e-4bbc-9cdf-a5ad2be2c4d7] [signal:92050897-f9c6-4a58-8618-d8202309bd27]

One customer prefers a mix of analog and digital controls, while another points to Cadillac as an example of a vehicle with more physical buttons. [signal:800f376d-6841-4ea1-b02f-a6b3ddee7679] [signal:7205b71c-7c2e-4695-b80c-00c378b57618]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include six USA customers with G60 vehicles and one Europe customer with an F70 vehicle expressing a preference for more physical buttons. [signal:8107619b-158b-4239-9814-6399f402cee8] [signal:4e7f3ef9-c20a-4099-99db-ff37cef7469e] [signal:7205b71c-7c2e-4695-b80c-00c378b57618] [signal:800f376d-6841-4ea1-b02f-a6b3ddee7679] [signal:806428fd-ac8e-4bbc-9cdf-a5ad2be2c4d7] [signal:92050897-f9c6-4a58-8618-d8202309bd27] [signal:54be89b1-d09b-4008-a050-40ef1f6a5aa9]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish which commonly used features customers most want to operate with physical controls beyond radio presets and menu access. [signal:806428fd-ac8e-4bbc-9cdf-a5ad2be2c4d7] [signal:92050897-f9c6-4a58-8618-d8202309bd27]

value.title: G70 technology takes repeated sessions to learn

highlights: Learning the software and new technology can require repeated help.
Two signals concern USA G70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some G70 customers report difficulty learning parts of the software and say the amount of new technology takes repeated sessions to understand. [signal:557304b3-1033-433e-9053-7fe8daa520e2] [signal:cd2153be-545e-4caa-b6e6-e42970126c78]

## What customers say
One customer needed help from a local Genius to learn parts of the software; the note also says the corporate Genius team can help. [signal:557304b3-1033-433e-9053-7fe8daa520e2]
Another customer said they needed several Genius visits, more than one or two sessions, to learn the new technology. [signal:cd2153be-545e-4caa-b6e6-e42970126c78] That customer also praised the technology and said voice commands worked very well. [signal:cd2153be-545e-4caa-b6e6-e42970126c78]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA and concern the G70; these signals do not show market differences. [signal:557304b3-1033-433e-9053-7fe8daa520e2] [signal:cd2153be-545e-4caa-b6e6-e42970126c78]

## Open questions
Do customers beyond these two signals also need repeated help learning the G70 technology? [signal:557304b3-1033-433e-9053-7fe8daa520e2] [signal:cd2153be-545e-4caa-b6e6-e42970126c78]
Which parts of the software or technology take the most effort to learn? [signal:557304b3-1033-433e-9053-7fe8daa520e2] [signal:cd2153be-545e-4caa-b6e6-e42970126c78]

value.body_md:
## Problem
A G70 customer wants to move and group BMW apps, while a G60 customer asks about app visibility and adding shortcuts after a software update changed the screen layout. [signal:92f707f0-dac0-48d8-9184-3b960b201863] [signal:b2303ee6-b15e-49fa-808d-ea4e83548c36]

## What customers say
The G70 customer wants to rearrange and organize apps into groups. [signal:92f707f0-dac0-48d8-9184-3b960b201863]
The G60 customer said the radio station had appeared on the left side of the screen before a software update, but afterward that area showed an image of the car; the customer asked about seeing apps in the center and adding shortcuts. [signal:b2303ee6-b15e-49fa-808d-ea4e83548c36]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA, but concern different vehicle lines: G70 and G60. [signal:92f707f0-dac0-48d8-9184-3b960b201863] [signal:b2303ee6-b15e-49fa-808d-ea4e83548c36]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether app grouping or adding shortcuts is available, or how consistently customers encounter these usability issues. [signal:92f707f0-dac0-48d8-9184-3b960b201863] [signal:b2303ee6-b15e-49fa-808d-ea4e83548c36]

value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals describe usability as a valued aspect of the operating concept: customers call the controls and technology straightforward, intuitive or simple to use. [signal:5cfe5a02-7fc3-4069-9f81-433255760432] [signal:63e6f0c5-b9a5-47ed-8a23-1d1c72f401fc] [signal:9bbe0e01-0fe4-4452-b17b-9368903d16f9] [signal:c41be2e6-bcbf-4eb8-8a88-005d506d9498] [signal:d405e623-53ce-4c04-a2e1-33558dc5164b]

## What customers say
A G60 owner describes the technology and iDrive as straightforward, intuitive and simple to operate. [signal:5cfe5a02-7fc3-4069-9f81-433255760432]
F70 owners praise straightforward controls, clearly visible controls and a media system that is simple to use. [signal:63e6f0c5-b9a5-47ed-8a23-1d1c72f401fc] [signal:9bbe0e01-0fe4-4452-b17b-9368903d16f9] [signal:c41be2e6-bcbf-4eb8-8a88-005d506d9498]
Another G60 owner says the technology is easy to use. [signal:d405e623-53ce-4c04-a2e1-33558dc5164b]

## Differences between markets
The feedback is positive in both markets: three Europe signals from F70 owners praise ease of use, while two USA signals from G60 owners do so. [signal:63e6f0c5-b9a5-47ed-8a23-1d1c72f401fc] [signal:9bbe0e01-0fe4-4452-b17b-9368903d16f9] [signal:c41be2e6-bcbf-4eb8-8a88-005d506d9498] [signal:5cfe5a02-7fc3-4069-9f81-433255760432] [signal:d405e623-53ce-4c04-a2e1-33558dc5164b]

## Open questions
The signals do not identify specific usability difficulties or compare the operating concept with competitors. [signal:5cfe5a02-7fc3-4069-9f81-433255760432] [signal:63e6f0c5-b9a5-47ed-8a23-1d1c72f401fc] [signal:9bbe0e01-0fe4-4452-b17b-9368903d16f9] [signal:c41be2e6-bcbf-4eb8-8a88-005d506d9498] [signal:d405e623-53ce-4c04-a2e1-33558dc5164b]

value.title: F70 controls and software feel overly complex
value.summary: F70 owners in Europe and Rest of World describe the operating system, controls, apps, or drive modes as difficult and distracting to use. Some say the complexity affects driving confidence or willingness to drive or buy the car again.
highlights: Owners describe the controls and software as complex, awkward, and distracting.
All five signals concern the F70: three from Europe and two from Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
F70 owners describe the screen computer, control panel, controls, apps, or drive modes as overly complex or difficult to use. [signal:4111d284-2a9d-47c2-bc1e-8334bb1af144] [signal:59a6de0d-e58e-44f4-ab5e-0473c74c4648] [signal:89593a95-8aa9-4fd5-b0c7-4a2bc9c24cfe] [signal:93d72e49-a976-4282-a33b-c9b02ed48ab7] [signal:ae05a5ff-4b3f-4b32-8915-131dc04ae017] Some say the controls distract them or feel difficult to operate while driving. [signal:59a6de0d-e58e-44f4-ab5e-0473c74c4648] [signal:89593a95-8aa9-4fd5-b0c7-4a2bc9c24cfe] [signal:ae05a5ff-4b3f-4b32-8915-131dc04ae017]

## What customers say
One Rest of World owner says the software feels unfinished and reports having to deal with the complicated system on every drive; they also say sales staff do not understand the software well enough to answer all their questions. [signal:4111d284-2a9d-47c2-bc1e-8334bb1af144] A Europe owner says unnecessary features can distract while driving. [signal:59a6de0d-e58e-44f4-ab5e-0473c74c4648] Another Rest of World owner calls the control panel awkward and dangerous to operate while driving. [signal:89593a95-8aa9-4fd5-b0c7-4a2bc9c24cfe] One Europe owner says the complexity puts them beyond their comfort level, their wife refuses to drive the car, and they do not plan to buy another BMW. [signal:93d72e49-a976-4282-a33b-c9b02ed48ab7] Another Europe owner says apps and drive modes are difficult and distracting to use while driving, and that they have to stop to deal with them. [signal:ae05a5ff-4b3f-4b32-8915-131dc04ae017]

## Differences between markets
The signals include three complaints from Europe and two from Rest of World, all concerning the F70. [signal:59a6de0d-e58e-44f4-ab5e-0473c74c4648] [signal:93d72e49-a976-4282-a33b-c9b02ed48ab7] [signal:ae05a5ff-4b3f-4b32-8915-131dc04ae017] [signal:4111d284-2a9d-47c2-bc1e-8334bb1af144] [signal:89593a95-8aa9-4fd5-b0c7-4a2bc9c24cfe] Both markets have reports of difficult or distracting operation while driving. [signal:59a6de0d-e58e-44f4-ab5e-0473c74c4648] [signal:89593a95-8aa9-4fd5-b0c7-4a2bc9c24cfe] [signal:ae05a5ff-4b3f-4b32-8915-131dc04ae017] The Europe signals also mention a refusal to drive and reduced intent to buy another BMW; the Rest of World signals mention limited software knowledge among sales staff. [signal:93d72e49-a976-4282-a33b-c9b02ed48ab7] [signal:4111d284-2a9d-47c2-bc1e-8334bb1af144]

## Open questions
Do owners experience the same usability issues across different operating-system functions, or are the complaints specific to controls, apps, drive modes, or the screen computer? value.title: Operating concept feels overwhelming or hard to navigate
value.summary: Some customers find the technology, settings, apps, or controls difficult to use, while others describe it as intuitive or straightforward once familiar. Signals come from USA G70 and G60 customers and a Europe F70 customer.
highlights: Some customers find the technology overwhelming, settings unclear, or controls difficult to navigate.
Signals cover USA G70 and G60 customers and a Europe F70 customer; usability feedback is mixed.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say the technology is difficult to use because there are many settings, apps take getting used to, or controls and functions are hard to locate. [signal:7e99dfc4-910f-4b59-8c6e-b2696ac1ebd1] [signal:806f0e9d-0278-4c48-893d-4986d86d8963] [signal:dc312caa-899e-4b3d-b3ad-d7496780a11e]

## What customers say
A G70 customer describes the technology as overwhelming and reports repeatedly resetting settings, lighting changing unexpectedly, and difficulty selecting radio stations and finding driving-assistance functions. [signal:dc312caa-899e-4b3d-b3ad-d7496780a11e]

A G60 customer says the number of settings makes use less straightforward, while also saying they are happy with the software. [signal:806f0e9d-0278-4c48-893d-4986d86d8963] [signal:c3dd6541-3070-45a9-8d02-3eda56dd0ca7]

Other customers describe the technology as intuitive or straightforward after becoming familiar with it; one G70 customer says they rarely need to interact with it once their settings are configured. [signal:61ce0da6-5d15-4fe4-a630-fb758884e076] [signal:6dc31945-3816-4ee0-b27c-316c6d3f3a00]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include both difficulty reports and positive usability feedback, across G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:7e99dfc4-910f-4b59-8c6e-b2696ac1ebd1] [signal:806f0e9d-0278-4c48-893d-4986d86d8963] [signal:dc312caa-899e-4b3d-b3ad-d7496780a11e] [signal:6dc31945-3816-4ee0-b27c-316c6d3f3a00] [signal:c3dd6541-3070-45a9-8d02-3eda56dd0ca7]

The Europe signal is positive, describing the new technology as straightforward once familiar. [signal:61ce0da6-5d15-4fe4-a630-fb758884e076]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether usability concerns persist after customers become familiar with the system, or how consistently the reported control and settings issues occur. [signal:7e99dfc4-910f-4b59-8c6e-b2696ac1ebd1] [signal:dc312caa-899e-4b3d-b3ad-d7496780a11e] [signal:61ce0da6-5d15-4fe4-a630-fb758884e076]

value.title: Infotainment controls are complex and functions hard to find
value.summary: Customers report that infotainment settings and functions are difficult to learn or find, with one European customer also describing distracting alerts and settings that reset. Signals cover G60, F70 and G70 vehicles in the USA and Europe.
highlights: Infotainment complexity makes settings and functions difficult to learn or find.
Five signals: three USA and two Europe; vehicles are G60, F70 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe infotainment functions as difficult to learn or find, including controls that require learning and functions buried in multiple menus. [signal:75b7926e-b513-4f80-a9e5-f0c76eb4ac98] [signal:950a2599-604d-462b-a914-ea25e5e86a73] [signal:e405b1b2-dd5b-430c-aa4b-8ad33b123805]

One European customer says settings revert to defaults after stopping, and that messages and sounds are distracting. [signal:863b1f06-d09d-4b3f-884c-3942428d0661]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer says there are many settings and controls and that learning every function takes time. [signal:75b7926e-b513-4f80-a9e5-f0c76eb4ac98]

Another USA G60 customer describes the infotainment as good overall but complex, with things tough to find. [signal:950a2599-604d-462b-a914-ea25e5e86a73]

A Europe G60 customer reports too many submenus. [signal:9da69320-8dd5-4ecf-aefd-144d663c46c1]

A USA G70 customer says many functions are buried under multiple screen menus and describes the dashboard layout and crystal-style controls as distracting. [signal:e405b1b2-dd5b-430c-aa4b-8ad33b123805]

## Differences between markets
Signals from both the USA and Europe report infotainment usability concerns. [signal:75b7926e-b513-4f80-a9e5-f0c76eb4ac98] [signal:950a2599-604d-462b-a914-ea25e5e86a73] [signal:9da69320-8dd5-4ecf-aefd-144d663c46c1] [signal:863b1f06-d09d-4b3f-884c-3942428d0661] The USA signals mention learning controls, finding functions and buried menus; the Europe signals mention submenus, settings reverting, and distracting messages and sounds. [signal:75b7926e-b513-4f80-a9e5-f0c76eb4ac98] [signal:950a2599-604d-462b-a914-ea25e5e86a73] [signal:e405b1b2-dd5b-430c-aa4b-8ad33b123805] [signal:9da69320-8dd5-4ecf-aefd-144d663c46c1] [signal:863b1f06-d09d-4b3f-884c-3942428d0661]

## Open questions
Do the reported difficulties vary by vehicle line or infotainment configuration? [signal:75b7926e-b513-4f80-a9e5-f0c76eb4ac98] [signal:863b1f06-d09d-4b3f-884c-3942428d0661] [signal:9da69320-8dd5-4ecf-aefd-144d663c46c1] [signal:e405b1b2-dd5b-430c-aa4b-8ad33b123805]

How often do settings revert and alerts distract customers?

value.title: New controls and touch interfaces are harder to use
value.summary: Some owners find the newer controls and digital touch interfaces harder to use than the controls in earlier BMWs, while one owner is still getting used to the changes. The signals come from USA G70 and G60 owners and Europe F70 owners, including older drivers.
highlights: Some owners find changed controls and digital touch interfaces difficult or less safe to use.
Signals: USA G70 and G60; Europe F70 (two owners), including older drivers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners say the controls in newer BMWs are harder to use than the controls they had in earlier models. [signal:8b081cbb-2d2f-4b64-b1cb-b56c78a68cd2] [signal:a76d0856-b914-42d1-9870-bbd9b26df99d] One G60 owner considers the lack of old-style knobs and dials a serious safety risk for anyone except the very youngest drivers. [signal:9c4a63dc-f1a6-461d-9247-11d176371095]

## What customers say
A G70 owner says they are still getting used to controls that differ from those in earlier 7 Series models. [signal:8b081cbb-2d2f-4b64-b1cb-b56c78a68cd2] An F70 owner prefers the earlier dashboard wheel for controlling functions and is not keen on an all-digital, touch-based interface. [signal:a76d0856-b914-42d1-9870-bbd9b26df99d] Two F70 owners compare the newer technology unfavourably with the controls they were used to; one explicitly identifies as an older driver. [signal:a76d0856-b914-42d1-9870-bbd9b26df99d] [signal:fd09c672-4be9-4a6f-aaa5-879e32449c47]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include a G70 owner adapting to changed controls and a G60 owner concerned about the absence of knobs and dials. [signal:8b081cbb-2d2f-4b64-b1cb-b56c78a68cd2] [signal:9c4a63dc-f1a6-461d-9247-11d176371095] Both Europe signals concern the F70 and express a preference for familiar earlier controls. [signal:a76d0856-b914-42d1-9870-bbd9b26df99d] [signal:fd09c672-4be9-4a6f-aaa5-879e32449c47]

## Open questions
Do other drivers experience the newer controls as difficult, or is this concern concentrated among people accustomed to earlier BMW controls? [signal:8b081cbb-2d2f-4b64-b1cb-b56c78a68cd2] [signal:fd09c672-4be9-4a6f-aaa5-879e32449c47] How often do drivers share the G60 owner's concern that fewer physical controls create a safety risk? [signal:9c4a63dc-f1a6-461d-9247-11d176371095]

value.body_md:
## Problem
A G70 customer says valet parking requires activating the service card and then using the valet setting, rather than handling both together in one step. [signal:e816b334-ea26-499a-9124-6a8073666a86] A G60 customer asked what valet mode is used for. [signal:f5ec621f-5269-464e-a455-9d6f0161539d]

The G70 customer says the two-step process is difficult and reports that the valet information described key-based valet mode as locking the trunk and glove box. [signal:e816b334-ea26-499a-9124-6a8073666a86] A G60 customer says he would prefer a separate valet key and does not want to remove it from the key fob; he is aware valet can be turned on in the software. [signal:bf642256-d4da-4b2a-aeee-9e2be49a6253] Another G60 signal records a question about the purpose of valet mode and an explanation that it can prevent access to the driver profile or trunk. [signal:f5ec621f-5269-464e-a455-9d6f0161539d]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA, covering the G70 and G60. [signal:e816b334-ea26-499a-9124-6a8073666a86] [signal:f5ec621f-5269-464e-a455-9d6f0161539d] [signal:bf642256-d4da-4b2a-aeee-9e2be49a6253] The signals describe different concerns: a multi-step process on the G70 and questions about purpose or key format on the G60. [signal:e816b334-ea26-499a-9124-6a8073666a86] [signal:f5ec621f-5269-464e-a455-9d6f0161539d] [signal:bf642256-d4da-4b2a-aeee-9e2be49a6253]

## Open questions

[signal:e816b334-ea26-499a-9124-6a8073666a86] [signal:f5ec621f-5269-464e-a455-9d6f0161539d] [signal:bf642256-d4da-4b2a-aeee-9e2be49a6253] Do customers who ask about valet mode’s purpose share the separate-key preference? [signal:f5ec621f-5269-464e-a455-9d6f0161539d] [signal:bf642256-d4da-4b2a-aeee-9e2be49a6253]

[signal:5e21d5a0-202c-49b1-9dc2-14fa60608cb1] The Rest of World signal mentions unsupported side-mirror heating, not a failure of the vehicle heater, so the signals do not establish a market difference in vehicle-heater reliability. ## Open questions
The customer provided no additional details or feedback, so the cause and circumstances of the heater failure are unknown from this report. [signal:5e21d5a0-202c-49b1-9dc2-14fa60608cb1]

[signal:883bd6af-09cf-4254-8e67-c1b35e2aaf5e] The comparison signal mentions a 740 camera that checks driver attention and a Mercedes-Benz 580 requirement to keep both hands on the steering wheel. value.title: Driver attention alerts feel intrusive and hard to control
value.summary: Some USA G70 and G60 drivers report repeated or confusing attention alerts, including while using driver assistance, and say they cannot adjust or disable them. Drivers also report uncertainty about what triggers the alerts and what happens if they are not acknowledged.
highlights: Repeated or confusing alerts can be difficult to control, and one driver says an alert interrupted self-driving.
Signals are from USA drivers of the G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers report repeated attention alerts while driving normally or using Driver Assistance functions, and one says an alert turned off the self-driving function. [signal:217ff495-ca96-41b4-ba38-0cea806d1546] [signal:47819c36-500f-4373-8525-f06f854de42f] [signal:cbce73f1-811f-493f-bb1e-651026483cba] A driver says the feature cannot be adjusted or deactivated, while another asked whether its sensitivity could be changed. [signal:217ff495-ca96-41b4-ba38-0cea806d1546] [signal:cbce73f1-811f-493f-bb1e-651026483cba] Drivers also describe uncertainty about the feature and about alerts warning of possible vehicle shutdown. [signal:c1e4f472-d12e-4a30-a2b0-ee04b2a0a53e] [signal:68d8623a-6cbf-496e-94d4-fc951faf1337]

## What customers say
A G70 driver reports receiving alerts despite driving normally and not using assisted driving; the driver says they found a workaround by slightly obscuring the camera. [signal:cbce73f1-811f-493f-bb1e-651026483cba] Another G70 driver reports an alert that turned off the self-driving function, despite not wearing sunglasses or having anything covering their eyes. [signal:217ff495-ca96-41b4-ba38-0cea806d1546] A G60 driver reports repeated watch-the-road messages while using Driver Assistance functions. [signal:47819c36-500f-4373-8525-f06f854de42f]

Drivers were told that steering-wheel position can block the camera and that sunglasses, including polarized sunglasses, may interfere with it. [signal:0e8edfe5-7866-48f3-93d1-510ed2eb1f75] [signal:47819c36-500f-4373-8525-f06f854de42f] One G70 driver says the alerts appeared only briefly. [signal:0e8edfe5-7866-48f3-93d1-510ed2eb1f75] Another reports warnings that the car could shut down if they were not acknowledged; the explanation given included possible emergency procedures such as shutting off the engine, contacting the BMW Operator, and unlocking the vehicle. [signal:68d8623a-6cbf-496e-94d4-fc951faf1337]

## Differences between markets
All provided signals are from the USA and cover the G70 and G60; there is no market comparison in the signals. [signal:0e8edfe5-7866-48f3-93d1-510ed2eb1f75] [signal:217ff495-ca96-41b4-ba38-0cea806d1546] [signal:47819c36-500f-4373-8525-f06f854de42f] [signal:68d8623a-6cbf-496e-94d4-fc951faf1337] [signal:c1e4f472-d12e-4a30-a2b0-ee04b2a0a53e] [signal:cbce73f1-811f-493f-bb1e-651026483cba]

## Open questions
How frequently do alerts occur for drivers whose faces are not visibly obstructed? [signal:217ff495-ca96-41b4-ba38-0cea806d1546] [signal:cbce73f1-811f-493f-bb1e-651026483cba] How often do alerts interrupt Driver Assistance or self-driving functions, and how clearly do drivers understand the consequences of not acknowledging them? [signal:217ff495-ca96-41b4-ba38-0cea806d1546] [signal:47819c36-500f-4373-8525-f06f854de42f] [signal:68d8623a-6cbf-496e-94d4-fc951faf1337]

value.title: Turn signals behave unpredictably or are harder to use
value.summary: Customers report unintended flashing, a changed turn-signal interval, and difficulty using or understanding some controls. These concerns appear in USA reports for G60 and G70 and a Rest of World report for F70; one Europe signal is positive about the cabin layout, not specifically flashing.
highlights: Reports describe unintended flashing, a shorter turn-signal interval, and hard-to-use hazard lights.
Complaints span USA G60 and G70 reports and a Rest of World F70 report.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe several distinct usability concerns: turn indicators coming on without being activated, a turn-signal interval perceived as too fast and short, and lower hazard lights that are hard to use. [signal:13ad0893-c37a-4c92-9ac3-f8cdef193423] [signal:35b92337-e2ce-496d-bf98-787cce4dd23f] [signal:3b8c1b6e-a09b-4e44-8b58-7fa537dc56e8] [signal:adc9be08-d002-4966-a4a6-e90c65b2c4ed]

## What customers say
A G60 owner in the USA reported the hazard lights came on randomly while driving during roughly the first three weeks, then stopped. [signal:13ad0893-c37a-4c92-9ac3-f8cdef193423]

Another USA G60 owner reported the turn indicators activated by themselves after purchase; the service team could not detect a fault when the vehicle was checked. [signal:3b8c1b6e-a09b-4e44-8b58-7fa537dc56e8]

A USA G70 owner said the turn signals blink faster and for a shorter duration than on their prior 7 Series, making them harder for other drivers to notice. [signal:35b92337-e2ce-496d-bf98-787cce4dd23f]

A Rest of World F70 signal says the lower hazard lights are hard to use. [signal:adc9be08-d002-4966-a4a6-e90c65b2c4ed] A separate USA G70 interaction records a customer asking what “one touch 3 blink” means, followed by an explanation of the setting. [signal:fea16b34-83b9-4599-b423-6003c842c053]

## Differences between markets
The reports of unintended activation and changed turn-signal timing are from the USA, while difficulty using the lower hazard lights is reported in Rest of World. [signal:13ad0893-c37a-4c92-9ac3-f8cdef193423] [signal:35b92337-e2ce-496d-bf98-787cce4dd23f] [signal:3b8c1b6e-a09b-4e44-8b58-7fa537dc56e8] [signal:adc9be08-d002-4966-a4a6-e90c65b2c4ed]

The Europe F70 signal praises the cabin layout as easy to understand, but does not specifically assess flashing controls; it therefore does not resolve the usability complaints. [signal:0b50df0d-8be8-491f-8f93-642d918e9036] [signal:adc9be08-d002-4966-a4a6-e90c65b2c4ed] [signal:fea16b34-83b9-4599-b423-6003c842c053]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why the G60 indicators activated unexpectedly, or whether the reported behavior recurred after the service visit. [signal:13ad0893-c37a-4c92-9ac3-f8cdef193423] [signal:3b8c1b6e-a09b-4e44-8b58-7fa537dc56e8]

The signals do not clarify how widespread the interval and hazard-light concerns are, or whether other customers share the G70 customer’s difficulty understanding the one-touch setting. [signal:35b92337-e2ce-496d-bf98-787cce4dd23f] [signal:adc9be08-d002-4966-a4a6-e90c65b2c4ed] [signal:fea16b34-83b9-4599-b423-6003c842c053]

value.title: Remote software upgrades feel too infrequent or delayed

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners want Remote Software Upgrades more often than the quarterly schedule they describe, while an F70 owner says they are still waiting for an expected patch. [signal:a881c27e-cf4f-4e1c-a3a5-8c396b4f1215] [signal:a7b56136-b4ef-4b2c-bad2-271b5330ede3]

Other owners mention hoping software updates will address vehicle quirks or add features, without specifying an RSU timing problem. [signal:0e19381d-630f-40bf-9eab-937dbd6365ff] [signal:1c97cf30-c1d2-4eb6-b11e-cc23aca172cb] [signal:b4a2b7c0-1c60-4e47-a199-b47bb6a570b5]

## What customers say
A G60 owner wants RSU updates more often than quarterly and says Tesla appears to issue updates every few weeks. [signal:a881c27e-cf4f-4e1c-a3a5-8c396b4f1215]

An F70 owner says they are waiting for a patch update that was expected in January. [signal:a7b56136-b4ef-4b2c-bad2-271b5330ede3]

A G60 owner appreciates that BMW adds new features through Remote Software Upgrade. [signal:24dfdab9-acb9-4467-a29a-569e4d7533ba]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include a request for more frequent RSU updates from a G60 owner. [signal:a881c27e-cf4f-4e1c-a3a5-8c396b4f1215]

The Europe signal is from an F70 owner waiting for a patch update. [signal:a7b56136-b4ef-4b2c-bad2-271b5330ede3]

The signals describe different concerns—update frequency in the USA and a delayed patch in Europe—and do not establish whether experiences differ by market. [signal:a881c27e-cf4f-4e1c-a3a5-8c396b4f1215] [signal:a7b56136-b4ef-4b2c-bad2-271b5330ede3]

## Open questions
The signals do not say how many owners share these concerns beyond the individual reports, or whether the expected patch arrived. [signal:a881c27e-cf4f-4e1c-a3a5-8c396b4f1215] [signal:a7b56136-b4ef-4b2c-bad2-271b5330ede3]

[signal:02a34b22-439b-48cf-8cfd-621bbbd862e4] [signal:172cfdd6-9512-4275-ae3e-57dc5ef9c935] [signal:591468f9-f111-4b99-8311-30307d2d6681]
One customer asked whether the driver seat could contact the screen and was told it could not. [signal:41bd232a-5192-491f-bd8e-a0b66316098d]

## Differences between markets

[signal:02a34b22-439b-48cf-8cfd-621bbbd862e4] [signal:172cfdd6-9512-4275-ae3e-57dc5ef9c935] [signal:41bd232a-5192-491f-bd8e-a0b66316098d] [signal:591468f9-f111-4b99-8311-30307d2d6681] [signal:7fc32ebc-09e4-4bf0-b7fc-87929e1cb21c] [signal:83e169cb-0a0a-43d2-b790-ad075c3b9a5c]

## Open questions
The displayed signals do not establish how often setup difficulties or touch issues occur across the full case, or whether they extend beyond the USA G70 examples. value.title: Remote software updates fail, disrupt screens and reset settings
value.summary: Customers report remote software updates that stop before completion, cause screen problems or leave the vehicle inaccessible; other reports describe settings being reset. Signals come from USA, European and Rest of World customers across G60, G70 and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Updates are reported to fail, disrupt the screen, reset settings or leave a vehicle inaccessible.
Reports span USA, Europe and Rest of World, and the G60, G70 and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report several reliability problems associated with software updates: one update stopped at 58%, another was followed by a screen that sometimes went black, and two customers said updates reset vehicle settings. One customer reported being unable to access the vehicle after starting an update. [signal:5ebe4ce7-545a-4d1b-a117-be78db2e49f5] [signal:1e1ca3fe-f1c4-429e-acfe-323b1ba0bbd9] [signal:266ba175-427d-447f-83be-3f43f53e6994] [signal:5b4a87b4-adc2-48d2-9bbb-6d895dda4361] [signal:a4a6cab5-55c4-4bf7-997a-5b40e58f9fe2]

## What customers say
A USA G70 owner said a remote update stopped at 58%; a dealer iDrive update resolved the problem. [signal:5ebe4ce7-545a-4d1b-a117-be78db2e49f5]

A USA G60 owner said the screen sometimes went completely black after a software update and called for more careful testing before updates are sent out. [signal:1e1ca3fe-f1c4-429e-acfe-323b1ba0bbd9]

An F70 owner in Europe said an update wiped their settings, requiring them to set them up again. [signal:266ba175-427d-447f-83be-3f43f53e6994] An F70 owner in Rest of World reported that settings including the automatic parking brake feature and phone registration were reset after an update. [signal:5b4a87b4-adc2-48d2-9bbb-6d895dda4361]

A USA G70 owner said they could not get into the vehicle after initiating an update; roadside assistance sent a tow truck, but the car could not be moved because it was not in neutral and the interior could not be accessed. [signal:a4a6cab5-55c4-4bf7-997a-5b40e58f9fe2]

## Differences between markets
The reported issues differ across the signals: USA reports describe an update that stopped, a screen problem after an update, and loss of vehicle access; Europe and Rest of World reports describe settings being reset. [signal:5ebe4ce7-545a-4d1b-a117-be78db2e49f5] [signal:1e1ca3fe-f1c4-429e-acfe-323b1ba0bbd9] [signal:a4a6cab5-55c4-4bf7-997a-5b40e58f9fe2] [signal:266ba175-427d-447f-83be-3f43f53e6994] [signal:5b4a87b4-adc2-48d2-9bbb-6d895dda4361]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often these problems occur, whether the reports share a cause, or whether settings loss and vehicle inaccessibility were resolved. [signal:1e1ca3fe-f1c4-429e-acfe-323b1ba0bbd9] [signal:266ba175-427d-447f-83be-3f43f53e6994] [signal:5b4a87b4-adc2-48d2-9bbb-6d895dda4361] [signal:a4a6cab5-55c4-4bf7-997a-5b40e58f9fe2]

value.title: Remote software upgrades are confusing and can disrupt services
value.summary: Customers report difficulty understanding and completing remote software upgrades, including complicated setup and services taking time to return. Signals come from USA and Europe across G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Upgrade steps can be confusing, setup complicated, and services may take time to return.
Signals span USA and Europe; G60, G70, and F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe uncertainty about upgrade steps and whether an update completed, as well as complicated setup and delays in services returning. [signal:1f73d00e-6067-435e-bdd3-e6c931bd1086] [signal:e5134936-96d9-4335-acea-63230897be78] Some USA customers also report download, installation, or connectivity problems. [signal:40bf9484-dce3-4378-9f88-7ead223564e7] [signal:46d8450f-f5f8-45f9-aa18-2797c8edf86a]

## What customers say
One G60 customer was unsure how to proceed after seeing update notifications in both the car and the My BMW App, and how to confirm completion. [signal:1f73d00e-6067-435e-bdd3-e6c931bd1086] A European G60 customer described the setup as too complicated and said it took almost three days for all services to return. [signal:e5134936-96d9-4335-acea-63230897be78] A European F70 customer said the app and vehicle update process should be simpler. [signal:d22d22bc-b2c4-45be-91e4-d145b7bc9d83] Another F70 customer said some settings reverted to factory settings after an update. [signal:37c6ed17-d40b-407f-ba8c-68b58091aef3]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include questions about update notifications and completion, alongside reports of download, installation, and connectivity issues in G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:1f73d00e-6067-435e-bdd3-e6c931bd1086] [signal:252c9f5c-32d6-4454-b8f3-d63352c0a5c6] [signal:40bf9484-dce3-4378-9f88-7ead223564e7] [signal:46d8450f-f5f8-45f9-aa18-2797c8edf86a] Europe signals describe complicated setup or a process that should be simpler in G60 and F70 vehicles; one F70 signal also reports settings reverting after an update. [signal:e5134936-96d9-4335-acea-63230897be78] [signal:d22d22bc-b2c4-45be-91e4-d145b7bc9d83] [signal:37c6ed17-d40b-407f-ba8c-68b58091aef3]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these experiences are or whether the reported setup complexity, connectivity issues, service delays, and settings changes share a cause. [signal:1f73d00e-6067-435e-bdd3-e6c931bd1086] [signal:40bf9484-dce3-4378-9f88-7ead223564e7] [signal:e5134936-96d9-4335-acea-63230897be78] [signal:37c6ed17-d40b-407f-ba8c-68b58091aef3]

value.title: Lighting controls are unclear and difficult to operate
value.summary: Customers report confusing, hard-to-reach, or easily activated lighting controls, as well as difficulty changing some light settings. Signals come from USA G60 and G70 owners and a Europe G60 owner.
highlights: Lighting controls are unclear, difficult to reach, or easy to activate by mistake.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 owners and one Europe G60 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe lighting controls as difficult to understand, reach, or operate without accidentally changing a setting. [signal:04e97b71-f199-4057-aeda-efb2f92307e9] [signal:73b78164-8a56-482a-9b7a-86193324c7aa] [signal:c5ae99ca-0423-4dd9-9d9c-8938ca3959f5]
Some customers also report difficulty changing automatic headlights or finding settings for daytime running lights. [signal:0d16d734-84a6-4cba-a363-632521745506] [signal:2800cad6-e161-4936-bf22-b2832ff5575a] [signal:2972e3b0-0a58-48a8-a481-73cedd7f971b] [signal:41f81751-0a90-4538-896c-620e6629f1e1]

## What customers say
A G60 owner asked what the individual lighting buttons do, while another said the headlight control was difficult to reach behind the steering wheel. [signal:04e97b71-f199-4057-aeda-efb2f92307e9] [signal:c5ae99ca-0423-4dd9-9d9c-8938ca3959f5]
A G70 owner said the touch controls were easy to press accidentally when reaching for the door-open button, and that he sometimes noticed only after driving away that the headlights were off. [signal:73b78164-8a56-482a-9b7a-86193324c7aa]
USA customers asked for help with headlight and daytime-light settings, including how to switch off daytime running lights through vehicle menus. [signal:0d16d734-84a6-4cba-a363-632521745506] [signal:2800cad6-e161-4936-bf22-b2832ff5575a] [signal:2972e3b0-0a58-48a8-a481-73cedd7f971b]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include G60 and G70 reports about understanding controls, changing light settings, accidental presses, and reach. [signal:04e97b71-f199-4057-aeda-efb2f92307e9] [signal:0d16d734-84a6-4cba-a363-632521745506] [signal:2800cad6-e161-4936-bf22-b2832ff5575a] [signal:2972e3b0-0a58-48a8-a481-73cedd7f971b] [signal:73b78164-8a56-482a-9b7a-86193324c7aa] [signal:c5ae99ca-0423-4dd9-9d9c-8938ca3959f5]
The Europe signal, from a G60 owner, says changing some settings such as headlights in very bright sun could be simpler. [signal:41f81751-0a90-4538-896c-620e6629f1e1]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often accidental changes occur beyond the reported G70 owner's experience. [signal:73b78164-8a56-482a-9b7a-86193324c7aa]
It remains unclear whether the reported control and settings difficulties are shared across other markets or vehicle lines. [signal:04e97b71-f199-4057-aeda-efb2f92307e9] [signal:41f81751-0a90-4538-896c-620e6629f1e1]

value.title: Steering-area noise with shaking or a suspected tie-rod fault
value.summary: Two USA complaints describe noise around the steering or front wheel area: one with steering-column movement and shaking while braking at higher speeds, and another with a suspected tie-rod fault. The reports concern G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Noise is reported alongside steering-column movement and shaking, or a suspected tie-rod fault.
Two USA complaints cover the G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Two USA complaints describe noise in the steering or front-wheel area, with different accompanying symptoms. [signal:6366b33b-1e62-417b-a4b8-e410a119f22a] [signal:b22033c9-ea54-4a88-a34b-4cada1210757]

## What customers say
A G70 customer reported steering-wheel shaking at higher speeds while braking, movement of the steering column where it meets the dash, and a clicking sound. The customer said the dealer could not detect a fault after two visits. [signal:6366b33b-1e62-417b-a4b8-e410a119f22a]

A G60 customer reported sound from the front passenger-side tire area. The dealer reportedly said the tie rod would need replacement; the vehicle remained at the dealership while parts were ordered. [signal:b22033c9-ea54-4a88-a34b-4cada1210757]

## Differences between markets
Both complaints are from the USA; the signals provide no comparison with other markets. [signal:6366b33b-1e62-417b-a4b8-e410a119f22a] [signal:b22033c9-ea54-4a88-a34b-4cada1210757]

## Open questions
Do the two reports share a cause, given that one describes steering-column movement and clicking while the other concerns noise near the front passenger-side tire and a suspected tie-rod fault? [signal:6366b33b-1e62-417b-a4b8-e410a119f22a] [signal:b22033c9-ea54-4a88-a34b-4cada1210757]

Was a fault ultimately identified in the G70 after the reported dealer visits? [signal:6366b33b-1e62-417b-a4b8-e410a119f22a]

value.title: Steering feels loose or makes tight maneuvers difficult
value.summary: Some G60 owners report highway vibration or wish for tighter steering, while a G70 owner says tight turns are difficult without integral active steering. A European F70 owner also reports a large turning circle.
highlights: Reports include highway steering vibration, a request for tighter feel, and difficulty in tight turns.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 owners and a Europe F70 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A USA G60 customer reported that the vehicle shakes on the highway and the steering column vibrates at around 70–80 mph, beginning within days of purchase. [signal:1ac88bb4-0750-4ae9-9411-26d2745147b0] Another USA G60 owner said the steering could be tighter. [signal:3012a40d-ed70-40e6-9350-d6d90fdc5a3f] A USA G70 owner said U-turns and steering in tight spaces are difficult without integral active steering. [signal:adbe6595-4341-4a39-89ef-3e398a76a887]

## What customers say
The G60 vibration complaint was noticed almost immediately after purchase, but the customer had not yet contacted the dealership. [signal:1ac88bb4-0750-4ae9-9411-26d2745147b0] The G60 owner who wanted tighter steering also praised the car’s handling. [signal:3012a40d-ed70-40e6-9350-d6d90fdc5a3f] The G70 owner described the car as smooth and luxurious, while identifying tight-space steering as a difficulty. [signal:adbe6595-4341-4a39-89ef-3e398a76a887]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include highway steering vibration and a request for tighter steering in the G60, plus tight-maneuver difficulty in the G70. [signal:1ac88bb4-0750-4ae9-9411-26d2745147b0] [signal:3012a40d-ed70-40e6-9350-d6d90fdc5a3f] [signal:adbe6595-4341-4a39-89ef-3e398a76a887] The Europe F70 owner reported that the turning circle was much larger than expected. [signal:52aa7234-2d24-465c-a76c-e2c28f5e46eb] The G60 owner praised handling, while also wanting tighter steering; the signals therefore include both positive and critical feedback. [signal:3012a40d-ed70-40e6-9350-d6d90fdc5a3f]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the vibration or tight-maneuver concerns are, or whether the reported G60 vibration was addressed. [signal:1ac88bb4-0750-4ae9-9411-26d2745147b0] [signal:adbe6595-4341-4a39-89ef-3e398a76a887]

value.title: Steering feels too light or soft in some models
value.summary: Some G60 and G70 drivers in the USA describe steering as too light, soft, or out of alignment, while a European F70 driver values its very light steering.
highlights: Some drivers find steering too light or soft; one reports an off-centre steering wheel.
Signals include three USA G60 steering-feel complaints, one USA G70 alignment complaint, and one positive Europe F70 signal.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some USA G60 drivers describe the steering as weak, too light, or softer and more cushioned than in a 540i. [signal:53a93894-2f1c-4a6f-8885-ca74e6ac4502] [signal:83ce4209-cebf-46b6-b56e-149a585e7981] [signal:84ba5b54-9ddd-48f4-aaa8-e3de302040b7] A USA G70 driver reported needing to hold the steering wheel about 25–30 degrees left to drive straight; the issue was corrected after a second alignment visit. [signal:3670dc60-d3e0-45b2-8e02-6375e5428254]

## What customers say
A G60 driver says the steering feedback is weak and the car does not feel like a proper BMW. [signal:53a93894-2f1c-4a6f-8885-ca74e6ac4502] Another says the steering effort is too light, while a 540i comparison describes the G60 steering as softer and more cushioned; that driver says Sport Mode slightly improves it. [signal:83ce4209-cebf-46b6-b56e-149a585e7981] [signal:84ba5b54-9ddd-48f4-aaa8-e3de302040b7]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include G60 complaints about light or soft steering and a G70 report of a steering wheel that was off-centre. [signal:53a93894-2f1c-4a6f-8885-ca74e6ac4502] [signal:83ce4209-cebf-46b6-b56e-149a585e7981] [signal:84ba5b54-9ddd-48f4-aaa8-e3de302040b7] [signal:3670dc60-d3e0-45b2-8e02-6375e5428254] By contrast, a Europe F70 driver says the steering is very light and presents it as a positive. [signal:716b35f4-7cfc-4d63-be9c-7df2b3256fe2]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these steering experiences are beyond the individual reports, or whether the differences reflect model, market, or driver preference. [signal:53a93894-2f1c-4a6f-8885-ca74e6ac4502] [signal:83ce4209-cebf-46b6-b56e-149a585e7981] [signal:84ba5b54-9ddd-48f4-aaa8-e3de302040b7] [signal:716b35f4-7cfc-4d63-be9c-7df2b3256fe2]

value.title: Steering feel is too light or insufficiently adjustable
value.summary: Some drivers want more road feedback, a firmer feel, or more ability to adjust the steering, particularly in the USA G60 and G70 signals. European F70 drivers also describe the steering positively, so experiences differ.
highlights: Some drivers find steering too light, low in road feel, or difficult to adjust.
The supplied examples include USA G60/G70 and European F70 drivers; the full 25-signal breakdown is unavailable.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some USA G60 drivers say the steering transmits little road feel or lacks the steering feel they associate with BMW. [signal:51bbaf6b-d069-4d25-b81c-20c4eb4b81c5] [signal:8318d667-ee52-4ccb-80ee-90e0adc871fa] A G70 driver wants a firmer steering feel than is available with the M Package alone, and says further sport steering adjustments require the Autobahn package. [signal:48374d2e-969c-45be-9241-5320a01eee77] A European F70 driver says the steering cannot be adjusted to suit them. [signal:d4a50893-ff06-40f3-bc47-bed7da121451]

## What customers say
One G60 owner appreciates that the steering is smooth on the freeway but wishes it provided more road feedback. [signal:51bbaf6b-d069-4d25-b81c-20c4eb4b81c5] Another says the car no longer offers the steering feel and maneuvering experience they associate with BMW. [signal:f34bcd05-e09b-47e0-b9ff-9ff9b0d8e565] A G70 owner says U-turns and steering in tight spaces are difficult without integral active steering. [signal:e4f51bba-ff96-490e-a35a-d6d29ea1e373]

Other signals are positive: European F70 drivers praise its hydraulic steering, lighter response, or steering feel. [signal:49414935-e00f-447b-8c48-456a1bffab69] [signal:58cd5a0b-0b61-4d12-9222-357cd53ebc47] [signal:715c5b17-ddf6-46c8-b2b0-7a1839f11f06] One Rest of World F70 driver says Sport mode sharpens the steering feel. [signal:72acdc0a-e30f-46f7-b386-02e179924da7]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA G60 signals include complaints about light steering and limited road feel. [signal:51bbaf6b-d069-4d25-b81c-20c4eb4b81c5] [signal:8318d667-ee52-4ccb-80ee-90e0adc871fa] The supplied European F70 signals include both a complaint about limited adjustability and positive assessments of steering feel. [signal:d4a50893-ff06-40f3-bc47-bed7da121451] [signal:49414935-e00f-447b-8c48-456a1bffab69] [signal:58cd5a0b-0b61-4d12-9222-357cd53ebc47] The supplied USA G70 signal also identifies a desire for firmer steering and more sport adjustment. [signal:48374d2e-969c-45be-9241-5320a01eee77]

## Open questions
The examples show different steering preferences, including positive assessments and requests for more feel or adjustability. [signal:49414935-e00f-447b-8c48-456a1bffab69] [signal:51bbaf6b-d069-4d25-b81c-20c4eb4b81c5] The supplied sample does not establish how these views are distributed across all 25 signals, markets, or vehicle lines.

value.title: Steering feel draws mixed observations across markets
