value.title: Lane departure warnings are inaccurate and sometimes stop working
value.summary: Some USA G60 and G70 owners report false lane warnings, missed feedback, or alerts that temporarily stop working.
highlights: Warnings can be inaccurate, miss lane-position changes, or temporarily stop working.
Reports are from USA owners of G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners report that lane departure warning can give alerts when they are within the lane, respond incorrectly around merging highway exits, fail to recognize when they have moved away from a lane line, or stop working temporarily [signal:7b0960b3-5998-483c-a20c-651f409e3717] [signal:ab4cfb65-b492-45cd-ae81-bc61ccf79496] [signal:ac32edda-e7b9-4630-8d6c-98eeb573c120] [signal:f143f28d-e5fc-4221-a22c-99653d223a3d].

## What customers say
One G60 owner says false warnings near merging highway exits cause the car to shake and jerk [signal:7b0960b3-5998-483c-a20c-651f409e3717]. Another G60 owner reports that the system beeps near a lane line but does not seem to notice when the car moves away from it [signal:ab4cfb65-b492-45cd-ae81-bc61ccf79496]. A G70 owner reports warnings while staying within the lane, followed by a message suggesting they may not be paying attention [signal:ac32edda-e7b9-4630-8d6c-98eeb573c120]. One G60 owner says lane departure and blind spot alerts stopped working despite remaining enabled, then returned the next day [signal:f143f28d-e5fc-4221-a22c-99653d223a3d].

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA; they concern G60 and G70 vehicles [signal:7b0960b3-5998-483c-a20c-651f409e3717] [signal:ab4cfb65-b492-45cd-ae81-bc61ccf79496] [signal:ac32edda-e7b9-4630-8d6c-98eeb573c120] [signal:f143f28d-e5fc-4221-a22c-99653d223a3d].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often these behaviors occur or whether they share a cause [signal:7b0960b3-5998-483c-a20c-651f409e3717] [signal:ab4cfb65-b492-45cd-ae81-bc61ccf79496] [signal:ac32edda-e7b9-4630-8d6c-98eeb573c120] [signal:f143f28d-e5fc-4221-a22c-99653d223a3d].

value.title: Lane warning settings and performance draw mixed reactions
value.summary: Some drivers find lane departure warning helpful or precise, while others dislike having to deactivate it repeatedly or compare its performance unfavorably with other vehicles. The signals include drivers in Europe and the USA, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Drivers report repeated deactivation and weaker lane-assist performance, while others value the warning.
Signals cover Europe and the USA, with F70, G60 and G70 vehicles represented.
Competitor comparisons mention Hyundai and lane assist in a cheaper vehicle.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers report that lane warning must be turned off repeatedly, and some describe lane-assist performance as less capable or harder to operate than in other vehicles. [signal:3e11387e-74c0-472f-96fc-8e68d377eae4] [signal:6cb30de3-fef9-4acd-9d88-0c077a19396c] [signal:17d04179-63c2-46f4-ad36-f9992fcc17eb]

Other drivers value the warning as a helpful reminder or appreciate its accuracy and responsiveness. [signal:3505bdcd-2ad2-4474-8a97-2bbb05620ac0] [signal:3c400e22-3999-4f04-8fb7-d16c069c4ada] [signal:44672201-3d31-4e3b-985a-4331e743c6e5]

## What customers say
A European F70 owner says turning the lane warning off once should be enough, rather than having to deactivate it again. [signal:3e11387e-74c0-472f-96fc-8e68d377eae4]

In the USA, a G60 driver says lane assist should keep the car centered and handle corners throughout a trip; another G60 driver prefers the lane assist in a cheaper vehicle and finds it easier to operate. [signal:6cb30de3-fef9-4acd-9d88-0c077a19396c] [signal:17d04179-63c2-46f4-ad36-f9992fcc17eb]

Positive USA feedback includes a G70 driver who values the warning as a way to wake up if drowsy, a G60 driver who finds the lane reminder helpful on the freeway, and a G70 driver who says the sensors are precise and responsive. [signal:3505bdcd-2ad2-4474-8a97-2bbb05620ac0] [signal:3c400e22-3999-4f04-8fb7-d16c069c4ada] [signal:44672201-3d31-4e3b-985a-4331e743c6e5]

## Differences between markets
The sampled European signal reports frustration with repeatedly turning off the warning. [signal:3e11387e-74c0-472f-96fc-8e68d377eae4]

USA signals are mixed: some drivers criticize lane-assist performance or operation, while others praise the reminder, accuracy, or responsiveness. [signal:6cb30de3-fef9-4acd-9d88-0c077a19396c] [signal:17d04179-63c2-46f4-ad36-f9992fcc17eb] [signal:3505bdcd-2ad2-4474-8a97-2bbb05620ac0] [signal:3c400e22-3999-4f04-8fb7-d16c069c4ada] [signal:44672201-3d31-4e3b-985a-4331e743c6e5]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the repeated deactivation complaint is beyond the European F70 report. [signal:3e11387e-74c0-472f-96fc-8e68d377eae4]

The feedback describes both lane departure warning and lane assist, but does not clarify whether the performance criticisms concern the warning function specifically. [signal:6cb30de3-fef9-4acd-9d88-0c077a19396c] [signal:17d04179-63c2-46f4-ad36-f9992fcc17eb]

value.title: Steering faults and inconsistent feel undermine confidence
value.summary: Some F70 and G60 drivers report steering faults, including locking or choppy movement; others describe lighter steering or difficulty turning tightly. The reports come from Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Drivers report steering faults, inconsistent feel and difficulty turning tightly.
Signals span Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across F70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers describe steering faults, including steering that feels loose or locks during a turn, and choppy movement after driving for a while. [signal:6901adc4-6e84-4c0a-b16d-43787eedc81d] [signal:cbd41e9e-70e8-4c35-b4a6-26cc1e13ac7e] An F70 owner says the steering went wrong within two months of ownership. [signal:3273415a-1cf3-479e-af6f-9f11ac41cd0a] Other complaints concern lighter steering that makes the car feel less stable, or a turning radius considered too large. [signal:915ddb03-1a36-4215-980c-66bc48e728f9] [signal:24bc0756-7ad1-4b3f-8c75-79503f7694b2] [signal:33e4f421-294f-4d9e-afe6-433dbe099b8c] [signal:43fbe716-f11f-4433-a361-1597c0f092c3]

## What customers say
A G60 driver in the USA says the wheel can feel loose and sometimes lock when turning; another describes choppy steering near center after 20–30 minutes at roughly 50 mph or above. [signal:6901adc4-6e84-4c0a-b16d-43787eedc81d] [signal:cbd41e9e-70e8-4c35-b4a6-26cc1e13ac7e] The latter says the dealership could not reproduce the issue, although the driver reports being able to bring it back reliably. [signal:cbd41e9e-70e8-4c35-b4a6-26cc1e13ac7e] An F70 driver says lighter steering makes the car feel less stable than the previous version. [signal:915ddb03-1a36-4215-980c-66bc48e728f9] Other F70 and G60 comments criticize the turning radius or say the car cannot turn as tightly as an older model. [signal:24bc0756-7ad1-4b3f-8c75-79503f7694b2] [signal:33e4f421-294f-4d9e-afe6-433dbe099b8c] [signal:43fbe716-f11f-4433-a361-1597c0f092c3]

## Differences between markets
The steering fault and choppy-movement reports are from USA G60 drivers, while the report of steering going wrong and the lighter-steering feedback are from Europe F70 drivers. [signal:6901adc4-6e84-4c0a-b16d-43787eedc81d] [signal:cbd41e9e-70e8-4c35-b4a6-26cc1e13ac7e] [signal:3273415a-1cf3-479e-af6f-9f11ac41cd0a] [signal:915ddb03-1a36-4215-980c-66bc48e728f9] Complaints about a large turning radius appear in Europe for the G60 and in Rest of World for the F70. [signal:43fbe716-f11f-4433-a361-1597c0f092c3] [signal:33e4f421-294f-4d9e-afe6-433dbe099b8c] The signals therefore describe different concerns; they do not establish a single shared steering issue across markets. [signal:6901adc4-6e84-4c0a-b16d-43787eedc81d] [signal:cbd41e9e-70e8-4c35-b4a6-26cc1e13ac7e] [signal:3273415a-1cf3-479e-af6f-9f11ac41cd0a] [signal:915ddb03-1a36-4215-980c-66bc48e728f9] [signal:43fbe716-f11f-4433-a361-1597c0f092c3] [signal:33e4f421-294f-4d9e-afe6-433dbe099b8c]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the reported steering faults occur or whether the different fault descriptions share a cause. [signal:3273415a-1cf3-479e-af6f-9f11ac41cd0a] [signal:6901adc4-6e84-4c0a-b16d-43787eedc81d] [signal:cbd41e9e-70e8-4c35-b4a6-26cc1e13ac7e]

value.title: Lane departure warning tugs drivers back too aggressively
value.summary: Drivers in the USA report that lane departure warning steering intervention tugs them back into their lane, feels irritating or unsafe, and can interfere with lane changes. The reports concern G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Drivers report intrusive steering tugs, including during lane changes.
Four USA complaints: two for G60 and two for G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers report that lane departure warning steering intervention feels too aggressive, irritating, or unsafe, and can tug the car toward a lane that does not exist. [signal:034753d1-6625-4055-b20c-2af48c78ff0e] [signal:54367fa0-00d6-47b0-b5c2-33615ec49eff] [signal:c5971327-3699-4a2f-8041-dde5577013bd] [signal:d35ec047-801f-4893-b8c1-5b604a942dd9]

## What customers say
One G60 driver said the system frequently misreads lane markings and worried it could resist an emergency lane change if the turn signal could not be used. [signal:034753d1-6625-4055-b20c-2af48c78ff0e] Another G60 driver disliked being tugged back into the lane. [signal:54367fa0-00d6-47b0-b5c2-33615ec49eff]

A G70 driver said the intervention could require both hands to counteract and reported being pulled back despite using the indicator to change lanes. [signal:c5971327-3699-4a2f-8041-dde5577013bd] Another G70 driver said steering tugged when moving into another lane. [signal:d35ec047-801f-4893-b8c1-5b604a942dd9]

In one report, a writer said intervention should not engage with the turn signal on and asked whether the driver waited after signaling; the available quote does not include the customer's full response. [signal:c5971327-3699-4a2f-8041-dde5577013bd]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are USA complaints: two concern G60 and two concern G70. [signal:034753d1-6625-4055-b20c-2af48c78ff0e] [signal:54367fa0-00d6-47b0-b5c2-33615ec49eff] [signal:c5971327-3699-4a2f-8041-dde5577013bd] [signal:d35ec047-801f-4893-b8c1-5b604a942dd9] No signals from other markets are provided.

## Open questions
The reports do not establish how often lane-marking misreads or unwanted steering intervention occur beyond these four complaints. [signal:034753d1-6625-4055-b20c-2af48c78ff0e] [signal:54367fa0-00d6-47b0-b5c2-33615ec49eff] [signal:c5971327-3699-4a2f-8041-dde5577013bd] [signal:d35ec047-801f-4893-b8c1-5b604a942dd9] The G70 report about intervention with the indicator on is incomplete, so the customer's full response and circumstances are unknown. [signal:c5971327-3699-4a2f-8041-dde5577013bd]

value.title: Limited interior trim choices and customization for some owners
value.summary: Some USA owners want more choice in interior colors and greater leather and lighting customization. A Europe owner likes the trim, so feedback is not uniformly negative.
highlights: Some USA owners find interior choices too limited or want more customization.
Signals cover two USA vehicles, G70 and G60, and one Europe vehicle, F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some USA owners want more interior color choices or more leather and lighting customization. [signal:9ce699b8-e1bd-4689-ba1d-d393f5183f4c] [signal:f0fde584-c951-4677-a011-86dc5c5c6de4]

## What customers say
A G70 owner says the interior color is too dark and asks for a light tan or cream option, while saying white is not preferred. [signal:9ce699b8-e1bd-4689-ba1d-d393f5183f4c] A G60 owner says leather and lighting customization could be improved. [signal:f0fde584-c951-4677-a011-86dc5c5c6de4] In contrast, an F70 owner says the trim looks good. [signal:1947a0dc-56fa-4775-bdc1-5f64dd6c565f]

## Differences between markets
The two signals from USA owners express unmet preferences; the Europe signal is positive about the trim. [signal:9ce699b8-e1bd-4689-ba1d-d393f5183f4c] [signal:f0fde584-c951-4677-a011-86dc5c5c6de4] [signal:1947a0dc-56fa-4775-bdc1-5f64dd6c565f]

## Open questions
How representative are these preferences across owners and vehicle lines? What specific leather and lighting customization do customers value? [signal:9ce699b8-e1bd-4689-ba1d-d393f5183f4c] [signal:f0fde584-c951-4677-a011-86dc5c5c6de4]

value.title: Lane departure warnings feel intrusive and difficult to control
value.summary: Drivers report intrusive warnings or steering intervention, confusing behavior, and difficulty controlling lane departure features. Signals cover Europe’s F70 and US G60 and G70 drivers.
highlights: Warnings and interventions can feel intrusive, overly sensitive, or difficult to disable.
Signals cover Europe (F70) and the USA (G60, G70).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe lane departure warnings or lane-keeping interventions as annoying, intrusive, or difficult to control. Some report wanting to disable features permanently or find the controls more easily. [signal:074b4b51-1eeb-46a5-9071-de7ecd624efa] [signal:3f8e5c4b-9ae1-4de6-82d3-c81d6e4e0793] [signal:523899ff-cd33-426a-ba02-2ef4dd034a35] [signal:d2931930-36e2-45db-be1b-798633b1beb0]

## What customers say
In Europe, F70 drivers complain that lane warnings are annoying to turn off and cannot be switched off permanently; one says the system has tried to correct the car when staying in the lane might have been unsafe. [signal:074b4b51-1eeb-46a5-9071-de7ecd624efa] [signal:3f8e5c4b-9ae1-4de6-82d3-c81d6e4e0793] [signal:523899ff-cd33-426a-ba02-2ef4dd034a35]

In the USA, a G70 driver says lane intervention prevented a lane change, while a G60 driver reports repeated warnings near the road edge. [signal:5969a539-5510-4236-86fe-8c9da301a1a9] [signal:a80d59bc-ad5a-43be-a10f-75880136fa71]

Other US reports describe the system as too sensitive to road damage or sealant, confused at intersections or merging lanes, and difficult to switch off. [signal:cf69c71b-dda2-4379-a528-9768c0769720] [signal:d269836b-a044-43fb-bab1-916501dec15a] [signal:d2931930-36e2-45db-be1b-798633b1beb0]

## Differences between markets
The European F70 reports emphasize annoyance and the inability to keep the feature switched off, including concern about steering correction. [signal:074b4b51-1eeb-46a5-9071-de7ecd624efa] [signal:3f8e5c4b-9ae1-4de6-82d3-c81d6e4e0793]

The US G60 and G70 reports include complaints about warning frequency, lane-change interference, sensitivity to road markings or surfaces, and behavior at intersections or merging lanes. [signal:a80d59bc-ad5a-43be-a10f-75880136fa71] [signal:5969a539-5510-4236-86fe-8c9da301a1a9] [signal:cf69c71b-dda2-4379-a528-9768c0769720] [signal:d269836b-a044-43fb-bab1-916501dec15a]

## Open questions
How often do drivers encounter these behaviors across the affected vehicle lines and markets? [signal:074b4b51-1eeb-46a5-9071-de7ecd624efa] [signal:a80d59bc-ad5a-43be-a10f-75880136fa71]

Which specific warning or steering-intervention settings do customers find difficult to understand or control? [signal:5969a539-5510-4236-86fe-8c9da301a1a9] [signal:d2931930-36e2-45db-be1b-798633b1beb0]

value.title: Obstructed sightlines undermine all-round visibility for some drivers
value.summary: Some drivers report pillars, mirrors, and the hood obstructing their view, while others praise visibility as excellent or good. The signals describe these concerns in USA G70 and G60 vehicles and also include positive feedback from Europe and a mixed view from Rest of World.
highlights: Pillars, mirrors, and the hood obstruct sightlines for some drivers.
USA G70/G60 complaints; Europe G60/F70 praise; Rest of World F70 feedback is mixed.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers say vehicle pillars obstruct their view when looking around intersections or checking behind them; other reported obstructions include the rearview mirror, exterior mirrors, and hood. [signal:2b22f25c-33c5-4eb0-a98d-3e233c124c47] [signal:57d90b0e-79dd-4c30-afd2-c6bad085dfb0] [signal:5f9eb53e-cd74-4c7f-8c86-fb2fa1f865a0] [signal:6a8ea8f6-d552-4d5b-96f1-c9ebc38bb8d0] [signal:29994f17-d1a2-47a9-bb43-737e4195ddd9]

## What customers say
A USA G70 driver reports that the A-pillar creates a significant blind spot. [signal:2b22f25c-33c5-4eb0-a98d-3e233c124c47] Another says the A-pillars make it difficult to see left and right at stop signs, requiring them to lean to look around the pillars. [signal:57d90b0e-79dd-4c30-afd2-c6bad085dfb0] A G70 driver also reports a rear passenger-side blind spot and reliance on the rearview camera. [signal:3803999e-5e4a-4f1a-ad8b-b6a22125235f]

USA G60 drivers report that a pillar obstructs their view when turning to look behind, and that the hood and exterior mirrors are hard to see around for one driver who is 5 feet tall and has raised the seat fully. [signal:5f9eb53e-cd74-4c7f-8c86-fb2fa1f865a0] [signal:6a8ea8f6-d552-4d5b-96f1-c9ebc38bb8d0] A Rest of World F70 driver says an oversized rearview mirror blocks the left-side view, particularly for drivers with a taller sitting height. [signal:29994f17-d1a2-47a9-bb43-737e4195ddd9]

Other customers praise visibility: a Europe G60 owner calls it excellent, and Europe F70 owners describe the all-round view or visibility as good. [signal:05066c07-62f3-49b4-8a9d-a12fe7ab4dea] [signal:1241219f-aeb0-4cb7-a8d1-a0fe411e15ad] [signal:a35170c3-9ad8-4160-8259-32208d816b61]

## Differences between markets
The USA sample includes visibility complaints for G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:2b22f25c-33c5-4eb0-a98d-3e233c124c47]  [signal:57d90b0e-79dd-4c30-afd2-c6bad085dfb0] [signal:5f9eb53e-cd74-4c7f-8c86-fb2fa1f865a0] [signal:6a8ea8f6-d552-4d5b-96f1-c9ebc38bb8d0] Europe feedback praises visibility in G60 and F70 vehicles. [signal:05066c07-62f3-49b4-8a9d-a12fe7ab4dea] [signal:1241219f-aeb0-4cb7-a8d1-a0fe411e15ad] [signal:a35170c3-9ad8-4160-8259-32208d816b61] Rest of World F70 feedback describes the view as obstructed for taller drivers, while recommending the car to drivers with a lower sitting height. [signal:29994f17-d1a2-47a9-bb43-737e4195ddd9]

## Open questions
Do the reported sightline obstructions vary by driver height or seating position beyond the examples described? [signal:29994f17-d1a2-47a9-bb43-737e4195ddd9] [signal:6a8ea8f6-d552-4d5b-96f1-c9ebc38bb8d0] How representative are the positive and negative visibility experiences across markets and vehicle lines?

value.title: Interior trim feels poor quality or has inconsistent finish
value.summary: Some customers report interior plastics that feel low quality, while one customer describes a raised spot beneath a door trim piece. The concerns appear in Europe and the USA across F70, G70 and G60 signals.
highlights: Interior plastics feel low quality, and a raised spot under trim suggests a finish inconsistency.
Signals cover Europe F70 and USA G70 and G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report interior plastic trim that feels poor quality, and one describes a raised spot under the front passenger door trim. [signal:0aed0708-0324-4bc6-94a8-9ac3ac47d9c8] [signal:0d1d1dc5-6ec8-46e6-9001-7ac0c03e4ebb] A G60 owner also says hard plastics creak and feel low quality. [signal:b1744d41-7b8b-4da0-8e6d-432f5b46f115]

## What customers say
An F70 owner in Europe deducted a point because some interior plastic trim felt poor quality. [signal:0aed0708-0324-4bc6-94a8-9ac3ac47d9c8] A G70 owner in the USA noticed a raised spot beneath the front passenger door trim, describing it as a dried-glue-like bump and a possible production inconsistency. [signal:0d1d1dc5-6ec8-46e6-9001-7ac0c03e4ebb] A G60 owner in the USA reports creaking hard plastics that feel low quality. [signal:b1744d41-7b8b-4da0-8e6d-432f5b46f115]

## Differences between markets
The signals include a perceived material-quality concern in Europe and both material-quality and finish concerns in the USA. [signal:0aed0708-0324-4bc6-94a8-9ac3ac47d9c8] [signal:0d1d1dc5-6ec8-46e6-9001-7ac0c03e4ebb] 

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these concerns are or whether the raised spot and creaking plastics share a cause. [signal:0aed0708-0324-4bc6-94a8-9ac3ac47d9c8] [signal:0d1d1dc5-6ec8-46e6-9001-7ac0c03e4ebb] [signal:b1744d41-7b8b-4da0-8e6d-432f5b46f115]

value.title: Emergency Stop Assistant activates unexpectedly and stops vehicles
value.summary: Customers report unexpected stops, shutdowns or power loss attributed to emergency or driver-attention features. Reports come from USA G60 and G70 owners and a UK F70 owner; the incidents have left some customers feeling unsafe or shaken.
highlights: Unexpected stops, shutdowns or power loss are reported.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 vehicles and a Europe F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report vehicles stopping unexpectedly, shutting off or losing power after emergency or driver-attention features activate. [signal:1b24ce4c-38db-49a1-a26d-ed00cc5dba85] [signal:2ccd20fe-92a1-4b67-86c0-570c76252d12] [signal:bdae5a0c-2ee9-4d68-9492-afae108c252e] [signal:c3d50f5a-2f03-4552-bbda-45b2472d8364] [signal:cd825753-b326-4933-a099-ccaeaddf914b]

## What customers say
One USA customer reported a stall and shift into park while moving, with no warning icon; another described unexpected acceleration followed by an abrupt stop and shutdown. [signal:1b24ce4c-38db-49a1-a26d-ed00cc5dba85] [signal:2ccd20fe-92a1-4b67-86c0-570c76252d12]
A G70 owner said the vehicle stopped on the freeway and entered emergency mode twice, usually in traffic, while automatically dialing BMW Assist. [signal:bdae5a0c-2ee9-4d68-9492-afae108c252e]
A UK F70 owner reported two emergency stops with no cars or obstacles ahead, and said the experience shook their wife and made them consider returning the car. [signal:c3d50f5a-2f03-4552-bbda-45b2472d8364]
A G60 owner said the vehicle lost power and was towed; they were told the driver-attention feature had activated and was overly sensitive, though they said they were paying attention. [signal:cd825753-b326-4933-a099-ccaeaddf914b]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include reports from G60 and G70 owners of stops, shutdowns or power loss. [signal:1b24ce4c-38db-49a1-a26d-ed00cc5dba85] [signal:2ccd20fe-92a1-4b67-86c0-570c76252d12] [signal:bdae5a0c-2ee9-4d68-9492-afae108c252e] [signal:cd825753-b326-4933-a099-ccaeaddf914b]
The Europe signal is from a UK F70 owner who objects to emergency stops when no obstruction was present and to being unable to permanently turn off ADAS. [signal:c3d50f5a-2f03-4552-bbda-45b2472d8364]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the cause of the reported incidents or whether the different reports share a failure mode. [signal:1b24ce4c-38db-49a1-a26d-ed00cc5dba85] [signal:2ccd20fe-92a1-4b67-86c0-570c76252d12] [signal:bdae5a0c-2ee9-4d68-9492-afae108c252e] [signal:c3d50f5a-2f03-4552-bbda-45b2472d8364] [signal:cd825753-b326-4933-a099-ccaeaddf914b]
The exact warnings in one G60 incident are not recalled, and the available report ends before confirming whether the emergency call connected. [signal:2ccd20fe-92a1-4b67-86c0-570c76252d12]

value.title: No sunglass holder in the G70
value.summary: A USA G70 owner says the car lacks a sunglass holder and reports breaking two pairs of sunglasses because of the storage design.
highlights: The owner says the missing sunglass holder has led to broken sunglasses.
One signal: a USA G70 owner.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A USA G70 owner says the car has no sunglass holder and describes the storage design as bad. [signal:f0ced098-66ae-433e-aa9c-b91caff8ad31]

## What customers say
The owner reports breaking two pricey pairs of sunglasses within about three months of owning the car. [signal:f0ced098-66ae-433e-aa9c-b91caff8ad31] They compare the G70 with an old 740, which had a sunglass holder. [signal:f0ced098-66ae-433e-aa9c-b91caff8ad31]

## Differences between markets
The signal is from the USA; there are no signals from other markets to compare. [signal:f0ced098-66ae-433e-aa9c-b91caff8ad31]

The signal does not establish whether other G70 owners experience the same issue. [signal:f0ced098-66ae-433e-aa9c-b91caff8ad31]

value.title: Interior trim feels cheap and shows wear easily
value.summary: Some BMW owners say interior materials and finishing feel below their expectations, while others report surfaces that show scuffs or fingerprints easily. Concerns appear in signals from Europe and the USA across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Owners describe cheap-feeling plastics, disappointing finishes and surfaces that mark easily.
Signals mention Europe and USA, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners say interior materials feel cheap or below the standard they expect from BMW, including hard plastic in lower door areas and other cabin surfaces [signal:075685dc-4581-459a-a5b2-d58cbde69a4f] [signal:2b047377-dc64-46ce-8378-01c30a83ab56] [signal:64212ddf-00cc-4b81-a70e-bb5d1cb9b85b]. Other concerns include seat stitching that owners consider below standard, and surfaces that show scuffs or fingerprints readily [signal:59daa1e3-e45f-45e6-98a8-f807d023ce34] [signal:10696c64-8447-47c8-9ec8-b3f391d13f7d] [signal:3c270323-f355-4c10-812e-9f7d4e95eb0e].

## What customers say
Some owners compare the materials unfavorably with those in their previous BMWs, citing less leather and more hard plastic [signal:10b1d161-9196-4e41-9603-20531d8e7409] [signal:64212ddf-00cc-4b81-a70e-bb5d1cb9b85b]. One owner says seat stitching does not meet expectations, while another says hard plastic sides scuff when brushed by a foot [signal:59daa1e3-e45f-45e6-98a8-f807d023ce34] [signal:10696c64-8447-47c8-9ec8-b3f391d13f7d]. A G70 owner dislikes the available interior color and says they wanted a light tan or cream option .

## Differences between markets
The supplied examples include European complaints about perceived material quality and stitching, and USA complaints about hard plastics, scuffing, fingerprints and interior color choice [signal:075685dc-4581-459a-a5b2-d58cbde69a4f] [signal:59daa1e3-e45f-45e6-98a8-f807d023ce34] [signal:64212ddf-00cc-4b81-a70e-bb5d1cb9b85b] [signal:10696c64-8447-47c8-9ec8-b3f391d13f7d] [signal:3c270323-f355-4c10-812e-9f7d4e95eb0e] . The examples cover F70, G60 and G70 vehicles [signal:075685dc-4581-459a-a5b2-d58cbde69a4f] [signal:10b1d161-9196-4e41-9603-20531d8e7409] [signal:3c270323-f355-4c10-812e-9f7d4e95eb0e].

## Open questions
How common are the different material, finish and surface-marking concerns across the full set of 34 signals? The supplied examples describe several distinct concerns, but do not establish their frequency [signal:075685dc-4581-459a-a5b2-d58cbde69a4f] [signal:59daa1e3-e45f-45e6-98a8-f807d023ce34] [signal:10696c64-8447-47c8-9ec8-b3f391d13f7d] [signal:3c270323-f355-4c10-812e-9f7d4e95eb0e].

value.title: Brake feel and braking functions draw mixed feedback
value.summary: Feedback on braking is mixed: some customers value easy, smooth or expected braking, while others report weak brakes, abrupt safety-system braking or concerns about access to braking functions.
highlights: Customers report both positive brake feel and concerns about braking strength, abrupt intervention and access to functions.
Braking comments appear in 8 supplied signals across the USA, Europe and Rest of World, covering G60, G70 and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe braking differently: some are satisfied with how the car stops, while others question brake strength or the timing and force of safety-system braking. [signal:11bbfdaf-ebd8-43f9-abd7-716f7c709dc3] [signal:1f9e61e8-e4e0-4300-b5fa-06804b807ed4] [signal:ee125e87-ac86-4e13-9220-d5b8b698548f]

Some feedback also concerns access to braking-related functions, including a paid subscription for brake seasoning and concern about a driving assistant that brakes being removed. [signal:987a454f-37a4-4e5b-a044-048402fbfc9b] [signal:69b15954-678c-4a67-9a28-b9db45da7088]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer says the brakes could be stronger for a vehicle of its size and weight. [signal:1f9e61e8-e4e0-4300-b5fa-06804b807ed4] A USA G70 customer says a safety feature brakes constantly and, when braking is needed, does so too hard and early. [signal:ee125e87-ac86-4e13-9220-d5b8b698548f]

Other USA customers say they are pleased with how the G70 stops and happy with its brakes, or appreciate how easy it is to brake in the G60. [signal:11bbfdaf-ebd8-43f9-abd7-716f7c709dc3] [signal:36d52dce-8781-4191-a7b2-f583face5883] A Europe F70 customer says the car brakes as expected, while another describes less snatch under braking than in the previous model. [signal:7beafb8f-8b09-44fc-8523-26ba5f317d6c] [signal:a63b0e1f-0599-4280-9fec-0f098cc2192a]

A Rest of World F70 customer says brake seasoning and related functions are available only as a paid subscription. [signal:987a454f-37a4-4e5b-a044-048402fbfc9b] A Europe F70 customer raises safety concerns about the removal of a driving assistant that brakes. [signal:69b15954-678c-4a67-9a28-b9db45da7088]

## Differences between markets
USA feedback includes both concerns about brake strength or safety-system intervention and positive comments about stopping and ease of braking. [signal:1f9e61e8-e4e0-4300-b5fa-06804b807ed4] [signal:ee125e87-ac86-4e13-9220-d5b8b698548f] [signal:11bbfdaf-ebd8-43f9-abd7-716f7c709dc3] [signal:36d52dce-8781-4191-a7b2-f583face5883]

Europe F70 comments include positive assessments of braking and a concern about removal of a braking assistant; the Rest of World F70 comment concerns subscription access to brake seasoning and related functions. [signal:7beafb8f-8b09-44fc-8523-26ba5f317d6c] [signal:a63b0e1f-0599-4280-9fec-0f098cc2192a] [signal:69b15954-678c-4a67-9a28-b9db45da7088] [signal:987a454f-37a4-4e5b-a044-048402fbfc9b]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common the reported concerns are across the full case, or whether views differ by braking function, vehicle line or market. [signal:1f9e61e8-e4e0-4300-b5fa-06804b807ed4] [signal:ee125e87-ac86-4e13-9220-d5b8b698548f] [signal:987a454f-37a4-4e5b-a044-048402fbfc9b] [signal:11bbfdaf-ebd8-43f9-abd7-716f7c709dc3] [signal:69b15954-678c-4a67-9a28-b9db45da7088]

value.title: Brake dust, rusty discs and braking vibration
value.summary: Customers report excessive brake dust, rusty discs and rough, vibrating braking. Signals come from USA G60 and G70 owners, a Europe F70 owner, and a Rest of World F70 owner who says automatic braking responds poorly.
highlights: Brake dust, disc rust and braking vibration are reported.
Signals mention USA G60 and G70, Europe F70, and Rest of World F70.
No competitor evidence about braking in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe several different brake-related quality concerns: excessive brake dust, discs becoming rusty, vibration during braking, and automatic braking that seems slow or unresponsive. [signal:35f72c61-ba69-40f1-a5ce-5d58694b1c8a] [signal:47d81546-b769-4f44-a325-9f09735a797d] [signal:56205b4a-885a-4c83-8d3b-20b820e9a919] [signal:147b6334-1bf9-4da8-b116-f3dec198dea3] [signal:674fb082-168e-48ef-90d2-b4d55a0f180d] [signal:4c6b591b-4d8f-4074-a032-a1ac7a7c684b]

## What customers say
Three USA G60 owners report brake dust collecting on the wheels or making them dirty quickly. [signal:35f72c61-ba69-40f1-a5ce-5d58694b1c8a] [signal:47d81546-b769-4f44-a325-9f09735a797d] [signal:56205b4a-885a-4c83-8d3b-20b820e9a919]
A Europe F70 owner says the brake discs became rusty after three months and were addressed by the dealership. [signal:147b6334-1bf9-4da8-b116-f3dec198dea3]
A USA G70 owner reports repeated, bumpy vibration when braking, says the braking feels rough, and feels uneasy pressing the pedal hard. [signal:674fb082-168e-48ef-90d2-b4d55a0f180d]
A Rest of World F70 owner says automatic braking, along with door locking, seems not to respond properly. [signal:4c6b591b-4d8f-4074-a032-a1ac7a7c684b]

## Differences between markets
The sampled brake-dust reports are from USA G60 owners; the rust report is from a Europe F70 owner. [signal:35f72c61-ba69-40f1-a5ce-5d58694b1c8a] [signal:47d81546-b769-4f44-a325-9f09735a797d] [signal:56205b4a-885a-4c83-8d3b-20b820e9a919] [signal:147b6334-1bf9-4da8-b116-f3dec198dea3]
The vibration report is from a USA G70 owner, while the concern about automatic-braking response is from a Rest of World F70 owner. [signal:674fb082-168e-48ef-90d2-b4d55a0f180d] [signal:4c6b591b-4d8f-4074-a032-a1ac7a7c684b]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these concerns are beyond the individual reports, or whether they share a cause. [signal:35f72c61-ba69-40f1-a5ce-5d58694b1c8a] [signal:147b6334-1bf9-4da8-b116-f3dec198dea3] [signal:674fb082-168e-48ef-90d2-b4d55a0f180d] [signal:4c6b591b-4d8f-4074-a032-a1ac7a7c684b]
The USA G70 owner had a brake-vibration inspection scheduled, but the signal does not report its outcome. [signal:674fb082-168e-48ef-90d2-b4d55a0f180d]

value.title: Braking feel and stopping performance are inconsistent
value.summary: Drivers report weak or unreliable stopping performance, as well as jerky or difficult-to-modulate braking and trouble stopping smoothly. Signals come from USA, Europe and Rest of World drivers across G70, F70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Reports range from weak or failed braking to jerky, awkward or unsmooth stops.
Signals mention G70, F70 and G60 vehicles in the USA, Europe and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Drivers describe braking that feels weak or unreliable, including reports of brake failure and concern about stopping quickly. [signal:385d954e-abc3-408c-8325-c80681c5ff44] [signal:c6afc5f3-0b6a-419e-919c-66e0c705f07c] [signal:2fa4e033-5cc7-402f-888d-3d3d3b1852df] [signal:e5f03f80-d7cb-43ce-957a-f3db2f4dd136]
Other drivers say brake response feels jerky, awkward or difficult to modulate, particularly when creeping or trying to stop gently and smoothly. [signal:6669d918-2f11-4bf5-abee-dc89699f5885] [signal:d4de9263-25dd-4058-abab-2b28b5b1abcf] [signal:f19d3bff-2858-4096-bcd2-d33040c25456] [signal:8a3efcc8-afe5-4d25-b44f-8c888a6961e5]

## What customers say
A USA G70 driver says the brakes feel poor above 60; another G70 driver says they do not feel strong enough when a quick stop is needed. [signal:385d954e-abc3-408c-8325-c80681c5ff44] [signal:c6afc5f3-0b6a-419e-919c-66e0c705f07c]
A USA driver reports that braking grabs and makes smooth stops difficult, while a Rest of World F70 driver describes braking performance as poor at times and wonders whether the car needs adjustment or is affected by a recall. [signal:d4de9263-25dd-4058-abab-2b28b5b1abcf] [signal:3ec34c4c-dc36-47d1-9cbf-e397bb021e88]
A USA G70 driver reports a brake recall and says they remain worried about stopping quickly; another says the brakes failed and describes a prolonged wait after requesting service. [signal:2fa4e033-5cc7-402f-888d-3d3d3b1852df] [signal:e5f03f80-d7cb-43ce-957a-f3db2f4dd136]
F70 drivers in Europe and Rest of World describe jerky or unsmooth braking at low speeds and difficulty making a gentle stop. [signal:6669d918-2f11-4bf5-abee-dc89699f5885] [signal:f19d3bff-2858-4096-bcd2-d33040c25456] [signal:8a3efcc8-afe5-4d25-b44f-8c888a6961e5]
A Rest of World F70 driver says the shift lever responds slowly for deceleration, leaving them relying on the brakes. [signal:769ed45d-0bef-45e3-b111-418b13a935e8]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals include braking complaints from the USA, Europe and Rest of World; the descriptions include weak or unreliable stopping and difficulty achieving smooth stops. [signal:385d954e-abc3-408c-8325-c80681c5ff44] [signal:6669d918-2f11-4bf5-abee-dc89699f5885] [signal:3ec34c4c-dc36-47d1-9cbf-e397bb021e88] [signal:d4de9263-25dd-4058-abab-2b28b5b1abcf]
The supplied braking signals mention G70, F70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:385d954e-abc3-408c-8325-c80681c5ff44] [signal:6669d918-2f11-4bf5-abee-dc89699f5885] [signal:d4de9263-25dd-4058-abab-2b28b5b1abcf]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether reports of poor braking performance or brake failure share a cause. [signal:3ec34c4c-dc36-47d1-9cbf-e397bb021e88] [signal:e5f03f80-d7cb-43ce-957a-f3db2f4dd136]
The signals do not clarify whether the reported recall concern and the reports of weak or inconsistent braking refer to the same issue. [signal:2fa4e033-5cc7-402f-888d-3d3d3b1852df] [signal:385d954e-abc3-408c-8325-c80681c5ff44]

value.title: Brake noise ranges from squealing to grinding
value.summary: Customers report squeaking, squealing, grinding, or other unusual brake sounds, sometimes from early in ownership and often at low speeds. Signals include BMW G60 and G70 customers in the USA and F70 customers in Europe.
highlights: Brake sounds include squeaks, squeals, grinding, and groaning.
Reports span USA G60 and G70 vehicles and Europe F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe brake noise in several forms, including squeaking, squealing, grinding, and groaning. [signal:383a76a7-5385-4699-b721-698f4f4e77f8] [signal:60ae44f4-1fe3-40de-bcf9-09f7b92d4539] [signal:737273d6-4dfc-4fc7-bd5c-6a373349592d]
Some reports describe noise soon after delivery: one G60 owner reported squeaking after about four weeks, while another described grinding beginning within the first 200 miles. [signal:3a0e4f5f-5462-41e0-b2e6-c86ec2ed16ce] [signal:60ae44f4-1fe3-40de-bcf9-09f7b92d4539]

## What customers say
A G60 owner said the squeaking occurred whenever the brake pedal was pressed, was loud and ongoing, and made the car unpleasant to drive. [signal:3a0e4f5f-5462-41e0-b2e6-c86ec2ed16ce]
Other USA reports describe noise during slow stops, when pulling into a garage, or while braking at low speeds. [signal:60ae44f4-1fe3-40de-bcf9-09f7b92d4539] [signal:46123d57-f83c-4e60-b9e7-38234cb4ca86] [signal:737273d6-4dfc-4fc7-bd5c-6a373349592d]
One G70 customer said a dealership had repaired an earlier squeak but they had not driven enough to verify the result. [signal:46123d57-f83c-4e60-b9e7-38234cb4ca86]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include G60 and G70 reports of squeaking, squealing, grinding, or groaning. [signal:3a0e4f5f-5462-41e0-b2e6-c86ec2ed16ce] [signal:60ae44f4-1fe3-40de-bcf9-09f7b92d4539] [signal:46123d57-f83c-4e60-b9e7-38234cb4ca86] [signal:737273d6-4dfc-4fc7-bd5c-6a373349592d]
Europe signals mention brake noise on F70 vehicles; one owner specifically described poor-sounding performance brakes. [signal:99508456-2d14-4af1-9ec9-e464937cc229] [signal:9127e4b9-ce03-4bd3-9db5-28941902b27d]

## Open questions
Do the different reported sounds share a cause, or do they occur under different braking conditions? [signal:3a0e4f5f-5462-41e0-b2e6-c86ec2ed16ce] [signal:60ae44f4-1fe3-40de-bcf9-09f7b92d4539] [signal:737273d6-4dfc-4fc7-bd5c-6a373349592d]
How often does the noise persist after repair? [signal:46123d57-f83c-4e60-b9e7-38234cb4ca86]

value.title: Brake response feels harsh, weak or delayed
value.summary: Customers describe braking that can be difficult to modulate, including abrupt stops, perceived weakness or delay, and unusual pedal feel. These concerns appear in signals from USA and Europe across G60, G70 and F70 vehicles, while some customers report good braking.
highlights: Customers report abrupt or jerky stops, weak or delayed response, and unusual pedal feel.
Signals include USA and Europe complaints on G60, G70 and F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe difficulty getting a smooth, predictable brake response: reports include sudden stops despite gentle pedal input, braking perceived as weak or delayed, and excess pedal movement. [signal:52f6ab8e-f2be-4486-8a8d-ac5a98a83095] [signal:50e8dbd8-55a3-4120-b7e7-d2d435e426ff] [signal:1a37a649-1163-4ca7-a522-23d0fab25662] [signal:f44c988e-e784-4daa-8e9a-31be20449896] Other reports describe brake noise or a sensation of adjustment through the pedal. [signal:01c33143-7b3a-4380-9c2a-917facb3bb02] [signal:172a718e-8594-4232-bb95-fb031b8b8b96]

## What customers say
A G60 owner says gentle pedal pressure can still produce a sudden halt, making a calm stop difficult. [signal:52f6ab8e-f2be-4486-8a8d-ac5a98a83095] Another G60 owner says the brakes do not feel strong enough. [signal:50e8dbd8-55a3-4120-b7e7-d2d435e426ff] F70 owners describe delayed braking, too much pedal movement, and harsh regenerative braking. [signal:1a37a649-1163-4ca7-a522-23d0fab25662] [signal:f44c988e-e784-4daa-8e9a-31be20449896] [signal:bbe74be8-c79e-4828-adfd-8056ddf5f136] A G70 owner reports a brake-pedal sensation as if a component is adjusting, while saying stopping power and response are good. [signal:172a718e-8594-4232-bb95-fb031b8b8b96] Other signals describe loud brake noise during gentle application and poor stopping at speeds above 60. [signal:01c33143-7b3a-4380-9c2a-917facb3bb02] [signal:5615ba9a-ba77-4137-b6e6-528614b72761] One G70 customer positively describes the braking. [signal:32d8856b-b9ea-4003-a590-f9fac1f0b49e]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA signals include complaints about brake strength, abrupt stopping, noise, pedal sensation and stopping at speed. [signal:50e8dbd8-55a3-4120-b7e7-d2d435e426ff] [signal:52f6ab8e-f2be-4486-8a8d-ac5a98a83095] [signal:01c33143-7b3a-4380-9c2a-917facb3bb02] [signal:172a718e-8594-4232-bb95-fb031b8b8b96] [signal:5615ba9a-ba77-4137-b6e6-528614b72761] The supplied Europe signals include delayed braking, pedal movement and harsh regenerative braking. [signal:1a37a649-1163-4ca7-a522-23d0fab25662] [signal:f44c988e-e784-4daa-8e9a-31be20449896] [signal:bbe74be8-c79e-4828-adfd-8056ddf5f136] The signals therefore show different reported brake concerns across the markets, rather than one consistent description. [signal:50e8dbd8-55a3-4120-b7e7-d2d435e426ff] [signal:1a37a649-1163-4ca7-a522-23d0fab25662]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often each reported brake feel occurs across the affected vehicles. [signal:52f6ab8e-f2be-4486-8a8d-ac5a98a83095] [signal:f44c988e-e784-4daa-8e9a-31be20449896] They also do not establish whether the varied reports share a common cause. [signal:01c33143-7b3a-4380-9c2a-917facb3bb02] [signal:172a718e-8594-4232-bb95-fb031b8b8b96] [signal:bbe74be8-c79e-4828-adfd-8056ddf5f136]

They also report that a BMW Genius, after checking the car’s equipment, said the feature should be there; the customer was then directed to a dealership. [signal:711cfc33-4d60-4a31-b428-d726e8dc7ea8]

value.title: Brake performance feels weak, uneven, or activates unexpectedly
value.summary: Customers report weak or inconsistent braking, brake faults that can prevent driving, and sudden braking without warning. Signals describe these concerns in G70 reports from the USA and F70 reports from Europe and Rest of World.
highlights: Reports range from weak or uneven braking to unexpected braking and brake faults.
Signals include G70 reports in the USA and F70 reports in Europe and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe braking that feels weak, requires unusually firm pedal pressure, or is difficult to modulate. Other reports describe brake faults that prevent driving or braking that activates suddenly without warning. [signal:1c7ae59a-2fbd-4b63-a340-764ad24b6761] [signal:2b04b9b4-37d2-4e43-92c1-ea80389ad265] [signal:2c9c45c0-8304-4904-9183-e306a8555149] [signal:13a0ff6a-b180-4964-8f6b-799e5670c96d] [signal:b489dfab-c5f7-4f59-a2d6-8cde8db4bcf1]

## What customers say
A G70 owner said the brakes did not feel strong enough during urgent stops, while another said the pedal had to be pressed firmly and nearly to the floor to stop the car. [signal:1c7ae59a-2fbd-4b63-a340-764ad24b6761] [signal:2b04b9b4-37d2-4e43-92c1-ea80389ad265]
A G70 customer reported a brake warning that appeared on restarting the vehicle and cleared after driving began. [signal:0eb3937a-b750-45f3-87a5-2c031909531c]
An F70 customer described the brakes as unprogressive, alternating between little response and suddenly sharp braking. [signal:2c9c45c0-8304-4904-9183-e306a8555149]
An F70 customer reported that the brakes suddenly applied hard in traffic without warning, followed by a collision with the vehicle behind. [signal:13a0ff6a-b180-4964-8f6b-799e5670c96d]
Other F70 reports describe a brake fault that stopped the customer from driving, and a braking-performance concern for which the customer asked whether a recall or adjustment was needed. [signal:b489dfab-c5f7-4f59-a2d6-8cde8db4bcf1] [signal:c8726b99-1dd9-4119-94d9-34f9a7435537]
A G70 customer said a failed DCS module made the brakes almost useless and nearly caused a severe incident. [signal:3952c2e3-6d05-46e3-acec-2d5272e85f50]

## Differences between markets
In the USA G70 reports, customers describe weak braking, a need for unusually firm pedal pressure, a brake warning, and braking affected by a reported DCS module failure. [signal:1c7ae59a-2fbd-4b63-a340-764ad24b6761] [signal:2b04b9b4-37d2-4e43-92c1-ea80389ad265] [signal:0eb3937a-b750-45f3-87a5-2c031909531c] [signal:3952c2e3-6d05-46e3-acec-2d5272e85f50]
In Europe F70 reports, customers describe uneven brake response, sudden braking without warning, and a fault that prevented driving. [signal:2c9c45c0-8304-4904-9183-e306a8555149] [signal:13a0ff6a-b180-4964-8f6b-799e5670c96d] [signal:b489dfab-c5f7-4f59-a2d6-8cde8db4bcf1]
A Rest of World F70 customer also questioned the car's braking performance. [signal:c8726b99-1dd9-4119-94d9-34f9a7435537]

## Open questions
What causes the reported differences between weak or uneven braking, unexpected brake application, and brake faults that prevent driving? [signal:1c7ae59a-2fbd-4b63-a340-764ad24b6761] [signal:2c9c45c0-8304-4904-9183-e306a8555149] [signal:13a0ff6a-b180-4964-8f6b-799e5670c96d] [signal:b489dfab-c5f7-4f59-a2d6-8cde8db4bcf1]
Are the reported brake warnings and performance concerns related to recalls, adjustments, or specific component failures? [signal:0eb3937a-b750-45f3-87a5-2c031909531c] [signal:c8726b99-1dd9-4119-94d9-34f9a7435537] [signal:3952c2e3-6d05-46e3-acec-2d5272e85f50]

value.title: AM radio missing and station selection feels cumbersome
value.summary: Some USA customers want AM radio, which is absent in the cited electric vehicles, while some Europe customers find touchscreen-based station selection cumbersome. Other requests include station-song information in presets; one USA customer values HD radio sound quality.
highlights: AM radio is missing for some customers, and touchscreen station selection feels cumbersome to others.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 customers and Europe F70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some USA customers report that AM radio is unavailable in their vehicles, including one customer who was told that electric vehicles do not include it because AM frequencies could affect electric components. [signal:13298c8d-20c5-469c-b8ad-a2890df7904e] [signal:843514f4-6496-4bc9-9e30-29becb78378e] [signal:fa0371c6-5a1a-4ae4-81f5-bc6a5a4d0cee]
Some Europe customers say that selecting radio stations through screen inputs takes more effort than using physical shortcut buttons. [signal:174b3f6c-fce4-428c-a4bd-d39fea677000] [signal:31ebeb8c-d9d6-4fbd-b9e8-371ecfb5f394]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer wants radio presets to show the song currently playing on each SiriusXM station, to help decide whether to switch stations. [signal:1663d395-3531-47aa-8de8-25bd23b71df2]
A USA G60 customer says the HD radio sound quality is enjoyable. [signal:09dc1185-df0d-4943-9846-765c90815a9f]
One USA G60 customer describes problematic CarPlay audio volume behavior, including needing high radio volume and incoming calls becoming very loud. [signal:2c42d710-8071-4baa-8bb8-02d6d3f88e5e]

## Differences between markets
The AM radio requests and report of AM unavailability come from USA customers in G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:13298c8d-20c5-469c-b8ad-a2890df7904e] [signal:843514f4-6496-4bc9-9e30-29bdc78378e] [signal:fa0371c6-5a1a-4ae4-81f5-bc6a5a4d0cee]
The complaints about screen-based station selection come from Europe customers in F70 vehicles. [signal:174b3f6c-fce4-428c-a4bd-d39fea677000] [signal:31ebeb8c-d9d6-4fbd-b9e8-371ecfb5f394]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread AM radio demand or touchscreen station-selection concerns are across customers. [signal:13298c8d-20c5-469c-b8ad-a2890df7904e] [signal:31ebeb8c-d9d6-4fbd-b9e8-371ecfb5f394]
The signals do not clarify how often the reported CarPlay volume behavior occurs. [signal:2c42d710-8071-4baa-8bb8-02d6d3f88e5e]

value.title: Unwanted sensations in brake and accelerator pedals
value.summary: Two USA complaints describe a bump felt through the G60 brake pedal during low-speed braking and a sticky feel in the G70 accelerator pedal.
highlights: Drivers report a brake-pedal bump at low speeds and a sticky-feeling accelerator pedal.
The complaints are from USA drivers of the G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 driver reports feeling bumps in the brake pedal while slowing near 20 mph and 5 mph; they say braking performance is unchanged. [signal:530d295a-21af-447d-a689-1dfc117a8b89] A G70 driver describes the accelerator pedal as slightly sticky. [signal:a7be656c-6163-42b2-88bc-e4b950ef49f9]

## What customers say
The G60 driver says the brake-pedal sensation occurs during light braking from about 30 mph, is always present near 5 mph, and does not occur at higher speeds. [signal:530d295a-21af-447d-a689-1dfc117a8b89] The G70 driver calls the accelerator feel sticky, alongside praise for the car’s ride, seats, audio, fuel economy, performance, and accent lighting. [signal:a7be656c-6163-42b2-88bc-e4b950ef49f9]

## Differences between markets
Both complaints are from the USA, but they concern different vehicle lines and different pedals. [signal:530d295a-21af-447d-a689-1dfc117a8b89] [signal:a7be656c-6163-42b2-88bc-e4b950ef49f9]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread either pedal concern is. [signal:530d295a-21af-447d-a689-1dfc117a8b89] [signal:a7be656c-6163-42b2-88bc-e4b950ef49f9]

value.title: Storage space feels limited and useful compartments are missing
value.summary: Customers report too little usable storage and missing places for everyday items, particularly in G60 and G70 vehicles in the USA. Other signals mention limited cabin or interior space in Rest of World and Europe.
highlights: Customers report too little usable storage and missing compartments.
Signals include USA G60 and G70 complaints, plus broader space concerns in other markets.
One customer says in-car storage is limited compared with the E-Class.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe too little usable storage in G70 vehicles, including one report that the small center console is the only usable storage [signal:03eb517d-d0ab-4fab-9d21-d30183f52ad2]. A G60 customer says general storage feels reduced compared with earlier 5 Series models [signal:27fe11dc-182a-46d8-b055-c04d1bd3455d]. Other G60 complaints mention missing rear-seat storage flaps or pouches and difficulty finding a place for sunglasses [signal:1bcde45a-adb4-4585-8d59-3199611ff82d] [signal:27fe11dc-182a-46d8-b055-c04d1bd3455d] [signal:2c7d73de-a7c5-477b-b04f-4a4b3346373c].

## What customers say
A G70 customer says there is not enough storage space anywhere in the vehicle, while another asks for a front trunk for extra storage [signal:23d99641-12c5-4fb9-9a81-b8ee232a9aef] [signal:1c0161c4-62e0-40b4-933f-e367b14d8c14]. A G60 customer specifically says in-car storage is limited compared with the E-Class [signal:d9c772fd-a713-4755-a413-6e65b9cb21f2]. Another G60 customer in the USA wants a dedicated place for sunglasses, like the one in their Lexus [signal:2c7d73de-a7c5-477b-b04f-4a4b3346373c].

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include specific complaints about storage volume and missing or hard-to-find compartments in G60 and G70 vehicles [signal:03eb517d-d0ab-4fab-9d21-d30183f52ad2] [signal:1bcde45a-adb4-4585-8d59-3199611ff82d] [signal:23d99641-12c5-4fb9-9a81-b8ee232a9aef] [signal:27fe11dc-182a-46d8-b055-c04d1bd3455d] [signal:2c7d73de-a7c5-477b-b04f-4a4b3346373c]. Rest of World signals mention limited in-car storage compared with the E-Class and concerns about interior or floor space [signal:d9c772fd-a713-4755-a413-6e65b9cb21f2] [signal:030fd9da-f02a-4f3a-a34e-0d38948d3198] [signal:30de20a0-2729-4ffb-8ae0-1975d9124d46]. A Europe signal describes the F70's interior space as too small, but does not specifically mention storage compartments [signal:c7125bcf-6f1b-4543-8208-d85b2e0a3c33].

## Open questions
Do customers mean insufficient overall storage volume, missing dedicated compartments, or both? [signal:03eb517d-d0ab-4fab-9d21-d30183f52ad2] [signal:1bcde45a-adb4-4585-8d59-3199611ff82d] Which everyday items and locations are most important to customers? [signal:2c7d73de-a7c5-477b-b04f-4a4b3346373c] Do storage concerns differ between G60 and G70 customers? [signal:23d99641-12c5-4fb9-9a81-b8ee232a9aef] [signal:27fe11dc-182a-46d8-b055-c04d1bd3455d]

value.title: Assisted driving disengages when the car enters curves
value.summary: A G70 customer in the USA says assisted driving does not slow for curves and turns off. Other USA G70 customers value hands-free driving on highways and long trips.
highlights: One customer reports the system does not slow for curves and turns off.
All four signals concern USA G70 customers: one wish and three positive comments.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer says Assisted Driving Plus does not automatically reduce speed through curves, causing the feature to turn off. [signal:dc07ac61-1954-4f10-ab19-f16a3169ebb2]

## What customers say
One customer wants the system to slow down for curves. [signal:dc07ac61-1954-4f10-ab19-f16a3169ebb2] Three other customers say they enjoy or appreciate hands-free highway driving, including one who reports travelling from Miami to Atlanta hands-free for virtually the whole journey. [signal:025fe131-a7e9-4bc5-b969-4a8bfc127051] [signal:b7a87f31-2f96-469a-9412-aac242083fd5] [signal:dc4c78ae-ddd7-440d-9b4c-df722f98d528]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA and concern the G70; no other markets or vehicles appear in these signals. [signal:dc07ac61-1954-4f10-ab19-f16a3169ebb2] [signal:025fe131-a7e9-4bc5-b969-4a8bfc127051] [signal:b7a87f31-2f96-469a-9412-aac242083fd5] [signal:dc4c78ae-ddd7-440d-9b4c-df722f98d528]

## Open questions
How often does the system disengage in curves, and do customers encounter this in situations beyond the reported experience? [signal:dc07ac61-1954-4f10-ab19-f16a3169ebb2]

value.title: Pedal operation accompanied by brake grinding and drivetrain clicking
value.summary: Customers report noise associated with pedal use: brake grinding when pressing the brake in a USA G60, and a clicking sound near the gearbox when releasing a pedal in a Europe F70.
highlights: Brake grinding and gearbox-area clicking are reported around pedal operation.
Two complaints: one USA G60 and one Europe F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report noises associated with operating or releasing a pedal: light grinding when pressing the brake and clicking near the gearbox when taking a foot off the pedal. [signal:0ddc0034-ff08-4043-853d-ca7c0f1e7a2b] [signal:60401d04-5aa3-4f05-a695-7243fc941161]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner says the brakes make a lot of noise and describes a light grinding sound when pressing the brake pedal. [signal:0ddc0034-ff08-4043-853d-ca7c0f1e7a2b]
A Europe F70 owner reports an irritating clicking sound near the gearbox when taking a foot off the pedal, and assumes it may be the hybrid cutting in. [signal:60401d04-5aa3-4f05-a695-7243fc941161]

## Differences between markets
The USA signal describes brake noise when pressing the pedal, while the Europe signal describes clicking near the gearbox when releasing a pedal. [signal:0ddc0034-ff08-4043-853d-ca7c0f1e7a2b] [signal:60401d04-5aa3-4f05-a695-7243fc941161]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the cause of either noise; the Europe owner only assumes the clicking may be related to the hybrid system. [signal:60401d04-5aa3-4f05-a695-7243fc941161]

value.title: Accelerator response concern with no confirmed pedal fault
value.summary: One Europe F70 owner describes poor accelerator response, while a USA G70 breakdown is reported without a confirmed cause linking it to the pedals. Another Europe F70 owner values easier pedal reach compared with a previous manual car.
highlights: A reported poor accelerator response and an unexplained breakdown leave pedal reliability unclear.
Signals cover two Europe F70 complaints and one USA G70 complaint; only one mentions accelerator response.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One Europe F70 owner reports poor accelerator response, but the signal does not specify a confirmed pedal fault. [signal:5f153cf0-33ea-48d1-8d08-f043fbcb1666] A USA G70 owner reports a breakdown and parts replacement, but does not know the cause; the signal does not link it to the pedals. [signal:a97d5b3a-329c-4a58-97d5-1600b9cf6446]

## What customers say
The F70 owner says the accelerator response is poor. [signal:5f153cf0-33ea-48d1-8d08-f043fbcb1666] Another F70 owner says not needing to use the left leg makes driving easier and describes having struggled to stretch their legs to reach the pedals in a previous manual car. [signal:bc6cfba4-5f21-4114-ac90-71ee11619fdf] The G70 owner says the vehicle is running fine after service-center repairs but cannot identify the issue. [signal:a97d5b3a-329c-4a58-97d5-1600b9cf6446]

## Differences between markets
The accelerator-response concern comes from a Europe F70 signal, while the USA G70 signal reports a breakdown without identifying its cause. [signal:5f153cf0-33ea-48d1-8d08-f043fbcb1666] [signal:a97d5b3a-329c-4a58-97d5-1600b9cf6446] A separate Europe F70 owner describes easier pedal reach positively. [signal:bc6cfba4-5f21-4114-ac90-71ee11619fdf]

## Open questions
Is the reported poor accelerator response caused by a pedal issue, and under what conditions does it occur? [signal:5f153cf0-33ea-48d1-8d08-f043fbcb1666] What caused the G70 breakdown, and was it related to pedal operation? [signal:a97d5b3a-329c-4a58-97d5-1600b9cf6446]

value.title: Park Distance Control availability is valued

highlights: A customer values having Park Distance Control available.
The signal is from one USA G60 customer.
No competitor evidence in the signals.

## What customers say
