value.title: Radio reception, settings and operation are unreliable
value.summary: Customers report radio reception problems, stations or presets changing, and the radio failing to turn on or behaving unexpectedly. Reports span F70, G60 and G70 vehicles in Europe, the USA and the Rest of World.
highlights: Radio reception, saved settings and on/off behavior are reported as unreliable.
Reports cover F70, G60 and G70 vehicles in Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe radio reception dropping or failing, presets not staying saved, stations changing, and inconsistent radio power behavior. [signal:45e50b32-2e1f-4db1-b170-3811c70786a3] [signal:a730e7c5-9a86-4ba6-9b05-ef09ab25c287] [signal:b2d6b726-9994-44aa-b2ac-4ae2683bbf22] [signal:5868112d-6e10-45c2-905f-fa3b4b204ce5] [signal:a4dbbc44-3bde-40fa-b873-ca6c9e699b0a]

## What customers say
A G70 owner says radio presets do not stay saved and stations switch without an apparent reason. [signal:45e50b32-2e1f-4db1-b170-3811c70786a3] G60 and G70 owners report difficulty locking onto satellite stations or frequent loss of VHF stations. [signal:a730e7c5-9a86-4ba6-9b05-ef09ab25c287] [signal:b2d6b726-9994-44aa-b2ac-4ae2683bbf22]

F70 owners report that the radio would not turn on, that radio trouble remains unresolved, or that the radio can come back on unexpectedly after the door is opened. [signal:5868112d-6e10-45c2-905f-fa3b4b204ce5] [signal:8a7fa2fe-e35d-4808-b009-5ba7aef49b6d] [signal:a4dbbc44-3bde-40fa-b873-ca6c9e699b0a] Another F70 report says the station name sometimes stops displaying. [signal:a2349735-e26a-4fb9-aced-b39a86563f40] A G70 owner says the radio cannot be prevented from turning on when the passenger door opens. [signal:36170116-9923-4bcb-97ac-1ffd500511e0]

A G70 hybrid customer reports that AM radio is not included. [signal:9e8d576c-1077-4e9c-8ca7-d0eeee212073]

## Differences between markets
Reports cover Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:1a92a919-cf23-4cf3-91cd-ece4e2520e64] [signal:1e9c72ea-137c-41e8-9fc0-1d02c5444fde] [signal:36170116-9923-4bcb-97ac-1ffd500511e0] [signal:45e50b32-2e1f-4db1-b170-3811c70786a3] [signal:5868112d-6e10-45c2-905f-fa3b4b204ce5] [signal:8a7fa2fe-e35d-4808-b009-5ba7aef49b6d] [signal:9e8d576c-1077-4e9c-8ca7-d0eeee212073] [signal:a730e7c5-9a86-4ba6-9b05-ef09ab25c287] [signal:b2d6b726-9994-44aa-b2ac-4ae2683bbf22]

The reported issues differ by signal: US reports include reception, presets and AM availability, while Rest of World reports include radio startup and station-name display; Europe includes unexpected radio power behavior. [signal:45e50b32-2e1f-4db1-b170-3811c70786a3] [signal:9e8d576c-1077-4e9c-8ca7-d0eeee212073] [signal:a730e7c5-9a86-4ba6-9b05-ef09ab25c287] [signal:b2d6b726-9994-44aa-b2ac-4ae2683bbf22] [signal:5868112d-6e10-45c2-905f-fa3b4b204ce5] [signal:8a7fa2fe-e35d-4808-b009-5ba7aef49b6d] [signal:a2349735-e26a-4fb9-aced-b39a86563f40] [signal:a4dbbc44-3bde-40fa-b873-ca6c9e699b0a]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often each issue occurs across the affected vehicles or whether the reports share a cause. The signals also do not clarify the circumstances behind the reported AM radio omission. [signal:9e8d576c-1077-4e9c-8ca7-d0eeee212073]

value.title: Radio presets and controls are difficult to use
value.summary: Customers report that setting and accessing presets, navigating away from a selected station, and controlling radio playback can be unintuitive. The signals include reports from USA G60 and G70 customers and a Rest of World F70 customer reporting poor reception.
highlights: Preset setup, station navigation, and radio controls are unintuitive for some customers.
USA G60/G70 usability reports; Rest of World F70 reception report.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe radio presets as difficult to set up or use, and report friction with station navigation and basic playback controls. [signal:0b03d86d-490f-4219-b4ba-a6c01a89689b] [signal:12f50889-cf90-494c-8dcd-942c8c4139de] [signal:26631b48-4a02-4b11-a9e5-7aa44504c412] One customer also says the radio continues playing while they initiate a call through iDrive. [signal:2b6798ab-5d50-4a7e-ae41-791e422e37fe]

## What customers say
A G70 customer needed guidance to save SiriusXM stations as favorites. [signal:0b03d86d-490f-4219-b4ba-a6c01a89689b] A G60 customer says the favorites list disappears after selecting a station, and that returning from the full-screen station view takes too many steps. [signal:12f50889-cf90-494c-8dcd-942c8c4139de] Another G60 customer was unsure how to turn the radio off and needed to be told that the volume knob is also a button. [signal:25d2b9ae-5296-4ee3-a83e-2785e4fa9a1e] A further G60 customer says setting and using presets is not straightforward and wishes the radio worked in a simpler on-off manner. [signal:26631b48-4a02-4b11-a9e5-7aa44504c412] [signal:2e74a8db-70ae-4a50-81c3-721e99da40a5]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA signals describe preset, navigation, and playback-control usability issues in G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:0b03d86d-490f-4219-b4ba-a6c01a89689b] [signal:12f50889-cf90-494c-8dcd-942c8c4139de] [signal:25d2b9ae-5296-4ee3-a83e-2785e4fa9a1e] [signal:26631b48-4a02-4b11-a9e5-7aa44504c412] [signal:2b6798ab-5d50-4a7e-ae41-791e422e37fe] A Rest of World F70 customer instead reports that radio reception on highways is poor. [signal:f3d671ac-7c26-4f2c-8938-61ac2146a07a]

## Open questions
Do preset and navigation difficulties occur across additional vehicle lines or markets? What conditions are associated with the highway reception complaint? [signal:0b03d86d-490f-4219-b4ba-a6c01a89689b] [signal:12f50889-cf90-494c-8dcd-942c8c4139de] [signal:f3d671ac-7c26-4f2c-8938-61ac2146a07a]

value.title: Park Distance Control reacts late or stops working
value.summary: Customers report Park Distance Control sensors that react too slowly or stop providing warnings. The reports involve an F70 in Europe and a G70 in the USA.
highlights: Sensors are reported to react too late or cease working.
Reports involve an F70 in Europe and a G70 in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer with an F70 in Europe says the reversing and side-front sensors react too slowly and pick up objects too late [signal:efdd925c-c4bb-4d10-8357-315f252468cc]. A customer with a G70 in the USA reports that the front PDC sensors stopped working, with no audible or visual warnings when entering a garage slowly [signal:fcc5cdeb-2fc2-4b68-8564-dee9695ddd5f].

## What customers say
The F70 customer says they now have to look around manually because the sensors pick up obstacles too late [signal:efdd925c-c4bb-4d10-8357-315f252468cc]. The G70 customer says the front sensors ceased working about two days before reporting the issue and had not yet contacted the dealer [signal:fcc5cdeb-2fc2-4b68-8564-dee9695ddd5f].

## Differences between markets
The slow-response complaint is from an F70 customer in Europe; the report of sensors ceasing to work is from a G70 customer in the USA [signal:efdd925c-c4bb-4d10-8357-315f252468cc] [signal:fcc5cdeb-2fc2-4b68-8564-dee9695ddd5f]. The signals describe different symptoms, so they do not establish a market difference [signal:efdd925c-c4bb-4d10-8357-315f252468cc] [signal:fcc5cdeb-2fc2-4b68-8564-dee9695ddd5f].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish the cause of the slow response or sensor failure [signal:efdd925c-c4bb-4d10-8357-315f252468cc] [signal:fcc5cdeb-2fc2-4b68-8564-dee9695ddd5f]. The G70 customer had not yet contacted the dealer, so the signals provide no diagnostic outcome [signal:fcc5cdeb-2fc2-4b68-8564-dee9695ddd5f].

value.title: Pedal spacing and position cause discomfort and operating difficulty
value.summary: Three USA complaints describe difficulty using the accelerator and brake due to pedal spacing, pedal angle, or seat fit. Reported effects include contact with both pedals, discomfort for drivers with short legs, and ankle strain for a driver with long legs.
highlights: Pedal spacing, angle, and seat fit make the pedals difficult or uncomfortable to use.
Three USA complaints cover the G60 and G70; drivers with both short and long legs are represented.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Three USA complaints report pedal usability concerns involving spacing, angle, or fit with the driver’s legs and seat position. [signal:0d6804a1-afad-4a8d-a820-395cfed80660] [signal:0f8cd0e1-4628-41e0-93eb-b1299925abf3] [signal:67b3e927-9559-4783-a85e-061dcc7dd532]

One G60 driver says their foot can contact the accelerator and brake at the same time, even when positioned as far right as possible. [signal:0d6804a1-afad-4a8d-a820-395cfed80660] A G70 driver says the seat design makes the pedals difficult to use comfortably with short legs. [signal:0f8cd0e1-4628-41e0-93eb-b1299925abf3] Another G60 driver says the pedal angle keeps their foot and ankle flexed on the accelerator and reports chronic right ankle joint issues. [signal:67b3e927-9559-4783-a85e-061dcc7dd532]

## What customers say
The G60 driver who reports pedal overlap is 6'5" and asks for roughly an extra quarter inch between the pedals. [signal:0d6804a1-afad-4a8d-a820-395cfed80660] The other G60 driver describes long legs and daily driving. [signal:67b3e927-9559-4783-a85e-061dcc7dd532] The G70 driver describes difficulty for someone with short legs. [signal:0f8cd0e1-4628-41e0-93eb-b1299925abf3]

## Differences between markets
All three signals are from the USA, so the signals do not provide a comparison between markets. [signal:0d6804a1-afad-4a8d-a820-395cfed80660] [signal:0f8cd0e1-4628-41e0-93eb-b1299925abf3] [signal:67b3e927-9559-4783-a85e-061dcc7dd532] The complaints cover the G60 and G70, with two signals for the G60 and one for the G70. [signal:0d6804a1-afad-4a8d-a820-395cfed80660] [signal:0f8cd0e1-4628-41e0-93eb-b1299925abf3] [signal:67b3e927-9559-4783-a85e-061dcc7dd532]

## Open questions
Do pedal usability concerns vary with driver height, leg length, or seat position? [signal:0d6804a1-afad-4a8d-a820-395cfed80660] [signal:0f8cd0e1-4628-41e0-93eb-b1299925abf3] [signal:67b3e927-9559-4783-a85e-061dcc7dd532] How often does pedal contact occur, and how broadly is the reported ankle strain experienced? [signal:0d6804a1-afad-4a8d-a820-395cfed80660] [signal:67b3e927-9559-4783-a85e-061dcc7dd532]

value.title: Wake word cannot be changed and commands may need repeating
value.summary: A European F70 owner misses being able to change the wake word, while a US G70 owner says the assistant sometimes needs the same command repeated. Other US customers describe enjoying the feature.
highlights: One owner wants to change the wake word; another reports repeating commands up to three times.
Signals include one European F70 and three US vehicles: one G70 and two G60s.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A European F70 owner says they miss being able to change the wake word. [signal:41b5c9a5-c327-46a6-8a6c-13d00d8496a1] A US G70 owner likes the “Hey BMW” function but says they sometimes have to repeat the same command three times, which becomes frustrating. [signal:05d09eaa-edc4-4f95-af04-a76fed06302d]

## What customers say
The F70 owner specifically misses being able to change the wake word. [signal:41b5c9a5-c327-46a6-8a6c-13d00d8496a1] The G70 owner reports repeated commands, while two US G60 customers describe enjoying using or talking to the assistant. [signal:05d09eaa-edc4-4f95-af04-a76fed06302d] [signal:9a84ccd4-a7ed-4063-9988-bd0ecbccf14f] [signal:b0f6e63a-aa3f-4dfb-8239-035c85695b4f] Another US G70 customer praises the feature’s interaction with other people. [signal:67e3573d-8f9e-4970-95f2-b17a703a4607]

## Differences between markets
The wake-word change request comes from Europe, while the report of having to repeat commands and the positive comments come from the USA. [signal:41b5c9a5-c327-46a6-8a6c-13d00d8496a1] [signal:05d09eaa-edc4-4f95-af04-a76fed06302d] [signal:67e3573d-8f9e-4970-95f2-b17a703a4607] [signal:9a84ccd4-a7ed-4063-9988-bd0ecbccf14f] [signal:b0f6e63a-aa3f-4dfb-8239-035c85695b4f] The signals therefore include both a usability complaint and positive experiences in the USA. [signal:05d09eaa-edc4-4f95-af04-a76fed06302d] [signal:67e3573d-8f9e-4970-95f2-b17a703a4607] [signal:9a84ccd4-a7ed-4063-9988-bd0ecbccf14f] [signal:b0f6e63a-aa3f-4dfb-8239-035c85695b4f]

## Open questions
Do other customers also want to change the wake word, and how often do commands need to be repeated? The signals contain one wake-word change request and one report of repeated commands. [signal:41b5c9a5-c327-46a6-8a6c-13d00d8496a1] [signal:05d09eaa-edc4-4f95-af04-a76fed06302d]

value.title: PDC engagement timing and parking coverage vary by customer need
value.summary: Some customers value PDC and parking sensors, while others want earlier activation, curb warnings, or parking sensors and cameras included as standard. The signals span USA G60 and European and Rest of World F70 owners.
highlights: Customers want earlier PDC engagement, curb warnings, or broader standard parking-sensor coverage.
Signals include USA G60 and European and Rest of World F70 owners.
One European customer says other brands treat cameras and sensors as basics.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report different expectations for Park Distance Control: some value the sensors, while others want earlier engagement, curb warnings, or sensors and cameras included as standard. [signal:883835a1-8771-4157-bd1c-7d6df21dc4a5] [signal:e839035d-0329-4c4e-be21-db3f7757acd0] [signal:46fc80e9-0d18-4ba9-91b5-5b1bcff0aa3d] [signal:cffbf7cf-6b13-4240-81b4-11dd6081c4cb]

## What customers say
A USA G60 customer says PDC, despite being configured for automatic activation, engages too late; they would like it active while searching for parking or entering a garage, and find repeatedly pressing the parking-assistant button bothersome. [signal:883835a1-8771-4157-bd1c-7d6df21dc4a5]

A short USA G60 customer wants a warning when close to a curb, having hit curbs without noticing and wanting to avoid vehicle damage. [signal:e839035d-0329-4c4e-be21-db3f7757acd0]

Other USA G60 customers appreciate the parking sensors, particularly when reversing, and PDC being included as standard. [signal:46fc80e9-0d18-4ba9-91b5-5b1bcff0aa3d] [signal:9daf3fe3-997d-4030-a1d0-0604b9d8886d]

## Differences between markets
In the USA G60 signals, customers both praise the sensors and standard inclusion and request earlier activation or curb warnings. [signal:46fc80e9-0d18-4ba9-91b5-5b1bcff0aa3d] [signal:9daf3fe3-997d-4030-a1d0-0604b9d8886d] [signal:883835a1-8771-4157-bd1c-7d6df21dc4a5] [signal:e839035d-0329-4c4e-be21-db3f7757acd0]

A European F70 customer questions why front and rear cameras and parking sensors are not fitted to every car, saying other brands treat them as basics. [signal:cffbf7cf-6b13-4240-81b4-11dd6081c4cb] A Rest of World F70 customer praises the reversing and overhead camera views and says assisted parking works well, though they lack full confidence in using it. [signal:a2b557a6-b884-45be-b10b-ceafe5cc3250]

## Open questions
Do customers who want earlier activation expect PDC to engage at a particular point while approaching or searching for a space? [signal:883835a1-8771-4157-bd1c-7d6df21dc4a5]

Which parking equipment do customers expect to be standard across vehicle lines and markets? [signal:cffbf7cf-6b13-4240-81b4-11dd6081c4cb] [signal:9daf3fe3-997d-4030-a1d0-0604b9d8886d]

value.title: Wake word response is slow, inconsistent or triggered unintentionally
value.summary: Customers report slow or incorrect recognition, unintended activation, and difficulty understanding or managing the wake word. The signals come from USA G70 and G60 owners and Europe F70 owners.
highlights: Wake word use can be slow, inaccurate, inconsistent or unintentionally triggered.
Signals include USA G70 and G60 owners and Europe F70 owners.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the wake word may take a long time to respond, recognize commands incorrectly, or activate during ordinary conversation. [signal:4c2dcf2b-6026-4d71-9dae-66dc6016da78] [signal:a94e8a1a-b445-4ba1-a2fb-e6b3805cca76] [signal:fdf49ea0-1f60-46f2-8334-a3955e2339bd] One customer found the wake word responded to some functions but not others, and described the controls and menus as difficult to use. [signal:b7fcbb24-7cc5-46a2-9e8c-8d917d17f578]

## What customers say
A G70 customer asked how to activate the assistant hands-free; another thought the wake word may have been switched off and needed guidance to find its setting. [signal:2814a4a0-38b9-49c5-857f-ba37b1d2da30] [signal:4d7ebfed-953c-4118-96e3-a24f0b1bcfcb] A G70 customer said the wake word took a long time to react and asked how to make it faster. [signal:4c2dcf2b-6026-4d71-9dae-66dc6016da78] [signal:5e49d7ac-78ee-45ee-bea8-fa28f55593c3] A G60 customer said recognition was wrong with the wake word enabled, but worked properly using the steering-wheel voice button after turning off “listen always.” [signal:a94e8a1a-b445-4ba1-a2fb-e6b3805cca76] Another G60 customer asked how to stop activation when saying “BMW” in conversation. [signal:fdf49ea0-1f60-46f2-8334-a3955e2339bd]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include G70 reports about slow response, activation and wake-word settings, and a G60 report about incorrect recognition and unintended activation. [signal:2814a4a0-38b9-49c5-857f-ba37b1d2da30] [signal:4c2dcf2b-6026-4d71-9dae-66dc6016da78] [signal:4d7ebfed-953c-4118-96e3-a24f0b1bcfcb] [signal:5e49d7ac-78ee-45ee-bea8-fa28f55593c3] [signal:a94e8a1a-b445-4ba1-a2fb-e6b3805cca76] [signal:fdf49ea0-1f60-46f2-8334-a3955e2339bd] Europe signals from F70 customers describe difficulty with the controls and menus, inconsistent responses across functions, and missing ability to change the wake word. [signal:b7fcbb24-7cc5-46a2-9e8c-8d917d17f578] [signal:c1234416-971d-4157-a557-518c58be7be0]

## Open questions
How often do slow or incorrect recognition, unintended activation, and inconsistent function responses occur across the affected vehicles? [signal:4c2dcf2b-6026-4d71-9dae-66dc6016da78] [signal:a94e8a1a-b445-4ba1-a2fb-e6b3805cca76] [signal:fdf49ea0-1f60-46f2-8334-a3955e2339bd] [signal:b7fcbb24-7cc5-46a2-9e8c-8d917d17f578] What makes wake-word settings difficult to find or understand for customers? [signal:4d7ebfed-953c-4118-96e3-a24f0b1bcfcb] [signal:b7fcbb24-7cc5-46a2-9e8c-8d917d17f578]

value.title: PDC alerts and interventions are confusing or mistimed
value.summary: Some USA drivers find PDC alerts difficult to interpret, want it to activate in specific situations, or report late front alerts and unexpected braking. The signals cover G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Drivers report confusing beeps, late front alerts, and braking when no obstacle is visible.
Five relevant USA signals cover G70 and G60: three G70 and two G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers are unsure how to interpret PDC beeps or access related parking functions. [signal:122c5476-b6e3-4f87-8f59-4eb124446b3b] [signal:5dd84455-015b-4f38-9f61-b0c2cc709daf] A G70 driver wants PDC to turn on automatically when entering a garage. [signal:5feee3ef-70de-4610-93cc-53b68e83519f] Other reports describe unexpected braking during a reversing manoeuvre and a front sensor that alerts only when the vehicle is very close to an object. [signal:7ae1300a-2f01-4789-810b-8acb1e331537] [signal:885d66fa-40c0-4dac-acca-2b4d72a007fd]

## What customers say
One customer said his wife gets nervous when the vehicle beeps while she backs out of the garage; the advisor explained that a solid tone means the vehicle is within eight inches of an object. [signal:122c5476-b6e3-4f87-8f59-4eb124446b3b] A G60 customer asked what the button marked with a P and camera symbol does and was told it opens the cameras and provides access to the self-parking feature. [signal:5dd84455-015b-4f38-9f61-b0c2cc709daf]

A G70 driver reported that the vehicle applied the brakes while reversing through a curved, slightly inclined parking approach, despite seeing nothing behind; the advisor said the sensors could interpret the incline and curves as obstacles. [signal:7ae1300a-2f01-4789-810b-8acb1e331537] A G60 driver said the front sensor alerted at around three inches from an object, while the rear sensor seemed to work more effectively. [signal:885d66fa-40c0-4dac-acca-2b4d72a007fd]

## Differences between markets
The five PDC usability reports in this sample are from the USA and cover G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:122c5476-b6e3-4f87-8f59-4eb124446b3b] [signal:5dd84455-015b-4f38-9f61-b0c2cc709daf] [signal:5feee3ef-70de-4610-93cc-53b68e83519f] [signal:7ae1300a-2f01-4789-810b-8acb1e331537] [signal:885d66fa-40c0-4dac-acca-2b4d72a007fd] The signals do not establish whether these experiences differ in other markets.

## Open questions
Do drivers understand the meaning of changing PDC tones, and how to access the parking camera functions? [signal:122c5476-b6e3-4f87-8f59-4eb124446b3b] [signal:5dd84455-015b-4f38-9f61-b0c2cc709daf]

How often do drivers expect PDC to activate automatically in a garage, and how often does it fail to alert until very close to an object? [signal:5feee3ef-70de-4610-93cc-53b68e83519f] [signal:885d66fa-40c0-4dac-acca-2b4d72a007fd]

Under what parking conditions do sensor interpretations lead to unexpected braking? [signal:7ae1300a-2f01-4789-810b-8acb1e331537]

value.title: Activation word stops working or responds inconsistently
value.summary: Some Intelligent Personal Assistant users report that the activation word stops working, switches itself off, or works inconsistently. Reports come from USA G60 and G70 owners and a Europe F70 owner.
highlights: Activation-word recognition can stop, switch off, or work inconsistently.
Three relevant reports: USA G60 and G70, and Europe F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the activation word may stop triggering the assistant, that its setting may switch itself off, or that voice apps work inconsistently. [signal:57cbca28-7098-4d75-bd13-c14874ba71d5] [signal:a75411c4-d59c-44b5-89ef-f7305596ff4d] [signal:e5b90364-a86d-4663-adad-d02c9e605326]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner said the assistant first stopped reacting to the wake word, then stopped working altogether; an iDrive software update at the dealer resolved the issue. [signal:57cbca28-7098-4d75-bd13-c14874ba71d5]

A USA G70 owner reported that the Wake Word function kept shutting off; when they tried to turn on its activation slider, it briefly turned green and then switched off again. [signal:a75411c4-d59c-44b5-89ef-f7305596ff4d]

A Europe F70 owner said the Alexa and “Hey BMW” apps worked inconsistently. [signal:e5b90364-a86d-4663-adad-d02c9e605326]

## Differences between markets
The activation-word-related reports cover USA G60 and G70 vehicles and a Europe F70 vehicle. [signal:57cbca28-7098-4d75-bd13-c14874ba71d5] [signal:a75411c4-d59c-44b5-89ef-f7305596ff4d] [signal:e5b90364-a86d-4663-adad-d02c9e605326] The reported symptoms differ: the G60 issue was resolved after a software update, the G70 setting would not stay on, and the F70 apps worked inconsistently. [signal:57cbca28-7098-4d75-bd13-c14874ba71d5] [signal:a75411c4-d59c-44b5-89ef-f7305596ff4d] [signal:e5b90364-a86d-4663-adad-d02c9e605326]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why the activation-word issues occur or how often they recur after troubleshooting. [signal:57cbca28-7098-4d75-bd13-c14874ba71d5] [signal:a75411c4-d59c-44b5-89ef-f7305596ff4d] [signal:e5b90364-a86d-4663-adad-d02c9e605326]

value.title: Rear-light faults recur on new F70 vehicles
value.summary: Some Europe-market F70 owners report rear-light malfunctions soon after delivery, including recurring warnings or faults that persist after light replacements. The supplied USA G70 signals concern headlight aim rather than rear-light reliability.
highlights: Rear-light warnings and faults recur, sometimes after replacement or dealer visits.
Reports concern Europe-market F70 vehicles; USA G70 signals describe headlight aim concerns.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some Europe-market F70 owners describe rear-light faults appearing shortly after delivery, including recurring malfunction warnings and lights that do not work properly. [signal:167eb663-7854-4a48-88cd-3275d741499a] [signal:2cce3f3b-e857-4514-b586-e9f370e60ded] [signal:5b697b0d-d1ed-4b92-909f-f0d2d3b27c0a]

In one report, rear taillights had been replaced twice, but the intermittent warning returned. [signal:167eb663-7854-4a48-88cd-3275d741499a] Another owner says a rear-light unit was replaced after a lighting-system check alert. [signal:2f3e857f-57fd-4d2f-9f61-628d316dfcbe]

## What customers say
Owners describe dealer visits and frustration when rear-light problems occur on a new vehicle. [signal:2cce3f3b-e857-4514-b586-e9f370e60ded] [signal:2f3e857f-57fd-4d2f-9f61-628d316dfcbe] One owner says a dealer identified a known software-related fault but had no solution at the time of the visit. [signal:5b697b0d-d1ed-4b92-909f-f0d2d3b27c0a]

## Differences between markets
The Europe-market F70 reports describe rear-light faults or recurring warnings. [signal:167eb663-7854-4a48-88cd-3275d741499a] [signal:5b697b0d-d1ed-4b92-909f-f0d2d3b27c0a] The supplied USA G70 reports instead say the headlights are not aimed as owners expect: one describes oncoming drivers being blinded, while another says the lights do not shine far enough. [signal:65dc7af4-c0b1-4ff3-bd89-53b30ee3d3b8] [signal:e647f33b-e4d3-49d7-8987-f3af5f186f84]

## Open questions
The supplied reports do not establish how widespread the rear-light issue is or whether the reported faults share a cause. [signal:167eb663-7854-4a48-88cd-3275d741499a] [signal:5b697b0d-d1ed-4b92-909f-f0d2d3b27c0a] The USA headlight-aim complaints do not establish whether the vehicles share the same issue. [signal:65dc7af4-c0b1-4ff3-bd89-53b30ee3d3b8] [signal:e647f33b-e4d3-49d7-8987-f3af5f186f84]

value.title: Headlight performance and rear-light visibility fall short
value.summary: Customers report headlights that seem too dim or perform worse than a comparison vehicle, a reverse light that is hard to notice, and headlights that cannot be switched off in a parking situation. Signals cover USA G70, Europe G60 and F70, and Rest of World F70 drivers.
highlights: Headlight brightness and performance, reverse-light visibility, and control are reported problems.
Signals cover USA G70, Europe G60 and F70, and Rest of World F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that headlights are not bright enough or perform as well as a comparison vehicle, and that the backup light is too small and low to be noticed easily. One customer says the headlights cannot be switched off while the engine is on, causing a reflection in a multi-storey car park that makes the vehicle harder to locate safely. [signal:26a62731-e644-4e6f-bfd0-73c6c8aa9a18] [signal:b6068af3-1a39-4132-b3a9-d53bb6e372d9] [signal:d67e0a01-7cb8-492a-9e0a-28cc8b683b77] [signal:347b89a3-8ce7-4b95-a80b-5bbb154a0056]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer would prefer slightly brighter headlights. [signal:26a62731-e644-4e6f-bfd0-73c6c8aa9a18]

A USA G70 customer says the backup taillight is tiny and low on the rear bumper, so others hardly notice when the car is reversing. [signal:b6068af3-1a39-4132-b3a9-d53bb6e372d9]

A Europe G60 customer says the low and high beams are not as good as on the i4 M Lazer. [signal:d67e0a01-7cb8-492a-9e0a-28cc8b683b77]

A Rest of World F70 customer says the headlights cannot be switched off while the engine is on, and reflections in an apartment car park make it harder to confirm the car's position. [signal:347b89a3-8ce7-4b95-a80b-5bbb154a0056]

A Europe F70 customer is disappointed that high-beam assist costs extra. [signal:9bfb55e0-74cf-4f95-831e-893b0cdbfef9]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals concern headlight brightness and backup-taillight visibility on the G70. [signal:26a62731-e644-4e6f-bfd0-73c6c8aa9a18] [signal:b6068af3-1a39-4132-b3a9-d53bb6e372d9]

Europe signals mention low- and high-beam performance versus the i4 M Lazer on the G60, and the extra cost of high-beam assist on the F70. [signal:d67e0a01-7cb8-492a-9e0a-28cc8b683b77] [signal:9bfb55e0-74cf-4f95-831e-893b0cdbfef9]

The Rest of World F70 signal concerns being unable to switch the headlights off while the engine is running. [signal:347b89a3-8ce7-4b95-a80b-5bbb154a0056]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these experiences are beyond the individual reports provided. [signal:26a62731-e644-4e6f-bfd0-73c6c8aa9a18] [signal:347b89a3-8ce7-4b95-a80b-5bbb154a0056] [signal:9bfb55e0-74cf-4f95-831e-893b0cdbfef9] [signal:b6068af3-1a39-4132-b3a9-d53bb6e372d9] [signal:d67e0a01-7cb8-492a-9e0a-28cc8b683b77]

value.title: Exterior lights show condensation, faults and chipped lenses
value.summary: Customers report condensation in headlights, chipped or malfunctioning lights, and disappointment with the changed headlight look. Reports come from USA G70 and Europe and Rest of World F70 and G70 owners.
highlights: Headlight condensation, chipped lenses and rear-light faults undermine perceived quality.
Reports span USA G70, Europe F70 and Rest of World F70 and G70 owners.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report condensation inside headlights, including in both front turn signals, and one owner reported a chip near a rear light's edge shortly after taking delivery. [signal:13fae390-23d8-47bd-b0d7-6fcd7a7cfea3] [signal:2f689cb4-ab5f-4bfa-ba62-1ad070f031d8] [signal:a2bdfe51-f8a4-4864-a21e-80a54ef2ef4c] [signal:1e51e970-0e6a-4233-84d4-26df6736eee9]
F70 owners in Europe also report rear-light faults, including an indicator/light/brake warning and a rear light that was not working properly. [signal:4e2541f1-1574-4825-93fb-547434a2ca67] [signal:87d0f822-f3af-45c7-8f05-4fb255d26c63]

## What customers say
One F70 owner said condensation appeared within a week of delivery and took three months to resolve. [signal:0cb954d0-b24a-4379-8322-54f38fb562ca]
A G70 owner said condensation occurred regardless of weather but did not appear to affect headlight operation; another described condensation after driving roughly 200 miles. [signal:536ef2ab-a7dc-43b4-9fc9-afed79637460] [signal:7cf02560-9870-42ff-b26b-f0519fcb70af]
A customer objected to seeing water in the front turn signals on an expensive car; the response in that signal described the lights as vented and advised seeking dealer help if the issue continued or water pooled. [signal:a2bdfe51-f8a4-4864-a21e-80a54ef2ef4c]
Some feedback describes the changed headlight appearance positively: one F70 owner said the new look took time to get used to but was growing on them. [signal:6c2f53c7-88bd-4f0b-8f7f-27a98f56b34b]

## Differences between markets
Condensation is reported by G70 owners in the USA and F70 owners in Rest of World. [signal:13fae390-23d8-47bd-b0d7-6fcd7a7cfea3] [signal:2f689cb4-ab5f-4bfa-ba62-1ad070f031d8] [signal:536ef2ab-a7dc-43b4-9fc9-afed79637460] [signal:7cf02560-9870-42ff-b26b-f0519fcb70af] [signal:a2bdfe51-f8a4-4864-a21e-80a54ef2ef4c] [signal:0cb954d0-b24a-4379-8322-54f38fb562ca]
Rear-light fault reports come from Europe F70 owners, while a chipped rear-light lens was reported by a USA G70 owner. [signal:4e2541f1-1574-4825-93fb-547434a2ca67] [signal:87d0f822-f3af-45c7-8f05-4fb255d26c63] [signal:1e51e970-0e6a-4233-84d4-26df6736eee9]

## Open questions
How often does condensation affect lighting operation, given one G70 owner reported no apparent impact while other owners described persistent or substantial condensation? [signal:536ef2ab-a7dc-43b4-9fc9-afed79637460] [signal:0cb954d0-b24a-4379-8322-54f38fb562ca] [signal:2f689cb4-ab5f-4bfa-ba62-1ad070f031d8]
What is the scope and status of the reported European F70 rear-light software fault, which one owner said was known but had no solution yet? [signal:87d0f822-f3af-45c7-8f05-4fb255d26c63]

value.title: Exterior lighting design draws mixed reactions
value.summary: Some USA G70 owners criticize the front light obstruction and taillight styling, while other owners value the lighting details or grow accustomed to the design.
highlights: USA G70 owners flag blocked grille lights and taillight styling.
Signals span USA, Europe, and Rest of World across G70, F70, and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Feedback on exterior lighting design is mixed: some owners criticize specific details, while others praise the lighting or say a design change is growing on them. [signal:1aabc59d-7e1f-404f-9975-742f0d8aa841] [signal:7f0e5ac2-9a07-4e29-b9a8-d41ab952853b] [signal:073d8506-9cda-499c-a35b-0bff0915e10f] [signal:29d50635-5b74-4e13-b001-e4805f97be00] [signal:91e7b6fd-a957-4042-8e9e-dc1c1d796937] [signal:eee3cd23-7bdc-45f0-a0c5-338f584dbf66] [signal:f7c22ed4-0233-45e8-90d6-04d234f83f83]

## What customers say
A USA G70 owner says the front license plate holder blocks the grille lights and calls this disappointing. [signal:1aabc59d-7e1f-404f-9975-742f0d8aa841]
Another USA G70 owner identifies the taillights as an area for exterior styling improvement. [signal:7f0e5ac2-9a07-4e29-b9a8-d41ab952853b]
A Europe F70 owner says the disappearance of the old BMW signature headlights took time to get used to, but that the new look is growing on them. [signal:073d8506-9cda-499c-a35b-0bff0915e10f]
By contrast, a Rest of World F70 owner likes the taillights, and another appreciates the taillight decoration and illuminated grille area. [signal:29d50635-5b74-4e13-b001-e4805f97be00] [signal:eee3cd23-7bdc-45f0-a0c5-338f584dbf66]
USA G60 owners praise grille illumination and nighttime lighting details. [signal:91e7b6fd-a957-4042-8e9e-dc1c1d796937] [signal:f7c22ed4-0233-45e8-90d6-04d234f83f83]

## Differences between markets
The two critical signals are from USA G70 owners; positive comments come from USA G60, Europe F70, and Rest of World F70 owners. [signal:1aabc59d-7e1f-404f-9975-742f0d8aa841] [signal:7f0e5ac2-9a07-4e29-b9a8-d41ab952853b] [signal:073d8506-9cda-499c-a35b-0bff0915e10f] [signal:29d50635-5b74-4e13-b001-e4805f97be00] [signal:91e7b6fd-a957-4042-8e9e-dc1c1d796937] [signal:eee3cd23-7bdc-45f0-a0c5-338f584dbf66] [signal:f7c22ed4-0233-45e8-90d6-04d234f83f83]

## Open questions
How do reactions differ by lighting element and vehicle line, given the G70 criticism and positive comments about F70 and G60 lighting? [signal:1aabc59d-7e1f-404f-9975-742f0d8aa841] [signal:7f0e5ac2-9a07-4e29-b9a8-d41ab952853b] [signal:073d8506-9cda-499c-a35b-0bff0915e10f] [signal:29d50635-5b74-4e13-b001-e4805f97be00] [signal:91e7b6fd-a957-4042-8e9e-dc1c1d796937] [signal:eee3cd23-7bdc-45f0-a0c5-c338f584dbf66] [signal:f7c22ed4-0233-45e8-90d6-04d234f83f83]

value.title: Exterior lighting availability, operation and brightness fall short
value.summary: Customers report exterior lighting that does not work as expected, is difficult to obtain or configure, or is less bright than they want. Requests also cover distinctive lighting options and appearance across several vehicle lines.
highlights: Lighting complaints span inoperative door-handle lights, brightness, and access to or configuration of lighting features.
Signals come from Europe and the USA, covering F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
Competitor comparisons say auto high beam is standard on a VW Polo and other brands, and mention Mercedes matrix lights.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe exterior lighting that is unavailable, inoperative, difficult to configure, or not bright enough. [signal:11c5bf3c-db9b-4d39-ab31-fa8b43e8fe8f] [signal:7da27e29-2bd5-48a8-9ad4-97d345425ea8] [signal:db6320a4-04f0-4af2-a732-94f2a73b255d] [signal:3c5f8b2d-ee04-456e-ade7-59d49fe12750]

## What customers say
A European F70 owner says the illuminated door handles cannot be programmed and the dealer could not assist; another says the handle lights do not operate and was told an extended lighting pack is needed. [signal:11c5bf3c-db9b-4d39-ab31-fa8b43e8fe8f] [signal:7da27e29-2bd5-48a8-9ad4-97d345425ea8]
A G60 customer says they received LED rather than adaptive LED after asking for the best lights, while another would like slightly brighter headlights. [signal:db6320a4-04f0-4af2-a732-94f2a73b255d] [signal:3c5f8b2d-ee04-456e-ade7-59d49fe12750]
USA customers request Crystal Headlights, illuminated grille lighting, or fog lights for appearance. [signal:1ca5dff3-c624-4635-8f05-a527ef6dcfe4] [signal:598226fa-fbf8-4b93-bd7a-9db35158face] [signal:606d0d7f-10f7-4526-8af6-46f4e6cc8443] [signal:f9b12c75-d495-4308-96a5-8214ebbafdca]

## Differences between markets
European F70 signals mention door-handle lighting and the cost or packaging of automatic high beam. [signal:11c5bf3c-db9b-4d39-ab31-fa8b43e8fe8f] [signal:7da27e29-2bd5-48a8-9ad4-97d345425ea8] [signal:8eba97f5-0de7-4287-a526-7ca86fc36ee0] [signal:a4dd5944-732b-4f9e-877b-428513bb0b51]
USA signals include requests for Crystal Headlights and illuminated grille lighting, alongside a G60 request for brighter headlights. [signal:1ca5dff3-c624-4635-8f05-a527ef6dcfe4] [signal:598226fa-fbf8-4b93-bd7a-9db35158face] [signal:606d0d7f-10f7-4526-8af6-46f4e6cc8443] [signal:3c5f8b2d-ee04-456e-ade7-59d49fe12750]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common each issue is across the 22 signals, or whether door-handle lighting problems share a cause. [signal:11c5bf3c-db9b-4d39-ab31-fa8b43e8fe8f] [signal:7da27e29-2bd5-48a8-9ad4-97d345425ea8]
The signals do not clarify the availability of Crystal Headlights over time or whether requests for brighter headlights reflect a broader concern. [signal:1ca5dff3-c624-4635-8f05-a527ef6dcfe4] [signal:3c5f8b2d-ee04-456e-ade7-59d49fe12750]

value.title: Exterior lighting controls are difficult to understand or override
value.summary: Some customers struggle to find or use exterior-lighting settings, while others cannot switch automatic headlights off. Customers also report unclear feature activation and unmet expectations about lighting equipment.
highlights: Exterior-lighting settings can be hard to find, understand or override.
The case has 18 signals across USA, Europe and Rest of World, involving G60, G70 and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers find exterior-lighting controls unclear or say they cannot switch the headlights off when they want to. [signal:2bd00989-6f0a-4003-b810-df9e8e9c1236] [signal:6d08c0f9-bdb4-4cef-8ea7-3050a10e59e6] [signal:767ec968-7ced-427e-9922-b86cdd77d4eb]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer needed an explanation that setting the exterior lights to Automatic enables daytime running lights. [signal:2bd00989-6f0a-4003-b810-df9e8e9c1236]

A Europe F70 customer said the lighting-stalk control did not disable the auto headlights while the engine was running; a Rest of World G70 customer also said the headlights could not be switched off. [signal:767ec968-7ced-427e-9922-b86cdd77d4eb] [signal:6d08c0f9-bdb4-4cef-8ea7-3050a10e59e6]

A USA G70 customer needed help locating the Iconic Glow setting and learned the vehicle had to be off to switch on the grille illumination. [signal:7c88e28b-65d2-4be0-8b14-a34bb7129f6b]

Other reported concerns include a G70 customer disliking the illuminated grille’s appearance, a USA G70 customer noticing occasional front-light fogging, and a Europe F70 customer disappointed by unclear expectations about door-handle lights in ordered packages. [signal:58d3308d-f401-48b6-9375-f01f7d4dadc0] [signal:80ff15de-ca8c-413e-9686-0e06c5ca0342] [signal:f99f4719-858f-403b-9580-4625674dd502]

## Differences between markets
The sampled reports about switching off automatic or front lights come from Europe and Rest of World; the daytime-running-light setting question comes from the USA. [signal:767ec968-7ced-427e-9922-b86cdd77d4eb] [signal:6d08c0f9-bdb4-4cef-8ea7-3050a10e59e6] [signal:2bd00989-6f0a-4003-b810-df9e8e9c1236]

The sampled USA reports also include questions about grille-illumination controls and a report of occasional front-light fogging. [signal:7c88e28b-65d2-4be0-8b14-a34bb7129f6b] [signal:80ff15de-ca8c-413e-9686-0e06c5ca0342]

## Open questions
Do the reported limits on switching off headlights vary by vehicle configuration or market? [signal:767ec968-7ced-427e-9922-b86cdd77d4eb] [signal:6d08c0f9-bdb4-4cef-8ea7-3050a10e59e6]

How often do customers have difficulty finding lighting settings, and how widespread are the reported fogging and package-expectation issues? [signal:7c88e28b-65d2-4be0-8b14-a34bb7129f6b] [signal:80ff15de-ca8c-413e-9686-0e06c5ca0342] [signal:f99f4719-858f-403b-9580-4625674dd502]

value.title: Charging cable reliability problems interrupt charging
value.summary: Customers report charging cables that cut in and out, disconnect, or do not function, affecting G60 and G70 owners in the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Charging cables are reported to disconnect, cut in and out, or fail to function.
Signals cover four USA complaints and one Rest of World complaint across G60 and G70.
Tesla is mentioned as a comparison in complaints from both markets.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report charging cables that cut in and out, pop out instead of staying connected, or do not function. [signal:2cea8864-fec2-44c3-94e8-7a8e7053f6cc] [signal:3113968d-7606-4f95-b915-b83784f37d0b] [signal:4da067a0-ee5b-4b22-9dde-1bb35803d8ee] [signal:b87d5afe-c554-4a35-a5b2-386d9fbc7bd9]

## What customers say
A G70 owner in Rest of World says the cable sometimes cuts in and out. [signal:2cea8864-fec2-44c3-94e8-7a8e7053f6cc]

USA G60 complaints say the cable pops out rather than staying connected. [signal:3113968d-7606-4f95-b915-b83784f37d0b] [signal:bf0efccb-5c6e-4064-bdb2-bff3f22a1be3]

A USA G70 owner reports a red indicator on the Flexible Fast Charger and inability to charge with it, while public charging stations worked. [signal:4da067a0-ee5b-4b22-9dde-1bb35803d8ee] Another USA G70 owner says the supplied cable did not work, but a dealer replacement worked perfectly. [signal:b87d5afe-c554-4a35-a5b2-386d9fbc7bd9]

Two complaints compare charging experiences unfavorably with Tesla. [signal:2cea8864-fec2-44c3-94e8-7a8e7053f6cc] [signal:3113968d-7606-4f95-b915-b83784f37d0b]

## Differences between markets
The signals include four USA complaints and one Rest of World complaint. [signal:3113968d-7606-4f95-b915-b83784f37d0b] [signal:4da067a0-ee5b-4b22-9dde-1bb35803d8ee] [signal:b87d5afe-c554-4a35-a5b2-386d9fbc7bd9] [signal:bf0efccb-5c6e-4064-bdb2-bff3f22a1be3] [signal:2cea8864-fec2-44c3-94e8-7a8e7053f6cc] The USA complaints cover G60 and G70; the Rest of World complaint concerns G70. [signal:3113968d-7606-4f95-b915-b83784f37d0b] [signal:4da067a0-ee5b-4b22-9dde-1bb35803d8ee] [signal:b87d5afe-c554-4a35-a5b2-386d9fbc7bd9] [signal:bf0efccb-5c6e-4064-bdb2-bff3f22a1be3] [signal:2cea8864-fec2-44c3-94e8-7a8e7053f6cc] The reported symptoms differ: USA signals describe disconnection or charger failure, while the Rest of World signal describes intermittent connection. [signal:3113968d-7606-4f95-b915-b83784f37d0b] [signal:4da067a0-ee5b-4b22-9dde-1bb35803d8ee] [signal:b87d5afe-c554-4a35-a5b2-386d9fbc7bd9] [signal:bf0efccb-5c6e-4064-bdb2-bff3f22a1be3] [signal:2cea8864-fec2-44c3-94e8-7a8e7053f6cc]

## Open questions
Do the reported cable issues share a cause, or are they different failure types? [signal:2cea8864-fec2-44c3-94e8-7a8e7053f6cc] [signal:3113968d-7606-4f95-b915-b83784f37d0b] [signal:4da067a0-ee5b-4b22-9dde-1bb35803d8ee] [signal:b87d5afe-c554-4a35-a5b2-386d9fbc7bd9] What was the outcome of the Flexible Fast Charger dealer assessment? [signal:4da067a0-ee5b-4b22-9dde-1bb35803d8ee]

value.title: Charging cable release and operation can be inconsistent
value.summary: Some customers report difficulty unplugging or using charging cables, while another reports intermittent charging. Signals come from USA, Europe, and Rest of World vehicles.
highlights: Customers report difficult cable release, adapter incompatibility, and intermittent charging.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70, Europe G60, and Rest of World G70.
Tesla is mentioned in a broader software comparison, not a charging-cable comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say the charging cable is difficult to unplug: one says the vehicle door must be opened first, while another says release sometimes requires the app. [signal:073921c9-4bbf-4442-b75b-d2b62307df8d] [signal:853388c9-f15a-41d7-bf15-a270ff06cb30]
A USA customer reports that a Tesla charger with an adapter did not appear to work with the car. [signal:55d2e552-37e7-4446-85c7-d9fb5ee5869d]
A Rest of World customer says the charging cable sometimes cuts in and out. [signal:37fd98ac-5472-4124-8c84-329e7ad9af63]

## What customers say
A USA customer finds it odd that the supplied cable used with a BMW wallbox charges at 40 amps when the car can handle up to 48 amps. [signal:5f7e5a97-e6d8-4601-8fb7-f14c77e6d9c5]
A Europe G60 customer says the plastic cover removed at a fast charger swings and knocks against the vehicle in windy conditions. [signal:a18f140b-0cdd-4558-bb6b-29e106ed248e]

## Differences between markets
USA signals describe difficult release, an adapter that does not appear to work, and a perceived 40-amp limitation. [signal:073921c9-4bbf-4442-b75b-d2b62307df8d] [signal:853388c9-f15a-41d7-bf15-a270ff06cb30] [signal:55d2e552-37e7-4446-85c7-d9fb5ee5869d] [signal:5f7e5a97-e6d8-4601-8fb7-f14c77e6d9c5]
The Europe signal concerns the loose fast-charger cover, while the Rest of World signal reports intermittent cable operation. [signal:a18f140b-0cdd-4558-bb6b-29e106ed248e] [signal:37fd98ac-5472-4124-8c84-329e7ad9af63]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often cable release requires the app or whether the cause is consistent across vehicles. [signal:073921c9-4bbf-4442-b75b-d2b62307df8d] [signal:853388c9-f15a-41d7-bf15-a270ff06cb30]
The signals do not clarify the cause of the adapter issue or intermittent charging. [signal:55d2e552-37e7-4446-85c7-d9fb5ee5869d] [signal:37fd98ac-5472-4124-8c84-329e7ad9af63]

value.title: Trunk lid squeaks when opened or closed

One directly relevant report: a USA-market G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:

## What customers say

The directly relevant report is from the USA and concerns a G60. [signal:b6b1e497-7363-4236-9fec-59430c37d38a] The other supplied signals do not describe trunk-lid opening or closing sounds. [signal:a925d749-6298-495c-a43a-124fd16778dc] [signal:fd0a05fd-8451-408d-9bce-1672d9061888]

## Open questions
The supplied signals do not establish how often this occurs or whether it affects other vehicles or markets. [signal:b6b1e497-7363-4236-9fec-59430c37d38a]

value.title: Desired accessories missing, unavailable or sold out
value.summary: Customers report missing or unavailable accessories, sold-out items, and a care kit they would have preferred to receive with the vehicle. Signals cover USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles and a Europe customer with an F70.
highlights: Customers want accessories that are missing, unavailable or sold out.
Signals cover USA and Europe, and G60, G70 and F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report wanting accessories that are missing or not currently available, including a rear trunk mat, dog guard and car-specific sunscreen; other requested items were sold out. [signal:39b58d89-e313-44c1-96ce-cebd3158bd3a] [signal:6fa27251-daa1-4a90-867b-2170e1e97c5d] [signal:877666ae-eea5-4d60-b96b-37fb17c874a5] [signal:40e21d76-2057-450e-8d64-1e676997d21f]

## What customers say
A G60 customer asked about a lug adapter for changing tires; the writer said one was most likely not available because the vehicle had a Mobility Kit rather than a spare tire. [signal:152ebb08-b7af-4a0d-97e4-5d07f2a8b083]

G70 customers requested front-seat headrest pillows, a rear trunk mat for the i7, a silicone cover for the crystal controller, and a car-specific front windshield sunscreen. [signal:1dfd7548-cefc-4ad7-b30c-c766348bb201] [signal:39b58d89-e313-44c1-96ce-cebd3158bd3a] [signal:7cb7c551-90d1-4010-ac99-910b1f6f2aa5] [signal:877666ae-eea5-4d60-b96b-37fb17c874a5]

A G60 customer said a tray table and rear-seat iPad holders were sold out and had been ordered through the parts department; the customer also wished a care kit had been included in the original sales package. [signal:40e21d76-2057-450e-8d64-1e676997d21f]

A Europe F70 customer said no dog guard was available and described this as a major negative. [signal:6fa27251-daa1-4a90-867b-2170e1e97c5d]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals concern G60 and G70 accessories, including items described as sold out or awaited. [signal:152ebb08-b7af-4a0d-97e4-5d07f2a8b083] [signal:1dfd7548-cefc-4ad7-b30c-c766348bb201] [signal:39b58d89-e313-44c1-96ce-cebd3158bd3a] [signal:40e21d76-2057-450e-8d64-1e676997d21f] [signal:7cb7c551-90d1-4010-ac99-910b1f6f2aa5] [signal:877666ae-eea5-4d60-b96b-37fb17c874a5] The Europe signal concerns a missing dog guard for the F70. [signal:6fa27251-daa1-4a90-867b-2170e1e97c5d]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the requested accessories are unavailable across markets or limited to the vehicles described. [signal:39b58d89-e313-44c1-96ce-cebd3158bd3a] [signal:6fa27251-daa1-4a90-867b-2170e1e97c5d] The signals also do not establish whether the sold-out items became available later. [signal:40e21d76-2057-450e-8d64-1e676997d21f]

value.title: Accessory options, pricing, fit and availability are unclear
value.summary: Some USA customers have difficulty understanding accessory options and fit, and report high prices or delays for accessories and parts. The signals concern G60 and G70 owners.
highlights: Customers report unclear accessory options and fit, high prices, and long waits.
Signals concern USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers ask where to find accessories and whether particular items fit their vehicle, while others report limited or expensive options and delays obtaining items. [signal:12c698bc-000c-4813-8571-e95a9c06a9d0] [signal:26e05768-9ff4-4e3d-8cf1-6e5c02bc4040] [signal:31c37947-8c02-4c8c-8b23-306218e9b4a4] [signal:83e97eb5-195a-482c-80db-8c41dda37ac4] [signal:455d6ee2-e197-406c-a94a-abbd20d791f8] [signal:a9b86fb6-646f-43b2-8af6-11399ff16b6c]

## What customers say
A G70 customer asked whether BMW sells a 12V adapter with USB-A and was directed to search the online shop; the response described two adapter options. [signal:12c698bc-000c-4813-8571-e95a9c06a9d0] A G60 customer unsure how to carry a bike without a trailer hitch asked for recommendations and was told about a roof bike rack. [signal:26e05768-9ff4-4e3d-8cf1-6e5c02bc4040]

A G70 customer said the Travel and Comfort brackets were expensive and that the proprietary accessories for the seat notches were limited and high-priced. [signal:31c37947-8c02-4c8c-8b23-306218e9b4a4] Another G70 customer expected front and rear cameras from the advanced eye camera accessory, but said it came with only the front camera and that the rear camera had to be ordered separately, requiring a wait. [signal:455d6ee2-e197-406c-a94a-abbd20d791f8] A G70 customer also reported waiting about two months for a replacement windshield. [signal:a9b86fb6-646f-43b2-8af6-11399ff16b6c]

A G60 customer asked whether the rear-seat attachment mount was intended for a tablet holder and was informed of several accessory options for it. [signal:83e97eb5-195a-482c-80db-8c41dda37ac4]

## Differences between markets
The supplied signals are from USA customers. [signal:12c698bc-000c-4813-8571-e95a9c06a9d0] [signal:26e05768-9ff4-4e3d-8cf1-6e5c02bc4040] [signal:31c37947-8c02-4c8c-8b23-306218e9b4a4] [signal:455d6ee2-e197-406c-a94a-abbd20d791f8] [signal:83e97eb5-195a-482c-80db-8c41dda37ac4] [signal:a9b86fb6-646f-43b2-8af6-11399ff16b6c] One customer said the China market includes front and rear cameras as standard; the signals do not provide a separate China-market account. [signal:455d6ee2-e197-406c-a94a-abbd20d791f8]

## Open questions
Do customers find accessory options and compatibility difficult to identify beyond the cases described here? [signal:12c698bc-000c-4813-8571-e95a9c06a9d0] [signal:83e97eb5-195a-482c-80db-8c41dda37ac4] How often do accessory or part delays occur? [signal:455d6ee2-e197-406c-a94a-abbd20d791f8] [signal:a9b86fb6-646f-43b2-8af6-11399ff16b6c]

value.title: Remote engine start becomes unavailable after vehicle faults
value.summary: Remote engine start was unavailable for customers in two reported cases in the USA: one after a vehicle malfunction and one shortly after purchase. The reports describe dealer visits to address the issue.
highlights: Remote start became unavailable after a malfunction or showed repeated warnings.
Two USA complaints: one G60 and one G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Two customers reported that remote start was unavailable: one said it stopped working after a vehicle malfunction, and another repeatedly received a warning that it could not be used. [signal:00bb2efd-3b2d-4dd7-b22c-1c6d974811bd] [signal:9915bf70-9e0b-42f7-ac8a-f4aee8d76488]

## What customers say
The G60 customer said the vehicle needed dealer repair after remote start stopped working following a malfunction. [signal:00bb2efd-3b2d-4dd7-b22c-1c6d974811bd]
The G70 customer said the dealership could not initially locate the cause, then contacted BMW engineers in Germany; the customer reported that a software update installed by the dealership resolved the problem. [signal:9915bf70-9e0b-42f7-ac8a-f4aee8d76488]

## Differences between markets
Both reports are from the USA; one concerns a G60 and the other a G70. [signal:00bb2efd-3b2d-4dd7-b22c-1c6d974811bd] [signal:9915bf70-9e0b-42f7-ac8a-f4aee8d76488]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the two cases share a cause, or whether the reported software update applies beyond the G70 case. [signal:00bb2efd-3b2d-4dd7-b22c-1c6d974811bd] [signal:9915bf70-9e0b-42f7-ac8a-f4aee8d76488]

value.title: Trunk latch failures and unreliable tailgate opening
value.summary: Customers report trunk latches failing and tailgate opening functions that do not work reliably or as they expect. Signals concern owners of G60 and G70 vehicles in the USA, an F70 in Rest of World, and an F70 in Europe.
highlights: Trunk latch failures can leave the trunk stuck open or needing to be tied shut.
Signals: USA G60 and G70 latch failures; Rest of World F70 kick-opening complaint; Europe F70 opening preference.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Two USA customers report trunk latch failures: one trunk became stuck open and the vehicle was towed to service, while another was tied shut after the latch broke during a drive. [signal:429c0731-eea1-456b-bda2-3d02eaba6859] [signal:4a7a2e38-806a-4add-bf41-b073313a9c7f]

An F70 customer in Rest of World says the tailgate kick-opening function is almost useless. [signal:4bb728ae-8780-4923-b26c-cf65905d4713] An F70 customer in Europe would prefer the boot to open when the key fob unlocks the car. [signal:3bf3b8b7-7e73-4c6b-86dc-4945d3974a33]

## What customers say
The USA latch complaints describe the trunk becoming stuck open, the vehicle being towed, and another customer having to secure the trunk shut with tape. [signal:429c0731-eea1-456b-bda2-3d02eaba6859] [signal:4a7a2e38-806a-4add-bf41-b073313a9c7f]

The Rest of World customer describes kick opening as almost useless; the European customer expresses a preference for opening the boot when unlocking with the key fob. [signal:4bb728ae-8780-4923-b26c-cf65905d4713] [signal:3bf3b8b7-7e73-4c6b-86dc-4945d3974a33]

## Differences between markets
The two latch-failure reports are from USA vehicles, one G70 and one G60. [signal:429c0731-eea1-456b-bda2-3d02eaba6859] [signal:4a7a2e38-806a-4add-bf41-b073313a9c7f] The opening-function complaints are from an F70 in Rest of World and an F70 in Europe. [signal:4bb728ae-8780-4923-b26c-cf65905d4713] [signal:3bf3b8b7-7e73-4c6b-86dc-4945d3974a33]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how frequently latch failures occur, how many vehicles are affected, or whether the two USA cases share a cause. [signal:429c0731-eea1-456b-bda2-3d02eaba6859] [signal:4a7a2e38-806a-4add-bf41-b073313a9c7f] They also do not clarify what makes kick opening almost useless or whether other customers share the European customer’s key-fob expectation. [signal:4bb728ae-8780-4923-b26c-cf65905d4713] [signal:3bf3b8b7-7e73-4c6b-86dc-4945d3974a33]

value.title: Remote start unavailable or limited by battery charge
value.summary: Some USA customers want Remote Engine Start or object to preconditioning being the only option and dependent on battery charge. Other customers value using the feature.
highlights: Some customers want remote start or report that preconditioning depends on battery charge.
All six signals are from USA customers with G60 or G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want Remote Engine Start where they report having only preconditioning, or want remote start to work when the battery is not fully charged. [signal:46231da4-3a48-45ce-9626-06048c755ca4] [signal:5190df85-0284-4141-ac87-ff8c3d044bfa] Another customer asked for Remote Engine Start. [signal:56360ba0-dfe7-48c0-ab24-b31032becee3]

## What customers say
A G70 customer said preconditioning would not operate unless the battery was charged. [signal:46231da4-3a48-45ce-9626-06048c755ca4] A different G70 customer wanted remote start to work when the battery was not at full charge. [signal:5190df85-0284-4141-ac87-ff8c3d044bfa] Three customers said they use or like Remote Engine Start. [signal:925c7156-a077-4d2e-8859-64d1dd703ca0] [signal:9b7a4ecc-01b3-4623-b972-4194cf74c4fd] [signal:e2ee9438-92ca-46f8-b40a-f65567610cae]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:46231da4-3a48-45ce-9626-06048c755ca4] [signal:5190df85-0284-4141-ac87-ff8c3d044bfa] [signal:56360ba0-dfe7-48c0-ab24-b31032becee3] [signal:925c7156-a077-4d2e-8859-64d1dd703ca0] [signal:9b7a4ecc-01b3-4623-b972-4194cf74c4fd] [signal:e2ee9438-92ca-46f8-b40a-f65567610cae]

## Open questions
Do customers experience the battery-charge limitation in the same way across G70 vehicles? [signal:46231da4-3a48-45ce-9626-06048c755ca4] [signal:5190df85-0284-4141-ac87-ff8c3d044bfa] How often do customers who want remote start use preconditioning instead? [signal:46231da4-3a48-45ce-9626-06048c755ca4] [signal:56360ba0-dfe7-48c0-ab24-b31032becee3]

value.title: Trunk lid opening and closing functions feel incomplete or misplaced
value.summary: Some European F70 owners want easier ways to close the boot, while US feedback on trunk-release button placement is split. One European signal also mentions an electric boot opener as missing.
highlights: Some owners find trunk-lid closing difficult or want an electric opener; US feedback on button placement differs.
Five Europe F70 signals raise boot-operation concerns; US G70 and G60 feedback differs on release-button placement.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some European F70 owners say they lack an electric button to close the boot or a handle inside it, and one says their height makes closing the lid challenging. [signal:17384d8c-4ccc-4a3c-b349-4983b3a812da] [signal:89a6a14f-5ee9-44f3-8613-f29d3af0ff61] Other F70 feedback asks for an electric boot opener or an electric button to shut it. [signal:19e07202-f86d-403c-b496-aa40749a6996] [signal:36b73b8f-6e01-48ce-bc29-10b2407463f1] [signal:a1b39c40-f882-43af-b56e-9bc8aeb55f6c]

## What customers say
A G70 owner says the trunk-release button moved from its location in their 2020 7 Series and that they preferred the former location. [signal:110ff658-e641-404e-bdbe-e4eda25887da] A G60 owner says the button is now in a much better position. [signal:ee12c73c-8b9b-42ca-af4a-6a8d3ca61408] These US views differ on button placement. [signal:110ff658-e641-404e-bdbe-e4eda25887da] [signal:ee12c73c-8b9b-42ca-af4a-6a8d3ca61408]

## Differences between markets
The European feedback shown here focuses on missing or difficult boot-closing functions, particularly in the F70. [signal:17384d8c-4ccc-4a3c-b349-4983b3a812da] [signal:19e07202-f86d-403c-b496-aa40749a6996] [signal:36b73b8f-6e01-48ce-bc29-10b2407463f1] [signal:89a6a14f-5ee9-44f3-8613-f29d3af0ff61] [signal:a1b39c40-f882-43af-b56e-9bc8aeb55f6c] The two US signals instead give opposing assessments of trunk-release button location. [signal:110ff658-e641-404e-bdbe-e4eda25887da] [signal:ee12c73c-8b9b-42ca-af4a-6a8d3ca61408]

## Open questions
Do the different US assessments reflect preferences about button location, or differences between vehicle generations? [signal:110ff658-e641-404e-bdbe-e4eda25887da] [signal:ee12c73c-8b9b-42ca-af4a-6a8d3ca61408] How broadly is difficulty closing the boot related to owner height among F70 customers? [signal:89a6a14f-5ee9-44f3-8613-f29d3af0ff61]

value.title: Trunk opening and closing feels unreliable or difficult to use
value.summary: Customers report inconsistent foot-operated opening, unexpected opening, and difficulty closing or adjusting the trunk lid. Signals span USA G60, Europe F70 and G60, and Rest of World F70 owners.
highlights: Trunk access and closing are unreliable or difficult for some customers.
Signals mention USA G60, Europe F70 and G60, and Rest of World F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe foot-operated opening that works inconsistently, a trunk that opens unexpectedly, and difficulty opening or closing the lid. [signal:22f07760-abf1-46ad-925a-f73f879c2b9e] [signal:2a2dd530-1787-401d-9628-efc871a4e602] [signal:36fa3d9d-8882-481e-8a7d-1d0e0cf45243]

Some F70 owners also report that the opening and closing adjustment changes too drastically between settings, or that reaching the lid to close it is difficult. [signal:0020f5f4-eae9-4054-877a-9ec569fd30a9] [signal:6263bd4b-fe9d-4834-a461-55470085e46c] [signal:fd2bc3f3-92bc-4ac6-b1d2-b6e5ac824630]

## What customers say
A USA G60 owner says the foot gesture often fails, so they use the key fob instead; another reports that the trunk sometimes opens while walking behind the vehicle. [signal:36fa3d9d-8882-481e-8a7d-1d0e0cf45243] [signal:2a2dd530-1787-401d-9628-efc871a4e602]

A USA G60 customer also reports a trunk release button on the driver door that does not open the trunk. [signal:736798b4-e3c6-4094-89ce-2920e3b7cc44]

A Europe F70 owner misses an automatic-opening hatch, while another wants an interior handle to pull the lid shut because they are not tall. [signal:eec1bc6e-75e9-4e65-b60a-70e5fa3b37e1] [signal:fd2bc3f3-92bc-4ac6-b1d2-b6e5ac824630]

## Differences between markets
USA G60 signals describe inconsistent foot-gesture opening, unexpected opening, and a non-working driver-door release button. [signal:36fa3d9d-8882-481e-8a7d-1d0e0cf45243] [signal:2a2dd530-1787-401d-9628-efc871a4e602] [signal:736798b4-e3c6-4094-89ce-2920e3b7cc44]

Europe F70 signals include the absence of automatic opening and difficulty reaching the lid to close it. [signal:eec1bc6e-75e9-4e65-b60a-70e5fa3b37e1] [signal:fd2bc3f3-92bc-4ac6-b1d2-b6e5ac824630] A Europe G60 signal concerns trunk grocery hooks, not opening or closing usability. [signal:8530e75e-1fdc-405b-84a7-b4e76144abc4]

A Rest of World F70 owner says the change between trunk opening and closing adjustment settings is too drastic. [signal:0020f5f4-eae9-4054-877a-9ec569fd30a9]

## Open questions
Do reports of unexpected opening and failed foot-gesture opening share a cause? [signal:2a2dd530-1787-401d-9628-efc871a4e602] [signal:36fa3d9d-8882-481e-8a7d-1d0e0cf45243]

How common are the reported issues across the affected vehicle lines and markets? The signals include individual reports but do not establish prevalence. [signal:22f07760-abf1-46ad-925a-f73f879c2b9e] [signal:36fa3d9d-8882-481e-8a7d-1d0e0cf45243] [signal:fd2bc3f3-92bc-4ac6-b1d2-b6e5ac824630]

value.title: Engine controls feel inconsistent at stops
value.summary: Some customers want more direct control over switching off the ignition or starting after selecting “brake,” while another values the center-console start-button placement.
highlights: Customers want manual ignition shutoff and question needing the start button after selecting “brake.”
Two wishes: Rest of World G60 and USA G70; a USA G60 customer likes the button placement.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A customer with a G60 in Rest of World wants to switch off the ignition manually when stopping [signal:03074edf-8234-42e3-ba7a-55c5f95b6a45]. A USA G70 customer questions needing to press the start button after already choosing “brake” [signal:4a2f682e-8b88-45f1-8d22-14336a438c30].

## What customers say
The Rest of World G60 customer asks for manual ignition shutoff when stopped [signal:03074edf-8234-42e3-ba7a-55c5f95b6a45]. The USA G70 customer says the start-button press should not be needed after selecting “brake” [signal:4a2f682e-8b88-45f1-8d22-14336a438c30]. By contrast, a USA G60 customer appreciates that the engine start button is on the center console rather than the dashboard [signal:1dde1f2a-4868-4aa9-98f6-7e92819275ea].

## Differences between markets
The signals include a request for manual shutoff from Rest of World and a complaint about the start-button sequence from the USA [signal:03074edf-8234-42e3-ba7a-55c5f95b6a45] [signal:4a2f682e-8b88-45f1-8d22-14336a438c30]. A separate USA G60 signal values the button’s center-console placement [signal:1dde1f2a-4868-4aa9-98f6-7e92819275ea].

## Open questions
Do customers want manual ignition shutoff in situations beyond stopping? Is the concern about pressing the start button after choosing “brake” shared by other customers?

value.title: Trunk lids fail to open, close or latch reliably
value.summary: Customers report trunk lids that fail to open or latch, need repeated attempts or force to close, and in one case close unexpectedly. The supplied signals concern USA G70 and F70 vehicles in Europe and the Rest of World.
highlights: Trunks sometimes will not open or latch, need force or repeated attempts, or close unexpectedly.
Supplied signals: USA G70 (4), Europe F70 (4), and Rest of World F70 (1).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe trunk operation problems ranging from a lid that will not open to latches that fail to catch or a lid that closes unexpectedly. [signal:04435871-c90f-42dc-9144-920cd7e750c5] [signal:84c87f09-afc0-4d0f-9fcd-4d630542bec1] [signal:afe61fe3-c292-42a8-a817-06f828603b6d]

Some customers say the lid needs to be slammed or closed several times before it catches. [signal:759e9570-7fcb-4144-af2d-8664e5d33c59] [signal:c99cc934-e896-4a5e-9ca5-526e8fb1029c] One F70 customer reports the tailgate closing by itself three times while someone was standing behind the car, including an occasion when the latch hit them on the head. [signal:afe61fe3-c292-42a8-a817-06f828603b6d]

## What customers say
A G70 owner said the trunk would not open at delivery; another said the driver-door open/close button had operated only once despite trying both pressing and holding it. [signal:04435871-c90f-42dc-9144-920cd7e750c5] [signal:2eda4ca2-cdcb-4d0d-8246-ff8bbccf5691]

G70 owners also report latch failures: one was without the vehicle for around two to three weeks while a replacement latch arrived and was installed, and another had the car towed with the trunk stuck open before the latch was replaced. [signal:84c87f09-afc0-4d0f-9fcd-4d630542bec1] [signal:88a68fa6-759c-40fc-9411-150b4ddfa796] One F70 owner says the trunk sometimes will not open. [signal:a79c5b8a-77f8-4ade-a224-8474699a061d]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA reports concern G70 opening controls and latch failures, including repair and vehicle downtime. [signal:04435871-c90f-42dc-9144-920cd7e750c5] [signal:2eda4ca2-cdcb-4d0d-8246-ff8bbccf5691] [signal:84c87f09-afc0-4d0f-9fcd-4d630542bec1] [signal:88a68fa6-759c-40fc-9411-150b4ddfa796]

The supplied Europe F70 reports describe needing to slam or retry closure, unexpected closing, and a wish for a boot-close button. [signal:759e9570-7fcb-4144-af2d-8664e5d33c59] [signal:afe61fe3-c292-42a8-a817-06f828603b6d] [signal:b6db22cb-a053-4863-bf7c-a4907f1b989d] [signal:c99cc934-e896-4a5e-9ca5-526e8fb1029c] A Rest of World F70 owner says the trunk sometimes will not open. [signal:a79c5b8a-77f8-4ade-a224-8474699a061d]

## Open questions
- How often do these opening, closing and latching problems occur across the affected markets and vehicle lines?
- Are the reported unexpected closures and failures to open or latch related, or are they separate issues?

value.title: Screen casting is too complicated to use
value.summary: A G70 owner in the USA says screen casting is too complicated, so they hardly use the screen. They would prefer AirPlay support as an Apple user.
highlights: Screen casting is described as too complicated and is hardly used.
One signal: a G70 owner in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.

A G70 owner says screen casting is too complicated, so they hardly use the screen. [signal:d6bd8bfe-ddfc-419b-990d-ec13ddccff70]

## What customers say
