value.title: Remote Engine Start is difficult to find and use
value.summary: Customers in the USA report difficulty finding, enabling, and starting Remote Engine Start with the vehicle key. The signals cover G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Customers struggle to locate, enable, and use Remote Engine Start.
All six signals are from the USA; they cover G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that Remote Engine Start is difficult to find, enable, or use with the vehicle key. [signal:63d91ed3-7130-4a6c-8613-419233707962] [signal:7f26cff9-ea3b-4211-b0cd-7cbdeff48803] [signal:9a3cbfb8-4f87-4bfc-892e-cd020ed0091e] [signal:aa4994ba-6c8d-48ab-ab8e-a47da2e488cb] [signal:b92738bb-0b61-4115-bd5b-59e890e10451]

## What customers say
One customer said enabling the feature through the Climate Menu did not feel intuitive. [signal:63d91ed3-7130-4a6c-8613-419233707962] Other customers said they could not find the feature or were unsure how to use it. [signal:7f26cff9-ea3b-4211-b0cd-7cbdeff48803] [signal:9a3cbfb8-4f87-4bfc-892e-cd020ed0091e] [signal:aa4994ba-6c8d-48ab-ab8e-a47da2e488cb] One customer tried pressing the BMW roundel three times, but the vehicle did not start; a writer then guided them through iDrive settings. [signal:b92738bb-0b61-4115-bd5b-59e890e10451] A separate customer asked how to start the vehicle with the key fob and how long it would run. [signal:1ed756db-70ab-4736-855f-80da4494e9a6]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:1ed756db-70ab-4736-855f-80da4494e9a6] [signal:63d91ed3-7130-4a6c-8613-419233707962] [signal:7f26cff9-ea3b-4211-b0cd-7cbdeff48803] [signal:9a3cbfb8-4f87-4bfc-892e-cd020ed0091e] [signal:aa4994ba-6c8d-48ab-ab8e-a47da2e488cb] [signal:b92738bb-0b61-4115-bd5b-59e890e10451]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported usability issues differ between the G70 and G60. [signal:1ed756db-70ab-4736-855f-80da4494e9a6] [signal:63d91ed3-7130-4a6c-8613-419233707962] [signal:7f26cff9-ea3b-4211-b0cd-7cbdeff48803] [signal:9a3cbfb8-4f87-4bfc-892e-cd020ed0091e] [signal:aa4994ba-6c8d-48ab-ab8e-a47da2e488cb] [signal:b92738bb-0b61-4115-bd5b-59e890e10451]

value.title: Engine start button feels unclear and awkward to locate
value.summary: Some G60 and G70 customers in the USA find the start/stop button’s purpose, location, or use unintuitive. One G70 customer asked whether starting still involved a lengthy procedure, while another said the current process was explained as approaching the vehicle and pressing the button.
highlights: Customers question the button’s purpose and find its location or operation unintuitive.
Signals are from USA customers in G60 and G70 vehicles.
A G60 customer cited Tesla’s drive-away startup as a comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers question why they must press a start/stop button, find it hard to locate, or prefer its former dashboard position. [signal:bb262cb4-2cac-440f-8641-56d337ca5fef] [signal:fa719a67-5685-4899-830c-facf35b06d53] [signal:a8194b39-b52d-49a2-80ef-00a4ec09d4a4]

## What customers say
A G60 customer said the button was initially hard to find and took time to get used to. [signal:fa719a67-5685-4899-830c-facf35b06d53] Another G60 customer found it odd to press the button to switch the vehicle on and off and preferred the vehicle to power up on entry, then be driven by selecting a gear. [signal:1f540de5-27a7-461f-8c1e-c66c74242500] A G70 customer questioned the button’s purpose, saying an electric vehicle could always stay on. [signal:bb262cb4-2cac-440f-8641-56d337ca5fef] Another G70 customer preferred the engine start button’s previous dashboard location to its center-console location. [signal:a8194b39-b52d-49a2-80ef-00a4ec09d4a4]

A G70 customer asked whether the vehicle had the same lengthy, multi-step startup process as her previous 7 Series; the writer explained that the startup process begins as she approaches and that she then presses the button inside. [signal:3805ecd6-8074-48c8-a8e8-1c7c55396669]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA, covering G60 and G70 vehicles; there are no signals from other markets to compare. [signal:3805ecd6-8074-48c8-a8e8-1c7c55396669] [signal:64277793-87ea-489b-bf69-71ba5ea83bee] [signal:bb262cb4-2cac-440f-8641-56d337ca5fef] [signal:fa719a67-5685-4899-830c-facf35b06d53] [signal:1f540de5-27a7-461f-8c1e-c66c74242500] [signal:a8194b39-b52d-49a2-80ef-00a4ec09d4a4]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these experiences are among G60 or G70 customers, or whether they vary by vehicle configuration. [signal:fa719a67-5685-4899-830c-facf35b06d53] [signal:a8194b39-b52d-49a2-80ef-00a4ec09d4a4]

value.title: Starting problems leave some BMWs unusable or unreliable
value.summary: Customers report cars that will not start, take a long time to start, or cut out during startup. The reports span USA and Europe and include G70, G60, and F70 vehicles.
highlights: Cars fail to start, start only after a delay, or cut out at startup.
Signals cover 8 complaints: 6 from the USA and 2 from Europe, across G70, G60, and F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report cars that would not start, including cases where repeated attempts failed or a tow to a dealer was needed. [signal:086e0f0b-0f15-41a9-a83c-92b623d772d4] [signal:8b876f06-f81f-46f3-8ea0-ca658fc523e7] Some reports also describe a long delay before the car started or the engine cutting out during startup. [signal:11555db3-5bef-410e-a431-e871657851b5] [signal:790950e5-9e4e-4855-97df-9627e270068d]

## What customers say
One USA customer said two new 740i vehicles would not start within their first months of ownership and both were towed to a dealership. [signal:086e0f0b-0f15-41a9-a83c-92b623d772d4] Other USA reports describe a drivetrain error while the car would not start, a parking-brake malfunction message alongside a no-start, and a starting problem within the first three months of ownership. [signal:8b876f06-f81f-46f3-8ea0-ca658fc523e7] [signal:97186fc4-82d2-43fa-9215-320fa2eff14d] [signal:fe935a95-98b3-4d0c-a385-9e280d5b56ba]

A Europe customer said the car took nearly two hours to start while on vacation. [signal:11555db3-5bef-410e-a431-e871657851b5] Another Europe customer said the car cuts out when started and that a prior service visit had not changed the problem. [signal:790950e5-9e4e-4855-97df-9627e270068d]

A USA G60 owner reported that the car did not detect the digital key or key fob and could be started using the digital key card in the phone tray. [signal:effaf877-bbf6-4317-a27f-c67262b935d3] One USA G70 report describes a brake-booster-module failure that left the vehicle undrivable, but does not specifically say it failed to start. [signal:a5b71275-61ae-448f-b05d-b6184377bd02]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include repeated no-start reports, mostly for G70 vehicles, as well as one G60 report involving key detection and starting. [signal:086e0f0b-0f15-41a9-a83c-92b623d772d4] [signal:8b876f06-f81f-46f3-8ea0-ca658fc523e7] [signal:97186fc4-82d2-43fa-9215-320fa2eff14d] [signal:a5b71275-61ae-448f-b05d-b6184377bd02] [signal:fe935a95-98b3-4d0c-a385-9e280d5b56ba] [signal:effaf877-bbf6-4317-a27f-c67262b935d3] The Europe signals describe a delayed start for G60 and cutting out at startup for F70. [signal:11555db3-5bef-410e-a431-e871657851b5] [signal:790950e5-9e4e-4855-97df-9627e270068d]

## Open questions
What causes the reported no-start and startup cut-out events, and do they share a cause? [signal:086e0f0b-0f15-41a9-a83c-92b623d772d4] [signal:790950e5-9e4e-4855-97df-9627e270068d] In one case, dealership diagnostics did not identify a problem after a no-start event. [signal:8b876f06-f81f-46f3-8ea0-ca658fc523e7] Are key-detection problems related to the reported starting failures? [signal:effaf877-bbf6-4317-a27f-c67262b935d3]

value.title: Screen mirroring is unavailable or limited for some uses
value.summary: Customers in the USA want screen mirroring to be available for iPhone apps and video, including while charging, and some describe restrictions or account requirements. Signals come from G70 and G60 customers.
highlights: Customers want screen mirroring restored or usable for more iPhone and video use cases.
All six signals are from USA customers: three G70 signals and three G60 signals.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe screen mirroring as unavailable or limited: requests include restoring access, mirroring any iPhone app, watching video, and mirroring while the vehicle is charging. [signal:0b3c0e7d-674e-491d-9349-efddae905030] [signal:2514df0a-1b14-4f0f-8e6a-fe62df2e33ca] [signal:271eec1f-72bb-4691-a7e1-067a536644d4] [signal:4106c3b0-abb2-4c06-af3e-73caa601363b]

One G60 customer said mirroring video from CarPlay would be preferable without eSIM activation or a Wi-Fi hotspot, because they would use an additional line only occasionally. [signal:888db5bf-8143-4136-9b9f-704a2f0b5110] Another G60 customer was told mirroring was possible with a personal eSIM account, but not a business account. [signal:b5679a5d-5956-4304-b3cb-fac01520d22a]

## What customers say
A G70 customer wanted to mirror any app on an iPhone 16 and was told Apple devices did not currently support that functionality. [signal:0b3c0e7d-674e-491d-9349-efddae905030] Another G70 customer asked for screen mirroring to be available again. [signal:2514df0a-1b14-4f0f-8e6a-fe62df2e33ca] A further G70 customer wanted to use it while the vehicle was charging. [signal:271eec1f-72bb-4691-a7e1-067a536644d4]

G60 customers requested iPhone screen mirroring for videos or full movies, and video mirroring from CarPlay without eSIM activation or a Wi-Fi hotspot. [signal:4106c3b0-abb2-4c06-af3e-73caa601363b] [signal:888db5bf-8143-4136-9b9f-704a2f0b5110] A separate G60 customer asked about mirroring with eSIM and acknowledged the explanation that a personal account was required. [signal:b5679a5d-5956-4304-b3cb-fac01520d22a]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA; they cover G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:0b3c0e7d-674e-491d-9349-efddae905030] [signal:2514df0a-1b14-4f0f-8e6a-fe62df2e33ca] [signal:271eec1f-72bb-4691-a7e1-067a536644d4] [signal:4106c3b0-abb2-4c06-af3e-73caa601363b] [signal:888db5bf-8143-4136-9b9f-704a2f0b5110] [signal:b5679a5d-5956-4304-b3cb-fac01520d22a] There are no signals from other markets to compare.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish which iPhone apps or video sources can be mirrored, or how mirroring availability differs across use cases. [signal:0b3c0e7d-674e-491d-9349-efddae905030] [signal:4106c3b0-abb2-4c06-af3e-73caa601363b] They also do not clarify the circumstances behind the request for mirroring to be available again. [signal:2514df0a-1b14-4f0f-8e6a-fe62df2e33ca] Further evidence would be needed to understand the eSIM, hotspot, and charging-related constraints across customers. [signal:271eec1f-72bb-4691-a7e1-067a536644d4] [signal:888db5bf-8143-4136-9b9f-704a2f0b5110] [signal:b5679a5d-5956-4304-b3cb-fac01520d22a]

value.title: Remote parking often fails or causes service concerns
value.summary: Customers report remote parking that fails or has unresolved service concerns. The reports come from G60 and G70 owners in the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Remote parking is described as unreliable, including failures in tight spaces and unresolved service concerns.
Signals cover USA and Rest of World, with reports for G60 and G70.
One customer compares the experience unfavorably with Audi; another mentions Mercedes-Benz and Audi when discussing vehicle size.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe remote parking as unreliable: one says it fails about half the time and is unavailable in tight spaces, while another calls the issues severe. [signal:a51113d6-c7e9-483b-9799-5159ae0ec620] [signal:027a9248-1791-4f0b-b291-79aafb697d42]
A USA customer also reports waiting two weeks for the service center to arrange a visit related to the remote-parking concern. [signal:ea8bf6a5-1d04-426e-bb98-3e5bea78498b]

## What customers say
A Rest of World G60 owner says the paid option often refuses to work, estimates failure in about half of ten attempts, and says it will not allow remote parking in tight spaces. [signal:a51113d6-c7e9-483b-9799-5159ae0ec620]
A Rest of World G70 owner says remote parking was one reason they did not give the vehicle a perfect rating. 
A USA G60 owner reports that remote parking issues are severe. [signal:027a9248-1791-4f0b-b291-79aafb697d42]
Another USA G60 owner says they were told the vehicle needed a service visit and battery cycle, and had waited two weeks for the service center to respond about scheduling. [signal:ea8bf6a5-1d04-426e-bb98-3e5bea78498b]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include a general complaint about remote-parking issues and a report of a service visit and scheduling delay. [signal:027a9248-1791-4f0b-b291-79aafb697d42] [signal:ea8bf6a5-1d04-426e-bb98-3e5bea78498b]
Rest of World signals include a G60 owner's estimate that the feature fails about half the time, especially in tight spaces, and a G70 owner's lower rating related in part to remote parking. [signal:a51113d6-c7e9-483b-9799-5159ae0ec620] 

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why remote parking fails or whether the reported service and battery-cycle concerns are related to the failures. [signal:a51113d6-c7e9-483b-9799-5159ae0ec620] [signal:ea8bf6a5-1d04-426e-bb98-3e5bea78498b]
The signals do not clarify whether the reported issues differ by vehicle line or market. [signal:027a9248-1791-4f0b-b291-79aafb697d42]  [signal:a51113d6-c7e9-483b-9799-5159ae0ec620] [signal:ea8bf6a5-1d04-426e-bb98-3e5bea78498b]

value.title: Remote parking is valued but can be missing or unreliable
value.summary: Some customers miss a summon capability or report remote parking failing frequently, while others value the feature and describe it working well. Signals cover USA G70 and G60 customers and a Rest of World G60 customer.
highlights: Remote parking is missing for some customers and unreliable for one reported owner, despite positive experiences from others.
Signals include 5 USA customers across G70 and G60, and 1 Rest of World customer with a G60.
Competitor references include Tesla summon, Mercedes-Benz E-Class, Audi A6, and Rolls-Royce.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customer experiences differ: one customer misses a Tesla-like summon capability, and a G60 owner says paid remote parking fails about half the time and is unavailable in tight spaces. Other customers praise the feature or report it worked without issues. [signal:33508726-c2e9-449b-b8e3-fe65cb897991] [signal:bcad9c2b-3c33-4802-b410-c2f617f077e7] [signal:92e1f37e-3b2f-4012-81ca-078c899ca79b] [signal:962c973e-6fab-4062-a426-0b775886aa98]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer says they miss using a Tesla’s summon function to bring the car to them in the rain. [signal:33508726-c2e9-449b-b8e3-fe65cb897991]

A Rest of World G60 customer says remote parking fails about half the time in their experience, especially in tight spaces, and expresses dissatisfaction with having paid for it. [signal:bcad9c2b-3c33-4802-b410-c2f617f077e7]

Positive USA feedback includes a G60 owner calling remote control parking their favorite feature, a G70 owner reporting phone-based parking worked well without issues, and another G70 owner looking forward to trying it. [signal:92e1f37e-3b2f-4012-81ca-078c899ca79b] [signal:962c973e-6fab-4062-a426-0b775886aa98] [signal:aaacf33f-f80b-4000-b566-f0c1befa83ef]

A USA G70 owner also names phone-based remote control parking as a favorite function. [signal:dbcb4d67-215c-48ad-8a95-34ebfa67c8c3]

## Differences between markets
The five USA signals include one customer missing summon and four positive mentions of remote parking. [signal:33508726-c2e9-449b-b8e3-fe65cb897991] [signal:92e1f37e-3b2f-4012-81ca-078c899ca79b] [signal:962c973e-6fab-4062-a426-0b775886aa98] [signal:aaacf33f-f80b-4000-b566-f0c1befa83ef] [signal:dbcb4d67-215c-48ad-8a95-34ebfa67c8c3]

The single Rest of World signal, from a G60 owner, reports frequent failures and difficulty in tight spaces. [signal:bcad9c2b-3c33-4802-b410-c2f617f077e7]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why remote parking fails in tight spaces; the G60 customer speculates about a sensor error or another cause. [signal:bcad9c2b-3c33-4802-b410-c2f617f077e7]

The signals do not clarify whether the summon capability the USA G70 customer misses is available on any BMW vehicle or in any market. [signal:33508726-c2e9-449b-b8e3-fe65cb897991]

value.title: Speed limit assistance lacks requested automatic and audible responses
value.summary: Some US customers want the car to adjust speed automatically or provide an audible speed-limit warning, while European customers report valuing speed alerts and easing off near lower limits.
highlights: US customers report missing automatic speed adjustment and an audible warning.
Signals cover two US vehicles (G70, G60) and two European F70 vehicles.
A customer cites Tesla’s audible over-speed sound; no other competitor evidence appears.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A US G70 customer says the car lacks active automatic speed-limit assistance and does not adjust speed on its own. [signal:30847180-5deb-4767-a867-1fca09a4bc80] A US G60 customer says the car provides a visual indication but no audible warning, and would prefer a sound when exceeding the limit. [signal:a4d0ed7a-2ba1-4496-b8f4-9e011685ea58] Another US G60 customer would like cruise control to adjust automatically to the speed limit. [signal:ce9e64d1-93ca-4012-a765-12b6a8e28c14]

## What customers say
The G60 customer who wants an audible warning says Tesla offered a sound when exceeding the speed limit and that the sound would be useful in an insurance program that reduces premiums for safe driving. [signal:a4d0ed7a-2ba1-4496-b8f4-9e011685ea58] A European F70 customer likes the speed warning alerts. [signal:4d445cbe-db21-4f77-8554-53c749eef9a9] Another European F70 customer appreciates that the car starts easing off speed when approaching lower speed limits. [signal:65edfcb7-5d75-4072-911f-9fa7c8afa94f]

## Differences between markets
The US signals include requests for automatic speed adjustment and an audible warning, while the two European F70 signals describe speed alerts and easing off near lower limits positively. [signal:30847180-5deb-4767-a867-1fca09a4bc80] [signal:a4d0ed7a-2ba1-4496-b8f4-9e011685ea58] [signal:4d445cbe-db21-4f77-8554-53c749eef9a9] [signal:65edfcb7-5d75-4072-911f-9fa7c8afa94f]

## Open questions
Do customers distinguish automatic speed adjustment from cruise control that adjusts to the limit? [signal:30847180-5deb-4767-a867-1fca09a4bc80] [signal:ce9e64d1-93ca-4012-a765-12b6a8e28c14] Are the requests for audible warnings and automatic adjustment shared by customers beyond these US signals? [signal:a4d0ed7a-2ba1-4496-b8f4-9e011685ea58] [signal:30847180-5deb-4767-a867-1fca09a4bc80]

value.title: Speed limit warning repeatedly needs to be switched off
value.summary: Some European G60 and F70 drivers find the speed limit warning irritating, including because it must be turned off repeatedly. The signals describe annoyance and repeated switching, not incorrect speed-limit detection.
highlights: Drivers report an irritating speed warning and having to switch it off every drive.
Complaints come from Europe: one G60 driver and one F70 driver.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some drivers find the speed limit warning irritating; one says it needs to be turned off every drive. [signal:50007198-e3d4-47c0-812d-54c13941c9bf] [signal:6235fc6f-5fb7-46df-866d-388f2a7f7c03]

## What customers say
A G60 driver says the speed warning gets on their nerves. [signal:50007198-e3d4-47c0-812d-54c13941c9bf]
A F70 driver says having to turn off the speed limit warning every drive is irritating. [signal:6235fc6f-5fb7-46df-866d-388f2a7f7c03]

## Differences between markets
Both signals that mention the speed limit warning are from Europe, covering the G60 and F70. [signal:50007198-e3d4-47c0-812d-54c13941c9bf] [signal:6235fc6f-5fb7-46df-866d-388f2a7f7c03]
The signals do not establish whether this experience differs by market. [signal:50007198-e3d4-47c0-812d-54c13941c9bf] [signal:6235fc6f-5fb7-46df-866d-388f2a7f7c03]

## Open questions
The signals describe annoyance and repeated deactivation, but do not say whether speed-limit readings are inaccurate. [signal:50007198-e3d4-47c0-812d-54c13941c9bf] [signal:6235fc6f-5fb7-46df-866d-388f2a7f7c03]

value.title: Remote parking can be unreliable or cumbersome to use
value.summary: Some G60 and G70 customers report difficulty activating or operating Remote Controlled Parking, including failures, phone compatibility limits and a cumbersome iPhone process. Other customers want greater operating range, while one customer praises the feature.
highlights: Customers report failed activation, unreliable operation and a cumbersome phone-based process.
Signals cover G60 and G70 customers in the USA, Europe and Rest of World.
Mercedes-Benz E-Class and Audi A6 are cited for vehicle size, not remote-parking performance.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that Remote Controlled Parking can be difficult to activate or use. A USA G60 customer said activation did not work after attempts [signal:1f9478b7-a2dd-42eb-8644-5a5e871c8366], while a Rest of World G60 customer reported that it failed about half the time and was unavailable in tight spaces [signal:33a3216c-1131-4799-bfc5-59cf3f0ff5a4]. A USA G70 customer found the iPhone operation cumbersome [signal:442a4ed4-5b2f-462c-ac82-2b4d57dce7a4].

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer with an iPhone XR was told the feature requires Ultra Wide Band and that an iPhone 11 or newer has it [signal:4532f4eb-e02b-4ef8-8529-130a0936fcef]. A USA G60 customer needed guidance to confirm the feature was equipped and learn how to use it [signal:d0091994-9ab5-427f-ad6c-d41de04dd77d]. Another USA G60 customer asked whether it could move the car forward into a space and requested a video [signal:efea26d0-ace0-45d1-b5a5-1dd9b7ab3761]. A USA G70 customer wanted it to operate from farther away [signal:7717acb3-81d7-42e0-b48d-cfce4826ccbb]. One Rest of World G60 customer praised remote parking as a cutting-edge function [signal:87e9a7cd-3658-4619-ac0e-ad1e0baf364b].

## Differences between markets
USA signals describe activation and operating difficulties on G60, phone usability and compatibility concerns on G70, and a request for greater range [signal:1f9478b7-a2dd-42eb-8644-5a5e871c8366] [signal:442a4ed4-5b2f-462c-ac82-2b4d57dce7a4] [signal:4532f4eb-e02b-4ef8-8529-130a0936fcef] [signal:7717acb3-81d7-42e0-b48d-cfce4826ccbb]. Rest of World G60 signals include a report of frequent failures and a separate positive view of the feature [signal:33a3216c-1131-4799-bfc5-59cf3f0ff5a4] [signal:87e9a7cd-3658-4619-ac0e-ad1e0baf364b]. A Europe G60 customer objected to paying extra for remote parking, among other paid features [signal:be328e48-4924-411e-bccb-c1c9b9310885].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why the Rest of World G60 customer experienced failures in tight spaces; the customer speculated about a sensor error but was unsure [signal:33a3216c-1131-4799-bfc5-59cf3f0ff5a4]. The signals also do not clarify how often customers encounter phone-compatibility limits or whether the reported operating difficulties share a cause [signal:4532f4eb-e02b-4ef8-8529-130a0936fcef] [signal:1f9478b7-a2dd-42eb-8644-5a5e871c8366].

value.title: Intelligent Personal Assistant misses commands and responds inconsistently
value.summary: Customers report that the Intelligent Personal Assistant is unreliable, including missed simple commands, inconsistent responses, and difficulty changing radio stations. The complaints come from Europe and the USA, across F70, G70, and G60 vehicles.
highlights: The assistant misses commands or responds inconsistently.
Four Europe F70 complaints and two USA complaints across G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the Intelligent Personal Assistant as poor, inefficient, or unreliable, with some commands not recognized and responses inconsistent. [signal:7ec65464-920c-455d-b9ce-a1882ad2557f] [signal:bfdd74e4-47be-4fb9-883d-aa6df39bba5a] [signal:ec5d988b-2963-4766-b8bf-cdb30d535e0c] [signal:eeb38e5b-7243-4fe8-85e8-64a2373c2381]

## What customers say
An F70 owner says the assistant will not switch radio stations by voice, requiring touchscreen use instead. [signal:9c1032a4-b32e-4727-8a7b-d47bf3b1026b]
One G60 owner says “Hey Bimmer” is inconsistent and sometimes does not respond. [signal:bfdd74e4-47be-4fb9-883d-aa6df39bba5a]
A G70 owner says the assistant was used often in a previous X5M but was abandoned after a few attempts in the 760; the owner also reports frustration with which phone is selected when moving between cars. [signal:015e4763-942d-4366-9e12-e65ac28927fc]

## Differences between markets
Four complaints are from Europe, all concerning the F70; two are from the USA, concerning the G70 and G60. [signal:7ec65464-920c-455d-b9ce-a1882ad2557f] [signal:9c1032a4-b32e-4727-8a7b-d47bf3b1026b] [signal:ec5d988b-2963-4766-b8bf-cdb30d535e0c] [signal:eeb38e5b-7243-4fe8-85e8-64a2373c2381] [signal:015e4763-942d-4366-9e12-e65ac28927fc] [signal:bfdd74e4-47be-4fb9-883d-aa6df39bba5a]

## Open questions
Do the reported command-recognition and response issues vary by vehicle line or market? [signal:7ec65464-920c-455d-b9ce-a1882ad2557f] [signal:9c1032a4-b32e-4727-8a7b-d47bf3b1026b] [signal:bfdd74e4-47be-4fb9-883d-aa6df39bba5a] [signal:ec5d988b-2963-4766-b8bf-cdb30d535e0c] [signal:eeb38e5b-7243-4fe8-85e8-64a2373c2381]

value.title: Personal Assistant missing language and route options
value.summary: Customers value the Intelligent Personal Assistant’s responsiveness and usefulness, while some request Russian-language support and the ability to change to an alternate route during guidance.
highlights: Requests include Russian-language support and changing to an alternate route during guidance.
Signals include requests from Europe/G60 and USA/G70, plus positive feedback from USA/G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers request additional Intelligent Personal Assistant capabilities, including Russian-language support and switching to an alternate route while guidance is active. [signal:c4a10dc0-a877-46ac-a037-d39766466abc] [signal:d79a50dc-40eb-481d-9096-98e2ea17540f]

## What customers say
A Europe/G60 customer asks for Russian-language voice support and more fine-grained sound adjustments. [signal:c4a10dc0-a877-46ac-a037-d39766466abc]
A USA/G70 customer wants to switch to an alternate route to the same destination while guidance is running. [signal:d79a50dc-40eb-481d-9096-98e2ea17540f]
Other USA customers describe the assistant as responsive, simple to operate, helpful, convenient, effective, or something they like. [signal:1478d9fc-b167-470d-aaa0-0fe01d18db48] [signal:22d2462c-cac9-4c0d-bdcf-56f67d66add2] [signal:288561b9-d55e-4bb5-b89b-471b52fc8466] [signal:2fe33e34-fd00-4d6c-b7d8-60f624cdfd26] [signal:9bb50750-6999-42ad-8b67-39820a645cd9]

## Differences between markets
The requests shown are from Europe/G60 and USA/G70; positive feedback shown is from USA/G60 and G70. [signal:c4a10dc0-a877-46ac-a037-d39766466abc] [signal:d79a50dc-40eb-481d-9096-98e2ea17540f] [signal:1478d9fc-b167-470d-aaa0-0fe01d18db48] [signal:22d2462c-cac9-4c0d-bdcf-56f67d66add2] [signal:288561b9-d55e-4bb5-b89b-471b52fc8466] [signal:2fe33e34-fd00-4d6c-b7d8-60f624cdfd26] [signal:9bb50750-6999-42ad-8b67-39820a645cd9]

## Open questions
How broadly is Russian-language support requested beyond the Europe/G60 signal? [signal:c4a10dc0-a877-46ac-a037-d39766466abc]
How often do customers want to change routes while guidance is active? [signal:d79a50dc-40eb-481d-9096-98e2ea17540f]

value.title: Personal Assistant commands are unreliable and difficult to use
value.summary: Some customers report that the Intelligent Personal Assistant misses or misunderstands commands, responds slowly, or is difficult to operate. Reports come from USA G70 and G60 customers and a Europe F70 customer, while another Europe F70 customer values simple voice commands.
highlights: Customers report missed commands, limited phrase recognition, delays, and difficulty operating the assistant.
Signals include USA G70 and G60 reports and Europe F70 reports.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the Intelligent Personal Assistant can fail to recognize or understand voice commands, sometimes leading them to use manual controls while driving [signal:1ebd7620-fb84-46dc-a573-a255b4e4e443]. One customer also reports a delay of about 10 seconds before the navigation system prompts for a destination [signal:34370094-0716-4a59-8a18-02c0532151ee]. Another says the assistant recognizes “blower” but not “fan” for a climate-control request [signal:35847a57-9db0-4bb1-8103-772600b5c6ed].

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer says voice recognition is unreliable and that manual controls are distracting while driving [signal:1ebd7620-fb84-46dc-a573-a255b4e4e443]. Other USA G70 reports describe difficulty operating or enabling the assistant [signal:1d662eb6-aa02-4579-840e-f86320a0ebcb] [signal:0952ecb7-0f55-45de-896d-394c5f9279fc]. A separate G70 customer says microphone recognition initially failed often but later cleared up [signal:14b22966-e084-46c2-a068-d01336acede0].

A Europe F70 customer says the assistant fails to pick up a simple command about 75% of the time [signal:41c1a907-d1bb-4ba4-8dde-ccae47703ec8]. By contrast, another Europe F70 customer values the simple voice command [signal:60a4ea09-73f6-4dda-af6c-99a7c1b51da6]. These customer views differ.

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA reports concern G70 and G60 vehicles and describe recognition, operation, phrase coverage, or response-delay issues [signal:1ebd7620-fb84-46dc-a573-a255b4e4e443] [signal:0952ecb7-0f55-45de-896d-394c5f9279fc] [signal:1d662eb6-aa02-4579-840e-f86320a0ebcb] [signal:34370094-0716-4a59-8a18-02c0532151ee] [signal:35847a57-9db0-4bb1-8103-772600b5c6ed]. Europe F70 signals include both a strong complaint about command recognition and a positive view of simple voice commands [signal:41c1a907-d1bb-4ba4-8dde-ccae47703ec8] [signal:60a4ea09-73f6-4dda-af6c-99a7c1b51da6].

## Open questions
Do recognition, response delay, and ease of operation vary by command type or vehicle line? The reports describe these issues across G70, G60, and F70 vehicles but do not establish why they occur [signal:1ebd7620-fb84-46dc-a573-a255b4e4e443] [signal:34370094-0716-4a59-8a18-02c0532151ee] [signal:35847a57-9db0-4bb1-8103-772600b5c6ed] [signal:41c1a907-d1bb-4ba4-8dde-ccae47703ec8].

value.title: Lane change assistance is unavailable or unexpectedly activated
value.summary: In USA signals, one customer could not access Lane Change Assistant on their current configuration, while another was surprised when the vehicle changed lanes automatically. Other customers valued the function’s natural feel and smoother operation.
highlights: Access can depend on the vehicle configuration, and automatic lane changes can surprise customers.
USA signals cover G60 and G70; two customers reported positive experiences.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G70 customer wanted Lane Change Assistant after trying it in an i5 loaner but was told the function required the Driving Assistance Professional Package, which was not on their vehicle. [signal:80b10243-b8f6-4791-a662-717eb47fa350] A G60 customer was unaware the vehicle could change lanes automatically and wanted a more noticeable alert beforehand after a head check triggered a lane change that surprised him. [signal:90732673-95f4-462e-93ac-91a9dd4697da]

## What customers say
The surprised G60 customer reported no problems with the lane change itself and said the vehicle handled it perfectly. [signal:90732673-95f4-462e-93ac-91a9dd4697da] Another G60 customer described turning his head to initiate a lane change as natural and intuitive. [signal:6b1753be-3a3a-442c-b4ba-e7978b92d5b7] A G70 customer said the assistant operated more smoothly than before. [signal:8bbd7d35-c47c-4900-9070-4f29bd6eabdc]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA, so the signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:80b10243-b8f6-4791-a662-717eb47fa350] [signal:90732673-95f4-462e-93ac-91a9dd4697da] [signal:6b1753be-3a3a-442c-b4ba-e7978b92d5b7] [signal:8bbd7d35-c47c-4900-9070-4f29bd6eabdc]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often customers are unaware of automatic lane changes or whether the requested advance alert is a broader concern. [signal:90732673-95f4-462e-93ac-91a9dd4697da] They also do not show how many customers want the function but lack the required package. [signal:80b10243-b8f6-4791-a662-717eb47fa350]

value.title: Rear bumper scratches, chipping and rattling
value.summary: Customers report visible rear-bumper scratches and paint that seems to chip easily, as well as a loose-sounding bumper. The reports are from USA drivers of G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Reports include scratches, easy paint chipping and rattling from the rear bumper.
USA signals cover five G60 reports and one G70 report.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report rear-bumper scratches, paint that seems to chip easily, and rattling that may indicate something is loose. [signal:278d19d6-a39a-41dc-9370-e3916c94cf5a] [signal:2d4439e0-027e-4db3-bdc1-0e8b67b76f67] [signal:69f38859-3907-426c-8374-08c65042bb60] A separate report says the bumper's lower section gathers dirt and needs frequent cleaning. [signal:2d4439e0-027e-4db3-bdc1-0e8b67b76f67]

## What customers say
One G60 customer noticed small scratches at delivery and said the dealer had not contacted them to arrange repair. [signal:278d19d6-a39a-41dc-9370-e3916c94cf5a] Another G60 customer described a deep, visible scratch near the bottom rear of the car that became noticeable in sunlight the day after delivery. [signal:e9d2e4eb-14d1-44c4-8b3f-a96e3c1c8455] A G60 owner said the bumper rattles when turning or going over bumps. [signal:69f38859-3907-426c-8374-08c65042bb60] Another G60 report says the foot gesture to open the trunk only works sometimes. [signal:91429675-9953-49ad-a737-6e5edb5a05f5] A G70 customer said the backup taillight is small and low on the bumper, making it hard for others to notice when the car is in reverse. [signal:e2ec6b22-b188-4b0d-8954-43eac9b335fe]

## Differences between markets
All six provided signals are from the USA: five concern the G60 and one concerns the G70. [signal:278d19d6-a39a-41dc-9370-e3916c94cf5a] [signal:2d4439e0-027e-4db3-bdc1-0e8b67b76f67] [signal:69f38859-3907-426c-8374-08c65042bb60] [signal:91429675-9953-49ad-a737-6e5edb5a05f5] [signal:e2ec6b22-b188-4b0d-8954-43eac9b335fe] [signal:e9d2e4eb-14d1-44c4-8b3f-a96e3c1c8455] No other market is represented in the provided signals. [signal:278d19d6-a39a-41dc-9370-e3916c94cf5a]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often these issues occur across vehicles, or whether the scratches were present before delivery. [signal:278d19d6-a39a-41dc-9370-e3916c94cf5a] [signal:e9d2e4eb-14d1-44c4-8b3f-a96e3c1c8455] The cause of the reported rattling is not confirmed. [signal:69f38859-3907-426c-8374-08c65042bb60]

value.title: Speed Limit Assistant alerts and settings are difficult to manage
value.summary: Customers report recurring difficulty with speed limit warnings, configuring settings, and recognition of some signs. Signals come from European F70 owners and US G70 and G60 customers.
highlights: Warnings can be intrusive, settings confusing, and some signs go unrecognized.
Signals mention European F70s and US G70 and G60 vehicles.
One customer says a prior Lexus recognized offset signs better; another compares with an earlier BMW.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers in Europe report having to switch off speed limit warnings repeatedly, including warnings they say are on by default or return each drive. [signal:0c6ecd9d-dc97-4393-8f2b-84276c687873] [signal:1c402ee5-ad9d-4384-b798-9083019c5ebb] [signal:287c2d74-5a6d-49ce-936e-0e25a18a6ae7] [signal:53884bdc-0928-4839-87c2-9f348e826cda]
A US customer found the warning-offset setting unintuitive: they intended to set it to 10 MPH over the limit, but it alerted at 5 MPH. [signal:1b921967-d772-4963-b648-a463185e416a]
Some US customers say the assistant misses particular speed limit signs or does not update the displayed limit correctly. [signal:3caddf49-24b0-43b5-8470-3b08d7cadc7f] [signal:77a8ceb1-6102-4e06-a678-f80e27588193]

## What customers say
A European F70 owner says the warning is switched on by default; other F70 owners describe having to turn it off repeatedly or every time they drive. [signal:0c6ecd9d-dc97-4393-8f2b-84276c687873] [signal:1c402ee5-ad9d-4384-b798-9083019c5ebb] [signal:287c2d74-5a6d-49ce-936e-0e25a18a6ae7] [signal:53884bdc-0928-4839-87c2-9f348e826cda]
A US G60 customer asked how Speed Limit Assistant works; the representative explained the automatic, manual, and current-limit options. [signal:34ddbcd5-b25a-4a41-9f32-ecda1be243be]
A US G60 customer reports poor recognition of signs set back from the roadway near bicycle lanes and parked cars. [signal:3caddf49-24b0-43b5-8470-3b08d7cadc7f] Another says the car repeatedly misses two signs near home, though it recognizes other signs. [signal:77a8ceb1-6102-4e06-a678-f80e27588193]

## Differences between markets
The European signals focus on warnings that customers repeatedly switch off in F70 vehicles. [signal:0c6ecd9d-dc97-4393-8f2b-84276c687873] [signal:1c402ee5-ad9d-4384-b798-9083019c5ebb] [signal:287c2d74-5a6d-49ce-936e-0e25a18a6ae7] [signal:53884bdc-0928-4839-87c2-9f348e826cda]
The US signals include difficulty setting a warning offset in a G70 and questions about the feature and missed signs in G60 vehicles. [signal:1b921967-d772-4963-b648-a463185e416a] [signal:34ddbcd5-b25a-4a41-9f32-ecda1be243be] [signal:3caddf49-24b0-43b5-8470-3b08d7cadc7f] [signal:77a8ceb1-6102-4e06-a678-f80e27588193]
A US customer says a prior Lexus handled certain offset signs better; another says an earlier BMW 540 recognized two signs that their i5 misses. [signal:3caddf49-24b0-43b5-8470-3b08d7cadc7f] [signal:77a8ceb1-6102-4e06-a678-f80e27588193]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread the reported warning, configuration, or sign-recognition issues are across the vehicles mentioned. [signal:0c6ecd9d-dc97-4393-8f2b-84276c687873] [signal:1b921967-d772-4963-b648-a463185e416a] [signal:3caddf49-24b0-43b5-8470-3b08d7cadc7f] [signal:77a8ceb1-6102-4e06-a678-f80e27588193]
The available reports do not clarify whether sign recognition varies by sign placement, visibility, or other conditions beyond the examples customers describe. [signal:3caddf49-24b0-43b5-8470-3b08d7cadc7f] [signal:77a8ceb1-6102-4e06-a678-f80e27588193]

value.title: Lower lumbar support cannot be flattened
value.summary: A USA G60 owner says the front seats are uncomfortable for people around 5'8" or shorter because the lumbar section cannot be flattened. The owner and their husband cannot get proper back support and avoid taking the car on trips.
highlights: The lumbar section cannot be flattened, preventing proper back support.
One complaint from a USA G60 owner; the issue affects the owner and their husband.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem

## What customers say
The owner and their husband cannot get proper back support, so they use the car only around town and do not take it on trips. [signal:a3b48d88-bb37-4376-bce3-722b2a1061df]

The only signal is from the USA; there is no evidence to compare markets. [signal:a3b48d88-bb37-4376-bce3-722b2a1061df]

value.title: G70 climate complaints include windshield fogging and burning odor
value.summary: Three USA G70 signals describe climate-related concerns: two report windshield fogging, and one reports a plastic-burning odor from the air conditioning. One fogging issue stopped after a staff member explained the controls.
highlights: Windshield fogging and a plastic-burning air-conditioning odor are reported.
Three signals concern USA G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Three USA G70 signals describe climate-related concerns: two report windshield fogging and one reports a plastic-burning odor from the air conditioning. [signal:14e543cf-7d13-4c0b-a42b-1a084fd1d486] [signal:1db5b3e2-1cca-4119-98b4-5609f5d106ba] [signal:9fcdfdee-4bee-4dfd-a4dc-43aecac9511d]

## What customers say
One customer said the windshield fogged frequently around the lower center, and they used the wipers to clear it. [signal:14e543cf-7d13-4c0b-a42b-1a084fd1d486]

Another said the windshield fogged whenever the air conditioning or climate control was on; after staff reviewed the operating procedure, the windows no longer fogged. [signal:9fcdfdee-4bee-4dfd-a4dc-43aecac9511d]

A customer reported a fairly strong plastic-burning odor from the air conditioning, particularly after driving in Sport Plus mode, and had not yet visited the dealer. [signal:1db5b3e2-1cca-4119-98b4-5609f5d106ba]

## Differences between markets
The climate-related complaints in these signals are from USA G70 vehicles. [signal:14e543cf-7d13-4c0b-a42b-1a084fd1d486] [signal:1db5b3e2-1cca-4119-98b4-5609f5d106ba] [signal:9fcdfdee-4bee-4dfd-a4dc-43aecac9511d]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why the windshield fogging occurs or what causes the reported odor. [signal:14e543cf-7d13-4c0b-a42b-1a084fd1d486] [signal:1db5b3e2-1cca-4119-98b4-5609f5d106ba] [signal:9fcdfdee-4bee-4dfd-a4dc-43aecac9511d]

value.title: Lane Change Assistant is inconsistent and unclear to use
value.summary: Some USA customers report that Lane Change Assistant sometimes will not engage or stopped working after a software update; others are unclear about how activation, driver confirmation, and disabling the feature work.
highlights: Customers report inconsistent operation and confusion about activation and controls.
USA signals mention G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that Lane Change Assistant sometimes does not engage, and one customer said it stopped working after a software update. [signal:4ef9ed84-58fa-4b9a-805c-d734df05ebb0] [signal:8680e1fe-e58b-4ea7-9c24-2647c248b7fe]

Other customers are unclear about how the feature works: reports describe mirror glances, driver confirmation, and difficulty finding how to turn the function off. [signal:618b374c-3bdc-4939-a929-d1ea4081647c] [signal:c16eaad4-85f3-49b0-a379-f1b2ff2d1c70] [signal:d05c2ee4-4dc6-4d96-8248-22289c1844b5] [signal:e594aa74-240b-439c-8fca-a0bb619f644e]

## What customers say
One G60 customer estimated the assistant worked about 95% of the time but could not identify when it would fail to engage. [signal:4ef9ed84-58fa-4b9a-805c-d734df05ebb0]

A G70 customer said the feature stopped working after a software update, despite settings being on; whether it had recovered remained unconfirmed until a future drive. [signal:8680e1fe-e58b-4ea7-9c24-2647c248b7fe]

Customer accounts describe different activation explanations: one says a mirror glance confirms a lane change, while another says the driver must confirm a suggested change. [signal:618b374c-3bdc-4939-a929-d1ea4081647c] [signal:c16eaad4-85f3-49b0-a379-f1b2ff2d1c70] [signal:e594aa74-240b-439c-8fca-a0bb619f644e]

A G60 customer was unsure how to turn off the function while using highway assistant mode. [signal:d05c2ee4-4dc6-4d96-8248-22289c1844b5]

## Differences between markets
The provided signals are from the USA and include G60 and G70 vehicles; there is no market comparison in these signals. [signal:4ef9ed84-58fa-4b9a-805c-d734df05ebb0] [signal:618b374c-3bdc-4939-a929-d1ea4081647c] [signal:8680e1fe-e58b-4ea7-9c24-2647c248b7fe] [signal:c16eaad4-85f3-49b0-a379-f1b2ff2d1c70] [signal:d05c2ee4-4dc6-4d96-8248-22289c1844b5] [signal:e594aa74-240b-439c-8fca-a0bb619f644e]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why the system sometimes fails to engage or whether the reported post-update issue was resolved. [signal:4ef9ed84-58fa-4b9a-805c-d734df05ebb0] [signal:8680e1fe-e58b-4ea7-9c24-2647c248b7fe]

The signals give differing explanations of driver confirmation and do not show whether customers received consistent guidance. [signal:618b374c-3bdc-4939-a929-d1ea4081647c] [signal:c16eaad4-85f3-49b0-a379-f1b2ff2d1c70] [signal:e594aa74-240b-439c-8fca-a0bb619f644e]

value.title: Cabin cooling and heating feel weak or slow
value.summary: Customers report slow cabin cooling, weak airflow or heating, and difficulty directing cool air. These concerns appear in USA and Rest of World reports, while a Europe report objects to single-zone air conditioning.
highlights: Slow cooling, weak airflow and heating, and unsatisfying air direction.
Reports cover USA and Rest of World G70, G60 and F70 vehicles, plus Europe F70.
A USA customer says Mercedes cools the vehicle better.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe slow cabin cooldown, weak air conditioning or airflow, and warm air that takes time to arrive or feels weak. [signal:26b398d3-d1c3-40a3-8b0a-bddb677f23eb] [signal:37d4a8fa-1887-4303-91a2-06f0be3f82ff] [signal:2064369b-f830-46a2-8e85-c046fa7e3038]
Some also say cool air does not reach them well or cannot be directed at one person. [signal:6cd52de3-dfac-459d-90c4-59cfa86e19aa] [signal:47a24b5e-a2ae-48d8-b9ae-4ae7446239e0]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer says the cabin takes a long time to cool even with the air conditioning set to maximum. [signal:26b398d3-d1c3-40a3-8b0a-bddb677f23eb]
A USA G60 customer says cooling takes time and is especially important in Florida's intense heat. [signal:50b15872-6099-44f7-ac6f-51b3bdd048b7]
A Rest of World G60 customer reports that the heater starts slowly and the warm air feels weak. [signal:2064369b-f830-46a2-8e85-c046fa7e3038]
A USA G70 customer compares the system unfavorably with Mercedes, saying Mercedes cools the vehicle better. [signal:40d12075-56a9-43a3-ad6a-948aeb851e5a]

## Differences between markets
USA reports include slow cooling, weak overall effect, and difficulty directing or circulating air. [signal:26b398d3-d1c3-40a3-8b0a-bddb677f23eb] [signal:37d4a8fa-1887-4303-91a2-06f0be3f82ff] [signal:47a24b5e-a2ae-48d8-b9ae-4ae7446239e0]
Rest of World reports describe weak or slow heating in a G60 and poor reach of cool air in an F70. [signal:2064369b-f830-46a2-8e85-c046fa7e3038] [signal:6cd52de3-dfac-459d-90c4-59cfa86e19aa]
A Europe F70 customer criticizes the single-zone air conditioning as extremely poor. [signal:84a0d159-d912-4bf0-9aa9-b4fadb6d61c4]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread each concern is across markets or vehicle lines. [signal:26b398d3-d1c3-40a3-8b0a-bddb677f23eb] [signal:50b15872-6099-44f7-ac6f-51b3bdd048b7] [signal:6cd52de3-dfac-459d-90c4-59cfa86e19aa]
The signals do not clarify whether reports of weak performance reflect cooling capacity, airflow distribution, or both. [signal:37d4a8fa-1887-4303-91a2-06f0be3f82ff] [signal:40d12075-56a9-43a3-ad6a-948aeb851e5a]

value.title: Front lumbar support cannot be adjusted enough for some drivers
value.summary: Some front-seat occupants report missing or insufficient lumbar adjustment, leaving them without proper back support. The complaints come from USA drivers of the G70 and G60.
highlights: Front lumbar support is absent or cannot be adjusted to a comfortable position.
Two USA complaints: one each for the G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One G70 owner says the front seats do not offer lumbar adjustment [signal:3bf2f3d2-aa57-45c1-b35c-c8f0732c7656]. A G60 owner says the lumbar section cannot be flattened enough to provide proper back support [signal:fd6cb322-f2b8-4730-abb4-645d96ee7654].

## What customers say
The G60 owner reports that the front seats are extremely uncomfortable for occupants around 5'8" or shorter, and says the lack of proper back support limits their use of the car to local trips [signal:fd6cb322-f2b8-4730-abb4-645d96ee7654]. The G70 owner mentions missing lumbar adjustment but gives no further detail about its effect on comfort [signal:3bf2f3d2-aa57-45c1-b35c-c8f0732c7656].

## Differences between markets
Both complaints are from the USA, one for the G70 and one for the G60; the signals do not provide evidence from other markets [signal:3bf2f3d2-aa57-45c1-b35c-c8f0732c7656] [signal:fd6cb322-f2b8-4730-abb4-645d96ee7654].

## Open questions
Do other G70 or G60 occupants report similar lumbar-support limitations? [signal:3bf2f3d2-aa57-45c1-b35c-c8f0732c7656] [signal:fd6cb322-f2b8-4730-abb4-645d96ee7654]
Do the reported limitations differ by occupant height or preferred lumbar position? [signal:fd6cb322-f2b8-4730-abb4-645d96ee7654]

value.title: Climate control usability and availability vary across vehicles
value.summary: Customers report climate control that is difficult to use, lacks desired functions or rear-seat coverage, or does not behave consistently. Signals span USA G60 and G70 and Europe F70 vehicles.
highlights: Climate controls are difficult to use or lack desired functions and coverage.
Supplied signals: USA G60 (5), G70 (1); Europe F70 (6).
One customer compares the missing dog mode with Tesla; no other competitor evidence.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe climate control concerns including difficult airflow adjustment, limited manual controls, unavailable rear air conditioning, and inconsistent operation. [signal:54937859-1c15-4631-87cd-8ace78366065] [signal:922222fe-ba68-45c6-b627-d18ea5a0e2fd] [signal:49a446b7-bea1-456e-8152-0c72b7731660] [signal:318f3a81-c267-4b2e-be20-9ecf170713d0]
Some customers also want climate to remain active for a pet in the vehicle or want separate rear-seat controls. [signal:29b84f41-78e1-44dd-808e-231625241554] [signal:65973304-36d2-48fe-9c8d-d2559b050cde]

## What customers say
A G60 customer says airflow direction is less straightforward than in previous German cars. [signal:54937859-1c15-4631-87cd-8ace78366065]
F70 customers request standard dual-zone climate and more manual heating or air-conditioning controls. [signal:8b765996-61f0-4de5-a9c7-8e462799d965] [signal:922222fe-ba68-45c6-b627-d18ea5a0e2fd] [signal:fa7c0c7f-4293-4cbc-95b4-f5676533b9b4]
A G60 owner misses Tesla's dog mode, while another asks for a mode that keeps climate control operating when leaving a dog in the car. [signal:67bae765-9c4e-4742-aada-fd48c749a62d] [signal:29b84f41-78e1-44dd-808e-231625241554]

## Differences between markets
USA signals include requests for pet mode and physical rear-seat climate controls, as well as complaints about airflow adjustment and climate synchronization. [signal:29b84f41-78e1-44dd-808e-231625241554] [signal:65973304-36d2-48fe-9c8d-d2559b050cde] [signal:54937859-1c15-4631-87cd-8ace78366065] [signal:318f3a81-c267-4b2e-be20-9ecf170713d0]
Europe F70 signals include requests for rear air conditioning, dual-zone climate, and more manual controls. [signal:49a446b7-bea1-456e-8152-0c72b7731660] [signal:8b765996-61f0-4de5-a9c7-8e462799d965] [signal:922222fe-ba68-45c6-b627-d18ea5a0e2fd] [signal:fa7c0c7f-4293-4cbc-95b4-f5676533b9b4]
The F70 feedback is not unanimous: several customers criticize climate features or controls, while another says the air conditioning works very well in hot weather. [signal:49a446b7-bea1-456e-8152-0c72b7731660] [signal:8b765996-61f0-4de5-a9c7-8e462799d965] [signal:922222fe-ba68-45c6-b627-d18ea5a0e2fd] [signal:674c2bf9-8806-4296-83d3-628ebbef80c7]

## Open questions
Which climate-control concerns apply across vehicle lines, and which are specific to individual models or equipment? [signal:54937859-1c15-4631-87cd-8ace78366065] [signal:49a446b7-bea1-456e-8152-0c72b7731660]
How often does climate synchronization fail, and under what conditions? [signal:318f3a81-c267-4b2e-be20-9ecf170713d0]

value.title: Climate controls are confusing and airflow is hard to adjust
value.summary: Customers report confusing climate-control behavior, missing or difficult-to-find controls, and limited vent adjustment. Signals come from USA G70/G60 and Europe F70 owners, with concerns varying by vehicle and issue.
highlights: Climate settings, automatic behavior, and airflow controls are difficult or frustrating to use.
Signals describe USA G70/G60 and Europe F70 owners; no counts by vehicle or market are provided.
One Europe F70 owner says its A/C cools less well than an older 420i and a MINI.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe climate-control usability issues including temperature settings that stay linked, difficulty finding or adjusting vents, and climate functions behaving unexpectedly. [signal:155dca55-4c45-45f8-a420-3fa62ca2b983] [signal:2a3a077a-de08-4f6a-b0b5-05d4e6f8b704] [signal:5d640065-9533-4491-9894-bafaa07e8326] [signal:08b27138-3d42-4e7b-9568-8310a5f5db13]

Some owners also object to climate settings being touchscreen-only, while another says heated seats and the steering wheel turn on automatically at vehicle start. [signal:2c864a15-3960-4067-8ecd-6022160bbb63] [signal:1e063909-3158-425b-9022-a2c267cf4cc5]

## What customers say
An F70 owner says they cannot find a sync-off control and cannot set driver and passenger temperatures independently. [signal:155dca55-4c45-45f8-a420-3fa62ca2b983]

A G70 owner says they have not figured out where the vents are, while another describes the vent adjustment range as very limited. [signal:2a3a077a-de08-4f6a-b0b5-05d4e6f8b704] [signal:5d640065-9533-4491-9894-bafaa07e8326]

A G70 customer reports that A/C switches off again after being turned on; the service writer suggested the Automatic Program might be involved. [signal:08b27138-3d42-4e7b-9568-8310a5f5db13]

An F70 owner says the A/C is loud and cools less effectively than their previous 420i and their MINI. [signal:1eaccb51-ede8-4a35-804d-2fd3b70bae80]

## Differences between markets
The supplied USA examples include G70 reports about A/C switching off, automatic heated functions, and vent location or adjustment; a G60 owner gives a general complaint about the heating and cooling setup. [signal:08b27138-3d42-4e7b-9568-8310a5f5db13] [signal:1e063909-3158-425b-9022-a2c267cf4cc5] [signal:2a3a077a-de08-4f6a-b0b5-05d4e6f8b704] [signal:5d640065-9533-4491-9894-bafaa07e8326] [signal:0f48d060-a8c1-4750-8307-720cbf786b43]

The supplied Europe examples include F70 concerns about linked temperature settings, touchscreen controls, and A/C noise or cooling performance. [signal:155dca55-4c45-45f8-a420-3fa62ca2b983] [signal:2c864a15-3960-4067-8ecd-6022160bbb63] [signal:1eaccb51-ede8-4a35-804d-2fd3b70bae80]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common each issue is across the 27 case signals, or whether the reported behavior differs by vehicle configuration. [signal:08b27138-3d42-4e7b-9568-8310a5f5db13] [signal:155dca55-4c45-45f8-a420-3fa62ca2b983]

The A/C shutoff report includes a service writer's possible explanation involving the Automatic Program, but the supplied quote does not confirm the cause. [signal:08b27138-3d42-4e7b-9568-8310a5f5db13]

value.title: Climate control faults and missing functions
value.summary: Customers report climate control that produces warm or hot air, does not retain sync settings, or is unavailable to passengers after the driver exits. Other complaints concern separate driver and passenger temperature control being absent or optional.
highlights: Climate control reports include warm air, hot air, lost sync settings, and passenger loss of A/C.
Signals cover five USA complaints on G60/G70 and four Europe complaints on F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe climate control that does not behave as expected: A/C has reportedly produced warm or hot air, sync settings do not stay as desired, and passengers can be left without A/C when the driver exits. [signal:1d137f93-0ac3-4673-a047-d2a8cc6118ca] [signal:80b1e083-1657-4b9d-a756-06fe9dbccbe6] [signal:40a90190-a595-4e85-ace7-3747ce777379] [signal:863da83c-7f0b-423d-8844-2244e44880ec]

Some F70 customers instead describe a missing or optional function: separate driver and passenger temperature settings. [signal:c3d7a286-4f0d-4a27-afbd-a01810298939] [signal:e12f3e41-8504-4a77-a66c-77762f9d730e]

## What customers say
A G60 customer reported warm air during a road trip and said the issue had occurred earlier as well. [signal:1d137f93-0ac3-4673-a047-d2a8cc6118ca] A G70 customer said Max A/C had blown hot air since vehicle purchase. [signal:80b1e083-1657-4b9d-a756-06fe9dbccbe6]

Customers also report that climate sync does not stay set, cannot be locked on or off, or cannot be unsynced. [signal:1baaa9c0-7b37-49ee-8af6-97502945fe05] [signal:40a90190-a595-4e85-ace7-3747ce777379] [signal:3c52d31b-c7c6-4e9a-bddd-9c16bb2dc64e] One G70 customer said the car powers down when the driver exits, leaving passengers without A/C. [signal:863da83c-7f0b-423d-8844-2244e44880ec]

F70 customers were unhappy that dual climate control was not standard, and one said they learned after four service-centre visits that separate temperature settings were an optional extra. [signal:c3d7a286-4f0d-4a27-afbd-a01810298939] [signal:e12f3e41-8504-4a77-a66c-77762f9d730e]

## Differences between markets
The USA signals include reports of warm or hot air, sync settings that do not stay as desired, and passengers losing A/C when the driver exits. [signal:1d137f93-0ac3-4673-a047-d2a8cc6118ca] [signal:80b1e083-1657-4b9d-a756-06fe9dbccbe6] [signal:40a90190-a595-4e85-ace7-3747ce777379] [signal:863da83c-7f0b-423d-8844-2244e44880ec]

The Europe signals include a complaint that climate sync cannot be undone, alongside complaints that dual climate control or separate temperature settings are not standard. [signal:3c52d31b-c7c6-4e9a-bddd-9c16bb2dc64e] [signal:c3d7a286-4f0d-4a27-afbd-a01810298939] [signal:e12f3e41-8504-4a77-a66c-77762f9d730e] The signals therefore describe both reported operating faults and differences in available climate functions; they do not establish whether these are the same issue. [signal:1d137f93-0ac3-4673-a047-d2a8cc6118ca] [signal:c3d7a286-4f0d-4a27-afbd-a01810298939]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often the warm-air reports occur, whether they share a cause, or whether sync-setting complaints reflect a fault or expected system behavior. [signal:1d137f93-0ac3-4673-a047-d2a8cc6118ca] [signal:80b1e083-1657-4b9d-a756-06fe9dbccbe6] [signal:40a90190-a595-4e85-ace7-3747ce777379] [signal:3c52d31b-c7c6-4e9a-bddd-9c16bb2dc64e]

value.title: Hood alerts and difficult opening or closing
value.summary: Some US G70 and G60 owners report a false hood-open alert or difficulty opening and securely closing the hood. These issues caused repeated dealer visits for one owner and repeated attempts to operate the hood for others.
highlights: False hood alerts and difficult opening or closing are reported.
Three US signals mention hood issues across G70 and G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Owners report a hood-open alert despite the hood being closed, difficulty releasing or opening the hood, and needing multiple attempts or force to close it securely. [signal:cef91086-b93a-4b5b-adae-53b38b354b6a] [signal:d082c2c3-21ad-47ea-a39c-8f5b177492ac] [signal:dd9f6d9a-c4e1-4980-911e-13c1b78e4299]

## What customers say
One G70 owner says a faulty sensor triggered a hood-open alert while traveling, leading to three dealer visits. [signal:cef91086-b93a-4b5b-adae-53b38b354b6a]
A G70 owner says the hood release is hard to operate and the hood does not pop up easily. [signal:d082c2c3-21ad-47ea-a39c-8f5b177492ac]
A G60 owner says opening took multiple tries and closing required slamming the hood to make it lock. [signal:dd9f6d9a-c4e1-4980-911e-13c1b78e4299]

## Differences between markets
The three signals with specific hood complaints are from the USA and concern G70 and G60 vehicles. [signal:cef91086-b93a-4b5b-adae-53b38b354b6a] [signal:d082c2c3-21ad-47ea-a39c-8f5b177492ac] [signal:dd9f6d9a-c4e1-4980-911e-13c1b78e4299]
The Europe F70 signal does not provide a specific hood complaint, so the signals do not establish a market difference. [signal:5131a5c1-e319-4a84-bc9a-5f323165d0f6]

## Open questions
Do the false hood-open alert and the difficult opening or closing reports share a cause? [signal:cef91086-b93a-4b5b-adae-53b38b354b6a] [signal:d082c2c3-21ad-47ea-a39c-8f5b177492ac] [signal:dd9f6d9a-c4e1-4980-911e-13c1b78e4299]
How often do these issues occur beyond the three US reports with specific hood details? [signal:cef91086-b93a-4b5b-adae-53b38b354b6a] [signal:d082c2c3-21ad-47ea-a39c-8f5b177492ac] [signal:dd9f6d9a-c4e1-4980-911e-13c1b78e4299]

value.title: Lower lumbar support is missing or insufficient for some drivers
value.summary: Some drivers report no lumbar support or insufficient lower-back support, while some G60 owners in the USA are pleased with their lumbar support. The concerns appear in European F70 reports and US G70 and G60 reports.
highlights: Drivers report missing lumbar support or discomfort in the lower back.
Signals cover European F70s and US G70s and G60s, with both complaints and positive feedback.
A G60 owner mentions choosing it over a Model S for build quality; no lumbar-support comparison is given.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some European F70 drivers say their seats have no lumbar support. [signal:5e35e6e7-69fb-4b2d-a320-752a8e20b7a0] [signal:708590d9-b4e0-4f69-a73a-798170fbd405] [signal:c6da9cf7-25b3-4085-85ea-5f57eadca979] A US G70 driver reports no lumbar adjustment, and another asks for increased lumbar support. [signal:6874ce4b-11c8-4f1f-98ca-7641ba4792b2] [signal:7da21fd4-4ec3-4d64-8934-02d74a81798e] A US G60 driver describes extreme lower-back discomfort even with lumbar support turned down to minimum. [signal:c58a528a-3849-4165-9aeb-319251dca8be]

## What customers say
F70 owners describe the seats as basic or comfortable and supportive, but say lumbar support is absent. [signal:5e35e6e7-69fb-4b2d-a320-752a8e20b7a0] [signal:708590d9-b4e0-4f69-a73a-798170fbd405] One G60 owner reports lower-back discomfort despite adjusting the lumbar support to minimum. [signal:c58a528a-3849-4165-9aeb-319251dca8be] In contrast, two US G60 customers say they like or are pleased with the lumbar support. [signal:3098cde3-1880-4659-86bd-054f158cdf81] [signal:98ae79d8-4c9a-41ad-a348-20cb940649c3]

## Differences between markets
The European reports concern missing lumbar support in the F70. [signal:5e35e6e7-69fb-4b2d-a320-752a8e20b7a0] [signal:708590d9-b4e0-4f69-a73a-798170fbd405] [signal:c6da9cf7-25b3-4085-85ea-5f57eadca979] US reports are mixed: G70 customers ask for adjustment or increased support, while G60 customers include both a discomfort complaint and positive feedback. [signal:6874ce4b-11c8-4f1f-98ca-7641ba4792b2] [signal:7da21fd4-4ec3-4d64-8934-02d74a81798e] [signal:c58a528a-3849-4165-9aeb-319251dca8be] [signal:3098cde3-1880-4659-86bd-054f158cdf81] [signal:98ae79d8-4c9a-41ad-a348-20cb940649c3]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the F70 reports refer to the same seat configuration or whether the G70 request concerns absent adjustment or insufficient support. [signal:5e35e6e7-69fb-4b2d-a320-752a8e20b7a0] [signal:6874ce4b-11c8-4f1f-98ca-7641ba4792b2] [signal:7da21fd4-4ec3-4d64-8934-02d74a81798e] The signals also do not explain why G60 owners report both lower-back discomfort and satisfaction with lumbar support. [signal:c58a528a-3849-4165-9aeb-319251dca8be] [signal:3098cde3-1880-4659-86bd-054f158cdf81] [signal:98ae79d8-4c9a-41ad-a348-20cb940649c3]

value.title: Lumbar support is hard to find or adjust comfortably
value.summary: USA customers report difficulty finding or adjusting lumbar support, with some unable to reach a comfortable position and one G70 owner reporting no lumbar adjustment. Another G60 owner values the support it provides.
highlights: Some customers cannot find or adjust lumbar support to a comfortable position.
Signals cover USA G70 and G60 customers; one G60 customer values the support.
A G70 customer feels more slouched than in a prior Porsche.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say they had difficulty finding the lumbar adjustment or could not achieve the comfort they wanted in their current BMW seats. [signal:0784b903-bf8a-4f84-99fa-e5d4e18afe9b] [signal:5ec83e70-0c23-41ab-9cd8-8888089ee26a] One G70 customer reported that the front seats did not offer lumbar adjustment. [signal:ea0e2a34-3b25-4328-9618-db8d208d8cb0] A G60 customer around five feet tall said the support remained uncomfortable at its minimum setting and wanted to be able to remove it entirely. [signal:66338a18-e8f2-42c2-9030-6a6ed35ff3d0]

## What customers say
A G70 customer only discovered the lumbar adjustment after owning the car for some time. [signal:0784b903-bf8a-4f84-99fa-e5d4e18afe9b] A G60 customer said the lumbar seats could not match the comfort of earlier BMW models. [signal:5ec83e70-0c23-41ab-9cd8-8888089ee26a] Another G70 customer wanted more outward support to sit more upright and felt more slouched than in a prior Porsche. [signal:33b7e073-214f-42bc-ae99-985451f6915a] In contrast, a G60 customer appreciated the lumbar support because it felt supportive and kept him positioned in the seat. [signal:21352ce3-054f-4793-9ebc-6ff7d27d93f0]

## Differences between markets
All provided signals are from the USA and cover the G70 and G60. [signal:0784b903-bf8a-4f84-99fa-e5d4e18afe9b] [signal:5ec83e70-0c23-41ab-9cd8-8888089ee26a] [signal:ea0e2a34-3b25-4328-9618-db8d208d8cb0] [signal:33b7e073-214f-42bc-ae99-985451f6915a] [signal:66338a18-e8f2-42c2-9030-6a6ed35ff3d0] [signal:21352ce3-054f-4793-9ebc-6ff7d27d93f0] The feedback is mixed: some customers report difficulty or discomfort, while one G60 customer likes the support. [signal:5ec83e70-0c23-41ab-9cd8-8888089ee26a] [signal:66338a18-e8f2-42c2-9030-6a6ed35ff3d0] [signal:21352ce3-054f-4793-9ebc-6ff7d27d93f0]

## Open questions
The signals do not clarify whether the reported absence of lumbar adjustment applies to a particular G70 configuration. [signal:ea0e2a34-3b25-4328-9618-db8d208d8cb0]

value.title: Hood release is difficult to find and use
value.summary: Customers in the USA report difficulty locating the hood release and understanding how to open the hood, including the two-pull process. The supplied signals concern G70 and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Customers struggle to locate and operate the hood release.
USA: supplied signals cover G70 (4) and G60 (2).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the hood release is difficult to locate, and some do not know how to open the hood. [signal:5571dcd4-add9-4bef-90c2-f8f672a1eb6a] [signal:55c9f0b3-fccb-4423-bf2b-85f141846bff] [signal:a9053103-b9bf-4165-b423-078019c35add] [signal:c9525d55-7cca-447e-9c3f-e42190f5a9d6]

## What customers say
One G60 customer could not find the latch or reach far enough under the hood to feel it. [signal:5571dcd4-add9-4bef-90c2-f8f672a1eb6a] A G70 customer described the release as hard to see and use properly. [signal:c9525d55-7cca-447e-9c3f-e42190f5a9d6]

Customers were told the lever is in the driver’s footwell and must be pulled twice to release and open the hood. [signal:3cce0beb-6b80-47da-b657-1e05d17165c9] [signal:ae35ae40-10db-4eea-a2cb-1d8067aeb8a9] One G70 customer had to call the dealership for instructions. 

## Differences between markets
All six supplied signal records are from the USA; they cover G70 (four records) and G60 (two records). [signal:3cce0beb-6b80-47da-b657-1e05d17165c9] [signal:5571dcd4-add9-4bef-90c2-f8f672a1eb6a] [signal:55c9f0b3-fccb-4423-bf2b-85f141846bff] [signal:a9053103-b9bf-4165-b423-078019c35add] [signal:ae35ae40-10db-4eea-a2cb-1d8067aeb8a9] [signal:c9525d55-7cca-447e-9c3f-e42190f5a9d6]

## Open questions
The supplied signals do not establish whether the reported difficulty differs across other markets or vehicle lines. [signal:3cce0beb-6b80-47da-b657-1e05d17165c9] [signal:5571dcd4-add9-4bef-90c2-f8f672a1eb6a] [signal:55c9f0b3-fccb-4423-bf2b-85f141846bff] [signal:a9053103-b9bf-4165-b423-078019c35add] [signal:ae35ae40-10db-4eea-a2cb-1d8067aeb8a9] [signal:c9525d55-7cca-447e-9c3f-e42190f5a9d6]

value.title: iDrive controller and nearby buttons stick or fail to respond
value.summary: Customers in the USA report sticking, missed or incorrect inputs from the iDrive controller and nearby buttons. Reports cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Controller presses can stick, fail to register or trigger the wrong function.
Four USA reports cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
Apple’s sticky-key repair program is mentioned as an analogy, not a vehicle comparison.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the iDrive controller or nearby buttons stick, need repeated presses, fail to respond, or trigger an unintended function. [signal:48681928-50d1-41e0-914c-9c4c6fe6e255] [signal:638035a9-0d87-4b86-bbe0-6eb019e492f2] [signal:699b88fb-878b-413f-b519-31cad79433f4] [signal:975d4c70-1e05-43e7-802e-dfeb32b1e339]

## What customers say
One G60 customer says the controller often needs several presses and worries it may eventually need replacement. [signal:48681928-50d1-41e0-914c-9c4c6fe6e255]

A G70 customer says pressing down sticks every time and requires centering the controller before it responds; tilting and rotating work fine. [signal:638035a9-0d87-4b86-bbe0-6eb019e492f2]

Another G70 customer reports that the home button has not worked since purchase; the vehicle had under 1,000 miles and was at a shop for diagnosis and repair. [signal:699b88fb-878b-413f-b519-31cad79433f4]

A further G70 report describes occasional sticking or missed inputs, including a button press triggering an adjacent function; the customer attributes this to the surrounding buttons being constructed as one piece. [signal:975d4c70-1e05-43e7-802e-dfeb32b1e339]

## Differences between markets
All four reports are from the USA, covering one G60 and three G70 vehicles; no other markets appear in these signals. [signal:48681928-50d1-41e0-914c-9c4c6fe6e255] [signal:638035a9-0d87-4b86-bbe0-6eb019e492f2] [signal:699b88fb-878b-413f-b519-31cad79433f4] [signal:975d4c70-1e05-43e7-802e-dfeb32b1e339]

## Open questions
Do the reported sticking and missed inputs share a cause across the G60 and G70 reports? [signal:48681928-50d1-41e0-914c-9c4c6fe6e255] [signal:638035a9-0d87-4b86-bbe0-6eb019e492f2] [signal:975d4c70-1e05-43e7-802e-dfeb32b1e339]

How often do these symptoms occur beyond the four reports, and what were the outcomes of the reported diagnosis or repair? [signal:699b88fb-878b-413f-b519-31cad79433f4]

value.title: Parking Assistant lacks spot selection and charging-station support
value.summary: One USA G60 customer wants to choose a specific parking spot on screen and says parking assistance at charging stations needs improvement. Other customers in the signals value the feature, including for tight parking spaces and larger vehicles.
highlights: A customer requests selectable parking spots and better assistance at charging stations.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70, and Rest of World F70 vehicles.
A customer compares spot selection with Tesla.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A USA G60 customer wants to select specific parking spots on screen and reports a need for better parking assistance at charging stations. [signal:bb39068c-53b4-4060-92d0-966d61728ec1]

## What customers say
A G60 customer says the parking assistance package is a major highlight, while another says they really like the parking assist features. [signal:03f380ff-cfaa-4a17-ac77-8619cb99d760] [signal:2b546ef2-ff2b-48ed-a96c-54e3a854542b]

G70 customers describe self-parking as helpful, including in a tight parking space; one says the vehicle is easy to park despite its size. [signal:1cd43b10-1bff-4685-887a-a097a2f73534] [signal:1e19cd6b-6484-4bc9-a0c0-f68cd2ce481c]

A Rest of World F70 customer calls optional automatic parking extremely handy, and a USA G70 customer enjoys the vehicle's ability to park itself. [signal:254047d1-b994-487d-82b6-0ebba8a569f9] [signal:2631ae28-99e6-46b8-ae5f-8f5253368f5c]

## Differences between markets
The positive comments come from USA G60 and G70 customers and a Rest of World F70 customer; the request for spot selection and better charging-station assistance comes from a USA G60 customer. [signal:03f380ff-cfaa-4a17-ac77-8619cb99d760] [signal:1cd43b10-1bff-4685-887a-a097a2f73534] [signal:1e19cd6b-6484-4bc9-a0c0-f68cd2ce481c] [signal:2b546ef2-ff2b-48ed-a96c-54e3a854542b] [signal:254047d1-b994-487d-82b6-0ebba8a569f9] [signal:2631ae28-99e6-46b8-ae5f-8f5253368f5c] [signal:bb39068c-53b4-4060-92d0-966d61728ec1]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often customers need selectable parking spots or better parking assistance at charging stations. [signal:bb39068c-53b4-4060-92d0-966d61728ec1]

value.title: Controller operation feels less accessible or differs by preference
value.summary: Some F70 customers in Europe miss the central iDrive controller and physical controls, while US customers report differing preferences about controller height, movement, and style. Other US customers value the controller’s position or joystick operation.
highlights: Some customers find controller operation or related interactions less accessible or less convenient.
Signals cover Europe F70 and USA G60 and G70, with both complaints and positive feedback.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some Europe-based F70 customers miss the central iDrive controller or physical buttons, and describe interactions that require looking away from the road or taking multiple taps. [signal:f9965952-6bf3-4de3-9e0c-52eab10f73f2] [signal:fef83e9a-8ee1-4b95-9369-77c04fc77e65] One F70 customer also reports iDrive freezing and says they preferred the previous model’s iDrive. [signal:71a244b0-0b64-41b0-a2f0-5c352f3aabed] A US G60 customer says the controller sits lower than in earlier vehicles and is slightly harder to move left or right. [signal:86e19e9b-1cdc-4f12-8cd0-1d772b6896f7]

## What customers say
A US G70 customer prefers the X7’s iDrive Controller to the one in the 7 Series. [signal:c70ff382-9582-463f-be4d-7e438d545b19] Other US feedback is positive: one G60 customer appreciates the center dial’s position, and one G70 customer likes the joystick controller and hopes touchscreen-only controls are not adopted. [signal:38e05a22-6117-4b04-9b2b-e0b133d1fd87] [signal:d07cbe1d-abe4-4a7f-a405-dc0cbd88ee50]

## Differences between markets
The sampled Europe signals concern the F70 and include complaints about missing physical controls and road-facing attention during interaction. [signal:71a244b0-0b64-41b0-a2f0-5c352f3aabed] [signal:f9965952-6bf3-4de3-9e0c-52eab10f73f2] [signal:fef83e9a-8ee1-4b95-9369-77c04fc77e65] US feedback spans the G60 and G70, with one G60 complaint about controller height and movement alongside positive comments about its position and the G70 joystick. [signal:86e19e9b-1cdc-4f12-8cd0-1d772b6896f7] [signal:38e05a22-6117-4b04-9b2b-e0b133d1fd87] [signal:d07cbe1d-abe4-4a7f-a405-dc0cbd88ee50] The US G70 signals also differ: one customer prefers the X7 controller, while another likes the joystick controller. [signal:c70ff382-9582-463f-be4d-7e438d545b19] [signal:d07cbe1d-abe4-4a7f-a405-dc0cbd88ee50]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common these preferences or complaints are beyond the cases provided. [signal:86e19e9b-1cdc-4f12-8cd0-1d772b6896f7] [signal:38e05a22-6117-4b04-9b2b-e0b133d1fd87] The signals also do not clarify whether the reported interaction concerns are specific to controller operation or to the wider infotainment interface. [signal:fef83e9a-8ee1-4b95-9369-77c04fc77e65]

value.title: Highway Assistant engagement delays and abrupt braking
value.summary: In the USA, customers report that Highway Assistant can be slow to engage and may brake sharply after waiting for a vehicle ahead to get closer. These concerns appear in signals for the G60 and G70.
highlights: Slow engagement and delayed, sharp braking are reported.
Two USA signals: one each for G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G60 customer says Highway Assistant can take a while to toggle on and start working when they want to engage it quickly. [signal:0b8ac9ff-ce6f-41c7-adca-6f5690f41561] A G70 customer says that at maximum following distance, the car waits until it is closer to a vehicle braking hard before braking sharply. [signal:a6687383-7eb8-4346-92d7-4500a08215de]

## What customers say
The G60 customer reports inconsistent or delayed engagement when trying to switch the function on quickly. [signal:0b8ac9ff-ce6f-41c7-adca-6f5690f41561] The G70 customer says they would prefer the car to detect traffic further ahead and ease into braking more like a human driver. [signal:a6687383-7eb8-4346-92d7-4500a08215de]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA, but they describe different concerns in the G60 and G70: engagement delay and braking behavior, respectively. [signal:0b8ac9ff-ce6f-41c7-adca-6f5690f41561] [signal:a6687383-7eb8-4346-92d7-4500a08215de]

## Open questions
- How often does delayed engagement occur for G60 customers? [signal:0b8ac9ff-ce6f-41c7-adca-6f5690f41561]
- Does the reported braking behavior occur in other conditions or vehicles? [signal:a6687383-7eb8-4346-92d7-4500a08215de]

value.title: Side-view camera display missing for lane changes

value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want a side-camera view to help them see around the vehicle when changing lanes. [signal:23d08077-8d67-44e7-b1e9-710e216c0c30] [signal:29697aa9-f0bd-4ecb-b9a2-de104cff10af]
Customers describe wanting the view to appear in the instrument cluster when they activate a turn signal. [signal:6460aaa7-089f-4fe7-8f70-aba1cb3f8dc0] [signal:8c31307e-8e38-40f7-90a9-16bb48c205e9]

## What customers say
A G70 customer says the vehicle’s large body makes a wider view useful for lane changes. [signal:23d08077-8d67-44e7-b1e9-710e216c0c30]
A G60 customer recalls side-repeater cameras on a prior Tesla, while a G70 customer recalls a blind-spot camera view on a prior Hyundai SUV. [signal:29697aa9-f0bd-4ecb-b9a2-de104cff10af] [signal:8c31307e-8e38-40f7-90a9-16bb48c205e9]
Another G60 customer wants the side-camera angle shown in the instrument cluster when the turn signal is activated. [signal:6460aaa7-089f-4fe7-8f70-aba1cb3f8dc0]

## Differences between markets
The provided relevant signals are from the USA and mention G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:23d08077-8d67-44e7-b1e9-710e216c0c30] [signal:29697aa9-f0bd-4ecb-b9a2-de104cff10af] [signal:6460aaa7-089f-4fe7-8f70-aba1cb3f8dc0] [signal:8c31307e-8e38-40f7-90a9-16bb48c205e9] [signal:cec6ff48-4504-467c-b927-9030bee75a6e]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common this request is beyond the reported cases, or whether customers want the view in the instrument cluster or another display in every instance. [signal:23d08077-8d67-44e7-b1e9-710e216c0c30] [signal:29697aa9-f0bd-4ecb-b9a2-de104cff10af] [signal:6460aaa7-089f-4fe7-8f70-aba1cb3f8dc0] [signal:8c31307e-8e38-40f7-90a9-16bb48c205e9]
