The signals do not clarify how the reported speed capabilities compare across markets or vehicles. [signal:cedf6f72-afee-40c7-b935-8d95a14e3211] [signal:738ffd79-1c23-45f6-a498-6390f138177c]

value.title: Highway assistant feels limited or unavailable to some drivers
value.summary: Some USA drivers want broader autonomous driving or miss Highway Assistant functions they had before, while others value the current driving-assistance features. The signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Some drivers want more autonomous functions or report missing Highway Assistant features.
USA signals mention G60 and G70 vehicles; some customers also praise driving assistance.
One customer compares the desired capability with Tesla; no other competitor evidence is provided.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers want capabilities beyond the current adaptive cruise control, including driving through intersections, while another reports that Highway Assistant was absent from their current 7 Series package compared with a prior vehicle. [signal:19ebfb70-ada9-4843-950e-609b9ff04af8] [signal:2e96f95b-d589-4dcb-816f-91526d823fb7] [signal:dfc964ca-c20e-4248-89a6-bcbf8dd4963f]

## What customers say
A G60 driver wants the vehicle to stop at traffic lights and turn at intersections. [signal:19ebfb70-ada9-4843-950e-609b9ff04af8]

Two G70 drivers express a preference for full autonomous driving, with one specifically comparing it to Tesla. [signal:2e96f95b-d589-4dcb-816f-91526d823fb7] [signal:6bc25c90-3a8b-434f-b85c-747a519d3378]

A G70 driver says their prior 7 Series kept the car in its lane around curves and had Driving Assistant Pro with Highway Assistant, which they say is not included on the current vehicle. [signal:dfc964ca-c20e-4248-89a6-bcbf8dd4963f]

Other customers praise the automatic lane-change feature with Highway Assistant and the driving assistant. [signal:0a76f4a6-09a6-40d4-a236-44e7d4fdeeb9] [signal:1177ad9a-98b3-48a6-b39f-f8453139df21]

## Differences between markets
All six sampled signals are from the USA, so they do not show differences between markets. [signal:19ebfb70-ada9-4843-950e-609b9ff04af8] [signal:2e96f95b-d589-4dcb-816f-91526d823fb7] [signal:6bc25c90-3a8b-434f-b85c-747a519d3378] [signal:dfc964ca-c20e-4248-89a6-bcbf8dd4963f] [signal:0a76f4a6-09a6-40d4-a236-44e7d4fdeeb9] [signal:1177ad9a-98b3-48a6-b39f-f8453139df21]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widespread these views are across the 47 signals or whether the reported package difference applies beyond the customer’s vehicle. [signal:dfc964ca-c20e-4248-89a6-bcbf8dd4963f]

value.title: Controller and touch operation feels awkward or unclear
value.summary: Some customers find screen-based controls, buttons, or controller functions awkward, hard to use, or unclear. Signals come from Europe and the USA across F70, G70, and G60 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report awkward screen use, difficult buttons, and unclear or overly complex controls.
Signals span Europe and the USA, across F70, G70, and G60 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say that using the screen while driving feels awkward, and they miss the rotary controller and shortcut buttons found in earlier BMWs. [signal:1ffa814f-960c-455a-b7a5-c50fd6e842a5] [signal:c4304cce-cd25-4539-8e93-17ed2694ade1] [signal:04f55f17-b696-4c7f-8f3d-9da643b88bba] [signal:18061a59-aeb8-4755-a3b8-d3427f8ed479]
Other customers describe buttons that are hard to press, controls that are difficult to move, or important functions that take too many menus and steps to reach. [signal:39dab5af-8fee-46d7-8ac0-818b3d73332c] [signal:7583b82c-bd71-407b-8f50-530fbaedf5fd] [signal:7b272972-a996-4c59-bfe0-e93dc9fa146a]

## What customers say
A Europe F70 customer says screen interaction feels awkward while driving, while other F70 customers miss the rotary controller and shortcut buttons. [signal:c4304cce-cd25-4539-8e93-17ed2694ade1] [signal:04f55f17-b696-4c7f-8f3d-9da643b88bba] [signal:18061a59-aeb8-4755-a3b8-d3427f8ed479]
In the USA, G70 customers report that some center-console buttons may need a second press, describe touch buttons and the control knob as difficult to use, and ask what the controller does. [signal:39dab5af-8fee-46d7-8ac0-818b3d73332c] [signal:7583b82c-bd71-407b-8f50-530fbaedf5fd] [signal:e4e89490-caf5-4c77-9892-679035e1c732]
A USA G60 customer says navigating menus and lists to find basic information is frustrating. [signal:7b272972-a996-4c59-bfe0-e93dc9fa146a]
There is also a positive USA G60 signal: one customer appreciates adjusting volume and radio stations while keeping a hand near the armrest and controller. [signal:4523fc89-836f-46be-bcbf-cedf586e2328]

## Differences between markets
Europe signals include F70 customers missing the rotary controller and shortcut buttons, as well as a G70 customer who prefers one button per function. [signal:04f55f17-b696-4c7f-8f3d-9da643b88bba] [signal:18061a59-aeb8-4755-a3b8-d3427f8ed479] [signal:9f41b331-e6b6-4b10-a3ac-76228ae6f813]
USA signals include complaints about G70 button and controller operation, and G60 comments about menu complexity and console-button placement. [signal:39dab5af-8fee-46d7-8ac0-818b3d73332c] [signal:7583b82c-bd71-407b-8f50-530fbaedf5fd] [signal:7b272972-a996-4c59-bfe0-e93dc9fa146a] [signal:a4d7f1d9-ce60-4a9b-a07b-e6a9fb8e3de4]
Views are not uniformly negative: a USA G60 customer values operating audio functions near the controller area. [signal:4523fc89-836f-46be-bcbf-cedf586e2328]

## Open questions
How often do customers encounter difficulty with the controls, and which specific functions are most affected? The signals describe individual experiences but do not quantify frequency or identify a common function across vehicles. [signal:39dab5af-8fee-46d7-8ac0-818b3d73332c] [signal:7b272972-a996-4c59-bfe0-e93dc9fa146a]
How does controller use while driving vary by vehicle line and market? The signals include both complaints about screen interaction and a positive report about using the controller area. [signal:c4304cce-cd25-4539-8e93-17ed2694ade1] [signal:4523fc89-836f-46be-bcbf-cedf586e2328]

value.title: Parking Assistant is hard to learn and inconsistent to use
value.summary: Some customers do not know how to start or use Parking Assistant, and some report difficulty triggering or relying on it. Others, particularly in Europe, say parking assistance makes parking easier.
highlights: Customers report difficulty learning, starting, and reliably triggering Parking Assistant.
Signals include USA G60 and G70, Europe F70, and Rest of World G60 owners.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers say they did not know the self-parking feature was available or are unsure how to use it. [signal:012f91b7-0c43-4005-bddf-fd2d0b7e40e5] [signal:055c492d-c413-4cb4-9a2b-bc20d4507609] A Europe F70 owner says automatic parking is not quick to grasp and they still do not know how to use it. [signal:fcaefb73-527a-4a06-9c14-43ff633e9d82]

A USA G60 owner says the recorded path function works only about half the time and can fail to offer a start option. [signal:26a769a3-7f56-4f3d-b1c5-0025ecc3586d] A Rest of World G60 owner says the parking assistant has not worked well and feels uneasy relying on it. [signal:a6532634-cd9c-4626-9b3e-6dae5f3571c3]

## What customers say
Some customers ask how to activate Parking Assistant and describe needing an explanation of the steps. [signal:055c492d-c413-4cb4-9a2b-bc20d4507609] [signal:0f21930f-77f2-40fb-be3c-cca9aeffbe08] A Europe F70 owner says a demonstration would have been useful because they do not know how to use automatic parking. [signal:05d14d9a-7bdc-450f-a2b4-df2e9cb9f41d]

Experiences are not uniformly negative: Europe F70 owners say parking assistance makes parking easier and describe the car as simple to park. [signal:0849d776-b966-4285-adcb-999fa0f2f8b0] [signal:f72ccaeb-916e-419b-a1c9-499350c9cd9d]

## Differences between markets
In the supplied signals, USA G60 and G70 owners ask how to use the system, and one USA G60 owner reports difficulty triggering the recorded path function. [signal:055c492d-c413-4cb4-9a2b-bc20d4507609] [signal:0f21930f-77f2-40fb-be3c-cca9aeffbe08] [signal:26a769a3-7f56-4f3d-b1c5-0025ecc3586d] Europe F70 signals include both difficulty learning automatic parking and positive views that assistance makes parking easier. [signal:fcaefb73-527a-4a06-9c14-43ff633e9d82] [signal:05d14d9a-7bdc-450f-a2b4-df2e9cb9f41d] [signal:0849d776-b966-4285-adcb-999fa0f2f8b0] [signal:f72ccaeb-916e-419b-a1c9-499350c9cd9d] A Rest of World G60 owner reports poor performance and unease relying on the assistant. [signal:a6532634-cd9c-4626-9b3e-6dae5f3571c3]

## Open questions
What conditions make the recorded path function fail to offer a start option or require precise positioning? [signal:26a769a3-7f56-4f3d-b1c5-0025ecc3586d] Which parts of the automatic-parking instructions are unclear to customers who ask how to use the feature? [signal:055c492d-c413-4cb4-9a2b-bc20d4507609] [signal:fcaefb73-527a-4a06-9c14-43ff633e9d82]

value.title: Hands-free lane driving missing from a buyer’s G70

value.title: Highway assistance becomes unavailable or stops unexpectedly
value.summary: US customers report highway assistance becoming unavailable or stopping unexpectedly, including cases where they had to take control of the vehicle. Reports cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Highway assistance can become unavailable or stop during a drive.
US reports affect G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report highway assistance becoming unavailable, refusing to activate, or stopping during a drive. [signal:8a311210-5090-4dd1-8967-8f00a4798538] [signal:9c86e1a5-aacb-4dd5-bf3e-f36c92bfe08e] [signal:ae82fc50-6ae1-441f-b553-db644aeeed9d] In one G70 report, the customer had to take over to drive safely when the feature stopped. [signal:9c86e1a5-aacb-4dd5-bf3e-f36c92bfe08e]

## What customers say
A G60 customer said the feature worked on highway trips for the first few weeks, then became unavailable on the same routes under similar conditions; the change was noticed after a remote software update. [signal:8a311210-5090-4dd1-8967-8f00a4798538] A G70 customer reported a sudden stop and a warning light, followed by more than four dealership visits before a component was replaced and the vehicle drove properly. [signal:9c86e1a5-aacb-4dd5-bf3e-f36c92bfe08e] Another G70 customer said the feature would not activate despite cleaning the sensors, and that cruise control and the front radar distance sensor also did not operate. [signal:ae82fc50-6ae1-441f-b553-db644aeeed9d]

## Differences between markets
All three reports are from the USA, involving G60 and G70 vehicles. [signal:8a311210-5090-4dd1-8967-8f00a4798538] [signal:9c86e1a5-aacb-4dd5-bf3e-f36c92bfe08e] [signal:ae82fc50-6ae1-441f-b553-db644aeeed9d] The signals provide no comparison with other markets.

## Open questions
- How often does the feature become unavailable or stop, and under what conditions?
- Are the reported failures related to a common cause?

value.title: Parking Assistant behaves inconsistently and can fail to stop correctly
value.summary: Customers report inconsistent parking-spot detection and saved-path behavior, abrupt or persistent alerts, and failures to stop or maneuver as expected. These concerns appear in signals from USA G70 and G60, Europe F70, and Rest of World G60 customers.
highlights: Parking assistance can be inconsistent, stop unexpectedly, or fail to stop in the right place.
Five USA signals, one Europe signal, and one Rest of World signal cover G70, F70, and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe parking assistance that is unreliable in different ways: saved parking options may not appear, the system may cut out or surge, and parking paths may not stop the vehicle where expected. [signal:17096e0e-b9d9-48d9-93ac-9b0d258c5d81] [signal:154e597e-8906-4556-beee-745a453d5d7c] [signal:f56c4c53-af4f-4200-b946-89d614aa14f8] One customer reported a sudden high-speed reverse that resulted in contact with another parked vehicle, and another said they had to take control to avoid a near crash. [signal:29f84432-22f2-4927-9d31-73b85203ad58] [signal:6a8ecd17-2d52-4f55-913d-4bc2ec54109b]

## What customers say
A USA G70 customer said a saved garage route’s activation gong continued sounding well past the activation point. [signal:0864e71c-bc0b-4622-b3d9-1f455bf9d025] Another USA G70 customer said the auto-park option sometimes did not appear when returning to a saved parking spot, including at night. [signal:17096e0e-b9d9-48d9-93ac-9b0d258c5d81] A USA G60 customer reported that parking-spot detection sometimes failed, while another said a saved garage path did not stop the car in the right place and the garage door scratched it. [signal:6a8ecd17-2d52-4f55-913d-4bc2ec54109b] [signal:f56c4c53-af4f-4200-b946-89d614aa14f8] A further USA G60 report described a high-speed reverse during parking and a later parking-sensor warning. [signal:29f84432-22f2-4927-9d31-73b85203ad58] A Rest of World G60 customer said the parking assistant had not worked well enough for them to feel comfortable relying on it. [signal:48f256ef-ca2c-40b4-b295-f772ca4f1e38] A Europe F70 customer said parking in tight spots was difficult because the system kept cutting out and stopping, and described the electric parking assistance as surging. [signal:154e597e-8906-4556-beee-745a453d5d7c]

## Differences between markets
The five USA signals cover G70 and G60 and include reports about saved routes, spot detection, unexpected reversing, and stopping position. [signal:0864e71c-bc0b-4622-b3d9-1f455bf9d025] [signal:17096e0e-b9d9-48d9-93ac-9b0d258c5d81] [signal:29f84432-22f2-4927-9d31-73b85203ad58] [signal:6a8ecd17-2d52-4f55-913d-4bc2ec54109b] [signal:f56c4c53-af4f-4200-b946-89d614aa14f8] The Europe signal is from an F70 customer and describes cut-outs, stopping, and surging in tight parking situations. [signal:154e597e-8906-4556-beee-745a453d5d7c] The Rest of World signal is from a G60 customer who said the assistant had not worked well and felt difficult to rely on. [signal:48f256ef-ca2c-40b4-b295-f772ca4f1e38]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish why the reported parking behaviors occur or whether they share a cause. [signal:0864e71c-bc0b-4622-b3d9-1f455bf9d025] [signal:17096e0e-b9d9-48d9-93ac-9b0d258c5d81] [signal:29f84432-22f2-4927-9d31-73b85203ad58] [signal:48f256ef-ca2c-40b4-b295-f772ca4f1e38] [signal:6a8ecd17-2d52-4f55-913d-4bc2ec54109b] [signal:f56c4c53-af4f-4200-b946-89d614aa14f8] [signal:154e597e-8906-4556-beee-745a453d5d7c] They also do not indicate how often these behaviors occur across customers or vehicles. value.title: Highway assistant controls and behavior are difficult to understand
value.summary: Some USA customers report uncertainty about activation, controls, operating modes and how the Highway Assistant behaves. Reports also describe a learning curve and jerky behavior through bends, including when the car slows before a corner.
highlights: Customers report unclear status, controls, modes and behavior.
The six supplied examples are from USA drivers in G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe uncertainty about when the Highway Assistant is active, how to respond to prompts, how its driving modes work and how it behaves in different situations. [signal:08ef93d4-d3e6-4a56-b8f4-f50f5303e90c] [signal:5ba54c2a-46c0-49fe-9d5d-daa517c5bb98] [signal:6085fb63-5c99-47b7-9d15-058af5686927] Some also report that the system feels more complicated than an older vehicle or takes time to learn. [signal:218b3d01-7073-4ecb-9ecb-795fb524ef36] [signal:49b373b6-069b-4117-98de-3fe4ce36e4cf]

## What customers say
One G60 customer was unsure whether “ready” meant the assistant was already active or required another action. [signal:08ef93d4-d3e6-4a56-b8f4-f50f5303e90c] A G70 customer did not know where to confirm an “okay” prompt, while another reported that the package felt more complicated to operate than in their 2019 X5. [signal:5ba54c2a-46c0-49fe-9d5d-daa517c5bb98] [signal:218b3d01-7073-4ecb-9ecb-795fb524ef36] Customers also described confusion about the two-level adaptive driving system and how speed limits affect adaptive mode. [signal:6085fb63-5c99-47b7-9d15-058af5686927] One customer said the system felt jerky through bends, particularly when slowing before a corner. [signal:60a52ad8-c4df-4054-8995-5f843930794e]

## Differences between markets
All six supplied examples are from the USA, covering G60 and G70 vehicles; the supplied examples do not show how experiences compare across markets. [signal:08ef93d4-d3e6-4a56-b8f4-f50f5303e90c] [signal:218b3d01-7073-4ecb-9ecb-795fb524ef36] [signal:49b373b6-069b-4117-98de-3fe4ce36e4cf] [signal:5ba54c2a-46c0-49fe-9d5d-daa517c5bb98] [signal:6085fb63-5c99-47b7-9d15-058af5686927] [signal:60a52ad8-c4df-4054-8995-5f843930794e]

## Open questions
How common is uncertainty about the “ready” status and prompt controls beyond the individual reports? [signal:08ef93d4-d3e6-4a56-b8f4-f50f5303e90c] [signal:5ba54c2a-46c0-49fe-9d5d-daa517c5bb98] Do customers share the same understanding of the two adaptive driving levels and speed-limit behavior? [signal:6085fb63-5c99-47b7-9d15-058af5686927] How often is cornering behavior perceived as jerky? [signal:60a52ad8-c4df-4054-8995-5f843930794e]

value.title: Driving modes lack preferred defaults and finer comfort tuning

highlights: Drivers report limited control over default Sport and comfort tuning in Personal mode.
USA feedback comes from G70 and G60 owners; Europe feedback praises mode-dependent performance in the F70.
A test-drive comparator from another German maker felt smoother at low speeds.
value.body_md:
## Problem
A G70 owner says Sport cannot be set as the default despite driving in Sport most of the time. [signal:7d4ab1e6-3584-4ef6-93f7-ba323c28d04c] A G60 owner who usually uses Personal mode wants a more comfort-oriented setting within it. [signal:c83b983a-0441-4b40-ab70-917fbf103691]

## What customers say
The G70 owner reports wanting Sport as the default. [signal:7d4ab1e6-3584-4ef6-93f7-ba323c28d04c] The G60 owner says they use Personal mode most of the time and would like a more comfort-oriented setting within it. [signal:c83b983a-0441-4b40-ab70-917fbf103691] An F70 reviewer praised the car’s steering feedback, handling, grip, and performance when the right mode was selected. [signal:047373a8-7cbd-4f11-a00b-2abce3dc4548] A Rest of World F70 buyer said a competing German maker’s 1.0-liter mild hybrid felt smoother at low speeds from a standstill. [signal:eacc87a1-5059-403e-b803-d7d6dfbd6e1b]

## Differences between markets
The mode-setting requests in the available signals are from USA G70 and G60 owners. [signal:7d4ab1e6-3584-4ef6-93f7-ba323c28d04c] [signal:c83b983a-0441-4b40-ab70-917fbf103691] The Europe F70 feedback praises performance when the right mode is selected, while the Rest of World F70 comparison concerns low-speed smoothness. [signal:047373a8-7cbd-4f11-a00b-2abce3dc4548] [signal:eacc87a1-5059-403e-b803-d7d6dfbd6e1b]

## Open questions
Would the G70 owner’s preferred Sport default and the G60 owner’s preferred Personal-mode comfort setting be shared by other drivers? [signal:7d4ab1e6-3584-4ef6-93f7-ba323c28d04c] [signal:c83b983a-0441-4b40-ab70-917fbf103691] Is the low-speed smoothness comparison related to drive-mode selection, or is it a separate driving concern? [signal:eacc87a1-5059-403e-b803-d7d6dfbd6e1b]

## Problem
Driving feel is not consistent across modes in the reports: one customer describes hesitation when pulling away in normal drive, while another says the vehicle corners less smoothly and leans away from turns. [signal:972672ff-8dfd-4723-9f63-3a08f73822ae] [signal:c7607155-eac6-4652-84fd-df1366558cac]

## What customers say
An F70 owner says switching to S mode resolves a small hesitation when pulling away in normal drive. [signal:972672ff-8dfd-4723-9f63-3a08f73822ae] A G60 owner says the car performs significantly better in Sport mode, but does not take corners as smoothly as their previous 540 and tends to lean away from the turn. [signal:c7607155-eac6-4652-84fd-df1366558cac] A G70 owner says Sport mode makes the 750 feel like a much smaller car and describes it as fun to drive, while also valuing its relaxed luxury cruising. [signal:a8a27a43-7839-453d-9296-6d1c4295d80b]

## Differences between markets
The Europe reports include an F70 customer who prefers S mode because it addresses the reported hesitation in normal drive. [signal:972672ff-8dfd-4723-9f63-3a08f73822ae] In the USA, a G70 customer praises Sport mode, while a G60 customer says Sport mode improves performance but reports less-smooth cornering and body lean. [signal:a8a27a43-7839-453d-9296-6d1c4295d80b] [signal:c7607155-eac6-4652-84fd-df1366558cac]

## Open questions
Do the reported differences in driving feel vary by vehicle line, or do they reflect different customer expectations? Which aspects of mode-dependent behavior matter most to customers?

value.body_md:
## Problem
A European G60 driver said the suspension felt soft and the car rocked or bobbed unless it was in Sport mode; a European F70 driver said the suspension felt harsh in every driving mode. [signal:5016f258-378b-4d04-89d3-69ec76df6c42] [signal:edee83f1-796c-4246-b2f0-e4b5ce38c084] A separate European F70 report described a drivetrain fault by the third day of ownership. [signal:ffb261ea-5e1c-480f-bab6-0717c16f667a]

## What customers say
The G60 driver described a soft suspension and rocking or bobbing outside Sport mode. [signal:5016f258-378b-4d04-89d3-69ec76df6c42] The F70 driver said the suspension was harsh regardless of the selected mode. [signal:edee83f1-796c-4246-b2f0-e4b5ce38c084] Another F70 driver reported a drivetrain fault on day three and said they eventually received a refund after legal action. [signal:ffb261ea-5e1c-480f-bab6-0717c16f667a]

## Differences between markets
The two suspension-mode reports are from Europe: one describes a difference between Sport and other conditions, while the other describes harshness in every mode. [signal:5016f258-378b-4d04-89d3-69ec76df6c42] [signal:edee83f1-796c-4246-b2f0-e4b5ce38c084] The drivetrain-fault report is also from Europe; the USA signals do not describe driving-mode behavior or drivetrain reliability. [signal:ffb261ea-5e1c-480f-bab6-0717c16f667a] [signal:258ec89e-eada-45b9-a3a7-6b22bed0eac9] [signal:81750723-e7a1-4ec2-b3e0-372a7b557f75]

## Open questions

[signal:ffb261ea-5e1c-480f-bab6-0717c16f667a] They also do not explain why one driver notices suspension behavior changing with mode while another reports harshness across all modes. value.title: Driving modes feel limited, distracting, or inconsistent
value.summary: Some US G70 customers report distracting or inconsistent display behavior and modes they see as having little driving impact. A G60 customer wants more personalized settings and a different default-mode choice.
highlights: Customers report distracting graphics, disappearing display content, and modes with little perceived driving impact.
Three complaints concern the G70; one wish concerns the G60, all in the USA.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some G70 customers describe driving-mode behavior as distracting or inconsistent: display content can disappear when switching modes, and an Efficient-mode graphic was irritating to one customer. [signal:093f9ee9-188f-4cd0-b42b-f6fdf56df486] [signal:f0804714-b8a5-447c-b39f-3439f2f29c3f] Another customer felt Digital Art, Expressive, and Relax modes only change images and do not affect driving performance. [signal:56fc9993-5a1d-4e73-827e-402948f07110]

A G60 customer misses being able to choose Sport or Efficient as the default and wants more individualized options within the standard modes. [signal:ba377ed0-66ef-4193-bf87-e92850450487]

## What customers say
One G70 customer reported that cosmetic content disappeared from the display when switching from a personal default mode to Sport, but had not identified a repeatable trigger. [signal:093f9ee9-188f-4cd0-b42b-f6fdf56df486]

Another G70 customer called Digital Art, Expressive, and Relax modes useless because, in their view, they only change images and not driving performance. [signal:56fc9993-5a1d-4e73-827e-402948f07110] A different customer found a blue polygon in the head-up display irritating in Efficient mode and said they would avoid the mode if it could not be turned off. [signal:f0804714-b8a5-447c-b39f-3439f2f29c3f]

The G60 customer compared the available default-mode choice and personalization with their i4 experience, and described the Digital Art, Expressive, and Relax modes as wasted space. [signal:ba377ed0-66ef-4193-bf87-e92850450487]

## Differences between markets
All four signals are from the USA; the signals do not provide a comparison between markets. [signal:093f9ee9-188f-4cd0-b42b-f6fdf56df486] [signal:56fc9993-5a1d-4e73-827e-402948f07110] [signal:f0804714-b8a5-447c-b39f-3439f2f29c3f] [signal:ba377ed0-66ef-4193-bf87-e92850450487]

## Open questions
What sequence, if any, triggers the disappearing display content remains unknown to the reporting customer. [signal:093f9ee9-188f-4cd0-b42b-f6fdf56df486] The signals do not establish how common these experiences are beyond the four reported cases. [signal:093f9ee9-188f-4cd0-b42b-f6fdf56df486] [signal:56fc9993-5a1d-4e73-827e-402948f07110] [signal:f0804714-b8a5-447c-b39f-3439f2f29c3f] [signal:ba377ed0-66ef-4193-bf87-e92850450487]

value.body_md:
## Problem
A USA G60 customer says changing driving modes involves too many steps and feels unsafe because it requires taking their eyes off the road. [signal:46c99d72-89ba-4295-86f3-acff4458605e] A Rest of World F70 customer wants to change modes using a switch within easy reach. [signal:c6413927-00d0-474a-94e7-4a17ac90da53]

## What customers say
The G60 customer describes the number of steps as excessive and links the process to looking away from the road. [signal:46c99d72-89ba-4295-86f3-acff4458605e] The F70 customer says they are happy with the ride and interior quality but would like an easy-reach switch for changing driving modes. [signal:c6413927-00d0-474a-94e7-4a17ac90da53]

## Differences between markets
The USA signal reports too many steps and a perceived safety concern, while the Rest of World signal asks for a switch within easy reach. [signal:46c99d72-89ba-4295-86f3-acff4458605e] [signal:c6413927-00d0-474a-94e7-4a17ac90da53]

## Open questions
The signals do not specify which driving modes are affected or how often customers change modes. [signal:46c99d72-89ba-4295-86f3-acff4458605e] [signal:c6413927-00d0-474a-94e7-4a17ac90da53]

value.title: Drive modes are complex and Sport cannot be default
value.summary: Some drivers find drive modes and related apps complex and distracting, while one driver cannot set Sport as the default. The signals come from F70 drivers in Europe and a G70 driver in the USA.
highlights: Drive-mode controls can feel complex and distracting; Sport cannot be set as the default for one driver.
Six signals concern the F70 in Europe; one concerns the G70 in the USA.
One driver says acceleration lag compares unfavourably with a partner’s Fiat 500e.
value.body_md:
## Problem
One F70 driver says the apps and drive modes are overly complex, not user-friendly, and distracting enough to require stopping to use them. [signal:eb1bd1f9-f356-42ec-8043-dc9e1c5bae61] A G70 driver says Sport cannot be set as the default, despite driving in Sport most of the time. [signal:ba6d1008-765b-4f11-8601-4b22b311c4e4]

## What customers say
Two F70 drivers describe using Sport to compensate for acceleration lag, but say switching modes ahead of time is not always practical. [signal:1baf6643-9904-4dd4-b6bf-ec95f9f3c0c8] [signal:31e99e93-31f6-4f12-87ae-ee74007176ae] One of them compares the acceleration unfavourably with a partner’s Fiat 500e. [signal:31e99e93-31f6-4f12-87ae-ee74007176ae] Another F70 driver says the car handles like a boat regardless of the selected drive setting. [signal:eb1bd1f9-f356-42ec-8043-dc9e1c5bae61]

## Differences between markets
The mode-complexity complaint and reports of switching into Sport relate to F70 drivers in Europe; the Sport-default complaint comes from a G70 driver in the USA. [signal:eb1bd1f9-f356-42ec-8043-dc9e1c5bae61] [signal:1baf6643-9904-4dd4-b6bf-ec95f9f3c0c8] [signal:31e99e93-31f6-4f12-87ae-ee74007176ae] [signal:ba6d1008-765b-4f11-8601-4b22b311c4e4] The signals do not establish whether these differences are market-specific.

## Open questions
How often do drivers struggle with the drive-mode interface, and which actions are most distracting? [signal:eb1bd1f9-f356-42ec-8043-dc9e1c5bae61] How common is the preference to start in Sport, and does it differ by vehicle line or market? [signal:ba6d1008-765b-4f11-8601-4b22b311c4e4]

value.title: Driving modes are hard to find, set, or keep
value.summary: Some USA customers have trouble finding or setting a preferred driving mode, while one reports the car switching away from ECOPro. The signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report difficulty finding, setting, or retaining a preferred driving mode.
Supplied signals: USA, four for G60 and two for G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers have difficulty locating a battery-saving mode or setting a preferred mode as the default [signal:179d247b-c8ac-4ea4-809d-cd3bb32185ce] [signal:fd8da9a6-afba-420b-8f7b-db4099899d2a]. Other customers want the car to start in their preferred mode without manually switching it [signal:24b505dd-da01-4283-9d08-793aadf323a8] [signal:45faa8c1-8d5a-415a-83e6-ae14e8ddbd45] [signal:49c15b4e-fd4c-449c-8cb1-944e188beba9]. One customer says the car switched from ECOPro to Comfort and would not let them change it back [signal:7f97966a-7fda-4de7-a09a-b1ac0d89b5f1].

## What customers say
A G60 customer looking to save battery power could not locate the mode they had heard about; the service writer directed them to Efficient mode through the drive mode button [signal:179d247b-c8ac-4ea4-809d-cd3bb32185ce]. A G60 customer asked how to make a driving mode the default and was given a sequence through My Modes, mode selection, settings, and Start mode [signal:fd8da9a6-afba-420b-8f7b-db4099899d2a].

Customers wish they could set a default mode rather than switch manually, start in Efficient mode, or start in ECO mode instead of Personal [signal:24b505dd-da01-4283-9d08-793aadf323a8] [signal:45faa8c1-8d5a-415a-83e6-ae14e8ddbd45] [signal:49c15b4e-fd4c-449c-8cb1-944e188beba9]. A G70 customer who usually drove in ECOPro reported that the car changed to Comfort after a few weeks and would not allow a change back [signal:7f97966a-7fda-4de7-a09a-b1ac0d89b5f1].

## Differences between markets
All six supplied signals are from the USA: four concern G60 vehicles and two concern G70 vehicles [signal:179d247b-c8ac-4ea4-809d-cd3bb32185ce] [signal:fd8da9a6-afba-420b-8f7b-db4099899d2a] [signal:24b505dd-da01-4283-9d08-793aadf323a8] [signal:49c15b4e-fd4c-449c-8cb1-944e188beba9] [signal:7f97966a-7fda-4de7-a09a-b1ac0d89b5f1] [signal:45faa8c1-8d5a-415a-83e6-ae14e8ddbd45]. No other market is represented in the supplied signals.

## Open questions
Do customers have difficulty discovering the default-mode setting, or is the main issue that they want a different startup behavior? [signal:fd8da9a6-afba-420b-8f7b-db4099899d2a] [signal:24b505dd-da01-4283-9d08-793aadf323a8] [signal:45faa8c1-8d5a-415a-83e6-ae14e8ddbd45] [signal:49c15b4e-fd4c-449c-8cb1-944e188beba9] What led the G70 customer’s vehicle to switch from ECOPro to Comfort and prevent switching back? [signal:7f97966a-7fda-4de7-a09a-b1ac0d89b5f1]

value.title: Rear window clears slowly and defrost control is hard to find
value.summary: USA customers report slow or incomplete rear-window clearing, and some are unsure where to find the defrost control. Signals cover G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Rear windows clear slowly or incompletely, and some customers cannot find the defrost control.
All six signals are from the USA: three concern G60 and three concern G70.
One G70 customer says the rear glass defogs more slowly than their former Mercedes S-Class.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the rear window clears slowly or remains foggy, and some have difficulty locating the rear defrost control. [signal:1462ae89-8f35-43da-9abf-864c8424c061] [signal:6dee7dd5-00ea-4f88-8cb9-438b95f80eff] [signal:73fcfa15-fa5e-49aa-8e21-4bbdf5a988d3] [signal:a03f705f-1c18-411f-b6b2-3c1bec283401] [signal:a6f0dfda-e63b-478d-ada0-c298d06b40dc] [signal:f842a42f-e68a-4e47-9a7f-c31ee1c3bc5f]

## What customers say
G60 customers describe clearing as less effective than on a prior model and taking a long time. [signal:1462ae89-8f35-43da-9abf-864c8424c061] [signal:6dee7dd5-00ea-4f88-8cb9-438b95f80eff] One G70 customer says the rear glass defogs more slowly than their former Mercedes S-Class; another says the window seems persistently foggy, especially in bright sun. [signal:73fcfa15-fa5e-49aa-8e21-4bbdf5a988d3] [signal:f842a42f-e68a-4e47-9a7f-c31ee1c3bc5f] Customers in both vehicle lines asked where the control was or were unsure how to switch on the defroster; they were directed to the dashboard below the center display. [signal:a03f705f-1c18-411f-b6b2-3c1bec283401] [signal:a6f0dfda-e63b-478d-ada0-c298d06b40dc]

## Differences between markets
All six signals are from the USA, so the supplied signals do not show differences between markets. [signal:1462ae89-8f35-43da-9abf-864c8424c061] [signal:6dee7dd5-00ea-4f88-8cb9-438b95f80eff] [signal:73fcfa15-fa5e-49aa-8e21-4bbdf5a988d3] [signal:a03f705f-1c18-411f-b6b2-3c1bec283401] [signal:a6f0dfda-e63b-478d-ada0-c298d06b40dc] [signal:f842a42f-e68a-4e47-9a7f-c31ee1c3bc5f]

## Open questions
Do the reports of slow or incomplete clearing vary by conditions or use? [signal:1462ae89-8f35-43da-9abf-864c8424c061] [signal:6dee7dd5-00ea-4f88-8cb9-438b95f80eff] [signal:f842a42f-e68a-4e47-9a7f-c31ee1c3bc5f] How often do customers have difficulty finding the control beyond the two recorded cases? [signal:a03f705f-1c18-411f-b6b2-3c1bec283401] [signal:a6f0dfda-e63b-478d-ada0-c298d06b40dc]

value.title: Broad infotainment options are valued by owners
value.summary: USA owners of G60 and G70 vehicles value the range of features and options, especially those associated with infotainment.
highlights: Owners value the vehicle’s range of features and infotainment options.
Signals come from two USA owners: one with a G60 and one with a G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The signals describe broad feature and option availability as valued, rather than reporting a specific problem. [signal:12388c6d-ccde-4880-984e-4055d28e31c3] [signal:4b625ca3-b1e2-42e2-89f9-7e8b9e7ebdb2]

## What customers say
A G60 owner likes the vehicle’s features and options. [signal:12388c6d-ccde-4880-984e-4055d28e31c3]
A G70 owner particularly values the many options associated with the infotainment system. [signal:4b625ca3-b1e2-42e2-89f9-7e8b9e7ebdb2]

## Differences between markets
Both signals are from the USA, so they do not show differences between markets. [signal:12388c6d-ccde-4880-984e-4055d28e31c3] [signal:4b625ca3-b1e2-42e2-89f9-7e8b9e7ebdb2]

## Open questions
The signals do not identify which specific features or options owners value. [signal:12388c6d-ccde-4880-984e-4055d28e31c3] [signal:4b625ca3-b1e2-42e2-89f9-7e8b9e7ebdb2]

value.title: Infotainment praised, but some functions take time to learn
value.summary: Customers across the signals value the technology and infotainment, while some say the range of functions or configuration takes time to understand. Reports include both easy-to-use screens and systems that can be tricky to navigate.
highlights: Technology and infotainment are valued, but some functions take time to learn.
In the supplied signals: Europe and USA; F70, G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers praise the technology and infotainment, but some report that configuring features or understanding the many functions takes time. [signal:2f697d2a-9fcd-4d7a-825f-af765291e1ba] [signal:83cf8059-a78f-4630-8193-4796fd99e402]

## What customers say
Some customers describe the screens as simple to figure out or the iDrive setup as straightforward and intuitive. [signal:260c884a-5bf7-4de4-b29a-dc49a74bb00d] [signal:c8f24f91-0ea9-47f1-bd86-04933307ed6a]
Others say they are still getting used to configuring features, that the wide-ranging functions take time to understand, or that some systems are tricky to work through. [signal:2f697d2a-9fcd-4d7a-825f-af765291e1ba] [signal:83cf8059-a78f-4630-8193-4796fd99e402] [signal:c8f24f91-0ea9-47f1-bd86-04933307ed6a]
Customers also praise the technology, infotainment, music access and speakers.  [signal:2f697d2a-9fcd-4d7a-825f-af765291e1ba] [signal:75debf22-fbea-4188-a527-e45556c8d576]

## Differences between markets
The supplied Europe signals include praise for the infotainment and in-car communication system, as well as one report of systems being tricky to use and another of still learning feature configuration. [signal:309d2a4a-597f-46c0-83ab-434e021fa9d4] [signal:925bcc6c-c979-4b42-bf46-20a464c725fc] [signal:c8f24f91-0ea9-47f1-bd86-04933307ed6a] [signal:2f697d2a-9fcd-4d7a-825f-af765291e1ba]
The supplied USA signals include praise for simple-to-figure-out screens and technology, alongside a comment that the interactive screen setup has almost too many choices. [signal:260c884a-5bf7-4de4-b29a-dc49a74bb00d] 

## Open questions
The signals do not establish which functions are hardest to learn or how often customers encounter usability difficulties. [signal:2f697d2a-9fcd-4d7a-825f-af765291e1ba] [signal:83cf8059-a78f-4630-8193-4796fd99e402] [signal:c8f24f91-0ea9-47f1-bd86-04933307ed6a]

value.title: Owners value the car’s modern technology
value.summary: The available feedback values the vehicles’ modern technology, electronics and user interface. Positive comments come from USA owners of G60 and G70 vehicles and a Europe owner of an F70.
highlights: Owners praise the technology, electronics and user interface.
Positive feedback appears in the USA for G60 and G70, and in Europe for F70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The available feedback is positive: owners praise the vehicles’ technology and electronics, with one G70 owner specifically liking the user interface. [signal:00f983b4-e890-4440-8181-2e666f302564] [signal:14003b7a-f585-47f7-b4b5-fc2f64e8f0c4] [signal:1a73a314-e689-4e40-a90f-28f09a302b8e]

## What customers say
USA owners describe the technology as modern, excellent and improved compared with their previous BMWs. [signal:14003b7a-f585-47f7-b4b5-fc2f64e8f0c4] [signal:336b966c-7c7d-434f-9f0d-ca1c588a4904] [signal:39204322-10eb-4503-8dfe-16e681bb7f91] [signal:48abc748-bc74-45df-bccf-ee5281678d92] A Europe F70 owner says the technology is better than in their previous 1 Series and describes it as reliable so far. [signal:d7d7a760-b090-4be0-8eea-3c3b42892854]

## Differences between markets
The sampled USA feedback covers G60 and G70 vehicles and includes praise for the technology and user interface. [signal:00f983b4-e890-4440-8181-2e666f302564] [signal:14003b7a-f585-47f7-b4b5-fc2f64e8f0c4] [signal:1a73a314-e689-4e40-a90f-28f09a302b8e] [signal:336b966c-7c7d-434f-9f0d-ca1c588a4904] [signal:39204322-10eb-4503-8dfe-16e681bb7f91] [signal:48abc748-bc74-45df-bccf-ee5281678d92] The sampled Europe feedback is from an F70 owner and is also positive. [signal:d7d7a760-b090-4be0-8eea-3c3b42892854]

## Open questions
The feedback does not identify specific ConnectedDrive or infotainment functions behind the general praise. [signal:00f983b4-e890-4440-8181-2e666f302564] [signal:14003b7a-f585-47f7-b4b5-fc2f64e8f0c4] [signal:48abc748-bc74-45df-bccf-ee5281678d92]

[signal:466e7428-f03a-424e-a818-64252b557b26] [signal:259c0a12-5626-4cd8-a923-cebc887f7ba0] [signal:374e3ace-223c-4b14-a35c-7e9ec1d83756] [signal:ba1e8c38-3aea-4610-8af9-87c5754617a1] [signal:f58023ff-ed9e-4482-9ade-f67859f67214]

value.title: Comfort Access reacts too easily or inconsistently
value.summary: Comfort Access is described as overly sensitive in some situations and unreliable in others, affecting customers with G60 and G70 vehicles in the USA and F70 vehicles in Europe.
highlights: Customers report unwanted locking, unlocking, beeping, or missed detection.
Signals cover USA G60 and G70 vehicles and Europe F70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe Comfort Access as either reacting too easily or failing to lock or unlock consistently. [signal:2c8529ba-05bd-4889-8442-8737cb11136d] [signal:7a3e9056-0ca3-41dd-8acd-942b21f6310e] [signal:3cb5b3de-ee5c-4bc2-99b7-768d42bdc251] Some reports describe a vehicle locking while a key remains inside, or repeatedly locking and unlocking when not wanted. [signal:1de2b659-3df8-4d79-b4c4-57ea954511fd] [signal:3a658f81-e826-4718-8bd5-7507588fb347]

## What customers say
A customer with a G60 said the vehicle beeps whenever he approaches with the key and finds this annoying. [signal:1f82f77b-b51e-4d80-a09a-06982d80c289] Other G60 customers reported inconsistent touch-free locking or unlocking, including digital key unlocking problems. [signal:3cb5b3de-ee5c-4bc2-99b7-768d42bdc251] [signal:53bcfa77-2336-47c1-b09a-2dda86935ad9] One G70 customer reported the car locking with a key still inside a purse; the service writer suggested key detection or battery condition might be involved. [signal:1de2b659-3df8-4d79-b4c4-57ea954511fd] Some customers asked about or were advised to use the “Exclude Home” setting for unwanted behavior at home. [signal:23af9f7e-7090-41af-9f2c-aa01b562e470] [signal:3a658f81-e826-4718-8bd5-7507588fb347]

## Differences between markets
The Europe F70 comments describe keyless entry as too sensitive or a nuisance. [signal:2c8529ba-05bd-4889-8442-8737cb11136d] [signal:7a3e9056-0ca3-41dd-8acd-942b21f6310e] The USA G60 and G70 reports instead include inconsistent operation, unwanted locking behavior, beeping, and questions about settings or key detection. [signal:1f82f77b-b51e-4d80-a09a-06982d80c289] [signal:3a658f81-e826-4718-8bd5-7507588fb347] [signal:3cb5b3de-ee5c-4bc2-99b7-768d42bdc251] [signal:1de2b659-3df8-4d79-b4c4-57ea954511fd]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported detection and operation problems share a cause. [signal:1de2b659-3df8-4d79-b4c4-57ea954511fd] [signal:3cb5b3de-ee5c-4bc2-99b7-768d42bdc251] [signal:53bcfa77-2336-47c1-b09a-2dda86935ad9] They also do not show how frequently these experiences occur beyond the individual reports provided. [signal:1f82f77b-b51e-4d80-a09a-06982d80c289] [signal:2c8529ba-05bd-4889-8442-8737cb11136d]

value.title: Comfort Access unlocking is inconsistent or unreliable
value.summary: Customers report inconsistent automatic unlocking, including a sensor that sometimes does not react and access that works only about half the time. Reports come from F70, G60 and G70 owners across Rest of World, the USA and Europe.
highlights: Automatic unlocking can fail, require handle contact or trigger near the car.
Five signals: USA (3), Rest of World (1) and Europe (1), across F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe Comfort Access as inconsistent: one F70 owner says the handle sensor does not react roughly one time in five, and a G60 owner reports it works about half the time. [signal:2bd9a444-61d0-4402-9b22-36c67893e63c] [signal:34b6f4e0-7bf8-4821-ba0f-baa6bb126229]

A G70 owner reports the car locking and unlocking while they are near the garage, despite excluding the home address from the feature. [signal:81774928-e3ff-4818-a179-87a981457d11] Another G60 owner says automatic unlocking stopped and they had to grab the handle. [signal:c8bed122-880d-434e-aeab-e320ef51913d]

## What customers say
The F70 owner describes the sensor as too insensitive and says the lock sometimes does not react to handle contact. [signal:2bd9a444-61d0-4402-9b22-36c67893e63c]

The G60 owner says Comfort Access works about 50% of the time despite trying different ways of holding the key fob; the dealer could not reproduce the issue. [signal:34b6f4e0-7bf8-4821-ba0f-baa6bb126229]

The G70 owner says the car repeatedly locks and unlocks when they are within about 10 feet. [signal:81774928-e3ff-4818-a179-87a981457d11] The other G60 report says automatic unlocking no longer happens, but the report also notes the customer was driving another vehicle and that permissions might need checking. [signal:c8bed122-880d-434e-aeab-e320ef51913d]

An F70 owner in Europe asks for proper keyless entry and a boot close button. [signal:bc0c83d1-4dd1-4be7-acb3-60aea23e867d]

## Differences between markets
The five signals cover the USA (three), Rest of World (one) and Europe (one), and the F70, G60 and G70. [signal:34b6f4e0-7bf8-4821-ba0f-baa6bb126229] [signal:81774928-e3ff-4818-a179-87a981457d11] [signal:c8bed122-880d-434e-aeab-e320ef51913d] [signal:2bd9a444-61d0-4402-9b22-36c67893e63c] [signal:bc0c83d1-4dd1-4be7-acb3-60aea23e867d]

USA reports include intermittent operation, unwanted locking and unlocking near the garage, and automatic unlocking no longer working. [signal:34b6f4e0-7bf8-4821-ba0f-baa6bb126229] [signal:81774928-e3ff-4818-a179-87a981457d11] [signal:c8bed122-880d-434e-aeab-e320ef51913d] The Rest of World report describes an insensitive handle sensor, while the Europe report asks for proper keyless entry. [signal:2bd9a444-61d0-4402-9b22-36c67893e63c] [signal:bc0c83d1-4dd1-4be7-acb3-60aea23e867d]

## Open questions
Does the intermittent unlocking reported in the USA and Rest of World have the same circumstances or cause? [signal:34b6f4e0-7bf8-4821-ba0f-baa6bb126229] [signal:2bd9a444-61d0-4402-9b22-36c67893e63c]

For the G60 report where automatic unlocking stopped, were permissions reset, and does the issue occur when the customer is with that vehicle? [signal:c8bed122-880d-434e-aeab-e320ef51913d]

value.title: Rear-door Comfort Access is missing or inconsistent
value.summary: Customers report missing rear-door Comfort Access on some vehicles, while others describe home proximity behavior they find disruptive or access that requires an extra-cost option. The signals come from G60, G70 and F70 owners in the USA, Rest of World and Europe.
highlights: Rear-door access is missing or inconsistent, and proximity locking or unlocking can be disruptive.
Shown signals: USA G60 (5), Rest of World G60 (1), Europe F70 (1), and USA G70 (1).
One European customer says similar access is standard on most cars, including basic versions.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers with G60 and G70 vehicles say they cannot use Comfort Access at the rear doors as they could on earlier BMWs or expected to on their current vehicle. [signal:e8f8ce0f-721f-4444-80c9-95b7b2740ab0] [signal:14436fb2-d9de-4bdf-8932-f4237a47795f] [signal:33c98f7d-2815-4178-91eb-18f050ceb48f] [signal:73e3cb08-2705-4d8c-9b7b-5155b56d60a0] One G60 owner also reports the car repeatedly locking and unlocking while parked in a garage near their home. [signal:2d6a916e-763a-4c52-ab8d-eeddbce76df5]

## What customers say
G60 owners describe wanting rear-door touch sensors or the ability to unlock the vehicle by touching a rear passenger door. [signal:14436fb2-d9de-4bdf-8932-f4237a47795f] [signal:8faadf0e-8aee-4d9c-9062-c5f1ee3427b3] One family-focused customer says rear-door access previously helped them get their children into the car while keeping the driver-door-only safety preference. [signal:33c98f7d-2815-4178-91eb-18f050ceb48f] A G70 owner says they miss the rear-door Comfort Access ridges from a previous 7 Series. [signal:73e3cb08-2705-4d8c-9b7b-5155b56d60a0] A European F70 owner says the door-handle button does not provide locking and unlocking unless the option is purchased, which they had not realized before buying. [signal:656a7511-8be2-4b05-8e44-3a083d2dfad6] Several G60 owners want a home-specific exclusion because proximity locking or unlocking can chirp and wake family members. [signal:2d6a916e-763a-4c52-ab8d-eeddbce76df5] [signal:3d301c43-50a7-425c-b447-8e11976d00c0]

## Differences between markets
The shown USA signals include G60 rear-door access requests and concerns about proximity behavior at home, as well as a G70 owner missing rear-door ridges. [signal:14436fb2-d9de-4bdf-8932-f4237a47795f] [signal:2d6a916e-763a-4c52-ab8d-eeddbce76df5] [signal:33c98f7d-2815-4178-91eb-18f050ceb48f] [signal:3d301c43-50a7-425c-b447-8e11976d00c0] [signal:73e3cb08-2705-4d8c-9b7b-5155b56d60a0] The Rest of World G60 signal also says rear-door convenience access is unavailable, while the Europe F70 signal concerns access being an extra-cost option. [signal:e8f8ce0f-721f-4444-80c9-95b7b2740ab0] [signal:656a7511-8be2-4b05-8e44-3a083d2dfad6] The F70 owner says similar functionality is standard on most cars, even basic versions. [signal:656a7511-8be2-4b05-8e44-3a083d2dfad6]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how widely rear-door access or home proximity concerns occur beyond the reported vehicles and markets. [signal:e8f8ce0f-721f-4444-80c9-95b7b2740ab0] [signal:14436fb2-d9de-4bdf-8932-f4237a47795f] [signal:2d6a916e-763a-4c52-ab8d-eeddbce76df5] [signal:33c98f7d-2815-4178-91eb-18f050ceb48f] [signal:3d301c43-50a7-425c-b447-8e11976d00c0] [signal:656a7511-8be2-4b05-8e44-3a083d2dfad6] [signal:73e3cb08-2705-4d8c-9b7b-5155b56d60a0] [signal:8faadf0e-8aee-4d9c-9062-c5f1ee3427b3] They also do not clarify whether the reported differences depend on vehicle configuration, model year or market. [signal:e8f8ce0f-721f-4444-80c9-95b7b2740ab0] [signal:656a7511-8be2-4b05-8e44-3a083d2dfad6] [signal:8faadf0e-8aee-4d9c-9062-c5f1ee3427b3]

value.title: Infotainment controls feel worse without the iDrive controller
value.summary: Some F70 owners in Europe find touch and voice controls frustrating and miss the rotary iDrive controller, while other owners value the simpler software and advanced technology. The signals also include concerns about navigation and parking-assistant performance in a G60 in Rest of World.
highlights: Some owners dislike touch and voice controls and miss the rotary controller.
Concerns appear in Europe’s F70 and Rest of World’s G60; US signals praise the technology.
One European F70 owner says they are checking other brands.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some F70 owners say the infotainment experience is worse without the rotary iDrive controller and shortcut buttons; one describes the touch and voice controls as awful. [signal:43011d86-522a-4d1c-8577-06f89319070c] [signal:5cfdf160-0c1f-409d-a52d-1f6e643940c8] A G60 owner in Rest of World says the navigation sometimes chooses routes that do not make sense and the parking assistant has not worked very well. [signal:243f8bbd-485d-4e5c-8d5e-b1c7e762a331]

## What customers say
Experiences are mixed: one F70 owner says the digital system makes basic tasks simpler, while another says the new infotainment is generally very good but misses features. [signal:30f85e63-0f0a-441b-8d9f-20b5fee90570] [signal:5cfdf160-0c1f-409d-a52d-1f6e643940c8] One F70 owner finds iDrive straightforward and the display responsive. value.title: Infotainment and vehicle technology feel unreliable or difficult to use
value.summary: Customers describe lag, screen failures, confusing controls and settings, and technology they find overwhelming or intrusive. Signals come from F70, G60 and G70 owners across Europe, the USA and Rest of World.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that infotainment and other vehicle technology can be slow, unreliable, difficult to operate, or intrusive. [signal:80aed237-f421-4533-b513-b92287b0d3a3] [signal:49b81adb-2029-46d4-be4c-01c2b1267ef4] [signal:c379a96c-0f35-4e8f-81d9-6277b74439f6] [signal:bae136bd-b694-46c1-a034-b6f3cc0695e9]

## What customers say
An F70 owner in Europe says the system often lags and the screen has sometimes remained black. [signal:80aed237-f421-4533-b513-b92287b0d3a3]
An F70 owner in Rest of World says removing physical buttons and the iDrive dial makes operation while driving worse, and describes the flat-panel buttons as hard to find by feel and slow to respond. [signal:49b81adb-2029-46d4-be4c-01c2b1267ef4]
An F70 owner in Europe says the lighting controls do not let them disable automatic headlights while the engine is running. [signal:98efddbd-9388-456f-924a-43177e8bbfa2]
A G70 owner in the USA describes the technology as overwhelming, says settings keep changing or need resetting, and finds driving-assistance functions hard to locate and adjust. [signal:c379a96c-0f35-4e8f-81d9-6277b74439f6]
A G60 owner in the USA objects to vehicle systems powering on when a door opens and taking a long time to power down. [signal:bae136bd-b694-46c1-a034-b6f3cc0695e9]
Another G60 owner in the USA says the software and app are good. [signal:e324dbb7-9332-4d63-b0ba-203672ce11e0]

## Differences between markets
The six signals cover three F70s, two G60s and one G70; three are from the USA, two from Europe and one from Rest of World. [signal:49b81adb-2029-46d4-be4c-01c2b1267ef4] [signal:80aed237-f421-4533-b513-b92287b0d3a3] [signal:98efddbd-9388-456f-924a-43177e8bbfa2] [signal:bae136bd-b694-46c1-a034-b6f3cc0695e9] [signal:c379a96c-0f35-4e8f-81d9-6277b74439f6] [signal:e324dbb7-9332-4d63-b0ba-203672ce11e0]
The USA signals include complaints about overwhelming or intrusive technology, while one G60 owner there says the software and app are good. [signal:bae136bd-b694-46c1-a034-b6f3cc0695e9] [signal:c379a96c-0f35-4e8f-81d9-6277b74439f6] [signal:e324dbb7-9332-4d63-b0ba-203672ce11e0]
The two European F70 signals describe different concerns: lag and screen failures in one, and automatic-headlight control in the other. [signal:80aed237-f421-4533-b513-b92287b0d3a3] [signal:98efddbd-9388-456f-924a-43177e8bbfa2]

## Open questions
How frequently do the reported lag and black-screen failures occur? [signal:80aed237-f421-4533-b513-b92287b0d3a3]
How widespread are the reported control, settings, and power-on concerns across vehicles and markets? [signal:49b81adb-2029-46d4-be4c-01c2b1267ef4] [signal:c379a96c-0f35-4e8f-81d9-6277b74439f6] [signal:bae136bd-b694-46c1-a034-b6f3cc0695e9]

value.title: Infotainment controls, navigation and guidance frustrate some owners
value.summary: Some owners report difficult or less clear infotainment controls, unsuitable navigation routes and limited access to vehicle guidance. These concerns are concentrated in the Europe-market F70 signals, while one F70 owner says the technology meets their needs.
highlights: Owners cite awkward controls, unclear maps, routing problems and hard-to-find guidance.
Europe F70: six signals; Rest of World G60 and USA G70: one each.
One signal compares controls with Mercedes; other competitor evidence is limited.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some owners find the infotainment experience difficult to use or less helpful than expected, citing swipe controls, unclear maps, navigation routes through narrow lanes and trouble accessing vehicle information. [signal:00dff6b4-3b2e-4fd8-8d08-08d1245a89ce] [signal:6446173b-995c-46e3-9223-7ff75bdc9c34] [signal:808e75a6-2f71-462d-9fc2-5b6ee5086157]

Several F70 owners say they miss a printed handbook; one describes the built-in guidance as hit and miss when searching for information. [signal:5c797e91-1f95-45dd-9b08-0d98e3b457e8] [signal:e202984e-8d95-4c1d-a511-1dd239476c3b]

The signals also include positive feedback: one F70 owner says the car has all the technology they realistically need. [signal:9aa874f5-bf97-4bb9-85be-e78309a90883]

## What customers say
One F70 owner says the track buttons are inconsistent and irritating, and compares the controls unfavourably with a Mercedes steering-wheel touch pad. [signal:00dff6b4-3b2e-4fd8-8d08-08d1245a89ce]

An F70 owner reports that navigation took them down narrow lanes on three trips, causing delays and stress; they also say their previous 1 Series offered fastest- or shortest-route choices that the new model does not. [signal:6446173b-995c-46e3-9223-7ff75bdc9c34]

Another F70 owner says the map is less clear than in their previous car and prefers the more definite control of the iDrive knob to swiping. [signal:808e75a6-2f71-462d-9fc2-5b6ee5086157]

A USA-market G70 owner says they expected traffic stop-and-go and lane-change assist, but were unhappy with the self-driving functions and received conflicting guidance after contacting BMW. [signal:c7ced28a-18c7-4deb-9bdb-a8be27d3278e]

## Differences between markets
Six supplied signals are from Europe-market F70 owners; they include both usability complaints and a positive view of the technology. [signal:00dff6b4-3b2e-4fd8-8d08-08d1245a89ce] [signal:5c797e91-1f95-45dd-9b08-0d98e3b457e8] [signal:6446173b-995c-46e3-9223-7ff75bdc9c34] [signal:808e75a6-2f71-462d-9fc2-5b6ee5086157] [signal:9aa874f5-bf97-4bb9-85be-e78309a90883] [signal:e202984e-8d95-4c1d-a511-1dd239476c3b]

The supplied USA G70 signal concerns expected driver-assistance features, while the Rest of World G60 signal does not describe an infotainment or ConnectedDrive issue. [signal:c7ced28a-18c7-4deb-9bdb-a8be27d3278e] [signal:3f873807-921b-4aaa-aced-885347b437cb]

## Open questions
- How widespread are the reported navigation, control and digital-guidance issues beyond the supplied signals?
- Which driver-assistance features were expected by the G70 owner, and what was ultimately available on that vehicle?

value.summary: Customers report recurring software faults, alongside infotainment that feels complicated or awkward to use. The signals include complaints from Europe, the USA and Rest of World across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Infotainment faults recur, while some customers find the system awkward and complicated.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe software faults including an iDrive display going black, a recurring component-protection error, disappearing home-screen widgets and an eSIM that sometimes will not activate. [signal:5aa6bafe-ba32-4e54-9d33-32d139c003e7] [signal:7056057f-4fe9-4a31-bee3-8b1bddf66fcc] [signal:2d703e37-9980-4f40-bf32-1e813eca1411] Other complaints concern infotainment complexity, hard-to-access functions and the loss of the rotary iDrive controller. [signal:0e5a2b02-1a8e-45c8-87d0-e3b53c7a4066] [signal:6c6bcca5-3c10-4df8-b206-9e74cb12cfc4] [signal:10aaff54-7dc5-45e3-8718-8458c2fedfa9]

## What customers say
One F70 owner in Rest of World says iDrive 9 went black about a month after delivery and was attributed to a possible communication failure. [signal:5aa6bafe-ba32-4e54-9d33-32d139c003e7] A Europe-based F70 owner says a component-protection error returned within weeks of a dealer visit. [signal:7056057f-4fe9-4a31-bee3-8b1bddf66fcc] A G70 owner in Europe reports randomly vanishing widgets and an eSIM that refuses to activate, while describing the app as excellent. [signal:2d703e37-9980-4f40-bf32-1e813eca1411]

Some F70 owners in Europe call the infotainment awkward or clunky and criticize losing the rotary controller and USB music playback. [signal:78c0701c-32a6-488e-9d5b-2147b852d806] Another F70 owner says touchscreen-only operation is distracting and awkward while driving. [signal:09814fc2-d04a-4e51-abf5-d8a58a92bf1d] A G60 owner in the USA describes the multimedia system as overly complicated, and a G70 owner in the USA says features are buried and take too long to access. [signal:0e5a2b02-1a8e-45c8-87d0-e3b53c7a4066] [signal:6c6bcca5-3c10-4df8-b206-9e74cb12cfc4]

## Differences between markets
The sample includes software-fault reports from Europe and Rest of World, and usability complaints from Europe and the USA. [signal:2d703e37-9980-4f40-bf32-1e813eca1411] [signal:5aa6bafe-ba32-4e54-9d33-32d139c003e7] [signal:7056057f-4fe9-4a31-bee3-8b1bddf66fcc] [signal:78c0701c-32a6-488e-9d5b-2147b852d806] [signal:0e5a2b02-1a8e-45c8-87d0-e3b53c7a4066] These signals do not establish that the problems differ by market. [signal:2d703e37-9980-4f40-bf32-1e813eca1411] [signal:5aa6bafe-ba32-4e54-9d33-32d139c003e7] [signal:7056057f-4fe9-4a31-bee3-8b1bddf66fcc] [signal:78c0701c-32a6-488e-9d5b-2147b852d806] [signal:0e5a2b02-1a8e-45c8-87d0-e3b53c7a4066]

## Open questions
How frequently do these software faults occur, and are they linked to particular software versions or vehicle configurations? [signal:5aa6bafe-ba32-4e54-9d33-32d139c003e7] [signal:7056057f-4fe9-4a31-bee3-8b1bddf66fcc] [signal:2d703e37-9980-4f40-bf32-1e813eca1411] Do customers who report usability issues also experience reliability faults? ## Problem
Customers describe BMW infotainment or IT systems as not intuitive, overly complicated or awkward to use. [signal:24c49245-eb0f-49a4-8467-b2e0fbc4edd7] [signal:afd38e9e-9e40-432c-a49b-9253a93b4088] [signal:e5bf77a3-eec5-4050-add1-d38158314d65] [signal:6292cad9-f5fb-458d-8e21-2a278f1911aa]

## What customers say
A G70 owner calls the infotainment system terrible and compares their satisfaction with it unfavourably to their Hyundai Palisade Calligraphy. [signal:65e9190d-aea9-4a49-b5da-01917005797b] A G60 owner says the multimedia setup is overly complicated and argues that luxury should be easy to use. [signal:afd38e9e-9e40-432c-a49b-9253a93b4088]

Experiences are not uniformly negative: one G60 owner names clarity as what they love most about the infotainment system. [signal:b5ecf499-66ae-41f0-bc19-40df7cc47d80] Another G60 owner says they basically never interact with it. [signal:675ad126-d758-476e-a3ca-6a19941ac26f]

## Differences between markets
The difficult-to-use complaints come from the USA, Europe and Rest of World. [signal:24c49245-eb0f-49a4-8467-b2e0fbc4edd7] [signal:65e9190d-aea9-4a49-b5da-01917005797b] [signal:afd38e9e-9e40-432c-a49b-9253a93b4088] [signal:e5bf77a3-eec5-4050-add1-d38158314d65] [signal:6292cad9-f5fb-458d-8e21-2a278f1911aa] Four signals concern G60 vehicles, two concern F70 vehicles and one concerns a G70. [signal:24c49245-eb0f-49a4-8467-b2e0fbc4edd7] [signal:afd38e9e-9e40-432c-a49b-9253a93b4088] [signal:675ad126-d758-476e-a3ca-6a19941ac26f] [signal:b5ecf499-66ae-41f0-bc19-40df7cc47d80] [signal:6292cad9-f5fb-458d-8e21-2a278f1911aa] [signal:e5bf77a3-eec5-4050-add1-d38158314d65] [signal:65e9190d-aea9-4a49-b5da-01917005797b]

## Open questions
The signals do not explain what makes the systems difficult or awkward to use. [signal:24c49245-eb0f-49a4-8467-b2e0fbc4edd7] [signal:6292cad9-f5fb-458d-8e21-2a278f1911aa] [signal:65e9190d-aea9-4a49-b5da-01917005797b] [signal:afd38e9e-9e40-432c-a49b-9253a93b4088] [signal:e5bf77a3-eec5-4050-add1-d38158314d65] The signals also do not clarify how the owner who values clarity reconciles that view with the usability complaints. [signal:b5ecf499-66ae-41f0-bc19-40df7cc47d80]

value.title: Infotainment and connected technology feel complicated and unreliable
value.summary: Customers report complicated interfaces, screen-focused controls, software glitches and unreliable connected functions. The supplied signals include complaints from Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across F70, G70 and G60.
highlights: Customers describe technology as complicated, unreliable or difficult to use.
In the supplied sample: 6 Europe, 5 USA and 1 Rest of World signals; F70, G70 and G60.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe infotainment and connected technology as complicated, and report software and connectivity problems. [signal:0c4e2f0d-a32d-470d-a0e9-8342fa37faad] [signal:08a5a9c9-9949-47e6-96ec-d4f2f9dc5431] Some say that screen-based controls require looking away from the road, while basic tasks can take several menu steps. [signal:041c91d5-3c28-4ad9-ab1d-f7c333792e3b] [signal:3e80bbe8-9cdc-4770-96f5-3fe479e1b56b]

## What customers say
One Europe customer reports the connected app sometimes does not work, the interface feels overly complicated, and voice instructions are unreliable. [signal:0c4e2f0d-a32d-470d-a0e9-8342fa37faad] Another reports the infotainment screen cutting out and needing resets. [signal:08a5a9c9-9949-47e6-96ec-d4f2f9dc5431] Customers also mention repeated password resets and re-saving preferences, post-update quirks, and difficulty adapting to the technology. [signal:1e1e0c82-ae39-4023-9dee-2a7ebf7e7286] [signal:119c0fef-4ad2-4313-a1e5-3aa43e3ba03d] [signal:1b079d0d-b801-4e67-85d9-7532805f60c2]

In the USA, customers report having to navigate multiple screens for adjustments, too many apps while driving, and software-related dissatisfaction. [signal:3e80bbe8-9cdc-4770-96f5-3fe479e1b56b] [signal:30ab1fbe-c6fb-41f8-9ae1-93a02efd5b9c] One Rest of World customer says the UI feels more complicated than in an older vehicle. [signal:54518737-aee8-4975-80b5-cf06d2523b47]

## Differences between markets
The supplied sample contains six Europe signals, five USA signals and one Rest of World signal; the vehicles named are F70, G70 and G60. [signal:041c91d5-3c28-4ad9-ab1d-f7c333792e3b] [signal:08a5a9c9-9949-47e6-96ec-d4f2f9dc5431] [signal:0c4e2f0d-a32d-470d-a0e9-8342fa37faad] [signal:119c0fef-4ad2-4313-a1e5-3aa43e3ba03d] [signal:1b079d0d-b801-4e67-85d9-7532805f60c2] [signal:1e1e0c82-ae39-4023-9dee-2a7ebf7e7286] [signal:10eb380c-38b2-461b-9b56-fa3d53bcb66a] [signal:30ab1fbe-c6fb-41f8-9ae1-93a02efd5b9c] [signal:3e80bbe8-9cdc-4770-96f5-3fe479e1b56b] [signal:4246d7ca-7c26-4a24-a1c6-a7794166d90e] [signal:43c33c30-17a0-4cad-b48b-7e51364eef30] [signal:54518737-aee8-4975-80b5-cf06d2523b47] The Europe signals include screen, app, voice-function and preference issues; USA signals include menu complexity, app volume and other software concerns. [signal:041c91d5-3c28-4ad9-ab1d-f7c333792e3b] [signal:0c4e2f0d-a32d-470d-a0e9-8342fa37faad] [signal:1e1e0c82-ae39-4023-9dee-2a7ebf7e7286] [signal:3e80bbe8-9cdc-4770-96f5-3fe479e1b56b] [signal:30ab1fbe-c6fb-41f8-9ae1-93a02efd5b9c] The Rest of World signal focuses on the UI feeling more complicated than before. [signal:54518737-aee8-4975-80b5-cf06d2523b47]

## Open questions
The supplied sample does not establish how common these experiences are across the 57 signals or across markets and vehicle lines. [signal:041c91d5-3c28-4ad9-ab1d-f7c333792e3b] It also does not show whether the reported software and connected-function problems share a cause. [signal:08a5a9c9-9949-47e6-96ec-d4f2f9dc5431] [signal:0c4e2f0d-a32d-470d-a0e9-8342fa37faad]

value.title: Rear sunshades are too dark and impair visibility
value.summary: Some US G70 and G60 customers find the sunshades difficult to use, especially when the raised rear shade blocks visibility. Other reported concerns include shades closing while the car is parked and uncertainty about operating the rear window shade.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the rear sunshade can be too dark or opaque to see through, making it difficult to use while driving and, in one account, raising a safety concern. [signal:3a3f311a-1fa1-4333-9bbd-c40d6f07a1c3] [signal:4a457c00-bd04-4b36-9317-cc7d0ce56aca] [signal:7be734ac-2a08-49ae-8d96-a03be3e0aec5] Other reported usability problems include shades closing while the vehicle is parked and difficulty knowing how to operate the rear shade from the driver's seat. [signal:0f9524d3-d6a1-400c-bebe-ff1076796f7b] [signal:490214da-57cc-464a-93e3-c0db9440915c]

## What customers say
One G70 customer said the rear shade was too dark, and another described the shades inside the vehicle as quite dark. [signal:3a3f311a-1fa1-4333-9bbd-c40d6f07a1c3] [signal:771c4755-3d76-4d62-a4d1-d2ce64cf9747] A G70 customer said the raised rear shade prevented them from seeing behind the vehicle; another said the rear shade was opaque compared with the side shades and had to be lowered while driving for visibility. [signal:4a457c00-bd04-4b36-9317-cc7d0ce56aca] [signal:7be734ac-2a08-49ae-8d96-a03be3e0aec5] One customer also reported that the shades sometimes close while the parked vehicle is shut off, and wanted them to open again upon re-entry. [signal:0f9524d3-d6a1-400c-bebe-ff1076796f7b] A G60 customer asked how to lower the rear window shade from the driver's seat. [signal:490214da-57cc-464a-93e3-c0db9440915c]

## Differences between markets
All six supplied reports are from the USA: five concern the G70 and one concerns the G60. [signal:0f9524d3-d6a1-400c-bebe-ff1076796f7b] [signal:3a3f311a-1fa1-4333-9bbd-c40d6f07a1c3] [signal:490214da-57cc-464a-93e3-c0db9440915c] [signal:4a457c00-bd04-4b36-9317-cc7d0ce56aca] [signal:771c4755-3d76-4d62-a4d1-d2ce64cf9747] [signal:7be734ac-2a08-49ae-8d96-a03be3e0aec5] No market differences are represented in the supplied reports. [signal:0f9524d3-d6a1-400c-bebe-ff1076796f7b] [signal:3a3f311a-1fa1-4333-9bbd-c40d6f07a1c3] [signal:490214da-57cc-464a-93e3-c0db9440915c] [signal:4a457c00-bd04-4b36-9317-cc7d0ce56aca] [signal:771c4755-3d76-4d62-a4d1-d2ce64cf9747] [signal:7be734ac-2a08-49ae-8d96-a03be3e0aec5]

## Open questions
Do the visibility concerns apply to other vehicles or markets? The supplied reports cover only the USA, G70, and G60. [signal:0f9524d3-d6a1-400c-bebe-ff1076796f7b] [signal:3a3f311a-1fa1-4333-9bbd-c40d6f07a1c3] [signal:490214da-57cc-464a-93e3-c0db9440915c] [signal:4a457c00-bd04-4b36-9317-cc7d0ce56aca] [signal:771c4755-3d76-4d62-a4d1-d2ce64cf9747] [signal:7be734ac-2a08-49ae-8d96-a03be3e0aec5] How often do the shades close while parked, and how frequently do customers have difficulty operating them? [signal:0f9524d3-d6a1-400c-bebe-ff1076796f7b] [signal:490214da-57cc-464a-93e3-c0db9440915c]

## Problem
Customers report rear sunshades sticking or failing to raise, lower, or move as expected. [signal:1ad64742-5bd6-49ae-bedb-e1ed2150a527] [signal:21c52d27-a0bb-4cd1-af20-2113662b7e9c] [signal:2d51d667-388b-499e-bf3c-27ec8978d8b1] One customer reports a rattle from the rear sun curtain, another says the shade does not drop in reverse, and a G60 owner says it bumps the rearview mirror when raised. [signal:751863a1-8e51-43a8-b844-de5bb7adb1c7] [signal:8ac132b7-b283-454e-9742-41d65d09283e] [signal:d6b99961-06f2-4c24-a39b-6101b914d743]

[signal:1ad64742-5bd6-49ae-bedb-e1ed2150a527] Another reports a rear shade stuck going down; a part was on order. [signal:21c52d27-a0bb-4cd1-af20-2113662b7e9c] A third says the blind stayed down, then began working again after about two days. [signal:2d51d667-388b-499e-bf3c-27ec8978d8b1] One customer reports a significant rear curtain rattle, and says it was taken apart or replaced to stop the noise. [signal:1ad64742-5bd6-49ae-bedb-e1ed2150a527] [signal:21c52d27-a0bb-4cd1-af20-2113662b7e9c] [signal:2d51d667-388b-499e-bf3c-27ec8978d8b1] [signal:751863a1-8e51-43a8-b844-de5bb7adb1c7] [signal:8ac132b7-b283-454e-9742-41d65d09283e] [signal:d6b99961-06f2-4c24-a39b-6101b914d743] Five concern the G70 and one concerns the G60. [signal:1ad64742-5bd6-49ae-bedb-e1ed2150a527] [signal:21c52d27-a0bb-4cd1-af20-2113662b7e9c] [signal:2d51d667-388b-499e-bf3c-27ec8978d8b1] [signal:751863a1-8e51-43a8-b844-de5bb7adb1c7] [signal:8ac132b7-b283-454e-9742-41d65d09283e] [signal:d6b99961-06f2-4c24-a39b-6101b914d743]

value.title: Vehicle technology is difficult for customers to understand and use
value.summary: All 91 complaints concern the usability of overall vehicle technology among USA customers with G60 and G70 vehicles. Customers describe the many systems and features as difficult to learn and navigate.
highlights: Customers find the vehicle’s technology and features difficult to understand and use.
USA customers across G60 and G70 are affected.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
All 91 signals are complaints about overall technology usability from USA customers: 46 in G60 and 45 in G70. Customers describe difficulty understanding and operating the vehicle’s many systems and features. [signal:05ee87f8-434a-41d0-82e8-ff62b877f308] [signal:07563058-21b6-4028-b686-423d0b3944e5]

## What customers say
Customers say the technology takes time to learn, and that there is a lot to remember even after an explanation. [signal:04e2d169-391f-4e00-90be-aaedb9fa9b99] Some describe understanding only a small share of the available systems and features. [signal:05ee87f8-434a-41d0-82e8-ff62b877f308] One customer says touchscreen use and navigating menus are too complicated. [signal:0a58c145-8c8d-4448-a9e7-b8dfd86985ab] Customers also describe gradually learning functions and relying on family members or seeking help to understand them. [signal:087a284f-0ace-4d62-9bfb-27edf2b847f8] [signal:0918fd33-dc46-4e8f-b1da-b737f6c3bc8b]

## Differences between markets
The case counts cover USA customers only; no other market is represented. The provided counts give no market-level comparison.

## Open questions
The counts show 91 complaints and no defects, wishes or likes. They do not indicate which systems or features are most difficult across the case.

## What customers say
Across the case, 27 customers raised 29 complaints, including 28 defects. [signal:4207d14d-d71d-4d5c-a22b-1429c18e0b5b] One customer calls the door material cheap-feeling, while another says the lower door panels use cheap plastic compared with a previous vehicle. [signal:4207d14d-d71d-4d5c-a22b-1429c18e0b5b] [signal:4762764a-5f48-48f9-ab19-eb788373b18e] A customer reports driver-door misalignment, and another says the doors do not feel solid. [signal:4207d14d-d71d-4d5c-a22b-1429c18e0b5b] [signal:2d1b55ed-ae6c-4c0e-9e2a-31d3df17324a] [signal:3862ba30-74dd-4705-badb-8c25198c8648] [signal:4b7e3558-80e6-424e-8d53-38bda006604f]

## Open questions
The case spans F70, G60, and G70 vehicles, with 14 complaints from 12 customers for F70, 7 from 7 for G60, and 8 from 8 for G70. The available counts do not specify which door-quality concerns occur across each vehicle line.

value.title: Climate settings are difficult to use and control
value.summary: BMW customers report difficulty understanding and adjusting climate settings, including synchronization and screen-based controls. The case covers Europe and the USA across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: 28 complaints cite usability problems with climate settings.
