value.body_md:
## Problem

Across the case, 28 of 44 customers complained about climate-setting usability, while 12 expressed wishes and 4 likes; there were no reported defects. Customers describe difficulty adjusting climate functions, including syncing or separating zones and operating controls through the screen. [signal:01d45927-f279-4e6d-b5a7-e9e2e7e5dd10] [signal:2f308a85-5c7d-40cd-b91e-bb31f2313bc8] [signal:361c1c86-be29-4e10-a2ba-bc74243b06ad]

## What customers say

Some customers find it unclear how to change or activate climate settings, and one reports that air seems to keep blowing even at a low level. [signal:1484fb71-00b9-4a19-8086-12ae5f91a50f] [signal:4de54842-0164-4fa7-8e66-97d00aceb79f]

Customers also describe frustration with screen-based controls instead of traditional buttons, and with the effort involved in adjusting heating while driving. [signal:361c1c86-be29-4e10-a2ba-bc74243b06ad] [signal:ebf9f401-97df-4e9c-9b0a-b92e0f7e5652]

Synchronization experiences differ: one customer wants sync to remain on between trips, while customers in Europe report difficulty turning sync off or separating driver and passenger settings. [signal:01d45927-f279-4e6d-b5a7-e9e2e7e5dd10] [signal:5b4ae5ad-ff58-4642-b1bd-2a19edf85fd1] [signal:7b7ffa9a-fce6-42f4-8d0a-eaecb498ee7b]

## Differences between markets

The case includes 9 customers in Europe and 35 in the USA. Complaints are reported by customers in both markets: 6 in Europe and 22 in the USA. [signal:4394eabe-7f31-4c3c-b253-de3b1375c5d1] [signal:361c1c86-be29-4e10-a2ba-bc74243b06ad]

The case covers 9 F70, 20 G60 and 15 G70 customers. [signal:4394eabe-7f31-4c3c-b253-de3b1375c5d1] [signal:2f308a85-5c7d-40cd-b91e-bb31f2313bc8] [signal:01d45927-f279-4e6d-b5a7-e9e2e7e5dd10]

## Open questions

The signals do not establish why climate functions are difficult for some customers to find or operate. [signal:4de54842-0164-4fa7-8e66-97d00aceb79f]

They also do not resolve how synchronization behavior differs by vehicle or setting. [signal:5b4ae5ad-ff58-4642-b1bd-2a19edf85fd1] [signal:01d45927-f279-4e6d-b5a7-e9e2e7e5dd10]

value.title: F70 suspension feels too firm on rough roads
value.summary: Customers report overly firm suspension and uncomfortable ride quality, particularly on rough or uneven roads. The case spans Europe, Rest of World and the USA, across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Suspension is reported as too firm, with discomfort on rough or uneven roads.
18 customers: Europe (12), Rest of World (4), USA (2); F70 (16), G60 (1), G70 (1).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the suspension as too firm, especially on bumpy or uneven roads. Reports include discomfort for passengers and back pain. [signal:603f2c98-c220-4d3a-a80a-9ebed9a5f78c] [signal:6983e1c7-3f6d-49a2-8588-f0aa5b1294c2] 

The counts record 18 customers, all with complaints classified as defects. [signal:603f2c98-c220-4d3a-a80a-9ebed9a5f78c]

## What customers say
F70 drivers describe a harsh ride over British roads and say the rear suspension can feel especially stiff. [signal:13326a84-ba60-47af-9659-3cd8e7544c7f] [signal:309932a2-edb2-414c-a933-338e2e6a804c] [signal:603f2c98-c220-4d3a-a80a-9ebed9a5f78c]

One customer says the firm suspension causes frequent shaking that varies with the road surface; another reports worry about hopping and bouncing on uneven roads. [signal:71b425a3-9afa-4b33-867c-5ee736569a74] [signal:f06bdf97-04bc-4ad5-be08-81bda3460bef]

One customer says the ride is too firm even for a performance model and questions the usefulness of adaptive suspension that cannot be adjusted. [signal:8dc3be9c-f9d3-4f07-89ea-a9c7425a8540]

## Differences between markets
The counts show complaints in Europe (12 customers), Rest of World (4) and the USA (2). [signal:603f2c98-c220-4d3a-a80a-9ebed9a5f78c]

The sampled European F70 reports describe a harsh ride on British roads, while Rest of World F70 reports mention rear stiffness, back discomfort and shaking on uneven roads. [signal:603f2c98-c220-4d3a-a80a-9ebed9a5f78c]  [signal:71b425a3-9afa-4b33-867c-5ee736569a74]

The counts cover F70 (16 customers), G60 (1) and G70 (1); the available G60 comment says adaptive suspension was not offered as an option on the e40. [signal:a392df02-cd26-493a-8c1d-703b0b2e6dc9]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported ride harshness reflects a defect in damping, suspension tuning, or differences in road surfaces and customer expectations. One F70 driver notes that some people may prefer a firm setup. 

The counts show no competitor signals.

value.title: Wireless charging unreliable or inoperative
value.summary: Wireless charging is reported as slow, inconsistent or inoperative by BMW customers in the USA. The case affects G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Wireless charging complaints describe slow, inconsistent or failed charging.
12 USA customers: 11 with G60 vehicles and 1 with a G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Wireless charging is reported as slow, inconsistent or inoperative. One customer says the pad had never worked from vehicle delivery and required dealer visits before it was corrected [signal:46973f88-eb1c-4c47-b8eb-d292e85ed71a].

## What customers say
- Customers describe very slow or ineffective charging [signal:43656c3c-68b9-44f4-9329-9b9093a61ab0] [signal:486a0616-e543-474e-9783-8216291de631].
- Reports include an apparently non-working passenger-side area and a passenger-side pad that sometimes fails [signal:007e0923-8723-4eba-b46b-c1f9cd4f8481] [signal:114d19e4-d3a3-4649-a3a5-5d57715ba0e9].
- One customer says charging did not work properly even after changing to a new iPhone [signal:44b7d7c3-8493-4907-be4d-652e89ab1d62].

## Differences between markets
The case is limited to the USA. The counts cover G60 and G70 vehicles.

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reports share a cause, or how charging performance varies across phones and vehicle configurations.

value.title: Personal eSIM activation is unreliable
value.summary: Personal eSIM activation is unreliable for BMW customers, leaving it unavailable or stuck during setup. The case spans Europe and the USA, and F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: 21 complaints, including 20 defects, concern Personal eSIM reliability.
16 customers across Europe and the USA; F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case contains 21 complaints from 16 BMW customers, including 20 defects. Customers report Personal eSIM failing to activate or remaining in setup, sometimes preventing use of rear Theater Screen streaming. [signal:3acfd4f3-1f4b-4d6b-aa66-e893cfdaabc1] [signal:900aac4b-da2f-4cde-82ca-c879f30a8542]

## What customers say
A USA customer says the eSIM had not worked after about three months and was needed for the Theater Screen. [signal:269cd49c-a755-4462-a14b-edcc75455347] Another reports that the eSIM never progresses past “Setting up personal eSIM” on many vehicle starts, preventing streaming to the rear screen. [signal:3acfd4f3-1f4b-4d6b-aa66-e893cfdaabc1] A further customer says months of troubleshooting did not resolve the issue. [signal:4c7b8880-efe4-4b3c-947c-1757d905c7b8]

## Differences between markets
The whole case includes 18 complaints from 14 customers in the USA and 3 complaints from 2 customers in Europe. In the USA, customers describe an eSIM that does not function or remains stuck during setup. [signal:2c1b310f-caa7-4c61-b094-fb757ca14647] [signal:3acfd4f3-1f4b-4d6b-aa66-e893cfdaabc1] European customers also describe the eSIM randomly refusing to activate. [signal:900aac4b-da2f-4cde-82ca-c879f30a8542]

The whole case covers F70, G60 and G70 vehicles. The counts are concentrated in G70, with 18 complaints from 13 customers; G60 has 2 complaints from 2 customers, and F70 has 1 complaint from 1 customer.

## Open questions
- What causes activation to fail or remain in setup?
- Under what conditions does the issue occur, and how consistently can it be reproduced?
- Is the issue associated with particular software versions or vehicle configurations?

value.title: Exterior mirrors fail, make noise or obstruct visibility
value.summary: Customers report exterior mirror malfunctions and noises, as well as visibility being obstructed by mirror size or interior-light reflections. The case covers BMW customers in Europe, the USA and the Rest of World across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Reported problems include non-working or tilted mirrors, folding noise and obstructed side visibility.
24 customers across Europe (11), Rest of World (5) and USA (8); F70 (14), G60 (3) and G70 (7).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem

The case contains 25 signals: 25 complaints about exterior rearview mirror reliability, covering 24 BMW customers. Reported issues include mirrors that do not work or change position, noises during folding, and visibility obstruction. The counts cover Europe, Rest of World and the USA, and vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70.

## What customers say

- Customers report a parking mirror that has never worked [signal:170e2785-7389-4e20-8dcf-274940bdadaf] [signal:7ce279a8-2311-48a8-a966-c7a93d55f7c3].
- One customer says the rear mirror tilts down after the car sits unused for about a week [signal:3ac28640-9d77-40cc-bf14-289631238fe6].
- Customers describe squeaking or other noise as the exterior mirrors open, close, fold or unfold [signal:36f13616-ff7c-4dd7-99e1-c3e3b422f197] [signal:85f0319b-8c57-472c-acb6-db5d3e851317].
- Some customers say the mirror or its view is obstructed: one describes an oversized mirror blocking left-side visibility [signal:0335b2b9-8053-4f49-af91-36aa211460e0], while others report interior or ambient lighting interfering with the view in a side mirror [signal:5ec18dba-5998-4e51-9be4-235290e94484] [signal:688badda-c1a5-40b3-8e4e-d446b1f5e5f6] [signal:85f0319b-8c57-472c-acb6-db5d3e851317].

## Differences between markets

The whole case includes customers in Europe, Rest of World and the USA, and complaints across F70, G60 and G70. The available signals describe different issues, but do not establish how those issues differ in prevalence between markets or vehicle lines.

## Open questions

- What causes the reported parking-mirror failures, position changes and folding noises?
- Under what conditions do visibility obstructions occur, and how often are they reported across the markets and vehicle lines?

value.title: Automatic start-stop is difficult to disable or control
value.summary: Customers report that automatic engine start-stop is difficult or frustrating to disable or control. The case covers 42 customers across the USA, Europe and Rest of World, with complaints and wishes across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Start-stop is difficult to disable or control.
42 customers: USA, Europe and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case contains 42 customer signals: 24 complaints and 18 wishes, with no defects or likes recorded. Customers describe difficulty disabling start-stop, finding its controls, or controlling when the engine shuts off. [signal:03b44255-dd47-42ec-833c-9bcbf3294705] [signal:21cdbeff-612a-476c-8629-69c263d95261] [signal:2f9fba31-f597-4f67-8e22-53029ab430cc]

## What customers say
Some customers say they must switch the function off every time they start the car, or that there is no quick button and they have to find the setting in the display. [signal:03b44255-dd47-42ec-833c-9bcbf3294705] [signal:36a13986-310e-4ae0-a7b9-2682d045809c] One G70 customer reports that the MSA off button is no longer available and that the setting did not appear in the iDrive path they checked. [signal:21cdbeff-612a-476c-8629-69c263d95261] Another customer dislikes the engine shutting off after unbuckling and opening the door, and would prefer it to keep running until they press the Start/Stop button. [signal:2f9fba31-f597-4f67-8e22-53029ab430cc] A Rest of World customer says the inability to disable idle stop raises concerns about battery and starter durability. [signal:267c72cd-6aba-45ee-ab3b-960caaf4eb3e]

## Differences between markets
The counts cover 40 customers in the USA, one in Europe and one in Rest of World. The USA has 22 complaints and 18 wishes; Europe and Rest of World each have one complaint and no recorded wishes. The sampled USA comments describe repeated disabling, hard-to-find controls and engine-shutoff behavior; the Rest of World comment raises battery and starter durability concerns. [signal:03b44255-dd47-42ec-833c-9bcbf3294705] [signal:36a13986-310e-4ae0-a7b9-2682d045809c] [signal:2f9fba31-f597-4f67-8e22-53029ab430cc] [signal:267c72cd-6aba-45ee-ab3b-960caaf4eb3e]

## Open questions
The signals leave open which start-stop controls and engine-shutoff conditions customers most want to change. They also raise, without resolving, concerns about long-term battery and starter durability. [signal:21cdbeff-612a-476c-8629-69c263d95261] [signal:2f9fba31-f597-4f67-8e22-53029ab430cc] [signal:267c72cd-6aba-45ee-ab3b-960caaf4eb3e]

value.title: Navigation reliability problems across markets and vehicle lines
value.summary: Customers report navigation that can be unreliable, unresponsive, inaccurate or missing place names. The case covers BMW customers in Europe, the USA and Rest of World across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Navigation complaints include reliability, responsiveness and accuracy problems.
22 customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe navigation that does not always work reliably: reports include inefficient or unreliable operation, an unresponsive screen, an incorrect vehicle location and missing place names. [signal:43d07d4a-c13b-4ebc-b798-b996201439bb] [signal:59c944db-4ccb-47f4-a5c9-425a973a5a1d] [signal:322e438e-6786-4c30-b65a-94851da7c391] [signal:71fc18a0-1bee-4fa8-a6f6-34d0cd1d4241]

## What customers say
One customer says navigation was inaccurate immediately after delivery, showing the car in the wrong place, but worked after an iDrive reboot. [signal:322e438e-6786-4c30-b65a-94851da7c391]

Another describes the navigation screen becoming unresponsive and the issue recurring after dealer visits. [signal:59c944db-4ccb-47f4-a5c9-425a973a5a1d]

A customer reports that navigation does not show place names, making it difficult to identify their location. [signal:71fc18a0-1bee-4fa8-a6f6-34d0cd1d4241]

A USA customer says navigation remained on a “starting navigation system” message, then worked again after a long iDrive reboot. [signal:920fe62c-8089-47b4-a7bc-36d8f35ff75a]

## Differences between markets
In Europe, a customer describes navigation as inefficient and unreliable. [signal:43d07d4a-c13b-4ebc-b798-b996201439bb] In Rest of World, reports describe an unresponsive navigation screen and missing place names. [signal:59c944db-4ccb-47f4-a5c9-425a973a5a1d] [signal:71fc18a0-1bee-4fa8-a6f6-34d0cd1d4241] In the USA, reports include incorrect positioning after delivery and navigation that stalls at startup. [signal:322e438e-6786-4c30-b65a-94851da7c391] [signal:920fe62c-8089-47b4-a7bc-36d8f35ff75a]

## Open questions
- Under what conditions do navigation screens become unresponsive or stall at startup?
- How often does the system show an incorrect location or omit place names?
- Do the reported problems persist after reboot or dealer visits?

value.title: Door locking and unlocking behavior is difficult to use
value.summary: Customers report confusing or inconvenient vehicle locking and unlocking behavior, including doors not unlocking as expected and keyless access issues. The case covers 38 customers across Europe, the Rest of World and the USA, and F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report difficult or unexpected door locking and unlocking behavior.
38 customers across Europe, Rest of World and USA; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem

The case includes 36 complaints, 2 wishes and 2 likes from 38 customers. Customers describe door access as difficult or different from what they expect, including rear or passenger doors remaining locked and uncertainty about settings. One customer also reports slow keyless unlocking. [signal:21255737-09af-4dba-874f-60db6960a666] [signal:3b951b67-d167-4841-8e5e-9926b115644e] [signal:708aa64e-8127-4de7-8fe3-0b892fbe2b4d] [signal:631a94cd-8ea3-48bf-939c-219bd8b54f4d]

## What customers say

Some customers expect all doors to unlock together, while others want doors to unlock at the end of a trip; one says they are unsure how to change the relevant setting. [signal:708aa64e-8127-4de7-8fe3-0b892fbe2b4d] [signal:2b83044a-ace5-4116-a85f-1d874070cfbc] [signal:3b951b67-d167-4841-8e5e-9926b115644e]

A customer describes difficulty understanding the locking setup when two drivers use the car, and another says the lock is hard to open. [signal:37e3e916-5cbd-48e5-af2f-13808b8f33b3] [signal:966ecf9e-cec9-44bd-8c8d-6341c6cc18fe]

One customer reports that a phone-based key sometimes needs resetting and requires phone face recognition before unlocking the car. [signal:d8e34428-690a-40b1-8701-cee51f96413e]

## Differences between markets

The counts include 5 complaints in Europe, 1 in the Rest of World and 30 in the USA. The cited European reports include doors staying locked after a driver-door unlock and slow keyless access; a USA report describes uncertainty about rear-door unlocking settings. [signal:708aa64e-8127-4de7-8fe3-0b892fbe2b4d] [signal:631a94cd-8ea3-48bf-939c-219bd8b54f4d] [signal:3b951b67-d167-4841-8e5e-9926b115644e]

## Open questions

What door-unlocking behavior do customers expect when opening the driver’s door or ending a trip? [signal:708aa64e-8127-4de7-8fe3-0b892fbe2b4d] [signal:2b83044a-ace5-4116-a85f-1d874070cfbc]

How easy is it for customers to find and understand the settings for rear-door and end-of-trip unlocking? [signal:3b951b67-d167-4841-8e5e-9926b115644e] [signal:2b83044a-ace5-4116-a85f-1d874070cfbc]

value.title: My BMW App reliability and connection failures
value.summary: BMW customers report unreliable app connections and functionality, including features that stop working or become unavailable. Complaints span Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: App connections and features can fail or behave inconsistently.
30 customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe the app as unreliable: connections can be slow or fail, and some functions stop working or disappear. One customer says trip statistics stopped working; another reports trips vanishing and vehicle updates changing settings without clear notice. [signal:1b653776-8a47-4bca-b0e8-e1e0aa085d9b] [signal:61ad43bc-d36b-467a-aa35-784ce6e60484]

## What customers say
A customer reports that the app connection often fails, while another says the car can connect slowly or not at all, particularly on short drives. [signal:1b653776-8a47-4bca-b0e8-e1e0aa085d9b] [signal:1231cf43-6ae9-4337-9b30-bee50859af30]

Other reported problems include being unable to access an account despite entering the required information, and alerts reaching the customer for only one of two BMWs. [signal:2e9a5fa0-8359-4c93-88c0-66bf54ba7500] [signal:22527061-71bc-48c6-bc10-369cff1764b1]

Customers also describe app features or connected services stopping or behaving unpredictably. One says trip statistics stopped and the app connection often failed; another says mileage disappeared and later returned without any action. [signal:1b653776-8a47-4bca-b0e8-e1e0aa085d9b] [signal:7bb3244c-06f4-4cda-a3ef-af7cc2d7f815]

## Differences between markets
The counts record complaints in Europe, the USA and Rest of World. In the cited European accounts, customers describe failed connections and app stability or functionality problems. [signal:1b653776-8a47-4bca-b0e8-e1e0aa085d9b] [signal:61ad43bc-d36b-467a-aa35-784ce6e60484]

In the cited USA accounts, customers describe slow or failed connections, account access problems and alerts not covering both of their BMWs. [signal:1231cf43-6ae9-4337-9b30-bee50859af30] [signal:2e9a5fa0-8359-4c93-88c0-66bf54ba7500] [signal:22527061-71bc-48c6-bc10-369cff1764b1]

A Rest of World customer reports that app mileage disappeared and later returned without intervention. [signal:7bb3244c-06f4-4cda-a3ef-af7cc2d7f815]

## Open questions
- What causes connections to fail or work inconsistently? [signal:1b653776-8a47-4bca-b0e8-e1e0aa085d9b] [signal:1231cf43-6ae9-4337-9b30-bee50859af30]
- Why do some app functions stop working or return without customer action? [signal:1b653776-8a47-4bca-b0e8-e1e0aa085d9b] [signal:7bb3244c-06f4-4cda-a3ef-af7cc2d7f815]
- What explains differences in alerts across vehicles associated with the same customer? [signal:22527061-71bc-48c6-bc10-369cff1764b1]

value.title: Personal eSIM setup and connection are difficult to use
value.summary: Customers report difficulty activating and using the Personal eSIM, including unreliable or recurring connections. The case spans 33 customers in the USA and Europe across the G60 and G70.
highlights: Personal eSIM activation and connection are reported as difficult and unreliable.
33 customers: 32 in the USA and 1 in Europe; 7 G60 and 26 G70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe Personal eSIM activation as difficult, and some report that the connection drops or requires repeated setup [signal:26189f37-a001-447c-90ff-d6757fde286b] [signal:1347d145-ddfd-40b4-a9ea-be61c25028fc] [signal:47ca4b8e-a72a-457f-bbd8-bb6a92436e36]. One customer says the eSIM works only when their phone is physically in the vehicle [signal:2dd7af8d-42ff-41df-894b-7947d8eea356].

## What customers say
One customer was told to contact their mobile provider before activation and then follow the app instructions [signal:0a08c4fb-8da7-4f60-9233-fbc6a38fc6e4]. Another had difficulty activating the eSIM before setting up an account with their carrier [signal:26189f37-a001-447c-90ff-d6757fde286b]. Customers also report that the connection may stop working after setup, recur as a setup notification, or be unreliable across multiple cars [signal:1347d145-ddfd-40b4-a9ea-be61c25028fc] [signal:47ca4b8e-a72a-457f-bbd8-bb6a92436e36] [signal:3ce24aca-432a-4d97-81d5-310d3e9231f9].

## Differences between markets
The case includes 32 USA customers and 1 Europe customer. The USA complaint descriptions include activation and connection problems [signal:26189f37-a001-447c-90ff-d6757fde286b] [signal:1347d145-ddfd-40b4-a9ea-be61c25028fc]. The Europe signal discusses other vehicle concerns and does not describe Personal eSIM usability [signal:e2778e1f-2a74-4289-8ce1-4945c761ed53].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether setup and connection problems share a cause, or how the reported behavior varies between the G60 and G70.

value.title: Seat quality, durability and fit concerns
value.summary: Seat-related complaints affect 35 customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World, on F70, G60 and G70. Reported concerns include deterioration, materials that stain or show dirt easily, and seat fit or equipment issues.
highlights: Complaints include seat deterioration, easily marked materials and fit or equipment concerns.
Affected: 35 customers across Europe, Rest of World and the USA; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report concerns with seat condition, material quality and fit. One F70 owner says the seats have deteriorated [signal:0e91d346-0fa2-4170-b6fb-f887426855cf]. G60 owners describe seats that stain or retain residue from wetness [signal:3f7704f5-0050-44bf-a35d-f7648e6ec51c] and seats that feel cheap [signal:6571be33-ace7-4924-945a-7eaf560211be]. A G70 owner says the seat and headrest feel too tall [signal:169496a7-19ba-43de-a483-b2b2cda932ae].

## What customers say
A USA G70 owner reports that white leather seats quickly show dirt when touched [signal:662e67f3-0ba1-43f3-a0aa-6be1b2185989]. A USA G60 owner says wetness leaves residue on the seat and that cleaning it is unclear [signal:3f7704f5-0050-44bf-a35d-f7648e6ec51c]. A G60 owner also objects to the absence of front-seat back pockets [signal:2d3b07d4-7dbd-4e12-8a67-74e9abafd707].

## Differences between markets
The case counts include 16 customers in Europe, 17 in the USA and 2 in Rest of World. In the signals cited here, a Rest of World F70 owner reports seat deterioration [signal:0e91d346-0fa2-4170-b6fb-f887426855cf]; USA owners describe staining or residue on G60 seats [signal:3f7704f5-0050-44bf-a35d-f7648e6ec51c] and dirt showing on white G70 seats [signal:662e67f3-0ba1-43f3-a0aa-6be1b2185989].

## Open questions
- Which seat concerns are most important to customers: durability, cleanability, fit or missing equipment?
- Do the reported material and condition concerns vary by seat trim or vehicle line?

value.title: Luggage compartment space and access limit everyday and travel use
value.summary: In the USA, customers report that luggage compartments feel too small or difficult to load, limiting space for shopping, luggage and bulky items. Others like the space.
highlights: Customers report limited capacity and openings that make some items difficult to load.
Affected: 36 USA customers across G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
In the USA, 23 of 36 customers complain that luggage compartment space or access does not meet their needs, while 12 like it. [signal:07f9ad1b-2a41-4b8a-97fa-03b59cff7099] [signal:098d9dd5-e553-41b5-ba2f-3925b30f54ac]

Customers describe the compartment as long but shallow, making taller items and large suitcases difficult to fit. [signal:07f9ad1b-2a41-4b8a-97fa-03b59cff7099] A narrow opening makes loading a wheelchair awkward, and limited capacity is also raised for shopping and work needs. [signal:104b0807-691b-475e-89b3-a4b8796c9c96] [signal:4143eb58-cf52-4bd1-b4e7-a0a916b35ef6] One customer says a spare tire takes up much of the space, making groceries and bulky items harder to load. [signal:416b76df-7949-4765-95aa-f5bc650d9048]

## What customers say
Some customers compare capacity unfavorably with other vehicles: one says a Charger has a larger trunk, and another finds wheelchair loading easier in a Mercedes S 580. [signal:4edd4419-c1ca-4d7a-8685-158438e4cc2e] [signal:104b0807-691b-475e-89b3-a4b8796c9c96] One customer says the space can prompt a wish for an X7. [signal:098d9dd5-e553-41b5-ba2f-3925b30f54ac]

## Differences between markets
The case covers the USA only. [signal:07f9ad1b-2a41-4b8a-97fa-03b59cff7099] The counts include 24 G60 customers and 12 G70 customers; complaints occur in both lines. [signal:4143eb58-cf52-4bd1-b4e7-a0a916b35ef6] [signal:098d9dd5-e553-41b5-ba2f-3925b30f54ac]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often particular item types or loading situations cause difficulty.

value.title: Automatic doors feel slow and difficult to operate
value.summary: Automatic doors are difficult to use for some G70 customers in the USA, with complaints about slow operation and confusing activation. The case also includes likes of the feature.
highlights: Customers complain that automatic doors are slow or difficult to operate.
Affected: 21 customers in the USA, all with the G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case covers 21 customers: 18 complaints and 3 likes. Customers report that automatic doors can feel slow or difficult to operate, and that activation can depend on button use and where they stand. [signal:026ad327-3172-40c1-9b8a-4068e8d8c485] [signal:1958fcb4-2127-455d-934e-b7c5a38a3e20] [signal:21a3530c-11ba-40ad-b1b4-22c5cdd9534b]

## What customers say
- One customer said the button must be held long enough and described the system as confusing; they also reported that sensor issues or standing in the wrong place can prevent operation. [signal:026ad327-3172-40c1-9b8a-4068e8d8c485]
- Customers described the doors as slow, with one saying they would rather open the door by hand after waiting and stepping back. [signal:1958fcb4-2127-455d-934e-b7c5a38a3e20] [signal:21a3530c-11ba-40ad-b1b4-22c5cdd9534b] [signal:2762f4dc-32e0-4b53-97fc-73ade4c45431]
- One customer asked how to open the driver's-side door from outside and was told to press the lit button area and step away from the door's travel path. [signal:26fecf07-b339-43eb-8071-78a76587a77f]
- One customer reported that the passenger-door sensor was not functioning. [signal:2b2a61c8-14ef-4f95-82ab-dd8e5c621fd8]

## Differences between markets
All 21 customers in the case are in the USA and have the G70; the counts show no other market or vehicle line.

## Open questions
The signals raise questions about how button-press duration, sensor behavior, and standing position affect operation. [signal:026ad327-3172-40c1-9b8a-4068e8d8c485] They do not clarify how widespread the reported passenger-door sensor issue is. [signal:2b2a61c8-14ef-4f95-82ab-dd8e5c621fd8]

value.title: Transmission shifts feel jerky, delayed or poorly timed
value.summary: Customers report jerky, rough or delayed transmission responses, including hesitation when engaging gears and during acceleration. Complaints span Europe and the USA, with some European customers also expressing positive views of the transmission.
highlights: Jerky, rough or delayed shifts and inconsistent transmission response.
28 customers across Europe and the USA; F70, G60 and G70.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Across the case, 24 of 28 customers report complaints and 4 report defects; 7 also like the transmission. [signal:0230ace1-3cf5-436b-a03e-8b5b78d8cdfc] [signal:1f21712b-0e61-4e35-9ed4-64bbecf7550a]

Customers describe jerky or rough gear changes, delays engaging a gear, and hesitation or slow response after pressing the accelerator. [signal:1b679c2d-ad28-4f66-89b1-7270bfc1966f] [signal:56f8d298-8f93-4559-ad06-c465efde3347] [signal:491f8a8d-3d22-481c-bf77-5bee7877dfed] [signal:36514795-49a4-4955-99ec-6cc65c826cbc]

## What customers say
A European F70 owner says the automatic gearbox feels less smooth than the one in a previous 3 Series. [signal:0230ace1-3cf5-436b-a03e-8b5b78d8cdfc]

Other F70 owners describe jerky low-speed manoeuvring, slow gearbox reactions and delayed acceleration. [signal:1b679c2d-ad28-4f66-89b1-7270bfc1966f] [signal:1f21712b-0e61-4e35-9ed4-64bbecf7550a]

USA customers report rough shifts, kicks on downshifts, delayed engagement and occasional shifts into neutral. [signal:56f8d298-8f93-4559-ad06-c465efde3347] [signal:2ebdf94e-db6f-402f-8ed7-35a7181abb6c] [signal:6fdeead5-0fa3-4cdf-ace7-1c80c527c6bd] [signal:b4e95578-6ab6-4e7c-a21c-999dbc29ddc1]

## Differences between markets
The case includes 22 customers in Europe and 6 in the USA. Europe includes 18 complaints, 4 defects and 7 likes; the USA includes 6 complaints and no defects or likes. [signal:0230ace1-3cf5-436b-a03e-8b5b78d8cdfc] [signal:1f21712b-0e61-4e35-9ed4-64bbecf7550a] [signal:3da12c66-7cfb-4f01-8eb7-54af0ba5602e]

## Open questions
The signals describe several forms of roughness, hesitation and delayed engagement, but do not establish whether these experiences share a cause. [signal:36514795-49a4-4955-99ec-6cc65c826cbc] [signal:3da12c66-7cfb-4f01-8eb7-54af0ba5602e]

value.title: Wind noise around windows and mirrors
value.summary: Customers report intrusive wind noise around windows, doors and mirrors. The case spans Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Complaints describe wind noise around windows, doors and mirrors.
27 customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report wind noise around the front windows, doors and mirrors, including noise described as excessive. One report says it becomes very loud above 100 km/h. [signal:1802e78d-942f-4132-bac0-354bc3cccec0] [signal:2735d6f4-d545-4d2a-9f51-01bf8b068bf5] [signal:18114c26-89c7-422e-9beb-60a87e8525a8] [signal:6ce68570-6136-4ea8-a35d-6b002f4e2123]

## What customers say
A customer reports wind noise coming through both side windows on every drive. [signal:13868108-ea6c-46b0-93d7-2c21e42d4805] Other reports locate it around the front doors and windows, or the door and wing-mirror area. [signal:2735d6f4-d545-4d2a-9f51-01bf8b068bf5] [signal:c616610d-388c-4110-98b2-8e686a1fac55] One customer says their dealer attributed the noise to the car’s shape and that it seemed to come from the mirrors. [signal:18114c26-89c7-422e-9beb-60a87e8525a8] Another report links wind noise to a bubble found in the driver-front window glass. [signal:6a10054c-aade-46cd-8e68-71279fd0e884]

## Differences between markets
The counts cover Europe, the USA and Rest of World, and the F70, G60 and G70. The signals describe wind noise in Europe and the USA, while a Rest of World report says it becomes very loud above 100 km/h. [signal:1802e78d-942f-4132-bac0-354bc3cccec0] [signal:18114c26-89c7-422e-9beb-60a87e8525a8] [signal:6ce68570-6136-4ea8-a35d-6b002f4e2123]

## Open questions
The reports identify several possible locations, including windows, doors and mirrors; it is unclear from these signals how consistently the noise occurs at each location. [signal:13868108-ea6c-46b0-93d7-2c21e42d4805] [signal:2735d6f4-d545-4d2a-9f51-01bf8b068bf5] [signal:18114c26-89c7-422e-9beb-60a87e8525a8] Whether the reported noise is related to the window-glass bubble is also unresolved. [signal:6a10054c-aade-46cd-8e68-71279fd0e884]

value.title: Tire defects, pressure loss and replacement availability
value.summary: Customers report tire defects and pressure loss, and difficulty obtaining replacement tires. Complaints span Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Tire defects, pressure loss and replacement availability are reported problems.
Affected across Europe, the USA and Rest of World, and F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe tire-related problems including a tire with a small sidewall hole and a possible slow leak [signal:471aa26e-a94a-4c26-adad-e24562b6e33d] [signal:396f7f85-eb6e-4b1e-895d-8a6d5f60ebe2]. One customer says a replacement tire was difficult to obtain after a puncture [signal:3a0689ce-18ce-4f07-b772-7a4a251315b2]. Across the case, there are 31 customers and 31 complaints, including 30 defects.

## What customers say
A USA customer reports a small hole in a tire sidewall that caused a flat, with no remembered impact and no dealer investigation into a possible manufacturing defect [signal:471aa26e-a94a-4c26-adad-e24562b6e33d]. Another USA customer noticed one tire at around 24 psi and inflated it, while monitoring for a possible slow leak [signal:396f7f85-eb6e-4b1e-895d-8a6d5f60ebe2]. A Europe customer says BMW could not readily provide a replacement tire after a puncture [signal:3a0689ce-18ce-4f07-b772-7a4a251315b2].

## Differences between markets
The case includes Europe, the USA and Rest of World. A Europe customer reports replacement-tire availability concerns [signal:3a0689ce-18ce-4f07-b772-7a4a251315b2]; the USA reports include a sidewall puncture and possible slow leak [signal:471aa26e-a94a-4c26-adad-e24562b6e33d] [signal:396f7f85-eb6e-4b1e-895d-8a6d5f60ebe2]. The case covers F70, G60 and G70.

## Open questions
The available reports do not establish whether the sidewall damage or pressure loss resulted from a tire defect [signal:471aa26e-a94a-4c26-adad-e24562b6e33d] [signal:396f7f85-eb6e-4b1e-895d-8a6d5f60ebe2]. They also do not indicate how broadly replacement tires are unavailable [signal:3a0689ce-18ce-4f07-b772-7a4a251315b2].

value.title: Electric range concerns and limited confidence on longer journeys
value.summary: Electric range is a concern for some customers, including uncertainty about the range estimate and whether longer trips are manageable; others value the range for removing range anxiety.
highlights: Customers report range concerns, uncertainty about estimates and wishes for more electric range.
68 customers across the USA, Europe and Rest of World; vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across the case, 24 customers complained about electric range and 12 wished for more range; 32 customers liked it. The concerns include confidence in the displayed estimate and having enough range for longer trips. Some customers also describe range as reassuring. [signal:0cc0f80a-7e84-4fdd-be57-f24bd582d92b] [signal:0f496148-597e-4ef6-961f-49a32c26c315] [signal:1668fae5-7637-4e31-a2b8-02282784cbe1] [signal:21aaec01-0621-4f32-b6f3-27ac46bda27a] [signal:77e85a49-5260-43ad-9543-c95a447f912b]

## What customers say
One customer was unsure whether the car was delivering good range and did not know its actual range. [signal:0cc0f80a-7e84-4fdd-be57-f24bd582d92b] Another worried about finding a charger on a longer trip. [signal:0f496148-597e-4ef6-961f-49a32c26c315] A customer described avoiding a family visit because it was slightly longer than the roughly 300-mile range they cited, and wished for closer to 400 miles. [signal:1668fae5-7637-4e31-a2b8-02282784cbe1] One customer questioned the range estimate after a cold-weather round trip and described losing confidence in reaching home. [signal:21aaec01-0621-4f32-b6f3-27ac46bda27a] Customers also wished for more battery range or a small all-electric car capable of at least 500 km on one charge. [signal:e5ee5da2-6513-4487-aae6-b9308e31bfbe] [signal:936021c3-f15f-4e9b-a2b3-5810fd1a2d27] In contrast, one customer said the car had completely removed their range anxiety. [signal:77e85a49-5260-43ad-9543-c95a447f912b]

## Differences between markets
The case spans the USA, Europe and Rest of World. In the cited USA accounts, customers raise concerns about range, estimates and longer journeys. [signal:0cc0f80a-7e84-4fdd-be57-f24bd582d92b] [signal:0f496148-597e-4ef6-961f-49a32c26c315] [signal:1668fae5-7637-4e31-a2b8-02282784cbe1] [signal:21aaec01-0621-4f32-b6f3-27ac46bda27a] European accounts include both a wish for greater all-electric range and a positive view that range anxiety was removed. [signal:936021c3-f15f-4e9b-a2b3-5810fd1a2d27] [signal:77e85a49-5260-43ad-9543-c95a447f912b] A Rest of World customer wished for more battery range. [signal:e5ee5da2-6513-4487-aae6-b9308e31bfbe]

## Open questions
The provided counts and signals do not establish how often range estimates differ from customers’ real-world journeys or what drives those differences. They also do not establish how customers’ range expectations vary by journey or conditions.

value.title: Ride can feel too harsh for passengers
value.summary: Customers report ride harshness and discomfort, particularly for passengers, alongside some positive assessments of ride quality. The case covers 22 complaints across Europe, Rest of World and the USA, in F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Some customers find the suspension too hard and the ride uncomfortable.
22 customers across Europe, Rest of World and the USA; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Some customers describe the ride as too firm or uncomfortable, especially for passengers or on rough roads. Other comments praise ride comfort, so experiences differ. [signal:2d4defea-96db-4104-a93f-a66264308425]  [signal:609f09e8-2bef-479c-b09d-50102c53750d] [signal:4526fb3e-bd11-4fe8-9152-89977e2e7152] [signal:36a0b7ff-c6f7-43f3-865d-66196f4cbb40]

## What customers say
One F70 owner says the hard suspension makes mountain-pass driving tough for passengers. [signal:2d4defea-96db-4104-a93f-a66264308425] Another F70 owner reports stiff legs and an uncomfortable ride, while a different F70 owner says rough-road impacts cause back pain.  [signal:609f09e8-2bef-479c-b09d-50102c53750d]

Ride assessments are not uniformly negative: one F70 owner describes the car as a big comfort improvement over a previous car, and a G70 owner praises ride comfort. [signal:4526fb3e-bd11-4fe8-9152-89977e2e7152] [signal:36a0b7ff-c6f7-43f3-865d-66196f4cbb40]

## Differences between markets
The case includes 6 customers in Europe, 11 in Rest of World and 5 in the USA. The counts do not establish how ride comfort differs by market. The ride-related comments cited above include both positive and negative assessments. [signal:2d4defea-96db-4104-a93f-a66264308425]  [signal:609f09e8-2bef-479c-b09d-50102c53750d] [signal:4526fb3e-bd11-4fe8-9152-89977e2e7152] [signal:36a0b7ff-c6f7-43f3-865d-66196f4cbb40]

## Open questions
The counts cover 16 F70, 1 G60 and 5 G70 customers, but do not break down ride complaints by vehicle line. What conditions, configurations or occupants are associated with the differing ride assessments is not established by the cited comments.

value.title: Panorama roof openness and cabin heat draw mixed feedback

35 customers across the USA and Rest of World, on G60 and G70.

value.body_md:
## Problem
Across the case, 24 customers express wishes about the panorama glass roof, while 11 like it. The feedback includes requests for a sunroof or greater opening, alongside a concern about cabin heat. [signal:38f88bc1-f646-4649-8669-91d8de87db84] [signal:18831385-0063-4bb2-b486-f0014b4c8a0f] [signal:394c37c5-cb3b-43d3-ac8a-a259d59e2275] [signal:026a818a-e62c-4484-a8db-ff3816c11773]

## What customers say
Some customers want a sunroof, or one that opens; another says the roof does not open as far as expected. [signal:38f88bc1-f646-4649-8669-91d8de87db84] [signal:18831385-0063-4bb2-b486-f0014b4c8a0f] [signal:394c37c5-cb3b-43d3-ac8a-a259d59e2275] A G60 owner says the sunroof lets a lot of heat into the cabin. [signal:026a818a-e62c-4484-a8db-ff3816c11773] In contrast, a customer lists the standard sunroof among the car’s positive features. [signal:24959a7e-40bd-4fc4-9785-0760f5f7402a]

## Differences between markets
The case covers 34 customers in the USA and one in Rest of World; the sample includes a positive mention from Rest of World and concerns about the sunroof from USA customers. The supplied roof-related comments include both vehicle lines. [signal:026a818a-e62c-4484-a8db-ff3816c11773] [signal:18831385-0063-4bb2-b486-f0014b4c8a0f]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common the heat concern or desired opening range is within the case, or whether feedback differs by market or vehicle line.

value.title: Driver assistance functions fail or trigger recurring alerts
value.summary: Customers report driver-assistance functions becoming unavailable and repeated or unexpected system alerts. The issue appears across Europe, the USA and Rest of World, and across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Driver-assistance functions fail or generate recurring alerts.
31 customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case contains 32 complaints from 31 BMW customers, all classified as defects. Customers describe driver-assistance functions becoming unavailable or producing repeated alerts. [signal:3b711b9a-5f1c-4422-91e6-c4e49c9cc832] [signal:1754e6fd-8bdf-4922-9259-941b2e080976]

## What customers say
- A customer reported that collision functions in Driving Assistant Professional stopped working after a software update. [signal:3b711b9a-5f1c-4422-91e6-c4e49c9cc832]
- A customer described recurring driving-assistance messages appearing in groups, despite not using Drive Assist. [signal:1754e6fd-8bdf-4922-9259-941b2e080976]
- Another customer received alerts for reduced driver assistance and several warning functions, including lane departure warning; the alerts did not recur. [signal:32661fb7-be1a-45d1-8961-9dc878ac3747]
- A customer said they avoided the parking assistant after a contact accident. [signal:0d0eb744-fe5a-4f32-88d9-bc2ad3bf58d6]

## Differences between markets
The counts cover Europe, the USA and Rest of World, and F70, G60 and G70 vehicles. The sampled accounts show unavailable collision functions and recurring alerts in Europe and the USA, while the Rest of World account describes avoiding the parking assistant after an accident. [signal:3b711b9a-5f1c-4422-91e6-c4e49c9cc832] [signal:1754e6fd-8bdf-4922-9259-941b2e080976] [signal:0d0eb744-fe5a-4f32-88d9-bc2ad3bf58d6]

## Open questions
- What causes the reported functions to stop working or alerts to recur? [signal:3b711b9a-5f1c-4422-91e6-c4e49c9cc832] [signal:1754e6fd-8bdf-4922-9259-941b2e080976]
- How often do the reported problems recur, and under what conditions? [signal:32661fb7-be1a-45d1-8961-9dc878ac3747]

value.title: Driver profiles are difficult to recognize and manage
value.summary: Driver profile usability is a problem for BMW customers, with complaints about profile recognition, login and setup. The case spans the USA, Europe and Rest of World, and the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Driver profile recognition, login and setup are difficult for many customers.
41 BMW customers across the USA, Europe and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem

The case includes 41 BMW customers: 36 complaints, 3 wishes and 2 likes. Customers describe difficulty with driver profile recognition, login and setup. Some report profiles switching to Guest or another driver's profile, while others describe settings or seat adjustments not behaving as expected. [signal:005dc0e2-6e43-4215-b439-b61c47aeb743] [signal:10fe4d17-473d-4a4f-8821-fd9480bbb121] [signal:16cd7984-9482-4a57-8485-9e2f05e4d13a] [signal:1f65a438-de8d-44a6-8b98-99870fdd1872]

## What customers say

One customer says entering with a Digital Key loads Guest instead of their personal profile. [signal:005dc0e2-6e43-4215-b439-b61c47aeb743] Another reports that a spouse's profile does not load properly. [signal:10fe4d17-473d-4a4f-8821-fd9480bbb121] A customer says selecting her profile does not adjust the seat and that changing the setting prompts her to log in with her phone. [signal:16cd7984-9482-4a57-8485-9e2f05e4d13a]

Customers also describe profile switching when multiple drivers' phones or registered users are present. [signal:1f65a438-de8d-44a6-8b98-99870fdd1872] [signal:8038efba-a947-4198-9147-929983982bc8] One customer says they must scan a QR code again every two or three trips. [signal:dd9ad3b9-8622-459c-8b6f-e9697952a0c7] Other concerns include difficulty distinguishing driver-specific settings from vehicle-wide settings, and taking a while to set up each driver. [signal:17f7d17e-9513-420b-8153-bc4b6e8c63fa] [signal:79d56777-9bd9-4764-8d57-d9498c4cd9db]

## Differences between markets

The counts cover the USA, Europe and Rest of World, and the F70, G60 and G70. The sample statements describe problems in all three markets: a customer in Rest of World says another registered user can be mistaken for the driver, while a European customer describes repeated profile logins. [signal:8038efba-a947-4198-9147-929983982bc8] [signal:dd9ad3b9-8622-459c-8b6f-e9697952a0c7]

## Open questions

How often do profile recognition and login problems occur across different keys, phones and combinations of drivers? [signal:005dc0e2-6e43-4215-b439-b61c47aeb743] [signal:1f65a438-de8d-44a6-8b98-99870fdd1872] Which settings customers find difficult to distinguish as driver-specific or vehicle-wide remains unclear. [signal:17f7d17e-9513-420b-8153-bc4b6e8c63fa]

value.title: Non-contact trunk opening works inconsistently

47 USA customers: 39 with G60 and 8 with G70.

value.body_md:
## Problem

## What customers say
A G70 customer says the trunk opens only occasionally when moving a foot under the rear of the car. [signal:1a7861b3-193c-4551-8ca0-90506f34e223] A G60 customer says they cannot open the tailgate by waving a foot behind the car. [signal:177bc5fa-fec0-477b-afd6-aaa8d8c8e3b4] Another G60 customer reports that the feature behaves inconsistently despite having used it on a prior vehicle. [signal:1fb475b0-eb0a-44ad-9104-7becb6c5face]

## Differences between markets
The case counts cover the USA only: 47 customers, comprising 39 with G60 and 8 with G70. The signals describe inconsistent activation on both vehicle lines. [signal:05602924-4d9d-4567-be3f-3f4afdf2f3d6] [signal:059c39be-29ad-458a-98b0-e18af504e1e3]

## Open questions
What foot movement and position do customers expect to work, and how consistently does the feature respond across G60 and G70?

value.title: Vehicle key detection and operation are unreliable
value.summary: All 34 customers report a vehicle-key defect, including inconsistent key detection or operation. The case spans Europe, the USA and the Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Vehicle keys are reported as unreliable, with all 34 customers reporting defects.
