value.body_md:
## Problem
All 34 customers in the case report a vehicle-key defect. Customers describe unreliable detection or operation, including a digital key that is detected intermittently and a fob that is only picked up sometimes. [signal:0b60a9b0-6160-4210-9245-2612f73c3fac] [signal:10267ad9-5a57-4def-9597-598b17cc0f39]

One customer says the smart key often barely reacts and requires taking it out of a bag to press its button. [signal:6764e394-bf42-4b3e-a552-ebf696ceba55] Other customers describe digital-key inconsistency, dealer updates, or a perceived decline in key-fob quality. [signal:22d784b1-0bbd-465e-9f25-390f652e599f] [signal:2b52d3e4-51d5-4b25-ae0e-15f344ef82a8] Some also object to receiving only one physical key. [signal:335a922f-073d-49ec-be75-1b08c26a37de]

## What customers say
Intermittent key detection can make it difficult to access the car and can prevent stored key settings from loading. [signal:0b60a9b0-6160-4210-9245-2612f73c3fac] [signal:10267ad9-5a57-4def-9597-598b17cc0f39] A customer reports that digital-key issues led to dealer updates. [signal:22d784b1-0bbd-465e-9f25-390f652e599f] Another says the smart key sometimes requires manual button presses to lock or unlock the car. [signal:6764e394-bf42-4b3e-a552-ebf696ceba55]

## Differences between markets
The counts cover Europe (16 customers), the USA (14) and the Rest of World (4); all 34 customers are counted as reporting complaints and defects. The case also covers F70 (20 customers), G60 (7) and G70 (7). The quoted reports include digital-key or fob reliability issues in Europe, the USA and the Rest of World. [signal:22d784b1-0bbd-465e-9f25-390f652e599f] [signal:10267ad9-5a57-4def-9597-598b17cc0f39] [signal:6764e394-bf42-4b3e-a552-ebf696ceba55]

## Open questions
Do the reported detection and operation problems differ between digital keys and physical fobs? Customers describe intermittent digital-key detection, inconsistent fob recognition and a smart key that sometimes needs button presses. [signal:0b60a9b0-6160-4210-9245-2612f73c3fac] [signal:10267ad9-5a57-4def-9597-598b17cc0f39] [signal:6764e394-bf42-4b3e-a552-ebf696ceba55] How often are dealer updates associated with these reports? One customer links digital-key problems with dealer updates. [signal:22d784b1-0bbd-465e-9f25-390f652e599f]

value.title: Doors are awkward to open, close and latch
value.summary: Customers report awkward door handles and releases, doors that need a hard slam to latch, and difficulty getting in or out. The case spans customers in Europe, the USA and Rest of World across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Door opening, closing and latching are difficult for some customers.
Customers are in Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across the F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case includes 45 signals from 44 customers: 35 complaints, 6 wishes and 4 likes. Customers describe difficulty operating door handles and releases, closing doors, and getting in or out. [signal:26bfd648-0422-490a-bde8-8a2141d46f09] [signal:1f05a962-e6e5-4a74-989e-47328615fb48] [signal:ab46b8bb-d7aa-4082-a631-b52dba76fc14]

## What customers say
- Some customers say the interior door handle or release is hard to use or challenging in design. [signal:26bfd648-0422-490a-bde8-8a2141d46f09] [signal:28ba304a-e466-4090-a667-da3bb6b326ad]
- A customer says touch unlocking on the exterior handles often does not work on the first attempt. [signal:28df7cd5-1184-42a5-92fd-bf38d266cfa2]
- Customers report that doors can need a hard slam to latch. [signal:1f05a962-e6e5-4a74-989e-47328615fb48] [signal:335a3342-9bdf-4d10-90b4-b4136014f0a0]
- A customer says the door must swing wide for comfortable entry and exit, particularly in car parks. [signal:ab46b8bb-d7aa-4082-a631-b52dba76fc14]
- A customer prefers a conventional pull handle to the small interior door-open button; another says the button can be pressed unintentionally when a leg swings over. [signal:2ef0915a-2c48-46cd-9378-e3ec03ef9d4d] [signal:31ac10da-1ee0-4b93-805c-9af0a0677ff6]

## Differences between markets
The counts show 6 complaints from 5 customers in Europe, 28 complaints from 38 customers in the USA, and 1 complaint from 1 customer in Rest of World. The case includes 6 complaints from 5 F70 customers, 14 complaints from 17 G60 customers, and 15 complaints from 22 G70 customers. The cited comments include door-latching and entry/exit concerns in Europe, and handle, release and door-button concerns in the USA. [signal:1f05a962-e6e5-4a74-989e-47328615fb48] [signal:335a3342-9bdf-4d10-90b4-b4136014f0a0] [signal:ab46b8bb-d7aa-4082-a631-b52dba76fc14] [signal:26bfd648-0422-490a-bde8-8a2141d46f09] [signal:28ba304a-e466-4090-a667-da3bb6b326ad] [signal:28df7cd5-1184-42a5-92fd-bf38d266cfa2] [signal:2ef0915a-2c48-46cd-9378-e3ec03ef9d4d] [signal:31ac10da-1ee0-4b93-805c-9af0a0677ff6]

## Open questions
Which door operation is the main source of difficulty: opening from inside, unlocking from outside, closing and latching, or making room to enter and exit? Do these experiences vary by door or vehicle line? The case counts include 6 wishes and 4 likes, but the available comments do not clarify what those customers wished for or liked.

value.title: Touchscreen fingerprints and dust reduce display usability
value.summary: Customers report that the touch display shows fingerprints that attract dust, making the surface difficult to keep clean. The case covers BMW customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World, and the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Fingerprints and dust make the touchscreen difficult to keep clean.
49 customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that fingerprints appear on the touch display and attract dust, leaving the surface dirty [signal:23ceb9f0-7977-484d-a3a8-ca26079e3433] [signal:5822321c-fbac-4873-b284-a8bb3631143e]. One customer asks how to remove fingerprints and is advised to use a microfiber cloth [signal:4ba6f9bb-3837-4e66-a5e6-d543b9fe7c33]. The case contains 49 complaints, including 31 classified as defects.

## What customers say
A USA customer says touching the screens leaves visible smudges that attract dust [signal:23ceb9f0-7977-484d-a3a8-ca26079e3433]. Another describes fingerprints and dust accumulating on the display surface [signal:5822321c-fbac-4873-b284-a8bb3631143e]. A customer asks for the best way to remove fingerprints; the response recommends a microfiber cloth [signal:4ba6f9bb-3837-4e66-a5e6-d543b9fe7c33].

## Differences between markets
The case includes 32 customers in Europe, 12 in the USA and 5 in Rest of World. The cited comments about fingerprints and dust are from USA customers [signal:23ceb9f0-7977-484d-a3a8-ca26079e3433] [signal:5822321c-fbac-4873-b284-a8bb3631143e].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish whether the reported surface issue differs by market or vehicle line, or how often customers need to clean the display.

value.title: Drivetrain faults disrupt vehicle operation
value.summary: Customers report drivetrain and engine faults, including warnings, rough operation and loss of acceleration; one report describes a fault that made the vehicle undriveable. The case includes customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World, and the F70, G60 and G70 lines.
highlights: Drivetrain and engine faults include warnings, rough operation and loss of acceleration.
Customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70 lines.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe drivetrain and engine faults ranging from warning messages and rough idling to impaired acceleration and a vehicle that could not be driven. One customer reported a drivetrain fault that required a tow [signal:4c656e11-937b-42f6-a7d3-229e3c96b656]. Another reported a drivetrain malfunction warning while the vehicle was at a dealer with no repair ETA [signal:05c10d50-3ded-40f9-9b38-1de0d6d367a3].

## What customers say
A customer reported a check-engine warning that required service [signal:22f3ce9c-79d1-439e-8273-b7c4ead879d5]. Another described rough engine idling during warm-up [signal:4d41fb15-20d4-4076-8713-4579fa4712b1]. A customer said a software issue caused loss of control over acceleration, although the dealer could not find a fault [signal:3bb4da68-f837-4801-a061-1e13e2f36498]. A separate customer felt the hybrid system linked poorly with the engine [signal:3b1a1deb-8e92-4c23-aa7e-73971d38528e].

## Differences between markets
The counts show complaints in Europe, the USA and Rest of World. The reported experiences differ: a European customer described loss of control over acceleration [signal:3bb4da68-f837-4801-a061-1e13e2f36498], while a USA customer reported a drivetrain fault that made the vehicle undriveable [signal:4c656e11-937b-42f6-a7d3-229e3c96b656]. A Rest of World customer criticized how the hybrid system linked with the engine [signal:3b1a1deb-8e92-4c23-aa7e-73971d38528e].

## Open questions
What underlying causes account for the reported drivetrain and engine faults? How often do warning messages correspond to a confirmed fault, and what explains the reported acceleration and hybrid-system concerns?

value.title: Owner's manual missing or difficult to understand
value.summary: Customers report that the owner's manual is missing or poorly written, making it harder to understand and use vehicle functions. The case spans BMW customers in Europe, Rest of World and the USA, across F70 and G70.
highlights: Customers report missing or unclear manual information.
Affects Europe, Rest of World and USA; F70 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across the case, 22 of 23 customers report complaints and one reports a wish; there are no reported defects or likes. Customers describe missing paper handbooks and difficulty understanding the instructions or manual, which can leave vehicle functions unclear or unused. [signal:0ffb4048-35ca-46d3-9725-3e6873a59eef] [signal:13abf7af-19b7-4e6e-8628-b6a973df381b] [signal:19f0f10e-d1b1-46d0-ac9b-d823f3f9df8f] [signal:2b8097b8-b5d0-44b6-b40d-56a94208866e]

## What customers say
Some customers miss a paper handbook as a convenient reference, and one says they are less comfortable using computers to look up details online. [signal:0ffb4048-35ca-46d3-9725-3e6873a59eef] Others say that without a proper manual, functions have to be found by trial and error. [signal:433e87d9-c4eb-492b-b300-3727be9aaed6] A customer in the USA says the manual is not well written and that digital icons add to the time needed to understand the functions. [signal:19f0f10e-d1b1-46d0-ac9b-d823f3f9df8f] A customer in Rest of World says the instructions are hard to make sense of and that many features remain unused. [signal:13abf7af-19b7-4e6e-8628-b6a973df381b]

## Differences between markets
The case includes 20 customers in Europe, two in Rest of World and one in the USA. Complaints are recorded in all three markets: 19 in Europe, two in Rest of World and one in the USA. The vehicle lines are F70, with 22 customers and 21 complaints, and G70, with one customer and one complaint. A European customer misses a paper reference, while the USA customer describes the manual as poorly written. [signal:0ffb4048-35ca-46d3-9725-3e6873a59eef] [signal:19f0f10e-d1b1-46d0-ac9b-d823f3f9df8f]

## Open questions
Which aspects of the manual are most difficult to understand, and how do customers’ needs differ between a paper reference and digital instructions? The available comments include both a preference for a paper handbook and difficulty understanding the written manual. [signal:0ffb4048-35ca-46d3-9725-3e6873a59eef] [signal:19f0f10e-d1b1-46d0-ac9b-d823f3f9df8f]

value.title: Touchscreen reliability issues disrupt vehicle functions
value.summary: BMW customers report screen glitches, slowdowns, freezes and blackouts that can make screen-controlled functions unavailable or require resets. The case covers Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Screen faults include glitches, sluggishness, freezes and blackouts.
Affected customers are in Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across the case, customers report touchscreen and screen-system reliability defects, including glitches, sluggish response, freezing and blackouts. Some faults interrupt functions controlled through the screen or lead customers to reset the system. [signal:2ea7db32-e687-4aa7-8829-b491235d01aa] [signal:3743f5d9-894d-4616-9535-138bdc0c380b] [signal:49dd3169-f17f-44c7-9e28-55f1f679fa7f]

## What customers say
One customer says the centre console can become sluggish or freeze, requiring a reset. [signal:2ea7db32-e687-4aa7-8829-b491235d01aa]
A customer reports that the main screen went completely black, making its controlled functions unusable; another describes a brief blackout while driving. [signal:3743f5d9-894d-4616-9535-138bdc0c380b] [signal:66858984-218d-44d6-800a-b96d09f41909]
A customer says screen glitches continued after an update. [signal:49dd3169-f17f-44c7-9e28-55f1f679fa7f]

## Differences between markets
The counts show complaints in Europe, the USA and Rest of World. The described faults include sluggishness and freezing in Europe, glitches and blackouts in the USA, and reported reaction lag in Rest of World. [signal:2ea7db32-e687-4aa7-8829-b491235d01aa] [signal:49dd3169-f17f-44c7-9e28-55f1f679fa7f] [signal:66858984-218d-44d6-800a-b96d09f41909] [signal:2a8a6f87-d589-49dc-97c5-3c767dfe235e]

## Open questions
The causes and recurrence of the reported faults are unclear. One customer wondered whether extreme heat caused a blackout, while another says an update did not resolve recurring glitches. [signal:66858984-218d-44d6-800a-b96d09f41909] [signal:49dd3169-f17f-44c7-9e28-55f1f679fa7f]

value.title: Charging socket cover intermittently fails to open
value.summary: Customers report that the charging socket cover sometimes fails to open or stops opening, disrupting access to the charging port. The case affects customers in the USA with G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: The charging socket cover intermittently fails to open or stops opening.
16 USA customers: 12 with G60 and 4 with G70 vehicles.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case contains 16 customer complaints classified as defects. Customers describe the charging socket cover as intermittently failing to open, or stopping opening altogether. [signal:014bd10b-8c26-4ac1-8332-c49a646f02db] [signal:2cceee8b-d08a-4da7-87f6-e8ede035b962]

## What customers say
One customer says the cover sometimes will not open even when the car is unlocked, and that restarting the car has been needed to get it to open. [signal:41625459-342d-408c-9cac-c767e7b926a1] Another says the problem had not occurred again for about a month. [signal:45489f62-68b9-437d-9ae5-e849e4a3885c] A G70 customer reports that the cover stopped opening after two days of ownership; the service center broke it while trying to open it, and the vehicle then remained there awaiting a backordered part. [signal:45a8102a-345b-47a3-829b-aba1a3124ec8]

## Differences between markets
The counts place all 16 customers in the USA. They include 12 G60 and 4 G70 customers. The available customer reports describe opening failures in both vehicle lines. [signal:014bd10b-8c26-4ac1-8332-c49a646f02db] [signal:2cceee8b-d08a-4da7-87f6-e8ede035b962]

## Open questions
The reports do not establish how often the cover fails, or whether the issue has the same cause across vehicles.

value.title: Battery charging guidance and scheduling are difficult to use
value.summary: Customers report difficulty understanding recommended charge levels and, in some cases, inconsistent scheduled charging. The case covers BMW customers in the USA and Rest of World across G60 and G70 vehicle lines.
highlights: Confusion about charging guidance and complaints about scheduled charging.
31 customers: 30 in the USA and 1 in Rest of World; 21 G60 and 10 G70 customers.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The whole case includes 31 customers: 24 complaints, 4 wishes and 3 likes. Customers raise usability concerns about charging the high-voltage battery, including questions about recommended charge levels and reports of scheduled charging not following the selected time slot. [signal:003d7ff7-8a1c-4eb9-8b7d-507b4e4a7b07] [signal:044d2f93-c1d9-44a5-ad97-5e2124e712aa] [signal:1ae84612-e1cc-4bbc-9b0f-59379146926d]

## What customers say
Customers ask whether the battery can be charged above 80% and describe uncertainty about recommended everyday charging levels. [signal:003d7ff7-8a1c-4eb9-8b7d-507b4e4a7b07] [signal:1bff48d8-bdbd-41f1-986c-95be8a730b60]

One customer reports that scheduled charging sometimes starts immediately or at a different time from the programmed slot, and that the configuration can change. [signal:044d2f93-c1d9-44a5-ad97-5e2124e712aa]

A customer new to electric driving describes the first week of working out how and when to charge as tense. [signal:136f836a-66ca-4d4c-ab19-35fc03273670]

## Differences between markets
The case includes 30 USA customers, with 23 complaints, 4 wishes and 3 likes, and 1 Rest of World customer, with 1 complaint. It covers 21 G60 customers (16 complaints, 3 wishes and 2 likes) and 10 G70 customers (8 complaints, 1 wish and 1 like). The counts show a much larger number of customers in the USA than in Rest of World; they do not establish different charging experiences by market.

## Open questions
The signals raise questions about recommended everyday charge levels and scheduled charging behavior, but do not establish how widespread either issue is beyond the case counts. [signal:003d7ff7-8a1c-4eb9-8b7d-507b4e4a7b07] [signal:044d2f93-c1d9-44a5-ad97-5e2124e712aa]

value.title: Touchscreen controls are hard to find and distracting to use
value.summary: Customers report that touchscreen controls and menus can be difficult to locate or operate, and may draw attention away from driving. The case spans Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Touchscreen controls are hard to find, awkward to use and can distract drivers.
52 customers: Europe (45), USA (6), Rest of World (1); F70 (45), G60 (5), G70 (2).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem

All 52 customers in the case report complaints about touchscreen operation. Controls can be hard to find, awkward to use, or buried in menus; customers also describe needing to look away from the road or switch between screens. [signal:003646d4-ca0f-4c6a-acde-facdf010abf6] [signal:1601906e-eb68-43c3-9f22-c358b7528a34] [signal:3ffa5a57-187d-43d4-82d2-da5b88256b81]

## What customers say

Customers describe difficulty locating screen options and say some touchscreen interactions, including map magnification, can be distracting while driving. [signal:003646d4-ca0f-4c6a-acde-facdf010abf6] [signal:00716995-5492-4c07-8f2e-1dea9e1e0eab]

Some customers say frequently used controls are hidden on the screen or that relying on menus makes operation awkward and takes attention from the road. [signal:0e993038-72b7-4cdd-9c1a-c9b31bd8fa74] [signal:4639b803-8b2f-419e-9fcf-595d78bac3ea]

Customers also report having to learn screen options, switch between screens to find needed information, and wait for the screen to boot. [signal:28484188-f1ca-4f5e-8a93-b762eb9a30d3] [signal:3ffa5a57-187d-43d4-82d2-da5b88256b81] [signal:cfa47722-a508-4f11-87dd-5ce47225d968]

## Differences between markets

The counts include 45 customers in Europe, 6 in the USA and 1 in Rest of World; all are complaints. [signal:003646d4-ca0f-4c6a-acde-facdf010abf6] [signal:28484188-f1ca-4f5e-8a93-b762eb9a30d3] [signal:cfa47722-a508-4f11-87dd-5ce47225d968]

The case covers 45 F70 customers, 5 G60 customers and 2 G70 customers; all are complaints. [signal:003646d4-ca0f-4c6a-acde-facdf010abf6] [signal:28484188-f1ca-4f5e-8a93-b762eb9a30d3] [signal:3cdba788-6d81-40d2-82c2-d1b5e7b855fa]

## Open questions

The signals do not establish which controls or screen interactions are most difficult across the full case. [signal:1601906e-eb68-43c3-9f22-c358b7528a34] [signal:3ffa5a57-187d-43d4-82d2-da5b88256b81]

value.title: Instrument cluster information is hard to read and find
value.summary: Customers describe instrument information as difficult to read, locate or understand, including basic mileage and range data. The issue appears across BMW vehicle lines in the USA and Europe.
highlights: Instrument information can be hard to read, locate or understand.
34 BMW customers across the USA and Europe; vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe difficulty reading or locating instrument information, and some find the controls or displays hard to use. One European customer says the instruments are harder to read and less ergonomic than those in an older car [signal:f979c749-2fa0-4fd9-9d86-927e7ba881ad]. In the USA, customers describe difficulty finding the odometer and viewing or resetting trip data [signal:0579fb53-b03b-493f-aa65-b1b4004ec457] [signal:0caa170f-cbd4-42ab-876a-05d8038a020d].

## What customers say
A G60 customer was unclear about the combined mileage figure and range indicator shown in efficient mode [signal:03fe5939-ed52-4a40-9414-6b5fc47a47b7]. Another found trip-data access over-engineered and said explanations involved multiple screens [signal:0caa170f-cbd4-42ab-876a-05d8038a020d]. A G70 customer described the gauges as “simply awful” [signal:2652f745-03e3-4383-840c-b1e164115cb7].

## Differences between markets
European comments include concerns about instrument readability and ergonomics [signal:f979c749-2fa0-4fd9-9d86-927e7ba881ad], as well as distraction from messages and sounds [signal:bf516f0e-a337-43e6-9e6d-06f4e545eef6]. USA comments include difficulty locating mileage information and understanding range displays [signal:0579fb53-b03b-493f-aa65-b1b4004ec457] [signal:03fe5939-ed52-4a40-9414-6b5fc47a47b7].

## Open questions
Which specific displays or controls are hardest to read or locate across the F70, G60 and G70? The comments raise concerns about readability and access, but do not establish whether the same issues affect each vehicle line [signal:f979c749-2fa0-4fd9-9d86-927e7ba881ad] [signal:0579fb53-b03b-493f-aa65-b1b4004ec457] [signal:2652f745-03e3-4383-840c-b1e164115cb7].

value.title: Owner's manual format and access do not meet customer needs
value.summary: Customers want a printed handbook or more accessible ways to find and learn vehicle functions; some report that a promised paper manual was not delivered. These needs appear among BMW customers in Europe and the USA across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Customers wish for a paper handbook, clearer reference material or easier ways to learn functions.
42 BMW customers across Europe and the USA; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers wish for a printed handbook or say they miss having a physical manual in the car. One customer also reports repeated promises to send a paper manual that never arrived. [signal:2c480b84-a2b2-40bf-9f0b-254b864faa12] [signal:ffebd26d-387d-43b1-a819-4bdd38013c37] [signal:2aec79df-a754-4bad-ad16-a68eb5c300ce]

Some customers find vehicle functions difficult to understand or say that looking up information on the screen is impractical while driving. [signal:07a64869-4ef2-40ed-8413-d57cb5aa4e24] [signal:2d747e1c-85cd-4b80-8d4a-849bf21ef703] [signal:97189606-42b0-4d47-832e-324c6bf2b791]

## What customers say
Customers express a preference for a printed manual over an online version, and one asks for a smaller manual focused on key functions. [signal:5860235b-2416-4c4d-803e-a1399a6cf461] [signal:78af839b-0d91-4277-9000-682827bf6a7f]

Other requests include a video walkthrough of every feature and a paper list of voice commands. [signal:08409202-7858-4d39-814b-5295aae440cd] [signal:2d747e1c-85cd-4b80-8d4a-849bf21ef703]

## Differences between markets
The case includes customers in Europe and the USA. European customers in the signals express a preference for a paper handbook, while USA customers request printed or alternative reference formats. [signal:2aec79df-a754-4bad-ad16-a68eb5c300ce] [signal:5860235b-2416-4c4d-803e-a1399a6cf461] [signal:78af839b-0d91-4277-9000-682827bf6a7f] [signal:08409202-7858-4d39-814b-5295aae440cd]

## Open questions
How well do the available manual formats help customers find answers and understand vehicle functions? [signal:97189606-42b0-4d47-832e-324c6bf2b791] [signal:08409202-7858-4d39-814b-5295aae440cd]

How often does a customer who expects a paper manual not receive it? [signal:ffebd26d-387d-43b1-a819-4bdd38013c37]

value.title: Public charging access and provider programs are difficult to use
value.summary: Public charging and external-provider programs are difficult to access, set up or use for some BMW customers. The case covers 45 customers, predominantly in the USA and across G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Customers report difficulty with charging access and provider-program usability.
45 customers: 43 in the USA and 2 in the Rest of World; 29 G60 and 16 G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across 45 customers, the case includes 38 complaints, 4 wishes and 3 likes about public charging and external providers. Customers describe issues involving charging availability, provider-program setup and charging recognition at stations. [signal:061edda5-f7a6-4f48-93d6-24a6904ed553] [signal:13f54cb6-8280-4a8e-8688-6dde2418e594] [signal:2c7a41ba-6cf9-42fe-9ade-a4adc57b19a5]

## What customers say
One customer reports uncertainty about where and when charging is available, particularly late at night. [signal:061edda5-f7a6-4f48-93d6-24a6904ed553] Another says charging stations they found felt unsafe or remote, and some were not listed on Charge America. [signal:0c5b505c-84be-42e7-80c5-7a4b3d4e60b2]

Customers also report trouble using external-provider programs: one could not configure Electrify America access for a secondary driver and says the car did not recognize the stored contract when plugged in. [signal:13f54cb6-8280-4a8e-8688-6dde2418e594] Another was unsure whether Plug & Charge was enabled and needed guidance to switch it on after being unable to charge with EA. [signal:2c7a41ba-6cf9-42fe-9ade-a4adc57b19a5] One customer did not know about included free charging or how to set up an account. [signal:223f35d4-0414-4e3e-8478-8fdf66e33f39]

## Differences between markets
The counts cover 43 USA customers, including 36 complaints, 4 wishes and 3 likes; the Rest of World has 2 customers, both with complaints. G60 accounts for 29 customers and 24 complaints; G70 accounts for 16 customers and 14 complaints. A USA customer describes uncertainty about charging availability late at night, while a Rest of World customer reports a shortage of charging stations across the country. [signal:061edda5-f7a6-4f48-93d6-24a6904ed553] [signal:01d41ed7-0ed4-44bd-b9b0-10157032250a]

## Open questions
How consistently do provider programs work for secondary drivers and recognize stored charging contracts? [signal:13f54cb6-8280-4a8e-8688-6dde2418e594] What makes charging availability, station discovery and the perceived safety of charging locations difficult for customers? [signal:061edda5-f7a6-4f48-93d6-24a6904ed553] [signal:0c5b505c-84be-42e7-80c5-7a4b3d4e60b2]

value.title: Touchscreen controls are difficult and distracting to use
value.summary: All 29 customers in the case report complaints about touchscreen operation. They describe difficulty finding or remembering controls and say screen interactions can divert attention from driving.
highlights: Touchscreen controls are difficult to use and can distract drivers.
Affected customers are in Europe, the USA and the Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
All 29 customers in the case report complaints about touchscreen operation. Customers describe controls as difficult to find, understand or use without looking at the screen while driving.

## What customers say
Some customers say that using screen controls for basic functions, including heating, takes their attention away from the road [signal:14d01ae6-61f5-4206-aee9-204377bdb339]. Others describe the touchscreen as dangerous to use while driving [signal:28a2fdf9-87bf-4d43-b083-58e0742ec3ce].

Customers also report difficulty remembering or recognizing touchscreen symbols [signal:612fcfd5-cf11-4442-b3c9-f3f7be00462d], and say the screen is tricky to adapt to and pulls focus from driving [signal:64c6e867-5f88-48ec-b92e-59c12a6243da]. One customer says audio, navigation and air-conditioning rely too much on the touch panel and are difficult to operate [signal:3b1b2110-46d8-4817-a579-bb1534a5a8f3].

## Differences between markets
The case includes complaints from Europe, the USA and the Rest of World. European customers describe distraction while using basic controls and difficulty locating information on screen [signal:14d01ae6-61f5-4206-aee9-204377bdb339] [signal:30da94d4-b3c1-40f2-a5ee-e89bd179e7de]. A customer in the Rest of World says the screen controls can be confusing and operation is poor [signal:1f883f72-a87f-4579-b757-3919778acd7a] [signal:3b1b2110-46d8-4817-a579-bb1534a5a8f3]. In the USA, customers report difficulty remembering touchscreen symbols and say the screen pulls focus from driving [signal:612fcfd5-cf11-4442-b3c9-f3f7be00462d] [signal:64c6e867-5f88-48ec-b92e-59c12a6243da].

The case spans F70, G60 and G70. The available comments include F70 customers describing distraction and difficulty using screen controls [signal:14d01ae6-61f5-4206-aee9-204377bdb339] [signal:3b1b2110-46d8-4817-a579-bb1534a5a8f3], G60 customers describing unfamiliar symbols and distraction [signal:612fcfd5-cf11-4442-b3c9-f3f7be00462d] [signal:64c6e867-5f88-48ec-b92e-59c12a6243da], and a G70 customer saying screen controls can draw attention from the road [signal:0d0902af-51c8-4b07-b684-c2c01d755847].

## Open questions
Which screen functions are hardest to find or operate across markets and vehicle lines? How much of the reported difficulty is unfamiliarity with the controls, and how much is the effort of interacting with the screen while driving?

value.title: Rear seat entertainment is difficult to use
value.summary: Rear seat entertainment usability is a problem for BMW G70 customers in the USA. Most customers in the case have complaints, while some express wishes or likes.
highlights: Rear seat entertainment usability draws 16 complaints among 21 customers.
All 21 customers are in the USA and drive the G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Rear seat entertainment usability is a recurring issue: 16 of 21 customers have complaints. The case also includes 2 wishes and 3 likes.

Customers describe difficulty with using the theater screen and setting up streaming or connected devices [signal:02a34b22-439b-48cf-8cfd-621bbbd862e4] [signal:172cfdd6-9512-4275-ae3e-57dc5ef9c935]. One customer calls the screen difficult to use and the process clumsy [signal:7fc32ebc-09e4-4bf0-b7fc-87929e1cb21c]. Another reports that touch controls are intermittently unresponsive [signal:83e169cb-0a0a-43d2-b790-ad075c3b9a5c].

## What customers say
Customers ask how to use the screen, stream content and connect a computer [signal:02a34b22-439b-48cf-8cfd-621bbbd862e4]. They also ask how to use Fire TV and stream shows and movies [signal:172cfdd6-9512-4275-ae3e-57dc5ef9c935]. One customer describes needing to close and reopen the screen to restore touch controls [signal:83e169cb-0a0a-43d2-b790-ad075c3b9a5c].

## Differences between markets
All 21 customers in the case are in the USA and drive the G70, so the counts provide no comparison across markets or vehicle lines.

## Open questions
How much do streaming and setup difficulties versus touch-control responsiveness contribute to usability complaints across the case? [signal:02a34b22-439b-48cf-8cfd-621bbbd862e4] [signal:83e169cb-0a0a-43d2-b790-ad075c3b9a5c]

value.title: Trunk lid latch failures and unreliable kick opening
value.summary: Trunk lid opening and closing quality is a reported problem for 29 BMW customers across Europe, the USA and the Rest of World, on F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Trunk latch failures and unreliable kick opening affect trunk lid quality.
29 customers across Europe, the USA and the Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case contains 29 customer complaints classified as defects concerning trunk lid opening and closing quality.

## What customers say
One customer reports that the trunk latch failed, leaving the trunk stuck open until the latch was replaced [signal:429c0731-eea1-456b-bda2-3d02eaba6859]. Another says the latch broke while driving and they had to keep the trunk shut with tape [signal:4a7a2e38-806a-4add-bf41-b073313a9c7f]. A customer describes the tailgate kick opening as almost useless [signal:4bb728ae-8780-4923-b26c-cf65905d4713].

## Differences between markets
The case includes 17 customers in Europe, 11 in the USA and 1 in the Rest of World. The cited latch failure reports are from the USA, while the kick-opening complaint is from the Rest of World [signal:429c0731-eea1-456b-bda2-3d02eaba6859] [signal:4a7a2e38-806a-4add-bf41-b073313a9c7f] [signal:4bb728ae-8780-4923-b26c-cf65905d4713].

## Open questions
The available information does not establish how the reported issues are distributed across all 29 complaints or whether they share a cause.

value.title: Storage space and compartments feel insufficient
value.summary: BMW customers report too little usable storage and missing or hard-to-find places for everyday items. The case spans the F70, G60 and G70 across Europe, the USA and the Rest of World.
highlights: Customers report limited usable storage and missing storage compartments.
Affected across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across the case, 29 of 42 customers complain about storage, while 12 express wishes and one likes the feature. Customers describe limited usable space, missing compartments and difficulty finding places for specific items. [signal:03eb517d-d0ab-4fab-9d21-d30183f52ad2] [signal:1bcde45a-adb4-4585-8d59-3199611ff82d] [signal:2c7d73de-a7c5-477b-b04f-4a4b3346373c]

## What customers say
Some G70 customers describe very little usable storage beyond the center console or insufficient space throughout the vehicle. [signal:03eb517d-d0ab-4fab-9d21-d30183f52ad2] [signal:23d99641-12c5-4fb9-9a81-b8ee232a9aef]

G60 customers mention missing storage flaps or pouches on the backs of the front seats, and one reports difficulty finding a place for sunglasses. [signal:1bcde45a-adb4-4585-8d59-3199611ff82d] [signal:27fe11dc-182a-46d8-b055-c04d1bd3455d] [signal:2c7d73de-a7c5-477b-b04f-4a4b3346373c]

One G70 customer wishes for a front trunk, while a G60 customer says storage feels reduced compared with earlier 5 Series models. [signal:1c0161c4-62e0-40b4-933f-e367b14d8c14] [signal:27fe11dc-182a-46d8-b055-c04d1bd3455d]

## Differences between markets
The USA accounts for 32 customers: 21 complaints, 10 wishes and one like. Rest of World has seven customers, all complaints; Europe has three customers, with one complaint and two wishes. These market counts describe different mixes of complaint, wish and like signals; they do not establish a shared view within each market.

## Open questions
Which storage needs matter most across the F70, G60 and G70? Do the concerns about limited space, missing seat-back storage and item-specific storage vary by market or vehicle line?

value.title: Exterior lighting faults and performance concerns
value.summary: Exterior lighting complaints include recurring rear-light faults as well as concerns about headlight aim and lighting controls. The case covers BMW customers in Europe and the USA across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Lighting complaints include faults and concerns about operation or performance.
14 customers: 11 in Europe and 3 in the USA; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case records 16 complaints and 16 defects from 14 BMW customers. Reports include rear-light malfunctions, alongside concerns about headlight aim and the ability to switch off automatic headlights. [signal:167eb663-7854-4a48-88cd-3275d741499a] [signal:65dc7af4-c0b1-4ff3-bd89-53b30ee3d3b8] [signal:0b110d9c-8960-4164-8982-298be064425f]

## What customers say
One F70 owner describes rear-light warnings that returned intermittently after the taillights had been replaced twice. [signal:167eb663-7854-4a48-88cd-3275d741499a] Another reports a rear-light software fault soon after delivery and says the light was not working properly. [signal:5b697b0d-d1ed-4b92-909f-f0d2d3b27c0a]

A USA G70 owner says the headlights blind oncoming drivers even on low beam; another says they do not shine far enough. [signal:65dc7af4-c0b1-4ff3-bd89-53b30ee3d3b8] [signal:e647f33b-e4d3-49d7-8987-f3af5f186f84] A Europe F70 owner says automatic headlights cannot be switched off while the engine is running. [signal:0b110d9c-8960-4164-8982-298be064425f]

## Differences between markets
The case includes 13 complaints from 11 customers in Europe and 3 complaints from 3 customers in the USA. It covers 12 complaints from 10 F70 customers, 2 from 2 G60 customers and 2 from 2 G70 customers. The cited European F70 reports describe rear-light faults and automatic-light control concerns; the cited USA G70 reports concern headlight aim and reach. [signal:167eb663-7854-4a48-88cd-3275d741499a] [signal:0b110d9c-8960-4164-8982-298be064425f] [signal:65dc7af4-c0b1-4ff3-bd89-53b30ee3d3b8] [signal:e647f33b-e4d3-49d7-8987-f3af5f186f84]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how common each specific lighting issue is within the case, or whether rear-light faults share a cause. One F70 owner reports that a rear-light problem continued after replacement, while another describes a software-related fault. [signal:167eb663-7854-4a48-88cd-3275d741499a] [signal:5b697b0d-d1ed-4b92-909f-f0d2d3b27c0a]

value.title: Personal Assistant voice commands are unreliable and difficult to use
value.summary: Customers report difficulty using the Intelligent Personal Assistant, including voice recognition that misses or misunderstands commands; some customers also value its voice controls. The case covers BMW customers in the USA and Europe across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: 25 complaints describe usability problems among 41 customers.
Customers span the USA and Europe and F70, G60 and G70 vehicle lines.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across 41 customers, 25 complaints concern usability, while 11 customers like the feature and 5 express wishes. Customers describe missed or misunderstood commands, difficulty operating the assistant, and delays before navigation voice input is available. [signal:1ebd7620-fb84-46dc-a573-a255b4e4e443] [signal:1d662eb6-aa02-4579-840e-f86320a0ebcb] [signal:34370094-0716-4a59-8a18-02c0532151ee]

## What customers say
One customer said voice recognition did not reliably understand commands and led them to use manual controls, which they found distracting while driving. [signal:1ebd7620-fb84-46dc-a573-a255b4e4e443] Another reported needing to wait around 10 seconds for the navigation system to prompt for a destination. [signal:34370094-0716-4a59-8a18-02c0532151ee] A customer also said the assistant recognized “blower” but not “fan” in a climate-control command. [signal:35847a57-9db0-4bb1-8103-772600b5c6ed]

Experiences are not uniformly negative: one customer described voice commands as simple, while another reported that microphone recognition initially often failed but later worked without further issues. [signal:60a4ea09-73f6-4dda-af6c-99a7c1b51da6] [signal:14b22966-e084-46c2-a068-d01336acede0]

## Differences between markets
The case includes 39 customers in the USA and 2 in Europe. The USA has 24 complaints, 5 wishes and 10 likes; Europe has 1 complaint and 1 like. Across vehicle lines, there are 13 customers for G60, 26 for G70 and 2 for F70. The case counts do not establish a reason for differences between markets or vehicle lines.

## Open questions
What accounts for differences in voice recognition and command understanding, including the reported variation in accepted wording? [signal:14b22966-e084-46c2-a068-d01336acede0] [signal:35847a57-9db0-4bb1-8103-772600b5c6ed] What accounts for the reported delay before navigation accepts a spoken destination? [signal:34370094-0716-4a59-8a18-02c0532151ee]

value.title: ConnectedDrive and infotainment reliability and usability problems
value.summary: Customers report infotainment and ConnectedDrive faults, including systems failing or behaving unpredictably, alongside complaints that the interface is awkward or complicated to use. The case covers BMW customers in Europe, the USA and the Rest of World across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: All 20 customers report a defect or complaint involving technology reliability.
Affected customers are in Europe, the USA and the Rest of World, across F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case contains 20 customer complaints and defects involving ConnectedDrive and infotainment reliability. Reported problems include iDrive errors, a screen going black, and features or interface elements that do not work as expected. Some customers also describe the system as awkward or complicated to use. [signal:5aa6bafe-ba32-4e54-9d33-32d139c003e7] [signal:7056057f-4fe9-4a31-bee3-8b1bddf66fcc] [signal:0e5a2b02-1a8e-45c8-87d0-e3b53c7a4066]

## What customers say
One F70 owner says iDrive 9 went black about a month after delivery and was assessed as having a possible communication failure. [signal:5aa6bafe-ba32-4e54-9d33-32d139c003e7]

An F70 customer reports a recurring “component protection” error after a dealer visit. [signal:7056057f-4fe9-4a31-bee3-8b1bddf66fcc]

A G70 owner says home-screen widgets disappear and the eSIM randomly refuses to activate. [signal:2d703e37-9980-4f40-bf32-1e813eca1411]

Customers also describe the infotainment interface as overly complicated or awkward, and say that losing the rotary iDrive controller made it harder to use. [signal:0e5a2b02-1a8e-45c8-87d0-e3b53c7a4066] [signal:78c0701c-32a6-488e-9d5b-2147b852d806]

## Differences between markets
The counts show complaints from Europe, the USA and the Rest of the World, and from F70, G60 and G70 customers. The cited reports include F70 complaints about errors and usability, and G70 reports about disappearing widgets and eSIM activation. [signal:5aa6bafe-ba32-4e54-9d33-32d139c003e7] [signal:7056057f-4fe9-4a31-bee3-8b1bddf66fcc] [signal:2d703e37-9980-4f40-bf32-1e813eca1411]

## Open questions
The signals do not establish how often each reported fault occurs or whether the different issues share a cause.

value.title: ConnectedDrive and infotainment displays go blank or freeze
value.summary: Customers report blank or frozen displays and other iDrive malfunctions. The case affects BMW customers in the USA and Rest of World across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: All 19 complaints describe defects in ConnectedDrive or infotainment reliability.
Affects 19 customers: 18 in the USA and one in Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
All 19 customers in the case reported defects, with complaints concentrated in the USA (18) and also present in Rest of World (one). The affected vehicle lines are G70 (14 customers), G60 (four) and F70 (one). The reports describe displays going black or freezing, and iDrive content failing to load or operate. [signal:057c16fa-a966-4dd9-b0f6-1c32dd20f19f] [signal:0f4f3393-3c3e-437f-a9c0-79abce3cf686] [signal:14c1ad50-b993-46a6-813c-577145b8fc7d] [signal:91d7b109-5905-4111-b369-fb5de81ab265]

## What customers say
A G60 customer describes content-display glitches, including freezing and content not loading. [signal:057c16fa-a966-4dd9-b0f6-1c32dd20f19f]

G70 customers describe screens going blank, including one report of a blank display lasting around 24 hours and another of the problem clearing after restarting the vehicle. [signal:0f4f3393-3c3e-437f-a9c0-79abce3cf686] [signal:2dfbeeb9-4c53-415d-aa14-cebd72bd7107]

A G70 customer says the display went black several times and that a dealer performed a system update. [signal:1eebcea5-0d92-4f2c-882f-dedf5c3f3f08]

The F70 report describes iDrive 9 going black about a month after delivery; the customer says a communication failure was suspected. [signal:91d7b109-5905-4111-b369-fb5de81ab265]

## Differences between markets
The counts show 18 customers in the USA and one in Rest of World. The supplied accounts describe display failures in both markets; they do not establish a difference in the problem between markets. [signal:057c16fa-a966-4dd9-b0f6-1c32dd20f19f] [signal:91d7b109-5905-4111-b369-fb5de81ab265]

## Open questions
The reports do not establish a common cause or whether the issues are resolved for all affected customers. One G60 customer says the system was reprogrammed after being told a service pack was causing the behavior. [signal:057c16fa-a966-4dd9-b0f6-1c32dd20f19f]

value.title: Cabin heating and cooling feel slow or too weak
value.summary: Customers report that the cabin takes too long to heat or cool, or that the airflow feels weak or does not reach them well. Complaints span Europe, the Rest of World and the USA, across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Slow heating and cooling, weak airflow and difficulty directing air.
34 customers across Europe, Rest of World and USA; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe slow cabin cooling and heating, weak airflow, and air that does not reach them as expected. One customer also calls the single-zone air conditioning poor. [signal:26b398d3-d1c3-40a3-8b0a-bddb677f23eb] [signal:2064369b-f830-46a2-8e85-c046fa7e3038] [signal:37d4a8fa-1887-4303-91a2-06f0be3f82ff] [signal:6cd52de3-dfac-459d-90c4-59cfa86e19aa] [signal:84a0d159-d912-4bf0-9aa9-b4fadb6d61c4]

## What customers say
In the USA, customers describe slow cabin cooling, insufficient cooling or air circulation, and difficulty aiming airflow at a person. [signal:26b398d3-d1c3-40a3-8b0a-bddb677f23eb] [signal:37d4a8fa-1887-4303-91a2-06f0be3f82ff] [signal:47a24b5e-a2ae-48d8-b9ae-4ae7446239e0] A customer in Florida says cooling takes time and is especially important in the heat. [signal:50b15872-6099-44f7-ac6f-51b3bdd048b7] In the Rest of World, customers describe weak or slow heat and difficulty getting cool air to reach them. [signal:2064369b-f830-46a2-8e85-c046fa7e3038] [signal:6cd52de3-dfac-459d-90c4-59cfa86e19aa]

## Differences between markets
The case includes complaints from Europe, Rest of World and the USA. The available customer descriptions differ: they mention cooling and airflow concerns in the USA, heating and airflow concerns in the Rest of World, and single-zone air conditioning in Europe. [signal:26b398d3-d1c3-40a3-8b0a-bddb677f23eb] [signal:2064369b-f830-46a2-8e85-c046fa7e3038] [signal:50b15872-6099-44f7-ac6f-51b3bdd048b7] [signal:6cd52de3-dfac-459d-90c4-59cfa86e19aa] [signal:84a0d159-d912-4bf0-9aa9-b4fadb6d61c4]

## Open questions
The customer descriptions raise questions about how consistently the system reaches the desired cabin temperature, how quickly it heats or cools, and how well airflow reaches occupants. [signal:26b398d3-d1c3-40a3-8b0a-bddb677f23eb] [signal:2064369b-f830-46a2-8e85-c046fa7e3038] [signal:6cd52de3-dfac-459d-90c4-59cfa86e19aa]

value.title: ConnectedDrive and infotainment are difficult to use
value.summary: All 57 customers report complaints about ConnectedDrive and infotainment usability. Their concerns include complicated interfaces, reliance on screens for basic tasks, and software that can be unreliable.
highlights: Customers report complicated controls, screen-related concerns and software issues.
57 customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
All 57 customers in the case report complaints. The concerns span interface complexity, accessing everyday controls and software reliability. Some customers say screen-based controls take attention away from driving or that basic tasks require navigating menus [signal:041c91d5-3c28-4ad9-ab1d-f7c333792e3b] [signal:3e80bbe8-9cdc-4770-96f5-3fe479e1b56b]. Others report screen, app, voice-function or software-update problems [signal:08a5a9c9-9949-47e6-96ec-d4f2f9dc5431] [signal:0c4e2f0d-a32d-470d-a0e9-8342fa37faad].

## What customers say
Some customers miss a rotary controller or physical buttons for functions such as heating, and say using the screen means looking away from the road [signal:041c91d5-3c28-4ad9-ab1d-f7c333792e3b]. One older customer says the newer technology is harder to use than the turning control they were used to [signal:1b079d0d-b801-4e67-85d9-7532805f60c2].

Customers also describe the interface as overly complicated and say common adjustments involve navigating multiple menus or screens [signal:0c4e2f0d-a32d-470d-a0e9-8342fa37faad] [signal:3e80bbe8-9cdc-4770-96f5-3fe479e1b56b]. Reported software concerns include a screen that cuts out, an unreliable connected app and voice function, and quirks after an update [signal:08a5a9c9-9949-47e6-96ec-d4f2f9dc5431] [signal:0c4e2f0d-a32d-470d-a0e9-8342fa37faad] [signal:119c0fef-4ad2-4313-a1e5-3aa43e3ba03d].

## Differences between markets
The case includes complaints from Europe, the USA and Rest of World. In the cited customer comments, European customers describe screen-based controls, complexity and software concerns [signal:041c91d5-3c28-4ad9-ab1d-f7c333792e3b] [signal:0c4e2f0d-a32d-470d-a0e9-8342fa37faad], a USA customer describes too much technology and too few buttons for basic tasks [signal:43c33c30-17a0-4cad-b48b-7e51364eef30], and a Rest of World customer describes the interface as more complicated than in an older vehicle [signal:54518737-aee8-4975-80b5-cf06d2523b47]. These comments do not establish that the concerns differ by market.

## Open questions
Which interface and software concerns are shared across markets and vehicle lines? How often do customers encounter reliability problems versus difficulty finding or operating controls? The case has no competitor signals.

value.title: Remote app controls lack desired climate and window functions
value.summary: Customers value remote services, but some want more control over climate settings and vehicle functions through the app. The case includes BMW customers in Europe and the USA across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Customers want more remote control over climate and vehicle functions.
13 BMW customers: 2 in Europe and 11 in the USA; F70, G60 and G70.
16 competitor signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case covers 29 signals from 13 BMW customers: 6 wishes and 7 likes, with no complaints or defects recorded in the counts. Customers express a desire for more remote control over climate settings, windows and other vehicle functions. [signal:166362e6-dd16-4dae-97f0-a95c9391ef75] [signal:2370e7f4-82f7-4788-86ff-a75fd62ad290] [signal:36645a8b-e01d-4d0a-b9bd-f1073472b2c2]

## What customers say
Some customers want to open or close windows remotely, adjust climate settings, or view cabin temperatures in the app. [signal:166362e6-dd16-4dae-97f0-a95c9391ef75] [signal:2370e7f4-82f7-4788-86ff-a75fd62ad290] [signal:30c635f2-ba0a-4acd-a595-90d99e31edd8] [signal:4ce660c5-44e2-47e4-960c-8be8a3f53190] [signal:36645a8b-e01d-4d0a-b9bd-f1073472b2c2]

One customer says the app's climate behavior does not leave the car cool enough, and wants more control over how climate starts remotely. [signal:5432061d-1efd-4792-bd7e-26a596badc42] Other requests include a notification when a door or trunk is left open and the ability to close windows and the sunroof remotely. [signal:5c3bcbea-ab3c-4acc-b4aa-9f1d804c7827] [signal:7eaa60d7-0e5a-43be-9594-7cf5c0c86bbc]

A customer wants to send a navigation address directly to the vehicle, and another asks for remote features comparable to a previous Lincoln. [signal:0461956c-2312-4013-8efb-c0013777a8d4] [signal:5252c717-f0c0-48a1-85f1-4ad8d463d205]

## Differences between markets
The counts include 2 customers in Europe and 11 in the USA. Europe has 1 wish and 1 like; the USA has 5 wishes and 6 likes. The sampled European requests include climate information, remote window control and an open-door notification. [signal:30c635f2-ba0a-4acd-a595-90d99e31edd8] [signal:4ce660c5-44e2-47e4-960c-8be8a3f53190] [signal:5c3bcbea-ab3c-4acc-b4aa-9f1d804c7827] The sampled USA requests include window operation and more control over remote climate. [signal:166362e6-dd16-4dae-97f0-a95c9391ef75] [signal:5432061d-1efd-4792-bd7e-26a596badc42]

The case spans F70, G60 and G70. The counts show 2 customers for F70, 5 for G60 and 6 for G70; the sampled requests cited above include F70 and G60.

## Open questions
The counts include 16 competitor signals. In the cited signals, one customer compares address sending with a Mercedes and another compares remote features with a previous Lincoln. [signal:0461956c-2312-4013-8efb-c0013777a8d4] [signal:5252c717-f0c0-48a1-85f1-4ad8d463d205] The available evidence does not describe what customers value in the app or remote services, despite 7 likes in the case counts.

value.title: Ambient lighting is valued, but trim can feel oversized

highlights: Three likes and one wish: lighting is valued, but the trim can feel too large.
Four USA customers across G60 and G70: two customers per vehicle line.
Three competitor signals are recorded.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Ambient lighting is mostly valued, but one customer considers the ambient-light trim too tall and says it occupies too much surface area. [signal:521f01b3-fe0a-4173-99b3-057df41630d0]

## What customers say
A G70 customer wishes the trim were less tall and broad. [signal:521f01b3-fe0a-4173-99b3-057df41630d0] G60 customers describe the accent lighting as elevating the experience and giving the interior a premium appearance. [signal:a61ca7d0-aecc-4472-a2ab-f9230dbd481b] [signal:c4393b17-647d-4ff0-95f8-242f9d996f6c] Another G70 customer likes the ambient lighting, especially in the skylight. [signal:b001771d-bedf-4d55-9338-0f86d818b850]

## Differences between markets
The case counts cover USA customers only. No other market is included in the counts.

What aspects of ambient-light design are represented by the three competitor signals?

value.title: Remote engine start valued for comfort and time savings

highlights: Remote engine start is valued for comfort and time savings.
No BMW customers, markets or vehicle lines are represented in the counts.

value.body_md:
## Problem
The case counts no BMW customer complaints, wishes or likes.

## What customers say
A signal values remote engine start for saving time and making trips more comfortable. [signal:a4234595-4ff0-4865-a5aa-487db9aabfe9]

The counts do not identify any markets or vehicle lines.
