value.title: Remote engine start access and behavior fall short of some expectations
value.summary: Across BMW customers in the USA and Europe, the feature has both positive feedback and wishes for different access, operation and climate-control behavior. The counts show 6 likes and 4 wishes among 10 customers.
highlights: Some customers want different remote-start access and behavior.
Customers across the USA and Europe, in the F70, G60 and G70.
4 competitor signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Among 10 customers, the counts record 4 wishes and 6 likes, with no complaints or defects. Wishes include requests for classic remote engine start and for the engine to start during app preconditioning [signal:0eafa831-ea02-45b2-8cd3-67da51fca172] [signal:15179525-40f6-4464-93b4-f8c61d40e2e5]. One customer says remote start is unavailable for their model year [signal:bd0b02cd-921b-472f-8a6d-9b0910453fca].

## What customers say
One customer says app start is unavailable when a window is down or the vehicle is unlocked [signal:14748749-5cfc-4013-8f17-1f7d84c72553]. Another wants the vehicle to remain on while they unlock it and load groceries [signal:b18e3776-4903-4572-ac02-fb41b79aa52b]. A G70 customer wants to choose the air-conditioning temperature and mentions that their Tesla and Audi offer this option [signal:bd28afde-6450-4b85-bade-9dde48bbe7d2]. A European F70 customer describes the BMW app as giving peace of mind and praises having vehicle technology accessible in one place [signal:3bbb1d0b-aeb8-455a-85c2-c4e084d857b7].

## Differences between markets
The counts cover 9 USA customers, with 4 wishes and 5 likes, and 1 European customer, with 1 like and no wishes. The sample customer statements describe requests from the USA; the European statement is positive [signal:3bbb1d0b-aeb8-455a-85c2-c4e084d857b7].

## Open questions
The signals raise questions about start eligibility when a window is open or the vehicle is unlocked [signal:14748749-5cfc-4013-8f17-1f7d84c72553], how long the engine remains on during unlocking and loading [signal:b18e3776-4903-4572-ac02-fb41b79aa52b], and whether app preconditioning starts the engine or allows temperature selection [signal:15179525-40f6-4464-93b4-f8c61d40e2e5] [signal:bd28afde-6450-4b85-bade-9dde48bbe7d2].

value.title: Interior comfort is valued, with a few requests for improvement
value.summary: Interior comfort is widely liked, though some customers have wishes for improvement. Among 163 BMW customers, 159 signals are likes and 4 are wishes, with no complaints or defects.
highlights: Interior comfort is widely liked, with 159 likes and 4 wishes among 163 BMW customers.
Customers are in Europe, Rest of World, the USA and unknown; vehicle lines are F70, G60 and G70.
There are 8 competitor signals in the case.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Interior comfort is predominantly valued: the whole case has 159 likes and 4 wishes among 163 BMW customers, with no complaints or defects. The sample includes a wish for a more luxurious-feeling interior [signal:bc1cf13c-1e0c-41b9-b210-2b73e65258be] and a wish for a central armrest when the middle seat is unused [signal:e43d6ad5-896d-468a-9241-aa4fe92e6874].

## What customers say
Customers describe the vehicles as comfortable [signal:020de605-465a-43ff-ad70-cd24eaaa7dd0] [signal:0408722c-f1ea-4900-af5e-1a84f2116c00]. One customer says the S-Class is more comfortable, particularly for rear-seat passengers [signal:cf41674a-a389-4c56-b194-8d4e22c43dd8].

## Differences between markets
The counts show likes in Europe (21), Rest of World (9), the USA (128) and the unknown market (1). Wishes appear in Rest of World (1) and the USA (3); no market has complaints or defects.

## Open questions
What aspects of interior comfort drive the positive assessments, and what underlies the wishes for a more luxurious feel or a central armrest?

value.title: Exterior design draws both praise and criticism
value.summary: Exterior design is valued by many BMW customers, while others criticize its styling or wish for changes. The case covers F70, G60 and G70 customers across Europe, Rest of World and the USA, as well as customers with an unknown market.
highlights: 449 likes alongside 11 complaints and 38 wishes among BMW customers.
493 BMW customers across Europe, Rest of World, the USA and unknown markets; F70, G60 and G70.
14 competitor signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Exterior design receives substantial positive feedback, but some customers find the styling unattractive, challenging or insufficiently distinctive. Across the whole case, BMW customers record 449 likes, 11 complaints and 38 wishes.

## What customers say
Some customers criticize the exterior as unattractive or say it lacks elegance or drama [signal:0eaafe00-2244-4a2a-a550-daab18308740] [signal:52d31439-d415-41bf-ad38-210cfaba3daf] [signal:362ab8c5-379a-4fca-bc5f-0789aae8c6af]. Others say the front styling is unappealing or that the rear design falls short [signal:2c468367-95f6-4ac7-9413-e602a187ac0c] [signal:7bf26f03-9981-42dd-b2e3-fea0d01fc163]. One customer says a 120 looks too much like the M135 [signal:04e64564-2860-4b2c-84f4-447ce76cc9ac].

Customers' views are not uniformly negative: one says BMW has nailed its latest design language, while describing the XM design as surprising [signal:236f3367-82ca-4876-9c7d-25feb6be9733]. Another says the exterior turns heads, but questions whether it does so for the right reasons [signal:225aed53-332d-4eb1-b7e5-1574c677451e].

## Differences between markets
The counts span Europe, Rest of World, the USA and an unknown market, and vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70. They show likes, complaints and wishes across markets, but the customer reactions cited above are not enough to establish a general difference in opinion between markets.

## Open questions
The counts show 14 competitor signals, but do not establish which competitors are referenced across those signals. The available comments also leave open which exterior-design elements matter most to customers beyond the specific styling reactions described above.

value.title: My BMW App usability and access problems
value.summary: Customers report that the My BMW App is difficult to use, hard to set up, or unreliable, while others value it. The case covers BMW customers in Europe and the USA across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Customers report confusing navigation, setup difficulties and connection problems.
38 customers across Europe and the USA, in F70, G60 and G70.
20 competitor signals are counted; their comparison is unspecified.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across the case, 38 BMW customers are represented, with 30 complaints and 8 likes. The case spans Europe and the USA and vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70. Customer feedback describes usability difficulties, alongside positive experiences.

## What customers say
- Customers describe the app as difficult to use and say it is challenging to keep track of its settings. [signal:15562da0-7c85-4ced-9ce5-68dd4b4dc89e]
- One customer says the Financial section is difficult to locate and they use a computer to make lease payments instead. [signal:1e6cc621-aff6-497f-9aea-ffcf5b191e4e]
- One customer reports that setup of the BMW data line was difficult, explanations were insufficient, and the app's connection status was hard to tell. [signal:169541be-cd5e-4140-a76a-3e4d65e8ff25]
- Customers also report specific limitations: sent destinations cannot be viewed or edited in the app, and favourites cannot be renamed there. [signal:075a9a27-d792-4c18-aa3b-2799a4086fa7] [signal:0ab8acca-4084-41a0-a324-10857176902e]
- One customer says the app opens without prompting whenever it connects to the vehicle and cannot be prevented from doing so. [signal:2446d316-1987-45c6-b1b6-eeb3e50bc9a3]
- One customer reports the app had stopped connecting to the vehicle, then connected again. [signal:2008a53d-d9cf-49f3-84aa-e46ec3586193]
- One customer says the app and BMW ID are a mess and that the app had not functioned for two months. [signal:0766beec-4fec-4c23-9ea9-8abc2a5a5606]
- Feedback is not exclusively negative: one customer says they have no use for the app. [signal:0475ed27-acdd-4bc2-8ffe-b940bb175b02]

## Differences between markets
The case includes 5 customers in Europe, with 4 complaints and 1 like, and 33 customers in the USA, with 26 complaints and 7 likes. The available feedback includes app-navigation and feature complaints in Europe [signal:075a9a27-d792-4c18-aa3b-2799a4086fa7] [signal:0ab8acca-4084-41a0-a324-10857176902e], and usability, setup and connection concerns in the USA [signal:15562da0-7c85-4ced-9ce5-68dd4b4dc89e] [signal:169541be-cd5e-4140-a76a-3e4d65e8ff25] [signal:2008a53d-d9cf-49f3-84aa-e46ec3586193].

## Open questions
- Which usability problems are most common across the 58 signals?
- How do the reported app difficulties differ across F70, G60 and G70?
- What do the 20 competitor signals say about app usability?

value.title: Road, wind and unwanted cabin noise affect interior acoustics
value.summary: Some BMW customers report road, wind or unwanted interior noise that affects cabin comfort, while the case also includes many likes. The issue appears across Europe, Rest of World and the USA, and the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: 27 complaints and 17 defects concern interior acoustics; the case also records 66 likes.
Customers are represented in Europe, Rest of World and the USA, across the F70, G60 and G70.
34 competitor signals; one customer compares cabin hush with Maybach, Bentley and Rolls-Royce.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The whole case contains 144 signals from 98 BMW customers: 27 complaints, 17 defects, 7 wishes and 66 likes. Customers describe road and wind noise entering the cabin, as well as unwanted noise from within the vehicle [signal:05d4f877-0c9f-41a7-bf4c-f2d880395d09] [signal:4c799c09-d698-49bd-8e8d-219539f26cca]. One customer says coarse pavement makes road noise particularly noticeable with 21-inch wheels and low-profile performance tires [signal:0a1d20a2-968d-438b-83d9-265197d0a705].

## What customers say
A G70 customer says outside noise is clearly audible inside the cabin [signal:479f4987-a521-4b19-9edc-de0320193f02]. Another reports road and wind noise, while a customer in Europe says motorway road noise makes the radio hard to hear [signal:05d4f877-0c9f-41a7-bf4c-f2d880395d09] [signal:6368baf1-829a-4900-80ab-c4b76fe70109]. Customers also describe noticeable wind noise and ongoing noise they associate with poor assembly [signal:658e06d5-87d1-4ccd-992d-4d54c69560a0] [signal:69de86d7-a055-4750-a2bf-941876dca082].

## Differences between markets
The case includes customers in Europe (12), Rest of World (16) and the USA (69), as well as one with an unknown market. Complaints are recorded in Europe (6), Rest of World (4) and the USA (17). In the signals cited here, European customers mention road and wind noise, while USA customers describe road noise, wind noise or unwanted cabin noise [signal:6368baf1-829a-4900-80ab-c4b76fe70109] [signal:658e06d5-87d1-4ccd-992d-4d54c69560a0] [signal:05d4f877-0c9f-41a7-bf4c-f2d880395d09] [signal:4c799c09-d698-49bd-8e8d-219539f26cca].

Across the vehicle lines, the case includes 17 F70 customers, 32 G60 customers and 49 G70 customers. Complaints number 6 for the F70, 8 for the G60 and 13 for the G70. A G70 customer compares cabin hush unfavourably with the Maybach, Bentley and Rolls-Royce [signal:00307da1-d371-4f3e-a42c-1e0799c43be8].

## Open questions
Which road, wind or interior noises are most important to customers? How do the reported experiences differ by vehicle line, market and driving conditions? What accounts for the case’s 66 likes alongside its complaints and defects?

value.title: Navigation usability problems with controls, routing and information
value.summary: Navigation usability is a problem for BMW customers, with complaints about controls, route guidance and the clarity or availability of information. The case spans Europe, Rest of World and the USA, across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: 55 complaints describe navigation usability problems.
69 customers: Europe (17), Rest of World (16), USA (36); F70 (27), G60 (25), G70 (17).
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case includes 76 signals from 69 BMW customers: 55 complaints, 10 wishes and 11 likes. Complaints point to usability concerns with map controls, route choices and guidance, and the visibility or availability of navigation information.

## What customers say
Some customers find on-screen map zoom difficult or distracting to adjust, and report that choosing route search results is harder without the former controller [signal:088cf584-c8a5-410d-8852-a7a850cda814] [signal:1386efe9-267f-4959-a220-514ddb9101e3]. One customer reports being routed onto narrow lanes and missing the option to choose between fastest and shortest routes [signal:0f43c114-f82b-4ccc-96c0-069b71901f47].

Other reports concern unclear or incomplete guidance: a customer says the system gives “bear right” or “bear left” prompts instead of proper turns, may not warn of lane splits, and does not recalculate properly after a wrong turn [signal:1172dc42-5cd4-483e-b06b-6125cd43ed52]. A customer finds traffic information small and difficult to access while driving, and minor roads faintly displayed [signal:40efb48d-e3cf-49d1-be98-2ca84fc34af0]. Another says navigation depends on a smartphone connection [signal:20e952fe-7dd7-4c41-8307-583b7241f448].

Experiences are not uniformly negative: one customer says smartphone destination sharing has made some navigation functions simpler, while also describing other functions as more awkward [signal:1386efe9-267f-4959-a220-514ddb9101e3].

## Differences between markets
The case covers Europe (17 customers), Rest of World (16) and the USA (36), and vehicle lines F70 (27), G60 (25) and G70 (17). The cited concerns include reports from Europe, Rest of World and the USA, but the available signals do not establish whether the issues differ by market or vehicle line [signal:088cf584-c8a5-410d-8852-a7a850cda814] [signal:1386efe9-267f-4959-a220-514ddb9101e3] [signal:1172dc42-5cd4-483e-b06b-6125cd43ed52].

## Open questions
How widespread are concerns about map controls, route selection and guidance across markets and vehicle lines? Do customer experiences differ between navigation functions that are described as easier and those described as more awkward [signal:1386efe9-267f-4959-a220-514ddb9101e3]?

value.title: Sound quality and engine tone fall short for some customers
value.summary: Customers report artificial or annoying vehicle sounds and audio that does not get loud enough, while others value the sound experience. Feedback covers BMW customers in Europe, Rest of World and the USA, across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Complaints include artificial engine sound, unwanted noises and audio that is not loud enough.
89 customers across Europe, Rest of World and the USA; F70, G60 and G70.
Two competitor signals are present.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across the case, 34 complaints and 60 likes indicate mixed views of sound. Some customers object to the sound or find it lacking, while others value it.

## What customers say
A Europe-based F70 customer dislikes the artificial internal sound and wants a more natural sound [signal:3e2670ab-bb1b-465a-8a34-432c8a402147]. Another Europe-based F70 customer objects to the fake engine sound and says noise cancelling masks a natural sporty tone [signal:625e6f4b-62fd-4ae8-a462-78990d96b1f6]. A Rest of World F70 customer dislikes the sounds played on entry [signal:39fe217e-d620-4ae3-b64a-f2cfd034ca15]. A USA-based G70 customer says the speakers do not get loud enough [signal:4fd73552-14a0-414f-954e-7a4ebaec8133]. By contrast, a USA-based G60 customer praises the speakers and sound system and calls the iconic sounds fun [signal:1f72499d-553b-4171-9bd9-670591b30ce8].

## Differences between markets
The counts show 17 complaints and 8 likes in Europe, 7 complaints and 2 likes in Rest of World, and 10 complaints and 50 likes in the USA. The cited Europe feedback concerns artificial engine tone, while the cited USA feedback includes both a complaint about speaker volume and praise for the sound system and iconic sounds [signal:3e2670ab-bb1b-465a-8a34-432c8a402147] [signal:625e6f4b-62fd-4ae8-a462-78990d96b1f6] [signal:4fd73552-14a0-414f-954e-7a4ebaec8133] [signal:1f72499d-553b-4171-9bd9-670591b30ce8].

## Open questions
The signals raise questions about which sounds customers find artificial or unwanted, and whether their concern is engine tone, entry sounds or audio volume. The counts include two competitor signals, but the available signal details do not clarify what they compare.

value.title: Ride damping feels too firm or poorly controlled
value.summary: Customers describe the ride as too firm or uncomfortable over rough roads and bumps, while some describe it as too soft, loose or heavily damped. The issue is reported across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Ride comfort complaints include harshness over rough roads and inconsistent damping.
19 BMW customers across Europe, Rest of World and USA; F70, G60 and G70.
12 competitor signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers report that the suspension can feel too firm on rough or uneven roads, with some describing discomfort for occupants or concern about bouncing. [signal:0b11f18c-ebb9-40fd-8fb8-97c02e23a0d0] [signal:ad4ab7f6-c8f3-4313-a1d6-a254d68893aa] [signal:a1caf98a-e1c3-47ef-b71f-dd92cc4274d0] Others describe the ride as softer or looser than expected, or say it feels heavily damped over a speed bump. [signal:748960d2-067c-4ca3-b350-2f8d1f66d9c9] [signal:8065191d-29aa-46d6-9205-72d53971175d] [signal:969f9bd5-0b93-4694-b36c-5873ed3383bc]

## What customers say
Some F70 customers say the suspension is too hard for everyday driving on rough roads, and one reports discomfort for rear-seat passengers. [signal:0b11f18c-ebb9-40fd-8fb8-97c02e23a0d0] [signal:ad4ab7f6-c8f3-4313-a1d6-a254d68893aa] A customer says the firm ride causes back pain over bumpy roads. [signal:ade6e1d6-484f-436f-8201-1e2f32db09ce] G60 customers describe the shocks as not absorbing bumps well, or the ride as too firm on rough roads. [signal:2f7be850-3da7-4a80-b45e-f33d74460549] [signal:3ff52c25-5b12-42b5-b97f-4726e7c7ee41] Other accounts differ: one describes the ride as mushier than a previous 5 Series, while another says the suspension feels loose. [signal:748960d2-067c-4ca3-b350-2f8d1f66d9c9] [signal:8065191d-29aa-46d6-9205-72d53971175d] A G70 customer calls the suspension excellent but says it feels over-damped on speed bumps. [signal:969f9bd5-0b93-4694-b36c-5873ed3383bc]

## Differences between markets
The counts show complaints in Europe, Rest of World and USA. In the cited accounts, European and Rest of World F70 customers describe a firm ride on rough roads, while USA G60 accounts include both insufficient bump absorption and a softer, less satisfactory feel. [signal:0b11f18c-ebb9-40fd-8fb8-97c02e23a0d0] [signal:ade6e1d6-484f-436f-8201-1e2f32db09ce] [signal:2f7be850-3da7-4a80-b45e-f33d74460549] [signal:748960d2-067c-4ca3-b350-2f8d1f66d9c9]

## Open questions
The accounts disagree on whether the ride feels too firm or too soft, loose or heavily damped. [signal:3ff52c25-5b12-42b5-b97f-4726e7c7ee41] [signal:748960d2-067c-4ca3-b350-2f8d1f66d9c9] [signal:8065191d-29aa-46d6-9205-72d53971175d] [signal:969f9bd5-0b93-4694-b36c-5873ed3383bc] How do road conditions, vehicle line and suspension configuration relate to these different ride impressions?

value.title: Ride comfort ranges from smooth to harsh over bumps
value.summary: Ride comfort is valued by many BMW customers, while some report a harsh, unsettled or choppy ride. The case covers BMW customers across Europe, Rest of World, USA and unknown markets, and F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Some customers report a harsh or unsettled ride, despite many positive comfort ratings.
95 BMW customers across Europe, Rest of World, USA and unknown markets; vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70.
46 competitor signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across the case, 92 of 95 BMW customers like the handling or riding comfort; the counts also include 4 complaints and 1 defect. Some customers describe a rough, sharp or choppy ride over bumps, while others value a smooth, comfortable ride. [signal:05064e5a-6428-4227-8b0a-8969e4afd699] [signal:27e21929-4690-403c-8402-df4ffaff8a5f] [signal:6fcc26b5-e5d1-45f4-85bd-8c82a48fa214] [signal:00bb483f-1bf9-4b8d-8330-f1df7d6ffe93]

## What customers say
Some F70 customers describe the suspension as crashy over bumps and potholes at low speeds, and say larger wheels make fidgeting over bumps more noticeable. [signal:39f355df-b3d0-495a-86af-1f7c30086ad5] [signal:46fa995f-3796-4844-aa31-c3930e7f3167] A G60 customer also describes the ride as sharp over bumps. [signal:27e21929-4690-403c-8402-df4ffaff8a5f]

Other customers praise the ride as comfortable and stable on highways, or say it remains comfortable on long drives. [signal:02020f9a-4ad4-4588-8dd7-bc9be823febb] [signal:02d5c611-b606-4995-ae9b-40970b55f28a] A G60 customer values the smooth ride and comfort at high speeds. [signal:00bb483f-1bf9-4b8d-8330-f1df7d6ffe93]

Competitor comparisons mention an unsettled ride in plug-in hybrid models relative to Audi A3 models without a plug-in, and fidgeting over bumps compared with the A-Class. [signal:1bfb0638-a249-445c-a3eb-37249a9a7aa2] [signal:46fa995f-3796-4844-aa31-c3930e7f3167]

## Differences between markets
Europe has 21 customers, including 19 likes, 3 complaints and 1 defect. Rest of World has 22 customers, including 21 likes and 1 complaint. USA has 50 customers, all with likes and none with complaints or defects. The market is unknown for 2 customers, both with likes.

## Open questions
The case counts show strong positive feedback alongside complaints and a defect, but do not establish how the ride experience varies by driving conditions, configuration or customer expectations.

value.title: App feedback mixes usability complaints with valued features
value.summary: BMW customers report both app problems and valued features, with feedback across Europe, the USA and Rest of World. Complaints and wishes are concentrated in F70, while G60 and G70 feedback includes more likes than complaints.
highlights: Complaints include route planning, compatibility and app-status concerns.
Affected markets: Europe, USA and Rest of World; vehicle lines: F70, G60 and G70.
13 competitor signals are present.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across 26 BMW customers, feedback includes 5 complaints, 1 defect, 7 wishes and 14 likes. The concerns raised include route planning, usability and the accuracy or availability of app information. One European F70 customer says route planning is no longer possible through the app [signal:02d14cc7-dc02-4a5f-8e78-773e30b99876]. A USA G60 customer wants the app to show the car’s status in real time rather than only the status from when it was last locked [signal:6c8908bd-e860-4f69-a0ec-02f8d819f884].

## What customers say
- A European F70 customer reports that the app no longer works on iPhone X [signal:71e6a15e-f4ae-4cc7-863b-0c5cc262bf1a].
- A USA F70 customer wants commonly used addresses, such as home, to be remembered [signal:a8ba0f74-d9e3-402d-8d08-50be45865294].
- A USA G70 customer says charging locations shown in the app may have chargers that are unavailable or fail to start charging [signal:04a96e89-94f7-491f-90e1-03bda6515ac2].
- A USA G70 customer says charging-route planning cannot start from a location other than where the car is parked [signal:8a767856-6f88-4360-a115-bc396609fdbf].
- A European F70 customer says the app gives environmental guidance instead of consumption and journey-distance information [signal:4b50dc99-c1c6-4143-9e17-f47a9b04db84].

## Differences between markets
Europe has 10 customers, 4 complaints, 1 defect, 3 wishes and 3 likes; the USA has 15 customers, 1 complaint, 4 wishes and 10 likes. Rest of World has 1 customer and 1 like. The European F70 feedback includes app compatibility and route-planning concerns [signal:71e6a15e-f4ae-4cc7-863b-0c5cc262bf1a] [signal:02d14cc7-dc02-4a5f-8e78-773e30b99876], while USA feedback includes a request for real-time vehicle status [signal:6c8908bd-e860-4f69-a0ec-02f8d819f884].

Across vehicle lines, F70 has 12 customers, 5 complaints, 1 defect, 3 wishes and 4 likes; G60 has 9 customers, 2 wishes and 7 likes; G70 has 5 customers, 2 wishes and 3 likes. The sampled G60 concern is about vehicle-status updates [signal:6c8908bd-e860-4f69-a0ec-02f8d819f884]; G70 concerns include charging information and route planning [signal:04a96e89-94f7-491f-90e1-03bda6515ac2] [signal:8a767856-6f88-4360-a115-bc396609fdbf].

## Open questions
- How common are the individual concerns about route planning, compatibility, charging information and vehicle-status updates within their respective markets and vehicle lines?
- What aspects of the app account for the likes reported across markets and vehicle lines?
- What do the 13 competitor signals say about comparison with other apps?

value.title: Interior design is widely liked but draws some specific criticisms
value.summary: Interior design is liked by most of the 252 BMW customers, while 26 express wishes and one reports a complaint. Concerns include materials, finish, layout and reflective surfaces.
highlights: Most customers like the interior design, but some have concerns about materials, layout and details.
252 BMW customers across Europe, Rest of World, USA and unknown; F70, G60 and G70.
8 competitor signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Across the whole case, 228 customers like the interior design, 26 express wishes, and one reports a complaint. The feedback is therefore largely positive, but includes specific concerns about design and finish.

## What customers say
One G60 customer calls the cabin design clunky [signal:4887e718-5375-461a-b2d9-4f18312472f8]. Another G60 customer says the electric version’s interior design is less pleasing than the combustion-engine version, while still describing the cabin as gorgeous overall [signal:ff29f481-e55f-4bdf-97fb-031b62387c8a].

Some customers criticize particular details: a G70 owner says glossy cockpit surfaces create distracting reflections [signal:4163970f-37b1-4270-9faf-3d4d0bfa3138], while a G60 owner dislikes the vent design and the red steering-wheel strip [signal:4740136f-4f5b-433e-bf29-7c429f025e30]. Other G60 customers say the interior finish seems inferior to a Genesis [signal:20effc2f-1531-4787-8d73-89be8f9c0a24] or that the materials look cheap [signal:d579b90e-3c09-4eca-b257-052b131e0d60].

Preferences also differ on layout and trim. An F70 customer prefers the previous version’s interior design and wants more physical buttons [signal:b1bd4ee9-372f-4507-9d8c-68a96ac55d85]; another says the center console looks untidy and the seat trims are unsatisfactory [signal:dca51f04-737b-4eea-a3c2-c4541114be8a]. A G70 customer prefers a Tesla’s flat rear floor to the BMW’s central hump, which makes it harder for their dogs to sit comfortably [signal:11be9a08-98d2-4c98-8c02-59f2106bbb1b].

## Differences between markets
The case includes 26 customers in Europe, 20 in Rest of World, 204 in the USA and two with an unknown market. Likes and wishes are recorded in Europe (24 and three), Rest of World (19 and one), the USA (183 and 22), and the unknown market (two and zero). The one complaint is in Rest of World.

By vehicle line, the case includes 33 F70, 102 G60 and 117 G70 customers. Likes and wishes are respectively 31 and three for F70, 91 and 11 for G60, and 106 and 12 for G70. The single complaint is for G60.

## Open questions
The counts show eight competitor signals, but do not specify a competitor breakdown. One customer compares the rear-floor layout with Tesla’s flat floor [signal:11be9a08-98d2-4c98-8c02-59f2106bbb1b], and another says a Genesis’s interior finish seemed better [signal:20effc2f-1531-4787-8d73-89be8f9c0a24].

value.title: Seat comfort varies from highly valued to uncomfortable
value.summary: Seat comfort is highly valued overall, but some customers report discomfort, firmness, pressure or difficulty finding a comfortable position. The case covers 160 BMW customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World, and F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Comfort is highly valued, but complaints describe seats as firm, uncomfortable or painful.
160 BMW customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70.
13 competitor signals are recorded; no competitor details are available.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Seat comfort receives both strong appreciation and criticism: the whole case includes 140 likes and 34 complaints among 160 BMW customers. Complaints describe discomfort ranging from firmness and pressure to pain or difficulty finding a comfortable position.

## What customers say
- One Europe F70 customer reports lower-back pain for both driver and passenger, despite two dealer visits and a further action being planned. [signal:0f55d7df-4f6b-4b0c-8b19-8e7a0bf5a01e]
- Customers describe comfort seats as too hard, and report that firm seats remain uncomfortable despite adjustments. [signal:1e3c9038-d6e2-4537-8e9f-afda289f6db9] [signal:347e24b3-1219-4e71-8195-183fc0978c20]
- A USA G60 customer reports hip pressure from the side bolsters and an uncomfortable lower cushion on longer drives. [signal:2d87c765-fd5a-4f5e-ae7a-e3f719cd3054]
- Other customers mention taking time to find a comfortable position, or that comfort is lower than in another BMW model. [signal:2dbe4fb9-aa79-4d74-b0fc-fabd33c2eafd] [signal:32d9655f-d61a-42e1-8baf-b3ba9775d83c]
- Positive comparisons also appear: one Rest of World customer says ride comfort is better than in a G80, while noting the rear seat is tight for three. [signal:50a261d0-847b-4f93-8ec5-5ae701f28cbc]

## Differences between markets
The case includes customers in Europe (40), the USA (106) and Rest of World (14). Likes and complaints are recorded in all three markets: Europe has 37 likes and 11 complaints, the USA 92 likes and 19 complaints, and Rest of World 11 likes and 4 complaints. The signals include comfort concerns in each market, alongside positive views of comfort. [signal:0f55d7df-4f6b-4b0c-8b19-8e7a0bf5a01e] [signal:127b2920-eb56-4241-a49e-3b8dde88110d] [signal:2d87c765-fd5a-4f5e-ae7a-e3f719cd3054] [signal:50a261d0-847b-4f93-8ec5-5ae701f28cbc]

## Open questions
- What seat characteristics are behind the different comfort experiences, including reported firmness, pressure and lower-back pain? [signal:1e3c9038-d6e2-4537-8e9f-afda289f6db9] [signal:2d87c765-fd5a-4f5e-ae7a-e3f719cd3054] [signal:0f55d7df-4f6b-4b0c-8b19-8e7a0bf5a01e]
- How do comfort perceptions vary by vehicle line, seating position and duration of use? [signal:127b2920-eb56-4241-a49e-3b8dde88110d] [signal:2d87c765-fd5a-4f5e-ae7a-e3f719cd3054]
- What do the 13 competitor signals say about seat comfort relative to other vehicles?

value.title: Seat controls and comfort are difficult to use
value.summary: Customers report confusing seat adjustments and concerns about seat position, support and upholstery. The case spans BMW customers in the USA, Europe and Rest of World across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Seat adjustment and aspects of seat comfort or finish are reported as problematic.
51 customers across the USA, Europe and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem

The whole case contains 51 customers: 39 complaints, 2 defects, 7 wishes and 5 likes. Customers describe seat adjustments as confusing or overly involved, alongside concerns about seating position, support and upholstery. [signal:44c17433-9e1d-4164-98ff-8a4592993581] [signal:49996993-990a-4de3-8df2-5de8a9641bd4] [signal:9747023f-2d53-4e07-9cd1-da0cf73dc684] [signal:8372c0b7-2b4f-47f8-9df3-0c2fc4bca839]

## What customers say

Some customers find seat adjustment unintuitive, including functions split between touchscreen and side controls, or adjustments that take several actions. [signal:44c17433-9e1d-4164-98ff-8a4592993581] [signal:49996993-990a-4de3-8df2-5de8a9641bd4]

Other concerns include difficulty finding a comfortable driver-seat position, insufficient front-seat support, and a seat that does not raise high enough for one customer. [signal:1a77c29d-aa9f-4b76-bc7b-b8877429b85d] [signal:9747023f-2d53-4e07-9cd1-da0cf73dc684] [signal:29ea27da-3d0c-4cd0-b06c-397e7e61ef49]

Seat-related finish and entry concerns include creasing, a rear-seat scratch, and upholstery that catches on clothing when sitting down. [signal:680e986b-c239-46eb-b06b-81419e0eb4d1] [signal:336dd1ba-2c12-4539-8ae5-aa9a7f576ec5] [signal:8372c0b7-2b4f-47f8-9df3-0c2fc4bca839]

## Differences between markets

The case includes 44 customers in the USA, 6 in Europe and 1 in Rest of World. The cited USA feedback includes adjustment complexity and seat-position concerns; the cited European feedback includes support, upholstery and finish concerns. [signal:44c17433-9e1d-4164-98ff-8a4592993581] [signal:49996993-990a-4de3-8df2-5de8a9641bd4] [signal:1a77c29d-aa9f-4b76-bc7b-b8877429b85d] [signal:9747023f-2d53-4e07-9cd1-da0cf73dc684] [signal:680e986b-c239-46eb-b06b-81419e0eb4d1] [signal:8372c0b7-2b4f-47f8-9df3-0c2fc4bca839]

## Open questions

Which adjustment tasks are most difficult across the F70, G60 and G70? The case spans all three lines, while the cited examples describe different issues, including control complexity and comfort or finish. [signal:44c17433-9e1d-4164-98ff-8a4592993581] [signal:49996993-990a-4de3-8df2-5de8a9641bd4] [signal:9747023f-2d53-4e07-9cd1-da0cf73dc684] [signal:680e986b-c239-46eb-b06b-81419e0eb4d1]

How consistently do customers experience the position, support and upholstery concerns, and how do these relate to the adjustment difficulties? [signal:1a77c29d-aa9f-4b76-bc7b-b8877429b85d] [signal:9747023f-2d53-4e07-9cd1-da0cf73dc684] [signal:8372c0b7-2b4f-47f8-9df3-0c2fc4bca839]

value.title: Ride firmness and handling feel fall short for some drivers
value.summary: Customers describe concerns with ride comfort, maneuverability and road feel, while others value the handling. The case spans F70, G60 and G70 customers across Europe, the USA and the Rest of World.
highlights: Concerns include firm or harsh ride, difficult maneuvering, and handling that can feel floaty or lack feel.
53 customers across Europe, the USA and the Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
No competitor evidence in the signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Customers describe a firm ride that can be uncomfortable, especially at low speeds or over bumps [signal:000dc5a3-69bb-443c-9d22-35eebf537d59] [signal:13261b3a-8ed0-415a-bf75-d6043c30f7ef] [signal:14513169-d121-4d2f-a51f-c04040933d2f] [signal:bb5f5e2e-0759-4fea-8d7c-1a1f8ba1aa8e]. Others report difficulty maneuvering a large, heavy car, a floaty feeling, weaker cornering, or steering that lacks feel [signal:c0f55915-8591-42ab-938e-b0a2120894ed] [signal:99782dc9-bc09-4ec8-a1ff-f83c081c5669] [signal:bc2f73fa-63c7-485b-98ae-012aa409bb17] [signal:235f2cac-ad0c-4681-8a94-2c0962d8a72f]. The whole case contains 7 complaints, 29 wishes and 17 likes, with no defects.

## What customers say
A Europe-based F70 driver says the touchscreen is hard to use with a steady hand while driving [signal:000dc5a3-69bb-443c-9d22-35eebf537d59]. Another customer describes rapid upshifts but slower downshifts and a ride that is too firm for everyday comfort [signal:14513169-d121-4d2f-a51f-c04040933d2f]. A USA-based G70 driver says the car's size and weight make U-turns tricky [signal:c0f55915-8591-42ab-938e-b0a2120894ed]. By contrast, a Rest of World G60 customer calls the ride comfortable and sporty, while noting that steering lacks some feel [signal:235f2cac-ad0c-4681-8a94-2c0962d8a72f].

## Differences between markets
The counts show 10 customers in Europe, 25 in the USA and 18 in the Rest of World. The balance of wishes and likes differs: Europe has 9 wishes and 1 like; the USA has 5 wishes and 14 likes; the Rest of World has 15 wishes and 2 likes. The sampled USA complaints include concerns about floatiness, harshness over bumps, cornering and maneuverability [signal:99782dc9-bc09-4ec8-a1ff-f83c081c5669] [signal:bb5f5e2e-0759-4fea-8d7c-1a1f8ba1aa8e] [signal:bc2f73fa-63c7-485b-98ae-012aa409bb17] [signal:c0f55915-8591-42ab-938e-b0a2120894ed].

## Open questions
The signals do not establish which ride or handling characteristics matter most to customers, or how experiences vary across vehicle lines. No competitor signals are counted.

value.title: Driving dynamics feel less engaging to some BMW drivers
value.summary: Driving performance is widely valued by BMW customers, with 84 likes among 90 customers, but 7 complaints describe reduced agility, playfulness or driving enjoyment. The case covers customers in Europe, the USA and Rest of World, across the F70, G60 and G70 vehicle lines.
highlights: Some customers find the driving experience less agile, playful or engaging.
Customers: Europe 23, Rest of World 19, USA 42; F70 39, G60 32, G70 19.
18 competitor signals are counted in the case.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Driving performance is broadly valued: 84 likes are recorded among 90 BMW customers. The case also records 7 complaints, including concerns about reduced agility and driving enjoyment.

## What customers say
Some G60 drivers describe less agility, understeer or a comfort-focused feel [signal:080589a4-654b-476c-a557-cd412a07e0ed] [signal:31cce63b-a995-4da3-a1dd-f7d0c2f4822f]. Others say a newer car has lost some of the playful character they valued [signal:1944ec23-ec18-401f-91d3-530c6c2db751]. A G60 owner also says the car feels less engaging than a lighter competitor [signal:65c0d085-0790-4e56-8d32-8547e7441f74].

## Differences between markets
The counts cover Europe, Rest of World, the USA and an unknown market. They record 1 complaint in Europe, 2 in Rest of World, 3 in the USA and 1 in the unknown market. The sampled comments include concerns about agility and driving enjoyment in Europe and the USA [signal:080589a4-654b-476c-a557-cd412a07e0ed] [signal:252b1d6e-f743-4cdf-963b-ac797383438e]. A Rest of World comment describes a loss of playfulness [signal:1944ec23-ec18-401f-91d3-530c6c2db751].

## Open questions
Which aspects of driving engagement matter most to customers who value the current performance, and which are most often behind complaints? How do these priorities differ across the F70, G60 and G70?

value.title: Steering feels too light and provides too little feedback
value.summary: Customers mainly complain that the steering feels too light, vague or short on road feedback. The case spans USA, Rest of World and Europe, and the F70, G60 and G70; one customer also likes the steering.
highlights: Steering complaints focus on light effort, vague feel and limited feedback.
Affected customers are in the USA, Rest of World and Europe, across F70, G60 and G70.
Competitor evidence is present in 15 signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case contains 15 complaints among 16 BMW customers. Customers describe steering that feels too light, vague or lacking in feedback; one customer likes it.

## What customers say
Customers say the steering feels dead or numb, with little information about what the front wheels are doing [signal:0817c86c-edf4-48e3-9e93-4cc38dc04fdc] [signal:0b989b83-b687-4fe9-81ff-9cd5f2fb552f]. Others describe it as too light for faster roads [signal:521c5f7c-58ce-4e15-b4b2-3d141ffcfa73], or say it is so light and vague that they need to make constant corrections [signal:61527331-1b2e-48c0-a080-034a4e23b53e]. One customer says the steering effort is too light [signal:83ce4209-cebf-46b6-b56e-149a585e7981]; another describes it as softer and more cushioned than in their previous 540i, with a slight improvement in Sport Mode [signal:84ba5b54-9ddd-48f4-aaa8-e3de302040b7].

## Differences between markets
Complaints are reported in the USA and Rest of World, while Europe has both complaints and a like. The case covers F70, G60 and G70. A European F70 customer says the steering is too light for faster roads [signal:521c5f7c-58ce-4e15-b4b2-3d141ffcfa73]; European G60 customers describe it as numb [signal:0b989b83-b687-4fe9-81ff-9cd5f2fb552f] and light and vague [signal:61527331-1b2e-48c0-a080-034a4e23b53e]. A USA G60 customer also reports weak steering feedback [signal:53a93894-2f1c-4a6f-8885-ca74e6ac4502].

## Open questions
How do customers’ expectations for steering weight and feedback vary across vehicle lines and markets? What accounts for the reported improvement in Sport Mode [signal:84ba5b54-9ddd-48f4-aaa8-e3de302040b7]?

value.title: Steering feel varies from heavy at low speeds to soft
value.summary: Some customers describe steering as heavy at low speeds or softer than they prefer, while another values how easy the vehicle is to steer. The case covers customers in the USA and Rest of World across the F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Steering feel draws two wishes and one like, with no complaints or defects.
Three customers across the USA and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70.
Nine competitor signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Two customers wish for a different steering feel: one finds it somewhat heavy at low speeds, and another describes it as soft. A customer in Rest of World likes how easy the vehicle is to steer. The counts show three customers, two wishes, one like, and no complaints or defects.

## What customers say
A USA customer says the steering feels somewhat heavier at low speeds [signal:16764164-1130-4ac5-9ff2-d1b0b090b0dc]. Another USA customer describes both the steering wheel and overall steering as somewhat soft, but says it is not particularly bothersome and may reflect being new to the vehicle [signal:c342d977-b2ac-4bd0-9699-019c7b78ba0b]. A Rest of World customer says the vehicle is easy to steer and drive [signal:f948efe6-5143-4c1d-8be4-3bb254f76587].

## Differences between markets
The counts show two USA customers with wishes and one Rest of World customer with a like. The USA comments describe steering weight or softness [signal:16764164-1130-4ac5-9ff2-d1b0b090b0dc] [signal:c342d977-b2ac-4bd0-9699-019c7b78ba0b], while the Rest of World comment values ease of steering [signal:f948efe6-5143-4c1d-8be4-3bb254f76587]. The case spans the F70, G60 and G70.

## Open questions
How do customers’ expectations for steering weight and softness vary by driving situation? The USA comments describe different aspects of steering feel [signal:16764164-1130-4ac5-9ff2-d1b0b090b0dc] [signal:c342d977-b2ac-4bd0-9699-019c7b78ba0b], while the Rest of World comment values ease of steering [signal:f948efe6-5143-4c1d-8be4-3bb254f76587].

value.title: Handling feedback is mixed, with cornering and ride concerns
value.summary: Among 40 BMW customers, handling and performance are often valued, but some report concerns with cornering, body roll, traction and ride feel. Complaints are concentrated in the USA and on the G60 and G70.
highlights: Handling is often praised, but complaints include body roll, cornering, traction and ride feel.
40 customers across Europe, Rest of World and USA; vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70.
Six competitor signals; one comparison praises handling against the Tesla Model S.
value.body_md:
## Problem
Handling and performance feedback is mixed: 30 customers like the feature, while 10 complain. Some describe smooth, enjoyable handling [signal:1210c3a9-cb35-4e06-a012-12cce0ca14be] [signal:2e19eefa-cdbc-4eaa-b7d8-2d0876fb230], while others report excessive body roll in corners [signal:7f9fda6d-8138-4313-924c-6d5f0113571e] or less smooth cornering and leaning [signal:0c017c6b-b622-42d8-8f30-05807be0761b]. One USA customer also reports poor traction on winter roads [signal:3497662d-834d-457c-b41b-272e06875310].

## What customers say
Customers who like the handling describe it as smooth and enjoyable [signal:1210c3a9-cb35-4e06-a012-12cce0ca14be], easy to manage [signal:2e19eefa-cdbc-4eaa-b7d8-2d0876fb230], and close to the fun-to-drive character they value [signal:2c2421ba-67d6-4cac-84ce-2bd0876fb230]. A Rest of World customer says the handling compares well with a Tesla Model S [signal:309361fe-abf8-47b0-aeb4-b85a26b9dd00].

Complaints include body roll and reduced enjoyment on turns [signal:0963e718-b4ae-4378-847e-86951576cb03] [signal:7f9fda6d-8138-4313-924c-6d5f0113571e], a ride that feels different from a previous BMW [signal:0c017c6b-b622-42d8-8f30-05807be0761b] [signal:18da8270-237c-448f-a1a6-a326ceff0715], and poor winter traction [signal:3497662d-834d-457c-b41b-272e06875310]. One customer says Sport mode improves cornering performance [signal:0c017c6b-b622-42d8-8f30-05807be0761b].

## Differences between markets
The counts show 9 likes and 1 complaint in Europe, 6 likes and no complaints in Rest of World, and 15 likes and 9 complaints in the USA. The sample includes a European complaint about handling [signal:86a9aaad-ad69-4a8e-9896-25d2839736ce] and USA complaints about body roll [signal:7f9fda6d-8138-4313-924c-6d5f0113571e] and winter traction [signal:3497662d-834d-457c-b41b-272e06875310].

Across vehicle lines, the counts show 11 likes and no complaints for F70, 13 likes and 6 complaints for G60, and 6 likes and 4 complaints for G70. A G60 customer praises smooth road feel [signal:309361fe-abf8-47b0-aeb4-b85a26b9dd00], while G60 and G70 customers also report cornering or body-roll concerns [signal:0c017c6b-b622-42d8-8f30-05807be0761b] [signal:7f9fda6d-8138-4313-924c-6d5f0113571e].

## Open questions
- What factors explain the difference between positive handling feedback and complaints about cornering, body roll and ride feel?
- What contributes to the reported winter traction concern?

value.title: Engine sound ranges from weak and strained to loud and artificial
value.summary: BMW customers describe engine acoustics they find weak, strained, noisy or artificial, while others like the sound. The case spans F70, G60 and G70 vehicles across Europe, Rest of World and the USA.
highlights: Engine sound is variously criticized as weak, strained, noisy or artificial.
30 BMW customers across Europe, Rest of World and the USA; F70, G60 and G70.
Competitor evidence is present: 9 signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem

Engine acoustics are not consistently valued: customers describe sounds that detract from refinement or lack character, while the case also includes likes. Across the case, 30 BMW customers contributed 3 complaints, 2 defect reports, 21 wishes and 7 likes.

## What customers say

Some F70 comments describe augmented or synthesized engine sound as undesirable or not immersive, and another describes a loud, thrashy tone that spoils refinement. [signal:01248812-dbca-4c5b-b7bb-3cc6b665a1d1] [signal:2170797d-7336-46e8-94a9-25ec065d74e5] [signal:8c9ec3b0-bc15-4b06-b016-bf0f16323f80]

Other comments describe a flat or weak growl, a lack of aural character, or an engine that sounds strained under load. [signal:808b9441-cf51-4275-987f-00bf74994b93] [signal:5ba4b538-b07a-4921-aad3-c0e836c36a40] [signal:82be0c82-8983-445c-b505-63cd7fd9d1e4]

A G60 comment reports a loud whining noise after a sharp accelerator input. [signal:8b06e0c2-1334-4b30-a82e-466812650865] A Rest of World G70 comment mentions diesel-like vibration and noise at startup. [signal:1b71ac58-e08b-4dc7-b6a1-6dbe369a0c57]

A USA G70 owner says the exhaust sound with the M Sport package is weak compared with sounds on other vehicles they know. [signal:00bcb6a3-41fb-43ba-9395-65cf06141970]

## Differences between markets

The comments describe different concerns: a loud, thrashy tone and synthesized sound in Europe, strained engine sound in the USA, and diesel-like startup vibration and noise in Rest of World. [signal:2170797d-7336-46e8-94a9-25ec065d74e5] [signal:8c9ec3b0-bc15-4b06-b016-bf0f16323f80] [signal:82be0c82-8983-445c-b505-63cd7fd9d1e4] [signal:1b71ac58-e08b-4dc7-b6a1-6dbe369a0c57]

## Open questions

The signals do not establish how sound preferences vary by driving mode, engine or trim, or whether the reported noises are widespread beyond the vehicles described. The case includes 9 competitor signals, but the available customer statements here do not describe what those signals say about competitors.

value.title: Drivetrain performance feels weak or slow to some customers
value.summary: Most customers value the drivetrain performance, but some report insufficient power, slow throttle response or slower downshifts. Across the case, 909 BMW customers are represented, with 825 likes and 117 complaints.
highlights: Some customers report insufficient power or slow drivetrain responses.
Customers across Europe, Rest of World and the USA; vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70.
9 competitor signals are present.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case includes 909 BMW customers: 825 likes and 117 complaints about drivetrain performance. Some describe the performance as adequate or satisfying, while others report shortcomings. [signal:18c714fa-dc0e-40ea-a832-affd9d29867e] [signal:1e154e35-5c42-4957-ad47-ca00e9ba8417]

## What customers say
Some customers say the engine feels short on power under strain, throttle response is slow, or downshifts feel slow. [signal:0f73dad4-d238-43fb-978d-1bd7b7b655bc] [signal:1341993c-e5de-4986-a925-20aeaf83d714] [signal:0916c1bc-985e-42e1-97ef-7b00d477df73]
One customer says the M135’s performance is lower than the previous M135i’s, and another feels the four-cylinder engine lacks the character expected of a super-hot hatch. [signal:0916c1bc-985e-42e1-97ef-7b00d477df73] [signal:18c0a1aa-81dc-41b1-a249-3600762905c0]
Other customers describe the performance as solid, adequate or not disappointing. [signal:0ee15148-62ee-4848-9de6-1f8250964cb0] [signal:18c714fa-dc0e-40ea-a832-affd9d29867e] [signal:1e154e35-5c42-4957-ad47-ca00e9ba8417]

## Differences between markets
The case covers Europe, Rest of World and the USA. Complaint counts are 53 in Europe, 39 in Rest of World and 25 in the USA; likes are recorded in each market as well. The customer comments cited above include Europe and Rest of World, but do not establish how drivetrain views differ across markets.

## Open questions
How widespread are the concerns about power, throttle response and downshifts across the F70, G60 and G70? The case covers all three lines, but the comments cited here do not establish line-by-line differences.

value.title: My Modes are difficult to understand and access
value.summary: Customers report that My Modes and driving experience settings can be complicated, overwhelming or hard to access. The case includes 66 BMW customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World, with 43 complaints, 14 wishes and 9 likes.
highlights: Customers report complicated settings, difficult access and unexpected display changes.
66 BMW customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70.
Competitor evidence appears in 3 signals.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case includes 75 signals from 66 BMW customers: 43 complaints, 14 wishes and 9 likes. Customers describe the driving modes and broader settings as complicated or overwhelming [signal:0003a45f-4947-4d10-bcbc-609006749ff4] [signal:078bacb0-3a5e-4a25-afaa-6a07d0044d44] [signal:1f8a3c9c-0a51-4245-9397-603f017a96f4] [signal:2c0ca957-d8fd-4f1d-9d76-dc187c399a00]. A customer says there is no physical button or shortcut to change modes [signal:0f2c5833-bf0d-4378-8b7c-e66724cdd1c5]. Another could not locate a mode they believed would save battery power [signal:179d247b-c8ac-4ea4-809d-cd3bb32185ce].

## What customers say
Customers describe settings as difficult to understand or find, and some report unwanted changes to display content when switching modes [signal:078bacb0-3a5e-4a25-afaa-6a07d0044d44] [signal:0f2c5833-bf0d-4378-8b7c-e66724cdd1c5] [signal:13a3056b-ee6a-4ba8-bece-6487e0616914]. One customer says switching from a personal default mode to Sport makes display content disappear [signal:093f9ee9-188f-4cd0-b42b-f6fdf56df486]. Some customers also describe using Sport mode to avoid unwanted stop-start behavior or to address slow pull-away  [signal:1baf6643-9904-4dd4-b6bf-ec95f9f3c0c8].

## Differences between markets
The counts include 10 customers and 10 complaints in Europe, 54 customers with 32 complaints, 13 wishes and 9 likes in the USA, and 2 customers with 1 complaint and 1 wish in Rest of World. In the sample of customer accounts, European drivers describe complexity and mode access concerns [signal:078bacb0-3a5e-4a25-afaa-6a07d0044d44] [signal:0f2c5833-bf0d-4378-8b7c-e66724cdd1c5], while a Rest of World customer also calls the settings complicated [signal:0003a45f-4947-4d10-bcbc-609006749ff4].

## Open questions
The counts include 11 customers, 10 complaints and 1 wish for F70; 30 customers, 17 complaints, 10 wishes and 3 likes for G60; and 25 customers, 16 complaints, 3 wishes and 6 likes for G70. The counts show 3 competitor signals, but provide no detail about what those signals say.

value.title: Space feels cramped in some areas and oversized overall
value.summary: Space is valued by many BMW customers, while others report tight rear seating or find the vehicle too large. The case covers F70, G60 and G70 customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World.
highlights: Many customers like the space, but others report cramped seating or excessive overall size.
139 BMW customers across Europe, the USA and Rest of World; vehicle lines F70, G60 and G70.
37 competitor signals are recorded.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case includes 108 likes, 11 complaints and 22 wishes from 139 BMW customers. Some customers value the space, while others describe tight rear seating or say the overall vehicle is too large. One G60 customer reports that a high floor makes the rear middle seat difficult to use [signal:4e7e1126-57d2-44f6-af73-36c98eec245e]. Some F70 customers describe the rear seats as tight [signal:4027b37a-95e0-4374-a86c-8bacf2637f5b] or say three adults may find the back a squeeze [signal:5ce4a09b-2cd2-46d1-bf46-7f3252413bd7]. G60 and G70 customers also describe the cars as too large or difficult to fit in garages and parking spaces [signal:2bb6cee2-c034-4191-91e8-24b07f06f80e] [signal:348a6af2-35df-4345-a4a0-f9bc80234b00] [signal:154b065d-95b6-4dd3-8ce0-7ca1880a1d3b].

## What customers say
Some feedback values the rear-cabin space: a G60 customer describes a more spacious rear cabin [signal:2cac28bd-b7d7-41b6-987d-0a7bf5e5d6d2]. Other feedback points to limited rear-seat room, including a tight squeeze in the F70 [signal:3bdc472f-6bab-4a5b-ac0f-df504d39858a] and a high floor that affects the G60's rear middle passenger [signal:4e7e1126-57d2-44f6-af73-36c98eec245e]. Some G60 and G70 customers say the vehicle's size makes garage or parking-space use difficult [signal:2bb6cee2-c034-4191-91e8-24b07f06f80e] [signal:348a6af2-35df-4345-a4a0-f9bc80234b00] [signal:154b065d-95b6-4dd3-8ce0-7ca1880a1d3b].

## Differences between markets
The counts include 29 customers in Europe, 90 in the USA and 18 in Rest of World; they record likes and complaints in each market. European feedback includes both a more spacious rear cabin [signal:2cac28bd-b7d7-41b6-987d-0a7bf5e5d6d2] and concerns about rear-seat space and floor layout [signal:4027b37a-95e0-4374-a86c-8bacf2637f5b] [signal:4e7e1126-57d2-44f6-af73-36c98eec245e]. Feedback from the USA and Rest of World also includes concerns about overall vehicle size and parking [signal:2bb6cee2-c034-4191-91e8-24b07f06f80e] [signal:348a6af2-35df-4345-a4a0-f9bc80234b00] [signal:154b065d-95b6-4dd3-8ce0-7ca1880a1d3b].

## Open questions
How do customers weigh spacious rear cabins against the feeling that the vehicle is too large? Which aspects of rear-seat space matter most, including floor height and room for multiple adult passengers? [signal:2cac28bd-b7d7-41b6-987d-0a7bf5e5d6d2] [signal:4e7e1126-57d2-44f6-af73-36c98eec245e] [signal:5ce4a09b-2cd2-46d1-bf46-7f3252413bd7]

value.title: Interior trim feels cheap and shows wear easily
value.summary: BMW customers report low-quality-feeling interior materials and surfaces that scuff or show fingerprints easily. The case covers customers in Europe, the USA, Rest of World and an unknown market, across F70, G60 and G70.
highlights: Customers report cheap-feeling materials, scuffing and fingerprint-prone surfaces.
34 BMW customers: 12 in Europe, 20 in the USA, 1 in Rest of World and 1 unknown; F70, G60 and G70.
Competitor evidence includes a complaint about Porsche interior plastics attracting dust and scratches.
value.body_md:
## Problem

Across the case, 34 BMW customers contributed 30 complaints, 12 defect reports, 1 wish and 4 likes. Customers describe some trim and upholstery as cheap-feeling or less luxurious, and report surfaces that scuff or show fingerprints easily. For example, one F70 owner calls the trim flimsy and the plastics scratchy [signal:019a25e0-af28-4266-8d87-48042cef40c0], while a G60 owner says hard plastic sides scuff easily when touched by a foot [signal:10696c64-8447-47c8-9ec8-b3f391d13f7d].

Some complaints compare the materials unfavourably with earlier BMWs. A G60 owner describes the lower door panels as cheap plastic compared with the soundproofed, leather-trimmed panels in their previous 3 Series [signal:10b1d161-9196-4e41-9603-20531d8e7409]. Another says the interior feels like a step down from the previous model, citing hard plastics and low-quality-looking door cards [signal:64212ddf-00cc-4b81-a70e-bb5d1cb9b85b].

## What customers say

Customers describe some interiors as budget-like or not luxurious enough. F70 owners say the lower trim feels far from luxurious [signal:075685dc-4581-459a-a5b2-d58cbde69a4f] and that the interior looks and feels like a budget car [signal:2b047377-dc64-46ce-8378-01c30a83ab56]. A G60 owner also reports cheap materials in the cabin [signal:2df92ec4-739a-4a41-b2f2-36bcdb5efb36].

Some G60 complaints focus on leather coverage and the feel of the doors, seats and centre console [signal:47d50dac-379a-45b8-b9c3-2a5218f04daa]. Fingerprints are another concern: a G70 owner says they show on interior surfaces, including the centre console controls [signal:3c270323-f355-4c10-812e-9f7d4e95eb0e].

The case also includes positive feedback: 4 likes are counted overall, including 4 in the USA; the sampled comments here do not describe what customers liked. A competitor-related complaint says Porsche’s polished black plastics attract dust and scratches [signal:236f3bb6-0eb4-4753-b3f4-aee3e217ff2d].

## Differences between markets

Europe accounts for 12 customers and 13 complaints, including 7 defect reports. The USA accounts for 20 customers, 15 complaints, 4 defect reports, 1 wish and 4 likes. Rest of World has 1 customer and 1 complaint, and the unknown-market category has 1 customer and 1 complaint.

The case spans F70, G60 and G70. F70 has 9 customers and 10 complaints; G60 has 16 customers and 14 complaints; G70 has 9 customers and 6 complaints. The counts show different complaint and like totals across markets and vehicle lines, rather than a single uniform response.

## Open questions

- Which materials or trim locations account for the defect reports and complaints across the full case?
- What do customers who liked the feature value, given the 4 likes counted overall?
- How do the 18 competitor signals compare with BMW customers’ specific concerns about trim quality?

value.title: ConnectedDrive and infotainment reliability problems
value.summary: BMW customers report unreliable connected and infotainment technology, including software bugs, freezes and system faults. The case spans Europe, the USA and the Rest of World across F70, G60 and G70 vehicles.
highlights: Software bugs, freezes and system faults undermine technology reliability.
Customers in Europe, the USA and Rest of World; F70, G60 and G70 lines.
Three competitor signals are counted; their details are not available here.
value.body_md:
## Problem
The case contains 50 signals from 43 BMW customers, including 47 complaints and 45 defects. Customers describe technology that does not work reliably: reports include infotainment that has not worked correctly, unresolved software bugs, and an iDrive system freezing [signal:300c4784-a970-4b78-91bb-dbbcff481c35] [signal:4d35f85e-884d-4f40-a1f5-af654cf2e63c] [signal:5817ed75-f62f-46b0-b681-a0bc9a9958da].

## What customers say
Some reports describe justified concerns about faults or lost functionality. One customer says alerts seem unjustified and onboard data is temporarily lost [signal:302cabf5-90ec-4bdb-a73b-dcb835b5feb2]. Another reports that a Wi-Fi option does not work and was told there was a BMW-side software fault [signal:398f21ef-fd43-4137-8769-a992d4d9f331]. A customer also says features disappeared after software or firmware changes [signal:82b6934f-44bd-472e-bd7b-a5775468c4e7].

## Differences between markets
The case includes 30 complaints from 27 customers in Europe, 11 complaints from 11 customers in the USA, and six complaints from five customers in the Rest of World. It covers F70 (31 customers), G60 (six) and G70 (six). The supplied market counts show different volumes, but do not establish that the underlying problems differ by market.

## Open questions
Which software, connected services or infotainment functions account for the reported faults? How do fault types and persistence differ across markets and vehicle lines? What do the three counted competitor signals say about reliability?
